1: Pehovelo Kalunga okwa shita eulu nedu.
Ndele edu ola li la tokekwa nola li hamungaho, nomulaulu owa li kombada youle womeva, nOmhepo yaKalunga ya tengelela kombada yomeva.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Nape uye ouyelele!” Nouyelele owe uya.
Ndele Kalunga okwa tala ouyelele oo omuwa. Ndele Kalunga okwa tongola ouyelele momulaulu,
ndele Kalunga okwa luka ouyelele “omutenya”, nomulaulu okwe u luka “oufiku”. Ndele opa ningwa onguloshi nongula, efiku lotete.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Napa kale evalelwa pokati komeva, lo li ninge etongoko pokati komeva nomeva.”
Ndele Kalunga okwa ninga evalelwa nokwa tongola omeva aa a kala koshi yevalelwa naa a kala kombada yevalelwa. Ndele osho sha ningwa.
Ndele Kalunga okwa luka evalelwa “eulu”. Ndele opa ningwa onguloshi nongula, efiku etivali.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Omeva okoshi yeulu naa ongale monhele imwe, opo oukukutu u monike.” Ndele osho sha ningwa.
Ndele Kalunga okwa luka oukukutu “edu”, ndele okwoongala kwomeva okwe ku luka “efuta”. Opo nee Kalunga e shi tala, sha wapala.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Edu nali twimike omwiidi, oimeno tai eta eembuto nomiti edi tadi imi oiimati pamaludi ado, nombuto yado kombada yedu.” Ndele osho sha ningwa.
Edu ola twimika omwiidi, noimeno ya eta eembuto pamaludi ayo nomiti da ima oiimati mu na ombuto yado pamaludi ado. Opo Kalunga okwe shi tala, sha wapala.
Ndele pa ningwa onguloshi nongula, efiku etitatu.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Mevalelwa leulu namu uye omaminikilo okutongola omutenya noufiku; ndele naa ninge omadidiliko omafimbo, omafiku nomido.
Oo naa kale ouyelele mevalelwa leulu okuminikila edu.” Ndele osho sha ningwa.
Kalunga okwa ninga omaminikilo avali manene: etango okupangela omutenya ohani okupangela oufiku, neenyofi yo.
Ndele Kalunga okwe a tula mevalelwa leulu a minikile edu,
nokupangela omutenya noufiku nokutongola ouyelele momulaulu. Opo Kalunga e shi tala, sha wapala.
Ndele opa ningwa onguloshi nongula, efiku etine.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Momeva namu yade oinamwenyo yomomeva, needila nadi tuke kombada yedu mevalelwa leulu.”

Ndele Kalunga okwa shita oinamwenyo inene yomefuta noinamwenyo aishe ei tai linyenganyenga nokunyangadala momeva pamaludi ayo. Nokwa shita eedila adishe di nomavava pamaludi ado. Opo nee Kalunga okwe shi tala, sha wapala.
Ndele Kalunga okwe i nangeka noupuna ndele ta ti: “Dalafaneni nye mu hapupale ndele yadifeni efuta, needila dokombada yedu nadi hapupale.”
Ndele opa ningwa onguloshi nongula, efiku etitano.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Edu nali ete oinamwenyo pamaludi layo: oimuna noyaalangati noifitukuti pamaludi ayo.” Ndele osho sha ningwa.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ninga oifitukuti aishe yedu pamaludi ayo, noimuna pamaludi ayo, noinamwenyo aishe ei tai linyenge kombada yedu pamaludi ayo. Opo nee Kalunga okwe shi tala, sha wapala.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Tu meni ovanhu oshifefa shetu, ve tu fe, ndele nava pangele oinamwenyo yomefuta, needila dokeulu, noimuna, nedu alishe, noinamwenyo aishe tai linyenge kombada yedu.”
Ndele Kalunga okwa shita omunhu oshifefa shaye; oshifefa shaye Ye e mu shita: omulumenhu nomukainhu Ye e va shita.

Ndele Kalunga okwe va nangeka noupuna, nokwe va lombwela: “Dalafaneni nokuhapupala ndele yadifeni edu, lo nali kale mepangelo leni, ndele pangeleni oinamwenyo yomefuta needila dokeulu noinamwenyo aishe tai linyenge kombada yedu.”
Kalunga okwa tonga vali ta ti: “Paife ohandi mu pe oimeno aishe tai eta eembuto ei i li kombada yedu alishe, nomiti adishe di noiimati i na eembuto. Oyo tai ka kala eendja deni.

Ndelenee koinamwenyo aishe yedu nokeedila adishe dokeulu nokoinamwenyo aishe tai linyenge kombada yedu, ei i na omufudo womwenyo, ohandi yandje oimeno aishe italala, i ninge eendja.” Ndele osho sha ningwa.
Opo nee Kalunga okwa tala aishe ei a ninga, ndele yo oya li ya wapala unene. Ndele opa ningwa onguloshi nongula, efiku etihamano.
2: Osho ngaha eulu nedu nomangafifi alo a xulifwa a pwa.
Ndele Kalunga okwa xulifa mefiku etiheyali oshilonga shaye eshi a longa, ndele okwa tulumukwa mefiku etiheyali koilonga yaye aishe Ye e i longa.
Ndele Kalunga okwa nangeka noupuna efiku etiheyali nokwe li yapula, shaashi Ye omo a tulumukwa koilonga yaye aishe e i shita noku i ninga.

Eshi omahepu taa hepaulula eulu nedu eshi la shitwa.
Mefiku olo Omwene Kalunga a ninga eulu nedu,

inapa kala nande oshixwa moixwa kombada yedu noshimeno shomoixwa nande oshimwe sha eta ohengo. Osheshi Omwene Kalunga ina lokifa natango odula kombada yedu, ndele inapa kala nande omunhu wokulonga edu;
ndelenee omuku wa dja medu ndele wa tutika ongonga aishe yedu.
Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa ma omunhu nondwi yedu ndele te mu fudile meyulu laye omufudo womwenyo. Osho ngaha omulumenhu a ninga omwenyo u na omwenyo.
Omwene Kalunga okwa twika oshikunino muEden, moushilo, omo Ye a yandja onhele, komunhu ou a ma.
Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa menifa medu omiti di lili noku lili da wapala okutala nodinyenye okuliwa, ndele mokati koshikunino Ye okwa menifa mo omuti womwenyo, nomuti wokushiiva ouwa nowii.
Ndele muEden mwa dja omulonga wokututika oshikunino ndele oo wa tukuka ndele tau ningi omilonga nhee.
Edina laau wotete oPishon, ou wa dingilila oshilongo ashishe shaHavila, omo mu noshingoldo.
Ndele oshingoldo shomoshilongo osho oshiwa. Omo omu na yo eka labedellion noumanya vaoniks.
Edina lomulonga omutivali, oGihon, ou wa dingilila oshilongo ashishe shaKus.
Nedina lomulonga omutitatu oTigris, ou wa enda koushilo waAsiria. Omulonga omutine oEufrat.
Opo nee Omwene Kalunga okwa kufa omunhu, ndele te mu nangeke moshikunino shaEden, oku shi longa noku shi kelela.
Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa lombwela omunhu ndele ta ti: “Lya komiti adishe domoshikunino ngaashi wa hala,
ndelenee omuti wokushiiva ouwa nowii, ino u lya. Osheshi efiku tuu olo to u li, ou na okufya shili.”
Omwene Kalunga okwa tile: “Keshiwa omunhu a kale aeke. Ame ohandi ke mu ningila ekwafo tali mu wapalele.”

Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa ma nedu oinamwenyo aishe yomoixwa needila adishe dokeulu, ndele Ye okwe i eta komunhu a tale nhumbi te i luku. Ndele naanaa ngaashi omunhu a luka oinamwenyo aishe, osho omadina ayo e na okukala.
Osho hano omunhu okwa luka oimuna aishe needila dokeulu noifitukuti aishe yomoixwa, ndelenee omunhu ina monenwa ekwafo, tali mu wapalele.
Opo Omwene Kalunga okwa kofifa omunhu eemhofi didjuu, ndele fimbo a kofa, Ye okwa kufa mo olupati limwe lomeemhati daye nonhele yalo okwe i fitika nonhumba.
Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa tunga olupati e li kufa momunhu, omukainhu, ndele te mu eta komunhu.

Opo nee omunhu ta ti:
“Eshi ekipa lomomakipa ange
nonhumba yomonhumba yange.
Ye oku na okulukwa omukainhu a dja momulumenhu,
osheshi ye okwa kufwa momulumenhu.”
Onghee hano omulumenhu oku na okufiya po xe naina nokukanyatela komukainhu waye. Ndele vo otava kala onhumba imwe aike.
Ndele vo aveshe vavali ova li hamunghele, omulumenhu nomukainhu waye, ndele vo inava fya ohoni nande.
3: Ndele eyoka la li la lungama li dule oifitukuti aishe yomoixwa ei Omwene Kalunga a ninga. Ndele lo ola pula omwalikadi: “Kalunga okwa ti shili: ‘Inamu lya komiti adishe domoshikunino?’ ”
Ndele omwalikadi okwa nyamukula eyoka: “Ohatu li oiimati yomiti domoshikunino,
ndelenee oiimati yomuti wopokati koshikunino Kalunga okwa ti: ‘Inamu i lya, nye inamu i kuma, muha fye.’ ”
Opo nee eyoka ola tya komwalikadi: “Nye itamu fi shili.
Kalunga oku shi shii nokutya, ngeenge mwe i li, omesho eni otaa pashuka, ndele tamu shiiva ouwa nowii, ngaashi Kalunga.”

Opo nee omwalikadi okwa tala, omuti ou omuwa nokulya notau hafifa omesho, heeno, omuti kau yehama shili okupa omunhu eendunge. Ndele ye okwa kufa oiimati yao ndele ta li ndele ta pe yo omulumenhu waye, ndele ye okwa lya.
Opo nee omesho avo aveshe vavali a pashuka, ndele vo ove liwete ve li hamunghele. Ndele vo ova hondjela kumwe omafo omukwiyu, ndele tave liningile omateta.
Ndele vo ova uda ondaka yOmwene Kalunga, fimbo Ye ta endaenda moshikunino onguloshi, eshi kwa talala. Ndele omulumenhu nomwalikadi waye ova ka hondama Omwene Kalunga momiti domoshikunino.
Opo nee Omwene Kalunga okwa ifana omulumenhu ndele ta ti kuye: “Ou li peni?”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Ame onda uda ondaka yoye moshikunino, ndele onda tila, osheshi ondi li hamunghele. Onghee ame onda hondama.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Olyelye e ku lombwela kutya ou li hamunghele? Ove owa lya komuti ou, nde ku kelela okulya?”
Ndele omulumenhu okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Omwalikadi ou wa pa nge a kale pwaame, oye a pa nge komuti, ndele ame onda lya.”
Opo nee Omwene Kalunga ta ti komwalikadi: “Ove owa ninga ngahelipi?” Ndele omwalikadi ta nyamukula: “Eyoka la kengelela nge, ndele ame nda lya.”

Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa lombwela eyoka ta ti:
“Ove eshi we shi ninga,
oto fingwa mokati koinamwenyo aishe.
Ove ou na okweendifa edimo loye,
ndele ou na okulya edu omafiku oye aeshe.

Ndele Ame ohandi ka tula outondwe
pokati koye nomwalikadi
nokoludalo loye nokoludalo laye.
Ye ota ka nyanyaula omutwe woye
ndele ove to ke mu twa moshififinwa.”

Ye okwa lombwela omwalikadi ta ti:
“Ame ohandi ke ku hapupalifila
oudjuu moufimba woye.
Ove to ka dala ounona voye nokuyehama.
Ndele oto kala nokuhala omulumenhu woye,
ndele ye ote ke ku pangela.”

Ndele Ye okwa lombwela omulumenhu ta ti:
“Ove eshi wa pwilikina ondaka yomwalikadi woye,
ndele wa lya komuti nde ku lombwela uha lye ko,
edu otali fingwa molwoye,
ndele oto ke lipalula noudjuu omafiku oye aeshe.

Lo oli na oku ku menifila yo omakiya neeshosholo.
Ndele ove oto ka lya oimeno yomoixwa.

Omungome woye
oto u li noshinhwi moshipala shoye,
fiyo oto shuna medu,
osheshi omo wa kufwa.
Osheshi oove edu,
ndele oto ka ninga edu.”
Ndele omulumenhu okwa luka omwalikadi waye Eva, osheshi ye okwa ninga ina yaaveshe ava ve na omwenyo.
Ndele Omwene Kalunga okwa ningila omulumenhu nomwalikadi waye oikutu yoipa ndele te i va dike.

Opo nee Omwene Kalunga okwa ti: “Paamha omunhu okwa ninga ngaashi umwe womufye, eshi a shiiva ouwa nowii. Opo aha nane eke laye a kufe ko vali komuti womwenyo nokulya ndele ta kala e na omwenyo fiyo alushe, ohandi mu taataa mo.”
Opo nee Omwene Kalunga okwe mu taataa mo moshikunino shomuEden a ka longe edu omu a kufilwe.
Osho hano Ye a taataa omunhu ndele ta tula ovakerubi koushilo woshikunino shaEden, ve na omaongamukonda a xwama omundilo taa taima vo va kelele omhito yokuya komuti womwenyo.
4: Ndele Adam okwa nangala nomwalikadi waye Eva, ndele ye ta ningi oufimba ndele ta dala Kain, ndele ta ti: “Ame onde limonena omulumenhu kekwafo lOmwene.”
Komesho okwa dala yo omumwaina Abel. Ndele Abel okwa ninga omufita weedi, ndele Kain omunamapya.
Ndele eshi pa pita efimbo, Kain okwa yambela Omwene oiimati yomepya.
Ndele Abel yo okwa eta eshi sha dalwa tete shomoimuna yaye nokutya, omaadi ayo. Ndele Omwene okwa tala nokuhokwa Abel noiyandjiwa yaye,
ndele Ye ina tala Kain noiyandjiwa yaye. Opo nee Kain okwa handuka unene, ndele ta fidimike oshipala shaye.
Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Kain: “Omolwashike wa handuka, nomolwashike wa fidimika oshipala shoye?
Hasho ngaha: ngeenge to longo ouwa, oto shiiva okuyelula omutwe woye; ndelenee ngeenge ito longo ouwa, oulunde otau ku nangele poshivelo, ndele tau ku hokwa. Ndele ove ou na oku u pangela.”
Ndele Kain okwa popya nondenge yaye Abel: “Natu ye moixwa,” ndele opa ningwa eshi va li moixwa, Kain okwa nhukila Abel ndele te mu dipaa.
Opo nee Omwene okwa tya kuKain: “Ondenge yoye Abel oi li peni?” Ndele okwa nyamukula: “Ame nghi shi shii. Aame mbela omufita wondenge yange?”
Ndele Ye ta ti: “Owa ninga shike? Ondaka yohonde yondenge yoye otai kuwile nge onghuwo medu.
Onghee hano ove oto ka kala wa fingwa, ove to ka kala kokule nedu eli la makula okanya kalo okupona ohonde yondenge yoye, keke loye.
Ove ngeenge oto longo edu, lo itali ku dalele sha vali. Ove oto ka ninga epongo nomutewatewi kombada yedu.”
Opo nee Kain ta ti kOmwene: “Etimba lange olinene unene nokuhumbata.
Tala, ove oto taataa nge paife mepya ndele ame ndi na okuhondama oshipala shoye. Ame ohandi ningi epongo nomutewatewi kombada yedu, nakeshe tuu ou ta mono nge, ota ka dipaa nge.”
Ndelenee Omwene okwe mu lombwela: “Onghee hano ngeenge umwe ta dipaa Kain, oku na okuhandukilwa luheyali.” Ndele Omwene okwa tula Kain edidiliko, opo keshe ou te mu mono, ehe mu dipae.
Opo nee Kain okwa dja ko koshipala shOmwene ndele ta ka tula medu laNod koushilo waEden.
Ndele Kain okwa nangala nomwalikadi waye ndele ye okwa ninga oufimba ndele a dala Henok. Komesho ye okwa tunga oshilando ndele e shi lukila edina lomona waye Henok.
Ndele Henok okwa dalelwa Irad. Ndele Irad okwa li xe yaMehujael. Ndele Mehujael okwa li xe yaMetusael. Ndele Metusael okwa li xe yaLamek.
Ndele Lamek okwa hombola ovalikadi vavali. Edina laau wotete oAda, ndele edina lomutivali oSilla.
Ndele Ada okwa dala Jabal. Ye okwa li xe yovanamatwali noyovanahambo.
Edina lamumwaina ola li Jubal. Ye okwa li xe yaaveshe ava hava shiki ouxumbafeta nomapoli.
Ndele Silla okwa dala yo Tubal-Kain, omuhambwidi ha hambula oilongifo i lili noi lili yoshikushu noyoivela. Nomumwaina omukainhu waTubal-Kain okwa li Naama.

Ndele Lamek okwa lombwela ovalikadi vaye:
“Ada naSilla, udeni ondaka yange!
Ovalikadi vaLamek, pwilikineni ondjovo yange.
Onda dipaa omunhu, eshi a denga nge oshipute,
nomunyasha omolwombole yange.

Osheshi Kain ota ka handukilwa luheyali,
ndelenee Lamek olwomilongo heyali naheyali.”
Ndele Adam okwa nangala vali nomwalikadi waye, ndele okwa dala omona okamati ndele e mu luka Set. Osheshi ye okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa pa nge omona umwe ponhele yaAbel, ou a dipawa kuKain.”
Ndele Set okwa dalelwa yo omona omumati, ou a luka Enos. Mefimbo tuu olo vo ova hovela okwiifana edina laKalunga.
5:
Efina lepata laAdam oleli:
Mefiku tuu olo Kalunga a shita omunhu, Ye okwe mu ninga oshifefa shaye.
Ye okwe va shitile omulumenhu nomukainhu ndele okwe va nangeka noupuna, ndele te va luku “omunhu” mefiku tuu olo vo va shitwa.
Omido daAdam eshi da li efele limwe nomilongo nhatu, ye okwa dala omona okamati oshifefa shaye, ndele okwe mu luka Set.
Ndele efimbo laAdam, eshi a dala Set, ola li omido omafele ahetatu. Ndele ye okwa li e na ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano efimbo olo alishe Adam a kala nomwenyo, ola li omido omafele omugoi nomilongo nhatu, eshi ye a fya.
Omido daSet eshi da li efele limwe nanhano, ye okwa dala Enos.
Ndele Set eshi a dala Enos, okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele ahetatu nomido heyali. Ndele ye okwa li e na ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daSet oda li omafele omugoi nomulongo nambali, eshi ye a fya.
Ndele omido daEnos eshi da li omilongo omugoi, ye okwa dala Kenan.
Ndele Enos eshi a dala Kenan, okwa kala natango nomwenyo omido omafele ahetatu nomulongo nanhano. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daEnos oda li omafele omugoi nomido nhano, eshi ye a fya.
Omido daKenan eshi da li omilongo heyali, ye okwa dala Mahalalel.
Ndele Kenan eshi a dala Mahalalel okwa kala natango nomwenyo omido omafele ahetatu nomilongo nhee. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daKenan da li omafele omugoi nomido omulongo, eshi ye a fya.
Omido daMahalalel eshi da li omilongo hamano nanhano, okwa dala Jared.
Ndele Mahalalel eshi a dala Jared, okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele ahetatu nomilongo nhatu. Ndele ye okwa li e na ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daMahalalel da li omafele ahetatu nomilongo omugoi nanhano, eshi ye a fya.
Ndele omido daJared eshi da li efele limwe nomilongo hamano nambali okwa dala Henok.
Ndele Jared eshi a dala Henok okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele ahetatu. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daJared da li omafele omugoi nomilongo hamano nambali, eshi ye a fya.
Ndele omido daHenok eshi da li omilongo hamano nanhano, okwa dala Metusala.
Ndele Henok eshi a dala Metusala okwa li ha ende pamwe naKalunga omido omafele atatu. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daHenok da li omafele atatu nomilongo hamano nanhano.
Ndele Henok okwa enda pamwe naKalunga. Ndele ye ina monika vali, osheshi Kalunga okwe mu kufa po.
Ndele omido daMetusala eshi da li efele limwe nomilongo hetatu naheyali okwa dala Lamek.
Ndele Metusala eshi a dala Lamek, okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele aheyali nomilongo hamano nomugoi, ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daMetusala da li omafele omugoi nomilongo hamano nomugoi, eshi a fya.
Omido daLamek eshi da li efele limwe nomilongo hetatu nambali, ye okwa dala omona okamati,
ndele okwe mu luka Noa, osheshi ye okwa tile: “Oye tuu ou te ke tu hekeleka moilonga yetu nomoudjuu woshilonga shomake etu mokulonga kwetu edu eli la fingwa kOmwene.”
Ndele Lamek eshi a dala Noa, okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele atano nomilongo omugoi nanhano, ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Osho hano omido adishe daLamek da li omafele aheyali nomilongo heyali naheyali, eshi ye a fya.
Ndele eshi omido daNoa da li omafele atano okwa dala Sem, Ham naJafet.
6: Ovanhu eshi va hovela okuhapupala kombada yedu, ndele tava dala ovana oukadona,
ovana ovamati vaKalunga va mona ovana oukadona vovanhu vawa, ndele vo ove likufila ovakainhu aveshe ava va hala.
Opo nee Omwene ta ti: “Omhepo yange itai ka pangela meni lomunhu fiyo alushe, osheshi ye ombelela. Ndelenee efimbo laye nali ninge omido efele limwe nomilongo mbali.”

Mefimbo linya okwa li ovatongolume kombada yedu nokomesho yo, eshi ovana ovamati vaKalunga ve litula kumwe novana oukadona vovanhu ndele vo tave va dalele ovana. Vo ovanaenghono vomounyuni wonale, ovalumenhu va tumbala.
Omwene eshi a mona owii wovanhu kombada yedu wa li uhapu, nomauko omadiladilo omitima davo okwa li mai efimbo alishe,
onghee Omwene okwe lialuluka eshi a ninga omunhu kombada yedu, ndele Ye ta yehama momutima waye.
Ndele Omwene okwa tya: “Ovanhu ava nda shita onda hala oku va komba po kombada yedu, heeno, ovanhu noimuna yo, noialangati needila dokeulu. Osheshi otashi yehameke nge, eshi nde va ninga.”
Ndelenee Noa okwa mona onghenda momesho Omwene.
Omahepaululo epata laNoa. Noa okwa li omulumenhu omuyuki nokwa li ehe na etimba mokati kovanhu vomounyuni waye. Noa okwa enda pamwe naKalunga.
Ndele Noa okwa li e na ovana ovamati vatatu: Sem, Ham naJafet.
Ndele edu ola li la nyonauka koshipala shaKalunga nola yada oukolokoshi.
Opo nee Kalunga okwa tala edu, nokutya lo ola nyonauka, osheshi ombelela aishe oya nyonauna okukala kwayo kombada yedu.
Ndele Kalunga okwa lombwela Noa: “Patokolo lange exulilo lombelela aishe ola fika. Osheshi vo ova yadifa edu noukolokoshi ndele tala, Ame ohandi ke va hanauna po pamwe nedu.
Lihongela ongulu yomomeva momuti wagofer. Ongulu yomomeva ou na oku i tukula omadimo noku i vaeka eka meni nokombada.
Ove ou na oku i ninga ngaha: Oule wongulu yomomeva omaludimbo omafele atatu, ounene wayo omaludimbo omilongo nhano, noule wopombada omaludimbo omilongo nhatu.

Ove u na okuninga ombululu mongulu yomomeva. Ndele yo oi na okuhongelwa koshihokohoko nounene wayo oludimbo limwe, ndele oshivelo shi tula molwamhati yongulu yomomeva. Ou na okuninga mo omitala nhatu nokutya, omutala woposhi nowopokati naau wopombada.
Osheshi tala, Ame ohandi yelulile edu eyelu, opo ndi hanaune po ombelela aishe i na omufudo womwenyo koshi yeulu. Aishe ei i li kombada yedu otai ka fya.
Ndelenee ame ohandi ka ninga ehangano naave. Ove novana voye ovamati nomwalikadi woye novalikadi vovana voye ovamati, omu na okuya mongulu yomomeva.
Ndele koinamwenyo aishe, kombelela aishe, ou na okutwala mo mongulu yomomeva ooivali nooivali, koludi keshe, opo i kale i na omwenyo pamwe naave: oi na okukala oindume noikadi.
“Meedila komaludi ado nomoimuna komaludi ayo, moialangati aishe yokombada yedu komaludi ayo, ooivali koludi keshe, oi na okuuya kwoove opo i kale i na omwenyo.
Ndele ove, likongela mo eendja adishe hadi liwa, ndele di ongela pwoove, opo di ninge eendja doye nodoinamwenyo.”
Ndele Noa osho a ninga. Naanaa ngaashi Kalunga a tonga, osho a ninga.
7: Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Noa ta ti: “Inda mongulu yomomeva, ove neumbo loye alishe, osheshi ove onde ku mona omuyuki koshipala shange mepupi eli.
Moinamwenyo ya koshoka likufila mo ooivali luheyali, oindume noikadi. Ndelenee moinamwenyo ei inai koshoka, kufa mo ooivali, oshindume noshikadi shasho.
Nomeedila dokeulu yo mbali luheyali, eendume neenghadi, oludi opo li kale li na omwenyo kombada yedu alishe.
Osheshi oku na omafiku aheyali natango opo nee Ame ohandi ka lokifila edu alishe odula omafiku omilongo nhee oufiku nomutenya, ndele handi ka komba po kombada yedu oinamwenyo aishe ei nda ninga.”
Ndele Noa okwa ninga naanaa ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela.
Ndele omido daNoa oda li di fike pomafele ahamano, eshi eyelu le uya kombada yedu.
Ndele Noa novana vaye ovamati nomwalikadi waye novalikadi vovana ovamati ova ya pamwe naye mongulu yomomeva va ye onhapo yomeva eyelu.
Moinamwenyo ya koshoka nomoinamwenyo inai koshoka, nomeedila nomoialangati yokombada yedu,
omwa dja ooivali nooivali, ya ya naNoa mongulu yomomeva, oshindume noshikadi, ngaashi Kalunga a lombwelele Noa.
Omafiku aheyali eshi a pita po, omeva eyelu okwe uya kombada yedu.
Momudo omutimafele ahamano womokukala kwaNoa, mohani onhivali mefiku etimulongo naheyali lohani, mefiku tuu olo eefifiya adishe domoule womedu oda fituluka noikelelifo yeulu oya yeuluka.
Ndele odula inene ya loka kombada yedu omafiku omilongo nhee oufiku nomutenya.
Mefiku tuu olo Noa naSem naHam naJafet, ovana vaNoa, nosho yo omwalikadi waNoa novalikadi vatatu vovana vaye, ova ya mongulu yomomeva.

Vo noifitukuti aishe pamaludi ayo noimuna aishe pamaludi ayo noialangati aishe tai linyenge kombada yedu pamaludi ayo needila adishe pamaludi ado, heeno, eedila adishe di lili nadi lili keshe eshi tashi tuka,
ombelela aishe ei ya li i na omwenyo, oya ya ooivali nooivali kuNoa mongulu yomomeva.
Ndele oyo ya ya mo, oya li oshindume noshikadi shomombelela aishe, ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwela. Ndele Omwene okwa idila po.
Ndele eyelu ola kala kombada yedu omafiku omilongo nhee: omeva okwa hapupala ndele taa yelula ongulu yomomeva, ndele yo oya yeluka ko kombada yedu.
Ndele omeva okwa lundumuka a hapupala unene kombada yedu, fimbo ongulu tai telaana kombada yao.
Ndele omeva okwa tumbalala kombada yedu, ndee eemhunda adishe dile dokoshi yeulu oda tuvikilwa.
Omeva okwa yeluka omaludimbo omulongo naatano kombada yado, eshi eemhunda da tuvikilwa.
Ndele ombelela aishe ya li kombada yedu oya fya: eedila noimuna noifitukuti noipuka ei hai nyangadala kombada yedu, novanhu aveshe.
Keshe eshi sha li shi na omufudo womwenyo momayulu, aishe ei ya kala koukukutu, oya fila mo.

Osho ngaha oinamwenyo aishe ei ya li kombada yedu ya kombwa po, ovanhu noimuna noialangati needila dokeulu. Yo oya kombwa po kombada yedu. Ndele Noa oye aeke a fyaala po naava va li pamwe naye mongulu yomomeva.
Ndele omeva okwa kala nokutumbalala kombada yedu omafiku efele limwe nomilongo nhano.
8: Ndele Kalunga okwa dimbulukwa Noa noifitukuti aishe noimuna aishe ei ya li pamwe naye mongulu yomomeva. Ndele Kalunga okwa pepifa omhepo kombada yedu opo omeva a oholoke,
osho yo eefifiya domoule womedu noikelelifo yeulu ya fitikwa, nodula inene yetilashi oya sheka.
Ndele omeva okwa oholoka kanini nakanini kombada yedu, ndele a hovela okwooholoka pexulilo lomafiku efele limwe nomilongo nhano.
Ndele ongulu yomomeva oya kanghama kombada yomhunda yaArarat mohani onhiheyali mefiku etimulongo netiheyali.
Ndele omeva okwa oholoka kanini nakanini fiyo okohani onhimulongo. Mohani onhimulongo, mefiku lotete lohani, eenhele deemhunda oda monika.
Opo nee pexulilo lomafiku omilongo nhee Noa okwa yeulula ekende longulu yomomeva, oyo a tunga,
nokwa pitifa mo ekola. Lo ola ingaana nokutelaana fiyo omeva otaa pwiinine kombada yedu.
Opo nee ye a pitifa mo vali onghuti, a tale ngeenge omeva a ninipala kombada yedu.

Ndelenee onghuti inai mona onhele yokuwila i tulumukife eenyala dayo, ndele oya shuna kuye mongulu yomomeva, osheshi omeva okwa li kombada yedu alishe. Opo nee ye a nana eke laye ndele e i kwata, nokwe i eta puye mongulu yomomeva.
Opo ye okwa teelela vali omafiku aheyali. Ndele ye okwa pitifa mo vali onghuti mongulu yomomeva.
Ndele onghuti oya alukila kuye komatango, ndele mokanya kayo omwa li efo litalala lolumono! Opo nee Noa a shiiva nokutya, omeva okwa ninga manini kombada yedu.
Ndele ye okwa teelela vali omafiku aheyali ndee okwa pitifa mo onghuti. Ndele yo inai alukila vali kuye.
Momudo omutimafele ahamano naumwe, mohani yotete mefiku lotete lohani, omeva okwa dja ko kombada yedu. Ndele Noa okwa kufa ko onduda yongulu yomomeva ndele ta lengalenga, ndele edu ola kukuta.
Mohani onhivali mefiku etimilongo mbali netiheyali edu ola li la kukuta.
Ndele Kalunga okwa lombwela Noa, ndele ta ti:
“Dja mo mongulu yomomeva, nye nomwalikadi woye novana voye ovamati novalikadi vovana voye ovamati pamwe naave.

Oinamwenyo aishe ei i li pwoove, yombelela keshe, nai dje mo pamwe naave. Eedila noimuna noinamwenyo aishe ei hai linyenge kombada yedu, i shiive okumyakatala kombada yedu, nai kale i na oludalo noi hapupale kombada yedu.”
Opo nee Noa okwa pita mo novana vaye ovamati nomwalikadi waye novalikadi vovana ovamati pamwe naye.
Oinamwenyo aishe, aishe tai alangata, needila adishe, aishe ei tai linyenge kombada yedu, pamaludi ayo, oya pita mo mongulu yomomeva.
Ndele Noa okwa tungila Omwene oaltari, ndele okwa kufa moinamwenyo aishe ya koshoka nomeedila adishe da koshoka, ndele okwa yamba omaxwikiloyambo koaltari.

Ndele omwene okwa li e udite edimba liwa, ndele Omwene okwe lipopila momutima waye ta ti: “Ame itandi ka finga vali edu molwovanhu, osheshi omadiladilo omutima womunhu omai kokudja kounona waye. Ndele itandi ka nyonauna po vali aishe i na omwenyo ngaashi nda ningile.
Fimbo edu li li po, efimbo lokukuna nefimbo lokuteya, outalala noupyu, okulombo nokufu, omutenya noufiku itai ka xula po.”
9: Ndele Kalunga okwa nangeka noupuna Noa novana vaye ovamati ndele okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Dalafaneni, hapupaleni, nye mu yadife edu.
Noinamwenyo aishe yedu needila adishe dokeulu nadi mu tile nokuhaluka. Aishe ei tai linyenge kombada yedu noikwameva aishe yomefuta oya yandjwa momake eni.
Aishe ei tai linyenge i na omwenyo nai ninge eendja deni. Nosho yo oimeno aishe italala Ame ohandi i yandje aishe kunye.
Ashike ombelela i na omwenyo nokutya, i na ohonde, inamu i lya.

Ndelenee ohonde yeni vene ohandi ke i kwatela onghone: keshe oshinamwenyo Ame ohandi ke shi kwatela onghone. Nosho yo Ame ohandi ka kwatela omunhu onghone omolwomwenyo wamukwao, heeno, omwenyo womunhu komunhu mukwao.
Ou ta tileshi ohonde yomunhu, ohonde yaye oi na okutilwashi komunhu. Osheshi Kalunga okwa ninga omunhu oshifefa shaye.
Ndelenee nye dalafaneni mu hapupale. Tandaveleni kombada yedu nye mu hapupale mulo.”
Kalunga okwa lombwela natango Noa novana vaye ovamati ta ti:
“Ndelenee, taleni, Ame ohandi ningi ehangano nanye noludalo leni tali mu shikula,
noinamwenyo aishe ei i li punye; needila noimuna noifitukuti aishe yokombada yedu i li punye, heeno, naaishe ei ya dja mongulu yomomeva nokutya, oinamwenyo aishe yokombada yedu.
Ndele Ame ohandi ningi ehangano nanye nokutya, ombelela aishe itai ka nyonwa po vali komeva eyelu, ndele itapa ka kala vali eyelu lokunyonauna po kombada yedu.”
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti: “Eshi edidiliko lehangano koludalo noludalo fiyo alushe, olo Ame handi ningi pokati ketu nanye noinamwenyo aishe i li punye.
Outa wange ohandi u tula moilemo, u ninge edidiliko lehangano pokati ketu nedu.
Ame ngeenge handi eta oilemo kombada yedu nouta ou tau monika moilemo,
opo nee Ame ohandi ka dimbulukwa ehangano lange eli li li pokati ketu nanye noinamwenyo aishe yomombelela aishe. Omeva itaa ka ninga vali eyelu a nyonaune po ombelela aishe.
Outa ou eshi tau kala moilemo, Ame ohandi ke u tala nokudimbulukwa ehangano lange laalushe pokati ketu noinamwenyo aishe yomombelela aishe yokombada yedu.”
Ndele Kalunga okwa lombwela Noa ta ti: “Edidiliko eli olo ehangano olo nda ninga pokati ketu nombelela aishe yokombada yedu.”
Ndele ovana ovamati vaNoa, ava va dja mongulu yomomeva ovo Sem naHam naJafet. Ham oye okwa li xe yaKaanan.
Ava vatatu ova li ovana vaNoa. Ndele muvo omwa hovela etandavelo loonakukala aveshe kombada yedu aveshe.
Noa okwa li omunamapya, ndele ye okwa hovela okutwika oshikokola shomiviinyu.
Ndele ye eshi a nwa omaviinyu, okwa kolwa ndele ta nangala hamunghele metwali laye.
Ndele Ham, xe yaKaanan, okwa mona epenge laxe, ndele te shi shiivifile vamwaina ve li pondje.
Opo nee Sem naJafet ova kufa ekumbafa ndele tave li tula komapepe avo ndele tava ende shanimanima, ndele tava tuvike epenge laxe, oipala yavo ya tala kumwe ku lili. Osho ngaha inava mona epenge laxe.
Opo nee Noa eshi a kololokwa komaviinyu ndele a shiiva eshi omona waye omushakati e mu ningila,
okwa ti: “Kaanan na fingwe! Ye oku na okuninga omupika wovapika vavamwaina.”
Ye okwa tya vali: “Sem na nangekwe noupuna kOmwene Kalunga. Ndelenee Kaanan oku na okukala omupika waye.
Kalunga na tandavelife Jafet, ndele ye na kale momatwali aSem, ndelenee Kaanan na kale omupika waye.”
Ndele Noa okwa kala nomwenyo konima yeyelu omido omafele atatu nomilongo nhano.
Hano omido adishe daNoa oda li omafele omugoi nomilongo nhano, eshi a fya.
10: Ndele eshi osho efina lomapata ovana vaNoa: Sem, Ham naJafet; vo ova dala ovana ovamati konima yeyelu.
Ovana ovamati vaJafet ova li: Gomer naMagog naMadai naJavan naTubal naMesek naTiras.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaGomer ova li: Askenas naRifat naTogarma.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaJavan ova li: Elisa naTarsis, Kittim naDodanim.
Ovo ooxekulu voiwana oyo i li komunghulofuta nokeenhunhu. Ava ovo oludalo laJafet: muvo mwa dja oonakukala meenhunhu doiwana momadu avo pamalaka avo, pamaludi avo nomoiwana yavo.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaHam ovava: Kus naEgipiti naPut naKaanan.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaKus ova li: Sheba naHavila naSabta naRaama naSabteka. Ndele ovana ovamati vaRaama: Seba naDedan.
Kus okwa dala Nimrod, ou a li omunaenghono nomunamapangelo wotete kombada yedu.
Ye okwa li omukongo omunaenghono koshipala shOmwene. Onghee hano kwa tiwa: “Omukongo omunaenghono koshipala shOmwene ngaashi Nimrod.”
Ehovelo loshilongo shaye okwa li Babel naErek naAkkad, aishe oyomedu laSinear.
Medu eli ye okwa dja mo, ndele okwa ya kuAsiria, ndele okwa tunga Ninive naRehobot-Ir naKalag,
naResen, pokati kaNinive naKalag. Osho oshilando shinene.
Ndele Egipiti okwa dala Ovalud nOvaanami nOvalehab nOvanaftu
nOvapatros nOvakaslu, muvo omo mwa dja Ovafilisti nOvakaftori.
Ndele Kaanan okwa li xe yaSidon, oshiveli shaye, naHet
nOvajebusi nOvaamori nOvagirgasi
nOvahevi nOvaarki nOvasini
nOvaarvadi nOvasemari nOvahamati. Ndele komesho omaludi Ovakaanan a tandavela.
Ndele onhele yokukala kwOvakaanan oya li okudja kuSidon ya yukilila Gerar fiyo okuGasa, nokuyukilila kuSodom naGomorra naAdma naSeboim fiyo okuLesa.
Ovo ovana vaHam pamaludi avo, pamalaka avo momadu avo nomoiwana yavo.
Ndele Sem, xekulu yovana aveshe vaEber, omukulu waJafet, okwa dala yo ovana ovamati.
Ovana ovamati vaSem ova li: Elam naAssur naArpaksad naLud naAram.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaAram ova li: Us naHul naGeter naMesek.
Ndele Arpaksad okwa dala Shela, ndele Shela okwa dala Eber.
Ndele Eber okwa dala ovana ovamati vavali: Edina laumwe ola li Peleg, osheshi momafiku aye oonakukala kombada yedu ova li ve lihanena edu. Edina lamumwaina ola li Joktan.
Ndele Joktan okwa li xe yaAlmodad naSelef naHasarmavet naJerag
naHadoram naUsal naDikla
naObal naAbimael naSheba
naOfir naHavila naJobab. Vo aveshe va li ovana vaJoktan.
Ndele onhele yokukala kwavo oya li okudja kuMesa nokuyukilila kuSefar fiyo okeemhunda dokoushilo.
Vo ovana ovamati vaSem pamaludi avo, pamalaka avo momadu avo nopaiwana yavo.
Oo omaludi ovana vaNoa pamapata avo nomoiwana yavo. Ndele muvo mwa tandavela oiwana yokombada yedu konima yeyelu.
11: Ndele mounyuni aushe omwa li elaka limwe alike noitya kakwa li ihapu.
Ndele eshi va ehena langhele koushilo, ova mona ko ehenene medu laSinear. Ndele oko va tula.
Opo nee va udafana, tava ti: “Ileni tu folomeni eedopi, fye tu di yofe di pame.” Eedopi ove di longifa ngaashi omamanya okutunga, neka ledu la li ekwatakanifo lado.
Ndele vo va tya: “Ileni, fye tu litungileni oshilando noshungo ile, onhele yayo i twe keulu, tu liningileni edina, tuhe lihanene nounyuni aushe.”
Opo nee Omwene okwa koloka ndele te uya poshi okutala oshilando noshungo ei ya tungwa kovanhu.
Ndele Omwene okwa ti: “Vo oshiwana shimwe, ndele vo aveshe ove na elaka limwe! Ndele eshi ehovelo alike loilonga yavo. Paamha kape na sha eshi tashi ke va imba eshi va hala okuninga.
Tu yeni, tu kolokeni, fye tu dongakanifeni elaka lavo, opo vehe liude omunhu namukwao.”
Osho hano Omwene okwe va halakanifila kombada yedu alishe. Ndele vo ova efa okutunga oshilando.
Onghee hano ve shi luka Babel, osheshi oko Omwene a dongakanifila elaka ledu alishe, ndele oko Omwene e va halakanifila ounyuni aushe.
Eshi efina lepata laSem: omido daSem eshi da li efele limwe, ye okwa dala Arpaksad, omido mbali konima yeyelu.
Ndele Sem eshi a dala Arpaksad, okwa kala e na omwenyo natango omido omafele atano. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daArpaksad eshi da li omilongo nhatu nanhano, okwa dala Shela;
Ndele Arpaksad eshi a dala Shela, okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele ane nanhatu. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daShela eshi da li omilongo nhatu, okwa dala Eber.
Ndele Shela eshi a dala Eber, okwa kala nomwenyo natango omido omafele ane nanhatu. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daEber eshi da li omilongo nhatu nanhee, okwa dala Peleg.
Ndele Eber eshi a dala Peleg okwa kala e na omwenyo natango omido omafele ane nomilongo nhatu. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daPeleg eshi da li omilongo nhatu, okwa dala Rehu.
Ndele Peleg eshi a dala Rehu, okwa kala e na omwenyo natango omido omafele avali nomugoi. Ndele ye okwa li e na ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daRehu eshi da li omilongo nhatu nambali, okwa dala Seruh.
Ndele Rehu eshi a dala Seruh, okwa li e na omwenyo natango omido omafele avali naheyali. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daSeruh eshi da li omilongo nhatu, okwa dala Nahor.
Ndele Seruh eshi a dala Nahor, okwa kala e na omwenyo omido omafele avali. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daNahor eshi da li omilongo mbali nomugoi, okwa dala Tera.
Ndele Nahor eshi a dala Tera, okwa kala e na omwenyo natango omido efele limwe nomulongo nomugoi. Ndele ye okwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Omido daTera eshi da li omilongo heyali, okwa dala Abram, Nahor naHaran.
Ndele eshi efina lepata laTera: Tera okwa dala Abram, Nahor naHaran, ndele Haran okwa dala Lot.
Ndele Haran okwa fila moshilongo omo a dalelwa, muUr shOvakaldea, fimbo xe, Tera, a li e na omwenyo natango.
Ndele Abram naNahor ove likongela ovalikadi. Edina lomwalikadi waAbram la li Sarai, nedina lomwalikadi waNahor ola li Milka, omona okakadona kaHaran, xe yaMilka naJiska.
Ndele Sarai okwa li ongadji, iha dala.

Ndele Tera okwa kufa omona waye omumati Abram naLot, omona waHaran, omutekulu waye, naSarai, oshitenya shaye, omwalikadi waAbram, omona waye. Ndele ava va dja mo pamwe naye muUr shOvakaldea va ye kedu laKaanan. Ndele vo va fika fiyo okuHaran oko va tula.
Omido daTera da li omafele avali nanhano, ndele Tera okwa fila muHaran.
12: Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Abram ta ti: “Fikama, dja mo moshilongo sheni nomepata leni nomeumbo laxo, u ye koshilongo eshi handi shi ku ulikile.
Ndele Ame ohandi ku ningi oshiwana shinene, ndele handi ku nangeke noupuna ndele handi ku ningile edina linene, ndele ove to ka kala omunangeki noupuna.

Ndele Ame ohandi ka nangeka noupuna
ava tave ku nangeke noupuna,
ndele handi ka finga ou te ku fingi.
Ndele omapata aeshe kombada yedu
otaa nangekwa noupuna mwoove.”
Opo nee Abram okwa fikama ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela, ndele Lot okwa ya pamwe naye. Ndele omido daAbram oda li omilongo heyali nanhano eshi a dja muHaran.

Ndele Abram okwa kufa Sarai, omwalikadi waye naLot, omona womumwaina, nemona lavo alishe, ve li likongela, novapika ve ve likongela muHaran, ndele vo ova dja mo va ye kedu laKaanan, ndele tava fiki kedu laKaanan.
Ndele Abram okwa enda moshilongo fiyo okonhele yaSekem, fiyo okoshuundungila shaMore. Mefimbo linya Ovakaanan ovo va li medu olo.
Opo nee Omwene okwe lihololela Abram ndele ta ti: “Edu eli handi ke li yandja koludalo loye.” Opo nee ye a tungila Omwene oaltari, ou e mu lihololela.
Ndele okwa fikama ndele ta ehene keemhunda dokoushilo waBetel ndele ta ongo onhanda pokati kaBetel mouninginino naAi moushilo, oko a tungila Omwene oaltari ndele ta ifana edina laYe.
Ndele Abram okwa enda nokweehena kedu lokoumbuwanhu.
Ndele moshilongo omwa holoka ondjala, opo Abram okwa ya medu laEgipiti, a kale ngaashi omunailongo, osheshi ondjala oya li inene moshilongo.
Ndele opa ningwa, eshi va ehena popepi okuya muEgipiti, ye okwa lombwela omwalikadi waye Sarai: “Tala, ondi shi shii, kutya ove omwalikadi muwa.
Hano Ovaegipiti eshi tave ke ku mona, otava ka tya: ‘Ye omwalikadi waye, ndele vo otava ka dipaa nge,’ ndee ove to kala nomwenyo.
Hano tya, ove omumwameme, opo ndi kale nawa molwoye, ame ndi dule okukala nomwenyo molwoye.”
Abram eshi e uya kuEgipiti, Ovaegipiti ova mona nokutya, omwalikadi waye okwa li muwa unene.
Omalenga aFarao nao okwe mu mona nokwe mu pandela puFarao. Omwalikadi okwa twalwa mouhamba waFarao.
Ndele vo ova ningila Abram ouwa molwaye, ndele ye okwa pewa eedi neengobe noumbulu novapika neengamelo.
Ndele Omwene okwa etela Farao nouhamba waye oiponga idjuu molwaSarai, omwalikadi waAbram.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana Abram ndele ta ti: “Owa ninga nge ngahelipi? Omolwashike ino shiivifila nge nokutya, ou omwalikadi woye?
Omolwashike wa lombwela nge, kutya ye omumwanyoko, nomolwaasho nde mu kufa a ninge omwalikadi wange? Hano omwalikadi woye oyou, mu kufa po ndele to i!”
Ndele Farao okwa lombwela ovapiya vaye ve mu te po puye nomwalikadi waye noinima yaye.
13: Osho ngaha Abram a dja muEgipiti ndele ta i moshilongo kombinga yokoumbuwanhu, ye mwene nomwalikadi waye noinima yaye aishe, naLot pamwe naye.
Ndele Abram okwa li oshipuna shinene shoimuna noshoshisiliveli noshoshingoldo.
Ndele ye okwa endaenda keembinga neembinga, okudja koshilongo sho kombinga yokoumbuwanhu fiyo opopepi naBetel, ponhele inya a ongele onhanda yaye yotete, nokutya pokati kaBetel naAi,
konhele oko a tungile nale oaltari. Ndele oko Abram a ifana edina lOmwene.
Ndele Lot, ou a enda pamwe naAbram, naye yo okwa li e na eedi neengobe neefaila.
Ndele oshilongo kasha li sha wanena okukala mo, osheshi ova li ve na oinima ihapu, osho inava dulila okukala pamwe.
Ndele opa holoka eemhata pokati kovafita vaAbram novafita vaLot. Pefimbo linya Ovakaanan nOvaperesi ova li yo moshilongo omo.
Opo nee Abram okwa lombwela Lot ta ti: “Inapa kala nande eemhata pokati ketu naave, nopokati kovafita vange nokovafita voye, osheshi fye vamwe aveke.
Oshilongo ashishe oshosho. Tu tukuke. Ove ngeenge oto i kolumosho, ame ohandi i kolulyo, ndele ngeenge ove oto i kolulyo, ame ohandi i kolumosho.”

Opo nee Lot okwa yelula omesho aye ndele ta mono kutya olufilu alishe lokuJordan oli na omeva mahapu. Pefimbo opo Omwene ina hanauna po manga Sodom naGomorra, lo la li kombinga yaSoar ngaashi oshikunino shOmwene, ngaashi edu laEgipiti.
Ndele Lot okwe lihoololela olufilu alishe lokuJordan, ndele Lot ta ehene kombinga yokoushilo. Osho ngaha ve litukauka.
Abram okwa fyaala medu laKaanan, ndele Lot okwa tula moilando yomolufilu lokuJordan ndele okwa kala meehambo daye nokweehena fiyo okuSodom.
Ndelenee ovanhu vomuSodom ova li vai unene novanyonauni koshipala shOmwene.
Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Abram, eshi va tukauka naLot ta ti: “Ponhele opo u li ofika, yelula omesho oye u tale koumbangalanhu nokoumbuwanhu nokoushilo nokouninginino.
Osheshi edu alishe u wete ohandi ke li ku pa noludalo loye fiyo alushe.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka hapupalifa oludalo loye ngaashi ondwi yedu, ngeenge ope na omunhu ta dulu okuvala ondwi yedu, ota shiiva yo okuvala oludalo loye.
Fikama, u taulule edu eli noule walo nounene walo, osheshi Ame ohandi ke li ku pa.”
Opo nee Abram okwa ehena komesho neefaila daye nokwa tula moshuundungila shomuMamre, popepi naHebron. Ndele oko a ka tungila Omwene oaltari.
14: Ndele mefimbo laAmrafel, ohamba yaSinear, naAriok, ohamba yaEllasar, naKedorlaomer, ohamba yaElam, naTideal, ohamba yaGoim,
va hovela okuhomona Bera, ohamba yaSodom, naBirsha, ohamba yaGomorra, naSineab, ohamba yaAdma, naSemeber, ohamba yaSeboim nohamba yomuBela nokutya, Soar.
Vo aveshe ova ongela omatanga avo ovakwaita molufilu laSiddim nokutya Efuta lOmongwa.
Ova li va longela Kedorlaomer omido omulongo nambali, ndele momudo omutimulongo nomutitatu ove mu liteeka.
Opo nee Kedorlaomer okwe uya momudo omutimulongo nomutine, neehamba edi da kala pamwe naye, ndele vo ova denga Ovarefai muAsterot-Karnaim nOvasusi muHam nOvaemim mehenene laKiriataim
nOvahori keemhunda davo Seir fiyo okuEl-Paran shi li pomunghulo wofuka.
Opo nee vo va aluka tave uya kuEn-Mispat nokutya, Kades, ndele tava teya oshilongo ashishe shOvaamaleki nosho yo shOvaamori ava va li muHaseson-Tamar.
Opo nee ohamba yaSodom nohamba yaGomorra nohamba yaAdma nohamba yaSeboim nohamba yaBela nokutya, Soar, da fikama, ndele tadi va lwifa molufilu laSiddim,
va lwife Kedorlaomer, ohamba yaElam, naTideal, ohamba yaGoim, naAmrafel, ohamba yaSinear, naAriok, ohamba yaEllasar: eehamba nhee di lwife eehamba nhano.
Ndelenee olufilu laSiddim ola li li yadi omalambo eka ledu. Eehamba daSodom naGomorra, eshi da ya onhapo, oda wila muo, noshixupe osha ya onhapo keemhunda.
Ndele vo ova kufa emona alishe lomuSodom naGomorra neendja davo adishe, ndele tava di po.
Vo ova kwata yo Lot, omona wamumwaina waAbram, nemona laye alishe, shaashi ye okwa li a tula muSodom, ndele tava i naye.

Ndele omunhu umwe a dja onhapo polwoodi, okwe uya oku shi hepaululila Abram, Omuheberi, a tula moshuundungila shomuMamre. Omunhu ou okwa li Omuamori, mumwaina waEskol naAner. Vo ova li va kwatafana naAbram.
Abram eshi a uda kutya omona wamumwaina a kwatwa, okwa dilila ovalumenhu omafele atatu nomulongo nahetatu, ava va dalelwa meumbo laye, ndele ta i navo ndele tave va shikula fiyo okuDan.
Oufiku ove va totela, ve va dilila keembinga di lili, ndele ye novapiya vaye, ve va taataa ndee ve va shikula fiyo okuHoba, shi li koumbangalanhu waDamaskus.
Ndele ye okwa alula emona alishe, nomona wamumwaina Lot nemona laye, nosho yo ovalikadi novana.
Mokwaaluka kwaye eshi a taataa Kedorlaomer neehamba edi da li pamwe naye, ohamba yaSodom oya li ye ke mu shakeneka kolufilu laShave nokutya, Olufilu lEehamba.
Ndele Melkisedek, ohamba yaSalem, omupristeli waKalunga wOkombadambada okwa eta omungome nomaviinyu,
ndele ye okwe mu nangeka noupuna ndele ta ti: “Abram omunangekwa noupuna waKalunga wOkombadambada, Omushiti weulu nedu,
ndele Kalunga wOkombadambada na hambelelwe, ou a yandja ovatondadi voye momake oye.” Ndele Abram okwe mu pa oshitimulongo shomwaaishe.
Ndele ohamba yaSodom oya lombwela Abram tai ti: “Pe nge ovanhu, ndele kufa po oinima i ninge yoye.”
Opo nee Abram okwa nyamukula ohamba yaSodom ta ti: “Ame ohandi ane kOmwene Kalunga wOkombadambada, Omushiti weulu nedu.
Oshili itandi kufa nande okangodi ile omwiya wonghaku, heeno, itandi kufa sha mwaaishe ei yoye, opo uha ka tye kutya: ‘nda ninga Abram oshipuna.’
Ame inandi hala sha nande! Ashike eshi sha liwa kovapiya nokombinga yovanhu ava va enda pamwe naame nokutya, Aner, Eskol naMamre, vo nava pewe oshitukulwa shavo.”
15: Konima yoinima ei ondjovo yOmwene ye uya kuAbram memoniko ndele tai ti: “Ino tila Abram, Aame oshikelelifo shoye, nondjabi yoye oinene unene.”
Opo nee Abram okwa pula ta ti: “Omwene Kalunga, Ove to pe nge shike, osheshi ame ohandi i ndihe na oludalo nomufyuululi weumbo lange Elieser, Omudamaskus?”
Abram okwa tya natango: “Ove ino pa nge oludalo. Osho hano omupika omudalelwa meumbo lange ota ka ninga omufyuululi wange.”
Opo nee ondjovo yOmwene oye uya kuye, ndele tai ti: “Ou ita ka ninga omufyuululi woye, ndelenee ou ta di molutu loye, oye ta ka ninga omufyuululi woye.”
Opo nee Ye okwe mu twala pondje ndele ta ti: “Tala pombada keulu ndele to vale eenyofi, ngeenge oto dulu tuu oku di vala.” Ndele Ye okwe mu lombwela: “Osho oludalo loye tali ka kala.”
Ndele ye okwa itavela Omwene. Ndele Ye okwe li mu valela ouyuki.
Ye okwe mu lombwela natango ta ti: “Aame Omwene, ou nde ku tembula muUr shOvakaldea, ove u pewe edu eli.”
Ndele ye ta ti: “Omwene Kalunga, ohandi shi shiiva ngahelipi nokutya, ohandi ke li pewa?”
Ndele Ye okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Etele nge ondema i na omido nhatu noshikombo oshikadi shi na omido nhatu noshikombo oshindume shi na omido nhatu, nonghuti onghutyona.”
Ndele ye okwe i eta aishe kuye ndele te i taula pokati ndele ta tula oipambu kumwe, ndele eedila ine di taula.
Opo nee eedila hadi li ombelela da wila kombada yoinamwenyo ei ya fya, ndele Abram okwe di taataa po.
Ndele pokuningina kwetango Abram okwa kwatwa keemhofi dinene, ndele tala, etilo nomulaulu munene owe mu wila.
Ndele Kalunga okwa lombwela Abram ta ti: “Kala u shi shii nokutya, oludalo loye otali ka kala ovanailongo medu lihe fi lavo. Oko tava ka ninga ovapika nokuhepekwa omido omafele ane.
Ndelenee Ame ohandi ka tokola yo oshiwana eshi she va tula moupika. Nokomesho otava ka pita mo nemona linene.
Ndelenee ove oto ka ya kooxo nombili, oko to ka pakwa, ngeenge wa kulupa.
Ndele epupi etine otali ka alukila apa, osheshi oulunde wOvaamori inau wana natango.”
Ndele etango eshi la ningina, eshi omulaulu fokofoko we uya, opa monika ediko tali twimaana omwifi nonyika yomundilo pokati keenhumba dombelela.
Mefiku tuu olo Omwene okwa ninga ehangano naAbram, ndele ta ti: “Koludalo loye Ame ohandi li pe edu eli, okudja komulonga waEgipiti fiyo okomulonga munene, omulonga waEufrat,
Ovakeni nOvakenisi nOvakadmoni,
nOvaheti nOvaperesi nOvarefai,
nOvaamori nOvakaanan nOvagirgasi nOvajebusi.”
16: Ndele Sarai, omwalikadi waAbram, ine mu dalela ounona. Ndele ye okwa li e na omupika Omuegipiti, edina laye Hagar.
Ndele Sarai okwa lombwela Abram ta ti: “Ove ou shi shii, Omwene ina pa nge oludalo.” Inda komupika wange. Kashiimba ohandi ka mona oludalo muye. Ndele Abram okwa itavela Sarai.
Opo nee Sarai, omwalikadi waAbram, okwa kufa Hagar omupika waye Omuegipiti, Abram eshi a kala omido omulongo medu laKaanan, ndele te mu pe omulumenhu waye Abram, a ninge omwalikadi waye.
Ndele ye okwa nangala naHagar, ndele ta ningi oufimba. Ndele ye eshi a mona nokutya, ye omufimba, okwa dina Sarai, omwene waye.

Ndele Sarai okwa lombwela Abram: “Odino ei handi dinwa nayo nai ku alukile! Aame mwene nda yandja omupika wange mekolo loye, ndele paife eshi a dimbulukwa kutya ye omufimba, ota tale nge nodino. Omwene na tokole pokati ketu naave.”
Ndele Abram okwa nyamukula Sarai: “Omupika woye oku li mepangelo loye, mu ningila ngaashi tashi ku wapalele.” Opo nee Sarai e mu monifa oixuna, ndele ye okwa dja po onhapo puye.
Ndele omweengeli wOmwene okwe mu mona e li pofifiya yomofuka, pofifiya pondjila yokuSur,
ndele okwa pula: “Hagar, omupika waSarai, owa dja peni, noto i peni?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ohandi i onhapo yomwene wange Sarai.”
Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene okwe mu lombwela: “Shuna kumwene woye, ove u lininipikile epangelo laye.”
Omweengeli wOmwene okwe mu lombwela natango ta ti: “Ame ohandi ka hapupalifa oludalo loye, olo tali ka nyengana okuvalwa molwouhapu walo.”
Omweengeli wOmwene okwe mu lombwela yo ta ti: “Tala, ove oumufimba, ndele oto dala okaana okamati, ndele ou na oku ka luka Ismael, osheshi Omwene okwe ku uda moudjuu woye.
Ndele ye ota ka ninga omulumenhu ngaashi ofino: eke laye otali ka tanganana kwaaveshe, nomake aaveshe otaa ka tanganana kuye! Ndele ota ka kala e na ouyelani kovamwaxe aveshe.”
Ndele ye okwa luka edina lOmwene, ou a popya naye: “Oove Kalunga u wete nge.” Osheshi ye okwa ti: “Ame onda mona ou a vilola, ou e wete nge?”
Onghee hano ye okwa luka omufima: “Beer-Lahai-Roi, u li pokati kaKades naBered.”
Ndele Hagar okwa dalela Abram omona omumati. Ndele Abram okwa luka omona ou a dalwa kuHagar, Ismael.
Ndele omido daAbram oda li omilongo hetatu nahamano, eshi Hagar e mu dalela Ismael.
17: Omido daAbram eshi da ninga omilongo omugoi nomugoi, Omwene okwe mu lihololela ndele te mu lombwele ta ti: “Aame Kalunga Omunaenghono adishe! Kala nokweenda koshipala shange, opo u kale omuyuki.
Ndele Ame nda hala okuninga ehangano pokati ketu naave noku ku hapupalifa neenghono.”
Opo nee Abram okwa wila eombe ndele Kalunga okwa popya naye ta ti:
“Tala, ehangano lange otali kala naave, ndele ove oto ka ninga xe yoiwana ihapu.
Onghee hano ito ifanwa vali Abram, ndelenee Abraham, osheshi Ame ohandi ku ningi xe yoiwana ihapu.
Ndele Ame ohandi ku pe oludalo lihapu unene: Ame ohandi ke ku ninga oiwana, neehamba otadi ka holoka mwoove.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka ninga ehangano pokati ketu naave nomaludalo oye komapupi nomapupi ao, ngaashi ehangano laalushe, ndi kale Kalunga koye naKalunga koludalo loye tali ku shikula.
Ndele Ame ohandi ku pe, noludalo tali ku shikula, edu eli loweendanandjila woye, edu alishe laKaanan, li ninge loye fiyo alushe. Ndele Ame ohandi ka kala Kalunga kavo.”
Kalunga okwa lombwela vali Abraham ta ti: “Ndelenee ove noludalo loye omu na okudiinina ehangano lange komapupi nomapupi.
Ehangano lange eli mu na oku li diinina, eli li li pokati ketu nanye nopokati ketu noludalo loye tali ku shikula, nokutya, okamati keshe mokati keni otaka ka pitifwa etanda,
nye omu na okuteta ko oshipa shokoxulo youlumenhu, ndele eshi oshi na okukala edidiliko lehangano lopokati ketu nanye.
Okamati komafiku ahetatu keshe mokati keni oke na okupita etanda; okamati keshe komepata leni. Ou a dalelwa meumbo loye, naau a landwa noimaliwa kovanailongo, ou ehe fi womepata leni,
ou a dalelwa meumbo loye naau we mu landa noimaliwa, oku na okupita etanda. Osho ngaha ehangano lange tali didilikwa mombelela yeni ngaashi ehangano laalushe.
Ndele omulumenhu ou ina pita etanda, e na oshipa shokoxulo youlumenhu waye inashi tetwa ko, omunhu e li ngaha na kombwe mo muvakwao. Ye okwa teya ehangano lange.”
Kalunga okwa lombwela vali Abraham ta ti: “Sarai, omwalikadi woye, ino mu ifana vali Sarai, ndele edina laye nali ninge Sara.
Ndele Ame ohandi ke mu nangeka noupuna, ndele handi ku pe muye okaana okamati. Heeno, Ame ohandi ke mu nangeka noupuna, opo ye a ka ninge oiwana, neehamba doiwana tadi ka dja muye.”
Opo nee Abraham okwa wila eombe ndele ta yolo, ndele te lipopile momutima waye: “Omunamido efele limwe ota ka dalelwa vali okaana? NaSara oku na omido omilongo omugoi, ota dala tuu vali?”
Ndele Abraham okwa lombwela Kalunga: “Ngeno Ismael a kale e nomwenyo koshipala shoye!”

Opo nee Kalunga okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Oshili, omwalikadi woye, Sara, ote ke ku dalela okaana okamati, ndele ou na oku ka luka Isak. Ndele Ame ohandi ka ninga ehangano nako, ehangano laalushe noludalo tali ka shikula.

Neindilo ove we li indilila Ismael onde li uda. Tala, Ame ohandi mu nangeke noupuna ndele handi mu pe oludalo ndele handi mu hapupalifa neenghono. Muye otamu ka dja eehamba omulongo nambali, ndele Ame ohandi ke mu ninga oshiwana shinene.
Ndelenee ehangano lange Ame ohandi ke li ninga naIsak, Sara ote ke mu ku dalela momudo tau uya pefimbo tuu eli.”
Ndele Kalunga eshi a mana okupopya naye, okwa dja po puAbraham ndele ta i pombada.

Opo nee Abraham okwa kufa omona waye Ismael naaveshe ava va dalelwa meumbo laye, naaveshe ava va landwa noimaliwa, ovalumenhu aveshe mokati kovanhu vomeumbo laye, ndele te va kenghe mefiku tuu olo, ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwela.
Ndele omido daAbraham da li omilongo omugoi nomugoi, oshipa shonhele youlumenhu waye eshi sha tetwa ko.
Ndele omido daIsmael, omona waye omumati da li omulongo nanhatu, oshipa shonhele youlumenhu waye eshi sha tetwa ko.
Mefiku tuu olo limwe Abraham nomona waye Ismael omo va kenghwa,
ndele ovalumenhu aveshe vomeumbo laye, ovo va dalelwa meumbo laye, novanailongo ava va landwa noimaliwa, ova kenghwa pamwe naye.
18: Ndele Omwene okwe lihololela Abraham poshuundungila shaMamre fimbo ye a li omutumba poshivelo shetwali moshanga shomutenya.
Ye eshi a yelula omesho, okwa mona ovalumenhu vatatu ve li ofika komesho yaye. Ndele ye eshi e va mona okwa dja po poshivelo shetwali ta endelele e ke va shakeneke ndele te linyongamene poshi,
ndele ta ti: “Omwene wange, ngeenge onda mona onghenda koshipala shoye, ino koya po omupiya woye.
Etelweni omeva manini mu koshe eemhadi deni ndele nangaleni mu tulumukwe momudile womuti.
Ndele ohandi mu etele oshipambu shomungome opo eemwenyo deni di mone eenghono, nye mu shiive okutwikila, osheshi omwe uya pomupiya weni.” Ndele vo ova nyamukula tava ti: “Ninga ngaashi wa popya.”
Opo Abraham okwa endelela okuya ketwali kuSara, ndele ta ti: “Ninga divadiva, lunga oufila weembekele nhatu, oufila womudiva ndele ninga omingome.”
Opo Abraham okwa endelela okuya koshuunda, nokwa kwata onhana omhunya iwa, ndele okwe i yandja komupiya, ou e i pyakuduka diva.
Ndele ye okwa kufa omaadi nomashini, nonhana ei ya pyakudukwa ndele te i tula puvo, fimbo ye mwene e li ofika momudile womuti. Ndele vo ova lya.
Ndele ova tya kuye: “Omwalikadi woye Sara oku li peni?” Ndele ye ta nyamukula: “Oku li metwali.”
Ndele Ye ta ti: “Ame ohandi ke uya vali kwoove moudwaali, nohandi ka hanga Sara, omwalikadi woye, e na okaana okamati.” Ndele Sara okwa li ta pwilikine poshivelo shetwali konima yaye.
Ndelenee Abraham naSara ova li va kulupa, nomafiku avo omahapu. Sara kakwa li vali ha i poshi panghedi yovakainhu.
Ndele Sara okwe liyola mwene nokwa diladila: “Ame ohandi udu tuu vali ounyenye wohole, eshi nda kulupa ngaha, nomulumenhu wange okwa kulupa?”
Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Abraham ta ti: “Omolwashike Sara a yola nokudiladila: ‘Ame ohandi ka dala tuu vali, eshi nda kulupa ngaha?’
Ope na tuu sha tashi nyenge Kalunga? Pefimbo tuu eli momudo tau uya, Ame ohandi ka aluka, ndele ohandi hange Sara e na okaana okamati.”
Ndelenee Sara okwe likala ndele ta ti: “Ame inandi yola,” osheshi ye okwa tila. Ndele ye okwa tya: “Ahowe, ove wa yola.”
Opo ovalumenhu va fikama ndele tava tale langhele kuSodom. Ndele Abraham okwa ya pamwe navo e va findikile.
Opo nee Omwene ta ti: “Ohandi dulu tuu okuholeka Abraham eshi handi ka ninga?
MuAbraham omo tamu ka dja shili oshiwana shinene shi na eenghono noiwana aishe kombada yedu otai ka nangekwa noupuna muye.
Osheshi Ame onde mu hoolola, opo a lombwele ovana vaye neumbo laye nokutya, nava diinine ondjila yOmwene, va shiive okulonga ouyuki noshili, opo Omwene a wanifile Abraham eshi Ye e mu udanekela.”
Omwene okwa tya natango: “Onghuwo molwaSodom naGomorra oya ninga inene shili, noulunde wavo wa ninga mudjuu unene shili.
Ame onda hala okukolokela poshi nokutala ngeenge ova ninga tuu shili ngaashi onghuwo yavo ya fika kwaame, ile hasho. Onda hala oku shi shiiva.”
Opo nee ovalumenhu va dja po va ya kuSodom, ndelenee Abraham okwa kala ofika natango koshipala shOmwene.
Ndele Abraham okwa ehena ndele ta ti: “Ove oto ka nyonauna po ovayuki pamwe novahenakalunga?
Pamwe moshilando omu omu na ovayuki omilongo nhano. Oto ke va nyonauna po, ndele ito file onghenda onhele oyo molwovayuki omilongo nhano ava ve li mo?
Nashi kale kokule naave oku shi ninga: u nyonaune ovayuki pamwe novahenakalunga, opo ovayuki va tokolelwe ngaashi ovahenakalunga. Nashi kale kokule naave: Omutokoli wedu alishe ita tokola pauyuki?”
Opo nee Omwene ta ti: “Ame ngeenge onda hange ovayuki omilongo nhano moshilando shaSodom, ohandi ka fila onghenda onhele aishe molwavo.”
Ndele Abraham okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Tala, ame ondi na ouladi okupopya nOmwene, nande ame ondwi nomute.

Pamwe oto hange mo ovayuki omilongo nhee navatano ponhele yomilongo nhano? Oto ka hanauna po oshilando ashishe, ngeenge ovayuki inava hanga pomilongo nhano?” Ndele Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame itandi ke shi hanauna po, ngeenge nda mono mo omilongo nhee navatano.”
Ndele ye okwa popya naye natango ndele ta ti: “Ngeenge pamwe omu na ovayuki omilongo nhee.” Ndele Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame itandi shi ningi omolwomilongo nhee.”
Natango ye ta ti: “Omwene, ino handuka, ngeenge handi popi natango. Ngeenge pamwe omu na omilongo nhatu?” Ndele Ye ta nyamukula: “Ame itandi ke shi ninga, ngeenge handi mono mo omilongo nhatu.”
Opo nee ye ta ti: “Tala, ame ondi na ouladi okupopya nOmwene. Ngeenge pamwe omu na omilongo mbali?” Ndele Ye ta nyamukula: “Ame itandi ke shi hanauna po omolwomilongo mbali.”
Opo ye ta ti: “Omwene, ino handuka, nandi popye ashike lumwe aluke. Kashiimba pamwe otamu monika omulongo.” Ndele Ye ta nyamukula: “Ame itandi ke shi hanauna po omolwomulongo.”
Ndele Omwene okwa dja po eshi a mana okupopya naAbraham. NaAbraham okwa shuna konhele yokukala kwaye.
19: Ndele ovaengeli venya vavali ove uya kuSodom onguloshi, fimbo Lot a li omutumba poshivelo shaSodom. Ndele Lot eshi e va mona, okwa fikama ndele te ke va shakeneka ndele te lifidimike pedu,

ndele ta ti: “Oovene vange, ileni meumbo lomupiya weni, mu nangale mo nye mu koshe eemhadi deni, opo mu shiive okumeneka tamu twikile ondjila yeni.” Ndele vo ova nyamukula: “Ahowe, fye ohatu ka nangala pondje.”
Ndele ye okwe va indila nokwiindililila; opo nee ve uya kuye ndele tave uya meumbo laye. Ndele ye okwe va telekela ouvalelo ndele te va lungile omingome inadi ya onhafi, ndele vo ova lya.
Fimbo inava ka nangala, ovalumenhu vomoshilando, ovalumenhu Ovasodom ovanyasha novakulunhu, aveshe kumwe ava va li moshilando, ove uya ndele tava dingilile ongulu yaLot.
Ndele vo ova ifana Lot ndele tava ti kuye: “Ovalumenhu ava ve uya nena kwoove ove li peni? Va eta pondje kufye opo tu nangale navo.”
Opo nee Lot okwa pita mo nokwa ya kuvo komesho yoshivelo ndele ta idile oshivelo konima yaye,
ndele ta ti: “Vakwetu, inamu ninga owii u fike opo.

Taleni, ame ondi na ovana vavali voukadona, inava kumafana novalumenhu natango. Ame ohandi va eta pondje kunye, ndele tamu va ningi ngaashi tashi mu wapalele. Ndelenee ovalumenhu ava, nye inamu va ningila sha, osheshi vo ve uya momudile wonduda yange.”

Opo nee vo ova nyamukula: “Dja po!” Ndele tava ti: “Oye tuu ou e uya po a kale ngaashi omunailongo apa, ndele alushe ye okwa hala oku tu pangela. Paife eshi ohatu ku monifa oixuna i dule yaava.” Ndele vo ova nhukila neenghono omulumenhu ou Lot ndele tava ehene va ka teye po omuvelo.
Ndele ovalumenhu venya va twala omake avo pondje ndele tava shilile Lot meumbo, ndele tava idile omuvelo.
Ndele ovalumenhu ava va li pondje pomuvelo wongulu, ounona novakulunhu, ove va twikifa omesho, ndele tava nyengwa okumona omuvelo.
Ndele ovaenda ava ova pula Lot tava ti: “Ou na mo oolyelye natango? Oshitenya, novana voye ovamati noukadona, naaveshe ava u na moshilando, va pitifa mo monhele ei,
osheshi fye hatu ka hanauna po onhele ei, osheshi onghuwo molwovanhu ava oya ninga inene koshipala shOmwene, nOmwene okwe tu tuma tu shi hanaune po.”

Opo nee Lot okwa ya a ka popye noitenya yaye, ovalumenhu ava va li ve na okuhombola ovana vaye oukadona, ndele ta ti: “Fikameni, djeni mo monhele ei, osheshi Omwene ota ka hanauna po oshilando.” Ndele vo ove mu tala, ta popi omashendjo.

Ndele eluwa eshi la hovela okutenda, ovaengeli ova ulumika Lot ndele tava ti: “Fikama, kufa omwalikadi woye novana voye oukadona vavali, ava ve li pwoove, opo muha nyonaunwe po molwoukolokoshi woshilando.”

Ndele ye okwa li ta ongaonga natango. Opo nee ovalumenhu ve mu kwata momaoko, nomwalikadi waye novana vaye oukadona vavali, osheshi Omwene okwa li a hala oku mu fila onghenda. Ndele vo ove va pitifa mo ndele ve va twala pondje yoshilando.
Ndele eshi ve va twala pondje, ova tya: “Xupifeni eemwenyo deni! Inamu tala monima noinamu kanghama mefilu eli laJordan. Djei po; indeni onhapo keemhunda muha nyonaunwe po.”
Opo nee Lot okwe va nyamukula: “Akutu Omwene wange!

Tala, ame omupiya woye, nda filwa onghenda koshipala shoye, ndele Ove owa monifa nge efilonghenda loye linene, eshi wa xupifa omwenyo wange. Ndelenee ame itandi dulu okuya onhapo keemhunda, onda tila oshiponga shi hange nge ndele handi fi.
Tala, oshilando osho shi li popepi, ndi shiive okufika mo. Pe nge ndi ye mo, sho oshinini noshongaho, omwenyo wange u xupifwe.”
Ndele Ye okwe mu lombwela: “Tala, moshinima eshi namo ohandi ku itavelele, ndiha hanaune po oshilando, osho wa popya.
Inda onhapo divadiva, osheshi Ame itandi dulu okuninga sha fimbo ino fika ko. Onghee hano va luka oshilando osho Soar.”
Lot eshi a fika muSoar, lo etango ola pita.
Ndele Omwene okwa lokifila Sodom naGomorra osulfuri nomundilo wa dja kuye meulu,
ndele Ye okwa hanauna po oilando ei nefilu alishe laJordan, nosho yo oonakukalamo aveshe voilando naashishe sha mena mo.
Ndele omwalikadi waLot, ou a li te mu shikula, okwa keuka monima ndele ye okwa shituka oshivanda shomongwa.
Ndele Abraham okwa penduka ongula inene ndele ta i konhele ei a li a kala ofika koshipala shOmwene.
Ye eshi a tala langhele kuSodom naGomorra nokefilu alishe laJordan, okwa mona omwifi tau di medu ndele tau lundumuka ngaashi omwifi womediko loivela.
Ndele eshi Kalunga a hanauna po oilando yomefilu laJordan, okwa dimbulukwa Abraham, ndele a pitifa mo Lot mehanauno, eshi Ye a hanauna po oilando omo mwa li Lot.

Ndele Lot okwa dja muSoar pamwe novana vaye oukadona vavali, ndele okwa ka tula keemhunda, shaashi okwa tila okukala muSoar. Onghee hano ye okwa kala pamwe novana vaye vavali oukadona mekololo lomomhunda.
Ndele ou woshiveli okwa lombwela ondenge yaye: “Tate okwa kula, nomoshilongo kamu na omulumenhu, ou ta dulu okuuya kufye panghedi younyuni aushe.
Ila, tu pe tate omaviinyu a nwe, ndele hatu nangala naye, opo tu limonene oludalo mutate.”
Oufiku ou vo ova pa xe omaviinyu a nwe ndele ou woshiveli okwe uya a nangale naxe. Ye ina shiiva kutya onaini e uya okunangala nonaini a penduka.

Mefiku la shikula oshiveli sha lombwela ondenge: “Tala, oufiku ou wa pita, ame nda nangala natate. Natu mu pe vali nena omaviinyu a nwe. Inda nee kuye u ka nangale naye, fye tu limonene oludalo mutate.”
Oufiku ou vo ova pa vali xe omaviinyu a nwe, ndele ondenge oya penduka, ndele tai nangala naye. Ye ina shiiva kutya onaini e uya okunangala nonaini a penduka.
Osho ngaha ovana oukadona vavali vaLot va pewa oufimba kuxe,
Ou woshiveli okwa dala okaana okamati, ndele e ka luka Moab. Oye xe yOvamoab fiyo onena.
Ndele ondenge nayo oya dala okaana okamati ndele ye ka luka Ben-Ammi. Oye xe yOvaammoni fiyo onena.
20: Ndele Abraham okwa dja po opo ndele okwa ya kombinga yokoumbuwanhu woshilongo, nokwa tula pokati kaKades naSur. Okwa kala muGerar ngaashi omunailongo.
Ndele Abraham mokutonga kwaye Sara, omwalikadi waye, okwa kala ha ti: “Ye omumwameme.” Opo nee Abimelek, ohamba yaGerar, okwa ka tala Sara.
Ndelenee oufiku tuu oo Kalunga okwe uya kuAbimelek mondjodi ndele ta ti kuye: “Tala, ove to ka fya molwomwalikadi ou wa eta omu, osheshi ye omwalikadi omuhombolwa.”
Ndelenee Abimelek ka li a ya pamwe naye natango. Onghee hano, okwa pula: “Omwene, ove oto ka komba po oshiwana shihe na etimba?
Haye mwene a lombwela nge nokutya, ye omumwaina? Ye naye mwene okwa tile: ‘Ou omumwameme omulumenhu.’ Opauyuki wokomutima wange nopaukoshoki womake ange nde shi ninga.”

Opo nee Kalunga e mu nyamukula mondjodi ta ti: “Ame ondi shi shii nokutya, owe shi ninga pauyuki wokomwenyo, ndele aame mwene nde ku kelela uha nyone kwaame. Onghee hano inandi shi itavela ove u mu kume.

Shunifa hano paife omwalikadi womulumenhu ou, osheshi ye omuxunganeki. Ndele ye ote ke ku ilikanena ove u kale nomwenyo. Ndelenee ove ngeenge ito mu shunifa, kala u shi shii, oto ka fya shili, ove mwene novakweni aveshe.”
Abimelek okwa penduka ongula inene, ndele ta ifana ovapiya vaye aveshe ndele oshinima ashishe te shi hepaululile momatwi avo. Opo nee ovalumenhu va tila unene.
Ndele Abimelek okwa ifana Abraham ndele te mu pula: “Owe tu ningila shike? Ame onda nyona shike kwoove, eshi wa etela nge, noshilongo shange etimba linene. Owa ningila nge oinima ihai ningwa.”
Abimelek okwa lombwela vali Abraham ta ti: “Ove owa hala ndi mone shike eshi we shi ninga?”
Ndele Abraham okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame nda diladila oshili kutya monhele ei kamu na etilokalunga. Vo otava dulu okudipaa nge molwomwalikadi wange.
Ye omumwameme shili. Ye omona okakadona katate, ndele ke fi omona wameme. Ndele ye a ninga omukainhu wange.
Ndele Kalunga eshi a kufa nge meumbo latate nokwa tula nge mokweendaenda, ame onde mu lombwela, handi ti: ‘File nge onghenda; keshe apa hatu i, ou na okutya, ove omumwameme.’ ”
Opo nee Abimelek okwa kufa eedi noikombo neengobe, nosho yo ovapika ovalumenhu novakainhu, ndele te va pe Abraham. Okwa shunifila yo Abraham omwalikadi waye Sara.
Ndele Abimelek ta ti: “Oshilongo shange oshosho. Ka tule keshe apa wa hala okukala.”
Ndele okwa lombwela Sara ta ti: “Onda pa omumwanyoko omulumenhu oimaliwa oisiliveli eyovi limwe. Tala, yo nai ninge oiwapalekifo momesho akeshe ou e li pamwe naave, opo ove u talwe omuyuki.”
Opo nee Abraham okwa ilikana Kalunga, ndele Kalunga okwa velula Abimelek, nosho yo omwalikadi waye novapika vaye ovakainhu, opo va shiive okudala.
Osheshi Omwene okwa fitikile oshidalelo keshe meumbo laAbimelek molwaSara, omwalikadi waAbraham.
21: Ndele Omwene okwa talela po Sara, ngaashi e mu udanekela. Ndele Omwene okwa ninga ngaashi a popile.
Sara okwa ninga oufimba, ndele okwa dalela Abraham moukulupe waye omona okamati mefimbo tuu olo a lombwelwa kuKalunga.
Ndele okaana okamati aka Sara e mu dalela, Abraham okwe ka luka Isak.
Ndele Abraham okwa pitifa okaana kaye okamati, Isak, etanda eshi ka ninga omafiku ahetatu, ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwela.
Nomido daAbraham oda li efele limwe eshi a dala okaana kaye okamati Isak.
Ndele Sara okwa tya: “Kalunga okwa yolifa nge. Keshe ou te shi udu, ota ka yola pamwe.”
Ye okwa tya vali: “Olyelye ngeno a shiiva okulombwela Abraham nokutya, Sara ona ka nyamifa ounona? Osheshi ame onde mu dalela okaana okamati moukulupe waye.”
Nokaana ka kula noka tova. Ndele Abraham okwa ninga oitelekela inene mefiku tuu olo Isak a tova.
Opo nee Sara okwa mona nhumbi omona waHagar, omupika omukainhu Omuegipiti ou a dalela Abraham, ta sheke Isak.
Ndele ye ta ti kuAbraham: “Taataa mo omupika omukainhu pamwe nomona waye. Osheshi omona womupika ou ita ka fyuulula pamwe naIsak, omona wange.”
Ndelenee Abraham okwa ninga omwenyo mwii molweendjovo odo molwokaana kaye.
Ndele Kalunga okwa lombwela Abraham: “Ino ninga omwenyo mwii molwomona nomolwomupika woye. Pwilikina Sara mwaashishe eshi te ku lombwele. Osheshi muIsak omo tamu ka dja ovo tava lukwa oludalo loye.
Ndele handi ka ninga yo omona womupika oshiwana shinene, osheshi ye omona woye.”

Opo nee Abraham okwa penduka ongula inene, ndele a kufa omungome noshako yomeva, ndele te i tula kepepe laHagar, pamwe nokaana ndele te va lekele. Ye okwa dja po ndele okwa ka elaela mofuka yaBerseba.
Ndele omeva omoshako eshi a pwa mo, ye okwa tula okaana kaye momudile woshixwa
ndele ta i a ka kale omutumba oule woshinano shokuumba oshikuti, osheshi ye ota ti: “Ihandi dulu okutala efyo lokaana.” Ndele ye okwa ya a ka kale omutumba kokule kanini ndele ta lili pombada.

Opo Kalunga okwa uda ondaka yokaana, ndele omweengeli waKalunga okwa ifana Hagar ndele te mu pula: “Oshike she ku hanga, Hagar? Ino tila osheshi Kalunga okwa uda ondaka yokaana koye ponhele apa ke li.
Penduka, kufa po okaana, ka kwata meke lako, osheshi Ame ohandi ke ka ninga oshiwana shinene.”
Opo nee Kalunga okwa pashukifa omesho aye, ndele okwa mona omufima! Ndele ye okwa ya nokwa yadifa oshako nomeva ndele a nwefa okaana.
Ndele Kalunga okwa kala pamwe nokaana. Ndele oka kula ndee taka kala mofuka ndele taka ningi omukongo.
Ye okwa kala mofuka yaParan. Naina okwe mu kongela omwalikadi medu laEgipiti.
Mefimbo tuu olo Abimelek naPikol, ondjai yaye, ova kundafana naAbraham ndele tava ti: “Kalunga ota kala pamwe naave mwaashishe eshi to longo.
Anene nge hano paife apa medina laKalunga, ove uha kotokele nge nepata lange noludalo lange. Ngaashi ame nde ku ningila ouwa, ove ou na okuningila nge yo ouwa noshilongo omo u li omunailongo.”
Ndele Abraham okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame ohandi ane.”
Ndele Abraham okwa tangunina Abimelek molwomufima oo a nyekwa kovapiya vaAbimelek.
Opo nee Abimelek okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame inandi shiiva kutya olyelye e shi ninga. Naave yo ino shi shiivifila nge, naame yo inandi uda sha fiyo onena eli.”
Opo Abraham okwa kufa eedi neengobe nokwe di pa Abimelek. Ndele vo vavali va ninga ehangano.
NaAbraham okwa tongola oudjona oukadi vaheyali meedi ve likalele.
Opo Abimelek okwa tya kuAbraham: “Oudjona ava vaheyali wa tongola mo, ovashike?”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ove ou na okutambula meke lange oudjona oukadi ava vaheyali, opo va ninge eendobwedi nokutya, aame nda xupile omufima ou.”
Onghee hano va luka onhele ei Berseba, osheshi vo vavali ova anena po.
Osho ngaha va ningila ehangano muBerseba. Opo nee Abimelek naPikol, ondjai, ove lilongekida nova shuna kedu lOvafilisti.
Ndele Abraham okwa twika omuti womutamarisk muBerseba nokwa ifana edina lOmwene Kalunga kaalushe.
Ndele Abraham okwa kala efimbo lile omunailongo medu lOvafilisti.
22: Konima yoinima ei Kalunga okwa yeleka Abraham ndele te mu lombwele: “Abraham!” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Aame ou!”
Opo Ye ta ti: “Kufa Isak, omona woye ewifa, ou u mu hole, ndele inda kedu laMoria. Ndee oko to ke mu yamba exwikiloyambo komhunda oyo Ame handi ke ku ulikila.”

Opo nee Abraham a meneka ongula inene ndele ta mange ondongi yaye, ndele ta kufa pamwe naye ovapiya vavali nomona waye Isak. Ndele ye okwa panda oikuni yexwikiloyambo nokwa fikama ndele ta i konhele oyo a ulikilwa kuKalunga.
Mefiku etitatu Abraham okwa yelula omesho aye ndele ta mono onhele i li kokule.
Ndele Abraham okwa lombwela ovapiya vaye ta ti: “Fyaaleni apa pamwe nondongi. Ame nomumwange ohatu i kwinya tu ka ilikane ndele hatu alukile kunye.”
Ndele Abraham okwa kufa oikuni yexwikiloyambo ndele te i twike komona waye Isak, ndele ta kufa omundilo nomukonda meke laye. Osho ngaha vo vavali va enda pamwe.
Opo nee Isak okwa popya naxe Abraham ndele ta ti: “Tate!” Ndele ye ta nyamukula: “Aame ou, mumwange!” Ndele ye ta ti: “Omundilo oyou noikuni oyei, ndele odi yexwikiloyambo oi li peni?”
Ndele Abraham okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Kalunga ote ke limonena odi yexwikiloyambo, mumwange.” Osho ngaha vo vavali va enda pamwe.
Eshi va fika ponhele oyo Kalunga e va ulikila, Abraham okwa tunga po oaltari ndele ta tula ko oikuni. Opo nee ye a manga omona waye Isak nokwe mu kaleka koaltari kombada yoikuni.
Opo nee Abraham okwa nana eke laye ndele ta kufa omukonda a dipae omona waye.
Ndelenee omweengeli wOmwene okwa ingida keulu ndele ta ti: “Abraham! Abraham!” Ndele ye ta nyamukula: “Aame ou!”
Ndele ye ta ti: “Eke loye ino li kumifa omumwoye, ino mu ninga sha. Osheshi paife ame ndi shi shii kutya oho tila Kalunga, no ino anyena nge omumwoye ewifa.”

Ndele Abraham eshi a yelula omesho okwa mona, ndele tala, konima yaye odi yondume ya dingila eembinga dayo moshixwa. Ndele Abraham okwa ya ndele ta kufa odi yondume ndele te i yambe exwikiloyambo ponhele yomona waye.
Ndele Abraham okwa luka onhele oyo: “Omwene te limonene!” Fiyo onena ponhele opo ohapa tiwa: “Komhunda oko Omwene te liholola.”
Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene okwa ingida olutivali okudja keulu kuAbraham
ndele ta ti: “ ‘Ame ohandi lianene mwaame mwene,’ Omwene ta ti, ‘ove eshi we shi ninga, no ino anyena nge omumwoye ewifa,
ohandi ke ku nangeka noupuna unene noludalo loye ohandi li hapupalifa unene ngaashi eenyofi dokeulu nongaashi eheke pomunghulo wefuta. Noludalo loye otali ka nangala moivelo yovanaita nalo.
Noiwana aishe kombada yedu otai ka nangekwa noupuna molwoludalo loye, osheshi ove wa uda ondaka yange.’ ”
Ndele Abraham okwa shuna kovapiya vaye. Ndele vo ove lilongekida, ndele ova ya pamwe kuBerseba. Ndele Abraham okwa kala muBerseba.
Konima yoinima ei Abraham a shiivifilwa kwa tiwa: “Tala, Milka yo okwa dalela mumwanyoko Nahor ounona oumati:”
Us, oshiveli shaye, naBus, ondenge yaye, naKemuel, xe yaAram,
nosho yo Kesed naHaso naPildas naJidlaf naBetuel.
Ndele Betuel, oye xe yaRebeka. Ava vahetatu Milka okwe va dalela Nahor mumwaina waAbraham.
Ndele omwalikadi wopomunghulo, edina laye Reuma, okwa dala yo Tebag naGaham naTahas naMaaka.
23: Ndele omido daSara da li efele nomilongo mbali naheyali. Odo omido daSara odo.
Ndele Sara okwa fila muKiriat-Arba nokutya, Hebron, medu laKaanan. Ndele Abraham okwe uya keefya daSara noku mu lila.
Opo nee Abraham okwa fikama ndee okwa dja po pomufi, ndee okwa popya novana vaHet, ndele ta ti:
“Ame omunailongo nomweenda mokati keni. Pei nge onhele yeembila medu leni, opo ndi shiive okupaka mo omufi wange.”
Opo nee ovana vaHet va nyamukula Abraham ndele tava ti:

“Tu pwilikina, omwene wetu! Ove elenga laKalunga mokati ketu. Paka omufi woye monhele yeembila iwa i dule adishe edi tu kwete. Kape na ou mokati ketu te ku anyene onhele yeembila u pake mo omufi woye.”
Opo nee Abraham okwa kala ofika nokwe linyongamena moipafi yovanhu vomoshilongo, koshipala shovana vaHet,
ndele ye okwa popya navo ta ti: “Ngeenge tashi mu wapalele, ohandi tumbu mo omufi wange meumbo ndele handi mu pake. Hano pwilikineni nge nye mu popile nge koshipala shaEfron, omona waSohar,
a pe nge ekololo laMakpela, laye mwene noli li kexulilo loshitukulwa shonhele yaye. Ne li pe nge pakuyeleka ondado yalo, opo ndi kale ndi na onhele yeembila mokati keni.”
Ndele Efron okwa li omutumba pokati kovana vaHet. Opo nee Efron, Omuheti, okwa nyamukula Abraham momatwi ovana vaHet, aveshe ava va ya mo moshivelo shoshilando shaye:
“Ahowe, omwene wange, pwilikine nge. Oshitukulwa osho shedu ame ohandi shi ku pe, nosho yo ekololo li li musho ohandi li ku pe. Moipafi yovanhu vange ame ohandi shi ku pe. Paka omufi woye.”
Opo nee Abraham okwe linyongamena koshipala shovanhu voshilongo,

ndele okwa popya naEfron momatwi ovanhu vomoshilongo ndele ta ti: “Eewa, ndelenee pwilikine nge tuu! Oshitukulwa osho shedu ohandi shi yandjele oimaliwa, i tambula kwaame, opo ndi shiive okupaka mo omufi wange.”
Ndele Efron okwa nyamukula Abraham ndele ta ti:
“Omwene wange, pwilikine nge. Oshitukulwa shedu shi fike peesekeli doshisiliveli omafele ane, oshi na shike pokati ketweni naave? Paka mo omufi woye.”
Opo nee Abraham okwa pwilikina Efron, ndele Abraham okwa yelekifila Efron oimaliwa i fike pwaai ya tongwa kuye momatwi ovana vaHet, eesekeli doshisiliveli omafele ane panghedi yoipindi.
Osho hano ngaha oshitukulwa shedu laEfron osho shi li muMakpela, sha shaama naMamre, oshitukulwa shedu nekololo lomusho nomiti adishe di li moshitukulwa shedu monhele aishe nopominghulo dayo,
ashishe sha ninga shaAbraham moipafi yovana vaHet, moipafi yaaveshe ovo va ya mo moshivelo shoshilando shaye.
Opo nee Abraham okwa paka omwalikadi waye Sara mekololo lomoshitukulwa shedu laMakpela koushilo waMamre, nokutya, Hebron, medu laKaanan.
Osho hano ovana vaHet va yandja kuAbraham oshitukulwa shedu nekololo lomusho, opo shi ninge onhele yaye yeembila.
24: Ndele pefimbo olo Abraham okwa kulupa, nomafiku aye a ninga mahapu, nOmwene okwe mu nangeka noupuna mwaaishe.
Opo nee Abraham okwa lombwela omupiya elenga lakula lomeumbo laye, ou a pashukila oinima yaye aishe, ndele ta ti: “Eke loye li shitika koshi yetundji lange;
onda hala u anene nge kOmwene Kalunga keulu nedu nokutya, ove uha kongele omumwange omwalikadi movana oukadona vOvakaanan ovo ndi li mokati kavo.
Ndelenee inda koshilongo shetu nokepata letu u ka kongele omumwange Isak omwalikadi.”
Opo nee omupiya okwe mu pula ta ti: “Omwalikadi ngeenge ina hala okuuya naame moshilongo eshi, ondi na okushunifa mbela omumwoye koshilongo shinya wa dja?”
Ndele Abraham okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Likelela shili opo uha shunife vali omumwange kwinya.

Omwene Kalunga keulu, ou a kufa nge meumbo latate nomoshilongo omo nda dalelwa naau a popya naame nokwa anena nge neendjovo edi: ‘Oludalo loye ohandi ke li pa edu eli,’ ote ke ku tetekelifa omweengeli waye ndele ove ou na okweetela ko omumwange omwalikadi.
Ndelenee omwalikadi ngeenge ina hala okuuya, nena owa mangululwa kokwaana kwoye kwaame. Ove ino shunifa ashike omumwange kwinya.”
Opo nee omupiya okwa shitika eke laye koshi yetundji laAbraham, omwene waye, ndele okwe mu anena moshinima eshi.

Ndele omupiya okwa kufa eengamelo omulongo domeengamelo domwene waye ndee okwa ya e na oinima i lili noi lili iwa i na ondilo yomoinima yomwene waye. Ye okwa fikama ndele okwa ya kuMesopotamia, koshilando shaNahor.
Neengamelo okwe di twifa eengolo pondje yoshilando pomufima umwe, etango longuloshi, mefimbo tuu olo ovalikadi tave uya okuteka omeva,
ndele ye ta ti: “Omwene Kalunga kaAbraham omwene wange, monife nge elao nena ndele fila onghenda omwene wange Abraham.
Ame ohandi kala ofika apa pomufima fimbo ovana oukadona voonakukala moshilando tave uya okuteka omeva.

Nashi ningwe hano: Okakadona aka handi ka lombwela hai ti: ‘Ehenifa oshiyuma shoye, ndi nwe mo,’ ngeenge ka nyamukula taka ti: ‘Nwa, ame ohandi ka nwefa yo eengamelo doye,’ nena okakadona oko, oko wa nunina omupiya woye Isak, nosho ngaha ame hai ka shiiva, nokutya Ove owa fila onghenda omwene wange.”
Ye fimbo ina mana okupopya, Rebeka okwe uya po. Ye omona okakadona kaBetuel, omona waMilka, omwalikadi waNahor ondenge yaAbraham. Ye oku na oshiyuma kepepe laye.
Ndele okakadona aka oka li kawa, inaka kumwa komulumenhu nandenande. Ndele ko oka kulukila momufima ndele taka teke oshitoo shako ndele oka aluka mo.
Opo nee omupiya okwa endelela ndele ta ti: “Pe nge ndi nwe mo moshiyuma shoye omeva manini.”
Ndele ko oka nyamukula taka ti: “Nwa mo, omwene wange.” Opo nee oshiyuma oke shi kululila diva momake aye ndee oke mu pa a nwe.
Eshi ke mu pa okunwa oka tya: “Ame ohandi ka xwiila yo neengamelo doye, di nwe di kumwe.”
Opo nee oshiyuma oke shi tila diva metemba ndele ka tondoka, ka shuna vali momufima ka ka teke, ndele ka xwiila eengamelo daye adishe.
Omulumenhu okwe ka tala, a kumwa a mwenenena nokwa hala a shiive ngeenge Omwene okwe mu monifa tuu ondjila i na elao.
Ndele eengamelo eshi da nwa da kumwa, omulumenhu okwa kufa olinga yoshingoldo, youdjuu wetata losekeli, noivela ivali yokomaoko yoshingoli, i fike peesekeli omulongo,
ndele ta ti: “Ove omona okakadona kalyelye? Lombwele nge. Meumbo laxo omu na onhele tu nangale mo?”
Ndele ko oke mu nyamukula taka ti: “Ame omona okakadona kaBetuel, omona waMilka ou e mu dala naNahor.
Ndele ko oke mu lombwela vali taka ti: Meumbo letu omu na omwiidi neendja dasha, nonhele yokunangala.”
Opo nee omulumenhu okwe linyongamena a twa oshipala shaye poshi ndee okwa ilikana Omwene

neendjovo edi: “Omwene Kalunga kaAbraham, omwene wange na hambelelwe, osheshi Ye ina anyena omwene wange ouwanghenda noudiinini waye. Omwene okwa endifa nge nondjila ei yokeumbo lamumwaina womwene wange.”
Opo nee okakadona oka tondoka, ka ka hepaulule meumbo laina eshi sha ningwa.
Ndele Rebeka okwa li e na omumwaina edina laye Laban. Ndele Laban okwa lotokela komulumenhu kwinya komufima.

Osheshi ye eshi a mona olinga noivela komaoko amumwaina nokwa uda eendjovo damumwaina Rebeka nokutya ope na omulumenhu ou a popya naye, ye okwa ya komulumenhu, fimbo ye a li ofika natango peengamelo pomufima,
ndele ta ti: “Ila meumbo, ove omunangekwa noupuna wOmwene! Oshike u li ofika pondje, manga ame nda longekida eumbo nonhele yo yeengamelo?”
Ndele omulumenhu okwe uya meumbo. Laban okwa mangulula eengamelo, ndele te di pe oikulya. Opo nee okwa etela omupiya waAbraham novalumenhu ava va li pamwe naye omeva okukosha eemhadi davo.
Opo nee vo ove mu etela eendja. Ndele ye ta ti: “Ame itandi li fimbo inandi tonga eenghundwa dange.” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Popya hano.”
Opo nee ye okwa tya: “Ame omupiya waAbraham.
Ndele Omwene okwa nangeka noupuna omwene wange unene, okwe mu yambapaleka unene, ndele okwe mu pa eedi neengobe, oshisiliveli noshingoldo, ovapika ovalumenhu novapika ovakainhu, neengamelo neendongi.
Ndele Sara, omwalikadi womwene wange okwa dalela omwene wange omona omumati moukulupe waye. Ndele omwene wange okwe mu pa ashishe osho e kwete.
Ndele ye okwa anifa nge ndele ta ti: ‘Ove ino kongela omumwange omwalikadi moukadona vOvakaanan, ovo ndi li moshilongo shavo.
Ndelenee ou na okuya keumbo latate nokepata letu nokukongela omumwange omwalikadi oko.’
“Opo nee nda pula omwene wange: ‘Omwalikadi ngeenge ina hala okuuya pamwe naame.’
