Ndele ye okwa nyamukula nge: ‘Omwene, moipafi yaye ame nda kala nokweenda, ota ka tuma omweengeli waye pamwe naave, ndele Ye ote ku monifa elao mondjila yoye, opo u shiive okweetela omumwange omwalikadi mepata letu nomeumbo latate,
opo nee ove wa manguluka keano we li anena nge, ngeenge to uya kepata letu; ndele vo ngeenge inava hala oku mu ku pa, opo nee wa manguluka keano we li anena nge.’
“Ame onde uya nena komufima ndele handi ti: ‘Omwene, Kalunga kaAbraham, omwene wange, ngeenge owa hala okumonifa nge elao mondjila yange,
ame handi kala ofika apa pomufima, nashi ningwe ngaha: Moukadona ava tave uya okuteka, ngeenge onda lombwele po kamwe hai ti: Pe nge ndi nwe mo omeva manini moshitoo shoye,
ndee ko taka nyamukula nge taka ti: Nwa mo ove mwene ndele neengamelo doye ohandi di xwiile, ou omwalikadi, Omwene e mu nunina omona womwene wange.’
Ame fimbo inandi mana natango okulipopila momutima wange, Rebeka okwe uya noshitoo shaye kepepe ndee ta kulukile komufima ndele ta teke. Opo nee ame nde mu lombwela: ‘Pe nge ndi nwe mo!’
Ndele ye okwa kulula diva oshitoo shaye kepepe ndele ta ti: ‘Nwa mo, nohandi ka xwiila eengamelo doye.’ Ndele ame onda nwa mo, nokwa xwiila yo eengamelo.

Opo nee nde ka pula ndele handi ti: ‘Ove omona walyelye?’ Ndele ko oka nyamukula: ‘Omona okakadona kaBetuel, omona waNahor, ou e mu dalelwa kuMilka.’ Opo nee nda tula olinga keyulu lako noivela yokomaoko komaoko ako,

ndele ame onde linyongamena nokutwa oshipala poshi koshipala shOmwene Kalunga kaAbraham, omwene wange, ou a endifa nge nondjila ya yuka opo ndi monene omona womwene wange, omona okakadona kamumwaina womwene wange.
Nye ngeenge omwa hala okumonifa omwene wange onghenda noudiinini, shi lombweleni nge. Nongeenge hasho, lombweleni nge, opo ndi shiive okuya kolulyo ile kolumosho.”
Opo nee Laban naBetuel ova nyamukula ndele tava ti: “Oshinima eshi osha dja kOmwene. Fye itatu dulu okupopya kwoove nande owii ile ouwa.
Rebeka oye ou e li ofika koshipala shoye, mu kufa po, indeni, opo ye a ka ninge omwalikadi womona womwene woye, ngaashi Omwene a tonga.”
Ndele omupiya waAbraham eshi a uda eendjovo davo, ye okwe linyongamena poshi koshipala shOmwene.
Opo nee omupiya okwa longolola oinima oisiliveli noingoldo noikutu, nde te i pe Rebeka. Komumwaina nokuina ye okwa yandja omilongelo di na ondilo.
Ndele vo ova lya nova nwa, ye novalumenhu ava va li pamwe naye, ndele ova nangala oufiku oo. Vo eshi va penduka ongula inene, ye ota ti: “Lekeleni nge ndi ye komwene wange.”
Ndelenee mumwaina naina tava ti: “Okakadona naka kale pufye efiku limwe ile omafiku omulongo, opo mu dule okuya.”
Ndelenee ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Inamu kelela nge, osheshi Omwene okwa monifa nge elao mondjila yange. Lekeleni nge ndi shiive okushuna komwene wange.”
Opo nee vo tava ti: “Natu ifaneni okakadona, koovene ka pulwe.”
Ndele vo ova ifana Rebeka ndele tave mu pula: “Owa hala okuya pamwe nomulumenhu ou?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Heeno.”
Opo nee vo ova lekela mumwaina Rebeka nomuyakuli waye pamwe nomupiya waAbraham novalumenhu vaye.

Ndele vo ova nangeka noupuna Rebeka ndele tava ti kuye:
“Omumwameme, mwoove namu dalwe
omayovi omilongo,
noludalo loye nali nangale moshivelo shovanaita naave.”
Opo nee Rebeka nomuyakuli waye ove lilongekida nova londa keengamelo nokushikula omulumenhu. Osho ngaha omupiya okwa kufa Rebeka ndele okwa shuna.
Ndele Isak okwe uya langhele puBeer-Lahai-Roi, osheshi ye okwa kala moshilongo shokoumbangalanhu.
Ndele Isak okwa ya a ka endaenda komaalala etango longuloshi. Ndele ye eshi a yelula omesho aye okwa mona eengamelo tadi uya.
Rebeka yo okwa yelula omesho aye nokwa mona Isak. Opo nee ye okwa londoloka kongamelo,
ndele ta ti komupiya: “Omulumenhu olyelye ou te tu shakeneke mealala?” Nomupiya okwa nyamukula ta ti: Oye mwene wange. Opo nee Rebeka okwa kufa oshikaiwa ndele okwe liuvika.
Opo nee omupiya okwa hepaululila Isak ashishe eshi a ninga.
Ndele Isak okwe mu twala monduda yaina Sara, ndele okwa tambula Rebeka, ndele okwa ninga omwalikadi waye. Ndele ye okwa li e mu hole. Osho ngaha Isak a hekelekwa kefyo laina.
25: Ndele Abraham okwa hombolulula omwalikadi, nedina laye oKetura.
Ndele ye okwe mu dalela Simran naJoksan naMedan naMidian naJisbak naSuah.
Ndele Joksan okwa li xe yaSheba naDedan. Novana vaDedan ovo Ovaassuri, Ovaletusi nOvaleumi,
novana ovamati vaMidian ovava: Efa naEfer naHenok naAbida naEldaa. Vo aveshe oludalo laKetura.
Ndele oinima yaye aishe Abraham okwe i pa Isak,
ndelenee ovana ovamati vovalikadi vaAbraham vopomunghulo, Abraham okwe va pa oipewa, ndele fimbo a kala nomwenyo, ye e va lekelifa Isak, omona waye, nokwe va tuma koshilongo shokoushilo.
Omafiku omido daAbraham oo ye a kala nomwenyo oyaa: omido efele limwe nomilongo heyali nanhano.
Abraham okwa fuda mo omhepo yaye nokwa fya moukulupe waye muwa, a kulupa nokwa kuta omwenyo. Ndele ye okwa ongelwa kovanepata vaye.
Ndele ovana vaye ovamati, Isak naIsmael, ve mu paka mekololo laMakpela moshitukulwa shedu shaEfron, omona waSohar, Omuheti, osho sha li koushilo waMamre,
oshitukulwa tuu osho Abraham a landele kovana vaHet; oko Abraham nomwalikadi waye Sara va pakwa.
Konima yefyo laAbraham, Kalunga okwa nangeka noupuna Isak, omona waye. Ndele Isak okwa kala puBeer-Lahai-Roi.
Eshi efina lepata laIsmael, omona waAbraham, a dalelwa Abraham kuHagar Omuegipiti, omupika waSara.
Naa omadina ovana ovamati vaIsmael, omadina avo pakushikula omapata avo: Nebajot, oshiveli shaIsmael, Kedar naAdbeel naMibsam,
naMisma naDuma naMassa,
Hadad naTema, Jetur, Nafis naKedma.
Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaIsmael nomadina avo nomikunda davo neenhanda davo, eehamba omulongo nambali pakushikula omapata avo.
Omido daIsmael, ye a kala nomwenyo odedi: omido efele limwe nomilongo nhatu naheyali. Ndele ye okwa fuda mo omhepo yaye nokwa fya, ndele a ongelwa kovanepata vaye.
Ndele venya ova li va kala meenhele okudja kuHavila fiyo okuSur, ei i li koushilo waEgipiti langhele kuAsiria. Novakwao aveshe okwe va nangeka kokule.
Eli ehepaululo laIsak, omona waAbraham: Abraham okwa li xe yaIsak.
Nomido daIsak oda li di fike pomilongo nhee ye eshi a hombola Rebeka, omona okakadona kaBetuel, Omuaram womuPaddan-Aram, mumwaina waLaban, Omuaram.
Ndele Isak okwa ilikana Omwene molwomwalikadi waye, osheshi ye okwa li ongadji. Ndele Omwene okwe mu uda, nomwalikadi waye, Rebeka, okwa ninga oufimba.
Ndele ounona ova ngwadjulafana medimo laye. Opo nee ye ta ti: “Hano ngeenge ongaha, omolwashike ndi na okukala vali nomwenyo?” Opo nee ye okwa ya a ka pule Omwene.

NOmwene okwe mu nyamukula ta ti:
“Oiwana ivali i li medimo loye,
Nomaludi avali taa ka dja meni loye.
Oludi limwe oli na eenghono li dule likwao,
nomukulunhu ota ka kalela ondenge yaye.”
Ndele efiku lokudala kwaye eshi la fika, okwa dala epasha.
Aka kotete oka pita mo, ka tilyana ngaashi oshikutu sholududi. Onghee ve mu luka Esau.
Nomumwaina eshi e mu shikula, eke laye la kwata oshififinwa shaEsau. Onghee ove mu luka Jakob. Nomido daIsak oda li di fike pomilongo hamano vo eshi va dalwa.
Novana ovamati ova kula. Esau okwa ninga omukongo omukongolela, omulumenhu a hokwa ofuka. Ndelenee Jakob okwa li omulumenhu e hole ombili, a hokwa okukala peumbo.
Ndele Isak okwa li e hole Esau, osheshi ye okwa li e na ounyenye wombelela yoifitukuti. Ndelenee Rebeka okwa li e hole Jakob.
Ndele efiku limwe Jakob okwa paka po eendja, naEsau eshi a aluka kofuka, okwa li a fya ondjala.
Opo nee Esau okwa lombwela Jakob ta ti: “Pe nge ndi lye paife oinima oyo itilyana, osheshi ame nda fya ondjala.” (Onghee hano ve mu luka Edom.)
Ndele Jakob okwa nyamukula: “Tu kumaane paife oushiveli woye.”
Ndele Esau okwa nyamukula: “Akutu, ondi na okufya; oushiveli wange otau kwafa shike opo.”
Opo nee Jakob ta nyamukula: “Anene nge paife.” Ndele ye okwe mu anena nokwa landifa po oushiveli waye kuJakob.
Ndele Jakob okwa pa Esau omungome nomakunde. Ndele ye okwa lya nokwa nwa, ndele okwa fikama ndee ta di, po. Osho ngaha Esau a dina oushiveli waye.
26: Oshilongo osha hangika kondjala ya shikula ondjala inya yopomafiku aAbraham. Onghee Isak okwa tembuka, a ya kuAbimelek, ohamba yOvafilisti, kuGerar.
NOmwene okwe mu lihololela ndele ta ti: “Ino ya kuEgipiti. Kala medu olo Ame handi ke ku ulikila.
Kala ngaashi omunailongo moshilongo eshi, ndele ame ohandi ka kala pamwe naave; noludalo loye ohandi ke li pa oilongo ei. Ame ohandi ka wanifa eano nde li anenene xo Abraham.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka hapupalifa oludalo loye li fike peenyofi dokeulu, noludalo loye ohandi ke li pa oilongo ei, nomoludalo loye oiwana aishe yokombada yedu otai ka nangekwa noupuna.
Osheshi Abraham okwa pwilikina ondaka yange nokwa diinina omalombwelo ange noipango yange neenghedimhango dange neemhango dange.”
Osho ngaha Isak a kala muGerar.

Ndele ovalumenhu vomoshilongo osho eshi ve mu pula omwalikadi waye, ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ye omumwameme.” Osheshi ye okwa li a tila okutya: “Ye omwalikadi wange”, osheshi pamwe ovalumenhu vomoshilongo osho otave mu dipaa molwaRebeka. Osheshi Rebeka okwa li muwa.
Ndele ye eshi a kala ko efimbo lile, Abimelek, ohamba yOvafilisti, okwa talela mekende, ndele ta mono Isak ta danauka naRebeka omwalikadi waye.

Ndele Abimelek okwa ifana Isak ndele ta ti: “Tala, ye mboli omwalikadi woye! Omolwashike wa tile: ‘Ye omumwameme?’ Ndele Isak okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: ‘Heeno, ame onda diladila kutya pamwe handi ka dipawa molwaye.’ ”
Ndele Abimelek okwa tya: “Owe tu ninga nee ngahelipi ngaho? Ngeno opa li umwe womovanhu vetu a nangala nomwalikadi woye, ngeno owa eta etimba kombada yetu!”
Opo nee Abimelek okwa yandja ondaka kovanhu vaye, ndele ta ti: “Ou ta kumu omwalikadi womulumenhu ou, ota ka fya doshilielela.”
Isak okwa kuna moshilongo shinya, ndele mudo olo okwa teya oilya lwefele, osheshi Omwene okwe mu nangeka noupuna.
Nomulumenhu ou okwa ehena komesho moupuna nokwa weda ko oupuna koupuna, fiyo a ninga oshipuna shinene.
Ye okwa li e na eedi neengobe novapiya vahapu, onghee Ovafilisti ve mu fila efupandubo.
Ndele omifima adishe odo da xupilwe kovapiya vaxe, momafiku axe Abraham, Ovafilisti ove di fufila ndele tave di yada edu.
Opo nee Abimelek okwa lombwela Isak ta ti: “Dja po pufye, osheshi ove wa punapala, u tu dule.”
Opo nee Isak okwa dja po opo nokwa onga onhanda mefilu laGerar nomo a kala.
Ndele Isak okwa xupulula omifima odo da xupwa momafiku axe Abraham, naado Ovafilisti va fufila konima yefyo laAbraham, ndele te di luku ngaashi xe e di lukile.
Ndele fimbo ovapiya vaIsak tava xupu mefilu, ova mona ofifiya i na omeva taa kunguluka.
Ndele ovafita vomuGerar ova twa eemhata novapiya vaIsak ndele tava ti: “Omeva aa oetu.” Onghee hano ye okwa luka omufima ou Esek, shaashi oko va li tava tu eemhata naye.
Opo nee vo va xupa omufima umwe, nomolwao vo va twa yo eemhata. Onghee hano e u luka Sitna.

Opo nee vo va dja po opo, ndele va ka xupa omufima umwe, ndele wo inave u twila eemhata. Onghee ye e u luka Rehobot ndele ta ti: “Heeno, paamha Omwene e tu pa onhele ya mbwalangadja ndele hatu dulu okuhapupala moshilongo.”
Opo ye a lunduluka po apa ndele ta i kuBerseba.

Nomoufiku tuu ou Omwene okwe liholola kuye ndele ta ti: “Aame Kalunga kaxo Abraham. Ino tila, osheshi Ame ondi li pwoove. Nohandi ke ku nangeka noupuna ndele handi ka hapupalifa oludalo loye omolwaAbraham, omupiya wange.”
Opo nee ye okwa tungila ko oaltari ndele ta ifana edina lOmwene, ndele ta diki ko eefaila daye. Novapiya vaIsak va xupa ko omufima.
Opo nee Abimelek a dja kuGerar e uya kuye pamwe naAhussat, kaume kaye, naPikol, ondjai yaye.
Ndele Isak okwe va pula ta ti: “Omolwashike mwe uya kwaame eshi tamu tondo nge nomwa taataa nge punye?”
Opo nee vo va nyamukula: “Fye otwe shi mona naanaa nokutya, Omwene oku li pamwe naave. Onghee hano fye otwa diladila pa kale eudafano lopakwaana pokati ketu nanye. Fye tu ningeni ehangano:
Nye inamu tu ningila owii nande owasha, ngaashi yo fye inatu ku kuma, noinatu ku ningila sha shii, ouwa auke ndele hatu ku lekele nombili. Ove ou li shili omunangekwa noupuna wOmwene.”
Opo nee ye okwe va telekela oshitelekela. Ndele vo ova lya nova nwa.
Ndele ongula inene va penduka ndele va anenafana eano. Opo nee Isak e va lekela, ndele vo ova dja po puye nombili.
Mefiku tuu olo ovapiya vaIsak ove uya kuye ndele tave mu hepaululile nokutya ova xupa omufima ndele tava ti kuye: “Fye twa mona omeva.”
Ndele ve u luka Seba. Onghee hano oshilando shinya hashi ifanwa Berseba fiyo onena eli.
Esau eshi a wanifa omido omilongo nhee okwa hombola Judit, omona okakadona kaBeeri, Omuheti naBasmat, omona okakadona kaElon, Omuheti.
Ndele vo ova etela Isak naRebeka oudjuu muhapu.
27: Isak eshi a kulupa nomesho aye a wiwika, ita shiiva okumona ko, ye okwa ifana oshiveli shaye, Esau, ndele te shi lombwele ta ti: “Mumwange!” Ndele sho oshe mu nyamukula: “Aame ou!”
Opo nee ye okwa tya: “Tala, ame nda kulupa, inandi shiiva efiku lefyo lange.
Kufa hano paife oiti yoye, onywa yoye nouta woye u ye momufitu u ka kongele nge oshifitukuti,
ndele pakele nge po eendja dinyenye, ngaashi ame ndi di hole; ndele to etele nge ndi lye, opo omwenyo wange u shiive oku ku nangeka noupuna fimbo inandi fya.”
Ndele Rebeka okwa pwilikina eshi Isak a popya nomona waye Esau. Ndele Esau okwa ya momufitu a ka konge oshifitukuti e shi ete.
Opo nee Rebeka okwa popya nomona waye Jakob, ndele ta ti: “Tala, ame nda uda xo a popya nomumwanyoko Esau ndele ta ti:
‘Etele nge oshifitukuti ndele to pakele nge po eendja dinyenye, opo ndi shiive okulya noku ku nangeka noupuna koshipala shOmwene fimbo inandi fya.’
Omumwange, pwilikine nge hano paife, naashi ame handi ku lombwele.
Lotokela paife koikombo u ka tale ko oukombwena vavali vawa, opo ame ndi shiive okupakela po xo eendja dinyenye, ngaashi ye e hole.
Opo u di twale kuxo, e di lye, ye e ku nangeke noupuna fimbo ina fya.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa tya kuina Rebeka: “Tala, mumwameme Esau omulumenhu e na olududi, ndele ame omulumenhu ndi li ngaho.
Pamwe tate ota ka pamhadala nge ndele handi ka ninga omukotokeli momesho aye. Ndele ame handi ke lietela efingo ponhele yenangeko noupuna.”
Ndelenee ina okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Efingo laye nali uye kwaame! Pwilikine nge ashike ndele to i u ke va talele nge.”
Opo nee ye okwa ya e ke va tale ndele te va etele ina. Ndele ina okwe va paka po eendja dinyenye ngaashi xe kwa li e di hole.
Rebeka okwa kufa yo oikutu iwa yaEsau, oshiveli shaye, ei ya li puye meumbo, ndele te i dike Jakob ondenge yaye,
nokwa uvika omake aye nofingo yaye noipa youkombwena,
ndele ye okwa yandja meke laJakob, omona waye, eendja dinyenye nomungome oo a ninga.
Opo nee ye okwe uya kuxe ndele ta ti: “Tate!” Ndele ye ta nyamukula: “Aame ou! Oove lyelye, mumwange?”
Ndele Jakob ta ti: “Aame Esau, oshiveli shoye. Ame nda ninga ngaashi wa lombwela nge. Penduka, u kale omutumba u lye ombelela yoshifitukuti shange opo omwenyo woye u nangeke nge noupuna.”
Opo nee Isak okwa tya komona waye: “Ongahelipi we shi mona diva ngaha, mumwange?” Ndele ye a nyamukula: “Osheshi Omwene Kalunga koye e shi pa nge.”
Ndele Isak okwa ya kuJakob: “Ehena popepi apa, opo ndi shiive oku ku pamhadala mumwange, ngeenge oove tuu shili omumwange Esau.”
Ndele Jakob okwa ehena popepi naxe Isak, ndele ye okwe mu pamhadala ndele ta ti: “Ondaka oyaJakob ndelenee omake aEsau.”
Ndelenee ye ine mu dimbulukwa, osheshi omake aye a li e na olududi ngaashi omake amumwaina Esau. Ndele ye okwe mu nangeka noupuna.
Ye okwa li a pula nokutya: “Oove tuu shili Esau?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Heeno.”

Opo nee ye ta ti: “I etele nge hano, ame ndi lye kombelela yoshifitukuti shomumwange, opo omwenyo wange u shiive oku ku nangeka noupuna.” Ndele ye okwe i mu etela, ndele ye okwa lya. Ye okwe mu etela yo omaviinyu, ndele ye okwa nwa.
Opo nee xe Isak okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Omumwange, ehena oku kwaame u fipe nge komilungu!”

Ndele ye okwa ehena kuye nokwe mu fipa komilungu. Opo nee ye okwa nyika edimba loikutu yaye ndele okwe mu nangeka noupuna ndele ta ti:
“Tala, edimba lomumwange ongaashi edimba lomufitu,
ou wa nangekwa noupuna kOmwene.

Kalunga ne ku pe omume yeulu nomaadi edu
noshishipo shoilya noshomaviinyu.

Oiwana nai ku longele,
nomaludi nae ku twile eengolo.
Ove kala omupangeli wavamwanyoko,
novana vanyoko nave linyongamene poshi koshipala shoye.
Nava fingwe ava tave ku fingi;
ndele nava nangekwe noupuna ava tave ku nangeke noupuna.”
Ndelenee Isak eshi a mana okunangeka noupuna Jakob, naJakob eshi a dja po puxe Isak, mumwaina Esau okwa aluka koukongo,
naye yo okwa paka po eendja dinyenye nokwe di twaalela xe ndele ta ti kuxe: “Tate, penduka u lye kombelela yoshifitukuti shomona woye, opo omwenyo woye u shiive okunangeka nge noupuna.”
Ndele Isak okwe mu pula: “Oove lyelye?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Aame Esau, oshiveli shoye.”

Opo nee Isak okwa haluka unene ndele ta ti: “Olyelye hano ou a kongela nge oshifitukuti ndele ta etele nge? Ndele ame nda lya kwaaishe ei, fimbo ino uya ndee onde mu nangeka noupuna. Ye ota ka kala a nangekwa noupuna.”
Opo nee Esau eshi a uda eendjovo edi daxe Isak, okwa haluka ndele ta ingida pombada nokukwena ndele ta lombwele xe: “Tate, nangeke nge yo noupuna!”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Mumwanyoko okwe ku kengelela nokwe ku nyeka enangeko noupuna.”

Opo nee Esau okwa tya: “Heeno, ye eshi ta ifanwa Jakob, osha twa! Osheshi ye okwa kengelela nge luvali: okwa nyeka nge oushiveli nopaife okwa nyeka nge enangekonoupuna. Nokwe mu pula vali ta ti: Ino fiila nge po nande enangekonoupuna limwe?”

Opo nee Isak okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuEsau: “Tala, ame nde mu tula po omupangeli kombada yoye, ndele onde mu pa ovamwaxe aveshe novapiya, ndele onde mu pa oilya nomaviinyu. Oshike ngeno handi dulu oku ku ningila, mumwange?”
Opo nee Esau okwa pula kuxe ta ti: “Tate, enangekonoupuna limwe alike wa li u kwete? Nangeke nge yo noupuna, tate!” Ndele Esau okwa lila pombada.

Opo nee xe Isak okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuye:
“Onhele yokukala kwoye
otai ka kala kokule nedu liwa
nokokule nomume yokeulu pombada.

Ove oto ka kala nomwenyo
meenghono deongamukonda
ndele to ka longela mumwanyoko.
Ndele tapa kala, ove ngeenge to fi ouladi,
oto ka kandula po ondjoko yaye kofingo yoye.”
Ndele Esau okwa tonda Jakob molwenangeko noupuna, olo xe e mu nangeka noupuna. Ndele Esau okwe lipopila momutima waye: “Omafiku okulila eefya datate ngeenge a fiki, mumwameme Jakob ohandi mu dipaa.”
Ndelenee Rebeka eshi a shiivifilwa omauko aa aEsau, oshiveli shaye, ye okwa ifana ondenge yaye Jakob ndele ta ti kuye: “Tala, mumwanyoko Esau okwe ku kwatela onghone nokwa a hala oku ku dipaa.
Hano mumwange, pwilikine nge paife: Lilongekida, inda onhapo kuHaran, kumumwameme Laban,
ndele kala puye fiyo oupyuhandu wamumwanyoko tau dimi,

fiyo ehandu lamumwanyoko loku ku handukila tali loto, ndele ta dimbwa osho we mu ningila. Opo nee ame ohandi tumu omunhu e ku ile ko. Omolwashike ndi na oku mu kanifa nye amushe vavali mefiku limwe alike?”
Rebeka okwa tya vali kuIsak: “Ame nda loloka omwenyo omolwovana oukadona ava vaHet. Jakob ngeenge ota hombola omwalikadi womoukadona Ovaheti vomoshilongo, omolwashike ndi na okukala vali nomwenyo?”
28: Opo nee Isak okwa ifana Jakob ndele te mu nangeke noupuna. Ndele okwe mu lombwela eendjovo edi ta ti: “Ino hombola omwalikadi womovana vaKaanan.
Lilongekida, inda kuPaddan-Aram, keumbo laBetuel, xe yanyoko, ndele likongela ko omwalikadi movana oukadona vaLaban, mumwaina wanyoko.
Ndele Kalunga Omunaenghono adishe ne ku nangeke noupuna, ne ku pe oludalo noku ku hapupalifa, opo mwoove mu dje oiwana.
Ndele Ye ne ku pe enangeko noupuna laAbraham, ove noludalo loye pamwe naave, opo u shiive okunangala oshilongo shoukwailongo woye, Kalunga e shi pele Abraham.”
Osho ngaha Isak okwa lekela Jakob ndele ye okwa ya kuPaddan-Aram, kuLaban, omona waBetuel, Omuaram, mumwaina waRebeka, ina yaEsau naJakob.

Esau eshi a mona nokutya, Isak okwa nangeka noupuna Jakob nokwe mu tuma kuPaddan-Aram opo e ke likongele ko omwalikadi, naashi e mu nangeka noupuna noku mu lombwela eendjovo edi: “Ino hombola omukainhu womovana oukadona vomuKaanan;”
naashi Jakob a pwilikina xe naina ndele okwa ya kuPaddan-Aram,
naashi Esau a mona nokutya, oukadona vomuKaanan ova li vai momesho axe Isak,
Esau okwa ya kuIsmael ndele ta hombola Mahalat, omona okakadona kaIsmael, omona waAbraham, mumwaina waNebajot, e mu weda po povalikadi vaye vonale.
Ndele Jakob okwa dja muBerseba ndee okwa ya kuHaran.
Opo nee ye okwe uya konhele apa a nangala, osheshi etango ola ningina. Ndele okwa kufa emanya lomomamanya enya nokwe li nangeka koshi yomutwe waye, ndele okwa nangala ko.
Ndele ye okwa twa ondjodi: vati kombada yedu ku na omhani, oxulo yayo ya twa keulu, novaengeli vaKalunga tava londele ko vo tava londolokele ko.
Ndele tala, Omwene okwa kala ofika pombada koxulo yayo ndele ta ti: “Aame Omwene Kalunga kooxo Abraham naKalunga kaIsak. Edu eli wa nangala, Ame ohandi li ku pe, ove mwene noludalo loye.

Noludalo loye otali ka kala ngaashi ondwi yedu, ndele to ka tandavela kouninginino nokoushilo, koumbangalanhu nokoumbuwanhu. Nomwoove nomoludalo loye omapata aeshe okombada yedu otaa ka nangekwa noupuna.

Ndele tala, Ame ondi li pamwe naave, ndele Ame ohandi ke ku amena apeshe apa to i, ndele Ame ohandi ke ku alulila moshilongo eshi. Osheshi Ame itandi ke ku efa, fimbo inandi wanifa eshi nde ku lombwela.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa papuduka meemhofi daye ndele ta ti: “Oshili, Omwene opo e li apa, ame inandi shi shiiva.”
Ndele ye okwa tila ndele ta ti: “Onhele ei oitilifa! Heeno, oyo ongulu yaKalunga noshivelo sheulu.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa penduka ongula inene nokwa kufa emanya olo kwa li a wilika omutwe waye, ndele okwe li dika edimbulukifomanya, ndele okwa tila ko omaadi.
Ndele ye okwa luka onhele ei Betel, ndele edina loshilando eshi nale ola li Lus.
Ndele Jakob okwe liudanekela eudaneko ndele ta ti: “Kalunga ngeenge ta kala pamwe naame ndele ta amene nge mondjila tuu ei handi ende nayo, ndele ta pe nge okulya omungome noikutu yokudjala,
nongeenge nda ka alukila nombili meumbo latate, opo nee Omwene ota ka kala Kalunga kange.
Ndele emanya tuu eli nde li dika edimbulukifomanya otali ka kala ongulu yaKalunga nomwaashishe Ove to pe nge, ame ohandi ke ku pa shili oshitimulongo.”
29: Opo nee Jakob okwa fikama ndele okwa ya, ndee okwa fika moshilongo shovakwaushilo.
Ndele tala, okwa mona omufima moixwa opo pa li pa omba omaufita atatu eedi, osheshi momufima ou vo va xwiila eedi. Nomoshivelo shomufima mwa tulwa emanya lakula.
Ndele ngeenge omaufita aeshe a ongala, ovafita veedi ohava alangatifa po emanya poshivelo shomufima ndele tava xwiile oimuna. Opo nee tava shunifa po emanya poshivelo shomufima ponhele yalo.
Opo nee Jakob okwa tya kuvo: “Vakwetu, nye ovapeni?” Ndele vo ova nyamukula tava ti: “Fye otwa dja kuHaran.”
Ndele ye okwe va pula ta ti: “Laban yaNahor omu mu shii?” Ndele vo ova nyamukula, tava ti: “Fye otu mu shii.”
Ye okwe va pula vali ta ti: “Oku li tuu nawa?” Ndele vo ova nyamukula tava ti: “Heeno, oku li nawa. Nomona waye okakadona, Rakel, oyoo te uya needi.”
Ndele ye ta ti: “Omutenya natango; inali toka natango okukongelela oimuna. Xwiileni eedi di ka lye.”
Opo nee vo ova nyamukula, tava ti: “Fye ihatu shi dulu, ofimbo omaufita aeshe inaa ongala. Opo nee hatu alangatifa po emanya poshivelo shomufima, ndele hatu xwiile eedi.”
Fimbo ye ta popi natango navo, Rakel okwe uya pamwe needi daxe, osheshi ye okwa li ha lifa eedi.

Jakob eshi a mona Rakel, omona okakadona kaLaban, omumwaina waina, noimuna yaLaban, mumwaina waina, okwa lotoka nokwa alangatifa po emanya poshivelo shomufima ndele ta xwiile oimuna yaLaban, mumwaina waina.
Ndele Jakob okwa fipa Rakel komilungu ndee ta lili pombada.
Ndele Jakob okwa hepaululila Rakel nokutya, ye omutekulu waxe nomona waRebeka. Opo nee Rakel okwa tondoka ndele okwe ke shi hepaululila xe.

Laban eshi a uda eenghundana edi daJakob, omona wamumwaina, okwa endelela oku mu shakeneka, ndele okwe mu papatela mofingo nokwe mu fipa komilungu nokwe mu twala meumbo laye. Jakob okwa hepaululila Laban oinima aishe ngaashi ya shikulafana.
Opo nee Laban okwe mu lombwela: “Oshili, ove ekipa lange nombelela yange.” Ndele ye a kala puye ohani aishe.
Opo nee Laban okwa lombwela Jakob: “Ove u longele nge ngeno oshali shaashi ove omukwetu? Lombwele nge eshi wa hala, ondjabi yoye.”
Ndele Laban okwa li e na ovana vavali oukadona, edina lomukulunhu oLea, nedina londenge oRakel.
Ndele Lea okwa li e na omesho haa fiike, ndelenee Rakel okwa li muwa kolutu nokoshipala.
Ndele Jakob okwa li e hole Rakel, onghee hano okwa ti: “Ame ohandi ke ku longela omido heyali molwaRakel, onghelo yoye.”
Opo nee Laban okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Oku mu ku pa oshi dule handi mu yandje komulumenhu umwe. Kala pwaame.”
Osho ngaha Jakob a longa omido heyali opo a pewe Rakel. Ndele do da li momesho aye ngaashi omafiku avali, shaashi ye okwa li e mu hole.
Opo nee Jakob okwa lombwela Laban ndele ta ti: “Pe nge nee omwalikadi wange, osheshi efimbo loku mu longela ola pwa ko opo ndi shiive okuya naye.”
Opo nee Laban okwa ongela ovalumenhu aveshe vomomukunda nokwa longekida oshivilo.
Ndelenee onguloshi ye okwa kufa omona okakadona Lea nokwe mu eta kuJakob. Ndele Jakob okwa nangala naye.
(Ndele Laban okwa li e mu pa omupika waye omukainhu Silpa, a ninge omupika womona waye Lea.)
Ndele mefiku lomongula, tala ko, opa li Lea! Onghee hano Jakob okwa lombwela Laban ta ti: “Paife hano owa ninga nge ngahelipi? Ame ondi shii onde ku longelela Rakel? Omolwashike wa kengelela nge?”
Ndele Laban okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Kashi fi onghedi yetu okuhombolifa onghelo komesho yoshiveli.
Wanifa oshivike shoshivilo shehombolo pamwe naye. Opo nee fye ohatu ku pe mukwao yo ngeenge to longo natango omido heyali pwaame.”
Ndele Jakob osho a ninga. Ye okwa wanifa oshivike ashishe shoshivilo shehombolo pamwe naau. Opo nee Laban e mu pa omona waye okakadona Rakel a ninge omwalikadi waye.
(Ndele Laban okwa pa omona waye Rakel omupika waye omukainhu Bilha, a ninge omupika waRakel.)
Ndele ye okwa ya mo yo kuRakel, ndele okwa li e hole Rakel komesho yaLea. Ndele Jakob okwa longela vali Laban omido heyali.
Ndele Omwene eshi a mona nokutya, Lea okwa li ehe holike, Ye okwe mu pa oludalo. Ndelenee Rakel okwa li ongadji.
Ndele Lea okwa ninga oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati nokwe ka luka Ruben. Osheshi ye okwa tya: “Oshili Omwene okwa mona oluhepo lange, ndelenee paife omulumenhu wange ota ka kala e hole nge.”
Ndele ye okwa ninga vali oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati ndele ta ti: “Oshili, Omwene okwa uda nokutya, ame omudinwa, nokwa pa nge vali ou.” Ndele ye okwe ka luka Simeon.

Ndele ye okwa ninga vali oufimba ndele okwa dala okaana okamati ndele ta ti: “Paife eshi omulumenhu wange ota ka kala e hole nge, shaashi ame nde mu dalela ounona oumati vatatu.” Onghee hano okwe ka luka Levi.
Ndele ye okwa ninga vali oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati ndele ta ti: “Paife ame ohandi ka hambelela Omwene.” Onghee hano e ka luka Juda. Ndele ye okwa ka oludalo.
30: Ndele Rakel eshi a mona nokutya, ye ita dalele Jakob ounona, okwa twila mumwaina ondubo ndele ta lombwele Jakob: “Pe nge oludalo, ngeenge hasho ohandi fi.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa handukila Rakel ndele ta pula: “Ame omuponhele waKalunga mbela, ou ine ku pa oludalo?”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Omupika wange Bilha ou; inda muye, opo ye a shiive okudalela mekolo lange, naame ndi mone oludalo muye.”
Opo nee ye okwe mu pa omupika waye Bilha ongomwalikadi waye, ndele Jakob okwa ya muye.
Ndele Bilha okwa ninga oufimba nokwa dalela Jakob okaana okamati.
Opo nee Rakel okwa tya: “Kalunga okwa yukifa oshinima shange nokwa uda nge nokwa pa nge okaana okamati.” Onghee e ka luka Dan.
Ndele Bilha, omupika waRakel, okwa ninga vali oufimba nokwa dalela Jakob okaana okamati okativali.
Opo nee Rakel okwa tya: “Ame nda kondja nomumwameme neenghono, ndele nda findana.” Nokwe ka luka Naftali.
Ndelenee Lea eshi a mona nokutya ye okwa ka oludalo, okwa kufa omupika waye omukainhu, Silpa, ndele te mu pe Jakob ongomwalikadi waye.
Ndele Silpa, omupika waLea, okwa dalela Jakob okaana okamati.
Opo nee Lea okwa tya: “Elao!” Ndele e ka luka Gad.
Opo nee Silpa, omupika waLea, okwa dalela Jakob okaana okamati okativali.
Opo nee Lea okwa tya: “Ame omunelao, osheshi oukadona tava ka ifana nge omunelao!” Ndele ye e ka luka Asser.
Ndele efiku limwe Ruben okwa ya ko mefimbo leteyo loilya nokwa mona moixwa omidi dohole ndele e di twaalela ina Lea. Opo nee Rakel okwa tya kuLea: “Pe nge momidi dohole domumwoye.”

Ndelenee ye okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuye: “Inashi wana ngeno, eshi wa kufa nge omulumenhu wange, eshi wa hala okukufa vali oiimati yohole yomumwange?” Ndele Rakel okwa tya: “Ondi na shike, na nangale naave oufiku wonena molwomidi dohole yomumwoye.”

Jakob eshi a aluka kepya onguloshi, Lea okwa ya e ke mu shakeneke neendjovo edi: “Ou na okuuya kwaame, osheshi pauyuki onde ku lilandela nomidi dohole domumwange.” Ndele ye okwa nangala naye oufiku oo.
Ndele Kalunga okwa uda Lea. Ye okwa ninga oufimba nokwa dalela Jakob okaana okamati okatitano.
Opo nee Lea ta ti: “Omwene okwa pa nge ondjabi, eshi nda pa omulumenhu wange omupika wange.” Ndele ye okwe ka luka Isaskar.
Ndele Lea okwa ninga vali oufimba nokwa dalela Jakob okaana okamati okatihamano.
Opo Lea okwa tya: “Kalunga okwa pa nge ondjabi ya wapala. Paife omulumenhu wange ota ka kala pwaame, shaashi onde mu dalela ovana ovamati vahamano.” Nokwe ka luka Sebulon.
Konima yaava ye a dala okaana okakadona nokwe ka luka Dina.
Ndelenee Kalunga okwa dimbulukwa yo Rakel, e mu uda ndele e mu pa oludalo.
Ye okwa ninga oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati. Opo ye okwa tya: “Kalunga okwa kufa po odino yange.”
Nokwe ka luka Josef, ndele ta ti: “Omwene na wedele nge vali okaana okamati!”
Ndele Rakel eshi a dala Josef, Jakob okwa tya kuLaban: “Lekele nge, ndi shiive okuya keumbo lange nokoshilongo shetu.
Pe nge ovalikadi vange novana vange molwavo nde ku longela, ndi shiive okuya, osheshi ove mwene ou shi shii nhumbi nde ku longela.”
Opo nee Laban e mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Ngeno ndi filwe onghenda momesho oye, osheshi ame onde shi koneka nokutya, Omwene okwa nangeka nge noupuna molwoye.”
Ndele okwa tya vali: “Pule nge ondjabi ei wa hala, naame ohandi i ku pe.”
Opo nee Jakob okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Ove mwene ou shi shii nhumbi nde ku longela noimuna yoye nhumbi ya hapupala momake ange.
Osheshi oyo ya li inini fimbo ame inandi uya, ndele yo oya hapupala unene. Ndele Omwene okwe ku nangeka noupuna keshe apa ame nda enda. Onaini handi ka longela yo eumbo lange mwene?”

Ndele ye okwa pula: “Oshike ndi na oku ku pa hano?” Opo nee Jakob okwa nyamukula: “Ino pumbwa okupa nge nande osha. Ngeenge oto itavelele nge eshi, ame nda hala komesho yo okulifa eedi noikombo yoye, heeno, okukala noshisho shayo,
onena eli ame ohandi ka ya meedi doye adishe nohandi tongola mo odo doimbafifi nodomavala, noudjona valaula nosho yo oikombo aishe oimbafifi noyomavala, oyo i ninge ondjabi yange.

Ndele ouyuki wange otau ka holoka opo: Ove ngeenge to uya okutala nomesho oye mwene ondjabi yange. Keshe eshi shihe na ouvala nomavala moikombo yange, noudjona vehe fi valaula moudjona vange, ovomoulunga.”
Opo nee Laban a nyamukula ta ti: “Eewa, nashi ningwe paendjovo doye!”

Mefiku tuu olo Laban okwa tongola mo oikombo yoindume youtotone noyomavala, noikombo aishe yoikadi youtotone noyomavala. Aishe oyo ya li i na ouvala nande ovanini, noudjona valaula, ndele te va yandje momake ovana vaye.
Ndele pokati kavo naJakob okwa kaleka po onhele yondjila yokweendwa omafiku atatu. Ndele Jakob okwa lifa eedi dikwao daLaban.
Opo nee Jakob okwa kufa outi vatalala vomiti domipopel novomiamandel novomiplatani, ndele te va ningi omakonda matoka moku va yuuna oipeta.
Outi ava va yuunwa okwe va tula momatemba okuxwiila, omo oimuna hai uya okunwa opo i kale i va wete eshi tai nu. Ndele outi ava ova feka oudjona vaadi di fimba eshi tadi nu.
Hano osho ngaha da dala oudjona vomavala, voutotone novomapolo va fekwa kouti.
Opo nee Jakob okwa tongola mo oudjona noipala yeedi okwe i taalelifa odo douvala nodomavala malaula domeedi daLaban. Hano osho ngaha e di tongolela oyuunda, ye ine di tula meedi daLaban.
Ndele keshe efimbo lokukulifa kweedi edi da pama, Jakob okwe di shingila komatemba omo mu na outi opo oudjona va fekwe.
Ndele odo inadi pama ye ine va tula komesho yado. Osho ngaha odo inadi pama da ninga daLaban, naado da pama odaJakob.
Osho ngaha omulumenhu okwa punapala unene nokwe lilikolela eedi dihapu novapika ovakainhu novalumenhu neengamelo neendongi.
31: Ndelenee Jakob okwa kundana eendjovo dovana ovamati vaLaban, nokutya, tava ti: “Jakob okwa kufa ashishe eshi sha li shatate. Noupuna waye aushe ou e u lilikolela mwaashi shatate.”
Jakob okwa koneka yo kutya oshipala shaLaban kashi li vali ngaashi ongheleinya.
Ndele Omwene okwa tya kuJakob: “Shuna koshilongo shooxo nokepata leni. Naame ohandi ka kala pamwe naave.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa tuma Rakel naLea, ve uye kofuka keedi daye,
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ame onda koneka koshipala shaxo nokutya, ye ke li vali naame ngaashi onghela nongheleinya, ndelenee Kalunga katate okwa kala naame.
Nanye vene omu shi shii nokutya, ame onda longela xo neenghono dange adishe.
Ndelenee xo okwa kengelela nge. Lwomulongo ye a lundulula ondjabi yange. Ndelenee Kalunga ine shi itavela, ye a ningile nge owii.
Ye eshi a tile: ‘Odo doutotone nadi ninge ondjabi yoye,’ oshuunda ashishe osha dala odo doutotone. Ndele eshi a tya: ‘Odo domapolo nadi ninge ondjabi yoye,’ oshuunda ashishe osha dala omapolo.
Hano osho ngaha Kalunga a kufa xo oimuna nokwe i pa nge.
Fiku limwe, mefimbo leedi da dikula, onda twa ondjodi, nda tala eemhedi deedi da hala oluhambo, da li domavala nodoutotone nodomapolo.
Ndele omweengeli waKalunga okwa lombwela nge mondjodi ta ti: ‘Jakob!’ Ndele nda nyamukula: ‘Aame ou!’
Ndele ye ta ti: ‘Yelula omesho oye, u tale: eemhedi adishe odo tadi hambe domavala nodoutotone nodomapolo. Osheshi ame onde i mona aishe ei Laban e ku ningila.
Aame Kalunga komuBetel, omo wa vaekela emanya ledimbulukifo nowa udanekela nge eudaneko. Hano fikama u dje mo moshilongo eshi, u shune koshilongo oko wa dalelwa.’ ”
Ndele Rakel naLea va nyamukula, tava ti: “Fye otu na vali oshitukulwa ile efyuululo latate?
Fye inatu ninga mbela ovanailongo momesho aye, ye eshi e tu landifa po, noupuna oo e tu landa po, okwe u lya po?
Osheshi oupuna aushe Kalunga e u kufa tate, otau ningi wetu nowovana vetu. Ninga ashike osho ashishe osho Kalunga e ku lombwela.”
Opo nee Jakob e lilongekida ndele a londeka keengamelo ovana vaye novalikadi vaye.
Ndele okwa kufa oimuna yaye aishe nomaliko aeshe aa e lilikolela, oimuna yaye, ei e lilikolela muPaddan-Aram a ye kuxe Isak medu laKaanan.
Fimbo Laban a ya a ka kulule eedi daye, Rakel okwa vaka mo oiketi yaxe.
Ndele Jakob okwa kengelela Laban, Omuaram, eshi ine mu shiivifila nokutya ye ta ka ya onhapo.
Osho hano a ya onhapo naashishe ye e kwete. Ye okwe lilongekida ndele ta tauluka Eufrat nokwa yukilila a taalela eemhunda daGilead.
Ndele mefiku etitatu Laban okwa lombwelwa nokutya, Jakob okwa ya onhapo.
Opo nee ye okwa kufa ovalumenhu ovakwao vaye nokwa ya navo oku mu shikula, oule wondjila u fike pomafiku aheyali ndele okwe mu hanga keemhunda daGilead.
Ndelenee Kalunga okwe uya oufiku kuLaban Omuaram mondjodi ndele te mu lombwele: “Likelela uha popye naJakob nande ouwa ile owii.”
Ndele Laban okwa fika kuJakob. Jakob okwa li a onga onhanda yaye meemhunda naLaban pamwe novalumenhu vaye va onga onhanda meemhunda daGilead.
Opo nee Laban okwa lombwela Jakob ndele ta ti: “Oshike wa ninga eshi wa kengelela nge nowa twala ovana oukadona vange eenghwate domoita?
Oshike we livakela nowa kengelela nge ino lombwela nge sha, opo ndi ku findikile nokukuwilila nokwiimba nokushika enghuma nokaxumbafeta?
Navali ove ino efa nge ndi fipe komilungu dovatekulu vange nodovana vange oukadona. Heeno, owa ninga nai.
Ame ondi na eenghono oku mu monifa oixuna, ndelenee Kalunga kooxo okwa lombwela nge oufiku wonena ndele ta ti: ‘Likelela uha popye naJakob nande ouwa ile owii.’
Heeno, hano ove ou li mondjila, eshi wa djuulukwa unene keumbo laxo. Ndelenee omolwashike mwa vaka po oiketi yange?”
Opo nee Jakob okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuLaban: “Osheshi nda tila, hai ti pamwe ove to ka kufa nge ovana voye oukadona keenghono.

Ndelenee ou ta monika e na oiketi yoye ke na okukala nomwenyo! Hadahada hano moipafi yovalumenhu voye, eshi shi li pwaame, ndele kufa mo ei yoye.” Ndelenee Jakob ina shiiva nokutya Rakel oye e i vaka po.
Opo nee Laban okwa ya mofaila yaJakob nomofaila yaLea nomofaila yovapika venya vavali, ndelenee ina mona mo sha. Ndele ye eshi a pita mo mofaila yaLea okwa ya mofaila yaRakel.
Ndelenee Rakel okwa li a kufa po oiketi nokwe i holeka momutumba wongamelo ndele ta kala omutumba kuwo. NaLaban okwa hadahada ofaila aishe, ndelenee ina mona mo sha.
Opo nee Rakel okwa lombwela xe: “Omwene wange, ino ninga omwenyo mwii, tala, ame itandi dulu okufikama.” Osheshi ondi na eshi shopakainhu! Ndele ye okwa konga, ndelenee ina mona oiketi yaye.
Opo nee Jakob okwa handuka ndele okwa twa eemhata naLaban. NaJakob okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuLaban: “Etauluko lange olilipipo, etimba lange lilipi, eshi ove wa shikula nge ngaha mehandu?
Paife eshi wa hadahada moinima yange aishe, oshike shoye wa mona mo? Shi tula apa moipafi yovalumenhu vange noyovalumenhu voye, nava tokole pokati ketu naave.
Omido omilongo mbali ame nda kala pwoove. Eedi doye eenghadi noikombo yoye oikadi inandi i wifa omadimo, needi doye eendume inandi di lya po.
Odo da lika koilyani, inandi di ku etela, nda li ndi na oku di futa. Ove owe di fininika meke lange, ngeenge da vakwa po omutenya ile oufiku.
Omutenya onda fya omutenya, noufiku onda fya outalala weandu, nomomesho ange inamu ya nande eemhofi.
Omido omilongo mbali nda kala meumbo loye. Omido omulongo nanhee nde ku longelela ovana voye vavali oukadona, nomido hamano molweedi. Ndele ove owa lundulula ondjabi yange lwomulongo.

Ngeno Kalunga katate, Kalunga kaAbraham netilo laIsak ina kala kombinga yange, heeno, ngeno owa lekela nge hamakasha. Kalunga okwa mona oluhepo lange noshilonga shange shidjuu shomake ange, Ye okwa tokola oshinima oufiku wonena.”

Opo nee Laban ta nyamukula ta ti kuJakob: “Oukadona ovo ovana vange, novamati ovo ovana vange, eedi odo eedi dange, heeno, ashishe eshi to shi tale, oshange. Ndelenee ame ohandi dulu shike novana vange oukadona novana vavo?
Ila hano, tu ninge ehangano, fye naave, opo li kale ondobwedi pokati ketu naave.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa kufa emanya nokwe li dika edimbulukifomanya.
Ndele Jakob okwa lombwela ovanhu vaye: “Eteni omamanya!” Ndele vo va ya va ka tale omamanya. Ndele a ninga onduba ndele va lila popepi nayo.
Ndele Laban okwe i ifana Jegar-Sahaduta, ndelenee Jakob e i luka Galed.
Opo nee Laban ta ti: “Onduba ei oyo ondobwedi pokati ketu naave.” Onghee ove i luka Galed.
Ndele onduba ei yomamanya ove i luka Mispa, osheshi ye okwa ti: “Omwene na ninge Omunangeli pokati ketu naave, eshi hatu tukauka.
Ngeenge to hepeke ovana vange oukadona, ndele to hombola ovalikadi ponhele yovana vange, kape nomunhu nande e li po, tala, Kalunga Oye ondobwedi pokati ketu naave.”
Laban okwa tya vali kuJakob: “Tala onduba yomamanya opo i li apa, nosho yo edimbulukifomanya nde li dika pokati ketu naave.
Onduba ei yomamanya oyo ondobwedi, nedimbulukifomanya olo ondobwedi nokutya, ame itandi ke uya kwoove nokutauluka onduba ei, naave ito uya kwaame nokutauluka onduba ei nedimbulukifomanya nomauko mai.
Kalunga kaAbraham naKalunga kaNahor, Kalunga kooxo, ye na kale omutokoli pokati ketu.” Ndele Jakob okwa anena etilo laxe Isak.
Opo nee Jakob okwa yambela komhunda etomenoyambo, nokwa ifana ovalumenhu vaye keendja. Ndele vo va lya ndele va kala komhunda oufiku ou.
Ndelenee ongula inene Laban okwa penduka ndele okwa fipa ovana vaye ovamati novana vaye oukadona komilungu ndee okwe va nangeka noupuna. Opo nee Laban okwa fikama ndele okwa shuna konhele yaye.
32: Jakob okwa twikila olweendo laye novaengeli vaKalunga ve mu shakeneka.
Ye, eshi e va mona, okwa ti: “Olo etanga lovakwaita vaKalunga!” Ndele ye okwa luka onhele ei Mahanaim.
Ndele Jakob okwa tuma ovatumwa komesho kumumwaina Esau moshilongo shaSeir medu laEdom.
Ndele okwe va lombwela eendjovo edi: “Omu na okulombwela Esau, tamu ti: ‘Omwene wetu ota ti ngaha: Jakob, omupiya woye, ota ti: “Onda kala omunailongo puLaban, noko nda kala fiyo opaife,
ndele ame onde lilikolela eengobe neendongi, eedi noikombo novapika ovalumenhu novakainhu, ndele ohandi shi shiivifile omwene wange, opo ndi filwe onghenda momesho aye.” ’ ”
Ndele ovatumwa va aluka kuJakob ndele tava ti: “Fye otwa ile kumumwanyoko Esau, ndele ye ote uya e ku shakeneke novalumenhu omafele ane pamwe naye.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa tila unene nokwa kwatwa koumbada, ndele ye okwa tukula ovanhu ava va li puye nosho yo eedi noikombo neengobe neengamelo meenhanda mbali.
Osheshi ye okwa diladila: “Esau ngeenge okwa tondokele monhanda imwe ndele te i hanauna po, onhanda ikwao otai i onhapo.”
Ndele Jakob okwa tya: “Akutu, Kalunga katate Abraham naKalunga katate Isak! Akutu Omwene, Oove wa lombwela nge: ‘Shuna koshilongo sheni nokepata leni, ndele Ame ohandi ku ningile ouwa.’
Ame inandi wanena onghenda aishe noudiinini aushe Ove we u ningila omupiya woye. Osheshi ame onda tauluka Jordan ndi na odibo aike, ndele paife onda ninga eenhanda mbali.
Xupife nge meke lamumwameme, meke laEsau, osheshi ame ohandi mu tila, ye ote uya okudipaa nge, nooina pamwe nounona vavo.
Oove mwene wa tile: ‘Oshili Ame ohandi ke ku ningila ouwa nokuhapupalifa oludalo loye li fike pefuta, lo itali dulu okuvalwa molwouhapu walo.’ ”
Ndele ye okwa kala ko oufiku. Ndele moinima ei e kwete a kufa mo omilongelo damumwaina Esau:
oikombo oikadi omafele avali noikombo oindume omilongo mbali, eedi omafele avali neemhedi omilongo mbali,
eengamelo eenyali omilongo nhatu novana vado, eengobe eedidi omilongo nhee, neemhedi omulongo, eendongi eenghadi omilongo mbali noundongwena omulongo.
Nokwe di yandja kovapiya vaye, keshe ongudu tai likalele nokwa lombwela ovapiya vaye: “Tetekelei nge komesho, nopokati kongudu nongudu napa kale onhele.”
Opo nee ye okwa lombwela ou wotete ndele ta ti: “Mumwameme Esau ngeenge te ku shakeneke ndele te ku pula ta ti: ‘Ove owalyelye noto i peni, noimuna oyo to shingi, oyalyelye?’
Opo nee u na okunyamukula: ‘Oyo oyomupiya woye Jakob. Yo omilongelo te di tumine omwene waye Esau, ndele tala, ye mwene ote tu shikula.’ ”
Ndele ye okwa lombwela yo omutivali nomutitatu naaveshe ava va shinga eengudu doimuna, ndele ta ti: “Osho ngaha mu na okunyamukula Esau ngeenge tamu mu mono,

nye mu na okutya: ‘Tala, omupiya woye Jakob ote uya yo, te tu shikula.’ ” Osheshi ye okwa diladila: “Ame onda hala oku mu handukulula nomilongelo edi tadi tetekele nge, osheshi ame ohandi ka tala oshipala shaye, pamwe ta ka fila nge onghenda.”
Osho hano ngaha omilongelo de mu tetekela, ndele ye mwene okwa kala oufiku monhanda.
Ndele oufiku tuu ou okwa penduka ndele ta tauluka okamulonga kaJabbok pamwe novalikadi vaye vavali novapika vaye vavali novana vaye omulongo naumwe.
Ndele ye okwe va kufa nokwe va taulukifa omulonga, nosho okwa twala ko aishe ei kwa li e i na.
Ndele Jakob ye aeke okwa kala ko. Nomulumenhu umwe okwa kondja naye fiyo eluwa la tenda.
Ndele winya eshi a mona nokutya, ite mu te, okwe mu denga ponho, ekipa lonho yaJakob ola domoka, ye eshi ta kondjo naye.
Opo nee winya ta ti: “Efe nge, osheshi eluwa la tenda.” Ndelenee ye ta nyamukula: “Itandi ku efa, fimbo ino nangeka nge noupuna.”
Ndele winya okwe mu pula: “Oove lyelye edina loye?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Aame Jakob.”
Opo nee winya ta ti: “Ove ito ka ifanwa vali Jakob, ndelenee Israel. Osheshi ove wa kondja naKalunga novanhu, ndele wa dula.”
Opo nee Jakob ta pula ta ti: “Lombwele nge edina loye!” Ndele Winya okwa nyamukula: “Omolwashike to pula edina lange?” Ndele opo tuu opo Winya okwe mu nangeka noupuna.
Onhele ei Jakob okwe i luka Penuel, osheshi, ngaashi a tile: “fye naKalunga otwa talafana oshipala noshipala, nonande ongaha,” ame onda xupa ndi na omwenyo.
Hano ye eshi a pitilila puPenuel, etango ola pita. Ndele ye okwa shongola monho.
Onghee hano ovana vaIsrael ihava li olufipa lomonho, nomifipa odo tadi yukilile monho fiyo onena eli. Shaashi ye okwa denga Jakob monho, polufipa lonho.
33: Ndele Jakob okwa yelula omesho ndele eshi a mona Esau te uya novalumenhu omafele ane pamwe naye, okwa tukulila Lea naRakel novapika vaye vavali ovana.
Ndele okwa pitifa komesho ovapika novana vavo, nova shikulwa kuLea novana vaye; naRakel okwe va shikula konima naJosef.
Ndelenee ye mwene okwe va tetekela nokwe linyongamena poshi luheyali kuye, fiyo ye e uya popepi a fika kumumwaina.
Opo nee Esau okwa endelela, ndele ta i kuye ndele te mu papatele nomaoko ndele te mu dingatele mofingo ndele te mu fipi komilungu. Vo ova lila.

Hano Esau eshi a yelula omesho aye ndele ta mono ovalikadi novana, okwa pula ta ti: “Ovo oolyelye ve li pamwe naave?” Ndele Jakob okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ovo ovamwange, ava Kalunga konghenda yaye a pa omupiya woye.”
Novapika ovakainhu va ehena pamwe novana vavo ndele vo ve linyongamena poshi.
NaLea pamwe novana vaye va ehena ndee vo ve linyongamena poshi. Vo ova shikulwa kuJosef naRakel ndele vo ve linyongamena poshi.
Opo nee Esau ta ti: “Osheendo shinya sha shakeneka nge, oshashike nowa hala shike?” Ndele Jakob a nyamukula ta ti: “Ndi filwe onghenda momesho omwene wange.”
Ndelenee Esau okwa tya: “Ame onda wanifa eliko, mumwameme! Kala noinima yoye!”

Opo nee Jakob okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ahowe tuu! Ngeenge onda mona onghenda momesho oye, tambula omilongelo edi meke lange. Ame onda mona oshipala shoye ngaashi omunhu ta mono oshipala shaKalunga, nowa fila nge onghenda.
Hano tambula omilongelo wa etelwa, osheshi Kalunga okwa punika nge, ame nda wana, nda wanenena pombada.” Ndele okwe mu fininika fiyo ye te di tambula.
Opo nee Esau okwa tya: “Tu fikameni tu eheneni komesho. Ame ohandi ku kwatele komesho.”

Ndelenee Jakob okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omwene wange, owa shiiva nokutya ounona inava pama nondi na eedi neengobe tadi nyamifa. Omunhu ngeenge okwe di shingilile nande efiku limwe alike, oimuna aishe otai fi.
Omwene wange na tetekelele omupiya waye, naame ohandi ka enda nokushikula paenghono doimuna nopaenghono dounona, fiyo handi ke uya komwene wange muSeir.”
Opo nee Esau ta ti: “Itavele nge ndi ku fiile ovanhu vamwe.” Ndee ye okwa nyamukula: “Ovokulonga shike? Onda hala ashike ndi filwe onghenda momesho oye, omwene wange.”
Osho hano mefiku tuu olo Esau okwa shuna ko nokwa ya nondjila yaye kuSeir.
Ndele Jakob okwa ya kuSukkot. Ye okwe lidikila ko eumbo, noimuna okwe i dikila oyuunda. Onghee onhele oyo tai lukwa Sukkot.
Ndele Jakob okwa fika nawa koshilando shaSekem, moshilongo shaKaanan, eshi a dile muPaddan-Aram. Nokwa onga onhanda komesho yoshilando.
Onhele oyo muyo a onga onhanda, okwe i lilandela kovana vaHamor, xe yaSekem noimaliwa efele limwe.
Ndele oko a tungila oaltari nokwe shi luka: Kalunga kaIsrael, Oye Kalunga!
34: Ndele Dina, omona waLea, ou a dalela Jakob, okwa ya a ka talele po ovalikadi vomoshilongo.
Opo nee Sekem, omona waHamor, Omuhevi, ohamba yoshikandjo, eshi e mu mona, ye okwe mu kwata ndele ta nangala naye kefininiko.
Ndele omwenyo waye wa kwatafana naDina yaJakob. Ndele ye okwa li e hole okakadona aka nokwa hafifa omutima wokakadona.
Sekem okwa popya naxe Hamor nokwa tya: “Indilile nge okakadona aka ka ninge omwalikadi wange.”
Jakob eshi a uda nokutya, omona waye Dina okwa fifwa ohoni, ovana vaye ovamati ova li poimuna mofuka. Ndele Jakob okwa mwena fiyo otave uya po.
Ndele Hamor, xe yaSekem, okwa ya kuJakob, a popye naye.

Novana vaJakob ove uya va dja koufita. Vo eshi ve shi uda, ova uda onya nova handuka unene, shaashi ye okwa ninga oshififahoni muIsrael, eshi a nangala nomona waJakob. Osheshi oshilonga sha tya ngaha ihashi longwa nande.
Opo nee Hamor okwa popya navo ndele ta ti: “Omumwange Sekem omwenyo waye okwe u mangeleka kokakadona komoludalo leni, hano mu peni omwalikadi waye.
Ndele tu putulafaneni, nye otamu tu pe ovana veni oukadona, nye otamu putula ovana vetu oukadona.
Kaleni pufye. Oshilongo oshosho, kaleni nokweendaenda musho nokulimonena omapya.”
Ndele Sekem okwa lombwela xe yaDina novamwaxe: “Nandi filwe onghenda momesho eni nakeshe eshi tamu shi pula nge, ame ohandi ke shi yandja.
Pulei nge ofuto ei mwa hala, nomilongelo, naame ohandi ke i mu pa ngaashi tamu lombwele nge; shamha handi pewa okakadona ka ninge omwalikadi wange.”
Opo nee ovana vaJakob va nyamukula Sekem naxe Hamor nelungi, shaashi winya okwa fifa ohoni mumwaina Dina,
ndele tava ti kuvo: “Fye itatu dulu oku shi ninga, tu yandje ngeno omumwameme okakadona komulumenhu ina pita etanda, osheshi oshinima osho oshififahoni kufye.
Ashike ohatu dulu oku shi itavela, ngeenge ovalumenhu aveshe ava ve li mokati keni tava pitifwa etanda.
Opo nee fye ohatu ke mu pa oukadona vetu nafye ohatu ka hombola oukadona veni. Ndele fye ohatu ka kala punye nokuninga oshiwana shimwe.
Ndelenee ngeenge itamu tu pwilikine mu pite etanda, ohatu kufa ko omumwameme okakadona, ndele hatu di po.”
Neendjovo davo oda li diwa momatwi aHamor nomomatwi aSekem, omona waye.
Nomulumenhu omunyasha ina ongaonga oku shi ninga, osheshi ye okwa li e hole unene omona okakadona kaJakob, ndele ye okwa li a fimana komesho yavakwao meumbo laxe.
Opo nee Hamor nomona waye Sekem va ya koshivelo shoshilando shavo ndele va popya novalumenhu vomoshilando shavo, tava ti:

“Ovalumenhu venya ove na ombili nafye. Onghee nava itavelelwe okukala moshilongo nokweendaenda musho. Edu olinene ola mbwalangadja keembinga adishe nokuvo yo. Fye ohatu dulu okuhombola oukadona vavo, nafye natu yandjeni oukadona vetu kuvo.
Ndelenee ovalumenhu venya otava itavele okukala pufye nokuninga oshiwana shimwe nafye, ashike ongeenge ovalumenhu aveshe ava ve li mokati ketu tava piti etanda, ngaashi venya va pita etanda.
Oimuna yavo nomaliko avo noinamwenyo yavo aishe, itai ka ninga ngeno yetu? Natu itaveleni hano, opo va kale pufye.”
Ndele vo ova pwilikina Hamor nomona waye Sekem, aveshe ava va pita mo moshivelo shoshilando. Novalumenhu aveshe va pitifwa etanda, aveshe ava va pita mo moshivelo shoshilando shaye.

Ndelenee mefiku etitatu vo eshi va li nouyehame wokuvela, Simeon naLevi, ovana vavali vaJakob novamwaina vaDina, ova kufa keshe umwe eongamukonda laye, ndele vo va tondokela oshilando, manga inashi fekela sha, ndee vo va dipaa ovalumenhu aveshe.
Vo ova dipaa yo Hamor, nomona waye Sekem keongamukonda. Opo nee va kufa mo Dina meumbo laSekem ndele va dja ko naye.
Ovana ovamati vaJakob va tondokela oonakudipawa ndele va tinha oshilando, osheshi venya ova li va fifa ohoni mumwaina.
Vo ova kufa po eedi davo noikombo yavo, neengobe davo neendongi davo edi da li moshilando naado da li moixwa.
Nomamona avo aeshe novana vavo aveshe novalikadi vavo aveshe ve va twala eenghwate noshihakanwa, nosho yo aishe ei ya li momaumbo.

Opo nee Jakob a lombwela Simeon naLevi ta ti: “Nye omwa twala nge momupya nomokuhandukilwa koonakukala moshilongo eshi nokOvakaanan nokOvaperesi. Ongudu yange oinini. Ngeenge va hangakene nge, otava ka dula nge, naame nepata lange otali ka kombwa po.”
Opo nee vo va nyamukula tava ti: “Omolwashike hano ye a kala namumwameme, ngaashi ta ka kala nombwada?”
35: Opo nee Kalunga okwa lombwela Jakob ta ti: “Lilongekida, inda kuBetel u kale oko. Dikila ko Kalunga oaltari, Kalunga ou e liholola kwoove eshi wa ya onhapo mumwanyoko Esau.”
Jakob okwa lombwela eumbo laye naaveshe ava va li pamwe naye ndele ta ti: “Ekeleishi oihongwakalunga yokoilongo, ei mu kwete mokati keni, lifeteni nye mu djale oikutu imwe.
Tu lilongekideni okuya kuBetel. Ame ohandi ka tungila ko Kalunga oaltari, Kalunga ou a nyamukula nge mefiku loudjuu wange nokwa kala pwaame mondjila ei nda enda.”
Opo nee va yandja kuJakob oikalunga yavo yokoilongo ve i kwete, neelinga domomatwi avo, ndele Jakob e i paka medu momwandi u li muSekem.
Ndele vo eshi va fikama, Kalunga okwa tumina oilando ye va dingilila ehaluko, opo venya vaha shikule ovana vaJakob.
Osho ngaha Jakob a fika kuLus shomuKaanan nokutya, Betel, ye mwene novanhu aveshe ava va li puye.
Ndele oko a tunga oaltari nokwa ifana onhele oyo El Betel, osheshi oko Kalunga e mu lihololelele eshi ye a ile onhapo yamumwaina Esau.
Ndele Debora, omuyakuli waRebeka, okwa fya, ndele ye okwa pakwa momwandi popepi naBetel. Ndele omuti ou ve u luka: “Omwandi wokulilila eefya.”
Opo nee Kalunga okwe lihololela vali Jakob, ye eshi a alukila kuPaddan-Aram, ndele okwe mu nangeka noupuna.
Ndele Kalunga okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Edina loye oJakob, ndele ito ifanwa vali Jakob, ndelenee Israel.” Ndele ye okwe mu luka Israel.
Kalunga okwe mu lombwela vali ta ti: “Aame Kalunga Omunaenghono adishe. Kala u na oludalo u hapupale. Oshiwana, heeno, oiwana tai ka dja mwoove neehamba tadi ka dja momatundji oye.
Nedu olo nde li pele Abraham naIsak, ohandi ke li ku pa, noludalo loye tali ku shikula Ame ohandi ke li li pa.”
Opo nee Kalunga okwa ya pombada nokwe mu fiya po monhele tuu ei Ye a popya naye.
Ndele Jakob okwa dikila monhele oyo Ye a popya naye edimbulukifomanya, nokombada yalo okwa tila ko oikunwayambo nokwa tila ko omaadi.
Ndele Jakob okwa luka onhele oyo apa Kalunga a popya naye Betel.
Opo nee va tembuka muBetel, ndele eshi va li kokule kanini kuEfrat, Rakel okwa hangika kefeto ledimo. Nefeto laye ola li lidjuu unene.
Ndele fimbo oudjuu wefeto wa li unene, omudalifi okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Ino tila, paife ou na vali okaana okamati.”
Ndelenee omwenyo waye eshi tau mu fiye po, osheshi ye okwa li e na okufya, ye okwe ka luka Ben-oni. Ndelenee xe okwe ka luka Benjamin.
Osho hano Rakel okwa fya. Ndele ye okwa pakwa pondjila yokuya kuEfrat, nokutya Betlehem.
Ndele Jakob okwa dikila ko edimbulukifomanya kombila yaye. Fiyo onena eli edimbulukifomanya lokombila yaRakel opo li li.
Ndele Israel okwa fikama a ehene komesho nokwa onga onhanda yaye langhele kwinya kombada yaMigdal-Eder.
Hano Israel fimbo a kala opo, Ruben okwa ya ko a ka nangale naBilha, omwalikadi waxe wopomunghulo, naIsrael okwe shi uda. Ovana ovamati vaJakob ova li omulongo navavali.
Ovana vaLea ovava: Ruben (oshiveli shaJakob), Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isaskar naSebulon.
Ovana vaRakel: Josef naBenjamin.
VaBilha, omupika waRakel, ovava: Dan naNaftali.
VaSilpa, omupika waLea, ovava: Gad naAsser. Ava hano ovo ovana vaJakob, va dalelwa muPaddan-Aram.
Ndele Jakob okwa fika kuxe Isak muMamre puKiriat-Arba, nokutya Hebron, oko Abraham a kala omunailongo nosho yo Isak.
Nomafiku aIsak a li e fike pomido efele nomilongo hetatu.
Ndele Isak okwa fuda mo omhepo yaye nokwa fya, ndele okwa ongelwa kovanepata vaye, a kulupa nokwa kuta omwenyo. Novana vaye ovamati, Esau naJakob ove mu paka.
36: Ndele eli oludalo laEsau, nokutya Edom.
Esau okwa kufa ovalikadi vaye moukadona vomuKaanan: Ada, omona okakadona kaElon, Omuheti, naOholibama, omona okakadona kaAna, omona okakadona kaSibeon, Omuhevi;
naBasmat, omona okakadona kaIsmael, omumwaina waNebajot.
NaAda okwa dalela Esau Elifas, naBasmat okwa dala Rehuel.
Ndele Oholibama okwa dala Jehus naJaelam naKora. Ava ovana vaEsau, ava ve mu dalelwa medu laKaanan.

Opo nee Esau okwa kufa ovalikadi vaye novana vaye ovamati noukadona vaye novanhu aveshe vomeumbo laye, oimuna yaye noinamwenyo yaye aishe nomamona aeshe aye e a likola medu laKaanan, ndele okwa tembukila moshilongo shi li kokule nomumwaina Jakob,
shaashi omamona avo okwa li manene unene, inava dula okukala pamwe, nedu loweendanandjila inali wana kuvo omolwouhapu woimuna yavo.
Ndele Esau okwa ka tula keemhunda daSeir; Esau, nokutya Edom.
Eli oludalo laEsau, xe yOvaedom vokeemhunda daSeir.
Omadina ovana ovamati vaEsau oyaa: Elifas, omona waAda, omwalikadi waEsau. Rehuel, omona waBasmat, omwalikadi waEsau.
Novana ovamati vaElifas ovo: Teman, Omar, Sefo naGaetam naKenas.
Ndele Timna okwa li omwalikadi wopomunghulo waElifas, omona waEsau. Ndele ye okwa dalela Elifas Amalek. Ovo ovana vamati vaAda, omwalikadi waEsau.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaRehuel ovava: Nahat naSera, Samma naMissa. Vo ovana vaBasmat, omwalikadi waEsau.
Ndele ovo ovana ovamati vaOholibama, omona omukainhu waAna, omona omukainhu waSibeon, omwalikadi waEsau; ye okwa dalela Esau Jehus, Jaelam naKora.
Ava eehamba mokati kovana vaEsau. Ovana vaElifas, oshiveli shaEsau: ohamba Teman, ohamba Omar, ohamba Sefo, ohamba Kenas,
ohamba Kora, ohamba Gaetam, ohamba Amalek. Vo eehamba domuElifas medu laEdom. Vo ovana vaAda.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaRehuel, omona waEsau, ovava: ohamba Nahat, ohamba Sera, ohamba Samma, ohamba Missa; odo hano eehamba da dja muRehuel medu laEdom. Vo ovana vaBasmat, omwalikadi waEsau.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaOholibama, omwalikadi waEsau, ovava: ohamba Jehus, ohamba Jaelam, ohamba Kora. Odo hano eehamba da dja muOholibama, omona okakadona kaAna, omwalikadi waEsau.
Ovo hano ovana vaEsau osho yo Edom neehamba davo.
Ovana ovamati vaSeir, Omuhori, oonakukalamo votete medu linya, ovava: Lotan naSobal naSibeon naAna,
naDison naEser naDisan. Ovo eehamba dOvahori, ovana vaSeir medu laEdom.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaLotan va li Hori naHeman. Nomona okakadona kaLotan oye Timna.
Novana ovamati vaSobal ovava: Aluan naManahat naEbal, Shefo naOnam.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaSibeon ovava: Aja naAna. Ana oye ou a mona eefifiya domeva mapyu mofuka, eshi ta lifa eendongi daxe Sibeon.
Novana vaAna: oDison, naOholibama, oye okwa li omona okakadona kaAna.
Novana vaDison ovava: Hemdan naEsban naJitran naKeran.
Ovana vaEser ovava: Bilhan naSaavan naAkan.
Novana vaDisan ovava: Us naAran.
Eehamba dOvahori edi: ohamba Lotan nohamba Sobal nohamba Sibeon nohamba Ana,
nohamba Dison, nohamba Eser, nohamba Disan. Hano eehamba dOvahori pamapata avo medu laSeir.
Neehamba edi odo da pangela oshilongo shaEdom fimbo Ovaisraeli va li inava kala nohamba nande imwe.
Bela, omona waBeor ya pangela muEdom. Nedina loshilando shaye la li Dinhaba.
Ndele konima yefyo laBela, Jobab yaSera wokuBosra okwa pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele konima yefyo laJobab, Husam womedu lOvatemani okwa pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele konima yefyo laHusam, Hadad yaBedad, ou a taataa Ovamidian mofuka yaMoab, okwa pangela ponhele yaye, nedina loshilando oAvit.
Ndele konima yefyo laHadad, Samla wokuMasreka okwa pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele konima yefyo laSamla, Saul wokuRehobot shopuEufrat, okwa pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele konima yefyo laSaul, Baal-Hanan yaAkbor okwa pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele konima yefyo laBaal-Hanan yaAkbor, Hadar okwa pangela ponhele yaye. Nedina loshilando ola li Pau. Nedina lomwalikadi waye ola li Mehetabel, omona okakadona kaMatred, omona waMesahab.
Omadina eehamba domepatalongo laEsau, pashikulafano lomapata ado, leenhele dado nolomadina ado: ohamba Timna, ohamba Alua, ohamba Jetet,
ohamba Oholibama, ohamba Ela, ohamba Pinon,
ohamba Kenas, ohamba Teman, ohamba Mibsar,
ohamba Magdiel, ohamba Iram. Hano odo eehamba domuEsau pashikulafano leenhele dado medu lavo. Osho Esau, oxekulu yOvaedom.
37: Ndele Jakob okwa kala moshilongo shinya, xe a li mo omunailongo, medu laKaanan.

Eli ehepaululo lepata laJakob:
Josef eshi a wanifa omido omulongo naheyali okwa li ha lifa eedi pamwe novamwaxe. Ye okwa li omunyasha natango, nokwa kala pamwe novana vaBilha novaSilpa, ovalikadi vaxe. Ndele Josef okwa hepaululila xe eendjovo dii da popiwa kuvo.
Ndele Israel okwa li e hole Josef komesho yovana vaye aveshe ovamati. Osheshi ye okwa li omona waye womoukulupe waye, ndele Israel okwe mu hondjifila oshikutu shile shi nomaoko male.
Ovamwaxe eshi va mona nokutya, oku holike kuxe komesho yovamwaxe aveshe, vo ove mu tonda, ndele inava shiiva vali okupopya naye nombili.
Josef okwa twa yo ondjodi, ndee okwe i hepaululila ovamwaxe. Onghee tuu vo ve mu tonda unene.
Osheshi ye okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Pwilikineni ondjodi ei nda twa.
Taleni, fye otwa li twa manga oipandi yoilya mepya, opo divadiva oshipandi shange osha kala ofika, fimbo oipandi yeni ye uya ye shi dingilila, ndele yo oye linyongamena koshipandi shange.”
Opo nee ovamwaxe ove mu lombwela tava ti: “Ove oto ke tu pangela mbela ile oto ka ninga ohamba yetu?” Ndele ove mu tonda unene shi dule nale, molweendjodi daye nomolweendjovo daye.
Efiku limwe ye okwa twa vali ondjodi imwe, ndele te i hepaululile ovamwaxe ndele ta ti: “Taleni, ame onda twa vali ondjodi: etango nohani neenyofi omulongo naimwe de linyongamena koshipala shange.”
Ye eshi e shi hepaululila xe novamwaxe, xe okwe mu handukila ndele ta ti kuye: “Ondjodi oyo wa twa oya tya ngahelipi oyo? Fye nanyoko novamwaxo otu na mbela okuuya tu wile eombe koshipala shoye?”
Ndele ovamwaxe ove mu twila ondubo, ndelenee xe okwa dimbulukwa eendjovo odo.
Ndele ovamwaxe va ya va ka life eedi daxe popepi naSekem.
Opo nee Israel okwa lombwela Josef ta ti: “Ovamwaxo otava lifa oimuna popepi naSekem.” Ila, ndi ku tume kuvo. Ndele ye okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Aame ou!”

Opo nee ye okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Inda hano u ka tale ovamwaxo nhumbi ve li, noimuna nhumbi i li, opo u aluke u shiivifile nge.” Osho ngaha hano ye okwe mu tuma a dja mefilu laHebron ndele te uya kuSekem.
Omulumenhu umwe okwe mu shakeneka moixwa, nomulumenhu okwe mu pula ta ti: “Oto kongo shike?”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame ohandi kongo ovamwatate. Lombwele nge apa tava lifa oimuna.”
Opo nee omulumenhu okwe mu lombwela: “Vo ova dja po apa, osheshi ame nda uda tava ti: ‘Natu yeni kuDotan.’ ” Ndele Josef okwa shikula ovamwaxe nokwe va hanga muDotan.
Ndele vo ove mu monena kokule. Ndelenee fimbo ye ina fika kuvo, vo ova pangela omhangela mekengelelo ve mu dipae.
Ndele vo ova tongafana tava ti: “Omutwi weendjodi oyoo ta di oko!
Ne uye tu mu dipaeni fye tu mu ekele melambo, ndele hatu ti kutya oshifitukuti she mu lya po; tu tale nee eendjodi daye eshi tadi wanifwa.”
Opo nee Ruben eshi e shi uda okwe mu xupifa mo momake avo eshi a tya: “Inatu mu dipaeni.”
Ruben okwe va lombwela vali ta ti: “Inamu tilashi ohonde. Mu ekeleni melambo eli li li mofuka, ndelenee nye inamu mu kuma neke,” opo ye a shiive oku mu xupifa momake avo noku mu shunifa kuxe.
Ndele Josef eshi e uya kovamwaxe, ova dula Josef oshikutu shaye shi na omaoko male osho a li a djala.
Ndele vo ove mu kufa ndele ove mu ekela melambo.

Ndele tava kala omutumba tava li eendja. Ndele vo eshi va yelula omesho, ova mona divadiva osheendo shOvaismaeli tashi di kuGilead notashi yuka kuEgipiti. Eengamelo davo da li da humbata eka, nomaadi abalsam noidimba yomirha.
Opo nee Juda okwa lombwela ovamwaxe ta ti: “Otashi tu kwafa shike ngeenge hatu dipaa omumwatate, ndele hatu holeke ohonde yaye?
Ileni, natu mu landife po kOvaismael, ndelenee inatu mu kumeni nomake, osheshi ye omumwatate, onhumba yetu.” Novamwaxe ve mu uda.
Ndele ovashingifi vokuMidian eshi va enda po, vo ova kufa Josef melambo ndele ve mu landifa po kOvaismael neesekeli doshisiliveli omilongo mbali. Ndele vo ova twala Josef kuEgipiti.
Opo nee Ruben eshi e uya kelambo, Josef ine mu hanga mo melambo! Onghee ye okwa pombaula oshikutu shaye,
ndele ye okwa ya kovamwaxe ndele ta ti: “Omumati ke mo! Ame ohandi yuka peni?”
Opo nee vo ova kufa oshikutu shaJosef ndee va dipaa oshikombo ndele va dedaula oshikutu mohonde,
ndele vo ova kufa oshikutu eshi shile ndele tave shi tumine xe neendjovo edi: “Oshikutu eshi otwe shi toola. Tala nawa, ngeenge osho oshikutu shomumwoye.”
Ndele ye eshi e shi tala okwa tya: “Oshikutu oshomumwange! Oshifitukuti she mu lya! A nyanyaulwa. Josef a nyanyaulwa!”
Opo nee Jakob okwa pombaula oikutu yaye ndee okwa djala oshikutu sheefya moshiya. Ndele ye okwa lila omona waye omafiku mahapu.

Novana vaye ovamati aveshe noukadona vaye aveshe va kendabala oku mu hekeleka, ndele ye okwa anya okuhekelekwa, ndele ta ti: “Ahowe, ohandi ka ya komumwange moshovafi nokunyika oluhodi!” Osho ngaha xe okwe mu lila.
Ovamidian ova twala Josef kuEgipiti ndele tave mu landifa po kuPotifar, elenga ekulunhu lomatanga ovanangeli vaFarao.
38: Mefimbo tuu olo Juda okwa dja po povamwaxe nokwa ya komulumenhu womuAdullam nedina laye Hira.
Ndele Juda okwa mona ko omona okakadona komulumenhu Omukaanan nedina lako oSua. Ye okwe mu hombola ndele okwa nangala naye.
Ndele ye okwa ninga oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati, ndele Juda okwe ka luka Er.
Okwa ninga vali oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati ndele Juda okwe ka luka Onan.
Ndele ye okwa dala vali okaana okamati ndele Juda omwalikadi e ka luka Shela. Ndele okwa li muKesib eshi e ka dala.
Ndele Juda okwa kongela oshiveli shaye, Er, omwalikadi, nedina laye oTamar.
Ndelenee Er, oshiveli shaJuda, inashi wapalela Kalunga. Onghee Omwene okwe mu efa a fye.
Opo nee Juda okwa tya kuOnan: “Inda u ka nangale nomwalikadi wamumwanyoko u mu hombole u etele mumwanyoko oludalo.”
Ndelenee Onan okwa li e shi shii nokutya, oludalo itali ka ninga laye, onghee hano keshe efimbo a nangala nomwalikadi wamumwaina, ine mu xuxwila a etele mumwaina oludalo.
Ndele eshi sha ningwa kuye, oshii momesho Omwene. Onghee Ye okwe mu efa a fye.

Opo nee Juda okwa tya kuTamar oshitenya shaye: “Kala ngaashi omufiyekadi meumbo laxo fiyo omona wange Shela ta kulu. Osheshi ye a diladila: ‘Naau yo kashiimba ota fi ngaashi ovamwaina!’ ” Osho ngaha Tamar a ya a ka kale meumbo laxe.

Ndele eshi pa pita efimbo lile, omona okakadona kaSua, omwalikadi waJuda, okwa fya; efimbo lokulila eefya eshi la pwa, ye okwa ya kuTimna, ye pamwe nakaume kaye Hira, Omuadullam, a ka talele po ovakululi veedi.
Ndele vo ova shiivifila Tamar, ndele tava ti kuye: “Tala, xomweno ota i kuTimna a ka kulule eedi daye.”

Opo nee ye okwe lidula oikutu youfiyekadi waye nokwe liuvikila oshiuvikifo nokwe lidingila nasho. Ndele ye okwa ya a ka kale omutumba poshivelo shaEnaim, shi li pondjila yaTimna. Osheshi ye okwa mona nokutya Shela okwa kula, ndelenee ye ine mu pewa omwalikadi waye.
Juda eshi e mu mona, okwa li e shi ye omulandifi woipala, shaashi okwa uvika oshipala shaye;
ndele ye okwa ya kuye pomunghulo wondjila ndele ta ti: “Tu nangale fye naave,” osheshi ye ina shiiva nokutya ye oshitenya shaye. Ndele ye okwa pula: “Oto pe nge shike ngeenge to nangala naame?”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame ohandi ku tumine okakombo kohambo koimuna.” Opo ye ta ti: “Shapo oto pe nge ombabyona, fimbo to ka tumine nge?”

Ndele ye ta ti: “Ombabyona oyashike ngeno handi ku pe?” Opo nee ye a nyamukula ta ti: “Oshihakolinga shoye nokanyemba kasho nodibo yoye, ei i li meke loye.” Ye okwe i mu pa ndele okwa nangala naye, ndele winya okwa pewa oufimba kuye.
Ndele omukainhu okwa penduka ndele okwa ya ndee te lidula oshiuvikifo ndele ta djala oikutu yaye youfiyekadi.
Ndele Juda okwa tuma ko okakombo, e ka pa kaume kaye Omuadullam, e ka fikife ko, opo ye a tambule meke lomwalikadi ombabyona. Ndele ye ine mu mona ko.
Opo nee ye a pula kovanhu onhele yaye ta ti: “Omulandifi woipala winya, ha kala pondjila muEnaim oku li peni?” Ndele venya ova nyamukula tava ti: “Apa ihapa kala omulandi woipala.”
Opo nee ye a shuna nokwa ya kuJuda ndele ta ti: “Ame inandi mu mona. Novanhu vomonhele inya otava ti: ‘Penya ihapa kala omulandifi woipala.’ ”
Opo nee Juda ta ti: “Na kale nayo, fye tuha fifwe ohoni. Tala, ame nde mu tumina okakombo, ndelenee ove ino mu mona.”
Ngeno eshi pa pita eehani nhatu, Juda okwa shiivifilwa nokutya: “Tamar, oshitenya shoye okwa haelwa, nokwa ninga oufimba mokuhaelwa!” Ndele Juda okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Mu twaleni ko a ka xwikwe po.”
Fimbo ta twalwa okwa shiivifila xemweno ndele ta ti: “Oufimba wange owomulumenhu woinima ei!” Ndele ye okwa tya: “Tala hano nawa oshihakolinga eshi nokanyemba aka nodibo ei kutya oyalyelye?”
Ndele Juda okwe i tala ndele ta ti: “Ye omuyuki e dule nge, osheshi ame inandi mu pa omumwange omumati Shela.” Ndele ye ina endafana vali naye.
Ndele ye eshi kwa li e na okudala, medimo laye mwa li epasha.
Ndele fimbo ta dala, kamwe oka eta eke lako, nomudalifi okwe li kwata nokwa mangela ko olufipa litilyana ndele a tya: “Aka oko ka dalwa tete.”
Ndelenee ko eshi ka shunifa mo eke lako, omumwaina okwa dalwa. Ndee ye okwa tya: “Ove we lieta mo ngahelipi!” Ndele vo ove ka luka Peres.
Opo nee mumwaina, ou a li e nolufipa litilyana meke laye, okwa dalwa; ndele ve mu luka Sera.
39: Ndele Josef okwa twalwa kuEgipiti, kuPotifar, elenga laFarao, omukulunhu wetanga lovanangeli vaye, omulumenhu Omuegipiti, oo e mu landa momake Ovaismaeli, ava ve mu twala ko.
Ndele Omwene okwa kala naJosef nokwa li e na elao moilonga yaye aishe nokwa li ha kala meumbo lamwene waye, Omuegipiti.
Ndele omwene waye okwa mona nokutya, Omwene a kala naye nokwe mu wapalekifa keshe eshi e shi longa.
Omwene waye okwa li e mu hokwa, nokwa hala a kale he mu longele, nokwe mu lenga elenga leumbo laye, ndele te mu pe oinima aishe momake aye.

Ndele okudja kefiku tuu olo ye eshi e mu ninga elenga leumbo laye alishe noloinima yaye aishe, Omwene okwa nangeka noupuna eumbo lOmuegipiti molwaJosef. Heeno, enangeko noupuna lOmwene la li mwaaishe yaye meumbo nomomapya.
Ndele ye okwa yandja momake aJosef oinima yaye aishe, nokwa li ehe na oshisho shasha nande, nomungome auke, ou a lya. Ndele Josef okwa li e na ondjelo ya wapala noshipala shiwa.
Komesho yoinima ei omwalikadi womwene waye okwa lembela Josef omesho, ndele ta ti: “Ila tu nangale.”
Ndele ye okwa anya ndele ta ti komwalikadi womwene waye: “Tala, omwene wange ke na ko nasha noinima yomeumbo, ndele ashishe shaye okwe shi yandja mepangelo lange.
Meumbo omu ye ke na epangelo li dule lange, ndele ina kelela nge sha, kakele kaave, osheshi ove omwalikadi waye. Ndi dule ngahelipi okuninga owii u fike opo nokunyona kuKalunga?”
Ndele ye eshi a popya ngaha naJosef efiku nefiku, ndele ye ine mu uda a nangale puye, opo va nangalafane.
Josef eshi e uya efiku limwe okulonga oilonga yomeumbo, eshi paha li omunhu,
opo nee ye okwe mu kwata koshikutu ndele ta ti: “Ila u nangale naame.” Ndelenee ye okwa fiya po oshikutu shaye meke laye nokwa faduka po ndele a ya pondje.
Opo nee ye eshi a mona nokutya, Josef okwa fiya oshikutu shaye meke laye nokwa ya pondje,
okwa ifana ovanhu vomeumbo ndele ta ti kuvo: “Taleni, ye okwe tu etela omulumenhu Omuheberi e tu dine. Ye okwe uya kwaame opo a nangale naame, ndele ame nda ingida pombada,
ndele ye eshi a uda nda yelula ondaka nonda ingida, ye okwa fiya pwaame oshikutu shaye ndele a faduka po ta i pondje.”
Ndele ye okwa tula oshikutu shaye ponho yaye fiyo omwene waye te uya keumbo.
Ndele ye okwe mu lombwela eendjovo odo, ndele ta ti: “Omupiya Omuheberi, ou we tu etela omu okwe uya kwaame a fife nge ohoni,
ndele eshi nda yelula ondaka yange nonda ingida, ye okwa fiya po oshikutu shaye pwaame ndele okwa faduka po a ya pondje.”
Omwene waye eshi a uda eendjovo domwalikadi waye nokutya: “Osho omupiya woye a ningila nge,” ye okwa handuka unene.
Ndele omwene waJosef okwe mu kwatifa nokwe mu idililifa modolongo monhele oyo eenghwate dohamba da idililwa mo. Ndele ye okwa kala modolongo.
Ndelenee Omwene okwa li naJosef nokwe mu monifila ouwanghenda nokwe mu hokwifa momesho omukulunhu wodolongo.
Ndele omukulunhu wodolongo okwa yandja momake aJosef aveshe ava va idililwa mo. Naashishe sha li shi na okuningwa, ye okwe shi ninga.
Omukulunhu wodolongo okwa li ehe na ko nasha noinima ei ya kala mepangelo laJosef, shaashi Omwene okwa li pamwe naye. Ndele keshe eshi sha longwa kuye Omwene okwe shi nangeka noupuna.
40: Komesho yoinima ei omupindi womalodu ohamba yaEgipiti nomuteleki womingome ova nyona komwene wavo, ohamba yaEgipiti.
Ndele Farao okwa handukila unene omalenga aye aa avali, omupindi omukulunhu nomuteleki omukulunhu.
Ndele ye e va yandja va kelelwe meumbo lelenga letanga lovanangeli, modolongo monhele tuu ei omo Josef a idililwa.
Ndele elenga letanga lovanangeli ola tula po Josef e va yakule. Ndele vo ova kala efimbo lile meidililo.
Ndele vo aveshe vavali va li va twa eendjodi, keshe umwe ondjodi yaye, moufiku tuu umwe, keshe umwe oyaye i lili, nomupindi nomuteleki wohamba yaEgipiti, ava va kala modolongo eenghwate.
Ndele Josef okwe uya kuvo ongula yefiku olo, nokwa dimbulukwa ovo va limbililwa.
Opo nee ye a pula komalenga aFarao, aa a kala pamwe naye, ndele a idililwa meumbo lomwene waye ndele ta ti: “Omolwashike oipala yeni ya nyika oufiye nena?”

Ndele vo ove mu nyamukula tava ti: “Fye otwa twa ondjodi, ndele kape na ou a shiiva oku i fatulula.” Ndele Josef okwe va pula ta ti: “Efatululo olo oshinima shaKalunga ndishi? Ngeno omu di hepaululile nge.”
Opo nee omupindi omukulunhu okwa hepaululila Josef ondjodi yaye ndele ta ti kuye: “Mondjodi yange opa li omuviinyu u li moipafi yange,
nomomuviinyu mwa li oitai itatu, shamha tuu wa tenda, eenhemo oda holoka neeviinyu oda pya momashila.
Neholo laFarao ola li meke lange. Ndele ame onda kufa eeviinyu nde di kolela mo meholo laFarao, nonda yandja eholo meke laFarao.”
Opo nee Josef e mu lombwela: “Efatululo layo oleli: Oitai itatu otai didilike omafiku atatu.
Opomafiku aa atatu opo Farao ote ke ku yela nokutya, oku ku shunifa moupindi woye, ndele ove to ka yandja eholo laFarao meke laye ngaashi shito, eshi wa li omupindi waye.
Ndelenee dimbulukwe nge ngeenge ove wa kala nawa, u file nge onghenda u hepaulule nge kuFarao ndele pitife nge meumbo eli.
Osheshi ame nda vakwa po, heeno, nda vakwa medu lOvaheberi ndele apa yo inandi ninga sha ndele vo ova idilila nge modolongo.”
Omukulunhu wovateleki vomingome eshi a mona nokutya, ye okwa eta po efatululo liwa londjodi, okwa lombwela Josef ta ti: “Nomondjodi yange yo opa li oimbale itatu mu na omingome komutwe wange,
nomoshimbale shokombada omwa li omingome di lili nadi lili daFarao, ovateleki ngaashi ve di teleka, needila de di shomona mo moshimbale shokomutwe wange.”
Opo nee Josef okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Efatululo layo oleli: Oimbale oyo itatu oyo omafiku atatu.
Opomafiku aa atatu opo Farao ote ke ku yela nokutya, ye ote ku endjelelifa momuti, ndele eedila tadi ka shomona eenhumba doye.”
Ndele mefiku etitatu, efiku lokudimbulukwa okudalwa kwaFarao, ye okwa telekela ovapiya vaye oshitelekela nokwa yela mokati kovapiya vaye omukulunhu wovapindi nomukulunhu wovateleki vomingome.
Okwa shunifa omukulunhu wovapindi moshilonga shaye shoupindi, opo a shiive okuyandja eholo meke laFarao,
ndelenee omukulunhu wovateleki vomingome okwe mu endjelelifa momuti, ngaashi Josef e va fatululila.
Nomukulunhu wovapindi ina dimbulukwa Josef, ndelenee okwe mu dimbwa.
41: Omido mbali eshi da pita po, Farao okwa twa ondjodi, a kala ofika pomunghulo waNil.
Ndele tala, muNil mwa djuuka eengobe heyali eedidi da wapala okutalwa noda ondoka, ndele do oda lya momanenge.
Ndele tala, do oda shikulwa keengobe dimwe heyali eedidi da dja muNil, eengobe dii okutalwa, nomalutu a utama ndele do oda ya ndele tadi kala ofika peengobe dinya pomunghulo waNil.
Neengobe eedidi odo da li dii okutalwa nomalutu a utama, oda lya po eengobe dinya heyali diwa okutalwa noda ondoka. Opo nee Farao okwa papuduka.
Ndele ye okwa kofulula vali nokwa twa vali ondjodi. Ndele tala, omitwe heyali doilya di li koshihati shimwe, da pya nawa, diwa unene.
Ndele do oda shikulwa komitwe dimwe heyali doilya da twiyuka mo da feta da kukutikwa komhepo yokoushilo.
Ndele omitwe dinya doilya da feta oda pona po odo heyali da pya da paka. Opo Farao a pashuka, ndele tala, oyo ya li ondjodi!

Ongula omwenyo waye owa li uhe na ombili ndele okwa tuma ko nokwa ifana ovamonikokule aveshe novanongo vomishangwa, vaye aveshe vomuEgipiti. Ndele Farao okwe va hepaululila ondjodi yaye, ndele kapa li nande umwe a shiiva oku i fatululila Farao.
Opo nee omukulunhu wovapindi okwa popya naFarao ndele ta ti: “Onena eli ame ohandi dimbulukwa omanyono ange.
Farao okwa li a handukila unene ovapiya vaye ndele okwa yandja nge ndi idililwe meumbo lelenga letanga lovanangeli, ame pamwe nomukulunhu wovateleki vomingome.
Ndele fye naye otwa twa eendjodi oufiku tuu umwe. Fye otwa twa eendjodi, keshe umwe ondjodi i na eendunge di lili.
Ndele mo omwa li pufye omunyasha umwe Omuheberi, omupiya welenga letanga lovanangeli; kuye twa hepaulula eendjodi ndele ye okwe tu fatululila eendjodi detu. Keshe umwe a fatululilwa ondjodi yaye.
Nongaashi ye e di tu fatululila, osho sha ningwa. Ame nda shunwa moshilonga shange, ndelenee omukulunhu wovateleki vomingome okwa endjelelifwa momuti.”
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana mo Josef, ndele vo ove mu pitifa mo divadiva modolongo. Ndele ye okwe likululifa nokwa djala oikutu imwe. Ndele ye okwe uya koshipala shaFarao.
Opo nee Farao okwa tya kuJosef: “Ame onda twa ondjodi, ndele kape na ou a shiiva oku i fatulula, ndelenee onde ku uda nokutya, shamha tuu ove wa udu ondjodi oto shiiva oku i fatulula.”
Ndele Josef okwa nyamukula Farao ndele ta ti: “Haame; oKalunga ha yandje efatululo liwa kuFarao.”
Opo nee Farao ta ti kuJosef: “Tala, mondjodi yange nda kala ofika pomunghulo waNil,
neengobe heyali eedidi da dja muNil, da li da ondoka nodiwa okutalwa, oda li tadi li momanenge.
Ndele tala, do oda shikulwa natango keengobe heyali eedidi doingone dii okutalwa noda utama. Medu alishe laEgipiti inandi mona nande eengobe dii da fa odo.
Ndele eengobe eedidi odo da utama nodii, oda lya po eengobe heyali dinya dotete,
do ode di lya po, ndelenee omunhu ina shiiva okudimbulukwa nokutya, ode di pona, osheshi okutalwa kwado okwa li kwii, ngaashi tete. Opo nee onda papuduka.
Komesho ame onda mona mondjodi yange, ndele tala, omitwe heyali doilya da pya nodiwa oda twiyuka moshihati shimwe.
Ndele do oda shikulwa komitwe heyali doilya da twiyuka, do da li dikukutu, da feta noda fetekwa komhepo yokoushilo.
Ndele omitwe heyali doilya da feta oda pona po omitwe dinya heyali diwa. Ndele ame nda shiivifila ovamonikokule, ndele inapa monika nande umwe a shiiva okupa nge efatululo.”
Opo nee Josef okwa tya kuFarao: “Eendjodi daFarao ode lifa. Kalunga okwa shiivifila Farao, eshi Ye a hala okuninga.
Eengobe heyali eedidi diwa otadi didilike omido heyali. Nomitwe heyali doilya diwa otadi didilike omido heyali. Eendjodi ode lifa.
Neengobe heyali eedidi dii da utama odo da djuuka de di shikula, otadi didilike omido heyali. Nomitwe heyali doilya da feta noda kukutikwa komhepo yokoushilo otadi didilike omido heyali dondjala.
Onghee hano onda lombwela Farao nokutya, eshi Kalunga a hala oku shi ninga, Ye e shi talifa Farao.
Tala, otape uya omido heyali di na oshishipo moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.
Ndelenee komesho otaku ke uya omido heyali dondjala, noshishipo ashishe tashi ka dimbuwa moshilongo shaEgipiti, nondjala otai ka lya oshilongo.
Ndele oshishipo itashi ka shiivika vali moshilongo omolwondjala tai shikula ko, osheshi yo otai ka ninga idjuu unene.
Naashi Farao a tuulula ondjodi luvali, otashi ti: oshinima eshi osha pama sha pangelwa kuKalunga ndele Kalunga ote ke shi wanifa diva.
Farao na konge hano omulumenhu e na eendunge nomayele, ye na yandje Egipiti mepangelo laye.
Farao na lombwele, ovadiinini va nangekwe komikunda nomikunda nomomido odo heyali doshishipo nava ongele oshitukulwa oshititano shomoilya moshilongo shaEgipiti.
Ndele ve na okwoongela eendja adishe domido heyali diwa tadi uya, nopamhango yaFarao ove na okwoongela oilya ngaashi eendja moilando noku i tuvikila.
Osho ngaha hano eendja tadi ka ninga oituvikilwa yoshilongo komido heyali dondjala edi tadi ke uya medu laEgipiti, opo oshilongo shaEgipiti shiha teke po kondjala.”
Ndele eendjovo edi oda li diwa momatwi aFarao novapiya vaye aveshe.
Opo nee Farao okwa tya kovapiya vaye: “Ohatu ka mona tuu omunhu umwe ngaashi omulumenhu ou e na Omhepo yaKalunga?”
Ndele Farao okwa tya kuJosef: “Kalunga eshi e ku hololela ashishe eshi, ope na tuu nande umwe e na eendunge nomayele ngaashi ove.
Ove ou na okupangela eumbo lange, novanhu vange aveshe ove na okudulika komalombwelo oye. Ashike kombinga yolukalwapangelo ame ondi ku dule.”
Natango Farao okwa lombwela Josef ndele ta ti: “Tala, ame ohandi ku lenge kombada yedu alishe laEgipiti.”
Opo nee Farao okwa kufa oshihakolinga meke laye ndele te shi tula meke laJosef. Ndele ye okwe mu djaleka oikutu iwa yoliina nokwe mu dika elyenge loshingoldo mofingo yaye.
Ndele ye okwe mu endififa metemba etivali loulenga womatemba, la shikula eli laye mwene, nokwa tetekelwa kovakuwilili tava ti: “Tweni eengolo!” Osho ngaha okwe mu lenga omupangeli womuEgipiti alishe.
Ndele Farao okwa tya kuJosef: “Aame Farao, ndelenee nande umwe moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti ita yelula eke laye ile omhadi yaye, ove ngeenge ino shi hala.”

Ndele Farao okwa luka Josef Safenat-Paneas, ndele okwe mu pa Asenat, omona okakadona kaPotifera, omupristeli womuOn, a ninge omwalikadi waye. Ndele Josef okwa dja po, ndele okwa endaenda noshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.
