Ndele omido daJosef oda li omilongo nhatu eshi a kala ofika koshipala shaFarao, ohamba yaEgipiti. Ndele Josef okwa dja po puFarao nokwa endaenda oshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.
Ndele momido odo heyali doshishipo oshilongo osha dala eendja dihapu unene.

Opo nee ye okwa ongela eendja adishe momido heyali fimbo Egipiti sha li shi na oshishipo, nokwe di tuvikilifa moilando. Moilando aishe okwa tuvikilifa mo eendja domomapya a li kominghulo popepi noilando.
Osho ngaha Josef okwa ongela oilya ihapu unene ngaashi eheke lopomunghulo wefuta, fiyo va efa okuvala, shaashi oya li ihapu unene.
Ndele Josef okwa dalelwa ovana ovamati vavali, fimbo omudo wondjala inau fika. Asenat, omona okakadona kaPotifera, omupristeli womuOn, okwe ve mu dalela.
Ndele Josef okwa luka oshiveli Manasse, osheshi ye okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa dimbwifa nge oluhepo lange alishe nosho yo eumbo alishe latate.”
Nondenge okwe i luka Efraim, osheshi ye okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa pa nge oludalo moshilongo shoudjuu wange.”
Opo nee omido heyali doshishipo oda pita po moshilongo shaEgipiti,
nomido heyali dondjala oda hovela, ngaashi Josef a tile. Ndele moilongo aishe omwa li ondjala, ndelenee moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti omwa li eendja.
Ndele edu alishe laEgipiti eshi la hangika kondjala oshiwana ashishe osha ya kuFarao okupula eendja, Farao okwa lombwela Ovaegipiti aveshe ta ti: “Indeni kuJosef, ningeni ngaashi te mu lombwele.”
Ndele ongonga aishe yedu oya hangika kondjala, ndele Josef okwa matula oituvikilwa aishe ndele okwa landifa oilya kOvaegipiti. Nondjala oya li idjuu medu laEgipiti.
Nounyuni aushe owe uya kuJosef muEgipiti, u lande oilya, osheshi ondjala oya handuka mongonga aishe yedu.
42: Jakob eshi a kundana nokutya muEgipiti omu na oilya, okwa lombwela ovana vaye ovamati ta ti: “Oshike tamu talafana ngaha?
Ndele ta ti: Taleni, ame onda kundana nokutya muEgipiti omu na oilya. Indeni ko hano mu ke tu landele oilya tu shiive okukala nomwenyo ndele tuha fye.”
Osho hano ovamwaxe omulongo vaJosef va ya va ka lande oilya muEgipiti.
Ndelenee Benjamin, ondenge yaJosef, Jakob ine mu tuma pamwe novamwaxe, osheshi okwa diladila kutya pamwe ota ka hangika koshiponga.
Osho hano ovana vaIsrael va ya ko va endela pamwe naavenya va ka landele ko oilya, osheshi muKaanan omwa li yo ondjala.
Ndele Josef okwa li omupangeli woshilongo, ye okwa landifa oilya kovanhu aveshe vomoshilongo. Onghee ovamwaxe vaJosef ve uya koshipala shaye ndele ve linyongamena oipala yavo poshi.

Ndele Josef eshi a mona ovamwaxe, okwe va dimbulukwa, ndelenee okwa li ngaashi omunailongo mokukalafana navo, nokwe va popifa neendjovo dikukutu ndele ta ti kuvo: “Otamu di peni?” Ndele vo va nyamukula: “Okedu laKaanan, twe uya tu lande eendja.”
Ndele Josef okwa dimbulukwa ovamwaxe, ndelenee vo inave mu dimbulukwa.
Opo nee Josef okwa dimbulukwa eendjodi dinya e va twilile. Ndele ye okwa tya kuvo: “Onye eendadi. Omwe uya okutala oshilongo apa sha heva.”
Ndelenee vo ove mu nyamukula tava ti: “Ahowe, omwene wetu, ndelenee ovapiya voye ve uya okulanda eendja.
Fye atushe ovana vomulumenhu umwe, fye ovanhu ovayuki, ovapiya voye, katu fi eendadi!”
Opo ye okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Ahowe, nye omwe uya okutala oshilongo apa sha heva.”
Ndele vo ova nyamukula: “Ovapiya voye fye omulongo navavali. Fye ovanhu vaxe imwe, ovana vomulumenhu umwe womedu laKaanan. Ndele tala, onghelo oi li putate, ndelenee umwe okwa kana po.”
Opo nee Josef ta ti kuvo: “Hano, osho tuu ngaashi nda ti nye eendadi!
Hano nye mu na okutalwa po, oshili ngaashi Farao e na omwenyo, nye itamu di po apa fimbo ondenge yeni inai uya.

Tumeni ko umwe a ka tale ko omumwaxo, ndelenee nye omu na okwiidililwa modolongo. Osho hano eendjovo deni tadi talwa, ngeenge odoshili ile doipupulu. Oshili, ngaashi Farao e na omwenyo, onye eendadi!”
Ye okwe va idililifa modolongo omafiku atatu.
Ndele mefiku etitatu Josef okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Ngeenge mwa hala okukala nomwenyo, omu na okulonga eshi, nde mu lombwela osheshi ame handi tila Kalunga!
Nye ngeenge ovanhu ovayuki, umwe womunye oku na okukala apa onghwate mongulu omo mwa li mwa idililwa, ndelenee nye indeni mu ka twale oilya kwaava tava fi ondjala meumbo leni.
Ndele etelei nge ondenge yeni, opo eendjovo deni di monike doshili, ndele itamu fi.” Ndele vo osho va ninga.

Opo nee vo ova tongafana tava ti: “Oshilishili, paife eshi ohatu alulilwa eshi twa ningila omumwatate, osheshi fye otwa tala oudjuu womwenyo waye, ye eshi e tu ilikana, ndele fye inatu mu pwilikina, onghee oudjuu otau tu hange.”
Opo nee Ruben okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Ame inandi shi mu lombwela kutya: ‘Inamu tula etimba lokaana aka?’ Ndelenee nye inamu uda nge. Taleni, paife ohonde yaye ohatu i pulweni.”
Ndele vo inava shiiva nokutya, Josef okwa li e udite ko, osheshi pokati kavo opa kala omutoloki.
Opo nee ye okwa dja po puvo nokwa lila. Komesho ye okwa aluka kuvo nokwa popya navo. Ndele ye okwa kufa Simeon mokati kavo ndele te mu mangifa moipafi yavo.
Opo nee Josef okwa lombwela va yadife omakutu avo noilya, noimaliwa yakeshe i tulwe mo mekutu laye noku va pa onghuta yomondjila yavo. Nosho va ningilwa.
Ndele vo ova tula oilya keendongi davo ndele va dja po.
Ndele umwe eshi a mangulula ekutu laye monhanda a pe okandongi kaye oilya, okwa mona oimaliwa yaye. Ndele tala, yo oya li kombada mekutu laye!

Ndele ye ta ti kovamwaxe: “Oimaliwa yange nde i alulilwa! Oyei i li mekutu lange omu!” Opo nee omitima davo da kakama, ndele va talafana nokuhaluka ndele tava ti: “Kalunga okwe tu ningila shike ngaha?”
Ndele vo ova fika kuxe Jakob medu laKaanan, ndele ove mu hepaululila ashishe she va hangela ko ndele tava ti:
“Omulumenhu, omupangeli woshilongo okwe tu popifa neendjovo dikukutu, ndele okwe tu tala fye eendadi doshilongo.
Ndelenee fye otwe mu lombwela: ‘Fye ovalumenhu ovayuki, katu fi eendadi.
Fye omulongo navavali, ovanhu vaxe imwe. Umwe ke po vali, nonghelo oi li putate medu laKaanan.’

Opo nee omulumenhu, omupangeli woshilongo, okwe tu lombwela ta ti: ‘Moshinima eshi ohandi ka shiiva nye ngeenge ovanhu ovayuki; omumwaxo umwe na fyaale po pwaame, ndele twaleni oilya kwaava tava fi ondjala keumbo leni, ndele indeni
mu ka tale ko onghelo i uye kwaame, opo ndi shiive nokutya, nye kamu fi eendadi. Nye ngeenge ovanhu ovayuki, ame ohandi ke mu alulila omumwaxo ndele tamu dulu okweendaenda moshilongo.’ ”
Ndele vo eshi va pimha oikulya momakutu avo, okakutu koimaliwa yakeshe umwe oka li mekutu laye! Ndele vo eshi va mona oukutu voimaliwa yavo, vo naxe yavo, ova tila.
Opo nee Jakob, xe yavo, okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Nye tamu nyeka nge ovana vange. Josef ke po! NaSimeon ke po! Ndele omwa hala vali okukufa nge Benjamin. Ashishe eshi tashi hange nge!”
Opo Ruben okwa lombwela xe ndele ta ti: “Ovamwange ovamati vavali va dipaa, ngeenge itandi mu ku alulile. Mu yandja meke lange, naame ohandi ke mu ku alulila.”

Ndelenee ye ta ti: “Omumwange ita i pamwe nanye, osheshi omumwaxe okwa fya, noye aeke a fyaala po. Nongeenge oshiponga tashi mu hange mondjila oyo tamu ende nayo, opo nee nye otamu twala eexwiki dange deenghwakutoka noluhodi moshovafi.”
43: Ndele ondjala oya li idjuu moshilongo.
Ndele oilya ei va kufa muEgipiti, eshi ya liwa po, xe yavo okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Indeni mu ke tu landele vali eendja.”
Opo nee Juda okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omulumenhu winya okwe tu londwela shili nokutya: ‘Nye itamu ka mona oshipala shange, ngeenge omumwaxo ke po punye.’
Ngeenge to mu tumu pamwe nafye, fye ohatu i ndele hatu ku landele eendja.
Ndelenee ove ngeenge ito mu tumu, itatu i ko. Osheshi omulumenhu winya okwe tu lombwela: ‘Nye itamu ka mona oshipala shange, ngeenge omumwaxo ke po punye.’ ”
Opo nee Israel okwa tya: “Omolwashike mwa ningila nge owii mokuhepaululila omulumenhu winya nokutya, omu na omumwaxo vali?”

Ndele vo ova nyamukula tava ti: “Omulumenhu winya okwe tu pula shili ofye novakwetu neendjovo edi: ‘Xo oku na omwenyo natango? Omu na tuu omumwaxo umwe?’ Opo nee fye otwe mu shiivifila paendjovo odo. Katwa li tu shii ngeenge ote tu lombwele: ‘Eteni omumwaxo oku.’ ”
Opo nee Juda okwa tya kuxe Israel: “Omumwoye mu lekela tu ye ko naye, opo nee hatu ke lilongekidila okuya, opo tu kale tu na omwenyo tuha fye, fye novana vetu.
Ame ondi mu na, mu tula momake ange, ame ngeenge itandi mu ku alulile, ndi mu kaleke koshipala shoye, ohandi ka kala ndi na etimba koshipala shoye mokukala kwange akushe.
Heeno, ngeno okwa li inatu ongaonga, ngeno osho otwa aluka nokuli olutivali.”

Opo nee Israel, xe yavo okwa tya kuvo: “Ngeenge oshi na okuningwa, nashi ningwe: longeleni momakutu eni oinima yomoshilongo eshi, nye mu i twaalele omulumenhu omilongelo, ngaashi omaadi omirha, oinima yokunyenyepekifa eendja, eendunga nomaxuku.
Ndele kufeni vali oimaliwa imwe i fike poimaliwa inya ya tulwa kombada momakutu eni. Kashiimba osha ningwa mepuko.
Ndele kufeni omumwaxo, lilongekideni ndele tamu shuna komulumenhu winya.

NaKalunga Omunaenghono adishe, ne mu monife efilonghenda komulumenhu winya, ye e mu alulile omumwaxo mukwao, e uye nanye naBenjamin. Ndelenee ame ngeenge ondi na okukufwa ovamwange, osho nashi ningwe hano!”
Opo nee ovalumenhu va kufa omilongelo ndele va kufa oimaliwa noishoshela yayo naBenjamin, ndele vo ova ya kuEgipiti ndee va fikama koshipala shaJosef.
Josef eshi a mona Benjamin puvo, okwa lombwela elenga leumbo laye: “Ovalumenhu ava va eta mo meumbo. Va tomena onhomena, u va telekele, osheshi ovalumenhu ava ove na okulya omwisha pwaame.”
Nomulumenhu okwa ninga ngaashi Josef e mu lombwela nokwa eta mo ovalumenhu meumbo laJosef.

Ndele ovalumenhu ova li va tila, eshi va etwa meumbo laJosef ndele tava ti: “Fye otwa etwa mo omolwoimaliwa inya twa hangele momakutu etu, eshi twa ile oku tete, opo ve tu vakele, ve tu kondekele mo, opo tu kwatwe ovapika pamwe neendongi detu.”
Onghee vo ova ehena komulumenhu ou a tulwa po elenga leumbo laJosef, ndele va popya naye poshivelo sheumbo,
ndele tava ti: “Akutu, omwene wetu, fye otwa ile apa tete okulanda oilya,
ndelenee fye eshi twa fika konhanda ndele hatu mangulula omakutu etu, oimaliwa yakeshe umwe oya li kombada mekutu laye, oimaliwa yetu ya wana po pakuyeleka, ndele otwe i etelela tu i shunife.
Fye otwa eta yo oimaliwa imwe tu lande eendja. Fye katu shii kutya olyelye a tula oimaliwa yetu momakutu etu.”
Opo nee ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ombili kunye! Inamu kala mwa tila! Kalunga keni naKalunga kooxo okwe mu pa emona momakutu eni. Oimaliwa yeni onde i pewa.” Opo nee ye okwa eta Simeon puvo.
Nomulumenhu winya okwa eta ovalumenhu meumbo laJosef, nokwe va pa omeva, ndele vo va kosha eemhadi davo. Ye okwa pa eendongi davo yo eendja.
Ndele vo ova longekida omilongelo davo fimbo Josef ine uya komwisha, osheshi ova uda kutya ove na okulya naye.
Josef eshi e uya meumbo ove mu etela omilongelo davo ndele ve linyongamena kuye poshi.
Ndele ye okwe va pula ngeenge ove li nawa ndele ta ti: “Xo yeni ou mwa popile oku li nawa? Ye oku na omwenyo natango?”
Ndele vo ova nyamukula: “Omupiya woye tate oku li nawa. Ye oku na omwenyo natango.” Ndele vo ove linyongamena noku mu fimaneka.
Opo nee ye okwa yelula omesho aye nokwa mona Benjamin, mumwaina, ndele ta ti: “Ei oyo nee ondenge yeni mwa lombwelele nge?” Opo nee okwe mu lombwela: “Kalunga ne ku file onghenda, omumwange!”
Josef okwa dja mo diva, osheshi omwenyo waye otau pi molwamumwaina. Ye okwa konga omhito yokulila, ndele ta i mondjuwo ndele omo a lilila.
Opo nee ye okwa kosha oshipala shaye nokwe uya te lidiinike, ndele ta ti: “Yandjeni eendja!”
Oye okwe lipelwa, navo ove lipelwa, nosho yo Ovaegipiti ve lipelwa, osheshi Ovaegipiti ihava lile pamwe nOvaheberi, osheshi osho oshidinififa kOvaegipiti.
Ndele vo ova kalekwa omutumba va taalela oshipala shaye, pashikulafano, tete oshiveli fiyo onghelo pakudalwa kwavo. Opo nee ovalumenhu va talafana va kumwa.
Ye okwa lombwela, va pewe eendja dokoshililo shaye. Ndelenee Benjamin okwa pewa eendja dihapu di dule lutano dinya davakwao aveshe. Ndele vo ova nwa pamwe naye nova hafa.
44: Opo nee Josef okwa lombwela elenga leumbo laye ndele ta ti: “Yadifa omakutu ovalumenhu oikulya i fike paenghono davo dokuhumbata, ndele tula mo oimaliwa yakeshe kombada mekutu laye,
neholo lange loshisiliveli pamwe noimaliwa yoilya yaye ou na oku li tula meni, kombada mekutu longhelo.” Ndele ye okwa ninga ngaashi a lombwelwa kuJosef.
Hano ongula, eluwa opo tali tende, ova lekela ovalumenhu neendongi davo.

Vo ova pita mo moshilando. Inava ya natango kokule opo nee Josef okwa lombwela elenga leumbo laye ndele ta ti: “Lilongekida u shikule ovalumenhu. Ndele ngeenge we va hange va pula: ‘Omolwashike mwa alula ouwa nowii? Omwa vakela mo shike eholo lange loshisiliveli?
Oshinima osho tuu osho omwene wange ha nwine mo nomo ha tale mo alushe oiholekwa? Nye omwa ninga nai, eshi mwa ninga ngaha.’ ”
Ndele ye okwe va hanga nokwe va lombwela eendjovo tuu odo.
Opo nee vo ova tya kuye: “Omolwashike omwene wetu ta popi eendjovo da tya ngaha? Eshi oshi li kokule nafye, tu ninge ngaha.
Tala, oimaliwa inya twa hangele meni kombada momakutu etu otwe i alula medu laKaanan noku i ku shunifila, fye ohatu dulu ngahelipi ngeno okuvaka oshisiliveli ile oshingoldo meumbo lomwene woye?
Ou, mokati kovapiya voye, ta hangika e na eholo olo oku na okufya, nafye atushe ohatu ningi ovapika vomwene wetu.”
Opo nee ye okwa tya: “Eewa, nashi kale ngaashi mwa tonga. Ou ta hangwa nalo ota ningi omupika wange, ndelenee nye omwa manguluka.”
Opo nee vo, keshe umwe, ova tula omakutu avo divadiva poshi ndele keshe umwe okwa mangulula ekutu laye.
Ndele ye okwa konga, a hovela pomukulunhu nokwa xulila ponghelo. Eholo ola monika mekutu laBenjamin.
Opo nee vo va pombaula oikutu yavo, keshe umwe okwa londeka omutengi kondongi yaye, ndele vo va shuna koshilando.
Ndele Juda okwe uya pamwe novamwaxe meumbo laJosef, fimbo natango ye a kala mo, ndele vo ova wila eombe koshipala shaye.
Opo nee Josef okwe va pula ta ti: “Oshike hano mwa ninga? Inamu shiiva nokutya, omulumenhu ngaashi ame, ohandi dulu okushiiva, kape na omalimbililo.”

Ndele Juda okwa pula ta ti: “Fye ohatu dulu okupopya shike komwene wetu? Ohatu ti shike? Onashike hatu dulu okulipopila? Kalunga okwa holola okunyona kwovapiya voye. Tala, fye ovapika vomwene wetu, fye naau a hangwa neholo.”
Ndele ye okwa tya: “Oshinima osho nashi kale kokule naame, ndi ninge ngaha. Omulumenhu ou a hangwa neholo oye aeke ta ka ninga omupika wange. Ndelenee nye indeni nombili kuxo.”
Opo nee Juda okwa ehena kuye ndele ta ti: “Akutu, omwene wange, omupiya woye na itavelwe okupopya ondjovo imwe momatwi omwene wange; ino handukila omupiya woye, osheshi ove ou li ngaashi Farao.
Omwene wange okwa pulile ovapiya vaye ndele ta ti: ‘Nye omu na tuu xo ile omumwaxo?’
Ndele fye otwa nyamukula omwene wetu twa tya: ‘Fye otu na tate a kulupa. Nomona omunyasha, ou a dalwa moukulupe, ndelenee mumwaina okwa fya. Ndele oye aeke a fyaala po kuina, naxe oku mu hole.’
Opo nee ove wa lombwela ovapiya voye: Mu eteni kwaame ndi shiive oku mu tala.
Ndele fye otwa nyamukula omwene wetu: ‘Omona ita dulu okufiya po xe, osheshi ngeenge te mu fii po, xe ota fi.’
Opo nee ove wa lombwela ovapiya voye: ‘Onghelo yeni ngeenge itai uya pamwe nanye, itamu ka mona vali oshipala shange.’
Ndele fye eshi twa fika kutate, omupiya woye, ndele twe mu hepaululila eendjovo domwene wetu,
tate okwe tu lombwela: ‘Indeni ko vali mu ke tu landele eendja.’
Ndelenee fye twa tile: ‘Fye itatu dulu okuya ko ngeenge katu li nonghelo yetu. Osheshi itatu ka mona oshipala shomulumenhu winya, ngeenge onghelo kai po pufye.’
Ndele tate, omupiya woye, okwe tu lombwela: ‘Nye omu shi shii nokutya omwalikadi wange okwa dalela nge ounona vavali,
umwe okwa dja po pwaame, ndele ame onda tile: “Oshili, ye okwa nyanyaulwa, okwa nyanyaulwa!” Ndele fiyo onena inandi mu mona.
Ngeenge tamu kufa po yo ou pwaame, ndele ta hangika koshiponga opo nee tamu ka twala eexwiki dange deenghwakutoka noluhodi moshovafi.’
Ame ngeenge handi i kutate, omupiya woye, ndele omona ke po pufye,
ota ka fya, ngeenge ita mono omona e li pufye osheshi omwenyo waxe owa kanyatela shili kuye. Novapiya voye otava ka twala eexwiki domupiya woye deenghwakutoka noluhodi moshovafi.
Osheshi omupiya woye okwe litula ponhele yomona koshipala shatate, ndele ame onda tile: ‘Ngeenge itandi mu alula kwoove, ame ohandi ka kala ndi na etimba koshipala shoye mokukala kwange akushe.’
Itavelela hano omupiya woye a kale ponhele yomona omupika womwene wange. Ndele efa omona a ye pamwe navamwatate,
osheshi ame ohandi dulu ngahelipi okuholoka kutate, omona ngeenge ke po pwaame? Ame itandi ka dula okutala oluhodi lidjuu tali ka hanga tate!”
45: Opo nee Josef a nyengwa okulidiinika vali moipafi yaaveshe va li puye, ndele ta ingida: Aveshe nava pite mo! Ndele inapa kala nande omunhu, Josef eshi e lihololela ovamwaxe.
Nokwa hovela okulila pombada, Ovaegipiti nomalenga aFarao ove mu uda.
Ndele Josef okwa lombwela ovamwaxe, ndele ta ti: “Aame Josef! Tate oku na omwenyo natango?” Ndelenee ovamwaxe va nyengwa oku mu nyamukula, osheshi ova haluka unene moipafi yaye.
Josef okwa tya vali kovamwaxe: “Eheneni oku kwaame.” Ndele vo eshi va ehena kuye okwa tya: “Aame Josef, omumwaxo, ou mwa landifa po kuEgipiti.
Ndelenee inamu kala mwa nyika oluhodi, nye inamu lihandukila eshi mwa landifa nge po. Osheshi omolwokuxupifa eemwenyo deni Kalunga okwe mu tetekelifa nge omu.
Paife ondjala oya kala moshilongo omido mbali, ndele natango ope nomido nhano itaku limwa ko itaku teywa.
Ndelenee Kalunga okwa tetekelifa nge oku opo Ye e mu xupifile oludalo kombada yedu neemwenyo deni di xupe ndele vahapu va xupifwe.
Hanye mwa tuma nge oku, ndelenee oKalunga. Ndele Ye okwa lenga nge omupukululi waFarao nelenga leumbo laye alishe nomupangeli woshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.
Hano endeleleni, mu ye kutate noku mu lombwela: ‘Omumwoye Josef ota ti ngaha: “Kalunga okwa lenga nge omwene woshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti. Ila kwaame, ino kala ko!
Ndele ove oto dulu okukala moshikandjo Gosen nokukala popepi naame nosho yo ovamwoye novatekulu voye needi doye neengobe naashishe u shi na.
Ndele ame ohandi ke ku kalela noshisho, osheshi natango ope na omido nhano dondjala, opo ove neumbo loye naaveshe ava ve li pwoove muha nyonwe po.” ’
Ndele taleni, omesho eni vene nomesho aBenjamin taa mono nokutya, aame mwenemwene handi popi nanye.
Hepaululileni tate efimano lange alishe muEgipiti naashishe mwe shi mona, ndele endeleleni okweeta tate oku.”
Opo naye okwa papatela omumwaina Benjamin mofingo ndele ta lili, naBenjamin yo okwa lilila mofingo yaye.
Ndele ye okwa fipa ovamwaxe aveshe komilungu nokwe va papatela nomaoko ndee okwa lila. Ndele konima ovamwaxe ova popya naye.
Ondaka okutya, ovamwaxe vaJosef ve uya, eshi ya fika meumbo laFarao, Farao novanhu vaye ove i hafela.
Ndele Farao okwa lombwela Josef ta ti: “Lombwela ovamwaxo: ‘Ningeni ngaha: tulikeni keendongi, indeni kedu laKaanan,
mu ka tale ko xo novanhu veni, ndele ileni kwaame, opo ndi ke mu pe ashishe eshi shiwa shomedu laEgipiti, nye mu lye omaadi omoshilongo.’
Hano ove ou na oku va lombwela to ti: ‘Kufeni omatemba moshilongo shaEgipiti mu endife mo ovana veni novalikadi veni, naxo na londe mo yo, ndele ileni.
Ndele inamu kalela oinima yomeumbo noshisho, osheshi ashishe shiwa shomoshilongo shaEgipiti, osheni.’ ”
Ovana vaIsrael osho va ninga. Ndele Josef okwe va pa omatemba palombwelo laFarao nokwe va pa onghuta yomondjila.
Ye okwe va pa aveshe, omulumenhu nomulumenhu, oshikutu shipe, ndelenee okwa pa Benjamin eesekeli omafele atatu doshisiliveli noikutu ipe itano.
Nosho yo okwa tumina xe eendongi omulongo da humbata oinima iwa ya hoololwa yomuEgipiti, neendongi eedidi omulongo da humbata oilya nomingome nonghuta yaxe yomondjila.
Opo nee ye okwa lekela ovamwaxe, ndele tava i. Ndele ye okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Inamu litangunina mondjila.”
Ndele vo ova dja muEgipiti nova fika medu laKaanan puxe Jakob.
Vo eshi ve mu hepaululila tava ti: “Josef oku na omwenyo natango! Oye omupangeli woshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti,” omutima waye owa kukuta, osheshi ye ine va itavela.
Ndele vo eshi ve mu shiivifila eendjovo adishe daJosef, odo a popya navo, naashi Jakob a mona omatemba aa a tumwa kuJosef oku mu endifa, opo nee omhepo yaJakob, xe yavo, ya hekelekwa.
Ndele Israel okwa tya: “Sha wana! Josef, Omumwange e na omwenyo natango! Ame ohandi i ndi ke mu mone, fimbo inandi fya.”
46: Ndele Israel okwa fikama neumbo laye alishe ndele okwa fika kuBerseba. Ndele okwa yambela Kalunga kooxe Isak omayambo.
Ndele Kalunga okwa lombwela Israel memoniko oufiku ndele ta ti: “Jakob, Jakob!” Ndele ye a nyamukula: “Aame ou!”
Opo nee Ye okwa tya: “Aame Kalunga, Kalunga kooxo. Ino tila okuya kuEgipiti, osheshi oko handi ke ku ningila oshiwana shinene.
Ame ohandi ka ya pamwe naave kuEgipiti, naame mwene ohandi ke ku alula ko vali. Ndele Josef ote ke ku fifikinifa omesho oye.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa dja po puBerseba. Novana vaIsrael va londeka xe Jakob, nounona vavo novalikadi vavo momatemba, oo Farao e va tumina e ke mu tale.
Ndele vo ova ongela oimuna yavo noinima yavo, ve lilikolela muKaanan, ndele va fika kuEgipiti, Jakob ye mwene noludalo laye alishe,
ovana vaye ovalumenhu novakainhu novatekulu vaye nepata laye alishe ye e li twala muEgipiti.
Omadina Ovaisraeli ava ve uya kuEgipiti oyaa: Jakob novana vaye oshiveli shaye okwa li Ruben.
Novana ovamati vaRuben: Henok naPallu naHesron naKarmi.
Novana ovalumenhu vaSimeon: Jemuel naJamin naOhad naJakin naSohar naSaul, omona womwalikadi Omukaanan.
Novana ovamati vaLevi: Gerson, Kohat naMerari.
Novana ovamati vaJuda: Er naOnan naShela naPeres naSera. Ndelenee Er naOnan ova fila medu laKaanan. Novana ovamati vaPeres ova li Hesron naHamul.
Novana ovamati vaIsaskar: Tola naPua naJasub naSimron.
Novana ovamati vaSebulon: Sered naElon naJagleel.
Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaLea, ye e va dalela Jakob muPaddan-Aram pamwe nomona okakadona Dina. Aveshe kumwe ovana ovamati noukadona vaye ova li omilongo nhatu navatatu.
Novana ovamati vaGad: Sifjon naHaggi, Suni naEsbon, Er naArodi naAreeli.
Ovana vaAsser: Jimna naJisva naJisvi naBeria naSera, omumwaina omukainhu. Novana ovamati vaBeria: Eber naMalkiel.
Ovo ovana ovamati vaSilpa, ou Laban e mu pa omona waye Lea. Ndele ye okwa dalela Jakob ovana ava omulongo navahamano.
Ovana ovamati vaRakel, omwalikadi waJakob: Josef naBenjamin.
Ndele Josef okwa dalelwa muEgipiti Manasse naEfraim, ava Asenat, omona waPotifera, omupristeli womuOn, e mu dalela.
Novana ovamati vaBenjamin: Bela naBeger naAsbel, Gera naNaeman, Egi naRos, Muppim naHuppim naArd.
Ovo ovana ovamati vaRakel e va dalela Jakob, aveshe kumwe ovanhu omulongo navane.
Nomona omumati waDan: Husim.
Novana ovamati vaNaftali: Jakseel naGuni naJeser naSillem.
Ovo ovana ovamati vaBilha, ou Laban e mu pa omona waye Rakel. Ndele ye okwe va dalela Jakob, aveshe kumwe ovanhu vaheyali.
Ava va tembukila kuEgipiti pamwe naJakob ndele ava va dja momatundji aye, aveshe kumwe ova li omilongo hamano navahamano. Ovalikadi vovana vaJakob inava valelwa mo.
Novana ovamati vaJosef ava ve mu dalelwa muEgipiti ova li ovana vavali. Ovanhu aveshe vomepata laJakob, ava ve uya kuEgipiti, ove li omilongo heyali.
Ndele ye okwa tetekelifa Juda kuJosef, e mu lombwele ondjila yokuGosen. Ndele vo ova fika medu laGosen.
Opo nee Josef okwa manga etemba laye, nokwa ya kuGosen a ka shakene naxe Israel. Ndele ye eshi a fika kuye, okwe mu dingatela mofingo nokwa lilila lule mofingo yaye.
Ndele Israel okwa tya kuJosef: “Paife handi dulu okufya, eshi nda mona oshipala shoye, eshi u na omwenyo natango.”
Opo nee Josef okwa lombwela ovamwaxe novakwao vaxe ta ti: “Ame ohandi i ndi ka shiivifile Farao ndele handi ti kuye: ‘Ovamwatate neumbo latate eli la li medu laKaanan ole uya kwaame.
Ndele ovalumenhu vo ovafita veedi, osheshi vo ova li ovafita voimuna, ndele vo ova etelela eedi davo neengobe davo naashishe ve kwete.’
Ndele Farao ngeenge te mu ifana ndele ta pula ta ti: ‘Oshilonga sheni oshashike?’

Nye nyamukuleni, tamu ti: ‘Ovapiya voye ova kala ovafita voimuna okudja kounyasha wavo fiyo opaife, fye otu li ngaashi ootate,’ opo mu shiive okukala muGosen. Osheshi omufita keshe woimuna oye oixuna, momesho Ovaegipiti.”
47: Opo nee Josef okwe uya ndee okwa shiivifila Farao ta ti: “Tate novamwatate ove uya needi davo neengobe davo noinima aishe ve kwete, va dja medu laKaanan, ndele vo ove li moshikandjo Gosen.”
Ndele ye okwa kufa mo ovamwaxe ovalumenhu vatano nokwe va eta koshipala shaFarao.
Opo nee Farao a pula ovamwaxe vaJosef ta ti: “Oshilonga sheni oshashike?” Ndele vo va nyamukula tava ti: “Ovapiya voye ovafita veedi ngaashi ootate.”

Natango vo ova lombwela Farao tava ti: “Fye otwe uya tu kale manga ngaashi ovanailongo moshilongo, osheshi kwinya kaku na oulifilo weedi dovapiya voye, shaashi ondjala idjuu oi li medu laKaanan. Itavela, fye ovapiya voye, tu tule moshikandjo Gosen.”
Opo nee Farao okwa popya naJosef ndele ta ti: “Xo novamwaxo ove uya kwoove.

Edu alishe laEgipiti oli li po la yeuluka moipafi yoye; xo novamwaxo nava kale momukunda muwa u dule adishe domoshilongo. Nava kale moshikandjo Gosen. Nongeenge wa shiiva nokutya mokati kovamwaxo omu na ovalumenhu ve shii okulineekelwa moshilonga shavo, va tula po va ninge ovapashukili voimuna yange.”
Opo nee Josef okwa eta mo xe Jakob nokwe mu kaleka koshipala shaFarao. Ndele Jakob okwa nangeka noupuna Farao.
Opo nee Farao okwa tya kuJakob: “Omido dokukala kwoye odi fike peni?”

Ndele Jakob okwa nyamukula Farao ndele ta ti: “Efimbo lounailongo wange omido efele nomilongo nhatu. Omuvalu womafiku okukala kwange omanini noku yadi oluhodi, olo inali hanga omuvalu wootatekulu va li ve u na mounailongo wavo.”
Opo nee Jakob okwa nangeka noupuna Farao, ndele va lekelafana naFarao.
Ndele Josef okwa nangeka xe novamwaxe nokwe va pa omapya oshilongo shaEgipiti, momukunda muwa u dule adishe moshilongo moshitukulwalongo shaRameses, ngaashi Farao a tonga.
Ndele Josef okwa palula xe novamwaxe neumbo alishe laxe nomingome pamuvalu woludalo.
Ndele moshilongo ashishe inamu monika vali omungome, osheshi ondjala oya handuka unene moshilongo shaEgipiti nomedu laKaanan inamu monika vali oilya.
Ndele Josef okwa ongela oimaliwa aishe ya li muEgipiti nomuKaanan mokulandifa oilya oyo va landa, ndele Josef okwa twala oimaliwa mouhamba waFarao.
Ndele oimaliwa eshi ya pwa mo muEgipiti nomuKaanan, Ovaegipiti aveshe ve uya kuJosef ndele ova tya: “Tu pa omungome! Omolwashike tu na okufya koshipala shoye? Osheshi oimaliwa oya pwa po.”
Ndele Josef okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Eteni oimuna yeni, ndele ame ohandi mu pe oilya moimuna yeni, ngeenge oimaliwa oya pwa po.”
Opo nee vo ova eta oimuna yavo kuJosef e va pe oilya meenghambe davo nomeedi davo nomeengobe davo nomeendongi davo. Nomudo tuu ou ye okwe va palula noilya i fike pomuvalu woimuna yavo.

Omudo winya eshi wa pita, vo ove uya kuye momudo omutivali ndele ova tya kuye: “Fye itatu dulu oku shi ku holeka, omwene wetu nokutya, oimaliwa oya pwa po noimuna yetu yo oya ninga yomwene wetu. Fye katu na sha vali shimwe, omalutu etu nomapya etu.

Omolwashike fye tu na okuxulila apa momesho oye, fye vene nomapya etu? Tu landa fye vene nomapya etu moilya. Ofye vene nomapya etu hatu liyandje ovapika vaFarao. Tu pa ombuto, tu ka kale tu na omwenyo, fye tuha fye nomapya etu aha ninge omaputu.”

Osho ngaha hano Josef a landela Farao omapya aeshe omuEgipiti, osheshi Ovaegipiti aveshe va landifa po omapya avo, shaashi ondjala oya li inene unene. Osho ngaha hano oshilongo ashishe sha ninga shaFarao.
Ndele ye okwa tula ovanhu moilando okudja komunghulo umwe waEgipiti fiyo okomunghulo mukwao.
Omapya ovapristeli oo aeke, ina landa, osheshi ovapristeli ova pewa ondjabi yavo kuFarao ndele ove lixupififa naashi va pewa kuFarao. Onghee hano omapya avo inave a landifa po.
Opo nee Josef okwa lombwela ovanhu ta ti: “Taleni, onena eli ame nde mu landela Farao, nye vene nomapya eni. Tambuleni ombuto mu shiive okukuna omapya eni.
Ndele mokuteya kweni omu na okweetela Farao oshitukulwa shimwe shomutitano. Oitukulwa ine nai ninge yeni, i ninge ombuto yomapya neendja deni nodaava ve li momaumbo eni neendja doludalo leni.”
Ndele vo ve mu nyamukula, tava ti: “Ove we tu kaleka nomwenyo. Natu filwe onghenda momesho omwene wetu, opo nee hatu ka kala ovapiya vaFarao.”

NOvaegipiti Josef e va pa omhango fiyo onena kombinga yomapya omuEgipiti nokutya, vo ove na okuyandja kuFarao oshitukulwa shimwe shomutitano shomomapya avo. Omapya ovapristeli oo aeke inaa ninga aFarao.
Israel okwa kala moshilongo shaEgipiti, moshikandjo Gosen. Ndele vo ova li ve na omapya ndele va hapupala, va dalafana vahapu vahapu.
Ndele Jakob okwa kala e na omwenyo muEgipiti omido omulongo naheyali. Nomafiku aJakob omido daye kwa li e na omwenyo oda li omido efele limwe nomilongo nhee naheyali.

Omafiku okufya kwaIsrael eshi a ehena popepi, ye okwa ifana omona waye Josef ndele ta ti kuye: “Ame ngeenge nda filwa onghenda momesho oye, tula mo hano eke loye koshi yetundji lange ndele monifile nge ohole noudiinini: ino paka nge moshilongo shaEgipiti!
Ame nda hala okukala pootatekulu, onghee hano kufe nge muEgipiti u ka nangeke nge mombila yavo.” Oye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame ohandi ningi ngaashi wa hala.”
Ye okwa tya: “Anene nge.” Ye okwe mu anena eano. Israel okwa ilikana nokwe linyongamena koshiwilo shomombete.
48: Komesho yoinima ei vo ova shiivifila Josef tava ti: “Tala, xo ota vele.” Opo nee ye okwa kufa ovana vaye vavali ovamati, Manasse naEfraim pamwe naye.
Ndele vo ova lombwela Jakob, tava ti: “Tala, omumwoye Josef ote uya kwoove.” Opo nee Jakob okwe liongela eenghono daye ndele ta kala omutumba kombete yaye.
Ndele Jakob okwa lombwela Josef ta ti: “Kalunga Omunaenghono adishe okwe liholola kwaame muLus, moshilongo shaKaanan, nokwa nangeka nge noupuna,
ndele okwa lombwela nge ta ti: ‘Tala, Ame ohandi ke ku dalifa oludalo ndele handi ku hapupalifa ndele to ningi eemhunga doiwana, noludalo loye ohandi li pe edu eli, li ninge lavo fiyo alushe.’
Ovamwoye vavali, ve ku dalelwa muEgipiti, fimbo inandi uya kwoove kuEgipiti, vo ovange: Efraim naManasse. Vo otava ka kala vange ngaashi Ruben naSimeon.
Ovamwoye we va dala va shikula venya, ovoye. Oitukulilwa yaavenya otai lukilwa ovamwaxe.

Ndele ame eshi nda dja muPaddan, Rakel okwa fila moshilongo shaKaanan mondjila, eshi pa li ashike okanano kanini okufika kuEfrat.” Oko nde mu paka pomunghulo wondjila yokuya kuEfrat nokutya, Betlehem.
Israel eshi a mona ovana ovamati vaJosef okwa tya: “Ovo oolyelye?”
Ndele Josef okwa nyamukula xe ndele ta ti: “Ovo ovana vange Kalunga e va pela nge apa.” Ndele Jakob ta ti: “Va eta oku kwaame ndi shiive oku va nangeka noupuna.”
Ndelenee omesho aIsrael a li a twika oshiwiwili molwoukulupe, ke wete ko. Ndele Josef eshi e va eta kuye, ye okwe va fipa komilungu nokwe va papatela momaoko.
Ndele Israel okwa lombwela Josef: “Ame kanda li nde shi diladila vali okumona oshipala shoye, ndele tala, Kalunga okwa monifa nge oludalo loye yo.”
Opo nee Josef okwe va kufa ko komatundji aye, nokwa twa eengolo koshipala shaye nokwe linyongamena poshi.

Opo nee Josef okwe va kwata ava aveshe vavali; Efraim okwe mu kwatifa olulyo laye la taalela olumosho laIsrael. Manasse okwe mu kwatifa olumosho laye la taalela olulyo laIsrael, nosho hano ngaha okwe va twala kuye.

Ndele Israel okwa twala ko olulyo laye ndele te li tenheke komutwe waEfraim, nande ye okwa li ondenge yamukwao, nolumosho laye kwe li tenheka komutwe waManasse. Hano a shiyakanifa omake aye, osheshi Manasse okwa li omukulunhu kumukwao.

Ndele ye okwa nangeka noupuna Josef, ndele ta ti:
“Kalunga, Oove Kalunga ootatekulu Abraham naIsak,
va endaenda koshipala shoye,
Kalunga, ou wa li Omufita wange,
okudja kokudalwa kwange fiyo onena eli,

Omweengeli, ou a xupifa nge moudjuu keshe,
oye na nangeke noupuna ovana ava ovamati,
nedina lange nolootatekulu Abraham naIsak
nali kale li na omwenyo muvo,
vo ove na okuhapupala
vahapu vahapu kombada yedu!”

Josef eshi a mona xe a tenheka eke laye lokolulyo komutwe waEfraim, kasha li she mu wapalela, onghee okwa kwata eke laxe e li lundulule, li dje ko komutwe waEfraim, ye e li tenhekulule komutwe waManasse.
Josef okwa lombwela xe: “Ahowe, tate, osheshi ou oshiveli, olulyo loye li tenheka komutwe waye.”

Xe okwa anya ndele ta ti: “Ondi shi shii, mumwange, ondi shi shii! Nomuye otamu di oshiwana, naye yo ota ka ninga munene a fimana. Ndelenee ondenge yaye otai mu dulu, noludalo laye tali ka ninga oiwana.”

Ndele ye okwe va nangeka noupuna mefiku tuu olo ndele ta ti: “Ovaisraeli nava tumbule edina loye, ngeenge tava nangeke noupuna ndele tava popi tava ti: ‘Kalunga ne ku fefife Efraim naManasse.’ ” Nosho ngaha a tula Efraim komesho yaManasse.
Ndele Israel okwa lombwela Josef ta ti: “Ame ondi li pokufya, ndelenee Kalunga ota kala pamwe nanye, ndele te mu shunifa koshilongo shooxokulu.
Ndele ame ohandi ku pe oshikandjo shi dule shovamwaxo, osho nda kwata mOvaamori keenghono deongamukonda nouta.”
49: Opo nee Jakob okwa ifana ovana vaye ovamati ndele ta ti: “Ileni, liongeleni, opo ndi shiive oku mu shiivifila eshi tashi mu hange pexulilo lomafiku:

“Liongeleni mu ude, nye ovana ovamati vaJakob;
pwilikineni Israel, xo yeni.

“Ruben, oove shiveli shange neenghono dange,
Oove wotete weenghono dange,
omukulunhu metumbalo, nomukulunhu mepangelo!

“Simeon naLevi, vo ovamwainafana.
Oiti yavo oilongifo youkolokoshi.

Omwenyo wange itau pande eenghundafana davo,
omutima wange itau kala neemhangela davo,
osheshi mehandu lavo va dipaa ovalumenhu,
nomoupwidi wavo va ngudupaleka eemhedi.

Ehandu lavo nali fingwe, osheshi lo ohali xwama diva,
Noupyuhandu wavo, osheshi oo udjuu.
Ame ohandi ke va tukula muJakob
noku va halakanifa muIsrael.

“Juda, oove tuu! Ove oto ka hambelelwa kovamwaxo.
Eke loye otali ka kala kofingo yovatondadi voye.
Koshipala shoye ovana vaxo otave ke linyongamena.

Juda onghoshi onyasha;
moihakanwa wa dja, omumwange.
Ye ote likoko, ndee ta nangala ngonghoshi,
ngaashi onghoshi onghadi. Olyelye ta dulu oku mu taataa?

Epangelodibo itali ka kufwa kuJuda
nodibo youhamba itai di po peemhadi daye.
Fiyo ou e na okuuya te uya,
noiwana tai ka dulika kuye.

Ye ota pandeke ondongi onyasha yaye komuviinyu,
nondongwena yondongi yonghadi yaye okeshila lomuviinyu.
Ye ota kosho oikutu yaye momaviinyu
nelwakani laye mohonde yeeviinyu.

Omesho aye a tilyana komaviinyu,
nomayoo a toka komashini.

“Sebulon ota ka kala pomunghulo wefuta,
ndee ta ka kala popepi neeskepa,
kombinga yokuSidon.

“Isaskar ondongi yomakipa a pama,
tai nangala pokati koyuunda.

Ye eshi a mona etulumuko oliwa
nedu la wapala,
ye okwa endameka epepe laye lokuhumbata omutengi,
ndele okwe liyandja a ninge omupika.

“Dan ota ka yukifila ovana vaye
ngaashi limwe lomomapata aIsrael.

Dan ota ka kala eyoka mondjila,
efu melila,
olo tali lumata pomhando yonghambe,
opo omulondi ta u ko ongali.
“Omwene, ohandi teelele exupifo loye!

“Gad, ovakwaita tave mu totele,
ndelenee ye ote va kwata koshififinwa.

“Asser, eendja daye di na omaadi,
ndele ta kongele eehamba oiliwa inyenye.

“Naftali ongaashi oholongo i na onhapo;
muye otamu di oludalo liwa.

Josef omuti mupe tau imi,
omuti mupe pofifiya.
Oitai yao tai tandavele kombada yekuma.

Ovaumbi vomauta tave mu nangele,
ndele tave mu umbu, ndele tave mu lwifa,

ndelenee outa waye wa pama
nomaoko nomake aye e na eenghono
molwomake Omunamapangelo womuJakob,
Omufita nemanya laIsrael,

Kalunga kaxo, ekwafo loye, nekwafo laKalunga Omunaenghono adishe,
ou te ku nangeke noupuna nomanangeko okeulu pombada,
nomanangeko nomakungulukilo omeva oposhi,
nomanangeko omavele nomomadimo.

Omanangeko noupuna aa xo a pewa,
e dule omanangeko noupuna eemhunda daalushe,
eeshali doupuna dokoikulundudu yaalushe.
Omanangeko noupuna aa naa kale kombada yomutwe waJosef
nokombada pokati komutwe womuhoololwa mokati kovamwaxe.

“Benjamin oye embungu tali nyanyaula.
Ongula tali li oshihakanwa shalo
nonguloshi tali tukula eshi la kwata.”
Aa omapata aeshe omulongo naavali omuIsrael. Ndele odo xe e va lombwela, ndele ye e va nangeka noupuna. Ye okwe va nangeka noupuna, keshe umwe enangeko noupuna laye li lili.
Opo nee ye e va lombwela ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ame ohandi ka ongelwa kovakwapata vange. Pakei nge pootate mekololo li li monhele yedu laEfron Omuheti,
mekololo li li monhele yedu laMakpela, koushilo waMamre, medu laKaanan, onhele yedu Abraham e i landa kuEfron, Omuheti ngaashi ombila yefyuululo.
Oko va paka Abraham naSara, omwalikadi waye. Oko va paka Isak naRebeka omwalikadi waye. Oko nda paka yo Lea,
onhele yedu nekololo li li mo, ei ya landwa kovana vaHet.”
Jakob eshi a mana okulombwela ovana vaye ovamati, okwa yelulila eemhadi daye kombete, ndele ta fuda mo omhepo. Ndele okwa ongelwa kovakwanepata laye.
50: Opo nee Josef okwa wila koshipala shaxe ndele okwe mu lila nokwe mu fipa komilungu.
Ndele Josef okwa lombwela ovapiya vaye ovahakuli, va vaeke xe nomaadi abalsam. Novahakuli va vaeka Israel nomaadi abalsam.
Omafiku omilongo nhee a pita po, osheshi omafiku e fike opo oo a wana mokuvaeka nabalsam. NOvaegipiti ve mu lila omafiku omilongo heyali.
Nomafiku okulila eefya eshi a pita po, Josef okwa popya neumbo laFarao ndele ta ti: “Ame ngeenge nda filwa onghenda momesho eni, ka popileni nge koshipala shaFarao, mu tye:

‘Tate okwa anifa nge ndele ta ti: “Tala, ame onda yuka kefyo. Nye omu na okupaka nge mekololo nde li lihokelele medu laKaanan.” Nandi itavelelwe okuya ndi ka pake tate. Opo nee ame ohandi ka aluka.’ ”
Ndele Farao okwa tya: “Inda u ka pake xo ngaashi ye e ku anifa.”
Opo nee Josef okwa fikama ta i a ka pake xe, ndele ovapiya aveshe vaFarao, omalenga eumbo laye ova ya pamwe naye, nomalenga aeshe omakulunhu omoshilongo shaEgipiti.
Nosho yo eumbo alishe laJosef novamwaxe neumbo alishe laxe. Ounona vavo aveke needi neengobe va fiya moshikandjo Gosen.
Ndele okwa ya ko nomatemba oita novalondi veenghambe pamwe naye, opa li hano osheendo shinene unene.
Ndele vo eshi va fika kuGoren-Atad, ei i li koushilo waJordan, ova ninga oshivilo shinene sheefya, ndele va lila eefya dinene. Ndele ye okwe va lombwela eefya daxe di lilwe omafiku aheyali.

Ovakaanan oonakukala moshilongo eshi va uda eefya tadi lilwa mu Goren-Atad ova popya tava ti: “Oku na eefya dOvaegipiti tadi lilwa.” Onghee onhele oyo hai ifanwa Abel Misraim, ya li moushilo waJordan.
Ndele ovana vaye ovamati va wanifa ngaashi ye e va lombwelele:
ovana vaye ovamati ve mu twala koshilongo shaKaanan, ndele ve mu paka mekololo lonhele yedu laMakpela, onhele tuu ei Abraham a landele ombila yefyuululo kuEfron, Omuheti, moushilo wokuMamre.
Opo nee Josef okwa shuna kuEgipiti, ye mwene novamwaxe naaveshe ava va ile pamwe naye eshi a ka paka xe.
Ovamwaxe vaJosef eshi va mona xe a fya vo otava ti: “Kashiimba Josef ota hovele oku tu handukila noku tu shunifa owii molwowii aushe twe mu ningila!”
Onghee hano va tumina Josef ondaka ei: “Xo, fimbo ina fya, okwe tu lombwela eendjovo edi:

nye omu na okulombwela Josef tamu ti: ‘Akutu, tu fila onghenda. Dima po etauluko lovamwaxo netimba lavo, eshi ve ku ningile nai.’ Ndelenee paife, tu dimina po etauluko letu, fye ava ovapiya vaKalunga kaxo.” Ndele Josef okwa lila, eshi va popya naye.
Ndele ovamwaxe voovene navo ova ya ndele va wila eombe koshipala shaye ndele tava ti: “Tala, fye ovapika voye.”
Ndele Josef okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Inamu tila. Aame ndi li ponhele yaKalunga?
Heeno, nye omwa diladilila nge owii, ndelenee Kalunga okwe u alulila kouwa, a longe eshi shi li po, oshiwana shinene e shi xupifile omwenyo.
Hano inamu kala mwa tila. Ame ohandi ke mu kalela noshisho, nye noludalo leni.” Osho ngaha ye e va hekeleka nokutulumukifa omitima davo.
Ndele Josef okwa kala muEgipiti ye neumbo laxe. Ndele Josef a kala nomwenyo omido efele nomulongo.
Ndele Josef okwa mona ovatekulu vaEfraim. Nosho yo ovana vaMakir, omona waManasse, ova dalwa fimbo Josef kwa li e nomwenyo.
Ndele Josef okwa lombwela ovamwaxe ta ti: “Ame ohandi ka fya, ndelenee Kalunga te mu diinine ndele te mu twala koshilongo eshi moshilongo shinya Ye a udanekela nokwaana Abraham naIsak naJakob.”
Ndele Josef okwa anifa ovana vaIsrael ndele ta ti: “Kalunga ngeenge te mu kongo, kufeni omakipa ange aa, a twaleni ko.”
Ndele Josef okwa fya e nomido efele nomulongo. Ndele ve mu vaeka nomuvavo wabalsam, ndele ve mu tula moshikefa muEgipiti.

1: Ndele omadina ovana ovamati vaIsrael ava ve uya kuEgipiti oo aa; ovo ve uya pamwe naJakob, keshe umwe neumbo laye:
Ruben, Simeon, Levi naJuda,
Isaskar, Sebulon naBenjamin,
Dan naNaftali, Gad naAsser.
Neemwenyo adishe edi da dja momatundji aJakob odo oda li eemwenyo omilongo heyali. Ndelenee Josef okwa li muEgipiti.
Ndele Josef okwa fya, novamwaxe vaye aveshe, nepupi alishe linya.
Ndelenee Ovaisraeli va li ve noludalo ndele va ninga vahapu, ndele va hapupala ndele va ninga vahapu neenghono nova yadifa oshilongo.
Opo nee ohamba ipe ya holoka tai pangele Egipiti, yo ya li inai shiiva Josef nande.
Yo oya lombwela ovanhu vayo: “Taleni, oshiwana shOvaisraeli osha ninga shinene shi neenghono shi tu dule.
Hano ileni, fye tu pangeleni omhangela momakoto oku va kondjifa, vo vaha dule okuhapupala, nongeenge hatu hangika koita, vo vaha ame kovatondadi vetu noku tu lwifa, ndele tava di mo moshilongo.”
Opo nee vo ova pewa ovapashukili oku va hepeka noilonga idjuu. Ndele vo ova tungila Farao oituvikilwalando Pitom naRamses.
Ndelenee okuhepekwa kwavo eshi kwa hapupala, nokuhapupala kwavo kwa ehena komesho, nova tandavela; opo Ovaegipiti va tila Ovaisraeli.
Onghee hano Ovaegipiti va fininika Ovaisraeli noilonga idjuu youpika,
nokukalamwenyo kwavo kwa lulumikwa noilonga idjuu yomunoko needopi noilonga i lili nai lili momapya, heeno, noilonga i lili nai lili ve i fininikilwa ve i longe.
Nohamba yaEgipiti ya lombwela ovadalifi Ovaheberi, umwe, edina laye Sifra nolamukwao Pua,
ndele tai ti: “Nye eshi tamu kwafa ovalikadi Ovaheberi mokudala omu nokutala pokudalifa, ngeenge okamati, mu noku ka dipaa, ndelenee ngeenge okakadona, naka kale nomwenyo.”
Ndelenee ovadalifi ava va li ovatilikalunga noinava ninga ngaashi ohamba yaEgipiti ye va lombwela, ndelenee va efa ouhanana oumati va kale ve nomwenyo.
Opo nee ohamba yaEgipiti ya ifana ovadalifi ndele tai ti kuvo: “Omolwashike mwe shi ninga nomwa efa ouhanana oumati va kale nomwenyo?”
Novadalifi va lombwela Farao, tava ti: “Ovalikadi Ovaheberi hasho ve li ngaashi Ovaegipiti, osheshi venya ve neenghono, fimbo omudalifi ina fika kuvo, ova dala nokuli.”
Ndelenee Kalunga okwa nangeka noupuna ovadalifi. Noshiwana osha hapupala nosha ninga shinene shi neenghono.
Ndele ovadalifi eshi va tila Kalunga, Ye okwe va pa oludalo lihapu.
Opo nee Farao okwa lombwela ovanhu vaye aveshe, ndele ta ti: “Ovana aveshe ovamati ava tava dalwa ve nokweekelwa muNil, ndelenee oukadona aveshe nava efuwe ve nomwenyo.”
2: Nomulumenhu umwe womepata laLevi okwa ya nokwa hombola omona waLevi.
Nomwalikadi a ninga oufimba nokwa dala okaana okamati. Ndele ye eshi a mona nokutya, ko okawa, ye e ka holeka eehani nhatu.
Ndelenee ye eshi ina dula vali oku ka holeka, okwe ka kufila okakefa komanenge nokwe ka hotifa eka, nokwa nangeka mo okaana ndele te ka tula momanenge pomunghulo waNil.
Nomumwaina wako okakadona okwa li kwinya konima kanini, e ka mone nhumbi taka ningwa.

Ndele okakadona omona waFarao okwa ya kuNil e ke likoshe mo, fimbo ovapiya vaye ovakainhu va endaenda komunghulo waNil. Ndele ye eshi a mona ko okakefa momanenge, okwa tuma ko omupiya waye nokwe ka kufa ko.
Ye eshi e ka tuula, okwa mona okaana, ndele tala, ko oka li okaana okamati taka lili. Ndele ye okwe ka fila onghenda ndele ta ti: “Aka okamwe kounona oumati vOvaheberi.”
Opo nee omumwaina wako okakadona ka tya komona okakadona kaFarao: “Owa hala ndi ku kongele omunyamifi movalikadi Ovaheberi, ye a nyamife okaana?”
Ndele okakadona omona waFarao okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Heeno”. Okakadona oka tondoka noka ifana ina yokaana.
Opo nee okakadona omona waFarao e mu lombwela ta ti: “Tambula okaana aka okamati u ka nyamifile nge nohandi ke ku futa. Nomwalikadi okwa tambula okamati nokwe ka nyamifa.”
Ndelenee okaana eshi ka kula, okwe ka twala kokakadona omona waFarao. Nokwa ninga omona waye omumati. Ndele ye okwe mu luka Moses ndele ta ti: “Ame onde mu kufa momeva.”

Ndele opa ningwa pomafiku enya Moses eshi a kula, okwa ya a ka talele po ovakwao, ovamwaxe nokwa mona oshilonga shavo shidjuu. Nokwa mona omulumenhu Omuegipiti nhumbi a denga omulumenhu Omuheberi, umwe womovakwao.
Ndele ye okwa lengalenga kombinga nombinga ndele eshi a mona pehe na ovanhu, ye okwa dipaa Omuegipiti ndele te mu fudike medu.
Mefiku lomongula ye okwa ya ko vali, ndele pa li ovalumenhu vavali Ovaheberi va dengafana. Opo nee ye a pula kwaau e noushima: “Oshike to dengele omukweni?”

Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Olyelye e ku tula po u kale omwene nomutokoli wetu? Wa hala ngeno okudipaa nge, ngaashi wa dipaa Omuegipiti?” Ndele Moses okwa tila ndele ta ti: “Oshili, oshinima sha shiivika.”
Ndele Farao eshi e di kundana, ye a konga Moses e mu dipae. Ndelenee Moses okwa yaFarao onhapo nokwa tula medu laMidian, ndele a kala omutumba pomufima umwe.
Ndele omupristeli waMidian okwa li e novana oukadona vaheyali. Vo ove uya komufima okuteka omeva nokuxwiila oimuna yaxe.
Ndelenee ovafita ve uya nove va taataa mo. Opo nee Moses okwa fikama nokwe va kwafa, ndele ta xwiile oimuna yavo.
Ndele eshi ve uya kuxe yavo Rehuel ye okwa tya: “Ongahelipi mwa endelela nena?”
Ndele vo tava nyamukula: “Omulumenhu Omuegipiti okwe tu popila kovafita. Nokwe tu tekela omeva ndele a xwiila oimuna.”
Opo ye ta ti kovana vaye oukadona: “Ye oku li peni? Omolwashike mwe mu fiila ko? Mu ifaneni ye e uye okulya omungome.”
Ndele Moses okwa hokwa po nokwa kala pomulumenhu ou, ndele ye okwe mu pa omona okakadona Sippora.
Ndele ye eshi a dala okaana okamati, Moses okwe ka luka Gersom. Osheshi ye a tile: “Ame nda kala ngaashi omunailongo koilongo.”
Ndele efimbo lile eshi la pita po, ohamba yaEgipiti oya fya. NOvaisraeli ova kuwa nokulila omolwoupika. Ndele onghuwo yavo molwoupika wavo oya fika kuKalunga.
Ndele Kalunga okwa uda ekemo lavo, naKalunga okwa dimbulukwa ehangano laye naAbraham naIsak naJakob.
Ndele Kalunga okwa tala Ovaisraeli, nokwe va kalela noshisho.
3: Ndele Moses okwa lifa oimuna yaxemweno Jetro, omupristeli waMidian. Ndelenee efiku limwe ye eshi a twalele oimuna langhele kwinya kouninginino wombuwa, okwe uya komhunda yaKalunga nokutya Horeb.
Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene okwe mu lihololela momutemo womundilo moshixwa sheno. Ndele ye eshi a tala ko shili, oshixwa sheno osha xwama omundilo, ndelenee inashi lungwina po komundilo!
Ndele Moses ta ti: “Onda hala ndi ehene ko popepi ndi tale emoniko eli linene, omolwashike oshixwa sheno itashi lungwina po.”
Omwene eshi a mona ta ehene po e shi tale, Kalunga okwe mu ifana, ta popi moshixwa sheno ta ti: “Moses, Moses!” Ndele ye ta nyamukula: “Aame ou!”
Ndele Ye ta ti: “Ino ehena oku. Dula ko eenghaku keemhadi doye, osheshi onhele apa u li ofika oyo edu liyapuki.”
Ye ta ti vali: “Aame Kalunga kooxo, Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob.” Opo nee Moses okwa uvika oshipala shaye, osheshi okwa tila okutala Kalunga.
NOmwene ta ti: “Ame onda mona okuhepekwa kwoshiwana shange, eshi shi li muEgipiti. Naame onda uda onghuwo yavo omolwovafininiki, heeno, ondi wete oudjuu wavo.

Onghee nde uya poshi, ndi va kulile mo meke lOvaegipiti, nondi va twale medu linya, medu liwa nola mbwalangadja, medu li yadi omashini nomaadi eenyiki, medu omo Ovakaanan nOvaheti nOvaamori nOvaperesi nOvahevi nOvajebusi ve li mo.
Ndele paife tala, onghuwo nekemo lOvaisraeli oya fika kwaame. Nonda mona yo ehepeko nalo Ovaegipiti tave va hepeke.
Hano inda ko, Ame ohandi ku tumu kuFarao, u pitife mo muEgipiti oshiwana shange Ovaisraeli.”
Ndelenee Moses okwa lombwela Kalunga ta ti: “Aame omushike ndi ye kuFarao, nondi pitife mo Ovaisraeli muEgipiti?”

Ndele Ye ta nyamukula: “Ame ohandi ka kala pamwe naave, naashi tashi ningi edidiliko kwoove nokutya, Ame nde ku tuma ko: ove eshi wa pitifa mo oshiwana muEgipiti, vo otava ka longela Kalunga komhunda tuu ei.”

Opo nee Moses okwa lombwela Kalunga ta ti: “Ndelenee ame ngeenge handi i kOvaisraeli ndele handi va lombwele: ‘Kalunga kooxo okwa tuma nge kunye,’ ndele tava pula nge: ‘Olyelye edina laye?’ Ohandi va nyamukula shike?”
Ndele Kalunga ta ti kuMoses: “Aame tuu Ame. U nokunyamukula Ovaisraeli u tye ngaha: ‘Aame tuu Ame,’ a tuma nge kunye.”

Opo nee Kalunga okwa lombwela vali Moses ta ti: “Odo u noku di shiivifila Ovaisraeli: ‘Omwene Kalunga kooxo, Kalunga kaAbraham naKalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob okwa tuma nge kunye.’ Olo edina lange fiyo alushe nalo Ame handi ifanwa kepupi fiyo okepupi.

Inda ko u shivile ko ovakulunhu vOvaisraeli noku va lombwela: ‘Omwene, Kalunga kooxo okwe liholola kwaame, Kalunga kaAbraham, kaIsak nokaJakob.’ ” Ndele okwa tya: “Oshili Ame ohandi mu pashukile noku mu kalela noshisho nokutala eshi tashi mu ningilwa muEgipiti.

Onghee hano onda tokola mwaame kutya: ‘Ame onda hala oku mu pitifa mo moudjuu womuEgipiti noku mu twala medu lOvakaanan nolOvaheti nolOvaamori nolOvaperesi nolOvahevi nolOvajebusi, moshilongo shi yadi omashini nomaadi eenyiki.’

“Ndele vo otave ke ku uda. Opo nee nye novakulunhu vOvaisraeli mu nokuya kohamba yaEgipiti, nomu noku i lombwela: ‘Omwene Kalunga kOvaheberi okwe tu shakeneka. Hano tu lekela paife, fye tu ka ende omafiku atatu kombuwa tu ka yandjele Omwene Kalunga ketu omayambo.’
Ndelenee Ame ondi shi shii nokutya, ohamba yaEgipiti itai mu lekele nande tai fininikwa keke li neenghono.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka nanena kombada yaEgipiti eke lange nohandi ke va monifila oikumwifa nomadidiliko aa handi ka ningila ko, opo nee ye ote mu lekele mu dje mo.
“Ndele oshiwana eshi Ame ohandi ke shi filifa onghenda kOvaegipiti, opo ngeenge tamu ka dja mo, itamu ka dja mo hamakasha,

ndelenee keshe omwalikadi e nokweehela omushiinda shaye naava ve li meumbo laye oinima oisiliveli noingoldo noikutu. Ndele nye otamu i humbatifa ovana veni ovamati noukadona; nosho ngaha tamu ka kufa oihakanwa kOvaegipiti.”
4: Opo nee Moses okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ndelenee vo ngeenge itava itavele nge ndele itava pwilikine ondaka yange, ndelenee tava ti: ‘Omwene ine ku lihololela?’ ”
Opo nee Omwene ta pula Moses ta ti: “Oshike shi li meke loye?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Onhaili.”
Ndele Ye ta ti: “I ekela poshi.” Opo ye e i ekela poshi, ndele yo oya ninga eyoka, naMoses okwe li ya onhapo.
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses: “Nana eke loye u li kwate komushila.” Moses okwa nana eke laye nokwe li kwata, ndele lo ola ninga onhaili meke laye,
Opo venya ve na okwiitavela nokutya: “Omwene Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob e ku lihololela.”
NOmwene okwe mu lombwela vali: “Shitika eke loye monghwapa.” Ndele ye okwa shitika eke laye monghwapa yaye. Ndele ye eshi e li kufa mo, la kwatwa koshilundu, la toka ngaashi eemhawe.
Ndele Ye ta ti: “Shitika mo vali eke loye monghwapa yoye.” Ndele okwa shitika eke laye monghwapa yaye; ndele eshi e li kufa mo, lo la li la yela ngaashi olutu laye.
Ndele Kalunga okwa ti vali: “Ngeenge itave ku itavele noitava udu molwedidiliko lotete, opo nee tava itavele molwedidiliko laxuuninwa.
Ndele ngeenge itava itavele omadidiliko aa avali noitava pwilikine ondaka yoye, teka hano omeva muNil u a tile poukukutu. Opo nee omeva aa a kufwa muNil taa ka ninga ohonde poukukutu.”

Opo nee Moses okwa lombwela Omwene: “Akutu Omwene, ame nghi shii kupopya; onghela nongheleinya nonena eli, eshi wa popifa omupiya woye; osheshi okutumbula kwange taku nyenge nge nelaka lange olidjuu.”
NOmwene okwe mu nyamukula: “Olyelye a shitila omunhu okanya? Nolyelye a shita omufitandaka nomufitamatwi, omunamesho nomupofi? Haame Omwene?
Inda ko hano ashike naame ohandi ka kala nokanya koye noku ku longa, eshi u nokupopya.”
Ndelenee ye ta ti: “Akutu Omwene, tuma ko umwe, nande olyelye wa hala.”

Opo nee ehandu lOmwene la xwamena Moses ndele Ye ta ti: “Omumwanyoko Aron, Omulevi, oko e li ndi shii. Ondi shi shii ye e shii okupopya nawa. Ndele ye ote ku shakeneke. Noye eshi te ku mono omutima waye tau ka hafa.
Ove u nokupopya nokutula mokanya kaye eendjovo. Ndele Ame ohandi ka kala nokanya koye nonokanya kaye, nde handi mu longo eshi mu nokuninga.
Ndele ye e nokupopya novanhu ponhele yoye, noye ota ka ninga okanya koye naave to ningi kalunga kuye.
Kufa hano onhaili ei meke loye, nayo u nokuninga omadidiliko.”

Opo nee Moses okwa dja po nokwa shuna koxemweno Jetro, ndele ye ta ti kuye: “Efe nge ndi shune kovamwameme ava ve li muEgipiti, ndi mone ngeenge ve nomwenyo natango.” Ndele Jetro te mu lombwele: “Inda nombili.”
NOmwene ye okwa lombwela Moses muMidian ta ti: “Inda ko u shune kuEgipiti. Osheshi ovanhu aveshe venya va li va hala oku ku dipaa, ova fya.”
Moses okwa kufa omwalikadi waye novana vaye ovamati nokwe va londeka kondongi, ndele a shuna kedu laEgipiti. Onhaili yaKalunga Moses e i kwete meke laye.

NOmwene okwa lombwela Moses ta ti: “Paife eshi to shuna kuEgipiti, tala, ka ninge oikumwifa aishe ei nde i ku pa, koshipala shaFarao. Ndelenee Ame ohandi ka kukutika omutima waye, opo ye ita ka efa oshiwana shi dje mo.
Ove u nokulombwela Farao kutya Omwene ta ti ngaha: ‘Israel oye oshiveli shange;
onghee handi ku lombwele, lekela omona wange omumati, opo a shiive okulongela nge. Ndelenee ngeenge to anye oku mu lekela, tala, oiveli yoye Ame ohandi i dipaa.’ ”
Hano mondjila, fimbo ve li monhanda, Omwene okwe mu hanga nokwa hala oku mu dipaa.
Opo nee Sippora okwa kufa okamanya ka upikwa nokwa kengha oshipa shonhele youlumenhu womona waye omumati nokwe shi kumifa eemhadi daMoses ndele ta ti: “Oshili, oove omuhomboli wange wopahonde.”
Ndele Ye okwe mu efa. Opo ye okwa tile: “Omuhomboli wopahonde! Omolwokupita etanda.”
Omwene okwa lombwela yo Aron ta ti: “Inda u ka shakeneke Moses mofuka.” Ndele ye okwa ya nokwe mu shakeneka komhunda yaKalunga, ndele okwe mu fipa komilungu.
Opo nee Moses okwa hepaululila Aron eendjovo adishe dOmwene nado Ye okwe mu tuma nomadidiliko aeshe oo Ye e mu lombwela.
Ndele Moses naAron ova ya nova ongaleka ovakulunhu aveshe vOvaisraeli.
NaAron okwa hepaulula eendjovo adishe odo Omwene e di lombwela Moses, nomadidiliko okwe a ninga moipafi yovanhu.
Novanhu va itavela. Ndele vo eshi va uda nokutya, Omwene okwa dimbulukwa Ovaisraeli nokwa mona oudjuu wavo, vo ove linyongamena nokutwa oipala yavo poshi.
5: Ndele Moses naAron ova ya kuFarao ndele tava ti kuye: “Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha: ‘Lekela oshiwana shange, shi ka ningile nge oshivilo mombuwa.’ ”
Ndelenee Farao ta nyamukula: “Omwene olyelye, ame ndi pwilikine ondaka yaye ndi lekele Israel? Omwene ou kandi mu shii noitandi ka lekela Israel a dje mo.”
Vo otava ti: “Kalunga kOvaheberi okwe tu shakeneka. Tu lekela hano, tu ka ye mondjila yomafiku atatu, tu ka yambele Omwene Kalunga ketu mombuwa, opo ehe tu dipaife oudu wolutapo ile eongamukonda.”
Ndelenee ohamba yaEgipiti ye va nyamukula, tai ti: “Moses naAron, omolwashike tamu kelele ovanhu va longe oilonga yavo? Indeni mu ka longe!
Farao okwa tile vali: Taleni, ovanhu vomoshilongo ovahapu nokuli, ndele mwa hala va fe oilonga yavo?”
Mefiku tuu olo Farao okwa lombwela ovafininiki vomovanhu novapashukili voilonga, ndele ta ti:
“Ovanhu inamu va pa vali omwiidi mokufoloma eedopi ngaashi shito. Ovo vene nave ke liongelele omwiidi.
Ndelenee eedopi di fike pwaadinya donghela nodongheleinya mu noku di pula kuvo. Inamu ninipalifa omuvalu wado. Osheshi vo ovandede. Onghee hava ingida tava ti: ‘Tu ka ningile Kalunga ketu exwikilo!’
Oshilonga nashi ninge shidjuu shili kovalumenhu, opo va kale mokulonga, vaha pwilikine eendjovo doipupulu.”
Opo nee ovafininiki vovanhu novapashukili va pita mo ndele va lombwela ovanhu ndele tava ti: “Farao osho ta ti: ‘Itandi mu pe omwiidi nande.
Indeni nye vene mu ka tale ko omwiidi keshe apa tau monika. Ndele oilonga yeni itai shuna monima.’ ”
Opo nee ovanhu va endaenda moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti va ka ongele oimbodi ponhele yomwiidi.
Novafininiki va fininika ndele tava ti: “Wanifeni oshilonga sheni keshe efiku naanaa ngaashi mefimbo linya pa li omwiidi.”

Hano ovalongifi venya Ovaisraeli va dengwa kovafininiki ava va tulwa po kuFarao, ndele tava ti: “Oshike hano inamu wanifa oilonga yeni onghela nonena, ngaashi shito, mu wanife omuvalu weedopi ngaashi mwa lombwelwa?”
Onghee hano ovapashukili Ovaisraeli va ya nova kemena Farao ndele va pulwa: “Omolwashike ove ho ningile ngaha novapiya voye?
Osheshi ovapiya voye itava pewa omwiidi, naavenya tava ti kufye: ‘Folomeni eedopi!’ Ndele tala, ovapiya voye tava dengwa, ndelenee oushima u li movanhu voye.”
Ndelenee ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Onye ovandede, heeno, ovandede. Onghee tamu ti: ‘Tu lekela tu ka ningile Omwene exwikilo.’
Hano paife eshi indeni ashike mu ka longe. Ndelenee itamu pewa omwiidi. Ndelenee wanifeni omuvalu weedopi naanaa.”
Opo nee ovapashukili Ovaisraeli ove liwete vo nhumbi ve li moudjuu, eshi pa lombwelwa: “Nye mu nokuwanifa eedopi deni keshe efiku omuvalu wado; omuvalu itau shunifwa monima.”
Ndele ve uya kuMoses naAron ava va li ko ofika ve va shakeneke venya eshi va dja kuFarao,
ndele vo ove va lombwela: “Omwene ne mu kwatele onghone noku mu tokola, eshi nye mwe tu tondifa momesho aFarao nomomesho ovapiya vaye, osheshi mwa yandja meke lavo eongamukonda vo ve tu dipae.”
Opo nee Moses okwa ya vali kOmwene ndele ta ti: “Omwene, omolwashike wa ningila oshiwana eshi owii? Omolwashike Ove wa tuma nge oku?
“Osheshi okefimbo tuu linya nda ya kuFarao ndi popye medina loye, ye okwa hepeka oshiwana eshi, naave ino xupifa oshiwana shoye.”
6: Opo nee Omwene okwa nyamukula Moses ndele ta ti: “Paife ove oto ka mona eshi handi ka ningila Farao. Osheshi molweke li neenghono ote mu lekele mu dje mo, heeno, okefininiko leke li neenghono ye ote ke mu taataa mo moshilongo.”
Kalunga okwa popya vali naMoses ndele ta ti kuye: “Aame Omwene,
ndele kuAbraham, kuIsak nokuJakob Ame nde ve liholela Kalunga Omunaenghono adishe, ndelenee Ame nde ve lihololela edina lange Omwene.
Nda ninga yo ehangano letu navo, ndi va pe edu laKaanan, edu lounailongo wavo, omu va kala;
ndele Ame nda uda yo ekemo lOvaisraeli ava va kwatwa moupika kOvaegipiti, ndele Ame nda dimbulukwa ehangano letu navo.

Onghee hano lombwela Ovaisraeli u tye: ‘Aame Omwene, ndele Ame ohandi ke mu kufa mo moshilonga shidjuu shOvaegipiti noku mu xupifa moupika wavo mudjuu ndele handi mu xupifa neke la yeluka nomatokolo manene,
Ndele handi ke mu tambula oshiwana shange naame Kalunga keni. Ndele tamu ka shiiva nokutya, Aame Omwene Kalunga keni, ou e mu pitifa mo moshilonga shidjuu shOvaegipiti.
Ndele Ame ohandi ke mu twala medu nde li udanekela nokwaana ndi li yandje kuAbraham naIsak naJakob. Ndele Ame ohandi ke li mu pa efyuululo; Aame tuu Omwene.’ ”
Opo nee Moses okwa popya nOvaisraeli, ndelenee vo inava pwilikina Moses, omolwokuhelidiinika nomolwoilonga idjuu.
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndele ta ti:
“Inda u lombwele Farao, ohamba yaEgipiti, a lekele Ovaisraeli va dje mo moshilongo.”
Ndelenee Moses okwa popya koshipala shOmwene ndele ta ti: “Ovaisraeli eshi inava pwilikina nge; Farao ota ka pwilikina nge ngahelipi, eshi ame ndi nomilungu inadi pita etanda?”
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses naAron ndele e va tuma kOvaisraeli neenghundana nokuFarao, ohamba yaEgipiti, nokupitifa mo Ovaisraeli moshilongo.
Oovene vomapata ovava: ovana ovamati vaRuben, oshiveli shaIsrael: Henok naPallu, Hesron naKarmi. Olo epata laRuben.
Novana ovamati vaSimeon: Jemuel naJamin, naOhad naJakin naSohar naSaul, omona womukainhu Omukaanan; olo epata laSimeon.
Nomadina ovana ovamati vaLevi oyaa pamapata avo: Gerson naKohat naMerari. Nomido daLevi, edi a kala nomwenyo, odo efele nomilongo nhatu nomido heyali.
Ovana ovamati vaGerson: Libni naSimei pamapata avo.
Novana ovamati vaKohat: Amram naIshar naHebron naUsiel. Nomido daKohat oda li efele nomilongo nhatu nomido nhatu.
Novana ovamati vaMerari: Mahli naMushi. Eli epata laLevi pashikulafano lomapata.
Ndele Amram okwa hombola Johobed, omumwaina waxe, ndele ye okwe mu dalela Moses naAron. Nomido daAmram da li efele nomilongo nhatu nomido heyali.
Novana ovamati vaIshar: Kora naNefek naSikri.
Novana ovamati vaUsiel: Mishael, Elsafan naSitri.
Ndelenee Aron okwa hombola Eliseba, omona okakadona kaAminadab, omumwaina waNashon. Ndele ye okwe mu dalela: Nadab naAbihu, Eliaser naItamar.
Novana ovamati vaKora: Assir naElkana naAbiasaf. Olo epata lOvakora.
NaEliaser, omona waAron, okwa hombola okakadona kamwe komovana vaPutiel. Ndele ye okwe mu dalela Pinehas. Ava ovakulunhu vomepata laLevi pashikulafano lomapupi avo.
Hano Moses naAron ova lombwelwa kOmwene: “Pitifeni mo Ovaisraeli medu lOvaegipiti pamatanga avo.”
Ovo tuu venya va popya naFarao, ohamba yaEgipiti, a pitife mo Ovaisraeli muEgipiti, Moses naAron.
Mefiku tuu olo Omwene okwa popya naMoses medu laEgipiti,
Omwene okwa popifa Moses neendjovo edi: “Aame Omwene. Lombwela Farao, ohamba yaEgipiti, ashishe eshi handi shi popi naave.”
Opo nee Moses okwa tya koshipala shOmwene: “Ame ndi nomilungu inadi pita etanda! Farao ota ka pwilikina nge ngahelipi?”
7: Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ta ti: “Tala, Ame ohandi ku tula po ngaashi kalunga kuFarao, nomumwanyoko Aron ota ka kala omuxunganeki woye.
U nokupopya alushe eshi Ame handi shi ku lombwele, nomumwanyoko Aron e nokupopya naFarao, opo a lekele Ovaisraeli va dje mo moshilongo.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka kukutika omutima waFarao nokuhapupalifa medu laEgipiti omadidiliko ange noikumwifa yange.

Ndelenee Farao ite ke mu pwilikina; ndele Ame ohandi ka tula eke lange kombada yaEgipiti oku shi lwifa nohandi ka pitifa mo medu laEgipiti omatanga ange, oshiwana shange Ovaisraeli momahandukilo nomomatokolo,
opo nee Ovaegipiti tava ka shiiva nokutya, Aame Omwene, ngeenge handi yelula eke lange kombada yaEgipiti nohandi pitifa mo Ovaisraeli mokati kavo.”
Opo Moses naAron va ninga ngaashi Omwene e va lombwela. Heeno, osho va ninga.
Ndele omido daMoses da li omilongo hetatu, nomido daAron omilongo hetatu nomido nhatu eshi va li va popya naFarao.
Ndele Omwene okwa popifa Moses naAron neendjovo edi:
“Farao ngeenge ta popi nanye ndele ta ti: ‘Ulikileni oshikumwifalonga,’ opo nee ove u nokulombwela Aron: ‘Kufa onhaili yoye, u i ekele poshi moipafi yaFarao, opo yo otai ka ninga eyoka.’ ”
Opo nee Moses naAron va ya kuFarao ndele va ninga ngaashi Omwene e va lombwela: Aron okwa ekela onhaili yaye poshi moipafi yaFarao noyovapiya vaye, ndele ya ninga eyoka.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana ovanongo neemhule. Ndele vo, eemhule dOvaegipiti ode shi ninga yo noupule wavo:
keshe umwe okwa ekela onhaili yaye poshi, ndele do oda ninga omayoka! Ndelenee onhaili yaAron oya pona po eenhaili davo.
Ndelenee omutima waFarao wa kukuta, onghee hano ine va pwilikina, ngaashi Omwene a tongele.
Opo nee Omwene okwa tya kuMoses: “Omutima waFarao wa kukutikwa. Ye ota anye okulekela oshiwana.
Inda kuFarao ongula inene, tala ye ota ka ya komeva. Kala ofika pomunghulo waNil u mu shakeneke. Ndele kufa meke loye onhaili ei ya shituka eyoka,
u mu lombwele: ‘Omwene Kalunga kOvaheberi okwa tuma nge kwoove nondaka ei: “Lekela ovanhu vange, vo va shiive okulongela nge mombuwa.” Ndelenee, tala, fiyo opaife ove ino di pwilikina.
Omwene ta ti ngaha: “Opo tuu opo oto ka shiiva nokutya, Aame Omwene.” Tala, nonhaili ei i li meke lange, ohandi denge omeva omuNil, ndele taa ka shituka ohonde.
Noikwameva yomuNil otai ka fya, opo Nil tau ka nyika nai. NOvaegipiti otava ka kendabala ongaho okunwa omeva omuNil.’ ”

Natango Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndele ta ti: “Lombwela Aron: ‘Kufa onhaili, ndele yelula eke loye kombada yomeva aeshe omuEgipiti, kombada yomilonga davo nomixupwalonga nomatale neenhele adishe mwa ongala omeva, a ninge ohonde: moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti tamu ka kala ohonde, moiyuma yoiti noyomamanya.’ ”
Moses naAron osho va ninga ngaashi Omwene e lombwela; ye okwa yelula onhaili nokwa denga omeva e li muNil moipafi yaFarao nomoipafi yovapiya vaye. Nomeva aeshe omuNil a ninga ohonde.
Noikwameva ya li muNil, ya fila mo. NaNil wa nyika nai, opo Ovaegipiti inava dula okunwa omeva omuNil. Nomedu alishe laEgipiti mwa li ohonde.
Ndelenee eemhule dOvaegipiti ode shi ninga yo noupule wado, opo omutima waFarao owa kukuta. Ndele ye ine va pwilikina, ngaashi Omwene a popya.
Ndele Farao okwa pilamena ko nokwa ya keumbo nomutima waye inau pupalekwa nande.
Ndelenee Ovaegipiti aveshe ova xupa keembinga adishe daNil va mone omeva okunwa, osheshi inava dula okunwa omeva omuNil.
Osho ngaha pa pita omafiku aheyali Omwene eshi a denga Nil.
8: Omwene okwa lombwela Moses a ye kuFarao e mu lombwele: “Omwene osho ta ti: ‘Lekela ovanhu vange va shiive okulongela nge.
Ndele ove ngeenge to anye oku va lekela, tala, oshilongo shoye ashishe ohandi ke shi yadifa omafuma,

Nil otau ka myakatala omafuma. Ndele oo taa ka djuuka mo nokuya meumbo loye nomonduda yoye yokunangala nomombete yoye; nomomaumbo ovapiya voye yo nomokati kovanhu voye oo tae uya, nomoikololo yomafiya nomoiyaxa yokulungila olumbololo lomungome,
nomafuma otaa ka nhukila kombada yovanhu voye nokombada yovapiya voye aveshe.’ ”
Natango Omwene okwa tya kuMoses: “Lombwela Aron: ‘Yelula eke loye li nonhaili kombada yomilonga adishe nomixupwalonga nomatale, opo omafuma a djuuke mo, edu alishe laEgipiti li yade omafuma.’ ”
NaAron okwa yelula eke laye kombada yomeva omuEgipiti, nomafuma a djuuka mo noa tuvika edu alishe laEgipiti.
Ndelenee eemhule osho yo da ninga noupule wado noda djuukifila edu laEgipiti omafuma.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana Moses naAron ndele te va lombwele: “Indileni kOmwene, a kufe po omafuma pwaame nopovanhu vange. Opo nee ame handi lekele ovanhu va dje mo va ka ningile Omwene exwikilo.”
Ndelenee Moses okwa lombwela Farao ta ti: “Lombwele nge onaini ndi ku ilikanene, onye novapiya voye novanhu voye, opo omafuma a kufwe po pwoove nopomaumbo, a kale mo ashike muNil.”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Ongula.” Opo ye ta ti: “Heeno, otashi ka ningwa paendjovo doye, opo u shiive nokutya, kape na kalunga nande kamwe ngaashi Omwene Kalunga ketu.
Nomafuma taa ka dja po pwoove nopeumbo loye nopovapiya voye nopovanhu voye. Ashike omuNil otaa ka kala.”
Opo nee Moses naAron ova dja po puFarao. Ndele Moses okwa kuwa kOmwene molwomafuma aa ye a undulilwa oku mu hepeka.
Ndele Omwene okwa ninga paendjovo daMoses; omafuma a fya mo momaumbo nomomaluumbo nomomapya.
Oo a ndubilwa eenduba, nedu ola nyika nai.
Farao eshi a mona ehepuluko le uya, ye okwa kukutika omutima waye ndele ine va pwilikina, ngaashi Omwene a popya.
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ta ti: “Lombwela Aron: ‘Yelula onhaili yoye u denge ondwi yedu, ndele yo otai ningi eemwe moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.’ ”
Ndele vo osho va ninga; Aron okwa yelula eke li nonhaili yaye nokwa denga ondwi yedu, opo nee eemwe da holokela ovanhu noimuna. Ondwi aishe yedu ya ninga eemwe moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.
Neemhule da kendabala okweeta po eemwe noupule wavo, ndelenee va nyengwa. Osho hano eemwe da li kovanhu nokoimuna.
Opo nee eemhule da lombwela Farao: “Eshi omunwe waKalunga!” Ndelenee omutima waFarao wa li wa kukuta opo ye ine va pwilikina ngaashi Omwene a tile.

Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses ta ti: “Meneka mongula u lilongekide okuholoka koshipala shaFarao, tala, ye ota ka ya komeva, ndele mu lombwela kutya Omwene osho ta ti: ‘Lekela ovanhu vange, va shiive okulongela nge.

Ndelenee ngeenge ito lekele ovanhu vange va dje po, opo nee tala, Ame ohandi mu tumine ove novapiya voye novanhu voye nomaumbo eni omawashe opo omaumbo aeshe Ovaegipiti taa kala e yadi omawashe nedu lo vene oku e li ofika.
Ndelenee mefiku tuu olo Ame ohandi tongola mo Gosen, omo ovanhu vange hava kala, opo muha kale omawashe, opo ove u shiive nokutya, Ame ndi li Omwene moshilongo.
Ndele Ame ohandi tula etongoko pokati koshiwana shange noshiwana shoye. Omadidiliko aa otaa ningwa mongula.’ ”
NOmwene osho a ninga: omawashe mahapu mahapu e uya meumbo laFarao nomomaumbo ovapiya vaye nomoshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti. Oshilongo sha hepekwa shili komawashe.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana Moses naAron ndele okwa tya: “Indeni mu ka ningile Kalunga omaxwikilo moshilongo eshi.”

Ndelenee Moses a nyamukula: “Inashi yuka oku shi ninga, osheshi eshi hatu shi yandjele Omwene Kalunga ketu, osho oixuna kOvaegipiti. Ngeenge hatu yambe eshi shoixuna momesho Ovaegipiti, vo itave tu dipaa nomamanya?
Tu lekela tu ka ende ondjila yomafiku atatu mombuwa, tu shiive okuyambela Omwene Kalunga ketu, ngaashi e tu lombwela.”
Opo nee Farao okwa tya: “Ame ohandi mu lekele, mu ye, opo mu shiive okuningila Omwene Kalunga keni exwikilo mombuwa. Ndelenee inamu ya kokule. Ilikanenei nge.”

Ndele Moses okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Tala, ame ohandi di pwoove, opo ndi indile Omwene, Ye a ninge nokutya omawashe a efe mongula Farao novapiya voye novanhu voye. Ashike Farao ehe tu kengelele vali oshiwana shiha dje mo okuyandjela Omwene omayambo.”
Opo nee Moses naAron va dja po puFarao ndele va indila kOmwene.
Ndele Omwene a ninga paendjovo daMoses; okwa kufa mo omawashe kuFarao nokovapiya vaye nokovanhu vaye. Inapa fyaala nande limwe.
Nopaife yo Farao okwa kukutika omutima waye, ndele ina lekela ovanhu, va dje mo.
9: Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses a ye kuFarao e mu lombwele: “Omwene Kalunga kOvaheberi ota ti ngaha: ‘Lekela ovanhu vange va dje mo, va shiive okulongela nge.
Osheshi ove ngeenge to anye oku va lekela, ndele to va kelele natango,
tala, eke lOmwene tali ka hanga oimuna yoye ei i li moixwa, neenghambe neendongi neengamelo neengobe needi; tadi kwatwa koudu mudjuu.
NOmwene ota ka tongola pokati koimuna yOvaisraeli noimuna yOvaegipiti, paha fye nande oshimwe shomwaai yOvaisraeli.’ ”
NOmwene okwa tula po efimbo, ndele okwa tya: “Efiku lomongula Omwene te shi ningi moshilongo ashishe.”
NOmwene okwe shi ninga efiku la shikula olo: Oimuna aishe yOvaegipiti oya fya. Ndelenee moimuna yOvaisraeli inamu fya nande shimwe.
NaFarao okwa tuma ko a ka shiive, ndele tala, moimuna yOvaisraeli inamu fya nande oshimwe. Ndelenee omutima waFarao wa li mukukutu ye ina lekela ovanhu va dje mo.
Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses naAron ta ti: “Kufeni ko omute wefiya omake eni avali e yadi, naMoses ne u undile pombada keulu moipafi yaFarao,
ndele ou otau ka ninga oshilemo shondwi kombada yedu alishe laEgipiti, tau ka eta mo oidinda idjuu muyo tamu di otwila movanhu nomoimuna moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti.”
Osho hano va kufa omudilombiya mefiya ndele va holoka koshipala shaFarao, naMoses e u ekela pombada keulu. Opo nee ou wa shituka oidinda i notwila movanhu nomoimuna.
Neemhule inadi shiiva okuholoka koshipala shaMoses molwoidinda. Osheshi oidinda ya li yo meemhule nomOvaegipiti aveshe.
Ndelenee Omwene okwa kukutika omutima waFarao, ehe va pwilikine, ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.

Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses a penduke ongula inene e lilongekide okuholoka koshipala shaFarao, e mu lombwele a tye: “Omwene Kalunga kOvaheberi ta ti ngaha: ‘Lekela ovanhu vange va shiive okulongela nge.
Osheshi paife eshi Ame ohandi ka tuma omahepeko ange aeshe kombada yoye mwene nokovapiya voye aveshe nokovanhu aveshe voye, opo va shiive nokutya, kombada yedu alishe kape na umwe ngaashi Ame.
Osheshi hanga nda yelula eke lange kwoove nokovanhu voye mu hangike koudu wolutapo, nosho ove wa dimwa po ngeno kombada yedu,
ndelenee Ame nde ku efa u kale po, opo ndi shiive okumonifa eenghono dange mwoove, edina lange opo li udifwe kombada yedu alishe.
Natango ove ho linenepekele oshiwana shange nokwaanya shiha dje mo.
Tala mongula pefimbo tuu eli, Ame ohandi ka lokifa eemhawe didjuu inadi monika nale muEgipiti kokudja efiku olo ekanghameno lasho la tulwa po fiyo opaife.

Tuma ko hano oimuna yoye naashishe u shi kwete poluhaela, i twalwe keenhele dokuyaama. Ovanhu aveshe noinamwenyo aishe ei i li pondje poluhaela; naai inai twalwa meenhele dokuyaama, eemhawe tadi i loko ndele tai fi.’ ”
Vamwe vomovapiya vaFarao ava hava tila ondjovo yOmwene, ova twala ovapika vavo noimuna yavo meengulu,
ndelenee ava inava yavala ondjovo yOmwene ova efa ovapika vavo noimuna yavo i kale moixwa.

Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndele ta ti: “Nana eke loye keulu, eemhawe opo tadi ka loka moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti, kombada yovanhu noinamwenyo nokombada yoimeno aishe yomoixwa moshilongo shaEgipiti.”
Ndele Moses okwa yelula onhaili yaye keulu, nOmwene okwa eta po endundumo neemhawe nokwa tuma omundilo kombada yedu. NOmwene okwa lokifila edu laEgipiti eemhawe.
Ndele pa li pe neemhawe didjuu, nomundilo wa xwama efimbo alishe mokati keemhawe; da tya ngaha inadi hanga edu laEgipiti nghee ovanhu va kala mo.
Neemhawe da denga ashishe eshi sha li poluhaela medu alishe laEgipiti, ovanhu noinamwenyo. Nosho yo eemhawe da denga oimeno aishe yomomapya, nomiti adishe domomufitu da teywa po.
Ashike moshikandjo Gosen, omo Ovaisraeli va kala, eemhawe inadi monika.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana Moses naAron ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ame nda nyona paife. Omwene Ye omuyuki, ndelenee fye novanhu vange tu netimba.
Ilikaneni Omwene, osheshi endundumo laKalunga neemhawe da ninga dihapu unene. Opo nee handi mu lekele, itamu pumbwa okukala po vali.”
Opo nee Moses te mu lombwela: “Shamha nda pita mo moshilando ame ohandi ka yelula omake ange kOmwene; endundumo tali ka mwena neemhawe itadi loko vali. Opo u shiive nokutya, edu olOmwene.
Ndelenee ondi shii nokutya, ove novapiya voye natango tuu inamu tila Omwene Kalunga.”
Ndele omindele nomahangu a nyonaunwa po, shaashi omahangu a li a kutumika nomindele da li da eta eenhemo.
Ndelenee oilyavala nomakunde inaa nyonauka po, shaashi oo a xuuninwa okumena.
Osho hano Moses a pita mo moshilando, a dja puFarao nokwa yelula omake aye kOmwene. Nendundumo neemhawe oda sheka nodula inai loka vali kedu.
Farao eshi a mona odula neemhawe da sheka, nendundumo la mwena, okwa nyona vali nokwa kukutika omutima waye, ye mwene novapiya vaye.
Heeno, omutima waFarao okwa li mukukutu onghee ina lekela Ovaisraeli, va dje mo, ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
10: Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses ndele ta ti: “Inda kuFarao, osheshi Ame nda kukutika omutima waye nomitima dovapiya vaye, opo ndi shiive okuwanifa omadidiliko ange mokati kavo,
naave yo opo u shiive okuhepaululila omumwoye nomutekulu woye, eshi Ame nda ninga muEgipiti, nomadidiliko ange nde a longa mokati kavo, opo va shiive nokutya, Aame Omwene.”

Opo nee Moses naAron ova ya kuFarao ndele tave mu lombwele: “Omwene Kalunga kOvaheberi osho ta ti: ‘Fiyo onaini ove to anye okulininipika koshipala shange? Lekela ovanhu vange, va shiive okulongela nge.
Ndelenee ngeenge to anye vali okulekela ovanhu vange va dje mo, tala, mongula ohandi ka tuma mo oshipaxu moshilongo shoye,
ndele sho otashi ka tuvika edu alishe loshilongo, omunhu opo a nyengwe okumona edu. Ndele sho otashi ka lya eshi sha xupa she mu xupifilwa po keemhawe. Nomiti adishe di li momufitu otashi ke di lya.

Neengulu doye neengulu dovapiya voye aveshe neengulu dOvaegipiti aveshe otadi ka yada oshipaxu, ouhapu washo inau monika kooxo nokooxokulu kokudja kefiku va kala kombada yedu nofiyo opaife.’ ” Ndele ye okwa punguluka nokwa pilamena ko a dja po puFarao.

Opo nee ovapiya vaFarao ve mu lombwela: “Fiyo onaini omulumenhu ou te ke tu ningila omwiyo? Lekela ovalumenhu va ye va ka longele Omwene Kalunga kavo. Ino shiiva mboli nokutya, Egipiti tashi teka po?”
Opo nee Moses naAron va ka alulwa ko, ve uya kuFarao, ndele ye te va lombwele: “Indeni ko hano mu ka longele Omwene Kalunga keni. Ndelenee oolyelye tamu i?”
Ndele Moses okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Fye ohatu i pamwe novanyasha novakulunhu novana vetu ovamati noukadona, noimuna yetu neengobe detu, osheshi twa hala okuningila Omwene oshivilo.”
Opo nee ye ta ti kuvo: “Heeno, Omwene na kale nanye, ame ngeenge handi mu efa, mu ye ko novana veni! Taleni, mu nomakoto meemwenyo deni!
Itashi ka ningwa! Indeni, nye ovalumenhu mu longele Omwene ngaashi mwa li mwa hala.” Ndele va tewatewa po puFarao.
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses: “Yelula eke loye kombada yedu laEgipiti, oshipaxu shi holoke kombada yoshilongo shaEgipiti, noshi lye oimeno aishe yoshilongo aishe ei ya xupa keemhawe.”
NaMoses okwa yelula onhaili yaye kombada yedu laEgipiti, nOmwene okwa pepifa omhepo yokoushilo moshilongo omutenya aushe noufiku aushe. Ongula eshi kwa sha omhepo yokoushilo ya eta oshipaxu.
Oshipaxu she uya medu alishe laEgipiti nosha wila moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti, eenduba dinene unene. Oshipaxu shi fike opo inashi kala po nale, noitashi ka holoka vali.

Ndele sho osha tuvika edu alishe loshilongo, nedu la li la twima. Ndele sho osha lya oimeno aishe noiimati yokomiti ei ya xupa keemhawe. Moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti inapa fyaala vali nande sha shitalala sha kala komiti ile koimeno yomomapya.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana diva Moses naAron ndele ta ti: “Ame nda nyona kuKalunga keni nokunye.
Dimeni po okunyona kwange oku natango, ndele indileni kOmwene Kalunga keni, a kufe po efyo eli.”
Ndele ye okwa dja po puFarao nokwa indila kOmwene.

Opo nee Omwene okwa pepifa po omhepo idjuu yokouninginino i shakene naikwao, yo oya kufa po oshipaxu noye shi undulila mEfuta Litilyana. Moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti inapa fyaala nande oshipaxu shimwe.
Ndelenee Omwene okwa kukutika omutima waFarao, ye ina lekela Ovaisraeli va dje mo.
Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses: “Yelula eke loye keulu, opo nee omilaulu tadi uya medu laEgipiti, omilaulu fokofoko di shiive okukwatwa keke.”
Moses eshi a yelula eke laye keulu, omilaulu fokofoko de uya moshilongo ashishe shaEgipiti, noda kala mo omafiku atatu.
Kape nomunhu kwa li e wete omukwao, nokape nomunhu a shiiva okulinyenga a dje mo monhele a kala omafiku atatu. Ndelenee Ovaisraeli aveshe va li ve nouyelele meenhele davo.
Opo nee Farao okwa ifana Moses ndele ta ti: “Indeni mu ka longele Omwene; ashike oimuna yeni neengobe deni nadi fyaale po. Ovana veni nava ye nanye.”
Ndele Moses ta ti: “Ove u noku tu pa yo eengobe domatomenoyambo nodomaxwikiloyambo tu di yandjele Omwene Kalunga ketu omayambo.

Hano oimuna i nokuuya pamwe nafye, nande ekondo limwe tali ka fyaala po, osheshi muyo tu nokukufa mo omayambo tu longele Omwene Kalunga ketu. Nafye vene yo inatu shiiva shike tu nokuyamba fimbo inatu fika ko oko, tu nokuyamba mokulongela kwetu Omwene.”
Ndelenee Omwene okwa kukutika omutima waFarao, onghee ye ina hala oku va lekela, va dje mo.
Ndelenee Farao okwe mu lombwela: “Inda, dja po pwaame. Tala, uha holoke vali koshipala shange. Osheshi efiku olo ove to holoka koshipala shange, ove u nokufya.”
Ndele Moses okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ove wa popya sha yuka. Ame itandi ka mona vali oshipala shoye.”
11: Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses ndele ta ti: “Natango ehandukilo limwe Ame ohandi ke li etela Farao naEgipiti. Opo nee ye te mu lekele, mu dje po apa. Ye ngeenge te mu efa mu dje mo nye amushe, ye ote mu taataa mo mu dje mo shili.
Lombwela hano ovanhu, keshe omulumenhu nakeshe omukainhu, na ehele omushiinda shaye oinima oisiliveli noingoldo.”
Ndele Omwene okwa monifa ovanhu onghenda momesho Ovaegipiti. NaMoses yo okwa li a fimanekwa unene moshilongo shaEgipiti momesho ovapiya vaFarao nomomesho oshiwana.
Ndele Moses okwa tya: “Omwene osho ta ti: ‘Pokati koufiku Ame ohandi ka endaenda muEgipiti,
opo nee oiveli aishe moshilongo shaEgipiti tai ka fya, okudja koshiveli shaFarao, ou ta kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo fiyo okoshiveli shomupika ou ta tu koshini nofiyo okoiveli aishe yoimuna.
Ndele tamu ka kala okulila kunene medu alishe laEgipiti, ngaashi inapa kala nande nale, noitapa ka kala vali.
Ndelenee kape nOmuisraeli umwe nande ombwa tai mu linyengifile elaka nande movanhu ile moimuna, opo mu shiive nokutya, Omwene ta ningi etongolo pokati kOvaegipiti nOvaisraeli.’ ”

Opo nee ovapiya voye aveshe ava tave ke uya kwaame nokulinyongamena poshi koshipala shange ndele tava ti: “Dja po, ove noshiwana ashishe eshi tashi ku shikula. Opo nee handi di po.” Nokwa dja po puFarao nehandu la hanya.
NOmwene okwa lombwela Moses ndele ta ti: “Farao ite ke mu pwilikina, opo oikumwifalonga yange i ninge ihapu medu laEgipiti.”
Ndele Moses naAron va ningila oikumwifalonga aishe ei moipafi yaFarao. Ndelenee Omwene okwa kukutika omutima waFarao, opo ye ina lekela Ovaisraeli va dje mo moshilongo shaye.
12: Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Moses naAron medu laEgipiti ta ti:
“Ohani tuu ei, oyo i noku mu ningila ehovelo leehani deni. Yo i noku mu ningila ohani yotete yomeehani domudo.
Lombweleni eongalo alishe laIsrael nokutya: Mefiku etimulongo lohani ei keshe umwe muvo, keshe omunyeumbo, e nokukufa odjona, keshe eumbo odjona.
