“Ove novana voye ovamati inamu nwa omaviinyu ile oikolwifa nye ngeenge tamu i metwali leongalo, muha fye. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe yomomaludalo eni.
Ndele nye mu nokutongola eshi shiyapuki nashi shihe fi shiyapuki, naashi sha koshoka nashi inashi koshoka,
ndele nye mu nokulonga ovana vaIsrael eenghedimhango adishe Omwene e di va shiivifila mokanya kaMoses.”

Ndele Moses okwa popya naAron novana vaye ovamati Eliaser naItamar, ava va xupa po, ndele ta ti: “Kufeni eendjayambo da xupa po komindiloyambo dOmwene, ndele di lyeni po ngaashi oikuki ihe nonhafi poaltari. Osheshi odo diyapukielela.
Onghee hano mu noku di lila monhele iyapuki, osheshi odo oshipewa shoye shovana voye ovamati shokomindiloyambo dOmwene. Eshi osho nda lombwelwa.

Nosho yo ombadja yedungadungifwayambo noshilama sheyelulwayambo nye mu noku i lila monhele iyapuki, ove pamwe novana voye ovamati noukadona. Shaashi ngaashi oshipewa shoye noshovana voye ovamati mwe shi pewa komapanduloyambo ovana vaIsrael.

Oshilama sheyelulwayambo nombadja yedungadungifwayambo pamwe noipambu nomakaadi omundiloyambo, vo ove nokudungadungifa koshipala shOmwene ngaashi edungadungifwayambo. Ndele olo tali ka ninga oshitukulwa shoye novana voye ovamati pamwe naave fiyo alushe, Omwene ngaashi a popya.”
Ndele Moses okwa konga nokukongelela oshikombo shetimbayambo, ndelenee tashi xwikwa po! Onghee hano ye okwa handukila unene Eliaser naItamar, ovana ovamati vaAron, ava va xupa po, ndele ye okwa tile:
“Omolwashike etimbayambo inamu li lila monhele iyapuki? Osheshi olo liyapukielela, ye okwe li mu pa omanyonauno eongalo a kufwe po, oku va kwatakanifa koshipala shOmwene.
Taleni, ohonde yalo inai etwa mo metwali liyapuki. Nye mu noku li lila shili metwali liyapuki ngaashi nde mu lombwela.”

Opo nee Aron ta ti kuMoses: “Tala, vo ova eta nena eli etimbayambo lavo nexwikiloyambo lavo koshipala shOmwene, noinima ya tya ngaha ya hanga nge. Ame ngeenge handi li nena etimbayambo, otashi wapalele tuu Omwene?”
Moses, eshi e shi uda, oshe mu wapalela.
11: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses naAron ndele ta ti kuvo:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye: Oinamwenyo yomoinamwenyo i nomaulu ane, ei i li kombada yedu, ei tamu li, oyo ei:
Mokati koinamwenyo lyeni aishe ei i nomakondo a pandjuka naai i nomakondo a pandjuka fiyo poshi, naai hai alula.
Ndelenee ei hai alula noi nomakondo inaa pandjuka inamu i lya, nokutya, ongamelo, osheshi yo ohai alula, ndelenee ihe nomakondo a pandjuka. Oyo inai koshoka kunye;
okahele, shaashi ko otaka alula, ndelenee kehe nomakondo a pandjuka. Ko inaka koshoka kunye,
nondiba, shaashi nayo otai alula, ndelenee kai nomakondo a pandjuka. Yo inai koshoka kunye.
Nosho yo oshingulu, osheshi sho oshi nomakondo a pandjuka, heeno, ndelenee ihashi alula, inashi koshoka kunye.
Ombelela yayo inamu i lya noinamu i kuma, ngeenge ya fya. Yo inai koshoka kunye.”
Mwaaishe ei i li momeva, lyeni aishe ei i nomilenge nomapeta i li momeva, mefuta nomomilonga. Oyo mu lya.
Ndelenee aishe ei ihe nomilenge nomapeta ei i li mefuta nomomilonga, aishe ei tai myakatala momeva noinamwenyo aishe ei i li momeva; oyo oshidila kunye.
Heeno, oyo mu noku i tonda. Ombelela yayo inamu i lya. Tondeni ei ya fya.
Oikwameva aishe ei ihe nomilenge nomapeta, oyo oshidila kunye.
Meedila tondeni edi, inamu di lya, ndelenee do nadi ninge oshidila kunye, nokutya: onhwa, oshikodinhwa, oshikombenhwa,
neimbi nookakodi pamaludi avo,
nekola keshe pamaludi alo,
nomho, okahanameva, edilafuta, okakodinghuti pamaludi avo,
neshikiti nahamukwateeshi nexuvi,
ekulu, nonyundu, enyamhanghalwa,
enghumbinghumbi, oolukenghe pamaludi avo, depupu nelimalima.
Noupuka aveshe ve nomavava hava ende nomaulu ane. Vo oshidila kunye.
Ndelenee oupuka aveshe ve nomavava, ava hava ende nomaulu ane, lyeni, ava ve nomaulu okunhukauka kombinga yokombada yomaulu, opo va nhukauke nao kombada yedu.
Vo muvo lyeni ava, nokutya: oshipaxu paludi lasho, oshipaxu shekamuti paludi lasho noshipaxu shanakapipi paludi lasho, noshipaxupuka shokunhukauka,
ndelenee oupuka aveshe ava ve nomavava nomaulu ane, vo oshidila kunye.
Nye otamu nyatekwa kounamwenyo ava; keshe umwe ta kumu ounamwenyo ava va fya, ota kala a nyata fiyo onguloshi.
Nakeshe umwe ta humbata ounamwenyo va fya e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukala a nyata fiyo onguloshi.
Noinamwenyo aishe ei i nomakondo a pandjuka, ndelenee inaa pandjuka fiyo oposhi noitai alula, yo oshidila kunye. Keshe umwe te i kumu ota ka kala a nyata.
Ndele aishe ei tai endifa omakasha mokati koinamwenyo nomaulu ane, yo oshidila kunye. Keshe umwe ta kumu oinamwenyo ei ya fya, e nokukala a nyata fiyo onguloshi.
Nosho yo ava hava humbata oinamwenyo ya fya ve nokukosha oikutu yavo nokukala va nyata fiyo onguloshi. Yo oshidila kunye.
Nomomapuka aa tae linyenge kombada yedu oo oshidila kunye nokutya, onghwi nomhuku noinyengele pamaludi ayo,
shinyengu nashinyengele, vandako womomapeta, nashikoko nafimbi.
Yo oshidila kunye momapuka aeshe; keshe umwe te a kumu oo ngeenge a fya e nokukala a nyata fiyo onguloshi.

Naashishe eshi tashi wilwa kuyo, otashi kala sha nyata. Oilongifo yomomiti ile oikutu ile oshipa ile oshako, keshe oshinima tashi longifwa, shi nokutulwa momeva ndele tashi kala sha nyata fiyo onguloshi. Opo nee tashi kala sha yela.
Noshiyuma shelova keshe musho limwe lomwoo tali wile mo, ashishe shi li mo osha nyata, nanye mu noku shi tatula.
Eendja adishe tadi liwa oda nyata, ngeenge omeva omoshiyuma osho otaa i mo. Nokunwa akushe taku nuwa otaku kala kwa nyata moshiyuma sha tya ngaha.
Keshe eshi tashi wilwa komapuka a fya, otashi kala sha nyata. Efiya lelova lokuteleka mo omungome li nokungumaunwa po, osheshi ola nyata, ndele nali kale la nyata kunye.
Ndelenee omeva omofifiya ile omomufima ile mondobe e nokukala a yela. Ndelenee ou ta kumu oshinamwenyo sha fya, sha fila mo, ota kala a nyata.
Ndele ngeenge oshinamwenyo shomuyo sha fya, tashi wile kombada yombuto ya kunwa, yo oya koshoka.
Ndelenee ombuto ngeenge ya tekelwa noshinamwenyo shomuyo sha fya tashi wile ko, opo nee tai kala oshidila kunye.
Noshinamwenyo shi noshilonga kunye ngaashi eendja deni, ngeenge tashi fi, ou ta kumu eshi she lifila e nokukala a nyata fiyo onguloshi,
ndele ou ta li eshi she lifila, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukala a nyata fiyo onguloshi. Ndele ou ta humbata eshi she lifila e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukala a nyata fiyo onguloshi.
Ndelenee omapuka aeshe tae linyenge kombada yedu, oo oshidila, itaa liwa.
Oyaalangati aishe naaishe hai ende nomaulu ane, nosho aishe i nomaulu mahapu nokutya, oupuka ovo have linyenge kombada yedu, nye inamu va lya, vo oshidila.
Inamu litondifa nye vene mokukuma oupuka tave linyenge, nye inamu linyateka kuvo, muha kale mwa nyata.
Osheshi Aame Omwene Kalunga keni. Liyapuleni hano mu kale ovayapuki, shaashi Ame omuyapuki. Onghee hano inamu linyateka omolwoupuka tave likoko kombada yedu.
Osheshi Aame Omwene, ou nde mu pitifa mo medu laEgipiti, opo ndi kale Kalunga keni. Osho ngaha hano nye mu nokukala ovayapuki shaashi Ame omuyapuki.
Omhango oyo tuu ei yoinamwenyo noyeedila noyoinamwenyo aishe ei tai linyenge momeva noyaaishe tai linyenge kombada yedu,
opo pa kale etongoko pokati kaashi sha nyata naashi shi yela nopokati koinamwenyo tai liwa naai itai liwa.
12: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndele ta ti:
Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye: Omukainhu ngeenge a ninga oufimba ngeenge a dala okaana okamati, ye e nokukala ina yela oule womafiku aheyali. Omafiku e fike pokumona ohani yaye e nokukala ina yela.
Ndele mefiku etihetatu okaana okamati ke noku ka tetwa oshipa shonhele youlumenhu wako.
Ndelenee omudali e nokukala meumbo omafiku omilongo nhatu naatatu fimbo oumwali waye tau oka. Na kale iha kumu sha shoshiyapuki ndele ita i ketwali liyapuki fiyo omafiku oumwali waye a pwa.
Ndelenee ye ngeenge ta dala okaana okakadona, ye e nokukala oivike ivali mokuhayela kwaye ngaashi moumwali. Opo nee ye e nokukala omafiku omilongo hamano naahamano moumwali waye.

Nomafiku oumwali konima yokudala okaana okamati ile okakadona, ngeenge a pwa, ye na ete odi yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo komupristeli nokanghutyona ile onghuti molwetimbayambo poshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Ye e noku i yamba koshipala shOmwene noku mu kwatakanifa. Opo nee ye ota ka kala a koshoka ketiko lohonde yaye. Oyo omhango yomudali wokaana okamati ile okakadona.

Ndelenee ye ngeenge ohepele iha dulu okulilandela odjona, ye e nokukufa omalyamono avali ile eenghutyona mbali, imwe exwikiloyambo naikwao etimbayambo. Nomupristeli e noku mu kwatakanifa. Opo nee ye ota kala a koshoka.
13: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses naAron ndele ta ti:

Moshipa shomunhu ngeenge tamu holoka ombulwa ile evangwa ile okavangwa ka toka, ngaashi oudu woshilundu tau hovele moshipa shombelela yaye, ye e nokutwalwa komupristeli Aron ile komona waye umwe womupristeli.

Nomupristeli e nokutala onhele ei i noudu womoshipa shaye. Olududi lomevangwa ngeenge olitoka noshipa ngeenge sha footela opo, eshi osho nee oudu woshilundu. Omupristeli ngeenge te shi mono e noku mu lombwela, nokutya okwa nyata.
Ndelenee moshipa ngeenge omu nevangwa litoka, ndele lo inali footela nolududi lomulo, inali toka, omupristeli e nokwiidilila mo omunaudu mefimbo li fike pomafiku aheyali.

Omupristeli ngeenge te mu konakona mefiku etiheyali, ndele ta mono nokutya, evangwa pakutala kwaye, oli li ngaashi la kala, evangwa inali tandavela moshipa, opo nee omupristeli e noku mu idilila mo vali omafiku aheyali.

Omupristeli ne mu konakone vali mefiku etiheyali, nongeenge ta mono evangwa la mbuduka noinali tandavela moshipa, opo nee omupristeli te mu lombwele nokutya ke noshilundu. Olo evangwa longaho; na koshe oikutu yaye, opo ta kala a yela.
Ndelenee evangwa ngeenge tali tandavele moshipa shaye konima yeliulikilo lomupristeli opo a talwe a yela, ye a nokuliulikila vali omupristeli.
Omupristeli ngeenge ta mono nokutya, evangwa la tandavela moshipa, opo nee omupristeli e noku mu tongola nokutya ou oo oudu woshilundu.
Oudu woshilundu ngeenge u li momunhu, ye e nokutwalwa komupristeli.
Nomupristeli ngeenge ta mono nokutya, moshipa omu nombulwa itoka, olududi lomuyo la toka fimbo onhumba tai umhuka mo mombulwa,
opo nee oo oudu woshilundu shikulu moshipa shaye, onghee hano omupristeli e noku mu tongola. Ye ine mu idilila mo vali, shaashi ye ina yela.
Ndelenee oudu woshilundu ngeenge tau holoka neenghono moshipa nokutandavela moshipa ashishe shomunaudu okudja komutwe waye fiyo okeemhadi daye, ngaashi omupristeli ta koneke mokutala kwaye;
omupristeli ngeenge ta mono oudu woshilundu wa tuvika olutu alushe, opo nee ye ta lombwele omunaudu nokutya, ye a yela; ye okwa toka kolutu alishe, ye a yela.
Ndelenee shamha pa monika onhumba tai umhuka mo mombulwa, ye ta ka tongolwa, ye ina yela.
Nomupristeli ngeenge ta mono onhumba ya umhuka mo mombulwa, ye e noku mu tongola. Onhumba ya umhuka, oyo ya nyata, oyo oudu woshilundu.
Ndelenee onhumba ya umhuka ngeenge ya dja po ndele ye ta toka, ye e nokuya komupristeli.
Omupristeli ngeenge te mu konakona ndele ta mono nokutya, ombulwa ya toka, opo nee omupristeli e nokulombwela omunaudu: “wa yela.” Oye a yela.
Ndelenee moshipa shomunhu ngeenge tamu holoka oshidinda, ndele tashi veluka,
ndelenee monhele yoshidinda ngeenge tamu holoka ombulwa itoka ile evangwa litoka litilyana, ye e nokuliulikila omupristeli.
Omupristeli ngeenge ta mono nokutya, sho osha footela, nolududi lomusho la toka, opo nee omupristeli e noku mu shiivifila ye e noudu woshilundu, wa holoka moshidinda.
Ndelenee omupristeli ngeenge te shi konakona, ndele musho muhe nolududi litoka noinashi footela nosha mbuduka, opo nee omupristeli e noku mu idilila mo omafiku aheyali.
Nongeenge oudu wa tandavela shili moshipa, omupristeli e noku mu shiivifila ye e noudu. Owo oudu woshilundu.
Ndelenee ombulwa ngeenge tai kala po itai tandavele, oyo oshivadi shoshidinda, nomupristeli e noku mu shiivifila nokutya, ye a yela.
Ile ngeenge monhumba, nokutya moshipa omu nonhele ya pya komundilo nonhumba ipe yomonhele ya pya itilyana ile itoka,

nomupristeli ote i konakona, ndele ta mono nokutya, olududi lomevangwa la mbuduka litoka nola footela, opo nee owo oudu woshilundu. Monhele ya pya owa holoka. Onghee hano omupristeli e noku mu shiivifila ye e noudu. Owo oudu woshilundu.
Ndelenee omupristeli ngeenge te li konakona, ndele ta mono nokutya, mevangwa la toka muhe nolududi litoka ndele inali footela ndele la mbuduka, opo nee omupristeli e noku mu idilila omafiku aheyali.
Opo nee omupristeli e noku mu konakona mefiku etiheyali. Owo ngeenge wa tandavela shili moshipa, omupristeli e noku mu shiivifila ye e noudu. Oo oudu woshilundu.

Ndelenee evangwa litoka ngeenge la kala ngaashi la li, inali tandavela moshipa nola mbuduka, opo lo oshivadi shoshipute shomundilo. Onghee hano omupristeli e noku mu shiivifila ehe noudu. Olo oshivadi shoshipute shomundilo.
Natango ngeenge momulumenhu ile momukainhu tamu holoka evangwa momutwe ile meendjedi,

nomupristeli te li konakona ndele ta mono lo la footela nomulo omu noulududi vanini va twima, opo nee omupristeli te mu shiivifile, ye e noudu. Olo evangwa tali nyu, lo oudu woshilundu wokomutwe ile womeendjedi.

Ndelenee omupristeli mokukonakona kwaye evangwa tali nyu, ngeenge ta mono nokutya, lo ola footela ndele mulo muhe nolududi lilaula, opo nee omupristeli e nokwiidilila mo ou e nevangwa tali nyu, a kale a idililwa omafiku aheyali.
Omupristeli ngeenge ta konakona mefiku etiheyali evangwa ndele ta mono nokutya, evangwa tali nyu inali tandavela nomulo muhe nolududi la mbuduka, nevangwa tali nyu inali footela,
opo nee omunhu e nokulikulula ndelenee onhele yevangwa ite i kulula, nomupristeli e nokwiidilila mo vali omunhu e nevangwa tali nyu, a kale mo omafiku aheyali a idililwa.

Mefiku etiheyali omupristeli ngeenge ta konakona evangwa tali nyu ndele ta mono nokutya, evangwa inali tandavela moshipa ndele inali footela, opo nee omupristeli e noku mu shiivifila, ye ke noudu woshilundu, ndele ye e nokukosha oikutu yaye ndele ta kala a yela.
Ndelenee evangwa tali nyu ngeenge tali tandavele shili moshipa konima ye eshi a shiivifilwa nokutya, ye a yela,
nomupristeli te li konakona ndele ta mono nokutya, evangwa tali nyu la tandavela moshipa, omupristeli ita tale vali olududi la mbuduka; ye e noudu woshilundu.
Ndelenee evangwa tali nyu, ngeenge pakutala kwaye, la kala ngaashi la li nolududi lilaula tali kulu mulo, opo nee evangwa ola veluka. Ye a yela, nomupristeli e noku mu shiivifila ye ke noudu.
Natango moshipa shomulumenhu ile shomukainhu ngeenge tamu monika omavangwa, omavangwa a toka,
nomupristeli ota mono nokutya, moshipa shavo omu nomavangwa a mbuduka a toka, opo nee oo omavangwa ongaho a holoka moshipa. Ye a yela.
Ndele omutwe womulumenhu ngeenge tau duduka eexwiki, ye omutwe wongwala, oye a yela.
Ndele omutwe waye ngeenge tau duduka eexwiki koshipala, oye e nongwala. Ye a yela.
Ndelenee mongwala yaye yokekofi ile yokoshipala ngeenge tamu holoka okanhele ka tilyana noka toka, opo nee oo oudu woshilundu wa holoka mongwala yaye yokekofi ile yokoshipala.
Omupristeli ngeenge te ka tale ndele ta mono ombulwa mongwala yokekofi ile yokoshipala i tilyana noi toka ngaashi oudu woshilundu moshipa,
opo nee ye omunashilundu, ye ina yela, omupristeli e noku mu tongola mo shili, ye e noudu komutwe waye.
Natango, oikutu yomunashilundu ou e noudu i nokukala ya pombaulwa, neexwiki daye dokomutwe di nokweendjelela. Ye e nokutuvika yo eendjedi daye nokwiingida: “Omunashilundu! Omunashilundu!”
Ye ta kala ina yela, fimbo oudu u li muye. Ye omunashilundu. E nokulikalela. Ye e nokulikalela pondje yonhanda.
Oudu woshilundu ngeenge tau holoka moshikutu sholududi ile sholiina,
ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno woliina ile wolududi ile moshipa nakeshe eshi sha hondjelwa oshipa,

ndele onhele ya hangika koudu i li moshikutu ile moshipa ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno ile mushimwe sha hondjelwa oshipa, hano onhele ei ngeenge ya fa omafo a hapa ile i tilyana, opo nee oo oudu woshilundu, vo ve i ulikila omupristeli.
Omupristeli e nokukonakona onhele ya hangika noudu nokutuvikila oinima ya hangika noudu omafiku aheyali.

Opo nee mefiku etiheyali ye e nokukonakona onhele. Oudu ngeenge wa tandavela moshikutu ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno ile moshipa shamha oshilonga oshipa tashi longifwa, opo owo oudu, oudu woshilundu shidjuu. Yo inai yela.

Onghee hano ye e nokuxwika po oshikutu ile eengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile omutonyeno wolududi ile woliina ile oinima imwe muyo mu nonhele ya hangika noudu. Osheshi owo oudu woshilundu shidjuu. Oyo i nokuxwikwa po momundilo.
Ndelenee omupristeli ngeenge ta mono onhele ya hangika moshikutu ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno ile moinima imwe, nokutya inai tandavela,
opo nee omupristeli e noku va lombwela vo ve nokukosha oshinima nonhele muyo sha hangika. Ndele ye e noku shi idilila mo natango omafiku aheyali.

Omupristeli ngeenge ta konakona oshinima sha hangika noudu, sho eshi sha koshwa, ndele ta mono onhele naanaa osho i li, nande inai tandavela, opo nee sho inashi yela. Ye e noku shi xwika po momundilo. Osho oudu woshilundu ngeenge kombada ile meni.
Ndelenee omupristeli ngeenge ta mono kutya onhele oyo eshi ya koshwa, oya mbuduka, opo nee ye e noku i konda mo moshikutu ile moshipa ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno.

Ndelenee oo ngeenge tau holoka vali moshikutu ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno ile moinima imwe ya longwa noshipa, opo nee oo oudu woshilundu wa holoka vali. Ye e nokuxwika momundilo oshinima sha hangika noudu.
Ndelenee oshikutu ile eengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile omutonyeno ile oshinima shimwe sha koshwa, onhele ngeenge ya dja mo, sho shi nokukoshwa vali lumwe, opo tashi ka kala sha yela.
Oyo omhango youdu woshilundu wa li moshikutu sholududi ile sholiina ile meengodi da poshelwa kumwe ile momutonyeno ile moshinima shimwe shoshipa, opo shi tongwe ngeenge sha yela ile inashi yela.
14: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndele ta ti:
Oyo omhango yomunashilundu mefiku lokufetwa mo kwaye. Ye e nokutwalwa komupristeli,
nomupristeli e nokuya pondje yonhanda. Omupristeli ngeenge ta mono oudu woshilundu wa veluka, wa efa omunashilundu,
omupristeli e nokulombwela ovakwao, vo va etele omuyelifwa eedila mbali di nomwenyo da koshoka nomuti wasederi, ongodi itilyana omheke naisopi.
Omupristeli ne va lombwele va dipaele odila imwe kombada yoshiyuma shelova musho mu nomeva mawa a yela.

Ye e nokukufa odila i nomwenyo nosho yo omuti wasederi nongodi itilyana omheke naisopi, oyo pamwe nodila i nomwenyo ye e noku i tula mo mohonde yodila ya dipaelwa kombada yoshiyuma shi nomeva mawa a yela.
Ndele ye e nokushamina ou e nokufetwa mo moudu woshilundu luheyali, noku mu ingidila eveluko, nodila i nomwenyo ye e noku i efa i tuke i ye noixwa.
Opo nee ou ta fetwa mo e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukululifa eexwiki dokomutwe nokulikosha. Opo nee ye a yela, ndele ta dulu okuuya monhanda, ndelenee e nokukala omafiku aheyali pondje yetwali laye.

Nomefiku etiheyali e nokukulula eexwiki adishe, eexwiki dokomutwe neendjedi neefeleisho, heeno, eexwiki daye adishe, ndele ye e nokukosha oikutu yaye, nolutu laye e noku li kosha momeva. Opo nee ye ta ka kala a yela.

Ndele mefiku etihetatu e nokukufa oudjona vavali vehe noshipo nokadjona okakadi komudo umwe kehe noshipo ndele e nokukufa oufila wa nakwa u fike peekilograma nhatu ngaashi eendjayambo mwa pilulilwa omaadi, nomaadi oshitatu sholita.
Nomupristeli ou ta fetifa na tule omunhu ou e nokufetwa mo neeshali daye koshipala shOmwene poshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Nomupristeli e nokukufa odjona imwe ye e i ete okuvelombediyambo pamwe nomaadi oshitatu sholita ndele te i dungadungifa koshipala shOmwene ngaashi edungadungifwayambo.
Opo nee ta dipaele odjona monhele apa hava tomene etimbayambo nexwikiloyambo, monhele iyapuki. Osheshi okuvelombediyambo ngaashi etimbayambo otai ningi yomupristeli. Olo liyapukielela.

Nomupristeli e nokukufa ohonde imwe yokuvelombediyambo, nomupristeli e noku i polola kokutwi kwokolulyo kwaau ta ka fetwa mo, nokomunwe wakula wokeke laye lokolulyo nokomunwe waye wakula wokomhadi yaye yokolulyo.
Omupristeli e nokukufa mo mulo omaadi noku a tila meke lomupristeli lokolumosho.
Opo nee omupristeli e nokutwa omunwe weke lokolulyo momaadi aa e li meke lokolumosho nokushamina omaadi nomunwe waye luheyali koshipala shOmwene.

Ndelenee momaadi aa a xupa po aa e li meke laye, omupristeli e nokupolola okutwi kwokolulyo kwaau ta fetwa mo, ndele komunwe waye wakula wokeke lokolulyo nokomunwe waye wakula wokomhadi yaye yokolulyo kombada yohonde yokuvelombediyambo.
Omaadi aa a xupa po e li meke lokolumosho lomupristeli, ye e noku a vaeka komutwe waau ta ka fetwa mo. Osho ngaha hano omupristeli e noku mu kwatakanifa koshipala shOmwene.
Omupristeli e nokuyamba yo etimbayambo nokukwatakanifa ou ta ka fetwa mo omolwoudu waye. Opo nee ye ta tomo exwikiloyambo.
Nomupristeli e nokuyamba exwikiloyambo neendjayambo koaltari. Osho ngaha hano omupristeli e noku mu kwatakanifa, ndele ye ota ka kala a yela.

Ndelenee ye ngeenge ohepele noita dulu oku i futa, ye e nokukufa odjona imwe okuvelombediyambo li dungadungifwe, li mu kwatakanife. Ndele pamwe nayo e nokweeta eendjayambo oufila wa nakwa u fike pokilograma imwe wa pilulilwa omaadi, nomaadi oshitatu sholita.
Nosho yo omalyamono avali ile eenghutyona mbali odo nge ye ta dulu okulilandela. Ndele imwe yomudo tai ka ninga etimbayambo naikwao exwikiloyambo.
Ye e noku di eta komupristeli mefiku etihetatu lokufetwa mo kwaye, poshivelo shetwali leongalo koshipala shOmwene.
Nomupristeli e nokukufa odjona yokuvelombediyambo nomaadi. Ndele omupristeli e noku i dungadungifa koshipala shOmwene ngaashi edungadungifwayambo.

Opo nee ye e nokudipaa odjona yokuvelombediyambo, nomupristeli e nokukufa mohonde yokuvelombediyambo noku i polola kokutwi kwokolulyo kwaau ta fetwa mo nokomunwe wakula wokeke lokolulyo nokomunwe wakula wokomhadi yokolulyo;
omupristeli e nokutila mo yo omaadi meke lokolulyo laye.
Opo nee omupristeli e nokushamina nomunwe wokeke lokolulyo luheyali omaadi e li meke laye lokolumosho, koshipala shOmwene.

Nomaadi aa e li meke laye omupristeli e nokupolola okutwi kwokolulyo kwaau ta fetwa mo, nokomunwe wakula wokeke lokolulyo nokomunwe wakula wokomhadi yaye yokolulyo, kombada yonhele yohonde yokuvelombediyambo.
Oo a xupa po komaadi omeke lomupristeli e noku a vaeka komutwe waau ta fetwa mo, ye opo e mu kwatakanife koshipala shOmwene.
Opo nee ye e nokuyamba elyamono limwe ile onghutyona imwe oyo a dula okulilandela,
imwe etimbayambo naikwao exwikiloyambo pamwe neendjayambo. Osho ngaha hano omupristeli e nokukwatakanifa ou ta fetwa mo koshipala shOmwene.
Oyo omhango yaau e noudu woshilundu oo ita dulu okuyandja omaano oo a ufilwa ewapaleko laye.
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses naAron ndele ta ti:
Onye ngeenge tamu tula medu laKaanan, olo handi ke mu pa ngaashi leni vene, ndele Ame handi tumu oudu woshilundu meumbo limwe lomoshilongo sheni,
mwene weumbo e nokuuya okulombwela omupristeli ndele ta ti: “Eumbo lange ola fa li noudu woshilundu.”
Nomupristeli ne va lombwele vo va tute mo aishe yomeumbo, fimbo omupristeli ine uya okutala oudu, opo aishe ei i li meumbo iha kwatwe koudu. Opo nee omupristeli te uya okukonakona eumbo.
Ye ngeenge ta konakona oudu ndele ta mono nokutya, oudu u li momakuma eumbo ngaashi ounhele va laula ngaashi oulaule womafo nova tilyana, ndele va footela,
opo nee omupristeli e nokudja mo nokuya koshivelo noku shi idila po omafiku aheyali.
Mefiku etiheyali omupristeli e nokwaaluka. Ye ngeenge ta mono oudu wa tandavela momakuma eumbo,
opo nee omupristeli te va lombwele va natule mo omamanya muwo mu noudu, ndele ve a ekeleshi koshala pondje yoshilando.
Eumbo lovene oli nokuyavwa meni keembinga adishe nokweekelashi omunoko ve u yaa, koshala pondje yoshilando.
Opo nee ve nokukufa omamanya amwe noku a tula ponhele yomamanya enya nove nokukufa omunoko umwe va kolonge eumbo.
Ndelenee oudu ngeenge tau holoka vali meumbo, vo eshi va natula omamanya nokuyaa eumbo nove li kolonga nomunoko,
omupristeli e nokuuya ndele ye ngeenge ta mono oudu wa tandavela meumbo; opo nee meumbo omu noudu woshilundu shidjuu. Olo inali yela.
Onghee hano ve nokungumauna po eumbo, omamanya alo noiti yalo nomunoko aushe womeumbo, ndele vo ve noku i twala koshala pondje yoshilando.
Ndele ou te uya meumbo fimbo lo la li la patwa, ye e nokukala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Naau ta nangala meumbo olo, e nokukosha oikutu yaye; naau ta li meumbo olo, e nokukosha oikutu yaye.

Ndelenee omupristeli ngeenge te uya, ndele ta mono oudu inau tandavela vali meumbo, olo eshi la kolongululwa, opo nee omupristeli te va shiivifile nokutya, eumbo ola yela, osheshi onhele omu mwa li oudu ya yela.
Opo nee ye na kufe eedila mbali molweyelifo leumbo, nosho yo omuti wasederi, ongodi itilyana omheke naisopi,
nokudipaela odila imwe moshiyuma shelova shi nomeva mawa a yela.
Opo nee ye e nokukufa omuti wasederi naisopi nongodi itilyana omheke nodila i nomwenyo, noku i yaveka mohonde yodila ya dipawa nomomeva a yela shekesheke. Ndele ye e nokushamina eumbo luheyali.
Osho ngaha hano ye e nokuyelifa eumbo nohonde yodila nomeva mawa a yela nodila i nomwenyo nomuti wasederi naisopi nongodi itilyana omheke.
Opo nee ta efa odila i nomwenyo pondje yoshilando i tuke, i ye noixwa. Osho ngaha hano ye e nokukwatakanifa eumbo, ndele olo tali ka kala la yela.
Oyo hano omhango youdu keshe woshilundu noyomavangwa taa nyu,
noyoshilundu shomoikutu noshomomaumbo
noyoidinda noyeembulwa noyevangwa la mbuduka,
oku va longa onaini oinima ya kwatwa koudu nonaini ya yela. Oyo omhango youdu woshilundu.
15: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses naAron
va lombwele ovana vaIsrael va tye: “Moulumenhu womulumenhu ngeenge tamu tika omahiyoyo, omahiyoyo aye oshiponga.
Ndele oshiponga shaye molwokutika kwaye osheshi: moulumenhu waye ngeenge tamu tika omahiyoyo ile ngeenge oulumenhu waye wa fita, muye omu noshiponga.
“Omutala keshe mwoo tamu nangala ou e netiko, tau talwa oo oshiponga. Naapeshe ye a kala omutumba, tapa ka kala oshiponga.
Nakeshe ou ta kumu omutala waawinya e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ta kala omunashidila fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele ou ta kala omutumba koshipundi kusho winya e netiko a li ko omutumba, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ye ta kala omunashidila fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele ou ha kumu olutu laau e netiko lomaxu, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Nongeenge ou e netiko lomahiyoyo ta fiile ou a yela omate, ye e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele keshe omutumba wa kalwa omutumba kwaa e netiko lomahiyoyo otau ka kala inau yela.
Nakeshe umwe ta kumu sha, shi li koshi yaye, e nokukala ina yela fiyo onguloshi. Ndelenee ou te shi humbata, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Nakeshe umwe ta kumwa kwaau e netiko lomahiyoyo fimbo ina kosha tete omake aye momeva, winya e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Noiyuma yedu yo ei tai kumwa kwaau e netiko lomahiyoyo i nokutataulwa po, ndelenee oinima yomomiti aishe i nokukoshwa nomeva.
“Ndele ou e netiko lomahiyoyo ngeenge ta veluka ketiko laye, na vale omafiku aheyali okudja keveluko laye nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukosha olutu laye momeva a yela. Opo nee ta kala a yela.
Ndele mefiku etihetatu e nokulikufila omalyamono avali ile eenghutyona mbali nokuuya koshipala shOmwene poshivelo shetwali leongalo noku di yandja komupristeli;
nomupristeli e noku di yamba, imwe etimbayambo naikwao exwikiloyambo. Osho ngaha hano omupristeli ta kwatakanifa koshipala shOmwene ou a li e netiko lomahiyoyo.
“Ndelenee momulumenhu ngeenge tamu di omahiyoyo ye e nokukosha olutu laye alishe momeva, ndele ta ka kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi,
nosho yo oshikutu keshe ile oshipa keshe kusho omahiyoyo a wila ko, shi nokukoshwa momeva, ndele sho otashi kala inashi yela fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele kombinga yomukainhu ou a nangala pambelela nomulumenhu, vo aveshe vavali ve nokulikosha ndele tava ka kala inava yela fiyo onguloshi.
“Ndelenee omukainhu ngeenge e netiko nohonde tai di muye, opo nee ye na kale omafiku aheyali mokutika kwaye. Nokeshe ou te mu kumu ota ka kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Naaishe oyo tai nangalwa kuye mefimbo letiko laye, oyo tai ka kala inai yela. Naaishe apa ta kala omutumba tai ka kala inai yela.
Ndele keshe ou ta kumu omutala waye, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele keshe ou ta kumu oshipundi kusho ha kala omutumba, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha nokukala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele umwe ngeenge ta kumu oshinima shi li momutala ile koshipundi kusho ye a kala omutumba, winya na kale ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta nangala naye ndele ta kumwa ketiko laye, ye e nokukala omafiku ahetatu ina yela. Nomutala keshe kwoo ta nangala, tau ka kala inau yela.

“Etiko lomukainhu ngeenge tali kala efimbo lile, nande efimbo kali fi lohani yaye, ile etiko ngeenge tali twikile efimbo lohani la pita, ye na talwe ina yela efimbo alishe letiko laye ngaashi mefimbo lohani yaye. Ye ina yela.
Omutala keshe kwoo a nangala omafiku aeshe etiko laye, tau ka kala kuye ngaashi omutala wetiko lohani yaye. Naaishe apa ta kala omutumba tai ka kala inai yela ngaashi mefimbo lohani yoshito.
Ndele keshe umwe ou ta kumu oinima ei, ota ka kala ina yela. Ye e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Ndele ngeenge ta veluka ketiko laye ye e nokuvala omafiku aheyali, opo nee ta ka kala a yela.
Ndelenee mefiku etihetatu ye e nokulikufila omalyamono avali ile eenghutyona mbali ndele te di twala komupristeli poshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Opo nee omupristeli e nokuyamba imwe etimbayambo naikwao exwikiloyambo. Nomupristeli e noku mu kwatakanifa omolwetiko laye lii koshipala shOmwene.
“Osho ngaha hano nye mu nokutongola ovana vaIsrael mokuhayela kwavo, vo opo vaha fye mokuhayela kwavo, eshi hava nyateke etwali lange liyapuki, eli li li mokati kavo.
“Oyo omhango yaau e netiko lomahiyoyo noyaau muye tamu di etiko lomahiyoyo, opo ye te linyateke nalo,
nomhango yomukainhu, ou e nohani yaye noyomulumenhu noyomukainhu, ava ve netiko lasha, noyomulumenhu ou ta nangala nomukainhu mefimbo lohani yaye.”
16: Ndele Omwene okwa popya naMoses, ovana vavali vaAron eshi va fya eshi va ehena koshipala shOmwene;

nOmwene okwa lombwela Moses ndele ta ti: “Lombwela omumwanyoko Aron nokutya, aha ye mo efimbo keshe monhele iyapuki, nokutya meni loshitukulifoyata koshituviko shekwatakanifo sho shi li koshikefa, opo aha fye, shaashi Ame ohandi holoka moshilemo koshituviko shekwatakanifo.
Aron e nokuya monhele iyapuki noinima ei: nomhedi onyasha etimbayambo nodi exwikiloyambo.

Ye e nokudjala oshikutu shokoshi shiyapuki sholiina, nodolombuluku yoliina i nokutuvika oulumenhu waye, ndele ye e nokulidika omwiya woshiyata sholiina, nokomutwe waye embale loshiyata sholiina. Oyo oikutu iyapuki. Ndele ye e nokukosha olutu laye momeva noku i djala.
Ndele ye e nokutambula keongalo lovana vaIsrael oikombo yoindume ivali etimbayambo nodi imwe exwikiloyambo.
Opo nee Aron ta eta omhedi yetimbayambo laye mwene ndele te likwatakanifa nokukwatakanifa yo eumbo laye.
Ye e nokukufa yo oikombo oyo ivali noku i tula koshipala shOmwene poshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Ndele Aron e nokuumbila oikombo oshihoololifo, oshihoololifo shimwe shOmwene noshihoololifo shimwe kuAshasheli.
Opo nee Aron e nokweeta po oshikombo sha hoololelwa Omwene noku shi yamba etimbayambo,
ndelenee oshikombo sha hoololelwa Ashasheli shi nokutulwa shi nomwenyo koshipala shOmwene, opo shi kwatakanifwe, nde tashi efiwa shi ye mofuka kuAshasheli.
“Opo nee Aron ta etifa ongobe yomhedi yetimbayambo laye ndele te likwatakanifa nokukwatakanifa yo eumbo laye. Ye e nokutoma omhedi yetimbayambo laye.

Ye na yadife oshikwatelwa shomundilo nomakala a hanya okoaltari koshipala shOmwene. Ndele pamwe nao oitwiminifo yoimbodi yedimba liwa ya tuwa nawa i fike peke limwe noku i twala meni loshitukulifoyata.
Ndele ye e nokutula oitwiminifo komundilo koshipala shOmwene, opo omwifi wetwiminifo u dule okutuvika oshituviko shekwatakanifo sho shi li koshikefa shoundobwedi, opo aha fye.

Ndele ye e nokukufa mo mohonde yomhedi noku i shamina nomunwe waye koshituviko shekwatakanifo kombinga yokoushilo. Nokomesho yoshituviko shekwatakanifo ye e nokushamina nomunwe waye ohonde ei luheyali.

“Opo nee ye e nokudipaa oshikombo shetimbayambo loshiwana nokutwala ohonde yasho meni loshitukulifoyata nokuninga nohonde ngaashi a ninga nohonde yongobe yomhedi: ye noku i shamina koshituviko shekwatakanifo nokomesho yoshituviko shekwatakanifo.

Osho ngaha hano ye e nokukwatakanifa etwali liyapuki omolwonyata yovana vaIsrael nomolwomatauluko avo, heeno, keshe tuu okunyona kwavo. Osho e nokuninga yo molwetwali leongalo, olo li li po puvo mokati komawii avo.

Ndele muha kale nande umwe metwali leongalo mefimbo olo Aron ta i mo a ka kwatakanife etwali liyapuki fiyo ye ta di mo, nokwe likwatakanifa nokwa kwatakanifa yo eumbo laye mwene, neongalo alishe laIsrael.

“Opo nee ye na dje ko ndele ta i koaltari i li koshipala shOmwene ndele ta ningi ekwatakanifo; ye e nokukufa mohonde yongobe yomhedi nomohonde yoshikombo noku i polola keembinga neembinga adishe doaltari
nokushamina nomunwe waye luheyali kuyo. Osho ngaha hano ye e noku i yelifa noku i yapula monyata yovana vaIsrael.
“Ndele ye eshi a mana okukwatakanifa onhele iyapuki netwali leongalo noaltari, opo nee ta etifa oshikombo shi nomwenyo,

ndele Aron e nokutenheka omake aye avali komutwe woshikombo shi nomwenyo nokuhepaulula opo oilonga aishe ii yovana vaIsrael nomatauluko avo aeshe, heeno, keshe tuu okunyona kwavo. Ye e noku i tula komutwe woshikombo, noku shi tuma nomulumenhu a hoololwa kofuka.
Osho ngaha hano oshikombo shi nokuhumbata komutwe washo oilonga yavo aishe ii noku i twala kofuka, ihe novanhu, ndele ye e nokumangulula oshikombo mofuka.
“Opo nee Aron e nokuya metwali leongalo nokulidula oikutu yoliina, ei kwa li e i djala, ye eshi a ile monhele iyapuki; ye ne i fiye mo.
Ndele ye e nokukosha olutu laye momeva monhele iyapuki nokudjala oikutu yaye. Opo nee ye ta i pondje okuyamba exwikiloyambo loshiwana, opo e likwatakanife nokukwatakanifa oshiwana.
E nokuxwika po yo koaltari omakaadi etimbayambo.
Ndele ou a twalele Ashasheli oshikombo, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukosha olutu laye momeva, opo nee ta shiiva okuuya monhanda.

Ndelenee ongobe yomhedi yetimbayambo noshikombo shetimbayambo, ohonde yayo ya etwa konhele iyapuki ngaashi ekwatakanifo, vo ve noku i twala pondje yonhanda. Noipa yayo nonhumba yayo noshandja shayo i nokuxwikwa po momundilo.
Ndele ou e i xwika po, e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokukosha olutu laye momeva, opo nee ta shiiva okuuya monhanda.

“Ndele oyo nai ninge kunye onghedimhango yaalushe nokutya: mohani onhiheyali mefiku etimulongo lohani, mu nokunyika oluhodi, ihamu longo oilonga yeni, ngee omudalelwamo moshilongo ile omunailongo ha kala mokati keni.
Osheshi mefiku tuu olo omupristeli te mu kwatakanifa mu fetwe mo ndele nye tamu fetwa mo komanyonauno aeshe eni koshipala shOmwene.
Olo nali ninge kunye efiku letulumuko la wana, ndele nye mu nokunyika oluhodi. Onghedimhango ei oyaalushe.
Nomupristeli ou a vaekwa ndele a yapulwa ponhele yaxe moshilonga shoupristeli, ye e nokulandula omufindilo woupristeli a djala oikutu youyambi,
nokuwanifa ekwatakanifo kOmuyapukielela. Ye e nokukwatakanifa yo etwali leongalo noaltari, okukwatakanifa omupristeli novanhu aveshe vomeongalo.
Ndele oyo i nokukala kunye onghedimhango yaalushe okukwatakanifa ovana vaIsrael molwomatimba avo aeshe lumwe momudo keshe.” Ndele vo va ninga, Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.
17: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele Aron novana vaye ovamati novana aveshe vaIsrael:
“Keshe umwe womeumbo laIsrael ta tomene ongobe ile ta dipaele odi ile oshikombo monhanda ile pondje yonhanda,
ndele ite i eta poshivelo shetwali leongalo a etele Omwene eyambo molwetwali liyapuki lOmwene, winya e netimba lohonde. Ye a tilashi ohonde, onghee ye e nokudimwa mo moshiwana shaye.
Onghee hano ovana vaIsrael nava ete omatomenoyambo avo ve a tomena pondje moluhaela komupristeli koshipala shOmwene poshivelo shetwali leongalo, noko ve noku i yambela Omwene epanduloyambo.
Opo nee omupristeli e nokutila ohonde koaltari yOmwene poshivelo shetwali leongalo nokuxwika po omakaadi edimba liwa kOmwene.
Ndelenee vaha yambe vali omatomenoyambo avo keendemoni domofuka, odo ve di shikula mokuhaela kwavo. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe kuvo nokomaludalo avo.
“Va lombwela yo kutya, keshe umwe womeumbo laIsrael nomovanailongo hava kala mokati kavo, ou ta eta exwikiloyambo ile etomenoyambo,
ndelenee ite li eta koshivelo shetwali leongalo e li yambele Omwene, ye e nokudimwa mo muvakwao.

“Ndele keshe umwe womeumbo laIsrael ile womovanailongo tava kala mokati keni, ta li ohonde keshe, heeno, kukeshe ou ha li ohonde, Ame ohandi ke mu taalelifa oshipala shange nehandu noku mu dima mo moshiwana sheni.
Osheshi omwenyo wombelela ou li mohonde, ndele Ame onde i mu pa koaltari i ninge ekwatakanifo leemwenyo deni, shaashi ohonde tai kwatakanifa, osheshi omwenyo ou li muyo.
Onghee hano Ame nda lombwela ovana vaIsrael: Nande umwe womunye ina lya ohonde, nomunailongo yo ou ha kala mokati keni aha lye nande ohonde.
“Nakeshe umwe womovana vaIsrael ile womovanailongo tava kala mokati keni, keshe ou ta kwata oshifitukuti ile odila tai liwa, ye e nokutilashi ohonde yayo noku i fufila nedu.

Osheshi omwenyo wombelela keshe oo ohonde, muyo omo mu nomwenyo. Onghee hano nda lombwela ovana vaIsrael: Inamu lya ohonde yomombelela, osheshi omwenyo wombelela keshe oo ohonde. Keshe umwe te i li, e nokudimwa po.

“Ndele keshe umwe ngeenge omudalelwa mo ile omunailongo ou ta li oshinamwenyo she lifila, ile shimwe sha nyanyaulwa e nokukosha oikutu yaye nokulikosha, ndele ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi. Opo nee ta ka kala a yela.
Ndelenee ngeenge ite i kosho ile ita kosho olutu laye, ye e nokuhumbata etimba laye.”
18: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael: “Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Inamu ninga ngaashi tashi ningwa medu laEgipiti, omo nye mwa kala mo, no inamu ninga ngaashi tashi longwa medu laKaanan, oko handi mu twala. Inamu enda paenghedimhango davo.
Mu nokuwanifa omalombwelo ange nokudiinina eenghedimhango dange mu ende mudo. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Onghee hano diinineni eenghedimhango dange nomalombwelo ange aa omunhu e noku a wanifa, opo a kale e nomwenyo omolwao.
“Paha kale nande umwe womunye ou, ta ehene komukainhu womukwanepatelela laye opo ehe mu dule eteta. Aame Omwene.
Ino dula xo eteta laye ile eteta lanyoko, osheshi oye e ku dala, ino dula mo eteta laye.
Ino dula mo eteta lomwalikadi waxo, osheshi to fifa xo ohoni.
Ino dula eteta lomumwanyoko omukainhu, oye omona okakadona kaxo ile omona okakadona kanyoko ile ou a dalelwa meumbo leni ile a dalelwa pamwe pe lili, ino mu dula mo eteta laye.
Ino dula mo eteta lomona okakadona kamumwanyoko omulumenhu ile lomona okakadona komumwanyoko omukainhu, omateta avo ino a dula mo, osheshi moku shi ninga to lififa ohoni.
Ino dula mo eteta lomona okakadona komwalikadi waxo, ou xo e mu dala; ye omumwanyoko omukainhu, ino dula mo eteta laye.
Ino dula mo eteta lomumwaina omukainhu waxo, osheshi ye omukwaoelela waxo.
Ino dula mo eteta lomumwaina omukainhu wanyoko, osheshi ye omukwaoelela wanyoko.
Ino dula mo eteta lomumwaina omulumenhu waxo; ino ehena komwalikadi waye. Osheshi ye omumwaina waxo.
Ino dula mo eteta loshitenya shoye omukainhu, osheshi ye omwalikadi womona woye. Ino dula mo eteta laye.
Ino dula mo eteta lomwalikadi womumwanyoko, osheshi ove to fifa ohoni omumwanyoko.
Ino dula mo eteta lomwalikadi nolomona waye okakadona. Ino tambula omona omukainhu womona waye, u mu dule eteta. Vo ovakwenielela. Oyo onhiko.
Ino hombola nokudula mo eteta lomumwaina omukainhu womwalikadi woye fimbo ye e nomwenyo, osheshi taku eta oudjuu.
“Ino ehena komukainhu fimbo ye ina yela molwohani yaye, ove u mu dule eteta.
Ndele ino nangala nomwalikadi womukweni, opo nye muhe linyateke.
Ino yandja ovana voye exwikiloyambo kuMolek, opo uha fife edina laKalunga koye ohoni. Aame Omwene.
Ino nangala nomulumenhu ngaashi tashi nangalwa nomukainhu. Osho oixuna yongaho!
Ndele ino nangala noshimuna, opo uhe linyateke nasho. Nomukainhu yo ehe liyandje koshimuna shi mu hambe. Osho oixuna itondifa.
Inamu linyateka noinima aishe ei, osheshi noinima aishe ei ovapaani ve linyateka, ovapaani ava Ame handi ke va taataa po komesho yeni.
Osho ngaha hano edu la nyatekwa. Ndele Ame ohandi ke li kwatela onghone molwoilonga yavo ii, opo edu li kunge mo oonakukalamo.
Ndelenee nye mu nokudiinina eenghedimhango dange nomalombwelo ange; inamu ninga sha shomoixuna ei itondifa, ngee omudalelwa mo ile omunailongo e li mokati keni.
Osheshi ovanhu vomoshilongo ava ve mu tetekela, ova ninga oixuna aishe ei, nedu ola nyata,
Opo edu lihe mu kunge mo, ngeenge tamu li nyateke, ngaashi lo ola kunga oiwana ye mu tetekela.
Osheshi aveshe ava hava ningi sha shomoixuna ei, ove na okudimwa mo moshiwana.
“Onghee hano mu nokudiinina eenghedimhango dange muha ninge sha shomeenghedi doixuna ya ningwa komesho yeni, opo muhe linyateke nayo. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.”
19: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael a tye: “Mu nokukala ovayapuki, osheshi Aame, Omwene Kalunga keni, omuyapuki.
Keshe umwe e nokutila ina naxe nokudiinina omashabata ange. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Inamu ama koikalunga no inamu li ningila oitelekwakalunga. Aame Omwene, Kalunga keni.
“Ndele ngeenge tamu tomene Omwene epanduloyambo, nye mu noku li yamba ngaha, mu shiive oku mu wapalela:
Mefiku tuu olo tamu li yambe ile efiku tali shikula, mu noku li lya. Ndelenee olo tali xupile po efiku etitatu, oli nokuxwikwa momundilo.
Ndele ngeenge tali liwa mefiku etitatu, lo ola ninga oshidila. Lo itali ka tambulwa nohokwe.
Ndele ou te li li, ota ka humbata etimba laye, osheshi olo la li liyapuki kOmwene, ndelenee ye okwe li nyateka. Onghee hano omwenyo ou u nokudimwa mo movanhu.
“Nye ngeenge tamu teya oilya momapya eni, inamu teya unene kominghulo; nomitwe doilya tadi wile po, inamu di toola po.
Moshikokola shoye shomiviinyu ino shi yeleka mokuteya; neeviinyu tadi wile poshi komuviinyu woye, ino di toola po. U noku di fiila po ovakwanaluhepo novanailongo. Aame Omwene, Kalunga keni.
“Nye inamu vaka noinamu popya oipupulu, ndele inamu kengelelafana.
Inamu ana oipupulu medina lange nokushekifa ngaha edina laKalunga koye. Aame Omwene.
“Ino hepeka ile okufininika omukweni. Ino kala nondjabi yaau te ku longele fiyo omongula.
Ino finga omufitamatwi, no ino tula oshipundukifo mondjila yomupofi; ndelenee u nokutila Kalunga koye. Aame Omwene.
“Moihokolola ino popya eshi inashi yuka. Ino kala u nokatongotongo pokati kohepele nomufimanekwa. U nokutokola omukweni pauyuki.
Ino endaenda mokati kovanhu ngaashi omupopyaani. Ino nangela omwenyo wamukweni. Aame Omwene.
“Omumwanyoko omulumenhu ino mu tonda momutima woye. Omukweni ino tila oku mu vela ombedi, ove opo uha pewe oushima molwaye.
Ovanhu vomoshiwana shoye ino va kwatela onghone noino va tonda, ndelenee hola omukweni ngaashi u lihole mwene. Aame Omwene.
“Nye mu nokudiinina eenghedimhango dange. Ino hambifa omaludi avali omoimuna yoye. Ino kuna eembuto domaludi avali mepya loye. Ino djala oshikutu sha tungifwa eengodi domaludi avali.
“Ndele omulumenhu ngeenge ta nangala nomukainhu omupika womulumenhu umwe, naau ina kulilwa ile ina pikululwa, opo vo ve nokuhandukilwa, ndelenee hakudipawa, osheshi omukainhu ina pikululwa;
ndele ye e nokweetela Omwene okuvelombediyambo koshivelo shetwali leongalo odi yomhedi okuvelombediyambo;
nomupristeli e noku mu kwatakanifa nodi yomhedi yokuvelombediyambo koshipala shOmwene molwomanyonauno aye, ndele ye ota ka mona edimepo lomanyonauno aye e a nyona.
“Nye ngeenge tamu fiki kedu linya ndele tamu twike omiti di lili doiimati, inamu lya oiimati yado, yo ya fa inai pita etanda kunye. Omido nhatu nai kale ya efwa, inamu i lya.
Ndelenee momudo omutine yapulileni Omwene oiimati aishe yado eeshalihafo.
Ndele momudo omutitano lyeni oiimati yado. Osho ngaha tamu hapupalifa oiimati yomiti. Aame Omwene, Kalunga keni.
“Inamu lya ombelela i nohonde. Inamu nyanekela nye inamu kala neemhule.
Inamu likulula omixungo, neendjedi doye ino di kulula momunghulo.
Nomalutu eni inamu a lengaula molwomufi, ndele inamu ninga omafano moshipa sheni. Aame Omwene.
“Nomumwoye okakadona ino mu fifa ohoni oku mu yandja mokuhaelwa, oshilongo opo shiha nyike oluhaelo nedu liha yadifwe oilonga yefifohoni.
Diinineni omashabata ange, nokutila etwali lange liyapuki. Aame Omwene.
“Inamu ama kovakwamhungu ile keemhule. Inamu di konga muha nyatekwe kudo. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Kala ofika moipafi yomukulunhu weenghwakutoka; fimaneka omukulunhu; tila Kalunga. Aame Omwene.
“Nomunailongo ngeenge ta kala punye moshilongo sheni, inamu mu fininika.

Omunailongo ou ta kala punye, na talwe kunye, oye ngaashi omudalelwa mo womoshilongo, ou e li mokati keni. Ndele mu noku mu hola ngaashi mu lihole nye vene, osheshi nanye yo mwa li ovanailongo medu laEgipiti. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
“Mokutokola kweni inamu tokola noipupulu, noinamu longifa oiyelekifo inai yuka: oshiyelekifo shoule, noshiyelekifo shoudjuu, noshiyelekifo shoshimbale.
Kaleni mu noshiyelekifo sha yuka shoudjuu, nomamanya a yuka okuyelekifa, noshiyelekifo sheefa sha yuka noshiyelekifo shahin sha yuka. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni, ou e mu pitifa mo medu laEgipiti.
Onghee hano mu nokudiinina nokuwanifa eenghedimhango dange nomalombwelo ange aeshe. Aame Omwene.”
20: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye:
“Keshe umwe womovana vaIsrael nowomovanailongo hava kala muIsrael, ou ta yandje kuMolek ounona vaye, ye e nokufya shili. Ovanhu vomoshilongo nave mu dipae nomamanya.

Naame ohandi ke mu taalelifa oshipala shange nehandu, ndele Ame ohandi ke mu dima mo moshiwana shaye. Osheshi ye a yandja ovana vaye kuMolek, opo a nyateke etwali lange liyapuki nokushekifa edina lange liyapuki.
“Ndele ovanhu vomoshilongo ngeenge tava xupifa omunhu ou ha yandje oludalo laye kuMolek, ndele itave mu dipaa,
opo nee Ame ohandi ka taalelifa oshipala shange shi nehandu kuye nokepata laye, ndele Ame ohandi ke mu dima mo moshiwana shaye pamwe naaveshe ava hava shikula Molek moluhaelo.
“Ndele omunhu umwe ngeenge ta ame keemhepo dovafi nokeemhepo deemhule noku di shikula moluhaelo, omunhu tuu ou Ame ohandi ke mu taalelifa oshipala shange shi nehandu noku mu dima mo moshiwana shaye.
Onghee hano liyapuleni ndele kaleni mwa yapulwa, osheshi Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Diinineni eenghedimhango dange noku di wanifa. Aame Omwene ou te mu yapula.
“Keshe umwe ta tuku xe ile ina, e nokufya shili. Ye a tuka xe naina. Ye e litula monhiko.
Ngeenge ope na ou ta haele omwalikadi womushiinda waye vo aveshe vavali, omulumenhu nomukainhu, ve nokudipawa shili.
Nomulumenhu ou ta nangala nomwalikadi waxe, ye okwa dula mo eteta laxe. Vo aveshe vavali ve nokudipawa shili. Ve litula monhiko.
Umwe ngeenge ta nangala noshitenya shaye shomukainhu, vo aveshe vavali ve nokudipawa. Vo ova ninga oshififahoni. Ve litula monhiko.
Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta nangala nomulumenhu ngaashi tashi nangalwa nomukainhu, vo aveshe vavali va ninga oshififahoni. Vo ve nokudipawa shili. Ve litula monhiko.
Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta hombola omukainhu na ina yomukainhu ou, osho oshififahoni. Vo ve noku va xwika po momundilo aveshe vavali. Mokati keni muha kale onhiko nande.
Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta nangala noshimuna, ye e nokudipawa shili, noshimuna yo shi nokudipawa.
Nomukainhu ngeenge ta ehene koshimuna shi mu hambe, nye mu nokudipaa omukainhu noshimuna. Vo ove nokudipawa shili. Vo ove litula monhiko.

“Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta hombola omumwaina omukainhu nokutya, omona okakadona ka xe ile omona okakadona ka ina, ndele ye ota dula mo eteta laye naawinya ota dula mo eteta laye, sho oshififahoni. Onghee hano vo ove nokudimwa mo moipafi yoshiwana shavo. Ye okwa dula mo eteta lomumwaina omukainhu. Ye e nokuhumbata etimba laye.

Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta nangala nomukainhu e noudu wohani, ndele ta dula mo eteta laye, ye a yeulula ofifiya yaye nomukainhu ta yeulula ofifiya yohonde yaye; opo nee vo aveshe vavali ve nokudimwa po moshiwana shavo.
“Ino dula mo eteta lomumwaina wa nyoko ile eteta lomumwaina wa xo, osheshi vo ovakweni. Vo ve nokuhumbata etimba lavo.
Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta nangala nomumwaina waxe, ye okwa dula mo eteta lomumwaina waxe. Vo ove nokuhumbata etimba lavo. Vo ve nokufya vehe noludalo.
Nomulumenhu ngeenge ta hombola omwalikadi womumwaina, sho onhiko. Ye okwa dula mo eteta lomumwaina. Vo ove nokukala vehe noludalo.
“Onghee hano diinineni eenghedimhango adishe dange nomalombwelo ange aeshe noku a wanifa, opo edu mulo handi mu twala mu ka kale mo, lihe mu kunge mo.
Ndele inamu enda paenghedi doshiwana eshi Ame handi ke shi taataa mo; osheshi oinima aishe ei vo ve i ninga. Ame ohandi inyonyodola.
Naame nde mu lombwela: Nye otamu ka tula medu lavo, edu li yadi omashini nomaadi eenyiki. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni, ou nde mu tongola moiwana imwe.

Onghee hano mu nokutongola pokati koinamwenyo ya yela naai inai yela, nopokati keedila da yela naadi inadi yela. Inamu linyateka koinamwenyo ile keedila ile ku eshi tashi alangata kombada yedu, oyo nde i mu tongolela noku mu lombwela, yo inai yela.
Ndele nye mu nokukala ovayapuki, osheshi Aame Omwene Omuyapuki; ndele Ame onde mu tongola mo moiwana, mu kale vange mwene.
Ndele ngeenge momulumenhu umwe ile momukainhu umwe omu nomhepo yomufi ile omhepo youpule, vo ve nokudipawa shili. Vo ve litula monhiko.”
21: Omwene okwa lombwela vali Moses a lombwele ovapristeli, ovana ovamati vaAron a tye kuvo: “Omupristeli ehe linyateke koshimhu shamukwao,
ndelenee shomukwaoelela waye shomukwaoelelelela ngaashi sha ina nosha xe, shomona omumati noshomona okakadona, noshomumwaina omulumenhu,
noshomumwaina, ye ngeenge okakadona, ndele a kala puye meumbo laye ndele ina hombolwa, ou kuye tashi dulika e linyateke.
Ye, eshi omukulunhu omulineekelwa mokati kovanhu vaye, ehe linyateke, opo ehe lifife ohoni.
“Vo vehe likulule epalu neendjedi davo vehe di tete momunghulo, ndele vo vaha ninge omafano moshipa shavo.
Vo nava kale va yapulilwa Kalunga kavo, va hafife edina laKalunga kavo ohoni, osheshi vo ohava yambe omundiloyambo wOmwene, eendja daKalunga kavo. Onghee hano ovapristeli ve nokukala ovayapuki.
Ovapristeli vaha hombole omukainhu e hole oipala ile omukainhu a fifwa ohoni. Vaha hombole omwalikadi ou a hengwa po komulumenhu waye. Osheshi vo ovayapuki vaKalunga kavo.
Onghee hano ove u noku mu tala ye omuyapuki, osheshi ha yambe eendja daKalunga. Ye a kale omuyapuki kwoove, osheshi Aame omuyapuki, Ame ou handi mu yapula.
Nomona okakadona komupristeli ngeenge te lififa ohoni mokuhaelwa, ye ota fifa xe ohoni. Ye e nokuxwikwa po momundilo.

“Nomupristeli ou a ninga omukulunhu mokati kavakwao, oo komutwe waye kwa tilwa omaadi evaeko, ndele a hoololwa a djale oikutu iyapuki, ye aha efe eexwiki daye dokomutwe di endjelele nodiha pombaule oikutu yaye.
Ndele ye aha ehene poshimhu nande oshimhu sha xe ile sha ina, ye aha nyatekwe ku sho.
Ndele ye aha dje mo metwali liyapuki, opo aha nyateke etwali liyapuki laKalunga kaye, osheshi komutwe waye e na evaeko leyapulo laKalunga kaye. Aame Omwene.
Ndele ye e nokuhombola omukainhu okakadona.
Ye aha hombole omufiyekadi ile omuhengwa ile ou a dulwa eteta ile ou e hole oipala. Ndelenee ye e nokuhombola okakadona komoshiwana shaye,
Opo aha fife ohoni oludalo laye lomepata laye. Osheshi Aame Omwene ou handi mu yapula.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele Aron a tye: “Paha kale nande umwe womoludi loye ou e noshiponga shokolutu ta dulu okweehena a yambe eendja daKalunga kaye.
Osheshi keshe ou e noshiponga shokolutu ita dulu okweehena, nokutya omupofi ile oshingudu ile umwe e noshiponga koshipala ile moinhimbu yolutu,
ile umwe a teka okuulu ile okwooko,
ile ou e nonhunda ile olutu la fipatela ile e nonhe keisho ile e nomakoko moshipa ile omavangwa taa nyu ile a lutulwa.

Omulumenhu nande omupristeli womoludalo laAron, ngeenge e noshiponga shokolutu, ita dulu okweehena a yambe omundiloyambo wOmwene. Muye omu noshiponga shokolutu. Ye aha ehene a yambe eendja daKalunga kaye.
Ndelenee na lye eendja daKalunga kaye, ngeenge doshiyapukielela naadi doshiyapuki.
Ndelenee ye aha ehene koshitukulifoyata noaltari, osheshi molutu laye omu noshiponga, opo aha nyateke etwali lange liyapuki. Osheshi Aame Omwene ou te mu yapula.”
Ndele Moses okwe shi lombwela Aron novana vaye ovamati novana aveshe vaIsrael.
22: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele Aron novana vaye ovamati: “Kaleni mwa lungama mokutambula kweni eeshali diyapuki dovana vaIsrael, odo tave di yapulile nge, opo muha shekife edina lange liyapuki. Aame Omwene.
Va lombwela nokutya, keshe ou womoludalo leni alishe ta ehene fimbo ine liyapula keeshali diyapuki edi ovana vaIsrael tave di yapulile Omwene, omwenyo ou u nokudimwa po koshipala shange. Aame Omwene.

Nande umwe womoludalo laAron, ou e noudu woshilundu ile etiko lomaxu, ita dulu okulya keeshali diyapuki fimbo ina fetwa mo. Naau ta kumu umwe ou e linyatekifa koshimhu ile ta kumu ou e netiko lomaxumbuto,
ile umwe ou ta kumu keshe epuka tali tumbanga, ndele te linyateke ngaha kulo ile ta kumu omunhu ou e linyatekifa kukeshe eshi tashi nyateke omunhu,
omunhu tuu ou ta kumu kusha sha nyata, ye e nokukala ina yela fiyo onguloshi, ye ita shiiva okulya eeshali diyapuki fimbo ye ine likosha nomeva.
Ndelenee etango ngeenge la ningina, ye ota ka kala a yela. Opo nee ta shiiva okulya eeshali diyapuki, osheshi odo eendja daye.
Ye aha lye sha shomoinamwenyo ya nyanyaulwa, opo ehe linyatekife kusho. Aame Omwene.
Onghee hano vo nava diinine eenghedimhango dange, vaha nyone molweeshali diyapuki ndele vaha fye omolwado eshi ve di nyateka. Aame Omwene ou te va yapula.
Osho yo edi itadi liwa kwaava inava yapulilwa oupristeli. Omukalele womupristeli naau te mu longele ita dulu okulya eshi shiyapuki.
Ndelenee omupristeli ngeenge te lilandele omupika noimaliwa yaye, ye ta shiiva okulya kusho; naau a dalelwa meumbo laye. Vo nava lye eendja daye.
Ndelenee omona okakadona komupristeli ngeenge ta hombolwa komuyeni, ita dulu okulya eeshaliyambo deeshali diyapuki.

Ndelenee omona okakadona komupristeli ngeenge ye omufiyekadi ile a hengwa, ndele ehe noludalo ndele ta shuna keumbo la xe ngaashi a li mounyasha waye, opo nee ta dulu okulya eendja da xe. Ndelenee omuyeni nande umwe ita dulu oku di lya.
“Ndele umwe ngeenge ta li eeshali diyapuki ndele ine shi shiiva, ye e nokuwedela po oshititano, nosho okwaalula komupristeli eshi shiyapuki,
Ovapristeli vaha nyateke eeshali diyapuki dOvaisraeli odo tadi twalwa kuvo koshipala shOmwene, opo Ye e di tambule,
vo vehe va vele eembedi vo ngeenge tava li eeshali diyapuki, osheshi Aame Omwene, ou te va yapula.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,

a lombwele Aron novana vaye ovamati novana aveshe vaIsrael a tye: “Keshe umwe womeumbo laIsrael ile womovanailongo vomokati kOvaisraeli, ou ta eta eyambo pamaudaneko aeshe avo neeshaliyambo adishe dokehalo liwa, odo tave di etele Omwene exwikiloyambo,
vo ve noku di eta ngaha, opo va wapalele Omwene nokutya, oshinima oshindume shihe noshipo ngee eengobe ile eedi ile oikombo.
Inamu eta sha shi noshipo shokolutu, osheshi sho itashi ke mu wapaleka.

Ndele umwe ngeenge ta yambele Omwene meengobe ile meedi epanduloyambo opo a wanife eudaneko laye ile eyambo lehalo liwa, opo nee eyambo li nokukala lihe noshipo, opo li kale la wapala. Mulo muha kale nande oshipo.
Eshi sha twika ile eshi sha teka ile eshi shi noinhimbu ya fipatela ile oidinda ile omakoko ile omavangwa taa nyu, inamu i etela Omwene noinamu yambela Omwene sha shomuyo omundiloyambo koaltari.
Ndelenee ongobe ile odi ngeenge i noshinhimbu shile unene ile shixupi unene, to dulu oku i yamba eyambo kehalo liwa. Ndelenee ngaashi eudanekoyambo itai mu wapalele.
Inamu yambela Omwene oshinamwenyo sha lutulwa mokufengenyena ile mokutetwa. Moshilongo sheni inamu shi ninga,
ndele meke lomunailongo inamu lilandela oinamwenyo ya tya ngaha mu i etele Kalunga keni ngaashi eendja, osheshi yo inai wapala, oi noshipo. Omolwayo nye itamu ka wapalela Omwene.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndele ta ti:
“Okatana okandume ile okadjona ile okakombwena ngeenge ka dalwa, naka kale omafiku aheyali pu ina, ndelenee okefiku etihetatu nokomesho ko otaka wapalele okuningila Omwene exwikiloyambo.
Ongobe nodi ile oshikombo inamu i dipaa pamwe noludalo layo mefiku limwe alike.
Ndele ngeenge tamu etele Omwene ehambeleloyambo, nye mu noku li yamba ngaha mu wapalele Omwene.
Mefiku tuu limwe alike li nokuliwa. Inamu xupifa po sha shomongula. Aame Omwene.
“Diinineni oipango yange noku i wanifa. Aame Omwene.
Inamu shekifa edina lange liyapuki, Ame opo ndi shiive okukala Omuyapuki mokati kovana vaIsrael. Aame Omwene, ou te mu yapula,
ou e mu pitifa mo medu laEgipiti opo ndi kale Kalunga keni. Aame Omwene.”
23: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Omafimbo oivilo yOmwene mwoo mu nokwoongala moiongalele iyapuki, oo omafimbo oivilo yange.
Napa longwe omafiku ahamano, ndelenee efiku etiheyali olo efiku letulumuko, efiku loshiongalele shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha, osheshi lo Eshabata lOmwene meenhele deni adishe.
“Omafimbo oivilo yOmwene nokutya, omafiku oiongalele iyapuki aa mu noku a diinina pomafimbo a pangelwa.”
Mohani yotete mefiku etimulongo netine lohani, onguloshi, olo Opaasa yOmwene;
ndele mefiku etimulongo netitano mohani tuu ei oku na oshivilo shomingome dihe nonhafi shOmwene. Nye mu nokulya omingome dihe nonhafi omafiku aheyali.
Mefiku lotete pu na okuningwa oshiongalele shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha.
Ndelenee momafiku aheyali eteleni Omwene omundiloyambo. Mefiku etiheyali pu na okukala oshiongalele shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Nye ngeenge tamu fiki medu linya Ame handi ke li mu pa, ndele tamu teya oilya yalo, mu nokweetela omupristeli oshipandi shotete shoshipe sheteyo leni.
Ndele ye e nokudungadungifa oshipandi koshipala shOmwene opo mu wapalele Omwene. Mefiku tali shikula Eshabata, omupristeli e noku shi dungadungifa.
Mefiku tuu olo nye tamu dungadungifa oshipandi, mu nokuyambela Omwene odi yomudo umwe ihe noshipo exwikiloyambo,
nongaashi eendjayambo dalo oufila wa nakwa u fike peekilograma mbali, wa lumbakanifwa omaadi ngaashi omundiloyambo wOmwene edimba liwa; naavali oikunwayambo yalo omaviinyu e fike polita imwe.
Ndele nye inamu lya omungome woshipe ile oilya ya kangwa ile oilya yahawiishu fiyo okefiku olo tamu twaalele Kalunga keni oshaliyambo. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe komaludalo eni meenhele adishe deni.
“Opo nee nye mu nokuvala okudja kefiku tali shikula Eshabata nokutya okefiku olo tamu eta oshipandi shedungadungifwayambo oivike iheyali i yadi
fiyo okefiku tali shikula Eshabata etiheyali nye mu nokuvala omafiku omilongo nhano. Opo nee mu nokweetela Omwene eendjayambo dipe.
Oko tamu kala nye mu nokweeta omingome mbali dokudungadungifwayambo, da telekwa noufila wa nakwa u fike peekilograma mbali, da telekwa di nonhafi ngaashi oshipe kOmwene.

Pamwe nomingome mu nokweeta yo eedi heyali domudo umwe dihe noshipo nongobe onyasha yomhedi needi eendume mbali. Do otadi ningi exwikiloyambo kOmwene pamwe neendjayambo noikunwayambo ngaashi omundiloyambo wedimba liwa kOmwene.
Ndele nye mu nokuyamba oshikombo oshindume etimbayambo nosho yo eedi mbali domudo umwe epanduloyambo,
nomupristeli e noku i dungadungifa edungadungifwayambo koshipala shOmwene pamwe nomungome woshipe needi mbali. Odo nadi kale diyapuki kOmwene ndele tadi ningi domupristeli.
Mefiku tuu olo mu nokushiva oshiongalele sheni shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe komaludalo eni meenhele deni adishe.
“Ndele nye ngeenge tamu teya omapya eni, mokuteya kweni inamu teya fiyo okominghulo, nomitwe da wila poshi, inamu di toola po. Ove u noku di fiila po ohepele nomunailongo. Aame Omwene Kalunga koye.”
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye: “Mohani onhiheyali efiku lotete lohani olo efiku letulumuko leni, efiku ledimbulukifo neshiko lomanghuma, efiku loshiongalele shiyapuki.
Inamu longa sha. Ndelenee eteleni Omwene omundiloyambo.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Ndelenee efiku etimulongo mohani ei onhiheyali olo efiku lekwatakanifo. Olo efiku loshiongalele shiyapuki kunye. Nye mu nokufya oluhodi nokuyambela Omwene omundiloyambo.
Nomefiku tuu olo inamu longa sha, osheshi olo efiku lekwatakanifo, opo mu kwatakanifwe koshipala shOmwene Kalunga keni.
Osheshi keshe umwe, ou ita fi oluhodi mefiku tuu olo, e nokudimwa po moshiwana shavo.
Nosho yo keshe umwe ou ta longo sha mefiku tuu olo, Ame ohandi ka dima po omwenyo ou moshiwana shavo.
Inamu longa sha nande. Onghedimhango ei oyaalushe komaludalo eni meenhele adishe deni.
Efiku olo nali ninge efiku letulumuko kunye ndele mu nokunyika oluhodi. Efiku etimugoi lohani onguloshi, okudja onguloshi fiyo okonguloshi mu nokudiinina Eshabata leni.”
NOmwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye: “Okefiku etimulongo netitano lohani tuu ei onhiheyali momafiku aheyali ope noshivilo shomatwali shOmwene.
Mefiku lotete ope noshiongalele shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha.
Momafiku aheyali mu nokweetela Omwene omundiloyambo. Mefiku etihetatu ope noshiongalele sheni shiyapuki, ndele mu nokweetela Omwene omundiloyambo. Olo efimbo loshivilo. Inamu longa sha.
“Olo efimbo loshivilo shOmwene, mulo mu nokwoongala moiongalele iyapuki mu etele Omwene omundiloyambo, exwikiloyambo, oiliwayambo, etomenoyambo nomanwinoyambo ngaashi sha pangelelwa efiku keshe.
Ponho yomashabata Omwene eeshali deni nomaudanekoyambo aeshe eni neeshali deni adishe dehalo liwa edi otamu di etele Omwene.

“Ndelenee mefiku etimulongo netitano lohani onhiheyali onye ngeenge tamu tuvikile oilya yeni yomomapya, nye mu nokudana omafiku aheyali. Efiku lotete olo efiku letulumuko nefiku etihetatu olo efiku letulumuko.
Mefiku lotete kufeni oiimati iwa komiti, noivale yomilunga noitai yomomiti da hapa nomihamba dopomulonga, ndele hafeni koshipala shOmwene Kalunga keni omafiku aheyali.
Ngaashi oshivilo shOmwene mu noku shi dana omafiku aheyali keshe omudo. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe komaludalo nomaludalo. Mohani onhiheyali mu noku shi dana.
Omafiku aheyali mu nokukala momatwali. Aveshe ava va dalelwa muIsrael ve nokukala momatwali,
Opo omaludalo eni a shiive nokutya, Ame nda kaleka ovana vaIsrael momatwali eshi nde va pitifa mo medu laEgipiti. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.”
Osho ngaha hano Moses okwa shiivifila ovana vaIsrael oivilo yOmwene.
24: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael ve ku etele omaadi eemono, omaadi mayela a yengwa molwoshikwatelwalamba, eelamba opo di kale da tema efimbo alishe.

Aron e noku shi pashukila pondje yoshitukulifoyata shoundobwedi metwali leongalo, opo eelamba di kale da tema okudja onguloshi fiyo ongula koshipala shOmwene efimbo alishe. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe komaludalo nomomaludalo eni.
Eelamba oku noku di tula moshikwatelwalamba shoshingoli shovenevene, di teme alushe koshipala shOmwene.
“Kufa oufila wa nakwa u teleke mwoo oikuki omulongo naivali. Moshikuki keshe mu nokukala oufila u fike peekilograma mbali.
Ove u noku i londakanifa meenhele mbali, oikuki ihamano monhele imwe koshitaafula sha yela koshipala shOmwene.
Ndele kombada yoikuki monhele keshe u nokutula oitwiminifo, oyo edimbulukifoyambo lomingome ngaashi omundiloyambo wOmwene.
Keshe efiku lEshabata Aron e noku i tula koshipala shOmwene efimbo alishe, ngaashi oshali yovana vaIsrael, ngaashi ehangano laalushe.
Ndele yo tai ningi yaAron novana vaye ovamati. Vo ove noku i lya monhele iyapuki, osheshi ngaashi iyapukielela tai ningi yaye yomomindiloyambo dOmwene, yo onghedimhango yaalushe.”
Omona omumati womwalikadi Omuisraeli, xe kwa li Omuegipiti, okwa dja moshilongo pamwe nOvaisraeli, nomona womwalikadi ou Omuisraeli nomulumenhu umwe Omuisraeli va twa eemhata monhanda.
Opo nee omona womwalikadi Omuisraeli okwa sheka edina laKalunga nokutukana. Onghee hano ve mu twala kuMoses. Nedina la ina la li Selomit, omona omukainhu waDibri womepata laDan.
Ndele vo ove mu idilila modolongo fiyo va hololelwa enyamukulo lOmwene.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndele ta ti:
“Twala omutukani pondje yonhanda, naaveshe ava ve mu uda ta tukana, ve nokutenheka omake avo komutwe waye. Opo nee eongalo alishe nali mu dipae nomamanya.”
Novana vaIsrael va lombwela u tye: “Umwe ngeenge ta tuku Kalunga kaye, ta ka humbata etimba laye.
Keshe ou ta sheke edina lOmwene, ota ka dipawa. Eongalo alishe li noku mu dipaa shili nomamanya. Omunailongo ngaashi yo omudalelwa mo moshilongo e nokudipawa, ngeenge ta sheke edina laKalunga.
“Ndele ngeenge umwe ta dipaa omunhu ye e nokudipawa shili.
Ndelenee ou ta dipaa oshimuna, e noku shi futa. Omwenyo omomwenyo.
Ndele umwe ngeenge ta tula mukwao ondjo molutu, ngaashi ye a ninga, nosho yo naanaa ye e nokuningilwa.
Okuteka omokuteka, eisho omeisho, eyoo omeyoo. Ondjo tuu pwaayo ye e i tula molutu lamukwao, ye e i tulwe yo.
“Hano ou ta dipaa oshimuna, e noku shi futa. Ndelenee ou ta dipaa omunhu, ye e nokudipawa yo.
Omhango imwe aike nai kale munye. Omunailongo na talwe ngaashi omudalelwa moshilongo, osheshi Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.”
Osho ngaha Moses okwa popya nOvaisraeli, ndele vo ova twala omutukani pondje yonhanda ndele ve mu dipaa nomamanya. Novana vaIsrael va ninga ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
25: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses komhunda yaSinai,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Nye ngeenge tamu fiki medu Ame handi mu pe, edu oli nokutulumukwa kefimaneko lOmwene.
Omido hamano mu nokukuna omapya eni nomido hamano mu nokuteta oikokola yeni yomiviinyu nokutoola eeviinyu domuyo.
Ndelenee momudo omutihamano owo efimbo letulumuko lashili ledu nokutya, Eshabata lOmwene. Inamu kuna omapya eni noinamu teta omiviinyu deni.
Eemhelelungu ino di teya noino teta omashila omiviinyu inadi tetwa. Ou ou nokukala omudo wetulumuko ledu.
Ndelenee eshi tashi mene medu momudo wEshabata nashi kale eendja deni. Eendja deni nodomupika omulumenhu nomukainhu nodomulongeli woye nodomwiidililwa woye,
nodoimuna yoye nodoifitukuti yomoshilongo sheni, keshe osho tashi mene mo nashi ninge eendja dayo.
“Ove u nokuvala oivike iheyali yomido nokutya, omido heyali luheyali, opo di ninge omido omilongo nhee nomugoi.
Opo nee mohani onhiheyali mefiku etimulongo lohani u nokushikifa enghuma. Mefiku lekwatakanifo ondaka yenghuma nai udike moshilongo sheni ashishe.

Ndele mu nokuyapula omudo omutimilongo nhano ndele mu nokuvilikila oonakukalamo aveshe emangululo. Oo omudo weni wekuwililo. Opo nee keshe umwe womunye na shune konhele yaye yefyuululo nakeshe umwe kepata lavo.
Oo, nokutya omudo omutimilongo nhano u nokukala omudo weni wekuwililo. Inamu kuna sha no inamu teya eemhelelungu ile inamu teta eeviinyu domiviinyu inadi tetwa.
Osheshi oo omudo wekuwililo. Oo u nokukala omuyapuki kunye. Lyeni eemhelelungu domomapya eni.
“Momudo tuu ou wekuwililo keshe umwe munye na shune konhele yefyuululo laye.
Ove ngeenge ho landifa po sha komukweni ile ho lilandele sha komukweni, inamu nyekafana.
Pamuvalo womido tadi shikula omudo wekuwililo ove u nokufuta komukweni. Pakuvalwa kwomido deteyo ye na pewe kwoove ofuto.
Omido ngeenge odihapu, ofuto tai hapupala. Omido ngeenge dinini, ofuto tai ninipala, osheshi ye ota landifile kwoove omivalo domateyo.
Inamu nyekafana, ndelenee kala nokutila Kalunga koye. Osheshi Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Ndele wanifeni eenghedimhango dange, diinineni omalombwelo ange, opo mu shiive okukala moshilongo mu nombili.
Nedu tali mu pe oiimati yalo, ndele nye otamu ka kuta nokukala nombili mulo.
Ndele ngeenge tamu ti: ‘Ohatu ka lya shike momudo omutiheyali, fye eshi itatu kunu no itatu teya?’
Opo nee Ame ohandi mu nangeke noupuna momudo omutihamano, oo otau mu pe oilya tai wana omido nhatu kunye.
Ndele momudo omutihetatu kuneni, ndele tamu li fiyo okomudo omutimugoi oilya ikulu. Fiyo oilya ya kunwa tai teywa, mu nokulya ei ikulu.
“Edu yo itali landwa po fiyo alushe, osheshi edu olange, nye ovanailongo novaidililwa pwaame.
Onghee hano nye medu linya tamu ke li pewa efyuululo, nye mu nokwiitavelelwa okukulila onhele yedu.
“Omukweni ngeenge ta ningi ohepele ndele ta landifa po sha shomonhele yedu laye, opo nee ou omukwaoelela omumangululi, na kulile eshi omukwao e shi landifa po.
Ndelenee umwe ngeenge ehe nomumangululi omukwaoelela, ndele ye mwene ta dulu okukonga shi fike pwaashi sha pumbiwa pekulilo,
na vale omido di fike peni da pita, onhele yedu eshi ya landwa po, ndele na fute hano komulumenhu ou a landa naye shi fike pomido di li ko, opo nee ta shuna konhele yedu lefyuululo laye.

Ndelenee ye ngeenge ta nyengwa okulikongela ofuto, oyo ye ei landifa po, nai kale komulandi washo fiyo okomudo wekuwililo. Ndelenee momudo wekuwililo yo otai shunifwa kuye, itai kulilwa, oye na shune monhele yedu laye.

“Umwe ngeenge ta landifa po ongulu i li moshilando shi nohotekuma, na itavelelwe oku i landulula ko mefimbo lomudo umwe ngeenge la pita okudja kefimbo ye e i landifa po. Efimbo li fike pomudo umwe e li pewa oku i kulila.

Ndelenee yo ngeenge inai kulilwa eshi omudo aushe wa pita po, ongulu ei i li moshilando shi nohotekuma, tai kala fiyo alushe yaau e i lilandela noyepata laye. Momudo wekuwililo itai ka shunifwa vali komulandifi.
Ndelenee eengulu domomikunda edi dihe neehotekuma, otadi talwa di li mumwe nomapya. Do odi nokukulilwa ndele tadi shuna koovene momudo wekuwililo.
Ndelenee Ovalevi nava itavelelwe alushe okukulila eengulu moilando ei i li monhele yefyuululo lOvalevi.
Ngeenge ope na ou womOvalevi ite i kulile, ongulu ei ya landwa po, ei i li moshilando shavo, i nokushunifwa momudo wekuwililo. Osheshi eengulu domoilando yOvalevi odavo mokati kovana vaIsrael.
Ndelenee oulifilo wavo u li popepi noilando, itau landwa po, osheshi owo onhele yefyuululo lavo fiyo alushe.
“Omukweni ou e li pwoove ngeenge ta xutuka ndele ita dulu vali okulikwafa, ove u noku mu yambidida ngaashi omunailongo ile omwiidililwa, opo a shiive okukala nawa pwoove.
Ino tambula kuye oishoshela yoimaliwa ei we i mu pele, ndelenee u nokutila Kalunga koye, opo omukweni a shiive okukala pwoove.
Ino mu pa oimaliwa yoye u i limonene noishoshela, neendja doye ino di yandja moku mu nyeka.
Aame Omwene Kalunga keni, ou e mu pitifa mo medu laEgipiti, opo ndi mu pe edu laKaanan, nondi kale Kalunga keni.
“Nomukweni ngeenge ta xutuka pwoove ndele te lilandifa po kwoove, ino mu longifa ngaashi omupika.
Ye e nokukala pwoove ngaashi omulongeli wondjabi, ngaashi omwiidililwa fiyo okomudo wekuwililo.
Opo nee ye ta di po pwoove ngaashi omumangululwa, ye mwene noludalo laye pamwe naye. Ndele ye e nokushuna kepata lavo nokonhele yedu laxe.
Osheshi vo ovapiya vange ndele Ame nde va pitifa mo medu laEgipiti. Vo itava dulu okulandwa po ngaashi ovapika tava landwa po.
Ino va pangela nonyanya, ndelenee u nokutila Kalunga koye.
Mokulilandela kwoye omupika omulumenhu ile omupika omukainhu, ve lilandela moiwana tai ku dingilile, omuyo u lilandela omupika omulumenhu ile omukainhu.
Nosho yo lilandeleni vomovana voonakukala punye nomomapata avo naava vomuvo va dalelwa medu leni. Vo nava ninge efyuululo leni.
Ndele nye mu va fyuululifile ovana veni efyuululo. Nava ninge ovapika veni fiyo alushe. Ndelenee movakweni, ovana vaIsrael umwe aha pangele omukwao nonyanya.
“Omunailongo ile onakukala pwoove ngeenge te likongele emona, nomukweni ota xutuka puye, ndele te lilandifa po komunailongo ile kunakukala pwoove ile kuumwe womepata lomunailongo,
hano ye ngeenge a hangika e lilandifa po, ye ota shiiva okukulilwa ko. Umwe womovakwao ne mu kulile,
ile xekulu ile omona waxekulu ne mu kulile ile umwe womovakwaoelela vomepata laye ta dulu oku mu kulila ile ngeenge ye mwene ta dulu oku lifutila ne likulile ye mwene.

Ndele ye pamwe nomulandi e nokuvala omido okudja komudo winya ye e lilandifa po fiyo okomudo wekuwililo. Nokuyeleka ondado yokulandwa po kwaye ku nokukala ku fike pomuvalu womido. Ngaashi efimbo lomulongi wondjabi osho efimbo tali ka kala.
Ngeenge pa xupa omido dihapu na alule oikulila imwe yondado ye a landwa nayo.
Ndelenee omido dimwe adike ngeenge da xupa po fiyo okomudo wekuwililo, omulandi ne di vale yo, ndele ne mu futile oikulila i fike pomido odo.
Ngaashi omulongeli wondjabi osho ye e nokukala puye. Ndelenee ehe mu pangele nonyanya komesho yoye.
Ndele ngeenge ita kulilwa panghedi ei, ye e nokumangululwa momudo wekuwililo, ye mwene novana vaye.
Osheshi ovana vaIsrael vo ovapiya vange. Vo ovapiya vange nde va pitifa mo medu laEgipiti. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
26: “Inamu li ningila oikalunga. Ndele inamu lidikila oshihongwafano ile ongudimanya, ndele inamu dika moshilongo sheni emanya mulo mwa pandelwa omafano opo mu li nyongamene kulo. Osheshi Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.
Diinineni omashabata ange, tileni etwali lange liyapuki. Aame Omwene.
“Nye ngeenge tamu ende meenghedimhango dange ndele tamu diinine oipango yange noku i wanifa,
opo nee Ame ohandi ke mu lokifila odula pefimbo liwa nedu tali yandje oshishipo nomiti domoixwa tadi yandje oiimati yado.
Nefimbo lokuxwa tali xulile pekolo leeviinyu, nekolo leeviinyu tali fiki fiyo okefimbo lokukuna, ndele tamu ka lya omungome weni wa wana, ndele tamu ka kala nawa muhe nombudi medu leni.

Ame ohandi ka yandja yo ombili moshilongo, opo mu shiive okunangala nokutulumukwa paha kale sha tashi mu etele omahaluhalu. Naame ohandi ka taataa mo oilyani ii medu leni neongamukonda itali ka pumina mo.
Ndele nye otamu ka taataa ovatondadi veni, ndele vo otava ka wila po keongamukonda komesho yeni.
Vatano veni tava ka taataa efele, nefele leni otava taataa omayovi omulongo, novatondadi veni otava ka wila po keongamukonda komesho yeni.
Noshipala shange ohandi ke shi mu taalelifila ndele handi mu pe oludalo ndele tamu hapupala. Nehangano lange nanye Ame ohandi ke li pameka.
Nye otamu ka lya oilya ikulu youdwaali ndele tamu ke i tilashi ponhele yaai ipe.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka dika etwali lange liyapuki mokati keni, ndele itandi ke mu nyonyodola nande.
Naame ohandi ka enda mokati keni nokukala Kalunga keni, nanye otamu ka kala ovanhu vange.
Aame Omwene Kalunga keni ou nde mu pitifa mo medu laEgipiti, opo muha kale ovapika vavo. Ndele Ame onda teya eendjoko deni opo nye mu ende mwa yukilila.
“Ndelenee nye ngeenge itamu udu nge nokuwanifa oipango aishe ei,
nongeenge tamu ekeleshi eenghedimhango dange nongeenge eemwenyo deni tadi nyonyodola omalombwelo ange, opo muha wanife oipango yange aishe, ndele tamu teya po ehangano letu nanye,

opo nee naame yo handi mu ningile eshi, nokutya: Ame ohandi ke mu tumina omahaluhalu, oidinda nolwiidi nomesho taa ka twikifwa nomwenyo tau liekelele. Nye otamu ka kuna yo oshimha ombuto yeni, osheshi ovatondadi veni tave ke i lya po.

Ndele oshipala shange Ame ohandi ke shi mu taalelifila nehandu, opo nye mu tewatewe kovatondadi veni. Novatondadi veni tave ke mu pangela, ndele nye otamu ke litwala onhapo nande pehe na ou te mu taataa.
“Ndele nye natango tuu ngeenge itamu pwilikine nge, opo Ame ohandi mu handukile luheyali molwomatimba eni.
Ndele Ame ohandi teya po elinenepeko leni, neulu leni handi li kukutike ngaashi oshivela, nedu leni ngaashi oshikushu.
Neenghono deni tamu di hepifa oshimha, osheshi omapya eni itaa ka eta oipalwifa yao, nomiti domoshilongo itadi imi.
“Ndele nye ngeenge tamu lundukile nge ndele itamu pwilikine nge, Ame ohandi ka hapupalifa luheyali oiponga kombada yeni molwomatimba eni.
Noilyani yomoixwa Ame ohandi ke mu tumina, ndele yo tai mu nyeka ovana veni nokumana po oimuna yeni, ndele handi xupipike omuvalu weni, opo eendjila itadi endwa vali.
Ndele nye ngeenge natango tuu itamu dulika komalondwelo ange, ndele tamu anye nge,
naame yo ohandi ke mu anya yo noku mu denga luheyali omolwomatimba eni.

Ndele Ame ohandi mu tumine eongamukonda. Lo otali ka wanifa ehandu lange molweteyo lehangano, ndele nye ngeenge tamu shuna moilando yeni, Ame ohandi ka tuma oudu wolutapo mokati keni, ndele nye tamu ka yandjwa momake ovatondadi veni.

Ame ngeenge handi kufa po ekwafelo lomungome, ovalikadi tava ka teleka omungome weni moshikololo shefiya limwe noku mu alulila omungome weni pashiyelekifo. Ndele nye otamu ka lya ndelenee itamu ka kuta.
“Nye ngeenge natango tuu itamu pwilikine nge, ndelenee tamu anye nge,
Ame ohandi ke mu anya moupyuhandu ndele Ame ohandi ke mu handukila luheyali omolwomatimba eni.
Ndele nye otamu ka lya ombelela yovana veni ovamati ndele tamu ka lya ombelela yovana veni oukadona.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka tokeka oikulundu yeni yomayambelo nokuteya po eengudi deni detango, noimhu yeni ohandi ke i ekela kombada yoimhu yoikalunga yeni. Nomwenyo wange otau ke mu nyonyodola.
Noilando yeni Ame ohandi ke i ninga eenduba doikulukuma, neetembeli deni handi ke di tokeka ndele itandi hokwa edimba loitwiminifo yeni.
Heeno, Ame mwene ohandi ka tokeka oshilongo, opo ovatondadi veni, ava tava ka tula mo musho, otava ka kanghwa.
Ndele Ame ohandi ke mu halakanifila mokati koiwana noku mu taataa neongamukonda. Noshilongo sheni tashi ka ninga omuulu noilando yeni tai ka ninga eenduba doikulukuma.

Opo nee edu tali ka tulumukifwa molwomashabata alo, momafiku aeshe lo tali kala la tokekwa, nanye fimbo mu li medu lovatondadi veni. Opo nee edu tali ka tulumukifwa nokwaalulilwa omafiku etulumuko lomashabata.
Olo li nokutulumukwa omafiku e fike pokutokekwa kwalo. Efimbo letulumuko edu inali li mona momashabata eni fimbo nye mwa kala mulo.

Ndele venya tava ka fyaala mo mokati keni, Ame ohandi ke va pa momitima davo omahaluhalu medu lovatondadi valo nokulinyenga kwefo likukutu taku va twala onhapo. Ndele vo otava ka ya onhapo ngaashi omunhu ta i onhapo eongamukonda, ndele tava wile po nande kapehe na umwe te va taataa.
Ndele vo otava ka wilafana ngaashi eongamukonda tali iwa onhapo, nande kape na umwe ou te va taataa. Ndele nye itamu dulu okulipopila moipafi yovatondadi veni.
Ndelenee nye tamu ka halakanifwa moiwana, nedu lovatondadi veni tali ke mu lya po.
Ndele ava tava ka xupa po mokati keni otava ka fila mo moilongo yovatondadi veni molwokuhenouyuki kwavo, heeno, okufya omolwokuhenouyuki wooxe pamwe navo.
“Opo nee vo otava hepaululile nge omatimba avo nomatimba ooxe eshi vo va li ve liteeka nge ndele va li va anya nge.
Opo naame yo nda li ndi noku va anya noku va twala medu lovatondadi vavo. Opo omitima davo inadi pita etanda ngeenge tadi lininipike, va mone ekwatakanifo lomatimba avo.
Opo nee Ame ohandi dimbulukwa ehangano letu naJakob, nosho yo handi ka dimbulukwa ehangano lange naIsak nosho yo ehangano lange naAbraham, ndele handi ka dimbulukwa edu yo.

Ndelenee tete oshilongo shi nokweefwa kuvo ndele shi nokutulumukifwa molwomashabata asho fimbo vehe mo tashi kala sha tokekwa, ndele vo nava kwatakanife omatimba avo eshi va ekelashi, heeno, eshi va ekelashi omalombwelo ange neemwenyo davo, da nyonyodola eenghedimhango dange.
Ndelenee fimbo vo ve li yo medu lovatondadi vavo Ame itandi va ekeleshi, ndele itandi va nyonyodola, ndi va mane po ngeno ile ndi teye po ehangano letu navo, osheshi Aame Omwene Kalunga kavo.
Ndelenee Ame moku va halela ouwa ohandi ka dimbulukwa ehangano letu nooxekulu ava nde va pitifa mo medu laEgipiti, opo ndi ninge Kalunga kavo. Aame Omwene.”
Odo eenghedimhango nomalombwelo Omwene e di tula pokati kaye novana vaIsrael pomhunda yaSinai e di pele Moses.
27: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Umwe ngeenge e neudaneko e li wanifile Omwene, ove u nokuyeleka ondado yomunhu;
opo nee omulumenhu ou a wanifa omido omilongo mbali fiyo omido omilongo hamano, ondado yaye i fike eesekeli doshisiliveli omilongo nhano pasekeli yetwali liyapuki.
Ndelenee ye ngeenge omukainhu ondado yaye oi fike peesekeli omilongo nhatu.
Ndele ye ngeenge e nomido nhano fiyo omilongo mbali, opo nee ondado yomulumenhu eesekeli omilongo mbali nondado yomukainhu eesekeli omulongo.
Ndelenee ye ngeenge e nohani imwe fiyo omido nhano, ondado yaye ngeenge omulumenhu, eesekeli nhano doshisiliveli, ndele ngeenge omukainhu ondado yaye eesekeli doshisiliveli nhatu.
Ndele ye ngeenge e nomido omilongo hamano ile di dule odo, ngeenge omulumenhu, ondado yaye eesekeli omulongo nanhano doshisiliveli, ndele ngeenge omukainhu eesekeli omulongo.
