Ndelenee ye ngeenge ohepele, ta nyengwa okufuta ondado, e nokutwalwa komupristeli, opo omupristeli a shiive okuyeleka ondado yaye. Omupristeli na yeleke ondado yaye paenghono dokufuta kwaye.
“Ndele ngeenge oshimuna mwaayo hava yambele Omwene, aishe ei ye te i pe Omwene, i nokukala ya yapulwa.
Ye ine shi pingakanifa ile e shi lundulule, eshi shiwa ile naashi shii ile eshi shii naashi shiwa. Ndelenee ye ngeenge ta lundulula oshimuna nashikwao, eshi naashinya nashi kale shiyapuki.
Ndelenee oshinamwenyo eshi sha kelelwa okuyambelwa Omwene, ye ngeenge te shi eta, ye e noku shi tula koshipala shomupristeli,
nomupristeli e noku shi yeleka ngeenge oshiwa ile oshii. Pakuyeleka kwomupristeli osho shi nokukala.
Ndelenee ye ngeenge a hala oku shi kulila na wede ko kondado oshititano shondado ei ya yelekwa.
“Umwe ngeenge a hala okuyapulila Omwene eumbo laye oshali iyapuki, opo nee omupristeli e noku li yeleka ngeenge oliwa ile olii. Omupristeli ngaashi ta yeleke, osho nashi kale.
Ndelenee ou e li yapula, ngeenge a hala okukulila eumbo laye, e nokuweda ko oshititano shoimaliwa sha yelekwa. Opo nee tali ningi laye mwene.
“Ndele umwe ngeenge ta yapulile Omwene ombinga imwe yepya laye, ondado yaye nai yelekwe pakukuna ombuto nokutya, eekilograma omilongo mbali domahangu eesekeli doshisiliveli omilongo nhano.
Ye ngeenge ta yapula epya laye okudja komudo wekuwililo, nali kale ngaashi ondado yalo ya yelekwa.
Ndelenee epya laye ngeenge te li yapula konima yomudo wekuwililo, omupristeli e noku mu valela oimaliwa pamido odo di li ko fiyo okomudo wekuwililo tau ke uya. Ndele yo i nokukufwa mo mokuyelekwa.
Ndele ou a yapula epya, ngeenge a hala oku li kulila, na wede ko kondado yalo oshititano shoimaliwa. Ndele lo otali ningi laye mwene.
Ndelenee ye ngeenge ita kulile epya, ile epya ngeenge e li landifa po komukwao, lo itali ka kulilwa vali.
Ndelenee epya, eshi tali mangululwa momudo wekuwililo, li nokuyapulilwa Omwene ngaashi epya laye mwene. Lo otali ningi lomupristeli.
“Ndele ye ngeenge ta yapulile Omwene epya ye e li landa, ndele lo kali fi epya lefyuululo laye,
omupristeli ne mu valele ondado yalo pakuyeleka fiyo okomudo wekuwililo. Ndele ye e nokufuta ondado ya yelekwa ngaashi oshali iyapuki yOmwene.
Momudo wekuwililo epya nali alulilwe ou e li landifa po naye, osheshi lo efyuululo laye.
Ndele aishe ye te i yeleke pe nokuyelekwa pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Mosekeli imwe omu neegera omilongo mbali.
“Ndelenee oiveli yoimuna oyOmwene ngaashi oiveli oyaye mwene, nande umwe e i yapule, osho ngeenge ongobe ile odi, osheshi shOmwene.
Ndelenee sho ngeenge oshomoinamwenyo inai yela, ye ne shi kulile payeleko loye nokuweda ko oshititano shondado, ndele sho ngeenge itashi kulilwa, shi nokulandifwa po pandado ye shi yeleka.

Ndelenee eshi sha yapulwa, keshe eshi sha yapulilwa Omwene, ngeenge omunhu ile oshimuna ile epya lefyuululo laye, nande oshinini itashi dulika okulandifwa po ile okukulilwa. Aishe ei ya yapulwa oyo oiyapukielela yOmwene.
Omunhu keshe ou a tokolelwa efyo, ou a fingwa mokati kovanhu, ita kulilwa. Ye e nokudipawa shili.
“Nosho yo oitimulongo aishe yomepya, yomoilya noyomoiimati yomiti yo oyOmwene. Oyo oiyapuki yOmwene.
Ndelenee umwe ngeenge a hala okukulila sha shomoitimulongo, ye e nokuweda ko oshititano shomusho.
Oitimulongo aishe yeengobe noyeedi, heeno, aishe ei tai lifwa, oitimulongo i nokuyapulilwa Omwene.
Vo vaha konakone yo ngeenge oiwa ile oii, ndele inave i lundulula. Ndelenee ngeenge tave i lundulula, yo pamwe naai ya lundululwa i nokuyapulwa. Itai kulilwa.”
Oyo hano oipango Omwene e i pa Moses komhunda yaSinai e i lombwele ovana vaIsrael.

1: Mefiku lotete lohani onhivali momudo omutivali, vo eshi va pita mo medu laEgipiti, Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses metwali leongalo mombuwa yaSinai, ndele ta ti:
“Vala omuvalu aushe weongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael pamapata avo, pamadina avo, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe, komutwe nomutwe,
nye naAron mu nokuvala ovalumenhu va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile ava va koya po, ava vomuIsrael va wana okuhomona moita pamatanga avo.
Ndele pamwe nanye napa kale omulumenhu womepata keshe, omukulunhu wepata.”
Nomadina ovalumenhu ovayakuli veni oyaa: muRuben: Elisur yaSedeur.
MuSimeon: Selumiel yaSurisaddai.
MuJuda: Nashon yaAminadab.
MuIsaskar: Netanel yaSuar.
MuSebulon: Eliab yaHelon.
Movana vaJosef: MuEfraim: Elisama yaAmmihud. MuManasse: Gamaliel yaPedasur.
MuBenjamin: Abidan yaGideon.
MuDan: Ahieser yaAmmisaddai.
MuAsser: Pagiel yaOgran.
MuGad: Eliasaf yaRehuel.
MuNaftali: Ahira yaEnan.
Vo ova ifanwa mo meongalo, ovakulunhu vomapata ooxe, ovakulunhu vomapata omuIsrael.
Opo nee Moses naAron va tambula ovalumenhu ava va tumbulwa komadina avo,

ndele vo va shiva eongalo alishe mefiku lotete lohani onhivali. Ndele va shangelwa membo pamapata avo omaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina, komutwe nomutwe, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po,
Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses. Ndele vo ove va vala mombuwa yaSinai.

Ovana vaRuben, oshiveli shaIsrael, pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laRuben, ava va valwa ova li omayovi omilongo nhee nahamano nomafele atano.

Ovana vaSimeon pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laSimeon, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo nhano nomugoi nomafele atatu.

Ovana vaGad pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laGad ava va valwa, va li omayovi omilongo nhee naatano nomafele ahamano nomilongo nhano.

Ovana vaJuda pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laJuda, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo heyali naane nomafele ahamano.

Ovana vaIsaskar pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laIsaskar, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo nhano naane nomafele ane.

Ovana vaSebulon pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laSebulon, ava va valwa aveshe ava va wana, ova li omayovi omilongo nhano naheyali nomafele ane.

Ovana vaJosef, ovana vaEfraim pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laEfraim, ava va valwa ova li omayovi omilongo nhee nomafele atano.

Ovana vaManasse pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laManasse, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo mbali naavali nomafele avali.

Ovana vaBenjamin pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laBenjamin ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo nhatu naatano nomafele ane.

Ovana vaDan pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laDan, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo hamano naavali nomafele aheyali.

Ovana vaAsser pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, pamaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laAsser, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo nhee nalimwe nomafele atano.

Ovana vaNaftali pakudalwa kwavo, pamapata avo, nomaumbo avo, pamuvalo womadina avo, komutwe nomutwe, ovalumenhu aveshe kumwe ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
ovo tuu ovo vomepata laNaftali, ava va valwa, ova li omayovi omilongo nhano naatatu nomafele ane.
Ovo tuu ovo va valwa kuMoses nokuAron nokovakulunhu vOvaisraeli, vo omulongo navavali, keshe umwe a vala epata laye.
Osho ngaha hano ava va valwa movana vaIsrael pamaumbo avo, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile va koya po, aveshe ava va wana okuhomona moita,
aveshe ava va valwa ova li ve fike pomayovi omafele ahamano nomayovi atatu nomafele atano nomilongo nhano.
Ndelenee Ovalevi vomepata looxekulu yavo inava valwa pamwe navakwao.
Osheshi Omwene okwa popya naMoses, ndee ta ti:
“Epata laLevi alike inamu li vala, nomuvalu walo aushe mokati kovana vaIsrael itau shangelwa mo,

ndelenee Ovalevi va tula moshilonga shetwali liyapuki noshoinima aishe yalo naaishe i li mo. Vo ove nokuhumbata etwali liyapuki naaishe ei i li mo ndele vo ve nokuyakula moilonga yomulo nokwoonga onhanda keembinga adishe detwali liyapuki.
“Netwali liyapuki ngeenge tali fikama, Ovalevi ve noku li pangulula. Netwali liyapuki ngeenge tali kanghama, Ovalevi ve noku li pangela po. Ndele omuyeni ou ta ehene kulo na dipawe.
Novana vaIsrael ve nokwoonga onhanda keshe umwe monhele yaye, nakeshe epata pepandela lalo pamatanga avo.
Ndelenee Ovalevi ve nokwoonga onhanda keembinga adishe detwali liyapuki, ehandu liha holoke kombada yovana vaIsrael. Osho ngaha hano Ovalevi ve nokuyakula moilonga yetwali liyapuki.”
Novana vaIsrael ve shi ninga naanaa Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses, osho va ninga.
2: Ndele Omwene okwa popya naMoses naAron ndee ta ti:
Ovana vaIsrael ve nokwoonga onhanda keshe umwe pepandela laye pomadidiliko omaumbo avo. Keembinga adishe detwali leongalo kokule kanini nalo ve nokwoonga onhanda yavo.
Ava tava ongo onhanda kombinga yokoushilo kepito letango ovo: Engafifipandela lonhanda yaJuda pamatanga avo. Ndele Nashon yaAminadab e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaJuda.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa va li omayovi omilongo heyali naane nomafele ahamano.
Epata laIsaskar nali onge onhanda puvo. Ndele Netanel yaSuar e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaIsaskar.
Onhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa va li omayovi omilongo nhano naane nomafele ane.
Opo nee epata laSebulon. Ndele Eliab yaHelon e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaSebulon.
Onhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa ova li omayovi omilongo nhano naheyali nomafele ane.
Aveshe ava va valwa vomonhanda yaJuda ova li ve fike po mayovi efele nomayovi omilongo hetatu nomayovi hamano nomafele ane pamatanga avo. Vo ve nokufikama tete.
Engafifipandela lomonhanda yaRuben pamatanga avo li nokukala kombinga yokoumbuwanhu. Ndele Elisur yaSedeur e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaRuben.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhee nahamano nomafele atano.
Epata laSimeon nali onge onhanda puvo. Ndele Selumiel yaSurisaddai e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaSimeon.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhano nomugoi nomafele atatu.
Opo nee epata laGad. Ndele Eliasaf yaRehuel e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaGad.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhee naatano nomafele ahamano nomilongo nhano.
Aveshe ava va valwa vomonhanda yaRuben pamatanga avo ova li ve fike pomayovi efele nomayovi omilongo nhano nalimwe nomafele ane nomilongo nhano. Ndele vo ovativali mokufikama.

Opo nee etwali leongalo tali fikama: onhanda yOvalevi tai i pokati keenhanda neenhanda. Ngaashi hava ongo eenhanda davo, nosho yo ve nokufikama, keshe epata monhele yalo pashikulafano lomangafifipandela avo.
Engafifipandela lonhanda yaEfraim pamatanga avo li nokukala kombinga yokouninginino. Ndele Elisama yaAmmihud e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaEfraim.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhee nomafele atano.
Ndele epata laManasse tali ongo onhanda puvo. Ndele Gamaliel yaPedasur e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaManasse.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhatu naavali nomafele avali.
Opo nee epata laBenjamin. Ndele Abidan yaGideon e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaBenjamin.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, va li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhatu naatano nomafele ane.
Aveshe ava va valwa vomonhanda yaEfraim pamatanga avo, ova li ve fike pomayovi efele nahetatu nefele limwe. Ndele vo ovatitatu mokufikama.
Engafifipandela lonhanda yaDan li nokukala kombinga yokoumbangalanhu pamatanga avo. Ndele Ahieser yaAmmisaddai e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaDan.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo hamano naavali nomafele aheyali.
Epata laAsser li nokwoonga onhanda puvo. Ndele Pagiel yaOgran e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaAsser.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhee nalimwe nomafele atano.
Opo nee epata laNaftali. Ndele Ahira yaEnan e nokuninga omukulunhu wovana vaNaftali.
Nonhanda yaye pamwe naava va valwa va li ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhano naatatu nomafele ane.
Aveshe ava va valwa vomonhanda yaDan ova li ve fike pomayovi efele nomayovi omilongo nhano naheyali nomafele ahamano. Vo hava xuuninwa mokufikama pamatanga avo.
Ovo ava va valwa vomovana vaIsrael pamaumbo avo. Aveshe ava va valwa vomeenhanda pamatanga avo ova li omayovi omafele ahamano nomayovi atatu, nomafele atano nomilongo nhano.
Ndelenee Ovalevi inava valelwa mo momuvalu wovana vaIsrael Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.
Novana vaIsrael osho va ninga naanaa Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses. Osho va onga eenhanda davo pomangafifipandela avo nosho onhanda yavo oya fikama keshe umwe pepata laye, peumbo laye.
3: Noludalo laAron nolaMoses mefiku linya Omwene a popya naMoses komhunda yaSinai, oleli:
Omadina ovana ovamati vaAron oyaa: Oshiveli Nadab, opo nee Abihu, Eliaser naItamar.
Oo omadina ovana ovamati vaAron, ovapristeli va vaekwa, ava e va tula mokuyakula moshilonga shoupristeli.

Ndelenee Nadab naAbihu va fila koshipala shOmwene, vo eshi va twala omundilo umwe koshipala shOmwene mombuwa yaSinai. Ndele vo va li vehe noludalo. Ndelenee Eliaser naItamar ova li va yakula moshilonga shoupristeli moipafi yaxe Aron.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Epata laLevi li ehenifa li kale moipafi yomupristeli Aron, opo vo va shiive oku mu yakula.
Vo nava diinine oilonga yaye noilonga yeongalo alishe komesho yetwali leongalo, va wanife oiyakulwalonga yetwali liyapuki.
Ndele vo ve nokukala noshisho shoilongifo aishe yetwali leongalo noponhele yovana vaIsrael okuyakula metwali liyapuki.
NOvalevi u noku va yandja kuAron nokovana vaye. Vo aveshe vomovana vaIsrael ova yandjwa kuye.
Ndelenee Aron novana vaye ovamati u noku va yapulila oshilonga shoupristeli. Ndele omuyeni ou ta ehene po, e nokudipawa.”
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Tala, Ame mwene onda kufa mo Ovalevi movana vaIsrael ponhele yoiveli aishe ei tai yeulula oshidalelo shaina movana vaIsrael, Ovalevi opo va kale vange mwene.
Osheshi oiveli aishe oyange. Mefiku tuu linya Ame nda dipaa po oiveli aishe medu laEgipiti Ame nde liyapulila oiveli aishe yomuIsrael, yovanhu noyoimuna. Vo ve nokukala vange, Aame Omwene.”
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses mombuwa yaSinai ndee ta ti:
Vala ovana ovamati vaLevi pamaumbo avo nopamapata avo. Ovalumenhu aveshe ava va wanifa ohani imwe ile va koya po, vo u noku va vala.
Ndele Moses okwe va vala palombwelo lOmwene ngaashi Ye e mu lombwela.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaLevi pamadina avo ovava: Gerson, Kohat, naMerari ovo va li ooxekulu yomaludi oo e va lukilwa.
Nomadina ovana ovamati vaGerson oyaa: Libni naSimei.
Novana ovamati vaKohat pamapata avo: Amram naIshar, Hebron naUsiel.
Novana ovamati vaMerari pamapata avo: Mahli naMushi Oo omapata Ovalevi pamaumbo avo.
MuGerson mwa dja epata lOvalibni nepata lOvasimei. Olo epata lOvagerson.
Ava va valwa vomuvo ovalumenhu aveshe ava va wanifa ohani imwe ile va koya po, omuvalu wavo u fike pomayovi aheyali nomafele atano.
Epata lOvagerson li nokwoonga Onhanda konima yetwali liyapuki langhele kouninginino.
Eliasaf yaLael e nokuninga omukulunhu womaumbo Ovagerson.
Ovana ovamati vaGerson ve nokukala noshisho shetwali liyapuki netwali oshikututuviko shoipa yeedi noshikututuviko shoipa yonguluve poshivelo shetwali leongalo,

noiyatafaila ya kambakanifwa yehale lokomesho, noshiidilifoyata shoshivelo shehale lokomesho tashi dingilile etwali liyapuki noaltari neengodi adishe dasho, heeno, aishe ei tai longifwa moshilonga shalo.
Ndele oludalo la dja muKohat: Epata lOvaamrami nepata lOvaishari nepata lOvahebroni, nepata lOvaussiel. Oo omapata Ovakohati.
Aveshe ava va valwa ovalumenhu aveshe ava va wanifa ohani imwe naava va koya po, ova li ve fike pomayovi ahetatu nomafele ahamano, ava va li hava diinine oilonga yetwali liyapuki.
Omapata ovana vaKohat nava onge onhanda kombinga yokoumbuwanhu wetwali liyapuki.
Ndele Elisafan yaUsiel e nokuninga omukulunhu wongudu yomapata Ovakohati.
Vo ove nokukala noshisho shoshikefa noshoshitaafula noshoshikwatelwalamba noshoaltari noshoilongifo yetwali liyapuki oyo hai longifwa kovapristeli noshoshitukulifoyata naaishe ei tai longifwa mulo.
Ndelenee Eliaser, omona womupristeli Aron, e nokuninga omukulunhu wovakulunhu vOvalevi, omupashukili waava hava longo metwali liyapuki.
Oludalo laMerari olo epata lOvamahli nepata lOvamushi. Oo omapata Ovamerari.
Ndele ava va valwa muvo ovalumenhu aveshe va wanifa ohani imwe naava va koya po ova li ve fike pomayovi ahamano nomafele avali.
Ndele Suriel yaAbigail e nokuninga omukulunhu wongudu yomapata Ovamerari. Vo ve nokwoonga onhanda kombinga yokoumbangalanhu wetwali liyapuki.
Novana ovamati vaMerari va li ve nokukala noshisho shoipilangi yetwali liyapuki neenhikifo dalo neengudi dalo noikwatelwamhadi yalo, noilongifo aishe ngaashi yo oilonga aishe ya li i nokulongwa,
neengudi dehale lokomesho keembinga adishe noikwatelwamhadi yado neembosha dado neengodi dado.

Ndelenee komesho yetwali liyapuki, kombinga yokoushilo, kepito letango, oko Moses naAron hava ongo onhanda novana vavo ava hava longo metwali liyapuki nokutya, oilonga ponhele yovana vaIsrael. Ndelenee omuyeni ou ta ehene po, e nokudipawa.
Ovalevi aveshe, ava va valwa kuMoses nokuAron palombwelo lOmwene, ava va valwa pamapata avo, ovalumenhu aveshe ava va wanifa ohani imwe nova koya po, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo mbali naavali.
Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Vala oiveli aishe yovalumenhu vovana vaIsrael, ava va wanifa ohani imwe ile va koya po, ove u shangele mo omuvalu wayo.
Kufile nge Aame Omwene Ovalevi ponhele yoiveli aishe yoimuna yovana vaIsrael.”
Ndele Moses okwa vala oiveli aishe yovana vaIsrael, Omwene ngaashi e mu lombwela.
Noiveli aishe yovalumenhu pakuvala omadina ayo, ei ya wanifa ohani imwe ile ya koya po, oya li pakuvalwa kwayo i fike pomayovi omilongo mbali naavali nomafele avali nomilongo heyali naitatu.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:

“Kufa Ovalevi ponhele yoiveli aishe yovalumenhu yovana vaIsrael, noyoimuna yOvalevi ponhele yoiveli aishe yovalumenhu yovana vaIsrael, noyoimuna yOvalevi ponhele yoimuna yavo, Ovalevi opo va shiive okukala vange mwene. Aame omwene.
Ndelenee ngaashi ekulilo laava omafele avali nomilongo heyali navatatu, ava va xupa po koiveli yovalumenhu vOvaisraeli momwaalu wOvalevi,
u noku va kufila keshe umwe eesekeli nhano; di kufa pakuyeleka osekeli yetwali liyapuki nokuvala eegera omilongo mbali mosekeli imwe.
Ndele ove u nokupa Aron novana oimaliwa ngaashi ekulilo laava va xupa mokati kavo.”
Ndele Moses okwa tambula oimaliwa yoikulila yaava va xupa po komuvalu wovakulilwa vOvalevi,
ye okwa kufa oimaliwa koiveli yovalumenhu vovana vaIsrael, i fike peesekeli eyovi limwe nomafele atatu nomilongo hamano nanhano pakuyeleka kwosekeli yetwali liyapuki.
Ndele Moses okwa yandja kuAron novana vaye ovamati oimaliwa yoikulila palombwelo lOmwene, ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
4: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses naAron ndee ta ti:
“Vala omuvalu aushe wovana ovamati vaKohat womovana vaLevi pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo,
ava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu naava va koya po fiyo okomudo omutimilongo nhano, aveshe ava va pewa oiwanifwalonga, ve i wanife metwali leongalo.
“Oshiyakulwalonga shovana ovamati vaKohat metwali leongalo osheshi: okukala noshisho shoinima iyapukielela.
Onhanda ngeenge tai hanaunwa po, mokufikama opo nee Aron novana vaye ovamati ve nokuuya ndee tava kulula oshitukulifoyata ndee tava tuvike nasho oshikefa shoundobwedi;
ndele vo nava tule kombada yasho oshikututuviko shoipa yonguluve noshiyata sha tungwa ashishe neengodi domavala sha yalwa kombada yasho, ndele ve nokuxwekela mo omitengi dokuhumbata.

Vo ve nokuuvika oshitaafula shomingome detaliko noshiyata shomavala, nokombada yasho ve nokutula ko oiyaxa noikwatelwa nomaholo neekana doikunwayambo. Nomingome odo di nokukala ko efimbo keshe, nadi kale ko yo.
Opo nee tava yale kombada oshiyata shapurpuri noku shi uvika noshituvikoyata shoipa yonguluve ndee tava xwekele mo omitengi dokuhumbata.
Opo nee nava kufe oshiyata shomavala ndee tava tuvike oshikwatelwalamba pamwe neelamba dasho neengodo dasho noukopi neekana adishe domaholo asho noilongifwa aishe.
Ndele vo ve noku shi tonyena pamwe noilongifo yasho aishe moshiyatatuviko shoipa yonguluve noku shi tula kolutala.
Ndele ve nokuyala oshiyata shomavala kombada yoaltari yoshingoldo noku i tuvika noshiyatatuviko shoipa yonguluve nokuxwekela mo omitengi dokuhumbata.
Vo ve nokukufa yo oilongifo aishe hava longo nayo metwali liyapuki ndee tave i tula moshiyata shomavala noku i tonyena mo moshiyatatuviko shoipa yonguluve nokuxwekela mo omitengi dokuhumbata.
Vo nava yuke ko omute moaltari nokutula ko oshiyata shopurpuri.

Ndele vo ve nokutula ko oilongifo aishe hava longo nayo nokutya: oikwatelwa yomakala, neenyala dombelela, nouxupulo nomaholo, noinima aishe yoaltari. Ndele vo ve nokuyala oshiyatatuviko shoipa yonguluve kombada yayo nokuxwekela mo omitengi dokuhumbata.

Aron novana vaye ovamati ngeenge va mane okutuvika etwali liyapuki noinima aishe yetwali, opo nee ovana ovamati vaKohat nave uye va ka humbate. Ndele vo vaha kume oinima iyapuki, opo vaha fye. Oinima oyo tuu oyo yetwali leongalo ovana ovamati vaKohat ve nokuhumbata.

Ndele Eliaser, omona womupristeli Aron na kale noshisho shomahooli oshikwatelwalamba noitwiminifo yedimba liwa neendjayambo defiku keshe nomaadi okuvaeka. Ye e nokukala noshisho shetwali alishe liyapuki naaishe i li mo: etwali liyapuki noinima aishe yalo.”
Ndele Omwene okwa popya naMoses naAron ndee ta ti:
“Taleni, epata laKohat liha dimwe po kongudu yomapata Ovalevi.

Va ningileni hano ngaha, opo va shiive okukala nomwenyo mokweehena kwavo koinima iyapukielela. Aron novana vaye ovamati nava ye oku va tula, keshe umwe, moshilonga shaye nokuhumbata oshihumbatwa shaye.
Ndelenee vo vaha ye mo okutala oinima iyapuki nande papakumo leisho, vaha fye.”
Ndele Omwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Vala omuvalu aushe wovana ovamati vaGerson pamaumbo avo nopamapata avo.
U noku va vala okudja kwaava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu naava va koya po fiyo okomido omilongo nhano, aveshe ava ve nokulonga vo va yakule moilonga yetwali leongalo.
“Oiwanifwalonga yomapata Ovagerson mokuyakula nomokuhumbata oyei:

Vo ve nokuhumbata eefailayata detwali, netwali leongalo noshikututuviko shalo shoipa yeedi noshikututuviko shoipa yonguluve, eshi shi li kombada yalo kombada yaaishe noshiidilifoyata shetwali leongalo,

noiyata ya kambakanifwa kehale lokomesho noshiidilifoyata shoshivelo shehale lokomesho eli tali dingilile etwali liyapuki noaltari, neengodi dasho noilongifo aishe tai longifwa moilonga yomulo. Vo nava longe oilonga aishe i nokulongwa mulo.

Eyakulwalonga alishe lovana ovamati Ovagerson nokutya, aishe ei ve nokuhumbata, noilonga yavo aishe oi nokuwanifwa palombwelo laAron novana vaye ovamati. Ndele ava nave va shiivifile aishe ei ve noku i humbata nokukala noshisho shayo.
Oshiwanifwalonga shopetwali leongalo shovana ovamati vaGerson osheshi hano. Naashi ve noku shi kalela noshisho ve noku shi diinina nokupashukilwa kwaItamar, omona omumati womupristeli Aron.”
Ovana ovamati vaMerari u noku va vala pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo.
U noku va vala okudja kwaava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu naava va koya po, fiyo okomido omilongo nhano. Aveshe ava ve nokulonga vo va yakule moilonga yetwali leongalo.
Oinima ei ve noku i kalela noshisho mokuhumbata kwavo meyakulwalonga lavo petwali leongalo oyei: oipilangi yetwali liyapuki neenhikifo dayo neengudi dalo noikwatelwamhadi yado

neengudi dehale lokomesho keembinga adishe noikwatelwamhadi yado neendungu dado neengodi dado, heeno, oilongifo aishe naashishe eshi tashi pumbiwa mokuyakulwa mulo. Noilongifo ei tai yandjwa kuvo ve i humbate, i nokutumbulwa kunye.
Eshi hano eyakulwalonga lomapata ovana ovamati vaMerari, oilonga yavo aishe mokuyakula petwali leongalo paulikilo laItamar, omona omumati womupristeli Aron.
Ndele Moses naAron novakulunhu veongalo ova vala ovana ovamati vaKohat pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo,
okudja kwaava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu naava va koya po fiyo okomido omilongo nhano, aveshe ava ve nokulonga vo va yakule moilonga yetwali leongalo.
Ndele ava va valwa pamapata avo ova li ve fike pomayovi avali nomafele aheyali nomilongo nhano.
Oo hano omuvalu waava va valwa vomomapata Ovakohati, aveshe ava va yakula petwali leongalo, ava va valwa kuMoses naAron palombwelo lOmwene ye e li lombwela Moses.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaGerson ava va valwa pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo,
ava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu naava va koya po fiyo okomido omilongo nhano, aveshe ava va li ve nokulonga vo va yakule moilonga petwali leongalo.
Omuvalo waava va valwa pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo wa li u fike pomayovi avali nomafele ahamano nomilongo nhatu.
Ovo hano va valwa vomomapata ovana ovamati vaGerson aveshe ava va yakula moilonga petwali leongalo ava va valwa kuMoses naAron palombwelo lOmwene ye e li lombwela Moses.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaMerari ava va valwa pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo,
ava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu naava va koya po fiyo okomido omilongo nhano, aveshe ava va li ve nokuyakula moilonga petwali leongalo,
omuvalu waava va valwa pamapata avo ou fike pomayovi atatu nomafele avali.
Oo hano omuvalu waava va valwa vomomapata ovana ovamati vaMerari, ava va valwa kuMoses nokuAron palombwelo lOmwene, Moses e li lombwelwa.
Ovalevi aveshe ava va valwa kuMoses naAron novakulunhu Ovaisraeli pamapata avo nopamaumbo avo,
ava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu ile va koya po fiyo okomido omilongo nhano, aveshe ava va li ve nokuyakula moilonga petwali leongalo ile mokuhumbata,
omuvalu wavo wa li u fike pomayovi ahetatu nomafele atano nomilongo ahetatu.
Palombwelo Moses e li lombwelwa kOmwene, keshe umwe wavo a ulikilwa eyakulwalonga laye noshilonga shaye mokuhumbata. Okuvala oko Moses e ku wanifa ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela.
5: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael nokutya, nava pitife mo monhanda ovanhu aveshe ve noudu woshilundu naaveshe ava ve netiko lomaxu naaveshe ava ve linyateka koshimhu.
Mu nokupitifa mo omulumenhu nomukainhu. Mu noku va pitifa mo pondje kombada yonhanda, vaha nyateke onhanda yavo, muyo Ame handi kala mokati kavo.”
Ndele ovana vaIsrael osho va ninga ndele ve va pitifa mo pondje kombada yonhanda. Ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses osho ovana vaIsrael va ninga.
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Ngeenge omulumenhu ile omukainhu ta nyono, ngaashi ovanhu hava nyono mokuhadiinina Omwene, nomwenyo otau pewa oushima,
Opo ye e nokuhepaulula etimba laye e li ninga. Opo nee ta alula oikolo yaye noku i wanifa nokuweda po oshititano shayo, ndele ye e noku i pa ou, ye e noikolo naye.

Ndelenee winya ngeenge ke nomunhu oku mu kulila, ou ta dulu okwaalula oikolo, opo oikolo nai alulilwe Omwene nokutya, omupristeli, ndee ta weda po odi yomhedi yekwatakanifo, opo winya a kwatakanifwe nayo.
“Neyambo keshe lomeeshaliyambo diyapuki dovana vaIsrael tave di eta komupristeli, li nokuninga laye.
Neeshaliyambo diyapuki dakeshe umwe, di nokuninga daye. Eshi tashi yandjwa komupristeli, shi nokuninga shaye.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Ngeenge pe na ou omwalikadi waye ta nyono kuye ndee ta teya po ohombo naye

nomulumenhu umwe ta nangala naye, ndelenee eshi sha kala sha holekwa momesho omulumenhu waye, ndele ye ine shi shiiva, nande omukainhu e linyateka, fimbo inapa kala nande ondobwedi ndele ina kwatelwa moshilonga shaye;
ndele omhepo youkodi ya hanga omulumenhu, onghee ta file omwalikadi waye, ou e linyateka, oukodi ile omhepo youkodi ya hanga omulumenhu ndee ta file omwalikadi waye oukodi, ou nande ine linyateka;

Opo nee omulumenhu na ete omwalikadi waye komupristeli noku mu yandjela eyambo: oufila woilya okilograma imwe, ndelenee kombada yao aha tile ko omaadi ndee aha wede ko oitwiminifo, shaashi olo eendjayambo doukodi, edimbulukifoyambo, tali dimbulukifa owii.
Nomupristeli na ehenife omwalikadi noku mu kalekela koshipala shOmwene.
Nomupristeli na tile moshiyuma shedu omeva mayapuki ndee na kufe mondwi ei i li poshi yetwali liyapuki ndee e i tule momeva.

Opo nee omupristeli e nokukaleka omukainhu koshipala shOmwene, ye na pandulule eexwiki dokomutwe womukainhu, ndee na tule edimbulukifoyambo momake aye, olo eendjayambo doukodi. Ndele meke lomupristeli mu nokukala omeva ouyehame mulula, oo taa eta etulomutima.

Nomupristeli e noku mu anifa nokulombwela omukainhu: “Omulumenhu nande umwe ngeenge ina nangala naave ndele ino nyona komulumenhu woye mokulinyateka, hano omeva aa ouyehame mulula, aa taa eta etulomutima itae ku ningi sha.
Ndelenee ove, ngeenge wa nyona komulumenhu woye, ndele we linyateka mokunangala nomulumenhu umwe ehe fi woye mwene,

opo nee omupristeli e nokwaanifa omukainhu neano lefingo, nomupristeli e nokulombwela omukainhu: Omwene ne ku ninge efingo netukano mokati koshiwana sheni, Omwene eshi ta fipatelifa oiya yoye ndee ta dindike edimo loye;
Omeva aa efingo naa ye momandjadja oye, opo oshiya shoye shi fipatele nedimo loye li dinde.” Nomukainhu na tye: “Amen, Amen.”
Opo nee eendjovo edi omupristeli ne di shangele mokafo, ye ne ka fetifile momeva efingo.
Opo nee omeva aa efingo ne a nwefe omukainhu, omeva aa taa eta etulomutima, opo omeva aa taa eta etulomutima a shiive okuya meni laye a ninge ouyehame mulula.
Nomupristeli na tambule meke lomukainhu eendjayambo doukodi, neendjayambo te di dungadungifa koshipala shOmwene ndee te di twala koaltari.
Omupristeli e nokukufa yo meendjayambo eke li yadi ngaashi edimbulukifoyambo noku di xwika po koaltari. Opo nee ta nwefa omukainhu omeva.

Ye eshi a nwefa omukainhu omeva, opo nee ye, ngeenge e linyateka nokunyona komulumenhu waye mokuhaelwa, omeva aa taa eta etulomutima taa i meni laye ngaashi ouyehame mulula nedimo laye tali ka dinda noshiya shaye tashi ka fipatela. Nomukainhu ou ta ka ninga omufingwa mokati koshiwana shavo.
Ndelenee omukainhu ngeenge ine linyateka, ndelenee a yela ita mono oshiponga ndee ta kala e noludalo.
“Omhango youkodi oyei: Omwalikadi ngeenge ta nangala naumwe fimbo e nomulumenhu waye, ote linyateke
ile omhepo youkodi ngeenge tai hange omulumenhu ndee ta file omwalikadi waye oukodi, opo ye e nokutwala omwalikadi waye koshipala shOmwene, nomupristeli e noku mu ningila pamhango tuu ei.
Nomulumenhu ota ka kala nowino, ndelenee omwalikadi ou e nokuhumbata etimba laye.”
6: Nomwene okwa popya vali naMoses,
a lombwele ovana vaIsrael a tye kuvo: “Omulumenhu ile omukainhu, ngeenge a hala okuudaneka eudaneko nokutya, eudaneko lOmunasiri, e liyapule kOmwene,
ye e nokulidilika omaviinyu noikolwifa, ye ke nokunwa omaetika omaviinyu ile oshinwa tashi kolwifa, heeno, aha nwe nande omeva a kolwa omandjebele, ye aha lye omandjebele matalala ile oo a kashekwa.
Momafiku aeshe omounasiri waye aha lye sha shomwashishe eshi sha ningwa komuviinyu, nande oipele ile keenhele domashila ado.
Momafiku aeshe omounasiri waye oshimbi shiha ye ko komutwe waye. Fiyo omafiku a pwa ko, aa ye e liudanekela Omwene, ye e nokukala omuyapuki, na efe eexwiki daye dokomutwe diha kululwe.
Momafiku aeshe ye e liyapulila Omwene ye aha ehene koshimhu.
Ndee nande naku fye xe ile ina ile omumwaina omulumenhu ile omumwaina omukainhu, ehe linyateke kuvo, osheshi komutwe waye oku nedidiliko nokutya, ye e liyapulila Kalunga kaye.
Omafiku aeshe omounasiri waye ye a yapulilwa Omwene.
“Ndele ngeenge pe na ou ta fi ohaluka puye, ndee ta nyateke ngaha omutwe waye wa yapulwa, ye e nokukululifa omutwe waye mefiku letetifo laye, mefiku etiheyali ne u kululife.
Ndele mefiku etihetatu ye e nokweeta omalyamono avali ile eenghutyona mbali komupristeli koshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Nomupristeli e nokuyamba imwe etimbayambo nashimwe exwikiloyambo noku mu kwatakanifa omolwaashi ye a nyona omolwomufi. Osho ngaha ye e nokuyapula vali omutwe waye mefiku tuu limwe alike.
Opo nee ye e nokuliudanekela vali Omwene omafiku omounasiri waye nokweeta kOmwene odi yomudo umwe okuvelombediyambo. Nomafiku enya otete itaa valwa vali, osheshi ounasiri waye wa nyatekwa.
“Omhango younasiri oyei: ‘Mefiku tuu olo omafiku omounasiri waye a xula po, vo ve noku mu eta koshivelo shetwali leongalo;
ndele ye e nokuyambela Omwene eyambo laye: odi yomudo umwe ihe noshipo exwikiloyambo, odi yonghadi yomudo umwe ihe noshipo etimbayambo, odi yomhedi ihe noshipo epanduloyambo,
okambale ke noikuki youfila wa nakwa ihe nonhafi, oikuki mwa pilulilwa omaadi, oikuki ya lalakana ihe nonhafi ya vaekwa nomaadi, pamwe neendjayambo nopamwe noikunwayambo.
Nomupristeli e noku i eta koshipala shOmwene nokuyamba omolwaye etimbayambo nexwikiloyambo.
Ye e nokulongekidila Omwene epanduloyambo odi yomhedi pamwe nokambale koikuki ihe nonhafi. Nomupristeli e nokuyamba omolwaye eendjayambo noikunwayambo.
Opo nee Omunasiri na kululife eexwiki daye dounasiri dokomutwe, ndee ta kufa eexwiki daye dounasiri dokomutwe ndee te di ekele momundilo, ou u li koshi yepanduloyambo.

Omupristeli na kufe ombeyo ya telekwa yodi yomhedi noshikuki shimwe shihe nonhafi shomokambale noshikuki shimwe sha lalakana shihe nonhafi. Ndele ye e noku i tula momake Omunasiri, ye eshi a kululifa eexwiki dounasiri waye.

Nomupristeli e noku i dungadungifa edungadungifwayambo koshipala shOmwene. Yo oshali iyapuki yomupristeli pamwe nombadja yedungadungifwayambo noshilama sheyelulwayambo. Opo nee Omunasiri na nwe omaviinyu.’
“Oyo hano omhango yOmunasiri, ou a udanekela Omwene eyambo molwounasiri waye pamwe naikwao, ye ta dulu oku i yandja. Ye e nokuninga paudaneko laye ye e li udaneka pamhango yOunasiri.”
Ndele Omwene okwa popya naMoses,
a lombwele Aron novana vaye ovamati a tye: “Mokunangeka kweni noupuna ovana vaIsrael, va lombweleni mu tye:
‘Omwene ne ku nangeke noupuna, Ye ne ku amene;
Omwene ne ku yelifile oshipala shaye Ye ne ku filonghenda;
Omwene na yelule oshipala shaye kwoove, Ye ne ku pe ombili.
Osho ngaha hano edina lange ve noku li tula kovana vaIsrael. Ndele Ame nda hala oku va nangeka noupuna.’ ”
7: Mefiku tuu olo Moses okwa li a dikila etwali liyapuki nokwe li vaeka noku li yapula noinima yalo aishe, noaltari noilongifo yayo aishe nokwe i vaeka noku li yapula,
opo nee ovakulunhu vOvaisraeli, novakulunhu veengudu domaumbo ova eta omayambo avo, vo va li ovakulunhu vomapata, venya va tulwa kombada yaava va valwa,

vo ova eta omayambo avo koshipala shOmwene: omatemba ahamano e neenduda deefaila neengobe omulongo nambali nokutya etemba limwe kovakulunhu vavali, nongobe imwe kukeshe omukulunhu. Ndele vo ve di eta komesho yetwali liyapuki.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“I tambula, osheshi yo otai shiiva okulongifwa meyakulwalonga letwali leongalo. Ndee ove u noku i pa Ovalevi, kukeshe payakulwalonga laye.”
Opo nee Moses okwa tambula omatemba neengobe ndele e i yandja kOvalevi.
Ye okwa yandja kovana ovamati vaGerson omatemba avali neengobe nhee payakulwalonga lavo.
Ndele kovana ovamati vaMerari ye okwe va pa omatemba ane neengobe hetatu payakulwalonga lavo, va longifwa kuItamar, omona womupristeli Aron.
Ndelenee ye ina yandja sha kovana ovamati vaKohat, osheshi oshilonga shavo petwali liyapuki osha li okuhumbata komapepe avo oinima yalo.
Novakulunhu va eta eeshali davo dokuyapula oaltari mefiku tuu olo, sho osha vaekwa, novakulunhu va eta omayambo avo komesho yoaltari.
NOmwene okwa lombwela Moses: “ovakulunhu nava ete, keshe umwe mefiku laye, eyambo laye keyapulo loaltari.”
Ndele mefiku lotete Nashon yaAminadab wepata laJuda okwa eta eyambo laye.

Eyambo laye oleli: oshiyaxa oshisiliveli, ondjele yasho okilograma netata, neholo loshisiliveli, ondjele yasho eegrama omafele ahetatu, pandjele yosekeli yetwali liyapuki. Aishe ivali i yadi oufila wa nakwa wa pilulilwa omaadi eendjayambo.
Oshikwatelwa shoshingoldo shi yadi oitwiminifo, ondjele yasho eegrama efele nomulongo,
ongobe onyasha yomhedi, nodi imwe yomhedi, odjona imwe yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo,
oshikombo shimwe oshindume etimbayambo,
eengobe mbali deemhedi, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi noudjona vatano vomudo umwe epanduloyambo. Olo hano eyambo laNashon yaAminadab.
Netanel yaSuar, omukulunhu waIsaskar, okwa eta mefiku etivali:

Ye okwa eta eyambo laye oshiyaxa shoshisiliveli, ondjele yasho eesekeli efele nomilongo nhatu, neholo loshisiliveli, ondjele yalo eesekeli omilongo heyali pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Aishe ivali i yadi oufila wa nakwa wa pilulilwa omaadi eendjayambo.
Oshikwatelwa shimwe shoshingoldo shoitwiminifo, shi yadi oitwiminifo, ondjele yasho eesekeli omulongo,
ongobe onyasha yomhedi, odi yomhedi odjona yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo,
oshikombo shimwe shoshindume etimbayambo.
Ndele epanduloyambo: eengobe mbali deemhedi, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi oudjona vatano vomudo umwe. Olo hano eyambo laNetanel yaSuar.
Eliab yaHelon, omukulunhu wovana vaSebulon, okwa eta mefiku etitatu.

ongobe imwe yonyasha yomhedi, odi yomhedi, odjona imwe yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo,

Ndelenee epanduloyambo: eengobe mbali, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi, oudjona vatano vomudo umwe. Olo hano eyambo laEliab yaHelon.

Ndele epanduloyambo: eengobe mbali, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi, oudjona vatano vomudo umwe. Olo hano eyambo laGamaliel yaPedasur.
Abidan yaGideon, omukulunhu wovana vaBenjamin mefiku etimugoi.

Eyambo laye oleli: oshiyaxa shoshisiliveli, ondjele yasho eesekeli efele nomilongo nhatu. Neholo loshisiliveli, ondjele yalo eesekeli omilongo heyali pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Aishe ivali i yadi oufila wa nakwa wa pilulilwa omaadi eendjayambo.
Oshikwatelwa shoshingoldo shoitwiminifo, ondjele yasho eesekeli omulongo, shi yadi oitwiminifo,
ongobe onyasha yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi, odjona imwe yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo,
oshikombo shimwe shoshindume etimbayambo.
Ndele epanduloyambo: eengobe mbali, eedi nhano deemhedi oikombo itano yoipedi oudjona vatano vomudo umwe. Olo hano eyambo laAbidan yaGideon.
Ahieser yaAmmisaddai, omukulunhu wovana vaDan omefiku etimulongo.

Eyambo laye oleli: oshiyaxa shoshisiliveli, ondjele yasho eesekeli efele nomilongo nhatu. Neholo loshisiliveli, ondjele yalo eesekeli omilongo heyali pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Aishe ivali i yadi oufila wa nakwa wa pilulilwa omaadi eendjayambo.
Oshikwatelwa shoshingoldo shoitwiminifo, ondjele yasho eesekeli omulongo, shi yadi oitwiminifo,
ongobe onyasha yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi, odjona imwe yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo,
oshikombo shimwe oshindume etimbayambo.
Ndele epanduloyambo: eengobe mbali, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi, oudjona vatano vomudo umwe. Olo hano eyambo laAhieser yaAmmisaddai.
Pagiel yaOgran, omukulunhu wovana vaAsser mefiku etimulongo nalimwe.

Eyambo laye oleli: oshiyaxa shoshisiliveli, ondjele yasho eesekeli efele nomilongo nhatu. Neholo loshisiliveli, ondjele yalo eesekeli omilongo heyali pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Aishe ivali i yadi oufila wa nakwa wa pilulilwa omaadi eendjayambo.
Oshikwatelwa shoshingoldo shoitwiminifo, ondjele yasho eesekeli omulongo, shi yadi oitwiminifo,
ongobe onyasha yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi, odjona imwe yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo,
oshikombo shimwe shoshindume etimbayambo.
Ndele epanduloyambo: eengobe mbali, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi, oudjona vatano vomudo umwe. Olo hano eyambo laPagiel yaOgran.
Ahira yaEnan, omukulunhu wovana vaNaftali omefiku etimulongo netivali.

Eyambo laye oleli: oshiyaxa shoshisiliveli, ondjele yasho eesekeli efele nomilongo nhatu. Neholo loshisiliveli, ondjele yalo eesekeli omilongo heyali pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Aishe ivali i yadi oufila wa nakwa wa pilulilwa omaadi eendjayambo.
Oshikwatelwa shoshingoldo shi yadi oitwiminifo ondjele yasho eesekeli omulongo,
ongobe onyasha yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi, odjona imwe yomudo umwe exwikiloyambo
oshikombo shimwe shoshindume etimbayambo,
eengobe mbali deemhedi, eedi nhano deemhedi, oikombo itano yoipedi noudjona vatano vomudo umwe epanduloyambo. Olo hano eyambo laAhira yaEnan.

Odo hano eeshali dovakulunhu vOvaisraeli meyapulo loaltari mefiku tuu olo yo ya vaekwa: Oiyaxa omulongo naivali yoshisiliveli. Omaholo omulongo naavali oshisiliveli. Oikwatelwa omulongo naivali yoshingoldo yoitwiminifo.

Ondjele yoshiyaxa keshe eesekeli doshisiliveli efele nomilongo nhatu. Neholo keshe eesekeli omilongo heyali. Oisiliveli aishe yomoinima aishe oya li i fike pomayovi avali nomafele ane pasekeli yetwali liyapuki.

Oikwatelwa omulongo naivali yoingoldo yoitwiminifo i yadi oitwiminifo. Oshikwatelwa keshe eesekeli omulongo pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Oshingoldo ashishe shomoikwatelwa yoitwiminifo osha li shi fike peesekeli efele nomilongo mbali.

Eengobe adishe dokexwikiloyambo oda li eengobe deemhedi omulongo nambali. Eedi deemhedi omulongo nambali. Oudjona aveshe vomudo umwe omulongo navavali pamwe neendjayambo. Noikombo yoipedi omulongo naivali yetimbayambo.

Neengobe adishe depanduloyambo oda li eengobe deemhedi omilongo mbali nanhee. Eedi deemhedi omilongo hamano. Oikombo yoipedi omilongo hamano. Oudjona vomudo umwe omilongo hamano. Odo hano eeshali deyapulo loaltari, yo eshi ya vaekwa.

Ndele Moses eshi a ya metwali leongalo a popye nOmwene, ye a uda ondaka ei ya popya naye koshituviko shekwatakanifo eshi shi li kombada yoshikefa shehangano, pokati kovakerubi vavali. Osho ngaha hano Ye a popya naye.
8: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela Aron u tye kuye: Nye ngeenge tamu tenheke eelamba, eelamba heyali di nokuminikila ombinga yokomesho yoshikwatelwalamba.”
Ndele Aron osho a ninga: ye okwa tenheka eelamba kombinga yokomesho yoshikwatelwalamba, ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
Oshikwatelwalamba osha hambulwa ngaha: sho oshihambulwalonga shoshingoldo. Omhadi yasho yovene neenhemo dasho oda hambulwa; pafano Omwene e li ulikila Moses, osho ye a ninga oshikwatelwalamba.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Ovalevi vomokati kovana vaIsrael, va tongola mo u va fetife.
Opo u va fetife u nokuninga navo ngaha: va shamina omeva okufeta po omanyonauno. Vo ove nokulikululifa noshimbi olutu alishe nokukosha oikutu yavo nokulifeta voovene.
Opo nee tava ka kufa ongobe onyasha yomhedi neendjayambo dayo nokutya, oufila wa nakwa ndele wa pilulilwa omaadi. Ndee vo ve nokukufa ongobe imwe yomhedi etimbayambo.
Ndele ove u noku ehenifa Ovalevi popepi komesho yetwali leongalo nokushiva eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael.
Opo nee ove u nokweehenifa Ovalevi koshipala shOmwene novana vaIsrael ve nokutenheka omake avo kOvalevi.
Ndee Aron e nokudungadungifa Ovalevi koshipala shOmwene edungadungifwayambo ponhele yovana vaIsrael, opo venya va shiive okukala mo mokuyakula moilonga yOmwene.
NOvalevi ve nokutenheka omake avo komitwe deengobe deemhedi. Imwe u noku i yamba etimbayambo naikwao exwikiloyambo lOmwene, u kwatakanife Ovalevi.
Opo nee ove ho kaleke Ovalevi moipafi yaAron novana vaye ovamati ho va dungadungifile Omwene edungadungifwayambo.
Ndele Ovalevi u noku va tongola mo movana vaIsrael, opo Ovalevi va kale vange mwene.”
Opo nee Ovalevi ve nokuuya va yakule metwali leongalo. Osho ngaha hano u noku va fetifa noku va dungadungifa edungadungifwayambo.
Osheshi vo aveshe va yandjelwa nge va tongolwa mo movana vaIsrael ponhele yaaveshe ava hava yeulula oshidalelo shaina, ponhele yoiveli aishe yomovana vaIsrael, Ame onde ve likufila.
Shaashi oiveli aishe yovana vaIsrael noyoimuna oyange. Ame nde i liyapulila mefiku linya Ame nda dipaa oiveli yomoshilongo shaEgipiti.
Ndele Ovalevi Ame nde va kufa ponhele yoiveli aishe yovana vaIsrael,

nOvalevi nde va yandja, heeno, vo va yandjelwa Aron novana vaye ovamati mokati kovana vaIsrael, opo venya va wanife eyakulwalonga lovana vaIsrael metwali leongalo nokukwatakanifa ovana vaIsrael, paha holoke nande oshiponga mokati kovana vaIsrael, ovana vaIsrael eshi tave uya ketwali liyapuki.
Ndele Moses naAron neongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael va ningila Ovalevi naanaa Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses mokutonga Ovalevi. Osho hano ovana vaIsrael ve va ningila.
NOvalevi ove lifeta po omanyonauno avo ndele va kosha oikutu yavo, ndele Aron okwe va dungadungifila koshipala shOmwene edungadungifwayambo. Ndele Aron e va kwatakanifa, opo vo va yele.
Opo nee Ovalevi ve uya va ka longe eyakulwalonga lavo metwali leongalo moipafi yaAron novana vaye ovamati. Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses mokutonga Ovalevi, osho hano vo ve va ningila.
NOmwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti:
“Hano odedi tadi tongo Ovalevi: Ye eshi a wanifa omido omilongo mbali nanhano ile a koya po, e nokuuya a ka wanife oiwanifwalonga yaye meyakulwalonga lometwali leongalo.
Ndelenee ngeenge a wanifa omido omilongo nhano, e nokumangululwa mokulonga ndee ina longa vali.
Oye na yakulile vakwao metwali liyapuki moilonga yavo. Oilonga yoovene ke noku i longa. Hano osho ngaha u nokuyukifila Ovalevi oilonga yavo.”
9: Ndele momudo omutivali mohani yotete vo eshi va dja kuEgipiti, Omwene okwa popya naMoses mombuwa yaSinai ndee ta ti:
“Ovana vaIsrael ve nokudiinina Opaasa mefimbo la pangelwa.
Mefiku etimulongo netine mohani tuu oyo, onguloshi, mu noku i dana mefimbo la pangelwa. Nye mu noku i dana paenghedimhango dayo adishe nopalombwelo layo alishe.”
Opo nee Moses a lombwela ovana vaIsrael, vo ve nokudana Opaasa.
Ndele vo va dana Opaasa mombuwa yaSinai mefiku etimulongo netine lohani yotete, onguloshi. Naanaa Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses, osho ovana vaIsrael va ninga.
Ndele pa li ovalumenhu ve linyateka koshimhu shomunhu ndele vo inava dula mefiku tuu olo okudana Opaasa. Onghee hano vo va ehena kuMoses naAron mefiku tuu olo,
novalumenhu ve mu lombwela: “Fye twe linyateka koshimhu shomunhu. Omolwashike fye hatu kelelwa okweetela Omwene eyambo mefimbo la pangelwa mokati kovana vaIsrael?”
Ndele Moses okwe va lombwela: “Kaleni apa, nda hala okuuda eshi Omwene te mu lombwele.”
Opo nee Omwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye: Umwe womunye ile womomapata eni ngeenge te linyateke koshimhu ile ye e li moweenda kokule, ye e nokudana Opaasa kefimaneko lOmwene.
Mohani onhivali, mefiku etimulongo netine, onguloshi, ve noku i dana. Vo ve noku i lya nomingome dihe nonhafi noimbodi ilula.
Vo vaha xupifile sha shomuyo efiku lomongula ile vaha teye po ekipa lomuyo. Panghedimhango aishe yaPaasa ve noku i dana.

Ndelenee omulumenhu ou a yela ndele ke li moweenda ndee ta anye okudana Opaasa, na dimwe mo moshiwana shavo. Osheshi ye ina etela Omwene eyambo mefimbo la pangelwa. Omulumenhu ou ye e nokuhumbata etimba laye.
“Nomunailongo ou ha kala punye, ngeenge a hala okudana Opaasa yOmwene, ye e noku i dana panghedimhango yaPaasa nopalombwelo layo. Yo onghedimhango imwe aike kovanailongo novadalelwamo moshilongo.”
Ndelenee mefiku tuu olo etwali liyapuki la dikwa, oshilemo sha tuvika etwali liyapuki, ndele onguloshi kombada yetwali londobwedi pa li ngaashi evadimo lomundilo fiyo okongula.
Osho ngaha sha kala alushe: oshilemo she li tuvika, ndele oufiku oluudi lomundilo.
Ndele shamha oshilemo she litumbu ko kombada yetwali, ovana vaIsrael ohava fikama po. Ndele ponhele apa oshilemo sha kanghama, opo Ovaisraeli hava ongo onhanda yavo,
palombwelo lOmwene ovana vaIsrael va fikama po, nopalombwelo lOmwene va onga onhanda. Omafiku aeshe fimbo oshilemo sha kala kombada yetwali liyapuki, vo ova kala monhanda.
Ndele oshilemo ngeenge sha kala omafiku mahapu kombada yetwali liyapuki, ovana vaIsrael va diinina oilonga yOmwene, ndele inava fikama po.
Ndelenee pomafimbofimbo oshilemo sha kala kombada yetwali liyapuki omafiku avali aeke, ndelenee palombwelo lOmwene vo ova onga onhanda ndele palombwelo lOmwene ova fikama po.

Ndele pomafimbo amwe oshilemo osha kala po okudja konguloshi fiyo okonguloshi ikwao, ndele shamha oshilemo she litumbu po ongula, vo ohava fikama po. Ngee nee omutenya ile oufiku oshilemo she litumba po, ohava fikama po.

Ngeenge oshilemo osha kala kombada yetwali liyapuki omafiku avali ile ohani imwe ile efimbo lile li dule olo ovana vaIsrael va kala opo ihava tembuka po. Ashike ngeenge oshe litumbu po, ohava tembuka.
Palombwelo lOmwene ova onga onhanda, nopalombwelo lOmwene ohava tembuka. Vo ova wanifa omayukifo Omwene palombwelo lOmwene ngaashi Ye a lombwela Moses.
10: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Ningila omanghuma avali oshisiliveli. U noku a hambula, ndele oo to a longifa mokushiva eongalo lovanhu nokufikamifa eenhanda.
Oo ngeenge taa shikwa, eongalo alishe li nokwoongala pwoove koshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Ndelenee ngeenge limwe alike lomuo la shikwa, ovakulunhu nokutya, ovakulunhu vomapata aIsrael ve nokuuya kwoove.
Ndele ngeenge tamu shiki omanghuma onghuwo, eenhanda dokombinga yokoushilo di nokutembuka.
Ndele ngeenge tamu shiki omanghuma olutivali, eenhanda odo di li kombinga yokoumbuwanhu di nokutembuka. Vo ve nokushika omanghuma efimbo keshe tava tembuka.
Ndelenee eongalo lovanhu ngeenge li nokwoongala, nye mu nokushika omanghuma nondaka i lilile.
Novana ovamati vaAron, ovapristeli, ve nokushika omanghuma. Oyo nai kale onghedimhango yaalushe momapata eni.

“Ndele nye medu leni ngeenge tamu hangika koita ndee tamu i mu ka lwife ovatondadi ava ve mu tondokela, nye mu nokushika omanghuma okukuwa onghuwo, opo nee tamu dimbulukiwa koshipala shOmwene, Kalunga keni, ndee tamu ka xupifwa kovatondadi veni.

Momafiku eni ehafo ngaashi yo moivilo yeni nopehovelo leehani deni dipe, nye mu nokushika omanghuma pomaxwikiloyambo eni nopomapanduloyambo eni. Oo otae mu dimbulukifa koshipala shaKalunga keni. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.”
Momudo omutivali, mohani onhivali mefiku etimilongo mbali lohani, oshilemo osha yeluka po ketwali londobwedi.
Novana vaIsrael va tumba po, va enda konhele nonhele nokudja mo mombuwa yaSinai, ndele oshilemo osha kanghama mombuwa yaParan.
Hano osho ngaha vo ova tumba po tete palombwelo lOmwene ngaashi Ye e shi lombwela Moses.
Ndele tete engafifi lepandela lonhanda yovana vaJuda pamatanga avo. Mwene wengafifi olo okwa li Nashon yaAminadab.
Ndele Netanel yaSuar okwa li mwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaIsaskar.
Ndele Eliab yaHelon okwa li mwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaSebulon.
Opo nee etwali liyapuki ola dikulwa po. Novana vaGerson novana vaMerari ava va li ovahumbati vetwali liyapuki, ova fikama.
Opo nee engafifi lepandela lonhanda yaRuben la fikama pamatanga avo. Nomwene wengafifi lao okwa li Elisur yaSedeur.
Ndele mwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaSimeon okwa li Selumiel yaSurisaddai.
Ndele mwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaGad okwa li Eliasaf yaRehuel.
Opo nee Ovakohati, ava va li ovahumbati vetwali liyapuki, ova fikama. Ndele etwali liyapuki ola dikwa fimbo vakwao inava fika.
Opo nee engafifi lepandela lonhanda yovana vaEfraim la fikama pamatanga avo. Ndele mwene wao okwa li Elisama yaAmmihud.
Ndele mwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaManasse okwa li Gamaliel yaPedasur.
Ndele mwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaBenjamin okwa li Abidan yaGideon.
Opo nee engafifi lepandela lonhanda yovana vaDan pamatanga avo, oo axuuninwa okeenhanda adishe. Namwene wengafifi lao okwa li Ahieser yaAmmisaddai.
Namwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaAsser okwa li Pagiel yaOgran.
Namwene wengafifi lepata lovana vaNaftali okwa li Ahira yaEnan.
Hano oo omalufo ovana vaIsrael mokufikama kwao pamatanga avo. Ndele vo ova ya.

Ndele Moses okwa lombwela Hobab yaRehuel, Omumidian, haukwe waye ndee ta ti: “Fye ohatu i konhele Omwene e i tongele: ‘Ame ohandi ke i mu pa.’ Tu ende pamwe, ndee fye ohatu ku ningile ouwa. Osheshi Omwene okwa udanekela Israel oinima iwa.”
Ndelenee ye okwe mu lombwela: “Ame itandi ka enda pamwe. Ndelenee ame ohandi ka ya kedu letu nokeumbo letu.”
Opo nee Moses e mu lombwela: “Ino tu efa, osheshi ove wa shiiva apa hatu dulu okwoonga onhanda mombuwa, ndee ove ninga omukwateli komesho wetu.
Ndele ove ngeenge ho ende pamwe nafye, ohatu ku ningile ouwa tuu ou Omwene te ke tu ningila.”
Ndele vo ova enda omafiku atatu va dja komhunda yOmwene. Ndele oshikefa shehangano lOmwene oshe va kwatela komesho omafiku atatu oku va kongela onhele yetulumuko.
Noshilemo shOmwene osha kala kombada yavo, vo eshi va tembuka po ponhanda.
Ndele oshikefa eshi sha ya mondjila Moses okwa tya: “Omwene fikama! Ovatondadi voye opo va halakanifwe novanandubo naave opo va ye onhapo oshipala shoye.”
Ndele sho eshi sha fika konhanda, ye okwa tya; “Aluka ko Omwene, ila komangafifi omayovi nomayovi Ovaisraeli.”
11: Ndelenee ovanhu va ngongota, sho osha li shii momatwi Omwene. NOmwene eshi e shi uda, ehandu laye la xwama nomundilo wOmwene wa tema mokati kavo, ndele wo wa lungwinifa po eenhanda dokomunghulo.
Opo nee ovanhu va ifana Moses, ndele Moses okwa ilikana Omwene, opo nee omundilo wa hovela okudima.
Onghee hano onhele oyo ya ifanwa Tabera, osheshi omundilo wOmwene wa xwama mokati kavo.
Ndele ehalo la penduka mokati kovashakati venya ve litula kuvo. Opo nee ovana vaIsrael yo va hovela vali okulila, ndee tava ti: “Olyelye te tu pe ombelela okulya?
Fye hatu dimbulukwa eeshi twe di lile ngaho muEgipiti noihenda yomatanga, omanuwa, ombidi, eenyanga nomakunde.
Ndelenee paife eemwenyo detu oda loloka, osheshi apa kape na sha. Fye itatu mono sha shimwe, omanna aeke.”
Omanna a li ngaashi eembuto dakoriander, mokutala ongaashi eka labedellion.
Ovanhu va endaenda moku a toola, ndele ve a twila pokati komamanya ile moini ndele ve a teleka meembiya ndele va ninga nao oikuki ya yofwa. Oyo oya makelwa ngaashi oikuki yomaadi.
Ndele oufiku omume eshi ya wila monhanda nomanna yo a wila mo.
Opo nee Moses okwa uda ovanhu, epata keshe, tali lili, keshe umwe poshivelo shetwali laye. Opo nee Omwene okwa handuka unene. Nomomesho aMoses yo eshi osha li shii.
Ndele Moses okwa lombwela Omwene: “Omolwashike wa ningila omupiya woye owii nomolwashike inandi filwa onghenda moipafi yoye, Ove eshi wa twika nge oudjuu wovanhu ava?

Ame mbela nda dalifa ovanhu aveshe ava? Ile va dala, Ove eshi to ti kwaame: Va humbata mekolo loye, ngaashi omutekuli wokaana ta humbata okaana taka nyamu, ndi va twale kedu linya we li udanekela ooxe?
Openi handi ka kufa ombelela ndi pe ovanhu aveshe ava? Osheshi ohava fininike nge nokulila kwavo ndele hava ti: ‘Tu pa ombelela tu lye.’
Ame andike ihandi dulu okuhumbata oshiwana eshi, osheshi sho oshidjuu kwaame.
Ndele Ove ngeenge wa hala okuningila nge ngaha, shi dule Ove to dipaa nge, ngeenge nda mona onghenda momesho oye, opo ndi efwe ndiha tale omupya ou.”

Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Ifanene nge ovalumenhu omilongo heyali vomovakulunhu vaIsrael, ava u shii vo ve li ovakulunhu vovanhu novapashukili, ndele va eta ketwali leongalo, ndee va kaleka ko ofika pamwe naave.

Opo nee Ame ohandi ka kolokela ko nokupopya naave. Ndele omhepo ei i li kombada yoye, Ame ohandi ke i tukula noku i tula kombada yavo. Ndele vo otave ke ku kwafa nokuhumbata oudjuu woshiwana, opo oove auke iho pumbwa oku u humbata.

Ndele ove u nokulombwela ovanhu: ‘Ongula liyapuleni, opo nee tamu ka lya ombelela. Osheshi nye mwa lila momatwi Omwene, mwa tya: Olyelye te tu pe ombelela? Osheshi muEgipiti twa li tu li nawa. Onghee hano Omwene te ke mu pa ombelela, ndee tamu ka lya.
Ndee nye itamu ka lya efiku limwe alike ile omafiku avali ile omafiku atano ile omafiku omulongo ile omafiku omilongo mbali,
ndelenee ohani aishe fiyo tai di mo momayulu eni tamu i nyonyodola, shaashi mwa dina Omwene ou a kala mokati keni ndele mwa lila koshipala shaye ndee tamu ti: Omolwashike fye twa dja muEgipiti.’ ”
Opo nee Moses ta ti: “Ovalumenhu omayovi omafele ahamano, omuvalu wovalumenhu vokolupadi mokati kavo ame nda kala, ndele Ove wa tile: Ame ohandi ke va pa ombelela, ndee vo otava ka lya ohani aishe!
Eedi neengobe di noku va tomenwa, opo i kale ya wana kuvo? Ile eeshi domefuta ngeno di noku va ongelelwa, opo pa kale di va wanene?”
Ndelenee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses: “Eke lOmwene olixupi ngeno? Paife ove to ka mona ngeenge eendjovo dange tadi wanifwa kwoove ile ahowe.”
Opo nee Moses okwa pita pondje ndele a shiivifila ovanhu eendjovo dOmwene. Ndele ye okwa ifana ovakulunhu voshiwana nokwe va kaleka va dingilila etwali.

Opo nee Omwene okwa kolokela ko moshilemo ndee ta popi naye. Ndele Ye okwa tukula mo mOmhepo ei ya li kombada yaye ndele Ye e i tula kombada yovakulunhu omilongo heyali. Ndele fimbo omhepo ya kala kombada yavo, vo ova xunganeka. Ndelenee hakomesho vali.

Ndelenee ovalumenhu vavali va fyaala monhanda. Edina laumwe Eldad nedina lamukwao Medad. NOmhepo ye uya nokombada yavo, shaashi vo yo ova shangelwa mo vo nande inava ya ketwali. Ndele vo ova xunganeka monhanda.
Opo nee omunyasha umwe okwa tondoka nokwa hepaululila Moses ndee ta ti: Eldad naMedad otava xunganeke monhanda.
Ndele Josua, omona waNun, omupiya waMoses okounyasha waye, okwa nyamukula ndee ta ti: “Omwene wange Moses, shi va kelela!”
Ndelenee Moses okwe mu lombwela: “Ove u nefupandubo molwange? Akutu, ovanhu aveshe vOmwene ngeno ovaxunganeki, Omwene opo a yandje omhepo yaye kombada yavo!”
Opo nee Moses okwa shuna konhanda, nopamwe naye ovakulunhu vaIsrael.

Opo nee omhepo ya tumwa kOmwene, ya hovela okupepa ndele yo oya undaula oimote kombinga yokefuta ndele ye i fininika okuya monhanda ndele ya kala ya halakanifwa keembinga adishe ngeno okweenda ku fike pefiku limwe, fike pomaludimbo avali kombada yedu.
Opo nee ovanhu va fikama ndele va toola oimote efiku alishe noufiku nefiku lomongula. Ou a toola inini i dulike kwaaveshe, a toola eekilograma eyovi. Ndele vo ve i nyaneka monhanda aishe.
Ombelela fimbo va li ve i na momakanya avo, fimbo inave i taafina, ehandu lOmwene ola xwamena nokuli ovanhu, ndele Omwene okwa undwila mokati kovanhu oshiponga shinene shefyo.
Onghee hano va ifana onhele oyo Kibrot-Hattava, osheshi oko va paka ovanhu ava va li ve liyandja kouhalu.
Ovanhu ava ova fikama kuKibrot-Hattava, ndele va ya kuHaserot, ndele va kala muHaserot.
12: Ndele Mirjam naAron va twa eemhata naMoses omolwomwalikadi Omukushiti, ou a hombolwa kuye; osheshi ye okwa hombola omwalikadi Omukushiti.
Ndele vo ova tya: “Omwene okwa popya ngeno naMoses aeke? Ina popya mbela nafye yo?” Ndele Omwene okwe di uda.
Ndelenee Moses okwa li omulumenhu omulininipiki unene e dule ovanhu aveshe kombada yedu.
Opo nee divadiva Omwene okwa lombwela Moses naAron naMirjam: “Indeni ko, nye amushe vatatu, ketwali leongalo.” Ndele vo aveshe vatatu va ya ko.
Ndele Omwene okwa kolokela ko moluudi loshilemo nokwa kala ofika poshivelo shetwali leongalo. Opo nee ye a ifana Aron naMirjam, ndele vo vavali va ya ko.
Opo nee Ye ta ti: “Udeni eendjovo dange. Mokati keni ngeenge omu nomuxunganeki, Ame ohandi mu lihololele memoniko, nohandi popi naye mondjodi.
Ndelenee hasho shi nomupiya wange Moses. Ye omudiinini meumbo lange alishe.

Fye ohatu popi naye mokanya nokanya nomokutala, hameendjovo inadi yela. Ndele ye mokanya nokanya nomokutala, hameendjovo inadi yela. Ndele ye ota mono ondjelo yOmwene. Omolwashike inamu tila okutwa eemhata nomupiya wange Moses?”
Ndele ehandu lOmwene le va xwamena, ndele Ye a dja po.
Oshilemo eshi sha li she litumba sha dja petwali, tala, Mirjam okwa hangika koudu woshilundu, a toka ngaashi omongwa. Ndele Aron eshi e mu tala, okwe mu mona, ye omunashilundu.
Opo nee Aron okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Akutu, omwene wange, ino tu valulila etimba eli twe li ninga moulai wetu.
Ino mu efa, a kale ngaashi okahanana ka fya, taka di mo moshidalelo shaina, olutu lako la ola kombinga imwe.”
Ndele Moses okwa ifana pombada Omwene, ndee ta ti: “Akutu, Kalunga! Mu velula!”
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses: “Xe ngeenge e mu fiila omate momesho aye, ye ina kala ngeno ta fi ohoni omafiku aheyali? Ye na kale hano pondje yonhanda omafiku aheyali, opo nee ye na aluke mo.”
Ndele Mirjam okwa kala pondje yonhanda omafiku aheyali; novanhu inava fikama, Mirjam fimbo ina alukila mo.
Ndelenee komesho ovanhu va fikama po muHaserot, ndele va onga onhanda mombuwa yaParan.
13: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Tuma ko ovalumenhu va ka lave edu laKaanan, olo Ame handi ke li pa ovana vaIsrael. Tumeni ko omulumenhu umwe womepata keshe looxo, keshe umwe omukulunhu mokati kavo.”
Ndele Moses okwe va tuma ko va dja mombuwa yaParan palombwelo lOmwene. Ovalumenhu aveshe venya va li ovakulunhu vovana vaIsrael.
Nomadina avo oo aa: Mepata laRuben: Sammua yaSakkur.
Mepata laSimeon: Safat yaHori.
Mepata laJuda: Kaleb yaJefunne.
Mepata laIsaskar: Jegeal yaJosef.
Mepata laEfraim: Hosea yaNun.
Mepata laBenjamin: Palti yaRafu.
Mepata laSebulon: Gaddiel yaSodi.
Mepata laJosef: mepata laManasse: Gaddi yaSusi.
Mepata laDan: Ammiel yaGemali.
Mepata laAsser: Setur yaMikael.
Mepata laNaftali: Nahbi yaWofsi.
Mepata laGad: Gehuel yaMagi.
Oo hano omadina ovalumenhu ava va tumwa kuMoses va ka lave edu. Ndele Moses okwa lukulula Hosea yaNun, ye Josua.
Ndele Moses okwe va tumine okulava edu laKaanan, ndee ta ti kuvo: “Indeni ko kombinga yokoumbuwanhu moshilongo mu ka londe keemhunda.
Lengalengeni oshilongo nhumbi shi li novanhu ava ve li mo, vo ngeenge ovanini ile ovahapu.
Nedu loovene omo hava kala nhumbi li li, lo ngeenge oliwa ile olii. Noilando yavo muyo hava kala, i li ya tya ngahelipi, eenhanda ile oilando i neehote domamanya,
navali edu ngeenge oliwa ile olii, nongeenge oli nomiti ile kadi ko. Kaleni mu nonyati, ndele eteni oiimati yomoshilongo pamwe nanye. Efimbo olo la li lekolo leeviinyu dotete.”
Ndele vo ova ya ndele va lava edu okudja kombuwa yaSin fiyo okuRehob apa tapa iwa kuHamat.

Ndele vo ova ya moshilongo shokoumbangalanhu ndele va fika fiyo okuHebron. Ndele oko kwa li Ahiman, Sesai naTalmai, oludalo laAnak. Ndele Hebron osha tungwa omido heyali fimbo Soan muEgipiti sha li inashi tungwa.
Opo nee va fika fiyo omefilu laEskol, ndele oko va teta po eshila la li li neeviinyu, ndele ovanhu vavali va li ve noku li humbata komutengi, nosho yo va kufa oiimati yagranati neenghwiyu.
Ova luka efilu omo ovana vaIsrael va kufa eshila leeviinyu Eskol.
Ndele omafiku omilongo nhee eshi a pita, vo ova aluka ko kokulava edu.

Ndele ova enda ndele va fika kuMoses naAron nokeongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael mombuwa yaParan muKades. Ndele vo ova hepaululila eongalo alishe eenghundana, ndele vo ve va ulikila oiimati yoshilongo shinya.
Ndele vo ove mu hepaululila ndee tava ti: “Fye otwa fikile kedu linya, ove we tu tumine ko. Heeno, oshili otali tondoka omashini nomaadi eenyiki, noiimati yalo ei.
Ndelenee ovanhu venya ve li moshilongo shinya, ove neenghono, noilando yavo oya pamekwa neehotekuma noya kula. Ndele otwa ko mona yo oludalo laAnak.
Ovaamaleki hava kala moshilongo shokoumbuwanhu, ndelenee Ovaheti, Ovajebusi, nOvaamori hava kala keemhunda, Ovakaanan hava kala pEfuta Lopokati nolanghele lwokuJordan.”
Opo nee Kaleb a hetekela okungungumaneka oshiwana sha li shi nondubo naMoses, ndee ta ti: “Natu yeni ko tu li nangale; osheshi fye ohatu li dulu shili.”
Ndelenee ovalumenhu venya va ile ko pamwe naye tava ti: “Fye ihatu dulu oku li nangala, osheshi venya ve tu dule eenghono.”

Osho ngaha hano vo ova tandavelifa mokati kovana vaIsrael oinima ii yedu linya, vo va li ve li lava, eshi tava ti: “Edu twe li lavele olo edu tali li ovanhu valo. Novanhu aveshe twe va mona mo, ova li ovalumenhu vanene.
Fye otwa mona mo yo ovatongolume, oludalo laAnak, oludalo lovatongolume. Fye otwa li twe litala ngaashi oshipaxu momesho etu. Nosho yo twa li momesho avo.”
14: Opo nee eongalo alishe la hovela okupopyaana nokukema novanhu va lila oufiku aushe.
Novana aveshe Ovaisraeli va ngongotela Moses naAron, neongalo alishe le va lombwela: “Akutu, ngeno twa filile medu laEgipiti! Ile ngeno twa lilile mombuwa ei!
Omolwashike Omwene te tu twala kedu linya tu dipawe keongamukonda? Ovalikadi vetu novana vetu tava ka ninga oshihakanwa shovatondadi. Ngeno shi dule fye tu shune kuEgipiti.”
Ndele vo ova kundafana tava ti: “Tu lihoololeleni omukulunhu, ndele tu shuneni kuEgipiti.”
Opo nee Moses naAron va wila eombe moipafi yeongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael.
Ndele Josua yaNun naKaleb yaJefunne, vavali ava va ile okulava edu, ova pombaula oikutu yavo,
ndele va lombwela eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael, ndee tava ti: “Edu linya twe li lava nokweendaenda mulo, edu oliwa unene.
Omwene ngeenge e tu hokwa, Ye ote ke tu twala ko medu olo ndee te li tu pe, edu li yadi omashini nomaadi eenyiki.
Hano inamu twa ondubo nOmwene ndele inamu kala nokutila ovanhu vomoshilongo shinya, osheshi vo ohatu ke va pona po. Omupopili wavo e va efa, ndelenee Omwene e li pamwe nafye. Inamu va tila!”
Opo nee eongalo alishe la hala oku va dipaa nomamanya. Ndelenee oshinge shOmwene osha holoka metwali leongalo moipafi yovana aveshe vaIsrael.
Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Oshiwana eshi otashi ka dina nge fiyo onaini? Ndele fiyo onaini hava kala ihava itavele nge, Ame nande nda ninga omadidiliko aa aeshe mokati kavo?
Ame ohandi ke va tumina oudu wolutapo noku va dima po. Ndele Ame ohandi ku ningi oshiwana shinene noshi neenghono shi va dule.”
Opo nee Moses a lombwela Omwene ndee ta ti: “Ndelenee Ovaegipiti ova uda ko kutya, Ove, meenghono doye wa pitifa mo muvo oshiwana eshi,

ndele ve shi tongela oonakukalamo moshilongo eshi. Venya ova uda nokutya, Ove Omwene u li mokati koshiwana eshi, osheshi Ove Omwene we liholola moipafi yavo. Noshilemo shoye tashi kala kombada yavo, ndele Ove ho va kwatele komesho moluudi loshilemo momutenya nomoluudi lomundilo oufiku.
Ovanhu ava ngeenge to va kombo po ngaashi omunhu umwe, opo nee oiwana, eshi tai udu eenghundana tadi ku tongo, otai ka tya:
‘Omwene eshi a nyengwa okutwala ovanhu ava medu linya, Ye e li va udanekela nokwaana, Ye okwe va komba po mombuwa.’
“Eenghono doye, Omwene, nadi liholole hano ngaashi we di tile nokutya:
‘Omwene Ye omutalanheni, omunene mouwanghenda, ou ta dimi po oilonga ii nomatauluko, ndele ita efa ina handukila, Ye ou ta kongolola po omanyonauno ooxe fiyo oludalo olutitatu nolutine.’
Dima po omanyonauno ovanhu ava voye omolwounene wouwanghenda woye ngaashi Ove wa dima po shito omanyonauno ovanhu ava okudja muEgipiti fiyo opapa.”
Opo nee Omwene ta ti: “Ame ohandi dimi po omanyonauno omolwondjovo yoye.
Ndelenee oshili ngaashi Ame ndi nomwenyo nongaashi edu alishe tali ka kala li yadi oshinge shange,
ovalumenhu aveshe venya va mona oshinge shange nomadidiliko ange oo, nde a ninga muEgipiti nomombuwa, ndelenee paife vo va shinda nge efimbo alishe, ndele inava pwilikina ondaka yange,
venya itava ka mona edu linya nde li udanekela ooxe nokwaana, heeno, aveshe ava va handukifa nge, itave ke li mona.
Ndelenee omupiya wange Kaleb, osheshi muye omwa li omhepo imwe ndele ye a shikula nge nomwenyo aushe, ye ohandi ke mu twala medu linya, a ile mo noludalo laye tali ke li nangala.
Ndelenee Ovaamaleki nOvakaanan eshi hava kala momalufilulongo, nye pilukeni mongula mu shune kombuwa nondjila yEfuta Litilyana.”
Opo nee Omwene okwa popya naMoses naAron ndee ta ti:
“Oshiwana eshi shii shi nondubo tashi ngongotele nge fiyo onaini? Ame nda uda omangongoto ovana vaIsrael, vo eshi va kala nokungongotela nge,
va lombwela: ‘Oshili, ngaashi Ame ndi nomwenyo, Omwene ta ti, oshili ngaashi va popya momatwi ange, osho handi ke va ningila.
Oimhu yeni tai ka nangala mombuwa ei nokutya, aveshe ava va valwa, pamuvalo wavo, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali naava va koya po, ava va nongotela nge.
Oshili, nye itamu ka ya medu olo nde li mu udanekela nokwaana nye mu li nangale, Kaleb yaJefunne oye aeke naJosua yaNun.
Ndelenee ovana veni ava mwa tonga: otava ka ninga oihakanwa, ohandi ke va twala mo ndele tava ka shiiva oshilongo shinya, nye mwe shi dina.
Ndelenee oimhu yeni tai ka nangala mombuwa ei.

Novana veni tava ka elaela ngaashi ovafita voimuna mombuwa omido omilongo nhee, osho ngaha hava humbata oudjuu omolwokuhadulika kweni, omido omilongo nhee, osho ngaha hava humbata oudjuu omolwokuhadulika kweni, fiyo oimhu yeni ya olela mo mombuwa.

Pamuvalo womafiku enya mwa li okulava edu, omafiku omilongo nhee, efiku limwe tali yeleke omudo umwe, nye mu nokuhumbata okuhadulika kweni, omido omilongo nhee nokushiiva eshi oshike Ame ngeenge nde likufa po punye.
Ame, Omwene, onde shi popya. Oshili eshi ohandi ke shi ningila oiwana aishe ei ii, yo ya hovela okutwila nge ondubo. Vo otava ka xula po mombuwa ei nokufila mo muyo.’ ”
Novalumenhu ava va tuminwe kuMoses okulava edu ndele mokwaaluka kwavo va xwameka eongalo alishe oku mu ngongotela molwokutandavelifa eendjovo doipupulu da tongelwa edu linya,
ovalumenhu tuu ovo va tandavelifa eendjovo dii dedu linya, ova fila moshiponga koshipala shOmwene.
Ndelenee movalumenhu ava va lavele edu, omwa xupa ve nomwenyo Josua yaNun naKaleb yaJefunne.
Ndele Moses eshi a lombwela ovana vaIsrael eendjovo edi adishe, ovanhu va nyika oluhodi unene,
ndele ongula inene ove lilongekida va londe konhele yomhunda ndee tava ti: “Fye twe lilongekida okuya oko, Omwene e tu lombwela, osheshi fye otwa nyona.”
Ndele Moses e va lombwela: “Omolwashike tamu tauluka vali elombwelo lOmwene, osheshi nye itamu ka dula?
Inamu ya ko, osheshi Omwene ke mo mokati keni, inamu ya ko, otamu ka tewa kovatondadi veni.
Osheshi Ovaamaleki nOvakaanan oko ve li komesho yeni ndele nye otamu ka dipawa keongamukonda, shaashi mwe liteeka kOmwene. Onghee hano Omwene ita ka kala pamwe nanye.”
Ndelenee ohaluka va ya mondubo yavo va ka londa komhunda. Ndelenee oshikefa shehangano naMoses inava dja monhanda.
Opo nee Ovaamaleki nOvakaanan ava va kala keemhunda ove uya ndele ve va taataa ndele ve va halakanifa fiyo okuHorma.
15: Omwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo: Nye ngeenge tamu ke uya moshilongo, Ame handi shi mu pe mu kale mo,

ndele mwa hala okuyambela Omwene omundiloyambo, exwikiloyambo netomenoyambo mu wanife eudaneko ile ngaashi oshali yehalo liwa ile moivilo yeni mu yambele Omwene edimba liwa leengobe, leedi ile loikombo,
hano ou ta etele Omwene eyambo e nokweeta eendjayambo oufila wa nakwa wokilograma imwe, mwa pilulilwa omaadi olita.
Oikunwayambo u noku i yamba olita yomaviinyu akeshe odjona pamwe nexwikiloyambo ile netomenoyambo.
“Odi yomhedi ngeenge tai yambwa ngaashi eendjayambo u nokuyamba eekilograma mbali doufila wa nakwa pamwe nomaadi olita netata ya pilulilwa moufila.
Ndelenee ngaashi oikunwayambo, eta omaviinyu olita netata ngaashi edimba liwa kOmwene.
“Ndele ngeenge to yambe ongobe onyasha yomhedi exwikiloyambo ile etomenoyambo u wanife eudaneko we li udanekele ile epanduloyambo lOmwene,
napa etwe pamwe nongobe onyasha yomhedi eendjayambo oufila wa nakwa u fike peekilograma nhatu wa pilulilwa omaadi eelita mbali.
Ndele oikunwayambo eta omaviinyu eelita mbali, omundiloyambo wedimba liwa kOmwene.
Osho ngaha hano nashi ningwe pokuyambwa kwakeshe ongobe ile kwakeshe odi yomhedi ile kwakeshe odjona ile okakombwena.
Hano osho mu nokuninga nokuyeleka omuvalu woimuna tai ka yambwa, pamuvalo wayo.
Omudalelwamo keshe e nokulonga oinima ei panghedi tuu oyo imwe aike, a yambele Omwene omundiloyambo edimba liwa.
“Ndele omunailongo ngeenge ta kala punye ile keshe ou ta kala mokati komapata eni a hala okweetela Omwene omundiloyambo wedimba liwa, ye e nokuninga ngaashi nye hamu ningi.
Onghedimhango imwe aike yeongalo noyeni noyovanailongo ava hava kala mokati keni. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe momaludalo eni: ngaashi nye osho yo omunailongo e nokukala koshipala shOmwene.
Omhango imwe nonghedi yeyukifilo limwe kunye nokomunailongo ha kala punye.”
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo: Nye eshi tamu uya koshilongo oko Ame handi mu twala,
nye, eshi tamu li oilya yoshilongo shinya, mu nokweetela Omwene oshaliyambo.
Ngee tamu longekida eendja dipe, oshifima shotete otamu shi ningi komukalo ou hamu ningi nge tamu longekida oshipe poshipale.
Nye mu nokupa Omwene eyambo loufila woshipe momaludalo eni.”
“Ndelenee nye ngeenge tamu puka ndele itamu wanifa oipango aishe ei, Omwene e i shiivifila Moses,
aishe ei Omwene e mu lombwela moku i tula mokanya kaMoses, okudja kefiku tuu linya Omwene a yandja omalombwelo aye nofiyo okomaludalo eni,

opo nee, okunyona ngeenge kwa ningwa mepuko moungone, neongalo inali ku shiiva hano eongalo alishe nali yambe ongobe onyasha yomhedi exwikiloyambo, edimba liwa kOmwene, pamwe neendjayambo noikunwayambo pamapukululonghedi omayambo. Noshikombo oshindume etimbayambo.

Nomupristeli e nokukwatakanifa eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael, nokunyona kwavo taku dimwa po. Osheshi va nyona, ndele va yambela Omwene, eyambo lavo omundiloyambo netimbayambo molwepuko lavo ve li eta koshipala shOmwene.
Okwo taku diminwa po eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael nosho yo omunailongo, ou ha kala mokati kavo. Osheshi epuko otali talwa oloshiwana ashishe.
“Ndele omunhu umwe ta nyono mepuko, ye e nokweeta oshikombo shomudo umwe etimbayambo.
Nomupristeli e nokukwatakanifa ou a nyona omolwokunyona kwaye mepuko koshipala shOmwene opo e mu kwatakanife. Ndele okwo taku mu diminwa po.
Omhango tuu ei imwe oyeni ava mwa dalelwa mo mokati kOvaisraeli noyomunailongo ha kala punye, ngeenge a nyona mepuko.
Ndelenee omunhu ou ta nyono owina, ye ngeenge omudalelwa mo ile omunailongo, ota sheke Omwene, ye e nokudimwa mo moshiwana shavo.
Osheshi ye a dina ondjovo yOmwene nokwa teya oshipango shaye; omwenyo ou u nokudimwa mo shili. Oulunde waye u li kombada yaye.”
Ndele fimbo ovana vaIsrael va kala mombuwa, ova hanga omulumenhu umwe ta tyava oikuni mefiku lEshabata.
Opo nee ava ve mu hanga eshi ta tyava oikuni, ve mu twala moipafi yaMoses noyaAron noyeongalo alishe.
Ndele ove mu idilila modolongo, osheshi inaku popiwa kutya ota ka ningwa ngahelipi.
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses: “Omulumenhu ou e nokudipawa shili. Eongalo alishe li noku mu dipaa nomamanya pondje yonhanda.”
Opo nee eongalo alishe le mu twala pondje kombada yonhanda ndele le mu dipaa nomamanya ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo, momaludalo fiyo okomaludalo ve nokulitungila eenyemba tadi endjelela keembinga doikutu yavo nokumanga meenyemba domeembinga ongodi yomavala.
Hano eenyemba odo ngeenge tamu di mono, mu dimbulukwe oipango aishe yOmwene ndele mu i wanife, muha shikule ouhalu womitima deni nowomesho eni, oo tae mu hongaula mu ye moluhaelo.
Heeno, opo mu dimbulukwe oipango yange aishe noku i wanifa ndele mu kale nye ovayapuki vOmwene.
“Aame Omwene Kalunga keni, ou nde mu pitifa mo medu laEgipiti opo ndi kale Kalunga keni. Aame Omwene Kalunga keni.”
16: Ndelenee Kora yaIshar yaKohat yaLevi pamwe naDatan naAbiram ovana vaEliab naOn yaPelet, ovana vaRuben, ova kufa ovalumenhu,
ndele vo pamwe novalumenhu omafele avali nomilongo nhano vomovana vaIsrael, ovakulunhu voshiongalele shoshiwana, ovalumenhu ovanamadina ova fikama nokutwa ondubo naMoses.

Ndele ova ongalela Moses naAron ndee tava ti kuvo: “Sha wana nee paife! Osheshi eongalo alishe oliyapuki. NOmwene oha kala mokati kavo! Omolwashike hano nye tamu linenepekifile kombada yeongalo lOmwene?”
Moses eshi e di uda okwa wila eombe.

Ndele ye okwa lombwela Kora nongudu yaye aishe ndee ta ti: “Ongula inene Omwene ta ka holola olyelye waye nalyelye omuyapuki nalyelye te mu itavelele okweehena kuye. Ou Ye ta hoolola Oye te mu itavelele okweehena kuye.
Ningeni ngaha: Kufeni ko oikwatelwa yomakala nye Kora nongudu yoye aishe,
ndele tuleni mo omundilo mu tule kombada yao oitwiminifo koshipala shOmwene. Opo nee omulumenhu ou ta hoololwa kOmwene oye omuyapuki. Hano eshi nashi mu wanene, nye ovana vaLevi.”
Moses okwa lombwela vali Kora: “Pwilikineni tuu nye ovana vaLevi!

Inashi mu wanena, Kalunga kaIsrael eshi e mu tongola mo meongalo laIsrael, opo mu itavelelwe okweehena kuye mu wanife eyakulwalonga letwali liyapuki lOmwene nokukala ofika moipafi yeongalo, nye mu va yakule?
Nokwe mu itavelela okweehena kuye pamwe novamwaxo aveshe Ovalevi; nye eshi mwa hala paife oshilonga shoupristeli?
Onghee hano ove nongudu yoye aishe, nye ovanhu tamu ongalele Omwene oku mu twila ondubo. Osheshi Aron oye omushike, eshi tamu mu ngongotele?”
Ndele Moses okwa ifana Datan naAbiram, ovana vaEliab. Ndelenee vo va tya: “Ahowe, fye itatu uya ko.
Inashi wana hamba, ove eshi we tu kufa mo medu li yadi omashini nomaadi eenyiki, opo tu file mombuwa. Ove wa hala okukala omupangeli wetu!
Navali ino tu twala medu linya li yadi omashini nomaadi eenyiki, ndele ino tu pa omapya noikokola yomaviinyu efyuululo. Ove wa hala mbela okutwiyula mo omesho ovalumenhu ava? Ahowe, fye itatu uya ko.
“Opo nee Moses okwa handuka unene, ndele okwa lombwela Omwene: ‘Ino taalela eyambo lavo. Ame inandi va kufa nande ondongi imwe ndele inandi ningila nande umwe wavo owii.’
“Moses okwa lombwela vali Kora, ndee ta ti: ‘Nye nongudu yoye aishe, kaleni ongula inene koshipala shOmwene, nye navo naAron.

Keshe umwe womunye na kufe oikwatelwa yomakala ndele tuleni ko omundilo nokombada oitwiminifo, ndele eteni keshe umwe, oikwatelwa omafele avali nomilongo nhano yomakala koshipala shOmwene, nosho yo nye naAron, keshe umwe e noshikwatelwa shaye shomakala.’ ”
Opo nee vo, keshe umwe okwa kufa oshikwatelwa shaye shomakala nokwa tula mo omundilo nokombada yao a tula ko oitwiminifo. Ndele ova ka kala ofika poshivelo shetwali leongalo. Nosho yo Moses naAron.
Ndelenee Kora okwe va ongaleka eongalo alishe poshivelo shetwali leongalo. Opo nee oshinge shOmwene sha holokela eongalo alishe.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses naAron ndee ta ti:
“Litongoleni mo mongudu ei, opo handi ke i nyona po mepakumo leisho.”
Ndelenee vo ove litwa oipala yavo poshi ndee tava ti: “Akutu Kalunga, Kalunga keemhepo dombelela aishe! Omulumenhu umwe ngeenge ta nyono, Ove to handukile tuu eongalo alishe?”
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela eongalo alishe: Djeni mo, mu likufe po pomatwali aKora, Datan naAbiram!”
Opo nee Moses okwa penduka ndele okwa ya kuDatan naAbiram, novakulunhu vaIsrael ve mu shikulila ko.
Ndele okwa lombwela ongudu ndee ta ti: “Djeni po pomatwali ovalumenhu ava ovahenakalunga, ndele inamu kuma sha shavo, muha nyonwe po molwomatimba avo.”
Ndele vo ve likufa po pomatwali aKora, Datan naAbiram. Ndelenee Datan naAbiram va li va pita mo ndele va kala ofika poivelo yomatwali pamwe novalikadi vavo novana vavo ovamati nouhanana vavo.
Ndele Moses okwa popya ta ti: “Opo tuu opo nye mu shi shii nokutya, Omwene okwa tuma nge okuninga oilonga aishe ei, ndele inai ningwa kehalo lange mwene.
Ava ngeenge tava fi ngaashi ovanhu vamwe tava fi, ndee tava ningwa ngaashi ovanhu aveshe vamwe tava ningwa, opo nee Omwene ina tuma nge.

Ndelenee Omwene ngeenge ta ningi shimwe shi lili, nedu tali makula okanya kalo ndele tali va ponene mo pamwe naashishe ve shi kwete, ndee tava ningine moshovafi ve nomwenyo, opo nee tamu shiiva kutya ovalumenhu ava ova tuka Kalunga.”
Ye eshi a mana okupopya eendjovo edi, edu ola tenda omufya koshi yavo.
Edu ola makula okanya kalo ndele le va pona po nomatwali avo, ongudu aishe yaKora noinima yavo aishe.
Ndele ova ningina mo moshovafi ve nomwenyo. Nedu le va tuvika ndele ova kombwa mo meongalo.
NOvaisraeli aveshe ava va li ve va dingilila, ova ya onhapo, eshi va uda onghuwo yavo, osheshi va tila edu li va pone po yo.
Ndelenee omundilo wa dja kOmwene ndele wa lungwinifa po ovalumenhu venya Omafele avali nomilongo nhano ava va eta oitwiminifo.
