NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela Eliaser, omona womupristeli Aron, ye na ka toole mo oikwatelwa yoitwiminifo momhile, nomundilo ne u ekeleshi shaashi yo oiyapuki,

nokutya, oikwatelwa yaava va nyona ndele va kanifa eemwenyo davo. Oikwatelwa nai hambulwe oipeleki ya lalakana, ndee tai ka ninga oshituvikopeleki shoaltari. Osheshi va eta oikwatelwa koshipala shOmwene, onghee yo oiyapuki. Ndele yo nai ninge edidiliko kovana vaIsrael.”
Opo nee omupristeli Eliaser okwa kufa oikwatelwa yoshikushu, oyo ya etwa kovalumenhu venya va lungwinifwa komundilo ndele ve i hambula ya lalakana ya ninga oshituvikopeleki shoaltari,

shi dimbulukife ovana vaIsrael nokutya, paha kale nande omuyeni umwe ehe fi omupristeli womepata laAron, ou ta ehene okutwiminina koshipala shOmwene, opo aha ningwe ngaashi Kora nongudu yaye, ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwelele mokanya kaMoses.
Ndelenee efiku lomongula eongalo alishe laIsrael la ngongotela Moses naAron, ndee tali ti: “Nye mwa dipaa ovanhu vOmwene.”
Ndelenee fimbo ovanhu va ongalela Moses naAron, vo ova taalela ketwali leongalo, ndele opo tuu opo oshilemo she li tuvika ndele oshinge shOmwene osha holoka.
Moses naAron eshi va fika ketwali leongalo,
Omwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Djei po pongudu ei, opo handi i nyono po mepakumo leisho.” Opo nee vo ove litwa oipala yavo poshi.

Ndele Moses okwa lombwela Aron: “Kufa oshikwatelwa shomakala u teme ko omundilo woaltari, tula ko oitwiminifo, ndele endelela u shi twale keongalo u li kwatakanife, osheshi ehandu la dja kOmwene, oshiponga osha hovela nokuli.”
Ndele Aron osho a ninga ngaashi a lombwelwa kuMoses. Ndele ye a endelela a ya mokati keongalo, ndele tala, oshiponga osha hovela nokuli mokati keongalo. Opo nee ye a twimina nokukwatakanifa ovanhu.
Ndele ye fimbo ta kala ofika mokati kovanamwenyo naava va fya, oshiponga osha lotekwa.
Ndele ava va fila moshiponga eshi ova li ve fike povanhu omayovi omulongo naane nomafele aheyali, venya va fya omolwaKora inava valwa.
Opo nee Aron okwa shuna kuMoses poshivelo shetwali leongalo, ndele oshiponga osha lota.
17: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Popya novana vaIsrael ndele tambula kuvo, kepata keshe, onhaili imwe, kovakulunhu aveshe vomapata, eenhaili omulongo nambali. Monhaili keshe shangela mo edina lepata.
Nedina laAron li shangela monhaili yepata laLevi, shaashi ope nokukala onhaili imwe yomukulunhu wepata keshe.
Ndele di tula metwali leongalo komesho yoshikefa shondobwedi, oko Ame handi shakene nanye.
Nonhaili yomulumenhu ou Ame handi hoolola mo, otai ka tutuma. Ndele Ame ohandi ka mweneka engongoto lovana vaIsrael, tave mu ngongotele.”

Opo nee Moses okwa popya novana vaIsrael novakulunhu vavo aveshe ve mu pa eenhaili, keshe omukulunhu wepata onhaili imwe, hano pamapata eenhaili omulongo nambali. Nonhaili yaAron ya li yo mokati keenhaili davo.
Ndele Moses okwa twala eenhaili koshipala shOmwene metwali londobwedi.
Ndele mefiku lomongula Moses eshi a ya metwali londobwedi, tala, onhaili yaAron womepata laLevi, tai tutuma. Muyo mwa holoka eembulukutu neenhemo noiimati yaamandel ya pya.
Opo nee Moses okwa kufa eenhaili adishe da kala koshipala shOmwene nokwe di twala adishe pondje kovana vaIsrael. Ndele vo ove di mona, nakeshe umwe okwa kufa onhaili yaye.

Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Shunifa onhaili yaAron koshipala shondobwedi i diininwe ngaashi edidiliko laava hava ngongota, ndele mana po okungongota kwavo opo ndiha pumbwe vali oku ku uda, opo vaha fye.”
Ndele Moses osho a ninga, ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela.
Opo nee ovana vaIsrael va popya naMoses ndee tava ti: “Tala, fye ohatu fi, ohatu xulu po, fye atushe hatu xulu po.
Keshe umwe ota ehene, heeno, keshe umwe ta ehene ketwali liyapuki lOmwene ota ka fya. Hano fye otu nokufya, ngaashi tu li, fye atushe?”
18: NOmwene okwa lombwela Aron ndee ta ti: “Ove novana voye ovamati nepata laxo, nye otamu pulwa omanyonauno etwali liyapuki ndele nye novana voye ovamati otamu pulwa omanyonauno oupristeli.
Novakweni yo, epata laLevi, epata laxo yeni, nave uye kwaame pamwe naave, nave mu kalele po noku ku longela fimbo ove novana voye ovamati pamwe naave mu li petwali londobwedi.
Ndele nava longe oilonga yoye noilonga aishe yetwali. Ndelenee vo vaha ehene popepi noinima iyapuki ile oaltari, vaha fye, osho vo ngaashi nanye yo.
Vo nava kale pwoove ndele nava longe oilonga yetwali leongalo, oilonga aishe yetwali. Ndele omuyeni aha ehene kunye.
Ndele nye mu nokulonga oilonga yetwali liyapuki noilonga yoaltari, opo paha holoke vali ehandu kombada yovana vaIsrael.
Osheshi Ame mwene nda kufa mo ovakweni, Ovalevi movana vaIsrael ngaashi oshali yeni, vo ovanhu va yandjelwa omwene, a longe eyakulwalonga letwali leongalo.

Ndelenee ove novana voye ovamati pamwe naave mu nokulonga oshilonga shoupristeli weni moinima aishe yoaltari naashi shi li meni loshitukulifoyata, omo tamu longo oilonga yeni. Oshilonga sheni shoupristeli ohandi shi mu pe oshali. Nomuyeni ou ta ehene po e nokudipawa.”

Omwene okwa popya vali naAron ndee ta ti: “Ame mwene nde ku pa oshilonga sheeshaliyambo dange. Eeshali adishe diyapuki dovana vaIsrael Ame ohandi di ku pe oshitukulwa shoye noshovana voye ovamati, eshi onghedimhango yaalushe.

Meeshali diyapukielela odo itadi xwikwa po, otadi ningi doye: omayambo avo aeshe nokutya, eendjayambo keshe, etimbayambo keshe nokuvelombediyambo keshe lavo, aa tava etele nge, oo naa kale ngaashi mayapukielela kwoove nokovana voye ovamati.
U noku a lya monhele iyapukielela: ovalumenhu aveshe nave a lye. Naa kale mayapuki kunye.

“Ndele oshitukulwa shoye shomeeshaliyambo davo osheshi: aishe ei ovana vaIsrael hava yambe omadungadungifwayambo. Ame ohandi i ku pe novana voye ovamati noukadona pamwe naave i kale onghedimhango yaalushe. Meumbo keshe ou a yela ne i lye.
“Omaadi omaadielela nomaviinyu manyenye aeshe noilya hai yandjwa oshipe shayo tave i etele Omwene, Ame ohandi i ku pe.
Oshipe shakeshe eshi tashi mene moshilongo shavo, eshi tave shi etele Omwene, shi nokuninga shoye. Keshe umwe a yela meumbo loye ne shi lye.
“Oinima aishe yomuIsrael eshi sha yapulwa, oshoye.

“Keshe eshi tashi yeulula oshidalelo shaina, ombelela aishe tai etelwa Omwene, ovanhu ile oinamwenyo, otai ningi yoye. Ndelenee oiveli yovanhu ove u noku i kulila shili. Nosho yo u nokukulila oiveli yoinamwenyo inai koshoka.

Nokukulila kwasho otaku ningwa ngaha: ovakulilwa ove u noku va kulilifa, vo eshi va wanifa ohani imwe ile va koya po. Nondjele yekulilo lavo nai yelekwe eesekeli eendjele nhano pasekeli yetwali liyapuki. Osekeli imwe oyo eegera omilongo mbali.
Ndelenee ino kulilifa oiveli yongobe ile oiveli yodi ile oiveli yoshikombo. Oyo oiyapuki. Ohonde yayo u noku i tila koaltari nokuxwika po omakaadi ayo omundiloyambo wedimba liwa kOmwene.
Nombelela yayo tai ningi yoye, ngaashi ombadja yedungadungifwayambo noshilama shokolulyo nai ninge yoye.

“Eeshaliyambo adishe doinima iyapuki ei tai yandjelwa Omwene kovana vaIsrael, Ame ohandi i ku pe novana voye ovamati noukadona i kale onghedimhango yaalushe. Eshi hano ehangano lomongwa koshipala shOmwene pokati keni noludalo leni pamwe nanye.”
Omwene okwa lombwela yo Aron: “Ove ito ka kala u noshitukulwafyuululwa medu lavo, ndele ino kala u noshitukulwa edu mokati kavo: Aame mwene oshitukulwa shoye nefyuululo loye mokati kovana vaIsrael.”
Ndele tala, ovana vaLevi Ame ohandi va pe oitimulongo aishe muIsrael i kale oshitukulwafyuululwa omolweyakulwalonga vo tave li longo, eyakulwalonga letwali leongalo.
Novana vaIsrael vaha ehene vali popepi netwali leongalo vaha mone etimba ndele vaha fye.

Ndelenee Ovalevi ve nokulonga eyakulwalonga petwali leongalo, ndee vo ve nokuhumbata omanyonauno avo. Eshi nashi kale onghedimhango yaalushe momaludalo avo. Ndele mokati kovana vaIsrael vaha kale ve noshitukulwafyuululwa.
Osheshi oitimulongo yovana vaIsrael, tave i yandje kOmwene eeshaliyambo, oyo ohandi i pe Ovalevi i kale efyuululo. Onghee Ame ihandi va pe efyuululo mokati kovana vaIsrael.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:

“Lombwela Ovalevi u tye kuvo: Nye eshi tamu tambula oitimulongo kovana vaIsrael ngaashi Ame nde va lombwelele, ve i mu pe oshitukulwa sheni shefyuululo hano muyo nye mu nokuyandja kOmwene oshitimulongo shomoitimulongo.
Ndele otashi talwa osho oshaliyambo yeni ngaashi oilya yomoshipale nomaviinyu omoshikolelo.
Osho ngaha hano nanye yo yandjeni kOmwene oitimulongo yomwaaishe ei tamu i pewa kovana vaIsrael. Ndele oshaliyambo ei i peni omupristeli Aron.
Meeshali adishe deni mu nokuyandja kOmwene oshaliyambo ya wana. Heeno, mwaashishe eshi shiwelela mu nokuyandja oshali iyapuki.
“Ove u noku va lombwela: Nye eshi tamu yandje eshi shiwelela, sho otashi talwa, osho oshaliyambo yOvalevi, ngaashi oilya yomoshipale nomaviinyu omoshikolelo.
Ndele nye mu noku i lya monhele imwe aike, nye neumbo leni. Osheshi oyo ondjabi yeni molweyakulwalonga petwali leongalo.
Nye eshi tamu yandje ngaha oshitukulwa shiwelela shomuyo, nye itamu nyono ndele itamu nyateke eeshali diyapuki dovana vaIsrael, opo muha fye.”
19: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses naAron ndee ta ti:
“Onghedimhango oyo tuu ei Omwene e i tongele ta ti: Lombweleni ovana vaIsrael, nave ku etele ondema itilyana ihe noshipo ndee molutu kamu noipo, ndele inai kala natango koshi yondjoko.
Ndele nye mu noku i yandja komupristeli Eliaser, ndele venya ve noku i twala pondje yonhanda ndee tave i tomene koshipala shaye.
Nomupristeli Eliaser e nokukufa mohonde yayo nomunwe waye, ndele ye e nokushamina ohonde yayo luheyali langhele kombinga yokomesho yetwali leongalo.
Opo nee ve nokuxwika po ondema komesho yaye. Vo ve nokuxwika po ekungha layo, ombelela yayo nohonde yayo pamwe noshandja shayo.
Nomupristeli e nokukufa oshiti shomuti womusederi naisopi nongodi itilyana noku i ekela meni lomundilo omo ondema tai xwikwa mo.
Opo nee omupristeli ta kosho oikutu yaye nolutu laye momeva. Opo nee ye ta dulu okuuya monhanda. Nomupristeli ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Nosho winya a xwika po ondema, e nokukosha oikutu yaye momeva nokukosha olutu laye momeva. Ndele ye ota kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Nomulumenhu a yela na ongele omute wondema, ndee ne u twale konhele ya yela pondje kombada yonhanda. Nomute ou u nokutuvikililwa eongalo lovana vaIsrael omolwomafetifomeva: oo omalifetifomanyonauno.
Ndele ou ta ongele omute wondema e nokukosha oikutu ndee ta kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi. Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe kovana vaIsrael nokomunailongo ou ta kala mokati kavo.
“Ou ta kumu oshimhu shomunhu, keshe shimwe, ye e nokukala ina yela omafiku aheyali.
Ye e nokulifetifa nomeva tuu aa mefiku etitatu nomefiku etiheyali, opo nee ye ta ka kala a yela, ndele ngeenge ine liyeleka nomeva aa mefiku etitatu netiheyali, ye ota kala ina koshoka.

Keshe umwe ta kumu omufi nokutya, oshimhu shomunhu, ndele ite lifetifa, ye ota nyateke etwali lOmwene, ndele ye na dimwe mo muIsrael, osheshi ina shaminwa nomalifetifomeva. Ye ina yela, nonyata yaye tai ka kala muye.
“Umwe ngeenge ta file metwali, keshe umwe ou ta i mo metwali naaishe ei i li metwali otai kala inai yela momafiku aheyali.
Nosho yo oshiyuma keshe inashi tuvikwa, inashi yela.
Ndele keshe umwe ta kumu onakudipawa keongamukonda poluhaela ile oipongolo yanakufya ile ombila ye e nokukala ina yela momafiku aheyali.
“Ou ina yela, na kufilwe mo momute wetimbayambo la xwikwa po nokutila moshiyuma omeva mayela.
Nomulumenhu a yela e nokukufa isopi noku i yaveka momeva nokushamina etwali noinima aishe novanhu aveshe ava va kala po ile ou a kuma oipongolo yanakufya ile ou a dipawa ile omufi ile ombila.
Ndele ou a yela e nokushamina ou ina yela mefiku etitatu nomefiku etiheyali, ye e nokulifetifa. Opo nee ye ta kosho oikutu yaye ndee te likosho momeva ndee ta ka kala a yela onguloshi.

Ndelenee umwe ngeenge te linyateke, ndele ite lifetifa, opo nee omwenyo ou u nokudimwa mo meongalo, osheshi ye okwa nyateka etwali liyapuki lOmwene. Omalifetifomeva inae mu tililwa, onghee hano ye ina yela.
Oyo onghedimhango yaalushe kunye. Ndele ou ta shamine omashaminomeva, ye e nokukosha oikutu yaye. Ndele ou ta kumu omalifetifomeva, e nokukala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.
Heeno, ashishe eshi tashi kumwa kwaau ina yela, otashi kala sha nyata. Nomunhu ou te mu kumu, ota ka kala ina yela fiyo onguloshi.”
20: Ndele eongalo lovana vaIsrael, eshi la fika mombuwa yaSin, mohani yotete, ovanhu va onga onhanda muKades. Ndele Mirjam okwa fila ko, oko a pakwa.
Ndelenee eongalo la li lihe nomeva. Opo nee va ongalela Moses naAron.
Novanhu va twa eemhata naMoses, ndele vo va popya, tava ti: “Akutu, ngeno twa file pamwe navakwetu, vo eshi va fila koshipala shOmwene!
Nomolwashike nye mwa eta eongalo lOmwene mombuwa ei, opo fye noimuna yetu tu fye po?
Nomolwashike mwe tu kufa mo muEgipiti mu tu ete monhele ei ii? Kai fi onhele yoilya ile yeenghwiyu ile yoikokola yomiviinyu ile yomiti dagranate. Navali pehe nomeva okunwa.”
Opo nee Moses naAron va dja po peongalo, va ya koshivelo shetwali leongalo, ndele va wila eombe. Opo nee oshinge shOmwene she va holokela.
NOmwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti:

“Kufa onhaili, shiva eongalo, nye nomumwanyoko Aron, ndele lombweleni emanya moipafi yavo. Opo nee lo otali ka yandja omeva alo. Osho ngaha hano to va kungulukifile omeva, ndee to nwefa eongalo noimuna yavo.”
Opo nee Moses okwa kufa onhaili koshipala shOmwene ngaashi Ye e mu lombwela.
Ndele Moses naAron va ongaleka eongalo komesho yemanya, ndele ye okwe va lombwela: “Udeni hano ovanandubo nye! Otu noku mu kungulukifila omeva memanya eli?”
Opo nee Moses okwa yelula eke laye ndee ta denge emanya luvali nonhaili yaye. Ndele omeva mahapu a dja mo, opo eongalo ola nwa nosho yo oimuna yovanhu.
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses naAron, ndee ta ti: “Nye eshi inamu itavela nge opo mu yapule nge moipafi yovana vaIsrael, onghee hano nye itamu ka twala eongalo eli medu linya nde li mu pa.”
Oo hano omeva eemhata, omeva oMeriba, ovana vaIsrael oko va twifila Omwene eemhata, Oye nokwe ve lishiivifila omuyapuki.
Opo nee omo muKades Moses okwa tuma ko ovatumwa kohamba yaEdom: “Omumwanyoko Israel ta ti ngaha: Ove mwene wa shiiva omaudjuu aeshe e tu hanga.
Ootate yetu va tembukila muEgipiti ndele fye otwa kala omafiku mahapu muEgipiti. NOvaegipiti ve tu hepeka fye nootate.

Opo nee fye twa kuwila Omwene ekwafo, ndele Ye okwa uda ondaka yetu. Ye okwe tu tumina omweengeli waye ndele okwe tu pitifa mo muEgipiti. Fye otu li paife muKades, oshilando shopongaba yoshilongo shoye.

Tu itavelela tu taulule moshilongo shoye; fye itatu ka enda momapya ile moikokola yomiviinyu, ndele itatu ka nwa omeva meendungu. Fye ohatu ka enda melila linene lohamba. Itatu ka yapuka nande kolulyo ile kolumosho, fiyo twa taulula moshilongo shoye.”
Ndelenee Edom okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Ahowe, ito ka taulula moshilongo shange. Ndele ngeenge to shi hetekele, ame ohandi ke ku shakeneka neongamukonda.”

Opo nee ovana vaIsrael ve mu lombwela: “Fye ohatu ka enda melila linene, ndele ngeenge hatu nu omeva oye, ame noimuna yange, ohandi ke ku futa. Itavela ndi taulule handi ende kolupadi; kape na sha shimwe.”
Ndelenee ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Nye itamu ka taulula nande!” Ndele Edom okwa fikama nomatanga mahapu neenghono dinene a ka lwe naye.
Osho ngaha hano Edom okwa anya okwiitavelela Israel okutaulula moshilongo shaye Opo nee Israel okwa dja po puye.
Novana vaIsrael, eongalo alishe, va dja mo muKades, ndele ve uya komhunda yaHor.
NOmwene okwa lombwela Moses naAron pomhunda yaHor pongaba yoshilongo shaEdom, ndee ta ti:
“Aron na ongelwe mo, a ye kovakwanepata vaye, osheshi ye ite ke uya medu olo nde li pa ovana vaIsrael, shaashi nye mwa li mwa anya elombwelo lange pomeva aMeriba.
Kufa Aron nomona waye Eliaser, ndele va twala komhunda yaHor.
Ndele Aron mu dula oikutu yaye ndele i djaleka omona waye omumati Eliaser. Ndele oko Aron ta ka ongelwa kovakwanepata vaye, ndee ta fi.”
Opo nee Moses okwa ninga ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela: Vo ova londa komhunda yaHor moipafi yeongalo alishe.
Ndele Moses okwa dula Aron oikutu yaye, ndele e i djaleka omona waye Eliaser. Ndele Aron okwa fila ko koxulo yomhunda; ndelenee Moses naEliaser va londoloka komhunda.
Neongalo alishe eshi la mona nokutya Aron okwa fya, eumbo alishe laIsrael ola lila eefya daAron omafiku omilongo nhatu.
21: Ndelenee Omukaanan, ohamba yaArad, ei ya kala moshilongo shaumbuwanhu, eshi ya uda Israel te uya nondjila yokuAtarim, yo oye lidengifa Israel, ndele yo ya twala vamwe vomuvo eenghwate.
Opo nee Ovaisraeli, va udanekela Omwene ndee tava ti: “Ove ngeenge to yandje momake etu ovanhu ava aveshe, fye ohatu ka hanauna po oilando yavo.”
NOmwene okwa uda ondaka yOvaisraeli nokwa yandja Ovakaanan momake avo. Ndele vo noilando yavo ve i hanauna po, ndele va luka onhele oyo Horma.
Opo nee ova dja po pomhunda yaHor ndele va enda nondjila yEfuta Litilyana, opo va dingilile oshilongo shaEdom. Ndelenee ovanhu va nyengwa okulidiinika mondjila.

Novanhu ova popya nokupa Kalunga naMoses oushima, ndee tava ti: “Omolwashike ove we tu kufa muEgipiti, fye tu file mombuwa? Osheshi muyo muhe nomungome nomuhe na nande omeva, neemwenyo detu tadi nyonyodola eendja edi dii.”
Opo nee Omwene okwa tuma mokati kovanhu omayoka oudiyo, aa a lumata ovanhu. Novanhu vahapu vomOvaisraeli ova fya.
Novanhu ove uya kuMoses ndee tava ti: “Fye otwa nyona eshi twa popya nokupa Kalunga naave oushima. Tu indilila kOmwene, Ye a kufe po pufye omayoka.” Ndele Moses okwa ilikanena ovanhu.
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses, ndee ta ti: Liningila eyoka u li endjelelife koshiti. Opo nee keshe umwe ou a lika ndee te li tale, ota ka kala nomwenyo.
Opo nee Moses okwa ninga eyoka loshikushu, ndele e li tula koshiti. Ndele ou a lika keyoka ngeenge a tala eyoka loshikushu, okwa kala nomwenyo.
Novana vaIsrael va dja po, ndele va onga onhanda muObot.
Opo nee va dja po puObot, ndele va onga onhanda muIiye-Abarim mombuwa i li langhele lwokoushilo waMoab.
Va dja po opo ndele va onga onhanda mefilu laSered.
Va dja po opo ndele va onga onhanda kombada yomulonga Arnon, ou u li mombuwa ndele tau di moshilongo shOvaamori. Osheshi Arnon ongaba yaMoab pokati kaMoab nOvaamori.

Onghee tamu tiwa membo loita yOmwene:
“Vaheb muSufa, nomafilu aArnon,

Nomakuma aa omefilu,
a ya fiyo okonhele yaAr,
a shaamafana neengaba daMoab.”
Ndele ova dja po ndele va ya kuBeer. Oo omufima Omwene e u lombwela Moses ta ti: “Ovanhu nava ehene kumwe, ndele Ame ohandi va pe omeva.”

Opo Ovaisraeli va imba eimbilo eli:
“Fuluka omufima! Nau imbilwe eimbilo!

Omufima wa xupwa keehamba,
novakomesho vomoshiwana ve u pandifa
omapangelodibo avo, neenhaili davo!”
Ndele mokudja mombuwa vo ve uya kuMattana.
Nokudja kuMattana va ya kuNahaliel. Nokudja kuNahaliel va ya kuBamot.
Ndele okudja kuBamot va ya kefilu li li medu laMoab pomhunda yaPisga ya taalela omuulu.
Ovaisraeli va tuma ovatumwa kuSihon, ohamba yOvaamori, ndee tava ti:

“Itavelele nge ndi taulule moshilongo shoye fye itatu ka endela nande momapya ile moikokola yomiviinyu. Fye itatu ka nwa omeva omomifima. Fye hatu ka diinina nokweenda melila linene lohamba fiyo twa taulula oshilongo shoye.”

Ndele Sihon ina itavelela Ovaisraeli okutaulula moshilongo shaye. Ndelenee Sihon ina itavelela Ovaisraeli okutaulula moshilongo shaye. Ndele Sihon okwa shiva omatanga aye aeshe ovakwaita nokwa ya kombuwa a ka lwife Ovaisraeli. Ndele ye eshi a fika kuJahas ye e lidenga nOvaisraeli.
Ndelenee Ovaisraeli ve mu taataa neongamukonda, noshilongo shaye sha nangalwa okudja kuArnon fiyo okuJabbok, fiyo okOvaammoni, osheshi ongaba yOvaamori ya li ya pamekwa neehote.
Osho ngaha hano Ovaisraeli va nangala oilando ei aishe, nOvaisraeli va kala moilando aishe yOvaamori muHesbon nomomikunda dasho adishe.
Osheshi Hesbon sha li oshilando shaSihon, ohamba yOvaamori. Ye okwa li e lidengifa ohamba yonale yOvamoab, nokwa kufa meke laye oshilongo shaye ashishe fiyo okuArnon.

Onghee hano ovatoti voitevo otava ti:
“Ileni kuHesbon!
Oshilando shaSihon nashi tungwe,
nashi pamekwe nohotekuma!

Osheshi omundilo wa dja muHesbon,
elaka lomundilo mohotengulu yaSihon.
Oo wa lungwinifa po Ar shOvamoab,
oonakukalamo moikulundudu yomuArnon.

Woo ove, Moab!
Onye mwa xula po, ovanhu vomuKemosh!
Ovana vasho ovamati she va yandja ovainhapo
novana vasho oukadona she va efa
va ninge eenghwate daSihon, ohamba yOvaamori.

Fye twe va umba fiyo okuDibon, Hesbon sha wa po,
ndele fye twa tokifa fiyo okuNofag nomundilo fiyo okuMedeba.”
Osho ngaha hano Ovaisraeli va nangala oshilongo shOvaamori.
Ndele Moses okwa tuma ko eendadi va ka lave Jaeser, ndele ove va ta ndele va nangala omikunda dasho; ndele ye okwa taataa mo meenhele davo Ovaamori venya va kala ko.
Opo nee Ovaisraeli va aluka ko ndele va ya nondjila yokuBasan. Ndele Og, ohamba yaBasan, oyo pamwe nomatanga ayo aeshe ovakwaita ova ya oku va shakeneka kuEdrei ve ke va lwife.

Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Ino mu tila, osheshi ame nde mu yandja meke loye pamwe novanhu vaye aveshe noshilongo shaye ashishe. Ndele u noku mu ninga ngaashi wa ningile Sihon, ohamba yOvaamori, ei ya kala muHesbon.”
Ndele vo ove mu ta, ye mwene novana vaye ovamati novanhu vaye aveshe fiyo inapa xupa nande umwe. Ndele va nangala oshilongo shaye.
22: Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael va dja po opo, ndele va ka onga onhanda pomaluhaela aMoab, koushilo waJordan, va shaama naJeriko.
Balak yaSippor, eshi a mona ashishe eshi Ovaisraeli va ningila Ovaamori,
Ovamoab ova tila unene ovanhu ava, osheshi va ninga vahapu. NOvamoab va kwatwa koumbada omolwovana vaIsrael.

Opo nee Moab okwa lombwela ovakulunhu vaMidian: “Paife eemhunga edi tadi ka lya ashishe eshi tashi di dingilile, ngaashi ongobe tai kunya omwiidi womoixwa.” Ndele Balak yaSippor okwa li ohamba yaMoab pefimbo olo.

Onghee hano ye okwa tuma ovatumwa kuBileam yaBeor muPetor sha kala puEufrat moshilongo shOmavite, oku mu ifana ndee ta ti: “Tala, ovanhu va dja muEgipiti. Tala ova pwipwikila oshilongo ashishe, ndele ve li meenhanda da yukilila nge.

Ila hano paife u lyangulile nge ovanhu ava, osheshi vo ove dule nge. Kashiimba handi dulu oku va denga noku va taataa mo moshilongo. Osheshi ondi shii ou ta nangekwa noupuna kwoove, ye ota nangekwa noupuna, ndee ou ta lyangulwa kwoove, ota kala a lyangulwa.”
Opo nee ovakulunhu vaMoab novakulunhu vaMidian ova ya ve nondjabi yomumonikokule, ndele ve uya kuBileam ndele ve mu hepaululila eendjovo daBalak.
Opo ye e va nyamukula ta ti: “Opo nee ame ohandi ke mu shiivifila ngaashi Omwene ta ka lombwela nge.” Opo nee ovakulunhu vaMoab va fyaala puBileam.
Ndele Kalunga e uya kuBileam ndee ta ti: “Ovalumenhu oolyelye ava ve li pwoove?”
Ndele Bileam okwa nyamukula: “Balak yaSippor, ohamba yaMoab, ya tumina nge ondaka:
Tala, ovanhu va dja kuEgipiti, ndele vo ova pwipwikila oshilongo. Ila hano paife u va lyangulile nge. Kashiimba ame ohandi dulu oku va denga noku va taataa mo.”
Opo nee Kalunga okwa lombwela Bileam: “Ino ya ko pamwe navo. Ino lyangula ovanhu venya, osheshi vo ovanangekwa noupuna.”
Opo nee Bileam okwa penduka ongula ndele ye ta ti kovakulunhu vaBalak: “Shuneni ko koshilongo sheni, osheshi Omwene okwa anyena nge okuya pamwe nanye.”
Ndele ovakulunhu vaMoab ova fikama ndele ve uya kuBalak, ndee tava ti: Bileam okwa anya okuya nafye.
Opo nee Balak okwa tuma ko vali ovakulunhu vahapu, ve dule venya, ndele va li va fimanekwa komesho yaavenya.
Ndele vo ove uya kuBileam, ndee tave mu lombwele: “Balak yaSippor osho ta ti: Ino anya okuya kwaame.”
Osheshi ame ohandi ke ku fimaneka unene, naashishe to lombwele nge, ame ohandi ke shi ninga. Onghee hano ila, lyangulile nge ovanhu ava.

Opo nee Bileam okwa nyamukula ndee ta ti kovapiya vaBalak: “Balak nande a pe nge oshisiliveli noshingoldo shi yadi eumbo laye, ame ihandi dulu okutauluka elombwelo lOmwene Kalunga kange nande moshinima shinini ile shinene.
Ndelenee kaleni ngeno natango oufiku wonena apa, opo ndi shiive eshi Omwene ta ka lombwela nge vali.”
Ndele Kalunga e uya kuBileam oufiku ndee ta ti kuye: “Ovalumenhu eshi ve uya oku ku ifana, fikama hano, inda navo. Ndelenee u nokuninga ashike eshi Ame handi ku lombwele.”
Opo nee Bileam a meneka ongula nokwa tula ondongi yonghadi omutumba, ndele ye okwa ya pamwe novakulunhu vaMoab.
Ndelenee ehandu laKalunga la xwama, ye eshi a ya. Ndele omweengeli wOmwene okwa kala ofika mondjila oku mu kelela, eshi a londa ondongi yaye novapiya vaye vavali ve mu findikila.

Nondongi oya mona omweengeli wOmwene ta kala ofika mondjila e neongamukonda la pweywa mo meke laye. Onghee hano ondongi ya yapuka mondjila ndele ya ya mepya. Ndelenee Bileam okwa denga ondongi e i shunife mondjila.
Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene okwa ya ponhele yondjila ya finana pokati koikokola yomiviinyu pokati komakuma.
Ndele ondongi eshi ya mona omweengeli wOmwene, yo oye lifininika kekuma noya fenghenyena omhadi yaBileam kekuma. Onghee hano ye okwe i denga vali.
Ndele omweengeli wOmwene okwa ehena vali komesho, ndele a kala ofika ponhele ya finana, apa kapa li vali okuyapukila kolulyo ile kolumosho.
Ondongi eshi ya mona omweengeli, yo oya nangala fimbo Bileam e li kuyo. Onghee hano Bileam okwa handuka unene nokwa denga ondongi noshiti.
Ndelenee Omwene okwa makulifa okanya kondongi ndee tai ti kuBileam: “Ame nde ku ninga shike eshi wa denga nge lutatu nokuli?”
Opo nee Bileam okwa nyamukula ta ti kondongi: “Shaashi ove wa lundukila nge. Ngeno ndi kale ndi neongamukonda meke lange, ngeno onde ku dipaa.”
Ndele ondongi tai ti kuBileam: “Haame ondongi yoye, ho londo nge shito mokukala kwoye fiyo onena? Wa mona nge ndi neenghedi da tya ngaha kwoove?” Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Aaye.”
Opo nee Omwene okwa pashukifa omesho aBileam, opo a dule okumona omweengeli wOmwene e li ofika mondjila e neongamukonda la pweywa mo meke laye. Ndele ye okwe linyongamena nokwa wila eombe.
Nomweengeli wOmwene okwa pula kuye: “Omolwashike wa denga nokuli lutatu ondongi yoye? Tala, Ame mwene nda fikama nde uya oku ku kelela, osheshi ondjila ei yoye oi noiponga momesho ange.
Ndelenee ondongi ya mona nge ndele ya kanduka ko komesho yange lutatu. Oyo ngeno inai kanduka ko komesho yange, ngeno nde ku dipaa, ndelenee ondongi handi i efa i nomwenyo.”

Opo nee Bileam okwa nyamukula omweengeli ndee ta ti: “Ame nda nyona, osheshi inandi shiiva nokutya, ove ou li mondjila to kelele nge.” Ndelenee ondjila ei, ngeenge inai wapala momesho oye, ame ohandi shuna.
Nomweengeli wOmwene okwa lombwela Bileam: “Inda pamwe novalumenhu, ndelenee ondjovo ei aike, Ame handi ku lombwele, u noku i popya.” Opo nee hano Bileam okwa ya novakulunhu vaBalak.
Balak eshi a uda nokutya, Bileam te uya, ye okwa fikama e ke mu shakeneke muIr-Moab, osho shi li pongaba yaArnon, koxulo yoshilongo.
Ndele Balak ta ti kuBileam: “Inandi tumununa ko kwoove ovanhu, nde ku ifana? Omolwashike ino uya kwaame? Ame ohandi nyengwa mbela oku ku fimanekifa?”
Ndele Bileam okwa nyamukula Balak, ndee ta ti: “Heeno, ame nde uya kwoove paife. Ndelenee ame ndi nepangelo mbela okupopya sha? Ondjovo ei aike Kalunga te i tula mokanya kange ohandi ke i popya.”
Opo nee Bileam okwa ya pamwe naBalak, ndele ova fika kuKiriat-Husot.
Ndele Balak okwa yamba eengobe needi nokwa tumina Bileam novakulunhu ava va kala puye dimwe domudo.
Ndele ongula Balak okwa kufa Bileam nokwe mu twala koshikulundu shaBaal, oko ye a shiive okumona okambinga kamwe koshiwana.
23: Opo nee Bileam okwa lombwela Balak: “Tungile nge eealtari heyali u longekidile nge eengobe heyali deemhedi needi deemhedi.”
Ndele Balak a ninga ngaashi Bileam a hala. Ndele Balak naBileam va yamba ongobe imwe nodi imwe koaltari keshe.

Opo nee Bileam a lombwela Balak: “Kala ofika pexwikiloyambo loye, ame handi i kwinya. Kashiimba Omwene ta shakeneke nge, ndele keshe eshi Ye ta ulikile nge, ame ohandi ke shi ku shiivifila.” Ndele ye okwa ya koshikulundu shihe noixwa.
Ndele Kalunga e uya nokwa shakena naBileam, ndele Bileam okwe mu lombwela: “Eealtari heyali nde di tungifa nongobe imwe yomhedi nodi imwe yomhedi onde i yamba koaltari keshe.”
Opo nee Kalunga okwa tula ondjovo mokanya kaBileam ndee ta ti: Shuna kuBalak, ndele osho ngaha u noku mu lombwela:
Ndele ye okwa shuna ko kuye fimbo ye a li ofika pexwikiloyambo laye, ye mwene novakulunhu aveshe vaMoab.

Bileam okwa tumbula etumbulo laye, nde ta ti:
“Balak okwe ilile nge muAram,
Ohamba yaMoab okeemhunda dokoushilo:
‘Ila u lile nge Jakob
Ila u lyangulile nge Israel.’

Ame ohandi shi fingi ngahelipi, Kalunga ite shi fingi?
Ndele ame ohandi shi lyangula ngahelipi,
Omwene ite shi lyangula?

Osheshi apa okonhele yomamanya ohandi shi tale
nokeemhunda handi shi mono.
Tala, oshiwana tashi likalele,
itashi valwa moiwana yovapaani.

Olyelye a vala ouwe veheke laJakob?
Nolyelye oshitukulwa oshitine shomuIsrael?
Ame nandi fye ngaashi ovayuki hava fi
nexulilo lange nali ninge ngaashi lavo.”
Balak okwa lombwela Bileam: “Ove owa ninga nge ngahelipi? Ame nde ku ifana u lyangule ovatondadi vange, ndelenee tala, ove we va nangeka noupuna!”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ndee ta ti: “Ame ndiha popye ngeno ngaashi Omwene ta tula mokanya kange?”
Opo nee Balak ta ti kuye: “Ila tu yeni pamwe monhele imwe, oko to dulu okumona ombinga imwe yasho, ndelenee ito dulu oku shi mona ashishe, ove u shi lyangulile nge.”
Ndele ye okwe mu twala kenyana laSofim, konhele yaPisga, ndele va tunga eealtari heyali ndele va yamba ongobe imwe yomhedi nodi imwe yomhedi koaltari keshe.
Opo nee Bileam ta ti kuBalak: “Kala ofika apa pexwikiloyambo loye, ndele ame ohandi ke mu shakeneka kwinya.”
NOmwene okwa shakeneka Bileam ndele okwa tula ondjovo mokanya kaye, ndee ta ti: Shuna ko kuBalak u tye ngaha;
Ndele ye okwa ya kuye, ye fimbo ta kala ofika pexwikiloyambo laye novakulunhu vaMoab va kala puye. Ndele Balak ta ti kuye: Omwene okwa popya shike?

Opo nee Bileam okwa tumbula etumbulo ndee ta ti:
“Fikama Balak u ude!
Pwilikine nge, omona waSippor!

Kalunga ke fi pomunhu a fufye ngeno.
Ile omona womunhu ye e lialuluke.
Ye a tonga sha ngeno, ndelenee ite shi ningi mbela?
Ile ta popi sha, ite shi wanifa hamba?

Tala, ame nda lombwelwa ndi va nangeke noupuna.
Ndele Ye eshi a nangeka noupuna,
ame ihandi dulu oku shi lundulula.

MuJakob inamu monika owii
ndele muIsrael inamu uya oshiponga.
Omwene Kalunga kaye e li pamwe naye,
nefimaneko lohamba otali udika puvo.

Kalunga ou e va pitifa mo muEgipiti;
Oye e li ngaashi eembinga domhuulu kuvo.

Osheshi oupule itau kwafa okupongeka Jakob,
nokulowa itaku dulu sha kuIsrael.
Paife eshi tapa ka shiivifwa
‘Tala eshi Kalunga e va ningila.’

Tala, oshiwana tashi fikama po ngaashi onghoshi yonghadi,
tashi yeluka po ngaashi onghoshi.
Itashi ka nangala fimbo inashi lya po oshihakanwa
nofimbo inashi nwa ohonde yaai ya dipawa.”
Opo nee Balak ta ti kuBileam: “Ove ino shi lyangula ndele ino shi nangeka noupuna.”
Ndelenee Bileam okwa nyamukula ndee ta ti kuBalak: “Inandi ku lombwela nokutya: Ashishe eshi Omwene ta popi, ame ondi noku shi ninga?”
Balak ta ti vali kuBileam: “Ila nee, ame ohandi ku twala monhele imwe. Kashiimba sha yuka momesho aKalunga, ove u va lyangulile nge kwinya.”
Opo nee Balak okwa kufa Bileam pamwe naye koxulo yomhunda yaPeor ei ya tumba mombuwa.
Ndele Bileam ta ti kuBalak: “Tungile nge eealtari heyali u longekidile nge apa eengobe deemhedi needi heyali deemhedi.”
Ndele Balak osho a ninga Bileam ngaashi a hala, ndele okwa yamba ongobe imwe yomhedi nodi imwe yomhedi koaltari keshe.
24: Bileam eshi a mona nokutya, okunangeka noupuna Israel taku wapala momesho Omwene, ye ina ama vali ngaashi shito koupule, ndelenee oshipala shaye e shi taalelifa kombuwa.
Ndele Bileam eshi a mona Ovaisraeli meenhanda pamapata avo, Omhepo yaKalunga ye uya kombada yaye.

Ndele ye okwa tumbula etumbulo laye ndee ta ti:
“Bileam yaBeor osho ngaha ta popi,
heeno, osho omulumenhu omesho aye a pashukifwa, ta popi.

Akutu Jakob, omatwali oye a wapala ngahelipi!
Eenhele dokukala kwoye, akutu Israel!

Ngaashi omafilulonga taa tandavele kokule,
nongaashi oikunino pomulonga,
nongaashi omiti daaloe da twikwa kOmwene,
heeno, ngaashi omisederi pomeva.

Omeva taa xunga momahemele avo,
neembuto davo tadi kala pomeva mahapu.
Nohamba yavo nai kale i dule Agag,
nouhamba wavo tau litumbu kombada.

Kalunga ou e mu pitifa mo muEgipiti,
a ninga kuvo ngaashi eembinga domhuulu.
Vo otava ka mana po oiwana, ovatondadi vavo
nokutetaula omakipa avo
noku va tyuula noikuti yavo.

Vo otava hondjaunine ngaashi onghoshi,
heeno, ngaashi onghoshi onghadi.
Olyelye ta dulu oku i shinda?
Ou te ku nangeke noupuna, na kale a nangekwa noupuna.
Naava tave ku tula omutima, nava kale va tulwa omutima!”

Opo nee Balak okwa handukila unene Bileam nokwa denga omake aye kumwe, ndele Balak okwa lombwela Bileam: “Ame nde ku ifanena okulyangula ovatondadi vange, ndele tala, lutatu nokuli we va nangeka noupuna!
Shuna hano paife eshi kuvambuleni! Ame nda tya: ‘Ndi ku fimanekife unene,’ ndelenee, tala, Omwene okwa anya u fimanekifwe.”
Opo nee Bileam ta ti kuBalak: “Inandi lombwela mbela ovatumwa voye nokuli ava we va tumina nge, nda tile:

‘Balak nande a pe nge oshisiliveli noshingoldo shi yadi eumbo laye, ame ihandi dulu okutauluka elombwelo lOmwene ndi ninge ngeno ouwa ile owii pamadiladilo omutima wange? Eshi Omwene te shi popi, osho ame handi shi tongo.’
Ndele paife, tala, ame ohandi shuna kovanhu vange. Ila, ame ohandi ku hololele oshiwana eshi otashi ka ninga ngahelipi koshiwana shoye pexulilo lomafiku.”

Opo nee ye a tumbula etumbulo ndee ta ti:
“Bileam yaBeor osho ngaha ta popi,
heeno, osho omulumenhu,
omesho aye a pashukifwa ta popi.

Ame ohandi mu mono, ndelenee hapaife;
ohandi mu tale, ndelenee hapopepi:
onyofi tai ka holoka muJakob,
nepangelodibo tali yeluka muIsrael.
Ndele Ye ta ka teyaula eembadu domomutwe waMoab
ndele ta kombo po oludalo alishe laShet.

NaEdom yo otashi ka kala oshipangelwa.
NaSeir, omutondadi waye, tashi ka ninga oshipangelwa.
Ndelenee Israel tashi ka ehena komesho meenghono.

MuJakob tamu di omupangeli.
Ye ota ka hanauna po oilando ei ya fyaala po.”

Ndele ye eshi a tala Amalek, okwa tumbula etumbulo eli ndee ta ti:
“Amalek sha li shotete shomoiwana,
ndelenee exulilo lasho ehanauno.”

Ye eshi a tala Ovakeni, okwa tumbula etumbulo eli ndee ta ti:
“Onhele yokukala kwoye oya pama,
noshihadi shoye sha tungilwa komamanya.

Ndele nande ongaha, Kain otashi ka tokekwa.
Fiyo Asiria tashi ku twala ko eenghwate.”

Ye okwa tumbula vali etumbulo ndee ta ti:
“Woo, olyelye ta ka kala e nomwenyo,
Kalunga eshi te shi ningi!

Eeskepa tadi uya langhele lwokombinga yOvakittim,
vo otava ka xutula Asiria, ndele tava ka xutula Eber.
Ndele nasho yo sha yandjelwa ehanauno.”
Opo nee Bileam a fikama nokwa dja po, ndee ta shuna kuvambulavo. Ndele Balak yo okwa ya nondjila yaye.
25: Ovaisraeli eshi va kala muSittim, ovanhu va hovela okuhaela novana oukadona Ovamoab.
Venya ova ifana ovanhu koivilo yomayambo oikalunga yavo. Novanhu va lya ndele ve linyongamenena oikalunga yavo.
Osho ngaha hano Ovaisraeli ve liyandjela okufimaneka Baal-Peor; ndelenee ehandu lOmwene la xwamena Ovaisraeli.
Opo nee Omwene ta ti kuMoses: “Kufa ovakulunhu aveshe voshiwana u va endjelelifile Omwene momutenya, opo oupyuhandu wOmwene okuhandukila Israel u lote.”
Moses okwa lombwela ovatokoli veendjovo vomuIsrael ndee ta ti: “Keshe umwe na dipae movalumenhu vaye ovo ve liyandjela Baal-Peor.”
Ndele omulumenhu umwe Omuisraeli e uya nokwa etela ovaneumbo vaye omukainhu Omumidian moipafi yaMoses nomoipafi yeongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael, fimbo va li tava lili poshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Pinehas yaEliaser, omona womupristeli Aron, eshi e shi mona, okwa dja mo mongudu, ndee ta kufa eonga meke laye.
Nokwa shikula omulumenhu Omuisraeli nokwa ya metwali ndee te va twile kumwe aveshe vavali, omulumenhu Omuisraeli nomukainhu. Opo nee omupya wa lota mokati kovana vaIsrael.
Ndelenee ava va fila momupya ou, va li ve fike pomayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Opo nee Omwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:

“Pinehas yaEliaser, omona womupristeli Aron okwa kandula po oupyuhandu wange movana vaIsrael, ye eshi a monifa ouladi wange nokudiinina ouladi mokati kavo, opo ame mouladi wange inandi mana po ovana vaIsrael.
Onghee hano popya u tye: ‘Tala, Ame ohandi ningi naye ehangano lombili yange,
ndele lo tali ka ninga kuye nokomaludalo aye konima yaye ehangano laalushe loupristeli, shaashi ye okwa fya ouladi omolwaKalunga kaye nokwa kwatakanifa ovana vaIsrael.’ ”
Nedina lomulumenhu Omuisraeli ou a dipawa, pamwe nomukainhu Omumidian, ola li Simri yaSalu, omukulunhu wepata laSimeon.
Nedina lomukainhu Omumidian ou a dipawa, ola li Kosbi yaSur. Xe okwa li omukulunhu wepata lOvamidian.
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Pongekeni Ovamidian mu ke va hanaune po,
osheshi vo ove mu pongeka omolwekengelelo lavo ve li mu diladilila moshinima shaPeor nomoshinima shaKosbi, omona okakadona komukulunhu Omumidian, ou a dipaelwa Peor mefiku lomupya.”
26: Ndele omupya eshi wa lota, Omwene okwa popya naMoses naEliaser, omona womupristeli Aron, ndee ta ti:
“Valeni omuvalu aushe weongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael, ava va wanifa omido omilongo mbali naava va koya po, pamaumbo avo, ovalumenhu aveshe vomuIsrael ava ve nokuhomona.”
Ndele Moses nomupristeli Eliaser ove va popifa momaluhaela naMoab puJordan monhele ya shaama naJeriko, ndee tava ti:

“Ava ve nomido omilongo mbali naava va koya po nava valwe, Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.”
Ndele Ovaisraeli ava va dja muEgipiti ovo:
Ruben, oshiveli shaIsrael. Ovana vaRuben ovo: MuHenok epata lOvahenok. MuPallu epata lOvapallu.
MuHesron epata lOvahesron. MuKarmi epata lOvakarmi.
Hano oo omapata Ovarubeni. Ndele ovavalwa vavo va li omayovi omilongo nhee naatatu nomafele aheyali nomilongo nhatu.
Nomona waPallu okwa li Eliab.
Novana vaEliab ovo Nemuel naDatan naAbiram. Datan naAbiram ovo va li ovakulunhu meongalo, ava va twa eemhata naMoses naAron meengudu daKora, ou a twa eemhata nOmwene.
Nedu la makula okanya kalo ndele le va pona po pamwe naKora, eengudu eshi da fya, omundilo eshi wa dipaa ovalumenhu omafele avali nomilongo nhano. Ndele vo va ninga edidiliko.
Ndelenee ovana ovamati vaKora inava fya.
Ovana ovamati vaSimeon pamapata avo: muNemuel epata lOvanemuel. MuJamin epata lOvajamin. MuJakin epata lOvajakin.
MuSera epata lOvasargi. MuSaul epata lOvasaul.
Hano omapata Ovasimeon e fike pomilongo mbali naavali.
Ovana ovamati vaGad pamapata avo: MuSefon epata lOvasefin. MuHaggi epata lOvahaggi. MuSuni epata lOvasuni.
MuOsni epata lOvaosni. MuEri epata lOvaeri.
MuArod epata lOvaarod. MuAreli epata lOvaareeli.
Hano oo omapata ovana ovamati vaGad pamapata avo: omayovi omilongo nhee nomafele atano.
Ovana ovamati vaJuda ovo: Er naOnan, ndelenee vo ova fila medu laKaanan.
Ovana ovamati vaJuda pamapata avo: MuShela epata lOvasela. MuPeres epata laPeres. MuSera epata lOvasargi.
Novana ovamati vaPeres: MuHesron epata lOvahesron. MuHamul epata lOvahamul.
Hano oo omapata aJuda pamuvalo waava va valwa: omayovi omilongo heyali nahamano nomafele atano.
Ovana ovamati vaIsaskar pamapata avo: MuTola epata lOvatola. MuPua epata lOvapuni.
MuJasub epata lOvajasub. MuSimron epata lOvasimron.
Omapata aIsaskar pamuvalo waava va valwa: omayovi omilongo hamano naane nomafele atatu.
Ovana ovamati vaSebulon pamapata avo: MuSered epata lOvasardi. MuElon epata lOvaeloni. MuJagleel epata lOvajagleel.
Omapata Ovasebulon pamuvalo waava va valwa: omayovi omilongo hamano nomafele atano.
Ovana ovamati vaJosef pamapata avo: Manasse naEfraim.
Ovana ovamati vaManasse: muMakir epata lOvamakiri. Ndele Makir okwa li xe yaGilead. MuGilead epata lOvagilead.
Ovana ovamati vaGilead: MuJeser epata lOvajeser. MuHelek epata lOvaheleki.
Ndele muAsriel epata lOvaasriel. Ndele muSekem epata lOvasekem.
Ndele muSemida epata lOvasemida. Ndele muHefer epata lOvahefri.
Ndelenee Selofhad yaHefer okwa li ehe novana ovamati, ndelenee ovana oukadona aveke. Nomadina ovana oukadona vaSelofhad aa: Mahla naNoa, Hogla, Milka naTirsa.
Omapata aManasse pamuvalo waava va valwa: omayovi omilongo nhano naavali nomafele aheyali.
Ovana ovamati vaEfraim pamapata avo ovo: MuSutelah epata Ovasutalhi. MuBeger epata lOvabegri. MuTahan epata lOvatahan.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaSutelah ovava: MuEran epata lOvaeran.
Oo hano omapata ovana vaEfraim pamuvalo wavo va valwa: omayovi omilongo nhatu naavali nomafele atano. Ovana ovamati vaJosef ava hano pamapata avo.
Ovana ovamati vaBenjamin pamapata avo: MuBela epata lOvabali. MuAsbel epata lOvaasbel. MuAhiram epata lOvaahiram.
MuSefufam epata lOvasufami. MuHufam epata lOvahufami.
Novana ovamati vaBela ovo: Ard naNaeman. MuArd epata lOvaardi. MuNaeman epata lOvanaami.
Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaBenjamin pamapata avo. Omuvalo waavo va valwa wa li omayovi omilongo nhee naatano nomafele ahamano.
Ovana ovamati vaDan pamapata avo aava: MuSuham epata lOvasuham. Oo hano omapata aDan pamapata avo.
Omapata aeshe Ovasuham pamuvalo waavo va valwa va li omayovi omilongo hamano naane nomafele ane.
Ovana ovamati vaAsser pamapata avo: MuJimna epata lOvajimna. MuJisvi epata lOvajisvi. MuBeria epata lOvaberi.
Movana ovamati vaBeria: MuEber epata lOvahebri. MuMalkiel epata lOvamalkiel.
Nedina lomona okakadona kaAsser la li Sera.
Omapata ovana ovamati vaAsser pamuvalo waavo va valwa: omayovi omilongo nhano naatatu nomafele ane.
Ovana ovamati vaNaftali pamapata avo: muJakseel epata lOvajakseel. MuGuni epata lOvaguni.
MuJeser epata lOvajisri. MuSillem epata lOvasillem.
Omapata aNaftali pamapata avo pamuvalo waava va valwa: omayovi omilongo nhee naatano nomafele ane.
Omuvalo wovana vaIsrael ava va valwa oyou: omayovi omafele ahamano neyovi limwe nomafele aheyali nomilongo nhatu.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Ovanhu ava nava tukulilwe edu, li ninge oitukulwafyuululo yavo pamuvalo womadina avo.
Epata linene li pa oshitukulwafyuululwa shinene. Ndele eli linini u noku li pa oshitukulwafyuululwa shinini. Epata keshe nali pewe oshitukulwafyuululwa shalo pamuvalo walo.
Edu nali tukulwe pashihoololifo. Vo ve nokufyuulula pamadina omapata ooxekulu vavo.”
Pashihoololifo efyuululo li nokutukulwa pokati komapata manene naa manini.
Ndele ava ovavalwa vaLevi pamapata avo: MuGerson epata lOvagerson. MuKohat epata lOvakohati. MuMerari epata lOvamerari.
Oo hano omapata aLevi: epata lOvalibni, epata lOvahebroni, epata lOvamaglik epata lOvamusi, epata lOvakora. Ndele Kohat okwa li xe yaAmram.
Ndele edina lomwalikadi waAmram la li Johobed, omona okakadona kaLevi, ou a dalelwa Levi muEgipiti. Ndele ye okwa dalela Amram: Aron naMoses naMirjam, omumwaina.
Ndele Aron okwa dala: Nadab naAbihu, Eliaser naItamar.
Ndele Nadab naAbihu ova fya, eshi va eta omundilo umwe uhe fi, wokoshipala shOmwene.

Novalumenhu aveshe vavo va valwa, ava va wanifa ohani imwe naava va koya po, ova li ve fike pomayovi omilongo mbali naatatu. Ndelenee vo inava valwa mokati kovana vaIsrael, osheshi vo inava pewa oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati kovana vaIsrael.
Ovava va valwa kuMoses nokomupristeli Eliaser, ava va valula ovana vaIsrael momaluhaela aMoab puJordan monhele ya shaama naJeriko.
Ndele mokati kaava inamu kala nande ou a valwa kuMoses nokomupristeli Aron, vo eshi va valula mombuwa yaSinai ovana vaIsrael.
Osheshi Omwene okwe va tongele: Vo ve nokufila mombuwa. Ndele muvo inamu fyaala nande umwe, Kaleb yaJefunne naJosua yaNun, ovo aveke.
27: Opo nee ovana oukadona vaSelofhad yaHefer yaGilead yaMakir yaManasse, womepata laManasse yaJosef, ova ehena po. Omadina ovana oukadona aa: Mahla, Noa naHogla naMilka naTirsa,
ndele ova ka kala ofika moipafi yaMoses noyomupristeli Eliaser noyovakulunhu noyeongalo alishe poshivelo shetwali leongalo, ndee tava ti:
“Tate yetu okwa fila mombuwa, ndele ye ina kala meengudu daava va ongalela okutwila Omwene ondubo, meengudu daKora, ndelenee ye okwa fila omatimba aye mwene, ndele ye okwa li ehe novana ovamati.
Omolwashike edina latate tali ka dimwa po mepata laye, shaashi ye okwa li ehe novana ovamati? Tu peni oshitukulwa mokati kovamwaina vatate ovalumenhu.”
Opo nee Moses okwa twala eendjovo davo koshipala shOmwene.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Ovana oukadona vaSelofhad ova popya da yuka. Ove u noku va pa shili oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati kovamwaina vaxe ovalumenhu oshitukulwafyuululwa shaxe nashi ninge shavo.
Ndele lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye: Umwe ngeenge ta fi ehe nomona omumati, nye mu nokupa omona okakadona oshitukulwafyuululwa shaye ovamwaina vaxe ovalumenhu.
Ndele ngeenge ye ke nomona okakadona, nye mu nokupa oshitukulwafyuululwa shaye ovamwaina vaxe ovalumenhu.
Ndele ngeenge ke novana ovamati, nye mu nokupa oshitukulwafyuululwa shaye ovamwaina vaxe ovalumenhu.

Ndele xe ngeenge ke novamwaina ovalumenhu, nye mu nokupa oshitukulwafyuululwa shaye omukwaoelela womepata laye, ndee ye e noku shi tambula ngaashi oshipangelwa shaye. Ndele eshi shi nokukala oshiyukifwanghedimhango shovana vaIsrael, Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.”
Ndele Omwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti: “Londa komhunda ei yaAbarim u tale edu olo Ame handi li pe ovana vaIsrael.
Ndele ngeenge we li mono, naave yo oto ka ongelwa kovakwanepata voye ngaashi omumwanyoko Aron a ongelwa ko.
Shaashi eshi mwa li mombuwa yaSin okukonga omeva, eongalo fimbo la twa eemhata mwa twilile nge ondubo nye inamu fimaneka nge moipafi yavo.” Oo omeva aMeriba puKades mombuwa yaSin.
Opo nee Moses okwa popya nOmwene, ndee ta ti:
“Omwene, Kalunga keemhepo dombelela aishe na tule kombada yeongalo omulumenhu umwe,
ou te va kwatele komesho mokupita kwavo nokuya mo kwavo te va kufa mo note va twala mo, eongalo lOmwene liha kale ngaashi eedi dihe nomufita.”
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Moses ndee ta ti: “Kufa Josua yaNun, omulumenhu e nOmhepo. Ndele tenheka eke loye kombada yaye,
u mu kaleke koshipala shomupristeli Eliaser nomoipafi yeongalo alishe, ndele mu nangeka moshilonga shaye moipafi yavo.
Ndele muye tula mo sha shomoukulunhu woye, opo eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael tali shiiva okudulika kuye.

Ndele ye e nokukala ofika koshipala shomupristeli Eliaser, opo ye e ku pulile muUrim enyamukulo laKalunga koshipala shOmwene. Kelombwelo laye vo va dje po nokelombwelo laye vo ve nokuuya mo, ye novana aveshe vaIsrael pamwe naye neongalo alishe.”
Ndele Moses osho a ninga Omwene ngaashi e mu lombwela; ye okwa kufa Josua nokwe mu kaleka koshipala shomupristeli Eliaser nomoipafi yeongalo alishe,
ndele ye okwa tenheka kuye omake aye nokwe mu nangeka moshilonga, Omwene ngaashi a popya noku shi lombwela Moses.
28: Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo: ‘Dimbulukweni shili okweetela nge pefimbo la pangelwa omayambo, eendja dange domindiloyambo dange edimba liwa kwaame.’
“Ndele u noku va lombwela: Omundiloyambo mu noku u etela Omwene oyou: Oudjona vavali vomudo umwe vehe noshipo, efiku keshe exwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe.
Odjona imwe mu noku i yamba ongula, nodjona ikwao mu noku i yamba onguloshi,
pamwe noufila wa nakwa okilograma imwe wa pilulilwa omaadi a yengwa e fike polita imwe.
Olo hano exwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe la dikwa komhunda yaSinai ngaashi edimba liwa omundiloyambo kOmwene.
Ndele pamwe nalo oikunwayambo, yo olita limwe kodjona keshe. Metwali liyapuki u nokuyambela Omwene oikunwayambo yomaviinyu e neenghono.
Ndele odjona u noku i yamba onguloshi. U noku i yamba panghedi yeendjayambo dongula noikunwayambo yado, ngaashi edimba liwa kOmwene.”
“Ndelenee mefiku lEshabata oudjona vavali vomudo umwe vehe noshipo, noufila wa nakwa weekilograma mbali, eendjayambo mwa pilulilwa omaadi, pamwe noikunwayambo yado.
Olo hano exwikiloyambo lEshabata mEshabata keshe la wedwa kexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndele pehovelo leehani deni dipe nye mu nokweetela Omwene exwikiloyambo: eengobe eenyasha mbali deemhedi nodi imwe yomhedi, oudjona vaheyali vomudo umwe vehe noipo.
Noufila wa nakwa weekilograma nhatu, mwa pilulilwa omaadi, eendjayambo kongobe keshe; oufila weekilograma mbali mwa pilulilwa omaadi, kodi imwe yomhedi.
Noufila wa nakwa wokilograma imwe mwa pilulilwa omaadi, eendjayambo kodjona keshe. Lo exwikiloyambo, edimba liwa, omundiloyambo wOmwene.
Ndele oikunwayambo yavo i nomaviinyu eelita mbali kongobe imwe yomhedi olita netata kodi imwe nolita limwe kodjona imwe. Lo exwikiloyambo kohani keshe ipe meehani domudo.
Omwene e nokuyambelwa yo oshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo, ponho yexwikiloyambo yomefiku keshe noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndelenee mohani yotete mefiku etimulongo netine lohani oku nOpaasa yOmwene.
Ndele mefiku etimulongo netitano mohani tuu oyo oku na oshivilo. Momafiku aheyali mu nokulya omingome dihe nonhafi.
Mefiku lotete oku nokukala oshiongalele shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni.
Ndelenee mu nokweetela Omwene exwikiloyambo: eengobe eenyasha deemhedi nodi imwe yomhedi noudjona vaheyali vomudo umwe. Ove nokukala vehe noipo kunye.
Noufila weendjayambo deni mwa pilulilwa omaadi. Mu nokuyamba eekilograma nhatu kongobe imwe yomhedi, neekilograma mbali kodi imwe.
Okilograma imwe mu nokuyamba kodjona keshe yomoudjona vaheyali.
Navali oshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo oku mu kwatakanifa.
Ponho yexwikiloyambo longula nokutya, exwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe mu noku di yamba.
Panghedi tuu oyo nye mu nokuyamba efiku keshe momafiku aheyali eendja domundiloyambo wedimba liwa kOmwene. Olo li nokuyambwa pexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe noikunwayambo yalo.
Ndele mefiku etiheyali pu na okukala oshiongalele sheni shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni.
“Ndelenee mefiku loshipe nye ngeenge tamu etele Omwene eendjayambo dipe moshivilo sheni shoshivike, omu nokwoongala moshiongalele sheni shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni.
Opo nee mu nokweetela Omwene exwikiloyambo edimba liwa: ongobe imwe onyasha yomhedi odi imwe yomhedi, oudjona vaheyali vomudo umwe;
neendjayambo davo: oufila wa nakwa mwa pilulilwa omaadi, eekilograma nhatu kongobe keshe, eekilograma mbali kodi imwe,
nokilograma imwe kodjona keshe yomoudjona vaheyali.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi shoku mu kwatakanifa.
Ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe pamwe neendjayambo dalo, noikunwayambo yeni oyo nye mu noku i yamba. Oimuna i nokukala ihe noipo.
29: “Ndele mohani onhiheyali mefiku lotete lohani nye mu nokwoongala moshiongalele sheni shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni. Olo nali ninge kunye efiku lokushika enghuma.
Nye mu nokuyamba exwikiloyambo edimba liwa kOmwene: ongobe onyasha imwe yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi, oudjona vaheyali vomudo umwe vehe noshipo,
neendjayambo deni: oufila wa nakwa mwa pilulilwa omaadi, eekilograma nhatu kongobe imwe yomhedi, eekilograma mbali kodi imwe,
nokilograma imwe kodjona keshe yomoudjona vaheyali.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo oku mu kwatakanifa,
ponho yexwikiloyambo lohani ipe neendjayambo dalo nexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe neendjayambo dalo, noikunwayambo yalo papukululomhango layo i ninge edimba liwa, omundiloyambo kOmwene.
“Ndele mefiku etimulongo lohani tuu ei onhiheyali mu nokwoongala moshiongalele sheni shiyapuki, ndele nye mu nokunyika oluhodi. Inamu longa sha.
Opo nee mu nokweetela Omwene exwikiloyambo edimba liwa: ongobe onyasha imwe yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi, oudjona vaheyali vomudo umwe vehe noshipo kunye;
neendjayambo dado: oufila wa nakwa mwa pilulilwa omaadi eekilograma nhatu kongobe imwe yomhedi, eekilograma mbali kodi imwe,
nokilograma imwe kodjona keshe yomoudjona vaheyali.
Oshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yetimbayambo lekwatakanifo nexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe neendjayambo dalo, noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndele mefiku etimulongo netitano lohani onhiheyali nye mu nokwoongala moshiongalele shiyapuki. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni, ndelenee mu nokudana oshivilo koshipala shOmwene omafiku aheyali.
Ndele mu nokweetela Omwene exwikiloyambo, omundiloyambo wedimba liwa: eengobe eenyasha omulongo nanhatu deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi, oudjona omulongo navane vomudo umwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado: oufila wa nakwa mwa pilulilwa omaadi weekilograma nhatu kongobe keshe yomeengobe omulongo nanhatu; eekilograma mbali kodi keshe yomeedi mbali.
Nokilograma imwe kodjona keshe yomoudjona omulongo navane.
Noshikombo oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, neendjayambo dao noikunwayambo yao.
“Ndelenee mefiku etivali: eengobe eenyasha omulongo nambali deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi noudjona omulongo navane vomudo umwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado noikunwayambo yado keengobe, keedi nokoudjona pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, eendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndele mefiku etitatu: eengobe omulongo naimwe deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi noudjona omulongo navane vomudo umwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado, noikunwayambo yado keengobe, keedi nokoudjona pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe neendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.
“Opo nee mefiku etine: eengobe omulongo deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi noudjona omulongo navane vomudo umwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado noikunwayambo yado keengobe, keedi nokoudjona pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, eendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndele mefiku etitano: eengobe omugoi deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi noudjona omulongo navane vomudo umwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado noikunwayambo yado keengobe, keedi nokoudjona, pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, eendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndelenee mefiku etihamano: eengobe hamano deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi, noudjona omulongo navane vomudo umwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado noikunwayambo yado keengobe, keedi nokoudjona pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, eendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.
“Ndelenee mefiku etiheyali: eengobe heyali deemhedi, eedi mbali deemhedi, oudjona omulongo navane vomudo u mwe vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado noikunwayambo yado keengobe, keedi nokoudjona pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, eendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.
“Mefiku etihetatu mu nokwoongala koshiongalele shoshivilo. Inamu longa sha shomoilonga yeni.
Ndele nye mu nokweetela Omwene exwikiloyambo, omundiloyambo wedimba liwa: ongobe imwe yomhedi, odi imwe yomhedi noudjona vaheyali vehe noshipo.
Eendjayambo dado noikunwayambo yado kongobe, kodi nokoudjona, pamuvalo wado papukululomhango.
Noshikombo shimwe oshipedi etimbayambo ponho yexwikiloyambo lomafiku aeshe, eendjayambo dalo noikunwayambo yalo.”
Oo mu noku a yambela okufimanekifa Omwene moivilo yeni ponho yomaudanekoyambo eni neeshaliyambo deni dehalo liwa, aa tamu a eta omaxwikiloyambo ile eendjayambo ile oikunwayambo ile omapanduloyambo.
Ndele Moses okwa lombwela ovana vaIsrael aishe naanaa ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela.
30: Ndele Moses okwa lombwela ovakulunhu vomapata ovana vaIsrael ve limwenenene opo nee omaudaneko aye aeshe taa kala a kwatekeka nelidiliko keshe e li lidilikifa ye mwene tali ka kala la kwatekeka.
Omunhu ngeenge ta udanekele Omwene eudaneko ile ta ane eano lelidiliko lakeshe eshi, oye e he nokulundulula eendjovo daye. Ye e nokushakenifa adishe odo okanya kaye ka tonga.
Ndelenee omukainhu ngeenge ta udanekele Omwene sha ile te lidilikifa elidiliko lakeshe eshi, fimbo ta kala meumbo laxe mounyasha waye;

naxe ota udu eudaneko laye nelidiliko laye e li lidilikifa ye mwene ndele xe ote limwenenene opo nee omaudaneko aye aeshe taa kala a kwatekeka nelidiliko keshe e li lidilikifa ye mwene tali ka kala la kwatekeka.

Ndelenee xe efiku tuu olo ye eshi ta udu omaudaneko aye ndee te mu shilike omaudaneko aye aeshe nelidiliko laye keshe e li lidilikifa elidiliko tali kala la kwatanuka nOmwene te mu dimine po, shaashi xe e shi mu shilika,
ndelenee ye ngeenge ta hombolwa fimbo ye e nomaudaneko inaa wanifwa ile ta pitifa mo mokanya kaye ondjovo mokuhadiladila shili e i lidilikifa ye mwene
nomulumenhu waye te shi udu ndee te i mwenenene mefiku tuu olo e i uda, opo nee omaudaneko aye a kwatekeka nosho yo keshe elidiliko laye e li lidilikifa elidiliko tali kala la kwatekeka.

Ndelenee omulumenhu waye mefiku tuu olo ye e li uda te lishilike, opo nee ye ta alulula eudaneko laye e li udaneka oku li wanifa nosho yo ondjovo ei ye e i popya mokuhadiladila e i lidilikifa keshe eshi. NOmwene ote ke shi mu dimina po.
Ndelenee omaudaneko omufiyekadi ile omwalikadi a hengwa po, osheshi ye e shi udaneka nokwaana otaa kala a wanifwa.
Ndele ye ngeenge meumbo lomulumenhu waye ta udaneke eudaneko ile te lidilike sha nokwaana,
nomulumenhu waye te shi udu ndee te limwenenene, ite mu shilike, opo nee omaudaneko aye aeshe taa ka kala a wanifwa nelidilikifo keshe laye tali ka kala la wanifwa.
Ndelenee omulumenhu waye mefiku tuu olo te a udu, ngeenge te a alulula hano keshe ondjovo ya dja mokanya kaye ile eudaneko inali wanifwa, omulumenhu waye e a alulula. Omwene ote shi mu dimine po.
“Eudaneko keshe neano keshe lokulidilika omwalikadi ote li udanekele okulihepeka, omulumenhu waye ota dulu oku li kwatekeka ile oku li kwatunununa.

Ndelenee omulumenhu waye ngeenge te mu limwenenene mefiku tuu olo hano osho ngaho ye okwa kwatekeka eudaneko laye ile okulidilika keshe, kwe ku lidilikifa, osheshi ye okwe mu limwenenena mefiku tuu olo ye e li uda.
Ndelenee ye ngeenge te a kwatunununa, eshi a pitifa po omafiku eshi e a uda, oye e nokuhumbata omanyonauno omwalikadi waye.”
Oyo hano onghedimhango Omwene e i lombwela Moses, i kale pokati komulumenhu nomwalikadi waye, pokati kaxe nomona waye okakadona, ye fimbo ta kala meumbo laxe mounyasha waye.
31: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Kwatela Ovamidian onghone omolwOvaisraeli, opo nee ove to ka ongelwa kovakwanepata loye.”
Opo nee Moses okwa lombwela ovanhu ndee ta ti: “Ovalumenhu vomokati keni nava longekidilwe oita, opo va shiive okuhomona Ovamidian ndele va fikife etokolonghone lOmwene kOvamidian.
Nye mu nokutuma koita yOvamidian ovalumenhu eyovi limwe vomomapata aeshe aIsrael.”
Opo nee momayovi Ovaisraeli mepata keshe mwa dja eyovi limwe, hano omayovi omulongo naavali, ava va longekidilwa oita.
Ndele Moses okwe va tuma koita, eyovi limwe lomepata keshe, vo pamwe naPinehas, omona womupristeli Eliaser, koita pamwe noinima iyapuki nomanghuma onghuwo.
Ndele vo ova tondokela Midian, Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses, ndele vo ova dipaa ovalumenhu aveshe.
Mokati kovadipawa vakwao va dipaa yo eehamba dOvamidian: Evi naRekem naSur naHur naReba, eehamba nhano daMidian. Vo ova dipaa yo Bileam yaBeor neongamukonda.
Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael va kufa ovakainhu Ovamidian nounona vavo eenghwate, ndele va hakana po eendongi davo adishe noimuna yavo aishe nemona lavo alishe.
Navali va xwika po nomundilo oilando yavo aishe neenhele davo dokukala mo neenhanda davo adishe.
Ndele va kufa oihakanwa aishe noixuulwa aishe, ovanhu noinamwenyo.
Ndele va eta eenghwate monhanda noixuulwa noihakanwa kuMoses nokomupristeli Eliaser nokeongalo lovana vaIsrael komaluhaela aMoab puJordan monhele ya shaama naJeriko.
Ndele Moses nomupristeli Eliaser novakulunhu aveshe veongalo ve ke va shakeneka pondje kombada yonhanda,
Moses okwa handukila ovakulunhu vomatanga, ovakulunhu vomayovi novakulunhu vomafele, ava va dja koita.
Ndele Moses okwe va lombwela ta ti: “Ovakainhu aveshe mwe va xupifa po ve nomwenyo?
Taleni ovo tuu ovo opapukululo laBileam, va pukifa ovana vaIsrael ve liteeke Omwene moshinima shaPeor, oshiponga opo sha kala meongalo lOmwene.
Hano dipaeni po oulume aveshe vomokati kounona. Dipaeni yo omukainhu keshe ou a nangala nomulumenhu.
Ndelenee ounona oukadona aveshe ava inava nangala nomulumenhu ve lixupifileni.
Ndelenee nye vene kaleni omafiku aheyali pondje yonhanda. Keshe ou a dipaa omunhu nakeshe ou a kuma omudipawa, nye mu nokulifetifa mefiku etitatu nomefiku etiheyali, onye vene neenghwate deni.
Noshikutu keshe nashi koshwe nosho yo oshinima keshe shoshipa naaishe ya tungwa nolududi loshikombo noshinima keshe shoshiti.”
Nomupristeli Eliaser okwa lombwela ovakwaita ava va ile koita, ndee ta ti: “Oyo hano onghedimhango Omwene e i lombwela Moses.
Ashike oshingoldo noshisiliveli, oshikushu noshivela, oikesha noholo

noshinima keshe itashi tila omundilo, mu noku shi endifa momundilo, ndee tashi ka kala sha yela. Ndele shi nokuyelifwa yo nomafetifomeva. Ndelenee ashishe eshi tashi tila omundilo, shi nokweendifwa momeva.
Nye mu nokukosha yo oikutu yeni mefiku etiheyali opo nee tamu kala mwa yela. Opo nee tamu dulu okuuya mo monhanda.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Nye nomupristeli Eliaser novakulunhu vomepata vomeongalo, valeni oixuulwa aishe, ovanhu noimuna.
Noixuulwa i tukulila ava va ile koita, ava va fikama keshivo neongalo alishe.
Ndele movakwaita ava va ile koita kufa kuvo efendelo lOmwene oshitukulwa shimwe shomoitukulwa omafele atano, ovanhu neengobe neendongi needi.
Li kufa moshitukulwa shavo u li yandje komupristeli Eliaser oshaliyambo kOmwene.

Ndele kufa mo moshitukulwa shovana vaIsrael oshitukulwa shimwe shomoitukulwa omilongo nhano, movanhu, meengobe, meendongi, meedi, moinamwenyo aishe. Ndele u noku i yandja kOvalevi ava hava diinine oshilonga metwali liyapuki lOmwene.”
Ndele Moses nomupristeli Eliaser osho va ninga Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.
Noixuulwa, oshixupe shoihakanwa ovakwaita va kufa, oya li eedi omayovi omafele ahamano nomayovi omilongo heyali naatano,
neengobe omayovi omilongo heyali naavali,
neendongi omayovi omilongo hamano nalimwe,
novanhu nokutya, oukadona ava inava nangala nomulumenhu, vo aveshe va li omayovi omilongo nhatu naavali.
Ndele etata, nokutya oshitukulwa shaava va ile koita, omuvalu washo eedi omayovi omafele atatu nomayovi omilongo nhatu naaheyali nomafele atano.
Nefendelo lavo kOmwene la li eedi omafele ahamano nomilongo heyali nanhatu.
Neengobe da li omayovi omilongo nhatu nahamano. Nefendelo lavo kOmwene la li omilongo heyali nambali.
Neendongi da li omayovi omilongo nhatu nomafele atano. Nefendelo lavo kOmwene la li omilongo hamano naimwe.
Novanhu va li omayovi omulongo naahamano, nefendelo lavo kOmwene ovanhu omilongo nhatu navavali.
Ndele Moses okwa yandja komupristeli Eliaser efendelo olo la pangelelwa Omwene oshaliyambo, Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.
Ndele metata lovana vaIsrael olo Moses a li e va tukulila lomwaashi shovakwaita,
netata tali i keongalo ola li eedi omayovi omafele atatu nomayovi omilongo nhatu naaheyali nomafele atano,
neengobe omayovi omilongo nhatu nomayovi ahamano,
neendongi omayovi omilongo nhatu nomafele atano,
novanhu omayovi omulongo naahamano.

Metata eli tali i kovana vaIsrael Moses okwa kufa mo oshitukulwa shimwe shomoitukulwa omilongo nhano movanhu nomoinamwenyo ndele ye e i pa Ovalevi, ava hava diinine oshilonga petwali liyapuki lOmwene, Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses.
Opo nee ovakulunhu vomayovi omatanga ovakwaita, ovakulunhu veyovi novakulunhu vefele ove uya kuMoses,
ndee tava ti kuMoses: “Ovapiya voye ova vala omuvalu aushe wovakwaita ava va kala mepangelo letu, ndele inatu yongola nande umwe.
Onghee hano keshe umwe womufye ta etele Omwene eyambo, oshingoldo e shi mona: oiposhe noingoldo, ouvela, oulinga, omangola, noulenga vopofingo, opo tu limonene ekwatakanifo koshipala shOmwene.”
Opo nee Moses nomupristeli Eliaser va tambula kuvo oshingoldo, oinima i lili nai lili ya longekeka.
Noshingoldo ashishe sheeshaliyambo, vo ve di etele Omwene osha li eekilograma omafele avali da yandjwa kovakulunhu veyovi nokovakulunhu vefele.
Ovakwaita ove litinhila oixuulwa.
Osho ngaha hano Moses nomupristeli Eliaser va tambula oshingoldo kovakulunhu veyovi nokovakulunhu vefele, ndele ve shi twala metwali leongalo, ovana vaIsrael opo va dimbulukiwe koshipala shOmwene.
32: Ndelenee ovana vaRuben novana vaGad ova li ve noimuna ihapu, omaufita manene. Ndele vo eshi va lava edu laJaeser nedu laGilead, ova mona olo onhele iwa yoimuna.
Opo nee ovana vaGad novana vaRuben ve uya kuMoses nokomupristeli Eliaser nokovakulunhu veongalo va popya navo, ndee tava ti:
“Atarot naDibon naJaeser naNimra naHesbon naEleale naSebam naNebo naBehon,
oshikandjo Omwene e shi nunina eongalo laIsrael oshiwa noimuna, novapiya voye ve noimuna.
Va tya vali: Fye ngeenge twa filwa onghenda momesho oye, natu pewe edu olo oshitukulwafyuululwa shetu. Ino tu twala langhele kwinya kombada yaJordan.”
Ndelenee Moses okwa nyamukula ovana vaGad novana vaRuben ndee ta ti: “Ovakweni tava ka homona mo moita ndele nye mwa hala okufyaala apa.
Omolwashike mwa hala okudima po ehalo lovana vaIsrael lokuya medu olo Omwene e li va pa?
Osho ooxo va ninga, vo eshi va tumwa kwaame muKades-Barnea, va ka lave oshilongo.
Vo eshi va fika fiyo okefilu laEskol ndele va mona oshilongo osho, ova dima po ehalo lovana vaIsrael lokuya kedu olo Omwene e li va pa.
Onghee hano mefiku tuu olo ehandu lOmwene la xwama, Ye okwa ana, ndee ta ti:

‘Oshili, nande umwe womovalumenhu venya va dja muEgipiti va wanifa omido omilongo mbali ile ve di koya, ta ka mona edu linya nde li udanekela nokwaana Abraham, Isak naJakob. Osheshi vo inava dulika kwaame nomutima aushe,
kakele kaKaleb yaJefunne, Omukenisi, naJosua yaNun. Osheshi ovo va dulika kOmwene nomutima aushe.’
Nehandu lOmwene ola xwamena Israel ndele Ye e va efela okweelaela mombuwa omido omilongo ine, fiyo epupi alishe linya la longa owii momesho Omwene, la xula po.
Ndee taleni, nye mwa fikama ponhele yooxo, oludalo nye lovalunde opo mu wede ko vali oupyuhandu wOmwene okuhandukila Israel.
Nye ngeenge tamu mu liteeka paife, oshiwana ote ke shi efela natango mombuwa, ndele nye otamu ka manifa po oshiwana ashishe.”
Opo nee vo ve uya kuye ndee tava ti: “Fye ohatu ka dikila apa oyuunda yoimuna yetu noilando yovana vetu,

ndelenee fye vene ohatu ka dililwa nokukwatela komesho ovana vaIsrael, fiyo twe va twala keenhele davo. Ndele ovana vetu tava ka kala moilando ya pamekwa neehotekuma dokukelela po ovanhu vomoshilongo eshi.
Fye itatu ka shuna komaumbo etu fimbo ovana vaIsrael, keshe umwe ina nangala oshitukulwafyuululwa shaye.
Osheshi fye itatu ka fyuulula pamwe navo kombada yaJordan ile langhele kwinya kokule, osheshi oshitukulwafyuululwa shetu twe shi mona langhele oku, moushilo waJordan.”
Opo nee Moses ta ti kuvo: “Ngeenge tamu ningi ngaha nongeenge tamu longekidilwa oita koshipala shOmwene,
nomulumenhu keshe womunye a dililwa koshipala shOmwene ndee ta tauluka Jordan fiyo ye a taataa ovatondadi vaye koshipala shaye,

ndee tamu aluka, oshilongo ngeenge sha ninga oshipangelwa shOmwene, opo nee muhe noushima koshipala shOmwene nomoipafi yaIsrael, nedu eli tali ka ninga kunye oshitukulwafyuululwa sheni koshipala shOmwene.
Ndelenee ngeenge itamu shi ningi, taleni, opo nee tamu nyono kOmwene, ndele kaleni mu shi shii, omanyonauno eni tae ke mu hanga.
Tungileni ovana veni oilando, dikileni oimuna yeni oyuunda ningeni ngaashi mwa popya nomakanya eni.”
Opo nee ovana vaGad novana vaRuben ova lombwela Moses ndee tava ti: “Ovapiya voye tava ka ninga ngaashi omwene wetu e tu lombwela.
Ovana vetu novalikadi vetu noimuna yetu neendongi detu otadi ka fyaala moilando yomuGilead.
Ndelenee ovapiya voye, aveshe ava va longekidilwa oita, otava ka homona koshipala shOmwene, omwene wetu ngaashi a popya.”
Opo nee Moses okwe va lombwelele omupristeli Eliaser naJosua yaNun, novakulunhu vomapata omapata ovana vaIsrael.

Ndele Moses okwe va lombwela: “Ovana vaGad novana vaRuben ngeenge tava tauluka Jordan pamwe nanye nokutya, aveshe ava va longekidilwa oita koshipala shOmwene nedu olo tali ningi oshipangelwa sheni, va peni hano edu laGilead oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo.
Ndelenee vo ngeenge itava tauluka va longekidilwa oita pamwe nanye, nye mu noku va monena oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo mokati keni medu laKaanan.”
Ndele ovana vaGad novana vaRuben ova nyamukula tava ti: “Osho Omwene e shi lombwela ovapiya vaye fye twa hala oku shi ninga.
Fye ohatu ka tauluka twa dililwa koshipala shOmwene nokuya medu laKaanan, ndele oshitukulwafyuululwa shetu tashi ka kala koushilo waJordan.”

Osho ngaha hano Moses a pa ovana vaGad novana vaRuben netata lepata laManasse yaJosef, oshilongo shaSihon, ohamba yOvaamori, noshilongo shaOg, ohamba yaBasan, oshilongo noilando yomusho nomikunda dasho, oilando yoshilongo keembinga adishe dasho.
Novana vaGad va tungulula Dibon naAtarot naAroer
naAterot-Sofan naJaeser naJogbeha
naBet-Nimra naBet-Haran, oilando ya pamekwa neehotekuma, noyuunda yeedi.
Novana vaRuben va tungulula Hesbon naEleale naKiriataim
naNebo naBaal-Meon (va lundulula omadina) naSibma. Noilando ve i tunga voovene, ve i luka omadina.
Novana ovamati vaMakir yaManasse va ya kuGilead, ndele ve li nangala nokutaataa Ovaamori va kala mo.
Ndele Gilead, Moses okwe shi pa Makir yaManasse. Ndele ye okwa ka tula mo.
Ndele Jair yaManasse okwa ya nokwa nangala omikunda davo nokwe di luka Jair.
Ndele Nobah okwa ya ndele okwa nangala Kenat noipangelwa yasho, nokwe shi luka padina laye Nobah.
33: Odo hano eenhanda domolweendo lovana vaIsrael, ava va dja medu laEgipiti pamatanga avo ovakwaita va kwatelwa komesho kuMoses naAron.
Palombwelo lOmwene Moses okwa shanga eenhele ngaashi va enda konhele nonhele. Odo hano eenhele davo kudo va ehena keenhele dokomesho:
Vo ova fikama muRameses mohani yotete mefiku etimulongo netitano lohani yotete. Mefiku tali shikula Opaasa, ovana vaIsrael va dja mo, meameno leke li neenghono moipafi yOvaegipiti aveshe,
fimbo Ovaegipiti va li ve noupyakadi okupaka ava va dipawa kOmwene mokati kavo, oiveli aishe. Omwene okwa handukila yo oikalunga yavo.
Ovana vaIsrael eshi va fikama muRameses, ova onga onhanda muSukkot.
Ndele va fikama muSukkot, ndele va onga onhanda muEtam, osho shi li pombuwa.
Ndele va fikama muEtam ndele ve lishilila kuPi-Hagirot, osho shi li koushilo waBaal-Sefon. Ndele va onga onhanda komesho yaMigdol.
Ndele vo ova fikama muPi-Hagirot ndele va tauluka efuta nokuyukilila ombuwa. Ndele va enda omafiku atatu mombuwa yaEtam ndele va onga onhanda muMara.
Ndele va fikama muMara ndele ve uya kuElim. Ndele muElim mwa kala eefifiya domeva omulongo nambali nomilunga, omilongo heyali, ndele oko va onga onhanda.
Ndele va fikama muElim ndele va onga onhanda pEfuta Litilyana.
Ndele va fikama pEfuta Litilyana ndele va onga onhanda mombuwa yaSin.
Ndele va fikama mombuwa yaSin ndele va onga onhanda muDofka.
Ndele va fikama muDofka ndele va onga onhanda muAlus.
Ndele va fikama muAlus ndele va onga onhanda muRefidim. Ndelenee oko inaku kala nande omeva ovanhu va nwe.
Ndele vo ova fikama muRefidim ndele va onga onhanda mombuwa yaSinai.
Ndele va fikama mombuwa yaSinai ndele va onga onhanda muKibrot-Hattava.
Ndele va fikama muKibrot-Hattava ndele va onga onhanda muHaserot.
Ndele va fikama muHaserot ndele va onga onhanda muRitma.
Ndele va fikama muRitma ndele va onga onhanda muRimmon-Peres.
Ndele va fikama muRimmon-Peres ndele va onga onhanda muLibna.
Ndele va fikama muLibna ndele va onga onhanda muRissa.
Ndele va fikama muRissa ndele va onga onhanda muKehelata.
Ndele va fikama muKehelata ndele va onga onhanda pomhunda yaSefor.
Ndele va fikama pomhunda yaSefor ndele va onga onhanda muHarada.
Ndele va fikama muHarada ndele va onga onhanda muMakhelot.
Ndele va fikama muMakhelot ndele va onga onhanda muTahat.
Ndele va fikama muTahat ndele va onga onhanda muTera.
Ndele va fikama muTera ndele va onga onhanda muMitka.
Ndele va fikama muMitka ndele va onga onhanda muHasmona.
Ndele va fikama muHasmona ndele va onga onhanda muMoserot.
Ndele va fikama muMoserot ndele va onga onhanda muBene-Jaakan.
Ndele va fikama muBene-Jaakan ndele va onga onhanda muHor-Hagidgad.
Ndele va fikama muHor-Hagidgad ndele va onga onhanda muJotbata.
Ndele va fikama muJotbata ndele va onga onhanda muAbrona.
Ndele va fikama muAbrona ndele va onga onhanda muEsion-Geber.
Ndele va fikama muEsion-Geber ndele va onga onhanda mombuwa yaSin, nokutya Kades.
Ndele va fikama muKades ndele va onga onhanda pomhunda yaHor, pomunghulo woshilongo shaEdom.
Opo nee omupristeli Aron okwa londa komhunda Hor palombwelo lOmwene, ndele oko a fila momudo omutimilongo nhee ovana vaIsrael eshi va dja medu laEgipiti, mohani onhinhano mefiku lotete lohani.
Ndele omido daAron da li di fike pefele nomilongo mbali nanhatu ye eshi a fila komhunda yaHor.
Omukaanan ohamba yaArad, ei ya kala moshilongo shaumbuwanhu medu laKaanan, oya uda ovana vaIsrael ve uya.
Ndele vo ova fikama momhunda yaHor ndele va onga onhanda muSalmona.
Ndele va fikama muSalmona ndele va onga onhanda muPunon.
Ndele va fikama muPunon ndele va onga onhanda muObot.
Ndele va fikama muObot ndele va onga onhanda muIiye-Abarim, pongaba yaMoab.
Ndele va fikama muIyim ndele va onga onhanda muDibon-Gad.
Ndele va fikama muDibon-Gad ndele va onga onhanda muAlmon-Diblataim.
Ndele va fikama muAlmon-Diblataim ndele va onga onhanda peemhunda daAbarim, komesho yaNebo.
Ndele va fikama keemhunda daAbarim ndele va onga onhanda momaluhaela aMoab puJordan monhele ya shaama naJeriko.
Ndele vo ova onga onhanda puJordan okudja muBet-Jesimot fiyo okuAbel-Shittim momaluhaela aMoab.
NOmwene okwa popya naMoses momaluhaela aMoab pomulonga waJordan popepi naJeriko, ndee ta ti:
Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo: “Nye ngeenge tamu tauluka Jordan mokuya medu laKaanan,
nye mu nokutaataa oonakukalamo aveshe vedu komesho yeni nokuhanauna po oihongwafano yavo. Nosho yo mu nokuhanauna po oitelekwafano yavo aishe nokutokeka oikulundu yavo yokuyambela.
Ndele nye mu nokunangala edu nokukala mo, osheshi Ame nde mu pa edu olo li ninge leni.

Ndele nye mu nokutaula edu olo efyuululwa pamapata eni. Kepata linene oshitukulwafyuululwa tashi ka ninga shinene, ndee kepata linini oshitukulwafyuululwa tashi ka ninga shinini. Oshihoololifo ngaashi tashi ulikile epata keshe, osho nye mu nokutaulilafana edu oitukulwafyuululwa.

Ndelenee nye ngeenge itamu taataa mo komesho yeni oonakukalamo moshilongo vo ava tamu va fii po, tava ka ninga omakiya momesho eni nongaashi eengona meemhati, ndele tave ke mu hepeka moshilongo omo tamu kala.
Opo nee ohandi ke mu ningila ngaashi nde shi diladila.”
34: NOmwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo: Nye eshi tamu uya medu laKaanan, edu olo tuu olo tali ka ninga oshitukulwafyuululwa sheni, edu laKaanan peengaba dalo.
Ombinga yeni yokoumbuwanhu i nokweenda okudja kombuwa yaSin nokukunghula naEdom. Nongaba yeni yokoumbuwanhu tai ka hovela kombinga yokoushilo kexulilo lEfuta lOmongwa;
ongaba yeni nai dingunuke Akrabim nokuyuka koumbuwanhu nokuya lwokuSin fiyo tai xulile oumbuwanhu waKades-Barnea. Opo nee tai i kuHasar-Addar nofiyo okuAsmon.
Ongaba tai dingunuka okudja kuAsmon fiyo okokamulonga kaEgipiti ndee tai xulile mEfuta Lopokati.
Efuta nali ninge ongaba yeni kombinga yokouninginino. Oyo hano ongaba yeni yokouninginino.
Nongaba yeni yokOumbangalanhu oyei: Okudja kEfuta Lopokati mu nokufinda omufinda wongaba yeni fiyo okomhunda yaHor.
Okudja komhunda yaHor mu nokufinda omufinda wongaba fiyo okoko taku iwa kuHamat. Nongaba i nokuxulila muSedad.
Opo nee ongaba tai ende kuSifron ndele i nokuxulila muHasar-Enan. Oyo hano ongaba yeni yokOumbangalanhu.
Natango ngaashi ongaba yeni yokoushilo omufinda u nokufindwa okudja kuHasar-Enan fiyo okuSefam.
Nongaba nai ende okudja kuSefam okuRibla, koushilo waAin; opo nee ongaba tai kulukile ndee tai tauluka ominghulo defuta Kinneret kombinga yokoushilo.
Ongaba i nokweenda vali kuJordan fiyo tai xulile mEfuta lOmongwa. Olo hano edu leni pakudingilila kweengaba dalo.”
Ndele Moses okwa lombwela ovana vaIsrael ndee ta ti: “Edu olo tuu olo nye tamu ke li tukulilafana pashihoololifo, ngaashi Omwene a tongele li pewe omapata omugoi netata lepata.
Osheshi epata lOvarubeni pamaludi avo, nepata lOvagad pamaludi avo, netata lepata laManasse ova mona ashishe, vo va pewa oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo.
Omapata aa avali netata lepata ova mona oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo kombinga yokoushilo waJordan monhele ya shaama naJeriko, koushilo.”
NOmwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Omadina ovalumenhu ava tave ke mu tukulila oitukulwafyuululwa yeni oyaa: Omupristeli Eliaser naJosua yaNun.
Napa wedelwe omukulunhu womepata keshe okutukula edu efyuululo.”
Nomadina ovalumenhu oyaa: Mepata laJuda: oKaleb yaJefunne.
Ndele mepata lovana vaSimeon: oSemuel yaAmmihud,
mepata laBenjamin: oElidad yaKislon,
mepata lovana vaDan omukulunhu oBukki yaJogli.
Movana vaJosef, mepata lovana vaManasse omukulunhu: oHanniel yaEfod.
Ndele mepata lovana vaEfraim omukulunhu: oKemuel yaSiftan.
Ndele mepata lovana vaSebulon omukulunhu: oElisafan yaParnah.
Ndele mepata lovana vaIsaskar omukulunhu: oPaltiel yaAssan.
Ndele mepata lovana vaAsser omukulunhu oAhihud yaSelomi.
Ndele mepata lovana vaNaftali omukulunhu: oPedael yaAmmihud.
Ovo tuu ava Omwene e va lombwela va tukulile ovana vaIsrael medu laKaanan omafyuululo.
35: NOmwene okwa popya naMoses momaluhaela aMoab puJordan, monhele ya shaama naJeriko, ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael va pe Ovalevi moitukulwafyuululwa yavo oilando va kale muyo; noulifilo ou wa dingilila oilando nave u pewe yo.
Noilando ei nai ninge eenhele davo dokukala mo. Ndelenee oulifilo wayo tau ningi woimuna yavo nowoinima yavo noweengobe davo.
Noulifilo woilando tamu i pe Ovalevi u nokuhanga omaludimbo eyovi limwe okuyeleka kohotekuma yoshilando keembinga adishe doshilando.

Ndele pondje kombada yoshilando yelekeni kombinga yokoushilo omaludimbo omayovi avali nokombinga yokoumbuwanhu omaludimbo omayovi avali nokombinga yokoumbangalanhu omaludimbo omayovi avali nokombinga omayovi avali, ndele oshilando tashi kala pokatielela. Onhele ei oyo oulifilo woilando.
“Ndele oilando ei tamu i Ovalevi ihamano tai ka ninga oihondamenolando ei mu noku i yandja, opo omudipai womunhu a shiive oku ka hondama mo. Ndele kwaai mu nokuweda ko oilando omilongo nhee naivali.
Oilando aishe ei nye tamu i yandje kOvalevi oi li oilando omilongo nhee naihetatu, yo kumwe noulifilo wayo.

Ndele oilando ei yOvaisraeli mu noku i yandja, momapata manene, namu kufwe ihapu ndele mwaa manini, namu kufwe inini. Hano epata keshe nali pe Ovalevi oilando i fike pwaai i li moshitukulwafyuululwa shalo.”
Omwene okwa popya vali naMoses ndee ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye kuvo: ‘Nye eshi tamu tauluka Jordan mokuya kedu laKaanan,
mu nokulihoololela oilando i li meenhele da yeleka, yo otai ningi oihondamenolando yeni, opo omudipai, ou a dipaa omunhu ohaluka, a shiive okuhondama muyo.
Noilando oyo nai kale omwaameni wokukelela omupuli wetimba, opo ou a dipaa, aha dipawe, eendjovo daye fimbo inadi tokolwa moipafi yeongalo.
Nomuvalu woilando oyo tamu va pe, ihamano oihondamenolando.
Oilando itatu mu noku i hoolola moushilo waJordan naitatu yomuyo omedu laKaanan. Oyo i nokukala oihondamenolando.
Mokati keni oilando ei ihamano oyo oihondamenolando yovana vaIsrael noyomunailongo noyomwiidililwamo, opo keshe umwe ou a dipaa omunhu ohaluka, ta shiiva okuhondama mo.
“Ndelenee ngeenge te mu denge noshivela, nomunhu ta fi, opo nee ye omudipaielela e nokufya shili.
Ndele ngeenge te mu denge nemanya li li meke, li shii kudipaa omunhu, nomunhu ta fi, opo nee ye omudipaielela. Omudipaielela e nokufya shili.
Ile ngeenge te mu denge noshiti shi li meke, shi shii kudipaa omunhu, nomunhu ta fi, opo nee ye omudipaielela. Omudipaielela e nokufya shili.
Omupuli wetimba e nokudipaa omudipaielela. Ye eshi te mu hange, ye e noku mu dipaa.
Ile umwe ngeenge te mu tu mehandu ile te mu kupula owina, e mu dipae, nomunhu ta fi,
ile te mu denge mehandu enghava, nomunhu ta fi, opo ou a denga, e nokudipawa shili. Ye omudipaielela. Omupuli wetimba e noku mu dipaa ngeenge e mu mono.
“Ndelenee ye ngeenge te mu kupula sha ohaluka, ehe nehandu ile te mu kupula sha ehe nehalo e mu dipae.
Ile ye ngeenge te mu kupula emanya, li shii oku mu dipaa, ndee ta fi, ye ine mu handukila, ye kakwa li a hala oku mu dipaa,
opo nee eongalo li nokutokola pamakululomhango aa pokati kaau a dipaa nomupuli wetimba.

Neongalo li nokuxupifa ou a dipaa nomake omupuli wetimba, neongalo nali efe a shune moshihondamenolando shaye, omo a ya onhapo. Ndele ye e nokukala ko fiyo okefyo lomupristeli omukulunhu ou a vaekwa nomaadi mayapuki.
Ndelenee omudipai ngeenge ta tauluka ongaba yoshihondamenolando omo a ya onhapo,
nomupuli wetimba te mu hange pondje yongaba yoshihondamenolando shaye, nomupuli wetimba te mu dipaa, opo nee ye ke netimba.

Osheshi winya e nokukala moshihondamenolando shaye fiyo okefyo lomupristeli omukulunhu. Ndelenee konima yefyo lomupristeli omukulunhu, omudipai ta dulu okushuna koshilongo omo oshitukulwafyuululwa shaye shi li.
Oyo nai ninge onghedimhango mokutokola momapata eni meenhele deni adishe.
