Ndelenee lungameni shili mu kukume eshi sha yapulilwa ehanauno, muha hangike ketulomutima, ngeenge tamu kufa sha shomoinima ya yapulilwa okuhanaunwa po, nena otamu twala onhanda yaIsrael koshi yetulomutima ndele tamu i etele omupya.
Ndelenee oshisiliveli ashishe noshingoldo noinima yoshikushu noyoshivela, oya yapulilwa Omwene, nai tulwe memona lOmwene.”

Opo nee ovanhu va ingida unene ndele va shika omanghuma. Oshiwana eshi sha uda ondaka yenghuma, osha lokosha pombada. Nohotekuma ya ngumauka po monhele yayo, ndele ovanhu va londa va ya moshilando, keshe umwe a yukilila, ndele va nangala oshilando.
Naashishe eshi sha li moshilando, ove shi dipaa neongamukonda, omulumenhu nomukainhu, omunyasha nomukulunhu fiyo okongobe nodi nondongi.
Ndele Josua okwa lombwela ovalumenhu venya vavali va lavele oshilongo ta ti: “Indeni meumbo lombwada ndele pitifeni mo omukainhu naaveshe ava ve li puye, ngaashi mwe mu anena.”
Ovalumenhu ovanyasha, eendadi, ova ya mo, ndele va pitifa mo Rahab naxe naina novamwaina naaveshe va li puye, novakwapata vaye aveshe ove va pitifa mo ndele ve va kaleka pondje yonhanda yaIsrael.
Noshilando naashishe sha li mo ve shi xwika po nomundilo. Oshisiliveli ashike noshingoldo noinima yoshikushu noyoshivela ve i weda kemona lOmwene.
Ndelenee Josua okwa efa Rahab neumbo laye naaveshe va li puye va kale nomwenyo. Opo ye a kala mokati kaIsrael fiyo onena eli, shaashi okwa holeka eendadi dinya da tuminwe kuJosua okulava Jeriko.

Mefimbo tuu olo Josua okwa anifa eano neendjovo edi: “Na fingwe koshipala shOmwene omulumenhu ou ta ka hovela okutungulula oshilando eshi shaJeriko.
Mokutunga kwaye ekanghameno
oshiveli shaye nashi fye
ndele mokutula mo oivelo
onghelo nai fye.”
NOmwene okwa li pamwe naJosua. Netumbalo laye ola ya nedu alishe.
7: Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael ova nyona eaneno lavo mokukufa moinima ya tokolelwa ehanauno. Osheshi Akan yaKarmi yaSabdi yaSera womepata laJuda okwa kufa moinima ya tokolelwa ehanauno, onghee hano ehandu lOmwene la xwamena ovana vaIsrael.

Opo nee Josua okwa tuma ovalumenhu va dja kuJeriko va ye kuAi, shi li puBet-Aven koushilo waBetel, ndele ye okwa popya navo, ndele ta ti: “Indeni mu ka lave oshilongo.” Novalumenhu va ya ndele va lava Ai.

Vo eshi va aluka kuJosua, ove mu hokololela: “Oshiwana ashishe itashi pumbwa okuya ko, shapu ovalumenhu omayovi avali ile omayovi atatu otava dulu okuya, ndele tava ka ta Ai. Inamu monifa omatanga aeshe ovakwaita oixuna, osheshi venya ve li ko ovanini.”
Opo nee ovanhu kashiimba ve fike pomayovi atatu va ya ko. Ndelenee vo va li ve nokuya onhapo komesho yovalumenhu vaAi.

Novalumenhu vokuAi ova dipaa muvo ovalumenhu ngeno omilongo nhatu navahamano, ndele ve va shikula okudja koshivelo fiyo okuSebarim, ndele ve va taataa fiyo opefina lomhunda. Nomitima dovanhu da mbadapala ndele da talala.
Opo nee Josua okwa pombaula oikutu yaye nokwa wila eombe komesho yoshikefa shOmwene fiyo onguloshi ye novakulunhu vaIsrael, ndele ve lifundila edu komitwe.

Ndele Josua okwa tya: “Akutu Omwene, Kalunga, omolwashike wa taulukifa ovanhu ava Jordan, ove u tu yandje momake Ovaamori, opo va shiive oku tu mana po sheke? Ngeno twa tokolele tu kale langhele kombinga inya yaJordan!
Akutu Omwene, ame ohandi ti shike, Ovaisraeli eshi va pa ovatondadi vavo ombuda?
NOvakaanan noonakukalamo aveshe vomoshilongo ngeenge tave shi udu, otave tu dingilile ndele tava dimi po edina letu kombada yedu. Ove oto ka ninga shike omolwedina loye linene?”
Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Josua: “Fikama! Omolwashike wa wila eombe?
Israel okwa nyona ndele a tauluka ehangano lange, eli nde li ninga navo, ndele okwa kufa yo moinima ya tokolelwa ehanauno ndele a vaka ndele meholeko e i tula moinima yaye.

Novana vaIsrael itava dulu vali okulipopila moipafi yovatondadi vavo. Otave ke va faduka po, osheshi voovene ve lilongela ehanauno. Ame ihandi ka kala vali pamwe nanye, fimbo nye inamu kufa mo mokati keni eshi sha tokolelwa ehanauno.

Penduka! Yapula ovanhu u tye: ‘Liyapuleni ongula, osheshi Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha: Mokati keni, Israel, omu noinima ya tokolelwa ehanauno! Nye itamu dulu okulipopila moipafi yovatondadi veni fimbo inamu kufa po mokati keni oshinima sha tongolelwa ehanauno.’

Ileni hano ongula inene pamapata eni. Nepata olo tali hoololwa kOmwene, li nokuuya pamaludi. Noludi tali hoololwa kOmwene, li nokuuya pamaumbo. Neumbo tali hoololwa kOmwene, li nokuuya ovalumenhu valo umwe naumwe.
Ndele ou a monika e noinima ya tongolelwa ehanauno, e nokuxwikwa po nomundilo, ye naaveshe ava ve li puye, osheshi ye okwa tauluka ehangano lOmwene nokwa ninga oshilonga shefifohoni muIsrael.”
Ndele Josua okwa meneka nOvaisraeli ve uya pamapata. Nepata laJuda la hoololwa.
Ye eshi a ongaleka omaludi Omujuda, oludi lOvasargi ola hoololwa. Ye eshi a ongaleka oludi lOvasargi ovalumenhu umwe naumwe, Sabdi a hoololwa.
Ye eshi a ongaleka eumbo laye umwe na umwe, Akan yaKarmi yaSabdi yaSera womepata laJuda a hoololwa.
Opo nee Josua okwa lombwela Akan ndele ta ti: “Omumwange, fimaneka Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael noku mu pa ehambelelo, ndele hepaululile nge eshi we shi ninga. Ino shi holeka nge.”
Opo nee Akan okwa nyamukula Josua ndele ta ti: “Oshili, ame nda nyona kOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael, nda ninga ngaha.

Onda mona moixuulwa oshikutu shiwa shokombada shokuSinear noshisiliveli shi fike peekilograma mbali; oingoldo i fike peegrama omafele atano; ame nde i haluka ndele nde i kufa, ndele tala, yo oi li metwali lange ya fudikwa medu noshisiliveli koshi.”
Josua a tuma ovatumwa ndele va ya ketwali, noinima oya li metwali laye ya fudikwa noshisiliveli koshi.
Ndele vo ve i kufa mo metwali ndele ve i twala kuJosua nokovana aveshe vaIsrael, ndele ve i tula koshipala shOmwene.

Opo nee Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye ova kufa Akan yaSera pamwe noshisiliveli noshikutu shokombada nokaila yoshingoldo novana vaye ovalumenhu noukadona neengobe daye neendongi daye needi daye netwali laye naashishe shaye ndele vo ve i twala kefilu laAkor.

Ndele Josua okwa tya: “Omolwashike we tu twala momupya! Omwene ote ke ku twala nena eli momupya?” Opo nee Ovaisraeli aveshe ve mu dipaa nomamanya ndele vo ove va xwika po nomundilo, ndele ve va kupula nomamanya.
Ndele vo ove mu ndubila onduba inene yomamanya ei i li po fiyo onena eli. Opo nee Omwene okwa handukuluka koupyuhandu waye. Onghee hano onhele inya otai ifanwa fiyo onena eli Efilu laAkor.
8: Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Josua ndele ta ti: “Ino tila, ino mbadapala! Kufa omatanga aeshe ovakwaita pamwe naave, fikama inda kuAi. Tala, ohandi yandje momake oye ohamba yaAi novanhu vayo noshilando shayo noshilongo shayo.
Ndele ove u nokuninga Ai nohamba yasho ngaashi wa ningile Jeriko nohamba yasho. Ashike oixuulwa yasho noimuna yasho otamu i litinhile. Tula ehonyeno konima yoshilando.”
Opo nee Josua okwa fikama pamwe nomatanga aeshe ovakwaita a ka homone Ai. Ndele Josua okwa hoolola ovalumenhu ovakwanyati omayovi omilongo nhatu nokwe va tuma ko oufiku.
Ndele ye okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Taleni, nye mu nokutula ehonyeno konima yoshilando. Inamu ya kokule moshilando ndele kaleni nye amushe mwe lilongekida.
Ndele ame nomatanga aeshe ovakwaita ava ve li pwaame, fye ohatu ke uya koshilando. Vo eshi tava di mo oku tu lwifa ngaashi shito, fye ohatu ke va ya onhapo.
Ndele vo otave tu shikula fiyo fye twe va ehenifa kokule noshilando, osheshi vo otava ka diladila: Venya tave tu i onhapo ngaashi shito. Ndele fye ohatu ke va ya onhapo.
Opo nee nye mu nokudja mo mehonyeno nokutotela oshilando, osheshi Omwene Kalunga keni ote ke shi mu pa.
Ndele nye ngeenge mwa totela oshilando mu noku shi tomeka, pandjovo yOmwene mu noku shi ninga. Taleni, ame ohandi shi mu lombwele.”
Osho ngaha hano Josua okwe va tuma ko, ndele vo ova ya kehonyeno ndele va kala pokati kaBetel naAi, kombinga yokouninginino waAi. Ndelenee Josua okwa li oufiku winya pamwe novanhu.
Josua okwa meneka nokwa ongela omatanga ovakwaita nokwa ya pamwe novakulunhu vaIsrael komesho yomatanga kuAi.

Ndele omatanga aeshe ovakwaita aa a li puye a fikama ndele a ehena ndele a fika komesho yoshilando. Ndele vo ova onga onhanda kombinga yokoumbangalanhu woshilando shaAi. Efilu ola li pokati kavo naAi.
Osho ngaha hano ye okwa kufa ngeno ovakwaita omayovi atano nokwe va tula mehonyeno pokati kaBetel naAi kombinga yokouninginino woshilando.

Ndele vo ova tula ovakwaita, onhanda aishe mekondekelo kombinga yokoumbangalanhu woshilando neengudu dao dokonima kombinga yokouninginino woshilando, ndelenee Josua okwa ya oufiku winya pokati kefilu.

Nohamba yaAi eshi ye shi mona, ovalumenhu vomoshilando ova endelela ongula inene, ndele yo oya dja mo ya ka shakeneka Israel molwoodi, yo nomatanga ayo aeshe ovakwaita monhele ya pangelwa poluhaela. Ndelenee yo inai shiiva nokutya, opa li ehonyeno konima yoshilando shayo.
Ndele Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe ve lifefa va dengwa ndele ova faduka po Ovaai ndele tava yuka langhele kombuwa.
Opo nee ovanhu aveshe vomoshilando va shiiva oku va shikula. Ndelenee fimbo tava shikula Josua oshilando sha fyaala kokule navo.
MuAi nomuBetel inamu kala nande umwe, ou ina dja mo a ka taatae Ovaisraeli. Ndele va efa oshilando sha yeululwa ndele va shikula Israel.
Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Josua ndele ta ti: “Eonga li li meke loye li nanena Ai, osheshi Ame nda hala oku shi yandja meke loye.” Opo nee Josua okwa nanena oshilando eonga la li meke laye.
Nomatanga ovakwaita aa, a li mehonyeno okwa fikama diva monhele yao ndele a tota, eshi a mona ye a nana eke laye, ndele enya a ya mo moshilando ndele e shi kwata ndele a tomeka diva oshilando.

Opo nee ovalumenhu vaAi, eshi va tala konima yavo, ova mona omwifi womoshilando nhumbi tau litumbu keulu. Ndelenee va li vehe na nande omhito yokufaduka po, ngee oko ile kwinya, osheshi omatanga ovakwaita ava va ya onhapo kombuwa, ova piluka ndele va lwifa ovataatai vavo.
Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe eshi va mona nokutya ovakwaita vomehonyeno va kwata oshilando ndele omwifi womoshilando tau litumbu pombada, ova aluka ndele ve lidengifa ovalumenhu vaAi.

Opo nee venya ova dja moshilando nokushakena navo, opo Ovaai ova kondekelwa pokati kOvaisraeli, vamwe kombinga ei vakwao kombinga inya. Ndelenee vo ove va ta fiyo inapa kala nande umwe a xupifwa ile a ya onhapo.
Ndelenee vo ova kwata ohamba yaAi, ndele ve i twala i nomwenyo kuJosua.

Ovaisraeli eshi va dipaa neongamukonda ovanhu vaAi aveshe ava va li moluhaela nomombuwa oko ve va taataela, ndele venya aveshe va fya fiyo okomulumenhu waxuuninwa, opo nee Ovaisraeli aveshe va aluka ndele va ya kuAi ndele venya va hanga mo ove va dipaa neongamukonda.
Naaveshe ava va fya mefiku olo, ovalumenhu novakainhu, ova li ve fike pomayovi omulongo nomayovi avali, oonakukalamo aveshe muAi.
Ndele Josua ina shunifa poshi eke laye li neonga, fimbo oonakukalamo muAi aveshe inava pwa po okudipawa.
Ovaisraeli ove litinhila oimuna aike noixuulwa ei ya monika moshilando palombwelo lOmwene, ngaashi Ye a lombwela Josua.
Opo nee Josua okwa xwika po Ai nokwe shi ninga onduba yomakuma fiyo alushe, ofuka fiyo onena eli.

Ndele ohamba yaAi ye okwe i endjelelifa momuti fiyo okonguloshi. Ndelenee etango eshi tali ningine mo, Josua okwe va lombwela ndele va kufa ko komuti oshimhu shayo ndele ve shi ekela poshivelo shoshilando ndele ve shi ndubila onduba inene yomamanya, ei i li ko nonena eli.
Opo nee Josua okwa tungila Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael oaltari komhunda yaEbal,

ngaashi Moses, omupiya wOmwene, a lombwelele ovana vaIsrael, nongaashi sha shangelwa membo lomhango yaMoses nokutya: “Oaltari ya tungwa nomamanya inaa hongwa,” aa inaa kumwa koshilongifo shoshivela. Ndele kusho va yambela Omwene omaxwikiloyambo ndele va toma omapanduloyambo.
Ndele oko ye okwa shangela momamanya omushangululwa womhango yaMoses, ei ye okwe i shangela ovana vaIsrael,

fimbo Ovaisraeli aveshe pamwe novakulunhu vavo novapashukili vavo novatokoli vavo va kala ofika kombinga nombinga yoshikefa, va shaama novapristeli Ovalevi, ovahumbati voshikefa shehangano lOmwene, heeno, omunailongo ngaashi omudalelwamo moshilongo, etata limwe lavo la taalela komhunda yaGerisim, netata likwao la taalela komhunda yaEbal, ngaashi Moses, omupiya wOmwene, a lombwelele shito oshiwana shaIsrael shi nangekwe noupuna.
Opo nee ye okwa lesha eendjovo adishe domhango, enangeko noupuna netulomutima, naanaa ngaashi da shangelwa membo lomhango.
Meendjovo odo da tongwa kuMoses inamu kala nande imwe Josua ine i leshela oshiongalele ashishe shaIsrael, pamwe novalikadi nounona novanailongo ava va enda pamwe navo.
9: Ndele eehamba adishe odo da kala mouninginino waJordan, keemhunda nokepumbu nomomunghulo aushe wEfuta Lopokati kombinga yokuLibanon nokutya, Ovaheti, Ovaamori, Ovakaanan, Ovaperesi, Ovahevi nOvajebusi, eshi ve shi uda,
ova ongala kumwe va ka lwife Josua naIsrael ngaashi omulumenhu umwe.
Ndelenee oonakukalamo muGibeon, eshi va uda eshi Josua a ningila Jeriko naAi,
navo yo ova kengelela: vo ova ya ve liningifa ovatumwa ndele va mangela keendongi omakutu a kulupa nomakutu a kulupa omaviinyu aa a pombauka ndele a vandekwa,
ndele va djala keemhadi davo eenghaku da kulupa da vandekwa nokomalutu avo oikutu ya kulupa. Nomingome davo adishe nonghuta oda kukuta noda ninga oupambu.
Osho ngaha ova ya kuJosua konhanda yomuGilgal ndele va lombwela Josua novalumenhu vaIsrael ndele tava ti: “Fye ohatu di koshilongo shokokule. Ninga paife ehangano nafye.”
Ndelenee ovalumenhu vaIsrael va lombwela Ovahevi: “Kashiimba tamu kala mokati ketu, ohatu dulu ngahelipi okuninga ehangano nanye?”
Opo nee vo va lombwela Josua: “Fye ovapiya voye!” Opo nee Josua okwe va pula ta ti: “Onye oolyelye, otamu di peni?”
Ndele vo ove mu lombwela: “Ovapiya voye otava di moshilongo shokokule unene omolwedina lOmwene Kalunga koye. Osheshi fye otwa uda eenghundana daye naashishe Ye e shi ningile muEgipiti,
naashishe Ye e shi ningila eehamba odo mbali dOvaamori langhele kwinya yaJordan nokutya, Sihon, ohamba yaHesbon, naOg, ohamba yaBasan, ei ya li muAstarot.

Onghee hano ovakulunhu vetu noonakukalamo aveshe vomoshilongo shetu va popya nafye ndele tava ti: Kufeni onghuta, indeni mu ke va shakeneke ndele va lombweleni: Fye ovapiya veni, ningeni hano paife ehangano nafye.
Tala, omungome wetu, oo wa li upyu, eshi twe u kufa onghuta momaumbo etu, eshi twa fikama tu uye kunye, ndelenee tala, paife oo wa kukuta ndele wa ninga oupambu.
Nomakutu omaviinyu aa a li mape, eshi twe a yadifa, ndelenee tala, oyaa a pombauka. Noikutu ei yetu neenghaku detu, oda kulupa omolwolweendo lile unene.”
Opo nee ovalumenhu va kufa monghuta yavo. Ndelenee vo inava pula omayele kOmwene.
Ndele Josua okwa panga ombili navo nokwa ninga ehangano navo, nokutya ye e va efa va kale nomwenyo. Novakulunhu veongalo ove shi va udanekela nokwaana.
Ndelenee omafiku atatu eshi a pita, ehangano navo eshi la ningwa, ovanhu va uda nokutya, venya ohava kala moushiinda wavo nomokati kavo.
Osheshi ovana vaIsrael ova dja po ndele va fika koilando yaavenya mefiku etitatu. Oilando yaavenya ya li: Gibeon naKefira naBeerot naKiriat-Jearim.
Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael inave va dipaa, osheshi ovakulunhu veongalo ve va anena kOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael. Eongalo alishe ola ngongotela ovakulunhu.
Opo nee ovakulunhu aveshe va lombwela eongalo alishe: “Fye vene twe va anena kOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael. Onghee ihatu dulu oku va kuma paife.
Ndelenee natu va ningeni ngaha, fye eshi twe va efa va kale nomwenyo, opo ehandu lihe tu hange molweano twe li va anena.
Novakulunhu ve va tonga, tava ti: Nava kale nomwenyo, ndelenee nava ninge ovatyavi voikuni novateki vomeva keongalo alishe,” ovakulunhu ngaashi ve va lombwelela.
Opo nee Josua e va shiva ndele a tonga navo ndele ta ti: “Omolwashike nye mwe tu kengelela eshi mwe tu lombwela: Fye ohatu kala kokule nanye, nande tamu kala mokati ketu?
Hano paife nye mwa tulwa omutima! Ndele fiyo alushe tamu ka kala okulongela ongulu yaKalunga kange, ovapiya ovatyavi voikuni novateki vomeva.”

Opo nee va nyamukula Josua ndele tava ti: “Ovapiya voye va hepaululilwa nokutya, Omwene Kalunga koye a lombwela Moses, omupiya waye, e mu pe edu alishe eli nokuhanauna po oonakukalamo aveshe komesho yeni, onghee hano fye otwa li twe mu tila unene molwokukalamwenyo kwetu ndele twa ninga oshinima eshi.
Ndelenee apa tu li po hano momake oye, tu ningila hano osho shiwa nosha yuka momesho oye.”
Ye osho e va ningila nokwe va xupifa momake ovana vaIsrael vo vehe va dipae po.
Osho ngaha hano Josua e va ninga ovatyavi voikuni novateki vomeva keongalo nokoaltari yOmwene fiyo onena eli monhele tuu oyo Ye e nokuhoolola.
10: Ndele Adoni-Sedek, ohamba yaJerusalem, eshi ya uda nokutya, Josua okwa teya Ai nokwe shi yapulila ehanauno ngaashi a ningile yo Jeriko nohamba yasho, osho a ninga yo Ai nohamba yasho, ndele oonakukalamo muGibeon va panga ombili nOvaisraeli ndele va li mokati kavo,
vo ova tila unene, osheshi Gibeon sha li oshilando shinene, ngaashi shimwe shomoilando yeehamba, ndele eshi sha li shinene shi dule Ai, ndele ovalumenhu vasho aveshe va li ovaladi.
Adoni-Sedek, ohamba yaJerusalem, okwa tuma kuHoham, ohamba yaHebron nokuPiream, ohamba yaJarmut, nokuJafia, ohamba yaLakis nokuDebir, ohamba yaEglon, tai ti:
“Ileni kwaame, mu kwafe nge, tu shiive okuteya po Gibeon, sho eshi sha panga ombili naJosua novana vaIsrael.”

Osho ngaha hano eehamba nhano dOvaamori oda ongala ndele da fikama: ohamba yaJerusalem, ohamba yaHebron, ohamba yaJarmut, ohamba yaLakis, ohamba yaEglon, odo pamwe nomatanga ado ovakwaita aveshe. Do oda fitikinina Gibeon ndele de shi lwifa.

Ndelenee ovalumenhu vomuGibeon va tuma kuJosua konhanda yomuGilgal va tya: “Ino kufa po omake oye povapiya voye. Ila diva kufye u tu xupife ndele u tu kwafe, osheshi eehamba adishe dOvaamori odo di li meemhunda, ova ongala ve tu lwife.”
Opo nee Josua okwa fikama a dja muGilgal, ye nomatanga aeshe ovakwaita novaladi aveshe pamwe naye.
Ndele Omwene okwa lombwela Josua ta ti: “Ino va tila, osheshi Ame ohandi ke va yandja meke loye. Ndele pehe na nande umwe womuvo ta ka dula okulipopila moipafi yoye.”
Opo nee Josua e va dudulukila ye eshi a enda oufiku aushe okudja muGilgal.

NOmwene okwe va dongakanifa moipafi yaIsrael ndele vo ve va lwifa olwoodi linene muGibeon, ndele ve va shikula nondjila oyo tai twala keemhunda daBet-Horon, ndele e va ta fiyo okuAseka nofiyo okuMakkeda.

Ndele vo eshi va ya onhapo Ovaisraeli fimbo va li pefina lomhunda yaBet-Horon, Omwene okwa ufila kombada yavo omamanya eemhawe a dja keulu ondjila aishe fiyo okuAseka, opo vo va fya. Ava va dipawa keemhawe ova li vahapu ve dule ava va dipawa keongamukonda lOvaisraeli.

Mefiku olo Omwene eshi a yandja Ovaamori momake ovana vaIsrael, Josua okwa popya nOmwene ndele a tile moipafi yOvaisraeli:
“Etango, kanghama muGibeon!
Nohani mefilu laAijalon!”

Opo nee etango la kanghama nohani ya kala inai linyenga fiyo ovanhu va mana okukwatela ovatondadi vavo onghone. Inali shangwa hamba mEmbo laJashar? Netango ola kanghama pokati keulu efiku alishe ndele inali endelela okuningina.
Ndele inapa kala nande efiku limwe la fefiku olo, komesho ile konima yalo, Omwene ngeno a uda ondaka yomunhu. Osheshi Omwene okwa kondjela Ovaisraeli.
Opo nee Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye va shuna konhanda yomuGilgal.
Ndelenee eehamba dinya nhano oda faduka po ndele da hondama mekololo lomuMakkeda.
Opo nee Josua eshi a shiivifilwa kwa tiwa: Eehamba dinya nhano oda monika, oda hondama mekololo lomuMakkeda,
Josua ota ti: “Alangatifileni kombululu yekololo omamanya manene ndele tuleni ko ovalumenhu ve va nangele.

Ndelenee nye inamu kanghama. Ovatondadi veni va taataeni noku va shikula, ndele omatanga avo okonima a tetei ko. Inamu va efa va ye moilando yavo, osheshi Omwene Kalunga keni ote va yandje momake eni.”
Ndele Josua novana vaIsrael eshi ve va dipaa po sheke molwoodi linene fiyo va manwa po, ndele vamwe aveke vomuvo va faduka po ndele va ya koilando i neehotekuma,
omatanga aeshe ovakwaita a aluka kuJosua muMakkeda, inapa kana nande umwe konhanda. Ndele kapa li nande umwe a dula okutonga sha mokupopya ovana vaIsrael.
Opo nee Josua ta ti: “Yeululeni ombululu yekololo ndele eteni eehamba odo nhano domekololo oku kwaame.”
Osho va ninga ndele va eta kuye eehamba odo nhano domekololo nokutya, ohamba yaJerusalem, ohamba yaHebron, ohamba yaJarmut, ohamba yaLakis, ohamba yaEglon.

Ndele eshi va eta kuJosua eehamba odo, Josua okwa ifana ovalumenhu aveshe vaIsrael ndele ta lombwele ovakulunhu novaladi ava va ile koita pamwe naye, ndele ta ti: Eheneni oku popepi, eemhadi deni di paekeni keefingo deehamba edi. Ndele vo ova ehena ko, ndele va paeka eemhadi davo keefingo dado.
Ndele Josua ta ti kuvo: “Inamu tila, inamu fya oumbada. Kaleni mwa pama mwa nyatipala, osheshi osho ngaha Omwene ota ka ningila ovatondadi veni aveshe ava nye tamu ka lwifa.”
Opo nee Josua okwe di dipaa ndele okwe di endjelelifa keengudi nhano. Ndele do oda li da endjelela keengudi fiyo onguloshi.

Ndele etango eshi tali ningine mo Josua okwe va lombwela, di kufwe ko keengudi ndele di ekelwe mo mekololo mulo va li va hondama. Ndele va tula omamanya manene kombululu yekololo, aa e li ko fiyo okonena eli.

Mefiku tuu olo Josua okwa ta yo Makkeda ndele okwa dipaa neongamukonda oonakukalamo. Nohamba yasho noshilando shoovene neemwenyo adishe da li mo okwe di yapulila ehanauno, inava efa nande umwe a xupa po ile a ya onhapo. Nohamba yaMakkeda ye okwe i ningila ngaashi a ningile ohamba yaJeriko.
Opo nee Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye ova fikama, va dja muMakkeda va ya kuLibna, ndele va homona Libna.

NOmwene okwe shi yandja yo pamwe nohamba yasho momake aIsrael. Ndele ve shi lwifa neongamukonda nosho yo va dipaa eemwenyo adishe da li mo. Ye ina efa nande umwe a faduke po, ndele okwa ningila ohamba yasho ngaashi a ningile ohamba yaJeriko.
Opo nee Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye ova dja po puLibna, ndele va ya kuLakis ve ke shi fitikinine noku shi homona.
NOmwene okwa yandja Lakis momake Ovaisraeli. Ye okwe shi ta mefiku etivali, ndele okwa dipaa neongamukonda eemwenyo adishe odo da li mo ngaashi a ningila Libna.
Opo nee Horam, ohamba yaGeser, okwa ya a ka kwafe Lakis, ndelenee Josua okwe mu ta novanhu vaye fiyo inapa kala nande umwe womuvo a ya onhapo.
Opo nee Josua pamwe nOvaisraeli aveshe va dja muLakis ndele va ya kuEglon ve shi fitikinine noku shi homona.
Ndele ve shi ta mefiku tuu olo ndele va dipaa neongamukonda oonakukalamo musho. Neemwenyo adishe da li mo ve di yapulila ehanauno mefiku tuu olo ngaashi va ningila Lakis.
Opo nee Josua nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye va dja muEglon ndele va ya kuHebron ve shi homone.

Ndele ve shi ta ndele va dipaa neongamukonda ohamba yasho noonakukalamo moilando yasho aishe, neemwenyo adishe da li mo. Inapa xupa nande umwe a ya onhapo, naanaa ngaashi a ningila Eglon. Ndele va hanauna oshilando novanhu aveshe vasho.
Opo nee Josua pamwe nOvaisraeli aveshe naye va dja po va ya kuDebir, ve ke shi homone.

Nokwe shi ta pamwe nohamba yasho noilando aishe yasho. Ndele vo ove va dipaa neongamukonda, neemwenyo adishe da li mo ve di yapulila ehanauno. Inapa xupa nande umwe a ya onhapo. Ngaashi a ningila Hebron, osho a ningila yo Debir nohamba yasho ngaashi a ningila Libna nohamba yasho.

Osho ngaha hano Josua okwa nangala oshilongo ashishe, edu leemhunda noshilongo shoumbangalanhu, epumbu neenhele dopopepi neemhunda, neehamba adishe dado. Kapa li nande umwe a xupa a ya onhapo. Ndele keshe eshi shi nomufudo ye okwe shi yapulila ehanauno, Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ngaashi e va lombwela.
Ndele Josua okwa nangala onhele yavo okudja kuKades-Barnea fiyo okuGasa, nedu alishe laGosen fiyo okuGibeon;
neehamba adishe odo noilongo yado Josua okwe i kufa molwoodi limwe alike, osheshi Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael okwa kondjela Israel.
Opo nee Josua nOvaisraeli pamwe naye ova shuna konhanda kuGilgal.
11: Ndele Jabin, ohamba yaHasor, eshi ye shi uda, oya tuma kuJobab, ohamba yaMadon nokohamba yaSimron nokohamba yaAksaf,
navali keehamba dokoumbangalanhu, keemhunda nokepumbu kombinga yokoumbuwanhu kuKinneret nokEfuta Loluhaela nokomutune waDor mouninginino,
kOvakaanan vomoushilo novomouninginino nokOvaamori nokOvaheti nokOvaperesi nokOvajebusi ava ve li keemhunda, nokOvahevi va kalele keemhadi deemhunda daHermon medu laMispa.
Opo nee do oda fikama nomatanga ado aeshe ovakwaita pamwe nado, ovanhu vahapu ve fike pedu lokomunghulo wefuta pamwe neenghambe dihapu nomatemba oita.
Neehamba adishe odo de lipa oshilaye di ongale kumwe ndele da onga onhanda pomeva aMerom opo di lwife Ovaisraeli.

Opo nee Omwene okwa lombwela Josua: “Ino va tila, osheshi mongula mefimbo tuu eli Ame ohandi ke va taataa aveshe noku va yandja kOvaisraeli. Nye mu nokuteta omifipa deemhando deenghambe davo nokuxwika po omatemba avo nomundilo.”
Ndele Josua nomatanga aye aeshe ovakwaita ove va dudulukila pomeva aMerom ndele ve va vakela.

NOmwene okwe va yandja momake Ovaisraeli, opo vo ove va ta noku va shikula fiyo okuSidon-Shinene nofiyo okuMisrefot-Maim nofiyo okoluhaela laMispa shomoushilo, ndele vo ve va dipaa fiyo inapa xupa nande umwe womuvo.
Ndele Josua okwe va ningila ngaashi Omwene e mu lombwela: okwa teta omifipa deemhando deenghambe davo nokwa xwika po omatemba avo oita nomundilo.
Ndele mefimbo tuu linya Josua okwa shuna nokwa nangala Hasor. Ndele okwa dipaa ohamba yasho neongamukonda. Hasor sha li nale onhele yepangelo loilongo inya aishe.
Ndele vo ova dipaa neongamukonda eemwenyo adishe da li mo ndele ve di yapulila ehanauno. Nande umwe ou a li e nomufudo a xupa po; ndele ye okwa xwika po Hasor nomundilo.
Noilando aishe inya yeehamba pamwe neehamba dayo adishe Josua okwa kufa ndele e di dipaa neongamukonda. Ye okwe di yapulila ehanauno ngaashi Moses, omupiya wOmwene e mu lombwela.
Noilando aishe inya aike ya li keemhunda, Ovaisraeli inave i xwika po; Hasor ashike, osho sha xwikwa po kuJosua.
Noixuulwa aishe yoilando inya noimuna, Ovaisraeli ve i litinhila ngaashi oihakanwa. Ovanhu aveke ve va dipaa keongamukonda fiyo ve va mana po. Inava efa nande umwe ou e nomufudo a kale nomwenyo.
Omwene ngaashi a lombwela omupiya waye Moses, osho Moses a lombwela Josua ndele osho ngaha Josua okwa ninga. Ye ina efa nande sha eshi ashishe Omwene a lombwela Moses.
Osho ngaha hano Josua okwa nangala edu olo alishe: eemhunda noshilongo ashishe shokoumbuwanhu nedu alishe laGosen nepumbu nEfuta Loluhaela neemhunda daIsrael nepumbu lado.
Oshitukulwa osha tandavela okudja kOmhunda yaHalak ei tai litumbu langhele kuSeir fiyo okuBaal-Gad, fiyo okefilu laLibanon pefina lomhunda yaHermon.
Josua okwa lwifa eehamba edi efimbo lile. Neehamba dayo adishe okwe di kwata nokwe di dipaa.
Kapa li nande oshilando shimwe sha ninga ombili novana vaIsrael, Ovahevi aveke, oonakukalamo muGibeon. Aishe ve i nangala neenghono dokulwa.
Osheshi Omwene osho a tokola va kale ve likukutika nokulwifa Ovaisraeli, opo va hangike kehanauno, paha kale kuvo nande onghenda, ndelenee va manwe po ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
Ndele mefimbo tuu olo Josua e uya nokwa taataa Ovaanaki keemhunda kuHebron, kuDebir, kuAnab, keemhunda adishe daJuda nokeemhunda adishe daIsrael. Josua okwe va yapulila ehanauno pamwe noilando yavo.
Omuanaki nande umwe a xupa po medu lovana vaIsrael. Ashike muGasa nomuGat nomuAsdod, ova fyaala po.
Osho ngaha hano Josua okwa nangala edu alishe ngaashi Omwene lombwela Moses. Ndele Josua okwe li yandja kOvaisraeli efyuululo keshe epata oshitukulwa shalo. Nedu ola tulumukwa koita.
12: Neehamba odo domoilongo ovana vaIsrael va dipaa noilongo yado ve di nangala kombinga yokoushilo waJordan langhele kepito letango, okudja komulonga waArnon fiyo okomhunda yaHermon nomaluhaela aeshe langhele lwokoushilo, odedi:

Sihon, ohamba yOvaamori, ei ya li muHesbon, yo ya li ya pangela okudja kuAroer sha li komunghulo womulonga waArnon konhele yopokati komulonga netata loshilongo shaGilead fiyo okomulonga waJabbok, ongaba yovana vaAmmoni,
kEfuta Loluhaela fiyo okEfuta laKinneret koushilo nofiyo okEfuta Loluhaela nokutya, Efuta lOmongwa koushilo langhele lwokuBet-Jesimot nokombinga yaumbuwanhu fiyo okomafina aPisga,
noshilongo shaOg, ohamba yaBasan, yo ya li mwaava va xupa vomOvarefai, ava va kala muAstarot nomuEdrei,
yo ya li ya pangela eemhunda daHermon naSalka naBasan ashishe fiyo okongaba yOvagesuri nOvamaakati nofiyo etata laGilead, oshilongo shaSihon, ohamba yaHesbon.
Moses, omupiya wOmwene, novana vaIsrael ove di dipaa. Ndele Moses, omupiya wOmwene, okwe shi pa Ovarubeni nOvagad netata lepata laManasse, ve shi nangale.

Neehamba odo domoilongo, Josua novana vaIsrael ve di denga kombinga ei yaJordan, langhele lwokouninginino, okudja kuBaal-Gad medu la lalakana laLibanon fiyo okOmhunda yaHalak, koumbuwanhu popepi naEdom. Ndele Josua okwe li tukulila omapata aIsrael pamapata avo, va kale mo alushe.

Oshitukulwa eshi osha kwatela mo edu lokeemhunda oikulundudu yopopepi nado kouninginino, olufilu laJordan noikulundudu yopopepi nalo, omafilukila okoushilo nedu lokoumbuwanhu oko ihaku lokwa. Edu eli ola li lOvaheti, lOvaamori, lOvakaanan, lOvaperesi, lOvahevi nolOvajebusi. Ovaisraeli ova finda eehamba doilando ei:
Jeriko, Ai (popepi naBetel),
Jerusalem, Hebron,
Jarmut, Lakis,
Eglon, Geser,
Debir, Geder,
Horma, Arad,
Libna, Adullam,
Makkeda, Betel,
Tappuah, Hefer,
Afek, Lassaron,
Madon, Hasor,
Simron-Meron, Aksaf,
Taanak, Megido,
Kedes, Jokneam (polwamba laKarmel),
Dor (komunghulo wefuta), Goim (muGalilea)
naTirsa. Eehamba adishe kumwe omilongo nhatu naimwe.
13: Ndele Josua eshi a kulupa nomafiku aye a ninga mahapu, Omwene okwe mu lombwela ndele ta ti: Ove wa kulupa nomafiku oye a ninga mahapu, ndele natango onhele inene yomedu ya fyaala inai nangalwa.
Edu olo la fyaala po oleli: Eenhele adishe dedu lOvafilisti nedu alishe lOvagesuri,

nedu alishe laAvvim koumbuwanhu. (Edu alishe okudja kuSihor i li koushilo waEgipiti fiyo okongaba yaEkron langhele koumbangalanhu, olo tali valelwa kedu lOvakaanan nokutya, eehamba nhano dOvafilisti: oyo yaGasa naayo yaAsdod, oyo yaAskelon, oyo yaGat naayo yaEkron) nosho yo Ovaavvim
vokoumbuwanhu. Edu alishe lOvakaanan naMeara yOvasidoni fiyo okuAfek, fiyo okongaba yOvaamori.
Nedu lOvagebali naLibanon alishe kombinga yokoushilo okudja kuBaal-Gad shi li pefina lomhunda yaHermon fiyo okonhele oko taku iwa kuHamat.

Oonakukalamo aveshe vokeemhunda okudja kuLibanon fiyo okuMisrefot-Maim, Ovasidoni aveshe, Ame mwene ohandi ke va taataa komesho yovana vaIsrael. Edu lavo li tukulila Israel ngaashi efyuululo, ngaashi Ame nde ku lombwela.
Edu olo li tukulila hano paife omapata omugoi netata lepata laManasse ngaashi oshitukulwafyuululwa.
Pamwe nOvamanasse nOvarubeni nOvagad ova tambula oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo, osho Moses e shi yandja kuvo kombinga inya yokoushilo waJordan, ngaashi Moses, omupiya wOmwene, e va pa:
okudja kuAroer, shi li komunghulo womulonga waArnon, oshilando shopokati kefilu nedu la tumba la lalakana okudja kuMedeba fiyo okuDibon.
Noilando aishe yaSihon, ohamba yOvaamori, ei ya li ya pangela muHesbon, fiyo okongaba yovana vaAmmoni;
naGilead noshikandjo shOvagesuri noshOvamaakati nomhunda aishe yaHermon naBasan ashishe fiyo okuSalka.
Nouhamba aushe waOg muBasan, ohamba yomuAstarot noyomuEdrei, yo ya li imwe yomOvarefai ava va xupa. Ndele Moses okwe va taataa nokwe va halakanifa.
Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael inava taataa Ovagesuri nOvamaakati, onghee Ovagesuri nOvamaakati va kala mokati kOvaisraeli fiyo onena eli.
Epata laLevi alike Moses ine li pa oshitukulwafyuululwa: omindiloyambo dOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael, oye oshitukulwafyuululwa shalo, ngaashi Ye e li udanekela.
Ndele Moses okwa yandja kepata lovana vaRuben pamaludi avo:
va pewa omukunda okudja kuAroer shi li komunghulo womulonga waArnon, oshilando shopokati kefilu nedu alishe la tumba la lalakana fiyo okuMedeba.
Hesbon noilando yasho aishe ei i li medu la tumba la lalakana, Dibon naBamot-Baal, naBet-Baal-Meon,
naJahas naKedemot naMefat,
naKiriataim naSibma naSeret-Hassahar, komhunda yomefilu,
naBet-Peor nomafina eemhunda daPisga naBet-Jesimot,

noilando aishe yomedu la tumba la lalakana noshilongo ashishe shaSihon, ohamba yOvaamori, ei ya pangela muHesbon, oyo ya dipawa pamwe nomalenga aMidian kuMoses: Evi naRekem naSur naHur naReba, omalenga aSihon, aa a kala moshilongo.
Pamwe naava va dipawa, ovana vaIsrael va dipaa yo neongamukonda Bileam yaBeor, omumonikokule.
Osho hano ongaba yovana vaRuben oya enda ngaha: Jordan, sho oshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaRuben pamaludi avo, noilando pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Ndele Moses okwa yandja kepata laGad, ovana vaGad pamaludi avo:
va pewa ngaashi omukunda wavo Jaeser noilando aishe yaGilead netata loshilongo shovana vaAmmoni fiyo okuAroer sha ama koushilo waRabba,
okudja kuHesbon fiyo okuRamat-Mispa naBetonim. Nokudja kuMahanaim fiyo okongaba yaLidbir.
Ndele mefilu: Bet-Haram naBet-Nimra naSukkot naSafon eshi sha xupa koshilongo shaSihon, ohamba yaHesbon, naJordan nomunghulo wao fiyo tau xulile mefuta laKinneret, kombinga yokoushilo waJordan.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaGad pamaludi avo, noilando nomikunda dayo.
Moses okwa yandja vali ketata lepata laManasse; osho hano etata lepata lovana vaManasse la pewa pamaludi alo oshitukulwa.
Omukunda wavo oyou: okudja kuMahanaim, Basan ashishe, oshilongo ashishe shaOg, ohamba yaBasan nomikunda adishe daJair muBasan, oilando omilongo hamano.
Netata laGilead naAstarot naEdrei, oilando yomoshilongo shaOg muBasan kovana vaMakir yaManasse ketata lovana vaMakir pamaludi avo.
Olo hano Moses e li tukula ngaashi efyuululo momaluhaela aMoab koushilo waJordan yaJeriko langhele lwokoushilo.
Ndelenee kepata laLevi Moses ina yandja oshitukulwafyuululwa. Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, Ye oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo, ngaashi Ye e va udanekela.
14: Eenhele odo ovana vaIsrael va pewa ngaashi oitukulwafyuululwa medu laKaanan, odo omupristeli Eliaser naJosua yaNun novakulunhu vomaludi omomapata ve va tukulila
noshihoololifo ngaashi oshitukulwafyuululwa palombwelo lOmwene, Ye a lombwelifa Moses ta tongo omapata omugoi netata lepata.
Osheshi Moses a yandja komapata avali netata lepata oitukulwafyuululwa kombinga inya yaJordan. Ndelenee Ovalevi ine va pa oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati kavo.

Osheshi ovana vaJosef va li omapata avali nokutya, Manasse naEfraim. Ndelenee Ovalevi inava pewa oshitukulwa shomedu, ndelenee oilando ashike, va kale mo muyo, nosho yo eenhele doulifilo molwoimuna yavo noinima yavo.
Omwene ngaashi a lombwela Moses, osho ngaha Ovaisraeli va ninga ndele va tukula edu.

Opo nee ovana vaJuda ve uya koshipala shaJosua muGilgal, ndele Kaleb yaJefunne, Omukenisi, okwe mu lombwela: “Ondjovo oyo Omwene e i lombwela Moses, omulumenhu waKalunga, a tonga omolwange nomolwoye yo muKades-Barnea, ou i shii.
Ame nda li nda wanifa omido omilongo nhee, Moses, omupiya wOmwene, eshi a tuma nge muKades-Barnea, ndi ye okulava oshilongo, ndele nde mu hepaululila naanaa ngaashi ndi shii momutima wange.
Ovakwetu venya va ile ko pamwe naame, va mbadapaleka omitima dovanhu, ndelenee ame nda li nda diinina mokushikula Omwene Kalunga koye.

Mefiku tuu linya Moses okwa ana ta ti: ‘Oshili, edu olo omhadi yoye ya lyata, otali ka ninga loye nololudalo loye ngaashi oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo fiyo alushe, shaashi ove wa diinina mokushikula Omwene Kalunga kange.’

Ndelenee paife, tala, Omwene e shi itavela ngaashi a udaneka, ndi kale nomwenyo natango omido omilongo nhee nanhano konima yefimbo linya Omwene a lombwela Moses ondjovo oyo fimbo Israel sha enda mombuwa. Ndele tala paife omido dange di li omilongo hetatu nanhano.
Ndele fiyo onena eli ndi neenghono di fike peenghono dange mefiku linya, Moses a tuma nge. Eenghono ngaashi da li mefimbo linya osho di li nonena: ndi neenghono nokulwa nokupita mo nokuuya mo.

Pe nge hano eemhunda odo da tongwa kOmwene, osheshi ove mwene we shi uda mefiku linya, nokutya Ovaanaki va kala ko, noko kwa li oilando inene i neehotekuma. Kashiimba Omwene e li pamwe naame, ndi shiive oku va taataa, ngaashi Omwene a tonga.”
Opo nee Josua okwa nangeka noupuna Kaleb yaJefunne nokwe mu pa Hebron ngaashi oshitukulwafyuululwa.
Osho ngaha hano Hebron sha ninga oshitukulwafyuululwa shaKaleb yaJefunne, Omukenisi, ngaashi shi li nonena, osheshi ye okwa li a diinina mokushikula Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael.
Ndelenee edina laHebron la li nale Kiriat-Arba, omolwedina laArba, ou a li omupangeli e neenghono e dule vakwao mokati kOvaanaki. Ndele edu la mona etulumuko koita.
15: Noshitukulwa shepata lovana vaJuda pamaludi avo pashihoololifo osheshi: okongaba yaEdom kombinga yokoumbuwanhu wombuwa yaSin fiyo okomunghulo moumbuwanhu
nomufinda wongaba yokoumbuwanhu oo okudja pomunghulo wEfuta lOmongwa okudja poshikumbi tashi yukilile koumbuwanhu,

ndele tau ende langhele lwokoumbuwanhu woshikulundudu shaAkrabim, ndele tau ende langhele lwokuSin ndele tau litumbu kombinga yaumbuwanhu yaKades-Barnea, tau i kuHesron, tau litumbu kuAddar ndele tau ngolyokele kuKarka;
opo tau ende langhele lwokuAsmon ndele tau i kokamulonga kaEgipiti, opo omufinda wongaba tau xulile mEfuta Lopokati. Oo hano tau ka ninga ongaba yavo yokoumbuwanhu.
Ndelenee omufinda wongaba wokoushilo oyou: Efuta lOmongwa fiyo opexulilo laJordan. Nomufinda wongaba wokombinga yaumbangalanhu: koshikololo shefuta okexulilo laJordan
omufinda tau ende kuBet-Hogla ndele tau i kombinga yokoumbangalanhu yaBet-Araba. Opo nee omufinda tau litumbu kemanya laBohan, omona waRuben.

Opo nee omufinda tau ende kuDebir okudja kefilu laAkor ndele tau ngolyokele koumbangalanhu waGilgal osho sha shaama naAdummim, kombinga yokoumbuwanhu wokamulonga. Opo nee omufinda tau taulula omeva olufifiya laSemes fiyo tau xulile polufifiya laRogel.

Opo nee omufinda tau ende mefilu laBen-Hinnom, poshakati shomhunda yOvajebusi, osho Jerusalem. Opo nee omufinda tau londo koxulo yeemhunda di li kouninginino wefilu laHinnom, lo li li kombinga yokoumbangalanhu wefilu laRefaim,
okudja koxulo yomhunda, omufinda tau kulukile molufifiya lomeva aNeftoah, ndele tau i koilando yokeemhunda daEfron. Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyokele Baala nokutya Kiriat-Jearim.
Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyokele kouninginino waBaala, tau i keemhunda daSeir ndele tau ende pefina lomhunda yaJearim oyo Kesalon lokoumbangalanhu ndele tau di kuBet-Semes ndele tau i kuTimna.
Opo nee omufinda tau ende koumbangalanhu wefina lomhunda yaEkron, opo omufinda tau ngolyokele kuSikron ndele tau londo komhunda yaBaala, tau i kuJabneel, fiyo omufinda tau xulile mEfuta Lopokati.
Ongaba yokouninginino oyo hano Efuta Lopokati nomunghulo walo. Oo hano omufinda wongaba tau dingilile oshitukulwalongo shovana vaJuda pamaludi avo.
Ndelenee ye okwa yandja kuKaleb yaJefunne oshitukulwa mokati kovana vaJuda, ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Josua nokutya, Kiriat-Arba, xe yaAnak, osho Hebron.
Ndele Kaleb okwa ta mo musho ovana ovamati vatatu vaAnak: Sesai, Ahiman naTalmai, vo oludalo laAnak.
Ndele oko ye a dja nokwa homona oonakukalamo muDebir. Ndelenee edina laDebir la li nale Kiriat-Sefer.
Ndele Kaleb okwa tile: “Ou ta te Kiriat-Sefer, ndele te shi nangala, oye ohandi mu pe omona wange okakadona Aksa a ninge omwalikadi waye.”
Opo nee Otniel yaKenas, ondenge yaKaleb okwe shi nangala. Ndele ye okwe mu pa omona waye okakadona Aksa a ninge omwalikadi waye.
Ndele Aksa eshi e uya, okwe mu heka a indile kuxe epya. Ndele ye eshi a londoloka kondongi, Kaleb okwe mu pula: “Owa hala shike?”
Ndele ye okwa tya: “Pe nge oshali. Osheshi ove wa pa nge edu likukutu, u nokupa nge yo eefifiya.” Opo nee Kaleb okwe mu pa eefifiya keemhunda nomefilu.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shepata lovana vaJuda pamaludi avo.
Noilando yokominghulo depata lovana vaJuda fiyo okongaba yaEdom ya li kombinga yokoumbuwanhu: Kabseel naEder naJagur,
naKina naDimon naAdada,
naKedes naHasor naJitnan,
naSif naTelem naBealot,
naHasor-Hadatta naKeriot-Hesron nokutya, Hasor.
Amam naShema naMolada,
naHasar-Gadda naHesmon naBet-Pelet,
naHasar-Sual naBerseba naBisiotia.
Baala naIijim naEsem,
naEltolad naKesil naHorma,
naSiklag naMadmanna naSansanna,
naLebaot naSilhim naAin naRimmon. Oilando aishe kumwe ya li omilongo mbali nomugoi pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Medu la lalakana: Estaol naSorea naAsna,
naSanoa naEn-Gannim, Tappuah naEnam,
Jarmut naAdullam, Sogo naAseka,
naSaaraim naAditaim naGedera naGederotaim: oilando omulongo naine pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Senan naHadasa naMigdal-Gad,
naDilean naMispa naJokteel.
Lakis naBoskat naEglon,
naKabbon naLagmas naKitlis,
naGederot, Bet-Dagon naNaama naMakkeda: oilando omulongo naihamano pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Libna naEter naAsan,
naJiftah naAsna naNesib,
naKeila naAksib naMaresa: oilando omugoi pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Ekron noipangelwa yasho nomikunda dasho,
okudja kuEkron langhele lwokouninginino fiyo okEfuta Lopokati, aishe oyo i li kombinga yaAsdod nomikunda dayo:
Asdod noipangelwa yasho nomikunda dasho. Gasa noipangelwa yasho nomikunda dasho fiyo okokamulonga kaEgipiti nEfuta Lopokati nomunghulo walo.
Ndele keemhunda: Samir naJattir naSogo,
naDanna naKiriat-Sanna nokutya, Debir,
naAnab naEstemo naAnim,
Gosen naHolon naGilo: oilando omulongo nashimwe pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Arab naDuma naEshan
naJanum naBet-Tappuah naAfek,
naHumta naKiriat-Arba nokutya, Hebron naSior: oilando omugoi pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Maon naKarmel naSif naJutta,
naJisreel naJokdaem naSanoa,
Kain, Gibea naTimna: oilando omulongo pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Halhul, Bet-Sur naGedor,
naMaarat naBet-Anot naEltekon: oilando ihamano pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Kiriat-Baal nokutya, Kiriat-Jearim naRabba: oilando ivali pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Mombuwa: Bet-Araba, Middin naSegaga.
Nibsan noshilando shomongwa naEngedi: oilando ihamano pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Ndelenee ovana vaJuda va nyengwa okuta mo Ovajebusi, oonakukalamo muJerusalem. Onghee hano Ovajebusi va kala pamwe novana vaJuda muJerusalem fiyo onena eli.
16: Noshihoololifo shoshitukulwa shovana vaJosef osheshi: okudja kuJordan puJeriko, koushilo womeva aJeriko langhele lwokombuwa yaJeriko omufinda wongaba tau londo keemhunda langhele lwokuBetel,
ndele tau di kuBetel tau i kuLus ndele tau ende nokuya koshilongo shOvaarki fiyo okuAtarot.
Opo nee tau kulukile mouninginino moshilongo shOvafleti nomoshilongo shaBet-Horon shoposhi nafiyo okuGeser ndele tau xulile mEfuta Lopokati.
Osho ngaha hano ovana vaJosef, Manasse naEfraim va mona oshitukulwafyuululwa.
Noshitukulwalongo shovana vaEfraim pamaludi avo osheshi nokutya, omufinda wongaba woshitukulwafyuululwa moushilo osheshi: Atarot-Addar fiyo okuBet-Horon shokombada,
opo nee omufinda tau i kEfuta Lopokati. Moumbangalanhu: Migmetat. Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyokele koushilo tau i kuTaanat-Silo ndele tau ende koushilo washo fiyo okuJanoak.
Ndele tau di kuJanoak tau i kuAtarot naNaara ndele tau tu Jeriko ndele tau xulile muJordan.
Okudja kuTappuah omufinda tau ende kouninginino tau i kokamulonga kaKana; opo nee tau xulile mefuta. Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaEfraim pamaludi avo.
Noilando aishe ovana vaEfraim ve i tukulilwa moshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaManasse oilando aishe pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Ndelenee vo inava ta mo Ovakaanan, oonakukalamo muGeser. Osho ngaha hano Ovakaanan va kala mokati kOvaefraim fiyo onena eli. Ndelenee vo ova li ve nokulongela Ovaisraeli.
17: Natango oshihoololifo shoshitukulwa shepata laManasse, ou a li oshiveli shaJosef: Makir, oshiveli shaManasse, xe yaGilead, ou a li omukwaita, okwa pewa Gilead naBasan.

Novana vakwao vaManasse ova pewa yo oshitukulwa pamaludi avo: ovana vaAbieser novana vaHelek novana vaAsriel novana vaSekem novana vaHefer novana vaSemida. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaManasse yaJosef pamaludi avo.
Ndelenee Selofhad yaHefer yaGilead yaMakir yaManasse, okwa li ehe novana ovamati, ndelenee ovana oukadona aveke. Nomadina ovana oukadona oo aa: Mahla naNoa, Hogla, Milka naTirsa.

Ndele ava ve uya koshipala shomupristeli Eliaser nokoshipala shaJosua yaNun nomoipafi yovakulunhu, ndele tava ti: “Omwene okwa lombwela Moses tu pewe oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati kovamwameme ovalumenhu.” Onghee ye e va pa oshitukulwafyuululwa palombwelo lOmwene mokati kovamwaina ovalumenhu vaxe.
Osho ngaha hano Manasse a pewa oitukulwa omulongo, nokwa wedelwa oilongo yaGilead naBasan i li langhele kwinya yaJordan.
Osheshi ovana oukadona vaManasse va pewa oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati kovamwaina vavo ovalumenhu, ndelenee oshilongo shaGilead sha ninga shovana vamwe vaManasse.
Ndele omufinda wongaba waManasse oyou: okudja kuAsser, tau i kuMigmetat, sha ama koushilo waSekem. Opo nee omufinda tau ende koumbuwanhu wa kwatela mo ovanhu vomuEn-Tappuah.
Onhele yedu laTappuah oya li yaManasse, ndelenee Tappuah osho shi li pongaba yaManasse, osha ninga shovana vaEfraim;

Opo nee omufinda tau i kokamulonga kaKana, kombinga yokoumbuwanhu wokamulonga. Oilando inya mokati koilando yaManasse oya ninga yaEfraim. Nomufinda waManasse u li kombinga yaumbangalanhu yokamulonga ndele tau xulile mEfuta Lopokati.

Edu lokoumbuwanhu wako ola ninga laEfraim, ndelenee edu lokoumbangalanhu la ninga laManasse. Efuta Lopokati olo omufinda wongaba. Kombinga yokoumbangalanhu tau tu kuAsser, ndelenee kombinga yokoushilo oIsaskar.
Ndele muIsaskar nomuAsser eenhele edi da ninga daManasse: Bet-Sean naJibleam naDor naEndor naTaanak naMegido nomikunda domomukulambo.
Ndelenee ovana vaManasse va nyengwa okunangala oilando oyo, nOvakaanan va mona ngaha omhito okukala moshilongo osho.
Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael eshi va mona eenghono, ova fininika Ovakaanan oku va longela, ndelenee inave va taataa mo sheke.

Opo nee ovana vaJosef va popya naJosua, ndele tava ti: “Omolwashike wa pa nge oshihoololwatukulwa shimwe ashike oshitukulwa shimwe ngaashi oshitukulwafyuululwa, nande aame oshiwana shinene, osheshi Omwene okwa nangeka nge noupuna fiyo onena eli?”
Ndele Josua okwe va lombwela: “Eshi oove oshiwana shinene, inda hano komufitu ndele likokoleleni onhele moshilongo shOvaperesi noshOvarefai, eshi u nofina keemhunda daEfraim.”

Ndelenee ovana vaJosef tava ti: “Eemhunda itadi ke tu wanena, nOvakaanan aveshe ava hava kala medu la lalakana ve nomatemba oivela, vo ava hava kala muBetshan nomikunda dasho naava hava kala mefilu laJisreel.”
Opo nee Josua okwa popya neumbo laJosef naEfraim naManasse ndele ta ti: “Oove oshiwana shinene ndele ove u neenghono dinene; ito ka kala u noshihoololwatukulwa shimwe ashike,
eemhunda tadi ka ninga doye. Odo omifitu u noku di kokola, opo nee eenhele dokominghulo dado tadi ningi doye. Osheshi u nokutaataa Ovakaanan, nande vo ve nomatemba oivela nonande vo ve neenghono.”
18: Ndele eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael la ongala muSilo, ndele oko va dika etwali leongalo, vo eshi va nangala edu.
Ndelenee mokati kovana vaIsrael mwa li natango omapata aheyali oitukulwafyuululwa yao inae i tukulilwa natango.
Opo nee Josua ta lombwele ovana vaIsrael ndele ta ti: “Fiyo onaini tamu ongaonga ndele itamu nangala edu olo Omwene Kalunga kooxo e mu pa?
Eteni oku ovalumenhu vatatu vomepata keshe, opo ndi shiive oku va tuma va ka endaende noshilongo, va yeleke nhumbi tashi ka tukulwa. Opo nee vo ve nokuuya kwaame,
ndele ve noku shi tukulilafana oitukulwa iheyali. Juda na kale moshitukulwalongo shaye moumbuwanhu, nepata laJosef nali kale moshitukulwalongo shalo moumbangalanhu.
Ndelenee mu nokuyeleka oshilongo oitukulwa iheyali nokweetela nge eyeleko oku. Opo nee ame ohandi ke mu hoololela oihoololwatukulwa koshipala shOmwene Kalunga ketu.

Osheshi Ovalevi vehe noshitukulwa mokati keni, shaashi oupristeli wOmwene oo oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo. Ndele Gad naRuben netata lepata laManasse a pewa oitukulwafyuululwa yao kombada yaJordan moushilo, oyo ve i pewa kuMoses, omupiya wOmwene.”

Ovalumenhu ve liunganeka ndele va ya ndele Josua okwe va lombwela mokuya kwavo va yeleke oshilongo, ndele ta ti: “Indeni ko, endaendeni noshilongo ndele shi yelekeni, ndele alukeni kwaame. Opo nee ame ohandi ke mu hoololela oihoololwatukulwa apa koshipala shOmwene muSilo.”
Novalumenhu va ya ndele va endaenda noshilongo ndele va shangela membo oilando noilando moitukulwa iheyali, ndele ve uya kuJosua, monhanda yomuSilo.
Opo nee Josua okwe va hoololela oihoololwatukulwa muSilo koshipala shOmwene. Ndele oko Josua okwa tukulila oshilongo kovana vaIsrael paitukulwa yavo.
Ndele oshihoololifo sha kwata epata lovana vaBenjamin pamaludi avo. Noshitukulwalongo eshi ve shi pewa koshihoololifo osha li pokati kovana vaJuda novana vaJosef.

Nomufinda wongaba yavo kombinga yokoumbangalanhu oyou: okudja kuJordan, omufinda tau londo koshikulundudu shi li koumbangalanhu waJeriko ndele tau londo keemhunda kombinga yokouninginino, ndele tau xulile mombuwa yaBet-Aven.
Nomufinda tau di ko, tau i kuLus, kombinga yokoumbuwanhu waLus nokutya, Betel. Omufinda tau i vali kuAtarot-Addar, tau londo keemhunda di li koumbuwanhu waBet-Horon shoposhi.

Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyoka ndele tau yuka kouninginino, tau i koumbuwanhu weemhunda odo di li koumbuwanhu da shaama naBet-Horon. Opo tau xulile muKiriat-Baal nokutya, Kiriat-Jearim, oshilando shovana vaJuda. Oyo hano ongaba yokouninginino.
Ongaba yokoumbuwanhu tai hovele komunghulo Kiriat-Jearim, nomufinda tau ende kombinga yokouninginino ndele tau i kolufifiya lomuNeftoah.

Opo nee omufinda tau i komunghulo womhunda oyo ya shaama nefilu laBen-Hinnom li li koumbangalanhu mefilu lOvarefaim. Opo nee tau i kefilu laHinnom koumbuwanhu woshikulundudu shOvajebusi ndele tau i kolufifiya laRogel,
tau ngolyoka koumbangalanhu ndele tau i kolufifiya laSemes nokuGelilot, ndele tau i koyuunda yomamanya oyo ya shaama noikulundudu yaAdummim, ndele tau i kemanya laBohan yaRuben.
Opo nee tau londo tau i koshikulundu sha shaama naAraba kombinga yokoumbangalanhu ndele tau i kuAraba.

Nomufinda tau i vali koshikulundu shaBet-Hogla kombinga yokoumbangalanhu. Opo nee omufinda tau xulile koshikumbi shokoumbuwanhu mEfuta lOmongwa, apa Jordan tau xulile moumbuwanhu. Oyo hano ongaba yokoumbuwanhu.
Ndele Jordan oye ongaba kombinga yokoushilo. Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaBenjamin pamaludi avo nomifinda dasho dongaba keembinga adishe.
Noilando yepata lovana vaBenjamin pamaludi avo oyei: Jeriko naBet-Hogla naEmek-Kesis,
naBet-Araba naSemaraim naBetel,
naAvvim naPara naOfra,
naKefar-Haammoni naOfni naGeba: oilando omulongo naivali pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Gibeon naRama naBeerot,
naMispa naKefira naMosa,
naRekem naJirpeel naTareala,
naShela, Elef naJebus, osho Jerusalem, Gibea, Kiriat-Jearim: oilando omulongo naine pamwe nomikunda dayo. Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaBenjamin pamaludi avo.
19: Noshihoololwatukulwa oshitivali osha kwata Simeon kepata lovana vaSimeon pamaludi avo. Oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo osha li pokati koshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaJuda.
Ndele oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo sha li: Berseba naSheba naMolada,
naHasar-Sual naBala naEsem,
naTolad naBetul naHorma,
naSiklag naBet-Markabot naHasar-Susa,
naBet-Leboat naSaruhen: oilando omulongo naitatu pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Ain, En-Rimmon naEter naAsan: oilando ine pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Nomikunda adishe da li moushiinda woilando oyo fiyo okuBaalat-Beer, Rama moshilongo shokoumbuwanhu. Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shepata lovana vaSimeon pamaludi avo.

Ovana vaSimeon va pewa oshitukulwafyuululwa shavo moshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaJuda, osheshi oshitukulwa shovana vaJuda sha li shinene unene kuvo. Onghee hano ovana vaSimeon va pewa oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati koshitukulwafyuululwa shavo.
Oshihoololwatukulwa oshititatu sha kwata ovana vaSebulon pamaludi avo, nomufinda wongaba woshitukulwafyuululwa shavo wa ya fiyo okuSarid.
Kouninginino omufinda tau londo kuMarala, tau tu kuDabbeset nokamulonga oko ke shi ama koushilo waJokneam.
Ndele okudja kuSarid tau ngolyoka koushilo kepito letango koshilongo shaKishlot-Tabor ndele tau i kuDaberat ndele tau londo kuJafia,
ndele oko tau londo koushilo, kuGat-Hefer, ku-Et-Kasin ndele tau i kuRimmon ndele tau tu kuNeah.
Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyoka koumbangalanhu kuHannaton ndele tau xulile mefilu laJiftah-El,
naKattat naNahalal naSimron naJideala naBetlehem: oilando omulongo naivali pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shovana vaSebulon pamaludi avo. Oilando tuu oyo nomikunda dayo.
Oshihoololwatukulwa oshitine sha kwata Isaskar, ovana vaIsaskar pamaludi avo,
ndele oshitukulwalongo shavo sha ama kuJisreel naKesullot naSunem,
naHafaraim naSion naAnagarat,
naRabbit naKisjon naEbes,
naRemet naEn-Gannim naEn-Hadda naBet-Pases;
nomufinda tau tu kuTabor naSahasima naBet-Semes, nomufinda wongaba tau xulile muJordan. Oilando omulongo naihamano pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shepata lovana vaIsaskar pamaludi avo, oilando pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Noshihoololwatukulwa oshititano sha kwata epata lovana vaAsser pamaludi avo.
Noshitukulwalongo shavo osheshi: Helkat naHali naBeten naAksaf,
naAllamelek naAmad naMiseal. Ndele sha twa mouninginino kuKarmel nokuSihor-Libnat.
Opo nee ongaba tai yukilile koushilo kuBet-Dagon, ndele tai tu kuSebulon nokefilu laJiftah-El koumbangalanhu, Bet-Emek naNehiel, ndele tai ende kolumosho laKabul,
naEbron naRehob naHammon naKana fiyo okuSidon-Shinene.
Opo nee ongaba tai ngolyoka kuRama nofiyo okohotelando yaTirus. Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyoka kuHosa ndele tau xulile mEfuta Lopokati okudja kuMahalab fiyo okuAksib.
NaUmma naAfek naRehob: oilando omilongo mbali naivali pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shepata lovana vaAsser pamaludi avo. Oilando tuu oyo pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Oshihoololwatukulwa oshitihamano sha kwata ovana vaNaftali pamaludi avo.
Nomufinda wavo wa dja kuHelef komwandi wopuSaananim, naAdami-Nekeb naJabneel fiyo okuLakkum, ndele tau xulile muJordan.

Opo nee omufinda tau ngolyoka kouninginino tau i kuAsnot-Tabor, ndele tau di ko tau yuka kuHukkok ndele tau tu kuSebulon moumbuwanhu. Ndelenee mouninginino tau tu kuAsser, ndele moushilo tau tu kuJuda puJordan.
Noilando i neehotekuma: Siddim, Ser naHammat, Rakkat naKinneret.
NaAdama naRama naHasor,
naKedes naEdrei naEn-Hasor,
naJireon naMigdal-El, Horem naBet-Anat naBet-Semes: oilando omulongo nomugoi pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shepata lovana vaNaftali pamaludi avo, oilando nomikunda dayo.
Oshihoololwatukulwa oshitiheyali sha kwata epata lovana vaDan pamaludi avo.
Moshitukulwafyuululwa shavo omu na: Sorea naEstaol naIr-Semes,
naSaalabbin naAijalon naJitla,
naElon naTimna naEkron,
naElteke naGibbeton naBaalat,
naJehud naBene-Berak naGat-Rimmon,
naMe-Jarkon naRakkon pamwe nomikunda da shaama naJoppa.

Ndelenee oshitukulwalongo shaDan ove shi kufwa, onghee hano ovana vaDan va fikama, ndele va lwifa Lesem ndele ve shi ta noonakukalamo ve va dipaa neongamukonda, ndele ve shi nangala ndele va tula mo. Ndele ve shi ifana Lesem Dan padina laxe yavo Dan.
Osho hano oshitukulwafyuululwa shepata lovana vaDan pamaludi avo. Oilando tuu oyo pamwe nomikunda dayo.
Vo eshi va tukula oshilongo ashishe meni lomifinda dongaba ngaashi oshifyuululwa, ovana vaIsrael va yandja kuJosua yaNun oshitukulwafyuululwa mokati kavo.
Palombwelo lOmwene ove mu pa oshilando osho ye e shi indila nokutya, Timnat-Sera keemhunda daEfraim. Ndele ye a tungulula oshilando nokwa kala mo.

Oitukulwafyuululwa oyo tuu oyo hano omupristeli Eliaser naJosua yaNun novakulunhu vomaludi va tukulila omapata ovana vaIsrael ngaashi oshifyuululwa pashihoololifo muSilo koshipala shOmwene poshivelo shetwali leongalo. Ndele va mana okutukula oshilongo.
20: NOmwene okwa popya naJosua ndele ta ti:
“Lombwela ovana vaIsrael u tye: ‘Litongoleleni oihondamenolando Ame nde i mu lombwelifile Moses,
opo ou a dipaa omunhu mokupapala, a shiive okuya mo onhapo, opo yo i kale eenhele dokuhondama omolwomupuli wetimba.

Ye eshi ta i onhapo hano moshilando shimwe shomoilando oyo, ndele ta kala ofika poshivelo shoshilando ndele ta shiivifile ovakulunhu voshilando eendjovo daye, vo ve noku mu tambula puvo moshilando noku mu pa onhele, opo a shiive okukala puvo.
Nomupuli wetimba ngeenge te mu shikula, vo vaha yandje kuye omunhu ou a dipaa mukwao mokupapala, ye eshi ine mu tonda shito.

Na kale mo moshilando osho fiyo a tokolwa koshiongalele, fiyo okefyo lomupristeli omukulunhu, ou a li po pefimbo linya. Opo nee ou a dipaa ta dulu okushuna moshilando shaye nomeumbo laye, koshilando oko a dile onhapo.’ ”
Opo nee va tongola Kedes muGalilea keemhunda daNaftali naSekem keemhunda daEfraim naKiriat-Arba nokutya, Hebron keemhunda daJuda.
Ndele kombada yaJordan moushilo waJeriko, va tongola: Beser mombuwa yomedu la lalakana lopombada shomepata laRuben, naRamot naGilead, shomepata laGad, naGolan muBasan shomepata laManasse.

Oyo hano oilando ya tongolelwa ovana aveshe vaIsrael nomunailongo ou ta kala mokati kavo, opo keshe ou a dipaa omunhu mokupapala ta dulu okuhondama mo, ndele ita dipawa keke lomupuli wetimba, fimbo ina kala ofika moipafi yoshiongalele shovatokoli.
21: Opo nee ovakulunhu vomaludi Ovalevi ve uya komupristeli Eliaser nokuJosua yaNun nokovakulunhu vomaludi omapata ovana vaIsrael.
Ndele ve va lombwela muSilo medu laKaanan, ndele tava ti: “Omwene okwe tu lombwelifila Moses, fye tu nokupewa oilando tu kale mo pamwe noulifilo woimuna yetu.”
Opo nee ovana vaIsrael va pa Ovalevi palombwelo lOmwene moshitukulwafyuululwa shavo oilando ei pamwe noulifilo wayo:
Oshihoololifo sha kwata oludi lOvakohati ngaha: mOvalevi ovana vomupristeli Aron va pewa mepata laJuda nomepata laSimeon nomepata laBenjamin oilando omulongo naitatu pashihoololifo.
Novana vaKohat momaludi omepata laEfraim nomepata laDan nometata lepata laManasse oilando omulongo pashihoololifo.
Novana vaGerson momaludi omepata laIsaskar nomepata laAsser nomepata laNaftali nomepata laManasse muBasan oilando omulongo naitatu pashihoololifo.
Novana vaMerari pamaludi avo mepata laRuben nomepata laGad nomepata laSebulon oilando omulongo naivali.
Osho ngaha hano ovana vaIsrael va yandja kOvalevi oilando tuu oyo pamwe noulifilo wayo ngaashi Omwene a lombwela Moses.
Mepata lovana vaJuda nomepata lovana vaSimeon ova pewa vali oilando ei, ve i ifana pamadina ayo:
Noshihoololifo shotete sha kwata oludalo laAron lomoludi laKohat womoludalo laLevi; ova pewa
Kiriat-Arba, xe yaAnak nokutya, Hebron, keemhunda daJuda noulifilo washo we shi dingilila.
Ndelenee omapya oshilando nomikunda dasho ove a yandja kuKaleb yaJefunne ngaashi oshitukulwa shaye.
Ndele ovana vomupristeli Aron, ve va pa Hebron oshihondamenolando shoonakudipaa noulifilo washo naLibna noulifilo washo,
naJattir noulifilo washo naEstemoa noulifilo washo,
naHolon noulifilo washo naDebir noulifilo washo,
naAin noulifilo washo naJutta noulifilo washo naBet-Semes noulifilo washo: oilando omugoi yomomapata aa avali.
Ndele mepata laBenjamin: Gibeon noulifilo washo naGeba noulifilo washo,
naAnatot noulifilo washo naAlmon noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Oilando aishe yovana vomupristeli Aron ya li oilando omulongo naitatu noulifilo wayo.
Nomaludi ovana vaKohat, Omulevi, ava va xupa po movana vaKohat, ova pewa oilando yavo pashihoololifo mepata laEfraim.
Ndele ve va pa: oshihondamenolando shoonakudipaa: Sekem noulifilo washo keemhunda daEfraim naGeser noulifilo washo.
NaKibsaim noulifilo washo naBet-Horon noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Ndele mepata laDan: Elteke noulifilo washo, Gibbeton noulifilo washo.
Aijalon noulifilo washo, Gat-Rimmon noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Ndele metata lepata laManasse: Taanak noulifilo washo naGat-Rimmon noulifilo washo: oilando ivali.
Aishe kumwe oilando omulongo nomaulifilo ayo komaludi ovana vaKohat ava va xupa po.
Ndele kovana vaGerson vomoludi lOvalevi, vometata lepata laManasse oshihondamenolando shoonakudipaa: Golan muBasan noulifilo washo naBeestera noulifilo washo: oilando ivali.
Ndele mepata laIsaskar: Kisjon noulifilo washo naDaberat noulifilo washo.
Jarmut noulifilo washo, En-Gannim noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Ndele mepata laAsser: Miseal noulifilo washo. Abdon noulifilo washo.
Helkat noulifilo washo, naRehob noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Ndele mepata laNaftali oshihondamenolando shoonakudipaa: Kedes muGalilea noulifilo washo naHammot-Dor noulifilo washo naKartan noulifilo washo; oilando itatu.
Oilando aishe yOvagerson oya li oilando omulongo naitatu noulifilo wayo.
Ndele komaludi ovana vaMerari, Omulevi, ava va xupa po natango mepata laSebulon: Jokneam noulifilo washo, Karta noulifilo washo.
Dimna noulifilo washo, Nahalal noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Ndele mepata laRuben: Beser noulifilo washo, naJahas noulifilo washo.
Kedemot noulifilo washo naMefat noulifilo washo: oilando ine.
Ndele mepata laGad oshihondamenolando shoonakudipaa: Ramot muGilead noulifilo washo, naMahanaim noulifilo washo.
Hesbon noulifilo washo, Jaeser noulifilo washo: aishe kumwe oilando ine.
Oilando aishe yovana vaMerari pamaludi avo, ava va xupa po natango momaludi Ovalevi: oilando omulongo naivali opashihoololifo.
Oilando aishe yOvalevi mokati koitukulwa yovana vaIsrael oya li oilando omilongo nhee naihetatu nomaulifilo ayo.
Moilando ei oshilando keshe sha li shi noulifilo tau shi dingilile. Osho ngaha oilando aishe oyo.
Osho ngaha hano Omwene okwa yandja kuIsrael edu alishe, Ye e li udanekelele ooxe nokwaana e li va pe. Ndele vo ove li nangala ndele va kala mo.

NOmwene okwe va pa etulumuko keembinga adishe naanaa ngaashi a udanekelele ooxe nokwaana. Inapa kala nande omutondadi wavo umwe, a shiiva oku va kala moshipala, osheshi Omwene okwa yandja ovatondadi vavo aveshe momake avo.
Ondjovo nande imwe yomeendjovo adishe diwa, Omwene e di popya neumbo laIsrael, ya kala inai wanifwa. Adishe da wanifwa.
22: Opo nee Josua okwa ifana Ovarubeni nOvagad netata lepata lOvamanasse
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Nye mwa diinina ashishe eshi Moses, omupiya wOmwene, e mu lombwela, ndele mwa uda nge mwaashishe nde shi mu lombwela.
Nye inamu efa oovakweni mefimbo eli lile fiyo onena, ndelenee mwa diinina oshipango eshi mwe shi lombwelwa kOmwene Kalunga keni.
Ndelenee paife Omwene Kalunga keni a pa ovamwanyoko etulumuko ngaashi Ye e va udanekela. Hano shuneni mu ye komatwali eni koshilongo mwe shi pewa kuMoses, omupiya waKalunga, kombada yaJordan.

Ashike diinineni shili oshipango nomhango ei, Moses omupiya wOmwene, e mu lombwela mu kale nokuhola Omwene Kalunga keni nokweenda neendjila daye adishe nokudiinina oipango yaye nokukanyatela muye noku mu longela nomutima weni aushe nomwenyo weni aushe.”
Opo nee Josua okwe va nangeka noupuna ndele te va lekele. Ndele vo ova ya komatwali avo.

Ndelenee etata limwe lepata laManasse, Moses okwe li pa oshitukulwafyuululwa muBasan, netata likwao lepata, Josua okwe li pa oshitukulwa pamwe novamwaina, kombinga ei yaJordan mouninginino. Ndele Josua eshi e va lekela va ye komatwali avo, ye okwe va nangeka yo noupuna,

nokwa popya navo ndele ta ti: “Shuneni ko komatwali eni noupuna muhapu neemhunga doimuna noshisiliveli noshingoldo noshikushu noshivela noikutu ihapu. Oixuulwa yokovatondadi veni i liyandjeleni novamwanyoko.”

Osho ngaha hano ovana vaRuben novana vaGad netata lepata laManasse va shuna ndele va dja po povana vaIsrael muSilo, osho shi li medu laKaanan, va ya kedu laGilead, koshilongo shavo oko va pewa oshitukulwalongo shavo kuMoses palombwelo lOmwene.
Ovana vaRuben novana vaGad netata lepata laManasse eshi ve uya koyuunda yomamanya puJordan, ei i li medu laKaanan, ova tunga ko oaltari puJordan, oaltari inene unene.
Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael eshi va uda tapa tiwa: Taleni, ovana vaRuben novana vaGad netata lepata laManasse, ova tunga oaltari ya shaama nedu laKaanan poyuunda yopuJordan kombinga yovana vaIsrael,
ovana vaIsrael eshi ve shi uda, eongalo alishe lovana vaIsrael la ongala muSilo, opo ve va homone.
Novana vaIsrael va tuma Pinehas yaEliaser, omupristeli kovana vaRuben nokovana vaGad noketata lepata laManasse medu laGilead,
nomalenga omulongo pamwe naye, elenga limwe koludi keshe lomapata aeshe aIsrael. Keshe limwe la li omukulunhu woludi lomapata aIsrael.
Vo eshi ve uya kovana vaRuben nokovana vaGad noketata lepata lovana vaManasse medu laGilead, vo ova popya navo ndele tava ti:

Eongalo alishe lOmwene tali ti ngaha: “Nye omwa tauluka ngahelipi eudafano nokuliteeka Kalunga kaIsrael, nye eshi tamu liteeka Omwene nena eli, eshi mwe litungila oaltari ndele tamu tu ondubo nOmwene paife?
Okunyona kwetu molwaPeor nani inaku tu wanena nofiyo onena eli inatu koshwa molwokunyona oko, nomolwakwo ehandukilo la hanga eongalo lOmwene?
Ndele nye mwa hala paife okuliteeka Omwene; nye ngeenge tamu tu ondubo nOmwene, nena Ye ota ka handukila mongula eongalo alishe laIsrael.

Ndelenee oshitukulwalongo ngeenge inashi yela, ileni moshilongo shoovene shOmwene, omo mu na etwali liyapuki lOmwene, mu tule mokati ketu. Ndelenee inamu twa ondubo nOmwene ndele inamu twa ondubo nafye mokulitungila oaltari ponho yoaltari yOmwene Kalunga ketu.
Akan yaSera eshi a kufa mo moinima ya tokolelwa ehanauno, ehandu inali uya nani kombada yeongalo alishe laIsrael? Ndele haye mwene aeke a nyonauka molwokunyona kwaye.”
Opo nee ovana vaRuben novana vaGad netata lepata laManasse ova nyamukula, ndele tava ti kovakulunhu vomapata aIsrael:
“Kalunga koikalunga, Omwene, heeno, Kalunga koikalunga, Omwene, Ye e shi shii! NaIsrael yo na kale e shi shii! Fye ngeenge twa twa ondubo ile twe liteeka Omwene, Omwene ino tu kwafa nena eli,
eshi twe litungila oaltari tu liteeke ngeno Omwene. Ndele ngeenge twe i tunga tu yambe kuyo omaxwikiloyambo neendjayambo ile tu yambe kuyo omapanduloyambo, Omwene Ye mwene ne shi ngumaune po.
Ndelenee oshili, fye twe shi ninga molwoshisho eshi: ‘Komesho ovana veni tava dulu okulombwela ovana vetu ndele tava ti: Nye omu na shike nOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael?
Omwene, tu shii, okwa tula po Jordan ngaashi ongaba pokati ketu nanye, ovana vaRuben novana vaGad.’ Nye muhe noshitukulwa mOmwene. Osho ngaha hano ovana vetu itava tila vali Omwene omolwovana veni.
Onghee twa tya: Tu litungileni oaltari ndelenee hakuyamba omaxwikiloyambo nomatomenoyambo,

ndelenee opo shi ninge ondobwedi pokati ketu nanye nomaludalo etu konima yetu, opo tu longe eyakulolonga lOmwene koshipala shaye nomaxwikiloyambo etu nomatomenoyambo etu nomapanduloyambo etu, opo ovana veni komesho vaha ka shiive okutya: ‘Nye kamu na mo sha mOmwene.’

Ndele fye otwa diladila nokutya: ‘Vo ngeenge tave shi tu lombwele komesho, noludalo letu, fye ohatu ka tya: Taleni oshiyelekela shoaltari yOmwene ootate va ninga hakuyamba omaxwikiloyambo nomatomenoyambo, opo i kale ondobwedi pokati ketu nanye.’

Nashi kale kokule nafye tu kale tu nondubo nOmwene ndele tu liteeke nena Omwene mokutunga oaltari yomaxwikiloyambo noyeendjayambo noyomatomenoyambo ponho yoaltari yOmwene Kalunga ketu, oyo i li komesho yetwali laye liyapuki.”

Omupristeli Pinehas novakulunhu veongalo novakulunhu vomapata aIsrael, ava va li pamwe naye, eshi va uda eendjovo odo da popiwa kovana vaRuben nokovana vaGad nokovana vaManasse, da li diwa momatwi avo.

Opo nee omupristeli Pinehas yaEliaser ta lombwele ovana vaRuben novana vaGad novana vaManasse ta ti: “Paife eshi tu shi shii nokutya, Omwene oku li mokati ketu, nye eshi inamu liteeka Omwene. Osho ngaha hano mwa xupifa ovana vaIsrael vaha hangike keke lOmwene.”
Opo nee omupristeli Pinehas yaEliaser novakulunhu va shuna va dja po povana vaRuben novaGad medu laGilead, va ya kedu laKaanan kovana vaIsrael, ndele ve va twaalela enyamukulo.
Nenyamukulo ola li liwa momatwi ovana vaIsrael, novana vaIsrael va hambelela Kalunga. Ndele vo inava diladila vali ve va homone nokunyona po edu omo ovana vaRuben novana vaGad va kala.
Novana vaRuben novana vaGad va luka oaltari ondobwedi: “Osho ondobwedi pokati ketu nokutya, Omwene Oye Kalunga.”
23: Eshi pa pita efimbo lile Omwene eshi a pa Israel etulumuko kovatondadi vaye aveshe keembinga adishe, ndele Josua okwa kulupa nomafiku aye a ninga mahapu,
Josua okwa ifana Israel ashishe, ovakulunhu vasho nomalenga asho, ovatokoli vasho novapashukili vasho, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ame nda kulupa, omafiku ange a ninga mahapu.
Ndele nye vene mwa mona ashishe eshi Omwene Kalunga keni a ningila oiwana aishe oyo, Ye e i taataa komesho yeni, osheshi Omwene, Kalunga keni, Ye e mu kondjela.

Taleni, ame nde mu hoololela epata keshe noshihoololifo oiwana oyo ya xupa po natango, oshitukulwafyuululwa, okudja kuJordan fiyo okEfuta Lopokati mouninginino, pamwe noiwana aishe oyo ame nde i taataa.
NOmwene Kalunga keni, Ye mwene ote ke i taataa komesho yeni, Oye ote va tembula koshipala sheni, mu shiive okunangala oilongo yayo, Omwene Kalunga keni ngaashi e mu udanekela.
Ndelenee nye mu nokukala mwa pama nokudiinina shili aishe ya shangelwa mo membo lomhango yaMoses muha yapukile kolulyo ile kolumosho lomhango.
Inamu dongakana noiwana oyo ya xupa po tai kala pamwe nanye. Inamu tumbula omadina oikalunga yavo ndele inamu ana kuyo, ndele inamu i longela ndele inamu linyongamena kuyo.
Ndelenee mu nokukanyatela kOmwene, Kalunga keni ngaashi mwa ninga fiyo onena eli.
Onghee Omwene okwa taataa komesho yeni oiwana inene i neenghono. Ndele inapa fyaala nande shimwe sha kala moshipala sheni.
Omulumenhu umwe womunye a taataa eyovi limwe, osheshi Omwene Kalunga keni okwe mu kondjela ngaashi e mu udanekela.
Kaleni hano oupafi molweemwenyo deni mu kale mu hole Omwene Kalunga keni.
Osheshi nye ngeenge tamu mu pilamene ndele tamu kanyatele koiwana ei ya xupa po tai kala pamwe nanye, ndele tamu hombolafana navo ndele tamu kwatafana navo, naavenya nanye,

kaleni mu shi shii, nokutya Omwene Kalunga keni ita taataa vali oiwana oyo komesho yeni, ndelenee yo tai ningi kunye eendjadja nomwiyo nongona yomalutu eni neeshosholo momesho eni fiyo nye otamu ka kombwa po moshilongo eshi shiwa, Omwene Kalunga keni e shi mu pa.

Ndele taleni, ame ohandi i paife nondjila yoonakukala aveshe kombada yedu. Ndelenee nye mu nokushiiva nomutima weni aushe nomwenyo weni aushe nokutya, kape na nande ondjovo imwe yomeendjovo adishe diwa Omwene Kalunga keni e mu lombwela tai kala inai wanifwa. Adishe de mu wanifilwa, kape na nande imwe inai wanifwa.

Ndelenee ngaashi oinima aishe iwa ye uya kombada yeni, oyo Omwene Kalunga keni e i mu udanekela, nosho yo Omwene ta ka tuma kombada yeni oiponga aishe fiyo te mu te mo medu eli liwa, mwe li pewa kOmwene Kalunga keni.

Nye ngeenge tamu teya po ehangano lOmwene Kalunga keni, Ye e li mu lombwela ndele tamu i mu ka longele oikalunga imwe ndele tamu linyongamene kuyo, opo nee ehandu lOmwene tali ke mu xwamena ndele tamu ka nyonwa po diva medu eli liwa Ye e li mu pa.”
24: Ndele Josua okwa ongela omapata aeshe aIsrael muSekem, ndele okwa ifana ovakulunhu vaIsrael nomalenga avo novatokoli vavo novapashukili vavo, ndele ve uya okukala ofika koshipala shaKalunga.

Opo nee Josua okwa lombwela oshiwana ashishe ndele ta ti: “Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha: ‘Ooxokulu, nosho yo Tera, xe yaAbraham naNahor, va kala nale kombada yomulonga waEufrat, ndele venya va longela oikalunga imwe.
Ndelenee Ame nda kufa xo Abraham kombinga inya yomulonga ndele nde mu endifa medu alishe laKaanan, ndele nda hapupalifa oludalo laye ndele nde mu pa Isak.
Ndele nda pa Isak Jakob naEsau, ndele kuEsau nda yandja eemhunda daSeir e di nangale. Ndelenee Jakob novana vaye va ya kuEgipiti.
Opo nee nda tuma ko Moses naAron ndele nda handukila Egipiti noiponga nde i ningila ko, opo nee Ame nde mu pitifa mo.
Ame eshi nda pitifa mo muEgipiti ooxo, nye mwe uya kefuta. Ndelenee Ovaegipiti va shikula ooxo nomatemba oita novalondi veenghambe fiyo okEfuta Litilyana.

Ndelenee vo ova kuwa kOmwene ndele Ye okwa tula po omilaulu pokati keni nOvaegipiti nokwe va undulila mefuta, lo ole va tuvikila, nomesho eni vene a mona osho nde shi ningila Ovaegipiti. Opo nee mwa kala omafiku mahapu mombuwa.

Opo nee Ame nde mu eta medu lOvaamori ava va kala moushilo waJordan, ndele vo ove mu lwifa. Ndelenee Ame onde va yandja momake eni, opo mwa nangala oshilongo shavo, ndele Ame onde va taataa komesho yeni.
Opo nee Balak yaSippor, ohamba yaMoab, ye lilongekida, ndele ya lwifa Israel. Ndele yo oya tuma kuBileam yaBeor, ye mu ifana e mu finge.
Ndelenee Ame inandi uda Bileam, opo ye e mu nangeka ashike noupuna. Ndele Ame onde mu xupifa mo momake aye.

Nye eshi mwa tauluka Jordan ndele mwe uya kuJeriko, opo nee oonakukala muJeriko nOvaamori nOvaperesi nOvakaanan nOvaheti nOvagirgasi nOvahevi nOvajebusi ve mu lwifa. Ndelenee Ame onde va yandja momake eni,
ndele nde mu tetekelifa omawashe, aa e va taataa komesho yeni, eehamba mbali dOvaamori, hakeongamukonda loye nouta woye.
Osho ngaha hano Ame nde mu pa edu nye inamu li longa, noilando nye inamu i tunga, mu shiive okukala mo muyo, noikokola yomiviinyu nomalumono, aa inaa twikwa kunye, opo mu lye kudo.’
“Tileni hano paife Omwene noku mu longela mouyuki nomoshili ndele ekeleishi oikalunga ei ooxo va longela kombada yaEufrat nomuEgipiti, ndele longeleni Omwene.

Ndelenee ngeenge inashi mu wapalela okulongela Omwene, lihoololeleni nena eli ou mwa hala oku mu longela, ngeenge oikalunga ooxo va longela kombada yaEufrat ile oikalunga vOvaamori medu lavo mu li. Ndelenee ame neumbo lange hatu ka longela Omwene.”
Opo nee ovanhu va nyamukula tava ti: “Nashi kale kokule nafye tu efe Omwene, opo tu longele oikalunga imwe.

Osheshi Omwene Kalunga ketu Oye tuu ou e tu pitifa mo nootate medu laEgipiti meumbo loupika, ndele a ninga omadidiliko aa manene moipafi yetu, nokwe tu amena mondjila aishe twe i enda nomoiwana aishe muyo twa taulula mo.
NOmwene okwa taataa oiwana aishe nOvaamori, oonakukala moshilongo, komesho yetu. Nafye yo ohatu ka longela Omwene, osheshi Oye Kalunga ketu.”
Ndelenee Josua okwa lombwela ovanhu ta ti: “Nye itamu dulu okulongela Kalunga. Osheshi Oye Kalunga omuyapuki, Ye Kalunga omuladi. Ye ita ka dima po omatauluko eni nomatimba eni.
Nye ngeenge tamu efa Omwene ndele tamu longele oikalunga imwe, Ye ote ke mu ningila vali owii ndele te mu kombo po, Ye eshi kwa li e mu ningila ouwa.”
Opo nee ovanhu va lombwela Josua: “Ahowe. Ndelenee fye ohatu ka longela Omwene.”
Opo nee Josua okwa lombwela ovanhu ta ti: “Onye eendobwedi deni vene, nokutya nye vene mwe li hoololela Omwene mu mu longele.” Ndele vo tava ti: “Heeno, fye eendobwedi.”
Okwa ti: “Ekeleishi hano paife oikalunga imwe ei mu i kwete, omitima deni di amekeni kOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael.”
Opo nee ovanhu va lombwela Josua: “Fye ohatu ka longela Omwene Kalunga ketu nokupwilikina ondaka yaye.”
Ndele mefiku tuu olo Josua okwa ninga ehangano novanhu nokwe va pangelela onghedimhango nomayukifo muSekem,
neendjovo edi Josua okwe di shangela membo lomhango yaKalunga, ndele okwa kufa emanya lakula, ndele okwe li dika momwandi ou u li monhele iyapuki yOmwene.

Opo nee Josua okwa lombwela ovanhu aveshe ta ti: “Taleni, emanya eli tali ka ninga ondobwedi yetu, osheshi lo ola uda eendjovo adishe dOmwene, Ye e di popya nafye. Ndele lo otali ka kala ondobwedi kunye, opo muhe lidimbike Kalunga keni.”
Opo nee Josua okwa lekela ovanhu, keshe umwe koshitukulwafyuululwa shaye.
Ndele konima yoinima ei Josua yaNun, omupiya wOmwene, okwa fya, e nomido efele nomulongo.
Ndele vo ove mu paka monhele yoshitukulwafyuululwa shaye muTimnat-Sera, keemhunda daEfraim koumbangalanhu womhunda yaGaas.

Ndele Ovaisraeli va longela Omwene omafiku aeshe fimbo Josua kwa li e nomwenyo nomafiku aeshe fimbo ovakulunhu ava va kala efimbo lile nomwenyo konima yefyo laJosua ava va shiiva nawa oilonga aishe yOmwene, Ye e i ningila Israel.

Nomakipa aJosef, ovana vaIsrael va dile nao muEgipiti, ove a paka muSekem, monhele oyo Jakob kwa li e lilandela noimaliwa efele limwe kovana vaHamor, xe yaSekem, oyo oludalo laJosef la pewa ngaashi oshitukulwafyuululwa.
Ndele Eliaser yaAron eshi a fya, ove mu paka moshikulundu shomona waye omumati Pinehas, osho a pewa keemhunda daEfraim.

1: Ndele konima yefyo laJosua, ovana vaIsrael va pula kOmwene ndele tava ti: “Olyelye womufye e nokufikama tete a ka lwife Ovakaanan?”
NOmwene okwa tya: “Juda e nokufikama tete. Taleni, Ame ohandi yandje oshilongo momake aye.”

Opo nee Juda ta ti komukulu waye Simeon: “Tu ye pamwe moshitukulwa shange, opo tu shiive okulwifa Ovakaanan, opo nee naame yo ohandi ka ya pamwe naave moshitukulwa shoye.” Ndele Simeon okwa ya pamwe naye.
Ndele Juda okwa ya, nOmwene okwa yandja momake aye Ovakaanan nOvaperesi, ndele va taataa ovalumenhu omayovi omulongo vomuvo muBesek.
Ndele va shakena naAdoni-Besek muBesek, ndele ve mu lwifa, ndele va taataa Ovakaanan nOvaperesi.
Ndele Adoni-Besek eshi a ya onhapo, vo ove mu shikula, ndele ve mu kwata, ndele va teta ominwe daye dakula dokomake nominwe daye dakula dokeemhadi.

Opo nee Adoni-Besek ta ti: Eehamba omilongo heyali odo da tetwa ominwe dokomake nominwe dokeemhadi, oda toola oundjaumukile koshi yoshitaafula shange shoshililo. Ngaashi ame nda ningile, osho Kalunga a ningila nge. Ndele ve mu twala kuJerusalem, noko a fila.
Novana vaJuda va homona Jerusalem, ndele ve shi nangala, noonakukalamo ve va dipaa neongamukonda ndele va xwika po oshilando.
Ndele konima ovana vaJuda va fikama va ka lwife Ovakaanan, ava va kala keemhunda, nomoshilongo shoumbangalanhu nomedu la lalakana.
Juda okwa homona Ovakaanan, oonakukalamo muHebron (edina laHebron la li nale Kiriat-Arba), ndele va taataa Sesai naAhiman naTalmai.
Ndele ye okwa dja ko nokwa ya a ka homone oonakukalamo muDebir (edina laDebir la li nale Kiriat-Sefer).
Ndele Kaleb ta ti: “Ou ta teya Kiriat-Sefer ndele te shi nangala, ame handi mu pe omona wange okakadona Aksa, a ninge omwalikadi waye.”
Opo nee Otniel yaKenas, ondenge yaKaleb e shi nangala. Ndele ye okwe mu pa omona waye okakadona Aksa a ninge omwalikadi waye.
Ndele Aksa eshi e uya, ye okwe mu heka, a pule kuxe epya. Ndele ye eshi a londoloka kokandongi, Kaleb okwe mu pula: “Wa hala shike?”
Ndele ye ta ti kuye: “Pe nge oshali. Osheshi ove wa pa nge edu likukutu, u nokupa nge eefifiya.” Opo nee Kaleb e mu pa eefifiya keemhunda nomefilu.
Ndele ovana vOmukeni, haukwe waMoses, ova fikama pamwe novana vaJuda moshilando shomilunga kombuwa yaJuda, yo i li koumbuwanhu waArad. Ndele ye okwa ya ko ndele a kala mokati kovanhu.
Ndele Juda okwa fikama pamwe nomukulu waye Simeon, ndele va taataa Ovakaanan, ava va kala muSefat, ndele ve shi hanauna po. Onghee va luka oshilando Horma.
Ndele Juda okwa nangala Gasa nomikunda dasho naAskelon nomikunda dasho naEkron nomikunda dasho.
NOmwene okwa li pamwe naJuda, onghee ye okwa nangala eemhunda. Ndelenee oonakukala vomomaluhaela ye a nyengwa oku va taataa shaashi vo va li ve nomatemba oivela.
Ndele va pa Kaleb Hebron ngaashi sha tongwa kuMoses. Ndele ye okwa taataa mo ovana vaAnak vatatu.
Novana vaBenjamin inava taataa mo Ovajebusi, oonakukalamo muJerusalem, onghee hano Ovajebusi va kala pamwe novana vaBenjamin muJerusalem fiyo onena eli.
Neumbo laJosef ola fikama yo va ye kuBetel, nOmwene okwa kala pamwe navo.
Neumbo laJosef eshi la lava Betel (edina loshilando la li nale Lus)
eendadi da mona omulumenhu umwe ta di mo moshilando ndele tadi mu lombwele: “Tu ulikila apa pa heva okupumina moshilando, opo hatu ku filonghenda.”
Ye okwe va ulikila apa pa heva okupumina moshilando. Ndele va dipaa neongamukonda oonakukalamo moshilando. Ndelenee omulumenhu winya nepata laye alishe ve li efa.
Nomulumenhu okwa dja mo nokwa ya moshilongo shOvaheti nokwa tunga oshilando nokwe shi luka Lus. Olo edina lasho fiyo onena eli.
Ndele Manasse ina taataa Betshan naTaanak naDor naJibleam naMegido nomikunda domoushiinda dOvakaanan. NOvakaanan tava dulu okukala moshilongo.
Ndelenee Ovaisraeli eshi va ninga eenghono, ova fininika Ovakaanan oku va longela. Vo inave va taataa mo shekesheke.
Ndele Efraim ina taataa mo Ovakaanan, oonakukalamo muGeser. Onghee hano Ovakaanan va kala mokati kavo muGeser.
Sebulon ina taataa mo oonakukalamo muKitron noonakukalamo muNahalol. Onghee hano Ovakaanan va kala mokati kavo. Ndelenee vo va fininikwa oku va longela.
Asser ina taataa mo oonakukalamo muAkko noonakukalamo muSidon nomuAglab nomuAksib nomu Helba nomuAfik nomuRehob,
onghee hano Ovaasseri va kala mokati kOvakaanan, ovanhu vomoshilongo, osheshi inave va taataa mo.

Naftali ina taataa mo oonakukalamo muBet-Semes noonakukalamo muBet-Anat, onghee ye a kala mo mokati kOvakaanan, ovanhu vomoshilongo. Ndelenee oonakukalamo muBet-Semes naBet-Anat, va fininikwa oku va longela.
NOvaamori va undwila ovana vaDan keemhunda, osheshi inave va efa okuuya medu la lalakana.
NOvaamori va kala muHar-Heres nomuAijalon nomuSaalbim. Ndelenee eke leumbo laJosef le va fininika ndele ve va longela.
Nongaba yOvaamori ya dja kuAkrabim, kemanya laSela ndele tai londo okudja kuShela.
2: Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene okwa dja muGilgal e uya kuBokim, ndele ta ti: “Ame nde mu pitifa mo muEgipiti ndele nde mu eta medu eli, nde li udanekela ooxo nokwaana, ndele nda tile: ‘Ame ihandi ka teya po ehangano letu nanye fiyo alushe,
