Opo nee omupristeli Hilkia naAhikam naAkbor naSafan naAsasia va ya komuxunganeki omukainhu Hulda, omwalikadi waSallum yaTikva yaHarhas, omudiinini woikutu, ye a kala muJerusalem mOshilando Shipe, ndele va popya naye.
Ndele ye ta ti kuvo: “Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha: ‘Lombweleni omulumenhu ou e mu tuma kwaame:
Omwene ta ti ngaha: “Tala, Ame ohandi tumine onhele ei noonakukalamo omupya, heeno, eendjovo adishe domembo, ohamba yaJuda ye li lesha.
Shaashi ve liteeka nge ndele va twimina oikalunga imwe, va handukifa nge noilonga aishe yomake avo. Onghee hano oupyuhandu wange tau ka xwamena onhele ei, ndele itau ka dima.
Ndelenee lombweleni ohamba yaJuda, oyo ye mu tuma okupula kOmwene, mu tye: Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha molweendjovo we di uda,

osheshi omutima woye wa pupalekwa keendjovo we di uda, ndele we lininipika koshipala shOmwene, eshi wa uda osho nde shi popya konhele ei noonakukalamo vayo, nokutya vo otava ka ninga oitilifa netumbulo lokutula omutima, ndele ove eshi wa pombaula oikutu yoye ndele wa lila koshipala shange, onghee hano nde ku uda, Omwene ta ti.
Onghee hano, tala, Ame ohandi ku ongele pooxo, ndele oto ka nangala nombili mombila yoye, nomesho oye itaa ka tala omupya ou Ame ohandi ka tumina onhele ei.” ’ ” Ndele va etela ohamba enyamukulo olo.
23: Opo nee ohamba ya ifana ndele va ongaleka ovakulunhu aveshe vaJuda novaJerusalem kuyo.

Nohamba ya ya mongulu yOmwene novalumenhu aveshe vaJuda noonakukalamo aveshe vomuJerusalem va ya pamwe nayo, nosho yo ovapristeli novaxunganeki novanhu aveshe, ounona novakulunhu. Ndele yo oya lesha eendjovo adishe domembo lehangano, lo la monika mongulu yOmwene, yo oye li leshela momatwi avo.

Nohamba ya kala ofika pongudi ndele tai ningi ehangano nOmwene koshipala shOmwene, nokutya vo ve nokudiinina nomutima aushe nomwenyo aushe oipango yaye neendobwedi daye neenghedimhango daye, opo va diinine eendjovo odo da shangelwa membo olo. Novanhu aveshe ve uya mehangano olo.

Opo nee ohamba tai lombwele omupristeli omukulunhu Hilkia novapristeli ve mu shikula novanangeli vopoivelo, va kufe mo motembeli oinima aishe ya ningilwa Baal naAsera neengudu adishe dokeulu. Ndele ve i xwika po pondje yaJerusalem kepumbu laKidron ndele omute wayo ve u twala kuBetel.

Ndele yo oya lekela yo ovapristeli voikalunga ava va tulwa moshilonga keehamba daJuda, ava va twimina koikulundu nomoushiinda waJerusalem, nosho yo venya va twiminina Baal netango nohani neengudu deenyofi nongudu aishe yokeulu.
Ndele ya kufa mo mongulu yOmwene Asera ndele ye shi twala pondje yaJerusalem, ndele ye shi xwika po pokamulonga kaKidron ndele ye shi twa ondwi, nondwi ye i ekelashi komaendo ovafyoona.
Ndele yo oya hanauna po eengulu domashenge odo da li mongulu yOmwene, mudo ovakainhu va tungila Asera omalapi oulenga.

Ndele oya ifana ovapristeli aveshe vomoilando yaJuda, ndele ya nyatekifa oikulundu yeealtari, oko ovapristeli va twimina, okudja kuGeba fiyo okuBerseba. Ndele yo oya hanauna po oikulundu yeealtari da li poivelo, naasho yo sha kala poshivelo shaJosua, omukulunhu woshilando, kolumosho omunhu ngeenge ta i mo moshivelo shoshilando.
Ovapristeli voikulundu yeealtari inava itavelwa okulonda koaltari yOmwene muJerusalem. Vo ova itavelwa okulya omungome uhe nonhafi pamwe navakwao.
Yo oya nyatekifa yo Tofet, sho sha li mefilu lovana vaHinnom, paha kale nande umwe ta endifile Molek ovana vaye ovamati ile oukadona momundilo.

Ndele yo ya kufa po eenghambe, eehamba daJuda de di yandjela okufimaneka etango, poshivelo shongulu yOmwene, pokandjuwo kelenga Natan-Melek lo la kala moushiinda woshilando, nomatemba etango yo ye a xwika po nomundilo.

Navali ohamba ya ngumauna po eealtari da li konduda yokangulu kopombada kaAhas, odo da ningwa keehamba daJuda, neealtari odo Manasse a tungila moihale ivali yomongulu yOmwene, ndele ya twa, nondwi yomuyo ye i ekelashi mokamulonga Kidron.

Nohamba ya nyatekifa oikulundu yokoushilo wokuJerusalem, koumbuwanhu wOmhunda yEnyonauko, oyo ya tungwa kuSalomo, ohamba yaIsrael, okufimanekifa Astarte, oixuna yOvasidoni, naKemosh, oixuna yOvamoab, naMilkom, oixuna yovana vaAmmoni.
Ndele yo oya teyaula eengudi domamanya ndele tai ke omiti domalupwelele daAsera neenhele dao yo ye di yadifa nomakipa ovanhu.

Nosho yo ya ngumauna po oaltari ya li muBetel, oshikulundu sha tungwa kuJerobeam yaNebat, ou a hongaulila Israel mokunyona, oaltari osho yo oshikulundu e shi hanauna po, ndele e shi ndongola nolupwelele laAsera e li xwika po.

Josia eshi a pilamena ko, okwa mona eembila da li komhunda. Okwa tuma ko, va ka kufe omakipa omeembila, nokwe a xwika po koaltari nokwe shi nyatekifa pandjovo yOmwene, omulumenhu waKalunga kwe di udaneka, ou a xunganeka oinima ei.

Opo nee ye ta ti: “Oshidimbulukifomanya eshi shokombila, ndi shi wete, oshilipipo?” Novalumenhu vomoshilando ve mu nyamukula: “Oyo ombila yomulumenhu waKalunga, a dile kuJuda nokwa xunganeka oinima ei, ove we i ningila oaltari yomuBetel.”
Opo nee ye ta ti: “Na kale nombili, nande umwe a kufe omakipa aye.” Ndele va efa omakipa aye a kale pamwe nomakipa omuxunganeki wokuSamaria, a kale nombili.
Neetembeli yo adishe domoikulundu yo ya li moilando yaSamaria, odo da tungwa keehamba daIsrael, opo va handukife Omwene, Josia e di ngumauna po nokwa ninga nado ngaashi a ninga muBetel.
Novapristeli aveshe voikulundu va li ko okwe va toma keealtari nokwa xwika po kuyo omakipa ovanhu ndele ta shuna kuJerusalem.
Opo nee ohamba ya lombwela oshiwana ashishe, tai ti: “Daneni Opaasa yOmwene Kalunga keni, ngaashi pa shangelwa membo lehangano.”
Osheshi Opaasa oyo inai danwa nghee omafiku ovatokolipangeli vaIsrael va pangela nomomafiku aeshe aa eehamba daIsrael nodaJuda.
Ndelenee momudo omutimulongo nomutihetatu wohamba Josia, Opaasa ei yOmwene ya danenwa muJerusalem.

Josia okwa komba po ovaifani veemhepo dovafi novamonikokule noihongwakalunga yomeumbo noikalunga noififahoni aishe oyo ya li moshilongo shaJuda nomuJerusalem, opo a pameke eendjovo domhango, odo da shangelwa membo, omupristeli Hilkia e li mona mongulu yOmwene.

Ndele kakwa li nande ohamba imwe komesho yaye ngaashi ye, ou e lidilulula e liyandja kOmwene nomutima waye aushe nomwenyo waye aushe neenghono daye adishe pamhango aishe yaMoses, ndele konima yaye inapa holoka nande imwe ngaashi ye.
Ndelenee Omwene ina handukuluka nande koupyuhandu waye munene nao ehandu laye la xwamena Juda omolwomahandukifo aeshe Manasse e mu handukifa.

NOmwene okwa tile: “Ame ohandi ka ekelashi Juda ngaashi nda ekelashi Israel koshipala shange. Naame ohandi ka ekelashi oshilando eshi Jerusalem nde shi hoolola, nongulu oyo nde i popya: Edina lange tali ka kala muyo.”
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Josia naaishe e i ninga, inai shangelwa mbela membo lomafimbo eehamba daJuda?
Pomafiku aye Farao Neko, ohamba yaEgipiti, ya homona ohamba yaAsiria komulonga waEufrat. Ohamba Josia oye ke mu shakeneka ko, Ndelenee Farao okwe mu dipaa muMegido divadiva, eshi ye mu mona.

Novapiya vaye ve mu twala a fya metemba, va dja kuMegido, ve mu eta kuJerusalem, ndele ve mu paka mombila yaye. Novanhu vomoshilongo va kufa Joahas yaJosia, nove mu vaeka ndele ve mu ninga ohamba ponhele yaxe.
Omido daJoahas da li omilongo mbali nanhatu, ye eshi a ninga ohamba. Nokwa pangela eehani nhatu muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Hamutal, omona omukainhu waJeremia womuLibna.
Ndele ye okwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene ngaashi ooxe va ninga.

Ndelenee Farao Neko okwe mu kwata onghwate muRibla, medu laHamat, opo ye aha pangele muJerusalem, nokwa futifa oshilongo ofuto yeekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane doshisiliveli neekilograma omilongo nhatu nanhee doshingoldo.
Ndele Farao Neko okwa ninga Eliakim yaJosia ohamba ponhele yaxe Josia, nokwa lundulula edina laye Jehoiakim, ndelenee okwa twala Joahas pamwe naye kuEgipiti, ndele oko a fila.

Noisiliveli noingoldo yo, Jehoiakim okwa tumina Farao. Ndelenee okwa yeleka omapya, opo a dule okufuta oimaliwa palombwelo laFarao. Pafendelo lakeshe, okwa tambula oshisiliveli noshingoldo shoonakukalamo moshilongo nokwe shi tumina Farao Neko.
Omido daJehoiakim da li omilongo mbali nanhano, ye eshi a ninga ohamba. Nokwa pangela omido omulongo nomudo umwe muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Sebida, omona waPedaja womuRuma.
Ndele ye okwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene, ngaashi ooxe va ninga.
24: Pomafiku aJehoiakim, Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, ya fikama i lwe, ndele Jehoiakim okwa ninga omupiya wayo omido nhatu. Eshi da pita, ye okwe i liteeka.

Opo nee Omwene ta tumu eemwiila dOvakaldea neemwiila dOvaarami neemwiila dOvamoab neemwiila dOvaammoni, di mu lwife Ye okwe di tuma okulwifa Juda, di shi hanaune po pandjovo yOmwene e i popififa ovapiya vaye ovaxunganeki.
Oshili osho sha ningilwa Juda palombwelo lOmwene, e va ekeleshi koshipala shaye omolwomatimba aManasse, molwoilonga aishe e i longa,
nomolwohonde ihe netimba, ye e i tilashi, eshi a yadifa Jerusalem nohonde ihe netimba. Onghee hano Omwene ina hala oku a dima po.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Jehoiakim naaishe e i ninga, inai shangelwa mbela membo lomafimbo eehamba daJuda?
Ndele Jehoiakim okwa ka nangala pooxe, nomona waye Jehoiakin a ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
Nohamba yaEgipiti inai fikama vali i dje moshilongo shayo, osheshi ohamba yaBabilon ya nangala ashishe eshi sha li shohamba yaEgipiti, okudja kokamulonga kaEgipiti fiyo okomulonga waEufrat.
Omido daJehoiakin da li omulongo nahetatu, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela eehani nhatu muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Nehusta, omona okakadona kaElnatan womuJerusalem.
Nokwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene, ngaashi ooxe va ninga.
Pefimbo tuu olo ovapiya vaNebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, va homona Jerusalem, ndele va kondeka oshilando.
Ndele Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabel, eshi ye uya koshilando, fimbo ovapiya vayo tave shi kondeke,
Jehoiakin, ohamba yaJuda, okwa pita mo. Okwa ya kohamba yaBabilon, ye, naina novapiya novakulunhu vaye nomalenga aye. Nohamba yaBabilon ye mu kwata onghwate momudo omutihetatu wepangelo laye.
Ndele yo oya kufa mo omamona aeshe omotembeli yOmwene nomamona omongulu yohamba. Ndele ya teta oingoldo yomoinima ya ningwa kuSalomo, ohamba yaIsrael, motembeli yOmwene, ngaashi Omwene a tongele.

Ndele yo oya twala oonakukalamo aveshe vomuJerusalem novakulunhu aveshe, noipuna aishe, eenghwate omayovi omulongo novahambwidi aveshe novapangeli voipatifo. Inapa fyaala nande umwe ponho yomapongo omoshilongo.
Ndele yo oya twala Jehoiakin moukwatwa kuBabilon, nosho yo ina yohamba novambada vohamba nomalenga ayo. Novanenenhu vomoshilongo ye va kufa muJerusalem, ye va twala moukwatwa kuBabilon.
Noipuna aishe i fike pomayovi aheyali, novahambwidi novapangeli voipatifo ve fike peyovi, aveshe ovaladi va ika okulwa, ovo ohamba yaBabilon ye va twala moukwatwa kuBabilon.
Nohamba yaBabilon ya ninga Mattanja, xekulu yaJehoiakin, ohamba ponhele yaJehoiakin, ndele ya lundulula edina laye: Sedekia.
Omido daSedekia da li omilongo mbali nomudo umwe, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, ndele a pangela omido omulongo naumwe muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Hamutal, omona okakadona kaJeremia womuLibna.
Nokwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene, ngaashi Jehoiakim a ninga.
Osheshi omolwehandu lOmwene, eshi sha hanga Jerusalem naJuda, fiyo Ye e va ekelashi koshipala shaye. Ndele Sedekia okwe liteeka ohamba yaBabilon.
25: Ndele momudo omutimugoi wepangelo laye, mohani onhimulongo, mefiku etimulongo lohani, Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, ye uya nomatanga aeshe ayo ovakwaita, va homone Jerusalem. Ndele va onga onhanda ndele va tunga ekumaledu la dingilila oshilando.
Noshilando sha kala sha kondekwa fiyo okomudo omutimulongo naumwe wohamba Sedekia.
Mefiku etimugoi lohani onhine, ondjala eshi ya ninga inene moshilando novanhu vomoshilongo vehe na vali omungome,

oshilando sha puminwa, novakwaita aveshe va ya onhapo oufiku, va pita moshivelo pokati keehotekuma mbali di li poshikunino shohamba, fimbo Ovakaldea va dingilila oshilando. Nohamba ya ya nondjila yokoluhaela.
Ndelenee omatanga Ovakaldea a shikula ohamba, ndele ve i kwata moluhaela laJeriko. Novakwaita vayo aveshe ve lihana po puyo.
Opo nee va kwata ohamba ndele ve i twala kohamba yaBabilon muRibla. Ndele ve i tokola.
Ndele va dipaa ovana vaSedekia moipafi yaye. Ndele vo ova twiyula omesho aye, ndele ve mu manga nomalyenge oshikushu ndele ve mu twala kuBabilon.

Ndele mohani onhinhano mefiku etiheyali lohani nokutya, momudo omutimulongo nomutimugoi wohamba Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, Nebusaradan, ondjai yomatanga ovaengeli, omupiya wohamba yaBabilon, e uya kuJerusalem.
Nokwa xwika po ongulu yOmwene nongulu yohamba. Nosho yo eengulu adishe domuJerusalem, heeno, ongulu keshe inene okwe i xwika po nomundilo.
Nomatanga aeshe ovakwaita Ovakaldea ovo va li pomukulunhu wovanangeli, ova ngumauna po ohotekuma yaJerusalem keembinga adishe.
Ndele Nebusaradan, omukulunhu wovanangeli, okwa twala moukwatwa oshixupe shovanhu va fyaala moshilando naavo ve liyandja kohamba yaBabilon, naavo va xupa po vali.
Ndelenee ovakwanaluhepo vomoshilongo, omukulunhu wovanangeli a efa, va fyaale po, va ninga ovalongi voikokola yomiviinyu novalongi vomapya.
NOvakaldea va teyaula eengudi doshikushu domongulu yOmwene, noweendifotemba nefuta loshikushu lo la li mongulu yOmwene. Ndele va twala oshikushu osho kuBabilon.
Vo ova twala yo eembiya noixupulo, omikonda, eenheka noinima aishe yoshikushu, yo ya longifwa melongelokalunga motembeli.
Nosho omukulunhu wovanangeli a kufa oikwatelwa yomakala nomaholo aa a ningwa oshingoldoelela noshisilivelielela.
Eengudi mbali nefuta noweendifotemba, oinima oyo Salomo e i ningila ongulu yOmwene, oshikushu osho shomoinima ei aishe sha nyenga okuyelekwa.

Oule wopombada wongudi imwe wa li eemeta omulongo nahetatu, nomutwe woshikushu wa li kombada yayo, noule womutwe wa li eemeta nhatu. Komutwe wayo kwa li oulenga weenhemo noweendunga tau u dingilile; aishe oyo oshikushu, osho yo kongudi ikwao noulenga wayo.
Omukulunhu wovanangeli a kufa omupristeli omukulunhu Seraja, nomupristeli omutivali Sefania novanangeli vatatu vopoivelo.

Ndele moshilando a kufa elenga limwe lohamba la li omupashukili womatanga ovakwaita, novalumenhu vatano va kala meumbo lohamba, ve i kalela, ava va hangika moshilando, nomushangi womukulunhu, ou a ongela ovanhu ve uye koukwaita, novalumenhu omilongo hamano vomovanhu ovo vomoshilongo va hangika moshilando.
Nebusaradan, omukulunhu wovanangeli, eshi e va kufa, e va twala kohamba yaBabilon muRibla.
Nohamba yaBabilon ye va dipaa muRibla moshilongo shaHamat. Ndele Juda sha twalwa moukwatwa, sha dja moshilongo shasho.
Ndele Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, ta tula Gedalja yaAhikam yaSafan, a ninge omupangeli wovanhu ovo va fyaala moshilongo shaJuda.

Ndelenee ovakulunhu aveshe vovakwaita, novalumenhu vavo eshi va uda nokutya, ohamba yaBabilon ya tula Gedalja, a ninge omupangeli, vo ove uya kuGedalja kuMispa, nokutya ava: Ismael yaNetanja, naJohanan yaKarea, naSeraja yaTanhumet, Omunetofa, naJaasanja yaMaakati, vo pamwe novalumenhu vavo.
Ndele Gedalja okwe va anena novalumenhu vavo ndele ta ti: “Inamu tila ovapiya vOvakaldea; kaleni moshilongo ndele longeleni ohamba yaBabilon, opo nee tamu mono elao.”
Ndelenee mohani onhiheyali Ismael yaNetanja yaElisama womepata lohamba, e uya pamwe novalumenhu omulongo ndele va dipaa Gedalja, nosho va dipaa Ovajuda nOvakaldea ava va li pamwe naye muMispa.
Opo nee ovanhu aveshe, ounona novakulunhu ve lilongekida pamwe novakulunhu vomatanga, ndele va ya kuEgipiti. Osheshi va tila Ovakaldea.

Ndele momudo omutimilongo nhatu nomutiheyali woumoukwatwa waJehoiakin, ohamba yaJuda, mohani onhimulongo nonhivali mefiku etimilongo mbali netiheyali lohani, Evil-Merodak, ohamba yaBabilon, momudo wayo yo ya kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo, ya mangulula Jehoiakin, ohamba yaJuda, modolongo.
Nokwe mu popifa nombili nokwe mu kaleka omutumba koshipundi shi dule oipundi yeehamba dikwao, odo da li puye muBabilon.
Nokwa itavelwa okulidula oikutu younghwate. Ndele ta li omungome koshipala shohamba omafiku aeshe okukalamwenyo kwaye.
Nokwa pewa kohamba eendja paemhumbwe defiku keshe, eendja de mu tokolelwa omafiku aye aeshe.

1: Adam, Set, Enos,
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
Henok, Metusala, Lamek,
Noa, Sem, Ham naJafet;
Ovana ovamati vaJafet ovava: Gomer naMagog naMadai naJavan naTubal naMesek naTiras.
Novana ovamati vaGomer ovava: Askenas naRifat naTogarma.
Novana vaJavan ovamati ovava: Elisa naTarsis, nOvakittim nOvarodanim.
Ovana ovamati vaHam ovava: Kus naEgipiti naPut naKaanan.
Novana ovamati vaKus ovava: Seba naHavila naSabta naRaama naSabteka. Novana ovamati vaRaea ovava: Sheba naDedan.
Ndele Kus okwa dala Nimrod, ou a li omunaenghono nomunapangelo wotete kombada yedu.
Ndele Egipiti okwa dala Ovalud nOvaanami nOvalehabi nOvanaftuhi,
nOvapatrosi nOvakaslu muvo omo mwa dja Ovafilisti nOvakaftori.
Ndele Kaanan okwa dala Sidon, oshiveli shaye, naHet
nOvajebusi nOvaamori nOvagirgasi,
nOvahevi nOvaarki nOvasini,
nOvaarvadi nOvasemari nOvahamati.
Ovana ovamati vaSem ovava: Elam naAssur naArpaksad naLud naAram naUs naHul naGeter naMesek.
Ndele Arpaksad okwa dala Shela, ndele Shela okwa dala Eber.
Ndele Eber okwa dalelwa ovana ovamati vavali. Edina laumwe la li Peleg, osheshi pomafiku aye oonakukala kombada yedu ve li tukauka. Nedina lomumwaina la li Joktan.
Ndele Joktan okwa dala Almodad naSelef naHasarmavet naJerag,
naHadoram naUsal naDikla,
naEbal naAbimael naSheba,
naOfir naHavila naJobab. Vo aveshe va li ovana ovamati vaJoktan.
Oludalo laSem Arpaksad, Shela,
Eber, Peleg, Rehu,
Seruh, Nahor, Tera,
Abram; nokutya Abraham.
Ovana ovamati vaAbraham va li Isak naIsmael.
Eshikulafano lomapata avo oleli: Oshiveli shaIsmael sha li Nebajot, vamwaina naKedar naAdbeel naMibsam,
Misma naDuma, Massa, Hadad naTema,
Jetur, Nafis naKedma. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaIsmael.
Novana ovamati vaKetura, omwalikadi waAbraham. Ye okwa dala: Simran naJoksan naMedan naMidian naJisbak naSuah. Novana ovamati vaJoksan ovava: Sheba naDedan.
Novana ovamati vaMidian ovava: Efa naEfer naHenok naAbida naEldaa. Vo aveshe ovana ovamati vaKetura.
Ndele Abraham okwa dala Isak. Ovana ovamati vaIsak ovava: Esau naIsrael.
Ovana ovamati vaEsau: Elifas, Rehuel naJehus naJaelam naKora.
Ovana ovamati vaElifas ovava: Teman naOmar, Sefi naGaetam, Kenas naTimna naAmalek.
Ovana ovamati vaRehuel ovava: Nahat, Sera, Samma naMissa.
Novana ovamati vaSeir ovava: Lotan naSobal naSibeon naAna naDison naEser naDisan.
Novana ovamati vaLotan: Hori naHomam. Nomumwaina waLotan omukainhu oye Timna.
Novana ovamati vaSobal ovava: Aljan naManahat naEbal, Shefi naOnam. Novana ovamati vaSibeon ovava: Aja yaAna.
Novana ovamati vaAna ovava: Dison. Novana ovamati vaDison: Hamran naEsban naJitran naKeran.
Ovana ovamati vaEser ovava: Bilhan naSaavan naJaakan. Ovana ovamati vaDisan ovava: Us naAran.
Neehamba odo da pangela oshilongo shaEdom, fimbo ovana vaIsrael inava pangelwa nande kohamba imwe, odedi: Bela yaBeor. Nedina loshilando shaye Dinhaba.
Ndele Bela okwa fya. Ndele ponhele yaye Jobab yaSera wokuBosra a pangela.
Ndele Jobab okwa fya. Ndele ponhele yaye Husam womoshikandjo shOvatemani a pangela.
Ndele Husam okwa fya. Ndele Hadad yaBedad, ou a taataa Ovamidian mepumbu laMoab, a pangela ponhele yaye. Nedina loshilando shaye Avit.
Ndele Hadad okwa fya. Ndele Samla wokuMasreka a pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele Samla okwa fya. Ndele Saul wokuRehobot shopomulonga Eufrat, a pangela ponhele yaye.
Ndele Saul okwa fya. Ndele Baal-Hanan yaAkbor, a pangela ponhele yaye.
Baal-Hanan eshi a fya, Hadad okwa pangela ponhele yaye. Nedina loshilando shaye ola li Pahi. Nedina lomwalikadi waye la li Mehetabel, omona okakadona kaMatred yaMesahab.
Hadad eshi a fya, eehamba domuEdom oda li edi: Ohamba Timna, ohamba Alja, ohamba Jetet,
ohamba Oholibama, ohamba Ela, ohamba Pinon,
ohamba Kenas, ohamba Teman, ohamba Mibsar,
Ohamba Magdiel, ohamba Iram, Odo eehamba daEdom.
2: Ovana ovamati vaIsrael ovava: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isaskar naSebulon,
Dan, Josef naBenjamin, Naftali, Gad naAsser.
Ovana ovamati vaJuda ovava: Er naOnan naShela, ava vatatu e va dalelwa komukainhu Omukaanan, omona okakadona kaSua. Ndele Er, oshiveli shaJuda, inashi wapalela Omwene, onghee hano e mu efa a fye.
Ndele Tamar, oshitenya shaye, she mu dalela Peres naSera. Ovana ovamati vaJuda va li vatano.
Ovana ovamati vaPeres ova li Hesron naHamul.
Novana ovamati vaSera ovava: Simri naEtan naHeman naKalkol naDara. Aveshe kumwe vatano.
Novana ovamati vaKarmi ovava: Akar, ou a twala Israel momupya, eshi a kufa oinima ya hoololelwa ehanauno.
Nomona omumati waEtan oye Asaria.
Novana ovamati vaHesron, ava ve mu dalelwa ova li Jerahmeel naRam naKelubai.
Ndele Ram okwa dala Aminadab, ndele Aminadab okwa dala Nashon, ohamba yepata laJuda.
Ndele Nashon okwa dala Salma, ndele Salma okwa dala Boas.
Ndele Boas okwa dala Obed, ndele Obed okwa dala Isai.
Ndele Isai okwa dala Eliab, oshiveli shaye, naAbinadab, omutivali, naSimea, omutitatu.
NaNetanel, omutine, naRaddai, omutitano,
naOsem, omutihamano, naDavid, omutiheyali.
Novamwaina vavo ovakainhu va li Seruja naAbigail. Novana ovamati vaSeruja ovava: Abisai naJoab naAsahel, vo vatatu.
Ndele Abigail okwa dala Amasa. Ndele xe yaAmasia okwa li Jeter, Omuismael.
Ndele Kaleb yaHesron okwa dalelwa ovana ovamati kuAsuba, omwalikadi waye nokuJeriot. Novana vaye ovamati ovava: Jeser naSobab naArdon.
Asuba eshi a fya, Kaleb okwa hombola Efrat. Ndele ye okwe mu dalela Hur.
Ndele Hur okwa dala Uri. Ndele Uri okwa dala Besaleel.
Konima yaashi Hesron okwa ya komona okakadona kaMakir, xe yaGilead. Nokwe ka hombola, ye eshi a wanifa omido 60. Ndele ye okwe mu dalela Segub.
Ndele Segub okwa dala Jair, ndele ye okwa li e noilando omilongo mbali naitatu muGilead.
Ndelenee Gesur naAram ve va kufa omikunda daJair, nosho yo Kenat nomikunda dasho, oilando 60. Vo aveshe va li ovana ovamati vaMakir, xe yaGilead.
Ndele konima yefyo laHesron muKaleb-Efrata, Abia, omwalikadi waHesron okwe mu dalela Ashur, xe yaTekoa.
Novana ovamati vaJerahmeel, oshiveli shaHesron, ovava: Oshiveli Ram. Navali Buna naOren naOsem, va dalwa kuAhia.
Jerahmeel okwa li e nomwalikadi umwe nedina laye Atara. Ye okwa li ina yaOnam.
Novana ovamati vaRam, oshiveli shaJerahmeel ova li Maas naJamin naEker.
Novana ovamati vaOnam ovava: Sammai naJada. Novana ovamati vaSammai va li: Nadab naAbisur.
Nedina lomwalikadi waAbisur la li Abigail. Nokwe mu dalela Ahban naMolid.
Novana ovamati vaNadab ova li Seled naAppaim. Ndele Seled okwa fya ehe novana.
Nomona omumati waAppaim kwa li Jisei. Nomona omumati waJisei kwa li Sesan. Nomona omumati waSesan kwa li Ahlai.
Novana ovamati vaJada, omumwaina waSammai, ova li Jeter naJonatan. Ndele Jeter okwa fya, ehe novana.
Novana ovamati vaJonatan ovava: Pelet naSasa. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaJerahmeel.
Ndele Sesan okwa li ehe na ovana ovamati, ovana oukadona aveke. Ndele Sesan okwa li e nomupiya Omuegipiti nedina laye Jarha.
Ndele Sesan okwa yandja omona waye okakadona komupiya waye Jarha a ninge omwalikadi waye. Ndele ye okwe mu dalela Attai.
Ndele Attai okwa dala Natan, naNatan okwa dala Sabad,
naSabad okwa dala Eflal, naEflal okwa dala Obed,
naObed okwa dala Jehu, naJehu okwa dala Asaria,
naAsaria okwa dala Heles naHeles okwa dala Eleasa,
naEleasa, okwa dala Sisemai, naSisemai okwa dala Sallum,
naSallum okwa dala Jekamja, naJekamja okwa dala Elisama.
Novana ovamati vaKaleb, omumwaina waJerahmeel, ova li Mesa, oshiveli shaye, ye okwa dala Sif, novana ovamati vaMaresa, xe yaHebron.
Novana ovamati vaHebron ovava: Kora naTappuah naRekem naShema.
Ndele Shema okwa dala Raham, xe yaJorkeam. NaRekem okwa dala Sammai.
Nomona omumati waSammai kwa li Maon. Ndele Maon okwa dala Bet-Sur.
Ndele Efa, omwalikadi waKaleb wopomunghulo okwa dala Haran naMosa naGases. Ndele Haran okwa dala Gases.
Novana ovamati vaJohdai ovava: Regem naJotam naGesan naPelet naEfa naSaaf.
Maaka, omwalikadi waKaleb wopomunghulo, okwa dala Seber naTirhana,
nokwa dala Saaf, xe yaMadmanna, Sheva, xe yaMagbena naxe yaGibea. Nomona okakadona kaKaleb okwa li Aksa.
Hano ovo ovana ovamati vaKaleb. Ovana vaHur, oshiveli shaEfrata, okwa li Sobal, nokwa dala Kiriat-Jearim,
Salma okwa dala Betlehem, Haref okwa dala Bet-Gader.
Novana ovamati vaSobal, xe yaKiriat-Jearim, va li Haroe nombinga imwe yaMenuhot.
Nomaludi aKiriat-Jearim oo aa: Ovaiitri nOvaputi nOvasumati nOvamisrai. Muvo mwa dja Ovasorati nOvaestaoli.
Ovana ovamati vaSalma ovava: Betlehem nOvanetofa, Atrot-Bet-Joab nombinga imwe Ovamanahati, nOvasoriti.
Nomapata ovanongo vomishangwa aa a kala muJabes: Ovatirati, nOvasimati nOvasukati. Vo Ovakeni, ava va dja muHammat xe yepata laRekab.
3: Ovana ovamati vaDavid ve mu dalelwa muHebron, ovava: oshiveli Amnon kuAhinoam womuJisreel; omutivali Daniel kuAbigail womuKarmel;
omutitatu oAbsalom, omona omumati waMaaka, omona waTalmai, ohamba yaGesur. Omutine oAdonia yaHaggit;
omutitano oSefatja kuAbital; omutihamano oJitream komwalikadi waye Egla.
Vahamano ve mu dalelwa muHebron, omo a pangela omido heyali neehani hamano. Ndele muJerusalem okwa pangela omido omilongo nhatu nanhatu.
Ndele muJerusalem okwa dalelwa ava: Simea naSobab naNatan naSalomo, vane kuBat-Sua, omona okakadona kaAmmiel.
Navali Jibhar naElisama naElifelet
naNoha naNefek naJafia
naElisama naEljada naElifelet, omugoi
aveshe ovana ovamati vaDavid ponho yovana ovamati vovalikadi vopomunghulo. Ndele Tamar oye omumwaina omukainhu.
Nomona omumati waSalomo okwa li Rehabeam. Omona waye omumati kwa li Abia. Omona waye omumati okwa li Asa, nomona waye omumati kwa li Josafat.
Nomona waye omumati kwa li Jehoram. Nomona waye omumati okwa li Ahasia. Omona waye omumati Joas.
Nomona waye omumati okwa li Amasia. Nomona waye omumati Asaria. Nomona waye omumati okwa li Jotam.
Nomona waye omumati okwa li Ahas. Nomona waye omumati okwa li Hiskia. Nomona waye omumati okwa li Manasse.
Nomona waye omumati Amon. Nomona waye omumati Josia.
Novana ovamati vaJosia ovava: oshiveli shaye Johanan, omutivali Jehoiakim, omutitatu Sedekia, nomutine Sallum.
Novana ovamati vaJehoiakim ova Jekonia naSedekia.
Novana vaJekonia ova li Assir naSalatiel
naMalkiram naPedaja naSenassar naJekamja naHosama naNedabja.
Novana ovamati vaPedaja ovava: Serubbabel naSimei. Novana vaSerubbabel ovava: Mesullam naHanania. Ndele Selomit okwa li omumwaina omukainhu.
NaHasuba naOhel naBerekia naHasadja, Jusab-Hesed, vatano.
Ovana vaHanania ova li Pelatja naJesaja, nomona waJesaja okwa li Refaja, nomona waRefaja okwa li Arnan, nomona waArnan okwa li Obadja, nomona waObadja okwa li Sekanja.
Omona waSekanja okwa li Shemaia. Novana vaShemaia ovava: Hattus naIgal naBariah naNearja naSafat, vahamano.
Novana ovamati vaNearja ovava: Eljoenai naHiskia naAsrikam, voo vatatu.
Novana ovamati vaEljoenai ovava: Hodavia naEljasib naPelaja naAkkub naJohanan naDelaja naAnani, vo vaheyali.
4: Ovana ovamati vaJuda ovava: Peres, Hesron naKarmi naHur naSobal.
Ndele Reaja yaSobal okwa dala Jahat, naJahat okwa dala Ahumai naLahad. Olo hano oludi lOvasorati.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaEtam ovava: Jisreel naJisma naJidbas. Nedina lomumwaina womukainhu ola li Hasselelponi.
Ndele Penuel okwa dala Gedor, naEser okwa dala Husa. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaHur, oshiveli shaEfrata, xe yaBetlehem.
Ndele Ashur, xe yaTekoa, okwa li e novalikadi vavali, Helea naNaara.
Ndele Naara okwe mu dalela Ahussam naHefer naTemen naAhastar. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaNaara.
Novana ovamati vaHelea ovava: Seret, Ishar naEtnan.
Ndele Kos okwa dala Anub naHassobeba noludi lOvaaharhel omona omumati waHarum.
Ndele Jabes okwa li a fimana komesho yovamwaina. Ndele ina okwe mu luka Jabes ta ti: Ame nde mu dala nouyehame.

Ndele Jabes okwa ifana Kalunga kaIsrael ndele ta ti: “Ngeno u nangeke nge ndele u tandavelife oshitukulwalongo shange; ngeno omake oye a kale pamwe naame ndele u amene nge kowii, opo ndiha hangike komahepeko!” Ndele Kalunga okwa wanifa eindilo laye.
Ndele Kelub, omumwaina waSuha, okwa dala Mehir. Oye okwa dala Eston.
Ndele Eston okwa dala Bet-Rafa naPaseah naTehinna, xe yoshilando shaNahas. Ovo hano ovalumenhu vaReha.
Novana ovamati vaKenas ovava: Otniel naSeraja. Novana ovamati vaOtniel: Hatat naMeonotai.
Ndele Meonotai okwa dala Ofra, naSeraja okwa dala Joab, xe Geharasim, osheshi vo va li ovahambwidi.
Novana ovamati vaKaleb yaJefunne ovava: Iru, Ela naNaam. Nomona omumati waEla: Kenas.
Novana ovamati vaJehalleleel ovava: Sif naSifa, Tireja naAsareel.

Novana ovamati vaEsra ovava: Jeter naMered naEfer naJalon. Novana ovamati vaBitja, omona okakadona kaFarao, ou a hombolwa kuMered. Ye okwa ninga oufimba nokwa dala: Mirjam naSammai naJisbag, xe yaEstemoa.
Nomwalikadi waye Omujuda okwa dala: Jered, xe yaGedor, naEber, xe yaSoko, naJekutiel, xe yaSanoa.
Novana ovamati vomwalikadi waHodia, omumwaina omukainhu waNaham, xe yaKeila, okwa li Omugarmi naEstemoa, okwa li Omumaakati.
Novana ovamati vaSimon ovava: Amnon naRinna, Ben-Hanan naTilon. Novana ovamati vaJisei va li Sohet naBen-Sohet.
Ovana ovamati vaShela yaJuda ovava: Er, xe yaLega, naLaeda, xe yaMaresa, nomapata ovatungi voshiyata sholiina wokuBetAsbea.
Natango Jokim novalumenhu vokuKoseba naJoas naSaraf, ovo va pangela Moab nova alukile kuBetlehem. Ndelenee omahepaululo aa omakulu.
Vo ova li ovahongi voiyuma noonakukala muNetaim nomuGedera. Oko va kala pohamba ndele ve i longela.
Ovana ovamati vaSimeon ovava: Nemuel naJamin, Jarib, Sera naSaul.
Omona waye omumati Sallum. Omona waye Mibsam. Omona waye Misma.
Novana ovamati vaMisma ovava: Omona waye Hammuel, omona waye Sakkur, nomona waye Simei.

Ndele Simei okwa li e novana ovamati omulongo navahamano noukadona vahamano. Ndelenee ovamwaina vovalumenhu va li vehe novana ovamati vahapu. Nepata lavo alishe inali hapupala ngaashi ovana ovamati vaJuda.
Ndele vo ova kala muBerseba nomuMolada nomuHasar-Sual,
nomuBilha nomuEsem nomuTolad
nomuBetuel nomuHorma nomuSiklag
nomuBet-Markabot nomuHasar-Susim, nomuBet-Birei nomuSaaraim. Oyo hano oilando yavo fiyo David a ninga ohamba.
Nomikunda davo da li: Etam naAin, Rimmon naTogen naAsan, omikunda nhano.
Nomikunda davo adishe odo da kunghula oilando oyo, fiyo okuBaal. Odo hano da li eenhele dokukala kwavo, ndele vo va li ve nembo leshikulafano lomapata avo.
Novakwao: Mesobab naJamleh naJosa, ovana ovamati vaAmasia,
naJoel naJehu, ovana ovamati vaJosibja, omona waSeraja, nomona waAsiel,
naEljoenai naJaakoba naJesohaja naAsaja naAdiel naJesimiel naBenaja
naSisa, omona waSifei yaAllon yaJedaja yaSimri yaShemaia.
Omadina a ava a tumbulwa apa, va li ovakulunhu vomapata avo, nomapata avo a hapupala unene.
Ndele vo ova ya fiyo okomhito yokuya kuGedor, fiyo okoushilo wefilu, va ka konge oulifilo woimuna yavo.
Ndele va mona oulifilo muwa mutalala, noshilongo ashishe sha li sha tamunuka keembinga adishe, sha mwena shi nombili, osheshi ovanhu ovo va kala ko nale ova li Ovaham.

Ndele ovo omadina avo a tumbulwa apa, ove uya pomafiku aHiskia, ohamba yaJuda, va nangala omatwali avo ndele va taataa Ovameunim ovo va li ko. Ndele ve va mana po sheke fiyo onena eli. Ndele va nangala onhele yavo. Osheshi oko kwa li oulifilo woimuna yavo.
Ndele muvo nokutya, mepata laSimeon, mwa dja ovalumenhu omafele atano va ya keemhunda daSeir. Ndele Pelatja naNearja naRefaja naUsiel, ovana vaJisei, ve va kwatela komesho.
Ndele vo ova dipaa oshixupe shovaxupifwa vomuAmalek, ndele va kala ko fiyo onena eli.
5: Novana ovamati vaRuben, oshiveli shaIsrael (osheshi ye okwa li oshiveli, ndelenee ye eshi a nyateka omutala waxe, oushiveli waye wa pewa ovana ovamati vaJosef yaIsrael, ndelenee ye ita shangelwa membo leshikulafano lomapata ngaashi oshiveli,
ndele osheshi Juda okwa li e neenghono mokati kovamwaina, e va dule, ndele umwe womoludalo laye a ninga ohamba, oushiveli wa kala muJosef)
ovava: Henok naPallu, Hesron naKarmi.
Ovana ovamati vaJoel: Omona waye Shemaia, omona waye Gog, omona waye Simei.
Omona waye Mika, omona waye Reaja, omona waye Baal,
omona waye Beera, ou a twalwa kuTiglat-Pileser, ohamba yaAsiria, moukwatwa. Ye okwa li omukulunhu wOvarubeni.
Ndele ovamwaina ovalumenhu pepata keshe ngaashi mwa shangelwa membo leshikulafano lomapata pamaludalo avo ovava: Jeiel, omukulunhu, navali Sakaria
naBela yaAsas yaShema yaJoel. Ye okwa li muAroer fiyo okuNebo nomuBaal-Meon.
Ndele moushilo okwa twa fiyo mombuwa ei tai hovele momulonga waEufrat. Osheshi oimuna yavo ya hapupala moshilongo shaGilead.
Ndele pomafiku aSaul va ninga oita nOvahagri, ndele eshi va homona oshilongo shavo, ova nangala omatwali avo kombinga aishe yokoushilo waGilead.
Novana ovamati vaGad va li moshilongo shaBasan fiyo okuSalka, sha shaama naavo.
Joel okwa li omukulunhu naSafam omutivali, va shikulwa kuJaenai naSafat, muBasan.
Novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu pamapata avo, ovava: Mikael naMesullam naSheba naJorai naJaekan naSia naEber, vaheyali.
Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaAbigail yaHuri yaJaroah naGilead yaMikael yaJesisai yaJagdo yaBus.
Ahi yaAbdiel yaGuni, okwa li omukulunhu womapata avo.
Ndele vo va kala muGilead, muBasan nomoipangelwanhele yasho nomomaulifilo aeshe omuSaron fiyo okexulilo lasho.
Vo aveshe ova shangelwa membo leshikulafano lomapata pomafiku aJotam, ohamba yaJuda, nopomafiku aJerobeam, ohamba yaIsrael.

Ovana ovamati vaRuben novaGad netata lepata laManasse, nokutya, ovaladi, ovalumenhu ava ve noshikelelifo neongamukonda ndele tava shili outa ndele va ika oita, va li omayovi omilongo nhee naane nomafele aheyali nomilongo hamano ovo ve nokufikama palombwelo leifano.
Ndele vo ova ninga oita nOvahagri naJetur naNafis naNodab.
Ndele va mona ekwafo moku va lwifa, nOvahagri va yandjwa momake avo naaveshe ava va li pamwe naavo. Osheshi va ifana Kalunga molwoodi, ndele Ye e va uda, shaashi vo ove mu lineekela.
Ndele vo ova twala oimuna yavo: eengamelo davo omayovi omilongo nhano, needi omayovi omafele avali nomayovi omilongo nhano neendongi omayovi avali novanhu omayovi efele.
Osheshi ovo va fya va li vahapu, shaashi oita oya li yaKalunga. Ndele va kala meenhele davo fiyo va twalwa moukwatwa.
Novana ovamati vometata lepata laManasse va kala moshilongo shaBasan fiyo okuBaal-Hermon nokuSenir nokomhunda yaHermon. Vo ova li vahapu.
Ndele ava va li ovakulunhu vomapata avo, nokutya: Efer naJisei naEliel naAsriel naJeremia naHodavia naJagdiel, ovalumenhu ovaladi, ovalumenhu ve nedina, ovakulunhu vomapata avo.
Ndelenee ve liteeka Kalunga kooxe, ndele moluhaelo va shikula oikalunga yoiwana yomedu olo, oyo Kalunga e i taataa komesho yavo.

Onghee hano Kalunga kaIsrael a pendula omhepo yaPul, ohamba yaAsiria, nokutya omhepo yaTiglat-Pileser, ohamba yaAsiria, oyo ya twala moukwatwa Ovarubeni nOvagad netata lepata laManasse ndele ye va twala kuHalag nokuHabor nokuHara nokomulonga waGosan fiyo onena eli.
6: Ovana ovamati vaLevi ovava: Gerson, Kohat naMerari.
Novana ovamati vaKohat ovava: Amram, Ishar naHebron naUsiel.
Novana ovamati vaAmram ovava: Aron naMoses, nomona okakadona Mirjam. Novana vaAron ovava: Nadab naAbihu, Eliaser naItamar.
Ndele Eliaser okwa dala Pinehas. Pinehas okwa dala Abisua.
Ndele Abisua okwa dala Bukki. Ndele Bukki okwa dala Ussi,
naUssi, xe yaSerahia, naSerahia xe yaMerajot,
naMerajot xe yaAmarja, naAmarja xe yaAhitub;
naAhitub xe yaSadok, naSadok xe yaAhimas;
naAhimas xe yaAsaria, naAsaria xe yaJohanan;
naJohanan xe yaAsaria, ou a li moshilonga shoupristeli mongulu oyo Salomo a tunga muJerusalem.
Ndele Asaria okwa dala Amarja, naAmarja xe yaAhitub;
naAhitub xe yaSadok, naSadok xe yaSallum;
naSallum xe yaHilkia, naHilkia xe yaAsaria;
naAsaria xe yaSeraja, naSeraja xe yaJosadak;
naJosadak okwa ya yo, Omwene eshi a yandja Ovajuda noonakukalamo muJerusalem momake aNebukadnesar e va twala moukwatwa.
Ovana ovamati vaLevi ovava: Gerson, Kohat naMerari.
Nomadina ovana ovamati vaGerson aa: Libni naSimei.
Novana ovamati vaKohat ovava: Amram naIshar naHebron naUsiel.
Ovana ovamati vaMerari ova li Mahli naMushi. Omaludalo Ovalevi pamapata avo aa:
Epata laGerson: omona waye kwa li Libni, omona waye Jahat, omona waye Simma,
omona waye Joah, omona waye Iddo, omona waye Sera, omona waye Jeatrai.
Ovana ovamati vaKohat ovava: Aminadab, omona waye Kora, nomona waye Assir,
omona waye Elkana, omona waye Ebjasaf, omona waye Assir,
omona waye Tahat, omona waye Uriel, omona waye Ussia, omona waye Saul.
Novana ovamati vaElkana ovava: Amasai naAhimot.
Omona waye Elkana nomona waye Sofai nomona waye Nahat,
omona waye Eliab, nomona waye Jeroham, nomona waye Elkana.
Novana ovamati vaSamuel: Oshiveli Joel nondenge yaye Abia.
Ovana vaMerari ovava: Mahli, omona waye Libni, omona waye Simei, omona waye Ussa;
omona waye Simea, omona waye Haggia, omona waye Asaja.
Ndele ovo tuu ovo David e va tula mokuwilika okwiimba mongulu yOmwene, oshikefa eshi sha mona onhele yetulumuko.
Ndele vo ova li ovaimbi metwali leongalo fiyo Salomo a tungila Omwene ongulu muJerusalem. Ndele vo ova kala moshilonga shavo pamalufonghedi avo.
Ndele ovo tuu ava va kala moshilonga shavo pamwe novana vavo: movana vaKohat: Heman, omwiimbi, omona waJoel yaSamuel,
omona waElkana, omona waJeroham, omona waEliel, omona waToa,
omona waSuf, omona waElkana, omona waMahat, omona waAmasai,
omona waElkana, omona waJoel, omona waAsaria, omona waSefania,
omona waTahat, omona waAssir, omona waEbjasaf, omona waKora,
omona waIshar, omona waKohat, omona waLevi, omona waIsrael.
Nomumwaina a li Asaf, ou a kala ofika kolulyo laye. Asaf okwa li omona waBerekia yaSimea,
omona waMikael, omona waBaaseja, omona waMalkia,
omona waEtni, omona waSera, omona waAdaja,
omona waEtan, omona waSimma, omona waSimei,
omona waJahat, omona waGerson, omona waLevi.
Novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu, ovana ovamati vaMerari, ava va li ofika kolumosho, ovava: Etan yaKisi, omona waAbdi, omona waMalluk,
omona waHasabja, omona waAmasia, omona waHilkia,
omona waAmsi, omona waBani, omona waSemer,
omona waMahli, omona waMushi, omona waMerari, omona waLevi.
Novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu, Ovalevi, ovo va tulwa moiyakulolonga aishe yometwali longulu yaKalunga.

Ndelenee Aron novana vaye ovamati va twimina koaltari yexwikiloyambo nokoaltari yetwimino, vo ova longa oilonga aishe yomouyapukielela va kwatakanife Ovaisraeli, ngaashi Moses, omupiya waKalunga e va lombwela.
Novana vaAron ovava: omona waye Eliaser, omona waye Pinehas, omona waye Abisua;
omona waye Bukki, omona waye Ussi, omona waye Serahia,
Merajot omona waye, nomona waye Amarja, nomona waye Ahitub,
Omona waye Sadok, nomona waye Ahimas.
Eenhele davo dokukala mo paenhanda davo moitukulwalongo yavo: nokutya eenhele doludalo laAron la li lomepata laKohat, osheshi vo ova mona oshitukulwahoololwa shotete.
Hano vo ova pewa: Hebron moshilongo shaJuda pamwe noulifilo washo tau shi kunghula;
ndelenee omapya oshilando pamwe nomikunda dasho da pewa Kaleb yaJefunne.
Ndele oludalo laAron la pewa oshihondamenolando Hebron naLibna pamwe noulifilo washo, naJattir naEstemoa pamwe noulifilo washo,
naHilen noulifilo washo, naDebir noulifilo washo,
naAsan noulifilo washo, naBet-Semes noulifilo washo;
ndele mepata laBenjamin: Geba noulifilo washo, naAlemet noulifilo washo, naAnatot noulifilo washo. Oilando yayo pamapata avo ya li oilando omulongo naitatu.
Ndele Ovakohati vakwao va pewa pashihoololifo oilando omulongo pamapata avo yomepata laEfraim, yomepata laDan, noyometata lepata laManasse.
Novana ovamati vaGerson va pewa pamapata avo, mepata laIsaskar nomepata laAsser nomepata laNaftali nomepata laManasse muBasan, oilando omulongo noilando itatu.
Ovana ovamati vaMerari va pewa pamapata avo mepata laRuben nomepata laGad nomepata laSebulon pashihoololifo, oilando omulongo noilando ivali.
Novana vaIsrael va yandja kOvalevi oilando pamwe nomaulifilo ayo.
Oilando oyo ve i tumbula nomadina ayo ve i yandja kuvo pashihoololifo shomepata lovana vaJuda nomepata lovana vaSimeon nomepata lovana vaBenjamin.
Ndele vamwe vomomapata Ovakohati va pewa pashihoololifo mepata laEfraim oilando ei.
Ndele va yandja kuvo oshihondamenolando Sekem pamwe noulifilo washo, keemhunda daEfraim, naGeser pamwe noulifilo washo,
naJokmeam pamwe noulifilo washo, naBet-Horon pamwe noulifilo washo,
naAijalon pamwe noulifilo washo, naGat-Rimmon pamwe noulifilo washo;
ndele moshitukulwa shimwe shepata laManasse: Aner pamwe noulifilo washo, naBileam pamwe noulifilo washo. Hano oyo ya pewa omapata makwao ovana vaKohat.
Ovana vaGerson va pewa pamapata avo oshitukulwa shikwao shepata laManasse: Golan shomuBasan pamwe noulifilo washo, naAstarot pamwe noulifilo washo.
Ndele mepata laIsaskar: Kedes pamwe noulifilo washo, Daberat pamwe noulifilo washo,
naRamot pamwe noulifilo washo, naAnem pamwe noulifilo washo.
Ndele mepata laAsser: Masal pamwe noulifilo washo, naAbdon pamwe noulifilo washo,
naHukok pamwe noulifilo washo, naRehob pamwe noulifilo washo.
Ndele mepata laNaftali: Kedes shomuGalilea pamwe noulifilo washo, naHammon pamwe noulifilo washo, naKiriataim pamwe noulifilo washo.
Ovana vakwao vaMerari mepata laSebulon: Rimmono pamwe noulifilo washo, Tabor pamwe noulifilo washo;
Ndele kombada yaJordan waJeriko, kombinga yokoushilo waJordan, mepata laRuben: Beser noulifilo washo, naJahas noulifilo washo,
naKedemot pamwe noulifilo washo, naMefat pamwe noulifilo washo.
Ndele mepata laGad: Ramot shomuGilead pamwe noulifilo washo, naMahanaim pamwe noulifilo washo,
naHesbon pamwe noulifilo washo, naJaeser pamwe noulifilo washo.
7: Novana ovamati vaIsaskar ovava: Tola naPua, Jasub naSimron, vane.

Novana ovamati vaTola ovava: Ussi naRefaja naJeriel naJahmai naJibsam naSemuel, ovakulunhu vomapata avo, oludalo laTola, ovaladi. Omuvalo wavo pamapata avo pomafiku aDavid e fike pomayovi omilongo mbali naavali nomafele ahamano.
Novana vaUssi okwa li Jisrahja. Novana vaJisrahja ovava: Mikael naObadja naJoel, Isshia, vatano, aveshe ovakulunhu.
Ndele puvo pa li omatanga ovakwaita omayovi omilongo nhatu naahamano pamaludalo nopamapata avo; osheshi vo va li ve novalikadi vahapu nounona vahapu.
Novamwaina ovalumenhu vomomaludalo aeshe aIsaskar, ovaladi omayovi omilongo hetatu naaheyali va shangelwa aveshe momambo eshikulafano lomapata.
Vatatu vovana vaBenjamin ova li Bela naBeger naJediael.

Novana ovamati vaBela ovava: Esbon naUssi naUsiel naJerimot naIri, ovakulunhu vatano vomapata, ovaladi. Ava va shangelwa meshikulafano lavo lomapata va li: omayovi omilongo mbali naavali nomilongo nhatu navane.
Novana ovamati vaBeger ovava: Semira naJoas naElieser naEljoenai naOmri naJeremot naAbia naAnatot naAlemet. Vo aveshe va li ovana ovamati vaBeger;
ndele meshikulafano lavo lomapata mwa shangelwa pamaludalo avo ovakulunhu vomapata avo, ovaladi omayovi omilongo mbali nomafele avali.
Nomona omumati waJediael okwa li Bilhan. Novana ovamati vaBilhan ovava: Jehus naBenjamin naEhud naKenaana naSetan naTarsis naAhisahar.
Ovana aveshe vaJediael pavakulunhu vomapata, ovaladi, va li omayovi omulongo naaheyali nomafele avali, ava va li ve nokuya koita paifano.
Ndele Suppim naHuppim va li ovana Ovamati vaIr. Husim kwa li omona waAher.
Ovana ovamati vaNaftali ovava: Jakseel naGuni naJeser naSallum, va dalwa kuBilha.
Omona waManasse kwa li Asriel ou a dalwa komwalikadi waye. Omwalikadi waye wopomunghulo, Omuaram, okwa dala Makir, xe yaGilead.
Ndele Makir okwa kongela Huppim naSuppim ovalikadi. Nedina lomumwaina omukainhu la li Maaka. Nedina lomutivali la li Selofhad. Ndele Selofhad okwa li e novana oukadona.
Ndele Maaka, omwalikadi waMakir, okwa dala okana okamati, nokwe ka luka Peres. Nedina lomumwaina la li Seres, novana vaye ovamati va li Ulam naRakem.
Nomona waUlam kwa li Bedan. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vaGilead, omona waMakir yaManasse.
Nomumwaina omukainhu Hamoleket okwa dala Ishod naAbieser naMahla.
Novana ovamati vaSemida ovava: Ahian naSekem naLikhi naAniam.
Nomona waEfraim kwa li Sutelah. Nomona waye kwa li Bered, nomona waye Tahat, nomona waye Eleada, nomona waye Tahat,
nomona waye Sabad, nomona waye Sutelah naEser naElead. Novalumenhu vaGat, ava va dalelwa moshilongo osho, ve va dipaa, osheshi ve uya va ka kufe po oimuna yavo.
Onghee hano xe yavo Efraim okwa li a nyika oluhodi omafiku mahapu, novamwaina ovalumenhu ve uya oku mu hekeleka.
Konima yoinima ei okwa ya mo momukainhu waye, ndele ye a ninga oufimba nokwa dala okana okamati. Nokwe ka luka Beria, shaashi sha ningwa meumbo laye pefimbo loluhodi.
Nomona waye omukainhu kwa li Seera. Ndele ye okwa tunga Bet-Horon shomefilu naashi shokomutune, naUssen-Seera.
Novana vaye ovamati va li Refah naResef, nomona waye Telah, nomona waye Tahan.
Nomona waye Ladan, nomona waye Ammihud, omona waye Elisama,
nomona waye Nun, nomona waye Josua.

Noshitukulwalongo shavo neenhele dokukala kwavo da li: Betel noipangelwa yasho. Ndele kombinga yokoushilo: Naaran. Ndele kombinga yokouninginino: Geser noipangelwa yasho, naSekem noipangelwa yasho fiyo okuAija noipangelwa yasho.
Ndele mepangelo lovana vaManasse mwa li Betshan noipangelwa yasho, Taanak noipangelwa yasho, Megido noipangelwa yasho, Dor noipangelwa yasho. Meenhele odo ovana vaJosef yaIsrael va kala mo.
Ovana ovamati vaAsser ovava: Jimna naJisva naJisvi naBeria; naSera, omumwaina omukainhu.
Novana ovamati vaBeria va li Eber naMalkiel. Ye okwa dala Birsajit.
Ndele Eber okwa dala Jaflet, naSomer naHotam; naSua, omumwaina omukainhu.
Novana ovamati vaJaflet ovava: Pasah naBimhal naAsvat. Vo hano ovana ovamati vaJaflet.
Novana ovamati vaSemer ovava: Ahi naRohega, Jehubba naAram.
Novana ovamati vomumwaina Helem ovava: Sofah naJimna naSeles naAmal.
Ovana ovamati vaSofah ovava: Suah naHarnefer naShual naBeri naJimra,
Beser naHod naSamma naSilsa naJitran naBeera.
Novana ovamati vaJeter ovava: Jefunne naPispa naAra.
Novana ovamati vaUlla ovava: Arah naHanniel naRisja.

Vo aveshe va li ovana vaAsser, ovakulunhu vomapata, ovahoololwa, ovaladi, ovakulunhu vomeehamba. Nomuvalu waava va wana okulwa, wa shangelwa meshikulafano lomapata wa li ovalumenhu omayovi omilongo mbali naahamano.
8: Ndele Benjamin okwa dala Bela, oshiveli shaye; omutivali Asbel, nomutitatu Aharah.
Omutine Noha, nomutitano Rafa.
Ndele Bela okwa li e novana ovamati: Addar naGera naAbihud,
naAbisua naNaeman naAhoah
naGera naSefufan naHuram.
Ndele vo ovana ovamati vaEhud, vo va li ovakulunhu vomapata oonakukalamo muGeba, ndele va twalwa moukwatwa kuManahat.
Va twala moukwatwa Naeman naAhia naGera, ndele ye okwa dala Ussa naAhihud.
Ndele Saharaim okwa ninga xe yovana momaluhaela aMoab, ye eshi a henga ovalikadi vaye Husim naBaara:
omwalikadi waye Hodes okwe mu dalela Jobab naSibja naMesa naMalkam,
naJehus naSagia naMirma. Vo hano ovana vaye ovamati, ovakulunhu vomapata.
Husim e mu dalela Abitub naElpaal.
Novana ovamati vaElpaal ovava: Eber naMiseam naSemed. Ye okwa tunga Ono naLod noipangelwa yayo.
NaBeria naShema, vo va li ovakulunhu vomapata oonakukalamo muAijalon. Vo ova taataa oonakukalamo muGat.
Ahjo, Sasak naJeremot
naSebadja naArad naEder
naMikael naJispa naJoha, ovana ovamati vaBeria,
naSebadja naMesullam naHiski naEber
naJismera, naJislia naJobab, ovana ovamati vaElpaal.
NaJakim naSikri naSabdi
naElienai naSilletai naEliel
naAdaja naBeraja naSimrat, ovana vaSimei.
NaJispan naEber naEliel
naAbdon naSikri naHanan
naHanania naElam naAntotia
naJifdeja naPenuel, ovana ovamati vaSasak;
naSamserai naSeharja naAtalia
naJaaresja naElia naSikri, ovana ovamati vaJeroham.
Vo va li ovakulunhu vomapata, ovakulunhu pashikulafano lomapata. Vo ova kala muJerusalem.
Ndele Jeiel, xe yaGibeon okwa li muGibeon, nedina lomwalikadi waye Maaka.
Noshiveli shaye sha li Abdon, navali Sur naKis naBaal naNadab
naGedor naAhjo naSeger.
Ndele Miklot okwa dala Simea. Ndele naavo yo va kala muJerusalem pamwe novamwaina ovalumenhu, va shaama naavo.
Ndele Ner okwa dala Kis, naKis xe yaSaul, ndele Saul okwa dala Jonatan naMalkisua naAbinadab naEsbaal.
Nomona waJonatan okwa li Merib-baal, ndele Merib-baal okwa dala Mika.
Novana ovamati vaMika ovava: Piton naMelek naTaarea naAhas.
Ndele Ahas okwa dala Jehoadda, naJehoadda kwa dala Alemet naAsmavet naSimri. Ndele Simri okwa dala Mosa.
Ndele Mosa okwa dala Binea. Omona waye okwa li Rafa. Omona waye Eleasa, omona waye Asel.
Ndele Asel okwa li e novana ovamati vahamano. Nomadina avo aa: Asrikam, Bogru naIsmael naSearja naObadja naHanan. Vo aveshe va li ovana vaAsel.
Novana ovamati vaEsek omumwaina ovava: Oshiveli shaye Ulam, omutivali Jehus, nomutitatu Elifelet.
Novana ovamati vaUlam va li ovalumenhu ovaladi va shiiva okuumba; ndele vo va li ve novana vahapu novatekulu vahapu, ve fike po efele nomilongo nhano. Vo aveshe ovomovana vaBenjamin.
9: NOvaisraeli aveshe va shangelwa momambo eshikulafano lomapata, ndele tala, vo va shangelwa membo leehamba daIsrael. Novanhu vomuJuda ova twalwa moukwatwa kuBabilon omolweliteeko lavo.
Ndele oonakukalamo shito, ava va kala momafyuululwamapya nomoilando, ova li: Ovaisraeli, novapristeli nOvalevi naava hava yakula moshilonga shomotembeli.
Ndele muJerusalem mwa kala Ovajuda nOvabenjamin nOvaefraim nOvamanasse:
Utai yaAmmihud yaOmri yaImri yaBani, vomovana vaPeres yaJuda;
ndele vomOvasiloni: Asaja, oshiveli novana vaye ovamati
novomovana ovamati vaSera: Jehuel novamwaina ovalumenhu omafele ahamano nomilongo omugoi;
novomovana ovamati vaBenjamin: Sallu yaMesullam yaHodavia yaHassenua,
naJibnea yaJeroham, naEla yaUssi yaMigri, naMesullam yaSefatja yaRehuel yaJibneja;
novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu pamapata avo omafele omugoi nomilongo nhano navahamano; ovalumenhu aveshe ava, va li ovakulunhu vomapata avo.
Ndele movapristeli: Jedaja naJojarib naJakin,
naAsaria yaHilkia yaMesullam yaSadok yaMerajot yaAhitub, omukulunhu wongulu yaKalunga.
NaAdaja yaJeroham yaPashur yaMalkia, naMaesai yaAdiel yaJagsera yaMesullam yaMesillemit yaImmer;
novamwaina ovalumenhu, ovakulunhu vomapata avo, eyovi nomafele aheyali nomilongo hamano, ovalumenhu ovaladi meyakulolonga yongulu yaKalunga.
Ndele mOvalevi: Shemaia yaHassub yaAsrikam yaHasabja, ovana vaMerari;
naBakbakkar, Heres naGalal naMattanja yaMikka yaSikri yaAsaf;
naObadja yaShemaia yaGalal yaJedutun. NaBerekia yaAsa yaElkana, ou a kala momikunda dOvanetofa.
Novanangeli vopoivelo ovava: Sallum naAkkub naTalmon naAhiman novamwaina vovalumenhu. Sallum okwa li omukulunhu,
ndele fiyo opaife ye omunangeli poshivelo shohamba, kombinga yokoushilo. Vo ova li ovanangeli voivelo vomeenhanda dovana vaLevi.

Ndele Sallum yaKore yaEbjasaf yaKora novamwaina ovalumenhu vomepata laye, Ovakora, va li meyakulolonga lavo ngaashi ovanangeli voivelo yometwali, ngaashi xe yavo monhanda yOmwene va li va nangela omhito yokuya mo.
NaPinehas yaEliaser, okwa li nale omukulunhu wavo. Omwene na kale naye!
Sakaria yaMeselemja, okwa li omunangeli woshivelo shetwali leongalo.
Aveshe ava va hoololelwa okunangela poivelo: omafele avali nomulongo navavali. Vo ova shangelwa meshikulafano lomapata momikunda davo. David nomumonikokule Samuel ve va tula moilonga oyo yavo.
Ndele vo pamwe novana vavo ovalumenhu va tulwa po va nangele oivelo yongulu yOmwene, nokutya etwalingulu.
Ovanangeli voivelo va tulwa keembinga nhee domhepo: koushilo, kouninginino, koumbangalanhu nokoumbuwanhu.
Novamwaina ovalumenhu momikunda davo ve nokuuya pomafimbofimbo pamwe naavo okulonga omafiku aheyali.
Osheshi ovakulunhu vane vovanangeli va kala efimbo alishe moshilonga shavo. Vo va li Ovalevi, ava va li ve nokupashukila eendjuwo nomamona omongulu yaKalunga.
Ndele momaufiku va li ve nokukala pongulu yaKalunga, osheshi vo va li ovanangeli; nongula keshe va li ve nokuyeulula oivelo.
Ndele vamwe vomuvo va tulwa po va diinine oinima tai longifwa mokulongela Kalunga, osheshi va li ve noku i eta mo ya wana, noku i twala pondje ya wana.
Ndele vamwe vomuvo va tulwa po, va diinine oinima aishe iyapuki noufila wa nakwa nomaviinyu nomaadi noitwiminifo noimbodi yedimba liwa.
Novana vamwe vovapristeli va ninga omuvavo womoimbodi yedimba liwa.
Ndele Matitia, Omulevi, oshiveli shaSallum, Omukora, a pewa oshilonga okupashukila eteleko loikuki.
Ndele vamwe vomOvakohati, vomovamwaina ovalumenhu, va li ve nokukala noshisho shomingome detaliko, di kale dipe mEshabata keshe.
Ndelenee ovaimbi, ovakulunhu vomapata Ovalevi va li meendjuwo dotembeli, va mangululwa moilonga imwe. Osheshi vo va diinina oufiku nomutenya oshilonga shavo.
Ovo hano ovakulunhu vomapata Ovalevi, ovakulunhu pamaludalo avo. Vo ova kala muJerusalem.
Ndele Jeiel, xe yaGibeon, okwa kala muGibeon. Nedina lomwalikadi waye la li Maaka.
Noshiveli shaye sha li Abdon, navali Sur, naKis naBaal naNer naNadab,
naGedor naAhjo naSakaria naMiklot.
Ndele Miklot okwa dala Simeam. Ndele va kala pamwe novamwaina ovalumenhu muJerusalem.
Ndele Ner okwa dala Kis, naKis xe yaSaul, naSaul okwa dala Jonatan naMalkisua naAbinadab naEsbaal.
Nomona omumati waJonatan okwa li Merib-baal, ndele Merib-baal okwa dala Mika.
Novana ovamati vaMika ovava: Piton naMelek naTagrea.
Ndele Ahas okwa dala Jaera, naJaera xe yaAlemet naAsmavet naSimri. Ndele Simri okwa dala Mosa.
Ndele Mosa okwa dala Binea; nomona waye Refaja, nomona waye Eleasa, nomona waye Asel.
Ndele Asel okwa li e novana ovamati vaheyali. Nomadina avo aa: Asrikam, Bogru naIsmael naSearja naObadja naHanan. Vo hano ovana ovamati vaAsel.
10: Ndele Ovafilisti va lwifa Ovaisraeli, novakwaita vOvaisraeli va ya onhapo Ovafilisti, oimhu yovadipawa ya nangala keemhunda daGilboa.
NOvafilisti va shikula Saul novana vaye ovalumenhu, nOvafilisti va dipaa Jonatan naAbinadab naMalkisua, ovana vaSaul.
Nolwoodi eshi la ninga lidjuu mokulwifa Saul, novaumbi vomauta ve mu yasha, Saul okwa kakama omolwetilo lokutila ovaumbi.

Ndele Saul okwa lombwela omuhumbati woiti yaye: “Pweya mo eongamukonda loye u twe nge nalo, opo ava inava pita etanda, vaha sheke nge.” Ndelenee omuhumbati woiti ina hala, osheshi kwa li a tila unene. Opo nee Saul a kufa eongamukonda nokwe liundwila kulo.
Omuhumbati woiti yaye eshi a mona nokutya, Saul okwa fya, naye mwene yo te liundwile keongamukonda laye ndele ta fi.
Osho ngaha hano Saul novana vaye ovalumenhu vatatu ova fya. Neumbo laye alishe la fya oshita.

Novalumenhu aveshe Ovaisraeli, ovo va li momaluhaela, eshi va mona nokutya, venya va ya onhapo, naSaul novana vaye va fya, ova efa oilando yavo ndele va ya onhapo. NOvafilisti ve uya mo ndele ve i nangala.
NOvafilisti eshi ve uya mefiku la shikula okudula ovadipawa, ova mona Saul novana vaye ovalumenhu va wila keemhunda daGilboa.
Opo nee ve mu dula, va teta ko omutwe waye ndele va kufa oiti yaye ndele ve i tuma koshilongo shOvafilisti, va etele oikalunga yavo novanhu ondaka yehafo.
Konima va tula oiti yaye motembeli yoshikalunga shavo Dagon. Nomutwe waye ve u valelifa motembeli yaDagon.
Ovajabes aveshe vomuGilead, eshi va uda osho Ovafilisti va ningila Saul,

ovalumenhu aveshe ovaladi va fikama ndele va kufa oshimhu shaSaul noimhu yovana vaye ovalumenhu, ndele ve i eta kuJabes, ndele va paka omakipa avo pomwandi womuJabes, ndele tave lidilike omafiku aheyali.
Ndele Saul okwa fya omolweliteeko, eshi e liteeka Omwene, molweendjovo dOmwene ine di diinina, nashaashi a pula ounongo komhepo yomufi,
ndelenee ina pula kOmwene. Onghee hano Omwene e mu dipaa, nokwa yandja ouhamba kuDavid yaIsai.
11: Opo nee Ovaisraeli aveshe va ongala puDavid muHebron ndele tava ti: “Tala, fye ekipa loye nonhumba yoye.

Nokuli shito nale, fimbo Saul kwa li ohamba yetu, ove wa endifa Ovaisraeli mokuya nomokwaaluka. NOmwene, Kalunga koye e ku lombwela: ‘Ove u nokulifa oshiwana shange shOvaisraeli, ndele u nokuninga ohamba yovanhu vange Ovaisraeli.’ ”

Osho ngaha hano ovakulunhu vOvaisraeli ve uya kohamba muHebron; ndele David okwa ninga ehangano navo muHebron koshipala shOmwene. Ndele va vaeka David a ninge ohamba yOvaisraeli pandjovo yOmwene, e i lombwela Samuel.
Ndele David nOvaisraeli aveshe va ya kuJerusalem nokutya, kuJebus. Ndele oko kwa kala Ovajebusi, oonakukalamo moshilongo.
Noonakukala muJebus, va lombwela David, tava ti: “Ove ito uya mo omu!” Ndelenee David okwa teya ohotemhundangulu yaSion, nokutya oshilando shaDavid.
Ndele David okwa tya: “Ou ta dipaa tete Omujebusi, ta ka ninga omukwateli komesho nomukulunhu.” Opo nee Joab yaSeruja a londa ko tete, nokwa ninga omukwateli komesho.
Ndele David okwa tula mohotemhundangulu. Onghee hano tave shi luku Oshilando shaDavid.
Nokwa tunga oshilando keembinga adishe okudja kuMillo fiyo okominghulo. Ndele Joab okwa tungulula oshilando kombinga ikwao.
Ndele David okwa ehena komesho meenghono efimbo alishe, nOmwene womatanga ovakwaita a kala pamwe naye.
Ndele ava va li ovakulunhu ovaladi vaDavid, ava ve mu kwafa mouhamba waye pamwe nOvaisraeli aveshe, opo ve mu ninge ohamba yaIsrael pandjovo yOmwene.
Nomuvalu wovaladi vaDavid ou: Jasobeam yaHakmoni, omukulunhu waava omilongo nhatu. Ye okwa dungadunga eonga laye kombada yaavo omafele atatu ava va fya pefimbo limwe alike.
Nokwa shikulwa kuEliaser yaDodo, Omuahohi, umwe waava vatatu.
Ye okwa li pamwe naDavid puPas-Dammim, Ovafilisti eshi va ongala ko va lwe. Ndele oko kwa li ombinga imwe yepya i yadi oilya, novanhu va ya onhapo Ovafilisti.
Ndelenee ye okwa ya a kale pokati kombinga oyo yepya, nokwe i alula, ndele ta taataa Ovafilisti; osho ngaha Omwene e va pa efindano linene.
Ndele vatatu vomovakulunhu venya omilongo nhatu va ya keemhunda kuDavid, kekololo laAdullam, fimbo onhanda yOvafilisti ya li mefilu laRefaim.
Ndele pefimbo olo David okwa li mohotemhunda. Nongudu yovanangeli Ovafilisti ya li muBetlehem.
Ndele David okwa li a hala omeva ndele ta ti: “Ngeno ndi pewe okunwa omeva omondungu oyo i li poshivelo shaBetlehem.”

Opo nee ovakwanyati vatatu va honyaeka monhanda yOvafilisti ndele va teka omeva mondungu yaBetlehem ya li poshivelo, ndele ve a humbata nove a eta kuDavid. Ndele ye ina hala oku a nwa. Okwe a tila shi poshi, kokufimaneka Omwene,

ndele ta ti: “Itandi dulu ndi nwe omeva aa, osheshi onda fa handi nu ohonde yovalumenhu ava, ve ke a talele mokweekelashi eemwenyo davo!” Ndele okwa anya oku a nwa. Ei oilonga youpenda yovakwanyati vatatu.

Ndele Abisai, omumwaina waJoab okwa li omukulunhu womapenda omilongo nhatu. Nokwa lwifa neonga laye ovalumenhu omafele atatu, nokwe va dipaa. Osho ngaha okwa mona efimano mokati komapenda omilongo nhatu.
Okwa li a fimana mokati kaava omilongo nhatu, onghee ye a ninga omukwatelikomesho wavo, ashike efimano laye inali fika pu laavenya vatatu votete.
Benaja yaJehoiada womuKabseel okwa li omukwaita omuladi; moilonga yaye youladi okwa dipaa eendjai mbali dOvamoab. Nokwa dipaa yo onghoshi mekololo mefiku lombabi.

Ye okwa dipaa yo Omuegipiti omutongolume, oule waye ou dule eemeta mbali. Nokwa li neonga lefo linene. Benaja okwe mu ponokela nodibo yaye yomutwe wakula, ndele te mu nyeka eonga laye, nokwa dipaa Omuegipiti neonga laye mwene.
Ei oyo oilonga youpenda yaBenaja yaJehoiada umwe womapenda enya omilongo nhatu.
Ye okwa li a fimana komesho yaava omilongo nhatu, ndelenee efimano laye inali fika pu laavenya vatatu. Ndele David okwe mu ninga omukulunhu wovanangeli vaye.
Novaladi ovava: Asahel, omumwaina waJoab omulumenhu, Elhanan yaDodo, womuBetlehem.
Sammot Omuharodi, Heles Omupeloni.
Ira yaIkkes, Omutekoa. Abieser, Omuanatot.
Sibbegai, Omuhusai. Ilai, Omuahohi.
Maharai, Omunetofa, Heled yaBaana, Omunetofa.
Ittai yaRibai womuGibea shovana vaBenjamin. Benaja, Omupiratoni.
Hurai womuNahab-Gaas, Abiel, Omuarba.
Asmavet, Omubahurim; Eliaba, Omusalboni.
Ovana ovamati vaHasem, Omugison, ovava: Jonatan yaSage, Omuharari;
Ahiam yaSakar, Omuharari; Elifal yaUr;
Hefer, Omumegera; Ahia, Omupeloni;
Hesro, Omukarmel; Naarai yaEsbai;
Joel omumwaina waNatan omulumenhu; Mibhar yaHagri;
Selek, Omuammoni; Naharai, Omubeerot, omuhumbati woiti yaJoab yaSeruja;
Ira, Omuiitri; Gareb, Omuiitri;
Uria, Omuheti; Sabad yaAhlai;
Adina yaSisa, Omurubeni, omukulunhu wOvarubeni, ndele pamwe naye kwa li omilongo nhatu.
Hanan yaMaaka; naJosafat, Omumitni;
Ussia, Omuastera; Sama naJeiel, ovana vaHotam, Omuaroeri;
Jediael yaSimri; naJoha omumwaina, Omutisi;
Eliel wokuMahavim naJeribai naJosavja, ovana vaElnaam; naJitma, Omumoabi;
Eliel naObed naJaasiel wokuMesobaja.
12: Ndele ovo ve uya kuDavid kuSiklag, fimbo ye okwa li ta hondama natango omolwaSaul yaKis, ovava: Vo va li yo mokati kovaladi ovo va kwafa David molwoodi,
va dililwa omauta, va deuka okukupula omamanya neke lokolulyo nolokolumosho ndele va dililwa oikuti nomauta. Vo va li vomepata laSaul vomuBenjamin.
Ova li mewiliko londjai Ahieser, omukulunhu, naJoas yaShemaa, Omugibea. NaJesiel naPelet, ovana vaAsmavet. NaBeraka naJehu, Omuanatot,
naJismaja, Omugibeon, omuladi mokati kaava omilongo nhatu, nomukulunhu waava omilongo nhatu, naJeremia naJahasiel naJohanan naJosabad womuGedera.
Elehusai naJerimot naBealja naShemaria naSefatja womuHaruf.
Elkana naIsshia naAsareel naJoeser naJasobeam, Omukora;
naJoela naSebadja, ovana vaJeroham womuGedor.

Ndele vomOvagad va ya yo kuDavid, kohotemhundangulu yomombuwa, ovalumenhu ovaladi, ovakwaita vomolwoodi, va dililwa noshikelelifo neonga, noipala yavo ya li ngaashi oipala yeenghoshi, ndele va li ve nonhapo ngaashi eemenye dokeemhunda:
Eser, omukulunhu, Obadja, omutivali, Eliab, omutitatu;
Mismanna, omutine, Jeremia, omutitano;
Attai, omutihamano, Eliel, omutiheyali;
Johanan, omutihetatu, Elsabad, omutimugoi.
Jeremia, omutimulongo, Mahbannai, omutimulongo naumwe.
Vo ova li vomovana vaGad, ovakulunhu vomatanga ovakwaita. Omuxupielela ta wana okulwifa efele. Nomunene wavo ta wana okulwifa eyovi.
Ovo tuu ovo va tauluka Jordan mohani yotete, fimbo oo wa li u yadi ndo, omeva taa kunguluka komakuma ao aeshe. Ndele va taataa oonakukalamo aveshe vomomaluhaela kombinga yokoushilo noyokouninginino.
Ndele ovo vomovana vaBenjamin novaJuda, eshi ve uya kohotemhundangulu kuDavid,

David okwa ya e va shakeneka ndele te va lombwele ta ti: “Nye ngeenge tamu uya kwaame nombili, mu kwafe nge, omutima wange tau ka kwatafana nanye. Ndelenee ngeenge tamu uya mu kengelele nge kovatondadi vange, nande momake ange kamu netimba, Kalunga kootate ne shi tale ndele ne shi handukile”.

Opo nee Omhepo ya yada Amasai, omukulunhu womilongo nhatu, ndele ta ti:
“Fye ovoye, David, ndele twa ama kwoove,
omona waIsai! Ombili.
Ombili nai kale naave,
nombili nai kale naava tave ku yakula,
osheshi Kalunga koye te ku kwafa!”
Opo nee David e va tambula ndele e va tula va ninge ovakulunhu veengudu domatanga.

Vamwe va dja yo kuManasse, ve uya kuDavid, ye eshi e uya pamwe nOvafilisti, va lwife Saul, ndelenee inave va kwafa, osheshi ovakulunhu vOvafilisti va kundafana ndele ve mu lekela, ndele tava ti: “Ye ota dulu okuyandja omitwe detu ndele ta ka ama komwene waye Saul.”
Fimbo ta i kuSiklag, ovo vomuManasse va ya kuye: Adna naJosabad naJediael naMikael naJosabad naElihu naSilletai, ovakulunhu vomayovi vomuManasse.
Vo ova kwafa David mokulwifa eengudu doita yomwii la, osheshi vo aveshe va li ovaladi novakulunhu vomatanga ovakwaita.
Osheshi efiku nefiku ve uya kuDavid, ndele tave mu kwafa, fiyo va ninga omatanga manene ovakwaita, ngaashi omatanga aKalunga.
Nomuvalu womatanga ovakwaita ava va dilililwa oita, ava ve uya kuDavid muHebron, ve mu pe ouhamba waSaul palombwelo lOmwene:
Ovana vaJuda, ava va humbata oshikelelifo neonga, va dilililwa oita, ova li omayovi ahamano nomafele ahetatu;
movana vaSimeon, ovaladi moshilonga shoita: omayovi aheyali nefele;
movana vaLevi omayovi ane nomafele ahamano;
naJehoiada, omukulunhu woludalo laAron napamwe naye omayovi atatu nomafele aheyali;
naSadok, omulumenhu omunyasha, omuladi, neumbo laye: ovakulunhu omilongo mbali navavali.
Ndele movana vaBenjamin, ovakwao vaSaul, omayovi atatu, osheshi vahapu unene va ama natango kepata laSaul.
Ndele movana vaEfraim omayovi omilongo mbali nomafele ahetatu, ovaladi, ovalumenhu ve nedina momapata avo;
ndele metata lepata laManasse omayovi omulongo naahetatu, ava va tumbulwa pamadina, va ye va ka ninge David ohamba.
Ndele movana vaIsaskar, ava va koneka efimbo ndele va li ve shi shii osho shi nokuningwa kOvaisraeli! Ovakulunhu vavo omafele avali, novakwao aveshe vomepangelo lavo.
MuSebulon ava ve nokuhomona palombwelo, va dilililwa oita ve noiti i lili nai lili, vo omayovi omilongo nhano, ve nehalo limwe alike meudafano lokulwa, ndele va li vehe nomitima mbali.
Ndele muNaftali ovakulunhu eyovi pamwe novanhu vavo omayovi omilongo nhatu naaheyali ve noshikelelifo neonga.
Ndele mOvadan, va dilililwa oita omayovi omilongo mbali naahetatu.
Ndele muAsser ava ve nokuhomona palombwelo, ve lilongekidila olwoodi: omayovi omilongo nhee.
Ndele kombinga inya yaJordan: mOvarubeni nomOvagad nometata lepata laManasse omayovi efele nomayovi omilongo mbali, ve noiti i lili nai lili.
Ovakwaita ovo aveshe ve uya kuHebron pamatanga nomutima we liyandja, va ninge David ohamba yOvaisraeli aveshe; nOvaisraeli vakwao aveshe va li ve nomutima umwe va ninge David ohamba.
Ndele va kala pamwe naDavid okulya nokunwa omafiku atatu, osheshi ovakwanepata vavo ve va pa onghuta.

Naavenya yo va kala moushiinda wavo fiyo okuIsaskar naSebulon naNaftali, va eta omungome wa humbatwa keendongi nokeengamelo nokomamula nokeengobe deenghutwa: oufila noikambi yeenghwiyu noikuki yeeviinyu nomaviinyu nomaadi neengobe needi dihapu, osheshi muIsrael mwa li ehafo.
13: Ndele David okwa kundafana novakulunhu veyovi novefele nomukulunhu keshe wovakwaita.

Ndele David okwa lombwela oshiongalele ashishe shOvaisraeli ndele ta ti: “Ngeenge tashi mu wapalele ndele tashi di kOmwene, Kalunga ketu, tu lihaneni ndele tu tumeni kuvakwetu ovo va fyaala natango moitukulwalongo aishe yOvaisraeli, ndele pamwe navo kovapristeli nokOvalevi vomoilando, oko ve nomaulifilo, nokutya nava ongale nafye.
Ndele natu eteni oshikefa shaKalunga ketu kufye, osheshi pomafiku aSaul inatu shi pula”.
Opo nee oshiongalele ashishe tashi ti, osho nashi ningwe, osheshi oshinima sha li sha wapala momesho ovanhu aveshe.
Ndele David okwa ongela Ovaisraeli aveshe okudja kuSihor shomuEgipiti fiyo okomhito yokuya kuHamat, va kufe mo oshikefa shaKalunga muKiriat-Jearim.
Opo nee David pamwe nOvaisraeli aveshe va ya kuBaala, kuKiriat-Jearim shomuJuda, opo va kufe ko oshikefa shaKalunga Omwene, ou ta kala omutumba kovakerubi, e shi tambula medina laye.
Ndele va tula oshikefa shaKalunga metemba lipe, ndele ve shi kufa mo meumbo laAbinadab. Ndele Ussa naAhjo va shinga etemba.
Ndele David nOvaisraeli aveshe va dana neenghono koshipala shOmwene nomaimbilo nouxumbafeta neenyalilo noungoma noosimbale nomanghuma.
Vo eshi ve uya koshipale shaKidon, Ussa okwa yakela oshikefa neke laye, osheshi eenhani oda punduka.
Opo nee ehandu lOmwene la xwamena Ussa, nokwe mu dipaa, shaashi ye a kuma oshikefa neke laye, onghee hano ye okwa fya koshipala shaKalunga.
Ndele David okwa ninga omwenyo mwii, Omwene eshi a dipaa Ussa. Onghee hano okwa luka onhele oyo Peres-Ussa fiyo onena eli.
Ndele mefiku tuu olo David okwa tila Kalunga ndele ta ti: “Ame ohandi dulu ngahelipi okweeta oshikefa shaKalunga kwaame?”
Onghee hano David ine shi itavela oshikefa shi etwe moshilando shaDavid, ndelenee ve shi twala meumbo laObed-Edom, Omugat.
Noshikefa shaKalunga sha kala meumbo laObed-Edom eehani nhatu; nOmwene okwa nangeka noupuna eumbo laObed-Edom moinima aishe.
14: Hiram, ohamba yaTirus, ya tuma ovatumwa kuDavid nomiti domisederi, novapangeli novahongi vomamanya, ve mu tungile ongulu.
Ndele David okwe shi dimbulukwa nokutya Omwene e mu pameka ohamba yOvaisraeli nouhamba waye wa tumbala omolwoshiwana shaye Israel.
Ndele David okwa kufa vali muJerusalem ovalikadi, ndele David okwa ninga xe yovana vahapu ovamati noukadona.
Nomadina ovana vaye ve mu dalelwa muJerusalem aa: Sammua oo naSobab, Natan naSalomo
naJibhar naElishua naElpelet
naNoha naNefek naJafia
naElisama naBeeliada naElifelet.
Ovafilisti eshi va uda nokutya, David a vaekwa nokwa ninga ohamba yOvaisraeli aveshe, Ovafilisti aveshe va fikama va ka konge David. David eshi e shi uda, okwa ya oku va shakeneka.
NOvafilisti ve uya ndele ve lihanena mefilu laRefaim.
Opo nee David okwa pula kuKalunga ndele ta ti: “Nandi ka lwife tuu Ovafilisti? Ove oto ke va yandja tuu meke lange?” Omwene okwe mu nyamukula: “Inda ko, Ame ohandi ke va yandja meke loye.”
Ndele vo eshi va ya kuBaal-Perasim, David e va taataa, ndele David ta ti: “Kalunga okwa teyaula ovatondadi vange neke lange, ngaashi omeva taa teyaula.” Onghee hano va luka onhele oyo Baal-Perasim.
Ndele venya va fiya po oikalunga yavo. Ndele David okwe va lombwela ndele ve va xwika po nomundilo.
Ndelenee Ovafilisti ve lihanena vali mefilu.
Opo nee David a pula vali kuKalunga, ndele Kalunga okwe mu lombwela: “Ino va shakeneka. Va dilila konima yavo, u va dje kombinga yomiti domitaku.
Ndele eshi to udu oikukulo yeemhadi membolongodjo domiti domitaku, tota hano, u ye molwoodi, osheshi Kalunga e ku tetekela a denge omatanga Ovafilisti.”
Ndele David okwa ninga ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwela, ndele va hanauna po omatanga Ovafilisti okudja kuGibeon fiyo okuGeser.
Nedina laDavid la tandavela moilongo aishe, nOmwene okwa pendula ehaluko loku mu tila moiwana aishe.
15: Ndele ye okwe litungila eengulu moshilando shaDavid, nokwa longekidila oshikefa shaKalunga onhele ndele te shi dikile etwali.
Opo nee David ta ti: “Kaku na umwe ta humbata oshikefa shaKalunga, Ovalevi aveke, osheshi Omwene e va hoololela okuhumbata oshikefa shaKalunga noku mu longela fiyo alushe.”
Ndele David okwa ongela Ovaisraeli aveshe muJerusalem, va ete oshikefa shOmwene konhele oyo yasho, ye e i shi longekidila.
Ndele David okwa ongela oludalo laAron nOvalevi:
movana vaKohat: Uriel, omukulunhu, novakwao efele nomilongo mbali;
movana vaMerari: Asasia, omukulunhu, novakwao omafele avali nomilongo mbali;
movana vaGerson: Joel, omukulunhu, novakwao efele nomilongo nhatu;
movana vaElisafan: Shemaia, omukulunhu, novakwao omafele avali;
movana vaHebron: Eliel, omukulunhu, novakwao omilongo hetatu;
movana vaUsiel: Aminadab, omukulunhu, novakwao efele nomulongo navavali;
ndele David okwa ifana ovapristeli Sadok naAbjatar, nOvalevi Uriel, Asasia naJoel, Shemaia naEliel naAminadab,
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Nye ovakulunhu vomapata Ovalevi: Liyapuleni, nye vene novakweni, mu ete oshikefa shOmwene, Kalunga kaIsrael, konhele oyo nde i shi longekidila.
Osheshi nye kamwa li po pehovelo, Omwene Kalunga ketu eshi e tu taula, shaashi inatu mu konga ngaashi sha wapala.”
Opo nee ovapristeli nOvalevi ve liyapula, va ka tale ko oshikefa shOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael.
NOvalevi va humbata nomitengi oshikefa shaKalunga komapepe ngaashi Moses e va lombwela pandjovo yOmwene.
Ndele David okwa lombwela ovakulunhu Ovalevi nokutya, vo va tule po oovakwao ovaimbi nouxumba nouxumbafeta neenyalilo noosimbale, va shike nokuyelula ondaka yomaimbilo ehafo.
Onghee hano Ovalevi va tula po Heman yaJoel nomovakwao Asaf yaBerekia, nomovana vaMerari, ovakwao Etan yaKusaja;

ndele pamwe navo vomepata lavo ava ve va shikula mokufimanekwa: Sakaria, Ben naJaasiel naSemiramot naJeiel naUnni, Eliab naBenaja naMaasea naMatitia naElifeleu naMikneja naObed-Edom naJeiel, ovanangeli voivelo;
novaimbi Heman, Asaf naEtan, va shike omanghuma oshikushu;
naSakaria naJaasiel naSemiramot naJehiel naUnni naEliab naMaasea naBenaja ve neenyalilo nondaka yopombada;
ndele Matitia naElifeleu naMikneja naObed-Edom naJeiel naAsasia ve nouxumbafeta, va kwatele olwiimbo komesho nondaka yombaafa.
Ndele Kenanja, omukulunhu wOvalevi, a tulwa po a diinine etuto loinima. Ye okwa pashukila okuhumbata kwoinima, shaashi ye kwa li e nomayele moshilonga osho.
Ndele Berekia naElkana va li ovanangeli poshivelo shoshikefa.
Novapristeli Sebanja naJosafat naNetanel naAmasai naSakaria naBenaja naElieser, va shika omanghuma, va li komesho yoshikefa shaKalunga. Ndele Obed-Edom naJehia va li ovanangeli voivelo yoshikefa.
Opo nee David novakulunhu vOvaisraeli novaneyovi va ya, ndele va eta nehafo oshikefa shehangano lOmwene, ve shi kufa mo meumbo laObed-Edom.
Ndele fimbo Kalunga a kwafa Ovalevi ava va humbata oshikefa shehangano lOmwene, eengobe heyali deemhedi needi heyali deemhedi oda yambwa.

Ndele David okwa li a djala ombaikifa yokombada ya hondjwa koshiyata shiwa sholiina, nosho yo Ovalevi aveshe ava va humbata oshikefa, novaimbi nomukulunhu wetuto, Kenanja pamwe novaimbi. Ndele David okwa li e noshikutu sholiina shokomapepe.
NOvaisraeli aveshe va ya va ka tale ko oshikefa shehangano lOmwene nehafo nokushika omanghuma nomanghuma oshikushu nousimbale, fimbo vakwao hava shiki eenyalilo nouxumbafeta.

Oshikefa shehangano lOmwene eshi she uya koshilando shaDavid, Mikal, omona waSaul, omukainhu, a talela mombululu yekende, ndele ta mono ohamba David ta tutula ndele ta shiki okaxumba, nokwe mu dina momutima waye.
16: Vo eshi va twala mo oshikefa shaKalunga ndele ve shi nangeka metwali olo David e li shi dikila, ova yamba omaxwikiloyambo nomapanduloyambo koshipala shaKalunga.
David eshi a yamba omaxwikiloyambo nomapanduloyambo, okwa nangeka noupuna ovanhu medina lOmwene.
Nokwa tukulila Omuisraeli keshe, ovalumenhu novakainhu, keshe umwe, omungome nonhumba yombelela noshikamena sheeviinyu.
Ndele mOvalevi okwa tula po ovayakuli, hava yakula moipafi yoshikefa shOmwene, va fimaneke Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael noku mu hambelela noku mu pandula:
Asaf, omukulunhu, naSakaria e mu shikula metumbalo; Jeiel naSemiramot naJehiel naMatitia naEliab naBenaja naObed-Edom naJeiel ve neenyalilo nouxumbafeta, fimbo Asaf e nenghuma
novapristeli Benaja naJahasiel va shika omanghuma oshikushu efimbo alishe moipafi yoshikefa shehangano laKalunga.
Mefiku tuu olo, David okwa tula po Asaf noovakwao otetetete, va imbe ehambelelo kOmwene:

Hambeleleni Omwene, ifaneni edina laye.
Hepaululeni oinenelonga yaye mokati koiwana yoilongo.

Mu imbileni mu shikileni,
udifeni oikumwifalonga yaye aishe.

Tumbalekeni edina laye liyapuki.
Ava tava kongo Omwene,
omutima wavo nau kale wa hafa.

Lipuleni nOmwene neenghono daye,
efimbo alishe kongeni oshipala shaye!

Dimbulukweni oikumwifa oyo e i longa,
nomadidilikokumwifa aye nomatokolo okanya kaye,

oludalo nye laAbraham, omupiya waye,
ovana vaJakob, ovahoololwa vaye!

Omwene Oye Kalunga ketu;
omatokolo aye otaa udika mounyuni aushe.

Diladileni alushe ehangano laye,
neendjovo daye edi a dikila omaludalo omayovi,

ehangano olo e li udafanene naAbraham,
neano, olo e li anenene Isak,

olo e li pamekelele Jakob, li kale omhangela yaye
nehangano laye naIsrael fiyo alushe,

eshi a tile: “Edu laKaanan, ohandi li ku pe,
lo li kale oshitukulwafyuululwa sheni.”

Vo eshi va li okangudu kanini,
ke vahapu nande, ndele va li mo ovanailongo,

ovatembavaukili koshiwana noshiwana,
koshilongo noshilongo.

Ndelenee Ye ina efa nande umwe e va fininike,
nokwa li a handukila eehamba omolwavo, ndele ta ti:

“Inamu kuma nande ovavaekwa vange,
nye inamu hepeka ovaxunganeki vange.”

Imbileni efimano lOmwene ounyuni aushe.
Udifeni exupifo laye efiku nefiku!

Efimano laye li hepaululeni mokati koiwana,
noikumwifa yaye moiwana aishe.

Osheshi Omwene Ye omunene nomuhambelelwa pombada,
Ye ota tilika kombada yoikalunga aishe.

Osheshi oikalunga aishe yoiwana oyo oikalunga.
Ndelenee Omwene okwa shita omaulu.

Epangelonghono noshinge shi li koshipala shaye,
eenghono nehafo tali kala monhele yokukala kwaye.

Fimanekeni Omwene, nye omapata oiwana,
peni Omwene efimano neenghono.

Peni Omwene efimano ledina laye, eteni omayambo,
mu holoke koshipala shaye,
linyongameneni Omwene mwa djala oikutu iyapuki.

Kakama koshipala shaye, ounyuni aushe.
Ongonga yedu oya pama, onghee itai tengauka.

Omaulu naa hafe nedu nali nyakukwe,
nava tye mokati koiwana: “Omwene Oye ohamba.”

Efuta naashishe shi li mo, nashi tukuluke,
nomufitu naashishe shi li mo nashi kuwilile.

Opo nee omiti domoixwa nadi shambukwe koshipala shOmwene.
Osheshi Ye ote uya okutokola ounyuni.

Hambeleleni Omwene, osheshi Oye omuwa,
ouwanghenda waye tau kala po fiyo alushe.

Tyeni: “Kalunga kexupifo letu, tu xupifa;
tu ongela u tu xupife mo moiwana,
opo tu hambelele edina loye liyapuki,
noku li tanga molwefimano loye.

Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael na hambelelwe
alushe fiyo alushe.”
Novanhu aveshe tava ti: “Amen!” nova hambelela Omwene.
Ohamba David oya tula po Asaf novakwao va kale ofika komesho yoshikefa shehangano lOmwene, va longe komesho yoshikefa efimbo alishe oilonga yefiku keshe.
Nosho yo Obed-Edom pamwe navakwao omilongo hamano navahetatu, ndele Obed-Edom yaJedutun naHosa va ninga ovanangeli voivelo.
Ndelenee omupristeli Sadok pamwe novapristeli vakwao e va tula komesho yetwali lOmwene koshikulundu shomuGibeon,
va yambele Omwene koaltari ongula nonguloshi omaxwikiloyambo, ndele ve shi ninga paashishe sha shangelwa momhango yOmwene, e i lombwela Ovaisraeli;
ndele pamwe navo Heman naJedutun novahoololwa vamwe ovo va tumbulwa pamadina va hambelele Omwene nokutya, ouwanghenda waye tau kala fiyo alushe.
Ndele Heman naJedutun va diinina omanghuma noushandje vovashiki nouxumba vamwe molwomalwiimbo okufimaneka Kalunga. Ndelenee ovana ovamati vaJedutun va li poshivelo.
Novanhu aveshe, keshe umwe, eshi a shuna keumbo laye, David okwa piluka, a ka nangeke noupuna eumbo laye.
17: Ndele David eshi a kala mongulu yaye, David ta ti komuxunganeki Natan: “Tala, ame ohandi kala mongulu yomiti domisederi, ndelenee oshikefa shehangano lOmwene oshi li koshi yeefaila.”
Opo nee Natan ta ti kuDavid: “Ninga ashishe to diladila momutima woye, osheshi Kalunga oku li naave.”
Ndelenee oufiku tuu ou ondjovo yOmwene ye uya kuNatan ndele tai ti:
“Inda u ka lombwele David, omupiya wange, ‘Omwene ta ti ngaha: Haave to ka tungila nge ongulu yokukala mo.
Ame inandi kala mongulu nande imwe okudja efiku linya nda pitifa mo Ovaisraeli muEgipiti fiyo okefiku eli lonena, ndelenee Ame nda tembuka mofaila nofaila nokonhele nonhele.

Ndele keshe apa nda endaenda mokati kOvaisraeli aveshe, Ame inandi lombwela nande umwe omovana vaIsrael ava nde li pa okulifa oshiwana shange, ndi tye: “Omolwashike inamu tungila nge ongulu yomiti domisederi?” ’
Onghee hano u nokulombwela omupiya wange David: ‘Omwene womatanga ovakwaita ta ti ngaha: Aame mwene nde ku kufa moufita wokulifa eedi, u ninge omukomesho wovanhu vange Ovaisraeli.
Ame nda kala pamwe naave apeshe apa wa ya, ndele nda halakanifa ovatondadi voye aveshe komesho yoye. Nohandi ke ku ningila edina linene, ngaashi edina lovanenenhu vokombada yedu;
ndele Ame ohandi ka longekidila oshiwana shange Israel onhele noku shi twika mo, opo shi kale monhele yasho vene ndele itashi kala vali shihe netulumuko. Novakolokoshi itave ke shi hepeka vali;

ngaashi shito okudja kefiku tuu linya Ame nda tula po ovatokolipangeli okupangela oshiwana shange shaIsrael, naame ohandi ke ku pa etulumuko kovatondadi voye aveshe. Ndele Omwene ote ku shiivifile nokutya Ye ote ke ku tungila eumbo.
Ndele omafiku oye ngeenge a pu ko, nowa fya, ndele wa pakwa kooxokulu, Ame ohandi ka lenga oludalo lomolutu loye, umwe wovamwoye ovamati, ta ningi omushikuli woye, nouhamba waye ohandi ke u pameka.
Ye ota ka tungila nge ongulu, nolukalwapangelo laye ohandi ke li pameka fiyo alushe.
Ame ohandi ka ninga xe, ndele ye ota ka ninga omumwange; nouwanghenda wange itandi u mu kufa, ngaashi nde u kufa kwaawinya e ku tetekela.
Ndelenee Ame ohandi ke mu kaleka ofika mongulu yange nomoshilongo shange fiyo alushe, nolukalwapangelo laye tali ka kala la pama fiyo alushe.’ ”
Paendjovo adishe edi nopamoniko eli, Natan okwa popya naDavid.
Opo nee ohamba David ya ya ndele tai kala koshipala shOmwene ndele tai ti: “Omwene Kalunga, aame omushike, nepata lange eshike, ove eshi wa fikifa nge fiyo opapa?
Ndelenee eshi oshinima shinini natango momesho oye, Omwene Kalunga, ove wa popya epata lomupiya woye ndele wa popya oinima yomefimbo lokomesho kokule, ndele wa ulikila nge omapupi enya okomesho.
Omupiya woye David ota dulu okupopya shike vali molwefimano we li mu pa? Osheshi omupiya woye ou mu shii.
Omwene, omolwomupiya woye nomolwomutima woye, Ove wa ninga oshinima eshi shinene, oinima aishe ei inene i shiivike.
Omwene, kaku na nande umwe ngaashi Ove, ndele kaku na Kalunga ponho yoye, kwaashishe twe shi uda nomatwi etu.

Noshiwana shilipipo kombada yedu sha fa oshiwana shaIsrael, osho sha xupifwa kuKalunga shi ninge oshiwana shaye, opo e liningila edina linene, eshi e shi ningila oinima inene noitilifa mounyuni moipafi yovanhu vaye, eshi e shi xupifa mo muEgipiti?
Ndele Ove we lilongekidila oshiwana Israel shi ninge oshiwana shoye fiyo alushe. Ndele Ove, Omwene, wa ninga Kalunga kavo.
Ondjovo oyo Omwene we i popya omupiya woye nepata laye, nai ninge yoshili fiyo alushe, ndele ninga ngaashi wa popya.

Heeno, nai ninge yoshili, nedina loye nali ninge linene fiyo alushe, vo opo va tye: ‘Omwene womatanga ovakwaita, Kalunga kaIsrael, Oye Kalunga kOvaisraeli.’ Nepata laDavid, omupiya woye tali kalelele koshipala shoye.
