Osheshi Ove Kalunga kange, we shi hololela omupiya woye nokutya, to ke mu tungila ongulu. Onghee hano omupiya woye a nyatipalekwa okwiilikana koshipala shoye.
Ndele paife, Omwene, Oove Kalunga, ndele Ove wa udanekela omupiya woye oshinima eshi shiwa.
Hano nehalo loye liwa nangeka noupuna epata lomupiya woye li kale fiyo alushe koshipala shoye. Osheshi osho Ove Omwene, to shi nangeke noupuna, tashi ka kala yo sha nangekwa noupuna fiyo alushe.”
18: Ndelenee konima yoinima ei, David okwa ta Ovafilisti ndele e va tula koshi yepangelo laye. Osho ngaha okwa kufa Gat nomikunda dasho momake Ovafilisti.
Ye okwa ta yo Ovamoab, onghee hano Ovamoab va ninga ovapiya vaDavid, ndele ve mu yandjela oifendela.
David okwa ta yo Hadadeser, ohamba yaSoba, sha ama kuHamat, yo eshi ya fikama i ka pameke epangelo layo pomulonga waEufrat.

Ndele David okwa kufa kuyo omatemba oita eyovi novalondi omayovi aheyali veenghambe novakwaita vokolupadi omayovi omilongo mbali. Ndele David okwa teta omifipa deemhando deenghambe adishe dokomatemba, ndelenee okwa xupifa eenghambe efele dokomatemba.
NOvaarami vokuDamaskus ve uya okupopila Hadadeser, ohamba yaSoba. Ndelenee David okwa ta ovalumenhu omayovi omilongo mbali naavali vomOvaarami.
Ndele David okwa nangeka omatanga ovakwaita muAram shaDamaskus, onghee Ovaarami va ninga ovapangelwa vaye ndele tava yandje oifendela. NOmwene okwa yandja kuDavid omafindano keshe apa a homona.
Ndele David okwa kufa oikelelifo yoshingoldo, oyo ya li hai longifwa kovapiya vaHadadeser, nokwe i twala kuJerusalem.
Ndele David okwa kufa muTibhat nomuKun, oilando yaHadadeser, oshikushu shihapu unene kai shii kutumbulwa. Salomo okwa ninga nayo efuta loshikushu neengudi noinima yoshikushu.
Tou, ohamba yaHamat, eshi ya uda nokutya, David a taataa omatanga aeshe ovakwaita vaHadadeser, ohamba yaSoba,

Okwa tuma omona waye omumati Hadoram, kohamba David, e mu pule nhumbi e li noku mu halela elao, ye eshi a lwifa Hadadeser nokwe mu taataa, osheshi Hadadeser okwa li omutondadi waTou. Nokwa eta oinima yoingoldo noyoisiliveli noyoshikushu i lili nai lili.
Ohamba David okwe i yapulila Omwene, pamwe noshisiliveli noshingoldo osho ye a kufa koiwana aishe nokutya kOvaedom nokOvamoab nokovana vaAmmoni nokOvafilisti nokOvaamaleki.
Ndele naAbisai yaSeruja yo okwa taataa Ovaedom, ovalumenhu omayovi omulongo naahetatu mEfilu lomongwa.
Nokwa tula muEdom omatanga ovakwaita, onghee hano Ovaedom aveshe va ninga ovapangelwa vaDavid. NOmwene okwa yandja kuDavid omafindano keshe apa a homona.
Ndele David okwa pangela Israel alishe, nokwa ningila oshiwana shaye ashishe osho sha yuka nosha wapala.
Ndele Joab yaSeruja okwa li ondjai yomatanga ovakwaita. Ndele Josafat yaAhilud okwa li elenga ekulunhu.
Ndele Sadok yaAhitub naAhimelek yaAbjatar va li ovapristeli, ndele Sausa okwa li omushangi.
Ndele Benaja yaJehoiada okwa li omukulunhu wOvakereti nowOvapleti, novana vaDavid ovamati va li tava pitapita ohamba.
19: Konima yoinima ei Nahas, ohamba yOvaammoni, okwa fya, nomona waye omumati Hanun okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaxe.

Opo nee David ta ti: “Ame nda hala okufila Hanun yaNahas onghenda, ngaashi xe a fila nge onghenda.” Onghee hano David a tuma ovatumwa kuye oku mu pendula omolwefyo laxe. Ovatumwa vaDavid eshi ve uya moshilongo shOvaammoni, kuHanun, ve mu pendule,
omalenga Ovaammoni a lombwela Hanun: “David ota fimaneke ngaho mbela xo momesho oye, eshi e ku tumina ovapenduli? Ovapiya vaye pamwe ve uya okupanapana oshilongo noku shi lava e shi hanaune po.”
Opo nee Hanun a kwata ovatumwa vaDavid nokwa kululifa eendjedi davo ndele ta tete oikutu yavo pokati fiyo moshiya, nokwe va lekela va ye.

Ndele David eshi a shiivifilwa ovalumenhu nhumbi va ningwa, okwa tuma ovatumwa oku va shakeneka, osheshi ovalumenhu va li va fya ohoni unene. Nohamba tai ti: “Kaleni muJeriko fiyo eendjedi deni tadi kulu. Opo nee tamu aluka.”

Ovana vaAmmoni eshi va mona nokutya, ve litondifa kuDavid, Hanun novana vaAmmoni va tuma eekilograma omayovi omilongo nhatu nomayovi ane doshisiliveli va itavelwe va longife omatemba oita novalondi veenghambe dokuMesopotamia nokuAram-Maaka nokuSoba.

Ndele vo ove likongela omatemba omayovi omilongo nhatu naavali nohamba yaMaaka nomatanga aye ovakwaita. Ndele ve uya ndele tava ongo onhanda komesho yaMedeba. Novana vaAmmoni yo va ongala, va dja moilando yavo va ka lwe.
Ndele David okwe shi uda nokwa tuma Joab nomatanga aeshe ovakwaita, ovaladi.
Novana vaAmmoni va fikama ndele va tanda ombinga poshivelo shoshilando, fimbo eehamba odo de uya, da li moluhaela neengudu da tongoka.
Joab eshi a mona nokutya, ta ka ponokelwa komesho nokonima, okwa hoolola mo movahoololwa aveshe vOvaisraeli nokwe va tula moipafi yOvaarami va tanda ombinga.
Ndelenee omatanga ovakwaita aa a xupa po e a tula mepangelo lomumwaina Abisai ndele vo e va tandifa ombinga kOvaammoni.
Nokwa tya: “Ovaarami ngeenge tava dulu nge eenghono, ove u nokuuya u kwafe nge, ndele Ovaammoni ngeenge tave ku dulu eenghono, ame ohandi uya ndi ku kwafe.
Kala wa pama, ndele atushe tu kaleni twa nyatipala omolwoshiwana shetu nomolwoilando yaKalunga ketu. Omwene na ninge osho tashi mu wapalele momesho aye.”
Opo nee Joab nomatanga ovakwaita ava va li puye va tota va lwife Ovaarami, ndele venya ova faduka po.
NOvaammoni eshi va mona kutya Ovaarami va faduka po, navo yo va ya onhapo omumwaina Abisai, ndele va ya moshilando. Ndele Joab okwe uya kuJerusalem.
Ovaarami eshi va mona va tewa kOvaisraeli, ova tuma ovatumwa kOvaarami venya va li kombada yaEufrat, ve uye pamwe naSofak, ondjai yoita yaHadadeser, ye va pitila komesho.

David eshi e shi shiivifilwa, okwa ongela omatanga aeshe ovakwaita Ovaisraeli ndele ta tauluka Jordan. Ye eshi e uya kuvo, okwe va tandela ombinga. Ndele David eshi a tandela Ovaarami ombinga, venya ove mu lwifa.
Ndelenee Ovaarami va ya onhapo Ovaisraeli. Ndele David okwa dipaa ovashingi vomatemba omayovi aheyali novakwaita vokolupadi omayovi omilongo nhee. NaSofak yo, ondjai yoita, okwe i dipaa.
Novapiya vaHadadeser, eshi va mona nokutya, va tewa komesho yOvaisraeli, ova panga ombili naDavid ndele ve mu longela. NOvaarami inava popila vali ovana vaAmmoni.
20: Nomudo umwe eshi wa pita, pefimbo olo eehamba tadi fikama okuhomona, Joab okwa twala omatanga ovakwaita ndele ta hanauna po oshilongo shovana vaAmmoni. Nokwe uya yo kuRabba ndele te shi kondeke, fimbo David a kala muJerusalem. Ndele Joab okwa nangala Rabba, ndele e shi hanauna po.

Ndele David okwa kufa oshishani shohamba yavo komutwe waMilkom, oudjuu woshishani wa li eekilograma omilongo nhatu nanhee doshingoldo, ndele mwoo mwa li okamanya ke nondilo, ndele owo wa tulwa komutwe waDavid. Nokwa kufa mo moshilando oixuulwa ihapu.

Noonakukalamo musho okwe va kufa mo nokwe va tula moilonga yoishaaxa, yeembike noyomapanda. Ndele osho David a ninga oilando aishe yOvaammoni. Ndele David okwa shuna nomatanga aeshe ovakwaita kuJerusalem.
Ndele konima yoinima ei, olwoodi la hovela nOvafilisti puGeser. Opo nee Sibbegai, Omuhusai, okwa dipaa Sippai womovana vOvarefai, ndele osho va ninipikwa.
Ndele pa li vali oita nOvafilisti. Ndele Elhanan yaJair okwa dipaa Lakmi, omumwaina waGoliat, ou Omugat, ou oshiti sheonga laye sha li ngaashi ongala yomushi.
Ndele pa li vali olwoodi puGat, ndele oko kwa li omulumenhu mule unene e nominwe hamano meke keshe nomomhadi keshe, kumwe ominwe omilongo mbali nanhee. Naye yo okwa li womoludalo lOvarefai.
Nokwa sheka Ovaisraeli, ndelenee Jonatan yaSimea, omumwaina waDavid, okwe mu dipaa.
Vo va li vomoludalo lOvarefai omuGat, ndele va dipawa keke laDavid nokomake ovapiya vaye.
21: Ndelenee Satana okwa twifa Ovaisraeli ondubo ndele ta tu David omayele okuvala Ovaisraeli.
Ndele David okwa lombwela Joab novakulunhu voshiwana: “Indeni mu ka vale Ovaisraeli okudja kuBerseba fiyo okuDan, ndele shiivifilei nge, opo ndi shiive omuvalu wavo.”

Ndele Joab ta ti: “Omwene na hapupalife ovanhu vaye lwefele ve dule ava ve li po paife. Omwene wange ohamba, ovanhu aveshe ovapiya voye. Omolwashike ohamba ya hala okuvalula oshiwana noku shi vela ombedi?”
Ndelenee ondjovo yohamba oya dula oyo yaJoab, ndele Joab okwa ya nokwa endaenda mOvaisraeli aveshe nokwe uya kuJerusalem.
Ndele Joab okwa yandja kohamba David omuvalu wovanhu. MuIsrael mwa li ovalumenhu va wana okulwa ve li omiliyona nomayovi efele, ndele muJuda omayovi omafele ane nomafele omilongo heyali aveke.
Ndelenee Levi naBenjamin ine va vala pamwe navenya, shaashi ondjovo yohamba ya li oixuna kuJoab.
Noshinima eshi inashi yuka momesho aKalunga, onghee hano Ye a denga Ovaisraeli.
Opo nee David ta ti kuKalunga: “Ame nda nyona nai shili, eshi nda ninga oshinima eshi. Ndelenee dimine nge po oilonga ei youshima.”
NOmwene okwa lombwela Gad, omumonikokule waDavid, ndele ta ti:
“Inda u ka lombwele David u tye: ‘Omwene ta ti ngaha: Ame ohandi ku pe u hoolole poinima itatu. Eshi to hoolola po, osho handi ke ku ningila.’ ”
Opo nee Gad e uya kuDavid ndele e mu shiivifila ondjovo yOmwene, ndele ta pula, ta ti: “Shi lipipo wa hala?

Omido nhatu dondjala, ile eehani nhatu okuya onhapo ovafininiki voye eshi tave ku taataa, ile omafiku atatu eongamukonda lOmwene, nokutya, oudu wolutapo moshilongo, eshi omweengeli wOmwene ta eta efyo muIsrael ashishe. Enyamukulo li lipipo hai twala kOmwene?”
Opo nee David ta ti kuGad: “Ndi udite oudjuu unene! Nandi wile meke lOmwene, osheshi olune laye olinene, ndelenee inandi hala okuwila momake ovanhu.”
NOmwene okwa tumina Ovaisraeli oudu wolutapo, ndele mOvaisraeli mwa fya ovalumenhu omayovi omilongo heyali.

Ndele Kalunga okwa tuma omweengeli kuJerusalem oku shi hanauna po. Ndele fimbo te shi hanauna po, Omwene e shi wete, nokwe lialuluka omolwomupya, nokwa lombwela omweengeli, ou ta hanauna: “Sha wana! Alula eke loye!” Nomweengeli wOmwene okwa kala ofika poshipale shOmujebusi Ornan.

David eshi a pashula omesho aye, okwa mona omweengeli wOmwene ta kala ofika pokati kedu neulu, e neongamukonda la pweywa mo, meke laye, la yelulilwa Jerusalem. Opo nee David novakulunhu va li va djala oikutu yeefya tava wile eombe.

Ndele David ta ti kuKalunga: “Ame ndi shii nde shi tya, ovanhu nava valwe? Heeno, ame tuu ou nda nyona ndele nda ninga eshi inashi yuka. Ndelenee eedi edi da ninga shike? Omwene Kalunga kange, eke loye nali denge nge neumbo lange, ndelenee ino denga ovanhu voye noudu wolutapo.”
Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene a lombwela Gad a tye kuDavid nokutya David e nokuya, a tungile Omwene oaltari moshipale shOmujebusi Ornan.
Ndele David okwa ya pandjovo yaGad, ye e i popya medina lOmwene.
Ornan eshi a punguluka, okwa mona omweengeli. Novana vaye vane ovamati va hondama. Ornan okwa li ta yele oilya.
David eshi e uya kuOrnan, Ornan okwa yelula omesho ndele ta mono David, nokwa dja mo moshipale ndele te linyongamene pedu koshipala shaDavid.
Opo nee David ta lombwele Ornan: “Pe nge onhele ei yoshipale, ndi shiive okutungila Omwene oaltari muyo. I pe nge pandjele yoimaliwa ya wana mo, opo oudu wolutapo u kandulwe po movanhu.”
Ndelenee Ornan ta ti kuDavid: “Shi kufa po, nomwene ohamba nai ninge osho sha wapala momesho ayo. Tala, eengobe handi di yandje exwikiloyambo, noilei oikuni, noilya eendjayambo. Aishe ohandi ku pe.”

Ndelenee ohamba David okwa lombwela Ornan: “Ahowe, ndelenee ame nda hala shili oku shi landa noimaliwa ya wana. Osheshi oinima oyo yoye inandi hala oku i kufa nokuyambela Omwene exwikiloyambo oyo inandi i futu.”
Ndele David okwa yandja kuOrnan eesekeli omafele ahamano doshingoldo mokufuta onhele oyo.
Ndele David okwa tungila ko Omwene oaltari ndele te mu yambele omaxwikiloyambo nomapanduloyambo. Fimbo ye ta ifana Omwene. Ye okwe mu nyamukula nomundilo wokeulu tau wile koaltari yexwikiloyambo.
NOmwene okwa lombwela omweengeli, a shunife eongamukonda laye moshilaleko.
Mefimbo olo David eshi a mona nokutya, Omwene e mu nyamukula moshipale shaOrnan, Omujebusi, ye okwa li ta yambe kwinya,
osheshi pefimbo linya etwali lOmwene olo la dikwa kuMoses mombuwa noaltari yexwikiloyambo, oya li koshikulundu shomuGibeon.
Ndele David okwa tila okuya ko koshipala shOmwene, shaashi a tila eongamukonda lomweengeli wOmwene.
22: Ndele David ta ti: “Opo tuu apa ongulu yOmwene Kalunga, nopo tuu apa oaltari yexwikiloyambo yOvaisraeli.”

Ndele David okwa yandja oshipango nokutya, ovanailongo aveshe ava ve li moshilongo shaIsrael, ve nokwoongelwa. Nokwa tula po ovatatuli vomamanya novahongi vomamanya a tatulwa okutunga ongulu yaKalunga.
Ndele David okwa ongela oivela ihapu unene ngaashi eembosha dokoivelo nomakandula, noshikushu shihapu shihapu sha nyenga okuyeleka.
Navali omandangalati mahapu omisederi a nyenga okuvalwa; osheshi Ovasidoni nOvatirus va tumina David omandangalati mahapu unene.

Osheshi David ta ti: “Omumwange Salomo omunyasha wokasheshelutu ndele ongulu oyo tai ka tungilwa Omwene, i nokuninga inene i dule eengulu adishe, i ninge etumbalo newapalo loilongo aishe. Nandi mu longekidile hano etungo.” Onghee hano David, fimbo ina fya, a longekida oitungifo ihapu.
Opo nee a ifana omona waye Salomo nokwe mu lombwela a tungile Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ongulu.
Ndele David ta ti kuSalomo: “Omumwange, ame mwene nda li nda hala okutungila edina lOmwene, Kalunga kange ongulu,

ndelenee ondjovo yOmwene ye uya kwaame tai ti: ‘Ove wa tilashi ohonde ihapu, ndele wa shinga oita inene; ito dulu okutungila edina lange ongulu, shaashi wa tilashi ohonde ihapu kombada yedu koshipala shange.

Tala, to ka dala omona okamati, ye ota ka ninga omulumenhu wombili, ndele Ame ohandi ke mu tulumukifa kovatondadi vaye aveshe keembinga adishe. Osheshi edina laye tali ka ninga Salomo, ndele Ame ohandi etele Israel ombili netulumuko.
Ye ota ka tungila edina lange ongulu, ndele ye ota ka ninga omumwange naame xe. Ndele Ame ohandi ka pameka olukalwapangelo louhamba waye okupangela Ovaisraeli fiyo alushe.’
Paife hano omumwange, Omwene na kale naave, u kale nelao mokutunga ongulu yOmwene Kalunga koye, ngaashi e ku xunganeka.
Omwene ne ku pe omayele neendunge, ne ku ninge omupangeli wOvaisraeli u diinine omhango yOmwene Kalunga koye.
Opo nee to ka kala omunelao ngeenge to diinine shili eenghedimhango nomalombwelo aa Omwene e a lombwela Moses molwOvaisraeli. Kala wa pama u nonyati! Ino tila ndele ino mbadapala!

“Ndele tala, omolwoshilonga shange shidjuu ame nda tuvikilila ongulu yOmwene oitalenti omayovi efele yoshingoldo noitalenti omiliyona imwe yoshisiliveli, noshikushu noshivela tashi nyenge okuyelekwa. Osheshi oyo oihapu unene. Ndele nda ongela yo omiti nomamanya. Naave to dulu okuweda po vali.
Pwoove ope na vali ovalongi vahapu voilonga: ovatatuli vomamanya novahongi vomamanya novomiti, novanongo ve lili nave lili vomoilonga i lili nai lili.
Hano oshingoldo noshisiliveli noshikushu noshivela, oinima ei ihapu kai shii kuyelekwa. Fikama u ka longe, nOmwene na kale naave!”
Ndele David okwa lombwela ovakulunhu aveshe vOvaisraeli va kwafe omona waye Salomo, ndele ta ti:

“Omwene Kalunga keni a kala pamwe nanye, ndele Ye e mu pa etulumuko keembinga adishe. Heeno, Ye okwa yandja meke lange oonakukalamo vomoshilongo, noshilongo sha tulwa mepangelo lOmwene noloshiwana shaye.

Hano paife, omitima deni neemwenyo deni di yukifeni okukonga Omwene Kalunga keni, ndele fikameni mu tunge otembeli yOmwene Kalunga, opo mu ete oshikefa shehangano lOmwene noinima iyapuki yaKalunga mongulu oyo tai ka tungilwa edina lOmwene.”
23: David eshi a kulupa nokwa loloka kombada yedu, okwa ninga omona waye Salomo ohamba yOvaisraeli,
nokwa ongela ovakulunhu aveshe vOvaisraeli novapristeli nOvalevi.
NOvalevi va valwa, okudja kwaava va wanifa omido omilongo nhatu ile ve di koya. Omuvalu wavo komunhu nomunhu wa li ovalumenhu omayovi omilongo nhatu naahetatu.
Omayovi omilongo mbali nomayovi ane vomuvo ve nokupashukila oshilonga shomongulu yOmwene, omayovi ahamano va ninga omalenga novayukifi voilonga.
Novanangeli voivelo omayovi ane, novaimbi omayovi ane, va hambelele Omwene nouxumba, ava ndele va ningila ehambelelo.
Ndele David okwe va tukula eengudu pavana vaLevi: Gerson, Kohat naMerari.
VomOvagerson: Ladan naSimei.
Ovana vaLadan ovava: Omukulunhu Jehiel, naSetam naJoel, vatatu.
Ovana ovamati vaSimei ovava: Selomot naHasiel naHaran, vatatu. Vo ova li ovakulunhu vomepata laLadan.
Novana ovamati vaSimei ovava: Jahat, Sina naJehus naBeria. Hano ovana vaSimei vane.
Ndele Jahat okwa li omukulunhu, ndele Sisa omutivali. Ndelenee Jehus naBeria va li vehe noludalo lihapu, onghee omapata avo a ninga ongudu imwe.
Ovana ovamati vaKohat ovava: Amram, Ishar, Hebron naUsiel, vane.

Ovana ovamati vaAmram ovava: Aron naMoses. Ndele Aron novana vaye ovamati va yapulilwa okuyapula oinima iyapuki fiyo alushe, va twimine koshipala shOmwene, ndele ve mu longele, ndele va nangeke noupuna medina laye fiyo alushe.
Ndele ovana ovamati vaMoses, omulumenhu waKalunga, ova valelwa mepata laLevi.
Ovana ovamati vaMoses va li Gersom naElieser.
Novana ovamati vaGersom: Sebuel, omukulunhu.
Novana ovamati vaElieser ovava: Omukulunhu Rehabja. Ndele Elieser kwa li e novana ovamati vamwe, ndelenee ovana ovamati vaRehabja va hapupala unene.
Omona waIshar: Omukulunhu Selomit.
Ovana ovamati vaHebron ovava: Omukulunhu Jeria, Amarja omutivali, Jahasiel omutitatu naJekameam omutine.
Ovana ovamati vaUsiel ovava: Mika, omukulunhu, naIsshia, omutivali.
Ovana ovamati vaMerari ovava: Mahli naMushi. Novana ovamati vaMahli: Eliaser naKis.
Ndele Eliaser okwa fya ehe novana ovamati, oukadona aveke. Ndele ovana ovamati vaKis, ovakwao vavo, ve va hombola.
Ovana ovamati vaMushi ovava: Mahli naEder naJeremot, vatatu.
Ovo hano Ovalevi pamapata avo, ovakulunhu vomapata, ngaashi va valwa pamuvalo wavo, omunhu nomunhu, ovo va longa oshilonga mongulu yOmwene ve nomido omilongo mbali ile ve di koya.
Osheshi David a tya: “Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael okwa pa oshiwana shaye etulumuko, ndele Ye ota kala muJerusalem fiyo alushe.
Osho ngaha hano Ovalevi inava pumbwa vali ngaashi oshilonga shavo okuhumbata etwali noinima aishe yalo,
(osheshi paendjovo daxuuninwa daDavid, movana ovamati vaLevi mwa valwa ovo ve nomido omilongo mbali ile ve di koya)
ndelenee oshilonga shavo sha li okuyakula oludalo laAron moshilonga shomongulu yOmwene, ngaashi ovapashukili voihale noveendjuwo nokuyelifa oinima aishe iyapuki noilonga yomongulu yaKalunga,
nomingome detaliko noufila wa nakwa womeendjayambo noikuki ya lalakana ihe nonhafi noshipeleki shokuteleka oikuki, neendjayambo da pilulwa noiyelekifo aishe yoiyuma noyoule,
nokukala ofika ongula keshe neenguloshi yo nokuhambelela Omwene noku mu pandula,
nokuyambela Omwene omaxwikiloyambo efimbo alishe koshipala shOmwene momashabata nomohani ipe nopomafimbo oivilo, pamuvalo wayo wa tongwa momalombwelomhango ao.
Osho ngaha hano va li ve nokudiinina oilonga yometwali leongalo noilonga yomotembeli, noilonga oyo oludalo laAron ya li li na mongulu yOmwene.”
24: Novana vaAron yo va li ve neengudu davo. Ovana ovamati vaAron va li: Nadab naAbihu, Eliaser naItamar.
Ndelenee Nadab naAbihu va fya moipafi yaxe, ndele vo va li vehe novana ovamati, onghee hano Eliaser naItamar va yakula moshilonga shoupristeli.
Ndele David pamwe naSadok womovana vaEliaser naAhimelek womovana vaItamar, ove va tukula eengudu pashilonga shavo.

Ndelenee eshi pa monika nokutya, movana ovamati vaEliaser mwa li ovakulunhu vahapu, ve dule ava vomovana ovamati vaItamar, ove va tukula ngaha: ovana ovamati vaEliaser va pewa ovakulunhu omulongo navahamano pamapata ndele ovana ovamati vaItamar vahetatu pamapata avo.
Ndele ve va tukula pashihoololifo, vo ngaashi venya. Osheshi movana vaEliaser ngaashi movana vaItamar mwa li omalenga otembeli nomalenga aKalunga.

Ndele omushangi Shemaia naNetanel womOvalevi okwe va shangela membo moipafi yohamba noyomalenga noyovapristeli Sadok naAhimelek yaAbjatar, noyovakulunhu vomapata ovapristeli vOvalevi. Eumbo limwe la kufwa, mepata laEliaser, nalimwe vali laItamar, pamalufo.
Oshihoololifo shotete sha kwata Jojarib, oshitivali Jedaja,
oshititatu Harim, oshitine Seorim,
oshititano Malkia, noshitihamano Mijamin,
oshitiheyali Hakkos, oshitihetatu Abia,
oshitimugoi Josua, noshitimulongo Sekanja,
oshitimulongo nashimwe Eljasib, oshitimulongo noshitivali Jakim,
oshitimulongo noshititatu Huppa, oshitimulongo noshitine Jesebeab,
oshitimulongo noshititano Bilga, oshitimulongo noshitihamano Immer,
oshitimulongo noshitiheyali Hesir, oshitimulongo noshitihetatu Happisses,
oshitimulongo noshitimugoi Petahja, oshitimilongo mbali Jeheskel,
oshitimilongo mbali nashimwe Jakin, oshitimilongo mbali noshitivali Gamul
oshitimilongo mbali noshititatu Delaja, oshitimilongo mbali noshitine Maasia.
Olo hano eshikulafano lomalufo avo omoilonga yavo, va ye mongulu yOmwene palombwelomhango laxe Aron, ngaashi Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael e mu lombwela.
Moludalo lovakwao vaLevi mwa valelwa movana ovamati vaAmram: Subael. Movana ovamati vaSubael: Jegdeja.
Movana ovamati vaRehabja: Isshia, omukulunhu.
MOvaishari: Selomot. Movana ovamati vaSelomot: Jahat.
Ovana ovamati vaHebron: Jeria wotete, Amarja omutivali, Jahasiel omutitatu, Jekameam omutine.
Ovana ovamati vaUsiel: Mika. Movana vaMika: Samir.
Omumwaina waMika kwa li Isshia. Movana vaIsshia: Sakaria.
Ovana ovamati vaMerari va li Mahli naMushi, novatekulu vomona waye Jaasia.
Ovana vaMerari vomona waye omumati Jaasia va li Soham naSakkur naIbri.
Oludalo laMahli: Eliaser. Ye okwa li ehe novana ovalumenhu.
Omona waKis kwa li Jerahmeel.
Novana vaMushi ovava: Mahli naEder naJerimot. Ovo hano ovana ovamati vOvalevi pamapata avo.
Navo yo va li ngaashi oovakwao vavo oludalo laAron, va umba oshihoololifo moipafi yohamba David naSadok naAhimelek novakulunhu vomapata ovapristeli nOvalevi: omukulunhu wepata ngaashi ondenge yaye.
25: Ndele David novakulunhu vomatanga va tukulila oshilonga ovana ovamati vaAsaf naHeman naJedutun, ovo va shika momhepo younongo ouxumbafeta, neenyalilo, nounghuma, nomuvalu waava va longa oshilonga eshi, oyou:
movana ovamati vaAsaf: Sakkur naJosef naNetanja naAsarela, ovana vaAsaf, kewiliko laAsaf, ou a wilikilwa kohamba ndele a shika momhepo younongo.

MoJedutun, ovana ovamati vaJedutun ovava: Gedalja naSeri naJesaja, Hasabja, Simei naMatitia, vahamano, kewiliko laxe yavo Jedutun, ou a shika ouxumbafeta momhepo younongo, a shikila Omwene ehambelelo nepandulo.
MoHeman, ovana ovamati vaHeman ovava: Bukkia, Mattanja, Usiel, Sebuel naJerimot, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Giddalti naRomanti-Eser, Josbekasa, Malloti, Hotir, Mahasiot.
Vo aveshe va li ovana ovamati vaHeman, omumonikokule wohamba womeendjovo daKalunga. Kalunga e mu pa ovana ovamati omulongo navane noukadona vatatu oku mu pameka.
Vo aveshe va li ovaimbi mewiliko laxe mongulu yOmwene, va li ve nounghuma, ouxumbafeta neenyalilo, moshilonga shomongulu yaKalunga, pawiliko lohamba nolaAsaf nolaJedutun nolaHeman.
Nomuvalu wavo pamwe noovakwao, ovo va longwa okwiimbila Omwene ehambelelo, aveshe ava va li ovanongo, va li omafele avali nomilongo hetatu navahetatu.
Ndele va umbila eshikulafano lomoshilonga, oshihoololifo, ovanyasha novakulunhu, novanongo pamwe novalongwa.
Noshihoololifo shotete sha kwata Asaf, nokutya Josef; oshitivali Gedalja; ye pamwe novamwaina ovalumenhu novana vaye ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali:
oshititatu sha kwata Sakkur; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitine Jisri; ovana vaye novamwaina vaye ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshititano Netanja; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitihamano Bukkia; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitiheyali Jesarela; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitihetatu Jesaja; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimugoi Mattanja; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo Simei; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshotete Asareel; ovana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshitivali Hasabja; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshititatu Subael; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshitine Matitia; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshititano Jeremot; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshitihamano Hanania; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshitiheyali Josbekasa; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshitihetatu Hanani; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimulongo noshitimugoi Malloti; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimilongo mbali Eliata; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimilongo mbali noshotete Hotir; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimilongo mbali noshitivali Giddalti; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali
oshitimilongo mbali noshititatu Mahasiot; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali;
oshitimilongo mbali noshitine Romanti-Eser; novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu va li omulongo navavali.
26: Mokupopya eengudu dovanangeli voivelo mOvakora mwa li Meselemja yaKore, womovana vaAsaf.
Ndele Meselemja kwa li e novana ovamati: Sakaria, oshiveli, Jediael, omutivali, Sebadja, omutitatu, Jatniel, omutine,
Elam omutitano, Johanan, omutihamano, Eljehoenai, omutiheyali.
NaObed-Edom yo kwa li e novana ovamati: Shemaia, oshiveli, Josabad, omutivali, Joah, omutitatu, Sakar, omutine naNetanel, omutitano,
Ammiel, omutihamano, Isaskar omutiheyali, Peulletai omutihetatu, osheshi Kalunga okwe mu nangeka noupuna.
Omona waye omumati Shemaia kwa dalelwa ovana ovamati, ovo va li ovakulunhu momapata avo, osheshi va li ovaladi.
Ovana vaShemaia ovava: Otni naRefael naObed, Elsabad; novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu ovanandjungu: Elihu naSemahja.
Vo aveshe va li vomovana vaObed-Edom, vo novana vavo novamwaina va li ovalumenhu ovanandjungu, ovadiinini vomoilonga. Ovalumenhu omilongo hamano navavali vomuObed-Edom.
Meselemja okwa li e na yo ovana novamwaina ovanandjungu omulongo navahetatu.
Ndele Hosa womovana vaMerari kwa li e novana ovamati: Simri, omukulunhu. Nande ye kakwa li oshiveli, xe e mu tula moukulunhu.
Hilkia okwa li omutivali, Tebalja omutitatu, Sakaria omutine; ovana novamwaina aveshe vaHosa va li omulongo navatatu.
Eengudu odo dovanangeli voivelo, ovakulunhu, ova li ve nokunangela ngaashi ovamwaina vavo ovalumenhu va longe mongulu yOmwene.
Ndele va umbila oshivelo keshe oshihoololifo, omunyasha nomukulunhu, pamapata avo.
Noshihoololifo shokoushilo sha kwata Selemja. Va umbila yo Sakaria, omupukululi omunaendunge oshihoololifo. Noshihoololifo she mu pa osho shoumbangalanhu.
Obed-Edom a pewa osho shokoumbuwanhu. Ndele ovana vaye ovalumenhu va pewa omalimba.
Suppim naHosa va pewa osho shokouninginino poshivelo Salleket pelila tali londo. Onhele yenangelo popepi nonhele yenangelo likwao.
Kombinga yokoushilo pa li Ovalevi vahamano. Koumbangalanhu vane keshe efiku, nokoumbuwanhu vane, ndelenee pomalimba vavali navavali.
PuParbar kouninginino opa li vane melila, navane puParbar.
Odo hano eengudu dovanangeli voivelo movana ovamati Ovakora nomovana ovamati vaMerari.
NOvalevi novamwaina ovalumenhu ava va li ovadiinini vomamona ongulu yaKalunga novomamona eeshali diyapuki, ovava: Ovaahia.
Ovana ovalumenhu vaLadan, oludalo lOvagersom, ovakulunhu vomapata omomaludalo aLadan, Omugerson: Jehieli,
Ovana ovamati vaJehieli: Setam nomumwaina Joel, va diinina omamona ongulu yOmwene.
Mokupopya Ovaamrami, Ovaishari, nOvahebroni, nOvaussiel,
Sebuel yaGersom yaMoses, kwa li elenga lomamona.
Ndele mokupopya ovamwaina, oludalo laElieser, omona waye kwa li Rehabja, nomona waye Jesaja, nomona waye Joram, nomona waye Sikri, nomona waye Selomot.
Selomot tuu ou novamwaina va li ovadiinini vomamona aeshe mayapuki, oo a yapulwa kohamba David nokovakulunhu vomapata nokovaneyovi nokovanefele nokovakulunhu vomatanga ovakwaita.
Yomoixuulwa yomoita ve i yapulila okudiinina ongulu yOmwene,
aishe oyo yo omumonikokule Samuel a yapula, naSaul yaKis, naAbner yaNer, naJoab yaSeruja, nakeshe eshi sha yapulwa, sha diininwa kuSelomot nokovamwaina vaye.
MOvaishari mwa li Kenanja novana vaye ovalumenhu ovapashukili novatokoli vOvaisraeli moinima yopashilongo.
MOvahebroni Hasabja novamwaina ovalumenhu, ovaladi eyovi nomafele aheyali, va li ovapashukili vOvaisraeli kombinga yokouninginino waJordan, moilonga aishe yOmwene nomokulongela ohamba.
Jeria okwa li omukulunhu wOvahebroni (momudo omutimilongo nhee wepangelo laDavid mwa ningwa epanapano mOvahebroni pamaludalo avo, pamapata avo, ndele muvo mwa monika ovaladi muJaeser shomuGilead).

Ohamba David okwa tula po ovamwaina vaJeria, ovalumenhu ovaladi omayovi avali nomafele aheyali, ovakulunhu vomapata, va pangele Ovarubeni nOvagad netata lepata lOvamanasse moilonga aishe yaKalunga nomoilonga aishe yohamba.
27: Ndele ovo hano ovana vaIsrael pamuvalo wavo, ovakulunhu vomapata novaneyovi novanefele novapashukili vavo ava va longela ohamba moinima aishe yomatanga oo a pingafana ohani nohani meehani adishe domomudo. Metanga keshe mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omukulunhu wetanga lotete mohani yotete, kwa li Jasobeam yaSabdiel. Metanga laye mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Oye okwa li womovana ovamati vaPeres, nokwa li omukulunhu wovakulunhu aveshe vomatanga vomohani yotete.
Nomukulunhu wetanga lomohani onhivali okwa li Dodai, Omuahohi. Metanga laye mwa li omukulunhu Miklot. Metanga laye mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omukulunhu omutitatu wetanga, mohani onhinhatu, okwa li Benaja, omona womupristeli omukulunhu Jehoiada. Metanga laye mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Benaja tuu ou okwa li omuladi mokati kaava omilongo nhatu nomukulunhu waava omilongo nhatu. Metanga laye mwa li omona waye Ammisabad.
Omutine womohani onhine okwa li Asahel, omumwaina waJoab, ndele a shikulwa komona waye Sebadja. Metanga laye mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutitano womohani onhinhano okwa li elenga Samhut, Omujisrahi. Metanga laye yo mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutihamano womohani onhihamano kwa li Ira yaIkkes, Omutekoa. Metanga laye mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutiheyali womohani onhiheyali okwa li Heles, Omupeloni womovana vaEfraim. Metanga laye yo mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutihetatu womohani onhihetatu okwa li Sibbegai, Omuhusai womOvasargi. Metanga laye yo mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutimugoi womohani onhimugoi okwa li Abieser, Omuanatot womOvabenjamin. Metanga laye yo mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutimulongo womohani onhimulongo okwa li Maharai, Omunetofa womOvasargi. Metanga laye mwa li yo omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutimulongo nowotete womohani onhimulongo naimwe okwa li Benaja, Omupiratoni womovana vaEfraim. Metanga laye yo mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Omutimulongo nomutivali womohani onhimulongo nonhivali okwa li Heldai, Omunetofa womoludalo laOtniel. Metanga laye yo mwa li omayovi omilongo mbali naane.
Novakulunhu vomapata aIsrael: Elieser yaSikri okwa li omukulunhu wOvarubeni. Sefatja yaMaaka okwa li omukulunhu wOvasimeon.
Hasabja yaKemuel okwa li omukulunhu wOvalevi; Sadok omukulunhu wOvaaron.
Elihu, omumwaina waDavid, okwa li omukulunhu waJuda. Omri yaMikael okwa li omukulunhu waIsaskar.
Jismaja yaObadja okwa li omukulunhu waSebulon. Jeremot yaAsriel okwa li omukulunhu waNaftali.
Hosea yaAsasia okwa li omukulunhu wovana vaEfraim. Joel yaPedaja okwa li omukulunhu wetata lepata laManasse.
Iddo yaSakaria okwa li omukulunhu wetata lepata laManasse muGilead. Jaasiel yaAbner okwa li omukulunhu waBenjamin.
Asareel yaJeroham okwa li omukulunhu waDan. Ovo hano ovakulunhu vomapata aIsrael.
Ndelenee David ina itavela ovo ve nomido omilongo mbali ile inava fika ko, va valwe. Osheshi Omwene okwa tile, nokutya Ye ota ka hapupalifa Ovaisraeli ngaashi eenyofi dokeulu.
Joab yaSeruja okwa hovela okuvala, ndelenee ina wanifa, osheshi omolwaasho Ovaisraeli va hangika kehandu. Onghee hano omuvalu inau shangelwa membo lomafimbo ohamba David.
Nelenga lomamona ohamba la li Asmavet yaAdiel. Ndele Jonatan yaUssia okwa li elenga lomamona omoshilongo, omoilando nomomikunda nomeeshungongulu.
Ndele Esri yaKelub okwa li elenga lovalongi vomomapya.
Simei, Omuramat, okwa li elenga loikokola yomiviinyu. Sabdi, Omusifmi, okwa li elenga lomalimba omaviinyu aa a ongelwa moikokola yomiviinyu.
Ndele Baal-Hanan, Omugeder, okwa li elenga lomalumono nomikwiyu domoixwa medu la lalakana. Ndele Joas okwa li elenga lomalimba lomaadi eemono.
Sitrai, Omusaron, okwa li elenga leengobe odo da lifwa muSaron. Ndelenee Safat yaAdlai okwa li elenga leengobe da li momaluhaela.
Ndele Obil, Omuismael, okwa li elenga leengamelo. Ndele Jegdeja Omumeroni, okwa li elenga leendongi deenghadi.
Jasis, Omuhagri, okwa li elenga leedi. Vo aveshe va li omalenga emona laDavid.
Ndele Jonatan, xekulu yaDavid, okwa li omupukululi. Ye okwa li omulumenhu e nomayele nomunongo womishangwa; ndele Jehiel yaHakmoni okwa li povana ovamati vohamba.
Ndele Ahitofel okwa li omupukululi wohamba. Ndele Husai, Omuarki, okwa li kaume kohamba.
Ndele Ahitofel okwa shikulwa kuJehoiada yaBenaja nokuAbjatar. Joab okwa li ondjai yohamba.
28: Opo nee David a ongela muJerusalem ovakulunhu aveshe vaIsrael, ovakulunhu vomapata, ovakulunhu vomatanga, ava va li moshilonga shohamba, novaneyovi novanefele, novakulunhu vomamona noveengobe novovana vaye pamwe nomalenga omouhamba novaladi nomulumenhu keshe omuladi.

Nohamba David oya kala ofika ndele tai ti: “Ovakwetu, novanhu vange, pwilikinei nge! Ame nda li nda diladila okutungila oshikefa shehangano lOmwene ongulu yetulumuko noshipundi sheemhadi daKalunga ketu, ndele nda kongela etungo oitungifo.
Ndelenee Kalunga okwa lombwela nge: ‘Ove ito tungile edina lange ongulu, osheshi oove omulumenhu wolwoodi, ndele wa tilashi ohonde.’

Ndelenee Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael okwa hoolola nge mepata letu alishe, ndi ninge ohamba yOvaisraeli fiyo alushe. Osheshi a hoolola Juda a ninge omukulunhu ndele mepata laJuda okwa hoolola eumbo letu. Ndele movana ovalumenhu vatate okwa hokwa nge, opo a ninge nge ohamba yOvaisraeli aveshe.
Ndele movana vange ovalumenhu, osheshi Omwene a pa nge ovana vahapu vovamati, okwa hoolola mo Salomo, a kale omutumba kolukalwapangelo louhamba wOmwene okupangela Ovaisraeli aveshe.
Nokwa lombwela nge: ‘Omumwoye Salomo ota ka tunga ongulu yange nomahale ange, osheshi Ame nde mu hoolola, a ninge omumwange ndele Ame ohandi ka kala xe.
Ndele Ame ohandi ka pameka ouhamba waye fiyo alushe, ngeenge ta kala omudiinini mokuwanifa oipango yange, ngaashi nena.’

Hano paife, moipafi yOvaisraeli aveshe noyoshiongalele shOmwene nomomatwi aKalunga ketu: Diinineni ndele kongeni oipango aishe yOmwene, Kalunga keni, opo mu kale moshilongo eshi shiwa novana veni konima yeni fiyo alushe ve shi fyuulule.

Ndele ove, omumwange Salomo, Kalunga kooxo, kala u mu shii, noku mu longela nomutima aushe nomwenyo u nehalo liwa, osheshi Omwene ta panapana omitima adishe nediladilo keshe lomomwenyo ye e li shii. Ove ngeenge to mu kongo, oto ke mu mona. Ndelenee ngeenge to mu liteeka, Ye ote ku ekeleshi fiyo alushe.
Tala hano, Omwene e ku hoolola, u tunge ongulu yotembeli. Kala wa pama, u i xulife.”

Ndele David okwa pa omona waye Salomo oshiyelekifofano shehale lotembeli noshomatungo asho, noshomalimba omamona nosheendjuwo dopombada nosheendjuwo domeni noshondjuwo muyo tamu ka kala oshituviko shekwatakanifo;
noshiyelekifofano shaaishe ya li momadiladilo aye: efano lomahale ongulu yOmwene noleendjuwo adishe tadi i dingilile nomalimba omamona ongulu yaKalunga nomalimba omamona eeshali diyapuki,
nosho yo lomatanga ovapristeli nOvalevi, noilonga aishe yomongulu yOmwene noilongifo aishe yomoilonga yomongulu yOmwene;
noshingoldo pashiyelekifo shoinima yomoshilonga keshe. Noinima aishe yoisiliveli pashiyelekifo shoinima aishe yomoshilonga keshe;

noshingoldo pashiyelekifo shoshikwatelwalamba keshe shoshingoldo neelamba dasho. Nosho yo oshiyelekifo shoshisiliveli shoikwatelwamhadi yeelamba, noshiyelekifo shoshikwatelwamhadi keshe nosholamba keshe pashiyelekifo shoshikwatelwamhadi keshe;
navali oshiyelekifo shoshingoldo shoitaafula yomingome detaliko, noshitaafula keshe, nosho yo shoshisiliveli shoitaafula tai ka ningwa noshisiliveli.
Noshoshiyelekifo shoshingoldo sha yela sheenyala nomatiti nomaholo noshomakopi oingoldo oshiyelekifo shoshingoldo shekopi keshe, noshiyelekifo shoshisiliveli shomakopi, oshiyelekifo shekopi keshe.
Nosho yo oshiyelekifo shoshingoldo sha yela shoaltari yokutwimina, nomafano oweendifotemba, ovakerubi voshingoldo ava ve nokutandavelifa omavava avo nokuuvika oshikefa shehangano lOmwene.
Ashishe eshi shi li momushangwa wa dja meke lOmwene, nokwe shi longa nge pashiyelekifofano.

Ndele David okwa lombwela omona waye Salomo: “Kala wa pama wa nyatipala, ndele shi xulifa. Ino tila, ino mbadapala! Osheshi Omwene Kalunga, Kalunga kange ta ka kala naave. Ye ite ku efa ndele ite ku ekeleshi, fiyo wa xulifa oilonga aishe yongulu yOmwene.

Nomatanga ovapristeli nOvalevi omo e li mongulu yaKalunga, va longe oshilonga keshe. Natango pwoove ope novanongo voilonga i lili nai lili, ve lilongekidila oshilonga keshe. Novakulunhu novanhu aveshe koilonga aishe yoye.”
29: Ohamba David ya lombwela vali oshiongalele ashishe: “Omumwange Salomo, ou a hoololwa kuKalunga, ye omunyasha noke na eshiivo la wana, noshilonga oshinene, ndelenee ouhamba oo kau fi womunhu, ndelenee owOmwene Kalunga.

Onghee hano neenghono dange adishe nda ongelela ongulu yaKalunga oshingoldo shoinima yoingoldo, noshisiliveli shoinima yoisiliveli noshikushu shoinima yoshikushu, noshivela shoinima yoivela, nomiti doinima yoiti. Oumanya vaoniks noumanya tava nyaminwa mo noumanya valaula, noumanya vomavala noumanya ve lili nave lili ve nondilo, nomamanya amarmor mahapu.
Ndele eshi ndi hole ongulu yaKalunga kange, ohandi yandje kongulu yaKalunga oshingoldo noshisiliveli shange mwene, ponho yaaishe oyo nde i tuvikilila ongulu yotembeli, nokutya:
oitalenti omayovi atatu yoshingoldo shomoingoldo yokuOfir, noisiliveli yoitalenti omayovi aheyali ya yelifwa okukolongifa nayo omakuma ongulu;
oshingoldo shoinima yoingoldo noshisiliveli shoinima yoisiliveli noyoinima aishe yomake ovanongo. Ope na tuu ou a hala nena eli nehalo liwa okweetela Omwene eeshali nomake e yadi?”
Opo nee va yandja nehalo liwa ngaha: ovakulunhu vomapata novakulunhu voitukulwalongo yOvaisraeli novaneyovi novanefele nomalenga omoshilonga shohamba,

va yandjela oshilonga shongulu yaKalunga: oshingoldo oitalenti omayovi atano noimaliwa yoidariki omayovi omulongo. Noshisiliveli oitalenti omayovi omulongo, noshikushu oitalenti omayovi omulongo naahetatu. Noshivela oitalenti omayovi efele.
Ndele ou kwa li e nomamanya mawa e nondilo, e a yandja komamona ongulu yOmwene, meke lomupashukili Jehiel, Omugerson.
Novanhu va hafela ehalo liwa lavo, osheshi va yandja kOmwene nomutima aushe nehalo liwa. Nohamba David yoo ya li ya hafa unene.
Ndele David okwa hambelela Omwene moipafi yoshiongalele ashishe, ndele David ta ti: “Oove Omwene Kalunga katate Israel, u hambelelwe alushe fiyo alushe!

Omwene, ounene owoye, neenghonopangelo odoye, noshinge oshoye, nouyelele owoye, nepangelofimano oloye, heeno, aishe yomeulu nokombada yedu oyoye. Oshilongo oshoye Omwene, ndele Oove Omupangeli waaishe!
Oupuna nefimano tali di kwoove, ndele Ove ho pangele ashishe. Ndele meke loye omu neenghono nepangelonghono. Ndele momapangelelo eke loye hamu di enenepeko neyombamo.
Ndele paife, Kalunga ketu, hatu ku hambelele ndele hatu fimaneke edina loye noshinge shalo.

“Osheshi aame omushike, noshiwana shange oshishike, tu dule keenghono detu vene okuyandja eeshali da tya ngaha dehalo liwa? Ndelenee ashishe eshi tashi di kwoove, ndele meke loye twe shi yandja kwoove.
Osheshi fye ovanailongo nomapongo koshipala shoye ngaashi ootate. Omafiku etu okombada yedu e li ngaashi omudidimbe, ndele pehe na sha, tu tule mo elineekelo letu.
Omwene Kalunga ketu, oupuna aushe ou twe u ongela, tu tungile edina loye liyapuki ongulu, otau di meke loye, naaushe oo owoye.

Kalunga kange, ame ndi shi shii, Ove ho panapana omutima, ndele wa hokwa ouyuki. Nomwenyo wa yuka nda yandja oinima aishe ei nehalo liwa. Ndele paife nda tala nehafo nhumbi ovanhu voye, ava ve li po, va yandja kwoove nehalo liwa.
Omwene, Kalunga kootate Abraham, Isak naIsrael, diinina fiyo alushe ehalo la tya ngaha lomadiladilo omitima dovanhu voye ndele omitima di yukifa kwoove,
ndele pa omumwange Salomo omutima umwe a diinine oipango yoye neendobwedi doye neenghedimhango doye, opo a ninge ashishe nokutunga ouhamba oo nde u longekida.”

Opo nee David a lombwela oshiongalele ashishe: “Paife hambeleleni Omwene, Kalunga keni.” Opo nee oshiongalele ashishe sha hambelela Omwene, Kalunga kooxe. Ndele ve linyongamena ndele tava wile eombe koshipala shOmwene nokoshipala shohamba.

Ndele efiku la shikula vo ova yambela Omwene omatomenoyambo ndele va etela Omwene omaxwikiloyambo: eengobe deemhedi eyovi limwe, eedi deemhedi eyovi limwe, oudjona eyovi limwe, pamwe noikunwayambo yao, nomatomenoyambo mahapu molwOvaisraeli aveshe.

Ndele mefiku tuu olo va lya ndele va nwa nehafo linene koshipala shOmwene, ndele va ninga Salomo yaDavid lutivali ohamba, ndele ve mu vaekela Omwene ngaashi ohamba, ndele va vaeka Sadok a ninge omupristeli.
Osho ngaha hano Salomo a kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo lOmwene ngaashi ohamba ponhele yaxe David. Nokwa li e nelao. NOvaisraeli aveshe va dulika kuye.
Novakulunhu aveshe novaladi novana voovene vaDavid ve litula mepangelo lohamba Salomo.
NOmwene okwa nenepeka unene Salomo moipafi yOvaisraeli aveshe ndele Ye e mu pa epangelofimano lo inali kala ko kohamba nande imwe yOvaisraeli ye mu tetekela.
Osho ngaha hano David yaIsai okwa li ohamba yOvaisraeli aveshe.
Nomafiku oo David a pangela Israel a li omido omilongo nhee. Okwa pangela muHebron omido heyali, nomuJerusalem omido omilongo nhatu nanhatu.
Nokwa fya moukulupe mouwa, a loloka okukala kombada yedu, e yadi oupuna nefimano, nomona waye Salomo a ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
Noinima oyo tai hepaulula David, inya yotete nayo yaxuuninwa, tala, ya shangelwa membo lomahepaululo lomumonikokule Samuel, nomembo lomahepaululo lomuxunganeki Natan nomembo lomumonikokule Gad,
pamwe noinima youhamba waye aushe noilonga yaye youladi nomafimbo Ovaisraeli naa oilongo aishe.

1: Ndele Salomo yaDavid okwa pama mouhamba waye. NOmwene Kalunga kaye okwa li pamwe naye nokwe mu nenepeka unene.
Ndele Salomo okwa kundafana nOvaisraeli aveshe, novaneyovi novanefele novatokoli nonomukulunhu keshe womuIsrael, ovakulunhu vomapata.
Ndele Salomo noshiongalele ashishe pamwe naye va ya koshikulundu shokuyambela shomuGibeon. Osheshi oko kwa li etwali laKalunga, olo la dikwa mombuwa kuMoses, omupiya wOmwene.
Ndelenee David okwa li a kufa oshikefa shaKalunga muKiriat-Jearim nokwe shi eta monhele oyo David e i shi longekidila. Osheshi David e shi longekidila etwali muJerusalem.
Noaltari yoshikushu yo osho sha ningwa kuBesaleel yaUri yaHur, osha li komesho yetwali lOmwene. Ndele Salomo noshiongalele ve ke shi konga.
Ndele Salomo okwa yamba koaltari yoshikushu shetwali leongalo koshipala shOmwene nokwa yambela ko omaxwikiloyambo eyovi limwe.
Oufiku tuu ou Kalunga okwe lihololela Salomo ndele ta ti kuye: “Indile nge eshi we shi hala Ame ndi shi ku pe.”
Ndele Salomo okwa nyamukula Kalunga: “Ove wa fila tate David onghenda inene ndele wa ninga nge ohamba ponhele yaye.
Omwene Kalunga, ondjovo yoye we i lombwela tate David paife nai ninge yoshili. Osheshi wa ninga nge ohamba yovanhu vahapu ngaashi ondwi yedu.
Pe nge hano paife ounongo nomayele opo ndi dule okufikama nokwaaluka komesho yoshiwana eshi. Osheshi olyelye ta dulu okupangela oshiwana eshi shinene?”

Opo nee Kalunga ta ti kuSalomo: “Shaashi ove u nomutima wa tya ngaha, ndele ino indila oupuna, omamona nefimano neemwenyo dovatondadi voye ile u mone omwenyo mule, ndelenee we liindilila ounongo nomayele, u dule okupangela oshiwana shange, musho Ame nde ku ninga ohamba,
onghee hano ove to ka pewa ounongo nomayele. Ame ohandi ke ku pa yo oupuna nomamona nefimano, eehamba odo de ku tetekela inadi kala nao, naado tadi ku shikula itadi ka kala nao.”
Ndele Salomo okwa dja koshikulundu shomuGibeon, ketwali leongalo, nokwe uya kuJerusalem, ndele ta pangele Ovaisraeli.

Ndele Salomo okwa ongela omatemba oita novalondi veenghambe, onghee okwa li e nomatemba oita eyovi nomafele ane novalondi veenghambe omayovi omulongo naavali. Okwe va nangeka muJerusalem nomoilando ikwao.
Nohamba osho ya ninga nokutya, muJerusalem mwa li oshisiliveli noshingoldo nomamanya nomiti domisederi dihapu, ngaashi omikwiyu domedu la lalakana.
Ovakalelipo vaSalomo va pashukila euyemo leenghambe okudja kuMusri nokuKuve
nolomatemba oita okudja kuEgipiti. Vo ova landifa eenghambe nomatemba oita keehamba dOvaheti nodOvaarami eesekeli doshisiliveli omafele ahamano metemba nefele nomilongo nhano monghambe.
2: Ndele Salomo okwe liudanekela okutungila edina lOmwene otembeli, nongulu youhamba.
Ndele Salomo okwa vala ovahumbati omayovi omilongo heyali, novatatuli vomamanya omayovi omilongo hetatu vokeemhunda novapashukili vavo omayovi atatu nomafele ahamano.
Opo nee Salomo a shiivifila Hiram, ohamba yaTirus, ta ti: “Ngaashi wa ningila tate David, eshi we mu tumina omisederi, ye e litungile ongulu yokukala mo, shi ningile nge yo.

Tala, ame ohandi hovele okutungila edina lOmwene, Kalunga kange ongulu, ndi i mu yapulile, opo muyo mu twiminwe koshipala shaye oidimba iwa, nomingome detaliko di kale mo alushe nomaxwikiloyambo a yambwe ongula nonguloshi nomomashabata nopeehani dipe nopomafimbo oivilo yOmwene Kalunga ketu, osho oshinakuwanifwalonga shaalushe shOvaisraeli.
Nongulu oyo ame handi ka tunga otai ka ninga inene, osheshi Kalunga ketu Ye omunene, e dule oikalunga aishe.

Ndelenee olyelye ta dulu oku mu tungila ongulu? Osheshi omaulu, heeno, eulu lopombadambada tali nyengwa oku mu kwatela mo. Aame omushike hano? Ndi dule oku mu tungila ongulu, okuyamba ashike omayambo koshipala shaye.

Tumine nge hano omulumenhu omunongo e shii kulonga oshingoldo noshisiliveli noshikushu noshivela, noilonga yeengodi dapurpuri noditilyana ngaashi ohonde nodomavala, ndele e nounongo okunyola omafano pamwe novanongo ve li pwaame muJuda nomuJerusalem, ovo tate David e va konga.
Tumine nge omiti domisederi nodomisipresi nodomisandeli dokuLibanon, osheshi ndi shi shii, ovapiya voye ve shii kuka omiti domuLibanon. Ndele tala, ovapiya vange tava ka kala pamwe novapiya voye,
nokutya, va kele nge omiti dihapu, osheshi ongulu oyo handi ke i tunga tai ka ninga inene ndele tai kumwifa.

Ndele tala, ngaashi eendja, ame ohandi yandje kovapiya voye oonakuka omiti, oilyavala eetona omayovi avali, nomahangu eetona omayovi avali, nomaviinyu eelita omayovi omafele ane, nomaadi eelita omayovi omafele ane.”
Ndele Hiram, ohamba yaTirus, okwa tonga monhumwafo oyo e i tumina Salomo: “Omwene eshi e hole oshiwana shaye, Ye e ku ninga ohamba yasho.”

Hiram okwa tya vali: “Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, ou a ninga eulu nedu, na hambelelwe, eshi a yandja kohamba David omona omulumenhu omunongo, ou e nomayele neendunge a tungile Omwene otembeli ndele a tungile ouhamba waye ongulu.
Ame ohandi tumu hano paife omunongo e neendunge, nokutya Huram Abi,

ye omona womwalikadi womovana oukadona vomuDan, ndelenee xe omulumenhu Omutirus, ou a shiiva okulonga oshingoldo noshisiliveli noshikushu noshivela nomamanya nomiti neengodi dapurpuri nodomavala noliina iwa neengodi ditilyana ngaashi ohonde. Nokunyola omafano e lili nae lili nokudiladila oilonga younongo, oyo e i pewa e i longe, pamwe novanongo voye novanongo vomwene wange, xo David.
Omwene wange na tume hano paife kovapiya vaye oilyavala nomahangu nomaadi nomaviinyu.
Ndele fye ohatu ka ka omiti domuLibanon di fike pwaado we di pumbwa, ndele fye ohatu di eta kuJoppa tadi ende mefuta oshipandi. Opo nee ove to dulu oku di twala kuJerusalem.”
Ndele Salomo okwa vala ovanailongo aveshe, ovo va li moshilongo shOvaisraeli pamuvalo wavo wa ningwa kuxe David, ndele vo va li omayovi efele nomilongo nhano naatatu nomafele ahamano.

Okwa ninga omayovi omilongo heyali vomuvo ovahumbati ndele omayovi omilongo hetatu va ninga ovatatuli vomamanya okeemhunda, na omayovi atatu nomafele ahamano ovalongifi ovo va li ve nokulongifa ovanhu.
3: Ndele Salomo okwa hovela okutunga ongulu yOmwene muJerusalem komhunda yaMoria, oko Ye e lihololela xe David, monhele ya longekidwa kuDavid, yomoshipale shOmujebusi Ornan.
Nokwa hovela okutunga mohani onhivali mefiku etivali momudo omutine wepangelo laye.
Ekanghameno eli Salomo okwa tungila ko etungo longulu yaKalunga: Oule, eemeta opashiyelekifo shikulu, eemeta 60, nounene eemeta omilongo mbali.
Nehale lokufikila: ola li li fike pomutamo wotembeli, eemeta omugoi; nomutumbo weemeta omilongo nhano nanhee. Ndele meni okwe li xwa oshingoldoelela.
Nolupale linene okwe li vaeka oipilangi yomisipresi nokwe li xwa oshingoldoelela shiwa nokwe li wapeka nomilunga nomalyenge.
Nokwa wapeka vali ongulu nomamanya mawa e nondilo, noshingoldo sha li oshingoldo shokuParvaim.
Nokwa xwa olupale nomitengi donduda nominghulo doposhi noshingoldo, nokwa vaeka ovakerubi momakuma.
Nokwa ninga vali olupale louyapukielela. Oule walo wa li u fike pounene wongulu, eemeta omilongo mbali. Nokwe li xwa noshingoldo shiwa shoitalenti omafele ahamano.
Noudjuu weembosha doshingoldo wa li eesekeli omilongo nhano. Neendjuwo dopombada okwe di xwa noshingoldo.
Nokwa ningila molupale louyapukielela ovakerubi vavali, oshilonga shounongo nokwe va xwa oshingoldo.
Nomavava ovakerubi: oule wavo wa li eemeta omilongo mbali. Evava leemeta nhano laumwe ola kuma kekuma lolupale, fimbo evava likwao leemeta nhano ola kuma kevava lomukerubi mukwao.
Evava lomukerubi mukwao, li fike keemeta nhano, la kuma kekuma lolupale. Nevava likwao, li fike keemeta nhano, ola kuma kevava lomukerubi mukwao.
Ovakerubi ava va tandavelifa omavava avo eemeta omilongo mbali. Ndele va kala ofika keemhadi davo, oipala yavo ya tala meni lolupale.
Nelapi la tukula okwe li ninga neengodi domaludi dapurpuri noditilyana ngaashi ohonde noshiyata shiwa sholiina nokwa fanekela mo ovakerubi.
Nokwa ninga vali eengudi mbali komesho yongulu. Oule wado wopombada eemeta omilongo nhatu nanhano pamwe noitenhekwa ya li komitwe dado, oule wopombada eemeta nhano.
Nokwa ninga yo omalyenge ngaashi oshidingo nokwe a tula keexulo deengudi. Nokwa ninga vali eegranati efele limwe nokwe di kwatakanifa nomalyenge.
Neengudi okwe di dika komesho yotembeli, imwe koumbuwanhu naikwao koumbangalanhu: ndele oyo yokoumbuwanhu okwe i luka Jakin, naayo yokoumbangalanhu Boas.
4: Nokwa ninga vali oaltari yoshikushu: oule wayo eemeta omugoi nounene wayo eemeta omugoi, noule wayo wopombada eemeta nhee netata.

Nokwa ninga yo efuta la folomwa. Komunghulo umwe nokomunghulo mukwao la yeleka eemeta nhee netata la li ngaashi oluvalakuulu. Noule walo wopombada wa li eemeta mbali nomoluputa la yelekwa nongodi yeemeta omulongo nanhatu.
Koshi yomunghulo walo okwa dingililifwa omatanga: omatanga omulongo mometa imwe. Omaulenga aa okwa li momikweyo mbali a dingilila efuta, a telekwa kumwe nefuta monhelekelo nokwa li molupe leemhedi.

Lo ola li la dikwa kombada yeengobe omulongo nambali: nhatu da taalela koumbangalanhu, nanhatu da taalela kouninginino, nanhatu da taalela koumbuwanhu, nanhatu da taalela koushilo, fimbo etemba la li kombada yado. Omakalo ado okwa ama meni.
Nounene weemhati dalo wa li u fike peke, nomunghulo walo wa ningwa wa fa odo depeta ngaashi onhemo yomado. Lo ola kwatelela mo eelita di dule omayovi omilongo hamano.
Nokwa ninga eembalisha omulongo dokulikoshela nokwa tula nhano koumbuwanhu nanhano koumbangalanhu. Oinima yomaxwikiloyambo va li ve noku i kosha mo, ndelenee efuta la li po ovapristeli ve likoshe mo.
Nokwa ninga oikwatelwashela omulongo yoingoldo, papukululo layo, ndele yo oya tulwa motembeli, itano koumbuwanhu naitano koumbangalanhu.
Nokwa ninga yo oitaafula omulongo ndele e i tula motembeli, itano koumbuwanhu naitano koumbangalanhu. Nokwa ninga oiyaxa efele limwe yoshingoldo.
Nokwa ninga vali olupale lovapristeli nolupale lakula noivelo yolupale. Nomapeta okwe a nateka noshikushu.
Nefuta okwe li tula kombinga youmbuwanhu la taalela oumbuwanhuushilo.
Huram okwa ninga vali eembiya, oixupulo noiyaxa. Osho ngaha hano Huram a wanifa oshilonga osho ye kwa li e noku shi ningila ohamba Salomo mongulu yaKalunga:
Eengudi mbali noipakululu ivali ya tenhekwa keexulo deengudi. Neendjadja mbali da dingilila oipakululu;
neegranati omafele ane da dingilila oipakululu: momikweyo mbali kukeshe shimwe.
Nokwa ninga oweendifotemba veembalisha neembalisha di li moweendifotemba;
nefuta limwe neengobe omulongo nambali koshi yalo;
neembiya noixupulo neenyala noinima aishe tai longifwa mongulu, Huram Abi okwa ningila ohamba Salomo i longifwe mongulu yOmwene, e i ninga oshikushu sha pundjwa nawa.
Moluhaela laJordan, omo mwa li edu lihapu, pokati kaSukkot naSareta, ohamba ye i folomifa moshifolomo shedu.
Ndele Salomo okwa ninga oinima aishe oyo ihapu unene, ndele oyo yoshikushu oya li ihapu ihe shii okuvalwa.
Ndele Salomo okwa hambulifa moshingoldo oiyakulifo yomotembeli: oaltari, noitaafula yokutenheka omingome deyambo kuKalunga,
noikwatelwalamba neelamba dayo, da li hadi temwa panghedi ya ufwa, komesho yOuyapukielela,
neenhemo neelamba neenghwato dayo,
noipwipwiko noiyaxa nouyaxa voitwiminifo noikwatelwa yomakala nomakandula omivelo dOuyapukielela nomivelo dopondje yotembeli. Aishe ei oya li yoshingoldoelela.
5: Ndele ohamba Salomo eshi ya mana oilonga aishe yotembeli, oya tuvikila momalimba otembeli oinima aishe oyo xe David a yapulila Omwene: oisiliveli noingoldo, noinima ikwao.
Ndele Salomo okwa ifana muJerusalem ovawiliki vOvaisraeli novakulunhu aveshe vomapata aIsrael, va kufe oshikefa shehangano lOmwene moshilando shaDavid, Sion, ve shi twale motembeli.
Novalumenhu aveshe Ovaisraeli va ongala koshivilo pohamba mohani onhiheyali.
Ovawiliki aveshe vaIsrael eshi va ongala muJerusalem, Ovalevi va tumba Oshikefa Shehangano.
Ndele va eta Oshikefa shOmwene motembeli; Ovapristeli nOvalevi va twala yo Etwali Leongalo noinima aishe iyapuki, ei ya li mo, motembeli.
Ohamba Salomo noshiongalele ashishe shOvaisraeli osho sha ongala pOshikefa, va kala ofika komesho yasho; ova yamba eedi neengobe dihapu unene, da nyengana okutengenekwa.
Ovapristeli va twala yo Oshikefa Shehangano lOmwene monhele yasho molupale lomeni longulu, mOuyapukielela, koshi yomavava ovakerubi.
Ovakerubi ova tandavelifa omavava kombada yonhele yoshikefa, onghee hano ovakerubi va uvika oshikefa nomitengi dasho kombada.
Nomitengi da li dile, eenhele dado di wetikile komesho yOuyapukielela, ndele hapamwe peli li. Ndele omo di li fiyo onena eli.
Moshikefa inamu kala sha shimwe, oipelende yomamanya ivali aike, oyo ya tulwa mo kuMoses pomhunda yaHoreb, Omwene eshi a ninga ehangano novana vaIsrael, eshi va dja medu laEgipiti.
Novapristeli eshi va dja mo motembeli, osheshi ovapristeli aveshe ava va li po ove liyapula, naavo yo vaha li molufo,

fimbo ovaimbi Ovalevi aveshe kumwe, Asaf, Heman naJedutun, pamwe novana vavo ovalumenhu novamwaina ovalumenhu, va li va djala oikutu yoliina, ve nomanghuma nouxumbafeta neenyalilo, va kala ofika koushilo woaltari, ndele pamwe navo ovapristeli efele nomilongo mbali, va shika omanghuma oivela,

novashiki vomanghuma oivela novaimbi aveshe kumwe va hovela nondaka imwe okuhambelela nokupandula Omwene, ndele opo vo eshi va yelula ondaka pamwe nomanghuma oivela nomanghuma eembinga noishikomwa, va imba: “Hambeleleni Omwene, osheshi Ye omuwa, osheshi ouwanghenda waye tau kala fiyo alushe!” Ongulu, nokutya ongulu yOmwene ya yadifwa oshilemo.
Novapristeli va nyengwa okukala ofika nokuwanifa oshilonga shavo omolwoshilemo, osheshi oshinge shOmwene sha yadifa ongulu yaKalunga.
6:
Opo nee Salomo ta ti:
“Omwene okwa tile a hala okukala momulaulu,

ndelenee ame nde ku tungila ongulu yokukala mo,
nonhele omo u kale fiyo alushe.”
Ovaisraeli aveshe ova li ofika, nohamba ya taalela kuvo ndele tai va indilile enangeko noupuna kuKalunga.
Ndele oya tya: “Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael na hambelelwe, omake aye a wanifa osho a udanekela tate David eshi a tile:

‘Okudja efiku linya Ame nda pitifa mo medu laEgipiti oshiwana shange, inandi hoolola nande oshilando shimwe medu laIsrael ndi tungilwe mo otembeli omo ndi na okufimanekelwa, ile ndi hoolole nande oumwe a wilike oshiwana shange shOvaisraeli.
Ndelenee nda hoolola Jerusalem, edina lange li kale mo, ndele nda hoolola David, a pangele ovanhu vange Ovaisraeli.’
Hano tate David eshi a diladila momutima waye okutungila edina lOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael, ongulu,
ndelenee Omwene okwa lombwela tate David: ‘Ove wa ninga nawa, eshi wa diladila momutima woye u tungile edina lange ongulu.
Ndelenee haave to ka tunga ongulu, ndelenee omona woye, ou ta di momatundji oye, ye ota ka tungila edina lange ongulu.’
NOmwene okwa wanifa ondjovo yaye e i popya. Onghee hano nde uya ponhele yatate David, ndele handi kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo lOvaisraeli. Ndele nda tungila edina lOmwene, Kalunga kaIsrael ongulu,
ndele nda tula motembeli Oshikefa Shehangano, omo mu nehangano lOmwene, e li ninga noshiwana shaIsrael.”
Opo nee Salomo a ya ndele ta kala ofika komesho yoaltari yOmwene ta taalele oshiongalele ashishe shOvaisraeli ndele ta yelula omake aye.

Osheshi Salomo a ninga oshipundi shoshikushu shokukala ofika nokwe shi tula pokati kolupale. Oule washo eemeta nhano, nounene washo omaludimbo atano, noule wopombada oludimbo limwe. Ndele oko a londa ta kala ofika ndele ta tu eengolo, a taalela oshiongalele ashishe shOvaisraeli nokwa yelula omake aye keulu
ndele ta ti: “Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael, meulu nokombada yedu alishe kaku na ou e ku fa, ou to diinine ehangano loye nouwanghenda woye kovapiya voye ovo hava ende koshipala shoye nomutima wavo aushe,
ou wa wanifa osho we shi udanekela omupiya woye, tate David; nena ondjovo keshe oya wanifwa.

Wanifa yo, Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, omaudaneko makwao aa wa udanekela tate David, nokutya: ‘Itapu ka pumbulukwa ohamba moludalo loye, oyo tai pangele Ovaisraeli, ngeenge tava diinine ondjila yange nokweenda momhango yange ngaashi ove wa enda koshipala shange.’
Hano paife nee, Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, ondjovo oyo we i lombwela omupiya woye tate David, nai ninge yoshili.
“Ndelenee Kalunga, oto dulu ngaho shili okukala kedu mokati kovanhu? Eshi neulu loovene itali ku wanene okukala mo, hano oto wana ngahelipi motembeli ei nda tunga?
Omwene Kalunga, ame omupiya woye; pwilikina eilikano lange, u pe nge osho handi ku pula.
Omutenya noufiku omesho oye naa pashukile ongulu ei, onhele ei we i hoolola okufimanekelwa mo. Ude nge ngeenge handi taalele otembeli nokwiilikana.
Uda hano omailikano ange nomailikano ovanhu voye ngeenge tava taalele onhele ei nokwiilikana. Heeno, meumbo loye meulu tu uda u tu dimine po.
“Ngeenge pe na ou ta nyono kumukwao, ndele ye ta etwa poaltari yoye motembeli a yandje eano laye, nokutya ina nyona sha,
Omwene, mu uda hano meulu, u tokole omupiya woye. Handukila ou e na okuhandukilwa, ove u mangulule ou ehe na etimba.
“Ndele ovanhu voye Ovaisraeli, ngeenge tava tewa kovatondadi, shaashi va nyona kwoove, ndele tave lialuluka ndele tave lihepaulula melininipiko nokupula ediminepo,
va uda hano meulu, ndele dima po okunyona kwovanhu voye Ovaisraeli ndele va alulila medu eli, ove we li va pa nooxe.
“Eulu ngeenge to li idile, nodula itai loko, shaashi ovanhu voye va nyona kwoove, opo nee ngeenge tave lialuluka ndele tava taalele kotembeli ei, nokwiilikana melininipiko,
va uda meulu u dime po omatimba ovapiya voye ovanhu voye Ovaisraeli, Ove u va longe eshi sha yuka, ndele Omwene, tuma odula koshilongo eshi shoye we shi pa ovanhu voye va kale mo alushelushe.

“Ngeenge ondjala i li moshilongo, ngeenge oudu wolutapo, koshikukuta ile onhimba ile okahaudjololo ile oshipaxu, ile ngeenge ovanhu va ponokelwa kovatondadi, ile ngeenge ope na oudu ile omukifi mokati kavo,
Ngeenge mefimbo olo pena umwe womOvaisraeli ou a fya oluhodi nota yelula omake aye kotembeli nokwiilikana,
uda eilikano laye. Va pwilikina meumbo loye lomeulu; va dimina po, Ove auke wa shiiva omadiladilo momitima dovanhu. Ningila keshe umwe ngaashi e lilongela,
opo ve ku tile, efimbo alishe eli tava kala medu eli we va pa nooxe.

“Heeno, nomunailongo yo, ke fi womoshiwana shoye shOvaisraeli, ta di moshilongo shokokule omolwedina loye linene, omolweke loye li neenghono, omolwokwooko kwoye kwa yeluka, ye ngeenge te uya ndele ta ilikana nokutaalela ongulu ei,

mu uda hano meulu, monhele yokukala kwoye, u ninge ashishe osho omunailongo te shi ku indile, opo oiwana aishe younyuni i shiive edina loye noku ku tila ngaashi oshiwana shoye shOvaisraeli, ndele va shiive nokutya, ongulu ei ame nde i tunga ya tambulwa medina loye.
“Ovanhu voye ngeenge to va tumu moita okulwifa ovatondadi vavo, ndele tave ku indile keshe opo ve li, va taalela koshilando eshi wa hoolola, nokotembeli ei nde ku tungila,
pwilikina omailikano avo. Va uda meulu nou va pe efindano.
“Vo eshi tava nyono kwoove, osheshi kape nomunhu ou ita nyono, ndele to va handukile ndele to va yandje kovatondadi vavo nde tave va twala eenghwate koshilongo nande oshokokule,

pwilikina omaindilo ovanhu voye. Moshilongo shoukwatwa, ngeenge tave lialuluka, ndele tave ku indile nokuhepaulula tava ti: ‘Fye twa nyona, fye twa ninga osho inashi yuka, ndele twa li tuhe na Kalunga,’

ndele ngeenge tava aluka kwoove nomutima aushe nomwenyo aushe moshilongo shoukwatwa wavo, ndele vo otava ilikana nokutaalela koshilongo osho we shi pa ooxe nokoshilando osho we shi hoolola nokotembeli ei nde ku tungila,
uda hano meulu, monhele yokukala kwoye, eindilo lavo nomailikano avo, ndele va pa ounongo ndele dimina po ovanhu voye osho ve shi nyona kwoove.
Kalunga kange, omesho oye naa pashukile eilikano lomonhele ei nomatwi oye naa pwilikine eilikano lomonhele ei.
Ndele paife: Omwene Kalunga, fikama u uye monhele yoye yetulumuko, Ove noshikefa sheenghono doye! Ovapristeli voye, Omwene Kalunga, nava kale va djalekwa exupifo, novayuki voye nava hafele ouwa woye.
Omwene Kalunga, ino ekelashi omuvaekwa woye! Dimbulukwa omaudaneko onghenda we a pa omupiya woye David.”
7: Ndele Salomo eshi a xulifa eilikano laye, omundilo wokeulu wa wila poshi, ndele wa lungwinifa exwikiloyambo nomatomenoyambo. Noshinge shOmwene osha yada otembeli;
novapristeli va nyengwa okuya mo mongulu yOmwene, osheshi oshinge shOmwene sha yada ongulu yOmwene.

Novana aveshe vaIsrael eshi va mona nhumbi omundilo noshinge shOmwene sha wila motembeli vo ova twa eengolo ve linyongamena oipala yavo poshi molupale lomamanya, ndele va ilikana nokupandula Omwene. Shaashi Ye omuwa nouwanghenda waye tau kalelele fiyo alushe.
Nohamba Salomo novanhu aveshe va yamba omayambo kOmwene.
Oya yamba omayambo eengobe omayovi omilongo mbali naavali needi omayovi efele nomilongo mbali. Nohamba novanhu aveshe va yapula ongulu yaKalunga

fimbo ovapristeli va kala ofika meenhele davo nOvalevi yo noishikomwa yOmwene oyo ya ningwa kohamba David okuhambelela Omwene nomaimbilohambelelo aDavid nokutya ouwanghenda waye tau kalelele fiyo alushe. Ovapristeli va kala ofika ve va taalela ndele va shika omanghuma oshikushu, nOvaisraeli aveshe va kala ofika.

Ndele Salomo okwa yapula endiki olo la li komesho yotembeli yOmwene. Noko a yambela omaxwikiloyambo, nomakaadi omahanganifoyambo, shaashi oaltari yoshikushu kaya li ya wana okutulwa omaxwikiloyambo aeshe aa.
Osho ngaha hano Salomo okwa dana oshivilo mefimbo tuu linya, omafiku aheyali, nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye, oshiongalele shinene, okudja komhito yokuya kuHamat fiyo okokamulonga kaEgipiti.
Ndele mefiku etihetatu vo va dana oshivilo, osheshi eyapulo loaltari ve li dana omafiku aheyali noshivilo omafiku aheyali.
Ndele mefiku etimilongo mbali netitatu mohani onhiheyali okwa lekela ovanhu va ye komatwali avo. Va hafa nokushambukwa komwenyo omolwoinima iwa Omwene a ningila David naSalomo noshiwana shaye Israel.
Ndele Salomo eshi a xulifa ongulu yOmwene nongulu yohamba, naaishe Salomo e i diladila momutima waye oku i longa mongulu yOmwene nomongulu yaye, e i wanifa nawa,
Omwene okwe lihololela Salomo oufiku ndele ta ti kuye: “Ame nda uda eindilo loye, nonhele ei Ame nde i hoolola i ninge ongulu yokuyambela mo.
Ame ngeenge handi idile eulu, odula itai loko, ile Ame ngeenge handi lombwele oshipaxu shi lye po oshilongo ile ngeenge handi tumu oudu u nolutapo movanhu vange,

ndele ovanhu vange, ava va lukilwa edina lange, otave lininipike ndele tava indile ndele tava kongo oshipala shange ndele tave lialuluka keendjila davo dii, Ame ohandi ka uda meulu nokudima po omatimba avo nokuvelula oshilongo shavo.
Paife omesho ange taa ka pashukila onhele ei nomatwi ange taa pwilikine eilikano lomonhele ei.
Osho ngaha ongulu ei nde i hoolola noku i yapula, edina lange opo li kale mo fiyo alushe, nomesho ange nomutima wange tau ka kala mo alushe.
Ndele ove ngeenge ho ende koshipala shange ngaashi xo David a enda, ndele to ningi aishe oyo nde ku lombwela ndele to diinine eenghedimhango dange nomalombwelo ange,
opo nee Ame ohandi ka pameka olukalwapangelo loye, ngaashi nda udanekela xo David, eshi nda tile: ‘Ove ito ka pumbwa nande omulumenhu ou ta pangele Ovaisraeli.’
Ndelenee ngeenge tamu liteeka nge ndele itamu diinine oipango neenghedimhango odo nde i mu pa, ndele tamu fimaneke oikalunga noku i linyongamena,

opo nee Ame ohandi ke va duda mo moshilongo shange eshi nde shi va pa, nongulu ei nde i yapulila edina lange, Ame ohandi ke i ekelashi koshipala shange, ndele handi i ningi oshitevo neimbilo lesheko mokati koiwana aishe.
Nopongulu tuu ei ya li ya tumbala, keshe umwe ta ende po, ota ka tumhauka omaxwilili ndele ta pula: ‘Omolwashike Omwene a ningila oshilongo eshi nongulu ei ngaha?’

Opo nee ovanhu tava ka nyamukula: ‘Omolwaashi ve liteeka Omwene, Kalunga kooxe, ou e va pitifa mo medu laEgipiti, ndele va ama koikalunga imwe noku i linyongamena, onghee hano Omwene okwe va tumina omupya ou.’ ”
8: Pexulilo lomido omilongo mbali omo Salomo a tunga otembeli yOmwene nongulu yaye mwene,
okwa tungulula oilando e i pewa kuHiram, nokwa nangeka mo ovana vaIsrael.
Konima yoinima oyo, Salomo okwa ya kuHamat-Soba nokwe shi nangala.
Nokwa tunga Tadmor shomombuwa, noituvikilwalando aishe oyo e i tunga muHamat.
Okwa tunga vali Bet-Horon shokombada naBet-Horon shoposhi ngaashi oilando i nohotekuma noivelo noiidilifo.

Nosho yo Baalat noituvikilolando aishe yaSalomo, noilando yomatemba oita noyovalondi veenghambe neenhele adishe dikwao Salomo okwa pondola oku i tunga muJerusalem nomuLibanon nomoshilongo ashishe shomepangelo laye.
Novanhu aveshe ovo vehe fi Ovaisraeli, ovo va xupa po mOvaamori nomOvaheti nomOvaperesi nomOvahevi nomOvajebusi;
movana vavo, ovo va xupa po moshilongo, ovo inava dipawa kovana vaIsrael, ovo tuu ovo Salomo okwe va tula moilonga yoshilongo fiyo onena eli.
Ndelenee ovana vaIsrael, Salomo ine va ninga ovapika voilonga yaye, ndelenee vo va li ovakwaita, novakulunhu vovaladi novakulunhu vomatemba oita novalondi veenghambe.
Novapashukili voilonga yefininiko yomatungo e lili noku lili aSalomo ova li omafele avali nomilongo nhano.

Ndele Salomo okwa kufa omona omukainhu waFarao moshilando shaDavid nokwe mu twala mongulu oyo e i mu tungila. Osheshi a tile: “Omwalikadi wange ita ka kala mongulu yaDavid, ohamba yaIsrael, osheshi oyo iyapuki, shaashi oshikefa shOmwene she ya mo.”
Opo nee Salomo okwa yambela Omwene omaxwikiloyambo koaltari yOmwene, oyo a tunga komesho yolupale lokomesho.
Vo va li ve nokuyamba efiku keshe pashipango shaMoses, momashabata nomeehani dipe nomomafimbo oivilo, lutatu momudo: moshivilo shomingome dihe nonhafi, nomoshivilo shoshivike nomoshivilo shomatwali.

Ndele pamhangela yaxe David, e mu lombwela, ta popi eengudu dovapristeli, okwe va ulikila oilonga yavo; nosho yo oinakuwanifwalonga yOvalevi nokutya, okuhambelela Kalunga nokuwanifa moipafi yovapristeli oilonga yomefiku keshe. Nosho yo oilonga yovanangeli voivelo paengudu doposhivelo keshe. Osheshi osho David, omulumenhu waKalunga a tile.
Ndele vo inava kanduka mo nande moshinima shimwe moshipango shohamba, tashi popi ovapristeli nOvalevi nomalimba omamona.
Osho ngaha hano oilonga aishe yaSalomo ya longwa kefiku tuu olo ekanghameno longulu yOmwene la tungwa fiyo okexulilo layo. Ongulu yOmwene oya pwa.
Opo nee Salomo a ya kuEsion-Geber nokuElat, komunghulo wefuta medu laEdom.

Ndele Hiram okwe mu tumina eeskepa da etwa kovapiya vaye nokovapiya va shiiva efuta. Ndele vo pamwe novapiya vaSalomo ve uya kuOfir, ndele va ka tale ko eekilograma omayovi omulongo nomayovi atano doshingoldo ndele va etela ohamba Salomo.
9: Nohamba omukainhu yaSheba eshi ya kundana efimano laSalomo oye uya kuJerusalem i mu yeleke nomapulo madjuu, pamwe nongudu inene, pamwe neengamelo da humbata oinima yedimba liwa noshingoldo shihapu nomamanya mawa. Ndele yo eshi ye uya kuSalomo, oya popya naye oinima aishe ya li momutima wayo.
Ndele Salomo okwe mu fatululila eendjovo daye adishe. Kape na nande ondjovo imwe ya nyenga Salomo okufatulula.
Ohamba omukainhu Omusheba eshi a uda ounongo aushe waSalomo, ndele eshi a mona ombala oyo a tunga,

neendja dokoshililo shaye, naapa hapa kala omalenga aye, nonhumbi ovayakuli vomombala va unganekwa, nomidjalo davo, novapindi vaye, nomaxwikiloyambo, aa a yambela motembeli yOmwene, ye okwa kumwa shili, a kanghwa.
Opo nee ta ti kuSalomo: “Keshe osho nde shi ku udila koshilongo shange, oinima yoye nounongo woye, oshoshili.
Ndele eendjovo davo inandi di itavela, fiyo nde uya oku ndi tala nomesho ange; ndele tala, etata lomounongo woye inandi li lombwelwa. Etumbalo loye li dule osho nde shi kundana.
Ovanyekadi voye ovanelao, naava have ku yakula ovanelao, naaveshe hava udu ounongo wokanya koye.

Omwene Kalunga koye na hambelelwe, eshi e ku hokwa nokwe ku kaleka omutumba kolukalwapangelo laye ngaashi ohamba okefimano lOmwene Kalunga koye! Kalunga koye, eshi e hole Israel fiyo alushe, Ye e ku ninga ohamba u longe ouyuki naasho sha yuka.”

Nokwa yandja vali kohamba eekilograma omayovi ane doshingoldo noinima ihapu unene yedimba liwa nomamanya mawa. Ouhapu woinima yedimba liwa, u fike pwaayo ya etelwa ohamba Salomo kohamba omukainhu Omusheba, inai etwa vali nande efiku limwe.
Ndelenee ovapiya vaHiram novaSalomo, ava va eta oshingoldo sha dja kuOfir, ova eta yo omiti dihapu domisandeli nomamanya mawa.
Omiti domisandeli ohamba ye di hongifa oinima yomongulu yOmwene noyomombala yohamba, nouxumbafeta neenyalilo dovaimbi. Ouhapu wado inau monika nale moshilongo shaJuda.

Nohamba Salomo ya yandja kohamba omukainhu Omusheba ashishe osho yo ye shi hala ndele yo ye shi indila, kombada yasho ohamba Salomo ye i pa. Opo nee inya ya fikama ndele tai shuna koshilongo shayo, novapiya vayo pamwe nayo.
Nondjele yoshingoldo, Salomo kwe shi etelwa momudo umwe, ya li oshingoldo sheekilograma omayovi omilongo mbali nomayovi atatu,
ponho yaayo, Salomo a etelwa oshingoldo noshisiliveli kovashingifi hava endaenda nomeliko lovalandifi noleehamba adishe domuArabia nolomalenga omoshilongo.
Nohamba Salomo ya ninga oikelelifo omafele avali inene yoshingoldo sha hambulwa. Keshe oshikelelifo shinene sha hambulwa, ye shi hambulififila neekilograma heyali doshingoldo,
noikelelifo omafele atatu inini yoshingoldo sha hambulwa. Keshe oshikelelifo shinini ye shi hambulififila oshingoldo eekilograma nhatu. Nohamba ye i tula kongulu yomomufitu wokuLibanon.
Ohamba ya ninga vali olukalwapangelo linene lomayoo eendjaba nokwe li nateka noshingoldoelela.

Nolukalwapangelo la li li neendodo hamano nola li noshipundi shoshingoldo sheemhadi, sha pangelwa kumwe nolukalwapangelo. Ndele kombinga nombinga yolukalwapangelo kwa li oikwatelelo yomake, neenghoshi mbali da kala ofika kominghulo doikwatelelo yomake.
Neenghoshi omulongo nambali da li ofika keendodo hamano kombinga nombinga. Oinima ya tya ngaha inai ningwa moshilongo nande shimwe.
Nomaholo aeshe ohamba Salomo a li oshingoldo. Noikwatelwa aishe yOngulu yOmufitu waLibanon oyoshingoldoelela. Oshisiliveli sha talwa shihe nongushu pomafiku aSalomo.

Osheshi ohamba ya li i neeskepa hadi i kuTarsis pamwe novapiya vaHiram. Lumwe momido nhatu eeskepa daTarsis de uya, da li di noshingoldo noshisiliveli, omayoo eendjaba neenghima needila hadi xwaananeke omishindi.
Osho ngaha hano ohamba Salomo ya tumbala i dule eehamba adishe kombada yedu moupuna nomounongo.
Neehamba adishe domounyuni da li da hala okumona oshipala shaSalomo, di ude ounongo waye, Kalunga e u mu pa momutima waye,
keshe ohamba ya etela Salomo oshali: oinima yoisiliveli noyoshingoldo noikutu nomaadi omirha noinyenyepeki, neenghambe nomamula. Osho sha ningwa omudo keshe.
Salomo okwa li e neespana deenghambe omayovi ane nomatemba oita novalondi omayovi omulongo naavali veenghambe, nokwe va nangeka moilando yomatemba nopohamba muJerusalem.
Ndele ye okwa li omupangeli weehamba adishe okudja kuEufrat fiyo okoshilongo shOvafilisti nofiyo okongaba yaEgipiti.
Nohamba ya longa ngaha fiyo muJerusalem mwa li oshisiliveli shihapu ngaashi omamanya nomiti domisederi dihapu ngaashi omikwiyu moshilongo sha lalakana.
Ndele va etela Salomo eenghambe da dja kuEgipiti nomoilongo aishe.

Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Salomo, oyo yotete nayo yaxuuninwa, inai shangelwa mbela mehepaululo lomuxunganeki Natan nomexunganeko laAhia, Omusilo, nomemoniko lomumonikokule Iddo, ta popi Jerobeam yaNebat?
Ndele Salomo okwa pangela Ovaisraeli aveshe muJerusalem omido omilongo nhee.
Ndele Salomo okwa fya nokwa pakwa moshilando shaxe David. Nomona Rehabeam okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
10: Ndele Rehabeam okwa ya kuSekem, osheshi Ovaisraeli aveshe va ya kuSekem, ve mu ninge ohamba.
Ndele Jerobeam yaNebat, eshi e shi uda manga a li muEgipiti, omo a ya ohamba Salomo onhapo, okwa alukila keumbo.
Ndele ovanhu voilando yokoumbangalanhu ove mu ifana ko. Jerobeam navo aveshe ova ya kuRehabeam nove mu lombwela:
“Xo okwe tu hepeka noku tu twika omutengi mudjuu, ndelenee ove pupaleka hano oudjuu nonghalamwenyo yetu, opo tu ninge ovapiya voye ovaduliki.”
Ndele ye okwe va nyamukula: “Peni nge omafiku atatu ndi shi dilonge, nye mu aluke.” Ovanhu va ya.
Opo nee ohamba Rehabeam a kundafana novakulunhu ovo va li ovayandjimayele vaxe, ndele ta pula: “Ondunge i lipi tamu pe nge opo ndi nyamukule ovanhu ava?”
Ndele vo ove mu lombwela, tava ti: “Ove ngeenge to kala u nombili novanhu ava, ndele to va wapalele ndele to va lombwele eendjovo dombili, vo otava ka ninga ovapiya voye fiyo alushe.”
Ndelenee ye ina landula epukululo lovakulunhu; okwa ka pula omayele kovanyasha ovo a kula navo, vo ovo a ninga ovayandjimayele vaye.
Ndele ye ta pula kuvo: “Nye otamu pe nge epukululo li lipipo, nandi nyamukule ngahelipi ovanhu ava va lombwela nge, tava ti: ‘Pupaleka omutengi, xo e u tu twika’?”

Novanyasha ovo va kula pamwe naye, va nyamukula ndele tava ti: “Ovanhu ovo ve ku lombwela tava ti: ‘Xo okwe tu twika omutengi mudjuu, ndelenee ove u u tu pupalekela,’ u noku va nyamukula ngaha: ‘Okamunwe kange kanini ke dule omatundji atate.
Tate ngeenge e mu twika omutengi mudjuu, ame ohandi ka weda ko komutengi weni. Tate ngeenge e mu dengifa eengola, ame ohandi ke mu dengifa eengola di nomakiya.’ ”
Jerobeam novanhu aveshe eshi ve uya kuRehabeam konima yomafiku atatu, ngaashi ohamba ye va lombwelele,
ohamba Rehabeam oya li ihe na ko nasha nepukululo olo lovakulunhu, noya pa ovanhu enyamukulo likukutu,

ndele tai va lombwele papukululo lovanyasha ndele tai ti: “Tate ngeenge e mu twika omutengi mudjuu, ame ohandi ka weda ko vali komutengi weni. Tate ngeenge e mu denga neengola, ame ohandi ke mu denga neengola domakiya.”
Osho ngaha hano ohamba inai pwilikina ovanhu, ndelenee Omwene osho a endifa, opo a wanife ondjovo yaye, e i popififa Ahia, Omusilo, a lombwela Jerobeam yaNebat.

Ovaisraeli aveshe eshi va mona nokutya, ohamba inai va pwilikina, ovanhu va nyamukula ohamba, ndele tava ti:
“Fye otu noshitukulwa shilipipo muDavid?
Katu noshitukulwafyuululwa momona waIsai!
Israel, keshe umwe na ye ketwali laye!
David, tala hano paife eumbo loye mwene!”
Opo nee Ovaisraeli aveshe va ya komatwali avo.
Ndelenee Rehabeam okwa kala ashike ohamba yovanhu ava vomoshitukulwa shaJuda.
Opo nee ohamba Rehabeam ya tuma Hadoram, omupashukili woilonga yefininiko moshilongo, ndelenee ovana vaIsrael ve mu dipaa nomamanya. Nohamba Rehabeam ya fadukila meendelelo kuJerusalem netemba loita.
Okudja opo Ovaisraeli va amuka kepata laDavid fiyo onena eli.
11: Ndele Rehabeam eshi e uya kuJerusalem, okwa shiva epata laJuda nolaBenjamin, ovalumenhu ovanyasha va wana okulwa, ve fike pomayovi efele nomilongo hetatu, va ka homone Israel, va alulile Rehabeam ouhamba.
Ndelenee ondjovo yaKalunga ye uya kuShemaia, omulumenhu waKalunga ndele tai ti:
“Lombwela Rehabeam yaSalomo, novanhu aveshe moilando yaJuda naBenjamin, u tye:

‘Inamu dengafana nOvaisraeli shaashi nye vamwe aveke. Shuneni amushe komaumbo, osheshi eshi sha ningwa kehalo lange.’ ” Vo aveshe va dulika keendjovo dOmwene ndele va shuna komaumbo. Inava homona Jerobeam.
Ndele Rehabeam okwa kala muJerusalem nokwa pameka oilando yomuJuda neehotekuma.
Osheshi a tunga eehotekuma kuBetlehem nokuEtam nokuTekoa,
nokuBet-Sur nokuSoko nokuAdullam,
nokuGat nokuMaresa nokuSif,
nokuAdoraim nokuLakis nokuAseka,
nokuSorea nokuAijalon nokuHebron. Oyo oilando i neehotekuma muJuda nomuBenjamin.
Nokwa pameka oilando i neehotekuma ndele ta tula mo ovakulunhu vovakwaita ve noituvikilwa yeendja nomaadi nomaviinyu,
nomoshilando keshe oikelelifo inene nomaonga. Nokwe i pameka shili unene. Ndele Juda naBenjamin ya kala mepangelo laye.
Novapristeli nOvalevi ovo va li muIsrael ashishe va dja moshilongo ashishe, ve uya kuye.

Osheshi Ovalevi va fiya po omaulifilo noitukulwafyuululo yavo, ndele ve uya kuJuda nokuJerusalem. Shaashi Jerobeam novana vaye ovalumenhu ve va ta mo, vo inava itavelwa vali okukala ovapristeli vOmwene.
Ndele ye okwe likongela ovapristeli va kalela oikulundu neendemoni domofuka neenhana deemhedi, e di ningifa.
Ndele venya va shikulwa kuvo va dja momapata aeshe aIsrael, nokutya ovo va yukifa omitima davo okukonga Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, ve uya kuJerusalem va ka yambele Omwene Kalunga kooxe.
Ndele osho va pameka ouhamba waJuda ndele va yambidida Rehabeam yaSalomo omido nhatu, osheshi va enda nondjila yaDavid noyaSalomo omido nhatu.
Ndele Rehabeam okwa hombola Mahalat, omona okakadona kaJerimot yaDavid nokaAbigail, omona okakadona kaEliab yaIsai.
Nokwe mu dalela ovana ovamati: Jehus naShemaria naSaham.
Ndele konima yaasho okwa hombola Maaka, omona waAbsalom, ndele ye okwe mu dalela Abia naAttai naSisa naSelomit.

Ndele Rehabeam okwa li e hole Maaka, omona waAbsalom, komesho yovalikadi vaye novalikadi vaye vopomunghulo. Osheshi okwa konga ovalikadi omulongo navahetatu novalikadi vopomunghulo omilongo hamano. Nokwa ninga xe yovana omilongo mbali navahetatu ovalumenhu novana oukadona omilongo hamano.
Ndele Rehabeam okwa lenga Abia, omona waMaaka, a ninga omukulunhu mokati kovamwaxe aveshe, shaashi okwa li a hala oku mu ninga ohamba.
Nokwa enda neendunge ndele ta tukulile ovana vaye ovalumenhu aveshe oilongo noilando aishe i neehotekuma yomuJuda noyomuBenjamin, nokwe va pa eendja dihapu ndele te va kongele ovalikadi vahapu.
12: Ndele Rehabeam eshi a pameka epangelo laye, okwa efa omhango yOmwene, nOvaisraeli aveshe pamwe naye.
Opo nee Sisak, ohamba yaEgipiti, ya homona Jerusalem momudo omutitano wohamba Rehabeam, shaashi vo va li inava dulika kOmwene.
Yo ye uya nomatemba eyovi nomafele avali oita novalondi omayovi omilongo hamano veenghambe. Novanhu vahapu vehe shii kuvalwa, ve uya nayo, va dja kuEgipiti: Ovalibia, Ovasukki nOvaetiopia.
Ndele yo oya nangala oilando i neehotekuma yomuJuda, ndele tai uya fiyo okuJerusalem.

Opo nee omuxunganeki Shemaia e uya kuRehabeam nokovakulunhu vOvajuda, ava va ya onhapo Sisak, ve uya kuJerusalem, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Omwene ta ti ngaha: ‘Nye eshi mwa efa nge, naame ohandi mu yandje yo momake aSisak.’ ”
Opo nee ovakulunhu vaIsrael nohamba ve lininipika ndele tava ti: “Omwene Ye omuyuki.”

NOmwene eshi a mona nokutya, venya ve lininipika, ondjovo yOmwene ye uya kuShemaia ndele tai ti: “Vo ove lininipika. Ame itandi va kombo po, ndelenee Ame ohandi va xupifa divadiva, noupyuhandu wange itau ka hanga Jerusalem tau di meke laSisak.
