Ndelenee vo otava ka ninga ovapiya vaye, opo va shiive nokutya, okulongela nge oku li ngahelipi, nokulongela oilongo yovanailongo oku li ngahelipi!”
Ndele Sisak, ohamba yaEgipiti, oya totela Jerusalem ndele ya kufa omamona omotembeli yOmwene naa omombala. Oye a kufa aeshe aeshe, ndele ya kufa yo oikelelifo yoshingoldo ya ningifwa kuSalomo.
Ponhele yayo, ohamba Rehabeam ya ningifa oikelelifo yoshikushu, nokwe i yandja momake omukulunhu wovanangeli ava va nangela poshivelo shouhamba.
Alushe ohamba eshi ta i kotembeli yOmwene, ovanangeli va humbata oikelelifo, nova kala have i shunifa mongulu yovanangeli.
Ndelenee omolwelininipiko layo, ehandu lOmwene la kanduka po puyo, onghee hano ine i komba po sheke. Ndele muJuda omwa li yo natango oinima iwa.

Nohamba Rehabeam ye lipameka muJerusalem ndele ya twikila okupangela. Osheshi omido daRehabeam da li omilongo nhee naumwe ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido omulongo naheyali muJerusalem, oshilando Omwene e shi hoolola momapata aeshe aIsrael, a pameke edina laye. Nedina laina la li Naama, Omuammoni.
Nokwa ninga osho inashi yuka, osheshi ina ameka omutima waye okukonga Omwene.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Rehabeam, inya yotete naayo yaxuuninwa, inai shangelwa mbela mehepaululo lomuxunganeki Shemaia nolomumonikokule Iddo? Ndele pa li alushe oita pokati kaRehabeam naJerobeam.
Ndele Rehabeam okwa ka nangala pooxe nokwa pakwa moshilando shaDavid. Nomona waye Abia okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
13: Momudo omutimulongo nomutihetatu wepangelo lohamba Jerobeam, Abia a ninga ohamba yaJuda.
Okwa pangela omido nhatu muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Mikaia, omona omukainhu waUriel womuGibea. Ndele pa li oita pokati kaAbia naJerobeam.
Ndele Abia okwa hovela oita, a fikama nomatanga ovakwaita ovaladi omayovi omafele ane ovalumenhu ovanyasha. Ndele Jerobeam okwe mu tandela ombinga novalumenhu ovaladi omayovi omavele ahetatu.
Opo nee Abia a ya komhunda yaSemaraim yomeemhunda daEfraim, ndele ta ti: “Pwilikinei nge Jerobeam nOvaisraeli aveshe!
Mu shi shii nokutya, Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael a pa David epangelo lokupangela Ovaisraeli fiyo alushe, Ye e li pa David novana vaye ovalumenhu, la pama ngaashi ehangano lomongwa?
Ndelenee Jerobeam yaNebat, omupiya waSalomo yaDavid, okwa fikama, ndele ta twifa omwene waye eemhata.
Novalumenhu vehe nelipulo novakolokoshi va ongala puye ndele va dula Rehabeam yaSalomo. Ndele Rehabeam okwa li omunyasha e nomutima u noumbada, onghee hano a nyengwa okulipopila.
Ndele paife tamu diladila okutwa ondubo nepangelo lOmwene li li momake oludalo laDavid, shaashi nye ongudu inene ndele mu neenhana doshingoldo odo Jerobeam e mu ningila oikalunga.

Nye inamu taataa ovapristeli vOmwene, oludalo laAron, nOvalevi, ndele mwe likongela ovapristeli ngaashi oiwana yoikwailongo? Keshe ou e uya nongobe onona yomhedi needi heyali deemhedi a tambulwa, ye a ninga omupristeli woikalunga.
Ndelenee Kalunga ketu Oye Omwene, ndele inatu mu efa. Otu na ovapristeli, Ovaaron nOvalevi, ava tava longele Omwene.

Ndele vo ohava yambele Omwene omaxwikiloyambo ongula keshe nonguloshi keshe, noitwiminifo yedimba liwa, ndele hava kala noshisho shomingome detaliko dokoshitaafula shoshingoldoelela noshoshikwatelwalamba shoshingoldo neelamba dasho, opo di temwe onguloshi keshe. Osheshi fye hatu diinine eenghedimhango dOmwene Kalunga ketu, ndelenee nye mwe mu efa.

Ndele taleni, pamwe nafye, heeno, omupitili komesho yetu Oye Kalunga, novapristeli pamwe nomanghuma onghuwo oku mu shikila onghuwo. Ovana vaIsrael, inamu lwifa Omwene Kalunga kooxo, osheshi itamu ka kala nelao.”
Ndelenee Jerobeam okwa tula ovanhu mekulwila, konima yavenya; Osho ngaha vamwe va kala komesho yovalumenhu Ovajuda, ndele vakwao mekulwila konima yavo.
NOvajuda eshi va punguluka, olwoodi la li komesho yavo nokonima yavo. Ndele va kuwa kOmwene, fimbo ovapristeli va shika omanghuma.
Opo nee ovakwaita Ovajuda va yelula onghuwo yolwoodi. Novakwaita Ovajuda eshi va yelula onghuwo yolwoodi, Kalunga okwa taataa Jerobeam nOvaIsraeli aveshe komesho yaAbia nOvajuda.
Novana vaIsrael va ya onhapo Ovajuda, ndele Kalunga e va yandja momake avo.
Ndele Abia novakwaita vaye, va lwa olwoodi linene navo, onghee hano mOvaisraeli mwa dipawa ovalumenhu ovanyasha omayovi omafele atano.
Ndele mefimbo linya ovana vaIsrael va ninipikwa, ndelenee ovana vaJuda va mona eenghono, shaashi ve liameka kOmwene Kalunga kooxe.
Ndele Abia okwa shikula Jerobeam nokwa kufa oilando yaye: Betel naJesana naEfron nomikunda dayo.
Ndele Jerobeam ina mona vali eenghono pomafiku aAbia. NOmwene e mu denga fiyo a fya.
Ndelenee Abia okwa ehena komesho meenghono. Nokwe likongela ovalikadi omulongo navane, ndele a ninga xe yovana ovalumenhu omilongo mbali navavali noyoukadona omulongo navahamano.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Abia, eendjila daye neendjovo daye, oya shangelwa membo lomafatululo lomuxunganeki Iddo.
14: Ndele Abia okwa ka nangala pooxe nokwa pakwa moshilando shaDavid. Nomona waye Asa okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye. Mefimbo laye oshilongo sha li shi nombili omido omulongo.
Ndele Asa okwa ninga osho shiwa nosha yuka momesho Omwene, Kalunga kaye.
Okwa hanauna po eealtari dokoilongo noikulundu yokuyambela, ndele ta tataula eengudi domamanya nokwa ka po omiti domalupwelele daAsera,
nokwa lombwela Ovajuda va konge Omwene, Kalunga kooxe nokudiinina omhango noipango.
Nokwa hanauna po yo oikulundu yokuyambela neengudi doiyelekelatango domoilando aishe yomuJuda. Noshilongo sha kala nombili mepangelo laye.
Nokwa tunga vali oilando i neehotekuma muJuda, osheshi oshilongo sha kala nombili. Ndele ka pa li olwoodi loku mu lwifa nomido odo, shaashi Omwene e mu pa etulumuko.

Onghee hano a lombwela Ovajuda: “Oilando ei natu i tungeni tu i dingililife eehotekuma di neeshungongulu, oivelo noiidilifo, fimbo oshilongo shi nombili. Shaashi twa konga Omwene, Kalunga ketu. Fye otwe mu konga, nokwe tu pa etulumuko keembinga adishe.” Vo ova tunga hano ndele va li ve nelao.

Ndele Asa okwa li e nomatanga ovakwaita ve noikelelifo nomaonga: ovalumenhu omayovi omafele atatu vomuJuda, novomuBenjamin omayovi omafele avali nomayovi omilongo hetatu, ava hava humbata oikelelifo nomaonga. Vo aveshe va li ovaladi.
Ndele Sera, Omuetiopia, okwe va homona nomatanga ovakwaita ve fike pomamiliyona nomatemba omafele atatu oita. Nokwe uya fiyo okuMaresa.
Opo nee Asa a ya oku mu shakeneka, ndele va tanda ombinga mefilu laSefata puMaresa.

Ndele Asa okwa ifana Omwene Kalunga kaye, ndele ta ti: “Omwene, kape na nande umwe ta dulu okukwafa ngaashi Ove pokati komunaenghono naau ehe neenghono. Omwene Kalunga ketu, tu kwafa, shaashi hatu liameke kwoove, ndele medina loye twe uya okulwa nongudu oyo. Omwene, Oove Kalunga ketu. Ino efa omunhu e ku dule.”
NOmwene okwa taataa Ovaetiopia komesho yaAsa nokomesho yOvajuda, nOvaetiopia va ya onhapo.

Ndele Asa novakwaita vaye ava va li puye, ve va shikula fiyo okuGerar. Ndele mOvaetiopia mwa fya vahapu, inava dula vali okumona eenghono. Osheshi va teywa po koshipala shOmwene nokoshipala shomatanga aye. Ndele va kufa oixuulwa ihapu unene.
Ndele va nangala oilando aishe yomoushiinda waGerar. Osheshi etilo la dja kOmwene, la li kombada yavo. Ndele va tinha oilando aishe, osheshi muyo mwa li oixuulwa ihapu.
Va kwata yo eehambo doimuna, ndele va kufa eedi dihapu neengamelo. Opo nee va shuna kuJerusalem.
15: Opo nee Omhepo yaKalunga ye uya kuAsaria yaOded;

nokwa fikama a ka shakeneke Asa ndele ta ti kuye: “Pwilikinei nge, Asa nOvajuda nOvabenjamin aveshe! Omwene ota kala pamwe nanye, ngeenge tamu kala pamwe naye, ndele ngeenge tamu mu kongo, otamu ke mu mona. Ndelenee ngeenge tamu mu efa, naye yo ote ke mu efa.
Efimbo lile Ovaisraeli va li vehe na Kalunga kashili, vehe nomupristeli ta longo, kave nomhango.
Ndelenee moudjuu wavo eshi va shuna kOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael, ndele ve mu konga, Ye okwe ve lihololela.
Pomafiku enya kakwa li ku nombili yeendafano noyokupita mo noyokuuya mo, shaashi ovanhu aveshe voilongo va hangika komalimbililo manene.
Noshiwana she lidenga noshiwana, oshilando noshilando, osheshi Kalunga e va limbilika eshi e va tumina omaudjuu e lili nae lili.
Ndelenee nye kaleni mwa pama, omake eni aha tyololoke, osheshi oshilonga sheni shi nondjabi.”

Ndele Asa eshi a uda eendjovo edi nexunganeko laAsaria yaOded, ye e di popya, okwe liladipaleka nokwa hanauna po oitondifa yomoshilongo ashishe shaJuda noshaBenjamin nomoilando oyo yokeemhunda daEfraim, ye e i nangala. Noaltari yOmwene oyo ya li komesho yolupale, okwe i tungulula.

Opo nee ye a ongela Ovajuda aveshe nOvabenjamin, novanailongo yo vomuEfraim novomuManasse novomuSimeon, ovo va li puvo. Osheshi vahapu va dja mo muIsrael ve uya kuye eshi va mona nokutya, Omwene Kalunga okwa li pamwe naye.
Ndele ova ongala muJerusalem mohani onhinhatu momudo omutimulongo nanhano womepangelo laAsa,
ndele mefiku tuu olo va yambela Omwene eengobe omafele aheyali needi omayovi aheyali domoixuulwa oyo ve i kwata.
Ndele va ninga ehangano nokutya, va konge Omwene Kalunga kooxe nomitima davo adishe neemwenyo davo adishe.
Ndele keshe ou ita kongo Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, ota ka dipawa, okaana ile omukulunhu, omulumenhu ile omukainhu.
Ndele va anena Omwene nondaka inene nokukuwilila nokushika omanghuma oshikushu nomanghuma eembinga.

NOvajuda aveshe va shambukwa keemwenyo omolweano, osheshi va ana nomitima davo adishe ndele va konga Omwene nehalo lavo alishe. Ndele Ye okwe ve lihololela, nOmwene e va pa etulumuko keembinga adishe.
Heeno, ohamba Asa ya kufa ina Maaka ouhamba, osheshi ye okwa dikila Asera oshitondifa. Ndele Asa okwa ka po oshitondifa, nokwe shi xwandaula nokwe shi xwika po mefilu laKidron.
Oikulundu yokuyambela yomuIsrael inai xula po, ndelenee omutima waAsa wa li inau tukauka pomafiku aye aeshe.
Nokwa twala mongulu yaKalunga eeshali daxe diyapuki neeshali daye mwene diyapuki: oisiliveli noingoldo noinima i lili nai lili.
Ndele inapa kala vali oita fiyo okomudo omutimilongo nhatu nomutitano wepangelo laAsa.
16: Momudo omutimilongo nhatu nomutihamano womepangelo laAsa ohamba yaJuda, Baasha, ohamba yaIsrael, ya kwata ko Juda, ndele tai tungu oshilandopopilo Rama, okupata eendjila adishe muJuda.
Opo nee Asa a tumina Benhadad, ohamba yaAram, yo ya li muDamaskus, oisiliveli noingoldo yomomalimba ongulu yOmwene noyomomalimba ongulu yohamba, ndele ta ti:

“Napa kale ehangano pokati ketu naave ngaashi la li pokati kootate. Omaano aa oshisiliveli noshingoldo ooye. Paife teya po ehangano leni naBaasha, ohamba yaIsrael, opo a kufe mo omatanga ovakwaita moshitukulwa shange.”

Ndele Benhadad okwa itavela eendjovo daAsa, nokwa tuma ovakulunhu vomatanga ovakwaita okuhomona oilando yomuIsrael, nokwa teya po Ijon naDan naAbel-Bet-Maaka noshitukulwa shopomunghulo wefuta laGalilea noshitukulwa shaNaftali ashishe omo mwa li hamu tuvikilwa oinima.
Ndele Baasha, eshi e shi uda, okwa efa okutunga Rama ndele a dimbuka okulonga oshilonga shaye.
Opo nee ohamba Asa ya ifana Ovajuda aveshe, ndele va kufa omamanya nomiti, odo Baasha e di pamekifa Rama, ndele tai di tungifa Geba naMispa.

Ndele pefimbo tuu olo omumonikokule Hanani e uya kuAsa, ohamba yaJuda, ndele ta ti kuyo: “Shaashi ove we liameka kohamba yaAram, ndele ino liameka kOmwene, Kalunga koye, onghee hano omatanga ovakwaita vohamba Aram a dja mo meke loye.
Ndi shi shii Ovaetiopia nOvalibia va li ve nomatanga manene unene nomatemba oita novalondi veenghambe? Ndelenee Ye okwe va yandja meke loye, shaashi we liameka kOmwene.
Osheshi omesho Omwene taa tale edu alishe, opo a kwafe neenghono ovo have liameke kuye nomutima aushe. Moshinima eshi wa ninga oushima, osheshi okudja paife tapa ka kala oita naave.”
Ndelenee Asa okwa handukila omumonikokule nokwe mu idililifa modolongo, shaashi ye okwa li e mu udila onya. Ndele pefimbo olo Asa okwa hepeka vamwe vomoshiwana.
Ndele tala, oinima tai hepaulula Asa, inya yotete naai yaxuuninwa, oya shangwa membo leehamba daJuda nodaIsrael.
Ndele momudo omutimilongo nhatu nomutimugoi womepangelo laye, Asa okwa vela eemhadi. Oudu waye wa li mudjuu. Ndelenee nomoudu waye ina konga Omwene, ndelenee ovahakuli.
Ndele Asa okwa ka nangala pooxe, ndele okwa fya momudo omutimilongo nhee naimwe womepangelo laye.
Ndele ve mu paka mombila yaye, e i lihokela moshilando shaDavid, ndele ve mu nangeka mombete i yadi oimbodi yedimba liwa, i lili nai lili ya pilaulwa komunongo. Ndele ve mu xwikila oixwikomwa ihapu.
17: Nomona waye omumati, Josafat, okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye. Nokwe lipamekela Ovaisraeli.
Nokwa nangeka omatanga ovakwaita moilando aishe i neehotekuma muJuda nokwa tula eengudu dovanangeli moshilongo shaJuda nomoilando yomuEfraim, oyo ya nangalwa kuxe Asa.
NOmwene okwa kala naJosafat, shaashi a enda neendjila diwa donale daxe David. Ndele ina konga ooBaal.
Ndelenee okwa konga Kalunga kaxe ndele ta ende moipango yaye ndele ina ninga ngaashi Israel.
Onghee hano Omwene okwa pameka epangelo laye. NOvajuda aveshe va pa Josafat eeshali, onghee hano okwa li e noupuna muhapu nefimano linene.
Omutima waye eshi wa wedwa ouyadi meendjila dOmwene, okwa hanauna po vali muJuda oikulundu yokuyambela nomiti domalupwelele daAsera.
Ndele momudo omutitatu wepangelo laye okwa tuma ovakulunhu vaye: Ben-Hail naObadja naSakaria naNetanel naMikaia koilando yaJuda va longe ovanhu,
ndele pamwe navo Ovalevi Shemaia naNetanja naSebadja naAsahel naSemiramot naJonatan naAdonia naTobia naTob-Adonia, vo Ovalevi. Ndele pamwe navo ovapristeli Elisama naJehoram.
Ndele vo ova longa ovanhu muJuda ndele va li ve nembo lomhango yOmwene, ndele va endaenda moilando aishe yomuJuda ndele va longa ovanhu.
Nehaluko lokutila Omwene le uya kombada yoilongo aishe yoiwana ya li kombinga nombinga yaJuda, onghee hano inava homona Josafat.

NOvafilisti yo vamwe va etela Josafat eeshali ndele va yandja oisiliveli ngaashi efendelo. NOvaarabi yo ve mu etela eedi omayovi aheyali nomafele aheyali eedi deemhedi, noikombo omayovi aheyali nomafele aheyali.
Osho ngaha hano Josafat a nenepekwa, a tumbala unene. Nokwa tunga omapopilongulu noilando i nomalimba muJuda.
Nokwa li e noituvikilwa ihapu moilando yomuJuda, ndele muJerusalem mwa li ovakwaita ovaladi.
Omalufo avo okuyakula pamapata avo oyaa: ovakulunhu vomayovi vomuJuda ovava: omukulunhu Adna pamwe naye ovaladi omayovi omafele atatu.
Naponho yaye omukulunhu Johanan napamwe naye omayovi omafele avali nomayovi omilongo hetatu.
Noponho yaye Amasia yaSikri, ou e liyandjela Omwene kehalo laye mwene, nopamwe naye ovaladi omayovi omafele avali.
Ndele muBenjamin: Eljada, omuladi nopamwe naye omayovi omafele avali, ve nomauta noikelelifo.
Ndele Ponho yaye Josabad, nopamwe naye omayovi efele nomilongo hetatu, va longekidilwa okuhomona.
Ava va yakula ohamba, naponho yavo ovo va li moilando i neehotekuma moshilongo ashishe shaJuda.
18: Ndele Josafat eshi a yada oupuna nefimano, okwa ninga oshitenya shaAhab.

Ndele eshi pa pita omido dimwe, okwa ya kuAhab kuSamaria, ndele Ahab okwe mu tomena novakwaita vaye ovo va li puye, eedi neengobe dihapu. Ndele Ahab okwe mu heka a ye naye okuhomona Ramot shomuGilead.

Ndele Ahab, ohamba yaIsrael, ya lombwela Josafat, ohamba yaJuda, tai ti: “Hatu i tuu pamwe naave kuRamot shomuGilead?” Nokwe i nyamukula: “Aame ongaashi ove, noshiwana shange ongaashi shoye. Ohatu ka ya pamwe naave koita.”
Josafat okwa lombwela vali ohamba yaIsrael, ta ti: “Ndelenee pula tete ondjovo yOmwene.”

Opo nee ohamba yaIsrael ya ifana ovaxunganeki, ve fike pomafele ane ndele tai va pula: “Nandi ka homone tuu Ramot shomuGilead ile nandi shi efe?” Ndele venya va nyamukula: “Inda, u ke shi homone, osheshi Kalunga ote ku pe efindano.”
Ndelenee Josafat ta ti: “Kape na vali omuxunganeki umwe e tu pulile kOmwene?”

Ahab okwa nyamukula, ta ti: “Oku na vali umwe, Mikaia yaJimla, ndelenee ame ohandi mu tondo, osheshi ye ita xunganekele nge nande ouwa, ndelenee alushe owii.” Josafat okwa nyamukula: “Ino popya ngaho!”
Opo nee ohamba yaIsrael ya ifana elenga layo ndele tai ti: “Inda u ka tale ko diva Mikaia yaJimla.”

Fimbo ohamba yaIsrael naJosafat, ohamba yaJuda, keshe imwe ya kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo layo, ndele da li da djala oikutu youhamba koshipale poshivelo shaSamaria, novaxunganeki aveshe tava xunganeke moipafi yado,
Sedekia yaKenaana okwe li ningila eembinga doshivela ndele ta ti: “Omwene ta ti ngaha: ‘Naadi ove to ka twa Ovaarami fiyo we va mana po.’ ”
Novaxunganeki aveshe osho va xunganeka ndele tava ti: “Fikama u homone Ramot shomuGilead, ndele to ka mona elao, nOmwene ote ke shi yandja momake ohamba.”
Opo nee omutumwa ou a ya a ka tale Mikaia, okwe mu lombwela: “Tala, ovaxunganeki aveshe va xunganekela ohamba ouwa. Ondjovo yoye yo nai kale ngaashi eendjovo davo, u xunganeke oinima iwa.”
Ndelenee Mikaia ta ti: “Oshili, ngaashi Omwene e nomwenyo, oshili, osho Kalunga te shi lombwele nge, osho handi ka popya!”

Eshi e uya kohamba, ohamba tai ti kuye: “Mikaia, fye naJosafat, natu ka homone tuu Ramot shomuGilead ile ahowe?” Ndele ye ota nyamukula: “Heeno, homoneni, osheshi oshili tamu ka findana; Omwene ote mu pe efindano.”
Nohamba Ahab tai ti kuye: “Nge to popi naame medina lOmwene, popya oshili. Olungapi ndi na oku ku lombwela?”
Opo nee a nyamukula: “Ame nda mona Ovaisraeli aveshe va halakanifwa keemhunda ngaashi eedi dihe namufita. NOmwene okwa tya: ‘Vo vehe na vali omuwiliki, nava shune nombili komaumbo avo.’ ”
Opo Ahab okwa tya kuJosafat: “Inandi ku lombwela kutya, winya iha xunganekele nge ouwa, alushe owii ashike?”
Mikaia ta ti vali: “Pwilikina ondjovo yOmwene, eshi ta ti: Ame nda mona Omwene e li omutumba kolukalwapangelo laye meulu, novaengeli aveshe va kala ofika puye.
NOmwene okwa pula: ‘Olyelye ta ka weweleka Ahab, opo a ka homone ye a ka file muRamot?’ Ndele ovaengeli ova nyamukula shi lili nashi lili.
Opo nee omhepo ye uya pOmwene, ndele ya tya: ‘Ame ohandi ka weweleka Ahab.’ NOmwene okwa pula: ‘Ngahelipi?’
Ndele omhepo oye mu lombwela: ‘Ame ohandi ka ya ndi ninge omhepo yoipupulu momakanya ovaxunganeki vaye aveshe.’ Ndele Omwene okwe mu lombwela: ‘Inda u ke mu weweleke, osheshi oto ka findana.’
Ndele Mikaia okwe mu lombwela, ta ti: ‘Eshi sha ningwa osheshi Omwene okwa ninga ovaxunganeki voye ve ku fufye, ashike Ye mwene okwa tokola e ku tumine omupya.’ ”
Opo nee Sedekia a yambuka nokwa denga Mikaia enghava moshipala, nde ta ti: “Onaini hano Omhepo yOmwene ya dja mo mwaame i uye i popye mwoove?”
Ndele Mikaia okwa nyamukula: “Tala, ove oto ke shi mona shito mefiku to ka hondama meendjuwo kofindo.”
Ndelenee ohamba Ahab ya lombwela elenga: “Kwateni Mikaia, mu mu twale kuAmon, ngoloneya woshilando, nokuJoas, omona wohamba.
Ndele u noku va lombwela ve mu tule modolongo, vo ve mu pe omungome nomeva ongaho, fiyo ame handi aluka inandi mona oshiponga.”
Mikaia okwa nyamukula: “Ngeenge to aluka ino mona oshiponga, otashi ti Omwene ina popya mwaame.” Nokwa tya vali: “Keshe umwe na ude eshi nda popya!”
Opo nee ohamba yaIsrael naJosafat, ohamba yaJuda, da ya kuRamot shomuGilead.

Nohamba yaIsrael ya lombwela Josafat: “Ame ohandi djalulula, ndi lidimbike ndele handi ka ya kolwoodi.” Ove kala po wa djala oshikutu shoye shouhamba. Ohamba yaIsrael ya djalulula ndele tai i kolwoodi.
Nohamba yaAram ya li ya lombwela ovakulunhu vomatemba oita ndele tai ti: “Inamu lwifa vamwe ve lili, ngeenge elenga ile omufyoona, lwifeni ohamba yaIsrael aike.”

Novakulunhu vomatemba oita eshi va mona Josafat, ova diladila: “Oye ohamba yaIsrael,” ndele va hovela oku mu lwifa. Opo nee Josafat okwa kuwa. Omwene okwe mu kwafa, naKalunga okwe va heka po, va dje po puye.
Ovakulunhu vomatemba oita eshi va mona nokutya, winya ke fi ohamba yaIsrael, ova dja po puye.

Ndelenee omulumenhu umwe, ou a li a shila outa waye ina shoneka, okwa yasha ohamba yaIsrael pokati komwiya noshivela shoponhulo. Opo nee oya lombwela omushingi wetemba layo: “Alula etemba, u kufe nge molwoodi, osheshi nda yashwa.”
Ndele efiku olo olwoodi la ninga linene, onghee hano ohamba yaIsrael ya kala ofika metemba layo nokutaalela Ovaarami fiyo onguloshi. Pokuningina kwetango oya fya.
19: Ndelenee Josafat, ohamba yaJuda eshi ya aluka, i li nawa keumbo layo muJerusalem,

omumonikokule Jehu yaHanani okwa ya oku mu shakeneka ndele ta lombwele ohamba Josafat, ta ti: “Ove wa li tuu u nokukwafa omuhenakonasha naKalunga, ndele wa li tuu u nokuhola ou ta tondwa kuKalunga? Onghee hano ehandu laKalunga tali uya kombada yoye.
Ndele mwoove mwa monika oinima iwa, osheshi wa hanauna po omiti domalupwelele moshilongo ndele wa ameka omutima woye okukonga Kalunga.”
Ndele Josafat okwa kala muJerusalem, nokwa ya vali mokati koshiwana okudja kuBerseba fiyo okeemhunda daEfraim nokwe va alulila kOmwene, Kalunga kooxe.
Ndele okwa tula ovatokoli veendjovo moshilongo, moilando aishe i neehotekuma domuJuda, moshilando keshe.
Nokwa lombwela ovatokoli, ta ti: “Taleni, eshi tamu ningi, osheshi itamu tokola omatokolo ovanhu, ndelenee omatokolo Omwene. Ndele Ye oku li punye momatokolo.
Etilo lokutila Kalunga nali mu pangele hano. Taleni oilonga yeni, osheshi pOmwene pehe nowii ile nokatongotongo, ndele ita tambula ombubo.”
Ndele muJerusalem yo Josafat okwa tula vamwe vomOvalevi novomovapristeli novomovakulunhu vOvaisraeli vomapata momatokolo Omwene, nokutokola eendjovo doihokolola. Ndele vo va alukila muJerusalem.
Nokwe va lombwela, ta ti: “Osho ngaha mu nokulonga metilo lokutila Omwene noudiinini nomutima aushe.

Ndele moihokolola keshe tamu i etelwa koovakweni, ovo ve li moilando yavo, ngeenge edipao, eemhango, oipango, neenghedimhango nomalombwelo, nye mu noku va londwela, opo vo vehe lietele ombedi mokunyona kOmwene, nehandu lihe uye kombada yeni ile yavakweni. Osho mu nokuninga muhe lietele ombedi.

Ndele taleni, omupristeli omukulunhu Amarja, oye omukulunhu weni moinima aishe yOmwene, ndele Sebadja yaIsmael, elenga lomepata laJuda, oye omukulunhu woinima aishe yohamba, nOvalevi vo ovapashukili voku mu yakula. Kaleni mwa pama ndele hoveleni oshilonga. NOmwene na kale naava vawa.”
20: Konima yoinima ei ovana vaMoab novana vaAmmoni napamwe navo ovanhu vamwe vehe fi Ovaammoni ve uya okulwifa Josafat.
Josafat eshi a shiivifilwa oshinima eshi taku tiwa: “Eengudu dihapu tadi di kombinga inya yefuta, kuEdom, tadi uya oku ku lwifa, ndele tala, vo aveshe ve li muHaseson-Tamar, nokutya muEngedi,”
Josafat okwa tila nokwe liameka okukonga Omwene nokwa vilikila muJuda ashishe efiku lelidiliko.
NOvajuda va ongala va ka konge ekwafo lOmwene; moilando aishe yomuJuda ove uya okukonga Omwene.
Opo nee Josafat okwa ya, ta kala ofika mokati koshiongalele shomuJuda noshomuJerusalem, mongulu yOmwene, komesho yolupale lipe,
ndele ta ti: “Omwene Kalunga kootate, Oove Kalunga komeulu, ndele Oove omupangeli woilongo aishe yoiwana. Heeno, meke loye omu neenghono nouladi, onghee hano kape na ou ta dulu oku ku kondjifa.
Haave Kalunga ketu, wa taataa oonakukalamo medu eli komesho yovanhu voye Ovaisraeli, ndele we li yandja fiyo alushe koludalo laAbraham, kaume koye?
Ndele va tula mo mulo, ndele ve ku tungila mo otembeli okefimano ledina loye, tava ti:

‘Ngeenge hatu hangika komupya ile keongamukonda ile kehandukilo ile koudu u nolutapo ile kondjala, opo hatu holoka komesho yongulu ei nokoshipala shoye, osheshi edina loye li li mongulu ei noku ku ifana moudjuu wetu, opo Ove u tu kwafe noku tu xupifa.’

Ndele tala, ovana vaAmmoni novana vaMoab novanhu vokeemhunda daSeir paife ove li apa, monhele yavo Ove ino itavela Ovaisraeli va taulule mo, vo eshi va dja medu laEgipiti. Ndelenee ve va dingilila ndele inave va hanauna po.
Heeno, tala, paife tave uya ve tu alulile owii noku tu taataa mo moshilongo shetu, osho twe shi pewa kwOove.
Kalunga ketu, ito va tokola? Osheshi mufye kamu neenghono okulwifa ongudu inene tai tu homona. Ndele inatu shiiva eshi tu nokuninga, ndelenee omesho etu taa tale kwoove.”
NOvajuda aveshe va kala ofika koshipala shOmwene pamwe nounona vavo novalikadi vavo novana vavo ovamati.
Opo nee Omhepo yOmwene ye uya mokati koshiongalele, kuJahasiel yaSakaria yaBenaja yaJeiel yaMattanja, Omulevi, womoludalo laAsaf,

ndele ye ta ti: “Pwilikineni amushe nye vomuJuda noonakukalamo muJerusalem, naave yo, ohamba Josafat! Omwene te mu lombwele ngaha: ‘Inamu tila, inamu haluka molwongudu oyo inene, osheshi olwoodi kali fi leni, ndelenee olaKalunga.
Mongula indeni mu ke va lwife. Tala, vo tave uya noshikulundu shaSis, ndele tamu ke va shakeneka komunghulo wefilu koushilo wombuwa yaJeruel.

Hanye tamu ka lwa. Fikameni, kaleni mu li ofika ndele taleni nhumbi Omwene te mu xupifa, nye Ovajuda noonakukalamo muJerusalem.’ Inamu tila ndele inamu haluka. Mongula fikameni mu va homone, nOmwene ta ka kala pamwe nanye.”
Opo nee Josafat e linyongamena oshipala shaye poshi, nOvajuda aveshe noonakukalamo muJerusalem va wila eombe koshipala shOmwene, va ilikana Omwene.
NOvalevi vomovana Ovakohati novomovana Ovakora, va kala ofika va hambelele Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael nondaka inene.

Va fikama ongula inene ndele va ya mombuwa yaTekoa. Ndele fimbo tava fikama Josafat a kala ofika ndele ta ti: “Pwilikinei nge, nye Ovajuda noonakukala muJerusalem! Itaveleni Omwene, Kalunga keni, opo nee tamu ka kala mwa pama. Itaveleni ovaxunganeki vaye, opo nee tamu ka kala nelao.”

Ndele ye okwa kundafana novanhu nokwa tula ovaimbi okuhambelela Omwene, va djala omidjalo diyapuki ndele tava piti komesho yovakwaita tava imbi tava ti: “Hambeleleni Omwene, osheshi onghenda yaye tai kalelele fiyo alushe!”

Ndele eshi va hovela okunyakukwa nokwiimba eimbilo lehambelelo, Omwene okwa tula ovanhu va ninge ekulwila konima yovana vaAmmoni novaMoab novovanhu vokeemhunda daSeir, ava ve uya okulwifa Ovajuda, ndele va tewa po.
Shaashi ovana vaAmmoni novaMoab va hovela okulwifa ovanhu vokeemhunda daSeir, ve va hanaunune po noku va mana po. Ndele eshi va mana po ovanhu vokeemhunda daSeir, ove lipilukila mokulidipaa.
NOvajuda eshi ve uya monhele omo va dula okutala ombuwa, ndele eshi va tala ongudu, va mona oimhu ya nangala pedu, ndele kapa li nande umwe a xupa po.

Opo nee Josafat novakwaita vaye ve uya okutinha oixuulwa, ndele va mona oinima ihapu, oikutu noinima i nondilo. Ndele va tinha ihapu unene, va nyengwa oku i humbata. Nomafiku atatu va ongela oixuulwa, oyo ya li ihapu.
Ndele mefiku etine va ongala mEfilu lehambelelo, osheshi oko va hambelela Omwene, onghee hano va ifana onhele oyo Efilu lEhambelelo fiyo onena eli.
Opo nee ovalumenhu aveshe vomuJuda novomuJerusalem naJosafat komesho yavo va shuna nehafo kuJerusalem. Osheshi Omwene e va hafifa molwovatondadi vavo.
Ndele ve uya kongulu yOmwene muJerusalem nokushika ouxumbafeta neenyalilo nomanghuma.
Ehaluko linene okutila Kalunga la li kombada yoilongo aishe yoiwana, eshi va uda nokutya, Omwene okwa lwifa ovatondadi vaIsrael.
Opo nee oshilongo shaJosafat sha mona ombili, naKalunga kaye e mu pa etulumuko keembinga adishe.
Ndele Josafat okwa pangela Juda. Omido daye da li omilongo nhatu nanhano eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido omilongo mbali nanhano muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Asuba yaSilhi.
Ndele ye okwa enda nondjila yaxe Asa, ndele ina yapuka mo nande nokwa ninga eshi sha yuka moipafi yOmwene.
Noikulundu yokuyambela ye ine i hanauna po. Ovanhu inava ameka natango omitima davo kuKalunga kooxe.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Josafat, inya yotete naai yaxuuninwa, tala, yo oya shangwa mehepaululo laJehu yaHanani, lo la tulwa membo leehamba daIsrael.
Ndelenee konima yoinima ei Josafat, ohamba yaJuda, ya ninga ehangano naAhasia, ohamba yaIsrael, yo ya li ihe na Kalunga mokukala kwayo.
Vo ova udafana va pangele eeskepa di ye kuTarsis. Ndele va pangela eeskepa muEsion-Geber.

Ndelenee Elieser yaDodava womuMaresa a xunganekela Josafat te mu popi ta ti: “Ove eshi wa ninga ehangano naAhasia, Omwene ota teya po oshilonga shoye.” Neeskepa oda nyonauka, onghee da nyengwa okuya kuTarsis.
21: Ndele Josafat okwa ka nangala pooxe nokwa pakwa pooxe moshilando shaDavid. Nomona waye Jehoram okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
Nokwa li e novamwaina ovalumenhu, ovana ovamati vaJosafat: Asaria naJehiel naSakaria naAsariahu naMikael naSefatja. Vo aveshe va li ovana ovamati vaJosafat, ohamba yaIsrael.
Ndele xe yavo e va pa eeshali dihapu doingoldo nodoisiliveli noinima i nondilo pamwe noilando i neehotekuma yomuJuda. Ndelenee epangelo louhamba okwe li pa Jehoram, eshi oye oshiveli.
Ndelenee Jehoram eshi a mona epangelo louhamba waxe ndele e lipameka, ye okwa dipaa neongamukonda ovamwaina ovalumenhu aveshe nosho yo vamwe vomovakulunhu vaIsrael.
Omido daJehoram da li omilongo nhatu nambali eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido hetatu muJerusalem.
Nokwa enda nondjila yeehamba daIsrael ngaashi epata laAhab la ninga, shaashi omwalikadi waye okwa li omona okakadona kaAhab, nokwa ninga osho shii moipafi yOmwene.
Ndelenee Omwene ina hala okuhanauna po epata laDavid omolwehangano e li ninga naDavid, omaudaneko okuyandja kuye nokovana vaye ovamati olamba i kale yavo alushe.
Pomafiku aye Ovaedom va amuka kuJuda ndele ve lihoololela ohamba.
Onghee hano Jehoram a ya pamwe novakulunhu vovakwaita nomatemba oita. Nokwa fikama oufiku ndele a taataa Ovaedom, ovo ve mu dingilila novakulunhu vomatemba oita.
Osho ngaha Ovaedom va amuka kuJuda fiyo onena eli. Mefimbo tuu limwe alike oshilando shaLibna yo she likufa mo mepangelo laye, osheshi Jehoram a ekelashi Omwene Kalunga kooxe.
Nokwa ninga yo oikulundu yokuyambela keemhunda domuJuda nokwa twala oonakukalamo muJerusalem mokuhaela nokwa pukifa Juda.
Opo nee a tuminwa komuxunganeki Elia onhumwafo tai ti: “Omwene Kalunga kaxo David ta ti ngaha: ‘Shaashi ino enda neendjila daxo Josafat noneendjila daAsa, ohamba yaJuda,
ndelenee wa twala Ovajuda noonakukala muJerusalem mondjila yeehamba daIsrael nomoluhaelo ngaashi epata laAhab le va twala moluhaelo, ndele wa dipaa ovamwaxo, ovo va li vawa ve ku dule;
tala, Omwene ta ka tuma oshiponga shinene mokati kovanhu voye nokovana voye ovamati nokovalikadi voye naaishe u i kwete,
naave mwene to ka vela oudu mudjuu, oudu wendjadja, fiyo pa pita omudo umwe ile omido mbali, omandjadja oye taa tika mo koudu ou.’ ”
Opo nee Omwene a pendula mOvafilisti nomOvaarabi, ovo va li ovashiinda vOvaetiopia, omhepo yokukondjifa Jehoram,

ndele va homona Juda, ve shi teya, ndele va kufa oinima aishe ya li meumbo lohamba oixuulwa nosho yo ovana vayo ovamati novalikadi vayo. Onghee inapa fyaala puye nande omona waye omumati, Joahas aeke, onghelo yaye.
Ndele konima yoinima ei aishe, Omwene okwe mu handukila noudu wendjadja, noudu inau velulwa kusha.

Ngeno eshi pa pita omido mbali nokutya, pexulilo lomudo omutivali, omandjadja aye a tokauka mo molwoudu waye, onghee okwa fya e li mouyehame unene. Noshiwana shaye inashi mu xwikila oixwikomwa yoku mu fimanekifa ngaashi ooxe va ningilwa.

Omido daJehoram da li omilongo nhatu nambali, eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido hetatu muJerusalem. Nokwa fya, ndele kape na ou e mu pongola. Nokwa pakwa moshilando shaDavid, ndelenee hameembila deehamba.
22: Opo nee oonakukalamo muJerusalem va ninga Ahasia, onghelo yaye, ohamba ponhele yaye. Osheshi eengudu odo de uya monhanda pamwe nOvaarabi, ova dipaa Ovana vaye aveshe ovakulunhu. Ndele Ahasia yaJehoram ohamba yaJuda, a ninga ohamba.
Omido daAhasia da li omilongo mbali nambali, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omudo umwe muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Atalia, omona waOmri.
Naye yo okwa enda neendjila depata laAhab, osheshi ina okwe mu pukifa, e mu twala mouhenakonashanakalunga.
Ndele ye okwa ninga osho shii moipafi yOmwene, ngaashi epata laAhab, osheshi vo va li ovapukululi vaye konima yefyo laxe, ndele ve mu nyona po.
Papukululo lavo okwa fikama yo pamwe naJoram yaAhab, ohamba yaIsrael, a homone Hasael, ohamba yaAram, puRamot shomuGilead. Ndelenee Joram a yashwa kOvaarami,
nokwa aluka a veluke muJisreel koiveta e i yashelwa puRama mokulwa naHasael, ohamba yaAram. Ndele Ahasia yaJoram, ohamba yaJuda, e uya okutalela po Joram yaAhab muJisreel, shaashi ta vele.
Ndelenee enyonauko laAhasia la dja kuKalunga, onghee hano okwa li e nokuuya kuJoram. Eshi a fika ko, okwa ya pamwe naJoram okushakeneka Jehu yaNimsi, ou a vaekwa kOmwene, a hanaune po epata laAhab.
Ndele Jehu eshi ta wanifa etokolo lepata laAhab, okwa shakeneka ovakulunhu vaJuda novana ovamati vovamwaina vaAhasia, ovapiya vaAhasia, nokwe va dipaa.

Konima yoinima ei okwa konga Ahasia, ndele ve mu kwata, fimbo a hondama muSamaria, ndele ve mu eta kuJehu. Ndele ve mu dipaa ndele tave mu pake, osheshi vo tava ti: “Ye omona waJosafat, ou a konga Omwene nomutima aushe.” Ndele meumbo laAhasia kamwa li nande umwe a wana okupangela.
Atalia, ina yaAhasia, eshi a mona nokutya omona waye omumati okwa dipawa, okwa yandja elombwelo ovakwahamba aveshe vomuJuda va dipawe.

Ndelenee Josabat, omona omukainhu wohamba, okwa ku fa Joas yaAhasia nokwe ka vaka mo movana ovo vohamba va li ve nokudipawa, nokwe ka eta pamwe nomunyamifi wako mondjuwo yokunangala. Ndele Josabat, omona wohamba Joram, omwalikadi womupristeli Jehoiada, osheshi ye okwa li omumwaina waAhasia, okwe mu holeka, onghee hano Atalia ine mu dipaa.
Nokwa li a holekwa puvo mongulu yOmwene omido hamano fimbo Atalia ta pangele oshilongo.
23: Ndelenee momudo omutiheyali Jehoiada okwe linyatipaleka nokwa ninga ehangano novanefele Asaria yaJeroham naIsmael yaJohanan naAsaria yaObed naMaasea yaAdaja naElisafat yaSikri.
Ndele va endaenda muJuda ndele va ongela Ovalevi vomoilando aishe yomuJuda novakulunhu vomapata aIsrael. Ndele vo ove uya kuJerusalem.
Noshiongalele ashishe osha ninga ehangano nohamba mongulu yaKalunga. Opo nee Jehoiada ta ti kuvo: “Taleni, omona wohamba e nokuninga ohamba ngaashi Omwene a popya oludalo laDavid;
Mu nokuninga ngaha: Oshitukulwa shimwe shomoitukulwa itatu shomunye, ava mu nolufo okunangela mEshabata, mu nokunangela poivelo, ovo vomovapristeli nomOvalevi.

Noshitukulwa shimwe shomoitukulwa itatu shi nokunangela pongulu yohamba, noshitukulwa shimwe shomoitukulwa itatu shi nokunangela pOshivelo shEkanghameno, novanhu aveshe ve nokukala momalupale okomesho yongulu yOmwene.
Ndelenee paha kale nande umwe ta i mongulu yOmwene, ovapristeli nOvalevi ava ve li moilonga, vo nava ye mo, shaashi ovo ovayapuki. Ndelenee ovanhu aveshe ve nokudiinina omalombwelo Omwene.
NOvalevi ve nokukala ofika nokudingilila ohamba, keshe umwe e noiti yaye meke laye, ndele ou ta i mo mongulu, e nokudipawa, ndele mu nokukala pohamba, yo ngeenge tai piti mo ile tai uya mo.”

Ovalevi nOvajuda aveshe va ninga ngaashi omupristeli Jehoiada e va lombwela: keshe umwe okwa kufa ovalumenhu vaye, ava ve nolufo okunangela navenya va dimbuka okunangela mefiku lEshabata. Osheshi omupristeli Jehoiada ina lekela eengudu.
Nomupristeli Jehoiada okwa yandja kovanefele omaonga noikelelifo inini noikelelifo yohamba David, oyo ya li mongulu yaKalunga.
Nokwa tula po ovakwaita aveshe, keshe umwe noiti yaye meke laye, okudja kombinga youmbuwanhu wongulu fiyo okombinga yokoumbangalanhu wongulu, fiyo okoaltari nokongulu, va dingilila ohamba.

Opo nee Jehoiada okwa eta Joas pondje, nde te mu dike oshishani nokwe mu pa embo lomhango youhamba. Ndele ve mu ninga ohamba. Ndele Jehoiada novana vaye ovalumenhu ve i vaeka ndele tava ti: “Ohamba nai kale nomwenyo!”
Ndele Atalia, eshi a uda ondaka yovanhu tava tondoka ndele tava kuwilile ohamba, okwe uya kovanhu mongulu yOmwene.

Ndele eshi a mona ohamba tai kala ofika monhele ya tumba poshivelo, novakulunhu novashiki vomanghuma va kala ofika pohamba, novanhu aveshe vomoshilongo va hafa ndele tava shiki omanghuma, novaimbi noishikomwa, fimbo tava wilike eimbilo lehambelelo, Atalia ta pombaula oikutu yaye ndele ta ti: “Ekengelelo! Ekengelelo!”

Ndelenee omupristeli Jehoiada okwa li ina hala Atalia a dipaelwe popepi notembeli. Onghee a ifana eendjai doita, nde ta ti: “Mu kwateni, mu mu pitifeni mo a upatwa kovaameni vomikweyo mbali. Ndele dipaeni keshe ou ta kendabala oku mu xupifa.”
Opo nee ove mu kwata, ndele eshi va fika pomhito yOshivelo Sheenghambe mombala, ove mu dipaa.
Ndele Jehoiada okwa ninga ehangano pokati kaye mwene novanhu aveshe nokutya, vo va ninge ovanhu vOmwene.
Ovanhu aveshe va ya motembeli yaBaal, ndele tave i ngumauna po, nova tataula po oaltari noiyelekelafano, nova dipaela Mattan, omupristeli waBaal, komesho yoaltari.

Omupristeli Jehoiada okwa tula vali ovanangeli pongulu yOmwene ve li mepangelo lOvalevi, novapristeli ovo David e va tukula eengudu okuyamba omaxwikiloyambo Omwene mongulu yOmwene nehafo nomaimbilo panghedimhango yaDavid, ngaashi pa shangwa momhango yaMoses.
Nokwa tula yo ovanangeli voivelo poivelo yongulu yOmwene, opo paha kale nande umwe ta dulu okuuya mo ngeenge e linyateka moshinima shonhumba ile shongadi.

Nokwa kufa ovanefele novalumenhu ovanamadina naavo va li ovakulunhu vovanhu, novanhu aveshe vomoshilongo, ndele a kufa ohamba mongulu yOmwene. Ndele va ya mo mongulu yohamba, va pita moshivelo shopombadelela, ndele va kaleka ohamba kolukalwapangelo.
Novanhu aveshe vomoshilongo va hafa, noshilando sha tulumukwa. Ndelenee va dipaa Atalia neongamukonda.
24: Omido daJoas da li heyali eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido omilongo nhee muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Sibja womuBerseba.
Ndele Joas okwa ninga osho sha wapalela moipafi yOmwene momafiku aeshe omupristeli Jehoiada.
Ndele Jehoiada okwe mu kongela ovalikadi vavali, nokwa dala ovana ovamati noukadona.
Konima yaashi Joas okwa diladila okuwapeka vali ongulu yOmwene.

Onghee hano a ongela ovapristeli nOvalevi ndele ta ti kuvo: “Indeni koilando yomuJuda ndele ongeleni oimaliwa kOvaisraeli aveshe, ongulu yaKalunga keni i wapekwe komudo nomudo. Noshilonga eshi shi endelelifeni!” Ndelenee Ovalevi inave shi endelelifa.

Opo nee ohamba ya ifana omupristeli omukulunhu Jehoiada ndele tai ti kuye: “Omolwashike ino kala noshisho nokutya, Ovalevi va etele etwali oundobwedi woimaliwa yomuJuda noyomuJerusalem, oimaliwa oyo yaMoses, omupiya wOmwene, naayo yeongalo lOvaisraeli?”
Osheshi ovana vomukolokoshi Atalia va panukila mo mongulu yaKalunga, ndele va kufa mo eeshali diyapuki domongulu yOmwene ndele ve di longifila ooBaal.
Hano palombwelo lohamba va pangela oshikefa ndele ve shi tula pondje poshivelo shongulu yOmwene.
Ndele va vilikila muJuda nomuJerusalem va etele Omwene oimaliwa oyo Moses, omupiya waKalunga e i lombwela Ovaisraeli mombuwa.
Opo nee ovakulunhu aveshe novanhu aveshe va hafa, ndele ve i eta ndele ve i ekela moshikefa fiyo sha yada.

Ndele alushe Ovalevi eshi va eta oshikefa kovakeleli va tulwa po kohamba, ndele va mona nokutya, oimaliwa i li mo ihapu, hamushanga wohamba nomupashukili a tulwa po komupristeli omukulunhu, va kufa mo oimaliwa moshikefa, ndele ve shi shunifa vali konhele yasho. Osho ngaha va ninga efiku nefiku ndele va ongela oimaliwa ihapu.

Nohamba naJehoiada ve i yandja kovalongifi ovo va pashukila oshilonga mongulu yOmwene. Ndele ovo va konga ovahongi vomamanya novahongi voiti va ningulule ongulu yOmwene, nosho yo ovahambwidi voivela naitwima va wapeke ongulu yOmwene.
Novalongifi voshilonga va diinina nawa, onghee oshilonga sha xuma komesho, ndele va wanifa ewapeko longulu yaKalunga pamhangela ya pangelwa ndele ve i wapeka.

Ndele vo eshi va mana, va etela ohamba naJehoiada oimaliwa oyo ya xupa po. Ndele oyo ya longifwa okuninga oinima yeyakulo noinima yeyambo noikwatelwa yoitwiminifo noinima yoingoldo noyoisiliveli. Ndele pomafiku aeshe aJehoiada va diinina okweetela ongulu yOmwene omaxwikiloyambo.
Ndele Jehoiada okwa kulupa nokwa kuta okukalamwenyo ndele ta fi. Omido daye pokufya kwaye da li efele nomilongo nhatu.
Nokwa pakwa peehamba moshilando shaDavid. Osheshi ye a ninga osho shiwa muIsrael naashi sha wapalela Kalunga nongulu yaye.
Ndele konima yefyo laJehoiada, ovakulunhu vaJuda ve uya ndele tave linyongamene koshipala shohamba. Opo nee ohamba ye va uda,
ndele va efa ongulu yOmwene Kalunga kooxe ndele va fimaneka omiti domalupwelele daAsera noikalunga. Opo nee ehandu le uya kombada yaJuda noyaJerusalem omolwetimba lavo.
Ndele Ye okwe va tumina ovaxunganeki ve va alule kOmwene. Ndele ove va londwela, ndelenee inave va uda.

Opo nee Omhepo yaKalunga ya yada Sakaria, omona womupristeli Jehoiada, nokwa kala ofika mokati kovanhu ndele ta ti kuvo: “Kalunga osho ta ti: ‘Omolwashike nye tamu tauluka oipango yOmwene nye mu mone omupya! Shaashi nye mwa ekelashi Omwene, naye yo e mu ekelashi.’ ”
Opo nee ve mu hangakena ndele tave mu dipaa nomamanya kelombwelo lohamba molupale lokomesho yongulu yOmwene.

Nohamba Joas inai diladila ouwa ye u monifwa kuJehoiada, xe yaSakaria, ndelenee okwa dipaa omona waye omulumenhu. Ndelenee pokufya kwaye oye okwe i lombwela: “Omwene ne shi tale ndele ne shi handukile!”
Ndele pexulilo lomudo etanga lovakwaita vaAram le mu homona, ndele ve uya muJuda nomuJerusalem, ndele va dipaa ovakulunhu aveshe voshiwana ndele va tuma oixuulwa yavo aishe kohamba yomuDamaskus.
Nande metanga lOvaarami olo le uya mwa li ovakwaita vanini, Omwene okwa yandja momake avo omatanga manene, shaashi Ovajuda va efa Omwene Kalunga kooxe. Ndele va handukila Joas noku mu tokola.

Ndele vo eshi va dja po puye, osheshi ve mu fiya po momahepeko madjuwelela, ovapiya vaye ve mu hangakena omolwohonde yomona womupristeli Jehoiada. Ndele ve mu dipaela mombete yaye. Nokwa pakwa moshilando shaDavid. Ndelenee inave mu paka meembila deehamba.
Ndele ovo ve mu hangakena ovava: Sabad yaSimeat, omona womukainhu Omuammoni naJosabad yaSimrit, omona womukainhu Omumoabi.

Novana vaye ovalumenhu nomaxunganeko mahapu tae mu popi newapeko longulu yaKalunga, tala, oinima aishe ei oya shangwa membo lefatululo lomishangwa deehamba. Nomona waye Amasia okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
25: Omido daAmasia, eshi a ninga ohamba, da li omilongo mbali nanhano, nokwa pangela omido omilongo mbali nomugoi muJerusalem. Edina laina oJehoadin Omujerusalem.
Nokwa ninga osho sha yuka moipafi yOmwene, ndelenee hanomutima aushe.
Nepangelo laye louhamba eshi la pama, okwa dipaa ovapiya vaye ovo va dipaa xe.
Ndelenee ina dipaa ovana vovadipai, ngaashi pa shangwa momhango yaMoses, omo Omwene ta ti: “Ooxe itava ka fila ovana vavo, novana itava ka fila ooxe. Ndelenee keshe umwe ota file etimba laye mwene.”

Opo nee Amasia a ongela Ovajuda nokwe va tula po pamapata avo, pavaneyovi nopavanefele, Ovajuda aveshe nOvabenjamin, nokwa hoolola ovo ve nomido omilongo mbali naavo ve di koya ndele ta mono nokutya, ovalumenhu ovahoololwa, ovo tava dulu okulongifa eonga noshikelelifo, ove fike pomayovi omafele atatu.
Nokwa ehela vali muIsrael ovaladi omayovi efele ye ta yandje eeshali doisiliveli yeekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane.

Opo nee omulumenhu umwe waKalunga e uya kuye, ndele ta ti: “Akutu, ohamba! Ino shi itavela, etanga lOvaisraeli li ende pamwe naave, osheshi Omwene ita kala pamwe nOvaisraeli, ita kala novana aveshe vaEfraim.
Ndelenee ngeenge oto i, fikama u kale wa nyatipala molwoodi. Ngeenge hasho, Kalunga ote ku efa u wile po moipafi yovatondadi. Osheshi Kalunga ta dulu okukwafa nokupundula.”

Ndelenee Amasia ta ti komulumenhu waKalunga: “Ndelenee eeshali doisiliveli yeekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane, nde di yandja kovakwaita Ovaisraeli, otadi ka ningwa ngahelipi?” Nomulumenhu waKalunga a nyamukula: “Omwene ta dulu oku ku pa shihapu shi dule oyo.”
Opo Amasia a lekela omatanga ovakwaita ava va dja kuEfraim va shune keenhele davo. Ndelenee va handukila unene Juda, ndele va shuna keenhele davo ve nehandu la xwama.
Ndelenee Amasia okwe linyatipaleka nokwa twala ovakwaita vaye mEfilu lomongwa, nokwa dipaa ovana vaSeir ve fike pomayovi omulongo.
Ovajuda va kwata eenghwate omayovi omulongo ve nomwenyo, ve va twala koxulo yomhunda ndele ve va undwila poshi, ndele aveshe va teyauka.

Ndelenee omatanga ovakwaita ovo Amasia a lekela va shune komaumbo avo vaha kale pamwe naye mokuhomona, ova ya moilando yomuJuda, okudja kuSamaria fiyo okuBet-Horon, ndele va dipaa omayovi atatu vomuvo ndele va twala oixuulwa ihapu.
Ndele Amasia eshi e uya keumbo eshi a taataa Ovaedom, okwa eta pamwe naye oikalunga yovana vaEdom nokwe i lidikila i ninge oikalunga yaye ndele okwe linyongamena kuyo ndele te i xwikile omayambo.
Opo nee ehandu lOmwene la xwamena Amasia, ndele Ye a tuma kuye omuxunganeki, ndele ye okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Omolwashike to kongo oikalunga yoshiwana osho, oyo ya nyengwa oku shi xupifa meke loye?”

Ndele fimbo ta popi naye, Amasia ta ti kuye: “Fye otwe ku tula po mbela, u ninge omupukululi wohamba? Mwena, oshike wa hala u dipawe?” Opo nee omuxunganeki a mwena ndele ta ti: “Ame ohandi dimbulukwa nokutya, Kalunga a hala oku ku nyonauna po, shaashi we shi ninga, ndelenee ino pwilikina epukululo lange.”
Ndele Amasia, ohamba yaJuda, eshi a kundafana novakulunhu, oya tuma kuJoas yaJoahas yaJehu, ohamba yaIsrael, tai ti: ila, tu lwe!

Ndelenee Joas, ohamba yaIsrael, ya shiivifila Amasia, ohamba yaJuda, tai ti: “Oshiyoosheuta shomuLibanon sha lombwela omusederi womuLibanon: ‘Omona woye okakadona, mu pa omumwange omumati, a ninge omwalikadi waye!’ Ndelenee oifitukuti i li mu Libanon, oya lyataula oshiyoosheuta nokweenda po kwayo.
Amasia, eshi wa finda Ovaedom, osho nee to linenepekele! Ame ohandi ku kunghilile u kale wa mwena meumbo. Omolwashike wa hala okweeta oudjuu, ove u kokele ovanhu naave mwene momupya?”
Ndelenee Amasia ina pwilikina. Osheshi oshinima eshi sha dja kuKalunga. Ye okwa li a hala oku ve liyandjela, shaashi ve likongela oikalunga vaEdom.
Opo nee Joas, ohamba yaIsrael, ya fikama, ndele va monafana puBet-Semes vo naAmasia, ohamba yaJuda.
Ndele Ovajuda va tewa kOvaisraeli, ndele va ya onhapo, keshe umwe keumbo laye.

Ndele Joas, ohamba yaIsrael, oya kwata puBet-Semes Amasia yaJoas yaAhasia, ohamba yaJuda, onghwate, ndele ye mu twala muJerusalem. Ndele a ngumauna po ohotekuma yaJerusalem oule wayo oshititano shi fike peemeta nhee, okudja koshivelo shaEfraim fiyo okoshivelo shokolonela.
Nokwa kufa oshingoldo ashishe noshisiliveli noinima aishe ya monika mongulu yaKalunga puObed-Edom, nomamona omongulu yohamba neenghwate, ndele ta shuna kuSamaria.
Ndele Amasia yaJoas, ohamba yaJuda, okwa kala nomwenyo konima yefyo laJoas yaJoahas, ohamba yaIsrael, omido omulongo nanhano.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Amasia, inya yotete naayo yaxuuninwa, inai shangelwa mbela membo leehamba daJuda nodaIsrael?
Ndele okudja kefimbo tuu olo Amasia eshi a amuka kOmwene, okwa hangakenwa muJerusalem, ndele okwa ya onhapo kuLakis. Ndele pa tumwa ovalumenhu ve mu shikula kuLakis, ndele ve mu dipaela ko.
Ndele oshimhu shaye ve shi londeka konghambe ndele okwa pakwa meembila deehamba moshilando shaDavid.
26: Opo nee ovanhu aveshe va kufa Ussia, omido daye da li pefimbo olo omido omulongo nahamano, ndele ve mu ninga ohamba ponhele yaxe Amasia.
Ye okwa tunga Elat nokwe shi alulila kuJuda, ohamba eshi ya ka nangala pooxe.
Omido daUssia da li omulongo nahamano ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela muJerusalem omido omilongo nhano nambali. Nedina laina la li Jekolia wokuJerusalem.
Nokwa ninga osho sha yuka momesho Omwene, naanaa ngaashi xe Amasia a ninga.
Nokwa konga Kalunga fimbo Sakaria okwa li e nomwenyo, ou a li e nounongo wokushiiva omamoniko aKalunga. Ndele pomafiku oo ye eshi a konga Omwene, Kalunga e mu pa elao.
Nokwa fikama ndele ta lwifa Ovafilisti nokwa ngumauna po ohotekuma yaGat nohotekuma yaJabne nohotekuma yaAsdod, ndele a tunga oilando moushiinda waAsdod nomokati kOvafilisti.
Ndele Kalunga okwe mu kwafa mokulwifa Ovafilisti nOvaarabi, ovo va kala muGur-Baal, nOvameuni.
NOvaammoni yo va fendela Ussia. Netumbalo laye la tandavela fiyo okuEgipiti, shaashi ye okwa li e neenghono dinene.
Ussia okwa tunga vali eehoteshungo muJerusalem pOshivelo Shokolonela nopOshivelo Shefilu nopOkolonela, nokwe di pameka.

Nokwa tunga yo eehoteshungo mombuwa ndele a panda eendungu dihapu domeva. Osheshi ye a li e noimuna ihapu medu la lalakana nomedu la tumba la lalakana, nokwa li e novalongi vepya novalongi voikokola yomiviinyu keemhunda nomedu loikunino, osheshi ye e hole oilonga yomapya.

Ussia okwa li e na vali omatanga ovakwaita va li moukwaita ndele va ya koita, pamatanga pamuvalo waava va li mokutalwa, wa shangwa komushangi Jeiel nokomupashukili Maasea, kewiliko laHanania, elenga limwe lomomalenga ohamba.
Omuvalo aushe wovakulunhu vomapata, wovaladi wa li omayovi avali nomafele ahamano.
Ndele mepangelo lavo mwa li omatanga ovakwaita ve fike pomayovi omafele atatu naaheyali nomafele atano, ovo tava dulu okulwifa neenghono adishe va kwafe ohamba okulwa nomutondadi.
Ndele Ussia okwa kongela ovakwaita aveshe oikelelifo nomaonga nomambale oivela noikutu yoivela nomauta noiumbifo yomamanya.

Nokwa ninga yo muJerusalem oilwifoshina, ya tungwa nondunge, ya tulwa meehoteshungo nomeekolonela dohotekuma, tai umbu oikuti nomamanya manene. Netumbalo laye la tandavela, osheshi a kwafa shili, oshikumwifa nokuli, fiyo a ninga omunaenghono.

Ndelenee ye eshi a ninga omunaenghono, omutima waye e u nenepeka, onghee a ninga osho inashi yuka nande, ndele a nyona kOmwene Kalunga kaye. Osheshi a ya mo motembeli yOmwene ndele ta twiminine oitwiminifo koaltari yokutwimina.
Ndelenee omupristeli Asaria okwe mu shikulila mo, novapristeli omilongo hetatu vOmwene, ovalumenhu ovaladi, va ya mo pamwe naye,

ndele va kelela ohamba Ussia ndele tava ti kuyo: “Kashi fi oshilonga shoye, Ussia, u twiminine Omwene oitwiminifo, ndelenee oshovapristeli, sholudalo laAron, ovo va yapulilwa okuyamba. Pita pondje, u dje motembeli, osheshi wa nyona, ndele eshi itashi ku etele efimano kOmwene Kalunga.”

Ndelenee Ussia okwa handuka unene, ndele a hangika e kwete oshikwatelwa shoitwiminifo meke laye. Ndele eshi a handukila ovapristeli, oudu woshilundu wa djuuka mombaba yoshipala shaye moipafi yovapristeli mongulu yOmwene poaltari yokutwimina.

Omupristeli omukulunhu Asaria novapristeli aveshe, eshi ve mu tala, va mona oudu woshilundu mombaba yoshipala shaye, ndele ve mu taataa mo diva, naye mwene yo okwa endelela a dje mo, osheshi Omwene e mu denga.

Nohamba Ussia ya li omunashilundu fiyo okefiku lefyo layo, ya kala mongulu ye likalela ngaashi ovanashilundu, osheshi yo ya kelelwa okuya kongulu yOmwene. Nomona waye Jotam ou a diinina eumbo lohamba, okwa pangela ovanhu vomoshilongo.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Ussia, yotete noyahauxuuninwa, oya shangwa komuxunganeki Jesaja yaAmos.
Ndele Ussia okwa ka nangala pooxe nokwa pakwa pooxe monhele yokupaka eehamba. Osheshi tava ti: “Ye omunashilundu.” Nomona waye Jotam okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
27: Omido daJotam da li omilongo mbali nanhano, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela muJerusalem omido omulongo nahamano. Nedina laina la li Jerusa, omona waSadok.
Nokwa ninga osho sha yuka momesho Omwene ngaashi xe Ussia a ninga. Ashike ina ya mo motembeli yOmwene. Ndelenee ovanhu va enda natango nokunyona.
Ye okwa tunga oshivelo shopombadelela shongulu yOmwene nokwa tunga unene ohotekuma yopuOfel.
Nokwa tunga vali oilando keemhunda daJuda nokwa tunga eehotengulu neehoteshungo momifitu.

Okwa lwifa yo ohamba yOvaammoni nokwe va ta, onghee ovana vaAmmoni ve mu pa momudo ou oisiliveli yeekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane nomahangu eetona eyovi noilyavala eetona eyovi. Ovana vaAmmoni ve i yandja yo kuye momudo omutivali nomomudo omutitatu.
Ndele Jotam okwa mona eenghono shaashi eendjila daye e di yukifa koshipala shOmwene Kalunga kaye.
Noinima imwe tai hepaululula Jotam, noita yaye aishe noilonga yaye aishe, tala, oya shangwa membo leehamba daIsrael nodaJuda.
Omido daye da li omilongo mbali nanhano ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela muJerusalem omido omulongo nahamano.
Ndele Jotam okwa ka nangala pooxe nokwa pakwa moshilando shaDavid. Nomona waye Ahas okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
28: Omido daAhas da li omilongo mbali ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela muJerusalem omido omulongo nanhano ndele ina ninga osho sha yuka momesho Omwene ngaashi xe David a ninga.
Ndelenee okwa enda neendjila deehamba daIsrael nokwa ningila Baal oitelekwafano.
Nokwa xwika omayambo mefilu laHinnom novana vaye e va xwika po nomundilo paixuna yoiwana ya tewa po kOmwene komesho yovana vaIsrael.
Nokwa yamba ndele ta twiminine oitwiminifo koikulundu nokomitune nopomuti keshe mutalala.

Onghee hano Omwene Kalunga kaye e mu yandja meke lohamba yaAram. Ndele vo ove mu ta ndele va kwata movakwaita vaye ongudu inene yeenghwate ndele ve va twala kuDamaskus. Ndele okwa yandjwa yo meke lohamba yaIsrael, ndele yo oye mu ta molwoodi linene.
Peka yaRemalja okwa dipaa muJuda mefiku limwe alike ovalumenhu ovaladi omayovi efele nomilongo mbali, shaashi vo ove liteeka Omwene, Kalunga kooxe.
Ndele Sikri, omuladi wokuEfraim, okwa dipaa Maasea, omona wohamba, naAsrikam, elenga leumbo lohamba, naElkana, ou a kala pohamba.
Novana vaIsrael va kwata ovamwaina vovakainhu novana ovamati noukadona ve fike pomayovi omafele avali ndele ve va twala eenghwate. Ndele va kufa kuvo oixuulwa ihapu ndele ve i twala kuSamaria.

Ndele oko kwa li omuxunganeki wOmwene, edina laye Oded. Nokwa ya okushakeneka omatanga ovakwaita ava ve uya kuSamaria, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Taleni, omolwoupyuhandu wOmwene, Kalunga kooxo eshi a handukila Juda, Ye okwe va yandja momake eni, ndele nye mwe va dipaa nehandu linene tali hange fiyo okeulu.
Ndele paife tamu diladila okuninga ovana vaJuda novaJerusalem ovapika veni ovalumenhu novakainhu. Kamu na nokuli mbela omanyonauno mahapu koshipala shOmwene Kalunga keni?
Pwilikinei nge paife, mu lekele eenghwate odo mwe di kufa kovamwaxo, va shune ko. Osheshi ehandu lOmwene li li kombada yeni!”
Opo nee ovalumenhu vamwe vomovakulunhu vovana vaEfraim va twa eemhata naava va dja koita nokutya, Asaria yaJohanan, Berekia yaMesillemot naJehiskia yaSallum naAmasa yaHadlai,
ndele tave va lombwele: “Inamu eta oku eenghwate, osheshi tamu tu velifa ombedi koshipala shOmwene. Osheshi okunyona kwetu okunene nehandu laye li li kombada yaIsrael.”
Ava va dililwa va efa hano eenghwate noixuulwa moipafi yovakulunhu noyoshiongalele ashishe.

Novalumenhu ava va tumbulwa pamadina avo va fikama ndele va tambula eenghwate ve di file oshisho, naaveshe ovo va li hamunghele mokati kavo va pewa oikutu yomoixuulwa. Ndele vo va pewa kuvo oikutu neenghaku ndele ve va pa okulya nokunwa ndele ve va vaeka ndele aveshe ava va loloka va londekwa keendongi ndele va twalwa kovamwaxe fiyo okuJeriko, oshilando shomilunga. Opo va shuna kuSamaria.
Pefimbo tuu olo ohamba Ahas ya tuma keehamba daAsiria, do di i kwafe.
Osheshi nOvaedom yo ve uya ndele va ta Juda ndele va kufa eenghwate.
NOvafilisti va luwa oilando yomoshilongo shoumbangalanhu waJuda. Ndele va nangala Bet-Semes naAijalon naGederot naSoko naTimna naGimso nomikunda dado ndele tava tula mo.
Osheshi Omwene a ninipika Juda omolwaAhas, ohamba yaIsrael, shaashi a tandavelifa okuhadulika ndele a kala ina diinina Omwene.
Ndele Tiglat-Pileser, ohamba yaAsiria, oye mu homona ndele ye mu fininika, ndele inai mu kwafa.
Osheshi Ahas okwa tinha ongulu yOmwene nongulu yohamba neengulu dovakulunhu, ndele oinima e i tuma kohamba yaAsiria, nande inya inai mu kwafa sha.
Nomefimbo tuu olo, eshi va fininika unene ohamba Ahas, yo ya nyona unene kOmwene,

ye okwa yambela oikalunga yomuDamaskus, oyo ya li ye mu taataa, ndele ta ti: “Shaashi oikalunga yeehamba daAram ye di kwafa, naame yo ohandi i yambele, opo i kwafe nge!” Ndelenee oyo tuu oyo ye mu twala noya twala Israel ashishe menyonauko.
Ndele Ahas okwa ongela oinima aishe yomongulu yaKalunga, noinima yomongulu yaKalunga e i teyaula po nokwa vika oivelo yongulu yOmwene, nokwe litungila eealtari monhele keshe yomuJerusalem.
Nomoilando aishe yomuJuda yo okwa tunga oikulundu yokuyambela oikalunga yoilongo nosho a handukifa Omwene Kalunga kooxe.
Noinima imwe tai mu hepaulula noilonga yaye aishe, yotete noyaxuuninwa, tala, oya shangwa membo leehamba daJuda nodaIsrael.
Ndele Ahas okwa ka nangala pooxe nokwa pakwa moshilando muJerusalem, osheshi inave mu paka meembila deehamba daIsrael. Nomona waye Hiskia okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
29: Omido daHiskia da li omilongo mbali nanhano, ye eshi a ninga ohamba nokwa pangela omido omilongo mbali nomugoi muJerusalem. Nedina laina la li Abia, omona waSakaria.
Nokwa ninga osho sha yuka moipafi yOmwene ngaashi xe David a ninga.
Momudo wotete wepangelo laye, mohani yotete ye okwa vikulula oivelo yongulu yOmwene nokwe i wapeka,
nokwa ifana ovapristeli nOvalevi ndele te va ongele mOnhele yokoushilo,
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ovalevi nye! Pwilikinei nge! Liyapuleni paife, ndele yapuleni ongulu yOmwene Kalunga kooxo, ndele kufeni mo ekako motembeli.
Osheshi ootate va nyona ndele va ninga osho inashi yuka moipafi yOmwene Kalunga ketu, ndele ve mu efa ndele va pilamena otembeli yOmwene ndele ve i pa ombuda.
Ova idila po yo oivelo yolupale lokomesho ndele va dima po eelamba ndele inava twimina oitwiminifo ndelenee inava yambela Kalunga kaIsrael omaxwikiloyambo motembeli.
Onghee hano ehandu lOmwene le uya kombada yaJuda noyaJerusalem nokwe va ninga etilifo noshikumwifa nesheko ngaashi mu shi wete nomesho eni vene.
“Ndele taleni, omolwoshinima eshi ootate va fya keongamukonda novana vetu ovamati noukadona, novalikadi vetu ve li moukwatwa.
Paife ndi nediladilo momutima wange: okuninga ehangano nOmwene, Kalunga kaIsrael, opo ehandu laye li kanduke po pufye.
Ovana vange ovalumenhu, paife inamu ongaonga vali. Osheshi Omwene e mu hoolola mu kale ofika koshipala shaye, mu mu longele, mu kale ovapiya vaye nokutwimina oitwiminifo.”
Opo nee Ovalevi va fikama: Mahat yaAmasai naJoel yaAsaria womovana vaKohat. Ndele movana vaMerari: Kis yaAbdi naAsaria yaJehallelel. Nomovana vaGerson: Joah yaSimma naEden yaJoah.
Nomovana vaElisafan: Simri naJehuel. Nomovana vaAsaf: Sakaria naMattanja.
Nomovana vaHeman: Jehiel naSimei. Nomovana vaJedutun: Shemaia naUsiel.
Ndele va ongela ovamwaina ndele ve liyapula ndele ve uya va ka wapeke ongulu yOmwene palombwelo lohamba, paendjovo dOmwene.

Novapristeli va ya meni lotembeli yOmwene ve i wapeke nekako alishe ve li hanga motembeli yOmwene, ve li twala pondje molupale lokomesho yongulu yOmwene. NOvalevi ve li kufa po ndele tave li twala pondje, kokamulonga Kidron.

Ndele va hovela okuyapula mefiku lotete mohani yotete ndele mefiku etihetatu lomohani va fika koshivelo shotete shOmwene ndele va yapula ongulu yOmwene momafiku ahetatu. Ndele mefiku etimulongo nahamano mohani yotete va xulifa oshilonga.
Opo nee va ya kohamba Hiskia ndele tava ti: “Fye otwa yapula ongulu aishe yOmwene, oaltari yomaxwikiloyambo noinima yayo noshitaafula shomingome detaliko noinima aishe yasho.
Noinima aishe oyo yo ohamba Ahas mefimbo lokupangela kwayo e i nyateka molwokunyona kwayo, fye twe i wapeka noku i yapula, ndele tala, oi li komesho yoaltari yOmwene.”
Opo nee ohamba Hiskia ya fikama ongula inene ndele tai ongele ovakulunhu voshilando, ndele va ya kongulu yOmwene.

Ndele va eta eengobe heyali deemhedi needi heyali deemhedi noudjona vaheyali noikombo iheyali ngaashi etimbayambo molwohamba nomolwotembeli nomolwaJuda. Ndele va lombwela oludalo laAron, ovapristeli, li di yambele koaltari yOmwene.
Opo nee va toma eengobe deemhedi, novapristeli va kufa ohonde ndele tave i tile koaltari, ndele va dipaa eedi, nohonde ve i tila koaltari, ndele va dipaa oudjona, nohonde ve i tila koaltari.
Opo nee va ehenifa po oikombo yetimbayambo koshipala shohamba nomoipafi yeongalo, ndele va tenheka omake avo kuyo.
Novapristeli ve i dipaa, nohonde yayo ngaashi etimbayambo ve i tila koaltari va kwatakanife Ovaisraeli aveshe. Osheshi ohamba ye va lombwela va yambele Israel ashishe exwikiloyambo netimbayambo.
Nokwa tula po Ovalevi mongulu yOmwene ve noosimbale nouxumbafeta neenyalilo pashipango shaDavid noshaGad, omumonikokule wohamba noshomuxunganeki Natan, osheshi Omwene e shi lombwela ovaxunganeki.
NOvalevi va kala ofika noishikomwa yaDavid, novapristeli ve nomanghuma oshikushu.

Ndele Hiskia okwa lombwela va yambe exwikiloyambo koaltari. Ndele eshi va hovela okuyamba exwikiloyambo, eimbilo lokuhambelela Omwene, nokushika omanghuma kwa hovela pawiliko loishikomwa yaDavid, ohamba yaIsrael.
Noshiongalele ashishe she linyongamena, eimbilo la udika, nomanghuma a shikwa, fiyo exwikiloyambo la pwa.
Ndele vo eshi va mana okuyamba, ohamba naaveshe ava va li puyo, ova twa eengolo ndele tave linyongamene.

Opo nee ohamba Hiskia novakulunhu va lombwela Ovalevi va hambelele Omwene neendjovo daDavid nodaAsaf, omumonikokule. Ndele va hovela nehafo eimbilo lehambelelo ndele ve linyongamena ndele tava ilikana.

Ndele Hiskia ta ti: “Paife mwe liyapulila Omwene. Ileni hano ndele eteleni ongulu yOmwene omatomenoyambo nomapanduloyambo.” Opo nee oshiongalele sha eta omatomenoyambo nomapanduloyambo, keshe umwe, ou a li e nehalo liwa, a eta exwikiloyambo.
Nomuvalu womaxwikiloyambo, a etwa koshiongalele, wa li eengobe omilongo heyali, eedi efele deemhedi, oudjona omafele avali; aishe oyo exwikiloyambo lOmwene.
Neeshali diyapuki oda li: eengobe deemhedi omafele ahamano needi omayovi atatu.

Ovapristeli ovo aveke va li vanini, va nyengwa okutoma omaxwikiloyambo aeshe. Ndelenee ovamwaina Ovalevi ve va kwafa, fiyo oshilonga sha pwa nofiyo ovapristeli ve liyapula voovene. Osheshi Ovalevi va li ve dule ovapristeli mouyuki wokomwenyo mokuliyapula.
Nomaxwikiloyambo yo kwa li mahapu pamwe nomakaadi omapanduloyambo noikunwayambo omaxwikiloyambo. Osho ngaha hano oilonga yomongulu yaKalunga ya pangelwa pamhangela yayo.
Ndele Hiskia noshiwana ashishe sha hafela osho Kalunga e shi ningila oshiwana shaye, osheshi sha ningwa moduduluka.
30: Ndele Hiskia okwa tumina Israel ashishe naJuda, ndele a shangela Efraim naManasse eenhumwafo, ve uye kongulu yOmwene muJerusalem va dane okufimaneka Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael oshivilo shaPaasa.
Nohamba novakulunhu vayo neongalo alishe lomuJerusalem va udafana va dane Opaasa mohani onhivali,
osheshi va nyengwa oku i dana mefimbo layo, shaashi ovapristeli ovo ve liyapula, inava wana, novanhu inava ongala muJerusalem.
Noshinima sha li sha yuka momesho ohamba nomomesho eongalo alishe.

Osho ngaha hano ova pangela omhangela va vilikile muIsrael ashishe okudja kuBerseba fiyo okuDan, nokutya ve nokuuya kuJerusalem, va dane Opaasa okufimaneka Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael. Osheshi inave i dana meongalo ngaashi sha pangelwa.

Eenhondoki da fikama hano ndele da ya muIsrael ashishe nomuJuda ndele da vilikila oshipango shohamba, tashi ti: “Nye Ovaisraeli, alukileni kOmwene Kalunga kaAbraham naIsak naIsrael, opo Ye a alukile kwaavo va xupa po munye ndele va xupifwa momake eehamba daAsiria.
Inamu kala ngaashi ooxo novamwanyoko, ovo va efa Omwene Kalunga kooxe, onghee va ninga oshitevo noshikumwifa ngaashi nye vene tamu shi mono.
Inamu kukutika eefingo deni ngaashi ooxo; yandjeni kOmwene omake ndele ileni kotembeli yaye, Ye e i yapula fiyo alushe, mu longele Omwene Kalunga keni, opo oupyuhandu waye u dje po punye.

Osheshi ngeenge nye tamu aluka kOmwene, ovamwanyoko novana veni tava ka filwa onghenda kwaava ve va twala ko eenghwate, vo va shiive okwaaluka moshilongo eshi. Osheshi Omwene Kalunga keni Ye e nolune nonghenda, ndele ita ka pungulula oshipala shaye kunye, nye ngeenge tamu aluka kuye.”
Ndelenee eenhondoki eshi da enda noilando koilando medu laEfraim nolaManasse fiyo okuSebulon, ove di yola ndele ve di sheka.
Ndelenee ovalumenhu vamwe vomuAsser naManasse nomuSebulon ve lininipika ndele va ya kuJerusalem.
MuJuda yo eke laKalunga la longa, onghee ve liyandja nomutima umwe, va wanife oshipango shohamba noshovakulunhu pandjovo yOmwene.
Novanhu vahapu va ongala muJerusalem va dane oshivilo shomungome uhe nonhafi, mohani onhivali, heeno, oshiongalele shinene.
Ndele va fikama ndele va hanauna po eealtari domuJerusalem. Nosho eealtari adishe dokutwimina ve di hanauna po ndele ve di ekela mokamulonga Kidron.
Mefiku etimulongo netine mohani onhivali va dipaa odi yaPaasa. Novapristeli nOvalevi va fya ohoni ndele ve liyapula ndele va eta omaxwikiloyambo mongulu yOmwene.
Ndele va ya va ka kale ofika meenhele davo palombwelo lomhango yaMoses, omulumenhu waKalunga, fimbo ovapristeli va tambula ohonde momake Ovalevi, ndele ve i tila.
Osheshi moshiongalele mwa li vahapu inave liyapula, onghee hano Ovalevi va li ve nokutoma omatomenoyambo ponhele yakeshe ou ina yapulwa, opo ve va yapulile Omwene.

Osheshi vahapu unene vomovanhu va dja muEfraim nomuManasse, muIsaskar nomuSebulon, inave liyapula, ndele va lya odi yaPaasa hapanghedi yayo. Ndelenee Hiskia okwe va ilikanena ndele ta ti: “Omwene muwa na kufile po
keshe umwe a yukifa omutima waye okukonga Kalunga, Omwene Kalunga kooxe, nande ehe neyapulo lopatembeli.”
NOmwene okwa uda Hiskia ndele a velula ovanhu.

Osho ngaha hano ovana vaIsrael ovo va li muJerusalem, ova dana oshivilo shomingome dihe nonhafi omafiku aheyali nehafo linene, fimbo Ovalevi novapristeli va hambelela Omwene efiku nefiku noishikomwa i neenghono okefimano lOmwene.

Ndele Hiskia okwa popifa nombili Ovalevi aveshe, ava va wanifa oilonga yavo paunongo wokufimaneka Omwene. Nomafiku aheyali va lya omayambo oshivilo ndele va yamba omapanduloyambo, ndele tava hambelele Omwene Kalunga kooxe.
Neongalo alishe eshi la udafana va dane vali oshivilo omafiku aheyali, vo ova dana nehafo oshivilo natango omafiku aheyali.

Osheshi Hiskia, ohamba yaJuda, ya yandja koshiongalele eengobe deemhedi eyovi needi omayovi aheyali. Novakulunhu va yandja koshiongalele eengobe deemhedi eyovi needi omayovi omulongo. Novapristeli vahapu ve liyapula.
Noshiongalele ashishe shOvajuda sha hafa, novapristeli yo nOvalevi noshiongalele ashishe yo shaava va dja muIsrael. Novanailongo yo va dja medu laIsrael naava va kala muJuda.
Ndele muJerusalem mwa li ehafo linene. Osheshi okomafiku enya aSalomo yaDavid, ohamba yaIsrael, oshinima sha tya ngaha inashi ningwa muJerusalem.
Opo nee ovapristeli nOvalevi va kala ofika ndele tava nangeke ovanhu noupuna. Nondaka yavo ya udika, nomaindilo avo a fika keumbo laye liyapuki lomeulu.
31: Ndele ashishe osho eshi sha xula po, Ovaisraeli aveshe ava va li po, va ya koilando yaJuda ndele va tataula po omiti neengudimanya, omalupwelele aAsera ve a ka po, noikulundu neealtari muJuda ashishe nomuBenjamin nomuEfraim nomuManasse ve i ngumauna po fiyo ve i hanauna po sheke. Opo nee ovana aveshe vaIsrael va shuna, keshe umwe, koshilongo shavo nokoshilando shavo.

Ndele Hiskia okwa tula po eengudu dovapristeli nodOvalevi paengudu davo, pashilonga shakeshe umwe ngeenge paupristeli ile paulevi, okuyakula nokupandula nokuhambelela poivelo yonhanda yOmwene fimbo omaxwikiloyambo nomapanduloyambo taa yambwa.
Oyo ohamba ya yandja yomoinima yayo, ya yamba ongaashi omaxwikiloyambo, omayambo ongula nonguloshi nomomashabata, momafiku ohani ipe nomoivilo, ngaashi mwa shangwa momhango yOmwene.
Ndele ya lombwela ovanhu, oonakukalamo muJerusalem nokutya, ve nokuyandja kovapristeli nokOvalevi oitukulwayandjiwa yavo, opo va shiive okuyapulila omhango yOmwene eenghono davo adishe.

Noshipango osho eshi sha tandavela, ovana vaIsrael va yandja oshipe shihapu shomoilya noshomaviinyu noshomaadi, noshomaadi eenyiki noshoinima aishe yomepya, ndele va eta oitimulongo ihapu yomoinima aishe.
Novana vaIsrael ovo va kala moilando yaJuda naavo yo va eta oitimulongo yomeengobe noyomeedi noitimulongo yeeshali diyapuki odo da yapulilwa Omwene Kalunga kavo ndele ve di tula meenduba.
Mohani onhinhatu va hovela okundubila, ndele mohani onhiheyali va mana.
Hiskia novakulunhu eshi ve uya ndele va mona eenduba, ova pandula Omwene novanhu vaye Israel.
Ndele Hiskia eshi a pula kovapristeli nokOvalevi, a pulila eenduba,

omupristeli omukulunhu Asaria womepata laSadok, okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Okudja kefiku olo va hovela okweetela otembeli yOmwene eeshali, fye twa lya ndele twa kuta, ndele natango shihapu sha xupa po. Osheshi Omwene okwa nangeka oshiwana shaye noupuna, onghee eshi shihapu osha xupa po.”
Opo nee Hiskia e va lombwela va tungile mongulu yOmwene omalimba. Ndele va tunga.
Neeshaliyambo noitimulongo neeshali diyapuki ve i twala mo nokudiinina. Nomukulunhu wayo ou a tulwa po Konanja, Omulevi, nomumwaina Simei ponho yaye.

Ndele palombwelo lohamba Hiskia nolaAsaria, omupristeli omukulunhu wotembeli yaKalunga; Jehiel, Asasia, Nahat, Asahel, Jerimot, Josabad, Eliel, Jismakja, Mahat naBenaja va li ovayakuli vaKonanja novomumwaina Simei.
NOmulevi Kore yaJimna, ou a li omunangeli woshivelo shokoushilo, a diinina eeshali dehalo liwa, da etelwa Kalunga nokwa li ha tukula eeshaliyambo dOmwene neeshali diyapukielela.
Ndele mewiliko laye mwa li Eden, Minjamin, Josua, Shemaia, Amarja naSekanja, ava va li ve nokutukulila noudiinini oovakwao ve li moilando yovapristeli, ovanyasha novakulunhu, oitukulwa paengudu,
ava inava valwa meshikulafano lepata, ovo ovalumenhu vomido nhatu naavo ve di koya, hava i kongulu yOmwene, omafiku olufo lavo, nongaashi va li ve noinakuwanifwalonga yavo paengudu.
Meshikulafano lepata lovapristeli, ovapristeli va shangwa mo pamaumbo nOvalevi ovo ve nomido omilongo mbali ile ve di koya, painakuwanifwalonga yavo paengudu.
Meshikulafano lepata lovapristeli mwa shangwa ovana vavo aveshe vanini, ovalikadi vavo novana vavo ovamati noukadona, ongudu yavo aishe, shaashi va diinina shili osho shiyapuki.

Ovapristeli, oludalo laAron, ovo va kala moulifilo woilando va li ve novalumenhu moshilando, va tumbulwa kedina ovo va li ve nokutukulila ovalumenhu aveshe vomokati kovapristeli nOvalevi aveshe ovo va shangwa meshikulafano lepata oitukulwa yavo.
Osho ngaha Hiskia a ninga muJuda ashishe. Ye okwa ninga osho sha wapala nosha yuka noshoudiinini koshipala shOmwene, Kalunga kaye.
Naashishe, osho e shi ninga mokukonga Kalunga kaye, ngee oshilonga shongulu yaKalunga ile omhango ile oipango, ye e shi ninga nomutima aushe, nokwa li e nelao.
32: Konima yoinima ei noyokweenda kwa yuka kwaHiskia, Sanheerib, ohamba yaAsiria, ye uya, ndele tai homona Juda, ndele ya fitikinina oilando yomusho i neehotekuma ndele ya hala oku i nangala.
Ndele Hiskia eshi a mona nokutya Sanheerib ote uya nokwa hala okuhomona Jerusalem,
okwa kundafana novakulunhu vaye novaladi vaye a fitike po eefifiya di li pondje yoshilando. Ndele vo ove mu kwafa.
Novanhu vahapu va ongala ndele va fitika po eefifiya, nosho yo okamulonga taka tondokele mokati koshilongo, ndele tava ti: “Omolwashike eehamba daAsiria mokuuya kwado di mone omeva mahapu?”

Nokwe linyatipaleka nokwa tungulula ohotekuma ya li ya ngumaunwa po, ndele ta tungu kuyo eeshungongulu. Nokwa tunga yo ohotekuma onhivali pondje. Nokwa tunga eehote muMillo shomoshilando shaDavid ndele ta hambulifa omaonga noikelelifo ihapu.
Nokwa tula po ovakulunhu vomatanga ovakwaita, nokwe va ifana kuye monhele ya lalakana yoposhivelo shoshilando ndele te va hekeleke, ta ti:
“Kaleni mwa pama, mwa nyatipala. Inamu tila ndele inamu haluka molwohamba yaAsiria ile molwongudu aishe oyo tai uya pamwe nayo. Osheshi ava ve li pufye ovahapu, ve dule venya ve li puyo.
Puyo ope nokwooko kwombelela, ndelenee pufye ope nOmwene Kalunga ketu te tu kwafa mokulwa moita yetu!” Novakwaita ve lineekela eendjovo daHiskia, ohamba yaJuda.

Konima yaashi Sanheerib, ohamba yaAsiria, ya tuma, osheshi yoovene nomatanga ayo aeshe ovakwaita va li puLakis, ya tuma ovapiya vayo kuJerusalem, kuHiskia, ohamba yaJuda, nokOvajuda aveshe ovo va li muJerusalem, oku va lombwela:
“Sanheerib, ohamba yaAsiria, tai ti ngaha: ‘Tamu lineekele lyelye, eshi tamu kala mwe liidilila muJerusalem?
Hiskia ite mu pukifa mbela, mu fye ondjala nenota, ye eshi ta ti: “Omwene Kalunga ketu te ke tu xupifa mo meke lohamba yaAsiria?”
Hiskia oye tuu ou, ndishi, a hanauna po oikulundu yaye neealtari daye nokwa lombwela Juda naJerusalem: “Mu nokutwa eengolo koaltari imwe aike, nokutwimina kuyo?”
Kamu shi shii eshi ame nootate va ningila oiwana aishe yoilongo? Oikalunga yoiwana yoilongo oya xupifa tuu oilongo yayo meke lange?
Olyelye womoikalunga yoiwana oyo aishe ya hanaunwa po kootate, ya dula okuxupifa oshiwana shaye meke lange opo Kalunga keni a dule oku mu xupifa meke lange?

Inamu itavela Hiskia e mu kengelele ndele te mu pukifa ngaha. Ndele inamu mu lineekela, osheshi kalunga nande kamwe koiwana ile koshilongo nande shimwe, ina xupifa oshiwana shaye meke lange ile momake ootate. Hano ngahelipi Kalunga keni ta dulu oku mu xupifa meke lange?’ ”
Ovapiya vayo va popya eendjovo dimwe dihapu dondubo nokusheka Omwene Kalunga nomupiya waye Hiskia.

Ndele yo oya shanga yo onhumwafo i sheke Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael nokupopya Omwene nokutya: “Ngaashi oikalunga yoiwana yoilongo ya nyengwa okuxupifa oiwana yayo meke lange, osho yo Kalunga kaHiskia ita ka xupifa ovanhu vaye meke lange.”
Ndele vo ova popya mOshiheberi kovakwaita vomuJerusalem, ve li kekuma lohote, opo va tilifwe nokuhaluka, venya va dule okunangala oshilando shavo.
Ndele va popya Kalunga kaJerusalem ngaashi oikalunga imwe yoiwana yokombada yedu, nande yo oilonga yomake ovanhu.
Ndelenee ohamba Hiskia nomuxunganeki Jesaja yaAmos, eshi va ilikanena oshiwana eshi ndele va kuwa keulu,

Omwene okwa tuma omweengeli, ndele a dipaa ovaladi aveshe novakulunhu vomatanga novaneyovi vomonhanda yohamba yaAsiria, onghee yo ya li i nokushuna nokufya ohoni koshilongo shayo. Ndele yo eshi ye uya mongulu yakalunga kayo, ovo va dja molutu layo vene, ve i dipaa neongamukonda.
NOmwene okwa xupifa Hiskia noonakukala muJerusalem meke laSanheerib, ohamba yaAsiria nomomake aveshe. Ndele Ye e va twala metulumuko keembinga adishe.
Ndele vahapu va etela Omwene muJerusalem eeshali neeshali di nondilo kuHiskia, ohamba yaJuda, onghee ye a tumbalekwa moipafi yoiwana aishe.
Pomafiku enya Hiskia okwa hangika koudu, hanga a fya. Ndelenee okwa indila kOmwene ndele Ye okwe mu nyamukula ndele e mu pa edidiliko loshikumwifa.
Ndelenee ouwa ye e u pewa, Hiskia ine u alulila ouwa, osheshi omutima waye we linenepeka. Onghee hano ehandu la kala kombada yaye nokombada yaJerusalem.
Ndelenee melinenepeko laye Hiskia okwe lininipika nomutima aushe, ye mwene noonakukala muJerusalem, onghee hano ehandu lOmwene inali uya kombada yavo pomafiku aa aHiskia.
Ndele Hiskia okwa li e noupuna muhapu unene netumbalo nokwe litungila omalimba emona loisiliveli noloingoldo nolomamanya mawa noloinima yedimba liwa noloikelelifo noinima i lili nai lili i nondilo,
nomaanda oilya nomaviinyu nomaadi, neenhele doimuna yomaludi e lili nae lili, noyuunda yoimuna.
Okwe litungila yo oilando nokwe likongela eengudu dinene deedi nodeengobe, osheshi Kalunga e mu pa emona lihapu.
Hiskia tuu ou a fitika po omakungulukilo omeva okamulonga kaGihon nokwe a popolela koshi kwi lwokouninginino koshilando shaDavid. Ndele Hiskia okwa li e nelao mwaashishe e shi ninga.
Onghee hano Kalunga e mu tala, opo a shiive ashishe osho shi li momutima waye, okwe mu yandja momake ovatumwa veehamba daBabilon, ovo va tuminwa okupula oshikumwifa osho sha ningwa moshilongo.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Hiskia noilonga yaye youyuki, tala, oya shangwa membo lomuxunganeki Jesaja yaAmos, membo leehamba daJuda nodaIsrael.

Ndele Hiskia okwa ka nangala pooxe, nokwa pakwa moshikulundu kusho taku londwa eshi taku iwa keembila doludalo laDavid. Ndele Juda ashishe noonakukala muJerusalem ve mu fimaneka pokufya kwaye. Nomona waye Manasse okwa ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
33: Omido daManasse da li omulongo nambali ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela muJerusalem omido omilongo nhano nanhano.
Nokwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene paixuna yoiwana oyo ya tewa kOmwene momesho Ovaisraeli.
Nokwa tungulula vali oikulundu, oyo ya ngumaunwa po kuxe Hiskia, nokwa dikila Baal eealtari nomiti omalupwelele ndele te linyongamene moipafi yeengudu adishe dokeulu noku di fimaneka.
Nokwa tunga yo eealtari mongulu yOmwene, odo Omwene e di popya: “Edina lange tali ka kala fiyo alushe muJerusalem.”
Nokwa tungila eengudu adishe dokeulu eealtari moihale aishe ivali yokomesho yongulu yOmwene.

Naye mwene yo okwa endifa ovana vaye ovamati momundilo mefilu lomona waHinnom. Nokwa xunganeka omadidiliko ndele ta nyanekele nokwa tula po ovo hava pula keemhepo dovafi ndele tava mono kokule. Okwa ninga shihapu osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene, a handukifa Omwene.

Nokwa tula yo mongulu yaKalunga oshihongwafano shoshikalunga, e shi ninga, osho sha tongwa kuKalunga e shi lombwela David nomona waye Salomo: “Mongulu ei nomuJerusalem, nde shi hoolola mo momapata aeshe aIsrael, Ame ohandi ka tula mo edina lange fiyo alushe.

Ndele ihandi ka kandula vali omhadi yaIsrael medu olo, Ame nde li sheyela ooxe, vo ngeenge hava diinine shili ashishe osho nde shi va lombwela pamhango aishe nopaenghedimhango nopamalombwelo, Ame nda pa Moses.”
Ndelenee Manasse okwa hongaula Juda noonakukala muJerusalem okunyona unene, ku dule okunyona kwoiwana oyo Omwene e i hanauna po komesho yaIsrael.
NOmwene okwa popifa Manasse novanhu vaye, ndelenee inava pwilikina.
Onghee hano Omwene a tuma ovakulunhu vomatanga novakwaita vohamba yaAsiria, ve va lwife. Ndele vo ova kwata Manasse neengona ndele ve mu manga nomalyenge oshikushu ndele ve mu twala kuBabilon.
Ndelenee moudjuu waye okwa konga onghenda koshipala shOmwene Kalunga kaye nokwe lininipika shili koshipala shaKalunga kooxe,
ndele te mu indile. Ndele Ye okwe mu uda ndele ta pwilikine omaindilo aye nokwe mu shunifa mouhamba waye muJerusalem. Opo nee Manasse a hepaulula nokutya, Omwene Ye oKalunga.

Ndele konima yaashi okwa tunga ohotekuma yopondje yoshilando shaDavid, kouninginino waGihon mefilu fiyo okomhito yokuya kOshivelo sheeshi, nokwe i tunga tai dingilile Ofel, ndele te i ningi ile ya ya pombada. Nokwa tula ovakulunhu vomatanga novakwaita moilando aishe yomuJuda i neehotekuma.

Nokwa hanauna po oikalunga yoilongo noshihongwafano shoshikalunga mongulu yOmwene, nosho a ngumauna po eealtari adishe e di tunga komhunda yongulu yOmwene nomuJerusalem, ndele te i ekele pondje yoshilando.
Nokwa tungulula vali oaltari yOmwene ndele a yambela ko vali omapanduloyambo nomahambeleloyambo ndele ta lombwele Ovajuda, va longele Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael.
Ovanhu va yamba vali koikulundu, ndelenee va yambela Omwene Kalunga kavo aeke
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Manasse neindilo laye eshi ta indile Kalunga neendjovo dovamonikokule odo ve di mu lombwela medina lOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael, tala, oyo i li mehepaululo leehamba daIsrael.

Neindilo laye nanhumbi la udika, nomatimba aye aeshe neliteeko laye neenhele oko a tunga oikulundu yokuyambela nokwa dikila omiti omalupwelele aAsera noihongwafano, fimbo ine lininipika, tala, oyo oya shangwa mehepaululo laHosea.
Ndele Manasse okwa ka nangala pooxe, nokwa pakwa mongulu yaye. Nomona waye Amon a ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
Omido daAmon da li omilongo mbali nambali eshi a ninga ohamba. Nokwa pangela omido mbali muJerusalem.
Nokwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene, ngaashi xe Manasse a ninga. Ndele Amon okwa yambela oihongwafano aishe oyo ya ningwa kuxe Manasse nokwe i fimaneka.
Ndelenee ye ine lininipika koshipala shOmwene ngaashi xe Manasse e lininipika. Ndelenee Amon okwa hapupalifa oulunde waye.
Novapiya vaye ve mu hangakena ndele ve mu dipaa mongulu yaye.
Ndelenee ovanhu voshilongo va dipaa aveshe ava va hangakena ohamba Amon, novanhu voshilongo va ninga omona waye Josia ohamba ponhele yaye.
34: Omido daJosia da li hetatu, ye eshi a ninga ohamba. Nokwa pangela omido omilongo nhatu naumwe muJerusalem.
Nokwa ninga osho sha yuka momesho Omwene nokwa enda neendjila daxe David, ndele ina kanduka mo nande kolulyo ile kolumosho.

Ndele momudo omutihetatu wepangelo laye, fimbo ye omunyasha natango, okwa hovela okukonga Kalunga kaxe David, ndele momudo omutimulongo nomutivali okwa hovela okuyapula Juda naJerusalem nokukufa mo oikulundu yokuyambela nomiti omalupwelele aAsera noihongwafano noitelekwafano.

Ndele moipafi yaye va ngumauna po eealtari daBaal. Neengudi detango da li ko, okwe di xwandaula, nokwa teyaula po omiti omalupwelele aAsera noihongwafano noitelekwafano nokwe i twa oufila ndele te i undu keembila daava va li ve i yambela.
Nomakipa ovapristeli e a xwika po keealtari davo nokwa yapula Juda naJerusalem.
Nomoilando yomuManasse noyomuEfraim noyomuSimeon nofiyo okuNaftali nomatemo avo

okwa ngumaunifa po eealtari davo nomiti omalupwelele aAsera noihongwafano okwe i nyanyaula ya ninga oufila neengudi adishe detango domoshilongo shaIsrael, okwe di ka po. Opo nee ye a aluka e uya kuJerusalem.

Ndele momudo omutimulongo nahetatu womepangelo laye, mokuyapula kwaye oshilongo notembeli, okwa tuma Safan yaAsalia naMaasea, omukulunhu woshilando naJoah yaJoahas, elenga ekulunhu, va yapule ongulu yOmwene Kalunga kaye.

Vo eshi ve uya komupristeli omukulunhu Hilkia, ova yandja oimaliwa oyo ya etelwa ongulu yaKalunga, oyo ya ongelwa kOvalevi ovanangeli vopoivelo, ve i ongela muManasse nomuEfraim nomoixupe yOvaisraeli nomuJuda ashishe nomuBenjamin nomoonakukalamo muJerusalem.
