Vo ove i yandja kovalongifi ovo va tulwa po va pashukile oilonga yomongulu yOmwene, ndele ava ve i yandja kovalongi ava hava longo mongulu yOmwene va wapaleke ongulu noku i vandeka.
Ndele ve i yandja kovahongi voipilangi nokovatungi, va lande omamanya a hongwa nomiti doikonde nodeemhati deengulu odo da nyonwa po keehamba daJuda.

Novalumenhu ava va longa oshilonga shavo palineekelo. Ovapashukili vavo va li: Jahat naObadja, Ovalevi vomovana vaMerari. NaSakaria naMesullam vomovana vaKohat, va wilika, nOvalevi aveshe ovo ve shi kushika oishikomwa,
umwe okwa pashukila ovahumbati vomitengi, nomukwao okwa wilika ovalongi aveshe moshilonga keshe. Ovashangi novapashukili novanangeli poivelo va li vomOvalevi.
Vo eshi va twala oimaliwa ya etelwa ongulu yOmwene, omupristeli Hilkia okwa mona embo lomhango yOmwene, oyo ya yandjwa kuMoses.
Opo nee Hilkia ta ti komushangi Safan: “Ame nda mona embo lomhango mongulu yOmwene.” Opo nee Hilkia a yandja embo lomhango kuSafan.
Ndele Safan okwa twala embo kohamba nokwe i fatululila oshinima osho, ndele ta ti: “Aishe, ovapiya voye va pewa va longe, ove i wanifa:
oimaliwa oyo ya li mongulu yOmwene ve i kufa mo ndele ve i yandja kovapashukili voshilonga nokovalongifi.”
Opo nee omushangi Safan ta shiivifile ohamba ndele tai ti: “Omupristeli Hilkia okwa pa nge embo limwe.” Ndele Safan okwa lesha mo, a leshela ohamba.
Nohamba eshi ya uda eendjovo domhango, oya pombaula oikutu yayo;
nohamba ya lombwela Hilkia naAhikam yaSafan naAbdon yaMika nomushangi Safan naAsasia, omupiya wohamba, ndele tai ti:

“Indeni mu ka pule kOmwene molwange nomolwaava va xupa po muIsrael nomuJuda, omolweendjovo domembo eli la monika. Osheshi oupyuhandu wOmwene ou wa tilwashi kombada yetu munene, shaashi ootate inava diinina ondjovo yOmwene, va ende mwaashishe sha shangwa membo eli.”

Opo nee Hilkia naava va tumwa kohamba, va ya komuxunganeki omukainhu Hulda, omwalikadi waSallum yaTokhat yaHasra, omudiinini woikutu, ye a kala muJerusalem, moshilando Shipe, ndele ve mu lombwela ngaha.
Opo nee ye ta ti kuvo: “Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha: ‘Lombwela omulumenhu ou e mu tuma kwaame,
Omwene ta ti ngaha: Tala, Ame ohandi tumu omupya kombada yonhele ei nokombada yoonakukalamo muyo, handi tumu omatulomutima aeshe a shangwa mo membo, mwe li leshela ohamba yaJuda.
Osheshi mwe liteeka nge ndele mwa twiminina oikalunga imwe, mu handukife nge noilonga yeni aishe yomake eni, onghee hano oupyuhandu wange tau ka tilwashi kombada yonhele ei, ndele itau ka dimwa po.
Ndelenee lombweleni ohamba yaJuda, oyo ye mu tuma mu pule kOmwene: Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ta ti ngaha: Omolweendjovo odo we di uda

omutima woye eshi wa pupala ndele ove we lininipika koshipala shaKalunga, eshi wa uda eendjovo daye te di popile onhele ei noonakukala muyo, ndele we lininipika koshipala shange, ndele wa pombaula oikutu yoye ndele wa lila koshipala shange, onghee hano nde ku uda, Omwene ta ti.

Tala, Ame ohandi ke ku ongela pooxo, ndele to ka pakwa nombili mombila yoye, nomesho oye itaa ka tala omupya aushe ou, Ame ohandi ke u tumina onhele ei noonakukala muyo.’ ” Ndele vo ova twalela ohamba enyamukulo.
Opo nee ohamba ya ifana ovakulunhu aveshe vomuJuda novomuJerusalem.

Nohamba oya ya kongulu yOmwene novalumenhu aveshe vaJuda noonakukalamo muJerusalem novapristeli nOvalevi novanhu aveshe, ovakulunhu novanyasha, ndele yo oya leshela momatwi avo eendjovo adishe domembo lehangano olo la monika mongulu yOmwene.

Nohamba oya ya tai kala ofika ponhele yayo ndele ya ninga ehangano koshipala shOmwene nokutya, yo tai shikula Omwene ndele tai diinine oipango yaye neendobwedi daye neenghedimhango daye nomutima aushe wayo nomwenyo aushe wayo, i wanife eendjovo dehangano, odo da shangwa membo olo.
Ndele ya tambula mehangano aveshe ava va monika muJerusalem nomuBenjamin. Noonakukalamo muJerusalem ova ninga ngaashi ehangano laKalunga, Kalunga kooxe, tali pula.

Ndele Josia okwa hanauna po oixuna aishe yomomikunda adishe dovana vaIsrael, naaveshe ovo va monika muIsrael ye okwe va fininika okulongela Omwene Kalunga kavo. Pomafiku aeshe aye, vo inava kanduka mOmwene Kalunga kooxe.
35: Konima yoinima ei Josia okwa dana muJerusalem oshivilo shaPaasa okufimanekifa Omwene. Ndele va dipaa odi yaPaasa mefiku etimulongo netine mohani yotete.
Nokwa tula ovapristeli moilonga yavo ndele te va nyatipaleke okulonga mongulu yOmwene.

Nokwa lombwela Ovalevi ava va longa Ovaisraeli aveshe ndele ovo va li ve liyapulila Omwene: “Tuleni oshikefa shiyapuki mongulu oyo Salomo yaDavid, ohamba yaIsrael, e i tunga. Itamu pumbwa vali oku shi humbata komapepe. Longeleni paife Omwene Kalunga keni novanhu vaye Ovaisraeli.
Ndele kaleni mwe lilongekida pamapata eni paengudu deni ngaashi David, ohamba yaIsrael, ya pangela omhangela nopalombwelo lomona waye Salomo:
indeni mo mu kale ofika motembeli paengudu domapata ovamwaxo, ovakweni, nokutya opamalufo omatanga omapata Ovalevi.
Ndele dipaeni odi yaPaasa mu liyapule, ndele i longekidileni oovakweni mu longe pandjovo yOmwene, e i lombwela Moses.”

Ndele Josia okwa yandja kovanhu vomoshiwana oimuna: oudjona veedi noukombwena, aveshe ovo omayambo aPaasa, kwaaveshe ava va li po, ve fike pomayovi omilongo nhatu, neengobe deemhedi omayovi atatu. Odo adishe oda li dohamba.

Nomalenga yo a yandja kovanhu, kovapristeli nokOvalevi. Hilkia naSakaria naJehiel, ovakulunhu vongulu yaKalunga, ova yandja kovapristeli omayambo aPaasa eedi omayovi avali nomafele ahamano neengobe deemhedi omafele atatu.
Ndele Konanja novamwaina Shemaia naNetanel naHasabja naJeiel naJosabad, ovakulunhu vOvalevi va yandja omayambo aPaasa eedi omayovi atano, neengobe deemhedi omafele atano.
Elongelokalunga ola ningwa ngaha: ovapristeli va kala ofika ponhele yavo, nOvalevi paengudu davo palombwelo lohamba.
Opo nee va dipaa odi yaPaasa, novapristeli va tambula ohonde momake Ovalevi ndele ve i tilashi. Ndelenee Ovalevi va yuva
ndele va tukula mo osho shokexwikiloyambo, ve shi yandje kovanhu vomoshiwana pamaumbo avo, ve shi yambele Omwene, ngaashi pa shangwa membo laMoses. Nosho yo va ninga neengobe.
Ndele va yofa odi yaPaasa komundilo pamapukululo, ndelenee eeshali diyapuki ve di teleka meembiya nomoiyuma nomomatiti, ndele ve di twaalela diva kovanhu aveshe.

Konima ve i lilongekidila yo nove i longekidila ovapristeli, osheshi ovapristeli, oludalo laAron, va li moilonga fiyo oufiku okuyamba exwikiloyambo nomakaadi. Onghee hano Ovalevi ve i lilongekidila ndele va longekidila yo ovapristeli, oludalo laAron.

Novaimbi, vomoludalo laAsaf, va li ponhele yavo palombwelo laDavid nolaAsaf nolaHeman nolaJedutun, omumonikokule wohamba, nosho yo ovanangeli vopoivelo poshivelo keshe. Vo inava pumbwa okudja po nokweefa oshilonga shavo, osheshi Ovalevi vakwao ve i va longekidila.
Osho ngaha hano elongelokalunga alishe la ningwa mefiku tuu olo, noshivilo shaPaasa nokuyamba omaxwikiloyambo koaltari yOmwene pashipango shohamba Josia.
Novana vaIsrael ovo va li po, va dana Opaasa pefimbo olo, nosho yo oshivilo shomingome dihe nonhafi, omafiku aheyali.

Opaasa ya fa oyo inai danwa muIsrael okudja komafiku omuxunganeki Samuel, osheshi ohamba nande imwe yOvaisraeli inai dana Opaasa ya tya ngaha ngaashi oyo ya danwa kuJosia novapristeli nOvalevi nOvajuda aveshe nOvaisraeli ovo va li po noonakukala muJerusalem.
Opaasa ei oya dana momudo omutimulongo nomutihetatu wepangelo laJosia.
Konima yoinima aishe oyo, Josia eshi a yapula otembeli, Neko, ohamba yaEgipiti, ya fikama a ka lwife puKarkemis puEufrat, ndele Josia okwa fikama e ke mu shakeneke.

Opo nee ye ta tumu kuye ovatumwa, va tye kuye: “Ondi na shike naave, ohamba yaJuda? Nena itandi uya kwoove, ndelenee okepata olo tali lwifa nge alushe. Ndele Kalunga okwa tya ndi nokweendelela. Ino kondjifa Kalunga ou e li pamwe naame, opo Ye ehe ku nyone po.”
Ndelenee Josia ina kanduka po puye, ndelenee okwe lidimbika a lwe naye. Ina pwilikina eendjovo daNeko, da dja mokanya kaKalunga. Nokwa ya mepumbu laMegido e ke mu lwife.
Novaumbi va yasha Josia. Opo nee ohamba tai ti kovapiya vayo: “Tumbe i nge po, ame nda yashwa nai.”

Ovapiya vaye ve mu kufa mo metemba loita ndele ve mu nangeka metemba laye limwe, ndele ve mu twala kuJerusalem. Nokwa fya nokwa pakwa meembila dooxe, fimbo Ovajuda aveshe noonakukalamo muJerusalem va lila Josia.

Ndele Jeremia okwa tota eimbilokemo omolwaJosia. Novaimbi aveshe ovalumenhu novakainhu hava imbi Josia momaimbilokemo avo fiyo onena eli, ndele ve shi ninga onghedimhango muIsrael. Ndele tala, osho osha shangelwa mOmaimbilokemo.
Noinima imwe tai hepaulula Josia noilonga yaye iyuki pakushangwa momhango yOmwene,
inya yotete naayo yaxuuninwa, tala, oya shangwa membo leehamba daIsrael nodaJuda.
36: Novanhu vomoshilongo va kufa Joahas yaJosia, ndele ve mu ninga ohamba ponhele yaxe muJerusalem.
Omido daJoahas da li omilongo mbali nanhatu, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela eehani nhatu muJerusalem.
Nohamba yaEgipiti ye mu kufa mo mepangelo muJerusalem, ndele ya futifa oshilongo eekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane doisiliveli, neekilograma omilongo nhatu nanhee doshingoldo.
Opo nee ohamba yaEgipiti ya ninga Eliakim, omumwaina, ohamba yaJuda noyaJerusalem, ndele ye mu lukulula Jehoiakim. Ndelenee Neko okwa kufa omumwaina Joahas nokwe mu twala kuEgipiti.
Omido daJehoiakim da li omilongo mbali nanhano, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido omulongo naumwe muJerusalem. Nokwa ninga osho inashi wapala momesho Omwene Kalunga kaye.
Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, oye mu homona ndele tai mu mange nelyenge loshikushu nokwe mu twala kuBabilon.
Nebukadnesar okwa twala yo kuBabilon oinima imwe yomongulu yOmwene ndele ye i tula motembeli yaye muBabilon.
Oinima imwe tai hepaulula Jehoiakim noixuna yaye e i ninga, naayo ya monika muye, tala, oyo ya shangwa membo leehamba daIsrael nodaJuda. Nomona waye Jehoiakin ya ninga ohamba ponhele yaye.
Omido daJehoiakin da li omulongo nahetatu, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela eehani nhatu nomafiku omulongo muJerusalem. Ndele ye okwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene.
Pexulilo lomudo ohamba Nebukadnesar ya tuma ko ndele ve mu twala kuBabilon pamwe noinima i nondilo yomongulu yOmwene. Nomumwaina Sedekia okwa ninga ohamba yaJuda noyaJerusalem.
Omido daSedekia da li omilongo mbali naumwe, ye eshi a ninga ohamba, nokwa pangela omido omulongo naumwe muJerusalem.
Nokwa ninga osho inashi yuka momesho Omwene Kalunga kaye. Ndele ye ine lininipika koshipala shomuxunganeki Jeremia, ou e mu lombwela odo da dja mokanya kOmwene.
Ye okwe liteeka yo ohamba Nebukadnesar, nande yo oye mu anifa puKalunga. Ndelenee ye okwa li e nofingo ikukutu nokwa kukutika omutima waye, onghee hano ina ama kOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael.
Novakulunhu yo vomovapristeli novanhu ve liteeka, ndele va longa paixuna aishe yovapaani, ndele va nyateka ongulu yOmwene oyo ye e i yapula muJerusalem.
NOmwene Kalunga kooxe ina loloka oku va tumina ovatumwa vaye. Osheshi Ye okwa li e nolune omolwovanhu vaye nongulu yaye.
Ndelenee va yola ovatumwa vaKalunga, ndele va dina eendjovo daye, ndele va sheka ovaxunganeki vaye, fiyo oupyuhandu wOmwene wa xwamena ovanhu vaye ndele inapa monika vali eveluko.

Onghee hano Ye okwa fikamifa ohamba yOvakaldea i va homone, ndele yo oya dipaa neongamukonda ovalumenhu ovanyasha mongulu yotembeli yavo, ndele inai uditila nande omunyasha omumati ile okakadona, ovakulunhu ile ovakulupe olukeno: Ye okwa yandja aveshe meke layo.
Noinima aishe yongulu yaKalunga, inene noinini, nomamona omongulu yOmwene nomamona ohamba, naa omalenga, aishe yo ye i twala kuBabilon.
Ndele va xwika po ongulu yaKalunga ndele va ngumauna po ohotekuma yaJerusalem neengulu adishe doipuna domusho ve di xwika po nomundilo, noinima aishe iwa i nondilo ya hanaunwa po.
Ndele ava va xupa keongamukonda oye va twala kuBabilon moukwatwa ndele va ninga ovapiya vayo novovana vayo, fiyo oshilongo sha nangalwa kOvapersia.
Opo ondjovo yOmwene e i lombwela Jeremia, i wanifwe nokutya: “Fiyo oshilongo sha mona eshakenifo molwomashabata asho. Osha tulumukwa omafiku aeshe etokeko, opo omido omilongo heyali di wanifwe.”

Ndele momudo wotete waKores, ohamba yaPersia, opo ondjovo yOmwene e i lombwela Jeremia, i wanifwe, Omwene okwa pendula omhepo yaKores, ohamba yaPersia, i shiivifile oshilongo shaye ashishe ndele ye shi shange yo monhumwafo nokutya:

“Kores, ohamba yaPersia, tai ti ngaha: ‘Omwene, Kalunga komeulu, okwa yandja mepangelo lange oilongo aishe yokombada yedu, nokwa lombwela nge ndi mu tungile ongulu muJerusalem osho shi li muJuda. Keshe umwe womoshiwana shaye, Omwene Kalunga kaye na kale naye, ndele na ye ko.’ ”

1: Ndele momudo wotete waKores, ohamba yaPersia opo ondjovo yOmwene e i lombwela Jeremia, i wanifwe Omwene okwa pendula omhepo yaKores, ohamba yaPersia, i shiivifile oshilongo shayo ashishe ndele ye shi shanga yo monhumwafo nokutya:
“Kores, ohamba yaPersia, tai ti ngaha: Omwene, Kalunga komeulu, okwa yandja mepangelo lange oilongo aishe yokombada yedu, nokwa lombwela nge ndi mu tungile ongulu muJerusalem osho shi li muJuda.
Keshe umwe womoshiwana shaye, Omwene Kalunga kaye na kale naye ndele na ye kuJerusalem shomuJuda, ndele na tunge ongulu yOmwene, Kalunga kaIsrael. Oye Kalunga, ou e li muJerusalem.

Ndele keshe umwe ou a xupa, monhele oyo ta kala ngaashi omunailongo, ye e nokupewa kovalumenhu vomonhele oyo oshisiliveli noshingoldo noinima noimuna neeshali dehalo liwa dongulu yaKalunga muJerusalem.”
Opo nee ovakulunhu vomapata omuJuda naBenjamin va fikama, novapristeli nOvalevi, keshe umwe omhepo yaye ya pendulwa kuKalunga a fikama, a ka tunge ongulu yOmwene, oyo i li muJerusalem.
Novashiinda aveshe vavo va kwafa oinima yoisiliveli noshingoldo noimuna neeshali di nondilo, ponho yaaishe ei ova eta eeshali dehalo liwa.
Nohamba Kores ya yandja oinima yongulu yOmwene oyo ya kufwa kuNebukadnesar muJerusalem, ndele e i tula mongulu yaKalunga kaye.
Ndele Kores ohamba yaPersia, ye i yandja kuMitridat, elenga lomamona. Ndele lo ole i vala moku i yandja kuSesbassar, omukulunhu wOvajuda.
Nomuvalu wayo wa li: oiyaxa omilongo nhatu yoshingoldo, oiyaxa eyovi yoshisiliveli, eembele omilongo mbali nomugoi,
omakopi omilongo nhatu oshingoldo, omakopi omafele ane nomulongo oshisiliveli noinima imwe eyovi.
Oinima aishe yoshingoldo noyoshisiliveli ya li omayovi atano nomafele ane. Oinima ei aishe Sesbassar okwe i eta, eenghwate eshi da dja kuBabilon ndele tadi i kuJerusalem.
2: Ndele oonakukalamo vomoshipangelwa shaJuda, ovo va dja mo moukwatwa weenghwate, odo Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, ya twala kuBabilon, ndele va shuna kuJerusalem nokuJuda, keshe umwe momukunda wavo,

ovo ve uya pamwe naSerubbabel, Josua, Nehemia, Seraja, Reelaja, Mordekai, Bilsan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baana.
Omuvalu wovalumenhu vomoshiwana shaIsrael oyou:
ovana vaParos omayovi avali nefele nomilongo heyali navavali,
ovana vaSefatja omafele atatu nomilongo heyali navavali,
ovana vaArah omafele aheyali nomilongo heyali navatano,
ovana vaPahat-Moab nokutya, oludalo laJosua nolaJoab omayovi avali nomafele ahetatu nomulongo navavali,
ovana vaElam eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo nhano navane,
ovana vaSattu omafele omugoi nomilongo nhee navatano,
ovana vaSakkai omafele aheyali nomilongo hamano,
ovana vaBani omafele ahamano nomilongo nhee navavali,
ovana vaBebai omafele ahamano nomilongo mbali navatatu,
ovana vaAsgad eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo mbali navavali,
ovana vaAdonikam omafele ahamano nomilongo hamano navahamano,
ovana vaBigvai omayovi avali nomilongo nhano navahamano,
ovana vaAdin omafele ane nomilongo nhano navane,
ovana vaAter nokutya, vaHiskia omilongo omugoi navahetatu,
ovana vaBesai omafele atatu nomilongo mbali navatatu,
ovana vaJora efele nomulongo navavali,
ovana vaHasum omafele avali nomilongo mbali navatatu,
ovana vaGibbar omilongo omugoi navatano,
ovana vomuBetlehem efele nomilongo mbali navatatu,
ovalumenhu vokuNetofa omilongo nhano navahamano,
ovalumenhu vokuAnatot efele nomilongo mbali navahetatu,
ovana vaAsmavet omilongo nhee navavali,
ovana vokuKiriat-Jearim, Kefira naBeerot omafele aheyali nomilongo nhee navatatu,
ovana vokuRama naGeba omafele ahamano nomilongo mbali naumwe,
ovalumenhu vokuMikmas efele nomilongo mbali navavali,
ovalumenhu vokuBetel naAi omafele avali nomilongo mbali navatatu,
ovana vokuNebo omilongo nhano navavali,
ovana vaMagbis efele nomilongo nhano navahamano,
ovana vaElam mukwao, eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo nhano navane,
ovana vaHarim omafele atatu nomilongo mbali,
ovana vaLod, Hadid naOno omafele aheyali nomilongo mbali navatano,
ovana vokuJeriko omafele atatu nomilongo nhee navatano,
ovana vaSenaa omayovi atatu nomafele ahamano nomilongo nhatu.
Ovapristeli: ovana vaJedaja vomepata laJosua omafele omugoi nomilongo heyali navatatu,
ovana vaImmer eyovi nomilongo nhano navavali,
ovana vaPashur eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo nhee navaheyali,
ovana vaHarim eyovi nomulongo navaheyali.
Ovalevi: ovana vaJosua naKadmiel vomovana vaHodavia omilongo heyali navane,
Ovaimbi: ovana vaAsaf efele nomilongo mbali navahetatu,
Ovana vovanangeli vopoivelo: ovana vaSallum, ovana vaAter, ovana vaTalmon, ovana vaAkkub, ovana vaHatita, ovana vaSobai, aveshe kumwe efele nomilongo nhatu nomugoi.
Ovayakuli votembeli: ovana vaSiha, ovana vaHasufa, ovana vaTabbaot,
ovana vaKeros, ovana vaSiaha, ovana vaPadon;
ovana vaLebana, ovana vaHagaba, ovana vaAkkub;
ovana vaHagab, ovana vaSamlai, ovana vaHanan;
ovana vaGiddel, ovana vaGahar, ovana vaReaja
ovana vaResin, ovana vaNekoda, ovana vaGassam;
ovana vaUssa, ovana vaPaseah, ovana vaBesai;
ovana vaAsna, ovana vaMeunim, ovana vaNefisim;
ovana vaBakbuk, ovana vaHakufa, ovana vaHarhur;
ovana vaBaslut, ovana vaMehida, ovana vaHarsa;
ovana vaBarkos, ovana vaSisera, ovana vaTemah,
ovana vaNesiah, ovana vaHatifa;
Ovana vovapiya vaSalomo: ovana vaSotai, ovana vaHassoferet, ovana vaPeruda;
ovana vaJaala, ovana vaDarkon, ovana vaGiddel;
ovana vaSefatja, ovana vaHattil, ovana vaPogeret-Hassebaim, ovana vaAmi.
Ovayakuli aveshe votembeli novana vovapiya vaSalomo va li omafele atatu nomilongo omugoi navavali.
Ndelenee ovo va dja kuTel-Melah, Tel-Harsa, Kerub, Addan, Immer, ndelenee va nyengwa okuholola omapata avo nooxekulu vavo ile ngeenge vo oludalo laIsrael
ovana vaDelaja, novana vaTobia, novana vaNekoda va li omafele ahamano nomilongo nhano navavali.
Ndele movana vovapristeli omwa li: ovana vaHabaja, ovana vaHakkos, ovana vaBarsillai, ou a hombola umwe womovana oukadona vaBarsillai, Omugilead, ndele a ifanwa pamadina avo.
Vo ova konga efina lepata lavo mwaava va tambulwa meshikulafano lepata, ndelenee inali monika. Onghee hano va talwa inava wana okuya moupristeli.
Nomupangeli okwe va lombwela vaha lye meeshali diyapukielela fiyo taku holoka omupristeli e na Urim naTummim.
Oshiongalele ashishe sha li omayovi omilongo nhee naavali nomafele atatu navahamano,
ponho yovapiya ovalumenhu novakainhu. Vo va li omayovi aheyali nomafele atatu nomilongo nhatu navaheyali. Ndele pa li vali ovaimbi ovalumenhu novakainhu omafele avali.
Eenghambe davo da li omafele aheyali nomilongo nhatu nahamano. Nomamula avo omafele avali nomilongo nhee naatano.
Eengamelo davo da li omafele ane nomilongo nhatu nanhano. Eendongi omayovi ahamano nomafele aheyali nomilongo mbali.
Ndele vamwe vomovakulunhu vomapata, eshi ve uya konhele yongulu yOmwene yomuJerusalem, va yandjela etungo longulu yaKalunga ponhele yavo eeshali dehalo liwa.
Paenghono davo va yandja koshikefa shoimaliwa yetungululo: oshingoldo eekilograma omafele atano, oshisiliveli eekilograma omayovi avali nomafele ahetatu, noikutu efele limwe yovapristeli.
Osho ngaha hano ovapristeli nOvalevi novanhu vomoshiwana novaimbi novanangeli vopoivelo novayakuli votembeli va tula moilando yavo, nOvaisraeli aveshe omoilando yavo.
3: Nohani onhiheyali eshi ye uya ko novana vaIsrael eshi va li moilando yavo, ovanhu va ongala ngaashi omunhu umwe muJerusalem.

Ndele Josua yaJosadak novamwaina ovapristeli naSerubbabel yaSalatiel pamwe novamwaina va fikama, ndele va tunga oaltari yaKalunga kaIsrael, va yambele ko omaxwikiloyambo ngaashi pa shangwa momhango yaMoses, omulumenhu waKalunga.
Ndele va tunga oaltari ponhele yayo, osheshi va hangika kehaluko omolwoiwana yedu. Ndele va yambela ko Omwene omaxwikiloyambo, omaxwikiloyambo ongula nonguloshi.
Ndele va dana oshivilo shomatwali ngaashi pa shangwa, ndele va yamba omaxwikiloyambo efiku nefiku pamuvalo wa ufwa, efiku keshe omaxwikiloyambo alo.
Ndele konima va yamba exwikiloyambo lefiku keshe naalo lohani ipe naaeshe aa omoivilo iyapuki yOmwene naa omunhu keshe ou a etela Omwene eeshali dehalo liwa.
Okudja kefiku lotete mohani onhiheyali va hovela okweetela Omwene omaxwikiloyambo, nande ekanghameno lotembeli inali tungwa natango.

Ndelenee va yandja oimaliwa kovahongi vomamanya novoipilangi. Ndele kOvasidoni nokOvatirus va yandja ko eendja noikunwa nomaadi, va kufe omiti domisederi muLibanon, ndele ve di ete kefuta kuJoppa pashipango shaKores, ohamba yaPersia, ye shi va pa.

Ndele momudo omutivali eshi va fika kongulu yaKalunga muJerusalem, mohani onhivali, Serubbabel yaSalatiel naJosua yaJosadak novamwaina vamwe ovapristeli nOvalevi naaveshe va dja moukwatwa ndele ve uya kuJerusalem, ova hovela okutunga, ndele va tula Ovalevi ava ve nomido omilongo mbali ile ve di koya, va pashukile oshilonga shongulu yOmwene.

Ndele Josua novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu naKadmiel novanhu vaye, oludalo laJuda, va fikama ngaashi omunhu umwe okupashukila ava hava longo oshilonga shongulu yaKalunga, pamwe novana vaHenadad, novana vavo novamwaina, Ovalevi.

Ovatungi eshi va hovela okutunga ekanghameno lotembeli yOmwene, ovapristeli va tulwa po va djala oikutu yavo youpristeli ve nomanghuma oshikushu, nOvalevi, ovana vaAsaf, ve nomanghuma eembinga, va hambelele Omwene pashipango shaDavid, ohamba yaIsrael.

Ndele va hovela okuhambelela nokupandula Omwene:
“Shaashi Ye omuwa,
nouwanghenda waye tau kalelele kOvaisraeli fiyo alushe.”
Novanhu va hafa nokunyakukwa unene, vo eshi va hambelela Omwene, shaashi ekanghameno longulu yOmwene la tungwa.

Ndelenee ovapristeli vahapu nOvalevi novakulunhu vomapata, novaxungu, ovo va mona ongulu yotete, ova lila pombada, eshi ve wete ekanghameno longulu ei ya tungwa moipafi yavo, fimbo vakwao va yelula ondaka yavo nokuhafa nokunyakukwa.
Novanhu va nyengwa okutongola ondaka yehafo mondaka yelilaano lovanhu, osheshi ovanhu va kuwilila pombada nondaka ya udika kokule.
4: Novatondadi vOvajuda novOvabenjamin eshi va uda nokutya, eenghwate tadi tungu otembeli yOmwene Kalunga kaIsrael,

ove uya kuSerubbabel nokovakulunhu ndele tava ti kuvo: “Natu tungeni pamwe, osheshi ngaashi nye osho nafye hatu kongo Kalunga keni, ndele hatu mu yambele okudja komafiku enya aEsar-Haddon, ohamba yaAsiria, oyo ye tu tuma oku.”

Ndelenee Serubbabel naJosua novakulunhu vamwe vomapata aIsrael ve va nyamukula: “Ahowe, itashi dulika mu tungile Kalunga ketu ongulu pamwe nafye, ndelenee fye atuke hatu ke i tungila Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael ngaashi ohamba Kores, ohamba yaPersia, ye tu lombwela.”
Opo nee ovanhu vomoshilongo va tyololokifa omake ovanhu Ovajuda ndele ve va halukifa vaha tunge.
Ndele va futa ovo ve va kondjifa va ongoloke omhangela yavo omafiku aeshe aKores, ohamba yaPersia, fiyo okepangelo laDarius, ohamba yaPersia.
Ndele mefimbo lepangelo laAhasveros, pehovelo lepangelo laye, va shanga onhumwafo yokuvela oonakukala muJuda nomuJerusalem ombedi.

Ndele pomafiku aArtasasta, Bislam, Mitridat, Tabeel pamwe naava va ama kuvo, va shangela Artasasta, ohamba yaPersia. Ndele eshango lomonhumwafo la li Oshiaramea, ndele la lundululwa melaka lOshiaramea.
Rehum, omupangeli, naSimsai, omushangi, va shangela ohamba Artasasta onhumwafo yokutwifa Ovajerusalem eemhata, tai ti:
“Rehum, omupangeli nomushangi Simsai naava va ama kuvo, ovatokolipangeli novapangeli novaxunganeki novakulunhu vovapangeli novalumenhu vaErek novaBabilon novaElam muSusa,
noiwana imwe oyo ya kufwa po kuAsnappar omunene nomutumbalekwa ndele ve i tula moshilando shaSamaria nomeenhele dimwe mouninginino waEufrat.”
Eshangululo eli lonhumwafo oyo ve i tumina: kohamba Artasasta: “Ovapiya voye ovalumenhu ve li kouninginino waEufrat, otave ku kundu.

“Ohamba tai shiivifilwa nokutya, Ovajuda, ovo va dja kwoove, ve uya kufye, ova fika kuJerusalem. Vo otava tungulula oshilando shii noshi nondubo. Otava tungulula eehotekuma ndele tava vandeke ekanghameno.
Ohamba nai kale i shi shii, oshilando nge sha tungululwa neehotekuma nge da pwa okutungwa, vo itava ka futa oimaliwa, noilya ile okuyandja efuto longaba, osho ngaha eehamba tadi lumbulwa emona.
Fye eshi hatu li omongwa wohamba, itatu dulu okutala ohamba tai dinwa, onghee hano hatu tumu ko ndele hatu shiivifile ohamba,

nokutya, mu konakone membo lomafimbo ooxo. Ndele ove to ka mona membo lomafimbo nokudimbulukwa nokutya, oshilando osho sha li oshilando shi nondubo tashi twifa eehamba eemhata, ndele tashi pongeke oilongo, ndele noshito nale nokuli mwa tukulukifwa omapiyaano. Onghee hano oshilando sha hanaunwa po.
Fye ohatu shiivifile ohamba nokutya, oshilando ngeenge sha tungululwa neehotekuma da tungwa, ove ito ka mona sha moshilongo shokouninginino waEufrat.”

Ohamba ya tuma enyamukulo eli:
“Komupangeli Rehum nokomushangi Simsai nokwaava va ama kuvo, ovo ve li muSamaria nomeenhele dokouninginino waEufrat: Ombili tuu.
Onhumwafo mwe i tu tumina onde i leshelwa nawa.
Ndele nde va lombwela ndele va konakona ndele va mona mo nokutya, oshilando osho noshito nale nokuli sha twifa eehamba eemhata, ndele mwa tukulukifwa ondubo nepiyaano.
Neehamba di neenghono da li muJerusalem do da pangela edu alishe lokouninginino waEufrat, ndele da etelwa oimaliwa, noilya yefendelo nofuto yeengaba.
Lombweleni ovalumenhu ovo va efe okutunga noshilando osho shiha tungululwe fimbo inandi mu lombwela.
Ndele lungameni muha shimike moshinima eshi, paha holoke oiponga inene, eehamba diha lumbulwe sha.”
Eshangululo lonhumwafo ya dja kohamba Artasasta eshi la leshelwa Rehum nomushangi Simsai naava va ama kuvo, vo ova endelela okuya kOvajuda kuJerusalem ndele ve va fininika neenghono va efe okutunga.
Opo nee oshilonga shetungululo longulu yaKalunga oyo i li muJerusalem, osha efiwa. Ndele sha efiwa fiyo okomudo omutivali wepangelo laDarius, ohamba yaPersia.
5: Ndelenee omuxunganeki Haggai naSakaria yaIddo, ovaxunganeki, va xunganekela Ovajuda ava va li kuJuda nomuJerusalem medina laKalunga kaIsrael, olo la li navo.
Opo nee Serubbabel yaSalatiel, naJosua yaJosadak va fikama ndele va hovela okutungulula ongulu yaKalunga oyo ya li muJerusalem, ndele ovaxunganeki vaKalunga ove va yambidida.

Mefimbo tuu olo Tattenai, omupangeli wombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, naSetar-Bosenai naava va ama kuvo, ve uya kuvo ndele tava ti ngaha kuvo: “Olyelye e mu lombwela mu tungulule ongulu ei nye mu tunge ohotekuma oyo?”
Opo nee twe va lombwela omadina ovalumenhu ovo hava tungu etungo eli.
Ndelenee eisho laKalunga la li kombada yovakulunhu vOvajuda, onghee hano vo inave va kelela fiyo eshiivifilo la tuminwa Darius, nofiyo onhumwafo i nenyamukulo ya aluka.
Eshangululo lonhumwafo, Tattenai, omupangeli wombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, naSetar-Bosenai naava va ama kuvo Ovafarsaki ovo va li mouninginino waEufrat, ove i tumina Darius.
Vo ove i tumina eshiivifilo, ndele mulo mwa shangelwa ngaha: “Kohamba Darius: Ombilielela!

“Ohamba tai shiivifilwa nokutya, fye twa ile koshilongo shaJuda kongulu yaKalunga omufimanekwa. Ndele yo oya tungwa nomamanya manene nomiti tadi tulwa komakuma, noshilonga osho tashi longwa nawa ndele tashi ehene komesho momake avo.
Opo nee twa pula ovakulunhu venya; fye twe va lombwela ngaha: Olyelye e mu lombwela, mu tungulule ongulu ei nye mu tunge ohotekuma oyo?
Fye twa pula vali omadina avo tu e ku shiivifile, nokutya fye twa shanga omadina aava tave va pitile komesho,

ndele vo ove tu pa enyamukulo eli ndele tava ti: ‘Fye ovapiya vaKalunga komeulu nokopedu, ndele hatu tungulula ongulu inya ya tungwa momido donale, oyo ya tungwa kohamba inene yaIsrael, ndele ye i shakenifa.
Ndelenee ootate eshi va handukifa Kalunga komeulu, Ye e va yandja momake aNebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, Omukaldea. Ye okwa hanauna po ongulu ei nokwa twala ovanhu kuBabilon.
Ndelenee momudo wotete waKores, ohamba yaBabilon, ohamba Kores ya yandja elombwelo kutya, ongulu yaKalunga i tungululwe.

Noinima oingoldo noisiliveli yongulu yaKalunga, oyo ya kufilwe kuNebukadnesar motembeli yomuJerusalem, nokwe e i twalele kotembeli yomuBabilon, oyo ya kufifwa kohamba Kores motembeli yomuBabilon, ndele ya yandjwa kuumwe e nedina Sesbassar, ou a tulwa po omupangeli.
Ndele Kores e mu lombwela: Tambula oinima ei, i tula motembeli yomuJerusalem, ndele tungululeni ongulu yaKalunga ponhele yayo.
Opo nee Sesbassar ou e uya nokwa tunga ekanghameno longulu yaKalunga yomuJerusalem. Okudja kefimbo olo fiyo opaife otai tungwa, ndelenee inai pwa okutungwa.’

Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, napa konakonwe melimba lomamona ohamba muBabilon, ngeenge osho tuu nokutya, ohamba Kores ya yandja elombwelo ongulu ei yaKalunga yomuJerusalem i tungululwe. Nohamba nai tu tumine eshiivifilo loshinima eshi.”
6: Opo nee ohamba Darius ye va lombwela ndele va konakona melimba lomambo makula, omo hava ongele mo omamona muBabilon.
Ndele mohotengulu yaAhmeta yomomukunda waMedia, va mona omushangwatonywa, omo mwa shangelwa:

“Aa omadimbulukoshangwa: momudo wotete wohamba Kores, ohamba Kores ya yandja elombwelo: Ongulu yaKalunga yomuJerusalem, ongulu oyo i nokutungululwa i ninge onhele yokuyambela; nomakanghameno ayo e nokutungwa. Oule wayo wopombada eemeta omilongo hamano, nounene wayo eemeta omilongo hamano;
momutameno wayo mu nokukala omamanya manene momikweyo nhatu, nomiti dipe omukweyo umwe. Neefuto tadi ka futwa kongulu yohamba.

Nosho yo oinima oingoldo noisiliveli yotembeli yaKalunga, oyo ya kufwa kuNebukadnesar motembeli yomuJerusalem nokwe i twala kuBabilon, i nokushunifwa i kale meenhele dayo motembeli yomuJerusalem, ndele mu noku i tula mongulu yaKalunga.”
“Hano, Tattenai, ove omupangeli wombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, naSetar-Bosenai novakwanepangelo vakwao vokouninginino waEufrat: nye paife kaleni kokule noshilonga osho.
Efeni okukelela oshilonga shetungululo longulu yaKalunga. Omupangeli wOvajuda novakulunhu vOvajuda nava tunge ongulu yaKalunga ponhele yayo.

Naame ohandi mu lombwele, osho mu noku shi ningila ovakulunhu vOvajuda fimbo tava tungu ongulu yaKalunga, nokutya: Moimaliwa yefendelo lohamba moshilongo shokouninginino waEufrat namu dje diva ofuto yovanhu venya paha xupe sha nande, nokweendelela.

Ndele osho tashi pumbiwa keshe efiku paindilo lovapristeli vomuJerusalem nave shi pewe vaha lumbulwe nande sha: eengobe deemhedi eenhumba needi deemhedi noudjona omolwomaxwikiloyambo aKalunga komeulu, ndele mu noku va twaalela oilya, omongwa, omaviinyu nomaadi, inamu ongaonga,
opo va yambele Kalunga komeulu omayambo mawa ndele va ilikanene omwenyo wohamba novana vaye ovalumenhu.
Ndele pashipango shange, keshe umwe, te shi tauluka, omuti nau kandulwe mo mongulu yaye, ndele ye e nokweendjelelifwa muwo ndele ta ka valelwa mo, neumbo laye nali ninge oshala.

Ndele Kalunga ou a tula mo edina laye, na hanaune po ohamba keshe noshiwana keshe osho tashi nane eke lasho oku shi tauluka, nokutya okuhanauna po ongulu ei yaKalunga muJerusalem. Ame Darius nde shi tya. Nashi wanifwe shili!”
Opo nee Tattenai, omupangeli wombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, Setar-Bosenai naava va ama kuvo, va longa naanaa ngaashi ohamba Darius ye va shiivifila.

Novakulunhu vOvajuda va tunga ndele va ehenifa etungo nawa komesho omolweyakulo lomaxunganeko ovaxunganeki Haggai naSakaria yaIddo. Ndele va tunga ndele etungo ve li xulifa kelombwelo laKalunga kaIsrael nokelombwelo laKores nolaDarius nolaArtasasta, ohamba yaPersia.
Nongulu ei oya pwa okutungwa mefiku etitatu mohani yaAdar, momudo omutihamano wepangelo lohamba Darius.
Novana vaIsrael, ovapristeli nOvalevi novakwao ava va dja moukwatwa, va dana nehafo oshivilo sheyapulo longulu yaKalunga.

Ndele moshivilo sheyapulo longulu ei yaKalunga va yamba: eengobe efele limwe deemhedi, eedi omafele avali deemhedi oudjona omafele ane, ndele etimbayambo oikombo omulongo naivali omolwOvaisraeli aveshe pamuvalo womapata aIsrael.
Ndele va tula po ovapristeli paengudu davo nOvalevi paengudu davo va longele Kalunga muJerusalem ngaashi sha shangwa membo laMoses.
Neenghwate da dana Opaasa mefiku etimulongo netine mohani yotete.
Osheshi ovapristeli nOvalevi ve liyapula ngaashi omunhu umwe. Vo aveshe va yela. Ndele va dipaela eenghwate adishe novapristeli vakwao navo vene odi yaPaasa.
Novana vaIsrael ava va aluka va dja moukwatwa, ove i lya, nosho yo aveshe ovo ve liyelifa keenyata doiwana yomoshilongo, va konge Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael pamwe navo.

Vo ova dana yo nehafo omafiku aheyali oshivilo shomingome dihe nonhafi. Osheshi Omwene e va hafifa nokwa pungululila omutima wohamba yaAsiria kuvo, ya pameka omake avo moshilonga shongulu yaKalunga, Kalunga kaIsrael.
7: Ndele konima yoinima oyo mepangelo laArtasasta, ohamba yaPersia, Esra yaSeraja yaAsaria yaHilkia
yaSallum yaSadok yaAhitub
yaAmarja yaAsaria yaMerajot
yaSerahia yaUssi yaBukki
yaAbisua yaPinehas yaEliaser yaAron, omupristeli omukulunhu,

Esra oye tuu ou, a fikama a dja muBabilon. Ye okwa li omunongo womishangwa, omukoneki womhango yaMoses, oyo ya yandjwa kOmwene, Kalunga kaIsrael. Nohamba ye mu pa ashishe ye e shi hala, shaashi eke lOmwene, Kalunga kaye, la li kombada yaye.
Movana vaIsrael yo nomovapristeli nomOvalevi nomovaimbi nomovanangeli vopoivelo nomovayakuli votembeli mwa fikama vamwe okuya kuJerusalem momudo omutiheyali wohamba Artasasta.
Nove uya muJerusalem mohani onhinhano momudo omutiheyali wohamba.
Osheshi va dja muBabilon mefiku lotete mohani yotete, ndele mefiku lotete mohani onhinhano ova fika muJerusalem, shaashi eke liwa laKalunga kaye la li kombada yaye.
Osheshi Esra a paka omutima waye mokukonakona omhango yOmwene noku i shikula nokulonga Ovaisraeli eenghedimhango nomalombwelo ayo.
Neshangululo lonhumwafo oyo ohamba Artasasta ya yandja kuEsra, omupristeli nomunongo womishangwa, ou a li omukoneki weendjovo doipango neenghedimhango dOmwene e di pa Ovaisraeli, olo ngaha:
“Artasasta, ohamba yeehamba, komupristeli Esra, omunongo womishangwa womhango yaKalunga komeulu.
Pashipango shange keshe umwe womoshiwana shaIsrael novapristeli vasho nOvalevi, ovo ve li moshilongo shange ndele va hala okuya kuJerusalem, nava ye pamwe naave;
osheshi ohamba novapukululi vayo vaheyali tave ku tumu, u konakone Juda naJerusalem pamhango yaKalunga i li meke loye;
ndele u twale ko oisiliveli noingoldo oyo ya yandjwa kehalo liwa kohamba nokovapukululi vayo ve i pa Kalunga kaIsrael, ongulu yaye i li muJerusalem.
Nosho yo oisiliveli noingoldo aishe to i mono moshitukulwalongo ashishe shaBabilon neeshali dehalo liwa, ovanhu novapristeli tave i yandje kongulu yaKalunga kavo muJerusalem.
Onghee hano noimaliwa ei paliudo loye u nokulanda eengobe deemhedi, eedi deemhedi, oudjona, neendjayambo noikunwayambo yado noku i yamba koaltari yongulu yaKalunga muJerusalem.
Oisiliveli noingoldo oyo tai xupu ko nye novakweni tamu i longifa pahalo laKalunga keni.
Ndelenee oinima we i pewa i longifwe moshilonga shomongulu yaKalunga koye, u noku i yandja moipafi yaKalunga muJerusalem.
Neemhumbwe dimwe dongulu yaKalunga ove to pumbwa vali oku di yandja, ove to dulu oku di pewa kelimba lomamona ohamba.

“Ndele ame ohamba Artasasta, ohandi lombwele ovapashukili aveshe vomalimba omamona vombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, nokutya, ashishe osho omupristeli Esra, omunongo womishangwa domhango yaKalunga komeulu, te mu pula, osho shi nokuwanifwa shili,
shi fike peekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane doshisiliveli neekilograma omayovi omulongo doilya, neelita omayovi avali domaviinyu, neelita omayovi avali domaadi, nomongwa itau valwa.
Ashishe Kalunga komeulu te shi mu lombwele, shi nokuwanifilwa shili naanaa ongulu yaKalunga komeulu, osheshi omolwashike ehandu li uye ngeno kombada yoshilongo shohamba novana vayo ovalumenhu.

Ndele ohatu mu shiivifile nokutya kaku na ou ta dulu okufendelifa ovapristeli nOvalevi aveshe novaimbi novanangeli poivelo novayakuli votembeli ile ovapiya vongulu ei yaKalunga: oimaliwa ile oilya ile efuto longaba.

“Ndele ove Esra, paunongo waKalunga ou u li meke loye, tula ovapashukili novatokoli okutokola ovanhu aveshe vokombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, aveshe ovo va shiiva omhango yaKalunga koye. Ndele ovo vehe i shii, ve noku i longwa.
Ndele keshe umwe, ou ita wanifa omhango yaKalunga, ye e nokuhokololifwa, nokutokolelwa efyo ile okutewa mo ile okufuta oimaliwa ile odolongo.”
Ndele Esra a tya: “Omwene Kalunga kootate na hambelelwe, ou e shi tula momutima wohamba nokutya, yo i nokuwapaleka ongulu yOmwene muJerusalem,

ou a fila nge onghenda koshipala shohamba nomoipafi yovakulunhu vayo nomoipafi yomalenga aeshe omanaenghono ohamba.
“Ndele ame onde linyatipaleka, shaashi eke laKalunga kange la li kombada yange, ndele ame nda ongela ovakulunhu vomuIsrael va ende pamwe naame.”
8: Ovakulunhu vomapata neshikulafano laava va enda pamwe naame mefimbo lepangelo lohamba Artasasta, va dja muBabilon:
vomovana vaPinehas: Gersom. Vomovana vaItamar: Daniel. Vomovana vaDavid: Hattus,
vomovana vaSekanja; vomoludalo laParos: Sakaria, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu efele nomilongo nhano va shangelwa meshikulafano.
Vomovana vaPahat-Moab: Eljehoenai yaSerahia, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu omafele avali;
vomovana vaSattu: Sekanja yaJahasiel, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu omafele atatu;
ndele vomovana vaAdin: Ebed yaJonatan, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu omilongo nhano;
ndele vomovana vaElam: Jesaja yaAtalia, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu omilongo heyali;
ndele vomovana vaSefatja: Sebadja yaMikael, ndelenee pamwe naye ovalumenhu omilongo hetatu;
ndele vomovana vaJoab: Obadja, omona waJehiel, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu omafele avali nomulongo navahetatu;
ndele vomovana vaBani: Selomit yaJosifiya, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu efele nomilongo hamano;
ndele vomovana vaBebai: Sakaria yaBebai, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu omilongo mbali navahetatu;
ndele vomovana vaAsgad: Johanan yaHakkatan, ndele pamwe naye ovalumenhu efele nomulongo;
ndele vomovana vaAdonikam, ou e uya konima, nomadina avo oyaa: Elifelet, Jehuel naShemaia, ndele pamwe navo ovalumenhu omilongo hamano;
ndele vomovana vaBigvai: Utai naSakkur, ndele pamwe navo ovalumenhu omilongo heyali.
Ndele ame nde va ongela pomulonga tau kungulukile kuAhava, ndele oko twa kala monhanda omafiku atatu. Ndele eshi nda tala ovanhu novapristeli, inandi mona mo Omulevi nande umwe.
Onghee hano nda tuma ovakulunhu Elieser, Ariel, Shemaia naElnatan naJarib naElnatan naNatan naSakaria naMesullam novalongi Jojarib naElnatan,

ndele nde va lombwela va ye komukulunhu Iddo momukunda Kasifja. Ndele nda paka eendjovo momakanya avo, odo ve noku di lombwela Iddo novayakuli ovakwao votembeli momukunda Kasifja, opo ve tu tumine ovayakuli vongulu yaKalunga ketu.

Ndele shaashi eke liwa laKalunga la li kombada yetu, ove tu tumina ovalumenhu ovanaendunge vomovana vaMahli yaLevi yaIsrael nokutya, Serebja pamwe novana vaye novamwaina ovalumenhu omulongo navahetatu;
naHasabja, ndele pamwe naye Jesaja womovana vaMerari novamwaina novana ovamati omilongo mbali.
Ndele movayakuli votembeli, ovo David novakulunhu va yandja kOvalevi, va yakule, mwa dja ovayakuli votembeli omafele avali nomilongo mbali, vo aveshe va tumbulwa omadina.
Opo nee nda shiivifa efimbo lelidiliko pomulonga waAhava, opo tu lininipike koshipala shaKalunga ketu, tu mu indile tu mone elao molweendo letu fye vene novanhu vetu noinima yetu aishe.

Osheshi nda li nda fya ohoni okupula kohamba etanga lovakwaita novalondi veenghambe, ve tu kwafe okulwifa ovatondadi mondjila, shaashi twa lombwela ohamba, twa tya: Eke laKalunga oli li kombada yaaveshe ovo have mu kongo, ndelenee eenghono daye nehandu laye li li kombada yaaveshe tave mu liteeka.
Osho ngaha hano twe lidilika ndele twa indila Kalunga ketu. Ndele Ye okwe tu uda.
Opo nee nda hoolola mo movakulunhu vovapristeli omulongo navavali: Serebja, Hasabja nomulongo vomovamwaina pamwe navo.
Ndele ame nde va yelekela oisiliveli noingoldo noinima nokutya, eeshaliyambo dongulu yaKalunga ketu, odo da yandjwa kohamba nokovapukululi vayo nokomalenga ayo nokOvaisraeli aveshe venya va li ko.
Ndele momake avo nda yelekela mo eekilograma eetona omilongo mbali nambali doisiliveli neekilograma omilongo heyali doinima oisiliveli, eekilograma omayovi atatu nomafele ane doshingoldo,
noiyaxa omilongo mbali oingoldo, ondado yao oimaliwa eyovi limwe, noiyaxa yoshikushu, iwaelela ya fefengwa nawa, ondado yayo ngaashi oshingoldo.
Ndele nde va lombwela: Nye mwa yapulilwa Omwene, noinima ya yapulwa, noisiliveli noingoldo oyo eeshali dehalo liwa dOmwene Kalunga kooxo.
I pashukileni hano noku i diinina fiyo tamu i yeleke moipafi yovakulunhu vovapristeli novOvalevi nomoipafi yovakulunhu vomapata Ovaisraeli muJerusalem momalimba ongulu yOmwene.
Opo nee ovapristeli nOvalevi va tambula oisiliveli noingoldo noinima oyo ya yelekwa, ve i twale kuJerusalem, mongulu yaKalunga ketu.

Opo nee twa dja po pomulonga Ahava mefiku etimulongo netivali mohani yotete, tu ye kuJerusalem. Neke laKalunga ketu la li kombada yetu, onghee Ye e tu xupifa mo meke lomutondadi nomomahanyeno mondjila.
Ndele fye twa fika kuJerusalem ndele twa kala ko twa mwena omafiku atatu.

Ndele mefiku etine oisiliveli noingoldo noinima ya yelekwa mongulu yaKalunga ketu noya yandjwa momake omupristeli Meremot yaUria, ndele puye pwa li Eliaser yaPinehas, ndele puvo pwa li Josabad yaJosua naNoadja yaBinnui, Ovalevi.
Ashishe sha yelekwa pauhapu nopaudjuu washo, noudjuu aushe wa shangwa.

Eenghwate odo da dja moukwatwa, oda yambela Kalunga kaIsrael omaxwikiloyambo: eengobe omulongo nambali deemhedi molwOvaisraeli aveshe needi deemhedi omilongo omugoi, noudjona omilongo heyali navaheyali, oikombo omulongo naivali etimbayambo, oyo aishe exwikiloyambo kOmwene.
Ndele va yandja onhumwafo omo mwa shangwa oshipango shohamba kovapangeli vohamba nokomalenga ombinga yokouninginino waEufrat, ndele vo ova kwafa ovanhu nongulu yaKalunga.
9: Eshi va mana ashishe osho, ovakulunhu ve uya kwaame ndele tava ti: “Ovanhu Ovaisraeli novapristeli nOvalevi inave litukula noiwana yomoilongo nomoilonga yavo ii, mOvakaanan, mOvaheti, mOvaperesi, mOvajebusi, mOvaammoni, mOvamoab, mOvaegipiti nomOvaamori.

Osheshi va kufa mo movana vavo oukadona, va ninga ovalikadi vavo novovana vavo ovamati, onghee hano oludi liyapuki la lumbakanifwa kumwe novanhu vomoilongo. Novakulunhu novakomesho va tetekela meliteeko olo.”
Ndele eshi nde shi uda nda pombaula oshikutu shange nelwakani lange, ndele nde liduda eexwiki komutwe wange neendjedi dange, ndele nda kala omutumba nda nyika oluhodi.
Ndele ava va kakama molweendjovo daKalunga kaIsrael omolweliteeko leenghwate, ove uya aveshe kwaame. Ndele ame nda li omutumba nda nyika oluhodi fiyo okeyambo longuloshi.

Ndelenee pefimbo leyambo longuloshi ame nda penduka mokunyika oluhodi lange. Ndele fimbo handi pombaula oshikutu shange nelwakani lange, ame nda twa eengolo nokulinyongamena ndele nda yelula omaoko ange kOmwene Kalunga kange,

ndele handi ti: “Kalunga kange, ondi udite nda fya ohoni ndele ihandi dulu okuyelula oshipala shange kwoove, Kalunga kange, osheshi oulunde wetu wa lunda omitwe detu, nokuvelwa kwetu ombedi taku hange keulu.

Okudja komafiku ootate fiyo onena eli fye tu nombedi inene, nomolwowii wetu fye neehamba detu novapristeli vetu va yandjwa momake eehamba doilongo, nokeongamukonda nomoukwatwa nomokutikishwa po nomokufifwa ohoni, ngaashi shi li nena eli.

Ndele paife twa mona onghenda kOmwene Kalunga ketu okafimbo kanini, osheshi Ye e shi itavela ovamangululwa vomufye va xupa po, nokwe tu pa onhele moshiyapuki shaye, opo Kalunga ketu a yelife omesho etu tu fude po kanini moupika wetu.

Osheshi fye ovapika. Ndelenee moupika wetu Kalunga ketu ine tu ekelashi, ndele okwe tu fila onghenda koshipala sheehamba daPersia, onghee hano ode tu pa okafudo tu tungulule ongulu yaKalunga ketu nomakulukuma ayo tu a longolole, nokwe tu pa ohotekuma muJuda nomuJerusalem.
Ndele paife Kalunga ketu hatu ti shike omolwoinima ei? Osheshi twa efa oipango yoye,

we i lombwela ovapiya voye ovaxunganeki, eshi wa tile: ‘Oshilongo osho tamu i mo mu ke shi nangale, osho oshilongo sha nyata, omolweenyata doiwana yomoilongo molwoilonga yavo ii, va yadifa nayo oshilongo okudja kongaba imwe fiyo okongaba ikwao neenyata davo.

Paife inamu yandja ovana veni oukadona kovana vavo ovamati, ndele inamu kufa ovana vavo oukadona va ninge ovalikadi vovana veni ovamati, ndele inamu konga nande oukaume nelao lavo fiyo alushe, opo nye mu kale mwa pama nokulya ouwa woshilongo, ndele mu shi yandje kovana veni oshitukulwa fiyo alushe.’

Ndele konima yoinima aishe oyo ye uya kombada yetu molwoilonga yetu ii nomolwombedi yetu inene, osheshi Ove Kalunga ketu ino tu valela pawii wetu twe u lilongela, ndele we tu pa natango ovamangululwa vahapu ve fike opo.

Tu tauluke vali ngeno oipango yoye ndele tu ninge haukwe noiwana oyo tai longo oixuna? Ehandu loye itali ka kala ngeno kombada yetu fiyo twa kombwa po, ndele itapa fyaala nande oshixupe ile ovamangululwa?

Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael, Oove omuyapuki. Osheshi ofye atuke tu li efiku lonena ovamangululwa, twa xupa. Fye otu li po apa tu nombedi koshipala shoye, ndelenee omolwoinima ya tya ngaha kape na ou ta dulu okukala po koshipala shoye.”
10: Ndele fimbo Esra ta indile ndele ta wile eombe mokulila, ndele ta hepaulula komesho yongulu yaKalunga, muIsrael mwa dja ongudu inene yovalumenhu noyovakainhu nounona tave uya kuye, osheshi ovanhu va lila nokulililila.

Opo nee Sekanja yaJehiel, womovana vaElam, a hovela okupopya ndele ta ti kuEsra: “Fye twe liteeka Kalunga ketu, eshi twa hombola ovakainhu ovanailongo vomoiwana yomoshilongo. Ndelenee natango tuu Israel shi neteelelo moshinima eshi.
Natu ningeni hano paife ehangano naKalunga ketu, tu lekele ovalikadi aveshe naava twa dala navo, papukululo lomwene wange naava hava kakama omolwoshipango shaKalunga ketu. Ndele napa ningwe pamhango.
Penduka, osheshi oshinima eshi oshoye. Ndele fye ohatu ku popile. Kala wa pama u shi ninge!”
Opo nee Esra a penduka nokwa anifa ovakulunhu vovapristeli nOvalevi nOvaisraeli aveshe, va ninge pandjovo oyo. Ndele va ana.

Ndele Esra a kala ofika komesho yongulu yaKalunga nokwa ya kondjuwo yaJohanan yaEljasib. Nokwe uya ko. Okwa li ina lya omungome ndele ina nwa omeva, shaashi okwa li ta nyika oluhodi molweliteeko leenghwate.
Opo nee va shiivifila muJuda nomuJerusalem, eenghwate adishe di ongale muJerusalem.
Ndele keshe ou ite uya momafiku oo atatu, emona laye alishe li nokuhanaunwa po pamhango ya pangelwa komalenga nokovakulunhu, ndele ye mwene ta ka tewa mo meongalo leenghwate.

Onghee hano ovalumenhu aveshe vomuJuda novomuBenjamin va ongala muJerusalem momafiku oo atatu, mohani onhimugoi mefiku etimilongo mbali lohani. Novanhu aveshe va kala omutumba poluhaela longulu yaKalunga, ndele va kakama molwoshinima shoovene nomolwodula ya pauka.
Nomupristeli Esra okwa kala ofika ndele ta ti kuvo: “Nye mwe liteeka ndele mwa hombola ovakainhu ovanailongo mu hapupalife ombedi yaIsrael.
Hano peni Omwene Kalunga kooxo efimano ndele ningeni osho tashi mu wapalele, ndele tukaukeni moiwana yomoshilongo nomovalikadi ovanailongo.”
Opo nee oshiongalele ashishe sha nyamukula, ndele tashi ti nondaka yopombada: “Heeno, paendjovo doye, tu noku shi ninga.
Ndelenee ovanhu ove li po vahapu, efimbo eli olodula; itashi dulika okukala ofika pondje. Noshilonga osho kashi fi shefiku limwe ile shomafiku avali, osheshi moshinima eshi twa tauluka nai.

Ovakulunhu vetu nava holoke ponhele yoshiongalele ashishe, opo nee aveshe vomufye ava ve li momikunda detu, ava va hombola ovakainhu ovanailongo tava dulu okwoongala pomafimbo a pangelwa, novakulunhu novatokoli vomoshilando keshe pamwe navo, opo tu kandule po pufye oupyuhandu waKalunga ketu moshinima eshi.”
Ndele Jonatan yaAsahel naJakseja yaTikva ovo aveke ve shi anya, ndele Mesullam nOmulevi Sabbetai va ama kuvo.

Ndelenee ovana ovamati vomoukwatwa ova ninga ngaha: omupristeli Esra okwa hoolola ovalumenhu, ovakulunhu vomapata pamapata avo, ndele vo aveshe va tumbulwa pamadina avo. Ndele va ninga oshiongalele mefiku lotete mohani onhimulongo va konakone oshinima osho,
ndele mefiku lotete lohani yotete va shiiva omadina ovalumenhu aveshe ovo va hombola ovakainhu ovanailongo.
Nomovana vovapristeli, ava va hombola ovakainhu ovanailongo mwa li ovana vaJosua yaJosadak novamwaina: Maasea naElieser naJarib naGedalja.
Ndelenee mokupaafana omake va udaneka nokutya, tava ka lekela ovakainhu vavo, ndele tava ka yamba molwombedi yavo odi yomhedi.
Ndele movana vaImmer: Hanani naSebadja,
ndele movana vaHarim: Maasea naElia naShemaia naJehiel naUssia,
ndele movana vaPashur: Eljoenai naMaasea, Ismael, Netanel, Josabad naEleasa.
Ndele mOvalevi: Josabad naSimei naKelaja nokutya, Kelita, Petahja, Juda naElieser.
Ndele movaimbi: Eljasib; ndele movanangeli poivelo: Sallum naTelem naUri.
Ndele mOvaisraeli; movana vaParos: Ramja naJissia naMalkia naMijamin naEliaser naMalkia naBenaja;
ndele movana vaElam: Mattanja, Sakaria naJehiel naAbdi naJeremot naElia;
ndele movana vaSattu: Eljoenai, Eljasib, Mattanja naJeremot naSabad naAsisa;
ndele movana vaBebai: Johanan, Hanania, Sabbai naAtlai;
ndele movana vaBani: Mesullam, Malluk naAdaja, Jasub naSeal, Jeremot;
ndele movana vaPahat-Moab: Adna naKelal, Benaja, Maasea, Mattanja, Besaleel naBinnui naManasse;
ndele movana vaHarim: Elieser, Jissia, Malkia, Shemaia, Simeon,
Benjamin, Malluk, Shemaria;
movana vaHasum: Mattenai, Mattatta, Sabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manasse, Simei;
movana vaBani: Maadai, Amram naUel,
Benaja, Bedeja, Keluhu,
Vanja, Meremot, Eljasib,
Mattanja, Mattenai naJaasu
naBani naBinnui, Simei
naSelemja naNatan naAdaja,
Magnadbai, Sasai, Sarai,
Asareel, Selemja, Shemaria,
Sallum, Amarja, Josef;
movana vaNebo: Jeiel, Matitia, Sabad Sebina, Jaddai naJoel, Benaja.
Vo aveshe va hombola ovakainhu ovanailongo, ndele ovakainhu vamwe vomuvo va dala ounona.

1:
Ehepaululo laNehemia yaHakalja.
Mohani yaKislev, momudo omutimilongo mbali fimbo nda li mombala yaSusa,
Hanani, umwe womovakwetu ye novalumenhu vamwe va dja kuJuda ve uya kwaame. Ndele nde va pula Ovajuda, ovaxupifwa va xupa po kokukwatwa ve li ngahelipi, naJerusalem oshi li ngahelipi.

Ndele va lombwela nge kutya, oonakuxupilwa venya va xupa po kokukwatwa, va fyaala moshilongo, ove li moluhepo linene nomefifohoni. Ohotekuma yaJerusalem oya ngumaunwa po noivelo yasho ya xwikwa po nomundilo.
Ndele eshi nda uda eendjovo edi, ame nda kala omutumba nokulila ndele nda nyika oluhodi omafiku mahapu. Ndele nde lidilika nonda indila koshipala shaKalunga komeulu,
ndele handi ti: “Akutu Omwene Kalunga komeulu, Oove Kalunga munene u nokutilika, ou ho diinine ehangano nonghenda kwaava ve ku hole ndele hava diinine oipango yoye,

okutwi kwoye naku ude nomesho oye naa pashuke, u pwilikine omailikano omupiya woye, ame eshi handi ilikanene koshipala shoye omutenya noufiku ovana vaIsrael, ovapiya voye, nokuhepaulula omatimba ovana vaIsrael, aa twa nyona kwoove; naame yo neumbo lange la nyona.
Fye twa nyona unene kwoove, ndele inatu diinina oipango neenghedimhango nomalombwelo, aa wa lombwela omupiya woye Moses.
Dimbulukwa hano ondjovo we i lombwela omupiya woye Moses nokutya: ‘Ngeenge tamu liteeka, Ame ohandi ke mu halakanifila mokati koiwana,

ndelenee ngeenge tamu lialuluka kwaame ndele tamu diinine oipango yange ndele tamu i wanifa, ovo va tewatewa nande va kale fiyo okomunghulo weulu, Ame ohandi va eta monhele oyo nde i hoolola edina lange li kale mo.’
Vo ndishi ovapiya voye noshiwana shoye, ovo we va xupifa neenghono doye dinene neke loye la pama.

Akutu Omwene, okutwi kwoye naku ude hano eindilo lovapiya voye ovo va hala okutila edina loye! Ndele nena eli pa omupiya woye elao, u mu pe onghenda komesho yomulumenhu ou.” Osheshi ame nda li omupindili wohamba.
2: Ndele mohani yaNisan momudo omutimilongo mbali wohamba Artasasta, omaviinyu eshi a li koshipala shayo, ame nda kufa omaviinyu ndele handi pindile ohamba. Ndele inandi kala shito nda nyika oluhodi koshipala shayo.
Ohamba ya pula nge: “Omolwashike oshipala shoye tashi nyika oluhodi? To vele? Omutima woye tau fi oluhodi.” Ndele nda tila unene
ndele handi ti kohamba: “Ohamba nai kale nomwenyo fiyo alushe! Omolwashike oshipala shange shiha nyike oluhodi, eshi oshilando omo ootate va pakwa sha tokekwa noivelo ya xwikwa po nomundilo?”
Opo nee ohamba tai pula nge: “Ove wa hala shike hano?” Ndele ame nda indila Kalunga komeulu
ndele nda lombwela ohamba: “Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba nongeenge omupiya woye we mu hokwa, tume nge hano kuJuda, koshilando omo ootate va pakwa, opo ndi shi tungulule.”
Opo nee ohamba ya pula nge fimbo omumbada a kala omutumba puyo: To ka kala efimbo li fike peni meengeda doye, nonaini to aluka? Nohamba ya tala osha wapala okutuma nge. Naame nde i lombwela efiku
ndele nda lombwela ohamba: Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, nandi pewe eenhumwafo kovapangeli vokouninginino waEufrat, vo va itavelele nge okutaulula fiyo handi fiki kuJuda;

nonhumwafo kuAsaf, omupashukili womuulu wohamba, ye a pe nge omiti dokupangela oivelo yohotengulu yotembeli noyohotekuma yoshilando noyongulu omo ndi nokukala mo. Nohamba oye shi itavelela nge, shaashi eke liwa laKalunga kange la li kombada yange.
Ndele nde uya kovapangeli ovo ve li mouninginino waEufrat neenhumwafo dohamba onde di va pa. Ohamba ya tuma pamwe naame ovakulunhu vomatanga ovakwaita novalondi veenghambe.
Ndelenee Sanballat, Omuhoroni, naTobia, omupiya Omuammoni, eshi va uda, nokutya umwe e uya okukongela ovana vaIsrael ouwa, ova ninga omwenyo mwii.
Ndele eshi nde uya kuJerusalem ndele nda kala ko omafiku atatu,

ame nda fikama oufiku novalumenhu vamwe pamwe naame. Ndelenee inandi shiivifila nande omunhu umwe osho Kalunga kange e shi tula momutima wange ndi shi ningile Jerusalem. Pwaame kapa li nande oshilondomwa ponho yoshilondomwa osho nda li nda londa.

Ndele nda pita mo mOshivelo shefilu oufiku, nda londa nda yuka kombinga yOfifiya yeyoka nokOshivelo shoushosho. Ndele nda konakona eehotekuma daJerusalem, odo da ngumaunwa po, noivelo yasho ya xwikwa nomundilo.
Ndele nda ehena ko nda ya kOshivelo shofifiya nokEtale Lohamba. Ndelenee kapa li nande onhele yokupitila oshilondomwa osho nde shi londa.
Opo nee oufiku mefilu nda londa ndele nda konakona ohotekuma. Opo nee nda aluka vali handi piti mOshivelo shefilu nde uya mo.
Ndelenee ovakomesho inava shiiva apa nda ile naashi nda ninga. Osheshi natango tuu inandi shiivifila Ovajuda novapristeli novanamadina novakomesho novakwao ovo va li ve nokukala moshilonga.

Opo nee handi ti kuvo: “Nye mu wete oluhepo eli tu li mulo, nokutya Jerusalem sha tokekwa noivelo yasho ya xwikwa nomundilo. Ileni tu tungululeni ohotekuma yaJerusalem, tuha kale vali oshitevo shokushekwa.”

Ndele nde va hepaululila nhumbi eke liwa laKalunga kange la li kombada yange, nosho yo eendjovo dohamba, yo eshi ye di lombwela nge. Ndele vo va tya: “Natu fikameni ndele tu tungeni!” Ndele va pameka omake avo va longe oshilonga shiwa.

Ndelenee Sanballat, Omuhoroni, naTobia, omupiya Omuammoni, naGesem, Omuarabi, eshi ve shi uda, vo ove tu dina noku tu sheka ndele tava ti: “Oshike osho tamu ningi? Mwa hala hamba okutwa ondubo nohamba?”

Opo nee nde va nyamukula ndele handi ti kuvo: “Kalunga komeulu, Ye ote ke shi tu wanifila, nafye, ovapiya vaye, ohatu ka fikama tu tunge. Ndele nye kamu na nande oshitukulwa ile oshipewa ile oshidimbulukifo muJerusalem.”
3: Nomupristeli omukulunhu Eljasib okwa fikama pamwe noovakwao, ovapristeli, ndele vo ova tunga Oshivelo sheedi. Vo ove shi yapula, ndele va pangelela po omivelo. Navali fiyo okoshungo Hammea, osho ve shi yapula fiyo okoshungo Hananel.
Ndele popepi naye ovalumenhu vaJeriko va tunga. Ndele komesho yavo Sakkur yaImri okwa tunga.
Ndele ovana vaSenaa va tunga Oshivelo sheeshi. Ve shi pangela neenhikifo ndele va pangela omivelo dasho noiti ya shindjakana noiidilifo yasho.
Ndele polwamba lavo Meremot yaUria yaHakkos okwa tungulula. Ndele polwamba lavo Mesullam naBerekia yaMesesabel okwa tungulula. Ndele polwamba lavo Sadok yaBaana okwa tungulula.
Ndele polwamba lavo Ovatekoa va tungulula; ndelenee ovanenenhu vomuvo inava nyongameka eefingo davo mokulongela Omwene.
Jehoiada yaPaseah naMesullam yaBesodeja ova tungulula Oshivelo shikulu. Ve shi pangela neenhikifo ndele va pangela omivelo dasho noiti ya shindjakana noiidilifo yasho.
Ndele polwamba lavo Melatja, Omugibeon, naJadon, Omumeroni, ovalumenhu vaGibeon novaMispa va tungulula fiyo okolukalwapangelo lomupangeli woshilongo shOkouninginino waEufrat.
Polwamba laye Usiel yaHarhaja womovahambwidi voingoldo a tungulula. Ndelenee polwamba laye Hanania, umwe womovapilauli vomuvavo, a tungulula. Ndele vo ova tungulula Jerusalem fiyo okohotekuma inene.
Ndele polwamba lavo Refaja yaHur, omukulunhu wombinga yoshitukulwa shaJerusalem, okwa tungulula.
Ndele polwamba lavo Jedaja yaHarumaf okwa tungulula, a shaama nongulu yaye. Ndele polwamba laye Hattus yaHasabneja okwa tungulula.
Malkia yaHarim naHassub yaPahat-Moab, va tungulula Ombinga onhivali nosho Oshungo yediko lokuteleka omingome.
Ndele polwamba laye Sallum yaHallohes, omukulunhu wombinga yoshitukulwa shaJerusalem, okwa tungulula pamwe novana vaye oukadona.

Hanun noonakukalamo vomuSanoa va tungulula Oshivelo shefilu. Ve shi pangela neenhikifo ndele va pangela omivelo dasho noiti ya shindjakana noiidilifo yasho, nosho yo ekuma eemeta eyovi limwe fiyo okOshivelo shoushosho.
Ndele Malkia yaRekab, omukulunhu woshitukulwa Bet-Hakerem okwa tungulula Oshivelo shoushosho. Ye okwe shi tungulula nokwa pangela omivelo dasho noiti ya shindjakana noiidilifo yasho.

Ndele Sallum yaKolhose, omukulunhu woshitukulwa Mispa, okwa tungulula Oshivelo shofifiya. Ye okwe shi tungulula nokwe shi tungila onduda nokwa pangela omivelo dasho noiti ya shindjakana noiidilifo yasho. Nosho yo ekuma tali di kEtale laShela lekungulukilo lomeva poshikunino shohamba, nofiyo okeendodo tadi di koshilando shaDavid.
Komesho yaye Nehemia yaAsbuk, omukulunhu wombinga yoshitukulwa Bet-Sur, okwa tungulula fiyo okonhele ya shaama neembila daDavid nofiyo oketale lafewa nofiyo okOngulu yovaladi.
Komesho yaye Ovalevi va tungulula: Rehum yaBani; polwamba laye Hasabja, omukulunhu wombinga yoshitukulwa Keila, okwa tungulula onhele yoshitukulwa shaye.
Komesho yaye oovakwao, Bavai yaHenadad, omukulunhu wombinga yoshitukulwa oshitivali Keila, okwa tungulula.
Ndele komesho yaye Eser yaJosua, omukulunhu waMispa, okwa tungulula onhele onhivali ya shaama nonhele oyo omo tamu londwa kongulu yoiti nokutya, okolonela yomekuma.
Komesho yaye Baruk yaSabbai okwa tungulula noudiinini unene onhele onhivali: okudja kokolonela yomekuma fiyo okoshivelo shongulu yomupristeli omukulunhu Eljasib.
Komesho yaye Meremot yaUria yaHakkos okwa tungulula onhele onhivali okudja koshivelo shongulu yomupristeli omukulunhu Eljasib fiyo opexulilo longulu yaEljasib.
Ndele komesho yaye ovapristeli, ovalumenhu va dja koluhaela laJordan, va tungulula.
Komesho yaye Benjamin naHassub va tungulula onhele ya shaama nongulu avo. Komesho yaye Asaria yaMaasea yaAnanja a tungulula pongulu yaye.
Komesho yaye Binnui yaHenadad, okwa tungulula onhele onhivali okudja kongulu yaAsaria fiyo okokolonela yomekuma nofiyo opokolonela.
Palal yaUsai monhele ya shaama nokolonela yomekuma noshungo yopombada yokongulu yohamba, pehale lokomesho yodolongo. Komesho yaye Pedaja yaParos.
Novayakuli votembeli va li va kala koshikulundu Ofel fiyo okonhele ya shaama nOshivelo shomeva, kombinga yokoushilo noposhungongulu tai tumbu.
Komesho yavo Ovatekoa va tungulula onhele onhivali, okudja konhele ya shaama noshungo inene ya tumba fiyo okEkuma laOfel.
Kombada yOshivelo sheenghambe ovapristeli va tungulula, keshe umwe pongulu yaye.
Komesho yavo Sadok yaImmer a tungulula pongulu yaye. Ndele komesho yaye Shemaia yaSekanja, omunangeli wOshivelo shokOushilo okwa tungulula.
Komesho yaye Hanania yaSelemja naHanun, omona omutihamano omumati waSalaf, va tungulula onhele onhivali. Komesho yavo Mesullam yaBerekia okwa tungulula pokandjuwo kaye.
Komesho yaye Malkia, umwe womovahambwidi voingoldo, okwa tungulula fiyo okongulu yovayakuli votembeli nokovalandifi, konhele ya shaama nOshivelo shenangelo nofiyo okondjuwo yokombada yokolonela.
Ndele pokati kondjuwo yokombada yokolonela nOshivelo sheedi ovahambwidi voingoldo novalandifi va tungulula.
4: Ndelenee Sanballat eshi a uda, nokutya fye ohatu tungu ekuma, okwa handuka nokwa ninga omwenyo mwii unene. Ndele a sheka Ovajuda,

nokwa popya moipafi yavakwao noyomatanga aye ovakwaita vomuSamaria ndele ta ti: “Ovajuda vehe neenghono otava ningi shike? Ohatu va efa tuu ngaho? Otava ka yamba tuu? Otava ka xulifa tuu diva oshilonga shavo? Otava dulu tuu okushitulula omamanya omomakulukuma a ninge omwenyo, nande a xwikwe nomundilo?”
Ndele Omuammoni Tobia okwa kala ofika puye ndele ta ti: “Nava tunge, ndelenee okavandje ngeenge taka nhuka kulo, ko otaka ngumauna po ekuma lavo lomamanya!”
Pwilikina, Kalunga ketu, nhumbi tu li twa dinika! Ndele alulila esheko lavo kombada yomitwe davo, ndele va yandjela mokutikifwa moshilongo shoukwatwa.
Nomatauluko avo ino a tuvika ndele ino dima po omatimba avo koshipala shoye. Osheshi ve ku handukifa nokukala kwa tya ngaha novatungi.
Ndelenee twa tungulula ohotekuma nekuma alishe la tungululwa fiyo opokati koule walo. Novanhu va longa nomutima wavo aushe.
Ndelenee Sanballat naTobia nOvaarabi nOvaammoni nOvaasdod eshi va uda, nokutya etungululo leehotekuma daJerusalem tali ehene komesho, nomifya tadi vandekwa, ova handuka unene.
Ndele vo aveshe va hangakena va udafana va ka homone Jerusalem va ka pendulile ko epiyaano.
Ndelenee fye twa indila Kalunga ketu ndele twa tula ovanangeli tu amenwe kuvo omutenya noufiku.
Ndelenee Juda ta ti: “Eenghono dovahumbati vomitengi da nyengwa nomakulukuma omahapu unene, onghee itatu dulu okutunga ekuma.”
Novatondadi vetu tava ti: “Fimbo vo inava shiiva sha ile inava mona sha, fye ohatu uya mokati kavo ndele hatu va dipaa ndele hatu xulifa oshilonga shavo.”
NOvajuda venya va kala moushiinda wavo ve uya va dja meenhele adishe ve tu londwela lwomulongo nokuli: Omhangela yovatondi vetu.
Ndele ame nda tula ovanhu meenhele da filuka konima yekuma, meenhele dihe na sha, ovanhu nde va tula ko pamapata avo, ve nomaongamukonda avo nomaonga avo nomauta avo.

Ndele eshi nda tala nokukonakona ashishe, ame nda kala ofika nonda lombwela ovanamadina novakomesho novanhu vamwe: “Inamu va tila. Dimbulukweni Omwene nonakutilika, ndele kondjeleni vakweni novana veni ovamati noukadona, novalikadi veni neengulu deni.”
Ndele ovatondadi vetu eshi va uda, nokutya sho osha shiivika kufye, naKalunga okwa nyona po ehangakeno lavo, fye atushe twa shuna kohotekuma, keshe umwe okoshilonga shaye.
Ndele okefiku tuu olo etanga limwe lovanhu vange la longa, netanga limwe lovanhu la diinina omaonga noikelelifo nomauta noivela yoponhulo fimbo ovakulunhu va li ofika konima yOvajuda aveshe,
va tunga ekuma. Ovahumbati vomitengi va longa oshilonga shavo ngaha: Neke limwe va longa oshilonga shavo, ndele eke likwao la kwata eonga,
nomutungi keshe okwa li a mangela eongamukonda laye moshiya shaye ndele ta tungu, nomushiki wenghuma a kala ofika pwaame.
Ndele nda lombwela ovanamadina novakomesho novanhu vamwe: “Oshilonga oshinene nosha tandavela, ndele fye otwe lihanena kohotekuma ndele tu lyaafane kokule.
Konhele apa tamu udu ondaka yenghuma nye mu nokwoongala pufye. Kalunga ketu ote ke tu kondjela.”
Ndele fye osho twa longa oshilonga, fimbo etanga limwe lovanhu ve kwete omaonga okudja ketendo leluwa fiyo eenyofi da holoka.
Naame yo nda lombwela ovanhu pefimbo olo: Keshe umwe e nokukala pamwe novapiya vaye oufiku muJerusalem, opo ve tu kwafe oufiku mokunangela nomomutenya mokulonga.
Ndele ame mwene noovakwetu novanhu vange novalumenhu ovanangeli ava va shikula nge, inatu lidula oikutu yetu. Keshe umwe e kwete eonga meke laye.
5: Ndele ovafyoona novakainhu vavo va popyaana pombada ovakwao Ovajuda;
ndele vamwe tava ti: “Fye tu nokuyandja ovana vetu ovamati noukadona ombabyona opo tu mone oilya tu lye tu kale nomwenyo!”
Ndele vakwao tava ti: “Fye twa li tu nokuyandja omapya noikokola yetu yomiviinyu neengulu detu ombabyona, tu dule okulanda oilya mondjala!”
Ndele vamwe vali tava ti: “Fye otwa yandja omapya etu noikokola yetu yomiviinyu eengele tu mone oimaliwa yefendelo lohamba.

Ndele paife; omalutu etu e li ngaashi omalutu ovakwetu novana vetu ve li ngaho ngaashi ovana vavo, ndele nande ongaha, fye tu nokuyandja ovana vetu ovamati noukadona va ninge ovapika ndele novana vetu oukadona va ninga nokuli ovapika, ndele hatu nyengwa okuninga sha moshinima osho. Nomapya etu noikokola yetu yomiviinyu ya ninga yovanhu vamwe.”
Ndele eshi nda uda omakemo avo neendjovo odo, ame nda handuka unene.

Ndele nda diladila momwenyo wange ndele nda twifa ovanamadina novakomesho eemhata ndele handi ti kuvo: “Mokuyandja eengele nye otamu nyeka mokutambula oishoshela keshe umwe kumukwao.” Naame onde va shivila oshiongalele shinene,

ndele handi ti kuvo: “Paenghono detu twa kulila Ovajuda vakwetu, ovo va landwa po kovapaani. Ndele nye otamu landifa po ovamwaxo, vo ove nokulilandifa po kufye?” Ndele vo ova mwena, va nyengwa okunyamukula sha.
Ndele nde va lombwela vali: “Osho mwe shi ninga, inashi wapala. Ndishi mu nokweenda metilo laKalunga ketu nokuli omolwesheko lovapaani, ovatondadi vetu?
Ame mwene yo noovakwetu novapiya vange, otwa yandja kuvo oimaliwa noilya eengele. Tu dimeni po oikolo oyo!

Hano nena nokuli va alulileni omapya avo, oikokola yavo yomiviinyu, omiti davo deemono neengulu davo noshitukulwa oshitifele shomoimaliwa yavo noshomoilya yavo noshomomaviinyu noshomomaadi, oyo mwe i va pa eengele.”
Opo nee vo tava ti: “Fye ohatu ke shi va alulila ndele itatu fininike sha kuvo. Fye ohatu ka ninga ngaashi ove we tu lombwela.” Ndele nda ifana ovapristeli ndele nde va anifa va ninge pandjovo oyo.

Ndele nda tukumuna yo oshikutu shange ndele handi ti: “Kalunga na tukumune omulumenhu keshe ou ita wanifa ondjovo tuu ei, meumbo laye nomwaashi e shi kwete. Ndele na tukumunwe ngaha a kale ehe na sha!” Opo nee oshiongalele ashishe tashi ti: “Amen!” Ndele va hambelela Omwene, novanhu va ninga pandjovo ei.

Okudja kefiku linya nda tulwa po ndi ninge omupangeli wavo moshilongo shaJuda, okomudo omutimilongo mbali fiyo okomudo omutimilongo nhatu nomutivali wohamba Artasasta, oule womido omulongo nambali, ame novamwatate inatu lya oikulya yovapangeli.

Osheshi ovapangeli ovo va tetekela nge, ova djuupaleka unene oshiwana ndele va kufa kusho oikulya nomaviinyu avo nosho yo eesekeli omilongo nhee doshisiliveli. Ovapiya vavo yo ova hepeka oshiwana, ndelenee ame inandi shi ninga omolwetilo lokutila Kalunga.
Ndele ame mwene yo nda li moshilonga shokutunga ohote nomutima aushe. Inatu lilandela epya. Novapiya vange aveshe va ongala poilonga.
NOvajuda ovakomesho ovalumenhu efele nomilongo nhano naavenya va dja kovapaani vomoushiinda ve uya kwaame, ova li koshililo shange.

Ndele osho sha longekidwa efiku keshe: Ongobe imwe, eedi hamano da ondolwa needila, oda longekidwa pakufuta kwange, ndele efiku etimulongo keshe omaviinyu e lili nae lili mahapu unene. Ndele inandi pula eendja tadi pewa ovapangeli, shaashi oshilonga sha djuupaleka unene ovanhu ava.
Kalunga kange, dimbulukwa ashishe osho nda ningila ovanhu ava, shi etele nge ouwa.
6: Ndele Sanballat naTobia naGeshem Omuarabi novatondadi vetu vamwe eshi va kundana, nokutya nda tunga ohotekuma ndele inapa fyaala nande omufya inau vandekwa, nande pefimbo olo inandi tula mo omipito domoivelo natango,
Sanballat naGesem va shiivifila nge: “Ila, tu shakeneni momukunda umwe womefilu Ono.” Ndelenee ova diladila okuningila nge owii.
Opo nee nde va tumina ovatumwa oku va lombwela: “Ame ndi li moshilonga shinene, onghee hano ihandi dulu okuuya. Omolwashike oshilonga tashi mwena ame eshi handi shi efa ndi uye kunye?”
Natango va tumina nge lune panghedi oyo naame nde va nyamukula ngaashi nda tile.
Opo nee Sanballat a tumina nge omutumwa olutitano panghedi oye e nonhumwafo inai tuvikwa meke laye.
Omo mwa shangwa: “Moiwana hamu popiwa, ngaashi Gesem ta ti: Ove nOvajuda tamu diladila okutwila ohamba ondubo. Onghee ove to tungu ohotekuma, ndele wa hala u ninge ohamba yavo, osho taku tiwa.
Ove wa tula po ovaxunganeki ve ku udife muJerusalem nokutya, oove ohamba yOvajuda! Ndele paife, oinima ya tya ngaha tai ka udika kohamba. Ila hano tu kundafane.”
Ndelenee nde mu shiivifila: “Oinima ya tya ngaha we i popya inai ningwa, oove mwene we i tota.”
Osheshi vo aveshe va li va hala oku tu mbadapaleka ndele va diladila: “Omake avo taa ka tyololoka okulonga, sho shiha ningwe.” Pameka hano omake ange!

Ndele eshi nde uya mongulu yaShemaia yaDelaja yaMehetabel, ye fimbo a li a fitikininwa mo, ye ta ti: “Tu ye pamwe mongulu yaKalunga, meni lotembeli, ndele tu idileni po oivelo yotembeli; osheshi tave uya oku ku dipaa, heeno, tave uya oufiku ve ku dipae!”
Ndelenee ame nda tya: “Omulumenhu ngaashi ame ta i tuu onhapo? Ndele umwe ngaashi ame ota dulu ngahelipi okuya motembeli ndele ta kala nomwenyo? Itandi ka ya mo.”
Osheshi onda dimbulukwa, nokutya Kalunga ine mu tuma, ndelenee ye okwa lombwela nge exunganeko olo, shaashi a futwa kuSanballat naTobia.
Okwa pewa ombubo opo a mbadapaleke nge, ndi ninge ngaha ndele ndi nyone opo va mone sha va lundile nge nokusheka nge.
Kalunga kange, dimbulukwa Tobia naSanballat pailonga ei yavo, nosho yo omuxunganeki omukainhu Noadja novaxunganeki vamwe vo va hala okumbadapaleka nge!
Nohotekuma ya pwa okutungwa mefiku etimilongo mbali netitano mohani Elul, eshi pa pita omafiku omilongo nhano nambali.
Novatondadi vetu aveshe eshi ve shi uda, noiwana aishe yomoushiinda ya tila ndele ye litala itai dulu sha vali, ndele ve shi dimbulukwa, nokutya oshilonga eshi sha longwa kuKalunga ketu.
Pomafiku enya eenhumwafo yo dihapu da shangwa kovanamadina vaJuda odo da tuminwa Tobia, naadi daTobia de uya kuvo.
Osheshi muJuda mwa li vahapu va hangana naye neano, shaashi ye okwa li oshitenya shaSekanja yaArah, nomona waye omumati Johanan okwa hombola Mesullam, omona okakadona kaBerekia.
Vo ova lombwela nge yo ouwa waye, ndele va twala eendjovo dange kuye. Tobia okwa tuma eenhumwafo a mbadapaleke nge.
7: Nohotekuma eshi ya tungwa, ame nda tula mo omivelo. Novanangeli vopoivelo novaimbi nOvalevi va tulwa po.
Ndele omumwatate Hanani, naHanania, omukulunhu wohotengulu, nde va lenga ovapangeli vaJerusalem, osheshi ye okwa li omulumenhu e shii kulineekelwa ndele ha tila Kalunga, e dule vahapu,

ndele nde va lombwela: Oivelo yaJerusalem iha yeululwe fimbo omutenya inau twa. Novanangeli fimbo ve li po poivelo, oivelo i nokwiidilwa po nokutula po omiti da shindjakana. Noonakukala muJerusalem nava tulwe mo ovanangeli, nakeshe umwe ponhele yaye nakeshe umwe pongulu yaye.
Oshilando shoovene sha li shinene sha tandavela, ndelenee ovanhu vomusho va li vanini, neengulu inadi tungululwa natango.

Opo nee Kalunga a tula momutima wange ediladilo nokutya, ndi ifane ovanamadina novakomesho novanhu va ongale, va shangelwa meshikulafano lomapata. Naame nda mona eshikulafano lovanhu ava ve uya tete, ndele nda mona, nokutya mulo mwa shangwa:
Ava hano oonakukalamo moshitukulwalongo eshi, vo va dja moukwatwa weenghwate, odo Nebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon, ye di twala, ndele da aluka kuJerusalem nomuJuda, keshe imwe moshilando shayo.

Ovo ve uya pamwe naSerubbabel, Josua, Nehemia, Asaria, Raamja, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilsan, Misperet, Bigvai, Nehum, Baana.
Omuvalu wovalumenhu vomoshiwana shaIsrael ou:
Ovana vaParos omayovi avali nefele nomilongo hetatu navavali,
ovana vaSefatja omafele atatu nomilongo heyali navavali,
ovana vaArah omafele ahamano nomilongo nhano navavali,
ovana vaPahat-Moab nokutya, oludalo laJosua nolaJoab omayovi avali nomafele ahetatu nomulongo navahetatu,
ovana vaElam eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo nhano navane,
ovana vaSattu omafele ahetatu nomilongo nhee navatano,
ovana vaSakkai omafele aheyali nomilongo hamano,
ovana vaBinnui omafele ahamano nomilongo nhee navahetatu,
ovana vaBebai omafele ahamano nomilongo mbali navahetatu,
ovana vaAsgad omayovi avali nomafele atatu nomilongo mbali navavali,
ovana vaAdonikam omafele ahamano nomilongo nhano navaheyali,
ovana vaBigvai omayovi avali nomilongo hamano navaheyali,
ovana vaAdin omafele ahamano nomilongo nhano navatano,
ovana vaAter nokutya, Hiskia, omilongo omugoi navahetatu,
ovana vaHasum omafele atatu nomilongo mbali navahetatu,
ovana vaBesai omafele atatu nomilongo mbali navane,
ovana vaHarif efele nomulongo navavali,
ovana vaGibeon omilongo omugoi navatano,
Ovabetlehem nOvanetofa efele nomilongo hetatu navahetatu,
ovalumenhu vokuAnatot efele nomilongo mbali navahetatu,
ovalumenhu vaAsmavet omilongo nhee navavali,
ovalumenhu vokuKiriat-Jearim, Kefira naBeerot omafele aheyali nomilongo nhee navatatu,
ovalumenhu vokuRama naGeba omafele ahamano nomilongo mbali naumwe,
ovalumenhu vokuMikmas efele nomilongo mbali navavali,
ovalumenhu vokuBetel naAi efele nomilongo mbali navatatu,
ovalumenhu vokuNebo omilongo nhano navavali,
ovana vaElam mukwao eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo mbali navane,
ovana vaHarim omafele atatu nomilongo mbali,
ovana vaJeriko omafele atatu nomilongo nhee navatano,
ovana vaLod, Hadid naOno omafele aheyali nomilongo mbali naumwe,
ovana vaSenaa omayovi atatu nomafele amugoi nomilongo nhatu.
Ovapristeli: ovana vaJedaja vomepata laJosua omafele omugoi nomilongo heyali navatatu,
ovana vaImmer eyovi nomilongo nhano navavali,
ovana vaPashur eyovi nomafele ane navaheyali,
ovana vaHarim eyovi nefele navaheyali,
Ovalevi: ovana vaJosua naKadmiel vomovana vaHodavia omilongo heyali navane.
Ovaimbi: ovana vaAsaf efele nomilongo nhee navahetatu.
Ovana vovanangeli vopoivelo: ovana vaSallum, ovana vaAter, ovana vaTalmon, ovana vaAkkub, ovana vaHatita, ovana vaSobai, aveshe kumwe efele nomilongo nhatu navahetatu.
Ovayakuli votembeli: ovana vaSiha, ovana vaHasufa, ovana vaTabbaot;
ovana vaKeros, ovana vaSia, ovana vaPadon;
ovana vaLebana, ovana vaHagaba, ovana vaSalmai;
ovana vaHanan, ovana vaGiddel, ovana vaGahar;
ovana vaReaja, ovana vaResin, ovana vaNekoda;
ovana vaGassam, ovana vaUssa, ovana vaPaseah;
ovana vaBesai, ovana vaMeunim, ovana vaNefusim;
ovana vaBakbuk, ovana vaHakufa, ovana vaHarhur;
ovana vaBaslit, ovana vaMehida, ovana vaHarsa;
ovana vaBarkos, ovana vaSisera, ovana vaTemah;
ovana vaNesiah, ovana vaHatifa;
Ovana vovapiya vaSalomo: ovana vaSotai, ovana vaHassoferet, ovana vaPeruda;
ovana vaJaala, ovana vaDarkon, ovana vaGiddel;
ovana vaSefatja, ovana vaHattil, ovana vaPogeret-Hassebaim, ovana vaAmon.
Ovayakuli aveshe votembeli novana vovapiya vaSalomo va li omafele atatu nomilongo omugoi navavali.
Ndele ovo tuu ovo va dja kuTel-Melah, Tel-Harsa, Kerub, Addon, Immer, ndelenee va nyengwa okuholola omapata avo nooxekulu vavo ile ngeenge vo oludalo laIsrael:
ovana vaDelaja, novana vaTobia, novana vaNekoda va li omafele ahamano omilongo nhee navavali.
Ndele movana vovapristeli: ovana vaHobaja, ovana vaHakkos, ovana vaBarsillai, ou a hombola umwe womovana oukadona vaBarsillai, Omugilead, ndele a ifanwa pamadina avo.
Vo ova konga efina lepata lavo mwaava va tambulwa meshikulafano lepata, ndelenee inali monika. Onghee hano va talwa inava wana okuya moupristeli
Nomupangeli okwe va lombwela vaha lye meeshali diyapukielela fiyo taku holoka omupristeli e na Urim naTummim.
Oshiongalele ashishe sha li omayovi omilongo nhee naavali nomafele atatu nomilongo ahamano,
ponho yovapika ovalumenhu novakainhu. Vo va li omayovi aheyali nomafele atatu nomilongo nhatu navaheyali. Ndele pa li ovaimbi ovalumenhu novakainhu omafele avali nomilongo nhee navatano.
Eenghambe davo da li omafele aheyali nomilongo nhatu nahamano, nomamula avo omafele atatu omilongo nhee naatano.
Eengamelo omafele ane nomilongo nhatu nanhano, eendongi omayovi ahamano nomafele aheyali nomilongo mbali.

Ndele vamwe vomovakulunhu vomapata va yandjela etungo eeshali. Omupangeli okwa yandja koshikefa shoimaliwa yetungo eekilograma hetatu doingoldo, omaholo omilongo nhano noikutu yokoshi omafele atano nomilongo nhatu yovapristeli
Ndele vamwe vomovakulunhu vomapata va yandja koshikefa shoimaliwa yetungo eekilograma efele nomilongo hamano nahetatu doingoldo neekilograma eyovi nomafele avali nomilongo nhano doisiliveli.
Noixupe yovanhu ya yandja ngaha: eekilograma efele nomilongo hamano nahetatu doingoldo, neekilograma efele nomilongo nhee doisiliveli, noikutu omilongo hamano naiheyali youpristeli.
Osho ngaha hano ovapristeli nOvalevi novanangeli vopoivelo novaimbi novomovanhu novayakuli votembeli nOvaisraeli aveshe va tula moilando yavo.
8: Ndele ohani onhiheyali eshi ye uya, Ovaisraeli fimbo va kala moilando yavo, oshiwana ashishe sha ongala ngaashi omunhu umwe ponhele ya andjuka komesho yOshivelo shomeva ndele ovanhu va lombwela Esra, omunongo womishangwa, a ete embo lomhango yaMoses, ei Omwene e i pa Ovaisraeli.
Ndele omupristeli Esra okwa eta omhango komesho yoshiongalele shovalumenhu noshovakainhu naaveshe ve neendunge oku i uda. Eshi osha ningwa mefiku lotete mohani onhiheyali.

Nokwa lesha mo muyo ponhele ya andjuka komesho yOshivelo shomeva, oketendo leluwa fiyo opokati komutenya moipafi yovalumenhu noyovakainhu ava ve neendunge okushiiva. Nomatwi ovanhu aveshe ve a pakalekela embo lomhango.

Nomunongo womishangwa Esra okwa kala ofika koshipundi shile shoiti osho ve shi pangelela oshiongalele eshi, ndele puye kolulyo laye pa kala ofika: Matitia naSema naAnaja naUria naHilkia naMaasea. Ndele kolumosho laye: Pedaja naMishael naMalkia naHasum naHasbaddana, Sakaria naMesullam.
Ndele Esra okwa pandja embo moipafi yovanhu aveshe, osheshi ye okwa li a kala ofika a londa e dule ovanhu aveshe. Ndele ye eshi e li pandja, ovanhu aveshe va kala ofika.
Ndele Esra okwa hambelela Omwene Kalunga kanene, oshiwana ashishe osha nyamukula nokuyelula omake asho: “Amen! Amen!” opo ve linyongamena nokwiilikana Omwene, oipala yavo ya twa pedu.
Ndele Josua naBani naSerebja, Jamin, Akkub, Sabbetai, Hodia, Maasea, Kelita, Asaria, Josabad, Hanan, Pelaja nOvalevi va longa ovanhu omhango, fimbo ovanhu va kala ofika peenhele davo.
Ndele vo va lesha membo, momhango yaKalunga, va lesha nawa ndele ve i fatulula, opo va kale ve udite ko odo da leshwa.

Opo nee omupangeli Nehemia naEsra omupristeli nomunongo womishangwa nOvalevi ovo va longa oshiwana nokulombwela oshiwana ashishe tava ti: “Efiku eli ola yapulilwa Omwene Kalunga keni. Inamu nyika oluhodi nye inamu lila!” Osheshi oshiwana ashishe sha lila, eshi sha uda eendjovo domhango.

Ye okwe va lombwela vali: “Indeni mu ka lye eendja dinyenye ndele mu ka nwe oikunwa inyenye, ndele tumeni eendja kwaava inava telekelwa sha. Osheshi efiku eli la yapulilwa Omwene wetu; onghee hano inamu nyika oluhodi, osheshi ehafo mOmwene olo eenghono deni.”
NOvalevi va ngungumaneka oshiwana ashishe ndele tava ti: “Mweneni! Osheshi efiku eli oliyapuki. Onghee hano inamu nyika oluhodi.”
Opo oshiwana ashishe sha fikama sha lya ndele sha nwa ndele sha tumina eendja ovo inava telekelwa sha ndele sha dana oshivilo shehafo. Osheshi osho sha li shi udite ko eendjovo she di lombwelwa.
Ndele mefiku la shikula ovakulunhu vomapata oshiwana ashishe, novapristeli nOvalevi, va ongala puEsra, omunongo womishangwa, va ongalela eendjovo domhango di findilwe mo.
Opo nee va mona momhango yOmwene e i lombwela Moses, mwa shangelwa, nokutya ovana vaIsrael ve nokukala momatwali moshivilo tashi danwa mohani onhiheyali,

ndele vo ve nokuvilikila nokutuma moilando aishe nomuJerusalem nokutya: “Indeni keemhunda mu ka tale ko oitai yolumono noitai yolumono lomuliete noitai yamirti noivale yomilunga, noitai yomiti di nomafo a hapa, mu ninge omatwali ngaashi pa shangwa.”
Novanhu va ya ndele ve i eta ndele ve li ningila omatwali, keshe umwe konduda yaye nomoluumbo longulu yaKalunga nomonhele ya andjuka yopOshivelo shomeva nomonhele ya andjuka yopOshivelo shaEfraim.

Noshiongalele ashishe shaava va aluka va dja moukwatwa, ova ninga omatwali ndele va kala momatwali. Osheshi okudja komafiku aJosua yaNun fiyo okefiku olo, ovana vaIsrael inave shi ninga. Ndele pa li ehafo linene.

Okwa lesha membo lomhango yaKalunga keshe efiku, okudja kefiku lotete fiyo okefiku laxuuninwa. Ndele va dana oshivilo omafiku aheyali ndele mefiku etihetatu okwa li oshiongalele shoshivilo pamalombwelo.
