9: Ndele mefiku etimilongo mbali netine lohani ei ovana vaIsrael va ongala ndele ve lidilika va djala oikutu yeefya ndele ve liunda edu komitwe davo.
Noludalo laIsrael le likufa mo movanailongo aveshe li likalele, ndele va kala ofika tava hepaulula omatimba avo noulunde wooxe.

Ndele va kala ofika peenhele davo ndele va leshelwa membo lomhango yOmwene Kalunga kavo mokafimbo okatine komefiku, ndele va hepaulula omatimba nokwiilikana Omwene Kalunga kavo mokafimbo okatine komefiku.
Ndele mOvalevi Josua naBani, Kadmiel, Sebanja, Bunni, Serebja, Bani, Kenani va londa keenhele dOvalevi opo pa tumba ndele va indila nondaka yopombada Omwene Kalunga kavo.

NOvalevi Josua naKadmiel, Bani, Hasabneja, Serebja, Hodia, Sebanja, Petahja tava ti: “Kaleni ofika! Hambeleleni Omwene Kalunga keni alushe fiyo omoukwaalushe! Edina loye la fimana nali hambelelwe, lo ola yeluka kombada omapandulo nomahambelelo aeshe!”

Esra okwa ti: “Oove auke Omwene, Ove wa ninga eulu, eulu lopombadelela neengudi dalo adishe, nedu naaishe i li ko, nefuta naaishe i li mo, naaishe oyo Ove to i diinine i kale nomwenyo, nomatanga omeulu tae linyongamene koshipala shoye.
Oove Omwene Kalunga, wa hoolola Abram ndele we mu kufa mo muUr shomuKaldea ndele we mu lukulula Abraham.

Ndele wa mona omutima waye wa li omudiinini koshipala shoye, ndele wa ninga naye ehangano, nokutya u pe oludalo laye edu lOvakaanan nOvaheti nOvaamori nOvaperesi nOvajebusi nOvagirgasi; ndele wa wanifa eendjovo doye, osheshi Ove omuyuki.
“Ndele wa mona oluhepo lootate muEgipiti nowa uda onghuwo yavo pEfuta Litilyana.

Ndele Farao novapiya vaye aveshe novanhu aveshe vomoshilongo shaye we va ningila omadidiliko noikumwifalonga. Osheshi wa li u shi shii, nokutya vo ove va hepeka mokulinenepeka, Ove we liningila edina ngaashi li li nena eli.
Owa tukula efuta komesho yavo, onghee va tauluka efuta va enda poukukutu. Ndelenee ovataatai vavo we va ekela moule mwi, ngaashi emanya momeva manene.
Ndele we va kwatela komesho omutenya moluudi loshilemo ndele oufiku moluudi lomundilo u va minikilile ondjila nayo va li ve nokweenda.
Ove wa londoloka komhunda yaSinai ndele we va popifa, owe va pa omalombwelo a yuka neemhango di shii kulineekelwa, eenghedimhango diwa noipango.
Owe va shiivifila Eshabata loye liyapuki ndele we va pefifa omupiya woye Moses, oipango neenghedimhango.

Mondjala yavo Ove we va pa omungome tau di keulu, ndele menota lavo we va kungulukifila omeva taa di memanya, nowe va lombwela va ye va ka nangale oshilongo osho we shi va udanekela neano u shi va pe.
Ndelenee venya, nokutya ootate, va li va shishimana nova kukutika eefingo davo ndele inava dulika koipango yoye,

heeno, va anya okudulika noinava dimbulukwa oikumwifalonga yoye, oyo we i va longela mokati kavo. Ndelenee va kukutika eefingo davo ndele moku ku twila ondubo ve lihoololela omukulunhu va shune moupika muEgipiti. Ndelenee Ove Kalunga ho dimi po omatimba, u nonghenda nolune, u nonheni ndele Oove omunene mouwanghenda: Ove wa li ino va ekelashi.
Nande ve li ningila onhana ya telekwa monhelekelo ndele tava ti: ‘Kalunga koye oyoo, e ku pitifa mo muEgipiti!’ Nande va ninga oinima inene yoixuna yokusheka Kalunga,

Ove omolwefilonghenda loye linene ino va efa mombuwa. Oluudi loshilemo inali kanduka po puvo omutenya, le va endifa nondjila, noluudi lomundilo yo oufiku le va minikilila ondjila vo va li ve nokweenda nayo.
Ndele we va pa Omhepo yoye iwa, i va longe, omakanya avo ino a anyena omanna, ndele we va pa omeva menota lavo.
Nomido omilongo nhee we va kalela noshisho mombuwa. Vo inava hepa sha. Noikutu yavo inai kulupa neemhadi davo inadi dinda.
“Ndele mepangelo lavo wa yandja oilongo noiwana Ove we i taulila eengaba. Ovo ova nangala oshilongo shaSihon, heeno, oshilongo shohamba yaHesbon, noshilongo shaOg, ohamba yaBasan.
Novana vavo we va hapupalifa ve fike peenyofi dokeulu. Ndele we va twala mo moshilongo, osho we shi lombwela ooxe nokutya, vo va ye mo ve ke shi nangale.

Novana va ya mo ndele va nangala oshilongo noonakukalamo moshilongo, Ovakaanan, we va taataa komesho yavo, ndele we va yandja meke lavo, neehamba davo ngaashi yo ovanhu voilongo, ve va ningile ngaashi va hala.

Ndele va nangala oilando i neehotekuma nedu liwa, nova tinha eengulu di yadi oinima iwa i lili nai lili, eendungu da pandwa memanya, oikokola yomiviinyu nomiti domalumono nomiti dihapu doiimati. Ova lya ndele va kuta ndele va ondoka nova kala ve noshishipo omolwouwa woye munene.

Ndele inava dulika vo ve ku twila ondubo nova ekela omhango yoye kombuda yavo. Novaxunganeki voye ovo ve va londwela, ve va alulile kwoove, ve va dipaa ndele va ninga oinima inene yoixuna yokusheka Kalunga.

Onghee hano Ove we va yandja momake ovatondadi vavo, ndele ovo ve va fininika. Ndelenee alushe ngeenge va kuwa kwoove mefimbo loudjuu wavo, Ove we va uda meulu omolwefilonghenda loye linene, we va pa ovaxupifi, ve va xupife momake ovatondadi vavo.

Ndelenee shamha va mono etulumuko, va ninga vali owii koshipala shoye, ndele Ove we va yandja momake ovatondadi vavo, vo ve va pangele. Vo eshi ve ku ifana vali, Ove we va uda meulu, ndele omolwefilonghenda loye we va xupifa luhapu.

Ndele Ove we va londwela va aluke komhango yoye, ndelenee ve linenepeka ndele inava pwilikina oipango yoye, ndele va nyona keenghedimhango doye, nande: omunhu ou te di diinine, ota ka kala e nomwenyo molwado. Ndelenee vo ove ku pilamena, ve ku pa ombuda ndele va kukutika eefingo davo ndele inava pwilikina.
Nomido dihapu wa li u nolukeno navo ndele we va londola nOmhepo yoye nomakanya ovaxunganeki. Ndelenee vo va li inava hala okuuda. Onghee hano we va yandja momake oiwana yoilongo.
Ndelenee omolwefilonghenda loye linene Ove ino va mana po sheke ndele ino va efa, osheshi Oove Kalunga u nefilonghenda nonghenda.

“Hano paife Kalunga ketu, munene, omunamapangelo, Kalunga onakutilika, ou ho diinine ehangano loye nouwanghenda woye: oupyakadi oo aushe, uhe u tale oo unini, we tu hanga ko neehamba detu novakulunhu vetu novapristeli vetu novaxunganeki vetu, ootate novanhu voye aveshe, okudja komafimbo eehamba daAsiria fiyo okefiku eli.
Ndelenee Ove omuyuki mwaashishe she tu hanga, osheshi Ove wa li omudiininini moilonga yoye, ndelenee fye twa li ovahenakalunga.
Neehamba detu novakulunhu vetu novapristeli vetu nootate vetu inava wanifa omhango yoye ndele inava dulika koipango yoye nokeendobwedi doye we tu londola nado.
Ndele nande va kala moshilongo shavo vene nomouyadi weeshali doye, odo we di va pele, ndele va kala medu la tandavela noli nouwa, vo inava aluluka moilonga yavo ii.
Paife fye ovapika. Moshilongo tuu osho we shi pele ootate vetu, vo va lye oiimati noipewa yasho, moshilongo tuu osho tu nokukala fye ovapika.
Oshishipo shasho tashi pewa eehamba odo we di tula po di tu pangele omolwomatimba etu, ndele do otadi pangele omalutu etu noimuna yetu pahalo lavo, ndele fye otu li moudjuu munene.”
Ndelenee molwoinima aishe ei ohatu ningi ehangano la pama ndele hatu li pameke mokushanga omadina etu. Momushangwa wa hakwa ovakulunhu vetu nOvalevi vetu novapristeli vetu va shanga.
10: Ndele momishangwa da hakwa ava va shanga ovava: Omupangeli Nehemia yaHakalja, naSedekia,
Seraja, Asaria, Jeremia,
Pashur, Amarja, Malkia,
Hattus, Sebanja, Malluk,
Harim, Meremot, Obadja,
Daniel, Ginneton, Baruk,
Mesullam, Abia, Mijamin,
Maasia, Bilgai, Shemaia, ovo hano ovapristeli.
NOvalevi: Josua yaAsanja, Binnui womovana vaHenadad, Kadmiel,
novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu: Sebanja, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaja, Hanan,
Mikka, Rehob, Hasabja,
Sakkur, Serebja, Sebanja,
Hodia, Bani, Beninu.
Ovakulunhu vovanhu: Paros, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Sattu, Bani,
Bunni, Asgad, Bebai,
Adonia, Bigvai, Adin,
Ater, Hiskia, Assur,
Hodia, Hasum, Besai,
Harif, Anatot, Nebai,
Mahpias, Mesullam, Hesir,
Mesesabel, Sadok, Jaddua,
Pelatja, Hanan, Anaja,
Hosea, Hanania, Hassub,
Hallohes, Pilha, Sobek,
Rehum, Hasabna, Maasea,
Ahia, Hanan, Anan,
Malluk, Harim naBaana.

Noshixupe shoshiwana, ovapristeli nOvalevi, ovanangeli vopoivelo, ovaimbi, ovayakuli votembeli naaveshe ovo ve likufa moiwana yoilongo nova ame komhango yaKalunga ovalikadi vavo novana vavo ovamati noukadona, keshe umwe, ou e neendunge doku i uda ko,

va ama kuvakwao ovalumenhu ovanamadina mokati kavo ndele va ana nokwaanenena nokutya, oshinakuwanifwalonga shavo osho okudiinina omhango yaKalunga ya pelwe Moses, omupiya waKalunga, nokudiinina nokuwanifa oipango aishe yOmwene, Kalunga ketu nomalombwelo aye neenghedimhango daye.
Navali, itatu ka yandja ovana vetu oukadona kovanhu voilongo, ndele itatu ka konga ovana vavo oukadona va hombolwe kovana vetu ovamati.

Novanhu voilongo eshi tava eta oipindi noilya i lili nai lili ve i landife mefiku lEshabata, fye itatu lande sha kuvo mEshabata ile mefiku liyapuki. Ndele momudo omutiheyali hatu efa omapya a tulumukwe, neengele itatu di pula.
Ndele twa udafana oshinakuwanifwa eshi, nokutya tu yandje momudo keshe okatitatu kosekeli molweyakulo lomotembeli yaKalunga.

Molwomingome detaliko nomolweendjayambo defiku keshe nomolwexwikiloyambo lefiku keshe, molwomayambo omEshabata, omayambo eehani dipe, nomolwomafimbo oivilo, nomolweeshali diyapuki nomolwomatimbayambo okukwatakanifa Ovaisraeli, nomolwakeshe oshilonga shomongulu yaKalunga ketu.

Ndele fye ovapristeli nOvalevi noshiwana, twa umba oshihoololifo molwokweeta oikuni opo tu i etele ongulu yaKalunga ketu pamaumbo momafimbo a pangelwa omudo keshe, i xwikwe po koaltari yOmwene Kalunga ketu ngaashi sha shangwa momhango,
ndele twa udafana tu etele ongulu yOmwene omudo keshe oshipe shomomapya etu noshipe shomomiti di lili doiimati,

noiveli yomovana vetu ovamati noiveli yomoimuna yetu ngaashi sha shangwa momhango, noiveli yeengobe detu noyeedi detu, tu i twale kongulu yaKalunga ketu kovapristeli ava hava longo mongulu yaKalunga ketu,

twa udafana nokutya hatu ka eta moufila woshipe nomeeshali deyambo nomoiimati yomiti di lili nadi lili, momaviinyu nomomaadi kovapristeli momalimba ongulu yaKalunga ketu noitimulongo yomomapya etu kOvalevi. Ovalevi voovene hava ongele oitimulongo momikunda detu adishe.
Nomupristeli womoludalo laAron e nokukala pamwe nOvalevi, Ovalevi eshi hava ongele oitimulongo; nOvalevi ve nokweeta oitimulongo kongulu yaKalunga momalimba ongulu yomamona.

Osheshi Ovaisraeli nOvalevi ve nokweeta eeshaliyambo doilya nodomaviinyu nodomaadi keendjuwo omo oinima yotembeli i li mo, novapristeli ava ve li moshilonga novanangeli vopoivelo novaimbi ve li mo. Osheshi inatu hala okweefa ongulu yaKalunga ketu.
11: Novakulunhu voshiwana va kala muJerusalem, ndelenee oshixupe shovanhu va umba oshihoololifo, opo umwe womwaava omulongo a kale moshilando shiyapuki shaJerusalem, ndele vakwao omugoi omomikunda.
Novanhu va nangeka noupuna ovalumenhu aveshe ovo va hala kehalo lavo liwa okukala muJerusalem.

Novakulunhu voshitukulwalongo, ava va kala muJerusalem ovava: momikunda domuJuda keshe umwe a kala mepya laye lomoshilando shavo: Ovaisraeli ovapristeli nOvalevi novayakuli votembeli novana vovapiya vaSalomo.
Ndele ovana vaJuda novana vaBenjamin va kala muJerusalem; movana vaJuda: Ataja yaUssia yaSakaria yaAmarja yaSefatja yaMehalalel, vo oludalo laPeres;
naMaasea yaBaruk yaKolhose yaHasaja yaAdaja yaJojarib yaSakaria, Omusilo.
Ovana ovalumenhu aveshe vaPeres ava va kala muJerusalem va li omafele ane nomilongo hamano navahetatu vo ovakwaita.
Novana vaBenjamin ovava: Sallu yaMesullam yaJoed yaPedaja yaKolaja yaMaasea yaItiel yaJesaja;
ndele a shikulwa kuGabbai-Sallai, omafele amugoi nomilongo mbali navahetatu.
Ndele Joel yaSikri okwa li omupashukili wavo. Ndele Juda yaHassenua okwa li omutivali moulenga mepangelo loshilando.
Movapristeli: Jedaja yaJojarib, Jakin,
Seraja yaHilkia yaMesullam yaSadok yaMerajot yaAhitub, elenga longulu yaKalunga.
Novamwaina vavo ovalumenhu ava va longa motembeli va li omafele ahetatu nomilongo mbali navavali. NaAdaja yaJeroham yaPelalja yaAmsi yaSakaria yaPashur yaMalkia,
novamwaina ovakulunhu vomapata va li omafele avali nomilongo nhee navavali. NaAmasai yaAsareel yaAksai yaMesillemot yaImmer,
novamwaina ovalumenhu, ovaladi, va li efele nomilongo mbali navahetatu, omupashukili wavo okwa li Sabdiel yaHaggedolim.
Ndele mOvalevi: Shemaia yaHassub yaAsrikam yaHasabja yaBunni,
naSabbetai naJosabad, ovakulunhu vOvalevi ova pashukila oilonga yopondje yongulu yaKalunga.
NaMattanja yaMikka yaSabdi yaAsaf, omuwiliki weimbilo lehambelelo, ou a hovela eimbilo lehambelelo naBakbukja, omutivali moulenga mokati kovamwaina. NaAbda yaSammua yaGalal yaJedutun.
Ovalevi aveshe vomoshilando shiyapuki va li omafele avali nomilongo hetatu navane.
Novanangeli vopoivelo: Akkub, Talmon novamwaina ovalumenhu ava va nangela poivelo va li efele nomilongo heyali navavali.
NOvaisraeli vamwe, ovapristeli nOvalevi ova li moilando aishe yomuJuda, keshe umwe moshitukulwafyuululwa shaye.
Novayakuli votembeli va kala koshikulundu shaOfel. Ndele Siha naGispa va li ovapashukili vovayakuli votembeli.
Nomupashukili wOvalevi vomuJerusalem okwa li Ussi yaBani yaHasabja yaMattanja yaMikka yaAsaf, ovaimbi va longa mongulu yaKalunga.
Osheshi pa li oshipango shohamba tashi va tongo, onghedi ya pama yovaimbi va pewe eemhumbwe davo dakeshe efiku.
Ndele Petahja yaMesesabel womovana vaSera yaJuda okwa li elenga lokufikifa eendjovo adishe dovanhu kohamba.
Ndele komikunda odo kwa li ku nomapya avo. Vomovana vaJuda va kala muKiriat-Arba nomoipangelwa yasho nomuDibon nomoipangelwa yasho nomuJekabseel nomomikunda dasho,
nomuJosua nomuMolada nomuBet-Pelet
nomuHasar-Sual nomuBerseba nomoipangelwa yasho,
nomuSiklag nomuMegona nomoipangelwa yasho,
nomuEn-Rimmon nomuSorea nomuJarmut,
Sanoa, Adullam nomikunda dayo, Lakis nomapya asho opomunghulo, Aseka noipangelwa yasho; ndele va kala meenhanda okudja kuBerseba fiyo okefilu laHinnom.
Novana vaBenjamin: va kala okudja muGeba muMikmas naAja naBetel noipangelwa yasho,
Anatot, Nob, Ananja,
Hasor, Rama, Gittaim,
Hadid, Seboim, Neballat,
Lod naOno, Geharasim.
Ndele mOvalevi eengudu dimwe daJuda, da kala muBenjamin.
12: Ovapristeli nOvalevi ovo ve uya pamwe naSerubbabel yaSalatiel naJosua, ovava: Seraja, Jeremia, Esra,
Amarja, Malluk, Hattus,
Sekanja, Rehum, Meremot,
Iddo, Ginnetoi, Abia,
Mijamin, Maadja, Bilga,
Shemaia naJojarib, Jedaja,
Sallu, Amok, Hilkia, Jedaja. Ovo hano ovakulunhu vovapristeli novovamwaina ovalumenhu pomafiku aJosua.
NOvalevi ovava: Josua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Serebja, Juda, Mattanja, ou a wilika pamwe novamwaina ovalumenhu eengudu dovaimbi.
NaBakbukja naUnno, ovamwaina ovalumenhu, va kala ofika, ve va taalela mokuwanifa kwavo oshilonga shavo.
Ndele Josua okwa li xe yaJehoiakim. Ndele Jehoiakim okwa li xe yaEljasib, naEljasib okwa li xe yaJehoiada,
naJehoiada, oye xe yaJonatan, ndele Jonatan oye xe yaJaddua.
Ndele ovapristeli ava va li pomafiku aJehoiakim ovakulunhu vomapata: Meraja wepata laSeraja; Hanania wepata laJeremia;
Mesullam wepata laEsra, Johanan wepata laAmarja;
Jonatan wepata laMalluki; Josef wepata laSebanja;
Adna wepata laHarim; Helkai wepata laMerajot;
Sakaria wepata laIddo; Mesullam wepata laGinneton;
Sikri wepata laAbia; Piltai wepata laMinjamin wokuMoadja;
Sammua wepata laBilga; Jonatan wepata laShemaia;
Mattenai wepata laJojarib; Ussi wepata laJedaja;
Kallai wepata laSallai; Eber wepata laAmok;
Hasabja wepata laHilkia; Netanel wepata laJedaja.
MOvalevi opomafiku aEljasib, aJehoiada, aJohanan noaJaddua, ovakulunhu vomapata va shangwa novapristeli fiyo okepangelo laDarius, Omupersia.
Ovana vaLevi, ovakulunhu vomapata va shangelwa momushangwa womafimbo fiyo okomafiku aJohanan yaEljasib.
Ovakulunhu vOvalevi ovava: Hasabja, Serebja naJosua, Kadmiel, novamwaina ovalumenhu ava va kala ofika va shaama navo okuhambelela nokupandula palombwelo laDavid, omulumenhu waKalunga pongudu nongudu:
Mattanja naBakbukja, Obadja, Mesullam, Talmon, Akkub ova li ovanangeli vopoivelo, ava va nangela pomalimba opoivelo.
Vo ova li pomafiku aJehoiakim yaJosua yaJosadak nopomafiku omupangeli Nehemia nomupristeli Esra, omunongo womishangwa.

Nohotekuma yaJerusalem eshi ya li i nokuyapulwa, Ovalevi va kongwa meenhele davo adishe, va etwa kuJerusalem va dane oshivilo sheyapulo nehafo nomaimbilo epandulo, nokwiimba nokushika ounghuma nouxumbafeta neenyalilo.
Opo nee ovana ovamati vovaimbi va ongala va dja moushiinda waJerusalem nomomikunda dOvanetofa,
nomuBet-Gilgal nomomapya aGeba noaAsmavet, osheshi ovaimbi va tula mo momikunda da dingilila Jerusalem.
Novapristeli nOvalevi ve lifetifa nova yelifa ovanhu noivelo nekuma.
Ndele nda lombwela ovakulunhu vaJuda va londe kohotekuma ndele nda nangekela ko eengudu mbali dinene dovaimbi noyeendo yoshivilo kohotekuma, imwe kolulyo kombinga yOshivelo shoushosho,
ndele va shikulwa kuHosaja netata lovakulunhu vaJuda,
naAsaria, Esra naMesullam,
Juda naBenjamin naShemaia naJeremia,
novana ovalumenhu vovapristeli ve nomanghuma, Sakaria yaJonatan yaShemaia yaMattanja yaMikaia yaSakkur yaAsaf,
novamwaina ovalumenhu Shemaia naAsareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanel naJuda, Hanani, ve noishikomwa yaDavid, omulumenhu waKalunga. Ndele Esra omunongo womishangwa a kwatela osheendo komesho.
Ndele va enda nokuyuka va koya Oshivelo Shefifiya ndele va londa keendodo doshilando shaDavid konhele apa ohotekuma tai tumbu kombada yongulu yaDavid, fiyo okOshivelo shomeva shokoushilo.
Nongudu onhivali yovaimbi ya enda nokuyuka kouninginino, ya shikulwa kwaame noketata lovanhu, twa londa kohotekuma pOshungo yediko lokuteleka omingome, twa enda fiyo okekuma linene,
navali twa koya Oshivelo shaEfraim nOshivelo shikulu nOshivelo sheeshi noshungongulu Hananel noshungongulu Hammea fiyo okOshivelo sheedi. Ndele va kanghama, va kala ofika pOshivelo shodolongo.
Opo nee eengudu odo mbali dovaimbi da kala ofika mongulu yaKalunga, netata lovakulunhu ola li pwaame;
novapristeli Eliakim, Maasea, Minjamin, Mikaia, Eljoenai, Sakaria, Hanania ve nomanghuma,
naMaasea naShemaia naEliaser naUssi naJohanan naMalkia naElam naEser. Novaimbi va imba omaimbilo omahambelelo. Ndele Jisrakja okwa li omuwiliki.
Ndele mefiku tuu olo va yamba omayambo manene ndele va hafa, osheshi Kalunga e va hafifa unene. Novalikadi yo nounona va hafa, onghee hano ondaka yehafo lokuJerusalem la udika kokule.

Ndele mefiku tuu olo ovalumenhu va tulwa po okupashukila omalimba, omo mwa li eeshaliyambo, noshipe noitimulongo. Vo va li ve nokwoongela pamhango oitukulwa oyo yovapristeli noyOvalevi ava ve li moshilonga, tai ongelwa komapya oilando, osheshi Juda sha hafela ovapristeli nOvalevi ava va li moshilonga.
Ndele vo ova diinina oshilonga shavo mokulongela Kalunga kavo nomokuyelifa, nosho yo ovaimbi novanangeli vopoivelo palombwelo laDavid nolomona waye Salomo.
Osheshi noshitonale nokuli, mefimbo laDavid nolomwiimbifi Asaf, kwa li ovawiliki vovaimbi, ndele va imba ehambelelo nepandulo laKalunga.

NOvaisraeli aveshe vopomafiku aSerubbabel nopomafiku aNehemia va yandja oitimulongo kovaimbi nokovanangeli vopoivelo paemhumbwe defiku keshe. Ndele va yandja eeshali diyapuki kOvalevi, nOvalevi okOvaaron.
13: Efiku tuu olo va leshela momatwi ovanhu momhango yaMoses. Ndele omo mwa shangwa nokutya, nande Omuammoni ile Omumoabi umwe ita itavelelwa okuuya fiyo alushe meongalo laKalunga.
Osheshi inave uya okushakeneka ovana vaIsrael noku va etela omingome nomeva, ndele va futa Bileam e va tule omutima. Ndelenee Kalunga ketu okwa lundulula etulomutima la ninga enangeko noupuna.
Ndele vo eshi va uda omhango, ova tukula mo mOvaisraeli ovanhu aveshe ve neehonde da lumbakana.
Ndelenee nale omupristeli Eljasib, ou a tulwa po a pashukile eendjuwo domongulu yaKalunga nokwa li haukwe waTobia,

okwa longekidila Tobia ondjuwo inene, omo va tuvikila nale eendjayambo, oitwiminifo noilongifo noitimulongo yoilya noyomaviinyu noyomaadi, oitukulwa yopamhango yOvalevi noyovaimbi noyovanangeli vopoivelo neeshaliyambo dovapristeli.

Ndelenee oinima oyo aishe fimbo tai ningwa, kanda li muJerusalem. Osheshi omudo omutimilongo nhatu nomutivali waArtasasta, ohamba yaBabilon, ame nde uya kohamba. Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku ame nda pula kohamba ndi itavelwe
ndele nde uya kuJerusalem. Opo nee nda dimbulukwa owii ou Eljasib a ninga eshi a longekidila Tobia ondjuwo moihale yongulu yaKalunga.
Ame nda ninga omwenyo mwii unene, onghee hano nda ekelashi pondje oinima yaTobia,
ndele nda lombwela ve nokuyapula eendjuwo; ndele nda shunifa mo oinima yomongulu yaKalunga eendjayambo noitwiminifo.
Ndele nda dimbulukwa vali, nokutya inava yandja kOvalevi oitukulwa yavo, onghee hano Ovalevi novaimbi ava ve nokudiinina oshilonga, keshe umwe okwa faduka po a ya kepya laye.
Ndele nda twifa ovawiliki eemhata ndele handi ti: “Omolwashike ongulu yaKalunga inai diininwa?” Ndele nde va ongela nonde va tula vali moilonga yavo.
NOvajuda aveshe va eta oitimulongo yoilya noyomaviinyu noyomaadi komalimba.

Ndele nda tula omupristeli Selemja nomushangi Sadok naPedaja vomOvalevi va ninge ovapashukili vomamona. Ndele ngaashi ovayakuli vavo: Hanan yaSakkur yaMattanja, shaashi vo va li ve shii kulineekelwa. Ndele vo ve nokutukulila ovamwaina ovalumenhu.
Omolwaashi, dimbulukwe nge, Kalunga kange, ndele ino dima po oilonga yange iwa, oyo nde i ningila ongulu yaKalunga kange noilonga yayo.

Pomafiku enya nda mona muJuda ovanhu tava kolo moshikolelo ndele tava eta mo mefiku lEshabata omakutu oilya a londekwa keendongi, nosho yo omaviinyu, eeviinyu neenghwiyu neefulaxa di lili nadi lili tava eta mefiku lEshabata muJerusalem. Ame onde va londwela, vo eshi va landifa oinima yeendja mefiku olo.
NOvatirus yo ava va kala mo, va eta mo eeshi noipindi i lili nai lili ndele ve i landifa kOvajuda muJerusalem shoovene mEshabata.
Ndele nda twifa ovanamadina vomuJuda eemhata ndele handi ti kuvo: “Owii ou fike peni tamu u ningi, eshi tamu shekifa efiku lEshabata?
Ooxo yeni osho va ningile, onghee hano Kalunga ketu e tu etela noshilando eshi omupya aushe ou. Heeno, nye otamu hapupalifa oupyuhandu kombada yaIsrael, eshi tamu shekifa efiku lEshabata.”

Ndele naanaa etango eshi la toka moivelo yaJerusalem Eshabata fimbo inali hovela, ame nda tya oivelo i nokwiidilwa. Ndele nde va lombwela vehe i yeulule fimbo Eshabata inali pita. Ndele nda tula ovapiya vange poivelo; ofulaxa nande imwe inai etwa mo mefiku lEshabata.
Opo nee ovalandifi novashingifi voipindi i lili nai lili va nangala pondje yaJerusalem luvali.
Ndelenee ame nde va londwela ndele handi ti kuvo: “Omolwashike tamu nangala pondje yohotekuma? Ngeenge tamu shi ningi vali efiku limwe, handi mu kwata.” Okefimbo linya inave uya vali efiku lEshabata.

Ame nda lombwela vali Ovalevi, nokutya ve nokuliyelifa nokuuya va nangele oivelo opo efiku lEshabata li yapulwe. Dimbulukwe nge molwoshinima eshi yo, Kalunga kange, u file nge onghenda omolwouwanghenda woye uhapu.
Pomafiku enya nda mona Ovajuda va hombola ovakainhu Ovaasdod nOvaammoni nOvamoab.
Ndele movana vavo etata la popya Oshiasdod ile elaka limwe loiwana. Ndelenee inava shiiva okupopya Oshiheberi.

Onghee hano nde va twifa eemhata ndele nde va tula omutima ndele vamwe vomuvo nde va denga, ndele nde va shila keexwiki ndele nde va anifa puKalunga: “Inamu yandja ovana veni oukadona kovana vavo ovamati, ndele inamu kufa movana vavo oukadona va hombolwe kovana veni ovamati ile kunye vene.

Ndishi Salomo, ohamba yaIsrael, inai nyonifwa kuvo mbela? Nande moiwana inamu kala nande ohamba i fike puye, ye okwa li omuholike waKalunga, ndele Kalunga e mu ninga ohamba yOvaisraeli aveshe, ovalikadi ovanailongo ve mu nyonifa.
Ndele paife tu nokuuda molweni, nokutya mwa ninga owii aushe ou munene, eshi mwe liteeka Kalunga mokuhombola ovakainhu ovanailongo.”
Nomona umwe omumati womovana vaJehoiada omona womupristeli omukulunhu Eljasib, okwa li oshitenya shaSanballat, Omuhoroni. Onghee hano ame nde mu taataa pwaame.
Kalunga kange, va dimbulukwa, osheshi vo ova nyateka oupristeli nehangano lovapristeli nolOvalevi.
Osho ngaha hano nde va yapula mwaashishe shokoilongo. Ndele nda pangelela ovapristeli nOvalevi oilonga yavo, keshe umwe moshilonga shaye,
nosho yo omafiku oo ve na okutyava oikuni nooshipe yo. Kalunga kange, dimbulukwe nge ndi mone ouwa!

1: Pomafiku aAhasveros, nokutya Ahasveros ou a pangela okudja kuIndia fiyo okuEtiopia, oitukulwalongo efele nomilongo mbali naiheyali,
pomafiku enya ohamba Ahasveros a kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo layo louhamba mohotengulu yomuSusa,

momudo omutitatu wepangelo layo, oya telekela omalenga ayo aeshe novapiya vayo aveshe oitendele. Omatanga ovakwaita vomuPersia novomuMedia novalumenhu ovanamadina novapangeli vomoitukulwalongo va li moipafi yayo;
ndele omafiku mahapu, heeno, omafiku efele nomilongo hetatu yo oye va ulikila oupuna woshinge shomouhamba wayo nefimano lihapu lounene wayo.
Nomafiku oo eshi a pita po, ohamba ya ningila ovanhu vayo aveshe, ava va kala mohotengulu yaSusa, ovakulunhu novapiya oitendele yomafiku ahetatu mehale loshikunino shongulu yohamba.

Omo mwa li mu noiyata yoliina itoka noiyata yomavala ya kwatakanifilwa kumwe keengodi ditoka nodapurpuri, ndele kwa endjelelifwa eengodo doisiliveli keengudi damarmori! Moluumbo mwa yalwa omamanya amalakiti nomarmori itoka nomamanya taa konita nomarmori i nomavala, mwa tulwa eembete doingoldo nodoisiliveli dokutulumukilwa mo.
Pa nwinwa momaholo oingoldo, nomaholo inaa faafana, ndele oko kwa li omaviinyu ohamba mahapu unene, omaviinyu e fike poupuna wohamba.
Ndele pa nuwa paufo kutya, kape na ou a fininikwa. Osheshi ohamba ya lombwela ngaha ovapiya aveshe vayo va fimana vomongulu yayo, nokutya ve nokuyakula pahalo lakeshe umwe.
Vasti, omumbada wohamba okwa ningila ovakainhu oitendele mongulu youhamba wohamba yaAhasveros.

Mefiku etiheyali, omutima wohamba eshi wa hafifwa komaviinyu, yo ya lombwela omalenga ayo aheyali omouhamba, Mehuman, Bista, Harbona, Bigta naAbagta, Setar naKarkas, oo a li a yakula koshipala shohamba
a ka tale ko omumbada Vasti, a djala oshishani shohamba, e uye koshipala shohamba, yo i ulikile ovanhu nomalenga ouwa nondjelo yaye, osheshi ye okwa li muwa moshipala.
Ndelenee omumbada Vasti a anya okuuya palombwelo, ohamba ye li lombwela omalenga. Opo nee ohamba ya handuka unene, noupyuhandu wayo wa xwama muyo.
Nohamba ya popya novalumenhu ovanongo, ovashiivi vomafimbo, osheshi onghedi yohamba ya li okukonga omayele kovanongo aveshe vomhango novouyuki.

Ndele ovo va li popepi nayo ovava: Karsena, Setar, Admata, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena, Memukan, omalenga aheyali Ovapersia nOvamedia, aa a li a tala oshipala shohamba, ndele va kala omutumba ngaashi ovakomesho vomouhamba, ndele ohamba ye va pula:
“Omumbada Vasti e nokuningwa ngahelipi pamhango, shaashi ye ina dulika kelombwelo lohamba Ahasveros ye li tumifa omalenga ayo?”
Opo nee Memukan ta ti kohamba nokomalenga: “Omumbada Vasti ina nyona kohamba aike, ndelenee komalenga aeshe nokovanhu aveshe ovo ve li moitukulwalongo yohamba Ahasveros.

Osheshi oshinima eshi shomumbada tashi ka shiivika kovalikadi aveshe, onghee hano ovalumenhu vavo tava ka dinika momesho avo ndele tava ka tya: ‘Ohamba Ahasveros ya lombwela omumbada Vasti, a etwe koshipala shayo, ndelenee ye ine uya.’

Mefiku tuu eli lonena nokuli ovalikadi vomalenga omuPersia nomuMedia, eshi tava udu oshinima shomumbada ou, tave ke shi lombwela omalenga aeshe ohamba. Opo nee tapa ka kala okudinwa nokuhanduka kuhapu!

Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, nai yandje oshipango shi shangelwe meemhango dihe shii kulundululwa, dOvapersia nodOvamedia, nokutya Vasti aha holoke vali koshipala shohamba Ahasveros. Nohamba nai yandje omumbada waye kuumwe ou e mu dule.
Oshipango shohamba eshi tashi ka shiivika moshilongo shayo ashishe, nande sho oshinene, ovalikadi aveshe tava ka fimaneka ovalumenhu vavo, ovanamadina novaxupi.”
Eendjovo edi oda wapalela ohamba nomalenga, nohamba ya ninga papukululo laMemukan.

Ndele yo ya tumina oitukulwalongo aishe yohamba eenhumwafo, koshitukulwalongo keshe pakushangwa kwasho, noshiwana keshe palaka lasho, nokutya omulumenhu keshe na kale omwene meumbo laye, ndele na itavelwe okupopya elaka loshiwana shavo.
2: Konima yoinima ei, ehandu lohamba Ahasveros eshi la lota, oya dimbulukwa Vasti, osho e shi ninga naasho she mu tokolelwa.
Opo nee ovapiya vohamba, ovo ve i yakula tava ti: “Ohamba nai kongelwe oukadona ounyasha ve nondjelo iwa.

Ohamba nai tule mo moitukulwalongo aishe yoshilongo shayo ovahona, opo va ongele oukadona aveshe ovanyasha ovo ve nondjelo iwa, ve uye mohotengulu yaSusa mongulu yovalikadi, kelenga Hegai, omupashukili wovalikadi, e va pashukile. Ndele nava pewe omaadi okuvava oku va wapeka.
Nokakadona oko taka pandwa kohamba, naka ninge omumbada wohamba ponhele yomumbada Vasti.” Ondjovo ei ya wapalela ohamba, nosho ya ninga.
Mohotengulu yaSusa mwa li omulumenhu Omujuda, edina laye Mordekai yaJair yaSimei yaKis, Omubenjamin;
okwa kufwa muJerusalem nokwa li mokati keenghwate odo da li di nokuya moukwatwa pamwe naJekonia, ohamba yaJuda, yo ya twalwa ko kuNebukadnesar, ohamba yaBabilon.

Ndele ye okwa li omutekuli waHadassa, nokutya waEster, omona waxekulu, ndele okwa li ehe naxe ile ina. Ndele ye okwa li okakadona kawa kondjelo yako nokoshipala shako; ndele pefyo laxe nolaina, Mordekai e ka tambula omona waye.

Ndele oshipango shohamba nomhango yayo eshi ya shiivika, noukadona vahapu va ongelwa mohotengulu yaSusa komupashukili Hegai, ova eta yo Ester pamwe navo mongulu yohamba va diininwe kuHegai, omupashukili wovakainhu.

Nokakadona oko e ka panda ndele ka filwa onghenda kuye. Onghee hano okwa endelela oku ka pa omivavo dokuwapaleka, neendja de ka wapalela ndele e ka pa ovapiya ovakainhu vaheyali, va hoololwa vomongulu yohamba. Nokwe ka tula pamwe novapiya vako medimo liwa longulu yovakainhu.
Ester okwa li ina holola oshiwana shaye noludi laye, shaashi Mordekai okwe mu lombwela ehe shi popye.
Ndele efiku keshe Mordekai okwa enda mehale longulu yovakainhu a shiivifilwe ngeenge Ester oku li nawa ndele nonhumbi ta ningwa.

Ndele olufo lokakadona kamwe ngeenge la fika okuya kohamba Ahasveros, ko eshi ka wapalekwa eehani omulongo nambali pamhango yovakainhu (osheshi elilongekido lavo la pula efimbo li fike pomafiku oo. Eehani hamano nomaadi omirha neehani hamano nabalsam nomaadi ovakainhu makwao okuvava).
Okakadona eshi ka ya ngaha kohamba, aishe oyo ke i pula, ke i pewa ya dja mongulu yovakainhu ya twalwa pamwe nako kongulu yohamba.

Eshi ka ya mo onguloshi ndele ka aluka ongula, ka ya kongulu onhivali yovakainhu ya diininwa kuSaaskas, elenga lohamba, tali pashukile ovalikadi vohamba vopomunghulo. Itaka ka ya mo vali kohamba okuninga ohamba ye ka hokwa ndele tai ka ifana padina.

Olufo laEster, omona okakadona kaAbigail, xekulu yaMordekai, eshi la fika a ye mo kohamba, ko inaka hala sha shimwe, osho ashike Hegai, elenga lohamba, lo la pashukila ovakainhu, le ka lombwela. Ndele Ester okwa pandwa kwaaveshe ovo ve mu mona.
Ester okwa tambulwa kohamba Ahasveros mongulu yayo youhamba mohani onhimulongo nokutya, mohani Tebet, momudo omutiheyali wepangelo layo.

Nohamba ya li i hole Ester komesho yovakainhu aveshe noye mu hokwa ndele ye mu fila onghenda komesho youkadona aveshe. Ndele yo oye mu dika komutwe waye oshishani shohamba ndele ye mu ninga omumbada ponhele yaVasti.

Nohamba ya telekela omalenga ayo aeshe novapiya vayo aveshe oitendele inene, oitendele yaEster. Ndele yo ya shiivifila oitukulwalongo i dane efiku letulumuko ndele ya yandja eeshali di fike pakuyandja kohamba.
Oukadona eshi va ongelwa lutivali, fimbo Mordekai ta kala omutumba poshivelo shohamba.
Ester ina holola oshiwana shaye noludi laye, ngaashi Mordekai e mu lombwela. Ndele Ester okwa ninga ngaashi Mordekai e mu lombwela ngaashi mefimbo linya a kala mouteku waye.
Pomafiku tuu enya fimbo Mordekai a kala omutumba poshivelo shohamba, Bigtan naTeres, omalenga avali ohamba, ovanangeli vopoivelo, va handuka ndele va konga omhito va kwate ohamba Ahasveros.
Ndelenee Mordekai okwe shi uda nokwe shi shiivifila omumbada Ester. Ndele Ester e shi lombwela ohamba medina laMordekai.
Oshinima osho eshi sha konakonwa ndele sha monika osho oshili, venya vavali va endjelelifwa komuti. Ndele osho sha shangelwa membo omafimbo koshipala shohamba.
3: Konima yoinima oyo ohamba Ahasveros ya nenepeka Haman yaHammedata, Omuagag, ndele ye mu lenga ndele ya tula oshipundi shaye komesho yomalenga aeshe aa a kala puyo.
Novapiya aveshe vohamba, ovo va li poshivelo shohamba ve linyongamena ndele va wila eombe koshipala shaHaman, osheshi ohamba osho e va lombwela molwaye. Mordekai ine linyongamena ndele ina wa eombe.
Novapiya vohamba ava va li poshivelo shohamba, va lombwela Mordekai: Omolwashike ho tauluka oshipango shohamba?
Ndele eshi ve shi mu lombwela efiku keshe ndele ye ine va uda, ove shi shiivifila Haman, va tale elipopilo laMordekai ngeenge tali mu popile shili, osheshi ye e va shiivifila, nokutya ye Omujuda.
Haman eshi a mona, nokutya Mordekai ite linyongamene ndele ita wile eombe koshipala shaye, Haman okwa yada ehandu.

Ndelenee eshi a shiivifilwa oshiwana shaMordekai, okwa dina ekwafo laMordekai aeke. Onghee hano Haman a konga omhito a hanaune po Ovajuda aveshe nokutya, oshiwana shaMordekai sho shi li moshilongo shaAhasveros.

Mohani yotete, nokutya muNisan, momudo omutimulongo nomutivali wohamba Ahasveros, ova umba Pur, nokutya oshihoololifo, koshipala shaHaman efiku keshe mohani keshe fiyo okohani onhimulongo nonhivali, nokutya ohani yaAdar.

Opo nee Haman ta ti kohamba Ahasveros: “Moitukulwalongo aishe yomoshilongo shoye omu noshiwana shimwe she lihana ndele tashi likalele mokati koiwana, neemhango dasho odi lili hangaashi eemhango doiwana ikwao aishe. Ndele ihava diinine yo eemhango dohamba, onghee itashi dulika ohamba tai va efa va kale po.

Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, napa shangwe oshipango, nokutya vo ve nokuhanaunwa po. Naame ohandi ka yeleka oshisiliveli shi dule eekilograma omayovi omafele atatu nomafele omilongo nhee momake omalenga e i wedele komamona ohamba.”
Opo nee ohamba ya xukula okalinga kayo koshihako komunwe wayo ndele ye ka pa Haman yaHammedata, Omuagag, omutondadi wOvajuda.
Nohamba ya lombwela Haman: “Oisiliveli nai ninge yoye nosho yo ovanhu ovo, u va ningile ngaashi sha wapala momesho oye.”

Opo nee ovashangi vohamba va ifanwa mefiku etimulongo netitatu mohani yotete, ndele va shanga ngaashi Haman e va lombwela, oshipango kovapangeli vohamba nokomalenga omoshitukulwalongo keshe nokeehamba doiwana adishe, koshitukulwalongo keshe panghedi yasho okushanga nokoshiwana keshe melaka lasho vene. Sha shangelwa medina lohamba Ahasveros ndele sha hakifwa nokalinga kohamba kokuhakifa.

Neenhumwafo da tumwa neenhondoki koitukulwalongo aishe yohamba va hanaune po Ovajuda aveshe, okudipaa nokukomba po ovanyasha novakulunhu, ovana novalikadi, mefiku limwe, mefiku etimulongo netitatu lohani onhimulongo nonhivali, nokutya mohani Adar, nomamona avo e nokutikishwa oixuulwa.
Eshangululo loshipango sha shangwa nali hololwe ngaashi omhango moshitukulwalongo keshe oiwana aishe i li shiive, opo va kale ve lilongekida mefiku tuu olo.
Eenhondoki da fikama divadiva kelombwelo lohamba shamha tuu omhango ya yandjwa mohotengulu yomuSusa. Ohamba naHaman va kala omutumba ndele tava nu ndelenee oshilando shaSusa sha li sha haluka.
4: Mordekai eshi a uda ashishe osho sha ningwa, Mordekai okwa pombaula oikutu ndele a djala oikutu yeefya, ndele e liunda omute komutwe waye, nokwa ya mokati koshilando ndele ta ingida pombada eendjovo douyehame.
Osho ngaha e uya fiyo oposhivelo shohamba, ndelenee inashi itavelelwa omunhu ta i moshivelo shohamba a djala oikutu yeefya.
Ndele moitukulwalongo aishe omo oshipango shohamba nomhango yayo ya fika, mwa li oluhodi linene mokati kOvajuda: ve lidilika, va lila nokukema. Vahapu va yala koshi yavo oshako nomute.

Ovapiya ovakainhu vaEster nomalenga aye omouhamba eshi ve shi mu shiivifila, omumbada a kwatwa koluhodi linene. Nokwa tuma oikutu, opo Mordekai e i djale ndele e lidule oikutu yaye yeefya. Ndelenee ine i tambula.
Opo nee Ester a ifana Hatak womomalenga ohamba, ou a tulwa po kohamba oku mu yakula, nokwe li lombwela li ye kuMordekai a ude osho tashi ti shike nomolwashike e shi ninga.
Hatak okwa ya pondje kuMordekai konhele ya lalakana yoshilando oyo poshivelo shohamba.
Opo nee Mordekai e mu shiivifila ashishe osho she mu hanga, nosho yo oisiliveli i fike peni Haman a udaneka a yelekele momamona ohamba ofuto, Ovajuda eshi tava hanaunwa po.

NaMordekai okwe mu pa eshangululo lomhango ya shangwa muSusa yoku va hanauna po, opo e li hololele Ester ndele e mu shiivifile oshinima osho ndele e mu fininike okuya kohamba a indile onghenda ndele a popile oshiwana shaye kuyo.
Opo nee Hatak a ya mo nokwa shiivifila Ester eendjovo daMordekai.
Opo nee Ester ta lombwele Hatak ye a lombwele Mordekai nokutya:

“Ovapiya aveshe vohamba novanhu vomoitukulwalongo yohamba ve shi shii, nokutya keshe omulumenhu ile omukainhu ta i kohamba kehale lomeni ngeenge ina ifanwa, ta tokolelwa pamhango imwe: e nokudipawa, okuninga ohamba tai mu ulike nepangelodibo layo loshingoldo, a kale e nomwenyo. Ndele pomafiku omilongo nhatu inandi ifanwa ndi ye mo kohamba.”
Ndele eendjovo daEster ve di shiivifila Mordekai.
Opo nee Mordekai te va lombwele, va nyamukule Ester: “Ino diladila, nokutya ove eshi u li mongulu yohamba to ka xupifwa oove auke mOvajuda,

osheshi ove ngeenge to mwena, Ovajuda tava ka mona ekwafo nexupifo pamwe pe lili, ndelenee ove neumbo loye tamu ka hanaunwa po, ndele olyelye e shi shii kashiimba wa pewa oumbada wohamba omolwefimbo tuu eli?”
Opo nee Ester okwe va lombwela va nyamukule Mordekai, va tye:

“Inda u ongele Ovajuda aveshe ava tava monika muSusa, ndele lidilikeni molwange. Ndele momafiku atatu oufiku nomutenya inamu lya ndele inamu nwa. Naame yo pamwe novapiya vange ovakainhu hatu ke lidilika. Opo nee handi i mo kohamba, osho nande kashi li pamhango, ndele ngeenge ndi nokufya, ondi nokufya.”
Ndele Mordekai okwa ya ndele a ninga ngaashi Ester e mu lombwela.
5: Mefiku etitatu Ester okwa djala ngaashi ohamba nokwa ya a ka kale ofika mehale lomeni longulu yohamba a yukilila olupale lohamba, fimbo ohamba tai kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo layo molupale louhamba, ya shaama noshivelo sholupale.

Ndele ohamba eshi ya mona omumbada Ester ta kala ofika mehale, ye a filwa onghenda kuyo. Nohamba ya ulika Ester nepangelodibo loshingoldo olo la li meke layo. Ndele Ester okwa ehena ko nokwa kuma omutwe wepangelodibo.
Opo nee ohamba tai ti kuye: “Omumbada Ester, wa hala shike ile to kongo shike? Keshe eshi we shi hala, handi shi ku pe, nande etata loshilongo.”
Opo nee Ester ta nyamukula: “Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, ohamba naHaman nave uye nena koitelekela ame nde i telekela ohamba.”
Nohamba tai ti: “Ifaneni Haman divadiva, opo tu wanife ehalo laEster!” Nohamba naHaman va ya koitelekela yaEster.
Ndele fimbo hava nu omaviinyu, ohamba tai ti kuEster: “To indile shike? Oto shi pewa. Ndele oto pula shike? Keshe eshi we shi hala handi shi ku pe, nande etata loshilongo.”
Opo nee Ester ta ti: “Eindilo lange nehalo lange oleli:

Ame ngeenge nda filwa onghenda moipafi yohamba, ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba okwiitavelela eindilo lange nokuwanifa osho nde shi hala, ohamba naHaman nave uye koitelekela handi ke i va telekela mongula. Ame ohandi ka ninga pahalo lohamba.”

Ndele mefiku tuu olo Haman okwa hafa nokwa shambukwa unene komwenyo. Ndelenee Haman eshi a mona Mordekai poshivelo shohamba ndele ye ina kala ofika ile ine mu tila, Haman okwa yada ehandu molwaMordekai.
Ndelenee Haman okwe lidiinika. Ndele ye eshi e uya keumbo laye okwa ifana ookaume kaye nomwalikadi waye Seres.
Ndele Haman ote va hepaululile ta popi efimano laye noupuna waye nouhapu wovana vaye ovamati, nanhumbi ohamba ye mu nenepeka mwaashishe noku mu lenga kombada yomalenga noyovapiya vohamba.
Haman ta ti vali: “Nomumbada Ester mwene eshi a teleka oitelekela ina itavelela vamwe okuuya koitelekela, aame andike. Nosho mongula ame nda ifanwa ndi ye ko pamwe nohamba.
Ndelenee osho ashishe inashi wanena nge fimbo handi mono Omujuda Mordekai ta kala omutumba poshivelo shohamba.”

Opo nee omwalikadi waye Seres nookaume kaye aveshe tava ti kuye: “Mu ningila hano omuti wokumangeleka mo, oule wao omaludimbo omilongo itano u lombwele ohamba mongula inene, vo va endjelelife Mordekai muwo. Opo nee to i nehafo pamwe nohamba koitelekela.” Ondjovo oyo ya wapalela Haman, nokwa pangelifa omuti wokumangeleka mo.
6: Oufiku tuu ou eemhofi da londoka ohamba ndele ya tya, eteni oidimbulukifoshango nokutya, embo lomafimbo. Ndele lo eshi la leshelwa ohamba,
ova mona, nokutya mwa shangwa Mordekai okwa holola ekengelelo lomalenga avali ohamba omovanangeli vopoivelo, Bigtana naTeres, nokutya va konga omhito yokupyaifa omake avo kohamba Ahasveros.
Opo nee ohamba tai ti: “Mordekai okwe shi fimanekelwa nokwe shi lengelwa ngahelipi?” Ovapiya vohamba, ava tave i yakula, va nyamukula: “Ina ningilwa sha!”

Opo nee ohamba tai ti: “Olyelye e li kehale?” Pefimbo tuu olo Haman e uya mehale lopondjelela yongulu yohamba, e uya a lombwele ohamba, nokutya Mordekai e nokweendjelelifwa komuti wokumangeleka mo, oo ye e u mu dikila.
Novapiya vohamba ve i nyamukula: “Penya pa kala ofika Haman mehale lokomesho.” Opo nee ohamba tai ti: “Ne uye mo.”

Haman eshi e uya mo, ohamba tai mu pula: “Omulumenhu ou ohamba ya hala oku mu fimanekifa, ota ningwa ngahelipi?” Haman nokwe lidiladila ye mwene: “Olyelye vali ngeno e nokufimanekwa kohamba komesho yange, haame?”
Onghee hano Haman a lombwela ohamba: “Omulumenhu ou ohamba ya hala oku mu fimanekifa
ye na djalekwe oshikutu shohamba ya li ye shi djala, nonghambe oyo hai londwa kohamba, komutwe wayo kwa tulwa oshishani shohamba;

noshikutu nonghambe nai pewe umwe womomalenga ohamba, ovalumenhu ovafimanekwa.” Omulumenhu ou ohamba ya hala oku mu fimanekifa, ne shi djalekwe ndele na londe konghambe ndele ta endaendifwa momapandavanda oshilando ndele komesho yaye naku ingidwe ku tiwe: “Omulumenhu ou ohamba ya hala oku mu fimaneka, osho ta ningwa.”

Opo nee ohamba tai ti kuHaman: “Kufa divadiva oshikutu nonghambe ngaashi wa tonga, ndele osho ningila Omujuda Mordekai, ou ta kala omutumba poshivelo shohamba. Ino xupifa ondjovo nande imwe mwaado adishe we di popya.”

Ndele Haman okwa kufa oshikutu nonghambe, nokwa djaleka Mordekai nokwe mu endaendifa a londa konghambe momapandavanda omoshilando ndele a ingida komesho yaye: “Osho ngaha omulumenhu ta ningwa, ou ohamba ya hala oku mu fimaneka.”
Opo nee Mordekai a shuna koshivelo shohamba, ndelenee Haman okwa endelela nokuya keumbo laye e noluhodi nomutwe wa uvikwa.

Ndele Haman okwa hepaululila omwalikadi waye Seres nookaume kaye aveshe, ashishe osho she mu hanga. Opo nee ovalumenhu ovanongo nomwalikadi waye Seres ve mu lombwela: “Ngeenge Mordekai, koshipala shaye wa hovela nokuli okuxutuka, ngeenge ye owomoludi lOvajuda, ito ka dula sha, ndelenee okuwila po ashike koshipala shaye.”
Fimbo vo tava popi naye, ovapiya vohamba ve uya, ndele va twala Haman divadiva koitelekela, Ester e i teleka.
7: Ohamba naHaman ve uya komumbada Ester va ka lye oitelekela.

Ndele mefiku etivali, fimbo tava nu omaviinyu ohamba tai ti kuEster: “Omumbada Ester, to indile shike? Eindilo loye tali ka wanifwa. Ndele wa hala shike? Keshe eshi we shi hala, handi shi ku pe nande etata loshilongo.”

Nomumbada Ester ta nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Akutu ohamba! Ame ngeenge nda mona onghenda koshipala shoye, ndele ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, nandi xupifilwe omwenyo wange omolweindilo lange, nowoshiwana shange, eshi handi shi indile.

Osheshi fye twa landifwa po, ame noshiwana shange, tu hanaunwe po, tu dipawe ndele tu kombwe po. Ngeno twa landifwa po tu ninge ovapika ovalumenhu novakainhu, ngeno nda mwena, ndelenee omupya ou itau ka mona ewanifo mokunyekwa kwohamba.”
Opo nee ohamba Ahasveros ta ti komumbada Ester: “Ye olyelye, ndele openi e li, ou a diladila momutima waye oku shi ninga?”
Ndele Ester ta ti: Omunandubo nomutondadi ou Haman, omunawii! Opo nee Haman a haluka koshipala shohamba noshomumbada.

Nohamba mehandu layo ya fikama poikunwa yomaviinyu ndele tai i koshikunino shongulu yayo, fimbo Haman a fyaala po e liindilile omwenyo waye komumbada Ester. Osheshi a mona, nokutya ohamba ye mu tokolela omupya.

Ohamba eshi ya dja mo moshikunino shongulu yohamba, ya aluka vali molupale loikunwa, ndele Haman okwa li te liwilike komutala wetulumuko oko omumbada Ester a kala omutumba, ohamba tai ti: “Ye a hala yo okunangala nomumbada moipafi yange mongulu?” Shamha tuu ondjovo ya dja mokanya kohamba, ova uvika oshipala shaHaman.

Opo nee Harbona, umwe womovapiya vohamba ta ti kohamba: “Oko ku nomuti wokumangeleka mo, wa dikwa kuHaman, e u dikila Mordekai, ou a popila ohamba, u li pongulu yaye, oule wao omaludimbo omilongo nhano.” Opo nee ohamba tai ti: “Mu endjelelifa ko!”
Ndele va endjelelifa Haman komuti wokumangeleka mo, ou ye e u dikila Mordekai, nehandu lohamba la lota.
8: Mefiku tuu olo ohamba Ahasveros ya yandja kuEster eumbo laHaman, omutondadi wOvajuda. Ndele Mordekai okwe uya koshipala shohamba, osheshi Ester a hepaulula oye olyelye, nokutya omukwao.
Nohamba ya xukula mo okalinga kayo kokuhakifa aka ye ka kufa kuHaman, ndele ye ka pa Mordekai. Ndele Ester okwa tula po Mordekai a pangele eumbo laHaman.
Ndele Ester okwa popya vali koshipala shohamba ndele a wila eombe keemhadi dayo ndele ta lili noku i indila, nokutya a alule owii waHaman, Omuagag, nomhangela e i pangelele okuhanauna po Ovajuda,
Nohamba ya nanena Ester epangelodibo loshingoldo, naEster okwa penduka po ndele a kala ofika koshipala shohamba

ndele ta ti: “Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba ndele nda filwa onghenda kuyo ndele ohamba tai tale osho osha yuka ndele nda hokiwa kuyo, nai shangife oshipango shokwaalula omhangela yaHaman yaHammedata womepata laAgag neenhumwafo odo da shangwa kuye, a hanaune Ovajuda aveshe ve li moitukulwalongo aishe yohamba.
Osheshi ohandi dulu ngahelipi okutala omupya ou tau ka hanga oshiwana shange? Ndele handi dulu ngahelipi okutala ehanauno loludi letu?”

Opo nee ohamba Ahasveros tai ti komumbada Ester nokOmujuda Mordekai: “Tala, eumbo laHaman nde li yandja kuEster, ndele a endjelelifwa komuti wokumangeleka mo, shaashi a nanena eke laye okukwata Ovajuda.

Ndelenee shangeni medina lohamba oshipango tashi popile Ovajuda, ngaashi mwe shi tala tashi mu wapalele, ndele shi hakifeni nokalinga kohamba. Osheshi eshango olo la shangwa medina lohamba ndele la hakifwa nokalinga kohamba, itali lundululwa.”

Opo nee mefimbo tuu olo ovashangi vohamba va ifanwa, mohani onhinhatu, nokutya mohani Sivan, mefiku etimilongo mbali netitatu lomuyo. Ndele va shanga ngaashi Mordekai e va lombwela kOvajuda nomalenga nokovapangeli voitukulwalongo yo i li po okudja kuIndia fiyo okuEtiopia, oitukulwalongo efele nomilongo mbali naiheyali, kukeshe oshitukulwalongo panghedi yasho okushanga nokukeshe oshiwana melaka lasho, nokOvajuda panghedi yavo okushanga nomelaka lavo.
Nokwa shanga medina lohamba Ahasveros nokwe li hakifa nokalinga kohamba kokuhakifa. Nokwa tuma eenhumwafo novalondi veenghambe da dja moyuunda yeenghambe da deulwa dokufiyafana po;

nokutya ohamba otai shi itavelele Ovajuda moshilando keshe omo ve li va ongale kumwe va popile eemwenyo davo nokuhanauna po nokudipaa nokukomba po ovanhu aveshe vomoitukulwalongo, ovo ve noiti tave va fininike, nounona yo novalikadi nokukufa omamona avo ngaashi oixuulwa,
mefiku limwe alike moitukulwalongo aishe yohamba Ahasveros, mefiku etimulongo netitatu lohani onhimulongo nonhivali nokutya, mohani Adar.
Eshangululo leshango li nokushiivifilwa ovanhu aveshe vomoshitukulwalongo keshe, kutya olo omhango, opo Ovajuda va kale ve lilongekidila okuhandukila ovatondadi vavo.
Eenhondoki da londa eenghambe dohamba di nonhapo oda fikama kelombwelo lohamba ndele va endelela divadiva. Nomhango ya shangwa mohotengulu yaSusa.

Ndele Mordekai okwa pita mo mongulu yohamba a djala oshikutu shopauhamba shitoka shi nomavala, noshishani shinene shoshingoldo nelwakani loshiyata sholiina noshapurpuri, fimbo oshilando shaSusa sha hafa nokukuwilila.
Ovajuda va mona elao nehafo nekuwililo nefimano,

nomoitukulwalongo aishe nomoilando aishe omo oshipango shohamba nomhango yayo ya fika, omwa li ehafo nelao mokati kOvajuda, noitelekela nefiku loshivilo. Ndele vahapu vomovanhu va ninga Ovajuda, osheshi ehaluko molwOvajuda ve uya kombada yavo.
9: Ndele mohani onhimulongo nambali nokutya, ohani Adar, mefiku etimulongo netitatu lomuyo, eshi oshipango shohamba nomhango yayo ya li i nokuwanifwa, efiku tuu olo ovatondadi vOvajuda va li ve li teelela ve va kwate, ndelenee mefiku tuu olo Ovajuda va kwata ovatondadi vavo,

Ovajuda va ongala moilando yavo yomoitukulwalongo aishe yohamba Ahasveros okukwata ovo va li ve va halela oshiponga. Ndele kaku na ou a dula okukala a pama koshipala shavo, osheshi ehaluko omolwavo la kwata ovanhu aveshe.
Nomalenga aeshe omoitukulwalongo novapangeli ovapiya vohamba va ama kOvajuda, osheshi va haluka molwaMordekai.
Osheshi Mordekai kwa li a kula mouhamba wohamba, netumbalo laye la tandavela moitukulwalongo aishe, shaashi omulumenhu Mordekai okwa ehena komesho moulenga.
NOvajuda va taataa ovatondadi vavo noku va twa nomaongamukonda noku va hanauna po noku va dipaa, ndele va ningila ovatondadi vavo ngaashi va hala.
Ndele mohotengulu yaSusa Ovajuda va dipaa nokuhanauna po ovalumenhu omafele atano.
Ndele Parsandata naDalfon naAspata,
naPorata naAdalja naArdata,
naParmasta naArisai naAridai naWaisata,
ovana omulongo ovalumenhu vaHaman yaHammedata, omutondadi wOvajuda, Ovajuda ve va dipaa, ndelenee inava kuma omamona.
Mefiku tuu olo omuvalu waava va dipawa mohotengulu yaSusa, wa shiivifilwa ohamba.

Nohamba tai ti komumbada Ester: “Mohotengulu yaSusa Ovajuda va dipaa ovalumenhu omafele atano novana ovamati omulongo vaHaman. Ova ninga shike moitukulwalongo ikwao yohamba? Ove to indile shike? Otashi ke ku wanifilwa. Ndele wa hala shike vali? Tashi ka wanifwa.”

Opo nee Ester ta ti: “Ngeenge tashi wapalele ohamba, Ovajuda vomuSusa nava itavelelwe okuninga nongula pamhango oyo va ninga nena. Novana omulongo ovalumenhu vaHaman nava endjelelifwe komuti wokumangeleka mo.”
Nohamba ya yandja oshipango ve shi ninge. Nomhango ya shangwa muSusa, ndele ovana omulongo vaHaman ve va endjelelifa komuti.
NOvajuda vomuSusa va ongala vali mefiku etimulongo netine mohani Adar. Ndele muSusa va dipaa ovalumenhu omafele atatu, ndelenee inava kuma omamona.

NOvajuda vakwao ovo va kala moitukulwalongo yohamba, va ongala okulipopila ndele va mona etulumuko kovatondadi vavo. Ndele va dipaa movatondadi vavo ovalumenhu omilongo heyali navatano, ndelenee inava kuma omamona.
Eshi sha ningwa mefiku etimulongo netitatu mohani Adar. Ndele va tulumukwa mefiku etimulongo netine ndele ve li ninga efiku loitelekela nolokuhafa.
Ndelenee Ovajuda vomuSusa va ongala mefiku etimulongo netitatu nomefiku etimulongo netine, ndele mefiku etimulongo netitano lomuyo va tulumukwa, onghee ve li ninga efiku loitelekela nolokuhafa.
Onghee hano Ovajuda ovo va kala momikunda dihe neehotekuma, efiku etimulongo netitatu lohani Adar ve li ninga efiku lehafo noloitelekela yoshivilo omo hava tuminafana eendja dinyenye.
Ndelenee Mordekai okwa shangela membo oinima ei nokwa tumina Ovajuda vomoitukulwalongo aishe yohamba Ahasveros, ovo ve li popepi naavenya vokokule, eenhumwafo,
ndele e va pangelela, nokutya omido adishe mefiku etimulongo netine lohani Adar nefiku etimulongo netitano lomuyo ve nokudana oshivilo,

shaashi momafiku tuu oo nomohani tuu oyo Ovajuda va mona etulumuko kovatondadi vavo. Oluhodi la shituka ehafo, nokulila kwa shituka efiku loshivilo, opo omafiku aa ve a ninge omafiku oitelekela nokuhafa ndele va tuminafane eendja dinyenye nokutumina eehepele eeshali.
Ndele osho ve shi hovela okuninga naasho Mordekai e shi va shangela, Ovajuda ve shi ninga onghedimhango.
Osheshi Haman yaHammedata, Omuagag, omutondadi wOvajuda aveshe okwa pangela omhangela okuhanauna po Ovajuda, ndele a umba Pur nokutya, oshihoololifo e va hanaune po noku va komba po.

Ndelenee osho eshi sha udika kohamba, yo oya shanga ndele ya yandja oshipango, nokutya omhangela yaye youkolokoshi ye e i diladilila Ovajuda, i nokuwila komutwe waye mwene. Ndele ve mu endelelifa novana vaye ovalumenhu komuti wokumangeleka mo.
Onghee hano ohava luku omafiku oo Purim molwedina Pur. Onghee hano molweendjovo adishe odo domonhumwafo oyo, nomolwaasho voovene ve shi mona mo muyo naasho ve shi ningilwa,

Ovajuda ve shi pangela omhangela ndele ve shi tala eufomhango lavo nololudalo lavo nolaaveshe have litula muvo, opo li kale itali lundululwa, nokutya va diinine omafiku oo avali omudo keshe papukululoshango mefimbo la pangelwa.
Ndele epupi keshe lOvajuda nepata keshe noitukulwalongo noilando i dimbulukwe omafiku oo noku a diinina, nomafiku aPurim aha efiwe nokudimbulukiwa kwao mokati komaludalo avo kuha xule.
Nomumbada Ester, omona okakadona kaAbigail nOmujuda Mordekai ova shanga nokufinda mo movanhu onhumwafo oyo onhivali va pameke oshivilo Purim.
Ndele ye okwa shangela Ovajuda aveshe vomoitukulwalongo efele nomilongo mbali naiheyali yomoshilongo shaAhasveros, eenhumwafo di neendjovo dombili nodoshili,

opo a pameke omafiku aa aPurim pomafimbo ao a pangelwa ngaashi Omujuda Mordekai nomumbada Ester e va lombwela nongaashi kuvo nokomaludalo avo va pameka omapukululoshango taa tongo efimbo lelidiliko nolokukema.
Nelombwelo laEster omapukululoshango aPurim a pamekwa, ndele oo a shangelwa membo.
10: Konima yoinima oyo ohamba Ahasveros ya fendelifa edu nominghulo dopefuta.
Noilonga aishe yeenghono dayo noyepangelo layo nehepaululo tali hepaulula etumbalo laMordekai, omo ohamba ye mu lenga, inai shangelwa mbela membo lomafimbo eehamba daMedia nodaPersia?

Osheshi Mordekai okwa li omutivali moulenga mepangelo lohamba Ahasveros. Nokwa li omunene mokati kOvajuda nomuholike mokati kavakwao vahapu, shaashi a konga exupifo loshiwana shaye nokwa popila epata laye alishe.

1: Moshilongo shaUs mwa li mu nomulumenhu edina laye Job. Nomulumenhu ou kwa li ehe noshipo nomuyuki ta tila Kalunga ndele ta kukuma owii.
Nokwa dalelwa ovana vaheyali ovamati novana vatatu oukadona.

Nokwa li e noimuna eedi di fike pomayovi aheyali, neengamelo omayovi atatu neengobe deendjoko omafele atano, neendongi eenghadi omafele atano nongulu inene yovapika, onghee hano omulumenhu ou okwa li oshipuna e dule ovalumenhu aveshe vomoushilo.

Novana vaye ovalumenhu va li ve nonghedi okuteleka oitelekela meumbo lakeshe umwe mefiku lolufo laye. Opo nee va tuma ko ndele tava shivi ovamwaina vatatu ovakainhu va kale pamwe navo nokulya nokunwa.

Ndele omafiku oitelekela eshi a pita po, Job okwa tuma ko ndele te va yapula. Opo nee Job ta fikama ongula inene ndele ta yambe omaxwikiloyambo akeshe umwe womuvo. Osheshi Job a diladila: Ovamwange kashiimba va nyona ndele va sheka Kalunga momitima davo! Osho Job a ninga alushe.
Ndele efiku limwe ovana ovamati vaKalunga eshi ve uya ndele va kala ofika koshipala shOmwene, naSatana yo e uya pamwe navo.
Opo nee Omwene ta pula Satana: “Ove to di peni?” Ndele Satana ta nyamukula Omwene ndele ta ti: “Okokweendaenda kombada yedu nokweelaela.”
NOmwene ta pula Satana: “Ove wa didilika tuu omupiya wange Job? Osheshi kombada yedu kaku na nande umwe ngaashi ye: omulumenhu ehe noshipo, nomuyuki ndele ta tila Kalunga ndele ta kukuma owii.”
Ndele Satana ta nyamukula Omwene ndele ta ti: “U shii Job ota tila Kalunga ongaho?
Ove mwene, ndishi, we mu amena keembinga adishe neumbo laye naaishe e i kwete. Ove wa nangeka noupuna oilonga yomake aye noimuna yaye ya hapupala neenghono moshilongo.
Ndelenee nana eke loye u kume aishe e i kwete: ye ote ke ku liteeka shili moipafi yoye.”
Opo nee Omwene ta ti kuSatana: “Tala, aishe e i kwete, oi li meke loye. Ashike ye mwene ino mu kuma neke loye.” Ndele Satana okwa dja po koshipala shOmwene.
Ndele mefiku limwe ovana vaye ovalumenhu novakainhu va li tava li ndele tava nu omaviinyu meumbo loshiveli shavo,
omutumwa e uya kuJob ndele ta ti: “Fimbo eenhani da pulula neendongi tadi li opo pomunghulo wado,
Ovasaba va homona ndele ve di kwata, ndele va dipaa neongamukonda ovapiya. Aame andike nda xupa po ndi shi ku shiivifile.”
Fimbo ta popi, umwe okwe uya vali ndele ta ti: “Omundilo waKalunga wa wa keulu ndele wa xwika po eedi novapiya ndele we va lungwinifa po. Ndele aame andike nda xupa po ndi shi ku shiivifile.”

Fimbo ta popi, umwe okwe uya vali ndele ta ti: “Ovakaldea va li meengudu nhatu va tanda ombinga ndele va nhukila eengamelo ndele ve di kwata oixuulwa, ndelenee ovapiya ve va dipaa neongamukonda. Naame andike nda xupa po ndi shi ku shiivifile.”
Fimbo ta popi natango, umwe okwe uya vali ndele ta ti: “Ovana voye ovamati noukadona va li tava li ndele tava nu omaviinyu meumbo loshiveli shavo,
opo omhepo inene ye uya ya dja kombinga inya yombuwa ndele ya twa keekolonela nhee dongulu, ndele ya wila kombada yovanyasha ndele va fya. Naame nda xupa po ndi shi ku shiivifile.”
Opo nee Job a fikama, ta pombaula oshikutu shaye shokombada, a kulula eexwiki daye dokomutwe, nokwa wila poshi ta indile,
ndele ta ti: “Hamunghele nda dja medimo lameme, hamunghele ohandi ka shuna ko. Omwene okwa pele nge, nOmwene okwa kufa nge. Edina lOmwene nali hambelelwe!”
Pwaaishe oyo Job ina nyona sha ndele ina popya sha shokupa Kalunga oushima.
2: Ndele mefiku limwe ovana ovamati vaKalunga eshi ve uya koshipala shOmwene, Satana yo e uya pamwe navo a kale ofika koshipala shOmwene.
Opo nee Omwene ta pula Satana: “Oto di peni?” Ndele Satana ta nyamukula Omwene ndele ta ti: “Okokweendaenda kombada yedu nokweelaela.”

NOmwene ta pula Satana: “Ove wa didilika tuu omupiya wange Job? Osheshi kombada yedu kaku na nande umwe ngaashi ye: omulumenhu ehe noshipo nomuyuki, ta tila Kalunga ndele ta kukuma owii, ndele natango tuu ta anyene mouyuki waye, nande ove we mu shindila nge ndi mu nyone po, nande ehe nombedi.”
Opo nee Satana ta nyamukula Omwene ndele ta ti: “Oshipa omoshipa! Omunhu keshe osho e shi na, te shi yandjele omwenyo waye.
Ndele shamha to nane eke loye u kume omakipa aye nombelela yaye, ndele ye ote ke ku liteeka shili moipafi yoye!”
NOmwene ta ti kuSatana: “Tala, ye oku li meke loye. Xupifa ashike omwenyo waye!”
Ndele Satana okwa dja po koshipala shOmwene, nokwa umbila Job oidinda ii koshi yomhadi fiyo okombada yomutwe.
Ndele ye okwa kufa oshikangwa te linyae nasho ndele ta kala omutumba momute.
Opo nee omwalikadi waye ta ti kuye: “Natango tuu to anyene mo mouyuki woye? Efa Kalunga u fye!”
Ndelenee ye te mu nyamukula: “Ove to popi ngaashi elai tali popi! Fye ohatu tambula ouwa kuKalunga, nowii ngeno tuhe u tambule?” Pwaaishe oyo Job ina nyona sha nomilungu daye.

Nookaume vatatu vaJob, eshi va uda oiponga aishe oyo ye mu hanga, ove uya, keshe umwe konhele yaye: Elifas, Omuteman, naBildad, Omusuhi, naSofar, Omunaamati. Ndele va ongala paudafano ve ke mu pendule noku mu hekeleka.

Ndele eshi va li kokule ndele tava yelula omesho avo, va nyengwa oku mu dimbulukwa. Onghee hano va yelula ondaka yavo ndele tava lili. Keshe umwe womuvo a pombaula elwakani laye, ndele va unda ondwi komitwe davo.
Opo nee va kala omutumba poshi puye omafiku aheyali nomaufiku aheyali ndele nande umwe ina popya naye etumbulo nande limwe, shaashi va mona nokutya, ouyehame waye wa li mudjuu.
3: Opo nee Job a makula okanya kaye ndele ta tula omutima efiku lokudalwa kwaye.
Ndele Job okwa hovela ndele ta ti:
Efiku nda dalwa, nali kane, noufiku winya kwa tiwa: “Okaana okamati ka dalwa!”
Efiku olo nali ninge omulaulu. Kalunga kokombada ehe li pule, nouyelele uhe li minikile.
Nau kwetiwe komilaulu nokomudidimbe wefyo. Oshilemo shilaula nashi ke li uvike. Aishe oyo tai laulike efiku, nai li tilife.
Oufiku winya nau hakanwe po komilaulu. Liha hafe pamwe momafiku omomudo. Li ha valulwe momafiku eehani.
Heeno, oufiku winya nau kale ongadji. Mwaau muha udike ekuwililo.
Ovo hava tula omutima omutenya, naavo yo ve u tule omutima, ovo tava pendula Leviatan.
Eenyofi dongula dalo nadi laulikwe, lo li teelele ouyelele itau uya. Lo liha mone eefeleisho deluwa,
osheshi lo inali idilila nge po oivelo yoshidalelo ndele inali holeka oudjuu momesho ange.
Omolwashike inandi fila mo mekolo lameme? Omolwashike inandi fuda mo omhepo yange mokudja kwange medimo?
Omolwashike eengolo da tambula nge, nomolwashike omavele ndi a nyame?
Osheshi ame ngeno paife handi nangala ndele handi kala nombili ngeno nda kofa ndele nda mona etulumuko
pamwe neehamba nomalenga ounyuni, oo e litungila eeshungongulu,
ile pamwe novakulunhu voshilongo va kala ve noshingoldo, ovo va yadifa eengulu davo oisiliveli;
ile ngaashi edimo la wa mo, la pakwa ngaashi ovana inava mona ouyelele.
Oko ovahenakalunga tava efa okukolokosha, ndele ovo va loloka ohava tulumukilwa ko.
Eenghwate adishe di nombili, ihava udu ondaka yomufininiki.
Omufyoona nomunenenhu ove li ko va faafana. Nomupika a efiwa, ehe fi vali womwene waye.
Omolwashike Ye ota pe omufininikwa ouyelele, nomwenyo kwaava ve u nyikila oluhodi?
Ovo hava teelele efyo ndelenee itali uya, vo have li teelele unene komesho yemona la holekwa.
Ovo tava hafe nokushambukwa nokunyakukwa ngeenge tava mono ombila.
Omolwashike ta yandje ouyelele komulumenhu e nondjila ya holekwa, komulumenhu ou Kalunga e mu kondeka keembinga adishe?
Osheshi okukema kwange kwa ninga omungome wange. Okulila kwange taku kunguluka ngaashi omeva.
Osheshi osho nde shi haluka, sha hanga nge naasho nde shi tila, sha ningilwa nge,
fimbo inandi mona efudo nombili netulumuko, ouyehame we uya vali.
4: Opo nee Elifas, Omuteman, ta nyamukula, ta ti:
“Ino ninga omwenyo mwii ngeenge ope na ou ta hetekele oku ku popifa. Ndelenee olyelye ta dulu okumwena?
Tala, ove wa yukifa vahapu ndele wa pameka omake a tyololoka.
Eendjovo doye oda yambula ou ta punduka, neengolo da tengauka we di pameka.
Ndelenee paife oudjuu eshi we ku hanga, ove wa kanifa eyombamo loye. Paife eshi tau ku tu, ove wa limbililwa.
Etilokalunga loye kali fi elineekelo loye, nokweenda kwoye mouyuki kaku fi eteelelo loye?
Dimbulukwa, olyelye a nyonauka po, ngeenge ehe noshipo, nonaini ovayuki va nyonwa po?
Osho nde shi tala, nokutya ovo hava pulula osho inashi yuka, ndele hava kunu ehanauno, ovo tave li teya yo.
Vo otava nyonauka po komufudo waKalunga nokomhepo yehandu laye otava kombwa po.
“Ekumbo longhoshi nondaka yonghoshi inene tai mwenekwa, heeno, omayoo eenghoshi deenyasha taa teyaulwa po.
Onghoshi tai fi, osheshi ihe noshihakanwa, nounghoshona vonghoshi onghadi tave lihane.
“Meholeko ondjovo imwe ye uya kwaame, nokutwi kwange kwa uda enongofolo layo,
omadiladilo eshi tae linyenge momamoniko omoufiku, eemhofi didjuu eshi da wila ovanhu.
Ehaluko nekakamo la hanga nge, nomakipa ange aeshe a dekweta.
Opo nee omhepo ya koya nge po, eexwiki domolutu lange da handala.
Oya kala ofika moipafi yange, ndelenee olupe layo inandi li dimbulukwa. Nda uda ondaka tai nongofola, tai ti:
‘Omunhu ta dulu tuu okukala omuyuki koshipala shaKalunga? Omulumenhu ta dulu tuu okukala omukoshoki koshipala shOmushiti waye?
Tala, Ye ite lineekele ovapiya vaye, nomovaengeli vaye ota mono ombedi.
Unene hano mwaava hava kala momatwali edu, neefina dokukala kwavo odi li mondwi! Vo otava teyaulwa po ngaashi eenhwishi,
opokati kongula nonguloshi tava teyaulwa po. Vo otava hanaunwa po fiyo alushe ndele kape na ou te va dimbulukwa.
Ndishi: eengodi dofaila yavo tadi mangululwa, ndele tava fi vehe nounongo.’
5: “Ifana tuu! Ou na tuu ou te ku nyamukula? Ndele okulyelye womovayapuki to ame kuye?
Osheshi elai tali dipawa kehandu, ndele ou ehe neendunge ta dipawa kouladi.
Ame mwene nda mona elai nhumbi la twama omidi da pama. Ndelenee divadiva nda li ndi nokutula omutima eumbo lalo.
Ovana valo ve li kokule nelao; ndele tava lyatwa poshivelo vehe nomukwafi.
Eteyo lavo olokukutifa omunandjala, ndelenee Kalunga te li kufa mo momakanya avo. Naava ve nenota tava lalakanene emona lalo.
Osheshi omupya itau mene mondwi, noupyakadi itau twiyuka mo medu.
Ndelenee omunhu ta dalelwa moupyakadi, ngaashi eehandje domundilo tadi tuka pombada.
“Ndelenee ame, kombinga yange nda hala ndi konge Kalunga ndele ndi twale oshinima shange koshipala shaKalunga,
komesho yaau ta longo oilonga inene noikumwifa tai nyenge okukonakonwa nokuvalwa.
Ou ta lokifile edu odula ndele ta tumine omapya omeva,
opo a nenepekife ovaxupi; ndele ava ve noluhodi va mone elao linene!
Ye ota hanauna po omadiladilo ovakengeleli, onghee hano omake avo itaa dulu okukwata osho tashi kalelele.
Ye ota kwata ovanongo momalungi avo, nepukululo lovakengeleli tali ningi longaho.
Momutenya omulaulu tau va hange nopokati komutenya tava pamhadala ngaashi oufiku.
Ndelenee omukwanaluhepo Ye ote mu xupifa mo meongamukonda, te va kwafa mo meke lomulumenhu omunaenghono.
Onghee hano omukwanaluhepo e neteelelo, nouhenouyuki u nokumwena.
“Tala, omunelao omulumenhu ou ta handukilwa kuKalunga. Ino dina hano outekuhandu waau wOmunaenghono adishe.
Osheshi Ye ta yehameke, ndelenee ota hakula yo. Omake aye otaa teyaula, ndelenee otaa velula yo.
Momaudjuu ahamano Ye ote ku xupifa mo, heeno, momaudjuu aheyali, oshiponga nande shimwe itashi ku hange.
Mondjala ote ku xupifa mefyo, ndele molwoodi omeenghono deongamukonda.
Ongola yelaka owe i holekwa, ndele ito tila ehanauno eshi tali uya.
Nomahanauno nondjala ove to i yolo ashike, ndele iho tila oilyani yokombada yedu.
Shaashi ove wa ninga ehangano nomamanya omepumbu noilyani yomofuka i noukaume naave.
Ove oto ka mona nhumbi eumbo loye tali kala nombili, ndele ngeenge ho talatala onhele yoye, ito pumbwa sha.
Oludalo loye to li mono la hapupala novamwoye vahapu ve fike pomwiidi medu.
Mombila to i wa kula ngaashi omutwe wolulya tau teywa pefimbo lalo.
“Tala, osho twe shi konakona, osho shili. Shi uda, ove mwene u shi koneke.”
6: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Akutu, ngeno ouyehame wange u yelekwe, nomupya wange u tulwe ngeno moshiyelekifo pamwe nao!
Osheshi oo mudjuu u dule eheke lopefuta. Onghee eendjovo dange tadi puka.
Osheshi oikuti yOmunaenghono adishe i li mwaame, omhepo yange ya nwa oudiyo womuyo. Omatilifo aKalunga taa fininike nge.
Ofino otai kwena tuu pomatondokelo omeva, ile ongobe tai dimine tuu peendja dayo?
Eendja domumya tadi liwa tuu dihe nomongwa ile outokele wei u nounyenye?
Omwenyo wange tau anye oku di kuma; odo da fa eendja da nyata kwaame.
“Akutu ngeno Kalunga a ude omaindilo ange, naKalunga a wanife eteelelo lange!
Kalunga na teyaule nge, na nanene eke laye okuteta nge po ngeno!
Ngeno ndi kale ndi nehekeleko lange, nondi nhuke nehafo koshi youdjuu kau nolukeno, shaashi inandi lidimbika eendjovo dOmuyapuki.
Eenghono dange odashike ndi teelele sha vali, nexulilo lange olilipipo, ndi lididimike vali?
Eenghono dange da pama mbela ngaashi emanya? Nolutu lange mbela oshikushu?
Ame nghi na vali ekwafo ngeno; exupifo onde li kufwa mbela?
“Okaume e nokufila onghenda ou ehe nekwafo, nande a kale a efa etilo lokutila Omunaenghono adishe.
Vakwetu ve liholola omakoto avo ngaashi etondokelo lomeva, ngaashi omilonga tadi pwiinine po.
Do oda laulikwa keandu nokoikangwa, omo eemhawe tadi hondama mo;
nomefimbo loupyu womutenya tadi pwinine ndele tadi kombwa po komutenya meenhele dado.
Eendjila dekungulukilo dado tadi ngolyoka, tadi i kombuwa ndele tadi xulu po.
Oyeendo yokuTema ye di lengalenga, ovaendanandjila vokuSheba ve di teelela.
Ova fifwa ohoni mokulineekela kwavo; va fika ko, ndelenee va limbililwa.
Osho nanye yo ovongahoelela kwaame. Tamu mono ehaluko ndele tamu tila.
Ame nde mu lombwela mbela: Pei nge sha? Ile: Etelei nge omulongelo womoinima yeni?
Ile: Xupifei nge momake omutondi? Ile: Kulilei nge meke lomufininiki?
“Longei nge, naame ohandi ka mwena; ndele hololelei nge apa nda puka.
Eendjovo doshili tadi longo neenghono. Ndelenee omatangunino eni taa longo shike mbela?
Mwa hala mbela okuhandukila eendjovo? Ndelenee eendjovo daau ehe nelineekelo, otadi i omhepo!
Heeno, ofiye otamu i umbile oshihoololifo, nakaume keni tamu mu lande po.
Ndelenee paife, vakwetu, taalelei nge: Mu shii ame onde mu fufya apa moipafi yeni.
Alukeni, paha ningwe osho inashi yuka! Heeno, alukeni, natango tuu odoshili ndi di na.
Ope na mbela oukolokoshi kelaka lange? Ile ondakona yange itai tongola osho sha nyata?
7: “Omunhu e li molwoodi fimbo ye ta kala kombada yedu. Nomafiku aye e li ngaashi omafiku oonakulilongela?
Ngaashi omupika ta djuulukwa omudile nongaashi nakulonga ou ta teelele ondjabi yaye,
osho ame nda fyuulula eehani doluhepo, omaufiku oupyakadi a ninga ange.
Ame eshi handi ka nangala, ohandi diladila: Onaini handi ka penduka? Ndelenee onguloshi otai ningi ile, ndele ame ohandi loloka mokupiluka fiyo eluwa tali tende.
Ombelela yange ya djalekwa omainyo nomakuma ondwi. Oshipa shange tashi kukuta ndele tashi eta otwila.
Omafiku ange taa endelele e nonhapo e dule onhisho yomutungi woshiyata ndele taa xulu po ehe neteelelo.
“Dimbulukwa nokutya, okukalamwenyo kwange oku li omufudo womhepo. Omesho ange itaa ka mona vali elao.
Eisho laau, a mona nge, itali ka mona nge vali. Omesho oye taa kongo nge, ndelenee ame kandi po!
Oshilemo tashi pepuka po ndele tashi i; nosho yo ou a ningina mo moshovafi, ita aluka mo vali.
Ye ita aluka vali keumbo laye; nonhele yaye itai mu dimbulukwa vali.
“Nosho naame yo ihandi ka kelela okanya kange, ame nda hala okupopya mefininiko lomhepo yange, ame nda hala okukema moululu womwenyo wange.
Aame efuta mbela ile oshinamwenyo shomefuta eshi wa tula ovanangeli va nangele nge?
Eshi nda diladila: ‘Ombete yange tai etele nge ehekeleko, onhele yange yokunangala tai pupaleke oudjuu wange,’
opo nee Ove wa halukifa nge neendjodi ndele wa tilifa nge nomamoniko.
Onghee hano nda hoolola okupondwa, okufya ku dule oipongolo ei yange.
Nda kuta! Inandi hala okukala nomwenyo fiyo alushe: Itavelele nge ndi tulumukwe osheshi omafiku ange ongahoelela.
Omunhu omushike, Ove u mu lenge ngaha ndele to mu pashukile,
ndele to mu talatala ongula keshe, to mu konakona otundi keshe?
Fiyo onaini to kala ino punguluka pwaame, ito efa nge nande kanini, opo ndi pone po omayeye ange?
Nande nda nyona, ame onde ku ningila shike, Oove omupashukili wovanhu? Omolwashike wa tula nge etanga loye lokuyasha, nomolwashike ame nda ninga omutengi woye munene?
Nomolwashike ito dimine nge po omanyono ange? Ndele ito kufa po oshilonga shange shii? Osheshi paife handi ka nangala mondwi yedu. Opo nee Ove to ka konga nge, ndelenee ame nghi po vali.”
8: Opo nee Bildad, Omusuhi, a nyamukula, ta ti:
“Fiyo onaini ove to popi oinima ya tya ngaha neendjovo doye da fomhepo idjuu?
Kalunga ta endamekifa ouyuki mbela, ile Omunaenghono adishe ta endamekifa ngeno osho sha yuka?
Ovana voye ngeenge va nyona kuye, Ye okwe va efela momatauluko avo.
Ove ngeenge to kongo Kalunga ndele to indile onghenda yOmunaenghono adishe,
ove ngeenge wa koshoka ndele oove omuyuki, opo nee ta fikama oku ku kwafa ndele eumbo louyuki woye te li ku dikululile.
Opo nee ehovelo loye tali ka kala linini, ndelenee exulilo tali ningi linene.
“Hano pula kepupi lonale, u dimbulukwe osho sha konakonwa kooxe;
osheshi fye ovana vonghela ndele inatu shiiva sha, omafiku etu oo omudidimbe kombada yedu.
Venya otave ku longo ndele tave ku lombwele ndele eendjovo tave di holola mo momitima davo.
Oku na tuu omanenge apa pehe noututo, nolumbungu apa pehe nomeva?
Fimbo lo litalala, noinali pya okukashulwa, otali kukuta, fimbo omwiidi keshe inau kukuta.
Osho tava ningwa ava hava dimbwa Kalunga, eteelelo lomuhenakalunga tali xulu po,
elineekelo laye la tetwa po neameno laye eendjangwi deluviluvi.
Ye ote liameke keumbo laye, lo itali kala po. Ota dame kulo, ndelenee itali kala ofika.
Ota kala mutalala momutenya, noitai yaye tai tandavele moshikunino ashishe shaye.
Omidi dao otadi lidingile momamanya ndele tadi dame ongulu yomamanya.
Ndelenee Kalunga eshi te mu teya po monhele yaye, otai mu lidimbike, tai ti: Inandi ku mona nande.
Tala, osho hano ehafo lokweenda kwaye ndele mondwi tamu tutuma vamwe!
“Tala, Kalunga ita ekeleshi omuyuki nande, ndele ita kwatelele eke lovalongi vowii.
Ndele fimbo Ye ota ka yadifa okanya koye okuyola nomilungu doye nokunyakukwa,
ovatondadi voye tava ka djalekwa nohoni, nofaila yovahenakalunga tai kombwa po.”
9: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Oshili, ondi shi shii, oyo oyoshili. Omunhu ota dulu ngahelipi okumonika omuyuki koshipala shaKalunga.
Omunhu ngeno a hala okutwa eemhata naye, ngeno ita dulu oku mu nyamukula nande ondjovo imwe yomeendjovo eyovi.
Ye omunongo weendunge nomunaenghono weenghono. Olyelye ou e mu twila ondubo, ndelenee ina handukilwa ngeno?
Oye ta dikulula eemhunda, vo inave shi shiiva. Mehandu laye te di hanauna po.
Ye ota kakamifa edu, tali di po ponhele yalo neengudi dalo tadi dekweta.
Oye ta lombwele etango, lo itali piti, ndele ta idile po eenyofi noshihako shaye.
Ye aeke ta yale omaulu ndele ta lyataula omakufikufi efuta.
Oye a ninga onyofi yaBeer nOkalimba nOmbwa nOshofi neenduda dokoumbuwanhu.
Oye ta ningi oilonga inene tai nyenge okukonakonwa noikumwifa kai shi kuvalwa.
“Tala, Ye ota ende po pwaame ndelenee kandi mu wete. Ye ta telaana ta koya nge po, ndelenee ame itandi mu dimbulukwa.
Tala, Ye ota kufa oihakanwa, olyelye ta dulu oku mu kelela? Olyelye te mu pula: Ove to ningi shike?
Kalunga ita mwena mehandu laye. Noonakupopila Rahab ve nokulixupipika koshi yaye.
Ongahelipi hano ame handi dulu oku mu nyamukula, nokuhoolola eendjovo dange tu twe eemhata naye?
Nande ndi kale ndimuyuki, handi nyengwa okunyamukula. Ame ndi nokwiindila omutokoli wange a file nge onghenda.
Nande ndi mu ifane ndele Ye a nyamukule nge, inandi itavela Ye a tambula momatwi aye onghuwo yange.
Osheshi Ye ota taataa nge po noshikungulu shaye, ndele ta hapupalifa oipute yange oshimha.
Ye ita itavelele nge okufudifa nande omufudo, ndelenee ta yadifa nge nouyehame ulula.
Ngeenge taku pulwa eenghono domunaenghono, Ye ta ti: Aame ou! Ndelenee ngeenge ouyuki tau pulwa, ta ti: Olyelye ta dulu okuhokololifa nge?
Nande ndi kale ndimuyuki, okanya kange mwene taka pe nge oushima. Nande ndi kale ndihe nombedi, Ye ota mono owii mwaame.
Kandi nombedi. Ihandi yavala omwenyo wange; okukalamwenyo kwange onde ku dina.
Ashishe shimwe! Onghee handi ti: Ye ota xulifa ou ehe nombedi naau e nombedi.
Ongola ngeenge tai dipaa po ohangelela, Ye ota sheke eliekelelo laau ehe noushima.
Edu ola yandjwa mepangelonghono lovakolokoshi, Ye ota uvike oipala yovatokoli vaye. Ngeenge haye, olyelye hano?
“Heeno, omafiku ange e nonhapo e dule eenhondoki, taa i onhapo itaa mono elao;
tae litetuka nokweendelela ngaashi eewato deembungu, ngaashi onhwa tai kolokele poshihakanwa.
Ngeenge handi ti: Nda hala okudimbwa oluhodi lange, nda hala okulundulula oshipala shange nokunyakukwa,
opo nee handi haluka molwouyehame wange, ondi shi shii, Ove ito pe nge ounongo.
Ondi nokukala ndi noushima omolwashike handi lihepeke oshimha?
Nande ndi likoshe noshitwime, ndele ndi yelife omake ange nofewa,
natango tuu to ninginifa nge melambo leenyata, oikutu yange tai nyonyodola nge.
“Osheshi Ye ke fi omunhu ngaashi ame, ndi shiive oku mu nyamukula, tu shiive ngeno okuya pamwe koihokolola.
Kape nomutokoli pokati ketu naye, ou ta dulu okutenheka eke laye kufye vavali.
Na kufe po oshiti shaye pwaame, omahalukifo aye aha tilife nge,
opo ame ohandi popi, ndele itandi mu tila vali, osheshi ame hasho ndi li.
10: “Ame ohandi nyonyodola okukalamwenyo kwange. Onda hala, okukema kwange ku udike. Nda hala okupopya mouyehame wokomwenyo,
handi lombwele Kalunga: Ino tokola nge ndi pewe oushima. Shiivifile nge: molwashike ho twile nge eemhata?
Ove to lilikolele shike mokufininika nge, eshi to ekeleshi oshilonga shomake oye, ndelenee ho minikile eemhangela dovahenakalunga?
Ove u nomesho opambelela mbela? Ove ho tale mbela ngaashi omunhu ha tale?
Omafiku oye e li mbela ngaashi omafiku omunhu? Ile omido doye ngaashi omido domulumenhu?
Eshi Ove ho kongo owii wange ndele to pula omatimba ange,
nande u shi shii ame nghi nombedi, ndele kape na nande umwe ta xupifa mo momake oye?
“Omake oye a honga nge ndele a ninga nge keembinga adishe; ndele Ove to teyaula nge po.
Dimbulukwa, nokutya wa honga nge ngaashi elova ndele wa hala okushitulula nge ondwi vali.
Ove wa tilashi nge ngaashi omashini, ndele wa pameka nge ngaashi omashini a ota.
Ove wa djaleka nge oshipa nonhumba ndele wa tunga nge nomakipa neefipa.
Ove wa pa nge okukalamwenyo nonghenda, noshisho shoye sha amena omhepo yange.
Ndelenee wa holeka eshi momutima woye; ondi shi shii Ove we shi diladila:
ame eshi nda nyona, Ove wa nangela nge, ndele ino dimina nge po owii wange.
Ngeenge ndi nombedi, woo ame! Ndele ngeenge ndimuyuki, ame nda nyengwa okuyelula omutwe wange, eshi nda kuta ohoni nokutala oluhepo lange.
Ngeenge omutwe wange tau yeluka, Ove to taataa nge ngaashi onghoshi, ndele to monifa nge oixuna.
Ove ho kongele nge alushe ovahokololifi vape tava hokololifa nge, ndele to hapupalifile nge oupyuhandu woye, omatanga mape ovakwaita va homone nge!
Omolwashike wa shilila nge mo moshidalelo shameme? Ngeno nda fya fimbo eisho nande limwe inali mona nge!
Ngeno nda li nda fa ndihe po, moshidalelo shameme ngeno nda twaalelwa mombila.
Omafiku ange omanini. Na efe nge ndi kale nombili, na pilamene nge ndi nyakukwe kanini,
fimbo inandi fikama ndi ye koshilongo shomulaulu noshomudidimbe wefyo ndiha aluke vali,
koshilongo shomulaulu ngaashi pokati koufiku, oshomudidimbe wefyo noshehanauno oko ouyelele u li ngaashi omulaulu.”
11: Opo nee Sofar, Omunaamati, a nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Omapopyaano a kale ngeno itaa nyamukulwa? Ile omulumenhu omupopyaani ta ka pewa tuu ounongo?
Omapopyaano oye taa mweneke ngeno ovalumenhu, ove u sheke, kuhe na ou te ku fifa ohoni?
Wa tile: ‘Elongo lange ola yela, aame omukoshoki momesho oye.’
Ndelenee woo, ngeenge Kalunga ta popi, ndele te ku makulile omilungu daye
ndele te ku hololele oiholekwa younongo, nokutya Ye e neendunge dihapu! Opo to shiiva, nokutya Kalunga okwa hala okudimbwa dimwe domeembedi doye.
U shi, ove to dulu okukonakona oule wounongo waKalunga? Ile to dulu okuhanga ouyadi wOmunaenghono adishe?
Owo u fike poule weulu; ove to dulu shike? Owo u dule oule woposhi woshovafi; ove to dulu okushiiva shike?
Oule wao u dule wedu, noumbwalangadja wao u dule wefuta.
Ye ngeenge te uya ta ingaana ndele ta kwata onghwate ndele ta shivi oshiongalele shoihokolola, olyelye te mu kelele?
Osheshi ovanaipupulu va shiivika kuye ndele ta mono owii nande ine u konakona?
Osho ngaha hano elai tali dulu okupewa ounongo, nokandongwena taka ka dalululwa omunhu.
Ove ngeenge to longekida omutima woye nomake oye to a yelula noku mu ilikana,
ngeenge meke loye omu nowii, u ekela kokule, ndele ino itavela metwali loye mu kale nande owii,
opo to dulu okuyelula oshipala shoye shihe nokavala kohoni, ndele to kala wa pama nokupamenena, ku noku tila sha.
Heeno, nena to ka dimbwa omupya woye, noku u diladila wa fomeva a kunguluka po.
Okukalamwenyo kwoye taku ka kala ku nouyelele u dule ou wopokati komutenya; ndele nande naku laule, tau kala ngaashi etango longula.
Ove u nelineekelo, shaashi u neteelelo. Ove to lengaalenga ndele to ka nangala nombili.
Ove oto ka nangala pehe na ou te ku tilifa, ndele vahapu tava ka konga oukaume naave.
Ndelenee omesho ovakolokoshi taa ka loloka, onhele yavo yokuhondama ve i kanifa. Eteelelo lavo okufuda mo omufudo waxuuninwa.”
12: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Oshili, heeno, nye hamba ovanhu vashili, nounongo tau ka xula po pamwe nanye.
Naame yo ndi neendunge ngaashi nye. Kamu dule nge. Olyelye ina shiiva mbela oinima ya tya ngaha?
Aame oshiyolifa sho kaume kange, ame ou nda ifana Kalunga ndele a uda nge. Omuyuki nomuhenashipo a ninga oshiyolifa.
Ou e li meameno, ta diladila, nokutya osha wapala okudina oshiponga. Osha longekidilwa ovo omhadi yavo tai tengauka.
Omatwali ovakolokoshi taa kala nombili, ovo hava handukifa Kalunga, ohava kala nawa nova kola yo.
“Ndelenee pula koinamwenyo, yo otai ku longo, nokeedila dokeulu, do otadi ku shiivifile;
ile konakona edu, lo otali ku longo, neeshi domefuta nadi ku hepaululile.
Oshilipipo shomuyo aishe itashi shiiva ngeno nokutya, eke lOmwene le shi ninga,
Oye ou ta diinine meenghono daye oinamwenyo aishe nomhepo yomunhu keshe?
Hakutwi ngeno haku dimbulukwa eendjovo nondakona hai udu eendja?
Omulumenhu weenghwakutoka e nounongo, naau e nomafiku mahapu eendunge.
PuKalunga ope nounongo neenghonopangelo. Ye e nepukululo neendunge.
Tala, Ye ngeenge ta ngumauna po, itapa tungululwa vali. Ou a idililwa mo kuye ita yeululwa mo vali.
Tala, Ye ota kelele omeva ndele taa pwiinine. Ye ote a efa a kungulukile po, ndele taa tuvike edu.
Puye ope neenghono nomayele. Omupukifwa nomupukifi vo ovaye.
Ovapukululi te va twala koilongo, va tikishwa; novatokoli te va ningi omalai.
