Eemhango deehamba ote di mangulula ndele ta mange ongodi moiya yado vene.
Ovapristeli te va twala koilongo, va tikishwa, naava ve neenghono te va shundula.
Ye ota dundakanifa eendjovo dovalineekelwa, novakulunhu te va nyeka omayele.
Ovanamadina ote va tile okudinwa ndele ta yululula omiya dovanaenghono.
Ye ota holola omaulekule a tuvikwa komulaulu, nomulaulu fokofoko te u eta poluhaela.
Ye ota nenepekifa oiwana, ndele te i hanauna po. Ye ta tandavelifa oiwana ndele te i twala koilongo.
Ovapangeli voshiwana te va kufa eendunge ndele te va elaelifa meefuka dihe neendjila.
Hava pamhadala momilaulu muhe nouyelele, Ye ote va tengaukifa ngaashi eengholwe.
13: “Taleni, aishe ei omesho ange e i mona, nomatwi ange e i uda, ndele nde i koneka.
Oyo nye mu i shii, naame yo ndi i shii. Kamu dule nge.
Ndelenee nda hala okulombwela Omunaenghono adishe ndele nda hala okutomha Kalunga.
Ndelenee nye amushe tamu mange noipupulu nye ovahakuli vehe noshilonga.
Akutu, ngeno mu kale mwa mwena filu, opo mu talwe nye ovanongo!
Pwilikineni hano ehokololo lange mu dimbulukwe nhumbi omilungu dange tadi tu omhata.
Mwa hala tuu okupopila Kalunga neendjovo inadi yuka, nokupopya oipupulu mu mu wapeke?
Mwa hala hamba okukala mu nokatongotongo omolwaye? Ile mwa hala okupopya ponhele yaKalunga?
Otashi ka eta po tuu ouwa, Ye eshi ta hovele oku mu konakona? Ile tamu dulu tuu oku mu kengelela, omunhu ngaashi ta kengelelwa?
Ye ote ke mu handukila shili, ngeenge mu li mu nokatongotongo meholeko.
Ounene waye itau mu mbadapaleke nehaluko laye itali mu wile?
Omayeletumbulo eni oo omayeletumbulo omute, neehotengulu deni do eehotengulu dedu.
Mweneni ndi tulumukwe, opo ndi popye. Nandi hangike kukeshe osho shi nokuhanga nge.
Omolwashike ndi kwate ombelela yange nomayoo, nomwenyo wange ndi u tule meke lange?
Taleni, nande Ye a hala okudipaa nge, Oye handi mu lineekele. Nda hala ashike okupopila okweenda kwange koshipala shaye.
Osho yo exupifo lange, omukolokoshi ita dulu okweehena ko koshipala shaye.
Pwilikineni nawa eendjovo dange, nye mu ude osho handi shi tongo.
Taleni, nda eta po oihokolola yange, ondi shi shii, ame nda pewa ounongo!
Olyelye ta dulu okuhokololifa nge? Opo nee ame handi ka mwena nokufya.
“Ashike ino ningila nge oinima ivali, opo nee itandi ka hondama oshipala shoye:
Kufe nge eke loye! Nomahalwifo oye aha tilife nge.
Opo nee hokololife nge, ndi ku nyamukule ile ame handi popi, u nyamukule nge.
Oilonga yange ii nomatimba ange e fike peni ngeno? Shiivifile nge omatauluko ange nomatimba ange.
Omolwashike to holeke oshipala shoye ndele to tale nge, aame omutondadi woye?
Efo tali i momhepo wa hala oku li halwifa ile to taataa oshihati sha kukuta?
Shaashi wa sheyelela nge oshipewa shilula, noilonga yange ii yomounyasha wange i ninge oshifyuululwa shange.
Osheshi Ove ho tula eemhadi dange meti ndele to nangele eendjila dange adishe, ndele to findi omufinda peemhadi dange,
nande ame ndi li ngaashi omuti wa tukwa, ngaashi oshikutu sha lika keenhwishi.
14: “Omunhu a dalwa komwalikadi, ta kala po omafiku manini ndele ta kuta oupyakadi,
ota kulu ngaashi onhemo ndele ta lembe. Ta faduka po ngaashi omudidimbe, ita kalelele.
Omunhu a tya ngaha Ove ho mu nangele, ndele to tula nge koshipala shoye u hokololife nge.
Mwaau a nyata, otamu di tuu ou a yela? Nande umwe.
Omafiku aye a pangelwa nomhangela, nomuvalu weehani daye wa shiivika kwoove. Ove we mu tulila ongaba, ita dulu oku i tauluka.
Kufa muye oshipala shoye a tulumukwe, opo a shiive okuhafa ngaashi omulongeli wondjabi pexulilo lefiku.
“Nokuli, nomuti u neteelelo, nande tau kewa po, otau tutuma oitutumine ipe, noitwiyuka yomidi inai pumba.
Nande omidi dao tadi kulupa medu noshifidi shao tashi file mondwi
ndelenee okedimba lomeva otau tutuma vali ndele tau twiyuka oitai ngaashi onhwika italala ya twikwa.
Ndelenee omulumenhu ta fi, ke neenghono, heeno, omunhu ta fuda mo omufudo waye ndele ye oku li peni?
Omeva taa pwiinine mo metale lakula, nomulonga tau pwiinine ndele tau kala ongaho.
Nosho yo omunhu ta nangala, ita penduka vali. Fimbo omaulu inaa xula po, itava ka papuduka, ndele itava ka penduka meemhofi davo.
Akutu, ngeno u holeke nge moshovafi, heeno, u holeke nge fiyo ehandu loye la lota, u pangelele nge efimbo opo nee u dimbulukwe nge vali.
Omunhu ngeenge ta fi, ota ka nyumuka tuu vali? Ngeno ndi kale nokunangela omafiku aeshe oukwaita wange fiyo olufo lange lokumangululwa la fika.
Ove ngeno u ifane, ame nohandi ku nyamukula, Ove ho djuulukwa oshilonga shomake oye.
Osheshi paife ho valula eenghatu dange. Iho pashukile mbela omatimba ange?
Omatauluko ange a tulwa momakutu a hakwa, nowii wange we u hotela mo.
Ndelenee ngaashi omhunda ya teka po, tai tatuka, nemanya tali dikulwa mo monhele yalo,
nomeva taa kweshula po omamanya, noshikungulu shodula tashi lafa po edu, osho Ove to mane po elineekelo lomunhu.
Ove to mu ninipike fiyo alushe, ndele ta ka ililila. Ove to shitukifa olupe laye ndele to mu tumu ko.
Ovana vaye tava ka fimanekwa, ndelenee ye ke shi shii. Vo otava shundulwa, ndelenee ite shi mono.
Ye e udite ashike ouyehame wolutu laye mwene, noluhodi lomwenyo waye mwene.”
15: Opo nee Elifas, Omuteman, a nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Omulumenhu omunandunge ota nyamukula tuu nokudenga omhepo, ndele ta yadifa tuu onhulo yaye nomhepo yokoushilo?
Ote lipopile tuu neendjovo dihe noshilonga, neendjovo itadi kwafa sha?
Heeno, ove to hanauna po etilokalunga loovene ndele to nyono po elimweneno lokoshipala shaKalunga.
Osheshi owii woye tau longo okanya koye ndele to hoolola eendjovo dovakengeleli.
Okanya koye mwene take ku tokola, haame. Heeno, omilungu doye mwene tadi ku pe oushima.
“Ove ngeno omudalwa wotete mokati kovanhu ile wa shitwa, wa tetekela oikulundudu?
Ove wa li tuu omupwilikini meenghundafana daKalunga? Oto diladila kutya oove auke omunandunge?
Ou shii shike, osho fye tuhe shii? Ou udite shike, osho inatu shi koneka?
Mokati ketu yo omu novanhu ve neenghwakutoka, ve nomafiku mahapu e dule omafiku ooxo.
Ho dini ehekeleko laKalunga neendjovo daye de ku popifa nolukeno?
Omolwashike omutima woye tau i noixwa? Nomolwashike omesho oye taa ningi manene ngaha,
nehandu loye to li yukifile Kalunga ndele to pitifa mo mokanya koye eendjovo da tya ngaha?
Omunhu ta dulu okukala ngahelipi a yela, ou a dalwa komukainhu ota dulu ngahelipi okukala omuyuki?
Tala, Ye ite lineekele nande ovayapuki vaye, nomaulu yo inaa yela komesho yaye,
ngahelipi hano omunhu omunyonyodolwa nomunyonwa, ou ta nu owii ngaashi ta nu omeva?
“Ame nda hala oku ku pukulula. Pwilikine nge. Handi hepaulula osho nde shi mona,
ovanongo osho tave shi holola, osho ve shi pewa kooxe, itave shi holeke,
kwaavo va pewa edu ovo aveke, nomunailongo ina enda mokati kavo.
Ovakolokoshi hava kala alushe ve noumbada, omido odo dinini omufininiki e di sheyelwa.
Eendaka dehalwifo di li momatwi aye. Mokati kefimbo lombili omuhanauni te mu nhukile.
Ye ita itavele, kutya ta xupifwa momulaulu, ndele a sheyelwa eongamukonda.
Ye ota elaela nokukonga omungome: openi u li? Ye oku shi shii nokutya, efiku lomulaulu le mu longekidilwa, li li popepi naye.
Noudjuu noumbada tau mu halukifa, tau mu tilifa ngaashi ohamba ya tandela olwoodi ombinga,
shaashi a nana eke laye a lwife Kalunga nokwe linenepekifa koshipala shOmunaenghono adishe.
Okwa lotoka oku mu kondjifa nehalo laye la kola meameno loikelelifo ihapu ya pama,
osheshi oshipala shaye e shi ondola nomaadi, eembwetule daye e di ondola di nomakaadi.
“Nokwa tula moilando ya hanaunwa po, meengulu da shilikwa okunangalwa ndele da tokolwa di kale eenduba domakuma,
onghee hano ye ita ningi oshipuna, noupuna itau kalelele, noilya yaye itai petamene poshi.
Ye ita i onhapo omulaulu, elaka lomundilo tali kukutike oitutumine yaye, ye ta nyonwa po komufudo womokanya kaKalunga.
Na kale ite lineekele oshinima shongaho; ote limbebeleke, osheshi eliko laye otali ka kala olongaho.
Netango laye fimbo inali fika, otashi mu shakeneke; noluvale laye itali talala vali.
Ye okwa fomuviinyu tau yaumukifa eenhemo domangongwa ao, nongaashi olumono tali yaumukifa eenhemo dalo.
Osheshi ongudu yovahenakalunga onhimba, nomundilo tau lafa po etwali laau a tambula ombubo.
Vo ve noufimba woupyakadi ndele tava dala ehanauno. Nomadimo avo taa longekida ekengelelo.”
16: Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Oinima ya tya ngaha nde i uda ihapu. Nye amushe ovahekeleki vongaho.
Okudenga omhepo itaku xulu po nokuli? Ile oshike tashi ku fininike u nyamukule?
Ngeno nye mu li ponhele yange, ngeno naame yo handi dulu okupopya ngaashi nye, ndele handi dulu okutunga omatumbulo ndi mu kondjife noku mu pukapukila omutwe wange.
Ohandi dulu okupopya eendjovo doku mu ladipaleka, ndi mu pupaleke nehekeleko lomilungu dange.
Ngeenge handi popi, ihandi mono epupaleko mouyehame wange nongeenge handi mwena, itau di mo tuu.
Ndelenee paife Ye okwa lolokifa nge. Ove wa mana po eumbo lange alishe.
Ove wa kwata nge. Okukwata nge kwoye kwa ninga ondobwedi tai pe nge oushima. Noudu wange tau twile nge ondubo, tau hokololifa nge moipafi.
Ehandu laye la lengaula nge ndele tali tondo nge. Ye ta kweshele nge omayoo aye. Ovatondadi vange hava dakamene nge omesho avo.
“Vo ova makulila nge omakanya avo. Hava denge nge polupanda nokutuka nge. Ngaashi omunhu umwe vo otava ngudumanene nge.
Kalunga ta yandje nge momake ovanhu vai ndele ta ekele nge momake ovakolokoshi.
Ame nda kala nombili, ndelenee Ye a halukifa nge, okwa kwata nge mofingo nokwa nyanyaula nge. Ye okwa tula nge etanga laye lokuyasha.
Oikuti yaye tai xwema kombinga nombinga yange. Ye ota taula eefiyo dange ehe nolukeno. Nonyango yange ote i tileshi poshi.
Okungumaunwa po kwange kwa shikulafana, Ye ta totele nge ngomukwaita.
“Oshipa shange nde shi hondjela oshikutu sheefya, oluvinga lange nde li twa medu.
Oshipala shange sha tilyana molwokulila, neefeleisho dange di nomulaulu,
momake ange nande muhe noukolokoshi neilikano lange ola yela.
“Edu, ino tuvika ohonde yange! Ndele paha monikile onghuwo yange nande onhele yetulumuko.
Taleni, nopaife Ondobwedi yange oku li meulu, nOmupopili wange mokombadambada!
Ookaume kange hava sheke nge, ndelenee omesho ange e nomahodi taa taalele Kalunga,
opo Ye a popile omulumenhu koshipala shaKalunga, a popile omona womunhu moipafi yamukwao.
Osheshi omido dange odo di li po natango odinini, opo nee handi i, ndele itandi aluka vali.
17: “Omhepo yange oya nyanyaulwa, omafiku ange taa dimwa po, ombila tai teelele nge.
Oshili, oshipewa shange okushekwa, nomesho ange e nokutala eemhata davo.
Ove mwene pe nge ombabyona; olyelye umwe ta popile nge?
Osheshi omitima davo we di fitikinina eendunge. Onghee hano ito va itavelele va finde nge.
Ookaume tava ifanenwa va tukulilwe oixuulwa, ndelenee omesho ovana vaye taa loloka.
“Ndelenee Ye okwa ninga nge oshitevo shovanhu, nokufiilwa omate moshipala shange.
Onghee hano eisho lange la loloka molwoluhodi, noinhimbu yange aishe i li ngaashi omudidimbe.
Omolwaasho ovayuki tava haluka, nomuhenambudi ota udile omukolokoshi owii.
Ndelenee omuyuki ota diinine ondjila yaye, naau e nomake a yela, ota kulu meenghono.
Ndelenee nye amushe, ileni oku vali! Ihandi mono nande omunongo mokati keni.
“Omafiku ange a xula po, eemhangela dange omahalo omutima wange a ninga ongaho.
Oufiku otave u pilula omutenya. ‘Ouyelele,’ vati, ‘tau ehene popepi, tau di momulaulu.’
Ame nande nde lihalela shike, oshovafi, osho eumbo lange. Oikumbafa yange handi i yale momilaulu,
handi lombwele ombila: ‘Oove tate!’ Nomainyo: ‘Meme, nomumwameme omukainhu!’
Elineekelo lange oli li peni? Heeno, eteelelo lange, olyelye te li mono?
Lo otali ka kuluka pamwe naame mokule moule mwi konima yoiidilifo yoshovafi, fye eshi hatu nangala pamwe mondwi yedu.”
18: Opo nee Bildad, Omusuhi, a nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Fiyo onaini mwa hala okulukila eendjovo eemwiyo? Ningeni eendunge, opo nee tu popye po.
Omolwashike hatu faafanifwa noimuna, fye katu neendunge momesho eni?
Ove to linyanyaula mehandu loye, omolwoye tuu edu li efiwe ngeno li kale ongaho, nemanya li dikuke monhele yalo?
“Heeno, ouyelele womuhenakalunga tau dimi, nelaka lomundilo waye itali yela.
Ouyelele otau laula meumbo laye nolamba yaye tai dimi kombada yomutwe waye.
Eenghatu dokweenda kwaye di neenghono tadi ka ninga dinini, nepukululo laye mwene tali mu wilifa poshi.
Osheshi eemhadi daye mwene tadi mu twala meendjadja ndele ta ende kombada yekelo.
Eendjadja dokukwata tadi kwata oshififinwa shaye, nelulo tali mu dame.
Omwiyo we mu holekelwa medu, nongodi yoku mu pundukifa i li mondjila.
Keembinga adishe ye ota tilifwa komahalukifo, ndele tave mu taataa fiyofiyo.
Ondjala otai ningi mukwao, kombinga ei oshiponga tashi mu teelele.
Oshiveli shefyo tashi kunya oinhimbu yomolutu laye, oinhimbu yaye tai lika kusho.
Ye ota nakulwa mo metwali laye, meameno laye e li lineekela. Ye e nokukatuka nokuholoka koshipala shohamba yomahalukifo.
Metwali laye mwa kala sha, sho shihe fi shaye, ponhele yeumbo laye tapa undwilwa osulfuri.
Omidi daye tadi kukuta medu, noshitai shaye tashi lembe kombada.
Edimbulukifo laye tali kana kombada yedu, ndele ehe nedina tali tumbulwa momapandavanda.
Ota undulwa mouyelele, a ye momulaulu, ndele ta ka tewa mo mounyuni.
Moshiwana shaye ehe nepata ile noludalo nande umwe womeumbo laye ta ka kala po.
Oonakukalamo vomouninginino tava ka haluka omolwefiku laye, nekakamo tali ka kwata ovanhu vomoushilo.
Oshili, osho omaumbo ovalongi vowii taa ka ningwa, nosho nonhele yaau, ina shiiva Kalunga.”
19: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Fiyo onaini tamu ka nyonyodolifa nge nokunyanyaula nge neendjovo?
Lwomulongo nokuli mwa sheka nge, ndele tamu hepeke nge muhe neudito lohoni.
Ame onda puka tuu shili, oushima otau kala tuu mwaame?
Ile tamu dulu tuu shili okushishimana koshipala shange, ndele mwa hala okuhololela nge okushekwa kwange;
kaleni mu shi shii nokutya, Kalunga a ninga nge nai nokwa dingila nge meendjadja daye, nande ndihe noshipo.
Taleni, handi kuu onghuwo, handi ti: “Oukolokoshi!” Ndelenee ihandi mono enyamukulo. Handi ifana ekwafo, ndelenee kape nouyuki.
Ondjila yange okwe i umbila ongubu, handi nyengwa okutauluka, nokwa yalela omalila ange omulaulu.
Ye okwa dula nge efimano lange nokwa kufa omutumbo wokomutwe wange.
Ye okwa nyanyaula nge keembinga adishe nokwa wilifa nge poshi ndihe noshilonga vali. Nokwa duda mo eteelelo lange ngaashi omuti.
Ehandu laye e li efela nge li xwamene nge, nokwa tala nge ame omutondadi waye.
Omatanga aye ovakwaita tave uya ngaashi omunhu umwe, tava kokola ondjila va lwife nge, ndele tava ongo onhanda tava dingilile etwali lange.
Oovakwetu okwe va twala kokule naame, novashiivikile vange ova ninga ovanailongo kwaame.
Ovashiinda ve liteeka nge, novalineekelwa vange va dimbwa nge.
Ava ve li meumbo lange novapiya vange ovakainhu tava tale nge ndimunailongo. Momesho avo onda ninga omweenda.
Ohandi ifana omupika wange, ndelenee ye ita nyamukula nge, nande ohandi mu indile nawa.
Okufuda kwange taku nyonyodolwa komwalikadi wange, nedimba lange tali nyikile nai ovana voshidalelo shameme.
Ovamati vanini tava dini nge. Ame eshi handi penduka, otava sheke nge.
Ookaume kange ovalineekelwa aveshe tava nyonyodola nge. Ndele ava ndi va hole, tava twile nge ondubo.
Omakipa ange a naatela koshipa shange. Ndihe na shimwe vali, oshama shange ashike.
Filei nge onghenda, nye ookaume kange, filei nge onghenda, shaashi eke laKalunga la kuma nge.
Omolwashike tamu haula nge ngaashi Kalunga ndele itamu kuta keenhumba dange?
“Ngeno eendjovo dange di shangwe di dimbulukiwe, ngeno di nyolelwe membo,
di nyolelwe mo noshishangifo shoshivela, di hokelwe memanya fiyo alushe.
Ndelenee ame ndi shi shii: omupopili wange e nomwenyo! Ndele xuuninwa ye ota ka kala ofika mondwi yedu!
Ndele oshipa eshi shange eshi sha yuvwa nge, ndele nda dja mo molutu lange, ame ohandi ka tala Kalunga.
Ohandi ke mu mona Oye omukwafi wange, omesho ange tae ke mu tala, ehe fi omweenda. Eefiyo dange oda notelwa meni lange!
“Nye eshi tamu ti: ‘Otu noku mu nangela ngahelipi?’ Mwaame vati tamu monika efina loshinima,
hano tileni eongamukonda, osheshi oupyuhandu tau ka hanga omatauluko haa handukilwa neongamukonda, mu shiive nokutya, oku netokolo.”
20: Opo nee Sofar, Omunaamati, a nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Odo omadiladilo ange tae di pe enyamukulo, molwoshinima osho meni lange mwa fuluka.
Ame ndi nokupwilikina okutanguna taku fifa ohoni. Ndelenee omhepo yeendunge dange tai nyamukula nge.
Osho shoshitonale ku shi shii, omunhu nghee a shitwa, a tulwa kombada yedu,
nokutya, enyaku lovahenakalunga itali kala po nehafo lomukolokoshi olixupi ongepakumo leisho.
Ounene waye nande u yeluke fiyo okeulu, nomutwe waye nande u hange oilemo,
ye ota ka xula po fiyo alushe ngaashi onyata yaye mwene. Ovo ve mu mona, tava pula: ‘Openi e li?’
Ye ota tuka po ngaashi ondjodi, onghee omunhu ite mu mono vali; ndele ta henuka po ngaashi emoniko lomoufiku.
Eisho le mu tala, itali mu tale vali. Nonhele yaye itai mu mono vali.
Ovana vaye ve nokulikongela onghenda yeehepele, nomake aye mwene e nokuyandja po emona laye.
Omakipa aye kwa li e yadi eenghono dounyasha, ndelenee do da li di nokuya mombila pamwe naye.
Owii nande ounyenye mokanya kaye, te u holeke koshi yelaka laye,
te u diinine, ina hala oku u efa, ndele te u kakatelifa kondakona yaye,
eendja odo tadi shituka momandjadja aye ndele otadi ningi onyango yefu meni laye.
Okwa pona po oupuna, ndelenee e noku u kunga mo vali. Medimo laye Kalunga te u taataa mo.
Okwa nyama oudiyo wefu, elaka leyoka tali mu dipaa.
Ita dulu vali okunyakukilwa omilonga, nomakungulukilo omaadi eenyiki nomashini a pama.
Osho e shi lilikolela mokulonga, ye e noku shi yandja po, ye mwene ita dulu oku shi pona, ehafo laye kali fike pemona e li likola.
Osheshi a fininika ovakwanaluhepo, nokwe va ekelashi ngaho, okwe likufila ongulu, ndele ita dulu oku i tungulula.
Osheshi ina shiiva nande ekuta ledimo laye, ndelenee ite lixupifa noinima yaye i nondilo.
Kape na nande oshinima shimwe sha ya onhapo olwisho laye, onghee hano elao laye itali kalelele.
Mouyadi woupuna waye ye ota ka kala e noumbada; omake aeshe ovakwanaluhepo tae mu pyaifwa.
Ye eshi ta yadifa edimo laye, Kalunga ota tumu kombada yaye oupyuhandu waye, Ye ote u mu lokifile eendja daye.
Ye ota ka ya onhapo oiti yoshivela. Ota ka tyuulwa kouta woshikushu.
Ye ngeenge ta shili mo oshikuti mombuda yaye, eongamukonda tali taima tali tyuuka monyango yaye. Omahalwifo tae mu pangele.
Omamona aye a tuvikililwa omulaulu fokofoko. Ye ota lungwinifwa komundilo inau pepelwa komunhu. Owo tau li po osho sha xupa po meumbo laye.
Eulu tali holola owii waye, nedu tali tu ondubo naye.
Eliko leumbo laye tali ka iwa nalo mefiku lehandu. Oinima yaye tai ka ya okwiililwa kefundja.
Osho hano oshipewa shomukolokoshi, te shi pewa kuKalunga, osho oshifyuululwa she mu sheyelwa kuKalunga.”
21: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Pwilikineni nawa eendjovo dange, di ninge ehekeleko lange.
Lididimikilei nge, ndi dule okupopya yo; ame eshi nda popya, nye tamu dulu okusheka.
Handi kemene ovanhu mbela? Ile shike ndiha nyengwe okulididimika.
Talei nge, mu haluke, mu tule omake komilungu deni.
Heeno, ngeenge handi i diladila, ohandi limbililwa shili, nehaluko tali kwata olutu lange.
“Omolwashike ovahenakalunga tava itavelwa okukala po ve nomwenyo, vo hava kulupa ndele hava mono eenghono?
Oludalo lavo tali kulu komesho yavo pamwe navo, noitutuma yavo moipafi yavo.
Omaumbo avo taa kala nombili, ehe nehaluko, itava hangika kongola yaKalunga.
Ongobe yaye omhedi itai hambe oshimha, ongobe yaye onghadi tai dala, itai helula.
Ovana vavo ovamati tave va pitifa mo ngaashi ongudu yeedi, nounona vavo hava nhuka nokudanauka.
Vo ohava imbi mokushikwa kwenghuma loshikushu nokwokaxumbafeta, ndele hava hafe mokushika eenyalilo.
Omafiku avo ove li melao ndele mefaukilo ohava ningine mo moshovafi.
Nande ongaha, ova lombwela Kalunga, tava ti: ‘Kala kokule nafye.’ Navali: ‘Eendjila doye inatu hala oku di shiiva.
Omunaenghono adishe omushike ngeno, tu mu longele? Noku mu indila otaku tu kwafa ngahelipi?’
“Taleni, elao lavo kali mo momake avo vene? Omapukululo ovahenakalunga naa kale kokule naame.
Olungapi nokuli olamba yovahenakalunga tai dimi, ndele tava hangika komupya wavo? Kalunga ota tukula omaudjuu mehandu laye.
Ohava ningi ngaashi oihati tai twalwa komhepo, nongaashi olungu tali kombwa po komhepo yoshikungulu?
Oshiponga shaye Kalunga, vati ote shi tuvikilile ovana vaye. Ye ne shi mu alulile shi mu valule.
Omesho aye mwene e nokutala omupya waye, ye mwene e nokunwa oupyuhandu wOmunaenghono adishe.
Osheshi ita yavala oludalo laye, ye eshi ta fi, nomuvalu weehani daye ngeenge wa wanifwa?
Kalunga e nokulongwa mbela eendunge, Ye ou ta tokola oikwaulu?
“Umwe ta fi melao la wana nombili netulumuko.
Oiyuma yaye i yadi omashini nomungo womakipa aye taa nwefwa omaadi.
Nomukwao ta fi e nomwenyo tau nyika oululu, ina makela ouwa.
Vo aveshe tava ka nangala medu, nomainyo tae va tuvike.
“Taleni, omadiladilo eni ndi a shii, nomaudafano eni mai, mwa hala okufininika nge nao.
Ngeenge tamu ti: ‘Eumbo lomuhepeki oli li peni? Nomatwali ovahenakalunga otaa kala peni?’
Hano inamu pula kovaendanandjila? Itamu dulu okulikala omahepaululo avo.
Ovalongi vowii tava xupifwa efiku lehanauno, ye ta amenwa efiku loupyuhandu.
Olyelye te mu lombwele moipafi yaye okweenda kwaye? Olyelye te mu alulile osho e shi ninga?
Opo nee tave mu twala noku mu findikila kombila, nombila yaye tai kalelwa noshisho.
Omakuma okefilu tae mu tuvike omapu kuye; ovanhu aveshe tave mu shikula ngaashi vahapu, vehe shi kuvalwa ve mu tetekela ko.
Omolwashike tamu hekeleke nge panghedi ii? Nomanyamukulo eni ekonda alike tali fyaala po!”
22: Opo nee Elifas, Omuteman, a nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Omunhu ota dulu tuu okukwafa Kalunga? Ahowe, Omunaendunge ote likwafa Ye mwene.
Omunaenghono adishe ote lilikolele tuu sha, ove ngeenge omuyuki? Ile ta mono tuu sha, ove ngeenge to ende uhe noshipo?
Ye ote ku handukile vati molwetilokalunga loye nomolwaasho mbela te ku hokololifa?
Owii woye muhapu, noilonga yoye ii tai nyenge okuvalwa.
Ove wa tambula ongaho ombabyona yovakweni, ndele vo va li hamunghele, we va dula oikutu yavo.
Omunotelwa ino mu pa omeva okunwa, naau kwa li e udite ondjala, we mu anyena omungome.
Ndelenee oshilongo sha ninga shomulumenhu mudjuu, nomunamadina aeke a itavelelwa okukala musho.
Ovafiyekadi we va lekela va dje po hamakasha pwoove, nomaoko eefiye a teyaulwa po.
Onghee hano to dingililwa keendjadja dokuyula, netilifo ole ku halukifa unene.
Ile ku wete omulaulu? Efundja lomeva tali ku tuvike.
Kalunga ke fi mulemule ngaashi eulu? Ndele tala eembado deenyofi, nhumbi di li moule wopombada.
Ndelenee to ti: ‘Kalunga a shiiva shike? Ta dulu tuu okutokola e li konima yoilemo ilaula fokofoko?
Oilemo oyo oiuviko yaye, ita mono ko, ndele ha ende kombada yevalelwa leulu.’
Wa hala okweenda nelila laalushe olo la endwa kovakolokoshi,
vo va hanaunwa po efimbo lavo fimbo inali fika, ekanghameno lavo la kombwa po komeva,
ovo va lombwela Kalunga: ‘Kala kokule nafye!’ Navali: ‘Omunaenghono adishe ta dulu oku tu ningila shike?’
Nande ngaha Ye okwa yadifa omaumbo avo nouwa. Ndelenee omhangela yovahenakalunga i li kokule naame.
Ovayuki otave shi mono ndele tava hafe, nomunashipo te va sheke, ta ti:
‘Oshili, omunandubo nafye a hanaunwa po. Ndele oyo ve i efa, oya lika komundilo.’
“Ninga oukaume naye, u mone ombili, opo nee to ka mona ouwa.
Tambula elongo lokanya kaye neendjovo daye di tuvikila momutima woye.
Ove ngeenge to aluka kOmunaenghono adishe, ove to ka tungala, ngeenge to taataele kokule owii meumbo loye,
noingoldo yoye to i ekele mondwi noshingoldo shokuOfir mokati komamanya omomulonga.
Opo nee Omunaenghono adishe ta ningi oshingoldo shoye nonduba yoye yoshisiliveli,
nehafo loye tali ka kala mOmunaenghono adishe, noshipala shoye to shi yelula kuKalunga.
Ove ngeenge to mu indile, Ye ote ku udu, nomaudaneko oye to ke a wanifa.
Keshe osho to shi diladila, u shi ninge, oto ke shi shakenifa yo, eendjila doye tadi minikilwa.
Ondjila ngee tai filukile to ti: ‘Okulonda!’ Nomulininipiki ote mu kwafa.
Ota xupifa yo ou e nombedi, omolwoukoshoki womake aye Ye ote mu xupifa.”
23: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Ndele natango onena eli ekemo lange la fondubo. Eke lange olidjuu omolwomifudo dange.
Akutu, ngeno ndi shiive, nhumbi ndi mu mone opo ndi fike ko oko ta kala,
ngeno ndi mu hololele eendjovo dange nokuyadifa okanya kange nomahepaululo,
opo ndi shiive eendjovo denyamukulo laye nokuuda osho te shi lombwele nge.
Ye ota ka twifa nge tuu eemhata neenghonopangelo daye dinene? Ahowe, ngeno a tale nge ashike!
Opo nee omulumenhu omuyuki ta kala moihokolola pamwe naye, ndele ame ohandi ka pewa komutokoli wange ounongo fiyo alushe.
Taleni, ohandi i koushilo, Ye ke ko, nokouninginino, ndelenee itandi mu dimbulukwa,
ngeenge ta longo moumbangalanhu kandi mu wete; ndele ngeenge te liameke koumbuwanhu, itandi mu mono ko.
Osheshi okweenda kwange kwa shiivika kuye. Ngeno Ye ta konakona nge ngeno handi monika nda yela ngaashi oshingoldo.
Eemhadi dange da kala nokudiinina eemhadi daye. Nda shikula ondjila yaye, ame inandi yapuka mo muyo.
Inandi kanduka mo moshipango shomilungu daye. Eendjovo dokanya kaye nde di diinina komesho yomhangela yange.
Ndelenee Ye ota kala ngaashi e li, ita lunduluka, olyelye ta dulu oku mu kelela? Ndele osho we shi hala, ote shi ningi.
Ota wanifa osho sha sheyelwa nge, oinima ya tya ngaha ihapu i li puye natango.
Onghee hano ame handi hangika kehaluko koshipala shaye. Ngeenge handi shi diladila, ohandi tila.
Kalunga okwa teyaula po eyombamo lange, nOmunaenghono adishe a halukifa nge.
Osheshi itandi nyonwa po omolwomulaulu ile omolwaame mwene, omulaulu wa tuvika nge.
24: “Omolwashike Omunaenghono adishe ina ufa omafimbo oihokolola, nomolwashike ava ve mu shii, itava mono omafiku aye oihokolola?
Vo ohava lundulula eengaba, hava nyeke oyuunda ndele tave i lifa.
Ohava twala ondongi yeefiye ndele hava kufa ongobe yomufiyekadi ombabyona.
Ovakwanaluhepo tave va undula mo mondjila. Ovakwanaluhepo aveshe vomoshilongo ve nokuhondama.
Taleni ove li ngaashi eefino mombuwa, tava i moshilonga shavo okukonga eendja. Ombuwa tai va pe omungome wavo nowovana.
Ohave liongelele eendja davo kepumbu nomoikokola yomiviinyu yovahenakalunga hava pupudulula.
Oufiku ohava nangala hamunghele, vehe noikutu, vehe na sha shokuliuvikila outalala.
Hava tutikwa koshikungulu shodula tashi di keemhunda, vehe noiyaamo, onghee tava yaama komamanya.
Okaana taka kufwa komavele, naasho omukwanaluhepo e shi kwete, ote shi kufwa po ombabyona.
Vo ohava ende hamunghele vehe noikutu. Ohava humbata oipandi yoilya ve nondjala.
Ohava kolo omaadi olumono pokati komakuma ovanhu, ndele moikolelo yavo yomiviinyu hava kolo va fyenota.
Ondaka yekemo lovalumenhu tai udika moshilando, nomwenyo weendjashe tau kuu onghuwo. Ndelenee Kalunga ita yavala oixuna.
Ovanhu va tya ngaha ovatondadi vouyelele, inava shiiva eendjila davo, ndele ihava kala nomalila ouyelele.
Fimbo eluwa inali tenda omudipai ta penduka, ta dipaa omukwanaluhepo nohepele; ndele oufiku ye ta ende ngaashi omulunga.
Eisho lomutei wohombo tali tale oshiwiwili ndele ta ti: Kape na nande eisho tali tale nge; ndele ta uvike oshipala shaye.
Momulaulu ota panukile mo momaumbo, omutenya ohava kala ve liidilila mo. Kave na sha nouyelele.
Osheshi omulaulu fokofoko u li kuvo ngaashi etango la sha, osheshi omahalwifo omulaulu fokofoko ve a shii.
Mokweendelela tava twalwa komeva. Epya lavo ola tulwa omutima moshilongo. Vo ihava aluka vali kelila lokoshikokola shomiviinyu.
Ngaashi oluteni noupyu tau twala eemhawemeva nosho yo oshovafi ovo va nyona.
Oshidalelo shaina tashi mu dimbwa. Omainyo tae mu li nehafo. Ye ita dimbulukiwa vali. Osho ngaha hano owii tau teyaulwa po ngaashi oshiti.
Ye okwa nyeka ongadji ei ihai dala, ndele ina kwafa omufiyekadi.
Meenghono daye Kalunga ta yambidida ovanaenghono va kale nomwenyo mule. Vo ohava kala ofika, nande va li va limbililwa okukalamwenyo kwavo.
Kalunga te va amene, ndele ve nomuyambididi a pama, nomesho aye otaa pashukile eendjila davo.
Ova lengwa ndelenee ohaluka, okafimbo kaxupi, kave po vali. Otava xutuka. Otava fi ngaashi aveshe, otava yaumuka ngaashi oshunga.
Ndele ngeenge hasho, olyelye ta vele nge ombedi molwoipupulu, ndele ta tomho eendjovo dange?
25: Opo nee Bildad, Omusuhi, a nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Epangelonghono netilifo li li puye, ou ha ningi ombili moule waye wopombandambada.
Olyelye ta dulu okuvala omatanga aye ovakwaita? Nolyelye ou, ouyelele waye itau mu yelele?
Omunhu ta dulu ngahelipi okukala omuyuki koshipala shaKalunga? Naau a dalwa komukainhu ota dulu ngahelipi okukala a yela?
Taleni, ohani yoovene itai yela nokuyelelela. Neenyofi inadi yela momesho aye.
Ngahelipi hano omunhu einyo, nomona womunhu, oshiyokashi!”
26: Ndelenee Job okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti:
“Ove wa yambidida nawa ngahelipi oshingone, ndele wa kwafa ngahelipi okwooko kwaau ehe neenghono!
Ove wa pukulula ngahelipi ou ehe nounongo ndele wa holola ngahelipi eendunge dihapu!
Eendjovo doye we di lombwela lyelye, nomhepo yalyelye ya kala mwoove?
“Oilulu yokoshi tai kakama koshi yomeva noyoonakukalamo muo.
Oshovafi shi li hamunghele koshipala shaye, nonhele yenyonauno inai uvikwa.
Ota yale oumbalanhu kombada yedundakano, ndele ta endjelelifa edu ponhele pehe na sha.
Ota mange omeva kumwe noilemo yaye, noilemo itai pombauka koshi yao.
Ye ota uvike olukalwapangelo laye, ndele te li yale noshilemo shaye.
Nokwa finda omufindangonga momeva apa ouyelele nomulaulu tai shakenafana.
Eengudi deulu tadi kakama ndele tadi kala da kuminwa etangunino laye.
Okeenghono daye ta tukulukifa efuta ndele keendunge daye ta teyaula po Rahab.
Molwomufudo waye eulu tali yela. Eke laye la tyuula eyoka li nonhapo.
Taleni ei, oyo ominghulo adike deendjila daye, ndele fye ohatu udu ko tuu okunongofola kwaye! Olyelye hano ta dulu okushiiva okungunguma kweenghono daye?”
27: Ndele Job okwa popya vali ndele ta ti:
“Oshili, ngaashi Kalunga e nomwenyo, ou a kufa nge eyukifo, nOmunaenghono adishe ou a nyikifa omwenyo wange oluhodi;
fimbo ndi nomwenyo nomufudo waKalunga momayulu ange,
omilungu dange itadi popi oipupulu nelaka lange itali fufya!
Nashi kale nge kokule, nye ndi mu pe ounongo. Fiyo handi ka fuda mo omufudo wange, itandi ekeleshi po ouyuki wange.
Ame ohandi dame kouyuki wange, itandi u efa nande. Eliudo lange itali vele nge ombedi nande efiku limwe lomokukala kwange.
“Omutondadi wange na ningwe ngaashi omuhenakalunga nomunandubo naame ngaashi omulongi wowii.
Elineekelo lashike omukolokoshi e li na, Kalunga eshi ta tete po okukala kwaye, Ye eshi ta kufa omwenyo waye?
Kalunga ota ka uda tuu onghuwo yaye, oluhepo ngee tali mu hange?
Ile ta dulu tuu okuhafela Omunaenghono adishe nokwiifana Kalunga efimbo keshe?
“Ame ohandi ke mu longa osho eke laKalunga tali longo. Osho shi li pOmunaenghono adishe itandi shi holeke.
Taleni, mwe shi mona nye vene amushe, omolwashike hano tamu diladila ngaho?
“Oshitukulwa shomuhenakalunga te shi pewa kuKalunga, noshifyuululwa shomufininiki te shi pewa kOmunaenghono adishe osheshi:
nande a kale e noludalo lihapu, lo tali ka liwa keongamukonda. Noitutuma yaye itai kutifwa komungome.
Ovo tava xupu po puye, otava ka fya koudu wolutapo, novafiyekadi itava lili eefya.
Ngeenge ta ndubile oisiliveli ngaashi ondwi, ndele ta ongele oikutu ngaashi edu,
heeno, ye ota ongele ndelenee omuyuki te i djala; nomuhenashipo ote litukulile oshisiliveli.
Ye ota tungu ongulu yaye ngaashi einyo lonhwishi nongaashi oshiyaamo sha dikwa komunangeli.
Ota ka nangala oshipuna, ndele ita ka kala oshipuna; nongeenge ta penduka, oupuna waye owa kana po.
Omahalukifo tae mu hange ngaashi omakungulukilo omeva. Oufiku oshikungulu oshe mu twala.
Omhepo yokoushilo tai mu twala, ye e nokwiililila. Noyo tai mu pepe mo monhele yaye.
Ndele Kalunga te mu umbu ehe nonghenda, ye e nokuya onhapo diva eke laye.
Ota pandulilwa omake ndele tave mu shikilwa omwilwa kovambulavo.
28: “Osheshi ope nonhele omo oisiliveli tai di, nonhele yoshingoldo omo tashi yelifwa.
Oshivela tashi kufwa medu, nongopolo tai hemunwa memanya.
Omulaulu tau tewa po nofiyo mokule mwi emanya tali konakonwa shili, emanya lo la tuvikwa komulaulu nokomudidimbe wefyo.
Omina otai hokwa tapa ka iwa mokule okoshi yoonakukala kombada yedu; ova dimbuwa kwaava hava lyata kombada. Vo ohava endjelele mo kokule novanhu, tava dungaanifwa.
Omungome tau di medu, ndelenee meni mwi koshi yedu omo mwa dongakana ngaashi omundilo.
Momamanya alo omu nonhele yasafir nomu neheke loshingoldo.
Elila lokuya mo olo inali shiivika konhwa, neisho lekodi inali li koneka.
Lo itali lyatwa koilyani, itali endwa konghoshi.
Eke tali kumu emanya likukutu, ndee tali hadahada eemhunda fiyo okomidi dado.
Momamanya tamu pandwa omikala neisho tali tale oinima i lili nai lili i nondilo.
Ye ota fitike po eedjo. Noiholekwa ote i eta poluhaela.
“Ndelenee ounongo otau monika peni? Nonhele yeendunge oi li peni?
Ondilo younongo inai shiivika komunhu, ndele medu lovanamwenyo itau monika.
Oule woposhi tau ti: Kau mo mwaame. Nefuta tali ti: Kau po pwaame.
Itau landwa noshingoldoelela, nondado yao itai yelekwa noshisiliveli.
Oshingoldo shomuOfir inashi u wanena, nosho yo oumanya vaoniks ve nondilo navasafir itave u wanene.
Nande oshingoldo ile ekende li fike puo, oo ngaashi itau landakanifwa noinima yoingoldo.
Okorali nakristali itai tumbulwa pamwe nao. Okukala nounongo ku dule ouwe.
Okamanya katopas komuEtiopia kake shii kuyelekwa nao, nongaashi itau yelekwa noshingoldoelela.
“Ounongo ohau di peni? Nonhele yeendunge oi li peni?
Heeno, owo wa holekwa omesho aaveshe ve nomwenyo, wa holekwa eedila dokeulu.
Onhele yenyonauko nefyo tali ti: Omatwi etu a uda oshipopiwa ashishe shao.
“Kalunga a shiiva ondjila tai twala ko, Ye a shiiva onhele yao.
Osheshi Ye e wete ko fiyo okominghulo dedu. Ye ta tale aishe oyo i li koshi yeulu.
Ye eshi a pele omhepo eenghono, nomeva okwe a yelekele noshiyelekifo,
Ye eshi a pa odula omhango yayo, noluvadi ondjila yalo.
Opo nee Ye a mona ounongo noku u holola, okwe u kalekela ko nokwe u konakona.
Ndelenee okwa lombwela omunhu ndele ta ti: ‘Tala, okutila Kalunga okwo ounongo. Nokukukuma owii okwo eendunge.’ ”
29: Job okwa twikila vali eendjovo daye netumbulo laye ndele ta ti:
“Akutu, ngeno ndi kale ngaashi nda li meehani doshito nale, ngaashi pomafiku enya Kalunga kwa li ta amene nge,
fimbo olamba yaye ya minikila komutwe wange, ndele nda enda nokutauluka omulaulu mouyelele waye.
Ngeno ndi kale ngaashi pomafiku enya okufu kwange fimbo oukaume waKalunga wa li kombada yetwali lange,
fimbo Omunaenghono adishe a kala pwaame, novana vange va dingilila nge,
fimbo eemhadi dange da koshwa momashini, nemanya pwaame la kungulukifa omakungulukilo omaadi.
Ame eshi nda ya koshivelo shoshilando, eshi va tula olukalwa lange koshilandelo.
Ovanyasha va kanduka po eshi va mona nge, novashamane veenghwakutoka va kala ofika.
Omalenga a mwena, nomake ao e a kwatifa omilungu davo.
Ondaka yovanamadina ya mwena filu, nelaka lavo la dama kondakona yavo.
“Osheshi keshe okutwi kwa uda nge, kwa fimaneka nge omunelao, ndele keshe eisho la mona nge, ola hepaululula nge,
osheshi ame nda xupifa omukwanaluhepo ou a kuwa onghuwo, nofiye ihe nomukwafi.
Enangeko noupuna lomukwanaluhepoelela le uya kwaame, nomutima womufiyekadi nde u hafifa.
Ame nda djala ouyuki, nowo wa uvika nge, nouyuki wa li elwakani lange.
Ame nda li eisho lomupofi, nomhadi yaau ta shongola.
Ame nda li xe yeehepele, neendjovo doihokolola yomunailongo nde di konakona shili.
Ame nda teyaula po eehamama domukolokoshi ndele nda kufa oshihakanwa momayoo aye.
Opo nee nda diladila: ‘Ame ohandi ka fila moshihadi shange nokuhapupalifa omafiku ange ngaashi edu.
Nomidi dange tadi tandavele da yuka komeva, nomume tai kala oufiku koitai yange.
Efimano lange tali pepalele mwaame alushe, nouta wange tau pepalele meke lange.’
Ova pwilikina nge ndele va teelela, va mwena nokuteelela epukululo lange.
Ame eshi nda popya inava tonga nande ondjovo imwe vali, neendjovo dange de va ndodela.
Ova teelela nge ngaashi odula ndele va makula omakanya avo va fa va teelela odula yoluteni.
Ame nde va pa omayoo vo eshi va limbililwa, nomeminikilo loshipala shange vo inava kala vali ve noluhodi.
Ame eshi nde lihoololela okuya kuvo, ame nda kala omutumba kolukalwa lokomeshoelela; nda li omutumba ngaashi ohamba mokati komatanga ayo ovakwaita, ngaashi ou ta hekeleke ava va nyika oluhodi.
30: “Ndele paife ovanyasha ovo ndi va dule omido, ohava yolo nge, ooxe nde va dina, ndi va tule ngeno keembwa doimuna yange.
Neenghono domake avo otadi kwafa nge shike, osheshi eenghono davo dounyasha oda manwa po koluhepo.
Vo ova pwa po koluhepo nokondjala. Vo ohava kunya edu likukutu momulaulu wombuwa nowetokeko,
vo ohava toola po oimeno ilula poixwa, neendja davo odo omidi doshixwa shaGinster.
Vo otava tewa po movanhu; omolwavo ovanhu tava kuu onghuwo ngaashi molwomulunga.
Vo ove nokukala momafilu matilifa eemhunda nomomakwena nomomakololo omamanya.
Hava xwema mokati koixwa nomokati koulilifa ohava ongala kumwe,
ovo oludalo longaho kalu noshilonga, ovanhu vehe nefimano, va tewa mo moshilongo.
Ndele paife ame nda ninga eimbilo lavo lesheko noshipopiwa shavo.
Ame ohandi nyonyodolwa kuvo, hava kala ofika kokule naame, itava yavala okufiila nge momesho omate.
Osheshi Kalunga a yululula ofipa youta wange nokwa ninipika nge, omiya doshitomo ve di efela nge koshipala shange.
Kolulyo taku litumbu ongudu yoidudu. Eemhadi dange otave di kandula po ndele tava umbile nge eendjila davo dehanauno.
Vo otava hanauna po elila lange, ohava kwafa okumana nge po, nande kape na ou te va pameke vali.
Vo otave uya va fa tava di momufya womekuma; tava alangata mo tava di meenduba domakulukuma.
Omahalukifo taa tale nge moshipala. Etumbalo lange tave li kombo po ngaashi omhepo, nongaashi oshilemo elao lange la pepuka po.
Onghee hano omwenyo wange tau diya mo mwaame, omafiku oluhepo a kwata nge.
Oufiku otau tyuula omakipa ange; nouyehame tau kunya nge, itau tulumukwa nande.
Keenghono dinene daye oshikutu shange sha lunduluka shihe na vali olupe, otashi pondo nge ngaashi ofingo yohema yokoshi.
Ye okwa ekela nge monyata, naame nda ninga ngaashi ondwi noshimhu shongaho.
“Ame ohandi ku kuwile ekwafo, ndelenee Ove ito nyamukula nge. Ame handi kala apa, ndele Ove ho dakamene nge omesho.
Ove wa shitukila nge omukukutu uhe nonghenda. Omolweenghono deke loye Ove ho haula nge ngaashi omutondadi.
Ove to yelula nge momhepo ndi londe kuyo. Ame handi nyonwa po koshihomo shoshikungulu.
Osheshi ndi shi shii: Ove wa hala okutwala nge mefyo nokongulu muyo aveshe ava ve nomwenyo tava ongala.
Kape na ou e li koshi yoingumaukilemanya ita djuula mo okwooko a xupifwe, ile momupya waye okukuwa exupifo?
Ile inandi lilila ngeno ou kwa li e nomafiku madjuu? Omwenyo wange inau humbatela omukwanaluhepo oshisho?
Heeno, onda teelela elao, ndelenee omupya wa hanga nge. Nda nangela ouyelele, ndelenee omulaulu we uya!
Omandjadja ange taa fuluka, omafiku oluhepo a hanga nge.
Ame handi ende noshikutu sheefya, ndihe netango. Ame ohandi penduka ndele handi ingida mongudu yovanhu.
Ame nda ninga omumwaina wokavandje nakaume komho.
Oshipa shange sha laula, ndele sha ninga omakoko ndele tashi natuka, nomakipa ange a pya kepupyu.
Osho ngaha hano okushika okaxumbafeta kange kwa shituka okulila eefya, nondaka yepoli lange ya shituka omutambo.
31: “Ame nda udafana nomesho ange: ndi tale ngahelipi kokakadona?
Oshitukulwa shilipipo ngeno Kalunga ta pe nge kwinya kombada noshitukulwafyuululwa shilipipo Omunaenghono adishe wokombada?
Omulongi wowii ita mono mbela ehanauno, nomulongi woulunde ita hangika mbela komupya?
Ye ita tale mbela eendjila dange adishe ndele ita vale mbela eenghatu dange adishe?
“Ame ngeenge nda enda noipupulu neemhadi ngeenge da endelela okukengelela:
Ye na yeleke nge noshiyelekifo sha yuka, Kalunga opo a shiive ouyuki wange.
Eenghatu dange ngeenge da yapuka mo mondjila nomutima wange ngeenge wa shikula omesho ange ile momake ange mwa kanyatela onyata,
umwe na lye osho nde shi kuna, noitutumine yange nai dudwe pamwe nomidi dayo.
Omutima wange ngeenge wa hokwa omukainhu wamukwetu ndele nda nangela poshivelo shamukwetu,
omwalikadi wange na twile omunhu umwe oilya, navakwao nave mu papatele.
Osheshi osho ngeno sha li oshilonga shoixuna nenyono tali handukilwa shili.
Heeno, osho omundilo tau lungwinifa fiyo okonhele yehanauno ndele tau mane po eliko lange alishe.
Ngeenge nda dina ngeno ouyuki womupika wange omulumenhu ile omukainhu, eshi va ka hokololifa nge,
ame ndi ninge shike Kalunga ngeenge ta fikama? Ame ndi mu nyamukule ngahelipi ngeenge a hovela okukonakona?
Haye tuu ou ngeno a shita nge medimo lameme, e mu shita yo, haye tuu aeke e tu shita koshi yomutima?
Onda anyena tuu ovakwanaluhepo osho ve shi hala, nomesho ovafiyekadi onde a lolokifa tuu?
Okapambu komungome aame andike mbela nde ka lile po, ofiye inandi mu tukulila yo?
Ahowe, nghee kounyasha wange onde i tekula ngaashi xe, ndele okudja kedimo lameme nde i kalela noshisho.
Ngeenge nda mona omukwanaluhepo ehe noshikutu, nomweeheli ehe noshiuviko,
olutu laye inali etela nge enangeko loupuna ndele inali pupyalifwa komalududi oudjona vange,
ofiye ngeenge nde i takela ongonyo yange, eshi nda mona ko okupopilwa kwange moshivelo,
Opo nee ombeyo yepepe lange nai we mo mofingo yayo, nokwooko kwange naku liteeke po ponhele yako.
Osheshi okuteyaulwa po kwange nde ku twikwa kuKalunga okwa halukifa nge unene, ame nda nyengwa, nda nyengelelwa epangelofimano laye.
Ame ngeenge nda tula elineekelo lange moshingoldo ndele nda lombwela oshingoldoelela: Oshilineekelwa shange,
ngeenge nda hafifwa kehapupalo lemona lange neke lange eshi la likola shihapu,
ngeenge mokutala kwange ouyelele wetango, nhumbi tali yela, nohani, oyo tai ende nokuvadima,
omutima wange ngeno wa hongaulwa meholeko nomilungu dange nde di fipifa eke lange;
ngeno oshilonga osho shii osha li shi nokuhandukilwa shili, osheshi nde liteeka ngeno Kalunga kokombada.
“Ame nda hafela tuu omupya womutondadi wange ile nda shambukwa komwenyo oshiponga eshi she mu hanga?
Inandi itavelela elaka lange li nyone, ndi mu tule omutima noku mu halela efyo.
Ovanhu vomeumbo lange ove nokuhepaulula nokutya, keshe umwe a pewa ombelela ihapu.
Omunailongo ka li e nokunangala pondje, oshivelo shange nde shi yeululila ondjila.
Ame nda tuvika tuu omatauluko ange ngaashi ovanhu, nda holeka ngeno owii wange monhulo yange,
shaashi ngeno nda li nda mbadapala eemhunga dovanhu nokutila okudinwa kepata lange, nda kala ngeno nde limwenenena, inandi pita moshivelo.
Akutu, ngeno pa kale omunhu ta pwilikine nge! Taleni, edina lange oleli, nde li nyola, Omunaenghono adishe na nyamukule nge! Neshango la shangwa komuhokololifi wange!
Oshili handi ke li twika kepepe lange noku li manga oshidingo komutwe wange.
Ngeno ndi mu shiivifile omuvalu weenghatu dange, ndele ndi holoke koshipala shaye ngaashi ohamba.
“Epya lange ngeenge la hokololifa nge neefola dalo adishe kumwe ngeenge da lila,
ngeenge nda lya oimeno yalo, inandi i futa, nomwene walo ngeno nde mu kemifa,
eeshosholo nadi mene ponhele yoilya, neengwena ponhele yomahangu.” Eendjovo daJob oda xulila apa.
32: Opo nee ovalumenhu ava vatatu va mwena, inava nyamukula vali Job, shaashi ye kwa li omuyuki momesho aye mwene.
Nehandu laElihu yaBarakel, Omubusi, womepata laRam, ola xwama. Ehandu laye la xwamena Job, shaashi ye e litala omuyuki koshipala shaKalunga.
Ehandu laye la xwamena yo ookaume kaye vatatu, shaashi inava mona enyamukulo lokutomha Job.
Ndelenee Elihu okwa teelela olufo laye lokupopya naJob, osheshi venya va li ovakulunhu; ve mu dule.
Ndelenee Elihu eshi a mona nokutya, ovalumenhu venya vatatu va li vehe na vali oshitya shenyamukulo momakanya avo, ehandu laye la xwama.

Ndele Elihu yaBarakel, Omubusi, okwa hovela ndele ta ti:
“Aame omunyasha, nye ovaxungu veenghwakutoka. Onghee hano nda mbadapala ndele nda tila oku mu hololela eshiivo lange.
Nda diladila: ‘Oukulunhu nau popye, ouhapu womido nau udife ounongo.’
Ndelenee omhepo yomomunhu nomufudo wOmunaenghono adishe tau va pe eendunge.
Havaxungu ve nounongo nongaashi haava aveke va kulupa ve neendunge okushiiva ouyuki.
Onghee hano handi ti: Pwilikinei nge. Naame yo nda hala okuholola eshiivo lange.
Taleni, ame nda teelela eendjovo deni. Nda li nda hala okuuda eendjovo deni deendunge, fiyo mu mone eendjovo da yuka.
Ndele nde mu taalela. Nde taleni, nande umwe a tomha Job, nande umwe a dula okunyamukula eendjovo daye.
Inamu tya: ‘Twe litwa mounongo woovene, Kalunga aeke ta dulu oku mu tomha, hamunhu.’
Ina popya eendjovo di nondubo naame, ame inandi hala oku mu nyamukula neendjovo deni.
“Vo ova kuminwa. Itava nyamukula vali. Eendjovo davo da xula po.
Ame ndi teelele vali, vo eshi itava popi, vo eshi hava kala ofika itava nyamukula vali.
Naame yo nda hala okunyamukula kombinga yange, naame yo handi holola eshi ndi shii.
Osheshi ndi yadi ndo eendjovo, omhepo yomonhulo yange tai fininike nge.
Tala, onhulo yange i li ngaashi omaviinyu a fitikwa, ngaashi ombao ipe ya nyika kutenda omufya.
Ame nda hala okupopya ndi pupale, okumakula omilungu dange nokunyamukula.
Ame inandi hala okukala ndi nokatongotongo ndele ihandi heke nande omunhu.
Osheshi inandi shiiva okuheka, osheshi Omushiti wange ngeno ta kufa nge po divadiva.
33: “Ndele Job, pwilikina paife okupopya kwange, u ude eendjovo dange adishe.
Tala, ame nda makula okanya kange. Elaka lange tali popi koshi yondakona yange.
Eendjovo dange tadi di moshili yomutima wange; naasho sha shiivika komilungu dange otadi shi popi odikilila.
Omhepo yaKalunga ya shita nge, nomufudo wOmunaenghono adishe tau mwenyeke nge omwenyo.
Ngeenge ho dulu, nyamukule nge. Lilongekida u kondjife nge. Tanda ombinga!
Tala, ame ndi li ngaashi ove koshipala shaKalunga. Naame yo okapambu kelova.
Tala, ito pumbwa okutila nge, nomutengi wange itau ke ku djuupalela.
Ndelenee ove wa popya momatwi ange, naame nda uda ondaka yeendjovo wa tile:
‘Aame omukoshoki, inandi tauluka, ndihe noshipo, mwaame kamu nombedi.
Taleni, Ye ota kongele nge eembedi dokuhandukila nge, ta tale nge ame omutondadi waye.
Ye ota tula eemhadi dange meti. Ta nangele eendjila dange adishe.’
“Tala, moshinima osho ku li mondjila osho handi ku nyamukula, osheshi Kalunga e dule omunhu.
Omolwashike we mu twifa eemhata, ye ngeenge ita nyamukula eendjovo adishe domunhu?
Osheshi Kalunga ta popi panghedi imwe, heeno, paenghedi mbali, ndelenee omunhu ite shi dimbulukwa.
Mondjodi, memoniko loufiku, ovanhu ngeenge tava wilwa keemhofi didjuu, ndele hava nangala momitala davo,
opo nee Ye ta fitulula omatwi ovanhu ndele ta pameke noshihako omakumaido aye,
opo a alule omunhu moshilonga shii nokwaamena omulumenhu kelinenepeko,
opo a amene omwenyo waye, uha ye mombila, nomwenyo waye keonga.
Omunhu ota handukilwa yo nouyehame momutala waye, momakipa aye eshi mu nolwoodi itali xulu po,
onghee nomwenyo waye tau nyonyodola omungome, nomutima waye eendja dinyenye.
Onhumba yaye tai kukuta, tai xulu po, ihe na vali ewapalo; nomakipa aye aa a li inaa monika, taa kunyuka.
Heeno, omwenyo waye tau ehene popepi nombila, nomhepo yaye popepi nomapangelonghono efyo.
Ngeenge pefimbo olo omweengeli ngeenge a ama kuye, omunghwandjila umwe womomayovi okushiivifila omunhu oshinakuwanifwa shaye,
opo nee Kalunga te mu file onghenda ndele ta ti: ‘Mu xupifa aha ye mombila, ame nda pewa oikulila.’
Opo nee olutu laye tali ka fuluka vali eenghono dounyasha, ye ota shuna vali momafiku ounyasha waye.
Ye ota indile Kalunga ndele Ye okwe mu hokwa, onghee ta tale nehafo oshipala shaye. Osho ngaha hano Ye ota alulile omunhu ouyuki waye.
Ye ota imbile ovanhu ndele ta ti: ‘Ame nda nyona ndele nda nyona ouyuki, ndelenee ame inandi handukilwa pawii wange.
Ye okwa xupifa omwenyo wange mombila, nomhepo yange ya tala nehafo ouyelele.’
“Tala, ashishe eshi Kalunga te shi ningile omunhu luvali ile lutatu nokuli,
opo a alule omwenyo waye mombila, ndele a yelelwe kouyelele womwenyo.
Tala, Job, pwilikine nge! Mwena, ame ndi popye!
Ndelenee ngeenge u neendjovo, nyamukule nge. Popya, osheshi nehalo liwa nda hala ove u kale wa pewa ounongo.
Ngeenge hasho, pwilikine nge; mwena, ndi ku longe ounongo.”
34: Elihu okwa popya vali ndele ta ti:
“Udeni eendjovo dange, nye ovalumenhu ovanongo! Pwilikinei nge nye ava mu neshiivo!
Osheshi okutwi ku udite eendjovo ngaashi ondakona tai makele eendja.
Tu konakoneni osho sha yuka, tu kongeni kumwe osho sha wapala.
Osheshi Job a tile: ‘Ame omuyuki, ndelenee Kalunga okwa kufa nge ouyuki wange.
Nande ndi nouyuki, ondi nokufufya ngeno. Oshiveta shange shoshikuti itashi veluka, nande ndihe netauluko!’
Omulumenhu olyelye e li ngaashi Job, ou ta nu okusheka Kalunga ngaashi omeva?
Ou te litula mongudu yovalongi vowii ndele ha ende pamwe novalumenhu vehe na Kalunga.
Osheshi ye a tile: Omulumenhu ke nekwafo nande na wapalele Kalunga.
“Onghee hano ovalumenhu ovanaendunge, pwilikinei nge: Kalunga oku li kokule nouhenakalunga, nOmunaenghono adishe oku li kokule nowii!
Ndelenee unene ta handukilile omulumenhu pashilonga shaye, ndele Ye ta futile omulumenhu pakweenda kwaye.
Heeno shili, Kalunga ita longo osho inashi yuka nOmunaenghono adishe ita endameke ouyuki.
Olyelye e mu tula po a pangele edu, nolyelye a tula ekanghameno lounyuni?
Ye ngeenge te lidiladila muye mwene ngeno, ndele ta alula omhepo yange nomufudo waye tau shuna kuye,
opo nee aishe i nomwenyo kumwe tai xulu po, nomunhu ta shuna mondwi.
“Hano ngeenge u neendunge, uda eshi. Pwilikina ondaka yeendjovo dange.
Ou ta tondo ouyuki, ota dulu tuu okupangela? Ile ove wa hala okupa omuyuki nomunaenghono oushima?
Olyelye ngeno ta lombwele ohamba: ‘Ove ku shi omunhu!’ Nokulombwela elenga: ‘Ove omukolokoshi!’
Oye iha popile ovakulunhu voshilongo ndele ita tula omukengeli komesho yomukwanaluhepo, osheshi vo aveshe oshilonga shomake aye.
Ohava fi mepakumo leisho pokati koufiku. Oiwana tai tengauka ndele tai nyonwa po, omunaenghono ta kandulwa po, ina kumwa keke lomunhu.
Osheshi omesho aye taa pashukile eendjila domunhu, ndele ta tale eenghatu daye adishe.
Kaku noshiwiwili ile omulaulu fokofoko omu ovalongi vowii hava dulu okuhondama.
Osheshi Ye ita pumbwa okukonakona omunhu efimbo lile, fimbo omunhu e nokuholoka a tokolwe koshipala shaye.
Ye ota teyaula po ovanaenghono ite va konakona, ndele ta tula po vamwe ponhele yavo.
Osho ngaha hano Ye a shiiva oilonga yavo, ndele te va hanauna po oufiku, ndele tava teyauka.
Ye ote va handukile ngaashi ovakolokoshi moipafi yaaveshe tave shi mono,
shaashi vo ove mu liteeka, ndele inava diinina nande imwe yomeendjila daye,
ndelenee va kuwifa eehepele onghuwo koshipala shaye, ndele Ye a uda onghuwo yovakwanaluhepo.
Ndele Ye ngeenge ta mwena, olyelye ta dulu oku mu tokola? Ndele ngeenge ta holeke oshipala shaye, olyelye ta dulu oku mu tala? Ye ota pashukile oshiwana ngaashi omunhu keshe,
opo ovanhu ovakolokoshi vaha mone omhito okupangela, vaha ningile ovanhu eemwiyo.
“Osheshi Kalunga ota lombwelwa ngeno: ‘Ame ohandi humbata ehandukilo, inandi hala vali okunyona.
Osho ndihe shi wete, shi longe nge. Ngeenge nda nyona, itandi shi ningi vali.’
Ove ho diladila ngeno Ye e noku mu handukila, oove ou ho dini etokolo laye? Heeno, ove u nokuhoolola, haame. Popya osho u shi shii!
Ovalumenhu ve neendunge tava lombwele nge, omulumenhu omunongo ou ta pwilikine nge, ta ti:
‘Job ta popi ehe nomayele, neendjovo daye dihe nounongo.’
Akutu Job na yelekwe fiyo okexulilo omolwomanyamukulo oo aye opaulunde.
Osheshi ye ta wedele ko etauluko ketimba laye. Mokati ketu ye ta popi shihapu e nondubo naKalunga.”
35: Elihu okwa popya vali ndele ta ti:
“Oto shi tale osho sha yuka ndele to shi luku, ouyuki woye koshipala shaKalunga,
eshi ho pula: ‘Tashi kwafa nge shike? Otashi kwafa nge tuu, shi dule ngeno eshi handi nyono?’
Ame ohandi ku pe enyamukulo, ndele handi nyamukula yo ookaume koye pamwe naave.
Tala keulu u tale, tala oilemo tai kala kombada yoye penya.
Ngeenge to nyono, oto dulu oku mu ningila shike? Ndele ngeenge omatauluko oye e li mahapu, oto mu ti ngahelipi?
Oove ngeenge omuyuki oto mu pe shike? Ile ta dulu okutambula shike meke loye?
Ouhenakalunga woye tau kumu ashike omunhu ngaashi ove, nouyuki woye omona womunhu.
“Ohava kemene ounene wefininiko; vo ohava kuu onghuwo omolwokwooko kwovanaenghono.
Ndelenee nande umwe ta ti: ‘Kalunga, Omushiti wange, oku li peni, ou ha yandje omahambeleloimbilo oufiku?
Ou te tu longo eendunge di dule odo doifitukuti yokombada yedu ndele te tu nongeke ounongo u dule eedila dokeulu?’
Opo nee otava ingida, ndelenee Ye ita nyamukula omolwelinenepeko lovanawii.
Oshili, Kalunga ita pwilikine omakemo ongaho, nOmunaenghono adishe ite a yavala,
“Unene ngeenge to ti kutya ove ku mu wete ko. Etokolo leendjovo oli li koshipala shaye, hano mu teelela.
Ndelenee paife, ehandu laye ite li longifa ndele ita yavala yo elinenepeko,
opo nee Job ta makula okanya kaye okupopya kwongaho, ndele ta popi eendjovo dinene moushima.”
36: Ndele Elihu okwa twikila ndele ta ti:
“Lididimikile nge manga, opo handi ku pe eendunge, osheshi natango tuu ondi na sha ndi shi popye molwaKalunga.
Eshiivo lange handi ke li tala kokule ndele handi ka pa Omushiti wange ounongo.
Osheshi oshili, eendjovo dange dihe fi oipupulu; koshipala shoye oku na omulumenhu e neshiivo la wanenena.
“Tala, Kalunga Oye omunaenghono, ndelenee ita dini nande umwe. Eenghono deendunge daye odinene.
Ye ita xupifa omwenyo womuhenakalunga ndelenee ta pe ovakwanaluhepo ounongo.
Omesho aye ite a kufa movayuki, ndelenee te va kaleke omutumba pamwe neehamba kolukalwapangelo fiyo alushe. Vo ohava nenepekwa.
Ndelenee vo ngeenge tava tulwa momalyenge, ndele tava mangwa noimangifo yoluhepo,
opo nee Ye ote va shiivifile oilonga yavo nomatauluko avo molwelinenepeko lavo.
Nomatwi avo te va fitululile omakumaido ndele te va lombwele nokutya, ve nokwaaluka mo moukolokoshi.
Ngeenge hava pwilikine ndele tave lininipike, vo otava ka kala omafiku avo melao nomido davo mehepuluko.
Ndelenee vo ngeenge itava pwilikine, tava ka wila komaonga efyo moulai wavo ndele tava fuda mo omufudo vehe neshiivo.
Ndelenee ovahenakalunga tave lidike ehandu, vo itava kuu onghuwo, Ye eshi e va kwata.
Eemwenyo davo tadi fi mounyasha, nokukalamwenyo kwavo taku xulu mohoni.
Ye ota xupifa omukwanaluhepo noluhepo laye ndele ta fitulula okutwi kwaye noudjuu.
“Heeno, naave yo, wa hekwa u dje mo moudjuu konhele ya mbwalangadja ihe nofina, nokounyenye woshililo shi yadi eendja domaadi.
Ndelenee ove wa hangika ketokolo lidjuu lovahenakalunga. Etokolo nehandukilo le ku kwata.
Ndelenee lungama oudjuu wouyehame uhe ku hongaule okusheka; ndele uha pukifwe kounene woikulila.
Onghuwo yoye otai dulu tuu okukwafa mefininiko, ile okulipamekela eenghono doye adishe?
“Ino lihalela oufiku wetokolo, ou tau kufa mo oiwana meenhele dayo.
Lungama, uha ame kowii, osheshi owo to u hoolola komesho yoluhepo.
Tala, Kalunga okwa fimana keenghono daye dihapu, omulongindunge olyelye ngaashi Ye?
Olyelye te mu lombwele ondjila yaye, nolyelye ta ti: ‘Ove wa nyona!’?
Naave yo dimbulukwa okuhambelela oilonga yaye, ovanhu ngaashi have i tange nokwiimba.
Ovanhu aveshe tave i tale nehafo nokukuminwa, noonaku ka fya tave i tale kokule.
Tala, Kalunga Oye omunene, hatu nyengwa oku mu shiiva.
Ye ota ongele omata omeva ndele moshihemime shao odula tai diya mo,
oilemo ndele tai i tilile kombada yovanhu vahapu.
Heeno, olyelye a shiiva etandavelo loilemo, olyelye endundumo lometwali laye?
Tala, Ye ota yale kombada yayo omaluvadi aye ndele ta tuvike oule wokoshi yefuta,
osho ngaha ota tokola oiwana, ta yandje eendja dihapu unene.
Ye ota tuvike omake aye aeshe avali nomaluvadi ndele te a tumine ovahomoni.
Endundumo laye tali mu holola heeno, noimuna yo euyo laye.
37: “Heeno, omolwaashi omutima wange tau kakama ndele tau nhuka mo monhele yao.
Pwilikina, pwilikina endundumo londaka yaye noshihomo tashi di mokanya kaye.
Ye ote shi tondokifile koshi yeulu alishe, oluvadi laye fiyo okominghulo dedu.
Konima yaye taku ulu ondaka yaye; Ye ta ndundumifa ondaka yaye i yadi epangelonghono ndele ita kelele omaluvadi, ondaka yaye eshi tai udika.
Kalunga ta ndundumifa ondaka yaye, tai nyenge eendunge. Ye ota longo oinima inene tai nyenge okukonekwa kufye.
Osheshi Ye ta lombwele eandu: ‘Kolokela poshi!’ Nosho yo oshikungulu shodula, heeno, oikungulu yaye yodula: ‘Kala u neenghono!’
Ye ota mwenyeke omakondjo akeshe omunhu, opo ovanhu aveshe va shiive oilonga yaye.
Oilyani tai shiti mo momahondameno ndele tai kala momakololo ayo.
Omhepo inene tai di melimba laye, noutalala tau di koumbangalanhu!
Oikangwa yomeva tai hekelifwa komufudo wokanya kaKalunga noumbwalangadja womeva wa kwatakanwa taa kamenwa kumwe.
Heeno, oilemo te i djuupaleke nouyadi womeva ndee te i lihanifa kokule kombinga, oshilemo shaye otashi eta omaluvadi.
Odo tadi umbu akushe keembinga adishe okelombwelo laye; onghee hano tadi wanifa ashishe osho Ye te shi di lombwele kombada yedu alishe.
Ye ote di tumu ko ngeenge okuhandukila edu ile oku li kwafa, ile oku li nangeka noupuna.
“Edi di pwilikina Job! Kala ofika wa mwena, u dimbulukwe oikumwifa yaKalunga.
U shi shii tuu Kalunga nhumbi te i pangele nonhumbi te i yelififa omaluvadi?
Oilemo, ove u i shii tuu okulinyenganyenga kwayo, oikumwifa yaau, Omushiivi waaishe?
Oove, oikutu yoye tai pupyaleke, edu ngeenge la mwena molwomhepo yokoumbuwanhu?
Owa shiiva tuu okuyala pamwe naye eulu la pama ngaashi okatengelelo koshivela sha telekwa?
Tu pa eendunge, tu shiive osho tu noku mu lombwela. Molwomulaulu hatu nyengwa okweeta po sha.
Tu noku mu shiivifila mbela nokutya ame nda hala oku mu popifa? Ile olyelye a tile a hala a nyonwe po?
“Ndele paife, omunhu ita dulu okutala ouyelele wetango, osheshi tali vema, la yelelela, omhepo eshi ya pepa okuyelifa eulu.
Evadimo loshingoldo tali di koumbangalanhu; kombada yaKalunga oku nepangelonghono tali tilika.
Omunaenghono adishe itatu dulu oku mu hanga, Oye omunene weenghono, ndelenee ita endameke osho sha yuka nouyadi wouyuki.
Onghee hano ovanhu nave mu tile, noonakulindungika, Ye ite va tale.”
38: Opo nee Omwene a nyamukula Job mokafudaela ndele ta ti:
“Olyelye ou ta laulike omhangela yange neendjovo dihe neshiivo?
Fikama, u lilongekide ngaashi omulumenhu, opo nee handi ku pula, u longe nge hano.
Ove wa li peni, eshi nda shita edu? Lombwele nge, ngeenge u neshiivo.
Olyelye a yeleka oiyelekifo yalo, ove u i shii mbela, ile olyelye a shila oshiyelekifongodi kombada yalo?
Omamanya ekanghameno lalo a dikilwa kushike? Ile olyelye a dika emanya lokolonela yalo?
Eenyofi dongula eshi da hafa mumwe novana aveshe ovamati vaKalunga va nyakukwa?
Efuta, olyelye e li idila po nomivelo, lo eshi la fuluka mo la dja moshidalelo?
Ame eshi nde li pa oilemo oshikutu shalo, nomulaulu eteta lalo,
Ame eshi nde li tulila po ongaba yange ndele nda ninga oiidilifo nomivelo dalo,
ndele nda tile: ‘Fiyo apa to uya, ndelenee hakukoya po opo. Ndele apa pa tulilwa ouladi womakufikufi oye ongaba?’
“Fimbo wa kala nomwenyo, wa lombwela ngeno ongula, i she, neluwa we li ulikila onhele yalo,
lo li kwate ominghulo dedu ndele li tukumune mo mulo ovahenakalunga?
Opo nee tali shituka ngaashi elova koshi yoshihakifo, naashishe tashi holoka ngaashi oshikutu.
Ovahenakalunga tava kufwa ouyelele wavo, nokwooko kwa yeluka taku teyaulwa.
Ove wa ile ko tuu keefifiya defuta? Ndele wa endaenda tuu moule woposhi meni lefuta poukukutu?
Omivelo defyo de ku hololelwa, wa mona tuu mbela oivelo yomilaulu?
Oumbwalangadja wedu u u shii tuu? Aishe ei, i holola hano, ngeenge u i shii.
Ondjila yokuya konhele youyelele oilipipo? Onhele apa omulaulu tau kala, oi li peni?
Opo u u twale monhele yao ndele u shiive omalila ao taa twala ketwali lao?
Ndishi ove u i shii, osheshi wa li wa dalwa hamba shito nale, nomuvalu womafiku oye omahapu unene mbela!
“Wa ile ko komalimba eandu? Ndele wa mona ko tuu omalimba eemhawe?
Odo nde di tuvikilila efimbo loudjuu, efiku lolwoodi noloita?
Ouyelele otau tukaulwa nondjila oilipipo omhepo youshilo otai liundwile medu alishe?
“Olyelye a panunina odula omatondokelo nelila lokutondokela mo oluvadi,
opo oshilongo shihe novanhu, shi lokwe, nombuwa omo itamu kala omunhu,
opo ombuwa ya tokekwa i kutifwe nedu li menife omwiidi muwa?
Odula oi na tuu xe, ile olyelye a dala omata omume?
Oikangwa yomeva ya dile moshidalelo shalyelye? Nolyelye a dala eandu leulu?
Omeva taa ningi makukutu ngaashi emanya, ombada youle womeva tai li tuvike.
“Ove to dulu tuu okuditika omamangifo oshofi? Ile okumangulula eengodi dOkalimbanombwa?
Ove to dulu tuu okupitifa mo eenyofi pefimbo lado, ile to dulu tuu okulinyengifa Omunghalavili nOshofi?
Wa shiiva tuu eemhango deulu? Ile ove to di lombwele nhumbi tadi pangele edu?
“Oto dulu tuu okuudifa ondaka yoye fiyo okoilemo, opo efundja lomeva li ku tuvike?
To dulu tuu okutuma omaluvadi a pite mo ndele tae ku lombwele: Ofye ava!
Olyelye a tula ounongo moilemo? Ile olyelye a pa oilemo eendunge?
Olyelye omunandunge a shiive okuvala omuvalu woilemo? Neeshako deulu olyelye te di fidimike
edu eshi la kukuta la ninga likukutu ngaashi la yofwa nomakuma taa damafana?
“To dulu tuu okukongela onghoshi onghadi oikulya, ile okukutifa ondjala yonghoshi yonyasha
do eshi tadi hondama momakololo ndele tadi nangala momudile tadi nangele?
Olyelye ta longekidile ekola eendja dalo, oludalo lalo eshi tali kuwile Kalunga ndele tali tukatuka lihe neendja?
39: “Efiku oupundja tava dala u li shii, ho nangele okufetwa kwoholongo?
To vale tuu eehani dado doufimba, nefiku tadi dala u li shii?
Odo tadi litonyene poshi ndele tadi pitifa mo oludalo, nokufetwa kwado kwa xula po.
Oludalo lado tali pame ndele tali kulile momufitu, tali i nokwiililila ndele itali aluka vali.
“Okafino komofuka, olyelye e ka pitifa mokalilifa? Olyelye a mangulula oimangifo yongolo?
Oyo nde i pa ombuwa onhele yokukala mo nekango lomongwa i kale mulo.
Yo otai yolo epulukuto loshilando; eingido lomushingi itai li udu.
Ominghulo deemhunda da li oulifilo wayo, ndele tai kongo keshe eshi sha hapa.
“Omhuulu tai ka dulika tuu kwoove i ku longele? Ile tai ka nangala tuu oufiku petemba loye lokulila?
Omhuulu, to dulu tuu oku i manga noku i fininika noshitomo i ende momufinda woshipululo? Ile tai ku shikula mefilu loku li helela?
To dulu tuu oku i lineekela molweenghono dayo dinene? To dulu tuu oku i fiila eliko lepya loye?
To i lineekele tuu nokutya, tai aluka ndele tai ongele oilya yoye moshipale shoye?
“Evava lomho ohali papama nokudana, ndelenee ohole yexuwashi otai kala mo tuu momavava nomomalwenya ayo?
Osheshi omai ayo tai a fii po medu ndele hai a tendulifa oupyu womedu.
Itai diladila nokutya, omhadi tai dulu oku a lyataula noifitukuti tai dulu oku a tataula.
Oyo hai hepeke oludalo layo, la fa lo kali fi layo. Ihai lipula sha, oshilonga shayo ngeenge ye shi longa epwanga.
Osheshi Kalunga okwe i lumbula ounongo ndele ine i pa oshitukulwa sheendunge.
Yo eshi tai tondoka nokweendelela otai yolo onghambe nomulondi wayo.
“Ove mbela to pe onghambe eenghono, ove mbela to djaleke ofingo yayo omulenge?
Ove mbela to i nhukifa ngaashi oshipaxu? Okulipemba kwayo kwa tilika.
Tai fundu mefilu ndele tai nyakukilwa eenghono dayo.
Tai yolo oumbada ndele itai haluka, itai i onhapo eongamukonda.
Kombada yayo onywa tai xwalakata neonga neongamukonda tali taima.
Nokukolokota nokupulukuta ya mana mo ndele itai ka kotolwa enghuma ngeenge tali shikwa.
Keshiko keshe lenghuma yo tai ti: Hiah! Ndele kokule nokuli tai fimbula olwoodi, nondaka inene yovakulunhu vovakwaita neingido loita!
“Molweendunge doye mbela ekodi tali liyelula pombada pee ndele tali ingaana langhele yokoumbuwanhu?
Ile okelombwelo loye onhwa tai ingaana pombada ndele tai tungu oshihadi shayo pombada?
Yo otai kala keemhunda oko tai nangala, okoxulo yemanya, mohotemhunda.
Oko tai kala nokunangela eendja dayo, omesho ayo taa tale kokule.
Ovana vayo tava xupaele ohonde, ndele apa pe novadipawa, oyo oi li ko yo.”
40: NOmwene okwa nyamukula Job ndele ta ti:
“Nakupewa oushima a hala okutwifa Omunaenghono adishe eemhata? Omuhokololifi waKalunga ne shi nyamukule.”
Opo nee Job a nyamukula Kalunga ndele ta ti:
“Tala, aame ongahoelela, ndi ku nyamukule shike? Eke lange handi li tula pomilungu dange.
Nda popya lumwe, itandi tongo sha vali. Nda popya luvali, ndelenee ihandi shi ningi vali.”
NOmwene okwa nyamukula Job mokafudaela ndele ta ti:
“Fikama u lilongekide ngaashi omulumenhu. Ame ohandi ku pula u longe nge.
Ouyuki wange wa hala tuu mbela oku u hanauna po, nokuvela nge ombedi, opo ove u kale omuyuki?
Ile u nokwooko ngaashi okwooko kwaKalunga? Ndele to dulu tuu okundunduma nondaka yoye ngaashi Ye?
Lidika hano efimano nounene, liwapeka nepangelonghono noshinge.
Ehandu loye li tondokifa ngaashi omakungulukilo omeva.
Tala, ovaninipiki u va wilife poshi, ovahenakalunga va teyaula monhele tuu oyo ve li mo.
Vo aveshe va paka mumwe mondwi. Oipala yavo i kwatelela mehondameno.
Opo nee naame yo ohandi ku hambelele, shaashi eke loye lokolulyo tali ku etele efindano.
“Tala, oko oku na ongolo. Ame nde i ninga pamwe naave? Otai li omwiidi ngaashi ongobe.
Tala, eenghono dayo di li meenho, noupamene wayo meefipa dolutu layo.
Yo otai tanganeke omushila wayo wa fomuti omusederi, eefipa doilama yayo da pandwa mumwe ngaashi omapando;
Omakipa ayo e li ngaashi ominino doshikushu, nomwoongo wayo ngaashi oiti yoshivela.
“Oyo yotete yomoilonga yaKalunga. Ou e i ninga, e i pa eongamukonda layo.
Osheshi eemhunda tadi i etele eendja, fimbo oifitukuti aishe tai danene ko.
Otai nangala momudile womiti dalotus, omehondameno lomanenge nolomeva.
Omiti dalotus tadi i tuvike nomudile wado, omihamba dopokamulonga tadi i dingilile.
Nomulonga ngeenge tau liyelulifa, yo itai u tila. Yo i udite etulumuko nande Jordan woovene i fike fiyo okomilungu dayo.
Olyelye te i kwata fimbo tai mu tale, olyelye ta tyuulifa ekupa eyulu layo?
41: “Oto dulu tuu okuyula ongadu Leviatan nondjolo? Nelaka layo to dulu tuu okumangifa ngeno ongodi?
To dulu oku i xwekela mo meyulu layo ongodi ya taafinwa? Nolupanda layo oto li tyuulifa oshitenda sheengona?
Otai ku ilikana tuu, i neendjovo dihapu, ile tai ku popifa neendjovo dombili?
Yo otai ningi tuu ehangano naave, nokutya ove u i kufe i kale omupika woye?
Oto dulu tuu okudanauka nayo ngaashi to danauka nokadila, ile oku i manga, ovamwoye oukadona ve i kwate?
Oonakuhangenafana veeshi otave i landifa tuu, ndele tave i tukululile ovashingifi?
Oshipa shayo, oto dulu tuu oku shi twa eengona nomutwe wayo u u twe nekupa?
Tula nee eke loye kuyo. Diladila olwoodi. Ito ke shi ninga vali.
“Tala, eteelelo keshe tali ningi longaho muyo, nokuli moku i tala omunhu ta wile poshi.
Kaku nomuladi te i shindi. Olyelye ou hano ta dulu okukala koshipala shange?
Olyelye a pa nge sha tete ndi mu futile ngeno? Aishe oyo i li koshi yeulu alishe oyange.
“Ame inandi hala okumwenenena oinhimbu yayo ile eenghono dayo ile okushitwa kwayo kwa wapala.
Oshikutu shayo shokombada olyelye te shi i alulile? Olyelye ta dulu okuya momayoo ayo omikweyo mbali?
Olyelye a yeulula oivelo yomoshipala shayo? Ehaluko la dingilila omayoo ayo.
Ombuda yayo oipakotolwa i nomifinda, ya kwatakanifwa mo oshihoteka sha pama.
Oipakotolwa i li naanaa kumwe, omhepo itai dulu okupitila mo nande.
Oshikwao sha kwatifwa nashikwao, ya pama. Ya kwatafana, kai na apa tai kwatukunuka.
Okutwonghisha kwayo taku vemifa ouyelele, nomesho ayo e li ngaashi eefeleisho deluwa.
Mokanya kayo tamu di omalaka omundilo, tamu tuka mo eehandje.
Momayulu ayo tamu di omwifi, ngaashi mombiya tai fuluka ya ehelifwa oihati.
Omufudo wayo tau xwameke omakala, nelaka lomundilo tau di mokanya kayo.
Mofingo yayo omu neenghono, ehalukotilifo tali nhuka komesho yayo.
Eenhumba domolutu layo da pamenena shili, da fa da telekwa monhelekelo, itadi linyenge nande.
Omutima wayo wa kukuta ngaashi emanya, heeno, ngaashi emanya lokoshi yoshini.
Yo ngeenge tai litumbu po, ovaladi tava kakama, noumbada tau va dundakanifa.
Ngeenge tai kondjifwa neongamukonda, lihe noshilonga, nosho yo eonga, ile oshihengo,
oshivela tai shi tale oihati, oshikushu ngaashi oiti ya ola.
Oshikuti itashi i twala onhapo. Omakupulomanya e li ngaashi olungu kuyo.
Eedibo te di tale ngaashi oshihati, ndele tai yolo edungadungo lomaonga.
Ombinga yayo yokoshi oipakotolwa i nomayoo, monhata otai liendifile mo nokufiya mo omufinda ngaashi woshilei shokuxwa.
Oule womeva tai u fulukifa ngaashi ombiya. Etale tai li ningi ngaashi ombiya muyo omuvavo tau telekwa.
Ondjila yayo tai yela konima yayo, oule womeva u nomakufikufi a feenghwakutoka.
Kombada yedu pehe na nande sha she i fa, sha shitwa shihe noumbada.
Otai dini oinima aishe ya fimana. Oyo ohamba yoifitukuti aishe i nounhwa.”
42: Opo nee Job a nyamukula Omwene ndele ta ti:
“Ame ndi ku shii nokutya, keshe eshi to shi dulu ndele iho nyengwa okuwanifa omhangela yoye keshe.
Olyelye ta holeke omadiladilo ange, ke nounongo? Osho ngaha hano nda popya ndihe neendunge; nda popya oinima tai nyenge nge eendunge, ndihe i shii.
Pwilikina tuu hano, nda hala okupopya. Ame ohandi ku pula, ove u longe nge!
Nde ku udile ashike omatwi, ndelenee paife omesho ange nde ku mona ko.
Onghee hano handi alula eendjovo dange ndele handi lidilulula mondwi nomomute.”

Ndelenee Omwene eshi a lombwela Job eendjovo tuu odo, Omwene ta ti kuElifas, Omuteman: “Ehandu lange le ku xwamena nookaume koye vavali yo. Shaashi nye inamu popya nge eendjovo da yuka ngaashi omupiya wange Job.

Kufeni hano paife eengobe heyali deemhedi needi heyali deemhedi, mu ka ye komupiya wange Job nye mu twale exwikiloyambo leni, omupiya wange Job ne mu ilikanene. Osheshi molwaye aeke, opo ndi ninge osho e shi hokwa, itandi mu handukile noku mu fifa ohoni, osheshi nye inamu popya nge eendjovo da yuka ngaashi omupiya wange Job.”
Opo nee Elifas, Omuteman, naBildad, Omusuhi, naSofar, Omunaamati, va ya ndele osho va ninga ngaashi Omwene e va lombwela. NOmwene okwa fila Job onghenda.
NOmwene okwa alulula oluhepo laJob, ye eshi a ilikanena ookaume kaye, nOmwene okwa alulila Job aishe, kwa li e i na noku i hapupalifa luvali i dule inya yotete.

Ovamwaina aveshe ovalumenhu novakainhu novashiivikile vaye aveshe ve uya kuye ndele va kala poshililo pamwe naye meumbo laye, ndele ve mu pendula noku mu hekeleka molwomupya waye aushe, Omwene e mu tuminine. Ndele keshe umwe womuvo okwe mu pa ombongo imwe nongodo yoshingoldo.

NOmwene okwa nangeka noupuna okukalamwenyo kwaxuuninwa kwaJob noupuna uhapu u dule winya wopehovelo. Ndele ye okwa li e needi omayovi omulongo naane, eengamelo omayovi ahamano, eengobe deendjoko omayovi avali neendongi eenghadi eyovi limwe.
Nokwa li e novana ovamati vaheyali noukadona vatatu.
Nokwa luka okakadona kotete Jemima nomutivali Kessia nomutitatu Kerenhappuk.
Ndele moshilongo ashishe inamu monika ovakainhu vawa va wapala ngaashi ovana oukadona vaJob. Naxe yavo e va pa oshitukulwafyuululwa pamwe novamwaina ovalumenhu.
Ndele Job okwa kala e nomwenyo natango omido efele nomilongo nhee nokwa mona ovana novatekulu vomapupi ane.
Opo nee Job a fya a kulupa nokukuta okukalamwenyo.

1:
Omulumenhu omunelao ou, iha ende
pamhangela yovahenakalunga,
ndele iha lyata mondjila yovalunde,
ndele iha kala omutumba mongudu yovasheki;

ndelenee ha hokwa omhango yOmwene
noku i diladila omutenya noufiku.

Ndele ye ota ka kala ngaashi omuti,
ou wa twikwa pomatondokelo omeva
ndele tau imifa oiimati yao pefimbo lao,
nomafo ao ihaa lembe.
Naashishe eshi ta ningi, osha fewa.

Ava vehe na Kalunga hasho ve li ngaho,
ndelenee vo va fa oshipepwalungu, tashi i omhepo.

Onghee ovahenakalunga metokolo itava ka kanghama mo,
novalunde itava kala mo meongalo lovayuki.

Osheshi ondjila yovayuki Omwene oku i shii;
ndelenee ondjila yovahenakalunga otai hanauka.
2:
Ovapaani otava lundalalele shike,
noiwana tai diladilile shike oinima yongaho?

Eehamba dedu tadi fikama,
ovapangeli otava kundafana pamwe
notava tu ondubo nOmwene nomuvaekwa waye.

Tava ti: “Tu tokauleni omapando avo,
fye tu liduleni omiya davo!”

Ou Omukali womeulu ote shi va yolele,
Omwene ote shi va ningile oshiyeele.

Ndele opo nee ote ke va hanyena mehandu,
nomokukeshuka kwaye ote ke va tilifa, ta ti:

“Aame tuu ou nda nangeka ohamba yange muSion
komhunda yange iyapuki.”

Onda hala okushiivifa omhangela yOmwene.
Oye a tya kwaame: “Oove Omona wange,
onena tuu eli nde ku dala.

Ehela kwaame, ndele handi ku pe ovapaani
va ninge efyuululo loye,
nominghulo dedu odoye.

Ove u noku va nyanyaula nodibo yoshivela,
ndele to va tataula ngaashi oshiyuma.”

Hano eehamba nye, paife pukulukeni,
ovatokoli nye vokombada yedu, lungameni.

Kaleleni Omwene netilo,
nyakukweni nokukakama.

Xupiteni Omona komilungu,
opo ehe mu handukile
ndele tamu nyonauka mondjila yeni;
osheshi ehandu laye kali kwete kufuluka.
Ovanelao ovava aveshe have mu lineekele.
3:
Omwene, ongahelipi ovatondi vange va hapupala!
Vahapu va fikamena nge!

Vahapu otava popi nge tava ti:
“Ke na ekwafo puKalunga!” Sela

Ndelenee Omwene, Oove oshikelelifo shange
netumbalo lange,
Ove noto yelula omutwe wange.

Onda lalekida Omwene mokule,
Ye nokwa uda eingido lange
komhunda yaye iyapuki. Sela

Ame ihandi tila ovanhu omayovi omulongo
tava dingilile nge keembinga adishe.

Exupifo oli li mOmwene.
Enangeko noupuna loye
nali kale kombada yoshiwana shoye. Sela
4:
Ngeenge handi lalekida, ude nge, alikana,
Kalunga kouyuki wange!
Mofina yange owa ningila nge mo omhito ya mbwalangadja;
file nge onghenda, Ove, uda eindilo lange.

Ovalumenhu nye, fiyo onaini tamu ka shekifa efimano lange?
Fiyo onaini mu hole oinima yongaho
nokukonga oipupulu? Sela

Shi shiiveni nokutya, Omwene okwe lihoololela omuyuki,
Omwene ota udu nge, ngeenge handi mu ifana.

Yandjeni omayambo ouyuki,
ndelenee lineekeleni Omwene!

Vahapu otava ti:
“Olyelye te tu monifa ouwa?
Omwene, tu yelulila ouyelele woshipala shoye!”

Ove wa pa nge ehafo momutima wange,
eli li dule lavo,
eshi ve noshishipo shoilya nomaviinyu.

Onda hala okunangala nombili nohandi kofa nawa,
osheshi Oove, Omwene,
to tula nge nawa, ndihe nombudi.
5:
Omwene, endekela okutwi kwoye keendjovo dange.
Koneka okuhefa kwange.

Akutu, Ohamba yange naKalunga kange,
uda elilo lange lopombada,
osheshi kwoove oko handi eta eindilo lange.

Osheshi Ove ku fi Kalunga ha hokwa oulunde.
Omunawii ke nokukala pwoove.

Ovalitumbaleki itava ka dula komesho yoye;
ovanyoni aveshe oho va tondo.

Ndelenee ame molwefilonghenda loye
onda pewa omhito yokuuya meumbo loye,
ndi liwitike poshi,
nda taalela kotembeli yoye iyapuki moku ku tila.

Kalunga, va tokolela owii.
Eemhangela davo nadi va pilukile.
Va undula po
molwouhapu womanyonauno avo;
osheshi vo ove ku lundalalela.

Opo nee aveshe ava ve ku lineekela,
nave ku hafele; alushe nava kuwilile,
molwaashi to va amene,
notave ku tanhele ava ve hole edina loye.

Osheshi omuyuki
Ove to mu nangeke noupuna, Omwene,
to mu dingilile nohokwe yoye
ngaashi oshikelelifo.
6:
Omwene, ino hanyena nge wa handuka,
Ove uha denge nge wa keshuka!

Omwene, file nge onghenda, osheshi onda ngona;
pameke nge, osheshi omakipa ange a halukifwa,

nomwenyo wange wa tililila,
Woo! Omwene, fiyo onaini hano?

Omwene, aluka, u mangulule omwenyo wange!
Xupife nge molwefilonghenda loye!

Osheshi mokufya ito dimbulukiwa vali komunhu.
Moshovafi omu na tuu ou, te ku imbile ehambelelo?

Omesho ange okwa twiyala koluhodi
nokwa kulupifwa molwovayelani vange aveshe.

Omwene okwa uda eindilo lange,
neilikano lange Omwene ohe li tambula.
7:
opo ye aha nyanyaule nge,
ngaashi onghoshi tai tukaula eenhumba dange,
ngeenge kape nomuxupifi.

Omwene, Kalunga kange,
ngeno kwa li nde va ninga nai,
ngaashi tava ti, ngeno omake ange a nyata kowii,

nonda shinda ou e nombili naame,
osho ondi shi shii hasho nda ninga:
nda xupifile nokuli naava va taataelele nge oinima yongaho,

heeno, ngeno okwa li hasho,
ngeno omuyelani wange na taatae nge, a kwate nge
ndele ta lyataulile omwenyo wange poshi,
nefimano lange nali xutulilwe mondwi yedu! Sela

Omwene, va tukulukila nehandu loye!
Ove yambukila onya yovafininiki vange!
Penduka u xupife nge,
Oove ou wa pangela omatokolo.

Eemhunga adishe doiwana nadi ku kundukile,
ndele Ove to shuna shambadaulu kombada yado!

Omwene ota tokola oiwana.
Omwene, yukifile nge
pauyuki wange nopaukoshoki wange.

Xulifa oumbudi wovakolokoshi,
Ove pameka ofika yovayuki voye,
Oove omukonakoni womitima noweefiyo,
Kalunga omuyuki.

Oshikelelifo shange ondi shi kwetelwe kuKalunga,
ou omukwafi waava ve nomutima wa yuka.

Kalunga Oye omutokoli omuyuki,
Kalunga omuhandunhu efiku keshe.

Omunhu ngeenge ite lialuluka,
opo Kalunga ta upike omukonda waye.
Outa waye te u kufa ndele ta shoneke.

Ye ota longekida oilongifo yefyo;
oikuti yaye oyo oilwifo ya xwama.

Tala, omunawii oha fetwa kowii
ndele ye a ninga omufimba woixuna,
ndelenee ta dala oipupulu.

Ye okwa fa ekelo, e li fa lile,
mboli oye mwene ta wile mekelo laye.

Oiponga ei a duta, otai pinukile komutwe waye mwene,
noixuna yaye otai mu alukile poluwewe laye mwene.

Onda hala okupandulila Omwene ouyuki waye
nokwiimba edina lOmwene ou wOkombadambada.
8:
Omwene, Omwene wetu,
edina loye la tumbalekwa shi fike nee peni
kombada yedu alishe,
Ove ou oshingepangelo shoye
we shi tula kombada yomaulu.

Momakanya ounona noouhanana
owa dika mo eenghonopangelo
molwovatondi voye
opo u hanaune po omuyelani nomunanghono.

Ngeenge handi tale keulu, koshilongwa shominwe doye,
kohani nokeenyofi, edi wa shita,

omunhu omushike, eshi ho mu dimbulukwa,
nomona womunhu, eshi ho mu file oshisho?

Eshi we mu shita, oshitwe yaye kashekamukona
e fike pwoove, Kalunga,
nowe mu dika oshinge nefimano.

ngaashi eedi, neengobe adishe,
pamwe noifitukuti yomofuka,

needila dokoshi yeulu, neeshi domomeva,
naashishe eshi tashi ende, neendjila domefuta.

Omwene, omupangeli wetu,
edina loye la tumbalekwa shi fike peni
kombada yedu alishe!
9:
Onda hala okuhambelela Kalunga nomutima wange aushe,
nda hala okuhepaulula oikumwifalonga yoye aishe.

Nda hala okuhafela nokunyakukilwa mwoove,
nda hala okwiimbila etumbalo ledina loye,
Ove ou wOkombadambada.

Osheshi ovatondi vange
ova shunifwa lwanima,
va pundaulwa nova nyonaunwa po koshipala shoye.

Ove u li po wa yukifila nge, nowa popila nge,
u li kolukalwapangelo loye,
Oove omutokoli omuyuki.

Ove wa aneka ovapaani
nowa nyonauna po ovahenakalunga,
nomadina avo we a dima po alushe fiyo alushe.

Ndelenee Omwene ota pangele fiyo alushe;
Oye a dika olukalwapangelo laye a tokole.

Oye mwene ta ka tokola
omunghulo wedu mouyuki,
ota pangele oiwana pauyuki.

Osho hano Omwene Oye emanyahote kovafininikwa,
emanyahote mefimbo loudjuu.

Ava va shiiva edina loye,
otave ku lineekele, Omwene,
Ove ito efa ava tave ku kongo.

Imbileni Omwene, ou ta kala muSion,
udifileni mokati koiwana oinenelonga yaye.

Osheshi ou omunanghonehonde,
he va dimbulukwa,
nonghuwo yomapongo ihe i dimbwa.

Omwene, file nge onghenda,
tala oudjuu wange
nda hepekwa nao kovatondi vange,
Ou ho kufa nge moivelo yefyo,

oilonga yefimano loye alishe
opo ndi shiive oku i hepaulula,
ndi shiive okunyakukilwa exupifo loye
moivelo yokakadona kaSion.

Ovapaani ova wila mekelo, eli va fele
nomelulo lomwiyo eli va telele,
ove liyula voovene keemhadi davo.

Omwene okwe lishiivifa,
nehandutokolo laye okwe li mana,
omulunde e likwatifa
koilonga yomake aye mwene. Sela

Ovakolokoshi ve nokuwila moshovafi,
novapaani aveshe ava va dimbwa Kalunga.

Osheshi ohepele iha dimbuwa fiyo alushe,
neelaelo lomapongo ihali tutuka fiyo alushe.

Omwene, tukuluka!
Ino efa ovanhu va lundakane,
ovapaani nava tokolwe koshipala shoye.

Omwene, va halukifa;
novapaani nave lishiive ovo ovanhu. Sela
10:
Omwene, oshike u li kokule ngaho
ndele to hondama pomafimbo oudjuu?

Moumbudilinenepeko otava taataa epongo;
nave likwatife neemhangela davo vene edi va tota.

Omukehenakalunga mokufulalala kwaye
ita kongo Kalunga;
Omadiladilo aye aeshe osho:
“Kaku na Kalunga.”

ta hondjaunine, te livate po,
nomunamupya ota wile momakasha aye.

Te lipopile momutima waye nokutya:
“Kalunga ote shi dimbwa,
Oye okwe likwata komesho,
Ye ite shi mono nande.”

Omwene, yambuka!
Kalunga, yelula okwooko kwoye!
Ove ino dimbwa ovanamupya!

Omukehenakalunga, oshike ta dini Kalunga
ndele ta ti momutima waye:
“Ito shi yavala.”

Teyaula okwooko
kwomukolokoshi nomuhenakalunga,
u yukife owii waye, fiyo ito u mono vali.

Omwene, Ove ohamba fiyo alushe;
mouhamba woye ovapaani ova pwa mo.

opo u yandjele ouyuki keefiye nokeehepele,
paha kale vali omukwadu
ta eta po etilifohaluko.
11:
Osheshi tala, ovahenakalunga
tava lukile omauta,
va tula oshikuti mofipa,
va shiive okuumba ve li momulaulu,
va yashe ava ve nomutima wa yuka.

Eengudi domukangha
ngeenge tadi ngumaunwa po,
omuyuki ta dulu sha vali mbela?”

Omwene oku li motembeli yaye iyapuki,
