Omwene ou, e nolukalwapangelo laye li li meulu;
omesho aye taa tale,
neemhafu daye tadi konenene oludalo lovanhu.

Omwene ota konakona
ovayuki novahenakalunga,
naau e hole owii,
omwenyo waye otau mu tondo.

Ovahenakalunga ote ke va lokifila
omakala omundilo nosulfuri;
nomhepo ya hanya
otai ka ninga oshitukulwa sheholo lavo.
12:
Omwene, kwafa, osheshi ovayuki va xula po,
novadiinini va pwa mo movana vovanhu.

Otava popyafana oipupulu namukwao,
nomokupopya omilungu davo
odi nomufenhu,
nomitima davo di li pavali.

Omwene, ngeno na tete po omilungu adishe
di nomufenhu
nakeshe tuu elaka tali litangele ounangane,

Omwene Ye ta ti:
“Molwokufininikwa kwomapongo,
nomolwokunyemata kweehepele
nda hala okufikama paife,
exupifo ohandi li etele
ou te li djuulukwa nokuhefahekumuna.”

Eendjovo dOmwene odo eendjovo da yela,
da fa oshisiliveli tashi kungulukile poshi
shi yela tashi vilima,
sha yelifwa luheyali.

Omwene, Oove to ke va diinina,
oto ke va amena kepupi eli fiyo alushe,

nande ovalunde nava shishimane shi fike peni,
molwaashi oulunde
tau hovele okutana mokati kovanhu.
13:
Omwene, fiyo onaini
to kala wa dimbwa nge shili?
Fiyo onaini to holeke nge oshipala shoye?

Fiyo onaini ndi nokuhumbata oisho
momwenyo wange,
noluhodi momutima wange efiku nefiku?
Fiyo onaini omuyelani wange
ta ka shishimana e dule nge?

Omwene, Kalunga kange, tale nge, ude nge!
Pashukifa omesho ange,
ndiha ka nangale meemhofi defyo!

Omushindani wange aha shiive okutya:
“Ame onde mu finda”,
novatondi vange vaha kalukile nge,
ngeenge handi pundauka.

Ndelenee ame handi lineekele efilonghenda loye:
omutima wange nau ka nyakukilwe ekwafo loye.

Ame ohandi imbile Omwene,
osheshi Ye a ningila nge ouwa.
14:
Elai otali ti momutima walo:
“Kape na Kalunga;”
oilonga yalo oififahoni, ya nyonauka:
kape na nande umwe auke,
ou ta longo ouwa.

Omwene meulu ota vandamene poshi,
ta tale ovana vovanhu,
a mone ngeenge ope na tuu
ou omunandunge, ou ta kongo Kalunga.

Ovahenouyuki ava aveshe
kave neendunge nande mboli,
ava hava li ovanhu vange
ngaashi hava li omungome?
Vo ihava ifana kOmwene.

Opo va kwatwa kehalukotilifo,
osheshi Kalunga a ama koludi lovayuki.

Onye omwa fifa ohoni
omhangela yomufininikwa,
ndelenee Omwene Oye eameno laye.

Akutu, exupifo laIsrael ngeno li holoke muSion!
Ngeenge Omwene ta alula oudjuu movanhu vaye,
opo Jakob ota hafe naIsrael ota nyakukwa.
15:
Omwene, olyelye ta itavelelwa
okukala monduda yoye?
Olyelye ta itavelelwa
okukala komhunda yoye iyapuki?

Oye tuu ou ha yukilile nota longo ouyuki,
ndele ta popi oshili momutima waye;

noita popyaana nelaka laye
noita ningile omukwao owii,
nomushiinda waye ite mu fifa ohoni.

Ye nota dini yo oonakudinwa,
nota fimaneke ava hava tila Kalunga;
nande a anene oshiponga shaye,
eano laye ite li lundulula,

noimaliwa yaye ite i yandjele
a shoshelwe ko moku i alulilwa,
ye ita tambula ombubo nokati okeenyala
okupa oushima ou ina ninga sha.
Ou ta yukilile nawa ngaha,
ye ita pundauka fiyo alushe.
16:
Kalunga, amene nge, osheshi kwoove
oko handi kongo ehondamo.

Onda tya kuKalunga: “Oove Omwene wange,
nghi na nande ouwa umwe, uhe fi Ove.”

Nokovayapuki vomoshilongo ohandi ti:
“Ovo tuu ovayapuki,
ohokwe yange aishe omuvo i li.”

Ava ve likongela kalunga e lili,
ove nomayehamo mahapu.
Oikunwayambo yavo yohonde
itandi ke i yandja;
nomadina avo itandi a pitifa nomilungu dange.

Omwene Oye oshitukulwa shefyuululo lange
noshoneka yange.
Ove ho diinine oshihoololifo shange.

Oshihoololifo sha hoololelwa nge
oshitukulwa medu liwa,
efyuululo lange ola wapalela nge.

Ohandi pandula, Omwene,
eshi wa pukulula nge;
moufiku omutima wange
tau shi dimbulukifa nge.

Onghee tuu omutima wange u nehafo,
nomwenyo wange tau nyakukwa,
nolutu lange tali tulumukwa mombili.

Osheshi omwenyo wange
Ove ito u efele moshovafi
nomuyapuki woye ito mu efa a mone eolelo.
17:
Omwene, uda ondjovo ya yuka!
Pwilikina okweehela kwange,
Ove u tambule eindilo lange,
inali dja komilungu di noipupulu!

Ove ho tale omutima wange,
moufiku to u shipaashipa,
Ove ho konakona nge,
ndele ito mono sha.
Keshe eshi handi diladila yo
itashi piti mokanya kange.

Keshe osho ovanhu tave shi longo,
ame handi kanyatele kondjovo yomilungu doye,
nohandi kukuma omalila ovahanauni.

Omanha ange onde a diinina
momufinda woye,
neenghatu dange inadi pumha mo nande.

Ohandi ifana kwoove,
osheshi Kalunga Ove to udu nge,
ehenifa okutwi kwoye kwaame,
u pwilikine ondaka yange.

Monifa onghenda yoye ikumwifa,
Oove omuxupifi waava tava kongo okuhondama
kolulyo loye molwovashindi vavo.

Diinine nge ngaashi omuni yeisho loye,
u holeke nge momudidimbe womavava oye,

molwovakolokoshi, hava nhukile nge,
nomolwovatondadi vange, hava dingilile nge.

Omitima davo dihe na eudito ve di idila po
nomakanya avo taa popi nelitumbaleko.

Mokweenda kwetu ve tu dingilila paife;
ohave tu tele opo ve tu shate poshi.

Ovo va fa onghoshi ya hala oshihondjauninwa,
ngaashi onghoshona tai hondjaunine mehondamo.

Omwene, fikama, u va lomhokele
ndele to va shate po!
Xupife nge kovahenakalunga
neongamukonda loye

neke loye kovanhu, heeno Omwene,
kovanhu vounyuni ou,
ve noshitukulwa shavo
shi li mokukalamwenyo omu,
omadimo avo ho a yadifa noipewa yoye,
ovana ovamati vavo tava kuta,
ndele tava fiile oludalo lavo oupuna wavo.

Ndelenee ame handi ka tala
oshipala shoye mouyuki;
ame ohandi ka mona ekuta
mokutala ondjelo yoye
ngeenge handi penduka.
18:
Omwene, ondi ku hole nohole yokomutima,
Oove eenghono dange.

Omwene Oye emanya lange la pama,
nohotengulu yange, nomuxupifi wange.
Kalunga kange
Oye omhunda yange yehondamo
oko handi tondokele,
Oye oshikelelifo shange,
noluvinga lexupifo lange,
nohote ya kolelela.

Eengodi defyo oda dingilila nge,
neemwiyo dehanauno oda halukifa nge.

Omapando omoshilongo shovafi a manga nge,
nomalulo efyo a wila nge.

Moudjuu wange nda ifana Omwene,
nda kuwila Kalunga kange onghuwo.
Ye okwa uda ondaka yange motembeli yaye,
nonghuwo yange ya fika momatwi aye.

Opo edu la hovela okukakama nokukakamenena,
nomafina eemhunda a nyenganyengifwa,
ndele tadi tengaukile keembinga neembinga;
osheshi Ye okwa li a uda onya.

Omwifi wa lundumuka meyulu laye,
nomundilo mokanya kaye,
nomutemo womakala wa ndwafuka muye.

Okwa endamekele eulu nokwa kolokela poshi,
nomulaulu woilemo wa li koshi yeemhadi daye.

Okwa enda kombada yomukerubi,
nokwa tukifwa nomavava omhepo;

Omulaulu okwe u ninga oshuuviko shaye,
omeva oilemo ilaula, e e lidingililifa.

Moshinge shokomesho yaye,
omo mwa li mwa undulwa eemhawe nomakala a hanya.

Opo Omwene okwa ndunduma meulu,
nondaka yaau wOkombadambada ya udika.

Nokwa umbile oikuti yaye, e va hanaune po,
ndele ta shelifa omaluvadi mahapu,
ndele te va halukifa.

Noukukutu woposhi womefuta wa monika,
omakanghameno ounyuni a holoka poluhaela
omolwomahanyeno Omwene,

Ye okwa li a lovelela nge neke laye,
e li pombada, a kwata nge,
ndele ta shili nge mo meyelu linene,

ndele okwa vakula nge
meke lomuyelani wange omunaenghono
nomovatondi vange,
ava va li ve dule nge eenghono unene.

Vo ova homona nge mefiku lomupya wange,
ndelenee Omwene okwa ninga
omuyambididi wange.

Okwa kufa nge pofina,
ndele ta twala nge poluhaela pa yela sheke,
okwa nakula nge mo,
molwaashi a hokwa nge.

Omwene okwa pa nge pauyuki wange
ndele ta punike nge paukoshoki womutima wange.

Osheshi eendjila dOmwene onde di diinina,
nokuKalunga kange inandi amuka po,
ndi ye mouhenakalunga.

Osheshi ame nda konenena oipango yOmwene;
noinandi twa omhata nomalombwelo aye.

onghee nee Omwene
a alulila nge pauyuki wange,
nopaukoshoki womutima wange.

Osheshi kwaau omunefilonghenda
oto limonifa oove mwene omunefilonghenda
nokomulumenhu omuyuki
oto kala yo omuyuki,

kovakoshoki oumukoshoki,
ndelenee kovanaihelele,
to limonifa mwene ove wa lunduluka.

Osheshi Oove ou to xupifa oshiwana she lininipika,
ndelenee kovalinenepeki oove omufifimani.

Heeno, ngeenge ndi li pamwe naave,
ohandi totele ongudu yoimhulu;
pamwe naKalunga kange
ohandi nhuka engholo.

Osheshi Kalunga kamwe
okelipipo mbela ponho yOmwene ou,
nemanya lexupifo olilipipo,
lihe fi Kalunga ketu aeke?

Kalunga ou ta dike nge eenghono,
ndele ta wapeke nokuwanifa ondjila yange,

nota pameke eemhadi dange
ngaashi oholongo,
ndele ta kaleke nge koikulundudu.

Nomake ange ote a longo okulwa,
opo omaoko ange a shiive
okulukila outa woshikushu.

Omwene owa amena nge nowa xupifa nge;
ekwafo loye ola nenepeka nge.

Omanha ange owe a longela
onhele ya mbwalangadja,
opo eemhadi dange diha fenhuke.

Ame nda taataa ovatondadi vange,
ndele nde va ta,
ndele inandi va aluka fiyo nde va mana po.

Onde va nyanyaula po, itava fikama po vali,
vo ova wila koshi yeemhadi dange.

Ove wa dika nge eenghono dolwoodi,
okufinda ovatondadi vange.

Ovatondi vange owe va kukumifa po,
va ya onhapo,
naaveshe ava hava tondo nge,
onde va halakanifa.

Ova kuwile onghuwo,
ndelenee kai tondokelwe komuxupifi;
ova ifana Omwene,
ndele ine va nyamukula.

Onde va lyataula va fa ondwi tai i omhepo,
nongaashi oushosho
tau kombwa momaluvanda.

Ndele Ove wa xupifa nge
meemhata dovanhu vange;
Ove wa ninga nge omupangeli woiwana.
Ovo inandi shiiva va ninga
ovapangelwa vange.

Ovanailongo tava komonene nge omitwe.
Mokuuda ondaka yange,
ova dulika kwaame.

Ova kanifa eenghono davo,
nomokukakama tava hondoloka
meehotengulu davo.

Omwene Oye omunamwenyo!
Emanya lange nali fimanekwe.
Udifeni pombada ounene waKalunga
omuxupifi wange!

noto kufa nge movatondi vange,
ndele to tula nge kombada
yovashindanhu vange,
ndele to mangulula nge
momulumenhu oshimhulu.

Omwene, handi ku fimaneke mokati koiwana,
ohandi imbi etumbalo loye.

Ove ou to yandje kohamba yoye omafindano manene,
nomuvaekwa woye to mu ningile onghenda,
oDavid nodikwa yaye aishe fiyo alushe.
19:
Eulu olo hali hepaulula oshinge shaKalunga,
nevalelwa lalo otali udifa
oshilonga shomake aye.

Omutenya ohau shi lalekidile omutenya mukwao,
noufiku ohau shi ingidile oufiku mukwao,

nande kae nelaka ile omatumbulo,
ondaka yao i udike;

nondaka yao oya ya nedu alishe,
neendjovo dao fiyo okominghulo dounyuni.
Etango okwe li dikila ko onduda yalo.

Lo otali piti mo,
ngaashi omuhomboli ta piti mondjuwo yaye,
otali kaluka ngaashi omukwaita omuladi
mokutondoka molweendo lalo.

Koxulo yeulu otali piti ko,
neengeda dalo otadi li fikifa
koxulo yalo ikwao,
ndele kape na oshinima tashi kala
sha hondama moupyu womutenya walo.

Omhango yOmwene oya wanenena,
yo ohai hekeleke omwenyo;
ehepaululo lOmwene
oli shii okulineekelwa shili,
olo hali nongopaleke omalai.

Omalombwelo Omwene okwa yuka,
taa hafifa omutima;
omhango yOmwene oi yela sheke,
tai minikile omesho.

Odo di noupuna u dule woshingoldo,
heeno, u dule woshingoldo shihapu
sha hoololekeka;
nodi nounyenye u dule womaadi eenyiki
ounyenyelela womashila ado.

Olyelye ta kala e udite omapuko?
Mangulule nge mwaa inandi a shipulula.

Osho yo omupiya woye
mu amena kovashishimani,
ino va efa va pangele nge.
Osho ngaha handi kala ndihe noshipo
nonda manguluka menyono linene.

Eendjovo domokanya kange
nomadilongo omomutima wange
nae ku wapalele, Omwene,
emanya lange nOmukulili wange.
20:
Omwene ne ku ude mefiku loudjuu,
edina laKalunga kaJakob nali ku amene!

Oye ne ku tumine ekwafo
li dje mouyapuki waye,
nepameko loye nali ku dilile muSion.

Na dimbulukwe eendjayambo doye adishe,
na tale nohokwe omaxwikiloyambo oye. Sela

Oye ne ku pe eshi omutima woye wa hala,
nomauko aeshe ne a wanife.

Opo nee twa hala okukalukila efindano,
nomedina laKalunga ketu
omo hatu dungadungifa omapandela etu;
Omwene na shakenife omaindilo oye aeshe.

Paamha ondi shi shii,
Omwene ota xupifa omuvaekwa waye,
ndele te mu udu meulu laye liyapuki
omafindano manene eke laye lokolulyo.

Oku na ovo have lineekele omatemba oita
navamwe eenghambe;
ndelenee fye hatu hepaulula
edina lOmwene Kalunga ketu.

Vo kave na apa tava kwatelele,
ndele tava natwa po,
ndelenee fye otu li ofika, itatu tengauka vali.

Omwene, yandja efindano kohamba!
Tu uda, ngeenge hatu ifana.
21:
Omwene, ohamba otai hafele eenghono doye,
nehafo la tya ngahelipi
tai hafele ekwafo loye!

Omahalelo omutima woye Ove we i pa,
naashi omilungu dayo da indila,
ino shi i shilika. Sela

Ove wa shakena nayo
u nomanangeko noupuna ouwa,
nowe i dika oshishani shoshingoldo komutwe wayo.

Oyo ye ku indila okukalamwenyo;
Ove nowe i pa omido dihapu, itadi xulu po fiyo alushe.

Molwekwafo loye etumbalo layo la ninga linene;
owe i tula eenghonopangelo noshinge.

Fiyo alushe owe i tula po
i ninge enangeko noupuna,
nowe i hafifa nenyaku linene koshipala shoye.

Osheshi ohamba oi li po
hai lineekele Omwene,
nomolwefilonghenda laau wOkombadambada
yo itai ka tengauka.

Eke loye itali kalele okuhanga
ovatondi voye aveshe,
nolulyo loye tali ka kwata
aveshe ava tave ku tondo.

Mokuholoka kwoye oto va ningi divadiva
va fa ediko la hanya;
mekeshuko laye
Omwene te va pona po hamudilu,
nomundilo tau ke va lungwinifa po.

Oiimati yavo Ove to i kombolola po kombada yedu
noludalo lavo omovana vovanhu.

Ngeenge tave ku dutile owii,
ndele tave ku ningi oukululufi,
itave shi dulu.

Osheshi Ove to va te po, va ye onhapo,
ndele to shoneke oipala yavo noikuti.

Omwene, yambuka po meenghono doye,
opo nafye ohatu ku imbile
nokufimaneka ouladinghono woye.
22:
Kalunga kange, Kalunga kange,
oshike wa efa nge?
Molwashike u li kokule nokukwafa nge,
kokule neendjovo dekemo lange?

Kalunga kange, omutenya ohandi kuu onghuwo,
ndele Ove ito i nyamukula,
nomoufiku ihandi mono elotifo!

Nande ope li ngaha, Oove Omuyapuki
ou ho kala momaimbilohambelelo Ovaisraeli.

Ootatekulu vonale okwa li ve ku lineekela,
ve litula melineekelo,
ndele Ove we va xupifa,

ova li ve ku ifana, nova mona exupifo;
nove ku lineekela ndele inava fifwa ohoni.

Ndelenee ame ondi li oshilikoki shongaho
nghi fi omunhu,
nda ninga oshiyolifa kovanhu,
nda dinika kuvo.

Aveshe, ava tava mono nge,
otava yeele nge,
otava leve nge nomulungu
nokupukapukila nge komitwe, tava ti:

Heeno, Ove ou wa pitifa nge medimo lameme
ndele wa itavelela nge
ndi tulumukwe nawa ponhulo yameme.

Nghee nda dalwa, okukalamwenyo kwange
okwa tulwa mwoove;
nghee nda dja moshidalelo shameme,
Oove u li Kalunga kange.

Ino kala nge kokule,
osheshi oudjuu u li nge popepi,
ndele nghi na omukwafi.

Onda kondekelwa keengobe deemhedi dihapu,
eengobenghono domuBasan da shakena nge;

otadi ulile nge unene
ngaashi eenghoshi da pepula okulyana.

Onda fa omeva a tilwashi,
omakipa ange aeshe a damuka;
omutima wange owa ninga ngaashi edi,
wa dilukila meni lange.

Eenghono dange oda kukutila mo
da fa oshikangwa,
nelaka lange ola kanyatela moshihokohoko;
Ove to nangeke nge mondwi yefyo.

Omakipa ange aeshe ohandi shiiva oku a vala,
ovo tava tale nge noku shi hafela.

Omidjalo dange otave di litukulile,
notava umbile elwakani lange oshihoololifo.

Ndelenee Omwene,
Ove ino kala kokule naame!
Oove eenghonopamo dange,
endelela u kwafe nge!

Xupifa omwenyo wange keongamukonda,
nokomakanya eembwa edi.

Xupife nge mokanya konghoshi,
u amene nge keembinga deemhuulu.

Edina loye onda hala
oku li shiivifila oovakwetu,
nomokati keongalo ohandi ku hambelele.

Nye ava hamu tila Omwene, mu hambeleleni.
Amushe nye vomeumbo laJakob,
mu fimanekeni.
Heeno, nye vomodikwa yaIsrael,
amushe mu tileni.

Osheshi Ye ina dina oudjuu womuhepekwa,
Ye ine mu tunyukwa,
noshipala shaye ine shi mu holeka,
naashi a kuwa onghuwo, okwe i tondoka.

Ehambelelo lange nali dje kwoove
meongalo linene,
ame ndi wanife omaudaneko ange
monhanaisho yaava tave ku tila.

Ovanambili tava ka lya va kute;
naava tava kongo Omwene,
tave mu hambelele.
Omitima deni nadi kale nomwenyo fiyo alushe.

Fiyo okominghulo dounyuni
otave ke shi shipulula,
ve lialulukile kOmwene,
noiwana aishe yovapaani
otai ke linyongamena koshipala shoye,

osheshi ouhambapangelo owo owOmwene,
Oye omutekuli woilongo aishe.

Ovanenenhu aveshe vokombada yedu
otava ka lya nokulinyongamena,
oonakufya novanyengwi vokulixupifila omwenyo,
aveshe otave ke mu twila eengolo.

Omapupi aa tae uya, otae ke mu longela,
oludalo eli tali holoka komesho,
otali ka hepaululilwa Omwene.

Mokuuya kwavo otava ka vilikilila ouyuki waye
kovanhu ava tava ka dalwa komesho,
va shiive, nokutya Oye e shi wanifa.
23:
Omwene Oye omufita wange,
ihandi pumbwa sha.

Oye ta lifa nge momatunda omwiidi mutalala,
nota twala nge komeva
ndi ka tulumukwe.

Nande ondi ende molufilu lomudile wefyo,
itandi tila owii,
osheshi Ove u li pwaame;
odibo yoye nonhaili yoye,
oyo ehekeleko lange.

Ove to yalele nge oshililo
monhanaisho yovatondi vange;
oto vaeke omutwe wange nomaadi,
neholo lange li yadi ndoo.

Heeno, ouwa nefilonghenda,
oyo otai shikula nge omafiku ange aeshe,
ndele ohandi kala mo fiyo alushe
meumbo lOmwene.
24: Edu olOmwene, naashishe shi yadi mo,

osheshi Ye okwe a shita
kombada yomeva efuta,
nokwe a pameka kombada yomilonga.

Elipipo ta itavelwa okuya
kombada yomhunda yOmwene?
Elipipo a wana okukala ofika
ponhele youyapuki waye?

Oyou e nomake inaa nyata owii,
noku na omutima wa yela,
noiha ameke nande omwenyo waye koungaho,
noiha fufya mokwaana kwaye.

Oye tuu ou ta nangekwa noupuna kOmwene
ndele ta pewa ouyuki kuKalunga kexupifo laye.

Ava ve li ngaha, ovo epata laava, tave ku pula,
ndele tave uya koshipala shaKalunga kaJakob. Sela

Oivelo nye, yeluleni omitwe deni,
nye mu yeluke, oivelo nye yaalushe,
ohamba yefimano opo i shiive okupitila mo!

Ohamba yefimano olyelye hano?
Omwene, omunaenghono omuladi,
Omwene omuladi moita.

Oivelo nye, yeluleni omitwe deni,
nye mu yeluke, oivelo nye yonalenale,
ohamba yefimano opo i shiive okupitila mo.

Ohamba yefimano olyelye hano?
Omwene weengudu dovakwaita,
Oye tuu ohamba yefimano. Sela
25: Omwene, omwenyo wange ohandi u yelula kwoove.

Heeno, nande umwe ou te ku teelele,
ita ka fifwa ohoni.
Ovaamuki epwanga aveke
tava ka fifwa ohoni.

Omwene, ulikile nge eendjila doye,
Ove u longe nge omalila oye,

ame ndi ende moshili yoye,
Ove u longe nge,
osheshi Oove Kalunga, omuxupifi wange,
ohandi ku teelele efiku alishe.

Omwene, dimbulukwa efilonghenda loye nolukeno loye,
osheshi oyo oya kala po nalenale.

Omatimba omounyasha, nomanyono ange,
nowii wange ino u dimbulukwa.
Dimbulukwe nge panghenda
nomolwouwa woye, Omwene.

Omwene omuwa nomuyuki,
onghee ta longo ovalunde okushiiva ondjila.

Ovalininipiki ote ke va endifa payuki,
novalininipiki ote va longo ondjila yaye.

Omalila aeshe Omwene onghenda noudiinini
kwaava hava diinine ehangano nehepaululo laye.

Omwene, molwedina loye,
kufa po etimba lange, nande olo linene.

Ou ha tila Omwene, ye olyelye?
Ye ote mu longo ondjila ei ye e nokuhoolola.

Oye ta ka kala nelao,
noludalo laye otali ka fyuulula edu.

Eendafano lOmwene oli li naava have mu tila;
ndele te va shiivifa ehangano laye.

Omesho ange alushe
onde a ameka kOmwene,
osheshi neemhadi dange ote di yululula momwiyo.

Alukila kwaame, u file nge onghenda,
osheshi ondi li omufiwapo nepongo.

Omatilifohodi omomutima wange a hapupala;
kufe nge mo moudjuu wange.

Tala omupya wange, noshiponga shange,
u dimine nge po omatimba ange aeshe.

Tala ovatondi vange, osheshi ovo ovahapu,
ve noutondwe naame, tava tondo nge nai.

Diinina omwenyo wange, u xupife nge;
ino efa ndi fifwe ohoni; Oove, nde lineekela.

Oukoshoki noukalinawa nau amene nge,
osheshi Omwene, Oove, nda teelela.

Akutu Kalunga, kulila Israel
momaudjuu aye aeshe!
26:
Omwene, ningile nge eshi sha yuka,
osheshi mokweenda kwange nda enda moukoshoki,
onda kala nde lineekela Omwene,
inandi tengauka.

Omwene, yeleke nge, u konakone nge,
shipulula eefiyo dange nomutima wange;

osheshi ounamutimanghenda woye
ou li komesho yange,
nohandi ende moshili yoye.

Ame ihandi kala omutumba pamwe neembudi,
noinandi endafana naava ve na koshi.

Ohandi tondo oshiongalele shovanawii,
noihandi kala omutumba pwaava vehe na Kalunga.

Omake ange ohandi a kosho ehe na mbudi,
nonda hala okudingilila oaltari yoye, Omwene,

ame ndi pandule nondaka inene,
nondi udife oinenelonga yoye aishe.

Omwene, ame ondi hole onhele yongulu yoye,
naapa tapa kala onhele yoshinge shoye.

Ino nakula po omwenyo wange pamwe novalunde,
nomwenyo wange mumwe novatilishi vohonde,

ava ve nomake a nyata oukolokoshi,
nolulyo lavo oli yadi ombubo.

Ndelenee ame ohandi ende mouyuki wange,
mangulule nge nokufila nge onghenda.

Eemhadi dange tadi kala ofika pedu la lalakana;
ohandi ka hambelela Omwene moiongalele yeongalo.
27:
Eemhote ngeenge tadi totele nge, di pone nge po,
ovayelani vange novatondi vange,
ovo vene tava punduka ndele tava wile po.

Nande etanga lovakwaita nali dingilile nge,
omutima wange itau tila sha;
nande ondi shingilwe oita,
natango ondi li po ndi neyombamo.

Shimwe ashike onde shi ehela kOmwene,
nde shi hala unene:
ngeno ame ndi kale mongulu yOmwene
omafiku ange aeshe,
okutala ouwanyenye wOmwene,
ndi lishipulule nawa motembeli yaye.

Osheshi Ye ta holeke nge monduda yaye
mefiku loixuna;
ota amene nge neameno letwali laye,
ndele ta yelulile nge kombada yemanya.

Osho hano omutwe wange otau ka lunda
dovatondi vange ava va dingilila nge;
ame nda hala okuyamba omayambo ekuwililo
mongulu yaye,
nda hala okwiimbila Omwene noku mu hambelela.

Omwene, uda, eshi handi ku ifana mokule!
File nge onghenda, u nyamukule nge.

Eshi nda dimbulukwa ondaka yoye ei tai ti:
“Nye kongeni oshipala shange”,
omutima wange otau nyamukula:
“Omwene, oshipala shoye
nda hala oku shi konga.”

Ino holeka nge oshipala shoye,
Ove ino kelela po omupiya woye nonya.
Oove ekwafo lange shito,
ino ekela nge shi u efe nge,
Kalunga kexupifo lange.

Osheshi tate nameme, vo ova efa nge ngaho,
ndelenee Omwene Oye ta kombelele nge.

Omwene, longe nge ondjila yoye,
u endife nge melila la yelakana
molwovatondi vange.

Ino yandja nge omuhanga kovataatai vange!
Osheshi ovahepaululi voipupulu
otava fikamene nge naau ta fulakata.

Iyaloo, ohandi itavele shili,
nokutya handi ka mona ouwa wOmwene
medu lovanamwenyo.

Teelela kOmwene!
Kala wa yombama,
omutima woye inau mbadapala;
heeno, teelela kOmwene.
28:
Omwene, ohandi ku ifana,
Oove emanya lange: ino amuka nge,
u kale wa mwena,
opo ndiha fe ava hava i mombila,
ngeenge to kala wa mwena filu.

Uda ondaka yomailikano ange;
ngeenge handi ku ifana u kwafe nge,
eshi handi yelula omake ange
mondingandinga youyapuki woye.

Ino faulila nge po pamwe novalunde
nomumwe novakolokoshi,
ava ve li po tava popifa mukwao nombili,
mboli meni lavo tave mu diladilile owii.

Va alulila shi fike poilonga yavo
nopoumbudi woiningwa yavo;
va alulila shi fike pokunyona kwomake avo,
Oove, u va pe ondjabi, ei va longela.

Osheshi ihava yavala oilonga yOmwene
noshilongwa shomake aye;
onghee nee ote ke va ngumauna po,
ndele ite va tungulula vali.

Omwene na fimanekwe,
osheshi eingido longhuwo yange okwe li uda.

Omwene Oye omupameki wange
noshikelelifo shange;
Oye nde lineekela momutima wange
nonda mona ekwafo.
Osho nee sha nyakula omutima wange,
nohandi mu pandula neimbilo lange.

Omwene, Oye eenghono doshiwana shaye,
ohotexupifo yomuvaekwa waye.
29:
Ovana ovamati vaKalunga nye,
eteleni Omwene efimano neenghono!

Eteleni Omwene efimano ledina laye!
Linyongameneni Omwene
momudjalowapalo muyapuki.

Ondaka yOmwene tai ende neenghono;
ondaka yOmwene i yadi oshingepangelo.

Ye ote di nhukifa ngaashi okatana,
Libanon naSirjon ngaashi okanimwena komhuulu.
Ondaka yOmwene tai tatula omalaka omundilo.

Ondaka yOmwene otai kakamifa ombuwa;
Omwene ta kakamifa ombuwa yaKades.

Omwene ota ka yandja eenghono koshiwana shaye;
oshiwana shaye Omwene te ke shi punika nombili.
30:
Omwene, nda hala ndi ku fimaneke pombada,
osheshi Ove wa shila nge movayelani vange,
noino va pa omhito, va hafele nge.

Omwene, Kalunga kange,
nda li nde ku kwenaukila u kwafe nge,
ndele owa velula nge.

Omwene, Oove wa alula omwenyo wange moshovafi,
wa alulila nge komwenyo,
hinga ndi mbonyokele mombila.

Imbileni Omwene ehambelelo,
ovakoshoki vaye nye,
panduleni nokudimbulukwa edina laye liyapuki!

Osheshi ehandu laye ohali kala po
okafimbo kepakumo limwe,
nonghenda yaye otai kalelele omafiku aeshe;
mokutokelwa ekweno,
nomokusha ehafo li li po.

Eshi nda li ndi shii nda pama, opo nee nda tya:
“Itandi punduka nande.”

Opo nee nde ku lalekida, Omwene,
nonda kuwa kwoove, Kalunga kange, nda tya:

“Mohonde yange oto mono mo ouwa washike,
ngeenge nda wile melambo?
Ondwi otai ku pandula mbela,
i udife oudiinini woye?

Omwene, ngeno u ude nge,
u file nge onghenda!
Omwene, Ove kala omukwafi wange!”

Enyeme lange, owe li shitukifa ehafotanhelo,
Ove owa dula nge oshikutu sheenghali,
ndele to dike nge ekwamo lehafo,
31:
Endekela okutwi kwaame,
endelela u xupife nge!
Ninga emanya lokwaamena nge,
nohotemhunda yange muyo u xupifile nge.

Oto shili nge mo meendjadja odo va tela nge meholeko,
osheshi Oove omwaameni wange.

Ava va kwatelela moikalunga yongaho,
ohandi va tondo,
ndele ame onde lineekela kOmwene.

Handi hafele nokunyakukilwa
ouwanghenda woye,
shaashi wa tala oudjuu wange,
nowa dimbulukwa omatilifo omwenyo wange,

noino yandja nge momake ovatondi,
neemhadi dange owe di endifa poluhaela.

Omwene, file nge onghenda!
Osheshi ame nda mbadapala;
omesho ange a wiwikifwa kouyehame wange,
omwenyo nolutu osho tuu.

Osheshi okukalamwenyo kwange otaku pu po moudjuu,
nomido dange ometwo lomadima;
eenghono dange oda utamekwa kowii wange,
nomakipa ange a fa a tukwa.

Onda ninga oshiyolifa shovayelani vange,
novashiinda vange otava kukuma nge;
ava tava litu nge mondjila,
otava i nge onhapo.

Onda dimbuwa, nda fa omufi, ou a dja mokudimbulukiwa,
nda fa oshikangwa itashi kwatelwa vali.

Heeno, ondi udite,
vahapu tava ambaamba nge,
oixuna keembinga adishe,
mokungudumana kwavo
otava diladilile nge efyo.

Ndelenee ame ohandi ku lineekele, Omwene,
ndele handi ti: Oove ngaho Kalunga kange.

Omafimbo ange e li meke loye;
Ove, xupife nge meke lovatondi nolovataatai vange!

Yelifila omupiya woye oshipala shoye,
xupife nge omolwouwanghenda woye!

Omwene, ino efa nge ndi lengaifwe,
Oove handi ifana.
Ava vehe na ko nasha naave,
ovo nava lengaifwe,
ndele eshi va tomhwa, nava ye moshovafi!

Omilungu doipupulu ngeno di mwenekwe,
edi tadi tongo omuyuki
mowii nomelinenepeko nomokudina.

Ouwa woye ounene u fike peni,
ou we u tuvikilila ava, have ku tila.
Noto u yandje moipafi yovanhu kwaava,
have ku lineekele.

Oto va amenifa oshipala shoye
molwomaduto ovanhu mai,
oto va holeke keemhata domalaka avo mondjuwo yoye.

Omwene na fimanekwe,
eshi a monifa nge onghenda yaye inene,
ya kumwifa moshilando sha pama.

Mokulimbililwa kwange onda li ndi shii,
onda kandulilwa kokule
ndi dje momesho oye;
ndelenee mboli nokuli
eshi nda kuwa kwoove,
owa uda ekwenauko lange.

Kaleni mu hole Omwene,
ovakoshoki nye amushe!
Ava tava diinine, Omwene ote va amene;
ndelenee ou te litumbaleke mwene,
ote shi mu alulile oushima u yadi.

Kaleni nomwenyo muwa,
nomitima deni nadi tiluluke,
nye amushe ava hamu teelele Omwene!
32:
Omunelao ou omanyono aye a dimwa po
nomatimba aye a tuvikwa.

Omulumenhu omunelao oye ou
Omwene ite mu valulile owii waye,
nomomhepo yaye ngeenge kamu na ekonda.

Eshi nda li inandi hepaulula omatimba,
omakipa ange a li a tekauka
molweemhata domeni lange efiku alishe.

Osheshi omutenya noufiku,
eke loye ola li la lyaminikila nge poshi;
omungo wange owa kukutila mo,
wa fa wa kukutikwa kokwenye. Sela

Opo nee onde ku hepaululila omatimba ange,
noulunde wange inandi u holeka, nda tya:
“Onda hala ndi hepaululile Omwene omanyono ange”;
opo ove owa kufila nge po owii womatimba ange. Sela

Onghee hano omuyuki ne ku ilikane fimbo to hangika,
opo ngeenge tape uya omayelu manene,
ehe mu kungulule.

Inamu fa eenghambe nomamula,
aa ehe na eendunge,
haa tulwa oitomo momakanya noikeshele,
i deule ava vapwidi, va ehene kwoove.

Omahepeko ovahenakalunga
oku li po mahapu;
ndelenee ou te lineekele Omwene,
ota dingililwa konghenda.

Ovayuki nye, hafeleni mOmwene,
nye kalukeni eenghalu,
nyakukweni pombada,
amushe nye ovayuki momutima.
33:
Ovayuki nye, nyakukilweni mOmwene!
Oshe mu wapalela, ovakoshoki nye,
mu mu imbile ehambelelo.

Panduleni Omwene, mu mu shikile oumbulumbubwa,
nye mu mu shikile onyalilo yeefenga omulongo.

Mu imbileni eimbilo lipe,
shikeni nawa neendaka denghuma.

Osheshi ondjovo yOmwene oya yuka,
nomudiinini moilonga yaye aishe;

Oku hole ouyuki netokolo la yuka;
edu oli yadi onghenda yaye.

Eulu ola shitifwa ondjovo yOmwene,
neengudi dalo adishe okomhepo yokanya kaye.

Omeva efuta ote a tumbifa ngaashi onduba,
momalimba aye ota tulike oulembwili.

Edu alishe nali tile Omwene.
Ovakalimo mounyuni aveshe
nava kakame koshipala shaye.

Osheshi Ye okwa popya, ndele sha ningwa,
okwa lombwela, ndele osha monika.

Omwene okwa hanauna po eemhangela doiwana,
nomadiladilo ovanhu okwe a xutula.

Omhangela yOmwene otai kalelele,
nomadiladilo omutima waye
okomapupi nomapupi.

Oshiwana oshinelao, osheshi
shi na Kalunga kasho Omwene,
e shi lihoololela, shi ninge efyuululo laye.

Omwene meulu ha tale poshi,
noku wete ovana aveshe vovanhu;
monhele yaye ota kevauka ovakwadu aveshe,

Oye tuu omuyandjilupe womitima davo adishe,
nomukoneki woilonga yavo aishe.

Ohamba itai xupifwa molwounenengudu wayo,
nofule itai likwafa keenghono dayo.

Onghambe itai kwafa sha mefindano
noitai xupifa keenghono dayo dinene.

Tala, eisho lOmwene otali taalele
kwaava have mu tila,
okwaava va teelela ouwanghenda waye,

a xupife eemwenyo davo mefyo,
Ye e va palule mondjala, vaha fye.

Eemwenyo detu otadi teelele kOmwene;
Oye ekwafo letu noshikelelifo shetu.

Heeno, omutima wetu otau hafele muye,
osheshi edina laye liyapuki olo twe lineekela.

Omwene, ouwanghenda woye
nau kale kombada yetu,
ngaashi fye yo tu li po, twe ku teelela.
34:
Onda hala okufimaneka Omwene alushe,
ehambelelo laye inali pwa mo
mokanya kange nande.

Omwene Oye elitango lomwenyo wange;
ovalininipiki nave shi ude nokunyakukwa.

Hambeleleni Omwene pamwe naame;
fye atusheni tu panduleni edina laye.

Ame nda konga Omwene,
ndele Ye okwa nyamukula nge
nokwa xupifa nge metilo alishe.

Ava hava tale kuye, tava eta eenhe dehafo,
noipala yavo itai pembifwa kohoni.

Apa pa li omukwanaluhepo a kwena,
Omwene okwe mu uda,
okwe mu xupifa momaluhepo aye aeshe.

Omweengeli wOmwene ota ongo
nokudingilila onhanda yaava have mu tila,
ndele te va xupifa.

Makeleni, nye mu tale ouwa wOmwene apa u fike;
keshe tuu ou te mu lineekele, oye e nelao.

Tileni Omwene, ovayapuki vaye nye,
osheshi ava, have mu tila,
itava pumbwa sha nande.

Eenghoshona odi udite oluhepo
noda fya ondjala,
ndelenee ou ta kongo Omwene,
ye ita hepa sha shiwa nande.

Ileni nye ounona, mu pwilikine nge:
onda hala oku mu longa okutila Kalunga.

Omulumenhu olyelye,
ou ehe nohokwe nokukalamwenyo
nokuhola omafiku opo a mone ouwa?

Hano kelela elaka loye, liha popye owii,
nomilungu doye diha popye oipupulu.

Kala kokule nowii, ove u longe ouwa;
konga ombili, u i hokele.

Omesho Omwene okwe a talifila ovayuki,
nomatwi aye okwe a ameka kekwenauko lavo.

Oshipala shOmwene otashi nyonyodola ovanawii,
a kombe po edimbulukifo lavo kombada yedu.

Ngee ovayuki otava kuwile ekwafo,
Omwene ote va udu,
ndele te va xupifa momaudjuu avo aeshe.

Omwene oku li popepi nomitima da teyauka,
Ye oha xupifa ava ve nomhepo ya nyanyauka.

Omaudjuu omuyuki oku li mahapu,
ndelenee Omwene ote mu xupifa mwaaeshe.

Ote mu diininine omakipa aye aeshe,
paha teke nande limwe.

Omulunde ota dipaifwa kowii,
nomutondi womuyuki ote lilongele oushimatimba.

Omwene ota kulile eemwenyo dovapiya vaye,
kaku na ou ta kongo ekwafo kuye, ta tokolwa.
35:
Omwene, va hokololifa ava tava shilafana naame,
kondja naava tava kondjifa nge!

Kufa oshikelelifo eshi shinini naashi shakula,
fikama u kwafe nge.

Yeda eonga, u idile ondjila yovataatai vange,
lombwela omwenyo wange u tye:
“Aame exupifo loye.”

Ava tava kongo omwenyo wange,
nava fifwe ohoni va lengaifwe!
Naava va dutila nge oshiponga,
nava shunifwe shanimanima,
nava pembifwe kohoni yavo.

Nava ningwe va fa olungu tali i omhepo,
nomweengeli wOmwene ne va undwileshi.

Ondjila yavo nai laulikwe, yo i kale nomufenhu,
nomweengeli wOmwene ne va taatae.

Osheshi vo ova tela nge omiyo oshimha meholeko,
nova fela nge elambo epwanga.

Ngeno na hangelelwe koshiponga ine shi shiiva,
a papale eshi e li melulo laye,
eli a tela nge meholeko,
e liyule ye mwene.
Omo na wile, a nyonauke po.

Opo nee omwenyo wange tau hafele mOmwene
nokunyakukilwa exupifo laye.

Nomakipa ange aeshe otaa ka tya:
“Omwene, olyelye e fike pwoove?
Ove ou ho xupifa omufininikwa
kwaau, e mu dule eenghono;
heeno, nomuhepekwa nohepele kwaau te mu lu.”

Otapa fikama eendobwedi doipupulu,
tava pula nge, eshi ndihe shii;

Vo eshi va li tava vele,
onda li nda djala omudjalo woufiye,
ndele handi lidilike eendja,
nohandi va indilile, nde lituvikila komutwe.

Nda li nda kala handi nyika oufiye
ngaashi omunhu te u nyikile kaume kaye nomumwaina,
nongaashi ou ta lili eenghali daina
osho ame nda li handi nyongameke omutwe wange.

Ndele paife, ame eshi nda punduka,
otashi va hafifa,
ndele tave liongelele nge, ve lipaka kumwe
ngaashi ovakalakali ava ndihe va shii,
navo otava shashaula nge,
itava fuda po nande.

Ove li po ovadinifi vange novashadauli,
tava ulilile nge mo,
ndele tave likweshele nge nomayoo.

Omwene, fiyo onaini to shi tale ngaho hano?
Shila omwenyo wange momanyonauno avo,
u u vakule meenghoshona.

Opo nee nda hala, ndi ku fimaneke meongalo linene,
nda hala, ndi ku tange
moipafi yongudu inene yovanhu.

Ava tava twifa nge eemhata epwanga,
ino efa va yole nge,
ava tava tondo nge oshimha,
ino efa, va fiikile nge omesho.

ova akamekela nge omakanya, tava ti:
“Shalongo, shalongo,
eshi otwe shi mona nomesho etu.”

Omwene, Ove we shi mona,
ino kala wa mwena!
Omwene, ino kala kokule naame!

Penduka, Ove pashukile nge, u yukifile nge,
Kalunga, Omwene wange, popile nge!

Pe nge ouyuki pauyuki woye mwene,
Omwene, Kalunga kange,
ino va efela va hafele nge.

Ino efa, va popye momitima davo va tye:
“Shalongo shetu, shahaitana.”
Ove ino efa va tye:
“Otwe mu nyonauna po.”

Ava tava hafele oudjuu wange,
aveshe kumwe, va fifa ohoni,
va dinde omitwe,
ava tave lishiivile nge oukengeli,
va djaleka elengwa nodino.

Ava, va halela nge eyukifilo,
vo nava nyakukifwe va hafe, alushe vo va tye:
“Omwene, Oye omunene,
ou ta halele omupiya waye ouwa.”

Nelaka lange nali tange ouyuki woye
nehambelelo loye efiku alishe.
36:
Enyono lomulunde tali popi momutima waye,
omesho aye itaa tila Kalunga nande,

osheshi olo tali mu shendjeleke momesho aye,
a longe owii waye,
aha mone ehalo loku u mu tondifa.

Eendjovo domokanya kaye odo oixuna nouketuketu,
okwa kaleka okulonga ounongo nouwa.

Mokunangala kwaye ota dutu okulonga owii,
ta hovele okweenda ondjila youmbudi,
ite u nyonyodola.

Omwene, ouwanghenda woye
otau hange fiyo okeulu,
noudiinini woye otau tu fiyo okoilemo kwi.

Ouyuki woye owa pama
ngaashi eemhunda daKalunga,
omatokolo oye oku li ngaashi
oule womeva efuta;
Omwene, Ove to kwafa omunhu noshinamwenyo.

Kalunga, ouwanghenda woye ounyenye u fike peni!
Ovana vovanhu ohava hondama
momudidimbe womavava oye.

Osheshi mwoove omo omu nofifiya yomwenyo;
nomouyelele woye, omo hatu mono ouyelele.

Diinina ouwanghenda woye
kwaava tave ku shiiva,
nouyuki woye okwaava ve nomutima wa yela.

Ino efa omhadi yomulinenepeki i lyate nge,
nomake ovakolokoshi a taatae nge.

Oko ovaningi vowii va papala,
eshi va pundulilwa po, va shatwa pedu,
ndele itava dulu vali okufikama nande.
37:
Ino handuka nande molwovanawii,
novanyonauni ino va ningila ondubo.

Vo ve li ngaashi omwiidi,
ou uhe kwete okukukuta,
otava lembe ngaashi oimeno italala.

Lineekela Omwene, u longe ouwa,
kala moshilongo, u diinine oshili!

Opo u hafele Omwene,
ndele Ye te ku pe, eshi sha wapalela omutima woye.

Ondjila yoye i tula meke lOmwene,
u mu lineekele; Oye note shi ningi,

ndele ta ka holola ouyuki woye ngaashi ouyelele,
neyukifilo loye ongaashi omutenya.

Omwenyo woye u lotifila mOmwene, u mu teelele;
ino mbilingwa molwaau,
ondjila yaye i nomholo,
nomolwomulumenhu ta wanifa oumbudi waye.

Efa ehandu, u dje mo monya.
Ino mbilingwa; opo uha longe owii.

Osheshi ovaningi vowii
otava ka kombololwa po,
ndelenee ava tava teelele Omwene,
otava ka nangala oshilongo.

Ngeenge pa pita okafimbo kaningholi,
omuhenakalunga ita kala po vali,
nongeenge to talatala onhele yaye,
ke po vali nande.

Ndelenee ovananheni
vo otava ka fyuulula edu,
ndele tava ka hafela ombili inene.

Omuhenakalunga ota dutile omuyuki owii,
ndele te mu kweshele omayoo;

ndelenee Omwene ote mu yolo,
eshi a mona efiku laye,
li li popepi noku mu hanga.

Ovahenakalunga otava pweya mo omikonda,
ndele tava shoneke omauta avo,
va wilife po omapongo nomawilandjila,
nova dipae ava, tava ende nouyuki.

Omikonda davo otadi va pilukile,
di va twe momitima davo vene,
nomauta otaa teyaulwa po.

Okaxupinima komuyuki okawa, ke dule
oupuna wovahenakonasha naKalunga vahapu.

Osheshi omaoko ovalunde otaa teyaulwa,
ndelenee ovayuki otava pamekwa kOmwene.

Omafiku ovayuki Omwene oku a shii,
efyuululo lavo otali kalelele po.

Itava fifwa ohoni mefimbo lii,
nomomafiku ondjala otava kutifwa.

Ndelenee ovalunde otava nyonauka po,
novatondi vOmwene otava pu po
ngaashi ewapalo loimeno yomomatunda,
tava di po ngaashi omwifi.

Omunawii ota li ongele, ndele ite i futu,
ndelenee omuyuki oku na onghenda,
ta dulu okuyandja oshali.

Osheshi ava va punikwa kOmwene,
otava fyuulula edu,
ndelenee ava va fingwa kuye,
otava kombwa po.

Omanha omulumenhu muwa
taa yukifwa kOmwene,
ndele ta hafele mondjila yaye.

Ngeenge ta punduka, ita wililile po,
osheshi Omwene ote mu yakele.

Nghee nda li omumati fiyo nda kulupa,
omuyuki inandi mu mona nande a efuwa,
ile oludalo laye tali ehela oshifima.

Kala kokule nowii u longe ouwa,
opo to kala alushe meumbo loye,

osheshi Omwene oku hole ouyuki,
novadiinini vaye ite va efa nande.
Ovalunde otava nyonaunwa po fiyo alushe,
nodikwa yavo otai kombololwa po sheke.

Ovayuki, vo otava ka fyuulula oshilongo,
ndele tava kala mo alushe.

Okanya komuyuki otaka popi ounongo,
nelaka laye ouyuki.

Omhango yaKalunga kaye
okwe i tula momutima waye,
nomanha aye itaa ka tengauka.

Omuhenakalunga ota nangele omuyuki,
ndele ta kongo oku mu dipaa.

Ndelenee Omwene ite mu yandje momake aye,
ita efa nande, a pewe oushima metokolo.

Teelela Omwene, ove u lambalale ondjila yaye,
opo nee Ye ote ku lenge,
oshilongo shi ninge shoye,
ndele to hafifwa kekombololo lovahenakalunga.

Onda mona omuhenakalunga a fulakata,
te litandavelifa ngaashi omuti mutalala,
tau litwala ko mwene.

Opo nda enda po, ndele tala, ke po vali,
onde mu konga, ndele inandi mu mona.

Lilonga komuhaya, tala kovayuki,
osheshi efimbo lokomesho
tali ka kala lomulumenhu omunambili.

Ndelenee ovanyonauni otava hanaunwa po,
nefimbo lokomesho lovahenakalunga
otali ka tetwa po sheke.

Ekwafo lovayuki otali di kOmwene,
Oye ohotengulu yavo mefimbo lomaudjuu;

osheshi Omwene ote va kwafa,
ndele te va xupifa;
ote va xupifa movahenakalunga,
ote va xupifa molwaashi ve liyandja kuye.
38:
Omwene, ino tokola nge mehandu loye,
Ove ino denga we likesha!

Osheshi oikuti yoye oya tyuula nge,
noudjuu weke loye otau findile nge poshi.

Mombelela yange kamu na nande
onhumba inai yehama molwehandu loye,
nomomakipa ange kamu na nande
etulumuko molwoulunde wange.

Owii wange owa ninginifa omutwe wange,
wa fa omutengi mudjuu,
wa dula nge eenghono.

Oidinda yange oya mbuta, tai nyika nai,
ya twiyukila nge molwoulai wange.

Onda tifuka, handi ende omwoodimba,
nda djala oikutu youfiye.

Eenho dange oda fulila tadi pi,
nomolutu lange kamu na nande onhumba itai vele.

Onda alamekwa, nda mongoshoka,
mokundakula kwomutima wange
ohandi kuu pombada.

Omwene, eshi nda hala,
ashishe ou shi shii,
netwo lomadima ange inali ku holekwa.

Omutima wange otau lomhauka,
neenghono dange oda fiya nge po,
nouyelele womesho ange yo owa kana.

Ookaume kange novashiivikile
ova tekukifwa komupya wange,
novambuletwelela otava kala nge kokule.

Ava tava nangele omwenyo wange,
otava tele omiyo,
naava va hala okuyehameka nge,
otava lombola oixuna,
ndele tava dutu ekonda efiku alishe.

Ndelenee ame ndi li ngaashi omufitamatwi, nghi udite sha,
nomufitandaka ou ita makula okanya kaye.

Ondi li po, nda fa nokuli omulumenhu iha udu ko,
noehe na nande enyamukulo mokanya kaye.

Osheshi Omwene, onde lineekela kwoove,
Omwene, Kalunga kange, Oove ou,
to pe nge enyamukulo.

Osheshi onda tya: Ngeno uhe va efe,
va lengaife nge,
neemhadi dange, ngeenge tadi fenhuka,
vo vaha shiive okufulalalela nge.

Osheshi ondi li popepi nokuteyauka eenghono,
nouyehame wange opo u li alushe.

Akutu, ohandi ku hepaululile owii wange,
nonda nyika oufiye omolwomatimba ange.

Ndelenee ava tava lwifa nge oshimha, ovanaenghono,
naava tava tondele nge oinima yongaho, ove li po vahapu.

Ouwa otave u pilulile nge owii,
ndele tava shivile nge olwoodi,
molwaashi nda anyena mouwa.

Ino efa nge, Omwene!
Kalunga kange, ino kala kokule naame!

Endelela u kwafe nge,
Omwene, exupifo lange!
39:
Onda li nda tya:
“Onda hala okulungamena
okweenda kwange,
ndiha nyone nelaka lange;
onda hala okuyukifa okanya kange noshitomo,
omuhenakalunga fimbo e li komesho yange.”

Omutima wange owa hovela okupupyala
monhulo yange; mokudiladila kwange,
onda fa ndi nomundilo wa xwama meni lange;
opo nda efa elaka lange li popye,
ndi fululuke nda tya:

“Omwene, longe nge okushiiva exulilo lange
nouxupi womafiku ange, apa e fike!
Konekife nge, nokutya oweenda wange
itau kalele okuxula po!”

Omafiku ange owe a yeleka,
e fike poule wominwe,
nefimbo lokukala po kwange,
olo okatata kongaho kwoove;
heeno, omunhu keshe mokweenda
a fa ashike omufudo. Sela

Hano paife, Omwene, handi teelele shike?
Eteelelo lange omwoove auke li li, Omwene.

Xupife nge momanyono ange aeshe!
Ino efa, ndi ningwe oshiyolifa shomalai!

Onda ponga, itandi makula okanya kange,
osheshi Oove ou, we shi ninga.

Oshimwati shoye shi alula ko kwaame;
oudjuu weke loye otau ninginifa nge.

Ngeenge to yukifa omunhu,
ndele to mu denge omolwowii waye,
opo nee ewapalo laye oto li nyonauna
ngaashi eenhwishi hadi ningi.
Akutu, omunhu keshe
oye omuku wongaho. Sela

Omwene, pwilikina eindilo lange,
Ove uda ekwenauko lange!
Omahodi ange ino a tala wa mwena ngaho!
Osheshi ame pwoove
omweendanandjila ashike
nomunailongo ngaashi ootate aveshe.

Efa okutongolola nge, opo ndi hafifwe,
fimbo inandi dja po noitandi kala po vali.
40:
Onda li nda teelela, nokuteelela Omwene,
nokwa vandamena kwaame
nokwa uda onghuwo yange.

ndele okwa tula mokanya kange eimbilo lipe,
ehambeleloimbilo lokufimaneka Kalunga ketu.
Vahapu tave li mono, ndele tava tila
ndele tave lineekele Omwene.

Omulumenhu omunelao ou,
ta tula elineekelo laye mOmwene,
noite liameke kovalinenepeki
nokwaava tava pukile oipupulu.

Onghee nee ame nda tya: “Tala, ohandi uya,
momushangwa omo mwa shangwa,
eshi handi longo.

Kalunga kange, okuwanifa ehalo loye,
osho otashi nyakula nge,
nomhango yoye oyo ya nyolelwa
moule womwenyo wange.”

Kouyuki woye inandi holeka ko sha
momutima wange,
onda udifa pombada oudiinini nekwafo loye;
onghenda noshili yoye
inandi i mweneka meongalo linene.

Onghee nee, Omwene, ndi shi shii,
Ove ito anyene nge efilonghenda loye;
onghenda noudiinini woye
ohau amene nge alushe.

Osheshi owii uhapu, uhe shii kuvalwa,
owa kondekela nge,
omanyono ange a kwata nge,
ihandi dulu okumona ko;
omuvalu wao ou dule
eexwiki dokomutwe wange,
nonyati yange oya pwa po.

Omwene, hala okuxupifa nge!
Omwene, endelela, u kwafe nge!

Aveshe ava tava nangele omwenyo wange,
ve u nyonaune po, nava fifwe ohoni,
i va pembife oshipala;
ava va halela nge omupya,
nava shunifwe shanimanima, va lengaifwe.

Nave lixwinifwe kelengwa lavo,
ava tava ulaula nge tava ti:
“Shalongo, shalongo!”

Aveshe ava tave ku kongo,
nava nyakukwe nokuhafela mwoove;
aveshe ava tava djuulukwa exupifo loye,
vo va tye alushe:
“Omwene Oye omunene!”

Nande ondi li moupongo nomoluhepo:
Omwene ota file nge oshisho.
Oove omukwafi nomuxupifi wange,
Kalunga kange, ino kala ko!
41:
Omunelao ou, ha yavele oshingone;
oye ta xupifwa kOmwene mefiku loiponga.

Omwene ote mu amene, a kale nomwenyo,
ta ifanwa omunelao kombada yedu,
ndele Ove ito mu yandje omuhanga
monya yovatondi vaye.

Ngeenge ta nangala ta vele,
Omwene ote mu pendula po,
onhala yaye yokuvela oto i lundulula.

Ame onda tya: “Omwene, file nge onghenda!
Akutu, velule nge, osheshi onda nyona kwoove.”

Ovayelani vange otava popi nge nai tava ti:
“Onaini mbela ta fi, nedina laye li xule po?”

Aveshe hava tondo nge, otava shashala nge,
otava diladilile nge omupya, tava ti:

“Ekolamudo ihali veluka, ole mu dama;
eshi a nangala ngaha, ita penduka po vali nande.”

Neume lange nokuli, eli nde lineekela nomutima aushe,
nola li hali li eendja dange,
olo la yelulila nge oshififinwa, li fangule nge.

Ndelenee Omwene, Oove, file nge onghenda,
u yambule nge po vali,
ame ndi va shunifile oushima wavo.

Mwaashi ohandi shiiva, nokutya owa hokwa nge,
ngeenge omutondi wange ita mono omhito yokuhafela nge.

Osheshi ame molwokuhenambudi kwange
oto pamekele nge ofika,
ndele to pe nge, ndi kale koshipala shoye fiyo alushe.

Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael,
na hambelelwe alushe fiyo alushe!
Amen, heeno, Amen.
42:
Ngaashi oholongo tai kwenene
komatondokelo omeva,
osho yo omwenyo wange
tau ku djuulukwa, Kalunga.

Omwenyo wange tau fi enota,
otau djuulukwa Kalunga,
Kalunga omunamwenyo.
Onaini mbela handi fiki ko,
ndi monike koshipala shaKalunga?

Omahodi ange okwa ninga eendja dange
omutenya noufiku,
osheshi efiku keshe otava pulapula nge
tava ti: “Kalunga koye oku li peni paife?”

Mokudimbulukwa oinima ya pita,
ohandi tileshi omwenyo wange;
onda li handi ende mosheendo shongudu inene,
hatu i nayo kongulu yaKalunga,
twa hafa hatu imbi nokupandula mengafifi loshivilo.

Omwenyo wange, oshike wa polimanena ngaha,
ndele to nhukauka meni lange uhe na efudepo?
Teelela Kalunga!
Osheshi natango tuu handi ke mu hambelela,
Omuxupifi wange

naKalunga kange.
Omwenyo wange otau nyika oufiye meni lange;
onghee tuu ohandi ku dimbulukwa
moshilongo shaJordan
nokeemhunda daHermon nopomhunda Misar.

Meenghungulukilo doye
oulemeva umwe otau ifana oulemeva ukwao;
omakufikufi oye aeshe
nomandwafuko oye okwe uya
kombada yomutwe wange.

Nomutenya Kalunga oha yandje onghenda yaye,
nomoufiku eimbilo laye otali kala pamwe naame,
nohandi ilikana Kalunga kokukalamwenyo kwange.

Ohandi ti kuKalunga, emanya lange:
“Omolwashike wa dimbwa nge?
Molwashike ndi nokweenda noluhodi
nokufininikwa komutondi wange?”

Onda fa nda tukwa momakipa ange,
eshi ovanandubo naame va sheka nge,
alushe tava ti kwaame:
“Kalunga koye oku li peni paife?”

Omwenyo wange, oshike wa polimana ngaha,
ndele to nhukauka meni lange uhe na efudo?
Teelela Kalunga!
Osheshi natango tuu handi ke mu hambelela,
Omuxupifi wange naKalunga kange.
43:
Kalunga, yukifile nge, u popile nge
kovanhu vehe na onghenda,
Omwene, Ove u xupife nge
kovanhu ve noipupulu noumbudi.

Osheshi Kalunga, Oove ou, ho amene nge.
Owa ekelela nge shi shike?
Ohandi endele shike nda nyika oluhodi
mokufininikwa komutondi wange?

Tumine nge ouyelele noshili yoye,
oyo i kwatele nge komesho,
yo i twale nge komhunda yoye iyapuki
nokoukalelo woye,

ame ndi fike koaltari yaKalunga,
kuKalunga kekaluko lange,
nondi pandule, Kalunga,
ndi ku shikile okaxumbafeta,
naKalunga kange!

Omwenyo wange, oshike wa polimana ngaha,
ndele to nhukauka meni lange uhe na efudo?
Teelela Kalunga!
Osheshi natango tuu handi ke mu hambelela,
Omuxupifi wange naKalunga kange.
44:
Kalunga, otwe shi uda nomatwi etu vene,
ootate eshi ve shi tu hepaululila,
eshi Ove wa longele oinenelonga
mounyuni wavo, momafiku onalenale.

Oove mwene neke loye wa tele mo ovapaani,
ndele ootate, Oove we va twika meenhele davo;
oiwana yoilongo owe i kombolola mo,
ndele vo we va hapupalifila mo.

Osheshi omikonda davo,
hado de va monififa oshilongo,
nomaoko avo, hao e va longela efindano,
ndelenee eke loye lokolulyo,
nokwooko kwoye nouyelele woshipala shoye,
oyo tuu, ye shi ninga;
osheshi Ove we va hokwa.

Oove auke ohamba yange, Kalunga!
Tumina Jakob ekwafo!

Nekwafo loye ohatu ka denga poshi
ovatondi vetu,
nomedina loye hatu ka lyataula
ovakondjifi vetu.

ndelenee Oove tuu, we tu xupifa
movakondjifi vetu,
ndele Ove wa lengaifile ovatondi vetu.

Kalunga, Oye elitango letu omafiku aeshe,
nedina loye ohatu li hambelele fiyo alushe. Sela

Ndelenee paife owe tu ekelashi nokuli,
nowe tu tula melengwa,
ndele ito ende vali nomatanga ovakwaita vetu.

Ove wa efa, tu shunifwe lwanima kovatondi vetu,
novatondi vetu ova hakana oihakanwa.

Owe tu yandja ko, ngaashi eedi tadi i koshidipaelo,
ndele to tu halakanifa mokati koiwana yovapaani.

Owa landifa po ovanhu voye oshimha,
nomoku va landifa po kwoye ino limonena mo sha.

Owe tu etelifa odino kovashiinda vetu,
nokwaava twa shaama navo,
otwa ninga oiyolifa novadinwa kuvo.

Owa efa, fye tu ningwe etewo leengano dii komaludi ovapaani,
nomokati koiwana ohatu pukapukilwa komitwe.

Alushe elengwa lange oli li komesho yange,
nohoni oya pembifa oshipala shange,

eshi handi udu eyeelo neendjovo domasheko,
naashi handi konenene omesho omutondi nomunanghone.

Ashishe eshi oshe tu hanga,
nande fye mboli inatu ku dimbwa,
noinatu enda nekonda mehangano loye.

Omitima detu inadi shuna monima,
neemhadi detu inadi kanduka mo mondjila yoye,

ngeno opo u tu denge twa alamekwa pomikwena douvandje,
ndele to tu dingililifa omulaulu wefyo.

ngeno Kalunga ine shi tenheneka poluhaela mbela?
Osheshi Oye omukonakoni woiholekwa yomutima.

Ahowe, omolwoye tu li po hatu dipawa keshe efiku,
ndee hatu talwa twa fa eedi dokudipawa.

Duduluka po! Omwene, oshike to kofa ngaha?
Penduka! Ino tu ekelashi fiyo alushe.

Molwashike wa uvika oshipala shoye,
ndele to dimbwa oluhepo letu nokufininikwa kwetu?

Akutu, eemwenyo detu oda polimanena mondwi yedu,
nomalutu etu okwa shatwa po, a lyamininwa poshi.

Fikama u tu kwafe,
Ove, tu kulila molwefilonghenda loye!
45:
Omutima wange ou yadi ndoondoo,
tau xunga eendjovo diwa.
Eimbilo lange ohandi li yapulile ohamba.
Elaka lange ola fopena yehamushanga ha endelele.

Omuladi ove, mangela omukonda woye moshiya shoye;
limanga noshinge nounene woye.

Kala omunelao mokufinda.
Kondjela oshili nelininipiko nouyuki.
Okwooko kwoye kwokolulyo naku ku longe oilonga yoitilifa.

Olukalwapangelo loye, Kalunga, otali kala po fiyo alushe
nodibo yoye youhamba oyo odibo youyuki.

Omudjalo woye aushe ou nedimba liwa
lomirha naaloe naakassia;
neshiko lokaxumbafeta otali ku hafifa
meengulu da tungifwa ekipa leendjaba.

Ovana veehamba oukadona
ove li mokati kovakainhu voye, va fimana;
omumbada woye ota kala ofika kolulyo loye,
a djala oulenga woshingoldo shomuOfir.

Ndele ohamba yoye, ngeenge ye ku hala,
osheshi oyo omwene woye,
opo nee ove linyongamena kuyo.

Ovanhu vomuTirus otave uya,
ve ku etele omilongelo,
novanenenhu otava kendabala okulihokwifa kwoove.

oka dikwa oikutu ya tungilwa omaluvala,
ndele taka twalwa kohamba;
oukadona, eengoleka dako,
nookahewa vako otave ka eta kwoove.

Otava endifwa nehafo neenghuwilili
tava i mongulu yohamba.

Ounona voye ovamati otava ka kala ponhele yooxo,
ndele to va ningi oidale moshilongo ashishe.

Edina loye nda hala oku li dimbulukifa
komapupi aeshe okomesho;
opo nee oiwana aishe yoilongo
otai ke ku fimaneka fiyo alushe.
46:
Kalunga Oye ehondamo letu neenghono detu,
nekwafo linene li shii kulineekelwa momaudjuu.

Hano itatu tila, nande edu nali linyenge,
neemhunda nande nadi ngumukile momeva efuta,

nande omakufikufi naa lundumuke pombada,
notaa tutuma onhutu,
neemhunda nande nadi kakamifwe kendundumo lao. Sela

Ope nomulonga: eenghungulukilo dao
tadi hafifa oshilando shaKalunga,
oukalelo uyapuki waau wOkombadambada.

Kalunga omo e li musho, onghee itashi tengauka,
Kalunga ote ke shi kwafa metendo leluwa.

Oiwana yovapaani oya lundakana,
nomauhamba avo a teyaulwa po;
Oye okwa ndwandwamifa ondaka yaye,
nedu tali kakama.

Omwene weengudu dovakwaita oku li pamwe nafye,
Kalunga kaJakob Oye ohotemanya yetu ya pama. Sela

Ileni, mu tale oilonga yOmwene,
ou ta longo oitilifalonga kombada yedu.

Ou ta xulifa po oita fiyo okeengaba dedu,
ndele ta teyaula omauta nomaonga,
nomatemba oita te a xwike po nomundilo.

Ota ti: “Ngungumaneni, nye dimbulukweni,
nokutya Aame andike Kalunga,
nda tumbala mokati koiwana yoilongo,
nda tumbala kombada yedu.”

Omwene weengudu dovakwaita oku li pamwe nafye,
Kalunga kaJakob Oye ohotemanya yetu ya pama. Sela
47:
Oiwana yoilongo nye amushe, panduleni nomake!
Nyakukilweni Kalunga nondaka inene.

Osheshi Omwene omunene
wOkombadambada, a tilika,
ohamba inene kombada yedu alishe.

Oilongo okwe i findila mepangelo letu,
omaludi nomaludi okwe a tula koshi yeemhadi detu.

Oye e tu hoololela ombinga yefyuululo letu,
oshifimanekwalongo shaJakob,
ou a hokiwa kuye. Sela

Kalunga okwa londa kolukalwapangelo laye nokunyakukilwa,
Omwene a ya koshipundi shaye mendudumo lomanghuma.

Imbileni Kalunga ehambelelo, imbeni ehambelelo.
Imbileni ohamba yetu ehambelelo, imbeni ehambelelo.

Osheshi Kalunga Oye ohamba yedu alishe:
onghee hano mu imbileni eimbilo lehambelelo.

Kalunga Oye ohamba yoiwana,
Kalunga e li omutumba kolukalwapangelo laye liyapuki.

Eedalekele doilongo oda ongala puye,
da ninga oshiwana shaKalunga kaAbraham.
Osheshi oikelelifo yedu oyaKalunga,
Oye a fimana pombada.
48:
Omwene Oye omunene, oku nokufimanekwa shili
moshilando shaKalunga ketu, omhunda yaye iyapuki.

Moumbangalanhu omhunda yaSion
otai litumbu pombada mewapalo,
oyo ehafo ledu alishe,
oyo oshilando shohamba inene.

Kalunga okwe limonikifa meengulu dasho,
nokutya Oye ohote ya pama.

Tala hano, eehamba da li de lipaka kumwe,
da ile oku i totela.

Ndele eshi de i mona, da kumwa nokuhaluka
ndele tadi i onhapo.

Do oda li po da kakama, di kwetiwe ketilo,
ngaashi omufimba ta fetwa.

Eeskepa dokuTarsis,
Ove to di ninginifa nomhepo yokoushilo.

Hano ngaashi twa li twe shi uda,
paife osho otwe shi mona yo
moshilando shOmwene weengudu dovakwaita,
moshilando shaKalunga ketu,
nokutya Kalunga ote shi pameke fiyo alushe. Sela

Kalunga, ouwanghenda woye
ohatu u dimbulukwa motembeli yoye.

Kalunga, ngaashi shi li edina loye,
osho oshi li yo efimano loye:
otali udika fiyo okeexulo dedu:
eke loye lokolulyo oli yadi ouyuki.

Omhunda yaSion otai shi hafele,
noukadona vaJuda tava nyakukilwa omatokolo oye.

Dingilileni Sion, shi ningileni okalovolovo,
nye mu vale eengulu dasho.

Konakoneni eehote dasho,
mokweenda kweni didilikeni omapopilongulu asho,
opo mu shiive oku shi hepaululila ovatekulu veni,
49:
Shi udeni, oiwana aishe!
Pwilikineni, oonakukala kombada yedu amushe!

Ovana veehepele nye novoidale nye,
amushe, oipuna nomapongo.

Okanya kange naka popye ounongo,
nomadiladilo omutima wange
oo eendunge doovenevene.

Okutwi kwange ohandi ku endekele koshipopiwa,
otumbutumbu nda hala oku i holola
peshiko lokaxumbafeta.

Ohandi tila shike mbela momafiku oipo,
oududu wovataataai vange
ngeenge tau kondeke nge,

ava ve li po tave lineekele omamona avo,
ndele tava fulalalele ouhapu woupuna wavo?

Kape na omunhu ta dulu okukulila omumwaina,
nokuyandjela mukwao oikulila kuKalunga,

osheshi okufutila omwenyo oifuta apa i fike,
otai nyengana,
ye ke na oku shi hetekela vali fiyo alushe,
winya ngeno a kale nomwenyo, ita mono enyonauko.

Ahowe, ote shi ulikilwa nokuli, nokutya
novanongo otava fi yo;
novashima novapwidi aveshe otava nyonauka po,
nemona lavo, ove noku li fiila vakwao.

Euko lomeni lavo oleli:
eengulu davo tadi ka kalelela,
eenghalelo davo kepupi fiyo okepupi,
nande va le ve nomapya avo.

Heeno, omunhu, nande na kale a tumbala,
ye ita kala mulo,
ye okwa fa oimuna tai hanauka po.

Eshi ondjila yaava have lineekele voovene,
novahopaeleli vavo,
ava tava pande eendjovo davo. Sela

Ove lifindila moshovafi ngaashi eedi mokatomeno,
efyo olo omufita wavo,
nongomongula otava pangelwa kovayuki,
nomalupe avo otaa lika po koshovafi,
aha mone mo omutumba.

Ino kala wa tila ngeenge umwe ta punapala,
nemona lomeumbo laye ngeenge tali hapupala;

osheshi mokufya kwaye ita i nashimwe shomuyo,
netumbalo laye okwa nyengwa okuya nalo.

Nande oku liwete, e li nawa fimbo e li po,
ndele ta fimanekelwa okuhepuluka kwaye,

ota i nokuli, apa pa ya ooxe,
ava itava mono nande vali ouyelele womutenya.

Omunhu, nande omunenenhweelela
ndele ke neendunge,
okwa fa oimuna tai xulifwa po.
50:
Kalunga, ou Kalungeelela, Omwene,
Oye ta popi, ndele ta ifana edu
kepito letango fiyo okoku, tali ka ningina,

muSion, mewano lewapalelo,
Kalunga omo nee te liholola mefimano.

Kalunga ketu ote uya, Ye ita mwena;
omundilo wokulungwinifa po,
otau mu pitile komesho,
nokafudaela kanene otake mu dingilile.

Eulu nedu ote li ifana,
opo Ye a tokole oshiwana shaye, ta ti:

“Ongeleleni nge ovakoshoki vange,
ava twa hangana navo nomayambo.”

Eulu opo nee ola udifa ouyuki waye,
osheshi Kalunga Oye tuu omutokoli ou. Sela

“Oshiwana shange, pwilikineni nge, ndi mu popife,
Israel, ove ndi ku londwele neaneko:
Aame Kalunga, Kalunga koye.

Eshi handi ku vele eembedi,
hamolwomatomenoyambo oye
nomaxwikiloyambo oye
alushe oo e li koshipala shange.

keshe tuu odila i li kombada yeemhunda, ondi i shii,
naashishe eshi tashi linyenganyenga moixwa,
oshi li meke lange.

Ou shii, ohandi li mbela ombelela
yeemhedi doye,
ile ohandi nu ohonde yoikombo yoye?

nomefiku loudjuu woye ifane nge,
nonda hala oku ku kwafa,
ndele ove oto ka fimaneka nge.”

Ndelenee omudinikalunga,
Omwene ota ti kuye: “Eenghedimhango dange,
ove to di tongele shike mbela,
nehangano letu nanye
to li tumbulile shike hano mokanya koye?

Ove mwene manga to dini outeku wange,
neendjovo dange oto di pe ombuda;

ngeenge to mono oshimhulu, oto litula pusho,
nou nomhangela novanyoni vohombo.

Okanya koye oto ka fulukifa owii keshe
ou tau uya mo,
nelaka loye otali kunu oipupulu.

Apa to kala omutumba,
omumwanyoko to mu tongele mowii,
nomona wanyoko oto mu shade.

Eshi osho ho ningi,
ndele Ame onde shi mwenena ngaho;
opo nee ove wa diladila,
Ame ondi li ngaashi ove.
Eshi ohandi shi ku velele eembedi,
ove u lipulapule nasho.

Shi didilikeni nye, hamu dimbwa Kalunga!
Opo Ame ndihe mu payaule po mokuxupifa.

Ou ta yambe olupandu,
oye tuu omufimaneki wange,
naau ehe na oshipo mokweenda kwaye,
oye tuu ou handi monifile exupifo laKalunga.”
51:
Akutu, Kalunga, file nge onghenda
molwouwanghenda woye.
Molwefilonghenda loye linene dima po omatimba ange.

Koshe nge owii wange, ndi koshoke,
Ove u fete po etimba lange.

Osheshi enyono lange, ame mwene ondi li shii nawa,
nomatimba ange alushe e li momesho ange.

Kwoove akuke nda nyona,
nonda ninga eshi shii momesho oye,
opo u kale omuyuki meendjovo doye,
nouhenombedi mokutokola kwoye.

Tala, ame onda dalwa moulunde,
nameme okwa dala nge moulunde.

Ove wa hala oshili i kale meni momutima,
nomoule womwenyo ho shiivifa nge ounongo.

Koshe nge naisopi, opo ndi yele;
koshe nge ndi yele, ndi dule outokele weemhawe.

Udife nge ehafo nenyakuko,
opo omakipa ange, aa we a teyaula, a nyakukwe.

Tuvika oshipala shoye, uha mone omatimba ange;
ove dima po owii wange aushe.

Kalunga, shitile nge omutima wa yela,
nomeni lange tula mo omhepo ipe i neenghono.

Ino ekela nge shi nande koshipala shoye,
nOmhepo yoye Iyapuki ino i kufulula nge.

Hafife nge vali, ndi hafele exupifo loye,
Ove yambidide nge nomhepo yeduliko.

Opo ava, va puka, ndi ke va longe eendjila doye,
ovalunde vo ve ku lialulukile.

Kalunga, Kalunga kexupifo lange,
kufe nge metimba lohonde,
elaka lange, lo li hambelele oudiinini woye.

Omwene, makukifa omilungu dange,
okanya ka udife efimano loye.

Osheshi omatomenoyambo ku na nao,
nomaxwikiloyambo Ove ino a hokwa.

Omayambo aa a halika kuKalunga,
oo omhepo ya teyauka.
Omutima, ou wa teyauka nowa alamekwa,
oo nee, Kalunga ito u dini.

Ningila Sion ouwa monghenda yoye.
Ove tungulula eehote daJerusalem.
52:
Omulinenepeki ove, oshike to litangele oupote woye?
Efilonghenda laKalunga, otali kala po fiyo alushe.

Elaka loye otali dutu oixuna,
la fa oshikululifo sha upikwa, mukotokeli ove!

Ove u hole owii, u ku dulile ouwa,
noipupulu, i ku dulile oshili. Sela
Eendjovo dombudi, odo adike u hole, ove elaka li nekoto!

Hano osho yo Kalunga ote ku hanauna po fiyo alushe,
ote ku nakula mo note ku vakula mo moshitulwa shoye,
ndele te ku duda mo moshilongo
shovanamwenyo nomidi doye. Sela

Ovayuki, otave shi mono notashi va halula
ndele tave shi mu yolele:

“Tala, omulumenhu ou, oye tuu,
ine lineekela Kalunga, a ninge engholo laye,
ndelenee okwe lineekela emona laye linene
nokwe litungila koupuna waye.”
53:
Elai tali popi momutima walo, tali ti:
“Kape na Kalunga.”
Oilonga yalo oififahoni, ya nyonauka;
kape na nande umwe ou ta longo ouwa.

Kalunga meulu ota vandamene poshi,
ta tale oludalo lovanhu,
a mone, ngeenge pe na omunandunge,
ou ta kongo Kalunga.

Ndelenee aveshe ova kanduka mo,
aveshe va kaula onyanga; inapa monika vali ou,
ta longo sha yuka, nande oumwe.

Ovanawii vehe na eendunge nande mbela?
Ava tava li po oshiwana shange
ngaashi tava li oshifima,
vo itava ifana nande Kalunga.

Akutu, exupifo laIsrael ngeno li holoke muSion!
Ngeenge Omwene ta alula oudjuu movanhu vaye,
opo Jakob ota hafe, naIsrael ota nyakukwa.
54:
Kalunga, xupife nge molwedina loye,
Ove yukifile nge molweenghono doye.

Kalunga, uda eindilo lange,
Ove pwilikina eendjovo dokanya kange.

Ondi shi shii, Kalunga Oye omukwafi wange,
Omwene Oye eyambidido lomwenyo wange.

Owii otau ka shunifilwa ovatondi vange;
va hanauna po molwoudiinini woye.

Okehalo liwa nda hala oku ku yambela eyambo,
nokuhambelela edina loye, Omwene, shaashi oliwa.

Osheshi olo la xupifa nge momaudjuu aeshe,
nomesho ange otaa hafele okutala ovatondi vange.
55:
Kalunga, uda eilikano lange,
Ove ino hondama okweehela kwange!

Pwilikine nge, u nyamukule nge.
Moluhodi lange ohandi pumauka,
nohandi tu omadima

omolweuyaano lovatondi
nomolwelundakano lovadinikalunga;
osheshi otava undwile nge oixuna,
nomokutonda nge tava kala nehandu.

Omutima wange otau litonyo monhulo yange,
noshinyongi shefyo osha wila nge.

Etilo nekakamo ola hanga nge,
la tumaukifa nge omaxwilili.

Opo handi popi, handi ti:
“Ngeno onda li nomavava ngaashi onghuti,
ngeno handi tuka po, ndi mone etulumuko.
Heeno, ngeno ndi tukile kokule ndi ka kale mofuka. Sela

Ngeno ohandi endelele ndi likongele
onhele yokuhondama,
ndi ye onhapo yoshikungulu shidjuu
sha handuka noyeembadi.

Omwene, va hanauna po, u tumhakanife omalaka avo!
Osheshi moshilando onda mona mo
oukolokoshi nolwoodi.”

Omutenya noufiku ohava ende keehote dasho,
nowii noudjuu ou li meni lasho.

Ehanauno li li musho, nomafininiko nomakotokelo
itaa pu mo moshilandelo shasho.

ahowe, oove omukwetu, oove tuu ou,
okaume kange nomulineekelwa wange,

twa kalafana pamwe nombili iwa
notwa ya mongulu yaKalunga
pamwe nongudu yoshivilo.

Efyo nali va kwate!
Nava mbolokotele moshovafi ve nomwenyo.
Shaashi owii wa kala
mokukalamwenyo kwavo nomeni lavo.

Ndelenee ame ohandi lalekida Kalunga,
ndele Omwene ota xupifa nge.

Onguloshi nongula nomutenya
ohandi lili nokunyemata,
opo Ye ota udu ondaka yange.

Kalunga ota udu, ndele te va xupipike,
Oye ou a kala omutumba
kolukalwapangelo laye, a dja nalenale,
shaashi itave lidilulula, vo itava tila Kalunga. Sela

Eke laye okwe li kwatifa ava va li nombili naye
ndele ta nyonauna po ehangano lavo naye.

Eendjovo dokanya kaye oda fa di nomulyo,
mboli momutima waye omu noita.
Elaka laye oliwa, li nomufenhu ngaashi omaadi,
ndelenee olo omikonda da pweywa mo.

Omutengi woye u undulila kOmwene,
Ye ote ku kalele noshisho.
Oye ita efa nande omuyuki a kale alushe nokutengauka.

Heeno, Kalunga, oto ke va undulila mombwili yehanauno;
ovadipai novanekonda,
omafiku avo tave a xulifile ondjilakati.
Ndelenee ame ohandi ku lineekele.
56:
Kalunga, file nge onghenda,
osheshi ovanhu otava fulile nge meemhanda,
ovakwaita alushe otava fininike nge.

Efiku eli handi tilifwa,
Ove handi lineekele nokuli.

Alushe otava hetekele okweendameka eendjovo dange;
omadiladilo avo aeshe otava diladilile nge owii.

Otava shivafana, va hondjaunine nge,
va nangele eenghatu dange,
osheshi va hala omwenyo wange.

Mowii wavo aushe otava ka xupifwa tuu?
Kalunga, mehandu loye undula po oiwana yoilongo!

Omafiku ange omupya, Ove we a vala,
omahodi ange, we a pimhila moshimbudju shoye,
heeno, shili, owe a nyolela membo loye.

Hano mokwiifana kwange Kalunga,
opo tuu ovatondi vange tava shuna monima.
Ondi shi shii shili:
Kalunga okwa ama kwaame.

Kalunga ou ta kwafa nge okufimaneka eendjovo daye,
Omwene ou ta kwafa nge okufimaneka eendjovo daye,

Oye handi mu lineekele ndele ihandi tila.
Ovanhu otava ningi nge shike!

Kalunga, ndi na eudaneko oku ku wanifila.
Onda hala ndi ku etele eyambo lehambelelo.

Osheshi Ove wa xupifa omwenyo wange mefyo,
neemhadi dange mokupunduka,
ame ndi ende koshipala shaKalunga
omouyelele wovanamwenyo.
57:
Kalunga, file nge onghenda, file nge onghenda,
osheshi kwoove omwenyo wange otau kongo ekwafo,
ndele momudidimbe womavava oye
onda hala okukonga eameno
fiyo ehanauno la pita po.

Ohandi ifana Kalunga ou wOkombadambada
Kalunga ou ta fikifa oshinima shange.

Oye ta tumine nge ekwafo, tali di keulu,
ota lengaifa ou e uditile nge onya. Sela
Kalunga ota tumu ouwanghenda noshili yaye.

Omwenyo wange otau nangala
mokati keenghoshi
nomokati kovatondi ve yadi outondwe,
nomokati kaava ve nomayoo a fa omaonga noikuti,
nomalaka avo a fa omikonda da twa.

Kalunga, litumba kombada yomaulu,
efimano loye kombada yedu alishe.

Eemhadi dange ove di tela eendjadja,
ova polimanifa omwenyo wange.
Ekelo, ove li fa komesho yange,
ndele voovene tava wile mo. Sela

Penduka, omwenyo wange!
Pendukeni okaxumbafeta nonyalilo!
Onda hala okupendula etendo leluwa.

Omwene, onda hala oku ku tanga mokati koiwana,
onda hala ndi ku imbile mokati kovapaani.

Osheshi ouwanghenda woye tau lundu eulu,
noudiinini woye otau fiki fiyo okoilemo.

Kalunga, litumba kombada yomaulu,
nefimano loye kombada yedu alishe.
58:
Ookalunga nye, otamu popi tuu oshili?
Ovana vovanhu otamu va tokola tuu pauyuki?

Ahowe, momitima deni otamu dutile mo owii,
moshilongo otamu tandavelifa enyeko
pashiyelekifo shoumbudi womake eni.

Meni lavo ove noudiyo weyoka,
ngaashi efu efitamatwi,
eli tali lipwililikile mokuhauda ko,

noitali deuka kondaka yomudeuli,
omwiifani omunongo wao.

Kalunga, teyaula omayoo momakanya avo,
omaxuwambwa eenghoshona a teyaula po!

Nava pwiinine po,
ngaashi omeva aa taa ningine medu.
Ngeenge ta shoneke oikuti yaye,
nai kale ya fa ihe nonhele.

Ngaashi onghofya tai fi omutenya,
osho naye na nyonaukile po,
ngaashi edimo lomukainhu, eli la dja po,
noinali mona etango.

Eembiya deni, fimbo dihe udite
omundjene womundilo womakiya,
ote di kombo po noshikungulu shaye,
edi ditalala naadi da xwama.

Omuyuki eshi a mona ehandukilo lavo,
otashi mu hafifa,
neemhadi daye ote di koshele mohonde yovahenakalunga.
59:
Kalunga kange, xupife nge movatondi vange,
amene nge kovashindanhu vange!

Mangulule nge movanawii,
Ove u xupife nge kwaava hava tileshi ohonde.

Omwene, tala, osheshi vo otava nangele omwenyo wange,
ovanaenghono otava shivile nge olwoodi,
nande inandi nyona nondihe netimba.

Ame nande inandi ninga sha,
otava totele nge nokulilongekida.
Penduka, u shakeneke nge, u tale!

Heeno, Oove Omwene, Kalunga keengudu dovakwaita,
Kalunga kaIsrael, penduka,
u handukile ovapaani aveshe,
Ove, ino xupifa ko nande umwe womwaava
vehe nouyuki novehe noudiinini. Sela

Keshe onguloshi otava aluka,
ndele tava ono ngaashi eembwa,
ndele tava lyangaana noshilando.

Tala, otava fuluka onhutu mokanya,
omikonda odi li momilungu davo,
osheshi otava ti: “Olyelye mbela te shi udu?”

Ndele Omwene, Ove to shi va yolele,
novapaani aveshe oto va sheke.

Kalunga kange ota shakeneke nge nonghenda yaye;
Kalunga ota hafifa nge mokutala exutuko lovatondi vange.

Ino va dipaa manga, oshilongo shange shihe shi dimbwe.
Va shingila momapukifo neenghono doye,
ove u va xutule, Omwene, oshikelelifo shetu.

Va mana po mehandu loye,
va mana po, vaha kale po vali.
Vo nava mone, nokutya Kalunga kaJakob ota pangele
fiyo okomaxulilo ounyuni. Sela

Keshe onguloshi otava aluka,
ndele tava ono ngaashi eembwa
ndele tava lyaangana nomukunda.

Otava fimbaula, va mone, eshi tava li moufukenhu wavo,
nongeenge inava kuta, otava onaona.

Ndelenee eenghono doye onda hala oku di imba,
nakeshe ongula onda hala okunyakukilwa
ouwanghenda woye;
osheshi Ove wa kala ohote yange nomututu wokuhondama
pefimbo handi hangika koudjuu.
60:
Akutu Kalunga, Ove we tu ekelashi,
we tu halakanifa, wa handuka.
Tu alulila po natango!

Edu owe li kakamifa, owe li taula omifya.
Ove fitika omifya dalo,
osheshi oli li po tali tengauka.

Oshiwana shoye owa efa, shi monifwe oudjuu,
we tu nwefa oshikolwifa.

Ovatili voye, owe va pa epandela
opo va ongale meameno lalo komauta. Sela

Tu kwafa nolulyo loye, ovaholike voye fye,
opo tu xupifwe; tu uda.

Mouyapuki waye Kalunga okwa tonga ta ti:
“Nomokunyakukwa ohandi taula Sekem
nohandi yeleke efilu laSukkot.

Gilead oshange, naManasse oshange,
naEfraim oshange oshikelelifombale shokomutwe wange,
naJuda odibo yepangelo lange.

Olyelye ta twala nge mbela koshilando sha pama?
Olyelye wokufindikila nge kuEdom?

Haave, ou we tu ekelashi,
Kalunga, haave ito ende vali
pamwe neengudu dovakwaita detu?

Tu xupifa kovatondi vetu;
osheshi ekwafo lomunhu olongaho.

Pamwe naKalunga ohatu ka ninga oilonganghono,
nOye mwene ota ka lyataula ovatondi vetu.
61:
Kalunga, uda okwiingida kwange,
Ove didilika eilikano lange!

Moulikule wange kexulilo ledu ohandi ku ifana,
omutima wange eshi owa lololwa;
twale nge kemanya lile,
ame mwene nda nyengwa okulonda ko.

Osheshi Ove wa kala nale ehondamo lange,
nohote yange ya pama koshipala shomutondi wange.

Itavele nge ndi kale alushe metwali loye,
ndi hondame meameno lomavava oye. Sela

Osheshi, Kalunga, Ove wa uda omaudaneko ange,
wa pa nge efyuululo laava tava tila edina loye.

Wedela ko ohamba omafiku komafiku,
nomido dayo di ninge dihapu okepupi fiyo okepupi.

Osho nda hala okwiimbila edina loye
omahambelelo alushe fiyo alushe,
ndi wanife omaudaneko ange efiku nefiku.
62:
Oye aeke emanya lange, nehepuluko lange,
nohote yange; ame ihandi tengauka unene.

Fiyo onaini mwa hala nye amushe,
okukondjifa omulumenhu umwe,
mu mu nyonaune po,
a fe ekuma la endama
nongaashi ohote tai teka po?

Otava kundafana ashike omolwounene waye,
nhumbi ve mu undule ko,
ova hokwa oipupulu;
momakanya otava punike,
nomomitima otava fingaele. Sela

Lota, muKalunga amuke, omwenyo wange,
osheshi kuye otaku di eteelelo lange;

Akutu, oshiwana, mu lineekeleni alushe!
Mu mbubulileni omitima deni.
Kalunga Oye ouhondameno wetu. Sela

Ovanhu omuku wongaho,
vo aveshe ngee otava yelekwa,
aveshe vapu, ve dulike komuku.

Inamu lineekela omunyeka,
inamu liwewelekela oitinhwa yeni;
nemona ngeenge tali hapupala,
inamu mangela mo omitima deni!

Kalunga okwa popya lumwe nde shi uda luvali;
nokutya, eenghono odaKalunga.
63:
Osho ngaha onda li mouyapuki woye,
nde ku talatala,
ndi tale eenghono doye noshinge shoye,

Osho onda hala ndi ku hambelele,
fimbo ndi li po,
ame ndi yelule omaoko ange medina loye.

Omwenyo wange otau palulwa,
wa fa tau li omungo nomaadi;
nokanya kange otake ku pandula,
nomilungu di nenyakuko,

moku ku dimbulukwa momutala wange,
noku ku diladila momanangelo oufiku.

Osheshi Oove ekwafo lange,
nomomudidimbe womavava oye
ohandi nyakukwa.

Omwenyo wange owa dama mwoove;
eke loye lokolulyo otali pameke nge.

Ndelenee tava kongo omwenyo wange
nokulietela ngaha ehanauno,
otava i medu moule mwi.

Ndelenee ohamba otai hafele Kalunga,
keshe tuu ou ta ane medina layo,
ne litye, ye omunelao;
osheshi omakanya ovanaipupulu
otaa ka mwenekwa.
64:
Akutu Kalunga, uda ondaka yange mokuponga.
Amena omwenyo wange kokutila omutondi.

Holeke nge keemhangela dovanawii
nokongudu yovakolokoshi, tava uyaana,

ava, hava upike omalaka avo ngaashi omikonda,
neendjovo davo dilula otave di umbu ngaashi oikuti,

Otava dutaduta oilonga ii, tava ti:
“Fye otwa mana, omhangela yetu ya pwa.
Osheshi mokule monhulo yomunhu aushe
nomomutima waye ihamu shiivika.”

Opo tuu opo, Kalunga ote va yashe noshikuti:
otava papala ashike, eshi va ninga eendjashe.

Otava pundukifwa kelaka lavo vene,
ndele ovanhu aveshe ovo tave va mono,
otave va pukapukile komitwe.

Opo nee ovanhu aveshe otava haluka,
ndele tava hepaulula osho Kalunga e shi ninga,
ndele tava diladila oshilonga osho shaye.

Omuyuki ota hafele mOmwene,
ndele te mu lineekele,
naaveshe, ava ve nomutima wa yuka,
otave mu fimaneke.
65:
Oove, Omuudi womailikano,
ombelela aishe i nokuuya kwoove.

Owii wange omuhapu unene;
ndelenee Ove to tu dimine po omanyono etu.

Omunelao ou, we mu hoolola,
ndele oto itavele a ehene kwoove,
ye a kale momikala doye,
opo fye tu palulwe kouwa weumbo loye,
mouyapuki wotembeli yoye.

Oove ho tu nyamukula noikumwifa mouyuki,
Kalunga kexupifo letu,
Oove eameno lomaxulilo aeshe edu
nolomafuta okokulekule,

ou, ho diki eemhunda meenghono doye,
ndele wa mangwa nekwamo leenghono,

noho lotifa engungumo lomafuta,
engungumo lomakufikufi ao,
nomakolokoto ovanhu,

opo nee ovanhu vokomaxulilo edu,
vo va tile oidimbulukifo yoye;
noilongo ei ya shiya ko
koushilo nokoutokelo, to i yadifa ehafo.

Oto tutike oimhungu yalo,
noto hendifa eehenda dalo,
oto li pupaleke noihomo yodula,
nomumeno walo oto u nangeke noupuna.

Omudo oto u wapeke nouwa woye,
noshikoti shoye oto shi shishifile omaadi.

Nomwiidi womaulifilo, outalala mboomboo,
noikulundudu ya djala enyakuko.
66: Edu alishe, kuwilila Kalunga!

Imbileni efimano ledina laye ehambelelo,
neimbilopandulo laye nali mone etumbaloshinge.

Tyeni kuKalunga: “Oilonga yoye ikumwifa oi fike peni!
Molwouyadi weenghono doye,
ovatondi voye otave linyongamene kwoove.

Oilongo aishe oi nokulinyongamena kwoove
noku ku imbila,
nokwiimbila edina loye ehambelelo.” Sela

Ileni, mu tale oilonga yaKalunga,
ou ta kumwifa mokukala kwaye kombada yovanhu.

Oiwana nye, tangeni Kalunga ketu,
efimano laye nali udike mokule!

Oye e tu pa omwenyo,
neemhadi detu ine di efa, di fenhuke.

Heeno, Kalunga, Ove we tu pepela tuu,
owe tu yelifa ngaashi outale woshisiliveli tau yelifwa.

Owa efa, tu yulwe keendjadja,
nowe tu kuminika oudjuu mudjuu meembuda detu;

Owa efa, ovanhu va ende kombada yomitwe detu,
otwa li hatu taulula omundilo nomeva;
ndelenee hauxuuninwa owe tu kufa mo,
nowe tu twala mouyadi.

Onde uya meumbo loye nomalungwinifoyambo,
onde ku wanifila omaudaneko ange,

oo nde a tonga nomilungu dange,
nokanya kange ke e ku udanekela, eshi nda li moudjuu.

Onde uya, nde ku etela omalungwinifoyambo,
eedi da ondoka,
nomwifi wetwimino loikombo;
onda hala okulongekida eedidi neehove. Sela

Ileni amushe, mu pwilikine,
nye ava hamu tila Kalunga,
ndi mu hepaululile ashishe,
eshi Ye a ningila omwenyo wange.

Ame onda ifana kuye mokule nokanya kange,
nehambelelo ola holokela shimwe melaka lange.

Ngeno nda diladila owii momutima wange,
Omwene ngeno ina uda nge.

Ndelenee Kalunga okwa uda nge nokuli,
okwa dimbulukwa eindilo lange.

Kalunga na fimanekwe,
ou ina dina eindilo lange,
nouwanghenda waye ine u nyekulula nge.
67:
Kalunga ne tu file onghenda, Ye ne tu punike,
Oye ne tu minikilile oshipala shaye. Sela

Opo kombada yedu ku shiivike ondjila yoye,
nomokati koiwana yovapaani exupifo loye.

Kalunga, oiwana yoilongo oi noku ku fimaneka,
oiwana aishe yoilongo kumwe nai ku fimaneke.

Omaludi nomaludi naa hafe nokukuwilila,
molwaashi to tokola oiwana nouyuki,
noto kwatele omaludi kombada yedu komesho. Sela

Kalunga, oiwana yoilongo oi noku ku fimaneka,
oiwana aishe kumwe yoilongo nai ku fimaneke.

Edu oli li po la menifa omumeno walo:
fye ohatu ka punikwa kuKalunga, Kalunga ketu.

Kalunga ne tu nangeke noupuna.
Ndele Oye na tilike fiyo okeexulo adishe dounyuni.
68:
Kalunga ota fikama; novatondadi vaye otave lihane ashike,
novatondi vaye otava i onhapo yoshipala shaye.

Ngaashi omwifi tau i omhepo ngeenge tai pepe,
nongaashi edi leenyiki tali dilulwa komundilo,
osho yo ovakolokoshi otava hanauka po
koshipala shaKalunga.

Ndelenee ovayuki otava hafe nokunyakukwa
koshipala shaKalunga,
ehafo otali va kalukifa eenghalu.

Imbileni Kalunga, imbileni edina laye ehambelelo.
Mu paleleni ondjila, ou ta taulula neulumo meefuka,
Omwene olo edina laye;
nyakukweni koshipala shaye!

Oye xe yeefiye nomuyukifi wovafiyekadi,
Kalunga moukalelo waye uyapuki.

Kalunga ota dikile omawilandjila eumbo,
neenghwate ote di pitifile moulinawa;
ndelenee ovanandubo ove nokutulwa
moshilongo shi nonghange.

Akutu Kalunga, eshi wa endifa mo ovanhu voye,
nowe va tetekelela, ndele tamu taulula eefuka. Sela

Opo nee edu ola kakama, neulu la tika omeva
koshipala shaKalunga,
naSinai ya kakama koshipala shaKalunga,
Kalunga kaIsrael.

Kalunga, odula iwa wa shamina efyuululo loye;
ngeenge la loloka, Ove owe li pameka vali.

Eengudu doye oda mona mo onhele;
molwouwa woye owe li longekidila omapongo.

Omwene okwa yandja ondjovo,
ongudu inene yovakainhu tai twala ondaka yefindano:

“Eehamba doikulo oda ya onhapo, da ya onhapo,”
nomukainhu ota tukula oihakanwa.

Tamu fyaala mokati koyuunda yoimuna?
Omavava onghuti otaa vema,
a vaekwa noshisiliveli,
nomalwenya ayo taa twima ngaashi oshingoldo.

Omunaenghono adishe eshi a halakanifa eehamba,
opo nee eemhawe da paukila kombada yaSalmon.

Omhunda yaBasan, omhunda oove yaKalunga,
omhunda yaBasan, oove ou, u na eexulo dihapu.

Eemhunda nye, ava mu neexulo dihapu,
oshike tamu talele nondubo
omhunda ei ya hoololwa kuKalunga
a kale ko omutumba?
Heeno, Kalunga oko ta kala alushe.

Omatemba oita aKalunga,
oo omayovi omulongo eyovi lweyovi;
Omwene ota kala mokati kavo,
moukalelo waye, ngaashi kuSinai.

Ove wa londa pombada
neenghwate we di twaalela ko,
owa pewa omilongelo kovanhu,
nande ihava dulika,
opo Omwene Kalunga a kale ko.

Fye otu na Kalunga, Oye Kalunga Omuxupifi,
nOmwene, Omwene ou ha shiiva okuxupifa mefyo.

Heeno omitwe dovatondi vaye,
Kalunga ote di mbwangaula eembole,
neexwikiluwewe da handala dovaanyeni momanyono.

Omwene okwa tya:
“MuBasan nda hala ndi va alule mo,
heeno, ohandi va kufa moule womeva, ndi va shunife,

Oove, u koshe eemhadi doye mohonde,
nomalaka eembwa doye a mone po shao movatondi voye.”

Akutu Kalunga, otaku talwa
nhumbi oyeendo yoshivilo shoye tai ende,
oyeendo yoshivilo yaKalunga kange
noyohamba yange otai ende mouyapuki.

Ovaimbi otava tetekele, novashiki
vouxumbafeta otava shikula ko,
nomokati kavo otamu ende oukadona tava shiki oungoma.

Nye veengudu adishe, hambeleleni Kalunga,
nye vomofifiya yaIsrael, hambeleleni Omwene.

Kwinya taku ende Benjamin, ou onghelo,
te va kwatele komesho,
oko otaku ende omalenga aJuda nongudu yavo
noidale yaSebulon naava vaNaftali.

Kalunga koye e ku sheyela eenghono doye.
Akutu Kalunga, shi diinina,
eshi we tu ningila!

Molwotembeli yoye muJerusalem,
eehamba otadi ke ku etela omilongelo.

Hanyena oshilyani, shi li mokati komanenge,
nongudu yeemhedi noyoutana, vo oiwana yoilongo.
Lyataula po ava ve hole oisiliveli,
oiwana yoilongo, oyo i hole oita, i shinauna po.

Otaku uya ovatumwa tava di muEgipiti;
nOvaetiopia tava ka yelula omake okwiindila Kalunga.

Akutu omauhamba nye kombada yedu, imbileni Kalunga,
imbileni Omwene ehambelelo. Sela

Oye ou ta uluma momaulu omokulekule alushelushe!
Pwilikineni ondaka yaye, ondaka i neenghono.

Peni Kalunga eenghono daye!
Oshinge shaye otashi kala kombada yaIsrael,
neenghono daye omoilemo.

Kalunga omutilifi, mouyapuki waye otamu di etilifo.
Akutu Israel! Kalunga kaIsrael,
Oye ta yandje eenghono nepangelo koshiwana shaye.
Kalunga na hambelelwe!
69:
Kalunga, xupife nge,
osheshi omeva taa fiki nokuli pomwenyo wange;

ohandi ningine monhopo ihe na nande edu la pama,
onda hanga mokati koule wefuta,
nomakufikufi otaa tuvikile nge.

Onda loloka kokukuwa kwange,
omunino wange owa fita;
omesho ange okwa dinda kokulila kwange,
manga ndi li po nda teelela Kalunga kange.

Ava tava tondo nge epwanga, ovahapu,
ve dule omuvalu weexwiki dange,
ovatondi vange otava dulu nge eenghono,
tava kondjifa nge ndihe noushima,
vo tava ti, nandi fute, eshi inandi shi nyeka ko.

Akutu Kalunga, Ove to shiiva oushima wange,
nomanyono ange inae ku holekwa.

Ava tave ku teelele, ino efa,
va fifwe ohoni molwange,
Omwene Kalunga keengudu dovakwaita.
Molwange ino efa va lengifwe,
ava tave ku teelele, Kalunga kaIsrael.

Osheshi molwoye ohandi shekwa,
oshipala shange sha tuvikwa kohoni.

Ame nda ninga omunailongo kovamwameme,
itandi dimbulukiwa vali ovana ovamati vameme.

Ame, omwenyo wange owa kwena
nokulidilika eendja,
ndele osha monifa nge ashike omatukano.

Onda djala omudjalo woluhodi,
ndele vo otava tale nge oshiyolifa shavo.

Ovanhu vomeendabo dokulandela
aame tava shashala,
neengholwe otadi imbile nge.

Ndele Omwene, ame ohandi ku ilikana
pefimbo eli le ku wapalela, Kalunga,
molwolukeno loye linene,
ude nge, molwounene wonghenda yoye.

omakufikufi opo aha ninginife nge,
noule womeva uha pone nge po,
