nombwili iha umikile nge mo.

Nomupiya woye ino mu holeka oshipala shoye,
osheshi ndi li moudjuu. Ude nge diva.

Ehena komwenyo wange, u u kulile;
xupife nge molwovatondi vange.

Odino yange oya teya omutima wange,
nda ninga oshingone,
onda li kuteelela onghenda,
ndele inandi i mona,
onda li kuteelela ovahekeleki,
ndele inava holoka.

Ahowe, ova pa nge nokuli, ndi lye onyango,
naashi nda fya enota,
ova pa nge ndi nwe oshinuwa shilula.

Oshililo shavo nashi va shitukile elulo,
sho shi ninge oshiliwa shokukwata ovalineekeli muvo vene.

Wiwika omesho avo, vaha mone ko;
tifaukifa oiya yavo, i tifauke alushe.

Ehandu loye li tilashi kombada yavo,
va tikukila noupyu wonya yoye!

Eenhanda davo nadi ninge omaputu,
momatwali avo muha kale nande omunhu.

Osheshi otava taataa ou,
a dengwa kwoove mwene,
nouyehame weendjashe da yashwa kwoove,
otau va popyaanifa.

Weda ko oikolotimba koikolotimba yavo,
vo vaha hange kouyuki wokoshipala shoye.

Nava dimwe mo membo lomwenyo,
vaha kale va shangelwa pamwe novayuki voye.

Ndelenee aame omunamupya nomuyehami;
Kalunga, ekwafo loye nali hondameke nge.

Onda hala okutanga edina laKalunga neimbilo,
ndi mu tumbaleke pombada nehambelelo;

ondi shii lo otali pandwa kOmwene,
li dule eemhedi neehove,
edi da teyaula nodi nomakondo a makulwa!

Ovahepekwa ngeenge tave shi mono, otashi va hafifa.
Nye ovo, tamu kongo Kalunga,
omitima deni nadi penduke po!

Osheshi Omwene ota udu eehepele,
Ye ita dini ovakwatwa vaye.

Eulu nedu nali mu fimaneke, nomafuta,
naashishe eshi tashi linyenge mo.

Osheshi Kalunga ota xupifa Sion,
ndele ta tungululifa oilando yaJuda,
opo ovanhu va tule mo, ve shi nangale.

Noludalo lovapiya vaye otave shi fyuululifwa,
naava ve hole edina laye,
ovo tava kalelele mo.
70:
Akutu Kalunga, endelela u xupife nge,
Omwene, uluma, u kwafe nge!

Ovanangeli vomwenyo wange nava fifwe ohoni,
yo i va pembife oipala!
Nava fifwe ohoni ava tava halele nge omupya,
nava shunifwe monima nokufifwa ohoni.

Nava twalwe onhapo kokutondwa kwavo,
ava tava tanhe tava ti:
“Shalongo, shalongo shange!”

Ndelenee ava aveshe, tave ku kongo,
va nyakukwe nokuhafa mwoove.
Naava hava djuulukwa exupifo loye,
alushe nava hepaulule va tye:
“Kalunga Oye omunene!”

Ndelenee aame omukwanaluhepo nepongo.
Akutu Kalunga, tondokele nge!
Oove omukwafi nomuxupifi wange.
Omwene, ino kala ko!
71:
Kwoove, Omwene, oko handi kongo ouhondameno,
ino efa ndi fifwe ohoni nande fiyo alushe.

Kwafe nge, Ove u mangulule nge molwouyuki woye!
Ehenifa okutwi kwoye kwaame u xupife nge.

Kala emanya lokukala kwange,
nohote ya pama yokuningina mo.
Ove ou wa sheyela nge exupifo,
osheshi Oove emanya lange nohote yange.

Kalunga kange, mangulule nge meke lomuhenakalunga,
meengonyo domukolokoshi nomumonifi woixuna!

Osheshi Oove elineekelo lange, Omwene, Kalunga kange,
Oove omulineekelwa wange,
nghee nda dja mounona wange.

Vahapu ove wete nge ndi kumwifa;
ndelenee Ove u li po ehondamo lange la pama.

Okanya kange oke yadi ehambelelo loye,
nefimaneko loye omafiku aeshe.

Ino ekela nge shi mefimbo loukulupe wange,
Ove ino efa nge, ngee eenghono tadi fii nge po.

Osheshi ovatondi vange otava popi nge,
naava tava halele nge onhiko,
otava kundafanene nge,

Akutu, Kalunga, ino kala kokule naame!
Kalunga kange, endelela u kwafe nge!

Ava, tave lidengifa nge, nava fifwe ohoni, nava kombwe po.
Ava tava etele nge oixuna,
nava dikwe elengwa nodino.

Ndelenee ame onda hala okuteelela efimbo alishe,
nokutandavelifa efimano loye.

Onda hala okuhololela po oinenelonga yOmwene Kalunga,
ndi tange ouyuki woye, woye auke.

Akutu Kalunga, Oove, wa longa nge
okudja mounona wange fiyo onena,
nofiyo onena tuu eli onda hepaulula oikumwifa yoye,

nomokufika moukulupe wange,
ngeenge nda ninga eenghwakutoka,
Kalunga, Ove ino efa nge!
Ame opo nee ndi udifile epupi lokomesho
eenghono dokwooko kwoye.

Oto ka wedela nge nokuli koukulunhu wange,
ndele to hekeleke nge vali.

Hano, Kalunga kange, osho naame yo
nda hala ndi ku hambelelele oudiinini woye,
noku ku shikila eenyalilo,
ndi ku imbile nokushika okaxumbafeta,
Oove Omuyapuki waIsrael!

Omilungu dange nadi twe eenghalu
noku ku imbila kwange,
nosho yo omwenyo wange, ou wa kulila.
72:
Akutu Kalunga, yandja kohamba
onghedi yokutokola kwoye,
nokomona wohamba ouyuki woye,

yo i pangele ovanhu voye nouyuki,
noi yukifile omapongo oye.

Eemhunda nadi etele oshiwana ombili
noikulundudu ouyuki.

Oyo nai pe eehepele domovanhu eyukifilo,
i xupife omapongo, noi lyataule omufininiki.

Ovo tave ku tila, etango manga tali minikile
nohani tai kala komapupi nomapupi.

Nai ehene poshi, ngaashi odula tai loko
kombada yomwiidi womaulifilo,
ngaashi omudimbi tau yovele edu.

Momafiku ayo omuyuki ta kala a temuna,
nombili oi yadi mo, fiyo ohani ya fya ko.

Oyo nai pangele kefuta limwe fiyo okulikwao,
okomulonga waEufrat fiyo okexulilo ledu.

Novakwananghali tave ke i twila eengolo,
novatondi vayo nava lafe ondwi koshipala shayo.

Eehamba domuTarsis nodomoilongo
yokomunghulo wefuta nadi i etele omilongelo.
Eehamba daSheba naSeba otadi kungudwa.

Heeno, oyo oi nokulinyongamenwa koshipala shaye,
noiwana yovapaani i noku ke i longela.

Osheshi otai ka xupifa epongo
eli tali kuu onghuwo li kwafwe,
nomukwanaluhepo ou ehe na omukwafi.

Otai ningile omuxupi nohepele olukeno,
notai xupifa eemwenyo deehepele;

ndele tai di kulile momafininiko nomomalwifo,
nohonde yado otai i tale i nondilo.

Moshilongo namu kale oshishipo shoilya,
yo i mene fiyo okeexulo deemhunda;
omiti doiimati dasho nadi ime ngaashi Libanon,
nomoilando namu pimhuke mo ovanhu,
ngaashi omwiidi tau twiyuka medu.

Edina layo nali kale po fiyo alushe,
fimbo oku netango, edina layo nali twalwatwalwe,
opo oiwana aishe i nangekwe noupuna muyo
noku i pandula yo i nelao.

Kalunga Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael na fimanekwe,
ou ha longo oikumwifalonga, Ye aeke!

Edina laye liwa la fimana nali pandulwe fiyo alushe,
nedu alishe nali yadifwe noshinge shaye!
Amen, heeno, Amen.

Apa opo opa xulila
omailikano aDavid, omona waIsai.
73:
Oshili, Kalunga ota kala naIsrael e yadi ouwa
kwaaveshe ava ve nomutima wa yela.

Osheshi onda li handi mbilingwa molwovalinenepeki,
eshi nda mona ovakolokoshi ve li nawa.

Osheshi vo ihava mono nande omayehamo asha,
omalutu avo okwa pama, a ondoka.

Ihava hangika koiponga ngaashi ovakwadu vamwe,
vo ihava monifwa oixuna ngaashi ovanhu vakwao.

Onghee hano elitumbaleko lavo
olo omudjalo womeefingo davo,
oukolokoshi oo oshiliuvikifo shavo.

Omesho avo okwa tumhaanifwa mo komaondo avo,
nomadiladilo omitima davo otaa lundakana.

Ohava sheke nohava popi owii,
ndele tava tongo eendjovo,
itava yavala sha melitumbo lavo.

Omakanya avo otaa findi keulu,
nomalaka avo otaa ende kombada yedu.

Molwaasho ovanhu otava pilukile kuvo,
nomeva omahongaulo avo
otave e likokomwene, itava fuda.

Otava ti: “Kalunga ote shi shiiva ngahelipi mbela?
Otashi shiivika kwaau wOkombadambada ngahelipi hano?”

Taleni, ovakolokoshi osho ve li ngaha,
nomokuhatila sha kwavo otave lindubilile omamona avo.

Akutu, inashi kwafa sha nande,
eshi nda lungamena oukoshoki womutima wange,
naashi nda kosha omake ange mouyuki.

Nande onda li ngaha,
onda kala nda hepekwa omutenya aushe,
nakeshe tuu ongula ehepeko lange opo li li.

Ndelenee ngeno nda li nda tya:
“Nandi popye ngaashi venya hava popi,”
ngeno onda ninga omulikali mwii woludi lovana voye.

Opo nee nda hetekela oku shi tetaateta, ndi shi koneke;
ndelenee osha nyenga eendunge dange,

fiyo nda tyuukila mouyapuki waKalunga
nonda didilika exulilo lavo, nghee li li.

Heeno shili, Ove to va tula pomufenhu,
noto efa, va wile po va teyauke.

Ohava hanauka mehangelelo li fike peni,
ohava vakulwa po ndele tava mono exulilo lehalukifo.

Ngeno okwa li nda lulilwa natango momutima,
nondi keshuke meni lange,

ngeno ondi mulai shili, ndihe na nande eendunge,
nda fa oshimuna shongaho koshipala shoye.

Nande ongaha, handi anyene pwoove:
Ove u kwete nge nawa kolulyo lange.

Oto endifa nge pamhangela yoye mwene,
ndele komesho to ka tambula nge moshinge.

Olyelye vali ndi kwete meulu, ehe fi Ove?
Nokombada yedu nghi na nande oshihafifi shimwe,
shihe fi Ove.

Olutu lange nomutima wange nande nai pwinine po,
Kalunga Oove emanya lomutima wange nokuli
noshitukulwa shange.

Osheshi osho oshili: ou te likalele ehe li mwoove,
ota nyonauka po;
keshe tuu ou, ta amuka kwoove,
oto mu kombo po sheke.
74:
Akutu Kalunga, oshike we tu ekelelashi fiyo alushe,
needi doufita woye, oshike we di fulila onya?

Dimbulukwa eongalo loye, eli we liongelela nalenale,
nowe li likulilila, li kale epata loyelela.
Dimbulukwa omhunda yaSion,
ei ho kala kombada yayo.

Opa fa omufitu, ou ovanhu ve u yedela omakuva,
ndele tave u tetaula po.

Ndele paife ve li po tava xwandaula yo
oihongwa yayo aishe youlenga nomakuva neendjudo.

Ouyapuki woye ove u xwika po,
onhele yedina loye ove i nyateka nai
fiyo okomukangha.

Momitima davo ova tya:
“Tu va nyonauneni po shimwe.”
Opo nee eengulu adishe dokwoongalela
ove di xwika po moshilongo ashishe.

Oiulikilifo yetu iyapuki itatu i mono vali;
kape na vali omuxunganeki,
ndele mufye kamu na umwe
ta shiiva nokutya, fiyo onaini.

Akutu Kalunga, fiyo onaini hano to efa
omunafundo e tu sheke,
nomutondi a kale ta sheke edina loye?

Molwashike mbela to alula eke loye?
Ahowe, nana olulyo loye monghwapa,
u va nyonaune po.

Kalunga, Oove ohamba yange yonale, nghee nda dja;
oshilonga shexupifo oho shi longo kombada yedu.

Meenghono doye owa li wa tukula efuta pokati,
nomitwe deengadu owe di nyanyaulila kombada yomeva.

Oove ou, wa tetaulile omitwe daLeviatan,
ndele to di pe oifitukuti yomofuka, di liwe po.

Oove ou, wa fulukifile eedjo nomilola, nomilonga,
edi da li da tondoka omeva nale, owe di pwiininifa.

Omutenya owoye noufiku owoye,
Oove ou, wa tula ko omaminikilo keulu.

Omwene, shi dimbulukwa,
omutondi eshi te ku sheke,
oshiwana sha laipala, otashi dini edina loye.

Omwenyo wonghuti yoye ino u efela koilyani,
oukalimwenyo wovakwanaluhepo voye
ino u dimbwa fiyo alushe.

Dimbulukwa ehangano letu nanye!
Osheshi oikololo yoshilongo
oiyadi eenhele doumbudi.

Ino efa omufininikwa a dje po a limbililwa;
eehepele nomapongo nava tange edina loye.

Akutu Kalunga, fikama,
kondjela oshikondjelwa shoye!
Didilika omasheko, eshi to shekwa
kovapwidi keshe efiku.

Ove ino dimbwa omauyaano ovatondi voye,
nomakolokoto ovakondjifi voye aa itaa dimbuka.
75:
Ohatu ku tange, Kalunga,
noku ku hambelela unene;
osheshi edina loye oli li popepi,
oikumwifalonga yoye oyo have i udifa.

Ngeenge ndi wete nokutya efimbo ola fika,
opo handi tokola etokolo la yuka.

Edu nande nali tengauke pamwe novakwadu aveshe:
Aame ou, handi pameke eengudi dalo. Sela

Ohandi lombwele ovalinenepeki: “Inamu linenepeka.”
Nokovalundakani: “Inamu tanganeka oluvinga;

oluvinga leni inamu li tanganekela ngaho.
Inamu liyeka eefingo okupopya eendjovo delitumbo.”

Osheshi enenepeko loovene
itali di koushilo ile kouninginino,
koumbuwanhu ile koumbangalanhu,

ahowe, Kalunga Oye tuu ou omutokoli;
umwe ote mu ninipike, nomukwao ote mu nenepeke.

Osheshi Omwene oku kwete eholo meke laye,
li yadi ndoo omaviinyu taa fuluka,
mwa tulwa oimbodi yokukolwifa;
ndele ota pindi mo, heeno,
ovalundakani aveshe vokombada yedu
ove nokunwa yo onhafi yao.

Ndelenee ame ondi nonhele yokunyakukwa alushe,
onda hala okwiimba,
okwiimbilila Kalunga kaJakob ehambelelo.

Omaluvinga aeshe ovalundakani,
nda hala oku a tetaula po,
neembinga dovayuki ohandi di tumbu pombada.
76:
Kalunga okwa shiivika apeshe muJuda,
edina laye linene muIsrael.

Osheshi ondjuwo yaye oya tungwa muSalem,
ongulu yaye okukala mo komhunda yaSion.

Oko tuu oko a teyaula oikutiluvadi yomauta,
noshikelelifo, neongamukonda noiti yavo aishe. Sela

Ove wa dja moshinge nomeenghonopangelo
keemhunda doihakanwafindano.

Ovakwaita ovaladi ova nyekwa oiti,
ova li va kendjengelwa keemhofi didjuu,
novaladi aveshe ova fya oungonywe momaoko avo.

Eingido leaneko loye ola kambukifa
omatemba neenghambe, Kalunga kaJakob.

Heeno, Oove omutilifi,
olyelye ta dulu okukala koshipala shoye
fiku to handuka?

Keulu taku di eshiivifo letokolo loye,
opo edu la haluka la kanghwa,

eshi Kalunga a fikama okutokola,
a xupife ovafininikwa aveshe kombada yedu. Sela

Osheshi onyanya yovanhu
otai ku shitukifile efimaneko,
poxuuninwa eshi to lidike omitemo dehandu.

Tongeni omaudaneko
nye mu a wanifile Omwene, Kalunga keni!
Aveshe ovo tave mu kundukile,
ove nokweetela onakutilika omaano,

Oye tuu, ta xutula outuwalali wovakwananghali,
ndele ta tilifa eehamba dokombada yedu.
77:
Ohandi ingida Kalunga mokule, heeno,
ohandi lili pombada,
ohandi ingida Kalunga mokule, opo Ye a ude nge.

Ngeenge handi diladila Kalunga,
otashi kemifa nge,
ngeenge handi shipaashipa,
otashi fifa omhepo yange ounye. Sela

Eemhafu dange ito di pe eemhofi;
onda piyaana, ndele itandi dulu okupopya.

Ohandi shipulula omafiku onale,
omido edi da pita donalenale;

Oufiku ohandi dimbulukwa okaxumbafeta kange,
ohandi tetaateta momutima wange,
nomhepo yange otai dilonga ndele tai ti:

“Omwene oha ekelele nge fiyo alushe mbela,
Ye aha file nge vali onghenda nande?

Ouwanghenda waye owa oka nee fiyo alushe?
Omaudaneko aye itaa kala po nande vali?

Kalunga a dimbwa tuu mbela okufya onghenda,
ile olukeno laye la fitikwa kehandu laye?” Sela

Opo nee nde lipopila, nda tya:
“Otashi yehameke nge unene,
ou wOkombadambada eshi a lundulula
eke laye lokolulyo.”

Onda hala okudimbulukwa oinenelonga yOmwene,
heeno, okudimbulukwa oikumwifalonga yoye yonale,

onda hala ndi diladile okulonga kwoye
nokufekafeka oiningwa yoye inene.

Akutu Kalunga, ondjila yoye oiyapukielela,
Kalunga ke lipipo munene ke fike pwoove, Kalunga?

Oove tuu Kalunga, ho longo oikumwifa,
Oove ou wa shiivifa eenghono doye
mokati koiwana yoilongo.

Owa kulila oshiwana shoye
nokwooko kwa pama,
ovana ovamati vaJakob novaJosef. Sela

Omeva eshi kwa li e ku mona, Kalunga,
omeva eshi tae ku mono, oshe a kakamifa,
heeno, ekakamo la hanga omatondokelo omeva.

Oilemo oya lokifa odula ya pauka,
omaulu a pwalakatifa eembadi,
noikuti yoye oye liumba.

Engungumo londaka yoye ola udika mevalelwa,
nomaluvadi okwa minikila edu,
olo nola kakama la tengauka.

Ondjila yoye oya yukilila momeva efuta,
elila loye ola tavaulula omafuta manene;
ndelenee oshikoti sheenghatu doye
inashi monika nande.

Owa endifila oshiwana shoye ngaashi eedi,
keke laMoses naAron.
78:
Oshiwana shange, pwilikina omalongo ange;
endekeleni omatwi eni keendjovo domokanya kange.

Onda hala okumakula okanya kange,
ndi popye omayele,
onda hala okutomona eetumbutumbu domafiku onale.

Eshi twa uda, naashi twa mona,
notwe shi hepaululilwa kootate,

osho inatu hala oku shi holeka ovana vetu,
ndelenee ohatu hepaululile ovatekulululwa
oilonga ya fimana yOmwene,
neenghono daye, noikumwifa e i longa.

Osheshi muJakob okwa dika mo ehepaululo,
nomuIsrael okwa yandja mo omhango,
e i lombwela ootate,
vo ve i udifile ounona vavo,

vo vaha kale ngaashi ooxe,
ava va li va lundakana,
nova xuma, oludi li nomutima u neteke,
nomhepo yalo ihe kwete okutekuka kuKalunga.

Ovana vaEfraim,
ava va li ovakwataiti mokushiiva okuyasha,
efiku loita eshi le uya, ova ya onhapo.

Inava kwatelelela mehangano laKalunga
nova anya okweenda pamhango yaye,

ndelenee ova dimbwa oinenelonga yaye
noikumwifalonga e i va monifile.

Okwa li a longa oilonga yoixuna
monhanaisho yooxe
momahenene aSoan,
moshilongo shaEgipiti.

Okwa tukula omeva, ndele te va pitifa mo,
okwe a dika ngaashi ohote.

Omutenya okwe va endifa moshilemo,
noufiku aushe onomutemo womundilo.

Okwa panda omamanya mombuwa,
ndele te va nwefa mo momeva taa kunguluka.

Memanya okwa pitifa mo eedjo,
nokwa kungulukifa omeva a fa omilonga.

Ndelenee vo inava efa okunyona kuye,
ova handukifa ou wOkombadambada mombuwa.

Ova yeleka Kalunga momitima davo,
eshi va pula eendja pauhalu wavo,

ova twifa Kalunga eemhata, tava ti:
“Kalunga ota dulu tuu mbela
oku tu yalela oshililo mombuwa?

Heeno, okwa denga emanya,
ndele mwa dja omeva mahapu,
neefifiya da kunguluka;
ndelenee ota dulu tuu mbela okuyandja eendja
ile okukongela oshiwana shaye ombelela?”

Onghee hano, Omwene eshi e shi uda, okwa keshuka,
nomundilo owa xwamenena Jakob,
nehandu laye ola wila Israel,

osheshi inava itavela Kalunga,
vo inave lineekela ekwafo laye.

Opo okwa lombwela oilemo yokombada,
ndele ta yeulula oivelo yeulu,

ndele te va lokifile omanna,
va mone eshi tava li,
ndele te va pe oilya yeulu.

Ovanhu va lya omungome wovaengeli
va tuminwa eendja dihapu kuye.

Okwa pendula keulu omhepo yokoushilo,
nomeenghono daye okwa pepifa
omhepo yokoumbuwanhu.

Okwa lokifila ombelela ihapu ngaashi ondwi yedu,
eedila di fike pehekedu lopefuta.

Mokati komatwali avo okwe di wilifa
mo keembinga adishe deenhele davo.

Opo vo va lya, va kuta va kenywa,
Ye okwa mwenifa omalilila avo.

Ndelenee fimbo inava wanifa olwisho lavo,
neendja fimbo da li natango momakanya avo,

opo tuu ehandu laKalunga ole va wila,
ndele tali pondo po ovanaenghono mokati kavo,
novamati vomuIsrael okwe va denga poshi.

Ndele nande opa ningwa ngaha,
inava efa okunyona,
vo inava itavela oikumwifalonga yaye.

Onghee hano Ye okwa xulifa po omafiku avo
ngaashi okaulapepo,
nomido davo omeulumo letilifo.

Eshi e va yandja mefyo ngaha,
opo vo ove mu lipulaapulila ndele tave lialuka,
ndele tava kongo Kalunga,

ndele tava dimbulukwa,
nokutya Kalunga Oye emanya lavo,
naKalunga ou wOkombadambada
Oye Omukulili wavo.

osheshi omitima davo inadi dama shili kuye,
vo inava diinina nawa ehangano laye.

Ndelenee Ye okwa kala omunalukeno,
nowii wavo e u kufa po,
nokwa polifa luhapu ehandu laye melididimiko,
Ye ina pendula onya yaye aishe;

osheshi Ye e va dimbulukwa, ovo ombelela,
okaulapepo aka taka pepe po
ndele itaka aluka vali.

Omapa e fike peni, aa va twa ondubo naye mombuwa,
naa ve mu lilifa mofuka!

Ndele alushe ova li va shinda Kalunga,
nova handukifa Omuyapuki waIsrael.

Inava dimbulukwa eke laye leenghono,
nefiku olo, e va xupifile kovatondi vavo,

eshi a ningile oidimbulukifo yaye muEgipiti
noikumwifalonga yaye muSoan.

Oye a shitukifa omilonga davo ohonde,
nomomifima davo inava dula okunwa mo;

omawashe e va tuminine, e va lye,
nomafuma aa tae va nyono po.

Noimeno yavo aishe e i efele
i like po kokanakalombo,
naashishe eshi va longele, okoshipaxu.

Omiviinyu davo okwe di teyaulifile po keemhawe,
nomikwiyu onoshikungulu shinene.

Oimuna yavo okwe i dipaifile keemhawe,
nomaufita avo oneembadi.

Okwe va kupulile nomundilo wehandu laye,
nokufula onya, nonyanya noudjuu,
ndele te va tumine ongudu yovaengeli vomupya.

okwa dipaifile oiveli aishe yomuEgipiti,
oiveli oyo yeenghono davo momatwali aHam.

Opo nee a pitifile oshiwana shaye ngaashi eedi,
ndele te shi endifa mofuka ngaashi oufita weedi,

te va endifa, e va kelela nawa, vo vaha tile sha,
ndelenee ovatondi vavo ote va tuvikile nefuta.

Osho ngaha okwa li e va twala konhele yaye iyapuki,
komhunda ei, okwe i likongelele nolulyo laye.

Komesho yavo okwa taataele ko oiwana yovapaani,
noshilongo shavo okwe shi va taulila efyuululo,
nokwa nangeka omapata aIsrael momaumbo avo.

Ndelenee vo ova yelekela
Kalunga ou wOkombadambada,
va twa ondubo naye,
ndele itava diinine omahepaululo aye.

Ove mu pa ombuda,
nove mu ninga oukululufi va fa ooxe,
va shuna lwanima ngaashi outa wa yululuka.

Otave mu handukifa momiulu davo, omo va fiyawila,
ndele tave mu shindifa oikalunga yavo.

Kalunga eshi e shi udite, okwa keshuka,
ndele ta ekeleshi shili Ovaisraeli.

Okwa efa ongulu yaye muSilo,
outulilo waye, omo a kalele mokati kovanhu.

Okwa yandja eenghono daye moukwatwa,
noshifimanekwa shaye omomake ovatondi.

Ovanhu vaye okwe va yandja momukonda,
ovafyuululifwa vaye okwe va umanena.

Ovamati vaye ova lafwa po komundilo,
novafuko vaye ova lumbulwa omaimbilo omhoko.

Ovapristeli vavo ova dipawa nomukonda,
novafiyekadi vavo inava lila nande eenghali.

Opo nee Omwene okwa duduluka,
ngaashi ou kwa li a kofa,
nongaashi ofule, ou kwa li a kolwa komaviinyu.

Ovakondjifi vaye okwe va denga noku va taataa,
nokwe va tula melengwa laalushe.

Ndelenee etulilo laJosef okwe li efa,
nepata laEfraim ine li hoolola vali,

ndele okwe lihoololela epata laJuda,
omhunda yaSion e i hokwa po;

ndele ta tungu ouyapuki waye,
u fike poule wevalelwa,
owa fa edu, eli a shita okukala po fiyo alushe.

Opo nee okwe lihoololela omupiya waye David,
ou a kufa moyuunda yeedi;

ote mu kufa meedi deenyali,
Ye a life Jakob, oshiwana shaye,
naIsrael efyuululo laye.

Oye tuu okwa li te va lifa nomutima wa yukilila,
ndele te va kwatele komesho neke lounghulungu.
79:
Akutu Kalunga, ovapaani ova pumina moinima yoye,
va nyateka otembeli yoye iyapuki,
Jerusalem ove shi ninga eputu loikulukuma.

Oimhu yovapiya voye ove i yandja
keedila dokeulu, di i lye po,
nomalutu ovakoshoki voye okoilyani yedu.

Ohonde yavo ove i tilashi ngaashi omeva
mominghulo adishe daJerusalem,
kapa li ou te va pake.

Otwa ninga oiyolifa yovashiinda vetu,
otwa ninga ovashekwa, hatu tukaelwa koilongo,
ei ya shaama nafye.

Omwene, fiyo onaini hano to kala wa handuka?
Nonya yoye fiyo onaini
tai kala ya xwama ngaashi omundilo?

Ehandu loye li tilila kombada yovapaani
ava inave ku shiiva,
nokombada yoilongo ei tai dini okwiifana edina loye.

Osheshi ova mana po Jakob,
ndele va hanauna po etungilo laye.

Ino tu kwatela onghone molwowii wootatekulu,
endelela u tu shakeneke nefilonghenda loye,
osheshi fye twa tyololoka shili.

Kalunga kexupifo letu,
tu kwafa, molwefimano ledina loye,
tu xupifa, Ove tu dimina po omatimba etu
molwedina loye!

Ongahelipi mbela ovapaani va pewe va tye:
“Kalunga kavo paife oku li nee peni?”
Koipala yetu natu talifwe ehandukilo lovapaani
molwohonde yovapiya voye, ei va tilashi.

Okunyemata kweenghwate naku udike kwoove,
nokwooko kwoye kweenghono
xupifa eemwenyo daava va tokolelwa okufya.

Ovashiinda vetu, esheko lavo,
eli ve ku sheka nalo Omwene,
li va shunifila meenhulo davo luheyali.
80:
Akutu Omufita waIsrael, pwilikina!
Ou ho endifa Josef ngaashi oufita weedi,
noho kala omutumba kombada yovakerubi, limonikifa.

Holola eenghono doye,
kuEfraim naBenjamin naManasse.
Ove, ila u tu kwafe.

Akutu Kalunga, kwafa, tu yambuke vali,
Ove, minikilifa oshipala shoye,
fye tu hangwe kexupifo loye.

Akutu Omwene Kalunga weengudu dovakwaita,
fiyo onaini to kala wa handukila omaindilo oshiwana shoye?

Owe va pa va lye omungome womahodi,
nowe va nwefa omahodi omaholo e yadi.

Ove we tu yandja, tu ninge oshituwa
sheemhata kovashiinda shetu,
novatondi vetu ove tu ninga oiyolifa yavo.

Akutu Kalunga keengudu dovakwaita,
kwafa, tu yambuke vali,
Ove minikilifa oshipala shoye,
fye tu hangwe kexupifo loye!

Omuti womuviinyu owe u kufa mo muEgipiti,
wa dudile mo oiwana yovapaani,
ndele to u twike mo.

eemhunda okwa li da tuvikilwa komudile wao,
nomisederi daKalunga okeexulo doitai;

owa tandavelifa oitai yao fiyo okomeva Efuta Lopokati,
neenyapi dao fiyo okomulonga waEufrat.

Molwashike hano wa panuna ongubu yao,
naaveshe ava tava ende po, otava fola ko?

Onguluve yondume otai u tunauna po,
noifitukuti yomofuka otai u li ko.

Akutu Kalunga keengudu dovakwaita, aluka nee!
Meulu loye tala poshi u shi tale,
Ove u tekule omuti ou womuviinyu,

onhwika ei ya twikwa keke loye,
nomona ou we mu likulifila Ove mwene.

Oshi li po sha pya komundilo, sha tetwa ko;
kenyenyeto loshipala shoye otava pu po.

Yelulila eke loye omulumenhu wokolulyo loye,
u mu amene,
omona womunhu, ou we likulifila.

Opo nee fye inatu hala nande okutukuka kwoove.
Tu diinina tu kale nomwenyo,
fye tu shiive okutanga edina loye.

Akutu Omwene Kalunga keengudu dovakwaita,
kwafa, tu yambuke vali;
oshipala shoye nashi yele,
fye tu hangwe kexupifo loye!
81:
Imbileni Kalunga, Oye eenghono detu,
hambeleleni nokutanga Kalunga kaJakob.

Imbeni ehambelelo, nye shikeni oungoma
nokaxumbafeta kawa nonyalilo.

Kokamwedjona, shikeni omanghuma,
nomohani i li momutootoo okefiku loshivilo shetu.

Osheshi oyo onghedi yomuIsrael,
oshipango shaKalunga kaJakob.

Okwa li e shi dikila Josef edimbulukifo,
eshi a dja a lwife Egipiti.
Oyo ondaka inandi i uda shito,
ondi i udite paife tai ti:

“Onda kufa oudjuu komapepe aye,
omaoko aye ihaa humbata vali omutengi.

Eshi wa ifana nge moudjuu, onde ku kulila mo,
onde ku itavela moilemo yengungumo,
nde ku yeleka pomeva aMeriba. Sela

Oshiwana shange, pwilikine nge:
onda hala ndi ku londwele, Israel,
ngeno u ude nge!

Mokati keni ngeno inamu kala nande
kalunga kokoilongo,
ove uhe linyongamene nande
kukalunga kokoilongo.

Aame Omwene Kalunga koye,
ou nde ku tembula muEgipiti;
akama unene okanya koye,
Ame ndi ka yade.

Ndelenee oshiwana shange
inashi pwilikina ondaka yange,
naIsrael ina itavela ehalo lange.

Opo nee nde va efela
moukukutu womitima davo,
va lambalale eemhangela davo vene.

Akutu oshiwana shange, ngeno u ude nge,
naIsrael, ngeno na alukile meendjila dange.

Opo ngeno ohandi ninipike diva ovatondi vavo,
neke lange ohandi li aneke kovataataai vavo.

Ava hava tondo Omwene,
ngeno nava linyongamene kuye,
noshihangwa shavo nashi kale po alushe.

Ndelenee ngeno ohandi mu palula noilya
nohandi mu kutifa nomaadi owishi taa di memanya.”
82:
Kalunga oku li ofika moshiongalele shookalunga,
e li mokati kookalunga ta tokola:

“Fiyo onaini mwa hala okutokola etokolo inali yuka,
ndele tamu pe ovadinikalunga ounongo? Sela

Yukifileni ohepele nofiye,
epongo nomufyoona navo nava popilwe nawa.

Xupifeni omuxupi nomukwanaluhepo,
va vakuleni momaoko ovadinikalunga.

nande pe li ngaha, otamu fi,
ngaashi ovanhu hava fi,
ndele tamu lidenge po ominguda
ngaashi oidale aishe.”

Akutu Kalunga, fikama, u tokole edu;
osheshi oiwana aishe oyoye.
83:
Akutu Kalunga, ino likalela auke,
Ove ino kala wa mwena u tye filu, akutu Kalunga!

Tala, osheshi ovo tave ku tondo otava uyaana,
novatondi voye otava yelulile omitwe davo pombada.

Oshiwana shoye otave shi diladilile ekengelelo,
novanhu vopolwamba loye
otave va dutile ehangakeno,

tava ti: “Ileni tu yeni, tu ke va hanauneni po,
vo vaha ifanwe vali oshiwana,
opo edina lOvaisraeli liha tumbulwe vali.”

Heeno, va kundafana, va itavelela shimwe,
ove ku pangela omhangela yehangakeno,

Gebal naAmmoni naAmalek,
Ovafilisti pamwe nOvatirus.

NaAsiria yo okwa ama kuvo,
ova ninga okwooko kwovana vaLot. Sela

Va ninga, ngaashi wa ningile Midian naSisera,
nongaashi Jabin kokamulonga Kison,

ava va nyonauninwe po kuEndor,
noimhu yavo ya ninga oushosho womepya.

Oidale yavo i ninga ngaashi wa ningile
Oreb naSeeb, novadalekele vavo aveshe
ongaashi Seba naSalmunna,

Ava tava ti:
“Tu ka nangaleni po eenhele daKalunga.”

Kalunga kange, va ninga ngaashi omafo
taa i shambadaulu,
ngaashi oidudilo tai i omhepo.

Ngaashi omundilo ou tau xwike ofuka,
ngaashi omutemo tau vave eemhunda.

Osho u va shikula neembadi doye,
ndele to va halula noshikungulu shoye.

Oshipala shavo shi yadifa nohoni,
opo va hovele okukonga edina loye, Omwene.

Nava fifwe ohoni, va tilifwe fiyo alushe,
nava lengaifwe, vo va xule po.

Vo va kale, ve shi koneka, nokutya
Oove ou to ifanwa Omwene,
Ove auke u li po Okombadambada medu alishe.
84:
Eumbo loye oliwa shi fike peni,
akutu Omwene weengudu dovakwaita!

osheshi namusheshe okwa mona ko eumbo,
noxwilowi ya mona oshihadi,
omu ya nangeka oudilona vayo,
okutya, eealtari doye,
Omwene weengudu dovakwaita,
ohamba yange naKalunga kange.

Ovanelao ovo tava kala meumbo loye,
have ku hambelele alushe. Sela

Ovanelao ovava ve neenghono davo mwoove
mokulilongekidila oyeendo iyapuki.

Mokweenda molufilu lomahodi
otave li shitukifa eefifiya,
nodula yonhemuna
otai li yadifa omanangeko noupuna.

Otava ende alushe meenghono dipe,
fiyo tava fiki koshipala shaKalunga muSion.

Omwene, Kalunga keengudu dovakwaita,
pwilikina eindilo lange,
li uda, Kalunga kaJakob. Sela

Akutu Kalunga, Oove oshikelelifo shetu,
tala u tale oshipala shomuvaekwa woye.

Osheshi efiku limwe alike momikala doye
li dule omafiku eyovi pamwe pe lili.
Okukala konhu yeumbo laKalunga kange
oku dulile nge okukala meenduda dovalunde.

Omunelao omunhu ou te ku lineekele,
Oove Omwene weengudu dovakwaita!
85:
Omwene, oshilongo shoye, nale we shi hokwa,
noupika waJakob okwa li we u pandukulula.

Ove owa kufa po owii woshiwana shoye,
nomatimba avo owe a dima po. Sela

Onya yoye aishe owe i lotifile,
nowa polifile ehandu loye la xwama.

Kalunga kexupifo letu, tu pamekulula,
noku tu umanena kwoye, ku pungulula po.

Wa hala mbela oku tu kwatela onghone fiyofiyo,
nokufikifa ehandu loye koludalo noludalo?

Ino hala oku tu tula omwenyo vali,
oshiwana shoye, tu shiive oku ku hafela?

Omwene, tu monifa ouwanghenda woye,
Ove u tu pe exupifo loye.

Ame nda hala okupwilikina,
Kalunga Omwene eshi ta popi.
Ota unganekele oshiwana shaye
novadiinini vaye ombili;
vo ngeno vehe lishune vali moulai.

Heeno, exupifo laye ola kala popepi
naava have mu tila,
opo oshinge shaye shi kale
moshilongo shetu,

ouwanghenda noudiinini, oyo i shakenafane,
ouyuki nombili, yo i fipafane komilungu.

Oudiinini, opo otau ka twiyuka medu,
nomeulu ouyuki tau taalele poshi.

Osho vali Omwene ote ke tu pa ouwa,
nedu letu tali tu menifile oshishipo.

Ouyuki opo otau ke mu tetekelela,
nelao tali shikula eenghatu daye.
86:
Omwene, endeka okutwi kwoye, u ude nge,
osheshi aame epongo nohepele!

Omwene, file nge onghenda,
osheshi efiku alishe ohandi ku ifana.

Osheshi Omwene, Ove u nonghedi iwa,
u yadi ekufilo,
Ove u nolukeno naava have ku ifana.

Omwene, uda eindilo lange,
yavelela eilikano lange lomokule!

Fiku handi hangika koudjuu, ohandi ku ifana,
osheshi Ove ho udu nge.

Omwene, moikalunga kamu na umwe e ku fa,
nopehe na eshi sha fa oilonga yoye.

Oiwana aishe yovapaani, ngaashi we i shita,
otai ke uya i linyongamene
koshipala shoye, Omwene,
nai fimaneke edina loye;

osheshi Oove omunene nomulongi woikumwifa,
Oove auke Kalunga.

Omwene, ulikile nge ondjila yoye,
ame ndi ende moshili yoye,
omutima wange u mangeleka mokutila edina loye.

Omwene, Kalunga kange,
onda hala oku ku tanga nomutima aushe
nokufimaneka edina loye fiyo alushe.

Kalunga, ovalundakani ova fikamena nge
netanga lovakolokoshi otali nangele omwenyo wange,
noihave ku tula moipafi yavo.

Ndelenee Omwene, Oove omunalukeno
omunanghenda, nomunanheni,
omunene mouwanghenda nomoshili.

Talele nge u file nge onghenda;
pa omupiya woye eenghono doye,
Ove u xupife nge, aame omona omumati
womupiya woye okakadona.

Tule nge oshidimbulukifo shouwa,
ovatondi vange ve shi mone, nova fifwe ohoni,
nokutya Omwene, Oove ekwafo lange
nehekeleko lange.
87:
Okudikwa kwasho, osha dikilwa
kombada yeemhunda diyapuki.

Oivelo yaSion Omwene e i hole
komesho yeenhele adishe daJakob.

Oshilando shaKalunga ove,
oto tumbulwa wa tumbala. Sela

Rahab naBabilon, hai tongo ovashiivi vange,
heeno, naFilistia naTirus pamwe naEtiopia:
naavo yo va dalelwa ko.

Ndelenee okutonga Sion otaku tiwa:
“Shamha omunhu, omo a dalelwa musho,
naau wOkombadambada
Ye mwene ote shi pameke.”

Omwene mokuvalula kwaye oiwana yoilongo
ota shangele mo:
“Naau okwa dalelwa ko.” Sela

Mokwiimba nokutanha tava ti:
“Eefifiya adishe dange di li mwoove.”
88:
Omwene, Kalunga kexupifo lange,
omutenya aushe ohandi ku ifana,
noufiku ohandi ingida mokule koshipala shoye.

Eindilo lange ngeno li fike kwoove,
endekela okutwi kwoye kokweehela kwange.

Osheshi omwenyo wange owa tunyukwa omaudjuu,
nokukalamwenyo kwange
otaku likokele popepi noshovafi.

Mokati kovafi, omo ndi na omulele wange,
ondi li mo ngaashi ovadipawa,
ava va pakwa meembila,
noitava dimbulukiwa vali kwoove.

Owa undulila nge moshovafi mokule,
momulaulu fokofoko mombwili mwi.

Ehandu loye otali lyaminikile nge pedu,
omakufikufi oye oto a findilifa nge koshi. Sela

Ookaume kange aveshe we va amukifa kwaame,
wa dinifa nge kuvo,
onda patekena, noitandi dulu okudja mo.

Movafi mbela oto dulu okulongela mo oikumwifa,
ile oilulu tai nyumuka mbela i ku tange? Sela

Mombila ohamu hepaululwa tuu ouwanghenda woye,
ile monhele yeolelo oudiinini woye?

Eenghonokumwifa doye
otadi udifwa mbela momulaulu,
nouyuki woye mbela moshilongo
omo itamu lidimbulukiwa vali?

Onghee ohandi ingida mokule kwoove, Omwene,
nongulangula eindilo lange otali ku shakeneke.

Omwene, oshike to ekelele shi omwenyo wange,
to holeke nge oshipala shoye?

Aame omunamupya oshingone, nghee nda dja,
onda humbatifwa omatilifo oye, onda loloka.

Okuxwama kwehandu loye okwa wila nge,
noitilifa yoye oya hanauna nge po.

Alushe oi li po tai kondekele nge
ngaashi omeva, ya shakavaena aishe.

Ookaume kange novashiivikile we ve liteekifa nge;
omulaulu auke wa kalela nge.
89:
Omauwanghenda Omwene
onda hala oku a imba alushe,
noudiinini woye ndi u hepaululile
ovatekulululwa nokanya kange.

Osheshi Ove wa tya:
“Ouwanghenda otau ka kala wa dikwa po
fiyo alushe meulu,
oudiinini woye wa pamekwa.

Ame nda dika ehangano nomuhoololwa wange,
omupiya wange David, nde mu anenene:

‘Oludalo loye onda hala oku li pameka
li kale po fiyo alushe,
nolukalwapangelo loye ohandi li pangelele
omaludalo aeshe okomesho.’ ” Sela

Ndele omaulu otaa tange oikumwifalonga yoye, Omwene,
osho yo oudiinini woye meongalo lovayapuki.

Ile olyelye womoule meulu e fike pOmwene,
movana ovamati vaKalunga elipipo a fa Omwene?

A fe Kalunga ou ha tilika moshiongalele shovayapuki,
noku neshushu mwaaveshe ava hava kala puye.

Akutu Omwene, Kalunga keengudu
dovakwaita, olyelye ngaashi Ove?
Oove omunaenghono, akutu Omwene,
oudiinini woye otau ku dingilile apeshe.

Ove to pangele etukuluko lomeva efuta;
omakufikufi alo ngeenge tae litumbu, Ove to a lotifa.

Ove wa tyuvaula Rahab a fa a tetwatetwa,
okwooko kwoye kweenghono
we ku halakanififa ovatondi voye.

Eulu oloye, nedu oloye,
ongonga yedu nouyadi walo,
Oove we li dika.

Oumbangalanhu noumbuwanhu,
Oove we i shita.
Tabor naHermon nadi kuwilile edina loye.

Okwooko kwoye oku neenghono,
neke loye ola pama,
nolulyo loye ola yeluka.

Ouyuki neyukifo,
oyo efina lolukalwapangelo loye.
Ouwanghenda noudiinini otau tetekelele oshipala shoye.

Oshiwana shi nelao, osheshi shi udite oshivilohafo,
eshi hashi ende mouyelele
woshipala shoye, Omwene.

Efiku alishe otava tanhele edina loye,
molwouyuki woye otava nenepekwa.

osheshi oikelelifo yetu, oyOmwene,
nohamba yetu, oyo Omuyapuki waIsrael.

Shito owa popifile ovayuki voye memoniko, wa tile:
“Onda yandja eenghono komuladi
e mu kwafe, nde mu tumbila elenga,
eli nda hoolola movanhu.

Onda mona David, omupiya wange,
nde mu vaeka nomaadi ange mayapuki,

opo eke lange alushe li kale kuye,
nokwooko kwange ku mu pameke.

Kape nomunaita te mu ende koshi,
nombudi, i mu lungamene.

Ndelenee ovashindanhu vaye
onda hala oku va shataula po,
naava tave mu tondo,
ndi va pundaulile poshi.

Oudiinini wange nouwanghenda wange
tau kala pamwe naye,
nomedina lange oluvinga laye
nali yeluke pombada.

Onda hala okudulikifa omeva efuta keke laye,
Ame ndi tule olulyo laye kombada yomilonga.

Oye ou ta ka ifana nge: ‘Oove Tate yange,
Oove Kalunga kange, emanya lexupifo lange.’

Onghee hano naame yo
onda hala ndi mu ninge oshiveli nomukulunhu
mokati keehamba dokombada yedu.

Alushe onda hala, ndi mu diininine ouwanghenda wange,
nehangano letu naye nali mu pamene.

Noludalo laye onda hala oku li pameka fiyo alushe,
osho yo olukalwapangelo laye nali kale,
ngaashi eulu li li po.

Ovana vaye ovamati, ngeenge tava efa omhango yange
ndele itava kala meenghedi dange,

ndele tava nyono eemhangela dange,
ndele itava diinine oipango yange,

ndelenee ouwanghenda wange,
owo inandi hala, ndi u va nyekulule,
noudiinini wange itandi u likale.

Inandi hala, ndi xutule ehangano letu naavo,
naashi nda tongele nomilungu dange, ihandi shi tongolola.

Lumwe aluke onda li nda ana kouyapuki wange:
oshili, naDavid itandi ke mu fufya nande.

Oludalo laye nali kale po alushe,
nolukalwapangelo laye li faafane netango koshipala shange;

olo li kale po alushe ngaashi ohani;
ondobwedi ei yomoilemo oyoshili.” Sela

owa teyaula po ehangano leni nomupiya woye,
oshishani shaye shokomutwe we shi kufa etumbalo,
nowe shi kupaulashi mondwi yedu.

Omakuma aye aeshe neehote daye,
owe a ngumauna po,
owe a shitukifa oikulukuma.

Aveshe ava tava ende nondjila ei,
otave mu vakaavaka,
nokwa ninga oshiyolifa kovashiinda vaye.

Eke lokolulyo lovafininiki vaye owe li pa efindano,
wa hafifa ovatondi vaye aveshe.

Osho vali omukonda waye weememo
owe u shunifa monima molwoodi,
Ove ino mu pamekela mo ofika.

Oshinge shaye owe shi dima po,
nolukalwa laye owe li undwila poshi.

Omafiku ounyasha waye owe a xupipika,
owe mu tuvika nelengwa nodino. Sela

Fiyo onaini hano, Omwene,
wa hala okuhondama ngaha,
nehandu loye tali xwama fiyo onaini, la fa omundilo?

Omwene, dimbulukwa omafiku ange nhumba maxupi,
novanhu aveshe, nhumba we va shita
ihava kalele kuxula po.

Openi mbela pe na ou,
ta kala nomwenyo ndele ita mono efyo,
ye a xupife omwenyo waye mepangelo loshovafi? Sela

Omwene, omaudaneko oye ouwanghenda,
aa wa anena nale David moudiinini woye,
oku li nee peni?

Omwene, dimbulukwa odino yovapiya voye,
ame eshi ndi li po
handi humbata meni lange
omasheko oiwana yoilongo, apa i fike.

Oyaa, ovatondi voye, Omwene, tava sheke nao,
omanha omuvaekwa woye otave a sheke nao.

Omwene na fimanekwe fiyo alushe!
Amen, heeno, Amen.
90:
Omwene, Oove u li po ehondameno letu
okudja koludalo noludalo.

Manga ino shita eemhunda
nomanga ino holola po ounyuni,
Ove Kalunga kaalushe oko wa li,
noto ka kala alushe fiyo alushe.

Ove to shunifa omunhu mondwi yedu,
ndele to ti: “Alukeni, oludi lovanhu nye.”

Osheshi omido eyovi, kwoove oda fa
efiku longhela, eshi la pita po,
nongaashi olufo loufiku lomunangeli.

Ove to va kungulula po, ove li ngaashi eemhofi;
ongula ve li ngaashi omwiidi tau twiyuka;

ou tau penduka omutalala, ndele tau tutuma,
nomokutokelwa kwao tau lembalala,
ndele tau kukuta ngaho.

Osheshi fye ohatu nyonaunwa po kehandu loye,
nohatu vakulwa po kokuudonya kwoye.

Owii wetu u kaleka ofika koshipala shoye,
noiholekwa yetweelela
oto i holola ya yela koshipala shoye.

Osheshi omafiku etu aeshe otaa piti po ketikuko loye;
omido detu ohatu di xulifa po ngaashi ehefo.

Okukala po kwetu kombada yedu
oku fike pomido omilongo heyali,
ngeenge okuhapu, shapu omilongo hetatu,
nouwa wako: oudjuu auke netutuko;
osheshi oko otaku pitilile po diva,
fye ohatu vilola po.

Ndelenee elipipo te lipulapula
neenghono dehandu loye,
e lipulaapule nonyengo yoye,
opo a kale te ku tila?

Tu longa okuvala omafiku etu,
fye tu pewe omutima wa nongopala.

Omwene, aluka vali! Wa hala u kale ko
fiyo onaini mbela?
Ningila ovapiya voye olukeno.

Pita ongula, u tu palule nouwanghenda woye,
fye tu shiive okukuwilila
nokuhafa momafiku etu aeshe.

Hovela oku tu hafifa omafiku e fike pwaa
we tu nyematifa,
nomido di fike pwaadi twa li noudjuu.

Okulonga kwoye, efa ku monike kovapiya voye,
noshingetumbalo shoye okoludalo lavo.

Efilonghenda lOmwene Kalunga ketu
nali kale kombada yetu!
Noilonga yomake etu i punika,
heeno, oilonga yomake etu i nangeka noupuna.
91:
Ou e li omutumba meameno laau wOkombadambada,
ndele ta kala momudidimbe wOmunaenghono adishe,

ye ota ti kOmwene:
“Eameno lange, nohotengulu yange,
Kalunga kange, ou handi mu lineekele.”

Osheshi Oye tuu, te ku xupifa
melulo lomuteli womwiyo nomoudu wolutapo.

Ove ku na okutila oitilifa youfiku,
noshikuti, eshi tashi ku vakele omutenya,

noudu wolutapo,
ou tau ku hondjaunine momulaulu,
neefya, edi hadi hanauna po pouyelele.

Nande nava wile po eyovi limwe
kolumosho loye,
nomayovi omulongo kolulyo loye,
kwoove itau hange ko.

Nokuli, oto ke shi mona nomesho oye mwene,
u tale, nhumbi ovadinikalunga
tava shunifilwa eshi va longela.

Osheshi wa ninga Omwene eameno loye,
naau wOkombadambada owe mu ninga ohote yoye.

Ito hangika nande koudjuu,
neumbo loye itali mono oshiponga.

Osheshi Ye ote ku lombwelele ovaengeli vaye,
ve ku amene meendjila doye adishe.

Otave ku humbata nomaoko avo,
uhe lipume omhadi yoye kemanya.

Oto ende nokulyata onghoshi nonhoka,
oto lyataula onghoshona neyoka.

Oye eshi a dama kwaame,
onda hala ndi mu xupife,
nda hala ndi mu amene,
osheshi ota shiiva edina lange.

Ngeenge ta ifana nge, Ame ohandi mu udu;
ohandi liameke kuye moudjuu waye,
Ame ndi mu mangulule mo,
nohandi mu fimanekifa.

Ame ohandi mu palula
noku mu kaleka nomwenyo mule,
ndele ohandi mu monifa exupifo lange.
92:
okuhepaulula ouwanghenda woye ongula inene,
nokutonga oudiinini woye oufiku;

Osheshi Omwene, Ove wa hafifa nge mokulonga kwoye;
ohandi nyakukilwa oilonga yomake oye.

Omwene, oilonga yoye oinene, i fike peni!
Omadiladilo oye omale unene neenghono.

Omunhu ehe neendunge ite shi shiiva,
nelai itali shi koneke.

Ovadinikalunga eshi tava twiyuka ngaashi omwiidi,
novaningi vowii aveshe ngeenge tava hape ngaashi omiti,
otashi ningwa, vo va yaumuke ko fiyo alushe.

Ndelenee Omwene, Oove omunene
omutumbalekwa fiyo alushe!

Omesho ange okwa mona okufindika kwovatondi vange,
nomatwi ange e udite ehafo
molwoshiponga shovanawii ava tava fikamene nge.

Omukoshoki ota kulifwa,
a fa omuti womulunga, ota mene ta i pokule,
ngaashi omuti womusederi wokuLibanon.

Ova twikwa meumbo lOmwene,
otava tutuma momukunghulo
wondjuwo yaKalunga ketu,

vo nande nava kulupe, otava imike natango oiimati,
omiti ditalala da twiyauka omafo,

vo va kale tava udifa,
nokutya Kalunga Oye omuyuki,
emanya lange, muye kamu na nande oushima.
93:
Olukalwa loye ola kala lapama nale noshito,
Ove wa dja nale alushe.

Omwene, omilonga oda tukuluka,
omilonga oda tukuluka omipopomo,
omilonga oda tukuluka oihomo inene.

Ndelenee Omwene moule wokombadambada,
oku dule ounene womeva manene efuta
mokungunguma kwao mokule,
oku dule ounene womakufikufi efuta
tae lidenge kumwe taa ngunguma.

Omaufo oye oku shii kulineekelwa shili.
Ouyapuki tau wapalele eumbo loye
fiyo alushe, Omwene.
94:
Kalunga ho handukile, Omwene,
Kalunga omutokoli,
holoka mouyeleleshinge woye!

Omutokoli wedu, fikama,
Ove alulila ovalinenepeki oilonga yavo.

Fiyo onaini mbela, Omwene,
fiyo onaini ovadinikalunga tave litade?

Otava yadauka, otava popi omutyanai,
ovalongi vowii vo aveshe otave litumbile pombada.

Akutu Omwene, otava lyataulile po oshiwana shoye,
novafyuululifwa voye otave va fininike.

Ovafiyekadi novanailongo otave va pondo
neefiye otave di dipaa

ndele tava ti: “Omwene ite shi mono,
Kalunga kaJakob ke shi udite.”

Pukulukeni, nye ava tamu pwidauka mokati koiwana,
novashima nye, onaini tamu ningi eendunge hano?

Ou omutwiki womatwi, Ye ke udite ko mbela?
Nomushiti womesho ke wete ko hano?

Ou omutekuli woilongo, Ye iha denge hamba?
Oye tuu, ta longo ovanhu omayele.

Omwene oku shii nokuli omadiladilo ovanhu;
osheshi oo okaulapepo kongaho.

Omulumenhu omunelao
ou ta pukululwa kwoove, Omwene,
noto mu longo eendunge momhango yoye,

Ove u mu ningile etulumuko momafiku madjuu,
fiyo omunawii ta felwa ombila yaye.

Osheshi Omwene ita kanduka po oshiwana shaye,
Ye ita efa oshifyuululwa shaye.

Etokolo lopauyuki otali kala pauyuki:
aveshe ava ve hole ouwa, otava ame kulo.

Olyelye ta kwafa nge okukondjifa ovanawii?
Olyelye omupopili mokudenga oumbudi?

Omwene, ngeno haye ekwafo lange,
omwenyo wange ngeno wa mwena nale
moshilongo shovafi.

Alushe, eshi kwa li ndi shii,
omhadi yange tai hale okufenunguta,
ouwanghenda woye, Omwene,
owo wa paka nge ofika;

ngeenge ndi noshisho shoudjuu meni lange,
omahekeleko oye oo a hekeleka omwenyo wange.

Oshipundi shetokolo lomupya
osha kwatafana tuu mbela naave,
eshi tashi eta oixuna mokupengifa omhango?

Ove lipaka kumwe okunangela omwenyo womuyuki,
nohonde ei ihe netimba, otave i tokolele okufya.

Ndelenee Omwene, Oye a ninga ohote yange ya pama,
Kalunga kange, Oye emanya lange lokuhondama;

owii wavo ote u alulile kuvo vene,
ndele te va hanaunifa po oumbudi wavo;
heeno, Omwene, Kalunga ketu,
ote ya oku va hanauna po.
95:
Ileni, tu kuwilileni Omwene,
tu nyakukilweni emanya lexupifo letu!

Tu holokeni koshipala shaye nokupandula,
fye tu mu tanheleni nomaimbilo ehambelelo.

Osheshi Omwene Oye Kalunga kanene
nohamba inene kombada yookalunga aveshe.

Oye tuu ou e kwete meke laye
eembwili domeni ledu,
neexulo deemhunda odaye.

Nefuta olaye, osheshi Oye e li shita,
nedu likukutu olo la mewa keke laye.

Ileni, tu linyongameneni, fye tu liwitike pedu,
Omwene Omushiti wetu tu mu twileni eengolo!

Osheshi Oye Kalunga ketu,
ndele fye oshiwana shoufita waye,
needi domeke laye.
Akutu ngeno nena nye mu ude ondaka yaye:

“Inamu kukutika omitima deni,
ngaashi sha ningilwe muMeriba,
ngaashi efiku linya kuMassa mofuka,

omo ooxo va shindile nge,
nova yelekele nge,
nande va mona oilonga yange.

Omido omilongo ine
onda li nda tondifwa kepupi olo, opo nda tya:
‘Oshiwana eshi shi nomitima da puka;
ndele vo inava hala okushiiva eendjila dange.’

Opo nee mehandu lange onda anene nda tya:
‘Vo itava fiki metulumuko lange!’ ”
96:
Imbileni Omwene eimbilo lipe,
edu alishe, imbila Omwene!

Imbileni Omwene, tangeni edina laye,
efiku nefiku udifeni exupifo laye.

Hepaululeni oshinge shaye
mokati koiwana yovapaani,
noikumwifalonga yaye
mokati koiwana yoilongo.

osheshi ookalunga aveshe voiwana, ovo oikalunga,
ndelenee Omwene Oye Omushiti womaulu.

Etumbalopangelo noshinge otai mu tetekelele,
eenghono nevilimo otai yadifa ouyapuki waye.

Oiwana yovapaani nye, tumbalekeni Omwene,
mu peni efimaneko neenghono.

Yandjeni kOmwene efimano ledina laye,
eteni oiyambifo, mu uye momikala daye.

Linyongameneni Omwene, mwa djala ouyapuki,
edu alishe, kakama koshipala shaye.

Udifeni mokati kovapaani mu tye:
“Paife Omwene Oye ohamba.
Nongonga yedu okwe i pameka, ihe linyenganyenge;
ota ka tokolela oiwana pauyuki.”

Eshi, eulu nali shi nyakukilwe, nedu nali kuwilile.
Omeva efuta naa ngungume, naashishe tashi ilauka mo.

Omatunda naa nyakukwe, naashishe eshi sha hapa mwoo.
Opo omiti adishe domofuka tadi hovele okukuwilila

koshipala shOmwene, osheshi Ye ote uya,
heeno, ote uya okutokola edu;
ota ka tokola ongonga yedu mouyuki,
noiwana yoilongo paudiinini waye.
97:
Paife Omwene Oye ohamba.
Edu nali shi nyakukilwe,
eengudu deenhunhu domomeva nadi shi hafele.

Oilemo nomilaulu otai mu dingilile,
ouyuki noshili, oyo efina lolukalwa laye.

Omundilo otau tetekelele oshipala shaye,
ndele tau lungwinifa po ovatondi vaye
keembinga adishe.

Omaluvadi aye otaa minikile ongonga yedu,
edu otali a mono, ndele tali kakama.

Koshipala shOmwene eemhunda otadi diluka
ngaashi edi leenyiki,
koshipala shOmupangeli wedu alishe.

Omaulu otaa udifa ouyuki waye,
noiwana yoilongo aishe otai mono efimano laye.

Sion, eshi she shi uda, osha hafa,
noukadona vaJuda ohava kuwililile
omatokolo oye, Omwene.

Osheshi Omwene, Oove omunenenene
kombada yedu alishe,
wa tumbala unene komesho yookalunga aveshe.

Akutu onye ava, mu hole Omwene, tondeni owii!
Eemwenyo dovakoshoki vaye, ote di amene,
ote di xupifa momake ovadinikalunga.

Ouyelele wa kuminwa komuyuki,
nehafo okovanamadiladilo a yuka.

Ovayuki nye, hafeleni mOmwene,
nye hambeleleni edina laye liyapuki.
98:
Imbileni Omwene eimbilo lipe,
osheshi Ye okwa longa oikumwifalonga!
Olulyo laye nokwooko kwaye kuyapuki,
oyo ye mu longela efindano.

Omwene okwa shiivifa exupifo laye,
moipafi yoiwana yovapaani
omo a holola ouyuki waye.

Eumbo laIsrael okwe li dimbulukila
ouwanghenda waye noudiinini;
fiyo okeexulo adishe dounyuni
oda mona oshilonga shaKalunga shexupifo.

Edu alishe, kuwilila Omwene,
hoveleni okunyakukwa,
nye mu shike ouxumbafeta.

Shikileni Omwene ouxumbafeta,
va shikeni nokwiimba pombadambada.

Omanghuma neendaka deembeda nye,
tanheleni koshipala shOhamba Omwene.

Efuta nali popome, naashi tashi ilauka mo,
nongonga yedu, naava va tungila mo.

Omilonga nadi pandule nomake,
neemhunda adishe kumwe nadi nyakukwe

koshipala shOmwene, osheshi Ye ote uya okutokola edu.
Ongonga yedu ote ke i tokola mouyuki,
noiwana yoilongo ngaashi ye shi yukila.
99:
Omwene, Oye omunene muSion,
a tumbala unene kombada yoiwana aishe.

Nava fimaneke edina laye eli linene, litilifa,
Oye Omuyapuki,

nokuhambelela epangelo lohamba,
Ove u hole oshili.
Ove wa pangela po omhangela ya yuka
ya pama nawa.
Oshili nouyuki Oove we u ikifa muJakob.

Tumbalekeni Omwene, Kalunga ketu,
lidengeni poshi peemhadi daye,
Oye Omuyapuki.

Moses naAron va kala mokati kovapristeli vaye,
naSamuel mokati kaava va ifana edina laye.
Vo ova kuwila Omwene naye okwe va uda.

Akutu Omwene, Kalunga ketu, Ove we va uda,
Ove wa kala kuvo omudimipo
naKalunga te va kwatele onghone molwoilonga yavo ii.

Hambeleleni Omwene, Kalunga ketu.
Linyongameneni pomhunda yaye iyapuki.
Osheshi Omwene, Kalunga ketu,
Oye Omuyapuki.
100:
Longeleni Omwene nokuhafa!
Holokeni koshipala shaye nokukuwilila.

Shi dimbulukweni, nokutya Omwene Oye Kalunga.
Oye tuu, e tu shita, fye ovaye,
oshiwana shaye needi doufita waye.

Pitileni meenhu daye nokupandula,
nomomikala daye nokwiimba omahambelelo.
Mu panduleni, nye tangeni edina laye.

Osheshi Omwene omuwa,
nouwanghenda waye otau kala po fiyo alushe,
noudiinini waye okoludalo noludalo.
101:
Onda hala okwiimba ouwanghenda nouyuki.
Omwene, Oove, nda hala ndi ku shikile.

Mokweenda kwange onda hala ndi diinine ouyuki.
Akutu, onaini to uya kwaame?
Meumbo lange onda hala
ndi kale mo nomutima wa yela.

Ekonda nali kale kokule nomutima wange,
owii inandi u hala nande.

Ou ta ambe mukwao meholeko,
oye handi mu nyonauna po;
ou e nomesho taa nyikifa oukengeli
nomutima wa nyika elitumbaleko,
ye ota nyonyodolifa nge.

Meumbo lange inamu kala ou ta ende nekonda;
omupopi woipupulu ita kala koshipala shange.

Keshe tuu ongula onda hala okudima po
ovadudu aveshe vomoshilongo,
ame ndi kombolole po moshilando shOmwene
ovaningi vowii aveshe.
102:
Omwene, uda eindilo lange,
nonghuwo yange nai fike kwoove!

Alushe ngeenge handi tila,
ino holeka nge oshipala shoye,
alushe ngeenge handi ifana,
endekela okutwi kwoye kwaame, u kwafe nge diva.

Akutu, omafiku ange taa hanauka po ngaashi omwifi,
nomakipa ange otaa pupyala a fa taa pi komundilo;

omutima wange owa kata nowa kukuta ngaashi omwiidi;
osha dimbwifa nge okulya omungome.

Mokukema kwange mokule,
eenhumba dange otadi kanyatele komakipa ange.

Onda fa oshikakalwa mombuwa,
onda ninga nda fa exuvi meputu.

Ihandi mono nande eemhofi,
ndele ondi li ngaashi okadila ke likalela konduda.

Osheshi ohandi li omute ngaashi omungome hau liwa,
nomoshikunwa shange
ohandi shishifile mo omahodi

molwehandu loye nomolwonya yoye;
osheshi Ove wa yelula nge nowa shata nge poshi.

Omafiku ange okwa fa omudidimbe wa ya kokule,
ndele ame ohandi kukuta ngaashi ombidi.

Ndelenee Omwene, Ove ho pangele alushe,
nedina loye otali kala koludalo noludalo.

Ove to fikama nokuli, u ka file Sion onghenda,
osheshi efimbo loku shi fila onghenda
olo alike eli; okafimbo kaye oka monika.

Osheshi ovapiya voye ove hole
pomamanya aSion,
nomakulukuma asho tave a nyikile oufiye.

Opo nee opo ovapaani
otava ka tila edina lOmwene,
neehamba dokombada yedu efimano loye.

Heeno, Omwene ota ka tungulula Sion,
ndele ta monika moshinge shaye,

ote liameke komaindilo ovaefiwa,
ndele ita dini omakweno avo.

Eshi, osho nashi shangelwe oludalo olo tali uya,
ovanhu ovo opo tava shitwa,
vo va tange Omwene,

molwaashi e li moulembada waye uyapuki
a taalela pedu,
heeno, Omwene eshi e li meulu, ota tale pedu,

Ye a pwilikine eenghwate, nhumba tadi keme,
nokuxupifa ava va tokolelwa efyo,

vo va udife muSion edina lOmwene,
nefimano laye muJerusalem,

oiwana yoilongo, ngeenge tai liongele
aishe mumwe,
noilongo i longele Omwene.

Eenghono dange okwe di xutula ondjilakati,
nomuvalu womafiku ange okwe u ninipika.

Kalunga kange, ohandi ti:
“Ino vakula nge po
poshakati shomafiku ange, Oove ou,
u nomido hadi kala komaludalo aeshe.”

Nalenale Oove wa shita edu,
nomaulu oo oshilongwa shomake oye.

Oyo tai xulu po, Ove auke to kala po,
otai kulupa po aishe, ya fa oshikutu,
to i lidula ngaashi omudjalo u djale umwe,
oyo notai shitukifwa.

Ndelenee Ove to kala ngaho, ngaashi u li,
omido doye ihadi xulu po nande.

Ovana vovapiya voye otava kala ve li nawa,
noludalo lavo otali kala alushe koshipala shoye.
103:
Omwenyo wange, hambelela Omwene,
naashishe shomeni lange
nashi hambelele edina laye liyapuki!

Omwenyo wange, hambelela Omwene,
ove ino dimbwa ouwa, ou e ku ningila!

Oye tuu ou, ta dimi po owii aushe,
ndele te ku velula komaudu oye aeshe;

Oye tuu, ta xupifa oukalimwenyo woye melambo,
ndele te ku dike oshishani shouwanghenda nefilonghenda,

Oye tuu, ota wanifa omahalelo oye nouwa waye,
opo u alulilwe ounyasha woye
ngaashi ounyasha wonhwa.

Omwene oha longifa ouyuki,
novafininikwa aveshe ohe va longele eyukifilo.

Moses okwa li e mu shiivifa eendjila daye,
novamati vaIsrael oilonga yaye.

Omwene Oye omunefilonghenda nomunanghenda,
oku yadi onheni nouwanghenda munene.
Iha handuka alushe, nonya ihai kalelele muye.

Ye ite tu ningile eshi sha yeleka omatimba etu,
ndele ite tu alulile shi fike powii wetu;

ngaashi oushilo nouninginino u lili kokule,
osho Ye ha ehenifa omanyono etu kokule nafye;

ngaashi xe ta file ounona vaye onghenda,
Omwene osho ha file onghenda ava have mu tila.

Osheshi Oye ta shiiva oshitwe yetu, nhumbi tu li;
ota dimbulukwa, nokutya fye ondwi yedu.

Omunhu, omafiku aye okwa fa omwiidi,
ngaashi onhemo yomoixwa tai hape, osho ha kala;

omhepo, ngeenge tai i pepe po, yo kai po vali,
ndele onhele, apa ya kala, kape shiivike nande.

Ndelenee ouwanghenda wOmwene,
oo ohau kala alushe fiyo alushe
kombada yaava, have mu tila,
noudiinini waye koludalo noludalo,

kwaava, hava anyene mehangano lavo naye,
ndele tava dimbulukwa oipango yaye, ve i wanife.

Omwene meulu okwe li ningila mo olukalwa laye,
nouhamba waye otau pangele akushe.

Ovaengeli vaye nye,
hambeleleni Omwene,
ovaladi ovanaenghono nye,
oonakuwanifa ondaka yaye,
ava hamu dulika kelombwelo leendjovo daye!

Eengudu dovakwaita vaye amushe,
hambeleleni Omwene,
ovapiya vaye nye, ava hamu wanifa ehalo laye.

Oilonga yaye amushe nye,
hambeleleni Omwene
keenhele adishe depangelo laye.
Omwenyo wange,
hambelela Omwene!
104:
Omwenyo wange, tanga Omwene!
Omwene, Kalunga kange,
ounene woye ou fike peni!
Ove owa djala efimano noshinge,

Oove ou, ho liuvikile nouyelele wa fa omudjalo,
nowa valela eulu ngaashi ofaila,

ou, ho ningi eemhepo ovatumwa voye,
nomalaka omundilo oo ovapiya voye.

Edu owe li shitila keengudi dalo,
lo liha tengauke nande fiyo alushe,

ndelenee oku li hanyena kwoye,
okwe li shunifile lwanima;
ondaka yoye yengungumo oye
li kungulukifa ko.

Eemhunda ode litumbile pombada,
nomalufilu okwe lishunifile
meenhele edi we a longela.

Opo we a taulilile eengaba edi itaa tauluka,
aha tuvikile vali edu.

Oye ta fulukifa eefifiya momalufilu;
notadi tondoka pokati keemhunda.

Ndele odo otadi nwefa oifitukuti yomofuka,
tadi kumwifa eefine.

Eedila dokoshi yeulu
otadi tungile oihadi komiti daapo,
ndele otadi sheketele moitai.

Ota tekele eemhunda momufima waye womeulu;
nedu otali paluka kepunapalo loilonga yoye.

Oimuna ote i menifile omwiidi,
noimeno i dje eenhwika,
do di ninge oilonga yomake ovanhu,
opo Ye a menife eendja medu,

nomaviinyu, aa taa hafifa omutima womunhu,
opo a vemife oshipala shaye komaadi,
Ye a pameke omutima womunhu neendja.

Omiti dOmwene otadi likumifa nokunwa,
omiti omisederi daLibanon, edi a twika,

omo hamu dalele eedila, momusipresi
nanakandunga ota tungile mo oshihadi.

Eemhunda dile oda shitilwa oupundja,
noikulundudu oyo ehondameno louyelemani.

Ohani okwe i shita, i yeleke omafimbo,
etango oli shii efimbo tali ningine.

Ngeenge to undulile po omulaulu,
oufiku otau uya,
opo mofuka otamu hondoloka
oifitukuti aishe.

Eenghoshona otadi kumbile okulya,
eshi tadi pula eendja dado kuKalunga.

Etango nge tali piti, otadi shuna
oku ka nangala momakwena ado.

Opo nee omunhu ota piti, a ye koilonga yaye,
e i longe fiyo onguloshi.

Omwene, oilonga yoye oi fike peni!
Aishe owe i shita nounongo,
edu oli yadi oishitwa yoye.

Efuta opo li li linene
la mbwalangadja keembinga adishe,
omo mu yadi ndoondoo oinamwenyo
itai dulika okuvalwa, ei inini naai yakula.

Omo notamu ende eeskepa,
naLeviatan omo i li,
ei wa shitila okudanauka mo.

Aishe oyo, otai ku teelele,
Ove u i pe eendja pefimbo la yuka;

Ove to holeke oshipala shoye,
oyo otai haluka;
Ove to kufa mo omuku wayo,
opo otai shuna vali mondwi yedu, omu ya dja.

Ngeenge to pitifa mo omufudo wOmhepo yoye,
opo yo otai shitwa ipe,
noshitwe yedu oto i shitulula ipe.

Efimano lOmwene otali kala po fiyo alushe!
Omwene na hafele oilonga yaye!

Ngeenge ta konenene edu, otali kakama,
ngeenge ta kumu eemhunda,
do tadi twimaana omwifi.

Ame onda hala okwiimbila Omwene,
fimbo ndi nomwenyo,
nokutanga Kalunga kange, fimbo ndi li po.

Eshipululo lange nali mu wapalele.
Ohandi hafele mOmwene.

Ovalunde, ngeno nava kombololwe po kombada yedu,
novadinikalunga vaha kale po vali.
Omwenyo wange, tanga Omwene!
Halleluya!
105:
Hambeleleni Omwene,
ifaneni edina laye!
Hepaululeni oinenelonga yaye
mokati koiwana yoilongo.

Mu imbileni, mu shikileni,
udifeni oikumwifalonga yaye aishe.

Tumbalekeni edina laye liyapuki.
Ava tava kongo Omwene,
omutima wavo nau kale wa hafa.

Lipuleni nOmwene neenghono daye,
efimbo alishe kongeni oshipala shaye.

Dimbulukweni oikumwifa oyo e i longa,
nomadidilikokumwifa aye
nomatokolo okanya kaye,

oludalo nye laAbraham, omupiya waye,
ovana vaJakob, ovahoololwa vaye.

Omwene Oye Kalunga ketu;
omatokolo aye otaa udika mounyuni aushe.

Diladileni alushe ehangano laye,
neendjovo daye edi
a dikila omaludalo omayovi,

ehangano olo e li udafanene naAbraham,
neano olo e li anenene Isak,

olo e li a pamekelele Jakob,
li kale omhangela yaye
nehangano laye naIsrael fiyo alushe,

eshi a tile: “Edu laKaanan, ohandi li ku pe,
lo li kale oshitukulwafyuululwa sheni.”

ovatembavaukili koshiwana noshiwana,
koshilongo noshilongo.

Ndelenee Ye ina efa nande umwe e va fininike,
nokwa li a handukila eehamba omolwavo,

ndele ta ti: “Inamu kuma nande ovavaekwa vange,
nye inamu hepeka ovaxunganeki vange.”

Opo nee eshi kwa li a undulila oilongo ondjala,
nokwa kufa mo oshishipo keshe sheendja,

okwe va tetekelifila nale omulumenhu,
Josef, ou a li a landwa po, a ninga omupika.

Eemhadi daye okwa li ve di tula meti,
ve mu twalele ko nomalyenge

fiyo okefiku eli, exunganeko laye la shakenifwa,
nondaka yOmwene ye mu tokolela.

Opo nee ohamba oya tumine, a ka mangululwe,
omupangeli woiwana okwe mu efa,

ndele te mu lenge, a ninge elenga lakula leumbo laye,
nomuyukifi woinima yaye aishe,

a pangele omalenga aye pahalo laye mwene,
ye a longe ovakulunhu vaye eendunge.

Osho tuu ngaha Israel okwa ile muEgipiti,
ndele Jakob a kala omunailongo medu laHam.

Opo Kalunga okwa hovela okuhapupalifa ovanhu vaye,
ndele te va pameke ve dule ovafininiki vavo eenghono.

Eemwenyo daavenya okwe di lundulula,
va tonde ovanhu vaye,
nova ninge ovapiya vaye ekonda.

Opo nee Ye a tuma Moses, omupiya waye,
naAron, ou a hoolola;

omadidiliko aye a longa mokati kavo,
noikumwifa medu laHam.

Okwa umbila mo omulaulu, wa laula fokofoko;
ndelenee eendjovo daye inave di anya.

Omeva avo okwe a shitukifa ohonde,
eeshi adishe di file mo.

Oshilongo shavo osha yada omayula,
a shituka nomeendjuwo deehamba davo.

Okwa tonga, ndele oihomo yeemwe ye uya,
noyomawashe medu lavo alishe;

e va lokifila eemhawe ponhele yodula,
nomitemo domundilo moshilongo shavo.

Omiviinyu nomikwiyu davo okwe di tetaula po,
nomiti domoshilongo shavo okwe di teyaula mo.

Okwa tonga, opo oshipaxu she uya
nokanakalombo, kehe shii kuvalwa.

Yo oya mana po oimeno aishe moshilongo,
noilya yomomapya ya lika po sheke.

Opo vali okwa dipaifa oiveli aishe moshilongo,
oiveli yeenghono davo aishe,

ndele ta tembukifa mo Ovaisraeli
ve noisiliveli noingoldo,
nomokati komapata avo
kamwa li nande oshingudu.

Ovaegipiti okwa li va fudifwa ketembu lavo,
osheshi ova li va kwatwa koumbada molwavo.

Ye okwe va uvikila noshilemo ngaashi onhanga,
nomundilo wokuminikila oufiku;

vo ova indila, opo Ye okwe va undulila oimote,
ndele te va palula nomungome tau di keulu;

osheshi ye a dilakana ondjovo yaye iyapuki,
okwa dimbulukwa Abraham, omupiya waye.

Osho ngaha a pitifa mo ovanhu vaye nehafo,
novahoololwa vaye neenghalu;

opo nee e va pa oilongo yovapaani,
nolukongo loiwana yoilongo,
eli ye likongelele, vo ve li kwata,

opo vo va anyene moipango yaye,
nova shakenife eenghedi daye.
Halleluya!
106:
Halleluya!
Hambeleleni Omwene, osheshi Oye omuwa,
ouwanghenda waye tau kala po fiyo alushe.

Olyelye mbela ta dulu okutonga
oinenelonga yOmwene, e i fikife po,
ye a shiivife ngeno efimano laye alishe?

Ovanelao ovava, va dama mouyuki,
ndele tava kala alushe nokuwanifa ouyuki.

Omwene, dimbulukwe nge molwefilonghenda
eli ho ningile oshiwana shoye.
Talele nge po nekwafo loye.

Opo ndi shiive okutala elao lovahoololwa voye,
nondi nyakukilwe ehafo loshiwana shoye,
ame ndi litange pamwe noshitukulwafyuululwa shoye.

Fye nootate, atushe otwa nyona,
twe livilikita ndele twa longa oidinifikalunga.

Ootate yetu muEgipiti
inava koneka oikumwifalonga yoye,
inava dilakana ouhapu
womaningilo ouwanghenda woye,
va tumhakana mwoou wOkombadambada
pEfuta Litilyana;

ndelenee Ye okwe va xupifa molwedina laye,
okuholola eenghono daye.

Okwa aneka Efuta Litilyana:
ndele opa holoka oukukutu,
ndele te va pitifa momeva ngaashi ometunda.

Osho nee ngaha okwe va xupifa momake ovataataai,
ndele te va kulile meenghono domutondi.

Omeva okwa tuvika ovafininiki vavo:
inapa xupa nande umwe womuvo.

Opo va itavelela eendjovo daye,
ndele tava imbi efimano laye.

mofuka ove liyandja mokahalu kavo,
ndele va yeleka Kalunga mombuwa.

Opo nee ye e va pa eshi ve shi pula,
ndelenee okwa tuma muvo oudu mudjuu.

Opo nee monhanda ova ngongotela Moses
naAron, omupiyayapuki wOmwene;

opo tuu opo edu ola akama okanya
ndele tali pona po Datan,
ndele tali tuvike etanga laAbiram,

nomundilo owa xwika ongudu yavo,
omitemo oda mana po ovakolokoshi.

KuHoreb, oko ove li ningila oshiyelekela shokatana
ndele tava tu eengolo kefano loshivela la hambulwa.

Noshinge shavo ove shi tekuka
ndele tava tekukile oshiyelekela shomhedi,
ei tai li omwiidi.

Okwa li va dimbwa Kalunga, Omuxupifi wavo,
ou a ningile oinima inene muEgipiti,

noikumwifa medu laHam,
noitilifalonga pEfuta Litilyana.

Opo Ye a uka oku va hanauna po,
ndelenee e shi efifwa kuMoses, omuhoololwa waye,
ou a ile kuye, oku va popila,
Ye a pungulule po puvo ehandu laye loku va kanifa.

Opo nee va dina oshilongo shinya shiwa unene,
neendjovo daye inave di itavela.

Ndelenee va ngongota meenhanda davo,
ndele inava dulika kondaka yOmwene.

Opo nee Ye e va yelulila eke laye,
e va mane po mofuka,

noludalo lavo e li lihanifile movapaani
noku li nipila moilongo.

Opo nee ove lipaka kuBaal-Peor,
nova lya omayambo aai ihe nomwenyo

ndele tave mu tondifa noilonga yavo.
Opo nee eshi pa tukuluka eefya mokati kavo,

Pinehas okwa fikama ndele ta wanifa etokolo;
neefya oda kanghekwa.

Eshi osha talwa ko sha yuka notashi ka dimbulukiwa
koludalo noludalo fiyo alushe.

Opo va tikukifa Kalunga pomeva omuMeriba,
ndele Moses a monifwa oixuna molwavo.

Osheshi vo, eshi va li va hanyena
Omhepo yaKalunga,
oshe mu livondifa okupopya nomilungu daye.

Oiwana yoilongo inave i hanauna po,
ngaashi va lombwelwa kOmwene.

Ndelenee ova lumbakana mumwe novapaani,
ndele tave liikifa eenghedi davo.

Ndele tava longele oikalunga yavo;
yo oye va pundukifa nokuli.

Heeno, ovamati vavo noukadona vavo
ove va fiyawilile keendemoni,

ndele va tilashi ohonde ihe netimba
yovamati noyoukadona vavo,
ava ve va fiyawilila oikalunga yaKaanan,
nedu ola nyatekelwe komatimba.

Osho ve linyateka noilonga yavo
nova kala moukwaipala.

Opo ehandu laKalunga ola xwama
kombada yoshiwana shaye,
nokwa nyonyodola ovafyuululifwa vaye.

Okwe va yandja momake ovapaani,
novatondadi vavo ove va pangela.

Ovatondi vavo ove va inda unene moshipala,
fiyo ve va findila momhango yavo.

Luhapu okwe va mangulula,
ndelenee vo va anyena melundakano lavo,
va ninginifwa mo kowii wavo.

Ndelenee Ye okwe va yavelela moudjuu wavo,
alushe ngeenge a uda ekemo lavo,

nokwe va dilakanena ehangano laye navo,
nokwe va kenukila pauwanghenda waye munene,

nokwe va filifa onghenda kwaaveshe,
ava ve va kwata oupika.

Omwene, Kalunga ketu, tu kwafa,
tu kongolola mo moiwana,
opo fye tu hambelele edina loye liyapuki,
noku li tanga molwefimano loye.

Omwene, Kalunga kaIsrael na hambelelwe
alushe fiyo alushe!
Noiwana aishe nai tye: “Amen!”
Halleluya!
107:
Hambeleleni Omwene, osheshi Oye omuwa,
osheshi ouwanghenda waye otau kala po fiyo alushe:

osho nava tonge ava va kulilwa kOmwene,
ava a mangulula momaudjuu wavo,

nokwe va ongela moilongo moushilo nomouninginino,
moumbangalanhu nomoumbuwanhu.

Okwa li va endaenda mofuka
nomombuwa ihe na omalila,
inava mona nande oshilando shokukala mo.

Vo ova fya ondjala nenota,
neemwenyo davo da konenwa kuyo.

Opo nee moudjuu wavo
ova kuwa kOmwene onghuwo,
ndele Ye e va xupifa momatilo avo,

ndele e va endifa mondjila ya yuka,
vo va fike koshilando va kale mo,

ovo nava pandulile Omwene ouwanghenda waye
noikumwifa yaye, ei ha longele ovana vovanhu,

molwaashi a kumwifa omwenyo ou wa notelwa,
nokwa palula nouwa omwenyo wa konenwa.

Ava va li omutumba momulaulu
nomomudile wefyo,
va kwatelwa moluhepo nomelyenge,

osheshi va li va anya okudulika
keendjovo daKalunga,
nova dina epukululo laau wOkombadambada,

fiyo okwa ninipika omitima davo noudjuu,
ndele tava pundu, vehe namukwafi;

okwe va pitifa mo momulaulu nomomudile wefyo,
ndele ta tokaula omapando avo;

vo nava pandulile Omwene ouwanghenda waye
noikumwifa yaye, ei ha longele ovana vovanhu,

molwaashi a teyaula po oivelo yoshikushu,
noipatifo yoitenda okwe i tataula po.

Ava kwa li va nyika oulai,
eshi va hepifwa kokukala kwavo
momanyono nomolwowii wavo,

keshe tuu eendja ove di nyonyodola kwa li,
fiyo ove lifikifa popepi noivelo yefyo;

Oye okwa tuma ondjovo yaye nokwe va velula
noku va xupifa mombila.

Ovo nava pandulile Omwene ouwanghenda waye,
noikumwifa yaye, ei ha longele ovana vovanhu,

vo nava ete omayambo olupandu
nokuudifa oinenelonga yaye nenyaku.

Ava kwa li va yauka omeva efuta neeskepa,
va ka shingife oipindi yavo komafuta manene;

vo ova mona okulonga kwOmwene
noikumwifalonga yaye moule womafuta.

Osheshi Ye, eshi a tonga,
okwa tukulukifa oshikungulu shinene,
eshi sha tumbifa omakufikufi,
tashi a umbile pombada;

ova ifwa oshitelele, ndele tava tengaukifwa
va fa eengholwe,
neendunge davo opo da xulila opo.

opo vo ova hafa, eshi sha lota,
ndele Ye te va twala ketulilo, eli va hala;

ovo nava pandulile Omwene ouwanghenda waye
noikumwifa yaye, ei ha longele ovana vovanhu;

vo nave mu fimaneke meongalo loiwana
noku mu hambelela moshiongalele shovakulunhu.

Omilonga okwe di shitukifa eembuwa,
needjo oipale yongaho,

edilopya okwe li ninga edu loshimongwa,
omolwoulunde wovanhu ava ve li mo.

Osho yo apa, pa li shito ombuwa,
okwa shitukifa po omatale,
nedu likukutu okwe li shitukifa eefifiya,

novafi vondjala okwe va nangeka mo
ndele va ninga mo oshilando, omo va kala,

nokwe va nangeka noupuna,
ndele tava hapupala unene,
noimuna yavo keinini.

Ndelenee opo va ninipala vali, va xutuka,
va hangika komupya noshisho noluhodi.

Ovakengeli ote va vaeke odino,
ndele te va efa va puke va ende moxwati.

Epongo okwe li kufa moupongo walo,
nomapata ao okwe a tanifa
ngaashi oyuunda yeedi.

Ovayuki ohave shi mono noku shi hafela,
ndele oumbudi aushe u nokumutikwa okanya kao.

Ou e nounongo ne shi diladile,
ye na shipaashipe
omaningilo ouwanghenda wOmwene.
108:
Kalunga, omutima wange owa tiluluka.
Onda hala okwiimba nokushika.
Penduka, omwenyo wange!

Yambukeni, onyalilo nokaxumbafeta!
Onda hala okupendula eluwa.

osheshi ouwanghenda woye otau lundu eulu,
noudiinini woye otau koya oilemo.

Kalunga, fikama u liyeke fiyo okombada yeulu,
nefimano loye kombada yedu alishe!

Tu kwafa nolulyo loye,
ovaholike voye fye opo tu xupifwe, tu uda.

Mouyapuki waye Kalunga okwa tonga ta ti:
“Onda hala, ndi kaluke nda findana,
onda hala okutavaula Sekem
nokuyeleka, apa pe fike oule wolufilu laSukkot.

Gilead oshange naManasse oshange
naEfraim oshikelelifo shokomutwe wange,
naJuda odibopangelo yange.

Olyelye ta twala nge mbela koshilando sha pama?
Olyelye wokufindikila nge kuEdom?

Haave ou, we tu ekelashi, Kalunga,
haave ito ende vali pamwe neengudu d
ovakwaita detu, Kalunga?

Tu xupifa kovatondi vetu;
osheshi ekwafo lomunhu olongaho.

Pamwe naKalunga ohatu ka ninga oilonganghono;
osheshi naYe mwene ota ka lyataula ovatondi vetu.
109: Akutu Kalunga kepandulo lange, ino mwena!

ova kondekela nge neendjovo doutondwe,
ova ponokela nge oshimha;

ohole yange otave i alulile nge ondubo,
fimbo ame ndi li po, handi va indilile.

Ouwa ove u alulila nge owii,
noutondwe molwohole yange.

Mu fikamifila yo omukolokoshi, e mu tokole,
nomwaambi waye ne mu ame kolulyo;

metokolo laye na monike oushima,
neilikano laye nali nyike oulunde.

Omafiku aye naa xupipale,
umwe na tambule oufitalonga waye.

Ovana vaye nava ninge eefiye,
nomwalikadi waye omufiyekadi;

oludalo laye nali tembavauke nokweehelavaela,
okukonga eendja komakulekule
komakuluputu oyuumbo yavo.

Omunashikolo naye ne mu kufe keshe eshi e kwete,
novayeni nave mu nyeke oikongwa yaye;

ina mona nande ou, te mu fi eenghoto,
po inapa monika ou ta kenukile eefiye daye.

Oludalo laye nali kombwe po sheke,
movatekulu edina lavo nali dimwe mo.

oyo nai kale alushe koshipala shOmwene,
opo a dimbwife okushiivika kwavo kombada yedu.

Molwaashi ye ina yavala okulongifa ohole,
ndelenee okwa taataa epongo newilandjila,
nomunaluhodi a limbililwa, e mu dipae nokuli.

Ye a kala e hole okufinga, efingo ole mu hanga.
Okwa li ehe hole enangekonoupuna,
hano ole mu kala kokule.

Okwe lidika efingaelo ngaashi omudjalo waye,
olo le mu ya meni ngaashi omeva
nomomakipa aye ngaashi omaadi.

Nali ninge oshiliuviko shokuliuvikila
nongaashi ekwamo, e li djale alushe.

Eshi osho nashi ninge ondjabi
yovashindanhu vange, ve i pewe kOmwene,
noyaava tava popi nge nai.

Osheshi onda nyika oluhepo noufyoona,
nomutima wange owa tyuulwa monhulo yange.

Ohandi xulu po ngaashi omudidimbe,
ngeenge tau hovele okutandavela;
ohandi twalwatwalwa komhepo
ngaashi oshipaxu.

Omwene, Kalunga kange, Oove, kwafe nge!
Xupife nge molwouwanghenda woye!

Va dimbulukifa, nokutya eshi,
oshilonga sheke loye,
Omwene, kutya Oove mwene we shi eta po.

Vo nava finge ngaho,
ndele Ove, nangeka noupuna.
Ngeenge va fikamena nge, Ove va xutula.
Omupiya woye ame ndi hafe.

Ovatondi vange nava dikwe elengwa,
ve liuvike odino ngaashi oshidjalomwa.

Okanya kange naka pandule Omwene mokule,
ame ndi mu tangele meengudu davahapu;

osheshi Ye oku li ofika kolulyo lomufyoona,
e mu xupife kwaava tave mu tokola.
110:
Omwene okwa tya kOmwene wange, ta ti:
“Kala omutumba kolulyo lange,
fiyo handi ningi ovatondi voye
oshilyatelo shokeemhadi doye.”

Oshiwana shoye oshe lilongekidila
nehalo liwa unene, mefiku lehomono loye:
momidjalowapeko diyapuki
ovanyasha voye tava iluka
ngaashi omume mekolo leluwa.

Omwene okwa ana, ndele ite shi lundulula:
“Oove omupristeli fiyo alushe opanghedi yaMelkisedek.”

Omwene oku li kolulyo loye,
mefiku lehandu laye ota nyanyaula eehamba;

ota yandje etokolo mokati koiwana yoilongo,
oimhu otai napakana apeshe,
ota ka finda eehamba doilongo aishe.

Metondokelo lomeva opondjila ota nu mo;
eshi notashi mu lyaalalifa omutwe waye pombada.
111:
Halleluya!
Onda hala okutanga Omwene nomutima aushe
mongudu yovayuki nomeongalo.

Oilonga yOmwene oinene,
oya wana okukonakonwa kovahokwi vayo aveshe.

Oilonga yaye oya tumbala noya fimana,
nouyuki waye otau kala po alushe.

Ava have mu tila, ote va pe eendja,
alushe oha dimbulukwa ehangano lavo naye.

Eenghono doinenelonga yaye
okwe di shiivifa oshiwana shaye,
eshi e shi fyuululifa oilongo yovapaani.

Oilonga yomake aye, oyo oudiinini nouyuki,
omapangelo aye aeshe oku shii kulineekelwa,

ihaa hekuka nande, taa kalelele fiyo alushe,
taa wanifwa noudiinini nouyuki.
112:
Halleluya!
Omulumenhu omunelao ou ha tila Omwene,
ndele ta hokwa shili oipango yaye.

Meumbo laye omu yadi oinima noupuna,
nouyuki waye otau kalele.

Ovayuki ote va pitile ngaashi ouyelele momulaulu,
omunalukeno nomunanghenda nomuyuki.

Ou ha file onghenda
ndele ta yandje nokuhateelela sha,
oye omukalinawa.
Ta diinine oinima yaye pauyuki;

Omutima waye owa dja oumbada,
ye ita tila nande osha,
fiyo ote litadele ovatondi vaye.
113:
Halleluya!
Ovapiya vOmwene nye, tangeni,
tangeni edina lOmwene!

Edina lOmwene nali fimanekwe
onena fiyo omoukwaalushe.
Kepito letango fiyo okeningino lalo nali tangwe.

Omwene okwa tumbala
kombada yoiwana aishe yoilongo,
oshingefimano shaye osha lunda eulu.

Olyelye e fike pOmwene, Kalunga ketu,
ou e nonhele yokukala kwaye kombada,

ndele ta tale mokule mwi,
meulu nokombada yedu?

Ohepele ote i tumbu mo mondwi yedu,
nomufyoona ote mu toola mo monyata,

e mu kaleke omutumba pamwe noidale,
pamwe noidalekele yoshiwana shaye.

Omwalikadi ongadji ote mu pe onhele meumbo,
ote mu ningi omudalakadi a hafele ovana.
Halleluya!
114:
Israel eshi a tembwilwe muEgipiti,
eumbo laJakob eshi la dile moshiwana
shelaka tali duma,

Opo Juda a ninga ouyapuki waye,
naIsrael onhele youhamba waye.

Omeva efuta okwe shi mona,
ndele taa i onhapo,
omulonga Jordan owa shuna lwanima,

osha nhukifa eemhunda ngaashi eemenye
oimhundangala, ongaashi eedjona.

Efuta oove, oshike she ku hanga,
eshi to faduka po,
naave Jordan, eshi to i shanimanima?

Nanye eemhunda, eshi tamu nhukaanhuka
ngaashi eedi deemhedi,
nanye oimhundangala ngaashi eedjona?

Edu oove, kakama koshipala shOmwene,
koshipala shaKalunga kaJakob,

ou ta shitukifa emanya ediva,
eenghungumanya di ninge ofifiya.
115:
Omwene, fye hafye u longela efimano,
fye hafye, ndelenee edina loye mwene,
molwouwanghenda nomolwoudiinini woye.

Ovapaani otave ya okutya ngahelipi:
“Kalunga kavo oku li peni hano?”

Kalunga ketu, omeulu ngaho e li;
ashishe eshi a hala, ote shi longo nee.

Oikalunga yavo oyo oisiliveli noingoldo,
oitotwa yomake ovanhu.

Omakanya oi na, yo ihai popi,
nomesho oi a kwete, yo ihai mono ko.

Oi nomatwi, ndele ihai udu ko,
oi kwete omayulu, ihai fimbula.

Ovatoti vayo otave ya okufaafana nayo,
keshe tuu omulineekeli wayo.

Israel, ove, lineekela Omwene!
Oye ekwafo loye noshikelelifo shoye.

Ovaneumbo laAron nye, lineekeleni Omwene!
Oye ekwafo leni noshikelelifo sheni.

Ava hamu tila Omwene, lineekeleni Omwene!
Oye ekwafo leni noshikelelifo sheni.

Omwene okwe shi tu dimbulukila:
ote ya oku tu punika,
ota punike eumbo laIsrael,
ota punike eumbo laAron,

ote ya a punike ava, hava tila Omwene,
ovaxupi novale.

Omwene ne mu hapupalife,
nye amushe novana veni.

Nye ovanangekwa noupuna kOmwene,
ou a shita eulu nedu.

Eulu olo olOmwene,
ndelenee edu okwe li pa ovana vovanhu.

Ovafi naaveshe hava i melimweneneno,
ihava tange Omwene;

ndelenee fye, fye twa hala okutanga Omwene
okudja apa fiyo alushe.
Halleluya!
116:
Opo nee onda lalekida edina lOmwene:
“Akutu, Omwene, xupifa omwenyo wange!”

Omwene Oye omunanghenda nomuyuki,
ndele Kalunga ketu Ye omunalukeno.

Omwene oha amene ovalininipiki.
Ame nda ngona, ndelenee Ye okwa kwafa nge.

Omwenyo wange, alukila ketulumuko loye,
osheshi Omwene e ku ninga nawa.

ohandi ende koshipala shOmwene
medu lovanamwenyo.

Onda itavela, onghee handi popi:
“Onda findilwa unene poshi;”

melimbililo lange onda tile:
“Ovanhu aveshe ovanaipupulu.”

Omwene ohandi mu ningile shike,
ndi mu alulile ouwa aushe, ou a longela nge?

Onda hala okuyelula eholo lexupifo,
ame ndi fimaneke edina lOmwene pombada;

omaudaneko ange onda hala ndi a wanifile Omwene,
heeno, ndi a wanifile
moipafi yoshiwana shaye ashishe.

Momesho Omwene efyo lovayuki vaye
ola nhendipalekwa.

Akutu, Omwene, aame omupiya woye,
ondi mona womwalikadi omupiya woye.
Omapando ange we a pandukulula.

Onda hala ndi ku etele eyambo lolupandu
nokwiifana edina lOmwene;

omaudaneko ange onda hala ndi a wanifile Omwene,
heeno, ndi a wanifile
moipafi yoshiwana shaye ashishe,

momikala deumbo lOmwene,
meni loye, Jerusalem.
Halleluya!
117:
Oiwana nye amushe, tangeni Omwene!
Oiwana yoilongo amushe nye,
mu fimanekeni!

Osheshi ouwanghenda waye
u neenghono dinene kombada yetu,
noudiinini wOmwene otau kala po fiyo alushe.
Halleluya.
118:
Hambeleleni Omwene, osheshi Oye omuwa,
ouwanghenda waye otau kala po alushelushe.

Israel osho na tye:
“Ouwanghenda waye otau kala po alushelushe!”

Vomeumbo laAron osho nava tye yo:
“Heeno, ouwanghenda waye
otau kala po alushelushe.”

Ava hava tila Omwene osho nava tye:
“Heeno, ouwanghenda waye
otau kala po alushelushe.”

Moudjuu wange onda ifana kOmwene,
opo Omwene okwa uda nge,
ndele a tula nge mokaalanga.

Omwene Oye e kwete nge, itandi tila sha.
Ovanhu otava ningi nge shike?

Omwene okwa ama nge, Oye ta kwafa nge.
Osho handi dulu okutala nehafo ovatondi vange.
Okulineekela Omwene oku dule okulineekela ovanhu.

Okulineekela Omwene
oku dule okulineekela ovapangeli.

Ovapaani aveshe ova kondekela nge;
medina lOmwene onde va hanauna po.

Ova li va kondekela nge, va li va dingilila nge;
medina lOmwene onde va hanauna po.

Onda undwilwa nai kwoove ndi wile po,
ndelenee Omwene okwa kwafa nge.

Omwene Oye eenghono dange neimbilo lange,
Ye okwa ninga omuxupifi wange.

Okunyakukwa nokwiimbila efindano
otaku udika meenhanda dovayuki:
olulyo lOmwene otali longifa oilonga yeenghono:

“Olulyo lOmwene ola yeluka,
olulyo lOmwene ohali longifa oilonga yeenghono!”

Ame itandi fi, ndelenee ohandi kala nomwenyo,
ame ndi udife oinenelonga yOmwene.

Omwene okwa li a vyula nge noudjuu,
ndelenee Ye ina yandja nge ndi fye.

Yeululile nge oivelo youyuki,
onda hala okupita muyo,
ndi ka pandule Omwene.

Oshivelo shOmwene osheshi;
omu tamu iwa kovayuki.

Ohandi ku pandula, eshi wa uda nge,
naashi wa ninga omuxupifi wange.

Emanya olo ovatungi ve li ekelashi,
olo la ninga omutwe wokolonela.

Eshi osha dja mOmwene,
noshikumwifa momesho etu.

Efiku olo tuu eli, ola tulwa po kOmwene;
tu li nyakukilweni, fye tu li hafele.

Akutu, Omwene, tu xupifa!
Akutu, Omwene, tu pa elao!

Na nangekwe noupuna,
ou te uya medina lOmwene.
Ohatu mu punikile mongulu yOmwene.

Kalunga Oye Omwene, Oye e tu pa ouyelele.
Omayambo oshivilo a mangeni neengodi

Heeno, Omwene okwa li e tu ningila oinima inene.
Otwa kala twa hafa.

Omwene, shitukifa oshitukulilwa shetu,
ngaashi ho alula omatondokelo omeva odula
medu lokoumbuwanhu.

Ava hava kunu nomahodi,
ohava teya va nyakukwa.

Heeno, moku ka kuna ombuto,
otava ende nokulila;
ndele mokwaaluka otava kuwilile,
notava humbata oilya yavo.
127:
Omwene, ngeenge haye omudikifi weumbo,
ovadiki valo otava kendabala oshimha.
Omwene ngeenge ita amene oshilando,
omunangeli ota kelele oshimha.

Okumeneka kweni ongula,
nokuxunguluka moilonga oufikufiku, okwongaho,
eshi tamu li eendja deni noshisho.
Ovaholike vaye ohe di va pe mokukofa kwavo.

Heeno, ovana ovamati ovo oshali yOmwene,
nokumona oludalo osho ondjabi iwa.

Ngaashi oikuti i li meke lofule,
ovana ovamati osho tava kala mounyasha wavo.

Omulumenhu omunelao ou,
e va yadi ndoo monywa yaye!
Vo itava fifwa ohoni,
ngeenge tava kundafana novayelani moluvanda.
128:
Keshe tuu ou ha tila Kalunga
nota ende meendjila daye,
oye omunelao.

Eshi we lilongela nomake oye,
osho oshikongwa shoye shili,
ou nelao, to kala nawa.

Omwalikadi woye oku li ngaashi oshixwa shomuviinyu,
ou hau ima nawa meni leumbo loye;
ounona voye ova fa oitutumine yolumono,
hava dingilile oshililo shoye.

Heeno, osho ngaha
omulumenhu omutilikalunga ta nangekwa noupuna.

Omwene womuSion ne ku punike,
u kale nokutala elao laJerusalem
noku li nyakukilwa omafiku oye aeshe,

ndele to mono ounona vovana voye.
Ombili nai kale naIsrael!
129:
Israel osho na tye:
“Nghee nda dja kounona wange, ova fininika nge nai,

nghee nda dja kounona wange, ova fininika nge nai,
ndele inava finda nge nande.

Kombuda yange ovalimi ova lima ko,
ndele va pala oimhungu ile.”

Ndelenee Omwene omuyuki
Oye a tetaula omiya dovalunde.

Aveshe ava tava tondo Sion,
nava fifwe ohoni, vo va shunifwe shanimanima.

Nava ningwe ngaashi omwiidi
wa mena kombada yonduda,
ou tau kukuta, fimbo inau kola,

oo, omukashuli ita yadifa eke nao,
nomumangi womikuto otau xulunguta
momaoko aye,

naava tava ende po, itava ti nande:
“Epuniko laKalunga nali uye kombada yeni.
Fye ohatu mu nangeke noupuna medina lOmwene.”
130: Meni mokule mwi ohandi ku kuwile, Omwene!

Omwene, uda ondaka yange!
Omatwi oye naa pwilikine nawa
ondaka yomailikano ange.

Omwene, ngeenge to konenene omawii,
Omwene, olyelye ta kala po?
Ndelenee pwoove ope nekufilo, opo u tilike.

Ohandi teelele Omwene, omwenyo wange
ou netimaumbwile,
nohandi tula elineekelo mondjovo yoye.

Omwenyo wange ou neteelelo tau teelele Omwene,
li dule lomunangeli ta teelele ku she,
heeno, oli dule lomunangeli ta teelele ku she.

ndele Ye ote uya okukulila Israel
momawii aye aeshe.
131:
Omwene, omutima wange kau na elituleko,
omesho ange ihaa tale paukengeli;
oinima ei inai yeleka pwaame,
notai dulu nge eenghono,
