yo ihai veleke nge oshisho.

Ndelenee omwenyo wange onde u lotifa,
nonde u ngungumaneka ngaashi okaana,
aka ka tova, ka ukatwa mekolo laina,
osho ngaha omwenyo wange
owa tovifwa wa lota mwaame.

Israel, telamena Omwene
nena nofiyo alushe!
132:
Akutu, Omwene, dimbulukila David
omalipyakuduko aye aeshe,

ou a li nale e lianena Omwene
ndele ta udanekele Omunaenghono,
Kalunga kaJakob, ta ti:

“Metwali lomonhanda yange itandi i mo nande,
ile ndi ka nangale momutala wange,

nomesho ange itandi a efa a fye eemhofi,
neemhafu dange di fifikine,

fimbo inandi monena Omwene omutumba,
onhele yOmunaenghono waJakob.”

Tala, otwe shi uda muEfrata,
notwe shi mona mehenene laJaar:

Tu yeni moukalelo waye,
fye tu ka tweni eengolo poshilyatelo sheemhadi daye.

Omwene, fikama, u uye komutumba woye,
Oove mwene noshikefa sheenghono doye.

Ovapristeli voye nave lidike ouyuki,
novakoshoki voye nava nyakukwe.

Molwomupiya woye David
ino likandula oshipala shomuvaekwa woye;

Omwene okwa anena David eano lashili,
ite li lundulula, a tya:
“Umwe womoludalo loye,
onda hala oku mu paka omutumba
kolukalwapangelo loye.

Ovana voye ovamati,
ngeenge tava diinine ehangano lange navo,
ehepaululo eli handi longo,
opo nee ovana ovamati vavo
otava kala yo kolukalwapangelo loye fiyo alushe.”

Heeno Omwene okwa hoolola Sion,
okwe shi lihoololela, shi ninge onhele yokukala kwaye.

Oipalwifa yasho onda hala oku i punika i hapupale,
Ame ndi palule omapongo amo neendja.

Ovapristeli vasho ohandi va djaleke exupifo,
novayuki vasho nava nyakukifwe pombada.

Omo onda hala okukulifila mo eenghono daDavid,
nonda longekidila mo omuvaekwa wange oshiminikilifo.

Ovatondi veni ohandi va dike odino,
ndelenee oshishani shokomutwe waye,
nashi kale tashi vilima.”
133:
Taleni, oshiwa nosha wapala shi fike peni,
ovamwaxe ngeenge tava kala kumwe nombili.

Ongaashi omaadi edimba liwa okomutwe
taa ndodele meendjedi,
omeendjedi daAron,
edi da endjelela fiyo okomwooyo
womudjalo waye,

nongaashi omume, ei tai u kuHermon,
ndele tai nofaele keemhunda daSion,
osheshi oko tuu Omwene a yandjela ko
enangeko noupuna,
olo omwenyo fiyo alushe.
134:
Yambukeni, hambeleleni Omwene,
ovapiya vaye nye amushe,
ava hamu kala ofika meumbo lOmwene oufiku.

Yelulileni omaoko eni langhele kouyapuki,
nye tangeni Omwene.

Omwene omushiti weulu nedu
ne mu nangeke noupuna muSion.
135:
Halleluya!
Tangeni edina lOmwene,
li tangeni, ovapiya nye vOmwene,

ava hamu kala ofika meumbo lOmwene,
momikala deumbo laKalunga ketu.

Tangeni Omwene, osheshi Omwene omuwa.
Imbileni edina laye ehambelelo,
osheshi olo olinyenye.

Osheshi Omwene okwe lihoololela Jakob,
naIsrael, shi kale emona laye.

Heeno, ondi shi shii: Omwene Oye omunene,
naKalunga ketu Oye e dule ookalunga aveshe.

Omwene oha wanifa ashishe, eshi a hala
meulu nokombada yedu,
momafuta nomomaule aeshe ao.

Oye tuu ou, ta tumbifa oilemo keengaba dedu,
ndele ta holokifa omaluvadi mokuloka kwodula,
ndele ta pitifa mo omhepo momalimba ayo.

Oye tuu okwa dengele oiveli muEgipiti,
ei yovanhu noyoimuna,

nomwoove, Egipiti, Oye tuu a tuma
omadidiliko noikumwifa
kuFarao novanhu vaye aveshe.

Oye tuu ou a denga oiwana ihapu,
neehamba deenghono okwe di dipaa:

Sihon, ohamba yOvaamori,
naOg, ohamba yomuBasan,
nomauhamba aeshe omuKaanan,

noilongo yavo okwe i yandja efyuululo,
i fyuululwe kovanhu vaye Ovaisraeli.

Omwene, edina loye ohali kala po fiyo alushe,
efimano loye, Omwene, okoludalo noludalo;

osheshi Omwene ota yukifile ovanhu vaye,
novapiya vaye ote va file onghenda.

Oikalunga yovapaani oyo yoisiliveli noingoldo,
oyo ya mewa komake ovanhu.

Omakanya oi na, yo ihai popi,
nomesho oi a kwete, yo ihai mono ko.

Oi nomatwi ndele ihai udu ko,
osho yo momakanya ayo omufudo kau mo.

Ovatoti vayo otave uya okufaafana nayo,
keshe tuu omulineekeli wayo.

Nye ava vomeumbo laIsrael, hambeleleni Omwene!
Nye vomeumbo laAron, hambeleleni Omwene!

Nye vomeumbo laLevi, hambeleleni Omwene!
Ovatilikalunga nye, hambeleleni Omwene!

Efimano lOmwene nali holoke muSion,
laau, a tula muJerusalem!
Halleluya!
136:
Panduleni Omwene, osheshi Oye omuwa!
Osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Panduleni Kalunga kookalunga,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Panduleni Omwene woovene,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Oye ou, ha longo oikumwifalonga, Oye aeke,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Oye tuu ou, a shita omaulu nounongo waye,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Oye tuu ou, a valela edu kombada yomeva,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Ou omushiti womaminikilo manene,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Etango li pangele omutenya,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Ohani neenyofi oyo i pangele oufiku,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

ndele Farao nongudu yaye yovakwaita
okwe va undulila mo mEfuta Litilyana,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po;

neehamba da li da tumbala okwe di dipaa,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Sihon, ohamba yOvaamori,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po,

naOg, ohamba yomuBasan,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

i ninge efyuululo lomupiya waye Israel,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Oye tuu ou, e tu dimbulukwa mediniko letu,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Nokwe tu kulila kovafininiki vetu,
osheshi ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po alushe.

Oye ou, omupaluli woinamwenyo aishe,
osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.

Panduleni Kalunga komeulu!
Osheshi alushe ouwanghenda waye
tau kala po.
137:
Komilonga daBabilon,
oko twa li omutumba hatu lili,
eshi hatu dimbulukwa Sion.
Ouxumbafeta vetu otwe va tulikile komidime daako,

osheshi ovapiki vetu okwa li va hala tu va imbile po,
novahepeki vetu ove tu findila, tu nyakukwe tava ti:
“Tu imbileni po eimbilo limwe lomomaimbilo aSion!”

Ohatu dulu ngahelipi mbela okwiimba
eimbilo lOmwene medu lounailongo?

Ngeno ove, ndi ku dimbwe, Jerusalem,
eke lange lokolulyo ngeno nali fipatele!

Elaka lange ngeno nali kanyatele kondakona,
ngeenge ihandi ku dimbulukwa,
ngeenge itandi ku tetekelifa, Jerusalem,
komesho yoihafifi yange aishe.

Omwene, efiku lomupya waJerusalem,
kala we li xweenenena ovana vaEdom,
eshi va ingidile tava ti:
“Shi ngumauneni po, shi ngumauneni po,
nashi xulifwe po sheke!”

Omona okakadona kaBabilon, omuhanauni ove!
Omunelao oyou, te ku alulile ashishe,
eshi wa nyona kufye.

Omunelao oyou, ta kwata ouhanana voye,
ndele te va shataula po komamanya.
138:
Omwene, onda hala, ndi ku tange nomutima aushe,
ame ndi ku imbile ehambelelo moipafi yookalunga;

onda hala okuwila eombe,
nda taalela otembeli yoye iyapuki,
nokutanga edina loye
molwouwanghenda noudiinini woye,
edina loye neudaneko loye
owe i nenepekifa, shi dule shito.

Eshi nda li nde ku ifana owa uda nge
owa dika nge, onyati,
omwenyo wange wa mona eenghono.

Eehamba adishe dokombada yedu
otadi ke ku tanga, Omwene,
ngeenge tadi udu eendjovo domokanya koye,

ndele tadi ya okwiimbila oilonga yOmwene,
shaashi oshinge shOmwene oshinene,

osheshi Omwene Oye a tumbala,
ndele ta yavelele omudinwa,
ndelenee ovalituliko ohe va dimbulukile kokule.

Ngeenge handi ende pokati kamumhaka namumhaka,
Ove to diinine omwenyo wange,
ndele to nane eke loye,
u kelele onyanya yovatondi vange,
nolulyo loye ohali xupifa nge.

Omwene ote ke shi wanifila nge.
Omwene, ouwanghenda woye otau kala po alushe.
Ino umbilila oilonga yomake oye.
139: Omwene, Oove to konakona nge, ndele to koneke nge;

nande ndi li omutumba, ile nda fikama, owe shi shiiva;
omadiladilo ange ou a uditile kokule;

nande ohandi ende, ile nda nangala, ou shi wete;
neendjila dange adishe ou di shii;

osheshi fimbo etumbulo inali uya kelaka lange,
Omwene, Ove we li koneka.

Konima nokomesho owa dingilila nge,
neke loye owe li tenheka nge.

Eshiivo eli, olo oixuna kwaame,
ola nyengana, itandi dulu oku li hanga.

Omhepo yoye, ohandi i henukile peni?
Noshipala shoye ohandi shi i onhapo peni?

Ngeno ondi londe keulu, oko u li,
nongeno ndi ka nangale moshovafi, naamo omo u li,

ngeno ondi kufe omavava eluwa,
ndi vilole komeva efuta fiyo okexulilo lao,
oko ndi ka wile,

naako, ngeno eke loye otali endifile nge ko,
nolulyo loye otali kwata nge;

nonande ngeno ondi tye:
Omulaulu wa laula fokofoko, nau tuvike nge,
nouyelele ou u li pwaame, nau shituke omulaulu,

Osheshi Oove ou omushiti weefiyo dange,
owa dutila nge medimo lameme.

Oukipa vange kava li ve ku holekwa,
eshi nda mewa meholeko,
onda mewa moule wedu nounyakwa.

Omesho oye okwa li taa shipununa nge,
fimbo nda li engwili inandi tongoka,
nomembo loye omo omwa nyolelwa
omafiku ange aeshe, aa nda sheyelwa,
fimbo inapa holoka nande limwe lao.

Ndelenee kwaame, oidiladilwa yoye, Kalunga,
oinyenga, shi fike peni!
Oitulwakumwe yayo aishe, oihapu unenenene!

Akutu, Kalunga ngeno u dipae ovakolokoshi,
Ove u kandule pwaame ovakauli vonyanga,

ava have ku lundakanene nai,
nedina loye otave li tumbulile mowii.

Ava ovatondi voye, havo nandi tonde yo?
Ame mbela ndiha nyonyodolifwe kovakondjifi voye?

Ohandi va tondo noutondwe wefyo;
ondi wete, ovo ovatondi vange.

Kalunga, konakone nge,
u koneke omutima wange!
Yeleke nge, u dilakane omadiladilo ange,

opo u mone, ngeenge ondi li mondjila yepukifo,
Ove u endife nge mondjila,
ei tai twala moukwaalushe.
140:
Omwene, xupife nge movanhu vai,
Ove amene nge kovalumenhu ovakolokoshi,

ava hava dutu owii momitima davo,
otava etifa olwoodi keshe tuu efiku.

Otava upike omalaka avo, a fe leyoka;
oudiyo wonhoka u li koshi yomilungu davo. Sela

Omwene, amene nge komake ovakolokoshi!
Shiye nge kovalumenhu ovapwidi,
ava tava diladila okupundulila nge po.

Eemhote oda tela nge omwiyo nomalulo meholeko,
noiyulifo ohave i dikile nge pomunghulo wondjila
ndele tava fele nge omakelo. Sela

Onda tya kOmwene: Oove ngaho Kalunga kange.
Omwene, pwilikina omailikano ange omokule!

Omwene, Kalunga kange, ekwafo lange la pama,
Ove ho amene omutwe wange mefiku lolwoodi.

Omwene, ino itavela oihalwa yovakolokoshi,
ino efa ekondjelo lavo lii li ninge elao. Sela

Ngeenge va yelula omitwe davo,
va hangakena nge keembinga adishe,
opo omupya, ou wa pangelwa komilungu davo,
nau alukile kombada yomitwe davo vene.

Oye ne va lokifile omakala omundilo.
Ne va undwile momutemo, momakelo,
vaha shiive okufikama vali.

Ondi shi shii, Omwene Oye ota endifa
oshikondjelwa shovakwanaluhepo,
ekondjo lomapongo okuyukifilwa.

Heeno, ovayuki otava ka pandula edina loye,
ovakoshoki otava kala koshipala shoye.
141:
Omwene, ohandi kuu onghuwo kwoove, i tondoka!
Uda ondaka yange, eshi handi ku ifana.

Eindilo lange nali talwe kwoove,
olo etwimino, neyelulo lomaoko ange,
olo eyambo longuloshi.

Omwene, kokanya kange paka ko omukeleli,
nomunangeli koshivelo shomilungu dange!

Anda ko omutima wange, uha ame kowii,
ame ndiha longe oilonga youmbudi
pamwe naava ve i hole;
inandi hala nokuli okumakela kounyenye wavo.

Omuyuki na denge nge, osho ohole,
ye na pukulule nge,
osho omuvaeko womomutwe,
omutwe wange, eshi itau shi anye nande,
osheshi natango eindilo lange tali kondjifa oumbudi wavo.

Ovatokoli vomuvo,
ngeenge va undwilwa momakololo omamanya,
opo otaku udika eendjovo dange, nokutya odiwa.

Ngaashi umwe ta limi edu ndele te li hende,
osho omakipa etu taa nyanekwa mokanya koshovafi.

Osheshi Omwene, Kalunga kange,
kwoove omesho ange oko a yukilila,
kwoove oko handi ka ningina;
omwenyo wange ino u tilashi.

Shiye nge komwiyo, ou va tela nge,
nokomalulo ovaninginai.

Ovadinikalunga nave likwate nomalulo avo vene,
fimbo ame handi piti po.
142:
Ohandi lalekida Omwene mokule,
ohandi lilile Omwene mokule.

Eshi tashi tilifa nge, ohandi shi mu pimhile,
noudjuu wange ohandi u mu mbubulile.

Omhepo yange, nande nai notelwe meni lange,
Ove ou shii nokuli, nhumbi ndi li.
Mondjila ei handi ende,
ova tela nge omiyo meholeko.

Eshi handi tale kolulyo
nda vandavamena mominghulo:
nghi wete nande omunhu, e na naame.
Nghi na apa handi ningine nande,
kape na ou, ta yavele nge.

Omwene, Oove, handi lalekida,
ohandi ti: Oove eningino lange,
Oove onhele yange moshilongo shovanamwenyo.

Akutu, pupapupa eehelo lange,
shaashi eenghono dange oda xupipala nai.
Xupife nge movataataai vange,
osheshi ove dule nge eenghono.

Kufe nge meti, opo ndi tange edina loye.
Ovayuki va ka dingilile nge,
Ove ngeenge to ningi nge nawa.
143:
Omwene, uda eindilo lange,
Ove pwilikina eehelo lange.
Molwoudiinini woye itavela nge,
omolwouyuki woye.

Ove ino tokola omupiya woye,
osheshi kape na omunamwenyo
omuyuki koshipala shoye.

Akutu, omutondi ta taataa omwenyo wange,
ote u lyataulile poshi,
ota telatele nge momulaulu, ndi fe ava va fya nale.

Omhepo yange paife oya mbadapala,
omutima wange owa kanghelwa meni lange.

Ohandi dimbulukwa omafimbo onalenale,
oilonga yoye aishe ohandi i shipulula,
ame ndi shipaashipe okulonga kwoye akushe.

Omwene, endelela, ude nge!
Omhepo yange oya notelwa,
ino holeka nge oshipala shoye,
ndiha fe ava, va ya nale mombila.

Ngeenge taku shi, uditile nge ouwanghenda woye,
osheshi Oove nde lineekela.
Udikile nge ondjila, ame ndi ende nayo,
osheshi kwoove, oko handi yelula omwenyo wange.

Omwene, xupife nge movatondi vange!
Kwoove ohandi ka ningina ko.

Longe nge, ndi ninge eshi we shi hokwa,
osheshi Oove Kalunga kange.
Omhepo yoye iwa nai endife nge
mondjila ya fefengwa.

Omwene, molwedina loye kwafa,
ndi kale nomwenyo.
Molwouyuki woye kufe nge moudjuu.

Nomolwouwanghenda woye
hanauna po ovatondi vange,
Ove nyonauna po aveshe,
ava tava fininike nge,
osheshi aame omupiya woye.
144:
Omwene, emanya lange, Oye na fimanekwe,
ou ha longo omake ange okukondja,
nominwe dange di lwe oita.

Ou ta pe nge onghenda, nohotemanya yange,
nengholo lange, nomuxupifi wange,
noshikelelifo shange, kwaau oko nde lineekela,
ndele ta pangelifa nge oshiwana shange.

Omwene, omunhu oku li ngahelipi,
ye eshi to mu shipulula,
nomona womunhu, eshi we mu tala?

Omunhu okwa fa okaulapepo,
omafiku aye ongaashi omudidimbe hau vilola po.

Omwene, filukifila omaulu, u londoloke mo,
kuma eemhunda di twimaane!

Kupulifa omaluvadi, u va halakanife,
umba oikuti yoye, vo ve lihane po.

Moule wokombada, nana mo omake oye,
nakule nge, u xupife nge
momeva manene unene nomomaoko ovanailongo,

ava ve nomilungu tadi popi oipupulu,
nolulyo lavo otave li anifa nekonda.

Kalunga, onda hala ndi ku imbile eimbilo lipe,
ndi ku shikile onyalilo yeefenga omulongo,

Oove tuu ou, ho pe eehamba efindano,
wa vakula David, omupiya woye,
momukonda hau twana.

Shile nge mo, Ove xupife nge
momaoko ovanailongo,
ava ve nomilungu tadi popi oipupulu,
nolulyo lavo otave li anifa nekonda.

Ovamati vetu meenghono dounyasha wavo
ova fa eengudi domiti da kulifwa dile;
oukadona vetu ove li ngaashi eengudi
da ndodolwa nawa domomakuluumbo a dikikika.

Omaanda etu oku yadi ndoo,
tae tu pe oitulwamo i lili noi lili;
eedi detu otadi dalafana lwomayovi,
lwomayovi omulongo keehambo detu.

Eenghutwa detu ohadi humbata;
momakuma kamu na omufya,
mo kamu na etembu,
nomomapandavanda etu
ihamu udika eenghali dasha.

Oshilongo shi li ngaha, oshi nelao.
Oshilongo oshi nelao,
ngeenge Omwene Oye Kalunga kasho.
145:
Onda hala ndi ku fimaneke, Kalunga kange, ohamba,
nokutanga edina loye alushe fiyo alushe.

Keshe efiku onda hala, ndi ku tange,
nokuhambelela edina loye alushe fiyo alushe.

Omwene, Oye omunene nonakufimanekwa unene,
nounene waye ihau konekeka.

Oludalo limwe nali hepaululile likwao oilonga yoye,
noli shiivifwe oinenelonga yoye i neenghono.

Onda hala okupopya oshinge shefimano loye,
ame ndi imbe oikumwifalonga yoye.

Eenghono depangelo loye da tilika, do nadi udifwe,
noinenelonga yoye ya fimana,
onda hala ndi i hepaulule.

Efimano lefilonghenda loye linene
nali twalwatwalwe,
nouyuki woye nau tangwe nenyakuko.

Omwene oku na onghenda nolukeno,
oha tale onheni noku yadi ouwanghenda.

Kalunga omuwa kwaaveshe,
nohole yaye ya nyananana
kovashitwa vaye aveshe.

Omwene, oishitwa yoye aishe nai ku hambelele,
novayuki voye nave ku fimaneke;

nava fimaneke oshinge shouhamba woye,
vo va tange eenghono doye.

Ovana vovanhu va shiivifwe oilonga yoye yoixuna
noshinge shouhamba woye.

Ouhamba woye ou li po tau kalelele fiyo alushe
nepangelo loye fiyo okomapupi aeshe.

Omwene, omuyakeli waaveshe tava punduka,
naava va nyongamekwa koufiye,
ohe va nyongamununa.

Omesho aaveshe otae ku dakamene,
ndele ove to va pe eendja davo pefimbo lado.

Oto kamutulula eke loye
ndele to palula oinamwenyo aishe kohokwe yoye.

Omwene omuyuki meendjila daye adishe,
nomunanghenda mokulonga kwaye akushe.

Omwene oku li popepi naaveshe,
have mu ifana,
aveshe ava have mu ifana moshili.

Ava, have mu tila, ote va wanifile eshi va hala,
nonghuwo yavo ohe i udu, ndele te va xupifa.

Omwene oha amene aveshe, ava ve mu hole,
ndelenee ovadudu aveshe ote va kombo po.

Okanya kange naka udife efimano lOmwene,
noishitwa aishe nai tange edina laye liyapuki
alushe fiyo alushe.
146:
Onda hala okutanga Omwene
omafiku ange aeshe,
nokwiimbila Kalunga kange, fimbo ndi li po.

Oidale hai mu lineekele,
havanhu, ava vehe nekwafo nande.

Omuku ngeenge wa pwa mo muvo,
otava shunwa medu
nefiku tuu olo, omadiladilo avo kae po vali.

Omunelao ou, ekwafo laye ngeenge olo
Kalunga kaJakob,
nelineekelo laye ngeenge te li tula mOmwene,
Kalunga kaye,

ou omushiti weulu nedu,
nomeva efuta naashishe eshi shi li mo,
ou omudiinini fiyo alushe,

omupopili wovafininikwa,
nomupaluli wovanandjala.
Omwene Oye omumangululi wovamangwa.

Omwene omutwikululi wovapofi.
Omwene omunyongamununi
wovanyongamekwa koufiye.
Omwene omuhokwi wovayuki.

Omwene Oye ohamba fiyo alushe,
Sion oove, Oye Kalunga koye fiyo alushe.
Halleluya!
147:
Hambeleleni Omwene!
Osheshi okwiimbila Kalunga ketu, osho oshiwa,
noku mu imbila omahambelelo
osha wapala nosha yuka.

Omwene ota tungulula Jerusalem,
Ye ota ongele ava, va halakanifwa vovana vaIsrael.

Oha twamifa ava ve nomutima wa tekauka,
ndele ta mange oipute yavo tai yehama.

Oye ha pangelele eenyofi omuvalu apa u fike,
ndele te di tu adishe komadina.

Omwene wetu, Oye omunene
nomunaenghono unene.
Omayele aye kae na oshiyelekifo.

Ovakwanaluhepo, Omwene ote va pamekele ofika,
ndelenee eembudi ote di pundulile poshi.

Hoveleni okwiimbila po Omwene olwiimbo lolupandu,
shikileni Kalunga ketu okaxumbafeta!

Oye tuu ou, ta eta keulu oilemo,
ndele ta lokifile edu,
ota twiyukifa omwiidi keemhunda,

ndele ta pe oinamwenyo eendja,
nomakolwena tae mu kwenene.

Ye iha hokwa eenghono deenghambe,
ile omaulu omulumenhu.

Omwene oha hokwa ava, have mu tila,
ovava hava tula elineekelo lavo mouwanghenda waye.

Akutu Jerusalem, fimaneka Omwene!
Sion, hambelela Kalunga koye!

Osheshi Ye okwa pameka oiidilifo yoivelo yoye,
nounona vomwoove e va nangeka noupuna.

Ombili ote i yandje meengaba doye,
ote ku palula noilya inyenye.

Ondaka yaye ote i tumine kedu:
oshipango shaye otashi tondoka oshidudu shinene.

eemhawe ote di kupula pedu da fa outandu.
Olyelye te lididimikile meandu laye?

Ota tumu ondjovo yaye,
ndele oyo tai hekulula oihekele,
ota pepifa omhepo yaye,
nomeva opo taa tondoka.

Ye okwa udifila Jakob eendjovo daye,
naIsrael eemhango daye nomapangelo aye.

Kape na nande oiwana yoilongo a ningila ngaha,
onghee hano omapangelo aye inaa shiivika kuvo.
Halleluya!
148:
Halleluya!
Nye vomomaulu, tangeni Omwene,
moule wopombada, mu tangeni!

Ovaengeli vaye nye amushe, mu tangeni;
eengudu daye nye amushe, mu tangeni!

Etango nohani nye, mu tangeni,
oyonyofi nye amushe ava hamu vilima, mu tangeni!

Omaulu opombadambada nye, mu tangeni,
nomeva nye okombada yeulu!

ndele Ye okwe i tula po, i kalelele po fiyo alushe,
ndele te i pe oshipango ihashi taulukwa.

Ovakwambadayedu, tangeni Omwene,
onye oikwameva, noule aushe womafuta,

onye omundilo neemhawe,
oshihemime noshitwime, noshikungulu,
onye ava hamu wanifa elombwelo laye,

eemhunda nye noikulundudu amushe,
nomiti doiimati nye, nomisederi adishe,

oinamwenyo nye, yoifitukuti noimuna
noinakulikoka, needila nye hamu tuka,

eehamba nye dopedu noiwana nye amushe,
oidale nye, novatokoli amushe kombada yedu,

ovamati nye noukadona,
ovaxungu nounona nye.

Ovanhu vaye okwe va yelulila vali oluvinga,
osho oshifimanekifi shovayuki voye aveshe,
shovana vaIsrael, oshiwana shopolwamba laye.
Halleluya!
149:
Halleluya!
Imbileni Omwene eimbilo lipe,
efimano laye meongalo lovayuki.

Israel na hafele omushiti waye,
ovana vaSion nava nyakukilwe ohamba yavo.

Nava fimaneke unene pombada edina laye nokutanha,
vo ve mu shikile eengoma nouxumbafeta.

Osheshi Omwene okwa hokwa oshiwana shaye;
ovalininipiki te va dike exupifo.

Ovakoshoki nava tanhe nouladi,
nomomitala davo nava nyakukwe,

omahambelelo aKalunga naa kale momakanya avo,
nomikonda da upikwa, da twa momake avo,

dokuhanaunifa po ovapaani
nokushunifila oiwana owii,

vo va ka mange eehamba davo nomalyenge,
noidale yavo nomapando oivela,

vo va wanifilwe, eshi sha shangwa sha tokolwa nale,
sho shi ninge oshifimanekifi shovayuki vaye aveshe.
Halleluya!
150:
Halleluya!
Tangeni Omwene mouyapuki waye,
mu tangeni mevalelwaulu leenghono daye!

Mu tangeleni oikumwifalonga yaye!
Mu tangeni molwouyadipangelo laye!

Mu tangeni neshiko lomanghuma,
mu tangeni nonyalilo nokaxumbafeta!

Mu tangeni noungoma neenghuwilili,
mu tangeni nokauta nepoli!

Mu tangeni nekwelengedjo loosimbale,
mu tangeni noosimbale tadi popi mokule.

1: Omayeletumbulo aSalomo yaDavid, ohamba yaIsrael,
ovanhu va shiive ounongo noutekuduliko, va ude ko eendjovo domayele,
va tambule outekuduliko wefiku keshe ou tau eta eendunge, ouyuki, neyukifo noshili,
nokweetela ovashima eshiivo nomunyasha okushiiva nokunongela.
Omunongo na pwilikine opo a hapupalife eendunge, nomunaendunge ta ka pewa omadiladilo e neendunge,
opo a shiive eyeletumbulo neendjovo dekumbiko, eendjovo dovalumenhu ovanongo noitevo yavo.
Okutila Omwene oko efina leshiivo. Omalai taa dini ounongo noutekuduliko.
Omumwange, pwilikina outekuduliko waxo, ndele ino ekelashi elongo lanyoko.
Osheshi lo oshidingo sha wapala komutwe woye noulyenge va wapala mofingo yoye.
Omumwange, ovalunde ngeenge tave ku hongaula, ino shi itavela.
Vo eshi tava ti: “Ila, tu endeni pamwe, natu nangele ohonde, natu nangele ngaho omuhenashipo,
natu va pone po ve nomwenyo ngaashi oshovafi, hamudilu ngaashi ovo hava kulukile melambo.
Oinima i lili nai lili i nondilo, ohatu ke i mona, omaumbo etu hatu ke a yadifa noixuulwa.
Oshihoololifo shoye shi umba pamwe nafye, fye atushe tu kaleni tu nokakutu kamwe akeke koimaliwa.”
Omumwange, ino enda nondjila pamwe navo, omhadi yoye i kelela kelila lavo.
Osheshi eemhadi davo tadi tondokele owii ndele tadi endelele okutilashi ohonde.
Osheshi eemwiyo tadi telwa epwanga moipafi yeedila di lili nodi lili.
Osho ngaha vo ohava nangele ohonde yavo vene, vo hava holamene omwenyo wavo vene.
Osho ngaha tashi ningilwa aveshe ava have likongele omamona oulunde: Oo otae va kufa omwenyo.
Ounongo tau ingida pondje mokule, tau yelula ondaka yao meendabo,
meekolonela domapandavanda tamu mbuyaana, oo tau ingida, peembululu doivelo moshilando, oo tau popi eendjovo dao:
“Fiyo onaini nye ovashima mu hole oushima, novasheki mwa hala okusheka, nomalai okutonda eshiivo?
Alukileni omakumaido ange, opo nee Ame ohandi mu tondokifile omhepo yange, handi mu shiivifile eendjovo dange.
Ame eshi nda ifana nye mwa anya, eshi nda nana eke lange ndelenee nande umwe a pwilikina,
ndelenee inamu shikula epukululo lange, nomakumaido ange inamu a itavela,
onghee hano naame yo ohandi ka yola ehanauno leni, Ame ohandi ka sheka etilifo leni eshi tali uya.
Ehaluko leni eshi tali uya ngaashi oshikungulu, nehanauno leni ngaashi omhepo yokafudaela ndele tamu wilwa koluhepo noketilo.
Opo nee tava ka ifana nge, ndelenee itandi ka nyamukula. Vo otava ka konga nge, ndelenee itava mono nge.
Shaashi vo tava tondo eshiivo ndele inava hoolola etilo lokutila Omwene,
inava hala okushiiva epukululo lange, ndele va dina omakumaido aeshe ange.
Onghee hano vo otava ka lya koiimati yokweenda kwavo nokukuta keemhangela davo.
Osheshi ovashima tava dipawa kokuliteeka kwavo, nokukala kwavo kuhe noshisho taku nyono po omalai.
Ndelenee ovo hava pwilikine nge tava ka kala nombili netulumuko, itava tilifwa komupya.”
2: Omumwange, ove ngeenge ho tambula eendjovo dange noipango yange ho i tuvikile mwoove,
opo u pakalekele omatwi oye okupwilikina ounongo nokulemena omutima woye keendunge;
heeno, ngeenge ho ifana omayele, ho yelulile ondaka yoye keendunge,
ngeenge to di kongo ngaashi oshisiliveli ndele to di shitilile ngaashi omamona a holekwa,
opo nee to ka uda ko etilo lokutila Omwene nokumona eshiivo lokushiiva Kalunga.
Osheshi Omwene ta yandje ounongo, mokanya kaye tamu di eshiivo neendunge,
ovanashili Ye ote va tuvikilile ekwafo, Oye oshikelelifo shaava hava ende vehe noshipo.
Osheshi Ye ota pashukile omalila ouyuki ndele ta amene ondjila yovayuki vaye.
Osho nee to ka uda ko ouyuki neyukifo noshili, heeno, ondjila keshe youwa.
Osheshi ounongo tau ke uya momutima woye, neshiivo tali ka kala ounyenye komwenyo woye.
To ka amenwa kokulungama, ndele to ka diininwa keendunge
u xupifwe mondjila yovanawii, okovanhu hava popi oinima yongaho,
ovo va efa omalila ouyuki, va ende neendjila domulaulu,
ovo hava hafele oilonga ii, hava nyakukilwa omakengelelo ovanawii,
omalila avo a ngolyoka, ava hava yapuka mo meendjila davo;
opo a xupifwe momukainhu wovanhu, omuholi woipala, ou te likwatele neendjovo daye,
ou a efa kaume komounyasha waye, ndele ta dimbwa ehangano laKalunga kaye.
Osheshi eumbo laye tali endamene kefyo, nomalila aye okovakwamhungu.
Aveshe ava hava i ko kuye, itava aluka, itave uya vali komalila omwenyo.
Opo u ende nondjila yaava vawa ndele to dulu okudiinina omalila ovayuki.
Osheshi ovanashili tava ka nangala oshilongo, naava vehe noshipo tava ka kala mo.
Ndelenee ovahenakalunga tava ka dudwa mo moshilongo, novaliteeki tava ka kufwa mo musho.
3: Omumwange, ino dimbwa elongo lange, nomutima woye nau diinine oipango yange;
osheshi lo otali ku hapupalifile omafiku nomido dokukalamwenyo nombili.
Olune noudiinini wouyuki inau ku efa. I mangela mofingo yoye, i shangela moshipelende shomutima woye,
opo nee to ka mona onghenda nomayele mawa moipafi yaKalunga noyovanhu.
Nomutima woye aushe lineekela Omwene, ino liameka keendunge doye mwene.
Mu shiiva meendjila doye adishe, opo nee Ye ota ka lalakanifa omalila oye.
Ino kala omunongo momesho oye mwene. Tila Omwene, ndele kanduka mo mowii;
osho tashi pameke olutu loye ndele tashi koleke omakipa oye.
Omwene mu fimaneka neliko loye noshipe shoye shomukeshe to shi likola,
opo nee omaanda oye taa ka yada pombada noikolelo yoye tai ka xunga omaviinyu.
Omumwange, ino dina outekuduliko wOmwene, ino loloka Ye eshi te ku hanyene.
Osheshi ou Omwene e mu hole Ye ote mu hanyene, heeno, ngaashi xe ta hanyene omona waye e mu hole.
Omunelao omulumenhu ou a mona ounongo, nomulumenhu ou te likongele eendunge.
Osheshi oku di konga oku dule oshisiliveli, noku di mona oku dule oshingoldo;
Ondilo yado i dule okorali, noinima yoye aishe i nondilo itai yelekwa nado.
Meke lado lokolulyo omu noule womafiku, nomeke lado lokolumosho omu noupuna nefimano.
Eendjila dado odo eendjila da wapala, nomalila ado aeshe ombili.
Odo omuti womwenyo kukeshe ou te u kwata, nomunelao keshe oyou ta kanyatele kuo.
Edu Omwene e li dika nounongo, nokwa pameka omaulu neendunge;
omolweshiivo omakungulukilo omokule a panuka mo noilemo ya ndoda omume.
Omumwange, oinima ei iha dje mo momesho oye, diinina eshiivo neendunge,
opo nee yo tai ka ninga oukali womomwenyo woye noulenga womofingo yoye,
opo nee ho ende nawa nondjila yoye, ndele ito likwayula omhadi yoye.
Ngeenge to ka nangala, ito ka haluka, ndele ngeenge to nangala, eemhofi doye tadi ka kala ditalala.
Ove, ito pumbwa okukala u noumbada molwehaluko tali uya divadiva, ile ehanauno tali kolokele ovahenakalunga.
Osheshi Omwene ota ka kala omulineekelwa woye ndele Ye ota ka amena omhadi yoye komwiyo.
Ino anya okumonifila omukwanaluhepo ouwa, ngeenge ho dulu oku shi ninga.
Ino lombwela omukweni: “Inda, u lialuke, opo mongula handi ku pe,” nande ove u shi kwete.
Ino diladilila omukweni owii, fimbo ye ta kala pwoove te ku lineekele.
Ino twa eemhata nomunhu ye ine ku ningila sha shii.
Ino kala u nefupandubo nomukolokoshi, neendjila daye ino di lihoololela.
Osheshi omupukifi oye oixuna kOmwene, ndelenee Ye omushiiviki wovayuki.
Etulomutima lOmwene li li meumbo lomuhenakalunga, ndelenee eumbo lovayuki tali nangekwa noupuna kuye.
Ava hava sheke, Kalunga yo te va sheke. Ndelenee ovalininipiki tava filwa onghenda kuye.
Ovanongo tava ka fyuulula efimano, ndelenee oshipewa shomalai osho ohoni.
4: Ovamati nye udeni outekuduliko waxo, ndele pwilikineni mu longwe omayele.
Osheshi ame ohandi mu pukulula nawa, inamu xutwifa elongo lange.
Osheshi ame eshi nda li omona watate wokashendjelutu newifa lameme,
ye okwa longa nge ndele a lombwela nge: “Omutima woye nau dame keendjovo dange. Diinina oipango yange, opo u kale nomwenyo.
Lihapupalifila ounongo, likongela omayele! Ino dimbwa ndele ino kanduka mo meendjila dokanya kange.
Ino u xutwifa, opo u ku amene. U hola, opo nee tau ku popile.
“Efina lounongo oleli: Likongela ounongo, ndele likongela omayele noinima aishe u i kwete.
U fimaneka, opo otau ku lenge. Ngeenge to u papatele, otau ku fimanekifa.
Otau ku pe oshidingo sha wapala komutwe woye; tau ku etele oshishani sha wapalelela.”
Omumwange, uda eendjovo dange, di tambula, opo nee omido dokukalamwenyo kwoye tadi hapupala.
Ame ohandi ku longo ondjila younongo, ame ohandi ku twala meendjila da yukilila.
Mokweenda kwoye eenghatu itadi finana, ndele ngeenge to tondoka, ito ka punduka.
Likwatelela outekuduliko, ino u xutwifa, u diinina, osheshi owo okukalamwenyo kwoye.
Ino ya kelila lovahenakalunga ndele ino lyata ondjila yovanawii.
I efa, ino ya ko, kanduka mo muyo ndele i koya po.
Osheshi vo hava nyengwa okukofa ngeenge itava longo owii. Ndele itava kumuka, fimbo inava pundukifa omunhu.
Osheshi vo ohava li omungome wouhenakalunga, ndele hava nu omaviinyu oukolokoshi.
Fimbo elila lovayuki li li ngaashi eluwa tali tende, lo tali eta ouyelele tau hapupala fiyo omutenya tau tu,
ondjila yovahenakalunga oyo ngaashi omulaulu; vo inava shiiva apa tava ka pundukila.
Omumwange, pwilikina edi handi ku lombwele, endekela okutwi kwoye keendjovo dange.
Ino di kandula po koshipala shoye, di diinina meni lomutima woye.
Osheshi odo omwenyo kwaava tave di mono, omuti wokuvelula olutu lavo alishe.
Omutima woye u amena komesho yoinima aishe oyo i nokwaamenwa, osheshi muwo otamu di omwenyo.
Kandula po pwoove oipupulu yokanya koye, oipupulu yomilungu doye i kaleka kokule naave.
Omesho oye naa tale a yukilila, neemhafu doye nadi yukilile.
Elila lomhadi yoye li yelakanifa neendjila doye adishe nadi kale da pama.
Ino kanduka ko kolulyo ile kolumosho. Omhadi yoye i kaleka kokule nowii.
5: Omumwange, pwilikina ounongo wange, endekela okutwi kwoye komayele ange,
opo u mone omayele a wana nomilungu doye opo di diinine eshiivo.
Osheshi omilungu domukainhu wovanhu tadi ndoda omaadi eenyiki, nondakona yaye i nomufenhu ngaashi omaadi,
ndelenee pexulilo ye a lula ngaashi oshixwa shomululu, ngaashi eongamukonda la upikwa keembinga adishe.
Eemhadi daye tadi kulukile mefyo, neenghatu daye tadi twala moshovafi.
Ye eshi iha ende nelila lomwenyo la lalakana eendjila daye tadi ngolyauka, ye ke shi shii.
Nye ovamati, pwilikinei nge hano paife, ndele inamu kanduka mo meendjovo dokanya kange.
Ondjila yeni i kalekeni kokule naye, ndele inamu uya popepi noshivelo sheumbo laye,
opo ye aha yandje efimano leni kovanhu nomido deni kwaau ehe nonghenda,
Opo ovanhu vaha kutifwe kemona leni, noshilonga sheni shidjuu shiha ye meumbo lomunailongo.
Ndele pexulilo muha keme, eshi olutu leni nombelela yeni tai nangatele,
ndele tamu ka tya: “Ame nda tonda ngahelipi outekuduliko, nomutima wange wa dina ngahelipi okuhanyenwa!
Ndele inandi pwilikina ondaka yovalongi vange ndele inandi endeka okutwi kwange kwaava va longa nge!
Hanga nda ponwa po komupya mokati koshiongalele nokeongalo.”
Nwa omeva omomufima woye mwene naa taa kunguluka mondungu yoye mwene.
Eefifiya doye di kungulukile ngeno pondje, nomakungulukilo omeva komapandavanda.
Oo nae ku kalele oove auke, haumwe pamwe naave.
Ofifiya yoye nai kale ya nangekwa noupuna ndele kala ho nyakukilwa omukainhu, omufuko woye,
oholongo iwa nomenye ya wapala; omavele aye e ku kutife nehafo alushe, mohole yaye u xupule alushe.
Ndelenee omumwange, omolwashike u xupule pomukainhu wovanhu ndele u papatele omavele ombwada?
Osheshi eendjila domunhu keshe di li koshipala shOmwene, ndele Ye ota yeleke omalila aye aeshe.
Omuhenakalunga ta kwatwa komanyono aye mwene, ndele ta yulwa keefipa domatimba aye mwene.
Ye ota ka fya, shaashi okwa li ehe noutekuduliko, ndele ta ka undulilwa mepuko molwounene woulai waye.
6: Omumwange, ove ngeenge wa ninga omuponhele woifuta yomukweni, wa yandja eke kwaau uhe mu shii,
we limangifa keendjovo domokanya koye, wa kwatwa keendjovo dokanya koye,
shi ninga hano, omumwange, opo u lixupife, osheshi wa kwatwa komake kumukweni: inda u lininipike kuye u mu fininike,
ino itavelela omesho oye eemhofi, neemhafu doye okukumuka.
Lixupifa momake ngaashi omenye nongaashi odila meke lomukwati weedila.
Omundede ove, inda kokafelepuka, u tale eendjila dako u mone eendunge!
Ko kehe nomupiti wokomesho, nomupashukili ile omupangeli,
ndelenee ko take likongele omungome wako mokulombo, eendja dako ke di tuvikile mefimbo lokufu.
Omundede ove, fiyo onaini to kala wa nangala, onaini to ka penduka meemhofi doye?
Natango kofa po kanini, natango kumuka kanini, natango lixukata omake oye u tulumukwe,
opo nee oluhepo tali ku uya ngaashi omweelaeli, noufyoona ngaashi omulumenhu a dililwa oiti.
Ou ha endaenda nokanya ke yadi oipupulu, oye omukolokoshi nomulongi wowii,
ou ta pepe nomesho ta nyota edu neemhadi ndele ta yandje omadidiliko nominwe daye,
okukengelela oku li momutima waye, ta diladila alushe oumbudi ndele ta kunu eemhata.
Onghee hano ehanauno laye tali mu vakele, ta ka teywa po divadiva, ehe neveluko.
Oinima ei iheyali Omwene te i tondo, noinima iheyali oyo oixuna komwenyo waye:
omesho elinenepeko, elaka li noipupulu, nomake taa tileshi ohonde ihe netimba,
omutima tau diladila omauko mai, eemhadi tadi endelele okuninga owii,
ondobwedi i noipupulu tai tandavelifa oipupulu ndele tai kunu eemhata mokati kovamwaina ovalumenhu.
Omumwange, diinina oshipango shaxo, ino ekelashi elongo lanyoko.
Oyo i manga, i kale alushe pomutima, i endjelelifa mofingo yoye.
Oyo i ku pitile komesho mokweenda kwoye, yo i ku pashukile mokunangala kwoye, nomokupenduka kwoye oyo i ku popife.
Osheshi oshipango osho olamba, nelongo olo ouyelele nehanyeno lomoutekuduliko olo ondjila yomwenyo,
opo yo i ku amene komukainhu mwii, nokelaka lomufenhu lomukainhu wovanhu.
Momutima woye ino halukila ouwa waye, neemhafu daye dihe ku kwate.
Osheshi molwombwada okamungome taka kanifwa, nomukainhu a hombolwa ta yulu omwenyo u nondilo.
Olyelye ta dulu okuhumbatela mekolo laye omundilo, noikutu itai pi mbela?
Ile olyelye ta dulu okweenda komakala a hanya, eemhadi daye itadi tutu mbela?
Osho ngaha tashi ningilwa ou ta i mo momukainhu wamukwao. Keshe umwe te mu kumu, ita kala ina handukilwa.
Omulunga ita dinwa mbela nande ta vake e likutife, shaashi ye e na ondjala.
Ndele ye eshi a monika e nokufuta luheyali. Ye e nokuyandja po oinima aishe yeumbo laye.
Ou ta teya ohombo nomukainhu, ye ke neendunge. Ou a hala okunyona po okukalamwenyo kwaye mwene, osho na ninge.
Ye ota ka hangika koshiponga nokohoni, nokudinwa kwaye itaku dimwa po.
Osheshi oukodi tau xwameke ehandu momulumenhu, ndele ehe nolukeno mefiku longhone.
Ye ina hala nande ofuto, ndele ita itavele nande u hapupalife ofuto yoye.
7: Omumwange, diinina eendjovo dange, u tuvikilile mwoove oipango yange,
diinina oipango yange, opo nee to kala nomwenyo, u diinine elongo lange ngaashi omuni yeisho loye.
I manga kominwe doye, i shangela moshipelende shomutima woye.
Lombwela ounongo: “Oove omumwameme omukainhu!” Eendunge di luka Omulineekelwa woye.
Opo do di ku amene komukainhu wovanhu, komuhaelwa, ou ta popi neendjovo delihalifo.
Osheshi ame nda talela mo mekende leumbo lange, nda vandamena mombululu yekende lange,
ndele nda mona mokati kovashima, mokati kovanyasha nda didilika omumati ehe neendunge,
ou a enda nepandavanda, ta i kokolonela yomukainhu ndele ta katukile langhele lwokeumbo laye,
moshiwiwili, onguloshi yefiku momulaulu, mokati koufiku,
ndele tala omukainhu umwe te mu shakeneke, a djala ngaashi omuholi woipala e nomutima tau hongaula.
Ye ehe netulumuko nelilongelelo, eemhadi itadi dulu okukala meumbo laye;
ta i pondje, natango ta i meendabo, ndele ta kala ofika pokolonela keshe ndele ta nangele.
Ndele ye okwe mu kwata ndele te mu xupita, ndele ta ti kuye e noshipala shihe nohoni:
“Ame ndi nokuyamba omapanduloyambo, nena eli ame nda wanifa omaudaneko ange,
Onghee hano nda pita pondje ndi ku shakeneke, ndi konge oshipala shoye, ndele nde ku mona.
Ombete yange nde i yala omalapi okombete, oiyata yomavala yoliina yomuEgipiti.
Ombete yange nde i shamina namirha, aloe nokaneli.
Ila, natu kolweni kohole fiyo ongula, natu nyakukweni pamwe mohole.
Osheshi omulumenhu ke mo meumbo, okwa ya a ka endaenda kokule,
okwa kufa okakutu koimaliwa. Efiku lomutootoo wohani ye ota ka alukila keumbo.”
Ye okwe mu hongaula nokupopya kwaye kuhapu, molwomufenhu womilungu daye ye okwe mu yula.
Ye okwe mu shikula divadiva ngaashi ongobe tai twalwa kokatomeno, ngaashi elai tali twalwa la mangwa li handukilwe,
fiyo oshikuti tashi tyuula exuli laye, ngaashi odila tai tuka keendjadja dokukwata, ye keshi shii kutya ta shingifa omwenyo waye.
Hano paife nye ovamwange, udeni nge ndele pwilikineni eendjovo dokanya kange.
Omutima woye ino u ameka keendjila domukainhu ou, ino ka pukila momalila aye.
Osheshi ovadipawa vahapu ye e va denga poshi, novahapu aveshe ovo e va dipaa.
Meumbo laye tamu di eendjila domoshovafi, odo tadi kulukile meenhele defyo.
8: Ounongo itau ingida mbela, eendunge itadi yelula mbela ondaka yado?
Oo tau kala ofika koxulo yoikulundudu pondjila, pomatukaukilo omalila,
peemhito doshivelo shoshilando, moluvanda peenhu, oo tau ingida pombada:
“Ohandi mu ifana, nye ovalumenhu, ondaka yange tai lombwele ovana vovanhu.
Onye ovashima lilongeni eendunge, nomalai lilongeni okushiiva omayele.
Udeni, osheshi ame ohandi ka popya oinima iwaelela, ndele handi makulile omilungu dange kwaashi sha yuka.
Osheshi ondakona yange tai popi oshili, nouhenakalunga oo oixuna komilungu dange.
Eendjovo adishe dokanya kange oda yuka, mudo kamu na nande ekengelelo noipupulu,
odo adishe da yela da yelelela ovanaendunge, noda yuka kwaava va mona eshiivo.
Tambuleni outekuduliko wange, ndele haisiliveli; neshiivo ponhele yoshingoldoelela sha hoololwa.
Osheshi ounongo u dule okorali, noinima aishe i nondilo itai yelekwa nao.
Ame, Ounongo, nda koneka omayele, ame nda mona eshiivo nediladilo la yuka.
Etilo lokutila Omwene olo okutonda osho shii. Ame ohandi tondo elinenepeko nelitumbo, okweenda kwii nokanya koipupulu.
Ame ndi nepukululo nomayele. Aame eendunge. Eenghono odange!
Kekwafo lange eehamba tadi pangele, novapangeli tava pangele eemhangela da yuka.
Okekwafo lange ovapangeli nomalenga novatokoli aveshe kombada yedu tava pangele.
Ame ndi hole ava ve hole nge, naava hava kongo nge tava ka mona nge.
Oupuna nefimano li li pwaame, emona ihali xulu po nouyuki.
Oiimati yange i dule oshingoldo, heeno oshingoldoelela, neliko lange li dule oshisiliveli sha hoololwa.
Ame ohandi ende nondjila youyuki, pokati komalila oshili,
opo ndi pe ava ve hole nge efyuululo tali kalelele, ndele ndi yadife omalimba avo emona.
“Omwene okwa longekida nge ngaau wotete woilonga yaye, komesho yoilonga yaye, omafimbo ounyuni manga inaa shitwa.
Ye okwa ma nge moukwaalushe, opehoveloelela, komesho yomafimbo ounyuni,
omaule oposhi fimbo inaa kala po, ame nda dalwa, fimbo eefifiya di yadi omeva diha li ko,
eemhunda fimbo inadi dikwa mo komesho yoikulundudu ame nda dalwa,
fimbo Ye ina ninga natango edu nomapya neendwi adishe dounyuni.
Ye eshi a longekida eulu, ame nda li ko. Fimbo ina findila oule omufinda,
Ye eshi a pameka oilemo yopombada, eefifiya domokule eshi da mona eenghono,
Ye eshi a ningila efuta ongaba yalo, omeva aha tauluke oshipango shaye. Ye eshi a pameka omakanghameno edu,
opo nee ame nda li puye ngaashi omunongoelela, nda nyakukwa pombada efiku nefiku, ndele nda danauka moipafi yaye alushe,
ndele nda danauka kongonga yedu laye, ndele nda nyakukilwa ovana vovanhu.
“Ovamwange, pwilikinei nge hano, osheshi ovanelao ovovo hava diinine eendjila dange.
Pwilikineni outekuduliko ndele mu mone ounongo, ndele inamu u ekelashi.
Omunelao omunhu ou ta pwilikine nge, ou ta kala oupafi poivelo yange efiku nefiku, ou ta nangele peemhanga deenhu dange.
Osheshi ou ta mono nge, okwa mona omwenyo ndele te limonene okuhokwa kOmwene.
Ndelenee ou ta di pwaame, ota pongeke okukalamwenyo kwaye. Aveshe ovo hava tondo nge, ve hole efyo.”
9: Ounongo we lidikila eumbo, wa honga eengudi dao heyali;
Oo wa toma eenhomenawina dao, wa dunga omaviinyu ao ndele wa dika oshililo shao.
Oo wa tuma ko ovapiya vao ovakainhu, va shive kominghulo doikulundudu yoshilando:
“Omushima ne uye oku!” Ou ehe neendunge, ta lombwelwa kuo:
“Ileni, lyeni momungome wange ndele nweni momaviinyu nde a dunga.
Efeni oushima, opo nee tamu ka kala nomwenyo ndele endeni nondjila yeendunge.”
Ou ta kumaida omusheki, ote lietele ohoni, ndele ou ta hanyene omuhenakalunga, ta mono elopyolopyo lohoni.
Ino hanyena omusheki, opo ye ehe ku tonde. Hanyena omunandunge, ndele ye e ku hole.
Pa omunandunge, opo eendunge daye tadi ka hapupala; longa omuyuki, opo omayele aye taa ka hapupala.
Efina lounongo olo okutila Omwene. Okushiiva Omuyapuki okwo eendunge.
Osheshi omolwange omafiku oye taa hapupala, omido dokukalamwenyo kwoye tadi twikilwa.
Oove ngeenge omunongo, ounongo woye tau ku kwafa, ndele ngeenge ove omusheki, oove auke u noku shi humbata.
Oulai oo ngaashi omukainhu ehe netulumuko, oushima auke ndele ina shiiva sha nande.
Ndele ye ta kala omutumba ponhu yeumbo laye, koshipundi koikulundudu yoshilando,
a shiive ovo hava ende po nondjila, ovo hava ende va yuka nomalila avo:
“Omushima ne uye oku.” Ndele ta lombwele ou ehe neendunge ndele ta ti kuye:
“Omeva oulunga omanyenye, omungome wa holekwa omuwa.”
Ndelenee ou ke shi shii nokutya, oko oku na oilulu, novashivwa vakwao ve li mokule moshovafi.
10: Omayeletumbulo aSalomo: Omona omunaendunge ta hafifa xe, ndelenee omona elai oye oluhodi laina.
Omamona a likolwa mouhenakalunga, itaa kwafa sha, ndelenee ouyuki tau xupifa mefyo.
Omuyuki, Omwene ite mu efele ondjala, ndelenee olwisho lovahenakalunga Ye ote li kandula po
Ou ta longo neke li noundede, ota ningi omukwanaluhepo, ndelenee eke lomudiinini tali likolifa.
Omumati omunaendunge ta tuvikile mokufu, nomumati ta kofa, mefimbo leteyo ota fifa ohoni.
Omanangeko noupuna e li kombada yomutwe womuyuki, ndelenee okanya kovahenakalunga taka holeke oukolokoshi.
Okudimbulukiwa kwomuyuki taku nangekwa noupuna, ndelenee edina lomuhenakalunga tali xulu po.
Ou e nomutima u neendunge, ota diinine oipango, ndelenee ou e nomilungu doulai, ta wile po.
Ou ha ende moshili, ehe nombudi, ndelenee ou ta pengifa eendjila daye, ota ka hololwa.
Ou ta lembe nomesho aye, ta eta po ouyehame, ndele ou ta popi oulai ta ka wila po.
Okanya kovayuki oko ofifiya yomwenyo, ndelenee okanya kovahenakalunga taka holeke oukolokoshi.
Ehandu tali pendula eemhata, ndelenee ohole tai tuvike omatauluko.
Ounongo tau monika komilungu dovanaendunge, ndelenee ou ehe neendunge ta ka dengwa noshitetati kombuda.
Ovanongo hava tuvikile eshiivo, ndelenee okanya kelai oko ehanauko li li popepi.
Emona loshipuna olo oshilando shaye sha pama, ndelenee oluhepo lomukwanaluhepo olo ehanauko laye.
Eliko lomuyuki tali eta omwenyo; oikongwa yomuhenakalunga oyo oulunde.
Ou ta diinine outekuduliko, e li mondjila yomwenyo ndelenee ou ta kandula po omapukululo, ota ka puka.
Ou ta holeke ehandu, e nomilungu doipupulu. Ndele ou ta tandavelifa omalundilo, ye elai.
Apa pe neendjovo dihapu, etauluko itali pumbulukwa po. Ndelenee ou ta kelele omilungu daye, ye omunaendunge.
Elaka lomuyuki olo oshisiliveli sha hoololwa; nomutima womuhenakalunga kau na shilonga.
Omilungu dovayuki tadi yukifa ovanhu vahapu. Ndelenee omalai taa fi, shaashi ehe neendunge.
Enangeko noupuna lOmwene, olo tali likolifa, noshilonga shidjuu itashi wedele ko sha.
Okulonga oshilonga shii taku hafifa elai, ndelenee ounongo tau hafifa omulumenhu e neendunge.
Osho omuhenakalunga te shi tila, otashi mu hange. Ndelenee osho ovayuki ve shi hala, tave shi pewa kuYe.
Oshikungulu eshi sha pepa, ovahenakalunga kave po vali; ndelenee ekanghameno lovayuki la pama fiyo alushe.
Ngaashi omaetika komayoo nongaashi omwifi komesho, osho yo omundede komutumi waye.
Okutila Omwene taku hapupalifa omafiku, ndelenee omido dovahenakalunga tadi xupipikwa.
Eteelelo lomuyuki tali xulile mehafo, ndelenee etimaumbwile lomuhenakalunga tali xulu po.
Ondjila yOmwene oyo ohotengulu yovayuki, ndelenee oyo ehanauko lovalongi vouhenouyuki.
Omuyuki ita ka tengauka fiyo alushe, ndelenee omuhenakalunga ita ka kala mo moshilongo.
Okanya komuyuki taka tutuma ounongo, ndelenee elaka loipupulu tali ka kombwa po.
Omilungu domuyuki odi shii eshi sha wapala, ndelenee okanya komuhenakalunga oko ekengelelo longaho.
11: Oshiyelekifo inashi yuka osho oixuna koshipala shOmwene, ndelenee okuyeleka kwa wana Ye e ku hokwa.
Apa tape uya ounhwa, otape uya yo okufifa ohoni, ndelenee ounongo tau kala pwaava ve lininipika.
Ovayuki tava endifwa kouhenashipo wavo, ndelenee ovaliteeki tava hanaunwa po koipupulu yavo.
Emona itali kwafa sha mefiku loupyuhandu, ndelenee ouyuki tau xupifa mo mefyo.
Ouhenashipo womuyuki tau lalakanifa ondjila yaye, ndelenee omuhenakalunga tau nyonwa po kouhenakalunga waye.
Ouyuki wovayuki tau va xupifa, ndelenee ovaliteeki tava ka kwatwa kolwisho lavo vene.
Pefyo lomuhenakalunga etimaumbwile laye tali xulu po, neteelelo lovanaipupulu tali kana po.
Omuyuki eshi ta xupifwa mo momupya, nomuhenakalunga ta i mo ponhele yaye.
Nokanya kaye omupopi wowii ta nyono po omukwao, ndelenee eshiivo tali xupifa omuyuki.
Oshilando tashi hafele elao lovayuki, novahenakalunga ngeenge tava xulu po, oshilando tashi kuwilile.
Oshilando tashi pamekwa kokunangeka noupuna kwovayuki, ndelenee okanya kovahenakalunga take shi hanauna po.
Ou ehe neendunge, ota dini omukwao, ndelenee omulumenhu e neendunge ta mwena.
Ou ta endaenda nomalundilo, ota holola oshiholekwa, ndelenee ou e nomhepo i shii kulineekelwa, ota tuvikile oshinima.
Apa pehe nepukululo, oshiwana tashi xutuka, ndelenee ovapukululi vahapu otava eta exupifo.
Ou wa ninga omuponhele woifuta yomukwao ote likongele oudjuu. Ndelenee ou ta tondo okuyandja eke, ota kala ehe nombudi.
Omukainhu a wapala ota fimanekwa, novanaenghono tave lilikolele oupuna.
Omulumenhu onakufilonghenda ota kongele omwenyo waye ouwa: ndelenee ou ehe nonghenda, ta twala ombelela yaye mwene momupya.
Omuhenakalunga te likongele eliko loipupulu, ndelenee ou ha kunu ouyuki, ondjabi i shii kulineekelwa.
Ouyuki washili tau twala komwenyo, ndelenee ou ha shikula owii, ota shikula efyo.
Ou e nomutima inau yuka, oye oixuna koshipala shOmwene, ndelenee ava va koshoka mokukala kwavo Ye e va hokwa.
Oshili, ovo vai itava kala inava handukilwa. Ndelenee oludalo lovayuki otali xupifwa.
Omukainhu muwa ehe neendunge, e li ngaashi olinga yoshingoldo meyulu loshingulu.
Omahalo ovayuki taa twala kelao, ndelenee elineekelo lovahenakalunga olo etokolo lehandu.
Onakuyandja ta wedelwa ko shihapu, ndelenee ou ta luvapala, ota hepa.
Omwenyo ou tau nangeke noupuna, otau ka kutifwa, nomuhekeleki wovakwao ota hekelekwa yo ye mwene.
Ou ta luvapalele oilya, ta tulwa omutima kovanhu. Ndelenee enangeko noupuna tali kala komutwe waau ta landifa oilya.
Ou ta kongo osho shiwa, ota kongo osho sha wapala. Ndelenee ou ta kongo owii, oo otau uya kombada yaye.
Ou te lineekele oupuna waye, ota ka punduka. Ndelenee ovayuki tava ka hapa ngaashi ohapo.
Ou ta dongakanifa eumbo laye, ota fyuulula omhepo, nelai tali ka ninga omupika waau e nomutima u nounongo.
Oshiimati shomuyuki osho omuti womwenyo, ndele ou ta likola eemwenyo oye omunongo.
Ngeenge omuyuki ta mono ondjabi kombada yedu, unene hano omuhenakalunga nomulunde.
12: Ou e hole outekuduliko, ye e hole eshiivo. Ndelenee ou ha tondo okuhanyenwa, ye omushima.
Ou muwa ta hokiwa kOmwene, ndelenee ou okayoka komedu ote mu tokola.
Kape nomunhu ta dulu okulikaleka nomwenyo molwouhenakalunga. Ndelenee omudi wovayuki itau tengauka.
Omwalikadi omudiinini ye oshishani shomulumenhu waye, ndelenee omupwidi e li ngaashi otwila yomomakipa aye.
Omadiladilo ovayuki omawa; nomauko ovahenakalunga oo ekengelelo.
Eendjovo dovahenakalunga odo okunangela ohonde, ndelenee okanya kovayuki otake va xupifa.
Ovanhu ovahenakalunga tava kombwa po ndele vehe po vali. Ndelenee eumbo lomuyuki tali kala po.
Omulumenhu ta fimanekwa paendunge daye. Ndelenee ou e nomutima wa pilalala ta ka dinwa.
Omudinwa ou e nomupiya, e dule omulitumbi ehe nomungome.
Omuyuki a shiiva osho oshimuna shaye sha hala. Ndelenee omutima womuhenakalunga uhe nonghenda.
Ou ha diinine epya laye, e nomungome muhapu. Ndelenee ou ta lalakanene oinima yongaho ehe neendunge.
Omuhenakalunga te lihalele oikongwa yaava vai, ndelenee omudi wovayuki otau eta oiimati.
Etauluko lomilungu olo omwiyo mwii, ndelenee omuyuki ta xupifwa moudjuu.
Oiimati yokanya kaye tai eta po ouwa uhapu, noshilonga shomake omunhu tashi mu alukile.
Ondjila yelai oya yuka momesho aye mwene, ndelenee ovanaendunge tava pwilikine epukululo.
Ehandu lelai tali holoka divadiva, ndelenee omunaendunge te limwenenene efifohoni.
Ou ta popi odo doshili, ota hepaulula osho sha yuka. Ndelenee omuhepaululi omunaipupulu ta kengelele.
Omunhu ta tu neendjovo ngaashi eongamukonda, ndelenee elaka lovanaendunge tali velula.
Omulungu u shii kulineekelwa tau kalelele fiyo alushe, ndelenee elaka loipupulu epakumo leisho.
Ava hava diladila owii, ekengelelo li li momutima wavo, ndelenee ava hava tungu ombili ove nehafo.
Omuyuki ita hangika nande komupya umwe, ndelenee ovahenakalunga ve yadi oiponga.
Omilungu doipupulu odo oixuna koshipala shOmwene, ndelenee Ye a hokwa ovadiinini mokukala kwavo.
Omunhu omunamayele ta mwenenene eshiivo laye, ndelenee omutima womalai tau ingida pombada oulai wao.
Eke lomudiinini tali ka pangela, ndelenee omundede ta fininikilwa oilonga.
Oshisho shomomutima womunhu otashi u fidimike poshi, ndelenee ondjovo yehekeleko otai u hafifa.
Omuyuki ota tongola oufita waye, ndelenee ondjila yovahenakalunga tai va pukifa.
Omundede ita mono oshifitukuti moukongo, ndelenee okudiinina okwo emona lomunhu li nondilo.
Melila louyuki omu nomwenyo, nokweenda nalo oko itaku twala mefyo.
13: Omona omunandunge ta pwilikine outekuduliko waxe, ndelenee omusheki iha udu ko ekumaido.
Omoiimati yokanya kaye keshe umwe ta li ouwa, ndelenee ovaliteeki ve hole okukolokosha.
Ou ta lungamene okanya kaye, ota amene okukalamwenyo kwaye. Ou ta makula unene omilungu daye, ota i mehanauno.
Omwenyo womundede tau haluka, ndelenee ita mono sha, ndelenee omwenyo wovadiinini tau ka kutifwa.
Omuyuki ta tondo okupopya oipupulu, ndelenee okukala kwomuhenakalunga okwo ohoni ndele taku nyonyodolwa.
Ouyuki tau amene ou ha ende ehe noshipo. Ndelenee ouhenakalunga tau pundukifa omulunde.
Ope na umwe te linomo nokutya, ye oshipuna, ndelenee ke na sha nande. Umwe te lininipike nokutya, ye ohepele, ndelenee e noinima ihapu.
Oikulila yokukalamwenyo kwomulumenhu oyo oupuna waye, ndelenee ohepele ita udu omafininiko.
Ouyelele wovayuki tau minikile nokuhafifa, ndelenee olamba yovahenakalunga tai dimi.
Elinenepeko tali eta eemhata. Ndelenee pwaava hava tambula omapukululo, ope nounongo.
Oinima ya likolwa noupu tai ninipala, ndelenee ou ta diinine mokwoongela kanini nakanini, ota ka weda ko alushe.
Okuteelela efimbo lile taku kulaukifa omwenyo. Ndelenee eteelelo la wanifwa olo omuti womwenyo.
Ou ta dini Ondjovo, ote linyono po, ndelenee ou ha tila Oshipango, ota ka mona ondjabi.
Elongo lomunongo olo ofifiya yomwenyo okukandula po eemwiyo defyo.
Eendunge diwa tadi eta ohokwe, ndelenee ondjila yovaliteeki oyo ikukutu.
Omunamayele keshe ta longo neendunge, ndelenee elai tali tandavelifa oulai.
Omutumwa omuhenakalunga ta i momupya, ndelenee omutumwa e shii kulineekelwa, oye ngaashi ondjolowele.
Oluhepo nohoni oyo oshipewa shaau ta ekeleshi outekuduliko. Ndelenee ou ta udu ekumaido, ota ka fimanekwa.
Ehalelo la wanifwa olo linyenye komwenyo. Ndelenee okukukuma owii okwo oixuna kelai.
Kala nokweenda novanongo, opo nee naave yo u ninge omunongo. Ndelenee ou ha endafana novashima, ota ka laipala.
Omupya tau shikula omulunde, ndelenee ovayuki tava mono elao ondjabi.
Omulumenhu muwa ta fyuululifile ovatekulu vaye, ndelenee emona lovalunde tali tuvikililwa ovayuki.
Oshikokola sheehepele otashi eta eendja dihapu. Ndelenee vahapu tava hanaunwa po, shaashi ihava kala mouyuki.
Ou e nonghenda noshitetati, ye ha tondo omona waye. Ndelenee ou e mu hole, ote mu hanyene.
Omuyuki ta li fiyo a kuta. Ndelenee edimo lomuhenakalunga tali hepekwa keemhumbwe.
14: Ounongo wovalikadi tau diki eumbo, ndele oulai tau li hanauna po nomake ao vene.
Ou ta ende moshili, ye ota tila Omwene. Ndelenee ou e neendjila da penga ote mu dini.
Mokanya kelai omu noshitetati shelinenepeko lalo, ndelenee omilungu dovanongo tadi va amene.
Apa pehe neengobe, metemba lokulila kamu na sha. Ndelenee molweenghono donhani eliko tali hapupala.
Ondobwedi i shii kulineekelwa itai fufya, ndelenee ondobwedi yoipupulu tai kunu oipupulu.
Omusheki ta kongo ounongo, ite u mono; ndelenee omunaendunge ta mono eshiivo noupu.
Dja po pomulumenhu elai, osheshi ino dimbulukwa eshiivo lasha komilungu daye.
Ounongo womunaendunge oo okushiiva ondjila yaye, ndelenee oulai wovashima oo ekengelelo.
Etimbayambo tali shekifa omalai, ndelenee mokati kovayuki omu nokuhokwafana.
Omutima tau shiiva oluhodi lao vene, ndele mehafo lao omukwao ita dulu okunyakukwa.
Eumbo lovahenakalunga tali ka hanaunwa po, ndelenee etwali lovayuki tali nenepala.
Oku nondjila ya yuka momesho omunhu, ndelenee exulilo layo oleendjila defyo.
Mokuyola yo omutima tau dulu okuyehama, nexulilo lehafo lao olo oluhodi.
Omutima womuliteeki otau kutifwa kokweenda kwaye mwene, nosho yo omulumenhu muwa muye mwene.
Omushima ta itavele ondjovo keshe, ndelenee omunamayele ta diinine eenghatu daye.
Omunongo ha tila ndele ta yepa omunawii, ndelenee omushima ta duduluka e yadi elineekelo lokulineekela ye mwene.
Omuhandunhu ta longo oulai. Omunambudi ota ka tondwa.
Ovashima tava fyuulula oulai, ndelenee eshiivo olo oshishani shovanamayele.
Ovanawii ve nokulinyongamena koshipala shaava vawa, novahenakalunga poivelo yovayuki.
Omukwanaluhepo ota tondwa komushiinda shaye nokuli, ndelenee ookaume voshipuna ovahapu.
Ou ta dini omukwao, ota nyono. Ndelenee ou ta filonghenda eehepele ye omunelao.
Ihava puka mbela ava hava diladila owii? Ndelenee ava hava diladila ouwa tava ka mona ohole nelineekelo.
Oilonga aishe idjuu otai likolifa, nokupopyaana ashike otaku eta oluhepo.
Oupuna wavo oo oshishani shovanongo, ndelenee oulai womalai tau kala oulai.
Ondobwedi i shii kulineekelwa otai xupifa omwenyo, ndelenee ou ta kunu oipupulu, ye omukengeleli.
Metilo lOmwene omu nelineekelo la pama, heeno, ehondameno nokuli lovana.
Etilo lOmwene olo ofifiya yomwenyo okukandula po eemwiyo defyo.
Ouhapu wovanhu oo efimano lohamba, ndelenee eninipalo lovanhu, olo exutuko lomupangeli.
Omutalanheni ye e neendunge dihapu, ndelenee omuhandunhu te likongele oulai.
Omutima u nombili, oo omwenyo wombelela, efupandubo olo eolelo lomomakipa.
Ou ta fininike omukwanaluhepo, ota sheke Omushiti waye, ndelenee ou ta filonghenda ohepele, ote mu fimaneke.
Omuhenakalunga ta dengwa poshi kowii waye mwene, ndelenee omuyuki ta mono pefyo laye ehondameno.
Ounongo tau tulumukwa momutima womunaendunge, ndele tau li holola mokati komalai.
Ouyuki tau tumbu ovanhu, ndelenee oulunde oo elopyolopyo lohoni yoiwana.
Omupiya e nomayele ta hokiwa kohamba, ndelenee ou ta fifa ohoni, ota handukilwa.
15: Enyamukulo litalala tali kandula po oupyuhandu, ndelenee ondjovo ikukutu tai tukulula ehandu.
Elaka lovanongo tali hepaulula eshiivo loshili, ndelenee okanya kovashima taka fuluka oulai.
Omesho Omwene e li apeshe, ndele taa tale nokudidilika ava vai naava vawa.
Elaka lipu olo omuti womwenyo, ndelenee lo ngeenge li noipupulu tali holola omufya womomhepo.
Elai tali dini outekuduliko waxe, ndelenee ou ta tambula ehanyeno, ota ka ninga omunongo.
Meumbo lomuyuki omu nemona linene, ndelenee oikongwa yomuhenakalunga tai hanaunwa po.
Omilungu dovanongo tadi kunu eshiivo, ndelenee omutima womushima inau yuka.
Eyambo lomuhenakalunga olo oixuna koshipala shOmwene, ndelenee eindilo lomuyuki Ye te li hokwa.
Okweenda kwomuhenakalunga okwo oixuna koshipala shOmwene, ndelenee ou ta lalakanene ouyuki, Ye e mu hole.
Ou ta yapuka mo mondjila ota hangika kehandukilo lidjuu. Ou ta tondo ehanyeno ta ka fya.
Oshovafi nonhele yehanauno oya yeuluka koshipala shOmwene, unene hano omitima dovana vovanhu.
Omusheki ina hala okupukululwa komunhu, ita i kovanaendunge.
Omutima u nehafo tau yelifa oshipala, ndelenee ouyehame womutima tau nyikifa omhepo oluhodi.
Omutima womunaendunge tau kongo eshiivo, ndelenee okanya kovashima taka endaenda noulai.
Omafiku aeshe omufininikwa omai, ndelenee omutima tau hafe, otau dana oshivilo alushe.
Oshipewa shinini mokutila Omwene shi dule omamona mahapu noupyakadi wao.
Evelelo lombidi pe nohole li dule etomeno lohove ya ondoka ndele po pe netondafano.
Omulumenhu omuhandunhu ta pendula eemhata, ndelenee omutalanheni ta anuna eemhata.
Ondjila yomundede oyo ya fa omangade omano, ndelenee elila lovayuki la kokolwa.
Omona ta hafifa xe, nomunhu omushima ta dini ina.
Oulai oo enyakuko lovahenandunge, ndelenee omulumenhu omunaendunge ota ende a yuka.
Apa pehe nomapukululo, eemhangela tadi nyonauka, ndelenee apa pe novapukululi vahapu, do tadi wanifwa.
Omulumenhu ta hafele enyamukulo lomokanya kaye; ondjovo oiwa ngahelipi pefimbo layo!
Ondjila yomwenyo yomunaendunge tai twala pombada, onghee hano ta dulu okukukuma oshovafi shokoshi.
Omwene ta hanauna po eumbo lovalinenepeki, ndelenee ta pameke ongaba yomufiyekadi.
Eemhangela dovanawii oixuna koshipala shOmwene, ndelenee eendjovo doukaume oda yela.
Ou te likongele eliko loipupulu, ota hanauna po eumbo laye. Ndele ou ha tondo ombubo, ota kala nomwenyo.
Omutima womuyuki otau diladila osho tau shi nyamukula, ndelenee okanya kovahenakalunga taka fulukifa oinima ii.
Omwene e li kokule novahenakalunga, ndelenee ta udu eindilo lovayuki.
Omesho taa vilima, otaa hafifa omutima, nondaka iwa oyo omungo momakipa.
Okutwi taku udu ehanyeno lokomwenyo, otaku kala mokati kovanongo.
Ou ta ekeleshi outekuduliko, ota dini okukalamwenyo kwaye mwene, ndelenee ou ta pwilikine epukululo, ote likongele eendunge.
Okutila Omwene okwo outekuduliko tau eta ounongo; nelininipiko tali tetekele efimano.
16: Eemhangela domutima odomunhu, ndelenee enyamukulo lelaka tali di kOmwene.
Eendjila adishe domulumenhu oda yela momesho aye, ndelenee Omwene ta konakona eemhepo.
Oilonga yoye i yandja kOmwene, opo nee eemhangela doye tadi ka wanifwa.
Oinima aishe Omwene e i lilongelela, nosho yo omuhenakalunga okwe mu shitila efiku lomupya.
Keshe ou e nomutima we linenepeka, ye oixuna koshipala shOmwene. Oshili, ye ita ka kala ita handukilwa.
Okunyona taku yavelelwa nohole noudiinini, nomokutila Omwene omunhu ta kukuma owii.
Eendjila domulumenhu ngeenge tadi wapalele Omwene, Ye ote mu anuna novatondadi vaye.
Oshipewa shinini pamwe nouyuki shi dule ouhapu womaliko pamwe noipupulu.
Omutima womunhu tau diladila ondjila yaye, ndelenee Omwene ta endifa eenghatu daye.
Etokolo leendjovo li li komilungu dohamba. Moihokolola okanya kayo itaka popi oipupulu.
Oshiyelekifondjele noshiyelekifo sha yuka tashi di kOmwene, oiyelekifomanya yomokakutu oyo oshilonga shaye.
Oshilonga shouhenakalunga oixuna koshipala sheehamba, osheshi olukalwapangelo tali pamekwa kouyuki.
Eehamba da hokwa omilungu di nouyuki, ndele di hole ava hava popi oinima yoshili.
Oupyuhandu wohamba u li ngaashi ovatumwa vefyo, ndelenee omulumenhu omuyuki ote u lotifa.
Mouyelele woshipala shohamba omu nomwenyo, nokuhokwa kwayo okwo ngaashi oshilemo shodula mokwenye.
Okulilikolela ounongo ku dule unene oshingoldo nokulikongela eendunge ku dule oshisiliveli.
Ondjila yovayuki tai kukuma owii, naau ta pashukile okweenda kwaye, ota amene omwenyo waye.
Ounhwa tau tetekele ehanauno, nelinenepeko tali tetekele epunduko.
Okukala omunini mokati kovalininipiki ku dule okutukulilafana oihakanwa pamwe novalinenepeki.
Ou ta diinine ondjovo, ote ke limonena ouwa. Naau te lineekele Omwene, ye omunelao.
Ou e nomutima u nounongo, ota ifanwa omunaendunge, nounyenye womilungu tau hapupalifa elongo.
Eendunge domunaendunge odo ofifiya yomwenyo kuye, ndelenee outekuduliko womalai oo oulai.
Omutima womunongo tau mu nongopeke mokanya kaye ndele tau hapupalifa elongo lomilungu daye.
Eendjovo doukaume di li ngaashi oshikuki shomaadi eenyiki; ounyenye komwenyo nevelulo lomakipa.
Ope nondjila tai talwa komunhu oya yuka ndelenee exulilo layo eendjila defyo.
Ondjala yomulongi tai mu longifa, osheshi edimo laye tali mu fininike.
Omukatalume ota fe elambo loshiponga, nokomilungu daye oku na omundilo wa xwama.
Omulumenhu e nekonda ta kunu eemhata, nomulundili ta tukaula ookaume.
Omulumenhu omukolokoshi ta hongaula mukwao ndele te mu twala nondjila ihe fi iwa.
Ou ta fifikinifa omesho aye, ota diladila ekengelelo, ou ta umike omilungu daye, okwa ninga nokuli owii.
Eenghwakutoka odo oshishani shefimano. Otashi monika mondjila youyuki.
Omutalanheni e dule omuladi. Ndele ou te lipangele, e dule ou a teya oshilando.
Oshihoololifo tashi ekelwa mekolo, etokolo lasho tali di alushe kOmwene.
17: Oshipambu shomungome mukukutu pamwe nombili, shi dule ongudu yomayambo i yadi oililo pamwe neemhata.
Omupiya omunaendunge ta ka pangela omudalwa omumati omupwidi, ndele ta ka tukulila ovadalwa ovalumenhu efyuululo.
Onhelekelo koshingoldo, nediko koshisiliveli, ndelenee Omwene ta yelifa omitima.
Omunawii ta pwilikine omulungu u noipupulu, nomunaipupulu ta pwilikine elaka lii.
Ou ta sheke ohepele, ota dini Omushiti wayo. Ou ta hafele oshiponga, ita ka kala ita handukilwa.
Ovatekulu vo oshidingo shovakulupe nefimano lovana olo xe yavo.
Eendjovo doukulunhu itadi wapalele elai, hano eendjovo doipupulu tadi wapalele ngahelipi ohamba.
Okawe ke nondilo oko ombubo momesho amwene wako. Keshe apa ta ende, e nelao.
Ou ta tuvike etauluko, ota kongo ohole, ndelenee ou ta tongolola vali eendjovo, ta tukaula ookaume.
Epukululo tali longo momunaendunge li dule omadengo efele elai.
Oshimhulu tashi kongo ashike oshiponga, ndelenee omutumwa ehe nonghenda te mu tuminwa.
Okushakeneka emwangha la kufwa koumwanghona valo, oku dule okushakeneka elai moulai walo.
Ou ta alulile ouwa owii, owii itau ka efa eumbo laye.
Ehovelo leshilafano olo ngaashi omeva taa panuka, onghee hano, efa eemhata fimbo oo inaa panuka.
Ou ta yukipalifa omuhenakalunga ndele ta vele omuyuki ombedi, vo aveshe oixuna koshipala shOmwene.
Oimaliwa yokulikongela ounongo oi noshilonga shashike meke lelai? Shaashi ehe neendunge okulikongela eendunge.
Kaume oku na ohole alushe, nomumwaina ta dalwa, a kwafe moluhepo.
Ou ta yandje eke ndele a ninga omuponhele woifuta, ye omunhu ehe neendunge.
Ou e hole eemhata e hole yo etauluko. Ou te liningile oshivelo shile, te likongele ehanauno.
Ou e nomutima inau yuka, ita mono ouwa. Nelaka loipupulu otali wile momupya.
Elai tali etele omudali walo oluhodi, naxe yelai ke nehafo.
Omutima u nehafo tau kwafa mokuveluka, ndelenee omhepo yoluhodi tai kukutike omakipa.
Omuhenakalunga ta tambula ombubo konhulo yamukwao a pengife eendjila douyuki.
Omunaendunge e nounongo komesho yaye, ndelenee omesho elai taa lengaalenga ominghulo dedu.
Omona omushima ye oluhodi laxe, nouyehame munene waau e mu dala.
Owii nokuli ngeenge ou ehe nombedi, ta futifwa. Okudenga ovanamadina itaku wapala.
Ou ta pangele eendjovo daye, ye e neshiivo. Ndele ou e nomhepo ya pama, ye omulumenhu e neendunge.
Elai yo, ngeenge tali mwena, otali talwa lo omunaendunge. Ngeenge tali umike omilungu dalo, tali talwa olo li neendunge.
18: Ou te li tongola, ota kongo omahalo aye mwene. Neenghono adishe ta kondjifa osho shi neendunge.
Elai itali hokwa eendunge, ndelenee okuholola ashike omutima walo.
Ovahenakalunga eshi tave uya, nokudina yo taku uya. Ndele esheko tali uya pamwe nohoni.
Eendjovo domokanya komulumenhu odo omeva malemale, ekungulukilo lomeva taa fuluka, ofifiya younongo.
Okukala nokatongotongo nomuhenakalunga nokupengifa eendjovo daau ehe nombedi, itaku wapala.
Omilungu delai tadi eta eemhata, nokanya kalo taka ifana omadengo.
Okanya kelai oko ehanauno lalo, nomilungu dalo odo eemwiyo dokukalamwenyo kwalo.
Eendjovo domulundili da fa ouleke ndele tadi ningine mo fiyo omoukololo vomutima.
Ou e nounye moilonga yaye, ye omumwaina womuhanauni.
Edina lOmwene olo oshungongulu ya pama. Omuyuki ta hondama mo ndele ta amenwa.
Emona loshipuna olo oshilando shasho sha pama ngaashi ohotekuma ile momadiladilo asho.
Omutima womulumenhu tau linenepeke komesho yehanauno laye. Ndelenee elininipiko tali tetekele efimano.
Ou ta nyamukula fimbo ina uda ko, osho oulai waye ndele tashi mu fifa ohoni.
Omhepo yomulumenhu tai mu yambidida moudu waye, ndelenee omhepo ya teka, olyelye ta dulu oku i humbata?
Omutima womunaendunge tau likola eshiivo, nokutwi kwovanongo taku kongo eshiivo.
Oshali tai mbwalangadjifile omunhu eenhele ndele tai mu twala mokati kovanenenhu.
Pehovelo lomoihokolola keshe umwe e nounongo; ndelenee omuhokololifi wavo te uya ndele te mu konakona.
Oshihoololifo tashi lotifa eemhata ndele tashi tokola pokati kovanaenghono.
Omumwaina a kengelelwa te lipopile e dule oshilando sha pama, neemhata di li ngaashi oiidilifo yohotengulu.
Edimo lomulumenhu tali kutifwa koiimati yokanya kaye, ta kutifwa keteyo lomilungu daye.
Elaka li nepangelo lefyo nolomwenyo. Ava ve li hokwa, tava ka lya oiimati yalo.
Ou a mona omwalikadi, ye a mona elao, ndele a mona ohokwe yOmwene.
Omukwanaluhepo ta popi mokulininipika, ndelenee oshipuna tashi nyamukula eendjovo dikukutu.
Omulumenhu e nookaume vahapu ta ka mona oluhepo, ndelenee ope nookaume ve dule ovamwaina ovalumenhu mokulineekelwa.
19: Omukwanaluhepo ta ende ehe noshipo e dule ou e nomilungu inadi yuka ndele natango ye elai.
Ouladi uhe neshiivo inau wapala, naau ta endelele mokweenda ta lyata pomunghulo.
Oulai womunhu tau nyono po ondjila yaye, ndelenee omutima waye tau handukile Omwene.
Emona tali eta ookaume vahapu, ndelenee ohepele tai kanifa ookaume kaye.
Ondobwedi yoipupulu itai kala itai handukilwa. Naau ta kunu oipupulu, ita ka xupifwa.
Vahapu have likongele ohokwe yovanamadina, nomulumenhu ha yandje eeshali, e nookaume vahapu.
Ovamwaina aveshe ovalumenhu vohepele tave i tondo; unene ookaume vayo tava kala kokule nayo. Yo otai va shikula neendjovo, vo vehe po!
Ou ta hapupalifa eendunge, e hole okukalamwenyo kwaye. Ou ha diinine omayele, ota ka mona ouwa.
Ondobwedi yoipupulu itai kala itai handukilwa. Naau ta kunu oipupulu, ta nyonwa po.
Ehepuluko itali wapalele elai, unene ngahelipi okupangela omalenga taku wapalele omupiya!
Eendunge domunhu tadi mu pe outalanheni, nefimano laye olo okudima po etauluko.
Oupyuhandu wohamba u li ngaashi okukumba kwonghoshi yonyasha, ndelenee ohokwe yayo ngaashi omume kombada yoimeno.
Omona omushima oye oupyakadi waxe, nokungongota kwomwalikadi okwo ngaashi onhongo tai ndoda efimbo alishe.
Eumbo nemona olo efyuululifo looxe, ndelenee omwalikadi e neendunge ota di kOmwene.
Oundede tau kofifa eemhofi didjuu. Omwoongaongi ota ka fya ondjala.
Ou ta diinine oshipango, ota amene okukalamwenyo kwaye. Ou ita pashukile eendjila daye, ota ka fya.
Ou ta filonghenda eehepele, ota tulike kOmwene. Ndele Ye ote ke mu alulila oshilonga shaye shiwa.
Hanyena omona woye omumati fimbo pe neteelelo. Osheshi ino hala ndishi, ye a fye.
Omuhandunhu ota ka humbata ehandukilo. Osheshi ngeenge wa hala oku mu yakula, oto mu xwameke ashike unene.
Pwilikina epukululo u itavele outekuduliko, opo u mone eendunge dokomesho.
Eemhangela dihapu di li momutima womulumenhu, ndelenee epukululo lOmwene tali ka kala po.
Emona lomunhu la wapala li nondilo olo olune laye. Ohepele i dule omulumenhu omunaipupulu.
Okutila Omwene taku eta omwenyo: omunhu ta dulu okutulumukwa nawa oufiku, ndele ita hangika nande koshiponga.
Omundede ta velelifa eke laye, ta nyengwa oku li alulila kokanya kaye.
Denga omusheki, opo nee omushima ta mono eendunge, nomunandunge ngeenge ta hanyenwa, ota ka mona eshiivo.
Ou ta hepeke xe ndele ta taataa mo ina, oye omumati oshimhulu nomufifihoni.
Omumwange, ngeenge to efa okupwilikina outekuduliko, opo nee to puka mo meendjovo deshiivo!
Oshimhulu osho tashi hepaulula moihokolola, otashi sheke ouyuki, nokanya komuhenakalunga taka pona po ouhenouyuki.
Omatokolohandukilo a longekidilwa ovasheki nosho yo omadengo ombuda yovasheki.
20: Omaviinyu, oo omusheki, noikolwifa, oyo omuweeleli, ndele kaku na ou ta kolwa kuo, e neendunge.
Etilifo lohamba, olo la fa okukumba kwonghoshi yonyasha, ou te i handukifa, ota nyono po omwenyo waye.
Efimano lomunhu olo okukukuma eemhata, ndelenee elai keshe tali pendula eemhata.
Omundede ita pulula mokulombo; ndele mokufu ngeenge ta hadahada mefimbo leteyo, kaku na sha.
Eemhangela domutima womunhu di li ngaashi omeva malemale, ndelenee omulumenhu omunaendunge te ke di teka mo.
Ovanhu vahapu tave litangele ouwa wavo, ndelenee olyelye ta mono omulumenhu e shii kulineekelwa?
Omuyuki ha ende ehe noshipo, ovana vaye tave mu shikula vo ovanelao.
Ohamba tai kala omutumba kolukalwa letokolo, otai tokolifa omesho ayo nokutongola mo owii.
Olyelye ta dulu okutya: “Omutima wange nde u kosha, ame nda koshwa, ndihe nomatimba?”
Oiyelekifo i lili nai lili noiyelekifombale i lili nai lili oyo oixuna koshipala shOmwene.
Nokamati take liholola nokuli pakukala kwako, oilonga yako ngeenge ya yela noya yuka.
Okutwi haku udu ko, neisho tali mono ko, oyo aishe ivali Omwene e i ninga.
Ino kala u hole eemhofi, uha ninge ohepele; pashuka, opo u likutife nomungome.
Omulandi ta ti: “Shii, shii!” Ndelenee omulandifi eshi a dja po, ote litange.
Oku noshingoldo neekorali, ndelenee ewapeko li nondilo, olo omilungu di neshiivo.
Kufa oshikutu shaye, osheshi ye a ninga omuponhele woifuta, ndele u mu kufe ngaashi ombabyona molwavakwao.
Omungome womokunyeka omunyenye komunhu, ndelenee komesho okanya kaye ka yada omawe.
Eenghundafana tadi pameke eemhangela; hano mokushiva oita, diladila shili nawa.
Ou ta endaenda nomalundilo, ota holola oshiholekwa, hano ino litula pwaau e nomilungu da makuka.
Ou ta tulomutima xe naina, olamba yaye otai dimi momulaulu fokofoko.
Oinima tai hakanwa unene pehovelo, oxuuninwa itai eta enangeko noupuna.
Ino tya: “Nda hala okukwatela owii onghone!” Teelela Omwene, Ye ote ku yakula!
Oiyelekifo yomaludi avali, oyo oixuna koshipala shOmwene, noshiyelekifo inashi yuka ke shiwa.
Eenghatu domulumenhu tadi endifwa kOmwene; omunhu ta dulu ngahelipi okuuda eendjila daye?
Omunhu te litele omwiyo mokuhadiladila kwaye, ta udanekele Omuyapuki oshali ndelenee komesho ta ka diladila eudaneko.
Ohamba i neendunge otai duda mo ovahenakalunga, ndele tai alangatifa oshilei shokuxwa kombada yavo.
Omhepo yomunhu oyo olamba yOmwene, tai konakona oukololo aveshe vomutima.
Ohole noudiinini tai amene ohamba, nomolwohole yo otai yambidida olukalwapangelo layo.
Ewapeko lovamati, olo eenghono davo. Newapeko lovaxungu olo eenghwakutoka.
Omatoshaulo e nohonde taa yelifa omunawii, nomadengo taa yelifa oukololo vomutima.
21: Omutima wohamba u li meke lOmwene ngaashi omakungulukilo omeva. Ye ote u endifa keshe apa a hala.
Ondjila keshe yomunhu oya yuka momesho aye mwene, ndelenee Omwene ta konakona omitima.
Okulonga ouyuki noshili otaku wapalele Omwene, komesho yomayambo.
Elinenepeko lomesho nounhwa womutima osho evilimo lovahenakalunga novalunde.
Eemhangela dovadiinini tadi eta ouwa auke. Ndelenee omweendeleli keshe te likongele eemhumbwe.
Ovo tave likongele omamona nelaka loipupulu, vo va fa omhepo tai pepe, nomwiyo wefyo!
Oukolokoshi wavo tau nakula po ovahenakalunga shaashi va anya okuninga osho sha yuka.
Ondjila yomunhu e nombedi oya penga. Ndelenee oilonga yomukoshoki oya yuka.
Okukala mokolonela yonduda ku dule okukala meumbo limwe nomwalikadi e neenyamukudi.
Omwenyo womuhenakalunga u hole owii; mukwao ita mono nande onghenda momesho aye.
Omunhu ngeenge ta handukile omusheki, omushima ta mono eendunge. Nomunhu ngeenge ta pukulula omunaendunge, ye ota tambula eshiivo.
Omuyuki ta pashukile eumbo lomuhenakalunga. Ye ota undwile ovahenakalunga momupya.
Ou ta fitikile onghuwo yohepele okutwi kwaye, oye mwene yo ota ka kuwa onghuwo, ndele ita ka mona epopilo.
Oshali yomeholeko tai lotifa ehandu, noshali yomekolo tai mweneke oupyuhandu.
Okulonga ouyuki otaku hafifa omuyuki, ndelenee kovanawii okwo ehaluko.
Omunhu ou ta yapuka mo mondjila yeendunge, ota ka tulumukwa moshiongalele shoilulu.
Ou e hole oitelekela, ota ka hangika keemhumbwe. Ou e hole omaviinyu nomaadi, ita ka ninga oshipuna.
Omuhenakalunga ota ningi oikulila yomuyuki, nomuliteeki te uya ponhele yomunashili.
Okukala moshilongo shi yela ku dule okukala nokuhepekwa komwalikadi e neenyamukudi.
Emona li nondilo nomaadi e li meumbo lomuyuki, ndelenee omunhu omushima te a mane po.
Ou ta lalakanene ouyuki nolune, ota ka mona omwenyo, ouyuki nefimano.
Omunongo ota totele oshilando shovanaenghono ndele ta hanauna po ohote ya li eameno lasho.
Ou ta kelele okanya kaye nelaka laye, ota amene omwenyo waye koluhodi.
Omulinenepeki nomulunduki ota ifanwa omusheki, shaashi ha kala e nokudina kaku shii kuyelekwa.
Omundede ta dipawa kouhalu waye mwene, osheshi omake aye inaa hala okulonga;
efiku alishe ha kala nokahalu neenghono; ndelenee omuyuki ota yandje ita luvapala.
Eyambo lomuhenakalunga olo oixuna. Unene ngahelipi ngeenge tali etwa molwoshilonga oshififahoni!
Ondobwedi yoipupulu tai hanaunwa po, ndelenee omulumenhu e shii kupwilikina, ota itavelwa okupopya pefimbo keshe.
Omuhenakalunga ota kukutike oshipala shaye, ndelenee omuyuki ta yukifa eendjila daye nawa.
Kape nounongo ile eendunge ile epukululo lasha, tali kwafa mokukondjifa Omwene.
Onghambe ya longekidilwa efiku lolwoodi, ndelenee okufindana taku di kOmwene.
22: Edina li nondilo li dule oupuna uhapu, nohokwe i dule oshisiliveli noshingoldo.
Oshipuna nohepele otava pumhakana. Omwene e va shita vo aveshe.
Omunaendunge ota tale oshiponga ndele ta hondama, ndelenee ovashima tava ehene ko ndele tava hangika koshiponga.
Ondjabi yelininipiko noyokutila Omwene oyo oupuna nefimano nomwenyo.
Omakiya neemwiyo di li mondjila yomunaipupulu, ou ta kala kokule nayo, ota amene omwenyo waye.
Omona woye omumati, mu ikifa ondjila yaye ya yuka, opo nee ita ka yapuka muyo, eshi a kula.
Oshipuna tashi pangele eehepele. Naau e noikolo ta ningi omupika waau e mu pa eengele.
Ou ta kunu owii, ota ka teya omupya, noshiti shoupyuhandu waye otashi nyonauka po.
Ou e nehalo liwa ota ka nangekwa noupuna, osheshi ota yandje komukwanaluhepo omungome waye.
Taataa omusheki, opo nee eemhata tadi xulu po; neshilafano nesheko tali pu po.
Ou e hole oukoshoki womutima, ndele e nomilungu da wapala, ohamba otai ningi kaume kaye.
Omesho Omwene taa amene eshiivo. Onghee hano ta pengifa eendjovo dovaliteeki.
Omundede ta ti: “Pondje ope nonghoshi. Fiku limwe tai dipaa nge mokati komapandavanda!”
Okanya komukainhu wovanhu oko elambo lile. Ou ta hangika kehandu lOmwene, ota wile mo mulo.
Oulai owa kanyatela momutima wokaana, ndelenee outekushiti tau u taataa mo.
Ou ta fininike ohepele, ote i kwafa. Ou ta pe oshipuna, ye ote shi ningi ohepele.
Pakaleka omatwi u pwilikine eendjovo dovalumenhu ovanongo, u koneke eshiivo lange.
Osheshi sha wapala ngeenge to di tuvikile momwenyo woye. Do adishe nadi kale da longekidilwa omilungu doye.
Opo u kale nokulineekela Omwene, onghee handi ku longo nena eli, heeno, ove ho longwa.
Inandi ku shangela omayeletumbulo, nde ku pa nomapukululo neshiivo.
Opo ndi ku longe oshili, eendjovo di shii kulineekelwa, u shiive neendjovo odo doshili okunyamukula omutumi woye.
Ino hepeka omukwanaluhepo, shaashi ye omukwanaluhepo; ndele ino lyata ohepele moshivelo.
Osheshi Omwene ta popile eendjovo davo, ndele ta kufa omwenyo wovahepeki vavo.
Ino ninga kaume komuhandunhu ndele ino endafana naau e hole eemhata,
opo uha ike eendjila daye ndele uha twale omwenyo woye momwiyo.
Ino kala mokati kaava hava paafana eke, ava tava ningi ovaponhele yoifuta.
Ngeenge uhe na sha okufuta, ombete tave i kufa koshi yoye.
Ongaba ikulweelela ino i lundulula, yo oya tulwa po kooxe.
Ngeenge to mono omulumenhu e nomayele mokulonga kwaye; ye ota dulu okukala ofika moipafi yeehamba, hamokulongela ovafyoona.
23: Ove ngeenge ho kala omutumba okulya pamwe nomupangeli, didilika nawa ou e li koshipala shoye,
ndele tula ombele pofingo yoye, ngeenge wa hala okuhakana.
Ino haluka eendja daye dinyenye, osheshi odo eendja dekengelelo.
Ino lipyakidikila u ninge oshipuna, efa okulongifa eendunge doye moshinima eshi.
Omesho oye eshi a wile ko, oupuna uhe po, osheshi divadiva wa mona omavava ndele tau tuka ngaashi onhwa keulu.
Ino lya omungome waau e ku yele, ndele ino haluka eendja daye dinyenye.
Osheshi ngaashi ta diladila momwenyo waye, osho e li. Osho te ku lombwele: “Lya, nwa,” ndelenee omutima waye kau li pamwe naave.
Oshipambu we shi lya, u noku shi kunga mo; neendjovo doye doukaume we di hepifa ashike.
Ino popya momatwi elai, osheshi eendunge domeendjovo doye otali di dini.
Ino lundulula omufinda wongaba, ndele ino ya komapya eefiye.
Osheshi Omukulili wado e neenghono, Ye ota ka popila eendjovo dado kwoove.
Omutima woye, u eta moutekuduliko nokutwi kwoye keendjovo deshiivo.
Omona woye omumati ino mu fila onghenda oku mu handukila. Ngeenge to mu dengifa oshimwati, ye ita ka fya.
Ove to denge tuu oshimwati, ndelenee ove to xupifa omwenyo waye moshovafi.
Omumwange, omutima woye ngeenge tau mono ounongo, opo nee omutima wange yo otau hafe.
Neefiyo dange tadi kuwilile, omilungu doye ngeenge tadi popi odo da yuka.
Omutima woye uha fye efupa molwovahenakalunga, ndelenee kala efiku alishe mokutila Omwene.
Osheshi oshili oku nefimbo lokomesho, neteelelo loye itali ka hepa ngaho.
Omumwange, uda, u mone eendunge, yukifa omutima woye u yukilile mondjila.
Ino kala mokati kaava hava finyuna omaviinyu, hamokati kaava va duka okulya ombelela.
Osheshi omufinyuni nomufukedi otava ka ninga eehepele, nomukumuki ta ka djala oikutu yoinyanyu.
Pwilikina xo, ou e ku dala, ndele ino dina nyoko, eshi a kulupa.
Landa oshili, ino i landifa po; nosho yo ounongo, noutekuduliko neendunge.
Xe yomuyuki ota hafe pombada; naau a dala omunongo, ye ote mu nyakukilwa
Hafifa xo nanyoko, naau e ku dala, mu nyakukifa pombada.
Omumwange, pe nge omutima woye, omesho oye naa hokwe eendjila dange.
Osheshi ombwada oyo elambo lile, nomukainhu omuhaelwa oye ondungu ya finana.
Ye ota nangala ndele ta holamene ngaashi omulunga ndele ta hapupalifa ovaliteeki mokati kovanhu.
Umwe ta ti: “Akutu!” Nomukwao: “Woo ame!” Umwe e neemhata. Umwe vali ta keme. Umwe e noipute nande ina nyona sha. Umwe vali e nomesho a wiwika.
Ovo ava hava kala efimbo lile pomaviinyu, ovo hava i mo va ka makele oikunwa ya lumbakanifwa.
Ino tala omaviinyu nhumbi a tilyana, nhumbi taa wapala meholo, ndele taa fenungutile mo.
Pexulilo otaa lumata ngaashi eyoka, ndele taa fiile mo oudiyo ngaashi ongolonyoka.
Omesho oye otaa ka mona oinima yoikumwifa, nomutima woye tau ka popya oinima inai yuka,
ndele to ka kala ngaashi ou ta nangala meni lefuta mwi, ile ngaashi ou ta nangala koxulo yombodje yoskepa.
Ye ta ti: “Vo ova denga nge, ndelenee inandi uda ouyehame, Vo ova denga nge poshi, ame inandi shi dimbulukwa! Onaini handi ka papuduka? Opo nee handi ke a konga vali.”
24: Ino fila ovanawii efupa, ndele ino hala okukala pamwe navo.
Osheshi omutima wavo tau diladila oukolokoshi nomilungu davo tadi popi enyonauko.
Eumbo tali dikwa nomayele, ndele tali pamekwa neendunge.
Ndele mokushiiva omalimba taa yadifwa noinima i lili nai lili iwa i nondilo.
Omulumenhu omunongo e neenghono, nomulumenhu e neshiivo ota hapupalifa eenghono.
Osheshi molwokudiladila nawa to dulu okushinga oita, nouhapu wovapukululi tau eta efindano.
Ounongo otau kalele elai kombadeelela. Itali makula okanya kalo moshivelo.
Ou ta diladila okuninga owii, ota ifanwa omunauketuketu.
