Enyono olo oshilonga shoulai, nomusheki oye oixuna kovanhu.
Ngeenge wa monika wa fya ounye, efiku loluhepo eenghono doye tadi ka ninipala.
Xupifa ava hava twalwa kokufya, naava hava pungaukile koshidipaelo, va kanghameka.
Ove ngeenge to ti: “Tala, twa li inatu shi shiiva”, Ye, ou ha konakona omutima, ine shi didilika? Naau ta nangele omwenyo woye, e shi shii. Ndele Ye ota pe omunhu pailonga yaye.
Omumwange, lya omaadi eenyiki, osheshi oo omawa, nomalodu omaadi eenyiki, osheshi oo manyenye kondakona yoye.
Didilika hano, ounongo osho u li yo komwenyo woye. Ngeenge to u mono, ove u nefimbo lokomesho neteelelo loye itali ka ninga longaho.
Omuhenakalunga ove, ino nangela eumbo lomuyuki, ino hanauna po onhele yaye yetulumuko.
Osheshi luheyali omuyuki ta punduka ndele ta penduka vali, ndelenee ovahenakalunga tava ka wila momupya.
Ino hafa, omutondadi woye ngeenge ta wile po. Ndele ino kuwilila komwenyo, ye ngeenge ta punduka,
Opo Omwene ehe shi dimbulukwe, ndele sho itashi yuka momesho aye, ndele ta kandula po puye ehandu laye.
Ino handuka omolwovanawii; ino fila ovahenakalunga efupa.
Osheshi ovanawii vehe nefimbo lokomesho nolamba yovahenakalunga tai dimi.
Omumwange, tila Omwene nohamba, ino litula povakolokoshi.
Osheshi divadiva omupya tau va hange, nexulilo lomido davo, olyelye e shi shii, onaini.
Edi yo eendjovo dovalumenhu ovanongo: Inashi yuka okukala nokatongotongo moihokolola.
Ou ta lombwele omunamatimba: “Ove u nounongo!” Ovanhu otave mu tula omutima, noiwana tai mu fingi.
Ndelenee ava hava tokola vehe nokatongotongo, otava ka kala nawa, ndele tava ka mona elao nenangeko noupuna.
Ou e nenyamukulo la yuka, ye ota xupitwa komilungu.
Longa nokuyukifa oilonga yoye pondje ndele longekida epya loye, opo nee to tungu ongulu yoye.
Ino hokololifa omushiinda shoye, ehe netimba, ile ho kengelele nomilungu doye.
Ino tya: “Ye ngaashi a ningila nge, nosho yo ame ohandi ke mu ningila. Ame ohandi kwatele omulumenhu onghone pailonga yaye.”
Ame nda enda pepya lomundede, pomunghulo woshikokola shomiviinyu shomulumenhu omushima,
ndele tala, lo oli yadi eeshosholo, la uvikwa kokalilifa, nongubu yalo yomamanya ya hanauka.
Ame nde li tala, heeno, nde li didilika shili, nda dimbulukwa ndele nde lilonga:
Kofa natango kanininini, fefeleka po okafimbo, nangala natango we litonya,
opo nee oluhepo tali ku nhukile meemhumbwe doye ngaashi omulumenhu a dililwa.
25: Naao omayeletumbulo aSalomo, ovalumenhu vaHiskia, ohamba yaJuda ve a ongela.
Efimano laKalunga olo okuholeka oshinima, ndelenee efimano leehamba olo okukonakona nokuteneneka oshinima.
Okukonakona oule wopombada weulu noule woposhi wedu nomitima deehamba, otaku nyengana.
Kufa ko omange koshisiliveli, opo nee tapa holokele omuhambwidi woshisiliveli oshinima shi yela.
Kufa ko omuhenakalunga koshipala shohamba, opo nee olukalwapangelo layo tali ka pamekwa nouyuki.
Ino linenepeka koshipala shohamba, ndele ino litula ponhele yovanenenhu.
Osheshi shi dule, ove to lombwelwa: “Ila oku komesho!” Ile to ninipikwa moipafi yomunedina, ou omesho oye e mu wete.
Ino endelela okuhokololifa, fiku limwe ku na sha eshi to dulu, omukweni ngeenge te ke ku fifa ohoni.
Popila oshinima shoye koshipala shomukweni, ndelenee ino holola oshiholekwa shamukweni,
opo ou te shi udu te ku sheke ndele oku ku popila mowii itaku xulu po.
Eendjovo da popiwa mefimbo lado odo da fa omaapula oingoldo moshiyaxa shoshingoldo.
Omuhanyeni omunaendunge nokutwi taku pwilikine okwo okalinga koshingoldo noulenga woshingoldo.
Ngaashi outalala weandu mefiku leteyo, osho omutumwa ou e shii kulineekelwa e li komutumi waye. Osheshi ta talaleke omwenyo womwene waye.
Omulumenhu ou te litangele eeshali ite di yandje e li ngaashi oilemo nomhepo ihe nodula.
Ohamba tai mwenekwa koutalanheni, nelaka lombili tali teya po omakipa.
Ngeenge wa mona omaadi eenyiki, lya neendunge, uha nyonyodole ndele uhe a kunge mo.
Omhadi yoye ino i lyangaanifa luhapu meumbo lamukweni, opo ye ehe ku loloke ndele te ku tondo.
Omulumenhu wondobwedi yoipupulu kumukwao, oye ngaashi odibo, neongamukonda noshikuti sha upikwa.
Eyoo la ola nomhadi hai punduka osho okulineekela omunaipupulu mefiku loluhepo.
Ngaashi omunhu te lidula oshikutu shaye mokufu, nongaashi omaetika moshipute, osho yo ou ta imbile nakunyika oluhodi omaimbilo.
Omutondadi woye ngeenge ta fi ondjala, mu pa omungome okulya, ndele ngeenge ta fi enota, mu pa omeva a nwe.
Osheshi oto mu ongele omakala a hanya komutwe waye, nomwene ote shi ku alulile.
Omhepo yokoumbangalanhu tai eta odula, nomalundilo omeholeko taa eta po oshipala shehandu.
Okukala komutwe wonduda shiwa shi dule okukala meumbo limwe nomwalikadi e neenyamukudi:
Ngaashi omeva matalala komwenyo wa notelwa, osho eenghundana diwa dokoshilongo shokokule.
Ngaashi ofifiya ya dongala nongaashi ondungu ya nyonwa po, osho omuyuki ou ta tengauka koshipala shomuhenakalunga.
Okulya omaadi eenyiki mahapu keshiwa, ndelenee okukonakona oinima idjuu, okwo oudjuu.
Omulumenhu ehe shii kulipangela, e li ngaashi oshilando sha teywa po shihe nohotekuma.
26: Ngaashi eandu pokwenye nodula pefimbo leteyo nosho yo efimano itali wapalele elai.
Ngaashi namusheshe ta papala nongaashi okahanameva taka tuka po nosho yo etulomutima longaho itali wanifwa.
Oshokoto konghambe noitomo kondongi noshimwati kombuda yomalai.
Elai ino li nyamukula paulai walo, uha faafane nalo.
Elai li nyamukula paulai walo, lo lihe litale linongo.
Ou ta tumu ondaka nelai, ota tete po eemhadi daye, ndele ta nu omupya.
Ngaashi omaulu oshingudu taa endjelele nosho yo eyeletumbulo mokanya kelai.
Ou ta mange okamanya moshiumbifo ongaau ta fimaneke elai.
Ngaashi ekiya tali tu meke longholwe, osho eyeletumbulo mokanya kelai.
Ngaashi omuumbi wouta ta umbu aveshe, osho e li ou ta tambula elai e li fute, nosho yo ou ta tambula ovaendaendi ndele te va futu.
Ngaashi ombwa tai alukile onghungo yayo, osho elai tali popyulula oulai walo.
Wa mona ko tuu omulumenhu te litale ye omunongo momesho aye mwene? Okuteelela eendunge delai ku dule winya.
Omundede ta ti: “Onghoshi i li mondjila. Onghoshi onyasha i li poluhaela.”
Ngaashi omuvelo tau linyenge komakandula ao, osho yo omundede mombete yaye.
Omundede eshi a velela neke laye metiti, a loloka unene, ita dulu oku li alula ko kokanya kaye.
Omundede ye omunongo momesho aye mwene, e dule vaheyali ava hava nyamukula neendunge.
Ou ta kwata ombwa tai ende po komatwi, e li ngaashi ou ta handuka molweemhata dovanhu.
Ngaashi omupwidi ta umbu oikuti ya xwama omundilo, oikutu yefyo,
omulumenhu osho e li ou ta kengelele mukwao ndele ta ti: “Ame nda danauka ashike!”
Ngeenge kape noikuni, omundilo tau dimi po, nongeenge pehe nomulundili, eemhata tadi xulu po.
Ngaashi ekala lokuxwameka likwao noshikuni shomundilo nosho yo omulumenhu weemhata ta xwameke ehandu.
Eendjovo domulundili di li ngaashi ouleke ndele tadi fenungutile moukololo vomenielela lomutima.
Omilungu nomutima womunaipupulu ou li ngaashi oshikangwa sha xuwa oshisiliveli.
Omutondadi te lidimbwifa nomilungu daye, ndelenee meni laye ta diladila omakengelelo.
Ondaka yaye ngeenge te i shitukifa ondaka yohole, ino mu lineekela, osheshi oixuna iheyali i li momutima waye.
Outondwe nande tau liholeke mokukengelela, owii wao tau hololwa moshiongalele sheongalo.
Ou ta fe elambo, oye mwene ta wile mo. Naau ta alangatifile ko emanya, okombada yaye lo tali alukile.
Elaka loipupulu tali tondo oonakuyehamekwa kulo, nokanya ke noumbudi taka nyonauna po.
27: Ino litangela efiku lomongula, osheshi ino shiiva efiku otali ka eta shike.
Omukweni ne ku pandule, hakanya koye mwene. Umwe e lili ndelenee hamilungu doye mwene.
Emanya olo lidjuu neheke olidjuu, ndelenee ehandu lelai olidjuu li dule oyo aishe ivali.
Onya ya xwama, nehandu tali fuluka pombada. Ndelenee olyelye ta dulu okulididimikila oukodi?
Okuhanyenwa pombada ku dule ohole ya holekwa.
Omadengo ookaume e shii kulineekelwa. Ndelenee omafipokomulungu omutondadi omahapu unene.
Omwenyo wa kuta tau lyataula omaadi eenyiki, ndelenee omwenyo ou u udite ondjala naashi shilula yo oshinyenye.
Ngaashi okadila oko taka tukatuka noshihadi shako, osho yo omulumenhu ou ta elaela kokule neumbo lavo.
Omaadi noitwiminifo tai hafifa omutima, nosho yo ohole yakaume tai kala, e nehalo okupukulula.
Ino liteeka kaume koye nakaume kaxo, ndele ino ya mo meumbo lomumwanyoko mefiku lomupya woye. Omushiinda wopopepi omuwa e dule omumwanyoko e li kokule.
Kala u neendunge, omumwange, hafifa omutima wange, opo nee handi dulu okunyamukula ovalundili vange.
Omunaendunge eshi ta mono oshiponga, ota hondama. Ndelenee ovashima tava ehene ko, ndele tava mono oshiponga.
Kufa oshikutu shaye, osheshi ye a ninga omuponhele woifuta yamukwao. Mu kufa ngaashi ombabyona yomweendanandjila.
Ou ta nangeke noupuna kaume kaye, nondaka inene ongula inene, ye otashi mu valulilwa etulomutima.
Onhongo tai ndoda efimbo alishe mefiku lomudimbi oshi fike pamwe nomwalikadi e neenyamukudi.
Ou a hala oku mu holeka, ota holeke omhepo, neke laye lokolulyo tali kwata omaadi.
Oshivela tashi upike oshivela, nosho yo omunhu ta upike mukwao.
Ou ta kelele omukwiyu, ye ota li yo oiimati yao. Ndele ou ta yakula omwene waye, ota ka fimanekwa.
Ngaashi oshipala tashi tale oshipala shikwao momeva, nosho yo omutima womunhu tau monika momukwao.
Oshovafi nonhele yehanauno itai kuta. Nosho yo omesho omunhu itaa kuta.
Onhelekelo koshisiliveli, nediko koshingoldo, nomulumenhu e li ngaashi okupopiwa kwaye.
Elai nande u li twe koshini, nokutwifa omushi mumwe neemuma, oulai walo itau di mo.
Koneka nokukonekelela oipala yeedi doye. Diinina oimuna yoye.
Osheshi emona itali kalelele, ile oshishani itashi kala fiyo okepupi nepupi.
Omwiidi eshi wa kukuta noxuluxulu tai holoka, nomakunde okeemhunda a ongelwa,
ove u noudjona voikutu yoye noikombo yokulilandela epya,
nomashini oikombo a wana ngaashi eendja doye, neendja deumbo loye nokulya kwovapiya voye.
28: Ovahenakalunga tava i onhapo nande kaku na ou te va taataa. Ndelenee ovayuki ve nouladi ngaashi onghoshi yonyasha.
Omolwetauluko oshilongo tashi mono omalenga mahapu, ndelenee molwomunhu umwe omunaendunge e neshiivo neenghediduliko tadi kala po.
Omulumenhu omukwanaluhepo ta fininike ovakwanaluhepo, oye e li ngaashi odula tai yelula, yo itai eta omungome.
Ovaliteeki vomhango tava tange ovahenakalunga, ndelenee ovawanifi vomhango otave va hanyene.
Ovanhu vali ihava udu ko ouyuki, ndelenee ava hava kongo Omwene, ve neshiivo laaishe.
Ohepele oyo tai ende ihe noshipo, i dule oshipuna tashi ende neendjila mbali.
Ou ta diinine omhango, ye omumati omunaendunge. Ndelenee ou ha kala movahanauni, ota fifa xe ohoni.
Ou ta hapupalifa emona laye noishoshela noifutifa, ota ongelele ou ta file eehepele onghenda.
Ou ta fitike okutwi kwaye aha ude omhango, neilikano laye nokuli oixuna.
Ou ta pukifa ovayuki kondjila yowii, ye mwene ota ka wila mo melambo laye, ndelenee ava vehe noshipo tava fyuulula elao.
Omulumenhu oshipuna oye omunaendunge momesho aye mwene. Ndelenee ohepele e neendunge ote mu konakona.
Ovayuki eshi tava kuwilile, elao li li po linene. Ndelenee ovahenakalunga eshi tava fikama ovanhu tava hondama.
Ou ta holeke omatauluko aye, ita ka mona elao. Ndelenee ou te a hepaulula ndele te a efa, ota ka filwa onghenda.
Omunelao omunhu ou ta kala alushe a lungama. Ndelenee ou ta kukutike omutima waye ota ka wila momupya.
Ngaashi onghoshi tai kumbu, nemwangha tali fi ondjala, osho yo omupangeli ou ta pangele ovanhu ve noluhepo.
Ohamba oyo ya hepa eendunge, otai futifa unene, ndelenee oyo tai tondo eliko loipupulu, otai hapupalifa omafiku ayo.
Omunhu ou ta fininikwa ketimba lohonde yomunhu e nokuhondama fiyo okefyo laye. Kape na nande umwe ou te mu amene.
Ou ha ende nouyuki ota ka kwafwa, ndelenee ou ta ende nokutengatenga neendjila, ota wile po.
Ou ta longo epya laye, ota ka mona omungome muhapu. Ndelenee ou ta lalakanene oinima yongaho, ota ka mona oluhepo linene.
Omulumenhu e shii kulineekelwa ta nangekwa noupuna shili. Ndelenee ou e nolwisho lokupunapala, ita kala ina handukilwa.
Okukala nokatongotongo keshiwa, osheshi omolwokapambu komungome nokuli omunhu ta nyono.
Onakufya efupa a hala okulikongela divadiva, ndele ke shi shii, nokutya oluhepo tali ke mu hanga.
Ou ta hanyene omunhu, ota ka hokiwa komesho yaau ta heke nelaka laye.
Ou ta nyeka xe ile ina ndele ta ti: “Kaku nenyono,” oye omukwao womuhanauni.
Omunalwisho weliko ta pendula eemhata, ndelenee ou te lineekele Omwene, ota ka hekelekwa.
Ou te lineekele omutima waye mwene, oye elai. Ndelenee ou ha ende neendunge ota xupifwa.
Ou ta pe ohepele, ita ka hepa, ndelenee ou ta fifikinine omesho aye ota ka tulwa omutima shili.
Ovahenakalunga eshi tava fikama, ovanhu tava hondama. Ndelenee venya ngeenge tava hanaunwa po, ovayuki tava hapupala.
29: Omulumenhu ou a handukilwa shili ndele ta kukutike ofingo yaye, ota teywa po divadiva ehe nekwafo.
Ovayuki ngeenge tava hapupala, ovanhu hava hafe. Ndelenee ovahenakalunga ngeenge tava pangele, ovanhu tava keme.
Omulumenhu e hole ounongo, ota hafifa xe. Ndelenee ou ta endafana neembwada ota nyono po emona laye.
Ohamba tai pameke oshilongo shayo nouyuki. Ndelenee omulumenhu ou ta fendelifa nokufininika, ote shi hanauna po.
Omulumenhu ou ta heke mukwao, ote litele omwiyo keenghatu daye.
Metauluko mwii omu nomwiyo, ndelenee omuyuki ota ka kuwilila nokuhafa.
Eendjovo dovakwanaluhepo oda shiivika komuyuki, ndelenee omuhenakalunga ke di shii nande.
Ovasheki tava xwameke oshilando, ndelenee ovanaendunge tava lotifa ehandu.
Omulumenhu omunamayele ngeenge ta hokololifa omulumenhu elai, olo tali weelele ndele tali yolo, lihe netulumuko.
Ovadipai tava tondo ovahenashipo, ndele tava nangele omwenyo wovayuki.
Omushima ta pupula mo onya yaye aishe ndelenee omunaendunge te i lotifa.
Omupangeli ou ta pwilikine eendjovo doipupulu, ota mono ovapiya ovahenakalunga aveke.
Ohepele nomufininiki otava shakene, omesho aaveshe vavali Omwene te a minikile.
Ohamba tai tokola eehepele pauyuki, oi nolukalwapangelo la pama fiyo alushe.
Oshimwati nehanyeno tali yandje komunhu eendunge. Ndelenee omumati ehe noutekuduliko ta fifa ohoni ina.
Ovahenakalunga ngeenge tava hapupala nomatauluko yo otaa hapupala. Ndelenee ovayuki tava tale nehafo ehanauno lavo.
Handukila omumwoye omumati, opo ye ote ku hekeleke ndele ta hafifa omwenyo woye.
Apa pehe nehololo, ovanhu tava ka pwiduka. Ndelenee omunelao oyou ta diinine omhango.
Omupika ita yavala eendjovo dehanyeno. Ye a uda ko tuu, ndelenee iha dulika.
Wa mona ko tuu omulumenhu u endelele okupopya? Okuteelela eendunge delai ku dule winya.
Omunhu ngeenge ta lundukifa omupika waye okudja kounyasha waye, komesho ye ehe shii kupandula.
Omuhandunhu ota pendula eemhata, naau e nonya e nomatauluko mahapu.
Elinenepeko lomunhu tali mu xutula, ndelenee ou e nomhepo i nelininipiko, ota ka fimanekwa.
Ou ta tukulilafana nomunyeki, ota tondo omwenyo waye mwene. Ye ta udu eanifo, ndelenee ita holola sha.
Okutila omunhu taku tele omwiyo. Ndelenee ou te lineekele Omwene, ota ka amenwa.
Ope na vahapu hava kongo oshipala shomupangeli, ndelenee eyukifo lomunhu tali di kOmwene.
Omunhu omunaipupulu oye oixuna koshipala shovayuki, ndele omweendinondjila ya yuka oye oixuna koshipala shomuhenakalunga.
30: Eendjovo daAgur yaJake; exunganeko: Omulumenhu ta popi ta ti: “Akutu Kalunga! Ame nde lilolokifa! Akutu Kalunga, ame nde lilolokifa ndele nda nyonauka po.
Heeno, ame ndihe neendunge, inandi wana ndi talwe aame omunhu, ndele ndihe neendunge domunhu.
Ndele inandi longwa ounongo, ndi kale ngeno ndi neshiivo okushiiva Omuyapuki.

Olyelye a londa meulu ndele a londoloka ko? Omhepo olyelye e i ongela meke laye? Olyelye a mangela melwakani omeva? Olyelye a pameka ominghulo dedu? Edina laye lilipipo? Nedina lOmona waye lilipipo? Ngeenge u li shii?
“Ondjovo keshe yaKalunga oya yelekwa. Ye oshikelelifo shaava hava ame kuye.
Keendjovo daye ino weda ko sha, opo Ye ehe ku shile ketokolo, ndele uha ninge omunaipupulu.
Oinima ivali handi i pula kwoove: Ino i anyena nge fiyo okefyo:
Eenghalanghongo neendjovo doipupulu, di kaleka kokule naame. Ino pa nge oluhepo, ino pa nge oupuna. Pe nge omungome wa yeleka nge,
opo ngeenge nda kutilila, ndihe ku lidimbike nokutya: ‘Omwene olyelye?’ Nongeenge nda fya oluhepo, ndiha vake, nondi nyone kedina laKalunga kange.”
Omupiya ino mu lundilifa omwene waye, opo ehe ku tule omutima, ndele ove uha monike u nombedi.
Ope nepupi tali tula omutima xe, ndele itali nangeke ina yalo noupuna;
epupi tali litale lo la yela momesho alo, ndelenee inali koshoka keenyata dalo;
epupi li nomesho elinenepeko, neemhafu dalo otadi litumbu pombada;
epupi nomayoo alo omaongamukonda nomatayoo eembele, opo va lye po eehepele moshilongo novakwanaluhepo mokati kovanhu.

Onakufipa ohonde e novana vavali oukadona: Pe nge vali! Pe nge vali!
Vatatu ava ihava kuta; vane ava itava ti: “Sha wana.”
Oshovafi, edimo longadji, edu ihali kuta omeva nande, nomundilo ou itau ti: “Sha wana nokuli!”
Ou ta sheke xe, ndele ita yavala okudulika kuina, omesho aye taa shomonwa komakola omefilu, novana vonhwa tave a li po.
Oinima itatu onde i kuminwa. Heeno, ine oya nyenga nge okushiiva:
Ondjila yonhwa keulu, ondjila yeyoka kemanya, ondjila yoskepa mokati kefuta, nondjila yomulumenhu komukainhu omunyasha.
Osho ngaha yo ondjila yomukainhu ta teya po ohombo. Ye ota li te lifeta komilungu daye, ndele ta ti: “Ame inandi nyona sha.”
Koshi yoinima itatu edu tali kakama. Nokoshi yoinima ine lo itali dulu okukala la pama:
koshi yomupika, ye eshi ta ningi ohamba, nokoshi yelai, lo eshi li nomungome muhapu unene,
omukainhu ngeenge a kala a tondwa nale, ta hombolwa, nomupika omukainhu ngeenge ta taataa omwene waye.
Oinima ine i li kombada yedu, yo inini ndelenee i nounongo uhapu unene:
oufelepuka, oshiwana shihe neenghono, ndelenee tave lituvikilile eendja mokufu;
eehele odo oshiwana shi nounongo, ndelenee do otadi litungile omaumbo ado momamanya.
Oshipaxu kashi na hamba, ndelenee ohashi tukile shimwe.
Shinyengele ta kwata keke, ndelenee ye ota kala mouhamba wohamba.
Ope na itatu hai katuka nokutuwalala, naine hai ende nokutuwalala:
Onghoshi omuladi womoilyani, yo itai shunine nande sha,
onghambe ya paluka ile omenye, nohamba tai piti komesho yomatanga ayo.
Ngeenge wa shimika, eshi we linenepekifa ile wa li wa diladila owii, likwata komilungu,
osheshi mokushika omashini taku eta omaadi, nomokukama eyulu tamu di ohonde nomokuxwameka ehandu tamu di eemhata.
31: Eendjovo daLemuel, ohamba yaMassa, ina e i kumaida nado:
“Oshike, omumwange omumati, heeno, oshike omumwange womedimo lange, heeno, oshike omumwange womaudaneko ange, ndi nokutya?
Eenghono doye ino di yandja kovakainhu, kwaava hava nyono po eehamba.
Akutu Lemuel, inashi wapalela eehamba, heeno, inashi wapalela eehamba okunwa omaviinyu ndele inashi wapalela ovapangeli okupula: Oikunwa idjuu oi li peni?
Osheshi mokunwa kwaye oikolwifa ta dimbwa eenghedimhango ndele ta pengifa ouyuki wovakwanaluhepo aveshe.
Oikolwifa i peni ou a nyika okunyonauka po, nomaviinyu ava ve neemwenyo da nyika oluhodi.
Ye na nwe, opo a dimbwe oluhepo laye, ndele ita dimbulukwa vali oupyakadi waye.
Okanya koye ka makulila omufitandaka, u popile moihokolola aveshe hava fininikwa.
Makula okanya koye, tokola pauyuki, u yukife eendjovo deehepele nodovakwanaluhepo.”
Olyelye ta ka mona omwalikadi muwa? Ondilo yaye oinene i dule ondilo yomba koshilanda.
Omutima womulumenhu waye tau mu lineekele, ye ita pumbwa eliko.
Oye ta ningile omulumenhu waye osho shiwa, hasho eshi shii momafiku aeshe omokukalamwenyo kwaye.
Ye ota humbata oshisho sholududi leedi nosholiina ndele ta longo nomake e nehalo liwa.
Ye e li ngaashi eeskepa domulandifi, ota kongo kokule omungome waye.
Ndele ye oha meneka oufiku, neumbo laye te li pe eendja noitukulwa yavo kovapiya vaye.
Ye a hala epya ndele te li lande. Omeliko lomake aye te litwikile oshikokola shomiviinyu.
Oye te lidike moshiya shaye neenghono, ndele ta pameke omaoko aye.
Oye e wete omaliko aye taa hapupala. Olamba yaye itai dimi oufiku.
Eke laye tali kwata oshihodilifo nominwe daye tadi kwata oshitungifo shoshiyata.
Eke laye te li futululile eehepele, omake aye avali ote a twala komukwanaluhepo.
Eumbo laye ihali tila molweandu, osheshi eumbo laye alishe la dikwa olududi litilyana leedi.
Ye ote liningile omakumbafa. Oikutu yaye oyo oliina iwa nopurpuri.
Omulumenhu waye a shiivika poshivelo, eshi ta kala ko omutumba pamwe novakulunhu voshilongo.
Ye ota ningi eehema, ndele te di landifa, nomiya doshiyata te di shingifa po komulandifi woipindi.
Eenghono nefimano, odo oshikutu shaye, ndele ta yolo efiku tali ke uya.
Okanya kaye te ka makulile eendjovo dounongo, nomalongo matalala e li kelaka laye.
Ota pashukile nawa oilonga aishe yomeumbo laye, ndele ita li omungome wondede.
Ovana vaye ovamati tava fikama ndele tave mu pandulile elao laye nosho yo omulumenhu waye, ndele ye te mu pandula ta ti:
“Ovakainhu vahapu ve noudiinini moilonga, ndelenee ove u va dule aveshe unene.”
Onhemokainhu kai shii kulineekelwa. Ouwa womukainhu tau xulu po. Omwalikadi ou ha tila Omwene na hambelelwe.
Na shambukwe komwenyo molwoilonga yomake aye. Noilonga yaye nai mu pandule poshivelo.

1: Eendjovo domuudifi, omona waDavid, ohamba yomuJerusalem.
Aishe oyongaho, omuudifi osho a ti. Aishe oyongaho, oinima aishe oyongahoelela!
Omunhu ote limonene mo shike mokulipyakidila oupyakadi waye keshe koshi yetango?
Epupi limwe tali piti po nepupi likwao tali uya po. Ndele edu tali kala po fiyo alushe.
Netango tali piti, netango tali ningine, ndee tali endelele okufika konhele oko tali ka pita.
Omhepo tai i kOumbuwanhu ndele tai pungulukile alushe; nomhepo tai alukile kedingililo layo.
Omilonga adishe tadi tondokele mefuta, ndelenee efuta itali yada. Konhele apa omilonga tadi di, oko tadi tondokele vali alushe.
Oinima aishe tai lipyakidile, kaku nomunhu ta dulu oku shi hepaulula. Eisho itali kuta kokutala nokutwi itaku yada kokuuda.
Shinya sha kala ko, osho tashi ka kala ko vali. Naashinya sha ningwa, otashi ka ningwa vali, ndele kape na ipe koshi yetango.
Ngeenge ope na sha tashi tiwa: “Tala, eshi oshipe!” Sho osha kala ko nale nokuli mounyuni wonale, we tu tetekela.
Kaku na edimbulukiwo lootatekulu. Nosho yo momapupi tae uya itapa ka kala edimbulukiwo kwaava tave va shikula.
Ame omuudifi nda li ohamba yaIsrael muJerusalem.
Ndele nda tula omutima wange mokukonakona ounongo nokupanapana aishe oyo tai ningwa koshi yeulu. Oshilonga shidjuu osho Kalunga e shi pa ovana vovanhu, vo ve lipyakidile nasho.
Ame nda tala oilonga aishe oyo tai ningwa koshi yetango, ndele tala, oyo aishe oyongahoelela nokushikula omhepo.
Osho sha endama, itashi yukifwa; osho sha yongolwa, itashi valwa.

Ame nda popya nomwenyo wange, handi ti: “Tala ame nde likongela ounongo, naalushe ounongo ouhapu u dule woshito, u dule aushe waava va li nge komesho muJerusalem, nomutima wange wa mona ounongo uhapu nokushiiva kuhapu.”
Ndelenee omutima wange eshi nde u pungulula okukonga ounongo neshiivo, okuheneendunge noulai, onda koneka nokutya, nasho yo okushikula omhepo.
Osheshi apa pe nounongo uhapu, ope na yo oluhodi linene, nokushiiva ngeenge taku hapupala, ouyehame yo tau hapupala.
2: Onde lipopila momwenyo wange: “Paife nee nda hala oku ku yelekela nehafo. Kala u udite hano ouwa!” Ndelenee tala, naasho yo ongahoelela.
Nda lombwela oindjola, oyo oulai. Nehafo nde lilombwela: Otashi kwafa shike?

Ame nda diladila momwenyo wange ndi hekeleke olutu lange nomaviinyu, fimbo ounongo otau endifa omwenyo wange, nondi kanyatele koulai, fiyo handi mono oshike shiwa kovana vovanhu, osho ve noku shi ninga koshi yeulu momafiku avo omokukalamwenyo kwavo.
Ame nda longa oilonga inene: nde litungila eengulu, nonde likokolela oikokola yomiviinyu.
Ame nde li ningila oikunino noikunino yomiti ndele muyo nda twika mo omiti di lili nadi lili doiimati.
Nde li ningila omatale, opo ndi tekele oixwa yomiti dipe.
Ame onde lilandela yo ovapika ovalumenhu novakainhu naava yo va dalelwa meumbo lange. Ame nda li yo neengobe dihapu needi dihapu di dule daava va li nge komesho muJerusalem.
Ame nde likongela yo oshisiliveli noshingoldo nomamona eehamba nomamona oitukulwalongo. Ame onde likongela ovaimbi ovalumenhu novakainhu, ounyenye womahafo ovana vovanhu nokutya, ovaholike vahapu.
Ndele nda kula nda ninga omunenenhu ndi dule aveshe va li nge komesho muJerusalem. Ounongo owa kala yo pwaame.

Ame inandi kelela omesho ange kwaashishe oo e shi hala. Omutima wange inandi u kelela nande ehafo limwe, osheshi omutima wange wa hafela oilonga yange aishe idjuu, ndele osho sha li oshipewa shange shomoilonga yange aishe idjuu.
Opo nee nda tala oilonga yange aishe omake ange a longa, noilonga yange aishe idjuu nde i longa, ndele tala, oyo aishe oyongahoelela nokushikula omhepo. Ndele ashishe shokoshi yetango kashi nekwafo.
Ame nda punguluka ndi tale ounongo noulai noushima, osheshi omunhu ou ta shikula ohamba, ota dulu shike mbela shimwe, osho ashike eshi sha ningwa nale!
Opo nee nda mona nokutya, ounongo u dule oulai, nouyelele u dule omulaulu.
Omunaendunge e nomesho momutwe waye, ndelenee elai tali ende momulaulu. Ndelenee nda mona yo nokutya, oshipewa shavo aveshe oshi fike pamwe.
Onghee hano nde lipopila momwenyo wange: “Osho tashi hange elai, otashi hange nge yo. Omolwashike hano ame nda li omunongo unene?” Ndelenee nde lipopila momwenyo nokutya, owo yo owongahoelela.
Osheshi edimbulukiwo lomunongo itali kala po ngaashi yo lelai, shaashi momafiku tae uya, ashishe sha dimbuwa filu. Omunongo ta fi, ndishi, ngaashi elai!
Onghee hano nda tonda okukalamwenyo, osheshi oshilonga osho tashi ka ningwa koshi yetango inashi wapalela nge, shaashi ashishe oshongahoelela nokushikula ashike omhepo.
Ndele nda tonda oshilonga shange ashishe, osho nde shi longa noudjuu koshi yetango, eshi ndi noku shi efela omunhu ou ta ka shikula nge.
Ndele olyelye e shi shii ye ngeenge omunongo ile elai? Ndele ye ota ka pangela oilonga yange aishe nde i longa noudjuu ndele nde i likongela nounongo koshi yetango. Nasho yo oshongahoelela.
Onghee hano omutima wange nde u efela mexupulo omolwoilonga yange aishe, nde i longa noudjuu koshi yetango.
Osheshi osho shi li: omunhu ou e liningila oupyakadi nokulonga nounongo nomayele nouladi, e noku shi yandja komunhu, ou ine lipyakidila nasho. Nasho yo oshongahoelela noshiponga shinene.
Osheshi omunhu ota mono shike molwoupyakadi waye aushe nomolwelalakaneno lomutima waye, nalo ye te lietele oudjuu koshi yetango?
Osheshi omafiku aye aeshe ouyehame noshilonga shaye oluhodi. Nomoufiku yo omwenyo waye itau tulumukwa. Nasho yo oshongahoelela.
Omunhu ke na nande ouwa umwe, okulya nokunwa nokushambukifa omwenyo waye nouwa mokulonga kwaye kudjuu. Ame nda mona nokutya, osho osha dja meke laKalunga.
Osheshi olyelye ta dulu okulya nokunwa ehe na Kalunga?

Osheshi omunhu ou a wapala koshipala shaye, Ye ote mu pe ounongo, omayele nehafo, ndelenee omulunde ta pewa kuye oshilonga shokulikongela nokuhapupalifa, opo shi pewe ou a wapala koshipala shaKalunga. Nasho yo oshongahoelela nokushikula ashike omhepo.
3: Ashishe oshi notundi yasho ya pangelwa, noshinima keshe shokoshi yeulu oshi nefimbo lasho:

efimbo lokudalwa nefimbo lokufya,
efimbo lokutwika nefimbo lokududa mo osho sha twikwa,

efimbo lokudipaa nefimbo lokuvelula,
efimbo lokuhanauna po nefimbo lokutunga,

efimbo lokulila nefimbo lokuyola,
efimbo lokukema nefimbo lokutanha nehafo,

efimbo lokukupula omamanya nefimbo lokwoongela omamanya,
efimbo lokudingatela nefimbo lokuhadingatela,

efimbo lokukonga nefimbo lokukanifa,
efimbo lokutuvikila nefimbo lokweekelashi,

efimbo lokupombaula nefimbo lokuhondjela kumwe,
efimbo lokumwena nefimbo lokupopya,

efimbo lokuhola nefimbo lokutonda,
efimbo lolwoodi nefimbo lombili.
Nakulonga oku nelikwafo lashike mokulipyakidila kwaye?
Ame nda tala oshilonga osho Kalunga a pa ovana vovanhu e va pyakidilifa nasho,
Ye okwa ninga ashishe shiwa pefimbo lasho, nokwa tula momutima wavo oukwaalushe, ndelenee omunhu ita koneke oshilonga osho Kalunga ta ningi kehovelo fiyo okexulilo.
Onghee hano onde shi mona nokutya, vo vehe nelao limwe, okuhafa ashike nokulonga osho shiwa mokukalamwenyo kwavo.
Navali: oshali shaKalunga omunhu ngeenge ta li ndele ta nu ndele ta shambukwa kouwa moshilonga shaye ashishe shidjuu.
Ame onda koneka nokutya, ashishe osho Kalunga a ninga, otashi kala po fiyo alushe. Itapa wedelwa nande osha ndele itapa kufwa sha. Ndele Kalunga osho a ninga vo ve nokutila koshipala shaye.
Ashishe eshi shi li po, osha li po nale. Naasho tashi ka kala ka, osha li po nale. Ndele Kalunga ta kongo vali osho sha pita po.
Nda mona vali koshi yetango onhele yoihokolola: Pa li pehe nouyuki. Noponhele youyuki pa li pehe nouyuki!
Nde lipopila nomwenyo wange: “Kalunga ota ka tokola ovayuki novahenakalunga, osheshi oku nefimbo loshinima keshe noloshilonga keshe.”
Ame nde lipopila momwenyo wange: “Molwovana vovanhu osho shi li, opo Kalunga e va yelekele ndele vo ve limone nokutya, muvo vene vo oimuna.”

Osheshi ovana vovanhu tava ningwa ngaashi oimuna nokutya, oshipewa shavo shimwe ashike. Ngaashi omunhu ta fi, nosho yo oshimuna tashi fi, osheshi vo aveshe ve nomufudo umwe auke, ndelenee kape na sha momunhu osho tashi mu pitifa komesho yoshimuna. Osheshi ashishe oshongahoelela.
Aveshe tava i monhele imwe; aveshe va dja mondwi naaveshe tava shuna mondwi.
Olyelye e shi shii ngeenge, omufudo womona womunhu tau i pombada, nomufudo woimuna tau kuluka medu?
Osho ngaha hano nde shi mona nokutya, pehe na sha shiwa shi dule okuhafela oilonga yaye, osheshi osho oshipewa shaye. Osheshi olyelye te mu alula a ka tale osho tashi kala konima yaye?
4: Ame nda tala ehepeko alishe tali ningwa koshi yetango, ndele tala, opa li omahodi ovahepekwa, ndelenee vo vehe na nande omuhekeleki. Ndele kombinga yovahepeki opa li eenghonopangelo, ndelenee venya va li vehe nomuhekeleki.
Onghee hano nda tanga oonakufya, vo ovanelao, ve dule ovanamwenyo, ava ve nomwenyo natango,
ndele ovanelaoelela ve dule aveshe ava, venya inava kala po natango, ndele inava mona owii ou tau ningwa koshi yetango.
Mokutala oupyakadi aushe womokulonga noilonga aishe iwa, oyo okufilafana efupandubo. Osho yo shongahoelela nokushikula ashike omhepo.
Elai tali lixukata omaoko alo ndele tali li ombelela yalo vene.
Etulumuko li fike peke li dule eshambekela li yadi oupyakadi nokushikula omhepo.
Ndele natango nda mona oupyakadi wongaho koshi yetango:

oku na umwe, ye aeke ti, ehe nomukwao, ehe nomona omumati ile omumwaina omulumenhu; ndelenee oupyakadi waye itau xulu po, nomesho aye itaa kuta oupuna. Hano ame ohandi lihepekele lyelye ndele handi lihepekifa nokulumbula omwenyo wange ouwa? Osho yo shongahoelela noshinima shii.
Vavali ve dule umwe, osheshi vo otava mono ondjabi iwa yoshilonga shavo shidjuu.
Osheshi vo ngeenge tava punduka, umwe ta dulu okuyambula omukwao, ndelenee woo ou umwe, ngeenge ta punduka, ke na omukwao te mu yambula.
Navali, vavali ngeenge tava nangala pamwe, ove nenhwi; ndelenee umwe aeke ta dulu ngahelipi okumona enhwi?
Ndele omunhu ngeenge ta nhukile umwe, aveshe vavali tava dulu okulipopila. Ongodi ya pandwa neengodi nhatu itai tokoka diva.
Omumati ohepele nomunaendunge e dule ohamba ilai noya kulupa, yo kai shii kupukululwa.
Osheshi ou a dja kodolongo a ninge ohamba, nande moshilongo shambulavo omo a dalelwa ohepele.
Ame nda mona nokutya, ovanamwenyo aveshe ava hava ende koshi yetango va ama kombinga yomumati, kombinga yaawinya kwa li e nokuninga omushikuli wayo.
Kapa li nande exulilo lovanhu aveshe ava, nokutya, lovanhu aveshe e va pangela. Ndelenee omapupi taa ka shikula, itae mu hafele. Osho ngaha hano eshi oshongahoelela nokushikula ashike omhepo.
Amena omhadi yoye ngeenge to i kongulu yaKalunga. Okuuya nokupwilikina ku dule etomenoyambo lomalai. Osheshi ovo vehe neendunge, onghee hano hava ningi owii.
5: Ino endelelifa okanya koye, nomutima woye ino u endelelifa okupopya ondjovo koshipala shaKalunga. Osheshi Kalunga oku li meulu, ove ou li kombada yedu. Onghee hano eendjovo doye nadi kale dinini.
Ino endelelifa okanya koye okupopya, nomwenyo woye okuudaneka koshipala shaKalunga, shaashi Kalunga oku li meulu, ove ou li kombada yedu. Onghee eendjovo doye nadi kale dixupi.
Osheshi ngaashi ondjodi tai uya molwoisho ihapu, nosho yo okupopyaana kwelai molweendjovo dihapu.
Ove eshi wa udanekela Kalunga eudaneko, ou na oku li wanifa diva, osheshi Ye ita hokwa omalai. Wanifa osho we shi udaneka.
Shi dule ove iho udaneke sha, ponhele ho udaneke ndelenee ito wanifa.
Ino itavela okanya koye ka pefe olutu loye ombedi ndele ino tya moipafi yomutumwa waKalunga: “Nda puka!” Omolwashike ngeno Kalunga e nokuhandukila okupopya kwoye nokuhanauna po oshilonga shomake oye.
Osheshi eendjodi dihapu odongahoelela. Nosho yo omapopyaano mahapu. Ndelenee kala ho tila Kalunga!

Ngeenge to mono ohepele tai fininikwa neyukifo nouyuki tau lyatwa moshilongo, oshinima osho ino shi kuminwa; osheshi ou omunenenhu ota nangelwa komunenenhu mukwao, e mu dule, ndele aveshe vavali tava nangelwa kuvakwao ve va dule.
Ndelenee ekwafo linene loshilongo oleli: ohamba tai diinine oshilonga shomapya.
Ou e hole oimaliwa ita wanenwa koimaliwa. Ndele ou e hole oupuna, ita wanenwa keliko. Osho yo ongahoelela.
Emona eshi tali hapupala novali valo yo otava hapupala. Omunemona e nekwafo lashike hano kulo, omesho aye ashike tae li tale.
Eemhofi domulongi odo ditalala, nande ta li shinini ile shihapu; ndelenee oshipuna tashi nyengwa okukofa molwouyadipuna washo.
Nda mona koshi yetango oshiponga shidjuu: oupuna owo wa tuvikilila oshipuna omupya.
Oupuna ngeenge tau kanifwa po molwoshiponga, ndele e nomona omumati, ye ehe na sha vali.
Ngaashi ye a dile medimo laina, osho ta ka ya olutu longaho ngaashi e uya. Ndele ehe na sha osho shomoilonga a ka ye nasho.
Hano osho yo oshiponga shidjuu: naanaa ngaashi e uya e nokushuna ko. Hano okwa mona ekwafo lashike mokulipyakidila omhepo?
Nosho yo ha li mokukalamwenyo kwaye akushe momulaulu ndele e noluhodi lihapu. Navali okuhepekwa nehandu!

Tala, eshi yo nde shi mona osha wapala noshiwa: Okulya nokunwa nokushambukilwa ouwa moupyakadi aushe omunhu he u lipyakidile koshi yetango omafiku aye aeshe maxupi, Kalunga e mu pa. Osheshi osho oshipewa shaye.
Naashi yo oshali shaKalunga, Kalunga ngeenge ta pe omunhu oupuna nomamona ndele te mu itavelele okulya mo nokupewa oshipewa shaye nokulihafifa moilonga yaye idjuu.
Osheshi iha diladila unene omafiku omokukalamwenyo kwaye, shaashi Kalunga okwe mu itavelela ehafo lokomwenyo waye.
6: Oku noshiponga osho nde shi mona koshi yetango, osho tashi djuupaleke unene ovanhu:

Omulumenhu ou a pewa kuKalunga oupuna nomamona nefimano, ye ita pumbwa sha vali mwaashishe e shi hala, ndelenee Kalunga ite mu itavelele oku i hafela, osheshi omukwao te i hafele. Osho ongahoelela nehepeko.
Omulumenhu nande a dale ovana efele limwe ndele a kale ngeno e nomwenyo omido dihapu nomafiku mahapu omido daye nomwenyo itau wana kouwa ndele ita ka lilwa eefya; opo nee handi ti: ohele i mu dule.
Osheshi yo otai uya ngaho ndele tai i momulaulu, nedina layo tali tuvikwa komulaulu.
Yo inai mona etango ile inai li shiiva. Etulumuko layo oliwa li dule laawinya.
Heeno, nande a kale e nomwenyo luvali omido deyovi limwe, ndelenee ita mono elao, aveshe ndishi tava i monhele imwe aike?
Oupyakadi aushe womunhu otau ningilwa okanya kaye, ndelenee ouhalu waye itau mono ekuta.
Osheshi ouwa womunongo u dule ngahelipi ngeno oo welai, nomukwanaluhepo ota mono ekwafo lashike, ye eshi ta dulu okweenda nawa mokati kovanamwenyo?
Okutala kweisho ku dule okweelaela kwomwenyo. Okwo yo ongahoelela nokushikula ashike omhepo!
Naashi shi li ko, osha lukwa nokuli nale, ndele kwa shiivika, omunhu ta ka kala a tya ngahelipi. Ye ita dulu okuhokololifa ou e mu dule meenghono.
Osheshi apa pe neendjovo dihapu, otadi hapupalifa okupopyaana kwongaho. Omunhu e nekwafo lashike kudo?

Osheshi olyelye e shi shii kutya oshike tashi wapalele omunhu mokukalamwenyo, momafiku mahapu omokukalamwenyo kwaye kwongaho muo ye ta kala ngaashi omudidimbe. Ndele olyelye ta hololele omunhu osho tashi ke uya konima yaye koshi yetango?
7: Edina la fimana li dule omaadi mawa, nefiku lokufya li dule efiku lokudalwa.
Sha wapala okuya meumbo li neefya, shi dule okuya meumbo li noitelekela. Osheshi linya olo exulilo lovanhu aveshe, nomunamwenyo ote shi diladila momwenyo waye.
Oluhodi li dule okuyola, osheshi tashi wapalele omwenyo ngeenge oshipala sha nyika oufiye.
Omutima wovanaendunge u li meumbo li neefya, ndelenee omutima womalai u li meumbo lehafo.
Sha wapala okupwilikina ehanyeno lomunaendunge shi dule okupwilikina eimbilo lomalai.
Osheshi ngaashi omano taa topatopa koshi yombiya, osho okuyola kwelai. Okwo yo ongahoelela.
Oshili, eliko loipupulu tali laipike omunaendunge, nombubo tai nyono po omutima.
Exulilo loshinima li dule ehovelo lasho. Omutalanheni e dule omulinenepeki.
Ino endelela okulihandukifa nomwenyo woye, osheshi ehandu tali kala monhulo yelai.
Ino tya: “Omolwashike hano omafiku onale a li mawa e dule aa opaife?” Osheshi ito shi pula neendunge!
Ounongo u fike pamwe noshifyuululwatukulwa nekwafo laava hava tale etango.
Osheshi epopilo lounongo olo ngaashi epopilo loimaliwa. Ndelenee ekwafo lokushiiva, olo ounongo tau kwatelele omwenyo mwaau e u na.
Tala nokutala oilonga yaKalunga, osheshi olyelye ta dulu okuyukifa osho Ye e shi endamekifa?
Kala wa hafa mefiku liwa, ndele mefiku lii, kala u shi shii nokutya, Kalunga okwa ninga efiku eli ngaashi linya; osheshi omunhu ita pewa sha mwaai tai mu shikula.
Aishe nde i mona momafiku ange oyo yongaho: oku novayuki tava nyonauka ko mouyuki wavo, ndele oku na ovahenakalunga tava kala nomwenyo efimbo lile mowii wavo,
Ino kala unene omuyuki ndele ino limonifa omunaendunge unene. Omolwashike wa hala ngeno okulinyona po?
Ino kala unene omukolokoshi, ndele ino kala elai. Omolwashike ngeno u fye efimbo manga inali fika?
Oshe ku wapalela ngeenge ho kala nokwaama kushimwe, ndelenee eke loye liha efe shinya, osheshi ou ha tila Kalunga, ota xupifwa mwaaishe oyo.
Ounongo tau kwafa omunongo nekwafo linene li dule ovapangeli omulongo vomoshilando.
Osheshi kombada yedu kape na nande omunhu omuyuki, ou ha ningi ngeno ouwa auke, ndele ita nyono.
Ino dimbulukwa eendjovo adishe we di popiwa kovanhu, opo uha ude omupiya woye te ku tuku.
Osheshi omutima woye mwene yo u shi shii nhumbi wa tuka vakweni luhapu.
Ashishe eshi nde shi yelekela nounongo. Onda tile: “Ame nda hala ndi ninge omunongo,” ndelenee ounongo wa kala kokule naame.
Aishe oyo i li kokule nomokulekule, olyelye ta dulu oku i shiiva?
Momutima wange nda hovela okulilonga nokudiladila nokukonga ounongo nokushiiva osho sha konekwa, opo ndi shiive nokutya, ouhenakalunga owo oulai, noulai owo okukala kuhe neendunge.

Ndele nda mona sha shilula shi dule efyo: Omukainhu e nomutima wa fa eendjadja, nomake aye e li ngaashi omalyenge. Omunhu ou ta wapalele Kalunga ota xupifwa muye, ndelenee omulongi woulunde ta kwatwa kuye.
Tala, osho tuu eshi nde shi mona, omuudifi ta ti mokukonga kwaye efikilo lekonakono nokutula kumwe shimwe nashikwao,
osho omwenyo wange we shi konga efimbo lile, ndelenee inau shi mona. Onda mona omulumenhu umwe movalumenhu eyovi, ndelenee mwaaveshe venya inandi mona mo nande omukainhu umwe.
Tala, eshi ashike nde shi mona nokutya, Kalunga okwa ninga omunhu a kale a yuka, ndelenee voovene ohave likongele eemhangela dihapu dii.
8: Olyelye e li ngaashi omunongo, nefatululo loinima ola shiivika kulyelye? Ounongo womunhu tau yeleke oshipala shaye, noukukutu woshipala shaye tau lundululwa kuwo.
Ame ohandi ti: Diinina oshipango shohamba, unene molweano we li anena Kalunga.
Ino endelela okuliteeka kuyo. Ino ama koshinima shii, osheshi yo tai ningi eshi ye shi hala.
Osheshi ondjovo yohamba i neenghono, ndele olyelye ta dulu oku i lombwela: “To ningi shike?”
Ou ta diinine oshipango ita ka mona oshinima shii. Omutima womunongo wa shiiva efimbo netokolo la yuka.
Osheshi keshe oshinima oshi nefimbo lasho netokolo lasho. Osheshi owii womunhu tau mu djuupaleke unene.
Osheshi keshi shii eshi tashi ke uya. Olyelye te mu hololele osho shi nokuuya komesho?
Kaku na nande omunhu ta dulu okupangela omhepo a kelele omhepo, ndele kaku na ou ta pangele efiku lefyo. Kaku nelekelo molwoodi. Nosho yo ouhenakalunga itau xupifa ou e u hole.
Ashishe eshi nde shi mona, eshi nda pungululila omutima wange koshilonga keshe tashi longwa koshi yetango mefimbo mulo omunhu ta pangelele mukwao omupya.
Ame nda mona yo nhumbi ovahenakalunga va pakwa ndele va ya metulumuko, fimbo ovo va enda pauyuki va li ve nokudja po ponhele iyapuki ndele va dimbuwa moshilando. Nasho yo ongahoelela.
Shaashi etokolo loshilonga shii itali endelele, onghee omutima wovana vovanhu u yadi okulonga owii.
Osheshi omulunde ta nyono lwefele ndele ta kala nomwenyo efimbo lile. Ndelenee ondi shi shii ava hava tila Kalunga, otava ka ningilwa nawa, shaashi tava tila koshipala shaye,
ndele omuhenakalunga ita ka mona elao, ndele omafiku aye itaa ka lepala ngaashi omudile, osheshi iha tila Kalunga.
Naasho yo onghonelela kombada yedu, eshi ope novayuki tava ningilwa pailonga yovahenakalunga, ndele ope novahenakalunga tava ningilwa pailonga yovayuki. Onghee handi ti: Nasho yo ongahoelela.

Onghee hano ame nda pandula ehafo, osheshi omunhu koshi yetango ke na shimwe shiwa, okulya nokunwa nokunyakukwa. Oyo tai mu shikula moshilonga shaye shidjuu pomafiku okukalamwenyo kwaye Kalunga e mu pa koshi yetango.
Ame eshi nda pungulula omutima wange okulilonga ounongo, nokutala oinima tai ningwa kombada yedu, heeno, nokuli oufiku nomutenya kaku na ou ta mono eemhofi,

opo nee moshilonga ashishe shaKalunga nda mona nokutya, omunhu moshilonga osho tashi ningwa koshi yetango, ita mono mo sha, ndele omunhu te lilolokifa mokukonga, ndelenee ita mono; heeno, omunongo nande ha diladila ye e shi shii, ite ke shi shiiva.
9: Oinima ei aishe nde i kwatela momutima wange ndele ashishe eshi nde shi konakona shili, nokutya ovayuki novalumenhu ovanaendunge noilonga yavo ve li meke laKalunga, nosho yo ohole ngaashi ehandu. Omunhu keshi shii eshi shi li komesho yaye!

Aishe i fike pamwe kwaaveshe. Oshipewa shimwe ashike komuyuki nokomuhenakalunga, komukoshoki nokomulinyateki, kwaau ha yambe nokwaau iha yambe; ou muwa ta ningwa ngaashi omulunde, ou ta ane naau ha tila okwaana.

Mwaaishe tai ningwa koshi yetango omu noshinima inashi yuka nokutya, oshipewa shimwe ashike tashi hange aveshe, nomutima yo wovana vovanhu u yadi owii, noulai hau kala momitima davo mokukalamwenyo kwavo. Ndele konima yaashi otaku iwa koonakufya!
Osheshi ou fimbo e li mokati kovanamwenyo aveshe, ye e netimaumbwile. Osheshi ombwa i nomwenyo oi dule onghoshi ya fya.
Osheshi ovanamwenyo ove shi shii nokutya, ove nokufya. Ndelenee noonakufya inava shiiva nande osha, ndele vo vehe nondjabi vali, osheshi edimbulukifo lavo tali dimbuwa.
Ohole yavo ngaashi ehandu lavo nouladi wavo yo owa xula po nale. Ndelenee vo vehe na vali oshipewa mwaashishe tashi ningwa koshi yetango.
Inda hano u ka lye nehafo omungome woye, ndele nwa omaviinyu oye nomutima wa nyakukwa, osheshi Kalunga okwa hokwa nonale oilonga yoye.
Oikutu yoye nai kale alushe i yela, nomaadi komutwe woye aha pumbwe ko.

Hafifa omwenyo pamwe nomwalikadi woye ou u mu hole, omafiku aeshe omokukalamwenyo kwoye epwanga, okwo Ye e ku pa koshi yetango, heeno, omafiku oye aeshe oongahoelela. Osheshi osho oshitukulwa shoye mokukalamwenyo kwoye nomoshilonga shoye, osho to shi longo noudjuu koshi yetango.
Longa ashishe to shi dulu neenghono doye, osheshi moshovafi omu to i, kamu na nande oshilonga, ediladilo neshiivo ile ounongo.

Natango nda mona koshi yetango nokutya, okutondoka shanamutete kaku li mepangelo laau e nonhapo, haita mepangelo lovakwanyati, hamungome mepangelo lovanaendunge, haupuna mepangelo lovanamayele, hahokwe mepangelo lovanongo, ndelenee efimbo nesheyelo tali pangele aishe.

Heeno, nomunhu yo ina shiiva efimbo laye, ngaashi eeshi odo tadi yulwa moshiyulifo shitilifa nongaashi eedila tadi kwatwa meendjadja dokukwata. Ngaashi do osho yo ovana vovanhu tava yulwa mefimbo lii, olo tali va kwata divadiva.
Navali nde shi tala osho ounongo koshi yetango ndele nde shi tala osho oshinima shinene nokutya:
pa li oshilando shinini ndele musho mwa li ovalumenhu vanini nohamba inene ye shi homona, ye shi fitikinina, ndele ye shi tungila omatoteloshungo manene.
Ndele musho mwa kala omulumenhu umwe omukwanaluhepo nomunamayele. Oye ou a xupifa oshilando omolwounongo waye, ndelenee kakwa li nande umwe a ka dimbulukwa omulumenhu winya ohepele.
Opo nee ame nda tya: Ounongo u dule eenghono dovakwanyati. Ndelenee ounongo wohepele tau dinwa, ndele kaku na umwe a pwilikina eendjovo dayo.
Eendjovo domunamayele da pwilikinwa nokumwena, di dule eweelelo lomupangeli welai.
Ounongo u dule oilwifo yomoita, ndelenee omulunde ta nyono po oinima ihapu iwa.
10: Eedi da fya tadi mbutike ndele tadi nyono po omaadi omupiluli womiti. Oulai munini u dule eendunge nefimano.
Omutima womunaendunge u li kolulyo, ndelenee omutima welai okolumosho.
Heeno, mokweenda kwalo nondjila elai kali neendunge. Tali hololele keshe umwe nokutya, lo elai.
Ehandu lomupangeli ngeenge tali ku xwamene, ino efa oshilonga shoye, osheshi elididimiko tali kelele omanyono mahapu.
Oku nomupya nde u mona koshi yetango nokutya, epuko la dja komupangeli:
Oulai tau tulwa pombada u fimanekwe, noipuna i nokukala omutumba poshi.
Ame nda mona ovapika va londa eenghambe, ndelenee eehamba da enda ngaashi ovapiya kolupadi pedu.
Ou ta fe elambo, ota wile mulo, ou ta ngumauna po ekuma, ota lika keyoka.
Ou ta pande omamanya, ote lilengula nao, ndele ou ta pande oikuni, ta tuwa oipute kuyo.
Oshivela ngeenge sha fimha, nomunhu ina upika ombinga yeememo, ye e nokulonga neenghono dihapu. Hano okudiinina oilongifo okwo eendunge.
Eyoka ngeenge tali li omunhu, fimbo inali fipwa, ounongo wokufipa uhe na vali oshilonga.
Eendjovo domokanya komunamayele odiwa, ndelenee elai tali ponwa po komilungu dalo vene.
Ehovelo leendjovo dokanya kalo olo oulai, nexulilo lokupopya kwalo oushima.
Elai tali popi eendjovo dihapu, ndelenee omunhu iha shiiva oshike tashi ke uya. Olyelye te mu hololele osho tashi holoka konima yaye.
Elai olo itali shiiva okuya koshilando, osheshi la lolokifwa koupyakadi walo.
Woo ove oshilongo! Ohamba yasho okaana, nomalenga asho eshi taa kala poitelekela eengula dinene nokuli.
Akutu oshilongo ove shi nelao! Ngeenge ohamba yasho omunedina, ndele ngeenge omalenga asho taa kala poililo pefimbo la wapala ngaashi ovalumenhweelela, hangaashi ovafinyuni.
Omolwoundede oikonde yongulu tai teka po, nongulu tai lokifwa molwounye womake.
Oitelekela tai telekelwa okuhafifa, nomaviinyu taa hafifa omwenyo; ndelenee aishe tai etwa po koimaliwa.
Ino tuka nande ohamba momadiladilo oye, ndele monduda yoye yokunangala, ino tuka oshipuna. Osheshi eedila dokeulu tadi twala ondaka yoye, naai i nomavava tai holola eendjovo doye.
11: Ekela omungome woye kombada yomeva, osheshi ngeenge pa piti omafiku mahapu ove to ke u mona.
Oshitukulwa shi yandjela vaheyali, heeno, vahetatu yo, osheshi inamu shiiva omupya washike tau ka kala kombada yedu.
Oilemo ngeenge i yadi odula, yo otai i lokele edu. Ndele omuti ngeenge tau wile kOumbuwanhu ile kOumbangalanhu, kombinga tuu oyo omuti tau wile ko, oko tau nangala.
Ou ha tale omhepo, ita ka kuna nande; ndele ou ha tale oilemo, ita ka teya nande.
Ngaashi ino shiiva ondjila yomhepo ile nhumbi omakipa taa kulu mo medimo lomufimba, nosho ino shiiva oilonga aishe yaKalunga.
Ombuto yoye i kuna ongula, ndele ino tulumukifa eke loye komatango. Osheshi ku shi shii, ilipipo tai ka mena, oyo ile inya, ile ngeenge aishe ivali tai ka kala ya wapala.
Natango: ouyelele omuwa ndele tashi wapalele omesho okumona etango.
Osheshi omunhu nande a kale e nomwenyo omido dihapu, ye e nokuhafa mudo adishe nokudimbulukwa omafiku omulaulu, osheshi oo otaa ka kala mahapu. Ashishe osho tashi ke uya, oshongahoelela.

Omunyasha ove, kala wa nyakukwa mounyasha woye, nomutima woye nau ku hafife momafiku omounyasha woye. Ndele enda neendjila domwenyo woye, ndelenee kala u shi shii nokutya, Kalunga ote ku tokolifa molwaashishe eshi.
Ndele taataa mo oluhodi momwenyo woye, ndele kandula po omauyehame molutu loye, osheshi ehafo nounyasha yo oyongahoelela.
12: Ndele dimbulukwa Omushiti woye momafiku ounyasha woye, fimbo omafiku mai inae uya, nomido tadi uya, odo ove to di popi, to ti: “Odo inadi wapalela nge.”
Fimbo etango nouyelele nohani, neenyofi inadi laula noilemo eshi tai aluka konima yodula,

fimbo efiku tuu olo inali uya, ovanangeli vongulu tava kakama, novalumenhu ve neenghono tava ende omwoodimba, novatwi va efa okutwa, shaashi va ninga vanini, naava hava talele momakende, ove li momulaulu,
fimbo oivelo ya ama kepandavanda tai ka idilwa po, fimbo omifindo domoshini tadi ninipala. Ndele ye ta penduka, oudila eshi tava hovele okukwena neendaka adishe deimbilo da mwena.

Ye ota ka kala e noumbada molwoikulundudu noitilifa i li mondjila. Nomuti waamandel tau piti eenhemo, noshipaxu tashi lishilile komesho noudjuu, oshimbodi shakapper itashi pendula vali ouhalu. Osheshi omunhu ta i keumbo laye laalushe, noonakulila eefya tava endaenda momapandavanda,
fimbo ongodi yoshisiliveli inai tokoka noshiyuma shoshingoldo inashi tatuka, noshitoo shopofifiya inashi tatuka noluvalakuulu la tekauka ndele la wila mo mondungu,
fimbo ondwi inai shuna medu ngaashi ya li ko, nomhepo inai shuna kuKalunga, ou e i mu pele.
Aishe oyongaho, Omuudifi ta ti, aishe oyongahoelela.
Ndele ponho younongo Omuudifi, ye okwa longa ovanhu okushiiva, nokwa diladila ndele a konakona nokwa tunga omayeletumbulo mahapu.
Omuudifi okwa hetekela okumona eendjovo da wapala, da shangwa da yuka, eendjovo doshili.
Eendjovo dovalumenhu ovanamayele odi li ngaashi oivela neendjovo da ongelwa odi li ngaashi eembosha da dengelwa mokule, adishe da yandjwa kOmufita umwe auke.
Natango: “Omumwange, kala oupafi. Okushanga omikanda dihapu kaku nexulilo; nokulipyakidila unene mokulesha otaku lolokifa olutu.”
Efina loinima aishe twe i uda oleli: Tila Kalunga u diinine oipango yaye. Osheshi omunhu keshe osho e nokuninga.
Osheshi Kalunga ota alula keshe oshilonga ketokolo, olo tali uya kombada yoinima aishe ya holekwa, iwa naii.

1: Eimbiloelela laSalomo.
Ye na fipe nge omilungu nomafipo aye omilungu. Osheshi ohole yoye inyenye i dule omaviinyu.
Omivavo doye da nyika edimba liwa, edina loye omaadi a tilwa po, onghee hano ovakainhu ovanyasha ve ku hole.
Shile nge, natu endeleleni! Ohamba ya twala nge meenduda dayo domeni. Fye twa hala okunyakukwa noku ku hafela, nokufimaneka kwetu ohole yoye ku dule okufimaneka omaviinyu. Owa wana ve ku hole.
Oukadona nye vokuJerusalem, ame ondi laula, ndelenee nda wapala, ngaashi omatwali aKedar, ngaashi oiendjeleloyata yaSalomo.
Inamu tala nge eshi ndi laula, nda pya komutenya. Ovana ovamati vameme va handukila nge. Ova nangeka nge omunangeli woshikokola shomiviinyu, oshikokola shange mwene shomiviinyu inandi shi nangela.
Lombwele nge, omuholike womwenyo wange, openi ho lifa oimuna, openi ho ombifa oimuna omutenya? Osheshi omolwashike ndi kale ngaashi ou e liuvika oshipala, ta kala poimuna yavakweni?
Ngeenge ino shi shiiva, ove oumuwa muweelela mokati kovakainhu, shikula omakondo eedi, u life oudjona voye meenhele domatwali ovafita.
Omuholike wange, ame ohandi ku yeleke nonghambe onghadi yopetemba laFarao.
Eemhanda doye da wapala pamwe noulyenge nofingo yoye pamwe noilanda.
Fye ohatu ku ningile oulyenge voshingoldo noipatifo yavo yoshisiliveli.
Ohamba fimbo ya kala omutumba poshililo, omuvavo wange onarde wa nyika edimba liwa.
Omuholike wange oye oshipandi shomirha, tashi tulumukwa pokati komavele ange.
Omuholike wange oye eshila leenhemo dohenna lomoshikokola shomiviinyu shomuEngedi.
Tala, ove wa wapala, omuholike wange. Tala, ove wa wapala, omesho oye e li ngaashi eenghutyona.
Tala, ove wa wapala, omuholike! Omutala wetu muwa ngahelipi, wa hapa ngahelipi!
Omitengi dongulu yetu omiti domisederi, omifingo detu omisipresi.
2: Onhemo yaNarsis yomuSaron, aame onhemo yedo lomomafilu!
Ngaashi onhemo yedo mokati keeshosholo, osho omuholike wange e li mokati koukadona.
Ngaashi omuti womuapula u li mokati komiti domomufitu, osho omuholike wange e li mokati kovamati. Nda hala okukala omutumba momudidimbe wao, noshiimati shao oshinyenye mokanya kange.
Okwa twala nge monduda yomomiviinyu. Ohole yaye oyo epandela laye kombada yange.
Pamekei nge noikamena yeeviinyu, hekelekei nge noiimati yomaapula, osheshi ohandi vele ohole.
Eke laye lokolumosho li li koshi yomutwe wange, neke laye lokolulyo tali pamhadala nge.
Nye oukadona vomuJerusalem, ohandi mu anifa eemenye noupundja vokepumbu: Inamu pendula, inamu weelela ohole, fiyo oyo vene ya hala.
Pwilikina! Omuholike wange te uya. Tala, ou te uya ta nhuka eemhunda, ta nhukile oikulundudu.
Omuholike wange e li ngaashi oholongo ile ngaashi omenye onyasha. Tala, kwinya konima yekuma letu ota kala ofika, ta taalele mo mekende, ta vandamene mombululu.
Omuholike ta popi, ta lombwele nge, ta ti: “Fikama, omuholike wange. Oove onhemo yange, ila!
Osheshi tala, okufu kwa xula, odula ya sheka, ya pita, ya ya!
Eenhemo tadi monika medu, efimbo lokwiimba la fika nokushukushula kwonghuti taku udika moshilongo shetu.
Omukwiyu tau imi eedive, omashila omiviinyu taa piti, eenhemo da nyika edimba liwa. Fikama, omuholike wange, onhemo yange, ila!
“Onghuti yange, wa hondama mekololo lemanya, mehondameno lopeemhunda, tali fiile nge oshipala shoye, udifile nge ondaka yoye. Osheshi ondaka yoye inyenye nomesho oye a wapala.
Tu kwateleni ouvandje, ouvandje vanini, ava hava nyono po oikokola yomiviinyu, osheshi oikokola yetu yomiviinyu oya eta eenhemo.”
Omuholike wange, owange mwene, naame owaye; waau ta lifa mokati keenhemo domado.
Fiyo omhepo yonguloshi tai pepe nomidile tadi faduka po, ila kwaame omuholike wange, ngaashi omenye, heeno, ngaashi oholongo onyasha yokeemhunda domamanya.
3: Ou, omwenyo wange u mu hole, onde mu konga komutala wange oufiku, ame nde mu konga, ndelenee inandi mu mona mo.
Ame nda hala ndi penduke ndele handi ka endaenda moshilando, momapandavanda nomoilandele onda hala okukonga ou, omwenyo wange u mu hole; ame nda li ku mu konga, ndelenee inandi mu mona.
Ovanangeli ava hava endaenda moshilando va hanga nge. Onde va pula: “Ou, omwenyo wange u mu hole omwe mu mona?”
Ndele eshi tuu nde va koya po, ame nde mu mona, ou omwenyo wange u mu hole. Ame nde mu kwata ndele inandi mu efa, fiyo nde mu twala meumbo lameme nomonduda yanakudala nge.
Onye oukadona vomuJerusalem, ohandi mu anifa eemenye noupundja vokepumbu: Inamu pendula, inamu weelela ohole, fiyo oyo vene ya hala.
Olyelye ou ta di kombuwa ngaashi elundumuko lomwifi, a nyika edimba lamirha noitwiminino yomadimba, oitwiminino i lili yovalandifi?
Tala, osho olukalwa laSalomo tali humbatwa ndele tali dingililwa kovaladi omilongo hamano ovalumenhu Ovaisraeli.
Vo aveshe va dililwa eongamukonda, va ika olwoodi. Keshe umwe e neongamukonda moshiya shaye okulipopila omatilifo oufiku.
Ohamba Salomo okwe lipangelifila olukalwa lokuhumbatelwa mo, la hongwa omiti domuLibanon.
Eengudi dalo okwe di ningifa noshisiliveli, noshiyaameno shalo noshingoldo, omutumba onoshiyata shitilyana, meni lalo mwa wapekwa kohole youkadona vomuJerusalem.
Piteni pondje, nye oukadona vaSion, nye mu tale nehafo ohamba Salomo, taleni oshidingo, ina kwe shi lidika efiku lohombo yayo, efiku olo omwenyo waye wa hafa.
4: Omuholike wange, owa wapala ngahelipi, heeno, ove wa wapala! Omesho oye a fa eenghuti, taa monika momaluviluvi oshiuvikoyata. Eexwiki doye dokomutwe di li ngaashi ongudu yoikombo, tai koloka komhunda yaGilead.
Omayoo oye a foshuunda sheedi da kululwa, da djuuka mekosho, adishe di nepasha, nande imwe ihe noudjona.
Omilungu doye di li ngaashi ongodi ya tilyana, nokanya koye ke nounyenye. Eemhanda doye da foshiimati shagranati, sha tukulwa, tadi monika momaluviluvi oshiuvikoyata.
Ofingo yoye ngaashi oshungo yaDavid, ya tungilwa ohotengulu omo mwa endjelela oikelelifo eyovi, oikelelifo aishe yovaladi.
Omavele oye e li ngaashi oupundja vanyasha, ngaashi omapasha omenye, oo taa li mokati keenhemo domado.
Fiyo omhepo yonguloshi tai pepe nomidile tadi faduka po, ame ohandi ka ya komhunda yamirha nokoshikulundu shoitwiminino.
Oove omuholike wange, wa wapala, uhe na nande oshiponga.
Ila, omuvalekwa wange, tu dje kuLibanon; ila, tu dje kuLibanon. Dja ko konhele yaAmana, keexulo daSenir nodaHermon, okeenhele deenghoshi nokeemhunda deengwe.
Ove wa vaka omutima wange, omuvalekwa wange nomumwameme wange, heeno, wa vaka omutima wange okepakumo limwe alike leisho loye, noshilanda shimwe ashike shomokalyenge koye komofingo.
Omumwameme, nomuvalekwa wange, ohole yoye inyenye ngahelipi! Ohole yoye inyenye i dule omaviinyu. Edimba lomivavo doye liwa li dule eebalsam adishe!
Omilungu doye, omuvalekwa wange, tadi ndodele omaadi eenyiki. Pelaka loye ope nomaadi eenyiki nomashini, nedimba loikutu yoye li li ngaashi edimba laLibanon.
Omumwameme, nomuvalekwa wange e li ngaashi oshikunino sha idilwa, omufima wa idilwa, nofifiya ya patwa.
Oitutuma yoye oyo oshikunino shomiti tadi imi eegranati, noiimati inyenye i nondilo, eenhemo dohenna nodonarde,
heeno, onarde nasafran, kalmus nokaneli pamwe noixwa i lili yoitwiminifo, mirha naaloe pamwe noimeno i lili iwa yabalsam.
Oove ofifiya yoikunino, oove ondungu i nomeva e nomwenyo, omeva taa kunguluka taa di muLibanon.

Omhepo yokoumbangalanhu, penduka! Omhepo yokoumbuwanhu, ila, u pepele oshikunino shange, omadimba asho abalsam a tandavele. Omuholike wange ne uye moshikunino shaye na lye oiimati iwa i nondilo yomusho.
5: Omuvaleki: omumwameme, omuvalekwa wange, ame ohandi uya moshikunino shange, ohandi kola omirha yange nabalsam yange. Naame ohandi li eshila lange nomaadi ange eenyiki. Ohandi nu omaviinyu ange nomashini ange. Omuvalekwa: Ookaume, lyeni, nweni nye mu kolwe kohole!

Omuvalekwa: Ame nda kofa, nomwenyo wange wa pashuka. Pwilikina, omuholike wange ta konghola: Omumwameme, omuholike wange, onghuti yange, omufetuki wange, yeululile nge! Osheshi omutwe wange wa tuta omume, neexwiki dange di yadi omata oufiku.
Omuvalekwa: Ame onde lidula oshikutu shange. Ohandi shi lidjaleke ngahelipi? Onda kosha eemhadi dange, ohandi di yapula ngahelipi?
Omuholike wange okwe lieta mo eke laye mombululu yoshivelo. Nomwenyo wange we mu tukulukila.
Ame nda penduka ndi ka yeululile omuholike wange, nomake ange a ndodela omuvavo womirha, nominwe dange da yulika oshikwatifo shoshivelo omuvavo womirha.

Ame nda yeululila omuholike wange, ndelenee omuholike wange okwa dja po, a henuka po. Fimbo ye a popya, omwenyo wange wa limbililwa. Ame onde mu konga, ndele inandi mu mona. Ame nde mu ifana, ndelenee ina itavela nge.
Ovanangeli ava hava endaenda moshilando ova hanga nge, vo ova denga nge ndele va denga nge oipute. Ovanangeli vohotekuma va kufa nge eluviluvi lange.
Ohandi mu anifa, nye oukadona vomuJerusalem: Omuholike wange ngeenge tamu mu mono, otamu mu lombwele shike? Mu lombweleni nokutya, ame ohandi vele ohole.
Omuholike woye e dule ngahelipi vakwao, oove onhemoelela yomovakainhu? Omuholike woye e dule ngahelipi vakwao, eshi to tu anifa ngaha?
Omuholike wange omutootoo nokutilyana nokwa fimana mokati komayovi omulongo.
Omutwe waye oshingoldo, oshingoldoelela. Eenghwa deexwiki daye da feembale, dilaula ngaashi ekola.
Omesho aye a feenghuti pomatondokelo omeva, do de likosha momashini, ndele tadi kala omutumba pouyadi.
Eemhanda daye da foituvikilo yabalsam, ngaashi omaanda oimeno yedimba liwa. Omilungu daye da feenhemo domado, ndele tadi ndodele omirha.
Omaoko aye a foiti yoingoldo, e yadi ouwe vakrisolit. Olutu laye ngaashi omakipa ondjaba, oshilonga shomunongo, la uvikwa noumanya vasafir.
Omaulu aye a feengudi damarmori, a dikwa moshikwatelwamhadi shoshingoldoelela. Okutalika kwaye kwa fa Libanon, kwa wapala ngaashi omusederi.
Okanya kaye ounyenye woovene, ye mwene ondjelo yoovene. Heeno, omuholike wange osho e li; okaume kange osho a tya, nye oukadona vomuJerusalem.
6: Omuholike woye okwa ya peni, oove onhemoelela mokati kovakainhu? Fye naave tu ye tu ke mu konge.
Omuholike wange okwa ya koshikunino shaye koimhungu yeebalsam, a ka life moikunino yaye nokutoola eenhemo domado.
Ame owomuholike wange, nomuholike wange owange; ou ha lifa mokati keenhemo domado.
Ove omuholike wange, wa wapala ngaashi Tirsa, wa wapalelela ngaashi Jerusalem, onakutilika ngaashi omatanga ovakwaita.
Pilamene nge osheshi omesho oye, oo haa shili nge. Eexwiki doye dokomutwe di li ngaashi oshuunda shoikombo tai koloka komhunda yaGilead.
Omayoo oye a fongudu yeedi deenghadi da djuuka mekoshelo, keshe imwe i nepasha, nande imwe ihe noudjona.
Eemhanda doye di li ngaashi ogranati ya tukulwa, tadi vema meluviluviyata loye.
Ovambada vohamba omilongo hamano novakainhu omilongo hetatu vopomunghulo novakainhu ovanyasha vehe shii kuvalwa,

ndelenee umwe aeke, onghutyona yange, omufetuki wange, ewifa laina, omuhoololwa waau e mu dala. Oukadona moku mu tala hava fimaneke elao laye, ovambada vohamba novakainhu vopomunghulo tave mu hambelele.
Okakadona olyelye oko taka tende ngaashi eluwa, ka wapala ngaashi ohani, taka vema ngaashi etango, onakutilika ngaashi omatanga ovakwaita?
Ame nda ile koshikunino shoiimati ndi ka hafele ewapalo lomefilu, ndi tale omuviinyu ngeenge tau hape, eegranati ngeenge da eta eenhemo,
divadiva omwenyo wange wa kaleka nge omutumba momatemba oshiwana shange sha fimana.
Tanauka ko, tanauka ko tu ku tale, okakadona Okasulamit! Otamu tale shike muye? Ongaau ta tanhe mokati keengudu mbali dovakwaita.
7: Eemhadi doye oda wapala meenghaku, omona ove okakadona kohamba! Eenhumba deenho doye da wapala ngaashi oulenga vomofingo, oshilonga shomake omunongo.
Oshinena shoye sha feholo la didilakana, oipifiloviinyu nai kale inai pumba mo, edimo loye olo onduba yoilya ya dingililwa keenhemo domado.
Omavele oye e li ngaashi eemenye deenyasha mbali ngaashi epasha lokapundja.
Ofingo yoye i li ngaashi oshungongulu yomayoo ondjaba, omesho oye ngaashi omatale omuHesbon poshivelo shaBat-Rabbim. Eyulu loye ngaashi oshungongulu yomuLibanon, ya taalela Damaskus.
Omutwe woye tau tumbu ngaashi Karmel, neexwiki dokomutwe woye da fopurpuri, ohamba ya kwatwa kudo.
Ove umuwa ngahelipi! Oove ohole i yadi omahafo!
Olutu loye la fomulunga, omavele oye ngaashi omashila eeviinyu.
Ame nda diladila: “Handi ka londa komulunga, ndi kwate omapokolo ao.” Omavele oye ngeno ngaashi omashila eeviinyu, nedimba lomufudo woye ngaashi edimba leapula.
Okanya koye naka fe ounyenye womaviinyu mawa, omaviinyu taa kolokele noupu meni lomuholike wange ndele taa tutike omilungu doonakukofa!
Ame owomuholike wange ndele ye oha djuulukwa nge.
Ila, omuholike wange, tu ye koshilongo, fye tu ka nangale momikunda.
Ongula inene tu piteni tu ka ye koikokola yomiviinyu tu tale omiviinyu ngeenge da pita neenhemo ngeenge da temuna neegranati ngeenge da eta eenhemo. Oko handi ke ku pa ohole yange.
Oiimati yohole tai eta edimba, ndele poivelo yetu oku na oiimati i lili nai lili iwa i nondilo naai ipe naainya ikulu, onde i ku tuvikilila, omuholike wange.
8: Ove ngeno wa kala naame ngaashi omumwameme omulumenhu wa nyama omavele ameme! Ngeno handi ku shakeneke pondje, ndi ku fipe komilungu, ame ngeno ihandi dinwa nande.
Ngeno nde ku findikila, ndi ku ete mo meumbo lameme, ndele ye a pukululile nge. Ame ngeno ndi ku nwife omaviinyu manyenye, omeva oiimati yeegranati.
Eke laye lokolumosho li li koshi yomutwe wange, neke laye lokolulyo tali pamhadala nge.
Ohandi mu anifa, nye oukadona vomuJerusalem, inamu pendula ohole, inamu i weelela fiyo oyo vene ya hala.
Olyelye ou ta di kombuwa, ve likwete nomuholike waye? Ame nde ku pendula momuti womuapula. Omo nyoko e ku dalela, omo mwa fetelwa ou naku ku pa omwenyo.

Tule nge ngaashi oshihakifolinga ponhulo yoye, nongaashi oshihakifolinga mokwooko kwoye. Osheshi ohole i neenghono ya fa efyo. Ouladi wohole wa pama, wa foshovafi, eehandje dayo eehandje domundilo, elaka lomundilo wovenevene.

Omeva mahapu itaa dulu okudima po ohole, nomakungulukilo omeva itaa dulu oku i ninginifa mefundja lao. Ngeenge pe na ou a hala ngeno okuyandjela ohole emona alishe leumbo laye shapo ye ota dinwa ashike.
Fye otu nomumwameme munini, ehe nomavele. Omumwameme ou ohatu mu tile ngahelipi efiku olo ye ta ka kongwa?
Ngeenge oye ekuma, ngeno ohatu mu tungile ko oshungo yoshisiliveli. Ndele ngeenge oye oshivelo, ohatu shi idile po noipilangi yomusederi.
Aame ekuma nomavele ange a feeshungongulu. Ndelenee paife ndi li ngaashi nakuliyandja po omomesho aye.
Salomo e noshikokola shomiviinyu muBaal-Hamon. Oshikokola shomiviinyu e shi yandjela ovanangeli. Oiimati yasho tai landwa po ngeno eeshekeli deyovi.
Oshikokola shange shomiviinyu aame mwene handi shi pangele. Odo deyovi nadi ninge doye, Salomo, novanangeli voiimati yomusho nava pewe omafele avali.
Oonakukala moikunino, ookaume koye ohava pwilikine ondaka yoye. Itavelele nge, naame yo ndi i ude!
Endelela, omuholike wange ngaashi omenye, ngaashi oholongo yonyasha keemhunda dabalsam.

1: Emoniko laJesaja yaAmos, ye e li hololelelwa tali tongo Juda naJerusalem, opomafiku aUssia naJotam naAhas naHiskia, eehamba daJuda.
Akutu omaulu, udeni, nedu ove, tula momatwi oye, osheshi Omwene ota popi: “Ame onda tekula ounona nonde va kulifa, ndele vo ova twa ondubo naame.
Ongobe oi shii mwene wayo, nokandongi oke shii etemba lokulila mo lamwene wako, ndelenee Israel iha shiiva novanhu vange inave shi didilika.”
Woo, oshiwana shovalunde, ovanhu vomatimba mahapu, noludalo laava ihava udu ko, ounona ovanyoni. Ova efa Omwene, va dina Omuyapuki waIsrael ndele ve mu pilamena.
Omwa hala natango mu dengwe peni, eshi natango tamu twikile okuliteeka? Omutwe aushe otau vele, nomutima aushe u noudu.
Okudja koshififinwa fiyo okomutwe kape na nande onhele ya yela, ndelenee oipute noivadi noitoshoulwa, oyo inai tumbwa noinai mangwa, yo inai vaekwa omaadi.
Oshilongo sheni osha ninga omaputu, noilando yeni oya xwikwa po, omapya eni otaa teywa po kovanailongo moipafi yeni; sha ninga omaputu, ngaashi naanaa sha hanaunwa po kovanailongo.
Omona okakadona kaSion oye aeke a xupa po, a fa etwali mepya lomiviinyu. A fa okanduda moshikunino shomatanga, a fa oshilando sha kondekwa.
Omwene womatanga ovakwaita ngeno ine tu xupifila oixupe, ei ya xupa, ngeno otwa kala ngaashi Sodom notwa ninga ngaashi Gomorra.
Pwilikineni ondjovo yOmwene, onye ovakulunhu vaSodom! Tuleni momatwi omhango yaKalunga ketu, nye ovanhu vaGomorra!
Omwene ta ti: “Omatomenoyambo eni mahapuhapu ohandi a ningi shike? Ame onda nyonyodola komaxwikiloyambo eedi nomaadi outana va ondolwa. Ohonde yeemhedi noyeedi noyoikombo inandi i hala.
Ngeenge nye tamu holoka koshipala shange, olyelye te mu fininike mu lyate momaluumbo ange?
Inamu eta vali eendjayambo dongaho; omatwimino oo, oixuna yongaho kwaame. Eehani dipe nomashabata nomaifano oiongalele, okwa tondwa komwenyo wange, oulunde pamwe noivilo inene.
Omwenyo wange otau tondo eehani deni, nomafimbo eni oivilo, okwa ninga omutengi mudjuu kwaame, onda loloka oku u humbata.
Ndele Ame ohandi mu fifimana nomesho ange, ngeenge tamu yelula omaoko eni; nonande mu indile omaindilo mahapu, itandi a udu: osheshi omake eni oku yadi ohonde.
Likosheni, lifeteni; kufeni po owii womoilonga yeni koshipala shange, nye mu efe okulonga owii.
Lilongeni okuninga ouwa; shikuleni ouyuki, hekelekeni ovafininikwa, tokoleleni, eefiye etokolo liyuki, popileni ovafiyekadi.”
Tu yeni tu ka hokololeni Omwene ta ti: “Omatimba eni nande naa tilyane ngaashi ohonde, otaa ka toka ngaashi outokele weemhawe; nonande naa kale a tilyana pyu, otaa yela ngaashi omalududi a toka.
Ngeenge tamu dulika ndele tamu udu ko, otamu kala mo ndele tamu ka lya ouwa wedu.
Ndelenee ngeenge otamu anye ndele tamu, kala nokunangatela, otamu lika po keongamukonda; osheshi okanya kOmwene oke shi popya.”
Woo, oshilando oshidiinini osha ninga ngahelipi oshimbwada! Sho osha li shi yadi etokolo la yuka, nouyuki omo wa li, ndelenee paife osha yada ovadipai.
Oshisiliveli shoye osha shituka omange, nomaviinyu oye manyenye okwa nyika omeva.
Ovakulunhu voye ova ninga ovanandubo novakwao vovalunga; keshe umwe womuvo e hole okupewa ombubo, ndele ta lovelele ondjabi. Eefiye itadi yakulwa, neendjovo dovafiyekadi itadi fiki ko kuvo.

Opo nee Omwene, Omwene womatanga ovakwaita, Omunaenghono waIsrael ta popi, ta ti:
“Woo! Ehandu lange onda hala oku li polifila movatondi vange nonghone yange okwaava va twa ondubo naame.
Ndele eke lange otali ke ku kondjifa nohandi ka hemuna mo mwoove omange, ndi a hemunife omongwa nomute, ndele handi koona mo oholo aishe yoye.
Ndele onda hala ndi ku pe ovatokoli ngaashi va li mo nale, novapukululi voye ngaashi sha li pehovelo. Opo nee oto ka ifanwa oshilando shouyuki, noshilando shoudinini.”
Sion ota kulilwa ketokolo liyuki tave lidilululile muye okouyuki.
Ndelenee ovatauluki novalunde otava ka hanaunwa po sheke; naava tave liteeka Omwene otava manwa po filu.
Osheshi otamu ka fifwa ohoni omolwomiandi mwa li mwe di hokwa, ndele tamu ka pembifwa kohoni omolwoikunino yeni mwe i lihoololela.
Osheshi otamu ka kala ngaashi omwandi tau yaumuka omafo nongaashi oshikunino shihe nomeva.
Ndele ovanaenghono otava ka ninga oitemifo, noilonga yavo otai ka ninga eehandje, naaishe ei ivali otai pile mumwe, ndele kape nomunhu te u dimi.
2: Ondjovo ei, ya monika kuJesaja yaAmos, tai popi Juda naJerusalem.
Pomaxulilo omafiku omhunda yongulu yOmwene otai ka kala ya pamenena, koxulo yeemhunda adishe, ndele otaku tondokele oiwana aishe.

Noiwana ihapu oko tai ka ya, ndele tai ti: “Ileni tu ka londeni komhunda yOmwene, okongulu yaKalunga kaJakob, opo e tu longe eendjila daye, fye tu shiive okweenda momalila aye. Osheshi muSion otamu di omhango nomuJerusalem otamu di ondjovo yOmwene.”

Ndele Ye ota ka tokola pokati koiwana, ndele ta yukifa oiwana yomoilongo ihapu. Ndele vo otava ka hambula omaongamukonda omatemo, nomaonga avo oikashulifo; ndele itava ka lwifafana vali nongaashi itave lilongo vali oukwaita.
Yambuka, oove eumbo laJakob, natu kaleni nokweenda mouyelele wOmwene.
Osheshi ove owa ekelashi oshiwana shoye, eumbo laJakob, shaashi ove yadi eenghedi dokoushilo noupule wOvafilisti, notave livale oukaume novanailongo.
Nedu lavo oli yadi oshisiliveli noshingoldo, nemona lavo lihapu lihe nondjele; nedu lavo oli yadi eenghambe nomatemba avo oita ehe fi kuvalwa.
Edu lavo oli yadi oikalunga, ndele vo ohave linyongamene oshilonga shomake avo, eshi sha hongwa kominwe davo.
Osho ngaho omunhu ota ka ninipikwa nomulumenhu ota ka xutulwa; ndele Ove ino shi va dimina po.
Ningina mekololo lemanya, ove u ka hondame medu, u hondame ehalwifo lOmwene noshingevilimo sheenghonopangelo daye.
Omesho ovanhu ve hole ounhwa taa ka ninipikwa, nelitumbo lomulumenhu otali ka xutulwa; Omwene Oye aeke ta ka kala mefiku olo munene a fimana.
Osheshi efiku lOmwene womatanga ovakwaita tali uya kombada yaashishe eshi shi nounhwa nosha fulalala, nokombada yaashishe she litumba pombada, opo shi findilwe poshi,
kombada yomisederi daLibanon odo dinene da fimana nokombada yomiandi domuBasan,
kombada yeemhunda dile noikulundudu ya fimana,
kombada yeeshungo dile nakeshe omakumahote a pama,
nokombada yomawato aeshe omuTarsis, nokombada yoilonga aishe yeenghulungu.
Opo nee okulitumba kwovanhu otaku dengwa poshi, nelinenepeko lovalumenhu otali xutulwa, nOmwene Oye aeke ta ka kala munene mefiku olo.
Oikalunga otai ka xula po filufilu.
Ndele ovo tava ka ningina momakololo omamanya nomomambulukwena oikulundudu ndele tava ka hondama omatilifo Omwene noshingevilimo sheenghonopangelo daye, ngeenge ta fikama a kakamife edu.
Mefiku tuu olo omunhu ota ekeleshi oikalunga yaye yoshisiliveli noyoshingoldo, e i hambula e linyongamene kuyo, ndele te i pe eemhuku nomalimalima,
opo nee vo otava hondama momakololo omamanya nomomambulukwena oikulundudu, tava hondama omatilifo Omwene noshingevilimo sheenghonopangelo daye, ngeenge ta fikama a kakamife edu.
Hano tongokeni movanhu ve nomufudo momayulu; oye ota ka yelekwa nashike?
3: Osheshi tala, Omwene, Omwene womatanga ovakwaita, ota kufa muJerusalem nomuJuda oilineekelwa keshe, oshilineekelwa okulineekela oilya noshilineekelwa okulineekela omeva,
omuladi nomukwaita, omutokoli nomuxunganeki, omuxunganeki nomukulunhu;
omukulunhu womilongoitano nelenga, omupukululi, onghulungu yeendunge dihapu nomunongo mokupopya.
Ndele Ame ohandi va pe ovanyasha va ninge eehamba davo, novapwidi otave ke va pangela.
Ndele ovanhu otava ka hepekafana, omunhu nomunhu, omukwao nomukwao; okaana otaka tu ondubo nomukulunhu weenghwakutoka, omufyoona ota tu ondubo nomutumbalekwa.
Omumwaina ngeenge ta kwata omukwao meumbo laxe ndele ta ti: “Ove ou na oshikutu natango, ninga hano omupangeli wetu, nonduba yomakuma ei i tambula moshisho shoye.”
Opo nee winya ote mu nyamukula mefiku olo: “Haame omuhakuli woipute; meumbo lange kamu na nande oilya ile oikutu; inamu ninga nge omukulunhu woshiwana.”
Osheshi Jerusalem otashi ngumunwa po, naJuda otashi teka po, osheshi elaka lavo noilonga yavo i nondubo nOmwene, nova shinda oshipala shoshinge shaye.
Ehololo lomoipala yavo tali va pe oushima, nomanyono avo otave a popi movanhu ngaashi Ovasodom, ihava holeke nande osha. Woo kuvo shaashi tave liningile voovene owii.
Tongeni omuyuki nokutya, oye ota ka kala nawa, shaashi vo otava ka lya oiimati yoilonga yavo.
Woo omudinikalunga! Ota mono oixuna, osheshi ota ka ningilwa pailonga yomake aye.
Ovakwateli komesho voshiwana shange ovo ounona, ndele tava pangelwa kovakainhu. Akutu ovanhu vange, ovaulikili veni ovo ovapukifi, va nyona po ondjila yelila leni.
Omwene ota fikama okutokola, ta fikama a tokole oiwana
Omwene ote uya ketokolo ndele ta tokola ovakulunhu novapangeli vovanhu vaye: “Nye omwa likifa oikunino yomiviinyu, neliko mwe li nyeka ohepele oli li momaumbo eni.
Oshike shi mu kwete, eshi tamu lyata ovanhu vange ndele tamu nyanyaula oipala yovafyoona?” Omwene, Omwene womatanga ovakwaita ta ti.

Omwene okwa popya ndele ta ti: “Osheshi ovana oukadona vaSion otava shishimana, hava ende neefingo da endekwa ndele tava keuka nomesho avo, hava ende tava ngungula, ndele tava kwelengedjifa eengodo dokomaulu avo,
opo nee Omwene ota menifa omakoko koluwewe lovana oukadona vaSion ndele te va monikifa epenge lavo.”
Mefiku tuu olo Omwene ota ka dula ko oulenga weengodo komaulu noulenga voutango novouhani,
nomangola omomatwi nomalyenge okomaoko noukaiwa vokulituvika oshipala,
noumbale nomalyenge okomaulu, omakwamo oulenga neeshanga domaadi noiketi youlenga,
oulinga vokominwe noulinga vomomayulu,
oikutu yoivilo, omalwakani, oiliuviko nokakutu koimaliwa,
outengelelo noikutu yoliina, omashulu noituviko youlenga.
Ponhele yedimba liwa otapa kala otwila, ndele ponhele yomwiya tapa kala omufuwa; ponhele yeexwiki epalu; ponhele yoshikutu shoshivilo oshako; ponhele youwa wolutu okuxwika noshilimbo.
Ovalumenhu voye otava ka fya keongamukonda novaladi voye otava file moita.
Ndele oivelo yoye otai ka kala nokupopya nokutakuma, ndele tashi tinhwa po filu, ndele tashi kala omutumba pedu.
4: Ndele mefiku olo ovakainhu vaheyali tava ka kwata omulumenhu umwe, tava ti: “Fye otwa hala okulya eendja detu vene, ndele twa hala okudjala omidjalo detu vene; natu ifanwe ashike nedina loye, ove u tu kufe ohoni yetu.”
Mefiku tuu olo Oshitutumine shOmwene otashi tutumine oixupe yaIsrael ewapalo nefimano, noimeno aishe yomedu otai menene oulenga woupuna.
Ndele tapa ningi, keshe ou a xupa muSion e nomwenyo, naau ta hangika muJerusalem, ota ifanwa omuyapuki, keshe umwe ou a shangelwa movanamwenyo vomuJerusalem.
Omwene nghee a feta po ekako lovana oukadona vaSion nokwa kosha omatimba ohonde aJerusalem mokati kavo nOmhepo yetokolo nOmhepo yeyelifo.

Opo nee Omwene ota shiti oshilemo shokukala omutenya konhele oko ku nomhunda yaSion nokombada yeengudu dayo da ongala koshivilo nomwifi kumwe nouyelele womundilo wa tema pombada oufiku, osheshi kombada yoshinge ashishe tapu ka kala eameno.
Ndele otapa ka kala onduda yomudile wokukelela oupyu womutenya neameno lokwaamena koshikungulu nokodula.
5: Onda hala okwiimba omuholike wange, ame ndi imbe eimbilo lomuholike wange tali popi olo oshikokola shaye shomiviinyu. Omuholike wange okwa li e noshikokola shomiviinyu koshikulundudu sha wapala.

Nokwe shi lima, ndele ta fe mo omamanya nokwa twika mo eenhwika domiviinyu dinyenye, ndele ta tungile mo oshungo nokwa hongela mo oshikolelo shokukolela mo. Ndele ye okwa teelela, shi ime eeviinyu dinyenye, ndelenee osha ima eeviinyu domofuka.
Hano osho ngaha, nye Ovajerusalem novalumenhu muJuda, tokoleni pokati ketu noshikokola shange shomiviinyu.
Onda li ndi nokulonga ngahelipi hano oshikokola shange, oshike inandi shi longela? Osha imina hano shike eeviinyu domofuka, fimbo nda teelela shi ime eeviinyu dinyenye?
Onda hala ndi mu hololele, eshi handi ningile oshikokola shange shomiviinyu; ongubu yasho ohandi i umbulula, shi lifwe po, nekuma lasho ohandi li ngumauna po, shi lyataulwe po.
Ame ohandi shi efa shi ninge ofuka yongaho, shiha kokolwe vali, sho shiha limwe vali, shi mene omano neeshosholo, ndele handi lombwele oilemo ihe shi lokele vali odula.

Osheshi oshikokola shOmwene womatanga ovakwaita osho eumbo laIsrael, novalumenhu vaJuda oshikunino shehafo laye. Okwa li a teelela ouyuki, ndele tala, edipaafano nohonde, nokwa li a teelela omatokolo a yuka, ndele tala, ekuwaano lopombada.
Woo, ovo tava shaameke eumbo neumbo, ndele tava tula kumwe epya nepya, po kape na vali onhele; osho ngaha tamu nangala oshilongo, onye amuke.
Omwene womatanga ovakwaita osho a popya momatwi ange: Oshili, omaumbo mahapu otaa ka shituka omaputu, nao manene a wapala otaa kala ehe na oovene.
Osheshi oshikokola shomiviinyu otashi longwa kovanhu omulongo efiku limwe otashi imi eelita hetatu, noilya ya kunwa eelita efele nomilongo hetatu otai dala ashike eelita omulongo nahetatu.
Woo, ava hava meneka ongula inene ve lilongekidile ondala, ndele tava xungilile omaviinyu e va pupyaleke.
Ndele okaxumbafeta nonyalilo, nokangoma nofilita nomaviinyu, oyo i li moitendele yavo, ndele vo ihava tale oilonga yOmwene, eshi ta ningi, ngaashi ihava koneke oilonga yomake aye.
Onghee hano ovanhu vange otava i moukwatwa omolwaashi vehe na eshiivo, novanamadina otava ka fya ondjala, novakolokoshi otava ka undikwa kenota.
Opo nee oshovafi otashi mbwalangadjifa omunino ndee otashi makula okanya kasho ka mbwalangadja unene; nomo otamu mbolokotele ovanamadina vaJerusalem novafyoona noipuna novahafi.
Opo nee omunhu ota ka xutulwa, nomulumenhu ota ka findilwa poshi, nomesho ovalinenepeki otaa ninipikilwa poshi.
Ndelenee Omwene womatanga ovakwaita ota ka kala omunene molwomatokolohandu, naKalunga omuyapuki ote ve lihololele ngaashi Omuyapuki molwouyuki.
Ndele eedjona otadi ka lya ngaashi poulifilo wado vene novanailongo otava ka lifa poikulukuma yoipuna
Woo ava, tava shili owii i neengodi dongaho nomatimba nomiya detemba,
ava tava ti: “Oshilonga shaye nashi endelele diva, opo tu shi mone; netokolo lOmuyapuki waIsrael nali ehene, tu li shiive!”
Woo ava, tava ti: Owii oo ouwa, nouwa oo owii, tava pilike ouyelele nomulaulu, nomulaulu nouyelele, tava ningi ounyenye oululu, noululu ounyenye.
Woo ovo, ve shii ovo ovanaendunge nove litala ve nomayele,
Woo ovo, va ninga ovaladi mokunwa omaviinyu nova ninga ovalumenhwelela mokudunga oikolwifa;
ovo hava tokolele omushima ouyuki molwombubo, ndele tava pe omuyuki oushima.

Onghee hano, ngaashi omutemo womundilo tau lafa po oihati, nongaashi omwiidi mukukutu tau ongotele mo momundilo, osho omidi davo tadi olo ngaashi onhata, nonhemo yavo tai i omhepo ngaashi ondwi, osheshi vo ova dina omhango yOmwene womatanga ovakwaita, nova sheka eendjovo dOmuyapuki waIsrael.

Onghee hano ehandu lOmwene ola hanga oshiwana shaye, e shi yelulila eke laye, ndele te shi denge, neemhunda oda kakama noimhu yasho oya li momapandavanda ngaashi oushosho. Ndele mwaaishe ei ehandu laye inali kandulwa po, ndelenee natango eke laye ola yeluka.
Ndele Oye ta ka yelulila oshiwana shokokule epandela, ndele te shi ifana nomwilwa okominghulo adishe dedu. Ndele tala, divadiva otave uya nokweendelela.
Mokati kavo kamu na omuloloki ile omupunduki, kamu na ou ta kumuka ile ta kofa, nekwamo itali di mo moshiya, nomwiya weenghaku davo itau tokoka.
Oikuti yavo oya honga nomauta avo okwa lukilwa. Omakondo eenghambe davo ngaashi emanya likukutu, nomaulu omatemba avo ngaashi okafudaela.
Nonghuwo yavo ongaashi onghoshi yonghadi tai kumbu, ngaashi onghoshi onyasha tai ono ndele tai hakana oshihakanwa notai shi kokolola, ndele kape nomuxupifi.
