Ndelenee Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Olyelye ou mokati keni e nodi imwe aike, ndele tai wile moshilambo mefiku lEshabata, ite i kwata ndele te i shili mo ngeno?
Hano omunhu e dule odi luhapu unene! Onghee hano otashi dulika okulonga ouwa mefiku lEshabata.”
Ndele okwa tya komulumenhu ou: “Yukililifa eke loye!” Oye okwe li yukililifa; ndele la veluka, nola kala ngaashi likwao.
Ndele Ovafarisai ova dja mo ndele tave mu likundu nhumbi ve noku mu dipaa.
Ndele Jesus eshi a didilika eshi, okwa dja ko. Ndele vahapu ve mu shikula, nokwe va velula aveshe,
ndele okwe va kunghilila neenghono vehe mu holole;
opo di wanifwe edi da tongwa komuxunganeki Jesaja eshi ta ti:

“Tala, omunhu wange, nde mu hoolola,
omuholike wange, ou omwenyo wange we mu hokwa;
Ame ohandi mu tula Omhepo yange,
oye ndele ta udifile ovapaani etokolo la yuka.

Oye iha tamanana ndele iha ingida,
ndele ngaashi ondaka yaye
itai udika momapandavanda.

Oshihati sha tanduka ite shi nyanyaula,
nokangodi koshela yomaadi ka twimaana,
ite ka dimi po,
fiyo ta fikifa eshi sha yuka mefindano.
Novapaani otave ke lineekela edina laye.”
Ndele okwa etelwa po omulumenhu e na ondemoni, kwa li omupofi nomufitandaka, ndele okwe mu velula, nomufitandaka okwa popya nota mono ko.
Ndele ovanhu aveshe ova kumwa ndele tava ti: “Ou haye mbela omona waDavid?”
Ndelenee Ovafarisai eshi ve shi uda, ova tya: “Eendemoni ote di tefa mo Belsebul aeke, omukulunhu weendemoni.”

Ndelenee Oye a li e wete omadiladilo avo, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Okeshe tuu oshilongo tashi litwile ondubo musho vene, otashi teka po, nongaashi kaku noshilando ile eumbo tali litwile ondubo mulo vene tali kala po.
Ndele ngeenge Satana ta te mo Satana mukwao, hano oye okwe litwila ondubo muye mwene, oshilongo shaye otashi kala po ngahelipi?
Ndele ngeenge Ame handi te mo eendemoni naBelsebul, ovana veni hano otave di te mo nalyelye? Onghee hano ovo tava ningi ovatokoli veni.
Ndelenee Ame ngeenge handi te mo eendemoni nOmhepo yaKalunga, opo hano ouhamba waKalunga wa fika nee kunye.
Ile olyelye ta dulu okupumina meumbo lomunaenghono noku mu nyeka oinima, shapo ta mange tete omunaenghono mwene? Opo ta tinhi po eumbo laye.
Ou iha kala kumwe naame, oye e nondubo naame, naau ita ongele pamwe naame, oye ta halakanifa.
Onghee handi mu lombwele: okeshe tuu etimba nesheko ovanhu otave li diminwa po, ndele okusheka Omhepo Iyapuki itaku diminwa po.
Ndele ngeenge ku na ou ta popi ondjovo a twa ondubo nOmona wOmunhu, otai mu diminwa po, ndele ou ta popi Omhepo Iyapuki, oye ite shi diminwa po nande nomounyuni ou nomwaawinya tau uya.
“Ningeni omuti muwa, noiimati yao oiwa, ile mu ninge omuti mwii, noiimati oii; osheshi omuti ohau shiivika koiimati yao.
“Oludalo nye lomayoka, otamu shiiva ngahelipi okupopya ouwa, onye vene eshi mu li po muvai? Osheshi eshi shi yadi momutima, osho tashi popifa okanya.
Omunhu muwa ota holola mo ouwa omelimba laye liwa, nomunhu mwii ota kufa melimba laye lii owii.
Ndelenee ohandi mu lombwele: Okeshe tuu ondjovo yongaho, ovanhu tava tumbula, ovo ve na oku i pulwa efiku letokolo.
Osheshi okeendjovo doye ove to yukifwa omuyuki, nokeendjovo doye to pewa oushima.”
Opo nee vamwe vomovanongo vomishangwa novomOvafarisai ve mu nyamukula ndele tava ti: “Omuhongi, fye twa hala u tu ulikile edidiliko.”
Ndelenee Ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Epupi eli lii lovanyoni vohombo la hala edidiliko, ndele itali pewa edidiliko limwe, olo tuu alike lomuxunganeki Jona.
Osheshi ngaashi Jona a kalele medimo loshikwameva omitenya nhatu nomaufiku atatu, hano osho yo Omona wOmunhu ota ka kala koshi yedu omitenya nhatu nomaufiku atatu.
“Ovalumenhu vaNinive otava ka nyumuka pamwe nepupi eli metokolo, ndele tave li pe etimba; osheshi ovo va li ve lidilulula keudifo laJona, ndele tala, ou e li apa oku dule Jona.

Ohamba omukainhu yokoumbuwanhu otai ka fikama pamwe nepupi eli metokolo, ndele tai li pe etimba, osheshi oyo ya dile okominghulo dedu, ye uya okupwilikina eendunge daSalomo, ndele tala, ou e li apa, oku dule Salomo.
“Ndele omhepo ya nyata ngeenge ya dja mo momunhu, otai tokola omitunda nomitunda dihe na omeva, tai kongo etulumuko, ndele itai li mono.
Opo nee tai ti: ‘Ame ohandi ka shuna meumbo lange omo nda dile.’ Ndele ngeenge tai uya mo, otai li hange li li hamupulu, la kombwa, ndele la wapalekwa.

Opo nee tai i ndele tai ka konga eemhepo dikwao dii di i dule, ndele tadi i mo ndele tadi kala mo. Ndele okukala kwaxuuninwa kwomunhu ou, otaku ningi kwii ku dule kwinya kwotete. Hano epupi eli lii osho tali ningilwa.”
Ndele fimbo kwa li ta popi novanhu, tala, ina novamwaina ova li ofika pondje, nova hala ve mu popife.
Umwe ta ti kuye: “Tala, nyoko novamwanyoko ve li pondje, ndele va hala ve ku popife.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa nyamukula ou e shi mu lombwela, ta ti: “Meme olyelye novamwameme oolyelye?”
Ndele okwa ulika nokwooko kwaye kovalongwa vaye ndele ta ti: “Tala, meme, novamwameme ovo ava!
Osheshi keshe tuu ou ta wanifa ehalo laTate meulu, oye omumwameme omulumenhu nomumwameme omukainhu nameme.”
13: Ndelenee efiku olo Jesus okwa dja mo meumbo ndele ta ka kala omutumba pefuta.
Ndele ovanhu vahapu ova ongala kuye, onghee okwa ya mowato ndele ta kala omutumba, novanhu aveshe va li ofika komunghulo.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela dihapu domafaneko, ta ti: “Tala, omukuni okwa pita a ka kune.
Ndele mokukuna kwaye dimwe oda wila mondjila, needila ode uya notadi di shomona po.
Ndele dimwe oda wila pemanya, puhe nedu lihapu, ndele da mena diva, osheshi da li dihe nedu lihapu.
Ndelenee etango eshi la pita oda lemba, ndele eshi da li dihe na omidi oda kukuta.
Ndele dimwe oda wila meeshosholo, neeshosholo eshi dakula, ode di fininika.
Ndele dimwe oda wila medu liwa, ndele da dala, dimwe efele, dimwe omilongo hamano nadimwe omilongo nhatu.
Hano ou e nomatwi okuuda, na ude ko!”
Ndele ovalongwa vaye ove uya po ndele tava ti kuye: “Oshike to va lombwele odo domafaneko?”
Oye okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Nye omwa pewa okushiiva oiholekwa youhamba weulu, ndele venya inave i pewa.
Osheshi ou e na, oye ta pewa, ndele ta kala a wanenena, ndele ou ehe na, oye ta kufwa naashi e shi kwete.
Onghee hano handi va lombwele odo domafaneko, osheshi nande ove nomesho okutala, ihava mono ko, nomatwi okuuda, ihava udu ko, nongaashi kave udite ko.

Ndele omwaava omaxunganeko aJesaja taa ningi oshili, eshi ta ti:
‘Okuuda ohamu udu ko, nye kamu udite ko,
nokumona ohamu mono ko, nye itamu koneke sha.

Osheshi omutima woshiwana eshi owa kukuta,
nomatwi avo ve a fitika,
nomesho avo ve a fifikinifa,
vaha mone ko nomesho avo,
novaha ude ko nomatwi avo,
novaha koneke komitima davo,
vehe lidilulule, Ame ndihe va velule.’
Ndelenee omesho eni oku nelao, eshi e wete ko, nomatwi eni eshi haa udu ko.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Ovaxunganeki vahapu novayuki ova li va hala va halelela okumona ei hamu i mono, vo inave i mona, nokuuda odo hamu di udu, vo inave di uda.
“Pwilikineni hano odo domafaneko omukuni:
Ngeenge oku na ou ta udu eendjovo douhamba ye ke di udite ko, opo nee omunawii te uya ndele ta nyeka mo odo da kunwa momutima; odo tuu odo da kunwa mondjila.
Ndele odo da kunwa pemanya, oye tuu ou, ta udu eendjovo ndele te di tambula nehafo,
ndelenee ke na omidi muye mwene, ota diinine okafimbo kongaho, ndele ngeenge tape uya oudjuu netewatewo omolweendjovo, ota efa diva.
Ndele odo da kunwa meeshosholo, oye tuu ou ta udu eendjovo, ndelenee oshisho shounyuni neheka loupuna tali fininike eendjovo, ndele ta kala ehe noiimati.
Ndele odo da kunwa medu liwa, oye tuu ou ta udu eendjovo, e di udite ko ndele ta dala, umwe ta dala efele, umwe omilongo hamano naumwe omilongo nhatu.”
Ndele okwe va lombwela eendjovo dikwao domafaneko ta ti: “Ouhamba wokeulu owa fa omunhu, a kuna ombuto iwa mepya laye.
Ndelenee fimbo ovanhu va kofa, omutondi waye okwe uya, ndele ta kunu mo eu mokati koilya, ndele ta i.
Ndele oimeno eshi ya kula ndele tai dala, opo nee eu la holoka yo.
Opo nee ovamati vomwene ve uya ndele tava ti kuye: ‘Omwene, ino kuna mo hamba eembuto diwa mepya loye? Eu ola dja peni hano?’
Ndele okwa tya kuvo: ‘Omutondi okwe shi ninga.’ Ovamati ova tya kuye: ‘Owa hala tu ye tu ke li dude mo?’
Ndelenee oye okwa tya: ‘Ahowe, opo muha dude mo oilya pamwe nalo.
Efeni, aishe ivali i kale po i kule mumwe fiyo efiku leteyo; efiku leteyo ohandi lombwele ovatei: ongeleni manga eu, nye mu li mange oipandi, li xwikwe po, ndele oilya i tuvikileni momaanda ange.’ ”
Neendjovo domafaneko makwao okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Ouhamba wokeulu owa fa ombuto yoshinapi, omulumenhu e i kufa ndele te i kunu mepya laye.
Oyo okandji kanini ke dulike keembuto adishe, ndele ngeenge tai kulu, oyo i dule oimbodi aishe ndele tai ningi omuti, needila dokeulu otadi uya ndele tadi tungile mo oihadi yado moitai yao.”
Neendjovo dikwao domafaneko e va lombwela: “Ouhamba wokeulu wa fa onhafi, omukainhu e i kufa ndele te i pilulile moufila weelita omilongo nhee, fiyo aushe wa pya.”
Jesus okwa tonga adishe edi keengudu dovanhu momafaneko, Oye ina tonga kuvo dihe fi domafaneko,

opo eendjovo odo domuxunganeki di ninge doshili eshi ta ti:
“Ohandi popi momafaneko,
ndele handi holola eshi sha kala sha holekwa keshito lounyuni.”
Opo nee Ye okwa lekela ovanhu ndele ta i meumbo. Ovalongwa vaye ove uya kuye ndele tava ti: “Tu fatululila efaneko leu lomepya.”
Ndele Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ou ha kunu mo ombuto iwa, Oye Omona wOmunhu.
Ndele epya olo ounyuni, ombuto iwa oyo ovanhu vOuhamba, eu olo ovanhu vomunawii.
Nomuyelani ou e li kuna mo, oye Satana, eteyo olo exulilo lefimbo lounyuni, novatei ovo ovaengeli.
Hano ngaashi eu tali ongelwa notali xwikwa po momundilo, hano osho taku kala pexulilo lefimbo lounyuni.
Omona wOmunhu ota tumu ko ovaengeli vaye, ndele tava ka ongela mo mouhamba waye omashindo aeshe naava hava nyono ouyuki,
ndele tave va ekele mediko la hanya; omo hamu kala elilaano nomalikweshelo omayoo.
Opo nee ovayuki otava ka vilima ngaashi etango mouhamba waXe. Ou e nomatwi, na ude ko.
“Ouhamba wokeulu owa fa emona la holekwa mepya, omunhu e li mona, note li holeke, nomoku li hafela okwa ka landifa po oinima yaye aishe, ndele te lilandele epya olo.
Ndele vali, ouhamba wokeulu wa fa omushingifi, ta kongo okawe ka wapala,
ndele eshi a mona ko okawe kamwe kawa unene ke nondado ihapu, okwa ya ndele ta landifa po oinima yaye aishe, ndele te ke lilandele.
“Ndele vali, ouhamba wokeulu owa fa oshiyulifo sheeshi, sha endifilwa mefuta, ndele sha ongela eeshi doludi keshe.
Ndele eshi sha yada, ove shi shilila komunghulo, va kala omutumba, ndele tava tongola mo edi diwa, ndele ve di tula moikwatelwa, ndele edi dii ove di ekelashi.
Hano osho tashi ningwa pexulilo lefimbo lounyuni; ovaengeli otava i notava ka tongola ovanawii movayuki
ndele tave va ekele mediko la hanya; omo tamu kala elilaano nelikweshelo lomayoo.
“Omwa uda ko tuu adishe edi?” Ovo va tya kuye: “Heeno.”
Ndele opo nee Ye okwe va lombwela: “Onghee hano keshe omunongo womishangwa ou a ninga omulongwa wouhamba wokeulu okwa fa mwene weumbo, ta holola melimba laye oipe noikulu.”
Ndele opa ningwa, Jesus eshi a mana eendjovo odo domafaneko, okwa dja ko oko.
Ndele okwe uya koshilando shambulavo nokwe va longa moshinagoga yavo ndele vo va kumwa ndele tava ti: “Ounongo oo e u kwete noilonga yeenghono e i na, oyapeni?
Ou haye omona womuhongi womiti? Ina ke fi ta ifanwa Maria, novamwaina havoovo: Jakob naJosef naSimon naJudas?
Novamwaina ovakainhu aveshe havoovo ve li pufye apa? Ndele ye, aishe ei okwe i hanga peni?”
Ndele vo ve liyala omolwaye. Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Omuxunganeki ke na opo a dinwa, omoshilando tuu shambulavo nokeumbo lambulavo.”
Ndele omolwokuhaitavela kwavo ina ningila ko oilonga ihapu yeenghono.
14: Ndele opo nee pomafiku enya omupangeli woshitine shoshilongo Herodes okwa uda etumbalo laJesus.
Ndele okwa tya kovapiya vaye: “Oye Johannes Omushashi, a nyumuka koufi, onghee eenghono odo otadi longo muye.”
Osheshi Herodes okwa kwatifa Johannes ndele okwe mu manga, ndele okwe mu idilila modolongo omolwaHerodias, omukainhu waFilippus, ondenge yaye.
Osheshi Johannes okwe mu tile: “Oshidila, ito dulu okukala naye.”
Ndele Herodes okwa hala oku mu dipaa, ndele okwa tila ovanhu, osheshi ovo ve mu tala oye omuxunganeki.
Ndelenee oshivilo shefiku lokudalwa kwaHerodes eshi sha dana, omona okakadona kaHerodias oka tutula oudano moipafi yavo, ndele oo owa hafifa Herodes;
onghee okwe mu udanekela neano e mu pe keshe eshi a hala.
Ndele ye okwa tya ngaashi a hekelwa kuina: “Pe nge omutwe waJohannes Omushashi moshiyaxa eshi.”
Ndele Ohamba ya nyika oluhodi, ndele omolweano nomolwovaenda ya lombwela, ke u pewe.
Ndele oya tuma okutetifa ko omutwe waJohannes modolongo.
Ndele omutwe waye wa etwa moshiyaxa nokakadona ke u pewa, ndele ke u twalela ina.
Ndele ovalongwa vaye ve uya, ndele va kufa po oshimhu shaye, ndele tave shi pake; ovo va ya ndele tave shi hepaululile Jesus.
Ndele Jesus eshi e shi uda, okwa dja po ta ende mowato, okwa ya koima kwe likalela. Neengudu eshi de shi uda ode mu shikulila ko kolupadi, da dja koilando.
Ndele Jesus eshi e uya komunghulo, okwa mona ko ongudu inene yovanhu, ndele okwa li e va kenukila, ndele okwa velula ovanaudu vavo.
Ndele onguloshi eshi ye uya, ovalongwa vaye ve uya kuye ndele tava ti: “Poima apa omombuwa yongaho, netango la toka, lekela ovanhu, va ye komikunda ve ke lilandele oikulya.”
Ndelenee Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Ahowe, itava pumbwa okuya; va peni oikulya.”
Ndelenee vo tava ti kuye: “Fye otu nomingome nhano adike neeshi mbali.”
Ndele Ye ta ti: “Di eteni oku kwaame.”

Ndele okwa lombwela eengudu dovanhu di kale omutumba komwiidi, ndele okwa kufa ko omingome edi nhano neeshi mbali, okwa lyaamena keulu, e di nangeka noupuna, ndele te di pambula, okwa pa ovalongwa vaye omingome, novalongwa ve di tukulila ovanhu.
Ndele aveshe ova lya, ndele va kuta. Opo nee va toola oundjaumukile vomingome, oimbale omulongo naivali ya yada.
Ndele ava va lya, ovo va li ovalumenhu omayovi atano, ovakainhu nounona inava valwa.
Ndele Ye okwa ulumika ovalongwa vaye va ka londe mowato, ve ke mu tetekele komunghulo walanghele kwinya, fimbo Ye ta lekele eengudu dovanhu.
Ndele eshi a lekela eengudu dovanhu, okwa ka londa komhunda e likalela a ilikane. Hano eshi kwa ninga onguloshi okwa li ko Oye aeke.
Ndele owato ya hangika kokule nomunghulo, ndele ya monifwa oixuna komakufikufi, osheshi omhepo ye va dja komesho.
Ndelenee openangelo etine loufiku Jesus okwe uya kuvo ta ende kombada yomeva efuta.
Ndele ovalongwa eshi ve mu mona ta ende kombada yomeva efuta, ova haluka ndele tava ti: “Oshilulu osho!” ndele va kuwa pombada molwoumbada.
Ndelenee Jesus e va popifa diva, ta ti: “Kaleni nomwenyo muwa, Aame ou, inamu tila.”
Ndele Petrus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Omwene, ngeenge oove, lombwele nge ndi uye kwoove handi ende kombada yomeva.”
Ndele Oye ta ti: “Ila!” Ndele Petrus okwa dja mo mowato nokwa enda kombada yomeva e uye kuJesus.
Ndelenee eshi a mona omhepo inene, okwa tila, naashi a hovela okuningina mo, okwa ingida ta ti: “Omwene, xupife nge!”
Ndele Jesus okwa nana diva eke laye okwe mu kwata ndele ta ti kuye: “Omuneitavelo linini ove, oshike wa limbililwa?”
Hano vo eshi va ya mowato, omhepo ya lota,
ove linyongamena kuye ndele tava ti: “Oove shili Omona waKalunga.”
Ndele vo eshi va yauka ova fika komukunda waGenesaret.
Ndele ovalumenhu vokomukunda winya eshi ve mu koneka, ova tuma momukunda aushe, nova eta kuye ovanaudu aveshe.
Ndele ove mu indila va shiive okukuma nande okonyemba yoshikutu shaye; naaveshe ava ve i kuma, ova veluka.
15: Opo nee Ovafarisai novanongo vomishangwa ova dja kuJerusalem, ve uya kuJesus ndele tava ti:
“Ovalongwa voye oshike hava nyono eenghulunghedi dovakulunhu? Osheshi vo ihava kosho omake avo ngeenge tava li omungome.”
Ndelenee Ye okwe va nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Nanye yo oshike hano hamu nyono oshipango shaKalunga omolweenghulunghedi deni?
Osheshi Kalunga okwa tya: ‘Fimaneka xo nanyoko, na: ou ta tuku xe ile ina, oye e nokufya shili.’
Ndelenee nye ohamu ti: ‘Ou ta ti kuxe ile kuina: Oipalwifa ei nda li ndi noku ku palulifa ngeno, oyo nda yandja oshali kotembeli, oye ke nokufimaneka xe ile ina.’
Osho ngaha mwa hekula eendjovo daKalunga eenghono, omolweenghulunghedi deni.
Ovanaihelele nye! Jesaja okwe mu xunganeka da twa eshi a tya:

‘Ovanhu ava ohava fimaneke nge nomilungu,
ndele omitima davo odi li kokule naame;

ndelenee otava fimaneke nge ongaho
nokulonga ovanhu omalongo oipango yovanhu.’ ”
Ndele Ye okwa ifana eengudu dovanhu di ehene kuye, ndele ta ti kudo: “Udeni, nye mu didilike.
Hasheshi hashi i mokanya tashi nyateke omunhu, ndelenee osheshi hashi di mokanya tashi nyateke omunhu.”
Opo ovalongwa vaye ve uya kuye ndele tava ti: “Ou shi shii tuu kutya Ovafarisai eshi va uda eendjovo odo, ova ninga omwenyo mwii?”
Ndelenee Ye okwa nyamukula: “Okeshe tuu onhwika inai twikwa kuTate meulu, otai dudwa mo nomidi dayo.
Va efeni; ovo ovakwatiketi vovapofi; ngeenge ku nomupofi ta kwata omupofi mukwao komhango, aveshe vavali otava wile moshilambo.”
Ndele Petrus okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Tu fatululila efaneko eli.”
Ndelenee Jesus ota ti: “Nanye yo kamu neendunge natango.
Kamu shi wete, keshe eshi hashi i mokanya, otashi i medimo notashi piti mo vali.
Ndelenee keshe osho hashi di mokanya ohashi di komitima, ndele tashi nyateke omunhu.
Osheshi momutima omo hamu di omadiladilo mai, omadipao, omanyonohombo, oluhaelo, oulunga, omalundilafano, omasheko.
Oyo tuu ei tai nyateke omunhu; ndele okulya nomake inaa koshwa itaku nyateke omunhu.”
Ndele Jesus okwa dja ko oko ndele ta i komikunda daTirus naSidon.
Ndele tala, okwa dja omukainhu Omukaanan okoshikandjo tuu osho, a popya mokule ta ti: “Omwene, Omona waDavid, file nge onghenda! Omumwange okakadona ota hepekwa nai kondemoni.”
Ndelenee Ye ine mu nyamukula nande ondjovo. Ovalongwa vaye ove uya ndele tava indile tava ti: “Mu nyamukula, ote tu weelele monima yetu.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa nyamukula, ndele ta ti: “Ame inandi tuminwa kovanhu vamwe, okeedi odo da kana domeumbo laIsrael odo adike.”
Ndele ye okwe uya ndele ta tu eengolo koshipala shaye ndele ta ti: “Omwene, kwafe nge!”
Ndelenee Ye okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Inashi wapala okukufa omungome wounona noku u ekela oumbwena.”
Ndele omukainhu ta ti: “Heeno Omwene, noumbwena ohava li oundjaumukile ava hava u koshililo shoovene vavo.”
Opo nee Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Omukainhu ove, eitavelo loye olinene, ningilwa ngaashi wa hala.” Nopefimbo tuu olo omona okakadona oka veluka.
Jesus okwa dja oko ndele ta i kefuta laGalilea; okwa londa komhunda ndele ta kala ko omutumba.
Ndele eengudu dinene dovanhu de uya kuye, ndele da eta oingudu noilema novapofi novafitamatwi navakwao vahapu, ndele tadi va nangeke keemhadi daye; Oye okwe va velula.
Ndele ongudu yovanhu oya kumwa eshi va mona ovafitamatwi tava udu ko, noingudu ya veluka, noilema ya enda, novapofi ova twikuluka; ndele va hambelela Kalunga kaIsrael.

Ndele Jesus okwa ifana ovalongwa vaye ndele ta ti: “Ame ondi uditile ovanhu ava onghenda, osheshi vo ova menekela pwaame omafiku atatu, vo vehe na eshi tava li; ndele Ame inandi hala oku va lekela nondjala, vaha lolokele mondjila.”
Ndele ovalongwa tava ti kuye: “Omingome di fike apa ohatu di hange peni mombuwa omu, okukutifa ongudu i fike apa?”
Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Omu nomingome ingapi?” Vo ova tya: “Heyali neeshi dimwe.”
Oye okwa lombwela ovanhu va kale omutumba poshi.
Ndele okwa kufa omingome edi heyali neeshi, ndele ta pandula, ndele okwe di pambula ndele te di pe ovalongwa vaye, novalongwa ve di yandja kovanhu.
Ndele aveshe ova lya ndele va kuta. Ndele va toola po oundjaumukile ava va xupa po, oimbale iheyali i yadi.
Ndele ovo va lya, va li ovalumenhu omayovi ane, ovakainhu nounona inava valwa.
Ndele Ye okwa lekela ovanhu ndele okwa londa mowato, ndele okwa ya koshilongo shaMagadan.
16: Ndele Ovafarisai nOvasadukai ve uya kuye, va hala oku mu yeleka, ndele ve mu indila e va talife edidiliko lokeulu.
Ndelenee Ye okwe va nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Onguloshi ohamu ti: ‘Kaku nodula, osheshi eulu la tilyana,’
nongula ohamu ti: ‘nena otaku uya odula yoshikungulu, osheshi eulu ola tilyana noku na oilemo ilaula.’ Nye omu shii okudidilika oshipala sheulu, ndele omadidiliko omafimbo kamu shii oku a didilika.
Epupi eli olii nolovanyoni vohombo ovo va hala edidiliko, ndele vo itava pewa edidiliko limwe olo tuu eli laJona.” Ndele okwe va fiya po ndele ta i.
Ndele ovalongwa eshi va fika komunghulo walanghele kwinya, ova dimbwa okudja ko nomingome.
Ndele Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Taleni, livangekeni onhafi yOvafarisai noyOvasadukai.”
Ndele ova kundafana ndele tava ti: “Osheshi inatu dja ko nomingome.”
Ndelenee Jesus eshi e shi koneka, ta ti: “Nye omu neitavelo linini, oshike tamu kundafanene osho, eshi muhe na omingome?
Kamu udite ko natango? Nye inamu dimbulukwa omingome dinya nhano, novanhu omayovi atano, noimbale ingapi mwa toola oixupe,
nomingome dinya heyali okomayovi ane, noimbale ingapi mwa toola oixupe?
Ongahelipi inamu koneka kutya, Ame inandi popya omingome, ndelenee livangekeni onhafi yOvafarisai noyOvasadukai.”
Opo nee va uda ko kutya, ina popya elivangeko lonhafi yomingome, ndele omalongo Ovafarisai nOvasadukai.
Ndele Jesus eshi e uya komukunda waKesarea Filippi, okwa pula ovalongwa vaye ndele ta ti: “Ovanhu ohava ti ngahelipi, Omona wOmunhu Oye olyelye?”
Ndele ovo tava ti: “Vamwe otava ti: oJohannes Omushashi, vamwe oElia, vamwe oJeremia ile umwe womovaxunganeki.”
Oye ta ti kuvo: “Nye hano otamu ti ngahelipi, Aame lyelye?”
Ndele Simon Petrus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Oove Kristus, Omona waKalunga omunamwenyo.”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Oove omunelao, Simon yaJona, osheshi hambelela nohonde ye ku hololela osho, ndelenee oTate meulu.
Naame yo ohandi ku lombwele: oove Petrus, nokemanya tuu eli handi tungile ko eongalo lange, ndele itali ka dulika koivelo yoshovafi.
Ndele Ame ohandi ke ku pa eeshapi douhamba wokeulu, keshe osho to shi mange kombada yedu, otashi kala sha mangwa nomeulu, naasho to shi mangulula kombada yedu, nomeulu otashi ka kala sha mangululwa.”
Opo nee okwa kelela ovalongwa vaye vehe shi tonge nande okomunhu nokutya, Oye Kristus.

Hano okefiku tuu olo Jesus okwa hovela okuhololela ovalongwa vaye nokutya, e nokuya kuJerusalem noku ka hepekwa nomahepeko mahapu kovakulunhu nokovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovanongo vomishangwa nokudipawa nokunyumunwa efiku etitatu.
Petrus okwe mu kufa povanhu a hovela oku mu hanyena, ndele ta ti: Omwene, osho nashi ku kale kokule uha ningwe ngaha.
Ndelenee Ye okwa punguluka ndele ta ti kuPetrus: “Dja po pwaame, Satana. Oove omuhongauli wange, osheshi ove ito diladila osho shaKalunga, ndele osho oshovanhu.”
Ndele Jesus okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye: “Ngeenge ku na ou a hala okushikula nge, oye ne lixupule ye mwene, ne litwike omushiyakano waye, ye na shikule nge.
Osheshi ou a hala okuxupifa omwenyo waye, oye te u kanifa po, ndele ou ta kanifile nge omwenyo waye, oye ote u limonene.
Osheshi otashi kwafa shike omunhu, nande ne lilikolele ounyuni aushe, ndele ta kanifa omwenyo waye? Ile omunhu ota yandjele shike ekulilo lomwenyo waye?
Osheshi Omona wOmunhu te ke uya pamwe novaengeli vaye omoshinge shaxe, opo nee Oye ta futu keshe ou shi fike poilonga yaye.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: ope na vamwe mokati kaava ve li ofika apa, itava makele efyo, fiyo tava mono okuuya kwOmona wOmunhu mOuhamba waye.”
17: Ndele eshi pita omafiku ahamano, Jesus okwa kufa Petrus naJakob nondenge yaye Johannes, ndele okwe va twala komhunda ile unene, ve ke likalele.
Ndele okwa shituka moipafi yavo, noshipala shaye sha vema ngaashi etango, noikutu yaye oya yela ya fouyelele.
Ndele tala, Moses naElia ve va holokela, va kundafana naye.
Ndele Petrus okwa hovela okupopya ndele ta ti kuJesus: Omwene, apa opawa nokukala; ngeenge wa hala, ohandi ka dika apa omatwali atatu, limwe oloye, limwe olaMoses nalimwe olaElia.
Hano fimbo a li ta popi, tala, oshilemo shiyela oshe va tuvikila; ndele tala, ondaka ya dja moshilemo, ndele tai ti: “Ou Omona wange omuholike, onde mu hokwa; mu udeni.”
Ndele ovalongwa eshi ve shi uda, ova wilika oipala yavo poshi ndele ova tila unene.
Ndele Jesus okwe uya, e va kuma ndele ta ti: “Pendukeni, inamu tila.”
Eshi va petula omesho avo, inava mona vali nande omunhu, Jesus Oye aeke.
Ndele eshi va li tava londoloka komhunda, Jesus okwe va anda ko: “Emoniko eli inamu li hepaululila nande omunhu, Omona wOmunhu fimbo ina nyumuka koufi.”
Ndele ovalongwa vaye ove mu pula tava ti: “Ovanongo vomishangwa otava ti ngahelipi hano, Elia e nokuuya tete?”
Ndele Ye okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Heeno, Elia ote uya nota ka wapaleka vali aishe.
Ndelenee ohandi mu lombwele, Elia okwa ile mo, ndele vo inave mu koneka, nove mu ningila eshi va hala. Osho tuu Omona wOmunhu ota ka hepekwa kuvo.”
Opo nee ovalongwa va uda ko nee, nokutya, ote va lombwele Johannes Omushashi.
Ndele eshi va fika kongudu yovanhu, omulumenhu umwe okwe uya kuye, a twa eengolo koshipala shaye
ndele ta ti: “Omwene, fila onghenda, omumwange omumati e noshinhona ndele ta hepekwa unene, osheshi luhapu ota wile momundilo nomomeva.
Ndele ame onde mu eta kovalongwa voye, ndele vo va nyengwa oku mu velula.”
Jesus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Woo, ove epupi lihe neitavelo nola pilalala, ofiyo onaini ndi nokukala punye? Ndele ofiyo onaini ndi noku mu lididimikila? Mu eteni kwaame.”
Jesus okwe mu hanyena, opo ondemoni ya dja mo muye, nomumati okwa veluka efimbo tuu olo.
Eshi ve likalela, ovalongwa ve uya kuJesus tava ti: “Oshike hano twa nyengwa oku i ta mo?”

Ndele Ye ta ti kuvo: “Omolweitavelo leni linini, osheshi oshili handi mu lombwele, ngeno okwa li mu neitavelo li fike pombuto yoshinapi, ngeno otamu dulu okulombwela omhunda ei: ‘Lilundulula po apa, ove u lundulukile kwinya, ngeno tai lilundulula po, ndele kaku noshinima tashi mu nyenge.’
Ndelenee oludi eli ihali tewa mo koshinima shimwe, okeilikano nokelidiliko alike.”
Ndele eshi va li tava endaenda pamwe muGalilea, Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Omona wOmunhu ota ka yandjwa momake ovanhu,
ndele vo otave mu dipaa, ndele efiku etitatu ota nyumuka. Ndele vo va nyika unene oluhodi.”
Ndele eshi va fika kuKapernaum, ovashivi veesekeli dotembeli ove uya kuPetrus tava ti: “Omuhongi weni iha futu oimaliwa yotembeli?”

Oye ta ti: “Oha futu.” Ndele ye eshi a ya meumbo, Jesus okwa tetekela oku mu pula ta ti: “Oto ti ngahelipi, Simon? Eehamba dokombada yedu otadi pula kulyelye ofuto yokeengaba noifuta? Okovana ile okovanailongo?”
Ndele ye eshi a tya: “Okovanailongo”, Jesus ta ti kuye: “Hano ovana ihava futu sha.

Ndelenee opo tuhe va handukife, inda hano komunghulo wefuta ove u ekele mo ondjolo. Kufa oshi ei to yulu tete, ndele ngeenge wa makula okanya kayo, oto mono mo osekeli yoshisiliveli. Shi kufa mo u shi va pe omolwetu naave.”
18: Mefimbo tuu linya ovalongwa ove uya kuJesus tava ti: “Olyelye hano omunene e dule vakwao mouhamba wokeulu?”
Oye okwa ifana okaana, ndele okwe ka kaleka ofika mokati kavo
ndele ta ti: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: ngeenge itamu lidilulula ndele tamu ningi ngaashi ounona, kamu na apa tamu ka ya mouhamba wokeulu.
Onghee hano, ou te lininipike ngaashi okaana aka, oye omunene e dule vakwao mouhamba wokeulu.
Naau ta tambula okaana ka tya ngaha medina lange, Aame ta tambula.
“Ndele ou ta hongaula kamwe komwaava vanini, tava itavele nge, she mu wapalela ngeno a mangelwe mofingo yaye emanya loshini, ndele ta ninginifwa moule mefuta.
“Woo ounyuni omolwomahongaulo! Osheshi omahongaulo e nokuuya; ndelenee woo omunhu ou ta eta ehongaulo!

Ndele eke loye ile omhadi yoye, ngeenge tai ku hongaula, i teta ko ove u i ekeleshi; okuya momwenyo ove oshingudu ile oshilema okwe ku wapalela ku dule okukala nomake avali neemhadi mbali, ove to ekelwashi momundilo waalushe.
Neisho loye ngeenge tali ku hongaula, li kolola mo, ove u li ekeleshi; okuya momwenyo u neisho limwe alike okwe ku wapalela ku dule okukala nomesho avali, ndele to ka ekelwa momundilo woheli.
“Litaleni, muha dine nande okamwe komwaava vanini; osheshi Ame ohandi mu lombwele, ovaengeli vavo vomeulu ohava tale alushe oshipala shaTate meulu.
Osheshi Omona wOmunhu okwe uya okuxupifa ou a kana.
“Otamu ti ngahelipi? Ngeenge ku nomunhu e needi efele limwe, ndele imwe yomudo tai kana, ita fii po ngeno keemhunda odo omilongo omugoi nomugoi ndele ta ka konga inya ya kana?
Ndele ngeenge te i mono, oshili handi mu lombwele: ote i hafele nokuhafa ku dule okuhafela omilongo omugoi nomugoi, odo inadi kana.
Osho tuu kashi fi ehalo laXo yeni meulu, pa kane nande okamwe komwaava vanini.
“Ndele omumwanyoko ngeenge ta nyono kwoove, inda u ke mu pukulule mu li po amuke vavali; ndele ngeenge te ku udu, opo nee ove wa likola omumwanyoko.
Ndele ngeenge ita udu ko, ka ifane ko umwe ile vavali, eendjovo adishe opo di tokolwe komakanya eendobwedi mbali ile nhatu.
Ndele ngeenge ite va udu, shi lombwela eongalo. Ndele ngeenge ita udu ko keongalo, opo nee u kale we mu tala ngaashi omupaani nongaashi omufutifi.
“Oshili handi mu lombwele: Eshi tamu shi mange kombada yedu, otashi kala sha mangwa nomeulu, naashi tamu shi mangulula kombada yedu, otashi kala sha mangululwa nomeulu.
“Oshili handi mu lombwele vali: Ngeenge vavali vomunye kombada yedu tava udafana oshinima tave shi indile, otave shi pewa kuTate meulu.
Osheshi oku ku na vavali ile vatatu va ongala medina lange, Ame ondi li mokati kavo.”
Opo nee Petrus okwa ya kuye ndele ta ti: “Omwene, olungapi ndi nokudimina po omumwatate ta nyono kwaame: luheyali ola wana?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Ame ihandi ku lombwele luheyali, ndelenee lwomilongo heyali naheyali.
“Onghee hano Ouhamba wokeulu wa fa ohamba ya hala okuvalula oikolo yovapiya vayo.
Ndele eshi ya hovela okuvalula, oya etelwa mo umwe e noikolo nayo, yoitalenti omayovi omulongo.
Ndele eshi a li hamakasha, ehe na eshi ta futu, omwene waye okwa yandja elombwelo, a landwe po pamwe nomwalikadi waye novana nakeshe eshi e shi kwete, oikolo yaye i futwe.
Opo nee omupiya ou okwe linyongamena poshi, e mu ilikana ndele ta ti: ‘Tale nge onheni, ndele handi ku futile aishe.’
Ndele Omwene okwa fila omupiya ou onghenda, okwe mu efa, ndele te mu dimine po oikolo.
“Ndelenee omupiya ou eshi a ya pondje, okwe litwa omupiya mukwao, e mu lila oikolo yeedenari efele limwe; okwe mu kwata, e mu ponda ndele ta ti: ‘Futa oikolo yange.’
Opo nee omupiya ou mukwao okwa twa eengolo, e mu ilikana ndele ta ti: ‘Tale nge onheni, ohandi ku futile aishe.’
Ndelenee oye ina hala, okwa ya ndele te mu idililifa modolongo, fiyo ta futu oikolo yaye.
Ndele ovapiya vakwao eshi va mona eshi sha ningwa po, ova nyika oluhodi shili, ndele va ka hepaululila omwene wavo oinima ei aishe ya ningwa ko.
Opo nee omwene waye okwe mu ifana kuye ndele ta ti kuye: ‘Omupiya ove mwii, oikolo yoye aishe onde i ku kufila po, eshi wa ilikana nge;
naave yo ngeno wa li u nokufila onghenda omupiya mukweni, ngaashi ame nde ku fila onghenda.’
Ndele omwene waye mehandu laye okwe mu yandja kovahepeki fiyo ta futu oinima aishe e i mu lila oikolo.
Osho yo Tate meulu te mu ningile, ngeenge itamu dimine po okomitima deni keshe tuu omumwaina.”
19: Ndelenee Jesus eshi a mana okupopya eendjovo odo, okwa dja ko kuGalilea ta ende langhele kwinya yaJordan, ndele okwa ya komikunda daJudea.
Ndele eengudu dinene de mu shikula, nokwe va velulila ko.
Opo Ovafarisai ove uya kuye oku mu yeleka ndele tava ti: “Osha wapala tuu omulumenhu ta henge po omukainhu waye omolwondjovo keshe?”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Inamu lesha hamba, Omushiti okwe va shita pehovelo omulumenhu nomukainhu,
ndele ta ti: onghee hano omulumenhu e nokufiya po xe naina nokulimangeleka komukainhu waye, ndele ava vavali otava ningi omunhu umwe?
Osho hano kave fi vali vavali, ndelenee ombelela imwe. Hano osho Kalunga e shi tula kumwe, inashi kufwa kumwe komunhu.”
Ovo tava ti kuye: “Moses okwa yandjela shike oufemba wokuyandja ombapila yehengano, noku mu henga?”
Oye ta ti kuvo: “Moses okwe mu itavelela oukukutu womitima deni, okuhenga ovakainhu veni, ndele kasha li ngaha pehovelo.
Ndelenee Ame ohandi mu lombwele: Ou ta henge po omukainhu waye omolwoshinima shimwe shihe fi oluhaelo, ndele ta hombola umwe, ye ta haele; naau ta hombola po omuhengwa, ye ota haele.”
Ovalongwa tava ti kuye: “Ngeenge okukala kwomulumenhu nomukainhu waye okwa tya ngaha, okuhombola inaku wapala.”
Ndelenee ye okwa tya kuvo: “Haaveshe ve udite eendjovo odo, ndelenee ovo tuu aveke ve shi pewa.

Osheshi ope na ovalutulwa ava ve shi dalwa, nghee va dja medimo laina, ndele ope na vali ovalutulwa, ava ve shi ningwa kovanhu, ndele ope na vali ovalutulwa, ve shi lininga voovene omolwOuhamba wokeulu. Ou ta dulu oku shi tambula, ne shi tambule.”
Opo nee ounona va etwa kuye, e va tenheke omake aye, ye a ilikane; ndele ovalongwa ova hanyena ava ve va eta.
Ndele Jesus ta ti: “Efeni ounona, inamu va kelela okuuya kwaame, osheshi Ouhamba wokeulu owaava va li ngaashi ovo.”
Opo okwe va tenheka omake aye, ndele okwa dja po opo.
Ndele tala, omulumenhu umwe okwe uya ndele ta ti kuye: “Omuhongi muwa, nandi longe ouwa washike, ndi mone omwenyo waalushe?”
Oye ta ti kuye: “Oshike to ula nge ndimuwa? Umwe aeke muwa. Ndele ngeenge wa hala okuya momwenyo, wanifa oipango.”
Oye ta ti kuye: “Oilipipo?” Jesus ta ti: “Oyo ei: ‘Ino dipaa,’ ‘Ino nyona ohombo,’ ‘Ino vaka’, ‘Ino lundila.’
‘Fimaneka xo nanyoko’, ‘Hola mukweni ngaashi ove u lihole mwene.’ ”
Omunyasha ta ti kuye: “Aishe ei onde i diinina; oshike nda pumbwa vali?”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Ngeenge wa hala okuwana wa pwa, inda u ka landife po aishe ei u i kwete, u i yandje keehepele, ndele to kala u nemona meulu, ndele ila, u shikule nge.”
Ndele omunyasha eshi a uda ondjovo ei, okwa dja po a nyika oluhodi, osheshi ye okwa li e noinima ihapu.
Jesus ta ti kovalongwa vaye, Oshili handi mu lombwele: “Oshipuna oshi noudjuu okuya mouhamba wokeulu.
Ndele vali handi mu lombwele: okupitila kwongamelo meyulu longwiya hixwe, ku dule okuya kwoshipuna mouhamba wokeulu.”
Ovalongwa eshi ve di uda, ova haluka neenghono ndele tava ti: “Olyelye ta dulu okuxupifwa?”
Ndele Jesus okwe va tala ndele ta ti kuvo: “Heeno, ovanhu ohava nyengwa, ndele Kalunga iha nyengwa kusha.”
Opo nee Petrus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Tala, fye otwa fiya ko oinima aishe, notwe ku shikula; ohatu mono shike?”

Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: medalululo olo Omona wOmunhu eshi ta ka kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo loshinge shaye, nanye yo ava mwa shikula nge, tamu ka kala omutumba komalukalwa omulongo naavali, ndele tamu ka tokola omapata aIsrael omulongo naavali.

Ndele keshe ou a fiya ko, omolwedina lange, omaumbo ile ovamwaxe ovalumenhu ile ovamwaina ovakainhu ile xe ile ina ile ovana ile omapya, oye te ke i mona ko ihapu i dule ei, nomwenyo waalushe ote u fyuulula.
Ndele votete vahapu otava ningi vaxuuninwa novahauxuuninwa vahapu otava ningi votete.
20: “Osheshi ouhamba wokeulu wa fa omushamane, a meneka a ka shivile epya laye lomiviinyu ovalongi.
Ndele eshi va udafana novalongi odenari imwe efiku limwe, okwe va tuma kepya laye lomiviinyu.
Ndele ye okwa pita mo pokafimbo okatitatu, nokwa hanga ko vamwe ve li ofika ashike pomalandelo;
nokwa tya kuvo: ‘Nanye yo indeni kepya lange lomiviinyu, ndele handi mu pe osho, she mu yeleka.’
Ndele vo ova ya ko. Oye okwa pita mo vali potundi onhihamano nopotundi onhimugoi ndele ta ningi ngaashi a ningile.
Ndele eshi a pita mo potundi onhimulongo naimwe, okwa hanga po vali vamwe ve li ofika, ndele ta ti kuvo: ‘Oshike tamu kala ofika apa omutenya aushe?’
Ovo tava ti kuye: ‘Osheshi kaku na ou e tu shiva.’ Oye ta ti kuvo: ‘Nanye yo indeni kepya lange lomiviinyu, ndele tamu mono eshi sha yuka.’
“Ndele onguloshi eshi ye uya, mwene wepya lomiviinyu okwa lombwela elenga laye: ‘Ifana ovalongi ove u va fute ondjabi yavo, hovela kwaava vaxuuninwa fiyo okwaava votete.’
Ndele ava kwa li ve uya potundi onhimulongo naimwe eshi ve uya, ova pewa keshe tuu umwe odenari imwe.
Hano venya votete eshi ve uya, ova li ve shii tava pewa shihapu ve dule venya; ndele keshe tuu womuvo a pewa odenari imwe.
Ndele eshi ve i pewa, ova ngongotela omushamane
ndele tava ti: ‘Ava vaxuuninwa ova longa otundi imwe aike, ndele ove we va yeleka nafye ava twa humbata oudjuu womutenya noupyu.’
Ndelenee ye okwa nyamukula umwe waava ndele ta ti: ‘Kaume, inandi ku kotokela; fye naave, hamba, inatu udafana odenari imwe?
Kufa po ei yoye, ove u ye. Ndele ame onda hala okupa ou omuxuuninwa i fike pwaai yoye.
Hamba nda kelelwa okulongifa oinima yange ngaashi ame mwene nda hala. Ile ou na efupa shaashi ame ndi na onghenda?’
Hano osho, ovaxuuninwa otava ningi votete, novotete ovaxuuninwa, osheshi ovaifanwa ovahapu, ndele ovahoololwa ovanini.”
Ndele Jesus eshi a ka londa a ya kuJerusalem, okwa kufa ovalongwa omulongo navavali va kale ve likalela, nomondjila okwa tya kuvo:
“Tala, fye ohatu yeni kuJerusalem, nOmona wOmunhu ota yandjwa momake ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa, ndele vo otave mu pe etimba lokufya
ndele tave mu yandje kovapaani okushekwa nokudengwa nokuvalelwa, ndelenee mefiku etitatu ota nyumuka.”
Opo nee ina yovana vaSebedeus okwe uya kuye novana, ndele te mu twile eengolo a hala oku mu indila sha.
Ndele ye okwa tya komwalikadi: “Owa hala shike?” Ou ta ti kuye: “Itavela ovana vange ava vavali va ka kale omutumba, umwe kolulyo loye nomukwao okolumosho loye, mOuhamba woye.”
Ndelenee Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Onye kamu shi shii eshi mwa hala. Otamu dulu tuu okunwa eholo olo handi ke li nwa?” Ovo va tya kuye: “Ohatu shi dulu.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Eholo lange otamu ke li nwa, ndele okukala omutumba kolulyo lange nokolumosho lange haame handi ku pangele, ndele otaku pewa ovo, ve ku longelwa kuTate.”
Ndele venya omulongo eshi ve di uda, ova umanena ovamwaina ava vavali.
Ndelenee Jesus okwe va ifana kuye ndele ta ti: “Onye omu shi shii, ovapangeli voiwana ohave i pangele, novanaenghono ohava longifa eenghono davo kuyo.
Ndelenee hasho nashi kale mokati keni, ndelenee ou womunye a hala a ninge munene mokati keni, ye na kale omuyakuli weni,
naau womokati keni a hala a kale wokomesho, ye na kale omupiya waaveshe;
ongaashi nOmona wOmunhu ine uya okuyakulwa, ndele okuyakula nokuyandja omwenyo waye u ninge oikulila yavahapu.”
Ndele eshi va dja mo muJeriko ongudu inene ye mu shikula.
Ndele tala, ovapofi vavali va kala omutumba momunghulo wondjila; naashi va uda Jesus ta ende po, ova popya mokule ndele tava ti: “Omwene, Omona waDavid, tu fila onghenda!”
Ndele ovanhu ove va hanyena va mwene, ndele vo ova diinina okwiingida mokule, tava ti: “Omwene, omona waDavid, tu fila onghenda!”
Opo Jesus okwa kanghama, e va ifana kuye, ndele ta ti: “Omwa hala ndi mu ningile shike?”
Ovo va tya kuye: “Omwene, omesho etu a pashulwe.”
Ndele Jesus okwe va udila olukeno, okwa kuma omesho avo, nopo tuu opo va pashuka ndele tave mu shikula.
21: Opo nee eshi va ehena kuJerusalem nova fika kuBetfage, kOmhunda yEemono, Jesus okwa tuma ko ovalongwa vaye vavali
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Indeni komukunda winya u li komesho yeni ndele tamu ka hanga ko divadiva okambulu okakadi ka pandekwa, nokambulwena kako; va pandekululeni nye mu va ete kwaame.
Ndele ngeenge oku na ou te mu lombwele sha, tyeni: ‘Omwene e va pumbwa,’ ndele ye te va tumu diva.”
Ndele eshi osha ningwa, opo eendjovo odo da popiwa komuxunganeki di wanifwe, ou a tya:

“Lombweleni omona okakadona kaSion:
‘Tala, ohamba yoye te uya kwoove
omunambili nokwa londa okambulu,
okambulwena kokambulu haka longifwa.’ ”
Ndele opo nee ovalongwa ova ya, ndele va ninga ngaashi Jesus e va lombwela,
ndele va eta okambulu okakadi nokambulwena, ndele tava yale oikutu yavo kuvo, Oye okwa kala omutumba kombada yavo.
Ndele vahapu vomongudu va yala oikutu yavo mondjila, navakwao ova teta oitai komiti, ndele ve i ekela mondjila.
Ndele eengudu dovanhu, ovo va kwatela komesho naavo ve mu shikula, ova ingida mokule tava ti: “Hosianna Omona waDavid! Na nangekwe noupuna, ou te uya medina lOmwene. Hosianna omokombada!”
Ndele eshi e uya muJerusalem, oshilando ashishe sha tukuluka ndele tava ti: “Olyelye ou?”
Ndele eengudu dovanhu tadi ti: “Oye omuxunganeki ou, Jesus womuNasaret shaGalilea.”
Ndele Jesus okwa ya motembeli yaKalunga; ndele okwa ta mo aveshe va li mo tava lande naava tava landifile mo, ndele okwa undulila poshi oitaafula yovakumaani voimaliwa noipundi yovalandifi veenghuti.
Ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Okwa shangwa: ‘Ongulu yange i nokwiifanwa ongulu yeilikano’, ndele nye omwe i ninga oshikololo shovanyeki.”
Ndele ovapofi noingudu ove uya kuye motembeli, Oye okwe va velula.
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa eshi va mona oikumwifa ye e i longa, nounona, nhumbi va ingida motembeli va tya: “Hosianna, Omona waDavid”, ova umana
ndele ova tya kuye: “Ove, udite ko tuu ava osho tava ti?” Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Heeno, onye inamu lesha hamba nande lumwe: ‘Omomakanya ounona nouhanana we lilongela ehambelelo?’ ”
Ndele okwe va fiya po, okwa dja mo moshilando ndele okwa ya kuBetania, ndele okwa kala ko oufiku.
Ndele ongula inene eshi a meneka ta shuna koshilando, okwa fya ondjala.
Ndele a mona omukwiyu pondjila nokwa ya kuwo, ndele ina mona mo sha, omafo aeke; ndele ta ti kuwo: “Ku ima vali oiimati fiyo alushe.” Omukwiyu owa fya diva.
Ndele ovalongwa vaye eshi ve shi mona, ova kumwa ndele tava ti: “Omukwiyu owa fya ngahelipi divadiva ngaha!”

Ndelenee Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: ngeno mu neitavelo, nye itamu limbililwa, ngeno otamu dulu hasheshi ashike, omukwiyu eshi wa ningwa, ndele ngeno otamu lombwele omhunda ei: ‘litumba po, ove u liundulile mefuta’, ngeno otashi ningwa.
Nakeshe eshi tamu shi indile meilikano nokwiitavela, otamu shi pewa.”
Opo nee eshi a ya motembeli, ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu voshiwana ve uya kuye fimbo ta longo ovanhu, ndele tava ti: “Okeenghono dilipipo ho longo ei? Olyelye e ku pa epangelo eli?”
Ndele Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Naame yo ohandi mu pula ondjovo imwe; ngeenge tamu i lombwele nge, opo nee naame yo handi mu lombwele okepangelo lilipi handi longo ei.
Eshasho laJohannes ola dile peni? Omeulu ile omovanhu?” Ovo va kundafana ndele tava ti: “Ngeenge twa ti: ‘omeulu’, opo nee Oye ta ti: oshike hano inamu mu itavela?
Ndele ngeenge hatu ti: ‘omovanhu’, opo otu nokutila ovanhu, osheshi aveshe va tala Johannes oye omuxunganeki.”
Ovo va nyamukula Jesus ndele tava ti: “Katu shi shii.” Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Hano naame yo itandi mu lombwele okepangelo lilipi handi longo ngaha.
“Ndelenee otamu ti ngahelipi? Okwa li ku nomunhu e novana ovamati vavali; okwa ya komutete ndele ta ti: ‘Omumwange, inda u ka longe nena mepya lange lomiviinyu.’
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: ‘Inandi hala.’ Ndele lwanima okwe ke lidilulula ndele ta i ko.
Okwa ya kumukwao ndele okwe mu lombwela yo eendjovo tuu odo. Oye okwa nyamukula: ‘Heeno, omwene,’ ndele ina ya ko.
Elipipo pwaava vavali a wanifa ehalo laxe?” Ovo va tya: “Oye winya wotete.” Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: ovafendelifi neembwada otave mu tetekele okuya mouhamba waKalunga.
Osheshi Johannes okwe uya kunye nondjila youyuki, nye inamu mu itavela; ndele ovafutifi neembwada ovo ve mu itavela; ndele nande omwe shi mona, nokomesho inamu lidilulula ngeno mu mu itavele.

“Pwilikineni eendjovo domafaneko makwao. Okwa li ku nomushamane, a twika epya lomiviinyu, ndele te li umbile ongubu, ndele ta longele mo oshikolelo sheeviinyu, okwa tungila mo oshungo, nokwa nangeka mo ovalongi vepya, ndele okwa ya koilongo yokokule.
Ndele eeviinyu eshi da hola, okwa tuma ko ovapiya vaye kovalongi vepya va ka tambule oiimati ei e nokupewa.
Ndele ovalongi vepya ova kwata ovapiya vaye, umwe ove mu denga, nomukwao ove mu dipaa, nomutitatu ove mu kupula nomamanya.
Ndele okwa tumununa ko ovapiya vamwe ve dule venya votete mouhapu; ndele ovo ve va ninga ngaashi venya votete.
Ndele hauxuuninwa okwe va tumina omona waye, ta ti: ‘Omona wange otave mu tila.’
Ndelenee ovalongi vepya eshi va mona omona, ova kundafana ndele tava ti: ‘Ou omufyuululi, tu yeni, tu ke mu dipaeni fye tu mone efyuululo laye.’
Ndele vo ove mu kwata ndele tave mu ekeleshi mo mepya ndele tave mu dipaa.
Mwene wepya ngeenge ta aluka, ota ningi ngahelipi ovalongi ava vepya?”
Ovo va tya kuye: “Ovakolokoshi ovo ote va nyonauna po nai nepya lomiviinyu ote li pe ovalongi vamwe, ovo tave mu pe oiimati opefimbo tuu layo.”
Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Inamu lesha hamba nande lumwe momishangwa: ‘Emanya olo ovatungi ve li ekelashi, olo la ninga omutwe wokolonela: Eshi osha dja mOmwene, noshikumwifa momesho etu.’
Onghee handi mu lombwele: Ouhamba waKalunga otau mu kufwa ndele tau pewa ovanhu, hava imike oiimati yao.
Ndele keshe tuu ou ta pundukile kemanya olo, oye ta teka, naau ta wilwa kemanya olo, oye ta nyanyaulwa.”
Opo nee ovapristeli ovakulunhu nOvafarisai eshi va uda omafaneko aa aye, ova koneka kutya, ovo ta popi.
Ndele va hala ve mu kwate, ndele ova tila ovanhu, osheshi ovo ve mu tala Oye omuxunganeki.
22: Ndele Jesus okwa hovela vali oku va lombwela omafaneko, ndele ta ti:
“Ouhamba wokeulu u nokufanekwa nohamba ya ningila omona ehombolo.
Ndele oya tuma ovamati vayo va ka tale ko ovashivwa ve uye koshivilo, ndele vo inava hala okuuya.
Ndele oya tumununa ko ovamati vamwe, tai ti: ‘Lombweleni ovashivwa: Tala, oshivilo shange osha pwa okutelekwa, eehove noimuna ya ondolwa oya tomwa, ashishe sha longekidwa. Ileni kehombolo.’
Ndelenee vo va li inave shi yavala, ndele tava i, umwe okwa ya kepya laye, nomukwao a ka shingifa;
navakwao ova kwata ovamati vayo, ove va hepeka nove va dipaa.
Ndele ohamba oya handuka, ndele tai tumu ko ovakwaita vayo, ndele tava hanauna po ovadipai ovo, ndele tava xwike po oilando yavo.
Oya tya kovamati: ‘Oshivilo shehombolo osha pwa okulongekidwa, ndele ovashivwa ovo inave shi wapalela.
Indeni hano komashakeneno eendjila, aveshe ovo tamu mono, va shivileni kehombolo.’
Ndele ovamati ova ya keendjila, ndele va eta mo aveshe ovo va mona ko, vai novawa; olupale loshivilo shehombolo ola yada ovaenda.
“Ndele opo nee ohamba eshi ye uya okutala ovaenda, oya mona mo omunhu umwe ehe na oshikutu shehombolo.
Ndele oya tya kuye: ‘Kaume, owe uya mo ngahelipi omu, uhe na oshikutu shehombolo?’ Oye okwa mwena.
Opo nee ohamba tai ti kovamati vaye: ‘Mu mangeni komaoko nokomaulu, nye mu mu ekele momilaulu dopondjelela. Omo hamu kala elilaano nelikweshelo lomayoo.’
Osheshi vahapu ova ifanwa, ndele vanini ova hoololwa.”
Opo nee Ovafarisai va ya ndele va kundafana nhumbi tave mu yulu meendjovo.

Ndele ova tuma kuye ovalongwa vavo pamwe nOvakwaherodes oku mu lombwela: “Omuhongi, otu shi shii, Oove omunashili, nondjila yaKalunga oto i longo shili, ndele ku na nande nomunhu, osheshi Ove iho tale olupe lomunhu.
Hano tu lombwela: oto ti ngahelipi? Osha wapala tuu okupa omukesari efendelo ile inashi wapala?”
Ndelenee Jesus okwa koneka oihelele yavo ndele ta ti: “Ovanaihelele nye, oshike tamu shindi nge?
Ulikilei nge oshimaliwa shefendelo.” Ovo ove mu pa odenari.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Efano eli neshangelo eli olalyelye?”
Ovo va nyamukula: “Olomukesari.” Opo nee Ye ta ti kuvo: “Hano osho shomukesari, shi peni omukesari, naasho shaKalunga, shi peni Kalunga.”
Ndele vo eshi ve shi uda, ova kumwa, ove mu fiya po, ndele tava i.
Efiku olo vamwe vomOvasadukai ve uya kuye, ovo hava ti kaku nenyumuko, nove mu pula
ndele tava ti: “Omuhongi, Moses okwa tile: ‘Ngeenge ku na ou ta fi ehe na oludalo, omumwaina na hombole haukwe waye, oye na dalele omumwaina oludalo.’
Pufye apa opa li ovanhu novamwaina vaheyali. Omukulunhu okwa hombola omukainhu waye ndele ta fi; naashi kwa li ehe na oludalo, okwa fiila omumwaina omukainhu waye.
Osho tuu omutivali nomutitatu, nafiyo tuu aveshe vaheyali.
Ndele hauxuuninwa omukainhu okwa fya.
Hano menyumuko ota ningi walyelye mwaava vaheyali? Osheshi vo aveshe va li ve mu kwete.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Nye omwa puka, osheshi inamu shiiva omishangwa neenghono daKalunga.
Osheshi menyumuko ihava hombola ngaashi ihava hombolwa; ndelenee, otava ka kala ngaashi ovaengeli vaKalunga meulu.
Ndele mokupopya enyumuko lovafi, hamba, inamu lesha odo mwe di lombwelwa kuKalunga eshi ta ti:
‘Aame Kalunga kaAbraham naKalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob?’ Kalunga Oye ke fi Kalunga koonakufya,
Opo nee ovanhu eshi ve di uda, ova kuminwa elongo laye.”
Ndele Ovafarisai eshi va uda, Oye a tomha Ovasadukai, ova ongala;
naumwe womuvo omunongomhango, okwe mu yeleka ndele te mu pula:
“Omuhongi, oshipango shinene shomomhango oshilipipo?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuye: “ ‘Hola Omwene Kalunga koye nomutima woye aushe nomwenyo woye aushe neendunge doye adishe.’
Oshipango shinene noshotete osho tuu eshi.
Noshitivali shi fike pusho, osheshi, ‘Hola mukweni ngaashi ove u lihole mwene.’
Moipango ei ivali omhango aishe novaxunganeki ova kwatelelwa mo.”
Ndele Ovafarisai eshi va hangika va ongala, Jesus okwe va pula:
“Kristus, otamu mu tile ngahelipi? Oye omona walyelye?” Vo ova tya kuye: “OwaDavid.”
Oye okwa tya kuvo: “David okwe mu ifana hano ngahelipi momhepo Omwene, eshi ta ti:

‘Omwene okwa lombwela Omwene wange:
Kala omutumba kolulyo lange,
fiyo handi tula ovatondi voye koshi yeemhadi doye.’
Hano David eshi e mu ifana Omwene, hano oye omona waye ngahelipi?”
Ndele kakwa li ou a dula oku mu nyamukula nande ondjovo imwe; ndele kakwa li ou a shiiva oku mu pula nande osha, okefiku tuu olo.
23: Opo nee Jesus okwa lombwela eengudu dovanhu novalongwa vaye
ndele ta ti: “Ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai ove li omutumba kolukalwa laMoses.
Onghee hano, keshe osho tave shi mu lombwele, shi ningeni nye mu shi diinine; ndele inamu hopaenena oilonga yavo, osheshi ovo tava lombwele, ndele itava longo sha.
Ovo ohava mange omitengi didjuu nokuhumbata ndele tave di twike komapepe ovanhu, ndele voovene inava hala oku di kuma nande nomunwe.
Noilonga yavo aishe ohave i longo, va monike kovanhu. Oipeko yavo yomatumbulo omOmbiibeli ohave i taula inene, neenyemba doikutu yavo odiledile,
nove hole peenhele dokomesho moivilo nomomalukalwa okombada omeeshinagoga,
nokukundwa poilandelo nokwiifanwa kovanhu: ‘Rabbi, rabbi.’
Ndele onye inamu itavela nande mu ifanwe Rabbi, osheshi omuhongi weni Oumwe, ndele onye amushe ovamwainafana.
Ndele inamu ifana nande olyelye wokombada yedu xo, osheshi nye omu na Xo umwe aeke, ou womeulu.
Ndele inamu itavela mu ifanwe omupukululi, osheshi omupukululi weni umwe aeke, Oye Kristus.
Ndele omunene womokati keni na kale omuyakuli weni.
Ndele ou te linenepeke, oye ta ninipikwa, naau te lininipike, ye ota nenepekwa.”
“Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, eshi tamu idilile po ovanhu oshivelo shOuhamba wokeulu. Osheshi onye vene itamu i mo, ndele tamu kelele ovo va hala okuya mo.
Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, eshi hamu li omaumbo ovafiyekadi, ndele hamu indile omaindilo male mu monike ashike! Onye hano tamu ka mona etokolo lidjuu unene.
“Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, eshi hamu taulula efuta nedu mu likole omulongwa umwe; ndele ngeenge sha ningwa, otamu mu ningi omona woheli, e mu dule luvali.
“Woo nye, ovakwatiketi vovapofi, onye hamu ti: ‘Ngeenge ku na ou ta ane kotembeli, eano laye olongaho, ndele ou ta ane koshingoldo shotembeli, oye e noku li diinina.’
Onye omalai novapofi. Oshilipipo shi dule shikwao, oshingoldo ile otembeli, oyo hai yapula oshingoldo?
Na: ‘ngeenge pe na ou ta ane koaltari, eano laye olongaho, ndele ou ta ane koshali i li koaltari, oye e noku li diinina.’
Ovapofi nye! Oshilipipo shi dule oshikwao, oshali ile oaltari, oyo hai yapula oiyandjiwa?
Onghee hano, ou ta ane koaltari, oye ta ane kuyo nokwaai aishe tai kala kuyo.
Ndele ou ta ane kotembeli, oye ta ane kuyo nokwaau a kala muyo;
ndele ou ta ane keulu, oye ta ane kolukalwapangelo laKalunga nokwaau a kala ko omutumba.

“Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, eshi hamu yandje oshitimulongo shoumbidi ava vanini vomomapya, ndele hamu efa oinenenima yomomhango ouyuki nefilonghenda noudiinini! Ei i nokuwanifwa, naainya ihe shi okweefiwa.
Onye ovakwatiketi vovapofi, omwe otamu i dindi mo, nongamelo otamu i pona!
“Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, eshi hamu yelifa eholo netiti kombada, ndele meni oli yadi enyeko noufukenhu!
Omufarisai ove omupofi, yelifa tete eholo meni, opo li yele nokombada yo.
“Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, omwa fa eembila da kolongwa, da wapala okutalwa kombada, ndele meni lado omu yadi omakipa ovafi nonyata aishe!
Osho nanye yo moipafi yovanhu mwa fa ovayuki, ndele meni omu yadi oihelele nomatauluko omhango.
“Woo nye, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, ovanaihelele nye, eshi hamu tungu eembila dovaxunganeki ndele hamu wapeke omamanya okeembila dovayuki,
ndele hamu ti: ‘Ngeno otwa li ko pomafiku ootatekulu, ngeno fye tuhe na etimba lohonde yovaxunganeki pamwe!’
Hano opopo otamu lihepaulula, onye ovana vovadipai vovaxunganeki.
Wanifeni hano nokufikifa oulunde wooxekulu.
Omayoka nye, noludalo leenhoka, otamu shiiva ngahelipi okuya onhapo etokolo loheli?

Ndele tala, Ame ohandi tumu kunye ovaxunganeki novanaendunge novanongo vomishangwa. Vamwe vavo otamu va dipaa ndele tamu va valele komushiyakano, vamwe otamu va denge neeshokoto omeeshinagoga deni, ndele tamu va taataa moshilando noshilando;
ohonde aishe iyapuki, ya tilwashi kombada yedu opo i uye kombada yeni okohonde yaAbel omuyuki fiyo okohonde yaSakaria, omona waBerekia, mwe mu dipaela pokati kotembeli noaltari.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: aishe ei otai uya kombada yepupi eli.

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, ove ho dipaa ovaxunganeki ndele ho dipaa nomamanya ava ve ku tuminwa, olungapi nda hala okwoongela ovamwoye, ngaashi oxuxwa hai ongele ouxuxwena vayo koshi yomavava ayo! Ndele nye inamu hala.
Tala, ongulu yeni otai mu fiilwa i kale hamungaho.
Osheshi ohandi mu lombwele: itamu mono nge vali, fiyo tamu ka tya: ‘Na nangekwe noupuna, ou te uya medina lOmwene!’ ”
24: Ndele Jesus okwa dja mo motembeli nokwa ya, ovalongwa vaye ove uya kuye ve mu ulikile omatungilo otembeli.
Ndele Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti kuvo: “Kamu a wete aeshe oo! Oshili handi mu lombwele: itapa fiwa apa emanya la tenhekwa kulikwao inali ngumaunwa po.”

Ndele eshi e li omutumba kOmhunda yEemono, ovalongwa vaye ove uya kuye, eshi ve li po aveshe, tava ti: “Tu lombwela: onaini hano eshi tashi ka ningwa, nedidiliko lokuuya kwoye nolexulilo lefimbo lounyuni olilipi?”
Ndele Jesus okwe va nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Taleni, muha pukifwe nande okulyelye.
Osheshi otaku uya vahapu omedina lange ndele tava ti: aame Kristus, ndele tava pukifa vahapu.
Ndele tamu ka uda oita nomakundano oita; taleni, muha tulwe oumbada. Osheshi osho oshi nokuningwa, ndele exulilo inali fika manga.
Osheshi oiwana otai fikamene oiwana, noshilongo otashi fikamene oshilongo, otaku di omakakamo edu keembinga neembinga, ondjala tai uya nomapiyaano.
Ndelenee aishe ei ehovelo lefeto lokudala.
“Ndelenee tave mu yandje okuhepekwa, ndele tave mu dipaa, nde tamu tondelwa edina lange koiwana aishe.
Opo nee vahapu tava efa ndele tava kengelelafana ndele tava tondafana.
Ndele otaku uya ovaxunganeki ovanaipupulu vahapu, ndele tava pukifa vahapu.
Oukolokoshi tau hapupala, nohole yavahapu otai talala.
Ndelenee ou te lididimike fiyo exulilo, oye ta xupifwa.
Ndele evaengeli eli louhamba otali udifilwa ounyuni aushe li ningile oiwana aishe ondobwedi, opo nee taku uya exulilo.
“Hano ngeenge tamu mono oixuna yehanauno, ya popiwa komuxunganeki Daniel, i li ofika ponhele iyapuki (omuleshi ne shi didilike)
opo nee aveshe ovo ve li muJudea, nava ye onhapo keemhunda;
naau ta hangika kombada yongulu, aha londoloke ko a ka pitule oinima yaye meumbo,
naau ta hangika mepya, aha shune a ka tale elwakani laye.
Woo ovafimba novamwali vopomafiku enya!
Ndele indileni, okuya onhapo kweni kuhe mu hange okufu ile efiku lEshabata,
osheshi omafiku oo otapa kala oudjuu unene, inau kala ko okehovelo lounyuni fiyo opaife, ndele ngaashi itau uya vali.
Ndele omafiku enya ngeno inaa xupipikwa, ngeno kaku na nande ombelela imwe tai xupifwa; ndele omafiku enya otaa xupipikwa omolwovahoololwa.
“Hano ngeenge ku na ou te mu lombwele: ‘Tala, Kristus oku li apa’, ile oku li kwinya, inamu mu itavela.
Osheshi otaku holoka, ookristus ovanaipupulu novaxunganeki ovanaipupulu, ndele tava longo omadidiliko manene noikumwifalonga, va pukife, ngeenge tashi dulika novahoololwa yo.
“Tala, onda tetekela oku shi mu lombwela.
Onghee hano, ngeenge tamu lombwelwa: ‘Tala, omombuwa e li’, inamu ya ko, ile: ‘Tala, omondjuwo e li’, inamu itavela.
Osheshi ongaashi oluvadi tali shela koushilo ndele tali monika fiyo okouninginino, nokuuya kwOmona wOmunhu osho taku ningi.
Osheshi koima ku noshimhu, oko taku ongala eenhwa.
“Ndele oudjuu womafiku oo otau shikulwa diva kelauliko letango, nohani itai yela vali, neenyofi otadi u meulu, neenghono domeulu otadi kakamifwa.
Edidiliko lOmona wOmunhu tali monika keulu, opo nee oiwana aishe yedu tai lilaana; ndele tai ka mona Omona wOmunhu te uya kombada yoilemo yeulu e neenghono dihapu noshinge;
ndele ta tumu ko ovaengeli vaye ve nomanghuma e neendaka dopombada, ndele tava ongele ko ovahoololwa vaye keembinga nhee, okominghulo deulu fiyo okudikwao.
“Ndele lilongeni omafaneko komukwiyu: Oshitai shao ngeenge tashi tende, omafo taa hape, opo nee omu shi shii, okwenye kwe uya.
Hano osho nanye yo, ngeenge tamu mono aishe ei, kaleni mu shi shii, oku li popepi, poshivelo.
“Oshili handi mu lombwele: epupi eli itali xulu po, fiyo aishe ei tai wanifwa.
Eulu nedu otali xulu po, ndele eendjovo dange kadi na apa tadi xulu po.
“Ndelenee efiku olo notundi oyo kape na ou e i shii, nande ovaengeli vomeulu, ile Omona, Tate Oye aeke.
Ndele ngaashi sha li pomafiku aNoa, osho tuu taku ka kala pokuuya kwOmona wOmunhu.
Osheshi ngaashi ovanhu va li pomafiku enya a tetekela eyelu: kwa li hava li nohava nu, hava hombola nohava hombolifa, fiyo efiku olo Noa a ya monguluwato,
ndele vo inave shi shiiva, fiyo eyelu le uya nole va hanauna po aveshe; hano osho taku ningi yo pokuuya kwOmona wOmunhu.
Otaku ka kala ovalumenhu vavali mepya, umwe ota tambulwa, nomukwao ota fiwa po.
Ovakainhu vavali tava tu koshini, umwe ota tambulwa, nomukwao ota fiwa po.
Opo nee hano kaleni oupafi, osheshi kamu shi shii efiku lilipipo Omwene weni te uya.
Ndelenee kaleni hano mu shi shii, mwene weumbo ngeno e nowino, efimbo lilipi omulunga te uya, ngeno ta pashukile eumbo laye liha teywe.
Onghee hano nanye yo kaleni mwe lilongekida, osheshi Omona wOmunhu ote uya efimbo tuu olo inamu mu teelela.”
“Olyelye hano omupiya omudiinini nomunaendunge, omwene waye e mu tula kombada yovapiya vaye, e va pe oikulya pefimbo lavo?
Omupiya ou e nelao, omwene waye ngeenge ta aluka te mu hange a ninga ngaha.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Oye te mu ningi elenga loinima yaye aishe.
Ndelenee omupiya ou ngeenge omwii, note lipopile momwenyo waye: ‘Omwene wange ota kala ko’,
ndele ta hovele okudenga ovapiya vakwao ndele ta li ndele ta nu pamwe neengholwe,
opo nee omwene womupiya ou ote uya efiku olo ine mu teelela notundi oyo ine i shiiva,
ndele te mu shashaula ndele te mu pe oshipewa shovanaihelele. Omo hamu kala elilaano nelikweshelo lomayoo.
25: “Opo nee ouhamba weulu otau kala wa fa oukadona omulongo, va kufa eelamba davo va ye va ka shakeneke omuhomboli.
Ndele vatano vomuvo ova li omalai, navakwao vatano va li ovanaendunge.
Ndele omalai okwa kufa eelamba davo, Oo inaa kufa omahooli.
Ndele ovanaendunge ova dja ko ve nomahooli meeshanga nomeelamba davo.
Ndele omuhomboli eshi a kala ko, ova fya eemhofi aveshe, ndele tava kofa.
Ndele pokati koufiku okwa ingidwa: ‘Omuhomboli oye ou! Indeni mu ke mu shakeneke.’
Opo nee oukadona aveshe ova penduka ndele tava longekida eelamba davo.
Omalai okwa lombwela ovanaendunge: ‘Tu peni yo momahooli eni, osheshi eelamba detu otadi dimi.’
Ndele ovanaendunge ove va nyamukula: ‘Ahowe, itae tu wanene ofye nanye. Shi dule tamu i kovashingifi, nye mu ke lilandele.’
Ndele eshi va ya va ka lande, omuhomboli okwe uya; naavo va hangika ve lilongekida, ova ya mo pamwe naye koshivilo shehombolo, noshivelo osha idilwa po.
Ndele konima oukadona vakwao yo ve uya, ndele tava ti: ‘Omwene, Omwene, tu yeulula!’
Ndelenee Oye okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: ‘Oshili handi mu lombwele: Ame nghi mu shii.’
Kaleni hano oupafi, osheshi inamu shiiva efiku notundi.
“Osheshi otaku ningi ngaashi omunhu ta ka enda koilongo: okwa ifana ovapiya vaye ndele te va pe oinima yaye;
okwa pa umwe oitalenti itano, nomukwao ivali, nomutitatu shimwe, okeshe tuu ou osho sha yeleka eenghono daye, opo nee okwa ya koilongo.
Ndele oye ou a pewa oitalenti itano, okwa ya diva, ndele te i landakanifa, ndele okwa likolifa ikwao itano.
Nosho tuu ou a pewa oitalenti ivali okwa likolifa ikwao ivali.
Ndelenee ou a pewa shimwe okwa ya, okwa fa elambo medu, ndele okwa fudika mo oshitalenti shomwene waye.
“Ndele eshi pa pita efimbo lile, omwene wovapiya ava okwa aluka ko, ndele okwa valula navo omuvalu.
Opo nee ou a li a pewa oitalenti itano okwe uya, okwa eta ikwao itano, ndele ta ti: ‘Omwene, ove wa pele nge oitalenti itano, tala, ame onda likola oitalenti ikwao itano.’
Ndele omwene waye okwa tya kuye: ‘Iyaloo, omupiya ove muwa nomudiinini; ove wa li omudiinini mwaai inini, ohandi ku pe okupangela ihapu. Inda mehafo lOmwene woye.’
Naau kwa li a pewa oitalenti ivali okwe uya ndele okwa tya: ‘Omwene, ove owa pele nge oitalenti ivali, tala, ame onda likola oitalenti ikwao ivali.’
Omwene waye okwa tya kuye: ‘Iyaloo, omupiya ove muwa nomudiinini. Ove wa li omudiinini mwaai inini, ohandi ku pe okupangela ihapu. Inda mehafo lOmwene woye.’
“Ndele ou yo kwa li a pewa oshitalenti shimwe okwe uya ndele okwa tya: ‘Omwene, ondi ku shii, oove omulumenhu mukukutu, ho teya apa ino kuna po, ndele to ongele apa ino yelela po.
Onghee nda tila, ndele nda ya, ndele onda paka medu oshitalenti shoye; tala, oshoye osheshi!’
Ndelenee omwene waye okwa nyamukula ndele a tya kuye: ‘Omupiya oove mwii nomundedenhu! Ove wa li u shii nge, handi teya apa inandi kuna po, ndele handi ongele apa inandi yelela po.
Ove kwa li u nokuyandja oshitalenti shange kovalandakanifi, ame mokwaaluka kwange ngeno ndi alulilwe shange noshilikolwa shasho.
Onghee hano mu kufeni oshitalenti, nye mu shi pe ou e kwete omulongo.
Osheshi ou e na, oye ota pewa, ndele ta kala e na ihapu unene; ndele ou ehe na, oye ta kufwa naashi e shi kwete.
Ndele omupiya ou mwii mu ekeleni momilaulu dopondjelela; omo hamu kala elilaano nelikweshelo lomayoo.’
“Ndele Omona wOmunhu eshi te uya moshinge shaye novaengeli vayapuki aveshe pamwe naye, opo nee ota kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo loshinge shaye.
Noiwana aishe otai ongelwa koshipala shaye, ndele ta yoolola ovanhu moovakwao, ngaashi omufita ta yoolola eedi moikombo.
Eedi ote di ameke kolulyo laye, noikombo okolumosho laye.
Opo nee ohamba otai lombwele ovo vokolulyo layo: ‘Onye ovanangekwa noupuna vaTate, ileni, mu ka fyuulule ouhamba ou mwe u longekidilwa, keshito lounyuni.
Osheshi Ame onda li nda fya ondjala, onye omwa pa nge okulya; Ame onda li nda fya enota, onye omwa nwefa nge; Ame onda li ongedi, onye omwa nangeka nge.
Ame onda li olutu longaho, ndele mwa dika nge; ndele nda li nda vela, omwe uya okutalela nge po; nda li modolongo, omwe uya kwaame.’
Opo nee ovayuki tave mu nyamukula ndele tava ti: ‘Omwene, onaini twe ku mwene, wa fya ondjala ndele twe ku pa oikulya, nowa fya enota ndele twe ku nwefa?
Onaini twe ku mwene, Oove ongedi ndele twe ku nangeka, ile olutu longaho ndele twe ku dika?
Onaini twe ku mwene wa vela ile u li modolongo ndele fye twe uya kwoove?’
Ndele ohamba tai ke va nyamukula ndele tai ti kuvo: ‘Oshili handi mu lombwele: aishe ei mwe i ningila umwe waava ovamwatate vanini, Aame mwe i ningila.’
“Opo nee ota lombwele venya vokolumosho laye: ‘Djeni po pwaame, onye ovafingwa, mu ye momundilo waalushe wa longelwa Satana novaengeli vaye.
Osheshi Ame onda li nda fya ondjala, nye inamu pa nge okulya; Ame nda fya enota, nye inamu nwefa nge;
Ame onda li ongedi, nye inamu nangeka nge; hamunghele, nye inamu dika nge; nda li nda vela nomodolongo, ndelenee nye inamu uya okutalela nge po.’
Opo nee ava yo otave mu nyamukula ndele tava ti: ‘Omwene, onaini twe ku mwene wa fya ondjala ile enota ile ongedi ile hamunghele ile wa vela ile modolongo, ndele inatu ku yakula?’
Opo nee Oye te va nyamukula ndele ta ti: ‘Oshili handi mu lombwele: aishe inya inamu i ningila umwe waava vanini, Aame mwene inamu i ningila.’
Ndele ava tava i mokuhandukilwa kwaalushe, ndele ovayuki omomwenyo waalushe.”
26: Ndele opa ningwa, Jesus eshi a mana eendjovo odo adishe, okwa tya kovalongwa vaye:
“Onye omu shi shii, ngeenge taku piti omafiku avali oku nOpaasa; nOmona wOmunhu ota yandjwa okuvalelwa.”
Opo nee ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu voshiwana va ongala meumbo lomupristeli omukulunhu, edina laye Kajafas
ndele va kundafana, va kwate Jesus nekonda ve mu dipae.
Ndele tava ti: “Hapefimbo loshivilo shinene, puha ninge epiyaano movanhu.”
Opo nee Jesus eshi a li muBetania omeumbo laSimon omunashilundu,
omukainhu umwe okwe uya kuye, e nokashanga ke yadi omaadi e nondilo, ndele okwe a tila komutwe waJesus, fimbo a kala omutumba poshililo.
Ndele ovalongwa vaye eshi ve shi mona va ninga omwenyo mwii ndele tava ti: “Oshike hano taa hepifwa ashike?
Ngeno a landifwa po, ngeno oimaliwa ihapu, i yandjelwe eehepele.”
Ndelenee opo Jesus eshi e shi koneka, ota ti kuvo: “Oshike tamu nyikifa omukainhu oluhodi? Oye okwa longela nge oshilonga shiwa.
Eehepele omu va kwete alushe punye, ndele Ame kamu kwete nge alushe.
Osheshi eshi a tila omaadi aa kolutu lange, okwe shi ningila epako lange.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Keshe apa mounyuni aushe evaengeli eli tali udifwa, noshilonga eshi shaye otashi ka hepaululwa moku mu dimbulukwa.”
Opo nee umwe womwaava omulongo navavali, edina laye Judas Iskariot, okwa ya kovapristeli ovakulunhu
ndele ta ti: “Omwa hala okupa nge shike, ndi mu yandje momake eni?” Ovo ove mu futa oimaliwa oisiliveli omilongo itatu.
Ndele okudja kefiku tuu eli okwa li ta kongo efimbo la wapala oku mu kengelela.
Ndele efiku lotete lomingome inadi fingwa, ovalongwa ove uya kuJesus ndele tava ti: “Openi wa hala, tu ku longele odi yaPaasa u i lye?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Indeni koshilando kunima nye mu ke mu lombwele, mu tye: ‘Omuhongi ota ti: efimbo lange ola fika; opwoove handi ka lya oikulya yaPaasa pamwe novalongwa vange.’ ”
Ovalongwa ova ninga ngaashi Jesus e va lombwela, ndele va longekida odi yaPaasa.
Ndele onguloshi eshi ye uya, okwa kala omutumba poshililo pamwe novalongwa vaye omulongo navavali.
Ndele fimbo tava li, Ye okwa tya: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: umwe womokati keni ota kengelele nge.”
Opo vo ova nyika oluhodi shili, ndele va hovela oku mu pula va shikulafana, ndele tava ti: “Omwene, haame ndi shii?”
Oye okwa nyamukula, ta ti: “Ou a twa eke laye metiti pamwe naame, oye ta kengelele nge.
Heeno, Omona wOmunhu ota i ngaashi pa shangwa, ndele woo, omunhu ou, te mu kengelele! Omunhu ou ngeno okwa li ina dalwa, she mu wapalela.”
Ndelenee Judas, ou e mu kengelela, okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Omuhongi, haame ndishi?” Oye ta ti kuye: “Ove we shi tya.”
Ndele eshi va li tava li, Jesus okwa kufa omungome, ndele ta hambelele, ndele te u pambula, ndele te u pe ovalongwa vaye ndele ta ti: “Tambuleni, lyeni; eshi olutu lange.”
Opo Ye okwa kufa eholo, ndele ta pandula, ndele te li va pe, ndele ta ti: “Nweni mo amushe;
osheshi olo ohonde yange, ohonde yehangano, tai tilwashi omolwavahapu okudima po omatimba.
Ndele handi mu lombwele: okunena eli Ame itandi nu vali oiimati ei yomuviinyu fiyo efiku olo, handi ke a nwa mape pamwe nanye omouhamba waTate.”
Ndele eshi va imba eimbilo lepandulo ova dja mo ndele tava i kOmhunda yEemono.
Ndele Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Oufiku ou wonena onye amushe otamu lidimbike nge, osheshi okwa shangwa: ‘Ame ohandi denge omufita, needi doufita otadi lihane.’
Ndele Ame ngeenge nda nyumuka, ohandi mu tetekelele kuGalilea.”
Opo Petrus okwa nyamukula ta ti kuye: “Nande aveshe nave ku lidimbike, haame handi ku lidimbike nande efiku limwe.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Oshili handi ku lombwele: oufiku ou, ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena, ove to lidimbike nge lutatu.”
Petrus okwa tya kuye: “Nande ondi fye naave, itandi ku lidimbike nande.” Osho tuu ovalongwa vakwao aveshe va tya.
Opo nee Jesus okwa ya navo konhele, edina layo Getsemane; ndele okwa tya kovalongwa vaye: “Kaleni omutumba apa, fimbo handi i kwinya ndi ka ilikane.”
Ndele pamwe naye okwa kufa Petrus novana vavali vaSebedeus. Ye okwa hovela okunyika oluhodi nokuudite oudjuu.
Ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Omwenyo wange owa nyika oluhodi fiyo okufya, kaleni apa mu kale oupafi pamwe naame.”
Ndele okwa ehena ko kanini, ndele a wila eombe poshi, okwa indila ndele ta ti: “Tate, ngeenge tashi dulika, eholo eli nali koye nge; ndele hangaashi Ame nda hala, ndelenee ongaashi Ove wa hala.”
Ndele okwe uya kovalongwa, ndele okwe va hanga va kofa ndele ta ti kuPetrus: “Hano osho mwa nyengwa okukala oupafi okafimbo kamwe pamwe naame.
Kaleni oupafi, nye mu indile, muha hangike komahongaulo; omhepo oya hala, ndele ombelela i noungone.”
Ndele okwa shuna ko lutivali, okwa indila ta ti: “Tate, ngeenge itashi dulika eholo eli li koye nge inandi li nwa, ehalo loye nali wanifwe.”
Ndele okwa aluka ko ndele okwe va hanga vali va kofa, osheshi omesho avo a dinda keemhofi.
Ndele okwe va fiya po, ndele okwa shuna ko, ndele ta ilikana lutitatu, a popyulula eendjovo dinya.
Opo nee okwe uya kovalongwa ndele ta ti kuvo: “Otamu kofa natango, ndele tamu tulumukwa! Tala, efimbo ola fika, Omona wOmunhu ota yandjwa momake ovalunde.
Fikameni, tu yeni, tala, ou ta kengelele nge oku li popepi.”
Ndele tala, fimbo ta popi, Judas, umwe waava omulongo navavali, okwe uya, ta ende pamwe nongudu inene i nomaongamukonda needibo, va dja kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovakulunhu voshiwana.
Naau, e mu kengelela, okwa li e va pa oshidimbulukifo ta ti: “Ou handi mu fipi komulungu, Oye ou, mu kwateni.”
Ndele okwa ya kuJesus divadiva ndele ta ti: “Rabbi, wa tokelwa!” Ndele te mu fipi komulungu.
Ndelenee Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Kaume, owa ila shike apa?” Opo nee ova ehena kuJesus, ve mu nanena omake ndele ve mu kwata.
Ndele tala, umwe womwaava va li pamwe naJesus, okwa nana eke laye, a pweya mo eongamukonda laye, ta denge omupiya womupristeli omukulunhu, ndele okwe mu teta okutwi.
Opo nee Jesus ta ti kuye: “Shunifa mo eongamukonda loye moshilaleko shalo, osheshi aveshe ava tava kwata keongamukonda, otava fi keongamukonda.
Ile ou shii, nghi dulu okwiindila Tate, a tumine nge paife ovaengeli ve dule eengudu dakula omulongo nambali!
Ndele omishangwa otadi wanifwa ngahelipi ngeno, odo tadi ti, oshi nokuningwa ngaha?”

Efimbo tuu eli Jesus okwa lombwela eengudu: “Onye mwe uya okukwata nge ongaashi omukolokoshi, mu nomaongamukonda needibo. Omafiku aeshe kwa li nda kala omutumba motembeli ndele nda longa, nye inamu kwata nge.
Ndelenee aishe ei oya ningwa, omishangwa dovaxunganeki opo di wanifwe.” Opo nee ovalongwa aveshe ve mu fiya po, ndele va ya onhapo.
Ndele ovakwati vaJesus ove mu twala komupristeli omukulunhu, Kajafas, omo mwa ongala ovanongo vomishangwa novakulunhu.
Ndele Petrus okwe mu shikula e li konima kokule, fiyo omomukala womupristeli omukulunhu; okwa ya mo ndele okwa kala omutumba povapiya, a mone nhumbi tashi ningwa.
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu noshiongalele ashishe shovakulunhu ova li tava kongele Jesus oihokolola yoipupulu, va shiive oku mu dipaa,
ndele inave i mona, nande eendobwedi dihapu doipupulu da holokela po. Ndele hauxuuninwa eendobwedi mbali de uya mo
ndele tadi ti: “Ou okwa tile: ‘otembeli yaKalunga ohandi dulu oku i ngumauna po, noku i tungulula omafiku atatu.’ ”
Omupristeli omukulunhu okwa fikama ndele ta ti kuye: “Ito nyamukula sha, ava eshi tave ku popi.”
Ndelenee Jesus okwa mwena. Opo nee omupristeli omukulunhu okwa tya kuye: “Ohandi ku anifa kuKalunga omunamwenyo, u tu lombwele, ngeenge Oove Kristus, Omona waKalunga?”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Ove we shi tya. Ndele ohandi mu lombwele: onena eli otamu ka mona Omona wOmunhu ta kala omutumba kolulyo lEenghono ndele te uya, ta ende kombada yoilemo yokeulu.”
Opo nee omupristeli omukulunhu okwa pombaula oikutu yaye, ndele okwa tya: “Okwa tuka Kalunga. Ohatu kongele vali shike ondobwedi? Tala, paife eshi omwa uda etukano laye.
Otamu ti ngahelipi?” Ovo va nyamukula tava ti: “Oku netimba lokufya.”
Opo nee vo ve mu fiila omate moshipala ndele ove mu denga neengonyo; vamwe ove mu denga omanghava
ndele va tya: “Kristus, tu xunganekela, olyelye ou e ku denga.”
Ndele Petrus okwa li omutumba momukala. Ndele omukalele okakadona umwe e uya kuye ndele ta ti: “Naave yo owa li pamwe naJesus, Omugalilea.”
Ndele ye okwe lidimbika omoipafi yaaveshe ndele ta ti: “Nghi udite ko eshi to popi.”
Ndele eshi a ya moluvanda, okakadona kamwe ke mu mona ndele okwa tya kwaavo va li mo: “Naau yo okwa li pamwe naJesus, Omunasareti.”
Navali okwe lidimbika nokwaana: “Omulumenhu ou nghi mu shii.”
Ndele konima yokafimbo opwe uya vamwe ava va li ko ofika, ndele va tya kuPetrus: “Oshili naave yo oumwe waavenya, osheshi nelaka loye ole ku holola.”
Oye okwe lidimbika vali nokulifingaela nokwaana kutya: “Omulumenhu ou nghi mu shii. Ndele ekondobolo la kwena.”
Petrus okwa dimbulukwa eendjovo daJesus, e di mu lombwela: “Ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena, oto lidimbike nge lutatu.” Ye okwa ya pondje, ndele okwa lila unene.
27: Ndele ongula eshi kwa sha, ovapristeli ovakulunhu aveshe novakulunhu voshiwana ova ongala ndele ova kundafana Jesus, ve mu dipae.
Ndele ove mu manga, ndele ve mu twala ko, ndele tave mu yandje momake aPilatus, omupangeli woshilongo.
Opo Judas, omukengeleli waye, eshi a mona a tokolwa, okwe lidilulula, ndele okwa shunifa oimaliwa oisiliveli inya omilongo nhatu kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovakulunhu
ndele ta ti: “Ame nda nyona, eshi nda kengelela ohonde ihe netimba.” Ndele vo ova tya: “Otu na shike naave? Likwafa ove mwene!”
Ndele ye okwa ekelashi oimaliwa oisiliveli motembeli, a dja mo, okwa ya ndele te limangeleke.
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu ova toola po oimaliwa oisiliveli ndele tava ti: “Ei itai dulu okutulwa moimaliwa yotembeli, osheshi oyo efuto lohonde.”
Ndele eshi va kundafana, ove i landa epya lomuhongi woitoo, li ninge onhele yokupaka ovanailongo.
Onghee hano epya olo hali ifanwa epya lohonde fiyo onena eli.
Osho oda wanifwa odo da popiwa komuxunganeki Jeremia, ou ta ti: “Ovo va tambula oimaliwa omilongo nhatu, efuto lomulumenhu ou a yelekwa, ngaashi ve mu yeleka ponhele yovana vaIsrael;
ndele ove i yandjela epya lomuhongi woitoo, ngaashi Omwene a lombwela nge.”
Ndele Jesus okwa li ofika koshipala shomupangeli. Omupangeli okwe mu pula ndele ta ti: “Oove tuu ohamba yOvajuda?” Jesus okwa tya: “Heeno, ngaashi to ti.”
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu eshi ve mu hokololifa, Oye ina nyamukula sha.
Opo Pilatus ta ti kuye: “Ino uda ko, eshi tave ku popi unene?”
Ndele Oye ine mu nyamukula nande epulo limwe, opo tuu opo omupangeli okwa kumwa shili.
Ndele okwa li ku na onghedi, omupangeli ha mangululile ovanhu pefimbo loshivilo omukwatwa umwe, ou ve mu hala voovene.
Ndele pomafiku enya ova li ve na omukwatwa a popiwa nokokule, edina laye Barabas.
Hano eshi va ongala, Pilatus okwa tya kuvo: “Elipipo mwa hala, ndi mu mu mangululile, Barabas ile Jesus, haku tiwa Kristus?”
Osheshi ye okwa li e shi wete, ovo ve mu yandjela efupa.
Ndele fimbo a li omutumba kolukalwatokolo, omwalikadi waye okwa tuma kuye ndele ta ti: “Omulumenhu ou omuyuki ino mu ningila owii, osheshi ame onde mu ehamenwa shili oufiku wonena mondjodi.”
Ndelenee ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu ove shi hekela ovanhu okwiindila Barabas, nokudipaifa Jesus.
Opo omupangeli okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Elipipo mwaava vavali mwa hala, ndi mu mu mangululile?” Ovo va tya: “Barabas.”
Pilatus ta ti kuvo: “Jesus ou, haku tiwa Kristus, ohandi mu ningi ngahelipi?” Ovo aveshe ova tya: “Na valelwe komushiyakano!”
Ndele omupangeli ta ti: “Okwa nyona shike hano?” Ndele vo va diinina okuuyaana pombada va tya: “Na valelwe komushiyakano!”

Ndele Pilatus eshi a mona ehe na eshi ta dulu, ndele epiyaano ola ninga linene, okwa kufa omeva ndele okwe likosha komake aye moipafi yongudu ndele ta ti: “Ame nghi netimba lohonde yomulumenhu ou omuyuki. Litaleni nye vene.”
Ndele ongudu aishe oya nyamukula ya tya: “Ohonde yaye nai uye kombada yetu nokombada yovana vetu!”
Opo nee ye okwe va mangululila Barabas, ndele okwa dengifa Jesus neeshokoto, ndele okwe mu yandja a ka valelwe komushiyakano.
Opo ovakwaita vomupangeli va twala Jesus mongulu yomupangeli, ndele va ongela ovakwaita aveshe kuye.
Opo nee ove mu dula oshikutu shaye ndele ove mu djaleka oshikutu shinene shitilyana,

ndele ova tunga oshidingo shomakiya, ndele ve shi mu djaleka komutwe, ndele ove mu pa oshihati meke laye lokolulyo, ovo nove mu twila eengolo, ndele ve mu sheka, tava ti: “Kundwa Oove, ohamba yOvajuda!”
Ndele ove mu fiila omate, ndele ova kufa oshihati ve mu denga komutwe.
Ndele hano eshi ve mu sheka ngaha, ove mu dula oshikutu ndele ove mu djaleka oshikutu shaye mwene, nove mu twala a ka valelwe komushiyakano.
Ndele mokweenda kwavo ova hanga omulumenhu Omukireni, edina laye Simon. Ovo ve mu fininika e mu humbatele omushiyakano waye.
Ndele eshi va fika ko konhele, edina layo Golgata, tali ti: “Onhele yoshipongolo shomutwe.”
Ndele vo ove mu pa omaviinyu a lumbakanifwa onyango; ndele eshi e a makela, ina hala oku a nwa.
Ndele eshi ve mu valela komushiyakano, ova tukulilafana oikutu yaye ndele tave i ekele oshihoololifo.
Ndele ova kala omutumba ndele ove mu nangela oko.
Ndele ova tula kombada yomutwe waye etimba laye la shangwa ngaha: “Ou oJesus, ohamba yOvajuda.”
Ndele ovakolokoshi vavali va valelwa pamwe naye komushiyakano, umwe okolulyo laye nomukwao okolumosho laye.
Ndele ovo va pita po ove mu sheka nokupukapuka komitwe davo,
ndele tava ti: “Oove tuu ou to ngumauna po otembeli ndele to i tungulula omafiku atatu, likwafa mwene, ngeenge oove Omona waKalunga, ove u dje ko komushiyakano.”
Novapristeli ovakulunhu yo pamwe novanongo vomishangwa novakulunhu osho tuu yo ve mu sheka ndele tava ti:
“Okwa li ha kwafa ovanhu, ye ita dulu okulikwafa. Ngeenge ye ohamba yOvaisraeli, hano na dje ko paife komushiyakano, opo nee ohatu mu itavele.
Oye okwe lineekela Kalunga; Kalunga ne mu xupife hano paife, ngeenge okwe mu hokwa; osheshi Oye mwene okwa tile: Aame Omona waKalunga.”
Nosho ngaha ovakolokoshi yo ve mu sheka, ovo va valelwa pamwe naye.
Ndele potundi onhihamano opa ninga omilaulu moshilongo ashishe, fiyo opotundi onhimugoi.
Ndele potundi onhimugoi Jesus okwa ingida mokule ndele ta ti: “Eeli, Eeli, lama sabaktani?” Nokutya: Kalunga kange, Kalunga kange, oshike wa ekela nge shi?
Opo nee vamwe vomuvo va li ofika opo, eshi ve di uda ova tya: “Ota ifana Elia.”
Hano umwe waava okwa lotoka ndele okwa kufa okayavo ndele okwe ka yada omaetika, okwe ka tula koshihati, ndele te mu nwefa.
Ndelenee ovakwao ova popya tava ti: “Efa u tale, Elia ngeenge ote uya oku mu kwafa.”
Ndele Jesus okwa ingida vali pombada ndele ta fi.
Ndele tala, etukulifo lotembeli ola tauka pombada fiyo oposhi, nedu ola kakama, nomamanya okeemhunda okwa tanduka,
neembila oda yeuluka, omalutu mahapu oonakufya ovayapuki a nyumuka.
Ndele va dja mo meembila, ndele ove uya koshilando shiyapuki, Oye eshi a nyumuka, ndele ove lihololela vahapu.
Ndele omunefele a nangela Jesus pamwe navo, eshi va mona ekakamo ledu naaishe ei ya ningwa po, ova tila unene ndele tava ti: “Oshili ou okwa li Omona waKalunga.”
Ndele koima oko okwa li ku novakainhu vahapu, va dile kuGalilea ovo va shikulile Jesus nove mu yakulile; ova kala ofika kokule, ndele tave mu tale.
Mokati kavo omwa li Maria Magdalena naMaria, ina yaJakob naJosef, naina yovana vaSebedeus.
Ndele onguloshi eshi ye uya, ope uya omulumenhu oshipuna Omuarimatia, edina laye Josef, ou a li yo omulongwa waJesus.
Oye okwa ya kuPilatus, ndele okwe mu indila oshimhu shaJesus. Opo nee Pilatus okwa lombwela shi yandjwe kuye.
Ndele Josef okwa kufa ko oshimhu, okwe shi mangela moshiyata sholiina shiwa sha wapala,
ndele okwe shi nangeka mombila yaye ipe, kwa li e i lihokelifila memanya. Ndele okwa alangatifila poshivelo shombila emanya linene, ndele okwa dja po.
Ndele oko kwa li Maria Magdalena naMaria mukwao, va kala omutumba va shaama nombila.
Ndele efiku la shikula, olo tali shikula efiku lelilongekido, ovapristeli ovakulunhu nOvafarisai ova ongala kuPilatus
ndele tava ti: “Omwene, otwa dimbulukwa, omupukifi winya fimbo kwa li e nomwenyo, okwa tile: ‘Ngeenge pwa pita omafiku atatu, ohandi nyumuka.’

Lombwela hano, ombila i nangelwe shili fiyo efiku etitatu, ovalongwa vaye vehe uye ndele vehe mu vake mo, ndele vaha lombwele ovanhu: okwa nyumuka koufi; omapukifo ahauxuuninwa osho taa ningi mai e dule otete.”
