Pilatus okwa tya kuvo: “Ovanangeli ovo ava, indeni nee, nye mu nangele nawa ngaashi mu shi shii.”
Ndele vo ova ya ndele va idilifa po emanya noshihako ndele va nangeka ovanangeli pombila.
28: Ndele Eshabata eshi la pita neluwa la tenda, olefiku lotete loshivike, Maria Magdalena, naMaria mukwao ova ka tala kombila.
Ndele tala, opa ninga ekakamo linene ledu, osheshi omweengeli wOmwene a dja meulu, okwe uya po ndele ta kandula po emanya ndele te li kala omutumba.
Ndele okufa kwaye okwa li kwa fa oluvadi noikutu yaye itoka too, ya fa eemhawe.
Ndele mokuhalukilila ovanangeli vombila ova kakama, va fa va fya.
Ndele omweengeli okwa popifa ovakainhu ndele okwa tya: “Nye inamu tila; osheshi ndi shi shii, onye tamu kongo Jesus, omuvalelwa komushiyakano.
Ke mo, osheshi okwa nyumuka, ongaashi a tile. Ileni, mu tale onhele, apa a li a nangala.
Ndele indeni nee nokweendelela mu ka lombwele ovalongwa vaye nokutya, okwa nyumuka. Ndele tala, ote mu tetekelele okuya kuGalilea; oko tamu ke mu mona. Tala, aame nde shi mu lombwela.”
Ndele opo nee ova dja ko kombila diva nokutila nokuhafa pombada, ndele va tondoka va ka twalele ovalongwa vaye ondaka.
Ndele tala, Jesus okwe va shakeneka ndele ta ti: “Kundweni!” Ovo va ehena kuye, ove mu dingatela keemhadi daye, ndele ove mu twila eengolo.
Ndele opo nee Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Inamu tila, indeni mu ka lombwele ovamwatate, va ye kuGalilea, oko tava ka mona nge.”
Ndele fimbo va ya ko, tala, ovanangeli vamwe ove uya koshilando ndele va hepaululila ovapristeli ovakulunhu aishe ei ya ningwa ko.
Ndele ovo va ongala pamwe novakulunhu, ova kundafana, ndele va pa ovakwaita oimaliwa ihapu
ndele va tya: “Tyeni, ovalongwa vaye ve uya oufiku, ndele ve mu vaka mo oufiku fimbo twa kofa.
Ndele ngeenge tashi udika komupangeli, fye ohatu mu handukulula, ndele hatu mu popile, nye mu shiive okukala muhe noshisho.”
Ovo va tambula oimaliwa ndele va ninga ngaashi va lombwelwa. Ndele ehepaululo eli ola tandavelifwa mOvajuda, ndele tali hepaululwa nonena.
Ndele ovalongwa ovo omulongo naumwe ova ya kuGalilea okomhunda inya, Jesus e i va lombwela.
Ndele ovo eshi ve mu mona, ove mu linyongamena, ndele vamwe ova limbililwa.
Ndele Jesus okwe uya kuvo, okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Ame onda pewa eenghono adishe meulu nokombada yedu.
Indeni hano ka ningeni ovanhu aveshe ovalongwa vange, noku va shashela medina laXe nolOmona nolOmhepo Iyapuki,
noku va longa okudiinina aishe ei nde i mu lombwela. Ndele tala, Ame ondi li pamwe nanye omafiku aeshe, fiyo okexulilo lefimbo lounyuni.”

1: Ehovelo levaengeli laJesus Kristus, Omona waKalunga.

Ngaashi pa shangwa momushangwa womuxunganeki Jesaja:
“Tala, ohandi ku tetekelifile omutumwa wange,
oye te ku longekidile ondjila.

Ondaka yomwiingidi tai udika mombuwa:
‘Longekidileni Omwene ondjila,
mu yelakanifileni omalila.’ ”
Johannes Omushashi okwa holoka mombuwa nokwa udifa kutya, ovanhu nave lidilulule nava shashwe, opo omatimba avo a dimwe po.
Noshilongo ashishe shaJudea nOvajerusalem aveshe ova ya kuye, ndele ova shashelwa kuye momulonga waJordan, eshi va hepaulula omatimba avo.
Ndele Johannes okwa li a djala oshikutu sholududi longamelo nekwamo loshipa moshiya shaye, ndele okwa li ha li oshipaxu nomaadi eenyiki.
Ndele okwa udifa ndele ta ti: “Konima yange otaku di ou e dule nge eenghono, naame inandi wapala nande okupetama nokuditula omiya deenghaku daye.
Ame onde mu shasha nomeva, ndelenee Ye ote ke mu shasha nOmhepo Iyapuki.”
Ndele opa ningwa omafiku enya, Jesus okwa dja kuNasaret shomuGalilea, ndele okwa shashelwa kuJohannes momulonga waJordan.
Ndele eshi a dja momeva, oku wete eulu la yeuluka nOmhepo ya fa onghuti ye mu kulukila;
ndele meulu omwa dja ondaka tai ti: “Oove Omona wange omuholike, onde ku hokwa.”
Ndele diva Omhepo Oye mu twala mombuwa.
Ndele oye okwa menekela mombuwa omafiku omilongo ine, ndele okwa hongaulwa kuSatana, ndele okwa kala poifitukuti, novaengeli ove mu yakula.
Ndele Johannes eshi a kwatwa, opo nee Jesus okwa ya kuGalilea, ndele okwa udifa evaengeli laKalunga,
ndele ta ti: “Efimbo ola fika, ouhamba waKalunga wa ehena popepi, lidilululeni nye mu itavele evaengeli.”
Ndele mokweenda komunghulo wefuta laGalilea okwa mona ko Simon naAndreas, ondenge yaye, tava ekele oshiyulifo mefuta, osheshi ova li ovayuli veeshi.
Opo Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Shikuleni nge, ndele handi mu ningi ovayuli vovanhu.”
Opo tuu opo ova fiya po oiyulifo yavo, ndele ove mu shikula.
Ndelenee eshi a ehena ko kanini, okwa mona Jakob yaSebedeus nondenge Johannes, va hangika mowato, tava tangulula oiyulifo yavo.
Ndele okwe va ifana diva; vo ova fiya po xe Sebedeus mowato pamwe novamati ovafutwa, ndele ove mu shikula.
Ndele ova ya kuKapernaum; ndele diva efiku lEshabata okwa ya moshinagoga, ndele ta longo.
Ovo ova kuminwa elongo laye, osheshi Oye okwe va longa ngaashi omunaenghonopangelo, hangaashi ovanongo vomishangwa.
Ndele moshinagoga yavo omwa hangika omunhu e nomhepo ya nyata, ndele ya ingida
tai ti: “Owa hala shike mufye, Jesus Omunasareti? Owe uya u tu hanaune po? Ondi ku shii, kutya Oove lyelye, Oove Omuyapuki waKalunga.”
Jesus okwe mu hanyena ndele ta ti: “Mwena, ove u dje mo muye.”
Omhepo ya nyata oye mu kama, ndele oya dja mo muye nokwiingida pombada.
Aveshe ova kumwa, ova pulafana va tya: “Oshike eshi? Elongo lipe li neenghono! Ye ota hanyene eemhepo da nyata, ndele do tadi dulika kuye.”
Ndele etumbalo laye la udika diva momikunda adishe domuGalilea.
Eshi va dja mo moshinagoga, ova ya diva meumbo laSimon naAndreas, pamwe naJakob naJohannes.
Ndele inamweno yaSimon okwa hangika ta vele olwiidi, ndele ve mu tonga diva kuJesus.
Ye okwa ya kuye, ndele okwe mu yambula keke, nolwiidi ole mu efa, ndele ye te va yakula.
Ndele eshi onguloshi ye uya, netango la ningina, vo ova eta kuye ovanaudu aveshe, naava ve kwetiwe keendemoni.
Noshilando ashishe sha ongala poshivelo.
Ye okwa velula vahapu ava va vela omaudu e lili noku lili, ndele okwa ta mo eendemoni dihapu, Ye ina efa eendemoni di popye, osheshi odi mu shii.
Nongula inene, fimbo eluwa inali tenda, Ye okwa penduka a dja mo, ndele okwa ya koima kwe likalela, ndele ta ilikana.
Ndele Simon naava va li naye, ove mu shikula.
Ndele eshi ve mu mona, ova tya kuye: “Aveshe otave ku kongo.”
Ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Tu yeni komikunda dopoushiinda, opo ndi ka udifile ko yo, osheshi osho tuu osho nde shi endela.”
Ye okwa ya ndele ta udifa meeshinagoga davo domuGalilea ashishe, ndele ta te mo eendemoni.
Ndele kuye okwe uya omunaudu woshilundu, ndele te mu indile a twa eengolo ndele ta ti: “Oove ngeenge wa hala, oto dulu okuyelifa nge.”
Jesus okwe mu fila onghenda, okwa nana eke laye, ndele okwe mu kuma, ndele ta ti: “Onda hala, yela.”
Oshilundu osha dja mo muye diva, ndele ye okwa yela.
Okwe mu kumaida nomahanyeno, okwe mu lekela diva.
Ndele okwa tya kuye: “Tala, ino shi lombwela nande olyelye, ndele inda u ke liulikile komupristeli, ove u ka yandjele eveluko loye oshali osho sha tongwa kuMoses, shi va ningile ondobwedi.”

Ndele eshi a ya pondje, okwa hovela oku shi hepaulula shili nokuudifa oshinima osho, onghee hano Jesus ina dula vali okuya moilando moipafi, ndele okwa kala koxulo poima pe likalela novanhu vokeembinga adishe ove uya kuye.
2: Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku amwe, okwa ya vali kuKapernaum. Ndele eshi a udika nokutya, Ye oku li meumbo,
ovanhu vahapu ova ongalela ko diva, noposhivelo kapa li vali onhele. Oye okwe va udifila ondjovo.
Ndelenee ope uya ovanhu va eta kuye omunhu oshingudu a humbatwa kovalumenhu vane.
Ndele vo eshi va nyengwa kouhapu wovanhu oku mu eta kuye, ova ulula onduda omo a li, ndele ova kulukifa poshi olutala oko kwa nangala omunhu oshingudu.
Jesus eshi a mona eitavelo lavo, okwa tya koshingudu: “Omumwange, omatimba oye otaa dimwa po.”
Omwa li mu novanongo vomishangwa vamwe va kala omutumba, ndele ova diladila momitima davo:
“Ota popi ngahelipi ngaho? Ota sheke Kalunga. Olyelye ta dulu okudima po omatimba, ke fi umwe aeke, Kalunga?”
Jesus okwe shi koneka diva momhepo yaye kutya, vo ove lidiladilila ngaha, ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Oshike tamu diladilile eshi momitima deni?
Eshi shipu shi dule shikwao oshilipipo, okulombwela oshingudu: ‘Omatimba oye a dimwa po’, ile oku mu lombwela: ‘Fikama, kufa po olutala loye u ende?’
Ndele opo mu kale mu shi shii, Omona wOmunhu oku na epangelo okudima po omatimba kombada yedu,” okwa tya koshingudu:
“Ohandi ku lombwele: Fikama, kufa po olutala loye ove u ye keumbo leni.”
Ye okwa fikama, a kufa po diva olutala laye, ndele okwa ya pondje moipafi yaaveshe, aveshe ova kumwa, va hambelela Kalunga ndele tava ti: “Oinima i fike apa inatu i mona nale.”
Ndele okwa shuna kefuta nongudu aishe yovanhu ye uya kuye, ndele te va longo.
Ndele mokukoyelela po Ye okwa mona po Levi yaAlfeus, e li omutumba pongulu yomafutilo opeengaba, ndele okwa tya kuye: “Shikule nge.” Ye okwa fikama ndele te mu shikula.
Ndele opa ningwa, eshi a li omutumba poshililo meumbo laye, ovafutifi novalunde vahapu ova lya yo pamwe naJesus novalongwa vaye, osheshi ovo ve mu shikula, ova li po vahapu.
Ndele ovanongo vomishangwa vomOvafarisai eshi ve mu mona ta li pamwe novafendelifi novalunde, ova tya kovalongwa vaye: “Oha li pamwe novafendelifi novalunde?”
Jesus eshi e di uda, okwa tya kuvo: “Ava ve li nawa, itava pumbwa omuveluli, ovanaudu ovo tuu aveke. Ame inandi uya okwiifana ovayuki, ndelenee ovalunde.”
Ovalongwa vaJohannes novOvafarisai ova li po have lidilike oikulya. Vo ove uya ndele ova tya kuye: “Ovalongwa vaJohannes novOvafarisai ohave lidilike oikulya, oshike ovalongwa voye ihave lidilike?”
Jesus okwe va lombwela: “Ookaume komuhomboli ihava dulu ndishi okulidilika oikulya fimbo omuhomboli e li puvo. Fimbo ve na omuhomboli mokati kavo, itava shiiva okulidilika oikulya.
Ndele omafiku tae uya nomuhomboli te va kufwa, heeno, efiku olo otave ke lidilika oikulya.
“Kape na ou ta vandeke oshikutu shikulu noshivando shipe. Ngeenge te shi ningi, oshivando shipe otashi pombaula po oshikutu, ndele ombululu tai ningi inene i dule yonale.
Ndele kaku na ou ta dili omaviinyu mape momakutu makulu, ndelenee ngeenge, ongaha omaviinyu otaa pombaula omakutu, nomaviinyu otaa hepa ashike. Ndelenee omaviinyu mape naa ye momakutu mape.”
Ndele opa ningwa, eshi a taulula momapya, efiku lEshabata, ovalongwa ova hovela okuteya omasha mokweenda kwavo.
Opo Ovafarisai ova tya kuye: “Tala, oshike tava ningi eshi sha kelelwa mefiku lEshabata?”
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Nye inamu lesha mboli David eshi a ningile, eshi kwa li a hepa nokwa fya ondjala, ye mwene naavenya va li puye?
Nhumbi a ya mongulu yaKalunga pefimbo lomupristeli omukulunhu Abjatar, ndele ta li omingome detaliko inadi pitikwa okuliwa kwaava vehe fi ovapristeli nonhumbi e di pa ava va li puye?”
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Eshabata ola shitilwa omunhu, hamunhu a shitilwa Eshabata.
Hano osho ngaha Omona wOmunhu Oye mwene wEshabata.”
3: Ye okwa ya vali moshinagoga, ndele mo omwa li omulumenhu e neke la kukuta.
Ndele vo ove mu nangela va tale ngeenge te mu velula efiku lEshabata, opo va dule oku mu hokololifa.
Ye okwa lombwela omulumenhu ou e neke la kukuta: “Fikama, u ehene oku.”
Ndele okwa tya kuvenya: “Osho inashi kelelwa efiku lEshabata oshilipipo: okulonga ouwa ile okulonga owii? Okuxupifa omwenyo ile oku u dipaa?” Ndele vo ova mwena.
Opo nee Ye okwa keuka e va tala nehandu, okwa nyika oluhodi omolwoukukutu womitima davo, ndele okwa tya komulumenhu ou: “Nana eke loye.” Ye okwe li nana, ndele eke laye ola veluka.
Ovafarisai ova dja mo, ndele ove mu kundafana diva nOvakwaherodes nokutya, ve mu dipae.
Ndele Jesus okwa ya vali novalongwa vaye komunghulo wefuta novanhu vahapu vomuGalilea novomuJudea ove mu shikula.
Nosho yo muJerusalem nomuIdumea nolanghele kwinya yaJordan nomoshikandjo shaTirus naSidon omwa dja ovanhu vahapu ve uya kuye, eshi va uda osho ashishe a ninga.
Ye okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye ve mu diininine okawato popepi omolwongudu yovanhu, ihe mu fininike.
Osheshi Ye okwa velula vahapu, onghee aveshe ovo ve nouyehame, ove lifininika va ehene kuye ve mu kume.
Neemhepo da nyata eshi de mu mona, oda wila poshi koshipala shaye, ndele tadi ingida tadi ti: “Oove Omona waKalunga.”
Ye okwe di hanyena neenghono, dihe mu holole.
Ye okwa londa komhunda, ndele okwa ifana kuye ava Ye mwene a hala, ndele vo ove uya kuye.
Ye okwa tula po ava omulongo navavali, ovo e va luka ovayapostoli, va kale puye, Ye e va tume, va ka udife,
ndele va kale ve nepangelo lokuta mo eendemoni.
Ndelenee ava omulongo navavali e va tula po, ovava: Simon, ou e mu luka Petrus,
naJakob yaSebedeus naJohannes, ondenge yaJakob, ovo e va luka Boanerges, tali ti: Ovana vengungumo lodula,
naAndreas naFilippus naBartolomeus naMateus naTomas naJakob yaAlfeus naTadeus naSimon omuladi,
naJudas Iskariot, oye tuu ou e mu kengelela.
Ye okwe uya keumbo. Ndele opa li pa ongala vali ovanhu vahapu unene, onghee inava dula okulya omungome.
Ndele vakwao eshi ve mu uda, ova ya ko ve ke mu kwate, osheshi okwa tiwa: “Ota i eenghwengu.”
Novanongo vomishangwa ovo va dja kuJerusalem ova tya: “Ye oku kwetiwe kuBelsebul, neendemoni ote di te mo neenghono domukulunhu weendemoni.”
Ye okwe va ifana kuye ndele okwe va lombwela momafaneko ta ti: “Satana ota dulu ngahelipi okuta mo Satana mukwao?”
Ndele ngeenge ku noshilongo tashi litwile ondubo, oshilongo osho itashi kala po vali.
Neumbo ngeenge tali litwile ondubo, eumbo olo itali kala po vali.
NaSatana ngeenge te lihangakene, ndele te litwile ondubo, oye ke na vali eenghono okukala po, ota xulu po.
“Ndele kape na ou ta dulu okuya meumbo lomunaenghono noku mu luwa oinima yaye, ngeenge ina manga tete omunaenghono ou, opo nee te mu lu eumbo laye.
“Oshili handi mu lombwele: ashishe otashi diminwa po ovana vovanhu: omatimba nomasheko, nande a kale mahapu unene.
Ndelenee ou ta sheke Omhepo Iyapuki, oye ke nekufilo lomatimba fiyo alushe, osheshi ye oku na oushima wetimba laalushe.”
Osheshi vo ova tya: Oye e kwetiwe komhepo ya nyata.
Ina novamwaina ove uya po, va li ofika pondje, ndele tava tumu kuye tave mu ifana.
Ndele ongudu yovanhu oya li omutumba ye mu ongalela, ndele oye mu lombwela tai ti: “Tala, nyoko novamwanyoko ove li pondje tave ku kongo.”
Ye okwe va nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Meme novamwameme oolyelye?”
Ndele okwa tala ava va li omutumba puye okwa tya: “Tala, meme novamwameme ovava.
Osheshi ou ta wanifa ehalo laKalunga, oye omumwatate nomumwameme nameme.”
4: Ndele Ye okwa hovela vali okulonga ovanhu pomunghulo wefuta. Nongudu inene oya ongala puye, onghee okwa ya mowato, a li omutumba muyo mefuta nongudu aishe oya li poukukutu pomunghulo wefuta.
Ye okwe va longa oinima ihapu momafaneko ndele mokulonga kwaye okwa tya kuvo:
“Pwilikineni: Tala, omukuni okwa pita a ka kune.
Ndele mokukuna kwaye dimwe oda wila mondjila, needila de uya ndele tadi di shomona po.
Ndele dimwe oda wila poluma pehe na edu lihapu, ndele oda mena divadiva, osheshi edu ola li lixupi.
Ndele etango eshi la pita, oda lemba ndele oda fya po, osheshi oda li dihe na omidi.
Ndele dimwe oda wila meeshosholo, neeshosholo dakula tadi di fininike, ndele inadi dala sha.
Ndele dimwe oda wila medu liwa, oda mena, da kula, ndele oda dala fiyo omilongo nhatu, nomilongo hamano, nefele.”
Ye okwa tya: “Ou e na omatwi okuuda, na ude ko.”
Ndele eshi a li po Oye aeke, opo nee ovo va li pamwe naavo omulongo navavali, ve mu ongalela, ove mu pula omafaneko aa.
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Nye omwa pewa okushiiva oshiholekwa shouhamba waKalunga, ndele venya vopondje otava pewa aishe momafaneko,
opo va kale ve wete ko, vo vaha koneke, opo va kale nokuuda, ndele vehe udite ko, opo vehe lidilulule, novaha diminwe po omatimba avo.”
Okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Nye kamu udite ko efaneko eli, hano otamu udu ko ngahelipi omafaneko makwao aeshe?
Omukuni ota kunu ondjovo.
Odo da wila mondjila, ovava hava kunwa eendjovo, ndele fimbo tava pwilikine, Satana te uya divadiva, ndele ta kufa mo eendjovo da kunwa muvo.
Naadi da kunwa poluma ovava tava tambula eendjovo nehafo shimha tuu ve di udu.
Ndele vo vehe na omidi muvo vene, ndele ovo ovana vokafimbo, ndele ngeenge tava hangika koudjuu ile tava hepekelwa eendjovo, otave di efa.
Ndele dimwe odo da kunwa mokati keeshosholo, ovava tava udu eendjovo,
ndele oshisho shounyuni ou nepukifo loupuna, nakeshe tuu okahalu take uya mo ndele taka fininike eendjovo, ndele tadi kala oifete.
Ndele odo da kunwa medu liwa, ovava tava udu eendjovo, ndele tave di tambula, ndele tava dala oilya lwomilongo nhatu, lwomilongo hamano nolwefele.”
Ye okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Olamba itai etwa mo, ndishi, i pwipwikwe oshimbale, ile i tulwe koshi yomutala, itai tulwa mbela moshikwatelo?
Osheshi kaku na osho sha holekwa, itashi ka hololwa, naasho sha hondama, itashi ka holoka.
Ou e nomatwi okuuda, na ude ko.”
Ndele okwe va lombwela: “Didilikeni nawa osho hamu shi pwilikine, oshiyelekifo osho tamu shi yelekifa, nanye otamu shi yelekifwa, ndele tamu shoshelwa ko.
Osheshi ou e kwete, ye ota pewa, ndele ou ehe na, ye ota kufwa naasho e shi kwete.”
Ye okwa tya: “Ouhamba waKalunga owa fa omunhu a kuna ombuto medu,
ndele ta kofa ndele ta penduka oufiku nomutenya, ombuto otai mene, ndele tai kulu, ye mwene ehe shii nhumbi tai ningi.
Osheshi edu olo vene tali eta oilya, tete omino, ndele tadi shikulwa komutwe neemuma da kola komutwe.
Noilya ngeenge ya pya, ota tumu ko diva oshikashulifo, osheshi eteyo ola fika.”
Ye okwa tya: “Ouhamba waKalunga ohatu u fanekifa nashike ndele hatu u yeleke nefaneko lilipipo?
Owa fa ombuto yoshinapi, oyo pakukala i li okambuto kanini ke dulike keembuto adishe dokombada yedu.
Ashike ngeenge ya kunwa, ohai mene, ndele tai i pombada i dule oimeno aishe, ndele tai ningi oitai yakula needila dokoshi yeulu ohadi tungile momudile wayo.”
Nomafaneko makwao mahapu a fa aa okwe va lombwela eendjovo opaenghono davo dokuuda.
Ndele odo dihe fi domafaneko ine di va lombwela. Ndele ovalongwa vaye okwe va fatululila adishe, eshi ve ke likalela.
Hano eshi kwa ninga onguloshi yefiku tuu olo, okwa tya kuvo: “Tu yaukileni komunghulo winya.”
Ndele va lekela ongudu yovanhu, ndele ova dja ko naye, ngaashi a li mowato. Eewato dimwe da enda pamwe naye.
Ndele okwa dja omhepo idjuu nomakufikufi e lidenga mowato, hanga ya yada omeva.
Ndele Ye mwene okwa hangika mowato konima, ndele okwa kofa poshiwilo. Vo ove mu pendula ndele tava ti kuye: “Omuhongi, mboli Ove ku na ko nasha, eshi tu li hatu ningine mo?”
Opo Ye eshi a penduka, okwa hanyena omhepo ndele okwa lombwela efuta: “Mwena, ove u lote.” Omhepo oya lota, ndele okwa tya filu.
Okwe va lombwela: “Onye ovambada ngahelipi? Oshike muhe na eitavelo?”
Vo ova li va tila neenghono, ndele tava tongafana: “Ou olyelye hano, omhepo nefuta eshi tali dulika kuye?”
5: Ndele ove uya nee komunghulo winya wefuta, kedu lOvagerasa.
Ndele eshi tuu a dja mowato, okwa shakenekwa diva komulumenhu ta di meembila, a kwatwa komhepo ya nyata.
Ye okwa kala meembila, ndele kakwa li nande omunhu ta dulu vali oku mu manga nande onelyenge;
osheshi okwa li a mangwa luhapu nomiya nonomalyenge, ndele omalyenge okwe a tokaula, nomiya okwe di tokaula po, ndele kakwa li ou ta dulu oku mu mweneka.
Ye okwa kala alushe, oufiku nomutenya, meembila nomeemhunda, ta ingida pombada ye te lilengaula nomamanya.
Paife eshi a monena Jesus kokule, okwa tondoka, ndele ta tu eengolo koshipala shaye,
ndele okwa ingida mokule ta ti: “Owa hala shike mwaame, Jesus, Omona waKalunga, Ou wOkombadambada? Ohandi ku anene kuKalunga ino hepeka nge.”
Osheshi Ye okwe mu lombwela: “Dja mo momulumenhu, oove omhepo ya nyata.”
Jesus okwe mu pula: “Edina loye olyelye?” Oye okwa tya kuye: “Edina lange Ongudu yakula, osheshi fye otuvahapu.”
Ndele okwe mu indila neenghono, ehe di te po peenhele odo.
Ndele keemhunda oko okwa li ongudu inene yoingulu tai nape.
Odo de mu indila da tya: “Tu tuma moingulu tu ye muyo.”
Ye okwe di itavelela mo. Hano eemhepo da nyata oda dja mo muye, ndele tadi i moingulu. Nongudu yoingulu i fike pomayovi avali, oya mbolokota ko komutune mule ya wila mefuta, ndele tai file mefuta.
Ovafita vayo ova ya onhapo, ndele ove shi hepaululila moshilando nomomikunda. Ndele ovanhu ova ya va ka tale osho sha ningwa ko.
Vo ove uya kuJesus ndele ova mona ko omulumenhu ou kwa li e kwetiwe kongudu yakula, a kala omutumba a djala, ye e neendunge, ndele vo ova haluka.
Ndele ovo ve shi mona, ove va hepaululila osho sha ningilwa omunhu ou a li e kwetiwe komhepo ya nyata, noingulu nhumbi ya ningwa.
Ndelenee vo ova hovela okwiindila Jesus a dje mo momukunda wavo.
Hano Ye eshi ta i mowato, ou a dja eemhepo dii, okwe mu indila a dule okukala puye.
Ndelenee Jesus okwe mu anya, ndele ta ti kuye: “Inda keumbo kovakweni, ove u va hepaululile, Omwene nhumbi e ku ningila oilonga inene, ndele te ku filonghenda.”
Ye okwa ya ko ndele okwa hovela okuudifa muDekapolis oilonga inene e i ningilwa kuJesus opo i fike, ndele aveshe ova kumwa.
Jesus eshi a shuna komunghulo wokombinga inya yefuta nowato, ongudu inene yovanhu oya ongala puye. Ye okwa li pomunghulo wefuta.
Ndele taku di umwe womovakulunhu voshinagoga, edina laye Jairus, ndele eshi e mu mona, okwa wila poshi keemhadi daye,
Ndele okwe mu indila neenghono ta ti: “Okamwange okakadona otaka vele unene, ila, ove u ka tenheke omake ka veluke, ko ka kale ke nomwenyo.”
Ye okwa ya pamwe naye. Ovanhu vahapu ove mu shikula ndele ove mu fininika.
Ndele okwa li ku nomukainhu, a li a vela etiko lohonde eedula omulongo nambali.
Nokwe lihepeka shili neendudu dihapu, ndele ta manene mo emona laye alishe, ndelenee ina mona ekwafo, ndele oudu owa ya ashike komesho neenghono.
Ye eshi a kundana Jesus, okwe uya mongudu yovanhu e li konima yaye, ndele ta kumu koshikutu shaye,
osheshi ye okwa tya: “Shimha tuu nda kumu koshikutu shaye ohandi veluka.”
Opo tuu opo etiko lohonde laye ola oka, ndele oku udite molutu laye a veluka koudu waye.
Ndele Jesus eshi e udite muye mwa dja eenghono, okwa pungulukila mokati kovanhu ndele ta ti: “Olyelye a kuma koshikutu shange?”
Ovalongwa vaye ova tya kuye: “Ove ou wete ovanhu tave ku fininike, ndele to ti: ‘Olyelye a kuma nge?’ ”
Ndele Ye okwa li ta keuka a mone ou e shi ninga.
Omukainhu okwa kala a tila ndele ta kakama, osheshi okwa li e shi shii nhumbi a ningilwa, okwe uya ndele ta wile komesho yaye, ndele te mu hepaululile oshili aishe.
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Omumwangekadona, eitavelo loye ole ku velula. Inda nombili, ove u kale wa veluka koudu woye.”
Fimbo ta popi okwa dja ovanhu komukulunhu woshinagoga tava ti: “Omumwoyekadona okwa fya, oshike to lolokifa vali omuhongi?”
Ndele Jesus ina pwilikina eendjovo odo da popiwa, ndele okwa lombwela omukulunhu woshinagoga: “Ino tila, shimha wa itavela.”
Ndele Ye ina itavela nande omunhu a ye mo pamwe naye, oPetrus naJakob naJohannes, ondenge yaJakob, ovo aveke.
Vo ove uya keumbo lomukulunhu woshinagoga. Ndele Ye okwa mona ko ovanhu tava uyaana, ndele tava kwena ndele tava takuma.
Hano eshi a ya mo okwa tya kuvo: “Oshike tamu uyaana ndele tamu kwena? Okaana inaka fya, oka kofa.”
Vo ove mu yola. Ndele okwa ta mo aveshe, a kufa xe naina yokaana naava va li pamwe naye, ndele okwa ya omo mwa nangala okaana.
Ndele okwa kwata eke lokaana, ndele okwa tya kuko: “Talita kuum.” Otashi ti: okakadona, ohandi ku lombwele, penduka.
Okakadona oka penduka diva, ndele taka ende, osheshi okwa li ke nomido omulongo nambali. Vo va kwatwa kehaluko linene.
Ndele Ye okwe va kumaida shili, vehe shi lombwele nande olyelye, ndele okwe va lombwela ve ka pe oikulya.
6: Ndele Ye okwa dja oko, ta i moshilando shambulavo, novalongwa vaye ove mu shikula.

Ndele Eshabata eshi le uya, okwa hovela okulonga ovanhu moshinagoga nomoku mu pwilikina vahapu ova kumwa va tya: “Ei e i kwete oyapeni, nounongo ou e u pewa owa tya ngahelipi? Noilonganghono ei tai longwa komake aye oi fike peni?
Ke fi omuhongi womiti winya, omona waMaria nomumwaina waJakob naJoses naJudas naSimon? Novamwaina ovakainhu havo ovo ve li mokati ketu?” Ndele vo ove mu yala.
Opo nee Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Omuxunganeki iha dinwa pamwe pe lili, omoshilando tuu shambulavo, nomovakwao nomeumbo lavo.”
Ye ina dula okulonga ko oko nande oshilonganghono, ovanaudu vamwe aveke e va tenheka omake aye ndele te va velula.

Ndele Ye okwa kuminwa okuhaitavela kwavo.
Opo nee Ye okwa li ta endaenda momikunda, ndele ta longo ovanhu.
Opo nee Ye okwa ifana ovo omulongo navavali ve uye kuye nokwa hovela oku va tuma oovavali noovavali, ndele okwe va pa eenghono okupangela eemhepo da nyata.
Oye okwe va lombwela vaha ye ko nasha kondjila, onhaili aike, hamungome ile ekutu ile oimaliwa mondjato.
Ndelenee ova efelwa va djale eenghaku, ndele haikutu ivali.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Keshe meumbo omo tamu i mo, kaleni mo fiyo otamu ka ehena komesho.
Ndele oko itamu tambulwa ko, nye itamu pwilikinwa, djeni ko nye mu pupule ondwi koshi yeemhadi deni, i ninge ondobwedi kuvo.”
Ndele ova ya, ndele va udifa nokutya, ovanhu ve nokulidilulula.
Ova ta mo eendemoni dihapu ndele va vaeka ovanaudu vahapu nomaadi, ndele ove va velula.
Ohamba Herodes okwe mu kundana, osheshi edina laJesus ola shiivika novanhu ova tya: “Johannes Omushashi okwa nyumuka koufi, onghee eenghono odo otadi longo muye.”
Ndele vamwe ova tya: Oye Elia. Vamwe ova tya: Oye omuxunganeki ngaashi umwe womovaxunganeki.
Ndele Herodes eshi e shi uda okwa tya: “Johannes ou nde mu tetifa omutwe, oye a nyumuka koufi.”
Osheshi Herodes okwa tumine ko, a kwatifa Johannes nokwe mu mangifa, ndele okwe mu idililifa modolongo omolwaHerodias, omukainhu wondenge yaye Filippus. Osheshi Herodes okwe mu hombola.
Osheshi Johannes okwa tile kuHerodes: “Ito dulu okukala nomukainhu wondenge yoye, osheshi oshidila.”
Herodias okwe mu kwatela onghone ndele okwa kala a hala oku mu dipaa, ndele okwa nyengwa.

Osheshi Herodes okwa tila Johannes, eshi a li e mu shii, oye omulumenhu omuyuki nomuyapuki, ndele okwe mu amena. Ndele moku mu pwilikina okwa limbililwa koinima ihapu, ndele okwa hokwa oku mu pwilikina.
Hano efiku la wapala le ke uya, Herodes eshi a ningila omalenga aye novaneyovi novakulunhu vomuGalilea oshivilo shefiku ledalo laye.

Nomona okakadona kaHerodias oke uya mo, ndele taka tula po oudano, ndele wo owa wapalela unene Herodes novaenda vaye. Ohamba oya tya kokakadona: “Indile nge keshe osho wa hala ndele ohandi shi ku pe.”
Ndele ye okwa anena okakadona: “Keshe eshi to shi indile nge, ohandi shi ku pe, nande etata loshilongo shange.”
Ko oka pita pondje, ndele oka tya kuina: “Ohandi indile shike?” Ye okwa nyamukula: “Omutwe waJohannes Omushashi.”
Ko oka ya mo diva taka endelele ke uye kohamba, ke mu indila ndele taka ti: “Ame onda hala u pe nge paife eshi omutwe waJohannes Omushashi moshiyaxa.”
Ohamba oya nyika oluhodi linene, ndele omolweano layo novaenda inai hala oku shi ka anyena.
Diva ohamba oya tuma ko omukwaita, ndele okwe mu lombwela a ete omutwe waJohannes. Ou okwa ya ndele okwe mu teta omutwe modolongo,
ndele okwa eta omutwe waye moshiyaxa, ndele okwe u pa okakadona, okakadona oke u pa ina.
Ovalongwa vaye eshi ve shi uda, ove uya ndele tava kufa po oshimhu shaye, ndele tave shi pake mombila.
Ndele ovayapostoli ova ongala puJesus, ndele tave mu hepaululile aishe, keshe osho ve shi ninga nakeshe osho ve shi longa.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Ileni tu ke likaleleni koima kwe likalela, nye mu tulumukwe po kanini.” Osheshi okwa li ku na vahapu ava tave uya notava di po, ndele kava li vehe na nande efimbo lokulya.
Ndele ova ya nowato okoima oko kwe likalela, mouwike.
Ndele vahapu ove va mona eshi tava i, navahapu ove shi kundana nove mu shikula kolupadi nokweendelela va dja koilando aishe, ndele vo tava fiki ko tete.
Ndele eshi a fika koukukutu, okwa mona ko ovanhu vahapu, ndele okwe va udila olukeno, osheshi ova li va fa eedi dihe na omufita, ndele okwa hovela oku va longa oinima ihapu.
Ndele etango eshi la toka, ovalongwa ove uya kuye tava ti: “Poima apa omombuwa yongaho, ndele paife etango la toka.
Va lekela va ye komaumbo nokomikunda, ve ke lilandele oikulya.”
Ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Va peni oikulya.” Vo ova tya kuye: “Natu ke va landele omingome deedenari omafele avali, fye tu va pe va lye?”
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Nye omu na omingome ngapi? Indeni mu ka tale.” Eshi ve ke di tala, ova tya: “Odi li ko nhano neeshi mbali.”
Opo Ye okwe va lombwela, va kale omutumba eengudu neengudu de likalela pomwiidi mutalala.
Ndele ova kala omutumba eengudu neengudu da shaama, dimwe odefele, dimwe odomilongo nhano.

Ye okwa kufa omingome odo nhano neeshi mbali, okwa tala keulu, okwa pandula, ndele ta pambula omingome ndele te di pe ovalongwa vaye, ve di tukulile ovanhu, neeshi odo mbali okwe di tukulila yo aveshe.
Ndele aveshe ova lya, va kuta.
Ndele va toola oundjaumukile vomingome oimbale omulongo naivali i yadi neeshi yo.
Naava va lya omingome edi ova li ovalumenhu omayovi atano.
Ndele Ye okwa fininika diva ovalongwa vaye va ye mowato, vo va tetekele komunghulo wokombinga inya, kuBetsaida, fimbo Ye mwene ta lekele ovanhu.
Ye eshi e va lekela, okwa londa komhunda a ka indile.
Ndele eshi kwa laula, owato oya li mokati kefuta, oYe aeke a li kedu.
Ndele eshi kwa li e va wete ve noudjuu mokuduwa kwavo, shaashi omhepo ye va dja komesho, okwe uya kuvo, penangelo etine loufiku ta ende kombada yomeva, ndele okwa li a hala oku va koyelela po.
Ndele vo eshi ve mu mona ta ende kombada yomeva, ova li ve shii Ye oshilulu, ndele tava ingida pombada.
Osheshi aveshe ve mu mona nova haluka. Ndele divadiva okwe va popifa, a tya kuvo: “Kaleni nomwenyo muwa, Aame ou, inamu tila.”
Ye okwa ya kuvo mowato, ndele omhepo oya mwena. Ndele vo ova halukilila meni lavo.
Osheshi vo inava ninga eendunge nopomingome dinya, ndele omitima davo oda li da kukuta.
Ndele eshi va taulukila kwinya, ove uya kuGenesaret ndele tava ehenifa owato poshau.
Eshi va dja mo mowato, ovanhu ove mu koneka diva.
Ndele vo ova kala nokutondoka noshikandjo ashishe, ndele tava hovele okuhumbata ovanaudu komalutala, eshi va uda apa e li.
Ndele keshe oko a ya, komikunda ile koilando ile komaumbo, ovanaudu ova tulwa poilandelo, ndele Ye okwa indilwa va shiive nande okukuma kominghulo doshikutu shaye. Aveshe ava ve mu kuma, ova veluka.
7: Opo nee puye opa ongala Ovafarisai novanongo vomishangwa vamwe, va dile kuJerusalem.
Ndele eshi va mona ovalongwa vaye vamwe va lya omungome nomake inaa yela, okutya, inaa koshwa, ove va tala va nyona.
Osheshi Ovafarisai nOvajuda aveshe ihava li fimbo inava kosha shili omake avo nokudiinina eenghulunghedi dovakulunhu vonale.
Ndele ngeenge va dja koshilandelo, ihava li manga inave likosha; neenghedi dimwe dihapu hava diinine okuwanifa, ongaashi okukosha omaholo noitoo noiyaxa yongopolo.
Ovafarisai novanongo vomishangwa ove mu pula: “Oshike ovalongwa voye ihava diinine eenghulunghedi dovakulunhu, ndele hava li nomake inaa koshoka?”

Ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Jesaja okwe mu xunganekela da twa, nye ovanaihelele, ngaashi kwa shangwa: ‘Oshiwana eshi ohashi fimaneke nge nomilungu,
ndele omitima dasho odi li kokule naame.

Ndelenee ohava fimaneke nge hamungaho
nokulonga omalongo oipango yovanhu.’
Otamu ekeleshi oshipango shaKalunga, nye tamu diinine eenghulunghedi dovanhu ngaashi hamu diinine omakosho eenheka nomaholo, nohamu longo vali shi lili sha fa eshi.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Eewa, ohamu ekeleshi oshipango shaKalunga, mu diinine eenghulunghedi deni.
Shaashi Moses okwa tile: ‘Fimaneka xo nanyoko,’ na: ‘Ou ta tuku xe ile ina, oye na fye okufya.’
Ndele nye ohamu ti: Omunhu ngeenge ta ti kuxe ile kuina: ‘Osho wa li u noku shi pewa kwaame ekwafo, osho Korban’, nokutya, oshali kotembeli.
Opo nee itamu efa vali a kwafe xe ile ina.
Osho ngaha hamu dimi po eendjovo daKalunga konghulunghedi yeni mwe i dika. Naikwao ihapu ngaashi ei hamu i ningi.”
Ndele Ye okwa ifana vali ovanhu ve uye kuye, ndele okwe va lombwela: “Udeni nge amushe, nye mu didilike.
Kape na eshi shokombada tashi i momunhu, tashi mu nyateke, eshi tashi di momunhu, osho tashi mu nyateke.
Ngeenge oku na ou e nomatwi okuuda, ye na ude ko.”
Ndele eshi a tukuka novanhu ndele a ya meumbo lonhumba, ovalongwa vaye ove mu pula efaneko olo nhumbi tali ti.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Hamba, nanye yo kamu na eendunge? Kamu udite ko mboli? Keshe osho shokombada hashi i momunhu, ihashi mu nyateke.
Osheshi osho itashi i momutima waye, ndelenee omedimo, ndele tashi piti mo panghedi youshitwe.” Osho ngaha a tonga kutya, oikulya aishe oya koshoka.
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Osho hashi di momunhu, osho tashi mu nyateke.
Osheshi meni, momitima dovanhu, ohamu di omadiladilo mai, ohole yoipala, oulunga, edipao,
enyono lohombo, olwisho, onyanya, ekotokelo, oihole, efupa, eshekokalunga, elinenepeko, oupwidi.
Owii aushe ou tau di meni lomunhu, ndele tau nyateke omunhu.”
Ndele Ye okwa dja ko oko, okwa ya komikunda daTirus naSidon. Ndele Ye okwa ya meumbo lonhumba, ndele ina hala shi shiivike kovanhu. Ndele okwa nyengwa okuhondama.
Osheshi diva omukainhu umwe, e nokanona okakadona ke kwetiwe komhepo ya nyata, eshi e mu uda kutya, okwe uya po, okwa wila poshi keemhadi daye.
Ndele omukainhu ou a li Omugreka, a dalelwa moshikandjo shaFoinikia shomuSiria, okwe mu indila a te mo ondemoni momona okakadona.
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Efa ounona va kute tete, osheshi inashi wapala okukufa omungome wounona noku u ekela keembwena.”
Ndele ye okwe mu lombwela a tya: “Heeno, Omwene, eembwena ohadi li koshi yoshitaafula shoshililo oundjaumukile vounona.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya komukainhu: “Omolwondjovo ei, inda, ondemoni oya dja mo momumwoye okakadona.”
Ye okwa ya keumbo nokwa hanga okaana ka nangala komutala, ondemoni oya dja mo muko.
Ndele Ye okwa dja ko vali komikunda daTirus nokupitila muSidon, ndele okwa ya kefuta laGalilea, ta ende mokati kaDekapolis.
Ndele ova eta kuye omufitamatwi ehe shii okupopya nawa, nove mu indila a tenheke eke laye kuye.
Ndele Ye okwe mu kufa movanhu, a twa ominwe daye momatwi aye, a fiya omate, ndele ta kumu elaka laye.
Ndele okwa tala keulu, ta fuda mokule ndele ta ti: “Efata!” nokutya: “Fituluka!”
Omatwi aye a fituluka nelaka laye la manguluka ndele ta popi nawa.
Ye okwe va kelela vehe shi lombwele nande omunhu, ndele nande okwe shi va kelela shili nokukumaida, ove shi hepaulula.
Ovanhu ova haluka unene va tya: “Aishe okwe i ninga nawa, ovafitamatwi ohe va udifa ko novafitandaka ohe va ningi va popye.”
8: Pomafiku enya ongudu inene yovanhu eshi ya ongalela puye vali, ndele ova li vehe na eshi tava li, Jesus okwa ifana ovalongwa vaye ndele ta ti kuvo:
“Ovanhu ava ondi va uditile olukeno, osheshi ova menekela pwaame omafiku atatu, vo vehe na eshi tava li.
Ndele ngeenge handi va lekele va ye komaumbo avo inava lya, otava ka pundila mondjila, osheshi vamwe vomuvo ova dile kokule.”
Ndele ovalongwa vaye ove mu nyamukula: “Otapa monika peni oikulya mombuwa omu okupalula ovanhu ava?”
Ye okwe va pula: “Nye omu na po omingome ngapi?” Vo ova tya: “Heyali.”
Ndele Ye okwa lombwela ovanhu va kale omutumba poshi. Okwa kufa omingome odo heyali, ndele ta pandula, ndele te di pe ovalongwa vaye, ve di yandje kovanhu. Ndele ve di yandja keengudu.
Ndele vo ova li yo ve na oushi vamwe, ndele eshi e va nangeka noupuna, okwa lombwela yo va pewe ovanhu.
Ndele vo ova lya ndele tava kuta. Ndele ova toola oundjaumukile oimbale iheyali.
Ndele ava va lya ova li hanga ve fike pomayovi ane. Ndele Ye okwe va lekela.
Ndele diva okwa ya novalongwa vaye mowato, nova ya komukunda waDalmanuta.
Ovafarisai ova ya ko ndele ova hovela okutwa eemhata naye, ndele ve mu pula edidiliko lokeulu, ve mu yeleke.
Ye okwa fuda mokule momhepo yaye, ndele ta ti: “Epupi eli oshike tali pula edidiliko? Oshili handi mu lombwele: epupi eli itali pewa edidiliko.”
Ndele Ye okwe va fiya po ndele okwa ya vali mowato, ndele okwa yaukila komunghulo winya.
Ndele ova li va dimbwa okudja ko nomingome, omungome umwe auke va li ve u kwete mowato.
Ye okwe va londwela a tya: “Taleni, likeleleni konhafi yOvafarisai nokonhafi yaHerodes.”
Vo ova mbeleka tava ti: “Shiimba, osheshi tuhe na omingome.”
Jesus eshi e shi koneka, okwa tya kuvo: “Oshike tamu popi kutya, kamu na omingome? Nopaimhe inamu koneka, nye kamu udite ko? Omitima deni oda kukuta natango?
Omesho omu a kwete, nye kamu wete ko, nomatwi omu a kwete, nye ihamu udu ko? Nye inamu dimbulukwa,
eshi nda pambulilile ovalumenhu omayovi atano omingome dinya nhano, oimbale ingapi ya li i yadi mwa toolele oundjaumukile?” Vo ova tya: “Omulongo naivali.”
“Eshi nda pambulilile omayovi ane omingome dinya heyali, oimbale ingapi ya li i yadi mwa toolelele oundjaumukile?” Vo ova tya: “Iheyali.”
Ye okwe va lombwela: “Mboli natango kamu udite ko.”
Ndele ove uya kuBetsaida. Ndele Ye okwa etelwa omupofi, ndele ove mu indila e mu kume.
Ye okwa kwata omupofi keke, ndele okwe mu twala pondje yoshilando. Ndele Ye okwe mu fiila omate momesho nokwa tenheka omake aye kuye ndele te mu pula: “Ou wete sha?”
Ndele ou okwa yelula omesho, ndele ta ti: “Ondi wete ovanhu, osheshi ondi va wete va fa omiti tadi ende.”
Ye okwa tenhukulula omake aye komesho aye. Omulumenhu okwa kala e wetelele ko, a twikuluka. Ye okwa li e wete aishe, nokokule, ngaashi i li.
Ye okwe mu tuma keumbo, ndele okwa tya: “Ino ya momukunda ndele ino shi hepaululila nande umwe womomukunda.”
Ndele Jesus okwa ya novalongwa vaye komikunda daKesarea Filippi. Mondjila okwa pula ovalongwa vaye, a tya kuvo: “Ovanhu ohava tile nge ngahelipi, Aame lyelye?”
Ove mu nyamukula va tya: “OJohannes Omushashi, ndele vamwe: oElia, navamwe vali: Oumwe womovaxunganeki.”
Ndele Ye okwe va pula: “Nye otamu ti ngahelipi, Aame lyelye?” Petrus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Oove Kristus.”
Ye okwe va kumaida neenghono, vehe mu popye nande okulyelye.

Ndele Ye a hovela oku va longa, Omona wOmunhu nhumbi e nokuhepekwa shili, ndele ta ka ekelwashi kovakulunhu nokovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovanongo vomishangwa, ota ka dipawa, ndele ngeenge pa piti omafiku atatu, ota ka nyumuka koufi.
Ndele Ye okwe shi popya, ina holeka. Petrus okwe mu ifana ve ke likalele ndele ta hovele oku mu hanyena.
Ndele Ye okwa punguluka ta tale kovalongwa vaye, ndele okwa hanyena Petrus ta ti: “Inda konima yange, Satana, osheshi ove ito diladila eshi shaKalunga, ndelenee osheshi shovanhu.”
Ndele okwa ifana ovanhu novalongwa vaye ve uye kuye, ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Ngeenge oku na ou a hala okushikula nge, ne lidimbike ye mwene, ndele na humbate omushiyakano waye, ye na shikule nge.
Osheshi ou a hala okuxupifa omwenyo waye, ote ke u kanifa, ndele ou ta kanifa omwenyo waye molwange nomolwevaengeli, ye ote u xupifa.
Osheshi otashi kwafa shike omunhu nande ne lilikolele ounyuni aushe, ndele ta kanifa omwenyo waye?
Osheshi omunhu ota yandje shike mbela, a kulile omwenyo waye?

Osheshi ou ta fi ohoni molwange nomolweendjovo dange mokati kepupi eli lovanyoni vohombo noloulunde, naye tuu ou nOmona wOmunhu ote ke mu fya ohoni, eshi te uya moshinge shaXe pamwe novaengeli vayapuki.”
9: Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: oku na vamwe vomwaava ve li ofika apa itava makele efyo, fimbo inava mona ouhamba waKalunga tau uya neenghono dao.”
Omafiku ahamano eshi a pita po, Jesus okwa kufa Petrus naJakob naJohannes, ndele okwe va twala komhunda ile, ve ke likalele mouwike. Ndele Ye okwa shituka moipafi yavo.
Ndele oikutu yaye ya ninga itoka tootoo ya vilima, nokape na omuyelifi kombada yedu ta shiiva okutokifa ngaha.
Ndele ova holokelwa kuElia naMoses, ndele vo ova popya naJesus.
Ndele Petrus okwa hovela okupopya ndele ta ti kuJesus: “Rabbi, poima apa ope tu wapalela, tu dikeni po hano omatwali atatu, limwe oloye, limwe olaMoses nalimwe olaElia.”
Ndele kakwa li e shii eshi ta ti, osheshi ova haluka.
Ndele ope uya oshilemo she va tuvikila, nomoshilemo omwa dja ondaka ya tya: “Ou Omona wange omuholike, mu udeni.”
Ndele opo tuu opo, eshi va tala, va kevauka, inava mona nande umwe, oJesus aeke e li navo.
Ndele eshi tava londoloka komhunda, okwe va kumaida vaha hepaululile nande omunhu eshi ve shi mona ko, fimbo Omona wOmunhu ina nyumuka koufi.
Eendjovo odo ove di kwata nawa, ndele ova kala tava pulafana: Okunyumuka koufi mbela otaku ti ngahelipi?
Ndele ove mu pula tava ti: “Omolwashike ovanongo vomishangwa hava ti kutya, Elia oku nokuuya tete?”
Ye okwe va lombwela: “Heeno, Elia ote uya tete, ndele ta tula aishe peenhele dayo. Ndele ongahelipi hano Omona wOmunhu a tongwa momishangwa kutya, Oye e nokuhepekwa nokudinwa?
Ndele ohandi mu lombwele: Elia okwe uya nee, ndele ve mu ninga osho ve shi hala, ongaashi a tongwa momishangwa.”
Ndele vo eshi ve uya kovalongwa, ove va hanga ve li mokati kovanhu vahapu, ovanongo vomishangwa tava tu eemhata navo.
Ovanhu aveshe, eshi tuu ve mu mona, ova haluka, ndele ove uya kuye nokweendelela, ndele tave mu kundu.
Ye okwe va pula: “Eemhata tamu tu navo, odashike?”
Ndele umwe womongudu okwe mu nyamukula: “Omuhongi, onda eta kwoove omumwange omumati e nomhepo ye mu fitika ondaka.
Nakeshe opo tai mu kwatele, otai mu nate po, ndele ta tutumike onhutu mokanya, ndele te likeshe, ndele ta lenduka. Hano onda lombwela ovalongwa voye ve i te mo, ndele ova nyengwa.”
Ndele Ye okwe va nyamukula a tya: “Woo, oove epupi lihe na eitavelo fiyo onaini ndi nokukala punye? Fiyo onaini ndi noku mu lididimikila? Mu eteni kwaame.”
Ndele ove mu eta kuye; ndele eshi a mona Jesus, omhepo oye mu kama, ndele ye okwe lidenga poshi, okwa alangata, ndele okwa dja onhutu mokanya.
Ndele Jesus okwa pula xe: “Okwa ninga omafiku e fike peni, eshi eshi she mu hanga tete?” Ye okwa tya: “Okounona waye.
Luhapu ye mu undulila momundilo nomomeva, i mu nyone po. Ndele Ove, ngeenge to dulu sha, tu fila onghenda, Ove u tu kwafe.”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “ ‘Ngeenge to dulu’, wa ti? Ou ta itavele, iha nyengwa kusha.”
Xe yokaana okwa ingida diva okwa tya nomahodi: “Onda itavela. Kwafa okuhaitavela kwange.”

Ndele Jesus, eshi a mona ongudu yovanhu tai uya nokweendelela, okwa hanyena omhepo ya nyata, ndele ta ti kuyo: “Omhepo ove iho popi naave iho udu, ohandi ku lombwele: Dja mo muye, ove ino uya vali muye.”
Ndele yo oya ingida, oye mu kama neenghono ndele oya dja mo. Ndele ye okwa li a fa a fya, vahapu ova tya: Okwa fya.
Ndele Jesus okwe mu kwata keke, ndele okwe mu yambula po. Ndele ye okwa fikama.
Ndele eshi a ya meumbo, ovalongwa vaye ove mu pula, eshi va li po ovo aveke: “Oshike hano fye twa nyengwa oku i ta mo?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oludi eli ihali tewa mo koshinima shi lili, okeilikano tuu alike nelidiliko.”
Ndele vo ova dja ko oko, ndele tava pitile muGalilea, ndele Ye ina hala shi shiivike nande okomunhu.

Osheshi okwa longa ovalongwa vaye, ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Omona wOmunhu ota ka yandjwa momake ovanhu, ndele ovo tave mu dipaa, ndele eshi a dipawa, ndele tapa piti omafiku atatu, ota ka nyumuka koufi.”
Ndele ova li vehe udite ko eendjovo odo, ndele ova tila oku mu pula.
Ndele ove uya kuKapernaum; naashi a li meumbo, okwe va pula: “Omwa li tamu kundafana shike mondjila?”
Ndele vo ova mwena. Osheshi mondjila ova li tava kundafana: Omukulunhu, e dule vakwao aveshe, olyelye.
Ye okwa kala omutumba, ndele ta ifana po ovo omulongo navavali, ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Ngeenge ope na ou a hala okuninga wotete, oye na ninge wahauxuuninwa nomuyakuli waaveshe.”
Oye okwa kufa okaana, ndele te ka kaleke ofika mokati kavo. Naashi e ka papatela momake aye, okwa tya kuvo:
“Ou ta tambula okaana kamwe ngaashi aka medina lange, haame ta tambula, ndelenee Oye ou a tuma nge.”
Johannes okwe mu lombwela: “Omuhongi, otwa hanga ko umwe ou, ihe tu shikula, a ta mo eendemoni medina loye, ndele fye otwe mu kelela, shaashi ihe tu shikula.”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Inamu mu kelela, osheshi kaku na ou ta longo oshilonganghono medina lange, ndele ta popile nge mowii diva.
Osheshi ou ehe na ondubo nafye, ye okwa ama kufye.
Osheshi ou ote mu nwefa omeva eholo limwe, omolwaashi nye ovaKristus, oshili handi mu lombwele: oye ita kala ina pewa ondjabi yaye.
“Naau ta hongaula umwe waava vanini va itavela nge, oshiwa kuye, a mangelwe emanya loshini mofingo yaye, ye a ekelwe mefuta.
Neke loye ngeenge tali ku hongaula, li teta ko. Okuya momwenyo oshingudu okwe ku wapalela, ku dule okukala nomake avali nokuya moheli, momundilo ihau dimi mo,
omo einyo lavo ihali fi nomundilo wamo ihau dimi.
Nomhadi yoye ngeenge tai ku hongaula, i teta ko. Okuya momwenyo u na omhadi imwe okwe ku wapalela, ku dule okukala neemhadi mbali ndele to ekelwa moheli,
omo einyo lamo ihali fi nomundilo wamo ihau dimi.
Neisho loye ngeenge tali ku hongaula, li kolola mo. Okuya mouhamba waKalunga u na eisho limwe okwe ku wapalela, ku dule okukala nomesho avali, ndele to ekelwa moheli,
omo einyo lamo ihali fi nomundilo wamo ihau dimi.
“Osheshi keshe omunhu oku na okufingwa nomundilo, neyambo keshe oli na okufingwa nomongwa.
Omongwa oo omuwa, ndele omongwa ngeenge tau tutuka, otaku fingifwa shike? Kaleni mu nomongwa munye vene, nye mu kale mu nombili mokati keni.”
10: Ndele Ye okwa dja ko oko, ndele okwa ya keengaba daJudea ta ende kombinga inya yomulonga waJordan. Ndele ovanhu vahapu ove uya vali kuye, ndele Ye okwe va longa, ngaashi ha ningi shito.
Opo nee okwa dja Ovafarisai, ve uya kuye, ve mu pula ve mu yeleke, ngeenge osha itavelwa tuu omulumenhu ta henge po omukainhu waye.
Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti kuvo: “Moses okwe mu lombwela ngahelipi?”
Ndele ova tya: “Moses okwa itavela okushanga ombapila yehengano noku mu henga.”
Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Omolwoukukutu womitima deni e mu shangela oshipango eshi.
Ndele pehovelo leshito ‘Kalunga okwe va shita omulumenhu nomukainhu.’
‘Onghee hano omulumenhu e nokufiya po xe naina nokulimangeleka komukainhu waye.
Naava vavali otava ningi omunhu umwe.’ Hano kave fi vali vavali, ndelenee omunhu umwe.
Hano eshi Kalunga e shi tula kumwe, inashi kufwa kumwe komunhu.”
Ndele eshi va ya keumbo, ovalongwa ove mu pula vali oshinima eshi.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Ou ta henge po omukainhu waye, ndele ta hombola umwe, oye ta nyono ohombo kuye.
Nomukainhu ngeenge ta henge po omulumenhu waye, ndele ta hombolwa kuumwe, ye ota nyono ohombo.”
Ndele ova eta ounona kuye e va kume, ndele ovalongwa vaye va hanyena ava ve va eta.
Ndele Jesus eshi e shi mona, okwa umana, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Efeni ounona ve uye kwaame nye inamu va kelela ko, osheshi ouhamba waKalunga owaava ve li ngaashi ava.
Oshili ohandi mu lombwele: Ou ita tambula ouhamba waKalunga ngaashi okaana ita i mo muwo.”
Ndele Ye okwe va ukata momake aye, ndele okwe va nangeka noupuna nokutenheka omake aye kuvo.
Ndele eshi a dja mo, ta i kondjila, omulumenhu umwe a tondoka e uye kuye, ndele ta tu eengolo koshipala shaye, ndele ta ti kuye: “Omuhongi muwa, ondi nokulonga shike ndi mone omwenyo waalushe?”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Oshike to tile nge ndimuwa? Kaku na umwe muwa, oKalunga aeke.
Oipango ou i shii: ‘Ino dipaa. Ino nyona ohombo. Ino vaka. Ino lundila. Ino nyeka omunhu. Fimaneka xo nanyoko.’ ”
Ye okwe mu nyamukula: “Omuhongi, aishe ei ohandi i wanifa nghee nda dja mounyashele wange.”

Jesus okwe mu tala noku mu hokwa, ndele ta ti kuye: “Shimwe she ku pumbwa: Inda u ka landife po oinima yoye aishe ei u na, ove u i yandje keehepele, ndele to kala u nemona meulu, ove u uye u shikule nge.”
Ndelenee eendjovo odo de mu ningifa okamutima kanini, ndele ta di po a nyika oluhodi, osheshi ye okwa li e noinima ihapu.
Ndele Jesus okwa keuka keembinga neembinga, ndele ta ti kovalongwa vaye: “Oipuna oi noudjuu u fike peni okuya mouhamba waKalunga.”
Ovalongwa ova halukila eendjovo daye. Ndele Jesus okwa hovela vali okupopya, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ovamwange, ava ve lineekela emona lavo, ove noudjuu u fike peni okuya mouhamba waKalunga.
Okupita kwongamelo meyulu longwiya, xwepo ku dule okuya kwoshipuna mouhamba waKalunga.”
Ndele vo ova haluka unene, ndele tava lombwelafana tava ti: “Olyelye hano ta dulu okuxupifwa?”
Jesus okwe va tala ndele ta ti: “Otashi nyenge ovanhu, ndele haKalunga, osheshi Kalunga iha nyengwa kusha.”
Opo nee Petrus okwa hovela oku mu lombwela: “Tala, fye otwa fiya po ashishe, ndele otwe ku shikula.”
Jesus okwa tya: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: Kape na ou a fiya po molwange nomolwevaengeli eumbo ile ovamwaxe ile ina ile xe ile ounona ile omapya,
ndele ye ita mono ngeno lwefele, paife mounyuni ou mokati komahepeko omaumbo novamwaina ovalumenhu novamwaxe ovakainhu nooina nounona nomapya nomounyuni tau uya omwenyo waalushe.
Ndele vahapu vokomesho otava ningi vokonima naavo vokonima otava ka ninga vokomesho.”

Ndele ova li mondjila tava i kuJerusalem, ndele Jesus okwe va kwatela komesho, ndele vo ova hangika kehaluko, naava ve va shikula ova tila. Ye okwa kufa vali ovo omulongo navavali nokwa hovela oku va lombwela eshi tashi ke mu hanga:
“Tala, ohatu i kuJerusalem, nOmona wOmunhu ota ka yandjwa momake ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa, ovo otave mu pe etimba lokufya, ndele otave mu yandje kovapaani,
vo otave mu sheke, ndele tave mu fiile omate, ndele tave mu denge neeshokoto, ndele tave mu dipaa, ndele eshi pa pita omafiku atatu, ota nyumuka koufi.”
Ndele Jakob naJohannes, ovana vaSebedeus, ova ya kuye ndele tava ti kuye: “Omuhongi, otwa hala u tu ningile eshi hatu ku indile.”
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Omwa hala ndi mu ningile shike?”
Ndele vo ova tya kuye: “Tu itavela fye tu kale omutumba umwe okolulyo loye nomukwao okolumosho loye mefimano loye.”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Kamu shi shii eshi tamu shi indile. Otamu dulu tuu okunwa eholo linya ndi noku ke li nwa, ile okushashwa neshasho linya ndi noku ke li shashwa?”
Vo ova tya: “Heeno, ohatu shi dulu.” Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Heeno, eholo linya handi ke li nwa, otamu ke li nwa neshasho linya ndi noku li shashwa, omu na oku ke li shashwa.”
Ndele okukala omutumba kolulyo lange ile kolumosho, haame handi ku yandje, otaku ningi kwaava ve ku longekidilwa.
Hano ovo omulongo eshi ve di uda, ova hovela okuumanena Jakob naJohannes.
Ndele Jesus okwe va ifana kuye, ndele okwe va lombwela: “Nye omu shi shii, ovo haku tiwa ovapangeli voiwana, otave i pangele ngoovene vayo novanene vayo tava longififa eenghonopangelo davo muyo.
Ndele eshi hasho nashi kale mokati keni. Ndelenee ou a hala a ninge munene mokati keni, ye na kale omukalele weni.
Naau womokati keni a hala a kale wokomesho, ye na kale omupiya waaveshe.
Osheshi nOmona wOmunhu ine uya okukalelwa, ndelenee okukalela tuu nokuyandja omwenyo waye oikulila yavahapu.”
Ndele vo ove uya kuJeriko. Ndele Ye ta ti kuJeriko novalongwa vaye novanhu vahapu, Bartimeus yaTimeus, omweeheli omupofi, okwa li omutumba pondjila.
Naashi a uda kutya, Jesus Omunasareti Oye ou, okwa hovela okwiingida ta ti: “Jesus Omona waDavid, file nge onghenda.”
Vahapu ove mu hanyena a mwene, ndele okwa ingida mokule unene: “Omona waDavid, file nge onghenda.”
Opo Jesus okwa kanghama, ndele ta ti: “Mu ifaneni oku.” Ova ifana omupofi ndele tava ti kuye: “Kala nomwenyo muwa, fikama, Ye ote ku ifana.”
Ndele ye okwe lidula elwakani laye, ndele ta fikama diva, ndele te uya kuJesus.
Jesus okwe mu popifa ta ti: “Owa hala ndi ku ningile shike?” Omupofi okwa tya kuye: “Rabbi, ndi mone ko.”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Inda, eitavelo loye ole ku velula.” Opo tuu opo a pashuka, ndele okwe mu shikula mondjila.
11: Hano vo eshi ve uya popepi naJerusalem, puBetfage naBetania, pOmhunda yEemono, okwa tuma ovalongwa vaye vavali,
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Indeni komukunda u li komesho yeni, ndele diva, ngeenge tamu i mo, otamu ka mona okambulwena ka pandekwa, inaka londwa natango nande okomunhu, ka pandekululeni nye mu ka ete oku.
Ndele ngeenge oku na ou ta ti kunye: ‘Oshike tamu ningi osho’, tyeni: Omwene okwe ka pumbwa, ndele te ka shunifa oku diva.”
Ndele vo ova ya ko, ndele va mona okambulwena ka pandekwa pondje poshivelo moluvanda, ndele ove ka pandekulula.
Ndele vamwe vomwaava va li ofika penya, ova tya kuvo: “Oshike tamu pandekulula okambulwena?”
Ndele vo ove va nyamukula ngaashi va lombwelwa kuJesus, ndele vo ove va efa.
Ndele ova eta okambulwena kuJesus, ndele vo tava yale ko oikutu yavo kombada yako, ndele Ye ta kala ko omutumba.
Ndele vahapu ova yala oikutu yavo mondjila, vamwe ova teta oitai yomiti ndele tave i yale mondjila.
Ndele ovo va li komesho naavenya va shikula ko ova ingida: “Hosianna, na nangekwe noupuna, ou te uya medina lOmwene.
Ouhamba watate David, ou tau uya, nau nangekwe noupuna. Hosianna mokombada.”
Ye okwa fika kuJerusalem ndele ta i motembeli, ndele eshi a tala aishe, okwa ya naava omulongo navavali kuBetania, osheshi etango ola hangika la toka.
Ongula yefiku la shikula, eshi va dja kuBetania, okwa li a fya ondjala.
Ndele eshi a monena kokule omukwiyu u nomafo, okwa ya ko a tale ngeenge ta mono ko sha, ndele eshi e uya kuwo, ina mona ko sha, omafo aeke. Osheshi efimbo olo kala li leenghwiyu.
Opo nee Ye okwa popya ndele ta ti: “Inaku kala vali ou ta li oshiimati shomwoove fiyo alushe.” Novalongwa vaye ove shi uda.

Ndele opo nee ove uya kuJerusalem. Ndele Ye okwa ya motembeli, ndele ta hovele okuta mo oonakulandifa noonakulanda motembeli, okwa undulila poshi oitaafula yovakumaani voimaliwa noipundi yovalandifi veenghuti,
Ye ina efa nande umwe a humbate oshiyuma motembeli.
Ndele okwe va longa ndele ta ti: “Hamba, inaku shangwa: ‘ongulu yange i nokwiifanwa ongulu yeilikano yovanhu aveshe?’ Ndele nye omwe i ninga oshikololo shovanyeki.”
Ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ove shi uda, ndele va diladila nhumbi tava ningi va shiive oku mu dipaa, osheshi ove mu tila, osheshi elongo laye ola kumwifa ovanhu aveshe.
Onguloshi eshi ye uya, Ye okwa dja mo moshilando.
Hano ongula inene eshi va enda po, ova mona omukwiyu wa kukuta fiyo okomidi.
Ndele Petrus okwa dimbulukwa, ndele ta ti kuye: “Rabbi, tala, omukwiyu ou wa finga, owa kukuta.”
Ndele Jesus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuvo: “Kaleni mwa itavela Kalunga.

Oshili handi mu lombwele, ngeno pa kale pe na ou ta lombwele omhunda ei: ‘Litumba po, u liekele mefuta’, ye ina limbililwa momutima waye ndele ye okwe shi itavela kutya, osho e shi tonga, otashi ningwa, ngeno ote shi ningilwa.
Onghee hano handi mu lombwele: Ashishe eshi tamu shi indile mokwiilikana kweni, itaveleni kutya, omwe shi pewa, ndele otamu ke shi pewa.
Ndele nge tamu kala ofika tamu ilikana, kufilei po, ngeenge mu na sha namukweni, Xo yeni yomeulu e mu kufile po yo omatauluko eni.
Ndele ngeenge itamu kufile po, naXo yeni yomeulu ita kufa po yo omatauluko eni.”
Ndele vo ove uya vali kuJerusalem. Ye eshi a li ta ende motembeli, ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa novakulunhu, ove uya kuye,
ndele tava ti kuye: “Ei oho i longo kepangelo lilipi? Ile olyelye e ku pa epangelo lokulonga ei?”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Naame onda hala oku mu pula sha, lombweleni nge, opo naame handi mu lombwele, okepangelo lilipi handi longo ei.
Eshasho laJohannes ola dja meulu ile omovanhu? Lombweleni nge.”
Ndele vo ova kundafana muvo vene va tya: “Ngeenge hatu ti: ‘omeulu’, opo nee Ye ota ti: oshike hano inamu mu itavela?
Ile ngeno tu tye: ‘omovanhu?’ Eshi ove shi tila omolwoshiwana, osheshi va tala Johannes oye shili omuxunganeki.”
Vo ova nyamukula va tya kuJesus: “Katu shi shii.” Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Hano, naame itandi mu lombwele okepangelo lilipi handi longo ei.”
12: Ndele Ye okwa hovela oku va lombwela momafaneko: “Omulumenhu umwe okwa tota epya lomiviinyu ndele okwe li umbila ongubu, ndele okwa fa mo elambo lokukamena eeviinyu, okwa tunga ongulu yokukelela, ndele okwa nangeka mo ovalongi vepya, ndele ye okwa ya koilongo.
Efimbo eshi la fika, okwa tuma ko omupiya kovalongi, a pewe oiimati yepya lomiviinyu.
Ndele vo ove mu kwata ndele tave mu denge ndele tave mu shunifa hamakasha.
Ndele okwa tumununa ko vali omupiya umwe, naau ove mu denga eembole momutwe, ndele tave mu tukaele ndele tave mu shunifa.
Ndele okwa tuma ko umwe, ndele ove mu dipaa, nosho tuu oovakwao vahapu, vamwe ve va denga navamwe ve va dipaa.
Ndele Ye okwa li e na umwe natango, omona omuholike. Ye okwe mu tuma kuvo hauxuuninwa, ndele ta ti: ‘Vo otave mu fi eenghoto.’
Ndelenee ovalongi vepya lomiviinyu ova tongafana: ‘Ou omufyuululi, ileni, tu ke mu dipaeni, opo efyuululo li ninge letu.’
Ndele ove mu kwata, ve mu dipaa, ndele tave mu ekele kondje yepya lomiviinyu.
Nena mwene wepya lomiviinyu ota ka ninga mbela ngahelipi?” Ote uya: “Ndele ta hanaununa po ovalongi vepya lomiviinyu, ndele ta yandje epya kuvamwe.

Hamba, inamu lesha nande eshangelo eli:
‘Emanya olo ovatungi ve li ekelashi,
ola ninga emanya lokolonela.

Eshi osha dja mOmwene,
noshikumwifa momesho etu’?”
Ndele ova diladila oku mu kwata, ndele ova tila ovanhu, shaashi ova koneka kutya, ovo e va popya mefaneko eli. Ove mu fiya po, ndele tava i.
Ndele vo ova tuma kuye vamwe vomOvafarisai novomOvakwaherodes, ve mu kwate meendjovo.

Ndele ove uya ndele tava ti kuye: “Omuhongi, otu shi shii, Oove omunashili, ku na sha nomunhu, osheshi Ove iho tale oshipala shomunhu ndele to longo ovanhu ondjila yaKalunga pashili. Osha yuka tuu okupa omukesari oifendela, ile ahowe?”
Ndele Ye okwa shiiva oihelele yavo, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Oshike tamu yeleke nge ngaha? Eteleni nge odenari, ndi i tale.”
Ndele vo ve i eta. Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Efano eli neshangelo olalyelye?” Vo ova tya kuye: “Olomukesari.”
Opo nee Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Eshi shomukesari, shi peni omukesari, naasho shaKalunga, shi peni Kalunga.” Ndele vo ova kala ve mu kuminwa shili.
Opo nee Ovasadukai ve uya kuye, ava hava ti, kaku nenyumuko, ndele tave mu pula tava ti:

“Omuhongi, Moses okwe tu shangela momhango kutya, ‘ngeenge oku na omunhu ta filwa omumwaina a fiya po omukainhu, ndele ye ine mu fiila nande oludalo, nena ye na hombole po omukainhu wamumwaina ye a dalele mumwaina oludalo.’
Okwa li nee ku na ovamwainafana ovalumenhu vaheyali. Ou wotete okwa hombola omukainhu ndele mokufya ina fiya po oludalo.
Omutivali okwe mu hombola po, ndele okwa fya yo ina fiya po oludalo. Nosho tuu omutitatu.
Naaveshe vaheyali inava fiya po oludalo. Opo nee omukainhu okwa xuunina okufya.
Hano penyumuko eshi tava ka nyumuka, ota ka ninga omukainhu walyelye mwaava, osheshi ye okwa li omukainhu waaveshe ovo vaheyali.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Inamu puka mbela, shaashi muhe shii omishangwa neenghono daKalunga?
Osheshi mokunyumuka kwavo koufi ihava hombola ngaashi ihava hombolwa, ohava kala ngaashi ovaengeli meulu.

Ndele mokupopya ovafi nenyumuko lavo koufi, inamu lesha hamba momushangwa waMoses, mehepaululo olo tali popi oshixwa sheno, Kalunga nhumbi e mu popifa ta ti: ‘Aame Kalunga kaAbraham naKalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob.’
Ye ke fi Kalunga kovafi, ndelenee okovanamwenyo. Nye omwa puka unene.”

Opo nee okwe uya umwe womovanongo vomishangwa ou a uda okukundafana kwavo nokwa koneka kutya, okwe va nyamukula nawa. Ye okwe uya kuye ndele te mu pula ta ti: “Oshipango shotete shi dule oipango aishe, oshilipipo?”
Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Shotete osho eshi: ‘Israel, pwilikina, Omwene Kalunga ketu, Oye aeke Omwene.
Ove hola Omwene Kalunga koye nomutima woye aushe nomwenyo woye aushe neenghono doye adishe.’
Oshitivali osheshi: ‘Hola mukweni ngaashi u lihole mwene.’ Kaku na oshipango shinene shi dule ei.”
Omunongo womishangwa okwa tya kuye: “Heeno, omuhongi, owa popya doshili, nokutya, Oye umwe aeke, nokaku na mukwao, Oye tuu aeke.
Noku mu hola komutima aushe nokeendunge adishe nokeenghono adishe, nokuhola mukweni ngaashi u lihole mwene, okwo oku dule oiyandjiwa aishe yexwikilo nomayambo makwao.”
Hano Jesus eshi a mona ye a nyamukula nawa, okwa tya kuye: “Ove ku li kokule nouhamba waKalunga.” Ndele kakwa li vali ou e nouladi oku mu pula sha.
Ndele mokulonga ovanhu motembeli, Jesus okwa popya vali ndele ta ti: “Ovanongo vomishangwa otava ti ngahelipi, Kristus Oye Omona waDavid?

Osheshi David mwene okwa tile kOmhepo Iyapuki:
‘Omwene okwa lombwela Omwene wange:
Kala omutumba kolulyo lange,
fiyo handi tula ovatondi voye koshi yeemhadi doye.’
David ye mwene ote mu ifana ngaha Omwene, openi nee hano omona waye?” Ndele ovanhu vahapu ova kala ve mu pwilikina nehafo.
Ndele mokulonga ovanhu Ye okwa tya: “Lungameni ovanongo vomishangwa, ovo va hokwa okweenda va djala oikutu ile, nove hole okukundilwa poilandelo,
noipundi yokomesho meeshinagoga neenhele dopombada moivilo,
ovo tava mane po omaumbo ovafiyekadi, nohava ningi omailikano malemale okulimonikifa kwongaho. Vo otava ka pewa etokolo lidjuu.”
Ye okwa li omutumba a taalela koshikefa shoiyandjiwa ndele okwa tala ovanhu nhumbi tava umbile oimaliwa moshikefa. Oipuna ihapu oya umbila mo ihapu.
Ndele ope ke uya omufiyekadi wohepele, ndele ta umbile mo oumaliwa vavali, kumwe okapeni kamwe ngeno.
Opo Ye okwa ifana ovalongwa vaye kuye ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: omufiyekadi ou wohepele okwa tula mo shihapu, e dule aveshe ovo va umbila mo moshikefa.
Osheshi aveshe ova umbila mo eshi inava pumbwa, ndelenee ye moluhepo laye okwa tula mo ashishe eshi e kwete, emona laye alishe.”
13: Ndele Ye eshi a pita mo motembeli, umwe womovalongwa vaye okwa tya kuye: “Omuhongi, tala omamanya oo nomatungilo aa apa e fike.”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Ove ou wete eengulu edi dinene, itapa ka fiwa apa emanya la tenhekwa kombada yalikwao, inali ngumaunwa po.”
Ndele eshi a kala omutumba kOmhunda yEemono, a taalela kotembeli, Petrus naJakob naJohannes naAndreas, eshi va li po vo aveke, ove mu pula:
“Tu lombwela, onaini tashi ka ningwa nedidiliko olashike tali holola okuwanifwa kwoinima aishe?”
Ndele Jesus okwa hovela oku va lombwela: “Lungameni, muha pukifwe nande komunhu.
Osheshi vahapu otave ke uya medina lange ndele tava ti: Aame ou, ndele tava ka pukifa vahapu.
Hano ngeenge tamu udu omalwoodi neendaka doita, inamu tila. Ei oi na okuuya, ndele exulilo inali fika natango.
Osheshi oiwana otai ka fikamena oiwana, noshilongo otashi fikamene oshilongo, otaku ka ningwa omakakamo edu keembinga neembinga, ondjala tai uya nomapiyaano. Eshi ehovelo lomaudjuu.
“Ndele lilungameneni nye vene. Otave ke mu yandja koiongalele yovakulunhu, ndele tamu ka dengelwa meeshinagoga, ndele tamu ka twalwa koipala yomalenga noyeehamba molwange mu ninge ondobwedi kuvo.
Ndele tete evaengeli oli na okuudifilwa oiwana aishe.

Ndele ngeenge tave mu twala ndele tave mu yandje kovatokoli, inamu kala mu noshisho shaashi tamu ka popya, ndele osho otamu ke shi pewa mokafimbo oko, shi popyeni. Osheshi hanye vene tamu popi, ndelenee Omhepo Iyapuki.
Mumwaina ota yandje mumwaina mokufya, naxe omona, nounona otava ka twa ondubo novakulunhu vavo, ndele tave va dipaa.
Nye otamu ka tondwa kwaaveshe omolwedina lange, ndele ou te lididimike fiyo okexulilo, ye ota ka xupifwa.
“Ndele eshi tamu mono oixuna yehanauno tai kala poima inai fewa po (omuleshi ne shi didilike), opo nee ava tava hangika muJudea, nava fadukile keemhunda,
naau ta hangika kombada yongulu, aha londoloke ko, ye ina ya a ka pitule sha meumbo laye,
naau ta hangika mepya, ina shuna mo a ka tale ko oshikutu shaye.
Woo ovafimba novamwali opomafiku enya.
Indileni, shihe mu hange pokufu.
Osheshi omafiku oo otaku kala oudjuu unene, wa li uhe ko okehovelo loishitwa, Kalunga e i shita nongaashi itau ke uya vali.
Omwene ngeno ina xupipika omafiku enya, ngeno kaku na nande ombelela tai xupu, ndelenee omolwovahoololwa e va hoolola okwa xupipika omafiku oo.
“Ndele ngeenge oku na ou te mu lombwele ta ti: ‘Kristus oku li apa’, ile: ‘Tala, oku li kwinya’, inamu itavela.
Osheshi otaku holoka ookristus ovanaipupulu novaxunganeki ovanaipupulu, ndele tava longo omadidiliko noikumwifalonga va pukife yo ovahoololwa, ngeenge tashi dulika.
Litaleni nee. Onda tetekela oku mu lombwela aishe.
“Ndele momafiku enya oudjuu winya ngeenge wa xula po, etango tali laula nohani itai eta ouyelele wayo,
neenyofi otadi u ko keulu, neenghono domomaulu otadi ka kakamifwa.
Opo nee vo otava mono Omona wOmunhu te uya moilemo neenghono dinene noshinge.
Ndele Ye ota tumu ovaengeli vaye, ndele tava ongele ovahoololwa vaye okeemhepo dokeembinga nhee okexulilo ledu fiyo okexulilo leulu.
“Ndele lilongeni efaneko komukwiyu: Oshitai shao ngeenge sha eta eembeyo ndele tau hape, opo nee omu shi shii, okwenye okwa fika.
Nosho nanye yo, ngeenge tamu mono ei tai uya, shiiveni, Ye oku li popepi, oposhivelo.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Epupi olo itali xulu po, fimbo aishe ei inai wanifwa.
Eulu nedu otali xulu po, ndele eendjovo dange itadi xulu po.
Ndele efiku olo, ile otundi ei kaku na ou e i shii, nande ovaengeli meulu ile Omona, Tate Oye aeke.
Kaleni mwa lungama, pashukeni nye mu ilikane, osheshi inamu shiiva efimbo olo onaini tali uya.
Otaku kala ngaashi omunhu a ya koilongo: eshi a fiya po eumbo laye, ndele okwa pa ovanhu vaye epangelo, keshe tuu ou oshilonga shaye, okwa lombwela yo omunangeli woposhivelo a kale a pashuka.
Hano osho kaleni mwa pashuka, osheshi kamu shi shii onaini mwene weumbo te uya, ngeenge onguloshi ile opokati koufiku ile opekweno lekondombolo ile ongula,
ehe mu hange mwa kofa, eshi te uya ohangelela, te mu faukile.
Osho handi shi mu lombwele, ohandi shi lombwele aveshe: kaleni oupafi.”
14: Ndele opa li natango omafiku avali opo oshivilo shaPaasa noshomingome dinyenye shi fike. Novapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ova kundafana, nhumbi ve noku mu kwata nomakoto, vo ve mu dipae.
Osheshi ova tya: “Hapomafiku oshivilo, puha tukuluke embuyaano movanhu.”

Ndele eshi a li muBetania, meumbo laSimon omunashilundu, a kala omutumba poshililo, omukainhu umwe e uya mo, e noshanga i yadi omuvavo wonarde yoshili u nondilo. Ndele ye okwa tatula oshanga, ndele omuvavo okwe u tila komutwe waye.
Ndele omwa li mu na vamwe va umana, ndele tava lombwelafana: “Oshike omuvavo ou wa hepifwa ashike?
Omuvavo ou ngeno wa landifwe po eedenari di dule omafele atatu, ndele tadi yandjwa keehepele.” Ndele vo ove mu vela ombedi.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Mu efeni, oshike tamu mu nyematifa? Ye okwa longela nge oshilonga shiwa.
Osheshi eehepele omu di kwete alushe mokati keni nokeshe efiku mwa hala inamu nyengwa oku di ningila nawa, ndele Ame kamu kwete nge alushe.
Ye okwa ninga osho shi fike peenghono daye. Ye okwa tetekela okuvaekela olutu lange epako.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Keshe oko mounyuni aushe evaengeli tali ka udifwa, naashi yo ye e shi ninga, otashi ka hepaululwa oku mu dimbulukwa.”
Ndele Judas Iskariot, umwe waava omulongo navavali, okwa ya kovapristeli ovakulunhu e ke mu yandje momake avo.
Ndele vo eshi ve shi uda, ova hafa, ndele ove mu udanekela oimaliwa. Ndele ye okwa kala nee ta kongo efimbo la wapala oku mu kengelela.
Ndele efiku lotete lomingome dinyenye, odjona yaPaasa eshi hai dipawa, ovalongwa vaye ova tya kuye: “Openi wa hala tu ke ku longekidile odjona yaPaasa u i lye?”
Ndele okwa tuma ovalongwa vaye vavali, okwa tya kuvo: “Indeni koshilando, ndele tamu ka shakena nomulumenhu a humbata oshitoo shomeva, mu shikuleni.
Ndele omu ta i, tyeni kumwene weumbo olo: ‘Omuhongi ota ti: Openi pe nolupale lange ndi lile mo pamwe novalongwa vange odjona yaPaasa?’
Opo ye ote mu ulikile ondjuwo inene yokombada ya longekidwa. Omo tu longekidileni omo.”
Ovalongwa ova ya, ndele tave uya moshilando, ndele tava longekida odjona yaPaasa.
Ndele onguloshi eshi ye uya, Ye okwe uya pamwe novalongwa vaye ava omulongo navavali.
Ndele eshi va li omutumba tava li, Jesus okwa tya: “Oshili ohandi mu lombwele, umwe womunye ou ta li pamwe naame, ota kengelele nge.”
Ndele vo ova hovela okunyika oluhodi noku mu pula va shikulafana: “Haame ndishi?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oyou womunye omulongo navavali ou ta velele metiti pamwe naame.
Heeno, Omona wOmunhu ota i ngaha ngaashi a shangwa, ndele woo, omunhu ou te mu kengelele. Omunhu ou ngeno okwa li ina dalwa, ngeno oshe mu wapalela.”
Ndelenee fimbo va li tava li, Jesus okwa kufa omungome, e u nangeka noupuna, ndele te u pambula, te u va pe ndele ta ti: “Tambuleni, owo olutu lange.”
Ndele okwa kufa eholo, a pandula, ndele okwe li va pa, ndele va nwa mo aveshe.
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Ei ohonde yange, ohonde yehangano tai tilwashi omolwavahapu.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: itandi nu vali oiimati yomiviinyu fiyo efiku olo handi ke a nwa mape omouhamba waKalunga.”
Opo nee eshi va imba eimbilo lepandulo, ova ya kOmhunda yEemono.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Oufiku tuu ou nye amushe otamu lidimbike nge, osheshi okwa shangwa: ‘ame ohandi denge omufita, needi tadi lihane.’
Ndele ngeenge nda nyumuka ohandi mu tetekele okuya kuGalilea.”
Petrus okwa tya kuye: “Nande aveshe nave ku lidimbike, haame.”
Opo nee Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Oshili handi ku lombwele: nena, oufiku tuu ou wonena, ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena luvali, ove oto likale nge lutatu.”
Ndelenee okwa popya neenghono: “Nande ndi fye pamwe naave, itandi ku likale nande.” Nosho tuu vakwao aveshe va tya.
Opo nee vo ove uya ponhele, edina layo Getsemane, ndele Ye okwa tya kovalongwa vaye: “Kaleni omutumba apa, fimbo handi ka ilikana.”
Ndele Ye okwa kufa Petrus naJakob naJohannes pamwe naye, ndele okwa hovela okutila nokukakama momwenyo.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Omwenyo wange owa nyika oluhodi linene fiyo okufya, kaleni apa nye mu kale oupafi.”
Ndele Ye okwa ehena ko kanini, ndele ta wile poshi, ndele ta ilikana, ngeenge tashi dulika, okafimbo aka ke mu pitilile po.
Okwa tya: “Abba, Tate, aishe oto i dulu, kufe nge eholo eli. Ndele hangaashi Ame nda hala, ndele ongaashi Ove wa hala.”
Ndele okwe uya, ndele e va hanga va kofa, ndele ta ti kuPetrus: “Simon, owa kofa? Ino dula nande okukala oupafi okafimbo kanini?
Kaleni oupafi, nye mu ilikane, muha hangike komayeleko, heeno, omhepo oya hala, ndelenee ombelela oi na oungone.”
Ndele Ye okwa shuna ko, ndele ta ilikana ta popi eendjovo tuu dinya.
Eshi a aluka ko, okwe va hanga vali va kofa, osheshi omesho avo a li a djuupalekwa keemhofi, vo inava shiiva osho ve mu nyamukule ngeno.
Ndele Ye okwa aluka ko olutitatu ndele ta ti kuvo: “Natango tuu omwa kofa notamu tulumukwa! Sha wana nee. Okafimbo oke uya. Tala, Omona wOmunhu ota yandjwa momake ovalunde.
Yambukeni, tu yeni, tala, ou ta kengelele nge, oku li popepi.”

Opo tuu opo fimbo ta popi natango, Judas, umwe womwaava omulongo navavali, okwe uya nongudu inene yavahapu ya tya omaongamukonda noiti, ya dja kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovanongo vomishangwa nokovakulunhu.
Ndele ou e mu kengelela, okwe va pa oshidimbulukifo ta ti: “Ou handi mu fipi komulungu, Oye ou, mu kwateni, nye mu ye naye mwe mu diinina.”
Hano ye eshi e uya po, okwa endelela diva e uye kuye ndele ta ti: “Rabbi”, ndele ye te mu fipi komilungu.
Opo nee ova tula ko omake ndele tave mu kwata.
Ndele umwe womwaava va li ofika popepi, okwa pweya mo eongamukonda, ndele ta denge nalo omumati womupristeli omukulunhu, ndele te mu tete okutwi.
Ndele Jesus okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Nye omwa fa mwa endelela okukwata nge ngomukolokoshi mu na omaongamukonda noiti.
Omafiku aeshe onda kala punye motembeli handi longo ovanhu, nye inamu kwata nge. Ndele eshi otashi ningwa, omishangwa opo di twe.”
Opo nee vo aveshe ove mu fiya po, ndele tava faduka po.
Ndele Ye okwa shikulwa komunyasha, e lidingila onhanga yoliina kolutu longaho, ndele vo tave mu kwata.
Ndele ye okwa fiya po onhanga yoliina, ndele ye a faduka po e li hamunghele.
Ndele vo ova twala Jesus komupristeli omukulunhu. Oko kwa li kwa ongala ovapristeli ovakulunhu aveshe novakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa.
Ndele Petrus okwe mu shikula, a li konima kokule, fiyo omoluumbo leumbo lomupristeli omukulunhu, ndele ye okwa ka kala omutumba povapiya, a ka xuxumukwe pomundilo.
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu noshiongalele ashishe shovakulunhu ova li tava kongo ondobwedi okutomhifa Jesus, ve mu dipae, ndele inava mona.
Osheshi vahapu ove mu lundila, ndele omahepaululo avo inaa twa kumwe.
Opo nee vamwe va fikama, ve mu lundila va tya:
“Fye otwe mu uda ta ti: ‘Ame ohandi ngumauna po otembeli ei ya tungwa nomake, ndele momafiku atatu ohandi tungu imwe ei, inai tungwa nomake.’ ”
Ndelenee nomwaashi ehepaululo lavo inali twa kumwe.
Omupristeli omukulunhu okwa fikama nee, ndele ta ehene komesho, ndele ta pula Jesus ndele ta ti: “Ito nyamukula sha? Ava otave ku popile shike?”
Ndele Ye okwa mwena, ina nyamukula sha. Omupristeli omukulunhu okwe mu pululula ndele ta ti: “Oove tuu Kristus, Omona wOmufimanekwa?”
Opo nee Jesus okwa tya: “Heeno, Aame. Ndele otamu ka mona Omona wOmunhu e li omutumba kolulyo aKalunga, ndele te uya ta ende moilemo yeulu.”
Opo nee omupristeli omukulunhu okwa pombaula oikutu yaye, ndele ta ti: “Eendobwedi otwe di pumbwila vali shike?
Nye esheko laye lokufya omwe li uda. Otamu ti ngahelipi?” Ndele vo aveshe ove mu pa etimba.
Ndele vamwe ova hovela oku mu fiila omate, nokutuvika oshipala shaye, ndele tave mu denge neengonyo, ndele tava ti kuye: “Xunganeka! Novayakuli vetokolo ove mu denga nomanghava.”
Ndele fimbo Petrus a li pehalandjadja loposhi, kamwe komoukadona vomupristeli omukulunhu oke uya po.
Ndele eshi ka mona Petrus ta xuxumukwa, oke mu tala ndele taka ti: “Naave yo owa li pamwe naJesus Omunasareti.”
Ndele ye okwe likala, ndele ta ti: “Nghi mu shii, ndele kandi udite ko eshi to tongo.” Ndele ye eshi a ya poluhaela loposhivelo, ekondobolo ola kwena.
Hano okakadona eshi ke mu mona opo, oka hovela vali okulombwela ava va li ofika opo: “Ou oye umwe womuvo.”
Ndelenee ye okwe likalulula. Eshi pwa pita okafimbo, ava va kala popepi naye, ova lombwela vali Petrus: “Oshili ove oumwe waavenya, osheshi ove Omugalilea.”
Opo nee ye okwa hovela okulifingaela nokwaana: “Omulumenhu ou tamu tongo, nghi mu shii.”

Opo tuu opo ekondobolo ola kwena olutivali. Opo nee Petrus okwa dimbulukwa eendjovo daJesus edi e di mu lombwelele: “Ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena luvali, ove owe likala nge lutatu.” Omutima waye nowa teka ndele ta i pondje, ta lili.
15: Hano eshi tuu kwa ka sha, ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa, oshiongalele ashishe shovakulunhu osha tokola, ndele vo ova mangifa Jesus, ndele tave mu twala, ve ke mu yandje kuPilatus.
Ndele Pilatus okwe mu pula: “Oove ohamba yOvajuda?” Ye okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Heeno, ngaashi to ti.”
Ovapristeli ovakulunhu ove mu pa omatimba mahapu.
Opo Pilatus okwe mu pululula ndele ta ti: “Ito nyamukula sha. Tala, eshi tave ku pe omatimba mahapu.”
Ndele Jesus ina nyamukula vali sha, ndele eshi sha kumwifa Pilatus.
Ndelenee pomafiku oshivilo opa kala onghedi yoku va mangululila omukwatwa umwe, keshe ou va hala.
Ndelenee okwa li ku nomulumenhu umwe a mangwa, edina laye Barabas, a kwatelwa pamwe novakolokoshi vamwe, va li va dipaa omunhu moukolokoshi wavo.
Ndele eengudu dovanhu mokwiingida mokule oda hovela okwiindila Pilatus, ye e di ningile ngaashi ha ningi shito.
Pilatus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Omwa hala ndi mu mangululile ohamba yOvajuda?”
Osheshi okwa li e shi shii kutya, ovapristeli ovakulunhu ove mu ningila ondubo.
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu ova shushumika ovanhu va indile kutya, ne va mangululile Barabas.
Opo Pilatus okwa popya vali ta ti kuvo: “Ondi na okuninga ngahelipi naau, tamu mu ti, Ye Ohamba yOvajuda?”
Vo ova ingida vali: “Mu valela komushiyakano.”
Pilatus okwa tya kuvo: “Owii owashike hano a ninga?” Ndele ova ingida pombada: “Mu valela komushiyakano.”
Ndele Pilatus eshi a hala okuwapalela ovanhu, okwe va mangululila Barabas, ndele okwa dengifa Jesus neeshokoto, ndele te mu yandje a valelwe komushiyakano.
Ovakwaita ove mu twala meni longulu oyo tai ifanwa pretorium, ndele ova ifana etanga lavo alishe lovakwaita.
Ndele ove mu djaleka oshikutu shitilyana, ova tunga oshishani shomakiya, ndele tave shi tula komutwe waye,
ndele ova hovela oku mu kunda: “Kundwa Oove, Ohamba yOvajuda.”
Ove mu denga nolumbungu komutwe, ndele ve mu fiila omate ndele tave mu kundu nokutwa eengolo.
Ndele vo eshi ve mu sheka, ove mu dula oshikutu shitilyana, ndele tave mu dike oikutu yaye mwene. Ndele vo tave mu twala, ve ke mu valele komushiyakano.
Ndelenee vo ova fininika omulumenhu umwe, ta ende po ta di kepya, Simon Omukireni, xe yaAleksander naRufus, e mu humbatele omushiyakano waye.
Vo ove mu twala konhele, edina layo Golgata, tali ti: onhele yoshala sholukwe.
Ndele vo ove mu pa omaviinyu mwa tulwa oimbodi ilula, ndele Ye ine a nwa.
Opo nee ove mu valela komushiyakano, ndele vo va tukulilafana oikutu yaye noku i umbila oshihoololifo, kutya otai ningi yalye nalye.
Otundi ei ve mu valela komushiyakano oya li onhinhatu.
Ndele okwa tulwa eshangelo lokushiivifa etimba laye la tya: “Ohamba yOvajuda.”
Pamwe naye opa valelwa ovakolokoshi vavali, umwe kolulyo laye, nomukwao okolumosho laye.
Omushangwa ou owa twa: Ye okwa valulilwa movakolokoshi.
Ndele ava va pita po, ove mu sheka, tava pukapuka komitwe, tava ti: “Hamba ove, oove tuu ou to ngumauna po otembeli, ndele to i tungulula momafiku atatu,
likwafa mwene, Ove u dje ko komushiyakano.”
Nosho yo ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ove mu sheka, nokulombwelafana tava ti: “Okwa li ha kwafa ovanhu, ndelenee Ye okwa nyengwa okulikwafa.
Kristus, Ohamba yaIsrael, na dje ko komushiyakano paife eshi, tu shi mone, fye tu itavele.” Naavo yo va valelwa komushiyakano pamwe naye, ove mu sheka.
Ndele otundi onhihamano omilaulu da tuvikila edu alishe fiyo otundi onhimugoi.
Otundi onhimugoi Jesus okwa ingida mokule: “Eeli, Eeli, lama sabaktani?”
Ndele vamwe ava va li po ofika eshi ve shi uda, ova tya: “Tala, Ye ota ifana Elia.”
Opo nee umwe okwa endelela ndele ta yaveke oshiyavo momeva malula, ndele te shi tu koshihati, ndele te mu nwefa ta ti: “Mweneni, tu tale, Elia ngeenge te uya oku mu kufa ko.”
Ndelenee Jesus okwa ingida mokule nokwa yandja omwenyo waye.
Opo tuu etukulifo lotembeli ola pombauka okudja pombada fiyo oposhi,
ndele omukulunhu omunefele wovakwaita, ou kwa li a kala ofika e mu taalela, eshi a mona nhumbi Ye ta fi ngaha, okwa tya: “Omunhu ou okwa li shili Omona waKalunga.”
Ndele okwa li yo ovakainhu va li ofika kokule tava tale. Mokati kavo omwa li Maria Magdalena naMaria, ina yaJakob munini naJoses naSalome,
ovo va li have mu shikula, nohave mu yakula, eshi a li muGalilea novakainhu vamwe vahapu, ovo ve uya pamwe naye kuJerusalem.
Ndele onguloshi eshi ye uya, noshaashi kwa li efiku lelilongekido, okutya, efiku la tetekela Eshabata,
omukwashiongalele shovakulunhu a fimana, Josef wOkuarimatia, ou a li a teelela ouhamba waKalunga, okwe uya, e linyatipalifa komwenyo, ndele ta i kuPilatus, ndele ta indile ko oshimhu shaJesus.
Pilatus okwa kala a kumwa, ngeenge Ye okwa fya nale nokuli, ndele okwa ifana omukulunhu omunefele, ndele te mu pula, ngeenge Ye okwa fya nale.
Ndele eshi e shi uda komukulunhu omunefele, okwa yandja nee oshimhu kuJosef.

Ndele ye okwa landa oshiyata sholiina, ndele te mu kufa ko, ndele te mu tonyene moshiyata sholiina ndele te mu nangeke mombila ya hangika ya hokelwa memanya, ndele okwa alangatifila po emanya poshivelo shombila.
Ndele Maria Magdalena naMaria, ina yaJoses, ova tala opo Ye a nangekwa.
16: Ndele Eshabata eshi la xula, Maria Magdalena naMaria, ina yaJakob naSalome ova landa omuvavo wedimba liwa, ve ke mu vaeke.
Ndele ongula inene yefiku lotete loshivike, etango eshi tali piti, ove uya kombila.
Ndele eshi va tongafana: “Olyelye te tu alangatifile ko emanya koshivelo shombila?”
Ndele eshi va tala ko, ove wete emanya la alangatifwa ko, lo ola li linene unene.
Hano eshi va ya mombila, ova mona mo omunyasha e li omutumba kolulyo, a djala oshikutu shile, shitoka, ndele ova haluka neenghono.
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Inamu tila. Otamu kongo Jesus Omunasareti, omuvalelwa komushiyakano. Ye okwa nyumuka, ke mo omu. Taleni onhele ei apa va li ve mu nangeka.
Ndelenee indeni mu ka lombwele ovalongwa vaye naPetrus: ‘Ye ote mu tetekelele okuya kuGalilea. Oko tamu ke mu mona, ngaashi e mu lombwela.’ ”
Ndelenee vo ova dja mo, ndele tava di ko kombila oshikenyauko, osheshi ova kwatwa kekakamo nokehaluko, vo inava tya sha nande okomunhu, osheshi vo ova li va tila.
Ndelenee Ye eshi a nyumuka efiku lotete loshivike ongula inene, okwa holokela tete Maria Magdalena, mwaau a ta mo eendemoni 7.
Ndele ye okwa ya, ndele te shi hepaululile ava va kala puye nova li va nyika oluhodi, ndele tava lili.
Ndelenee eshi va uda kutya, oku na omwenyo, naMaria e mu mona, inave shi itavela.
Ndele konima okwa holokela vavali vomuvo e nolupe li lili, eshi tava ende tava i komukunda.
Ava ova ya ndele ova hepaululila vakwao, ndele navo yo eshi inave shi itavela.
Konima okwa holokela ovo omulongo naumwe fimbo ve li omutumba poshililo nokwe va tanguninina okuhaitavela kwavo noukukutu womitima davo, osheshi inava itavela ovo ve mu mona a nyumuka koufi.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Indeni nounyuni aushe, nye mu ka udifile ovashitwa aveshe evaengeli.
Ou ta itavele ndele ta shashwa, oye ta xupifwa, ndele ou ita itavele, ye ota ka tokolelwa ekano.
“Noilongadidiliko ei tai shikula ovo va itavela: omedina lange tava te mo eendemoni, otava popi omalaka mape,
otava ka kwata omayoka nongeenge tava nu oudiyo, itau va ningi sha; otava tenheke omake avo kovanaudu, notava veluka.”
Hano Omwene Jesus eshi a tonga kuvo, okwa tambulwa meulu. Ndele okwa kala omutumba kolulyo laKalunga.
