Ndele vo ova ya, ndele ova udifila akushe, ndele Omwene Jesus okwa li ta longo pamwe navo, ndele ta pameke eendjovo nomadidiliko tae di shikula.

1: Eshi vahapu va hovela okutunga ehepaululo loinima ei ya ningwa mokati ketu,
ongaashi venya va li tete ovamoni, novalongi veendjovo ve di tu fiila,
naame yo, eshi nda konakona shili aishe ngaashi ya shikulafana kehovelo, nda hala ndi ku shangele, Teofilus, omufimanekwa,
opo u shiive nawa oshili shomahepaululo oo we a longwa.
Opomafiku aHerodes, ohamba yOvajuda, okwa li ku nomupristeli edina laye Sakaria, wetanga laAbia, nomukainhu waye womoludalo laAron, edina laye Elisabet.
Ndele vo aveshe vavali ova li ovayuki koshipala shaKalunga nokweenda moipango aishe nomeenghedi dOmwene, ndele va li vehe na oshipo.
Ndele vo ova li vehe na okaana, osheshi Elisabet okwa li ongadji naaveshe vavali va kulupa.
Ndele fimbo kwa li ta longo oilonga youpristeli koshipala shaKalunga omolufo letanga laye,
okwa hoololwa panghedi yovapristeli, a ka twimine motembeli yOmwene.
Ndele ongudu aishe yovanhu oya li pondje, tai ilikana pefimbo letwimino.
Opo nee omweengeli wOmwene okwe mu holokela a kala ofika kolulyo loaltari yokutwimina.
Ndele Sakaria okwa haluka eshi e mu mona, noumbada we mu kwata.
Ndelenee omweengeli okwa tya kuye: “Sakaria, ino tila, osheshi eilikano loye ola udika, nomukainhu woye Elisabet ote ku dalele okamati, ndele to ka luku Johannes.

Ndele ye ota ka kala ehafo nenyakuko kwoove,
ndele vahapu otava ka hafela edalo lako.

Osheshi ye ota ningi omunene koshipala shOmwene,
omaviinyu nomeva keshe haa kolwifa ite a nu,
ota yadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki
fimbo e li medimo laina.

Ndele vahapu vomovana vaIsrael
ote va alulile kOmwene Kalunga kavo.

Ndelenee ye ote mu tetekelele
momhepo nomeenghono daElia,
nomitima dooxe ote di alulile kovana,
novahaduliki keendunge dovayuki,
opo a longekidile Omwene oshiwana sha pwa.”
Sakaria okwa tya komweengeli: “Eshi ohandi shi dimbulukwa koshike? Osheshi ame onda kula nomukainhu wange okwa kulupa.”
Ndele omweengeli okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Aame Gabriel, ou handi kala ofika koshipala shaKalunga, ndele onda tumwa ndi ku popife, ndi ku udifile ondaka ei yehafo.
Ndele tala, ove to fiti ondaka, ito shiiva okupopya fiyo efiku olo eshi tashi ningwa, shaashi ino itavela eendjovo odo dange, tadi wanifwa shili pefimbo lado.”
Ndelenee ovanhu ova li kuteelela Sakaria, ndele ova kumwa eshi a kala mo unene motembeli.
Ndelenee eshi a dja mo, okwa nyengwa okupopya kuvo, ndele vo ova koneka kutya ye okwa mona emoniko motembeli, ye okwe va lapa ndele ta kala a fita ondaka.
Ndele opo nee omafiku aye okulonga oilonga youpristeli eshi a pwa ko, okwa shuna nee keumbo.
Ndele omafiku enya eshi a pita po, Elisabet okwa ninga omufimba, ndele okwa hondama eehani nhano ndele ta ti:
“Osho ngaha Omwene okwa ningila nge pomafiku enya eshi a tala kwaame a kufe nge okudinwa kwovanhu.”
Ndele mohani onhihamano omweengeli Gabriel okwa tumwa kuKalunga a ye koshilando shomuGalilea, edina lasho Nasaret,
okokakadona ka putulwa komulumenhu edina laye Josef, womepata laDavid, nedina lokakadona oMaria.
Ndele omweengeli eshi e uya mo kuye okwa tya: “Kundwa, oove omufilwanghenda! Omwene oku li naave. Oove omunangekwa noupuna mokati kovakainhu.”
Ndele ye okwa halukifwa keendjovo odo nokwe lipula kutya ekundo olo otali ti ngahelipi.
Ndele opo omweengeli okwa tya kuye: “Maria, ino tila, osheshi ove owa mona onghenda kuKalunga.
Ndele tala, ove to ningi omufimba ndele to dala okamati, ndele to ka luka edina lako Jesus.

ndele Ye ota ningi ohamba yeumbo laJakob fiyo alushe,
nouhamba waye kau na apa tau xulu po.”
Opo Maria ta ti komweengeli: “Eshi otashi ka ningwa ngahelipi, osheshi omulumenhu nghi mu shii?”
Ndele omweengeli okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omhepo Iyapuki otai ku dile kombada, neenghono daau wOkombadambada otadi ku tuvikile, onghee hano omudalwa ou omuyapuki ota ka lukwa Omona waKalunga.
Ndele tala, naElisabet, omukweni, ou kwa tiwa ongadji, okwa ninga omufimba wokamati moukulupe waye, nohani ei yaye oyo onhihamano,
osheshi Kalunga iha nyengwa kusha.”
Ndele Maria okwa tya: “Tala, aame omupiya wOmwene, nandi ningwe ngaashi wa tya.” Ndele omweengeli okwa dja po puye.
Ndele pomafiku enya Maria okwa fikama ndele ta i nokweendelela komukunda wokeemhunda, okoshilando shonhumba shomuJudea.
Ndele okwa fika meumbo laSakaria, ndele ta kundu Elisabet.
Ndele opa ningwa nee, Elisabet eshi a uda ekundo laMaria, okaana oka nhuka medimo laye, ndele Elisabet okwa yadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki.
Ndele okwa popya mokule ta ti: “Oove omunangekwa noupuna mokati kovakainhu, ndele nakudalwa ou womwoove omunangekwa noupuna!
Ndele osha dila nge peni, ina yOmwene wange te uya kwaame?
Osheshi ondaka yekundo loye eshi ya fika momatwi ange, okaana oka nhuka kehafo medimo lange.
Ndele omunelao oyou ta itavela kutya osho te shi lombwelwa kOmwene, otashi ka wanifwa.”

Opo Maria a popya, ta ti:
“Omwenyo wange otau hambelele Omwene pombada,
nomhepo yange otai nyakukilwa Kalunga, Omukulili wange,

eshi a tala ouxupi womupiya.
Tala, okonena omapupi aeshe otaa fimaneke nge ndimunelao.

Osheshi Omunaenghono a ningila nge oinima inene,
nedina laye olo oliyapuki,

nefilonghenda laye otali kala koludalo nokomaludalo,
okwaava have mu tila.

Okwa longa oilonganghono kokwooko kwaye,
ndele okwa halakanifa po
ava va li ve nomadiladilo elinenepeko momitima davo.

Ovapangeli okwe va undula ko komalukalwa
ndele okwa nenepekifa ovaxupi.

Ovanandjala okwe va kutifa nouwa,
noipuna okwe i lekela ongaho.

Okwa tambula Israel, omupiya waye,
opo a dimbulukwe efilonghenda laye

kuAbraham nokoludalo laye fiyo alushe,
ngaashi a lombwela ootate.”
Ndele Maria okwa menekela puye eehani nhatu ndele okwa shuna keumbo lavo.
Ndele efimbo laElisabet lokudala la fika, nokwa dala okamati.
Ndele ovashiinda vaye novakwao eshi va uda Omwene e mu ningila onghenda inene, ova hafa pamwe naye.
Ndele efiku etihetatu ve uya va ka pitife okaana etanda, ndele ova hala ve ka lukile edina laxe Sakaria.
Ina okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ahowe, edina lako otali lukwa Johannes.”
Ndele vo ova tya kuye: “Mepata leni kamu na nande umwe e na edina eli.”
Ndele ova lapa xe, edina lilipi ngeno a hala oku ka luka.
Ye okwa indila okapelende, ndele ta shange mo ngaha: “Edina lako oJohannes.” Aveshe ova kumwa.
Opo tuu opo okanya kaye nelaka laye ola fituluka, ye okwa popya ndele ta hambelele Kalunga.
Ndele aveshe vomoushiinda ova kwatwa kehaluko, nokomukunda aushe wokeemhunda daJudea okwa hepaululwa aishe ei ya ningwa,
ndele aveshe ava ve di uda ove di lipula momitima davo ndele ova tya: “Okaana aka otaka ningi okashike?” Osheshi eke lOmwene ola li naye.
Ndele xe Sakaria okwa yadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki, nokwa xunganeka ta ti:

“Omwene Kalunga kaIsrael na fimanekwe,
osheshi e uya okutala oshiwana shaye,
ndele okwe shi longela ekulilo,

ndele okwe tu tumbila oluvinga lexupifo
omeumbo laDavid, omupiya waye,

ngaashi a lombwelifa omakanya ovaxunganeki vayapuki
momafimbo ounyuni wonale,

oku tu xupifa movanaita nafye
nomomake aaveshe ovo ve tu tonda,

a monifile ootate olukeno,
Ye a dimbulukwe ehangano laye liyapuki,
eano olo e li anenene tate yetu Abraham,

e tu pe omhito,
opo eshi twa xupifwa momake ovatondi vetu,
tu mu longele tuhe na oumbada
omouyuki nomouyapuki koshipala shaye omafiku etu aeshe.

Ndele ove okaana,
oto ka ifanwa omuxunganeki waau wOkombadambada,
osheshi ove u nokutetekelela Omwene noku mu palela eendjila daye,

u longe ovanhu vaye okushiiva exupifo
nedimepo lomatimba avo,

omolwefilonghenda lomomutima waKalunga ketu,
omo eluwa lokombada tali tu tendele,

li tu minikile ava hatu kala omutumba momulaulu
nomomudidimbe wefyo,
ndele li yukifile eemhadi detu mondjila yombili.”
Ndele okaana oka kula ndele oka pama momhepo, ndele oka kala meembuwa fiyo efiku olo a holokela Israel.
2: Ndele momafiku enya opa ningwa omhango ya dja komukesari Augustus, ounyuni aushe u lishangife u yandje oifendela.
Elishangifo eli olotete, nola ningwa Kirenius eshi a li omwene waSiria.
Ndele aveshe ova ya ko, ve ke lishangife, keshe ou moshilando shavo.
Ndele osho yo Josef a fikama muGalilea moshilando shaNasaret nokwa ya kuJudea koshilando shaDavid sha ifanwa Betlehem, osheshi ye owomeumbo nomepata laDavid,
e ke lishangife pamwe nomuputulwa waye Maria, ou a li omufimba.
Ndele pa ningwa, eshi va li ko, efiku lokudala le mu hanga.
Ndele ye okwe livelipa oshiveli shaye okamati ndele okwe ka tonyena momalapi, ndele okwe ka nangeka mepeta lokulila oimuna, osheshi inava mona onhele mongulu yovaenda.
Ndele oko kwa li ovafita va nangela oimuna yavo oufiku moixwa.
Ndele omweengeli wOmwene e uya noshinge shOmwene she va minikila, ndele vo ova haluka nehaluko linene.
Ndele omweengeli wOmwene okwa tya kuvo: “Inamu tila, taleni ame ohandi mu udifile ehafo linene tali ningi lovanhu aveshe.
Onena tuu eli mwa dalelwa Omukulili moshilando shaDavid, Oye tuu ou Kristus Omwene.
Nedidiliko mu mu koneke oleli: otamu ka mona okaana ka tonyenwa momalapi, ndele taka nangekwa mepeta lokulila oimuna.”
Ndelenee ohaluka, pomweengeli opa holoka ongudu inene yovakwaita vomeulu, ova hambelela Kalunga tava ti:
“Efimano olaKalunga mokombadambada nombili kombada yedu movanhu e va hokwa.”
Ndele ovaengeli eshi va dja po puvo va shuna meulu, ovafita ova tongafana tava ti: “Tu yeni hano kuBetlehem tu ka tale eshi sha ningwa ko, Omwene e shi tu hololela.”
Ndele vo ova ya nokweendelela, ndele va mona Maria naJosef nokaana ka nangala mepeta lokulila oimuna.
Ndele eshi ve ka mona, ova hepaulula apeshe eendjovo odo ve di lombwelelwa okaana aka.
Ndele aveshe ava ve di uda ova kuminwa odo ve di hepaululilwa kovafita.
Ndele Maria okwa tuvikila eendjovo odo adishe momutima waye.
Ndele ovafita ova shuna nokuhambelela nokufimaneka Kalunga omolwaaishe ei ve i uda nove i mona, ngaashi va lombwelwa.
Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku ahetatu, okaana ka pita etanda nedina lako ola lukwa Jesus, olo tuu olo ke li lukwa komweengeli fimbo inaka holoka medimo laina.
Nomafiku avo elikosho opamhango yaMoses eshi a wana, ove ka twala kuJerusalem, ve ka twale koshipala shOmwene;
ongaashi sha shangwa momhango yOmwene: Okalume keshe taka yeulula oshidalelo shaina naka yapulilwe Omwene,
nokuyandja eyambo omalyamono avali ile ounghutyona vavali opanghedi yomhango yOmwene.
Ndele tala, muJerusalem omwa li mu nomunhu edina laye Simeon, omuyuki nokwa tila Kalunga, onakuteelela ehekeleko laIsrael, nOmhepo Iyapuki ya kala muye.
Ndele okwa hololelwa kOmhepo Iyapuki kutya, ye ita mono efyo fimbo ina mona Kristus Omwene.
Ndele ye okwa etwa kOmhepo Iyapuki motembeli. Hano ovakulunhu eshi va eta mo okaana Jesus ve ka ningile panghedi yomhango,
naye yo okwe ka ukata momaoko aye, ndele ta hambelele Kalunga ndele ta ti:

“Omwene, paife oto lekele omupiya woye, a ye nombili
ngaashi wa tile,
osheshi omesho ange a mona exupifo loye,
we li longa moipafi yoiwana aishe,

ouyelele okuminikila ovapaani
nefimano loshiwana shoye Israel.”
Ndele xe naina ova kuminwa eendjovo odo de mu popilwa.

Ndele Simeon okwe va nangeka noupuna ndele okwa tya kuina yako Maria:
“Tala, ou okwa tulwa po okupundula nokuyambula vahapu vomuIsrael
nedidiliko eli tali twilwa eemhata,

naave mwene yo, eongamukonda otali tyuula omutima woye,
omadiladilo avahapu opo a hololwe.”
Ndele omo mwa li yo Hanna, omuxunganeki, omona waFanuel womepata laAsser. Okwa li a kula. Eshi a hombolwa okakadona, okwa kala nomulumenhu waye omido heyali,
ndele pefimbo olo okwa li omufiyekadi e nomido omilongo hetatu nanhee. Ye ina dja mo nandenande motembeli, ndelenee okwa longela mo Kalunga oufiku nomutenya nokulidilika nokwiilikana.
Ndele opefimbo tuu olo okwe uya po, okwa hambelela Kalunga nokwe ka hepaulula kwaaveshe ovo va teelela ekulilo laJerusalem.
Ndele eshi va wanifa aishe pamhango yOmwene, ova shuna kuGalilea koshilando shavo kuNasaret.
Ndele okaana oka kula ndele oka pama momhepo noka yada ounongo, nonghenda yaKalunga ya kala kombada yako.
Ndele ovakulunhu vako ova li hava i kuJerusalem keshe omudo koshivilo shaPaasa.
Ndele ye eshi a wanifa omido omulongo nambali ova ya ko vali panghedi yoshivilo.
Ndelenee omafiku oo eshi a pita po, ndele va dja ko, okaana Jesus oka fyaala muJerusalem, ndele Josef naina yako va li inave shi shiiva.
Ndelenee ova li ve shii oku li mongudu yovaendi, ndele ova enda oshikako shefiku limwe, ndele ove mu konga mokati kavakwao naava ve lishii navo,
ndele eshi inave mu mona mo, ova shuna kuJerusalem oku mu konga.
Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku atatu, opo nee ove ka hanga nee motembeli, ke li omutumba mokati kovalongindjovo noku va pwilikina noku va pula.
Ndele aveshe ovo ve ka uda ova kuminwa eendunge dako nomanyamukulo ako.
Ndele eshi ve ka mona ngaha ova haluka, ina okwe ka lombwela: “Omumwange, oshike we tu ningila ngaha? Tala, fye naxo twe ku konga nokuyehama.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oshike mwa konga nge? Kamu shi shii hamba, Ame ndi nokukala mwaai yaTate?”
Ndele vo ova li vehe udite ko eendjovo odo e di va lombwela.
Ndele Ye okwa dja mo navo, nokwe uya kuNasaret ndele okwa li ha dulika kuvo. Ndele ina okwa tuvikila eendjovo odo adishe momutima waye.
Ndele Jesus okwa kula mounongo nomoukulunhu nomonghenda puKalunga nopovanhu.
3: Ndele momudo omutimulongo nanhano wepangelo lomukesari Tiberius, Pontius Pilatus eshi kwa li omupangeli waJudea, naHerodes omupangeli woshitine muGalilea, nondenge yaye Filippus omupangeli woshitine shoshilongo shaIturea naTrakonitis, naLisanias omupangeli woshitine muAbilene,
naHannas naKajafas eshi va li ovapristeli ovakulunhu, eendjovo daKalunga ode uya kuJohannes, omona waSakaria, mombuwa.
Ndele ye okwa ya komikunda adishe dokuJordan nokwa udifa kutya, ovanhu nave lidilulule nava shashwe, opo omatimba avo a dimwe po,

ongaashi mwa shangwa momishangwa domaxunganeko omuxunganeki Jesaja:
“Ondaka yomwiingidi tai udika mombuwa:
‘Longekidileni Omwene ondjila,
mu yelakanifileni omalila,’

omalufilu aeshe naa fufilwe,
eemhunda nomituni adishe nadi kulumunwe po,
naashi sha endama nashi yukifwe,
noifilukutumba nai palwe,
nombelela aishe oi nokumona exupifo laKalunga.”
Ndele okwa lombwela eengudu odo de uya po va shashwe kuye: “Nye oludalo lomafu, olyelye e mu lombwela mu ye onhapo yehandu tali uya?
Imikeni hano oiimati yelidilululo, nye muha hovele okulipopila nokutya: ‘otu na tate Abraham;’ osheshi handi mu lombwele, Kalunga ta dulu okupendulila Abraham ounona momamanya aa.
Ndele paife ekuva ola tulwa pefina lomiti, keshe tuu omuti itau imi oiimati iwa otau kewa po ndele tau ekelwa momundilo.”
Ndele eengudu dovanhu ode mu pula da tya: “Tu nokuninga shike hano?”
Ndele ye okwe di nyamukula ta ti: “Ou e na oikutu ivali, shimwe ne shi pe ou ehe na, naau e neendja osho tuu na ninge.”
Ndele ovafutifi yo ove uya keshasho, ova tya kuye: “Omuhongi, otu na okuninga shike?”
Ndele ye okwe va lombwela: “Inamu futifa ovanhu shi dule eshi sha pangelwa.”
Ndele ovakwaita ve mu pula tava ti: “Fye otu na okuninga shike?” Ye okwe va lombwela: “Inamu fininika ovanhu, nye inamu va nyeka, ondjabi yeni tuu nai mu wanene.”
Ndele ovanhu eshi va li va teelela, ndele aveshe va diladila momitima davo, Johannes shiimba oye Kristus,

Johannes okwe va lombwela aveshe: “Ame ohandi mu shashe nomeva, ndele taku di ou e dule nge meenghono, ame inandi wana okuditula nande omiya deenghaku daye, ye ote mu shashe nOmhepo Iyapuki nomundilo.
Ye oku na oshiyelifo meke laye ndele ta kombo oshipale shaye, oilya ote i tuvikile momaanda aye nolungu ote li xwike nomundilo ihau dimi.”
Nomakumaido mahapu e lili okwe va kumaida noku va udifila evaengeli.
Ndelenee omupangeli woshitine, Herodes, eshi a hanyenwa kuye omolwaHerodias, omukainhu wondenge yaye nomolwowii aushe Herodes e u ninga,
koinima aishe ei okwa weda ko vali eshi, shokwiidilila Johannes modolongo.
Ndele opa ningwa, ovanhu aveshe eshi va shashwa naJesus eshi a shashwa ndele ta ilikana, eulu ola yeuluka
nOmhepo Iyapuki ya fa onghuti Oye mu kulukila nondaka ya dja meulu tai ti: “Oove Omona wange omuholike, onde ku hokwa.”
Ndele Jesus eshi a hovela oshilonga shaye, omido daye oda li di fike pomilongo itatu; okwa li, ngaashi kwa tengenekwa, omona waJosef owaEeli,
owaMatat owaLevi owaMelki owaJannai owaJosef,
owaMatatia owaAmos owaNahum owaEsli owaNagai,
owaMaat owaMatatia owaSemei owaJosek owaJooda,
owaJohanan owaResa owaSerubbabel owaSalatiel owaNeri,
owaMelki owaAddi owaKoosam owaElmadam owaEr,
owaJosua owaElieser owaJorim owaMatat owaLevi,
owaSimeon owaJuda owaJosef owaJonam owaEliakim,
owaMelea owaMenna owaMatat owaNatan owaDavid,
owaIsai owaObed owaBoas owaSala owaNashon,
owaAminadab owaAdmin owaArni owaHesron owaPeres owaJuda
owaJakob owaIsak owaAbraham owaTera owaNahor,
owaSeruh owaRehu owaPeleg owaEber owaShela,
owaKainan owaArfasad owaSem owaNoa owaLamek,
owaMetusala owaHenok owaJared owaMahalalel owaKainan,
owaEnos owaSet owaAdam owaKalunga.
4: Ndele Jesus okwa dja kuJordan a yada Omhepo Iyapuki ndele okwa twalwa kOmhepo mombuwa.
Satana okwe mu hongaula omafiku omilongo ine. Nomafiku oo ina lya sha, ndele eshi aa a pita po oku udite ondjala.
Ndelenee Satana okwe mu lombwela: “Oove ngeenge Omona waKalunga, lombwela hano emanya eli li shituke omungome.”

Ndelenee Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti:
“Hakomungome auke omunhu ta kala e nomwenyo.”
Opo Satana okwe mu twala komhunda ile, ndele e mu ulikila oilongo aishe yomounyuni mepakumo limwe alike
ndele ta ti kuye: “Epangelo laaishe ei nefimano lalo ohandi li ku pe, osheshi ame nde li pewa, nohandi li yandje kwaau nda hala.
Ove ngeenge to twile nge eengolo, aishe ei otai ningi yoye.”

Opo Jesus e mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Pa shangwa:
‘Omwene Kalunga koye u noku mu twila eengolo
noye aeke u noku mu kalela.’ ”
Ndele ye okwe mu twala kuJerusalem ndele e mu londeka koxulo yotembeli ndele okwa tya kuye: “Oove ngeenge Omona waKalunga, nhukila poshi,

osheshi pa shangwa:
‘Oye ote ku lombwelele ovaengeli vaye, ve ku amene,

ndele otave ku humbata nomaoko avo,
uhe lipume omhadi yoye kemanya.’ ”

Ndele Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Okwa tiwa:
‘Ino shinda Omwene Kalunga koye.’ ”
Ndele hano Satana eshi a xulifa omahongaulo aye aeshe okwa dja po puye manga.
Ndele Jesus okwa aluka ko meenghono dOmhepo e uya kuGalilea, nepopiwo laye ola ya komikunda adishe domoushiinda.
Ndele Ye okwe va longa meeshinagoga davo, ndele aveshe ove mu fimaneka.
Ye okwe uya kuNasaret omo a tekulwa ndele okwa ya moshinagoga efiku lEshabata, ngaashi a ika, ndele a fikama okulesha.
Ndele okwa pewa omishangwa domuxunganeki Jesaja. Hano eshi a tonyununa omishangwa, okwe litwa poima pa shangwa:

“Omhepo yOmwene oi li kombada yange,
osheshi Ye okwa vaeka nge
ndi udifile eehepele evaengeli,
Ye okwa tuma nge ndi xunge ava ve nomutima wa nyanyaulwa;
okwa tuma nge ndi ingidile eenghwate emangululo novapofi etwikululo,
okutembukifa mo oonakuhepekwa,
nokuudifa omudo muwa wOmwene.”
Ndele eshi a tonya omishangwa okwe di pa omupiya ndele okwa kala omutumba, nomesho aaveshe va li moshinagoga e mu tala.
Ndelenee Ye okwa hovela oku va udifila: “Nena tuu eli eshangelo eli la wanifwa ngaashi la fika momatwi eni.”
Ndele aveshe ove mu hepaulula nawa, ndele va kuminwa eendjovo odo donghenda da dja mokanya kaye ndele tava ti: “Ou ke fi omona waJosef?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Shiimba mwa hala okulombwela nge eyeletumbulo eli: ‘omuveluli, livelula mwene, osho twa uda sha ningilwa muKapernaum, shi ninga omu moshilando shambuleni yo.’ ”
Ndele Ye okwa tya vali: “Oshili handi mu lombwele, kape nomuxunganeki a fimana moshilando shavo.
Ndelenee shimwe ashike handi mu lombwele moshili, ovafiyekadi vahapu va li muIsrael pomafiku aElia, eulu eshi la li la idilwa po omido nhatu neehani hamano nondjala inene ye ile moshilongo ashishe.
Ndele Elia ina tuminwa kovafiyekadi vamwe, okomufiyekadi tuu ou womuSarefat aeke, muSidon.
Ndele ovanaudu voshilundu ova li vahapu muIsrael pomafiku Omuxunganeki Elisa, ndelenee inaku velulwa nande umwe, Naeman Omusiria, oye aeke.”
Opo nee aveshe ovo va li moshinagoga, eshi ve di uda, ova yada ehandu,
ndele va fikama ndele ove mu ta mo moshilando, ndele ove mu twala komungenge womhunda oyo oshilando shavo sha li sha tungilwa ko, ve ke mu undulile poshi.
Ndele Ye okwa pita mokati kavo ndele okwa ya.
Ndelenee Ye okwa ya kuKapernaum moshilando shomuGalilea, ndele okwe va longa momashabata.
Ndele vo ova kuminwa elongo laye, osheshi eendjovo daye oda li di neenghono.
Ndele omoshinagoga mwa li mu nomunhu e nomhepo ya nyata yondemoni. Ye okwa ingida mokule:
“Woo, otu na shike naave, Jesus Omunasareti! We uya u tu hanaune po? Ondi ku shii, Oove Omuyapuki waKalunga.”
Ndele Jesus okwe mu hanyena ta ti: “Mwena, ove u dje mo muye.” Opo ondemoni oye mu nata poshi mokati kavo ndele oya dja mo muye, ye ine mu ninga nande owii washa.
Aveshe ova kumwa unene, vo va pulafana tava ti: “Ondjovo ei oya tya ngahelipi, eshi ta lombwele eemhepo da nyata nepangelo neenghono, ndele do otadi di mo?”
Ndele etumbalo laye ola tandavela moshikandjo ashishe nomomikunda domoushiinda.
Ndele Ye okwa fikama moshinagoga ndele okwa ya meumbo laSimon, ndele ta hange inamweno yaSimon e kwetiwe kolwiidi la handuka, ndele vo ova indila Jesus omolwaye.
Ye okwa ehena kuye, ndele a hanyena olwiidi, ndele lo ole mu fiya po, ye okwa fikama po diva ndele okwe va yakula.
Ndele etango eshi la li pokuningina aveshe ovo va li ve novanaudu voudu u lili nau lili ove va eta kuye. Ye okwa tenheka omake aye kuvo aveshe, ndele okwe va velula.
Ndele eendemoni oda dja mo muvahapu, oda ingida tadi ti: “Oove Omona waKalunga.” Ye okwe di hanyena, Ye ina efa di popye, osheshi oda li di mu shii nokutya, Oye Kristus.
Ndele eshi kwa sha okwa dja mo ndele okwa ya koima kuhe na omaumbo, ndele eengudu ode mu konga, ndele eshi da fika kuye ode mu kwatela po aha dje po pudo.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Ondi na okuudifila oilando imwe yo evaengeli louhamba waKalunga, osheshi olo tuu eli nde li tuminwa.”
Ndele Ye okwa udifila meeshinagoga domuJudea.
5: Ndele opa ningwa, eshi a li ofika pefuta laGenesaret eengudu dovanhu de lifininikila puye, di pwilikine eendjovo daKalunga.
Ndele okwa mona eewato mbali da li pomunghulo, ndele ovayuli veeshi va hangika va dja mo, ndele va kosha oiyulifo yavo.
Ndele okwa ya muimwe yado, omwaai yaSimon, ndele e mu lombwela e i ehenife ko kanini i dje po pomunghulo, ndele okwa kala omutumba mowato, ndele a longa ovanhu.
Ndele eshi a mana okupopya, okwa lombwela Simon: “Ehena mokati kefuta mu ka lukile oiyulifo yeni.”
Ndele Simon okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omuhongi, oufiku aushe twa longa, fye inatu kwata mo sha, ndele oiyulifo ohandi i lukile molweendjovo doye.”
Ndele eshi ve shi ninga ova kwata eeshi dihapu unene, oiyulifo yavo oya tokauka.
Vo ova lapa oovakwao va li mowato ikwao, ve uye, ve va kwafe. Vo ove uya, ndele ova yadifa eewato adishe mbali hinga da ningina mo.
Ndele Simon Petrus eshi e shi mona, okwa twa eengolo keemhadi daJesus ndele ta ti: “Omwene, dja po pwaame, osheshi aame omulunde.”
Osheshi ye naaveshe ovo va li pamwe naye, ova halukilila eyulo olo ve li yula,
ndele osho tuu yo Jakob naJohannes, ovana vaSebedeus oovakwao vaSimon. Jesus okwa lombwela Simon: “Ino tila, okonena tuu eli oto ningi omuyuli wovanhu.”
Ndele vo ova eta eewato davo komunghulo, va fiya po aishe, ndele ove mu shikula.

Ndele opa ningwa, eshi a li koshilando shonhumba, omwa li mu nomulumenhu e yadi oshilundu, ye eshi a mona Jesus, okwa wila poshi koshipala shaye ndele okwe mu indila: “Omwene, ngeenge wa hala, Ove to dulu okuyelifa nge.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa nana eke laye, e mu kuma, ndele ta ti: “Onda hala, yela.” Opo pefimbo tuu olo oshilundu osha dja mo muye.
Ye okwe mu kumaida ehe shi hepaululile nande omunhu, ndele a tya: “Inda u ke liulikile omupristeli, ove u ka yandjele eveluko loye eyambo, ngaashi Moses a tile, opo li ninge ondobwedi kuvo.”
Ndelenee etumbalo laye ola tandavela, la ninga lihapu, novanhu vahapu ve uya oku mu uda nokuvelulwa kuye oudu wavo.
Ndelenee Ye okwe likalela Oye aeke mombuwa nokwiilikana oko.

Ndele efiku limwe, eshi kwa li ta longo ovanhu, Ovafarisai novalongimhango ova li po omutumba, va dile komikunda adishe domuGalilea nodomuJudea nomuJerusalem, ndele eenghono dOmwene oda longa mokuvelula ovanaudu.
Ndele tala, ovalumenhu vamwe ova humbata omunhu oshingudu a nangala kolutala, vo va hala oku mu eta mo noku mu nangeka koshipala shaJesus.
Nouhapu wovanhu eshi we va nyenga oku mu eta mo, ova londa kombada yongulu, va panuna onhala ndele ove mu kulukifa nolutala laye mokati kavo, koshipala shaJesus.
Ye eshi a mona eitavelo lavo okwa tya: “Omunhu, omatimba oye owe a diminwa po.”
Ndele ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai ova hovela nee okudiladila, ndele ova tya: “Olyelye ou, eshi ta popi ngaha omasheko? Olyelye ta dulu okudima po omatimba, ehe fi Kalunga, Oye aeke?”
Ndele omadiladilo avo eshi Jesus kwa li e a shii, okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Tamu diladila shike momitima deni?
Shipu shi dule shikwao oshilipipo okulombwela: ‘omatimba oye e ku diminwa po,’ ile okutya: ‘fikama u ende?’
Ndelenee opo mu shiive Omona wOmunhu e na eenghono kombada yedu okudima po omatimba,” okwa tya koshingudu: “Ohandi ku lombwele: Fikama, kufa po olutala loye, ove u ye keumbo.”
Opo nee ye okwa yambuka diva moipafi yavo, a kufa po olutala laye oko a li a nangala, ndele okwa ya keumbo nokuhambelela Kalunga.
Ndelenee aveshe ova kwatwa konghumwe, ndele ova hambelela Kalunga, ndele va yada oumbada, tava ti: “Nena otwa mona oinyengandunge.”
Ndelenee konima yaai okwa ya pondje, ndele okwa mona ko omufutifi nedina laye Levi, e li omutumba pongulu yomafutilo opeengaba, ndele te mu lombwele: “Shikule nge!”
Ye okwa fiya po aishe ndele okwe mu shikula.
Ndele Levi okwe mu ningila oshivilo shinene meumbo laye, ndele omo mwa li ongudu inene yovafendelifi noyavakwao va lila pamwe navo.
Ndele Ovafarisai novanongo vomishangwa vavo ova ngongotela ovalongwa vaye, ndele va tya: “Oshike tamu lile ndele tamu nwine pamwe novafendelifi novalunde?”
Ndele Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Ava ve li nawa ihava pumbwa omuveluli, ndelenee ovanaudu ovo tuu aveke.
Ame inandi uya okwiifana ovayuki, ndele ovalunde ve lidilulule.”
Opo vo va tya kuye: “Ovalongwa vaJohannes ohave lidilike eendja luhapu ndele hava ningi omailikano nosho yo vali ovo vOvafarisai, ndele voye ohava li nohava nu.”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Otamu dulu tuu okufininika ookaume komuhomboli ve lidilike oikulya, omuhomboli fimbo e li puvo?
Ndelenee omafiku otae uya fiku omuhomboli a kufwa po puvo, opo nee pomafiku oo tave lidilike.”

Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela efaneko ta ti: “Kaku na ou ta tete mo moshikutu shipe oshivando, ndele te shi hondjele koshikutu shikulu, ndele ngeenge te shi ningi, ota nyono po oshikutu shipe, noshivando shomoshikutu shipe itashi wapalele osho shikulu.
Ndele kape na ou ta dili omaviinyu mape momakutu makulu, ndele ngeenge te shi ningi, opo nee omaviinyu mape otaa pombaula omakutu ndele aa otaa tika mo, nomakutu otaa nyonauka po.
Ndelenee omaviinyu mape oku na okudilwa momakutu mape.
Ndele kape na ou a ikilila omaviinyu makulu a hala mape, osheshi ota ti: ‘Makulu omawa.’ ”
6: Ndele opa ningwa mEshabata limwe, Ye okwa tokola momapya, ndele ovalongwa vaye ova polola omasha ndele tava li noku a fengela pomake.
Ovafarisai vamwe ova tya: “Oshike tamu longo eshi sha dilikwa mefiku lEshabata?”
Ndele Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Hamba, inamu lesha, David nhumbi a ningile novanhu vaye, Ye eshi a fya ondjala,
nhumbi a ya mongulu yaKalunga, ndele okwa kufa mo omingome detaliko, ye a lya ndele ta pe ovanhu vaye, nande oda li da dilikwa okuliwa kovanhu vehe fi ovapristeli?”
Ye okwe va lombwela: “Omona wOmunhu Oye omwene wEshabata.”
Ndele mefiku limwe lEshabata opa ningwa, Ye okwe ya moshinagoga ndele okwa longa ovanhu, nomo mwa li mu nomulumenhu e nokwooko kwokolulyo kwa kukuta.
Ndele opo ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai ove mu nangela va mone ngeenge ta velula mEshabata, va mone omhito oku mu vela ombedi.
Ndele ye okwa li e shii omadiladilo avo, ndele ta ti komulumenhu, ou e neke la fya: “Fikama u ehene oku.” Ou okwa fikama ndele te uya po.
Jesus okwe va lombwela: “Ohandi mu pula, oshilipipo sha wapalela Eshabata, okulonga ouwa ile okulonga owii, okuxupifa omwenyo ile oku u nyona po?”
Ndele okwe va keuka aveshe nehandu, ndele okwa tya kuye: “Nana eke loye. Ndele ye okwe shi ninga, neke laye ola veluka.”
Ndele vo ova handuka, va kundafana nhumbi tava ningi Jesus.
Ndele momafiku aa opa ningwa, Ye eshi a londa komhunda a ka ilikane, okwa kala ko oufiku aushe nokwiilikana Kalunga.
Ndele eshi kwa sha, okwa ifana ovalongwa vaye ndele okwa hoolola mo omulongo navavali, ndele okwe va luka ovayapostoli:
Simon, ou e mu luka yo Petrus, naAndreas ondenge yaye, Jakob naJohannes, Filippus naBartolomeus,
Mateus naTomas, Jakob yaAlfeus, Simon ou a ifanwa omuladi,
Judas yaJakob naJudas Iskariot, ou a ninga omukengeleli waye.

Ndele eshi a londoloka ko pamwe navo, okwa kala ofika pehenene ndele oko kwa li ku nongudu inene yovalongwa vaye, novanhu vahapu vomuJudea ashishe novomuJerusalem novomomikunda daTirus nodaSidon di li pefuta, ava ve uya oku mu pwilikina nokuvelulwa komaudu avo,
nosho yo ava va li va hepekwa keemhepo da nyata ova velulwa.
Novanhu aveshe ova hala oku mu kuma, osheshi eenghono da dja muye da velula aveshe.

Ndelenee Ye okwa yelula omesho aye, a tala ovalongwa vaye ndele ta ti:
“Ovanelao nye eehepele, osheshi ouhamba waKalunga oweni.
“Ovanelao nye ovo mwa fya ondjala paife, osheshi nye otamu ka kutifwa. Ovanelao nye ava tamu lili paife, osheshi otamu ka yola.
“Ovanelao nye ovanhu ngeenge tave mu tondo molwedina lOmona wOmunhu ndele have mu kondo mo nohave mu sheke, nedina leni have li dini la fa lii.
Hafeni efiku olo nye mu nhuke nokunyakukwa pombada, osheshi ondjabi yeni oinene meulu, osheshi osho ngaha ooxe va ningila ovaxunganeki.
“Ndelenee woo nye oipuna, osheshi ehekeleko leni omwe li mona nokuli.

“Woo nye, ava mu nekuta paife, osheshi tamu ka fya ondjala.
“Woo nye, tamu yolo, osheshi otamu ka nyika oluhodi nokulila.
“Woo nye, ava ovanhu aveshe tave mu popile mouwa, osheshi osho tuu ngaha ooxe va ningila ovaxunganeki ovanaipupulu.
“Ndelenee nye ava tamu pwilikine ohandi mu lombwele: Holeni ovatondi veni, ovo have mu tondo va ningileni ouwa,
nangekeni noupuna ovo have mu fingi, ilikaneneni ava have mu sheke.
Ou te ku denge kolupanda, mu pa yo likwao, ndele ou te ku nyeka oshikutu shokombada, ino mu anyena naashi shokoshi.
Keshe ou te ku indile, mu pa, naau te ku kufa oshinima, ino shi mu pula nefininiko.
Ndelenee ngaashi mwa hala ovanhu ve mu ningile, osho va ningileni yo.
Ndele onye ngeenge mu hole ava ve mu hole, otamu mono epandulo lashike? Osheshi novalunde yo ove hole ava ve va hole.
Ndele ngeenge hamu ningile ouwa ovo have mu ningile ouwa, otamu mono epandulo lashike? Osheshi novalunde yo osho hava ningi.
Ndele ngeenge tamu yandje sha kwaava tamu teelele, ve shi mu alulile, otamu mono epandulo lashike? Novalunde yo otava yandje kovalunde, vo va pewe vali ngaashi va yandjele.

Ndelenee holeni ovatondi veni, nye mu va ningile ouwa, yandjeni nye muha teelele okwaalulilwa sha, opo ondjabi yeni tai ningi inene, ndele nye otamu ningi ovana vaau wOkombadambada, osheshi naye yo oku na onheni naava vehe shii okupandula naava vai.
Kaleni mu nonghenda, ngaashi Xo yeni e nonghenda.
“Ndele inamu tokola, nanye yo itamu tokolwa, inamu va tokolela ekano, nanye yo itamu tokolelwa ekano. Diminafaneni po omatimba, nanye yo tamu ke a diminwa po.

Yandjeni, nanye yo otamu ka pewa, oshiyelekifo shiwa sha fendwa, sha hekeshelwa, sha hekeshelekeka, tave shi tula mekolo leni. Osheshi oshiyelekifo eshi tamu shi yelekifa, nanye yo tamu ke shi yelekifwa.”
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela efaneko: “Omupofi ota dulu ngahelipi okukwata omupofi mukwao komhango? Itava wile melambo aveshe vavali?
Omulongwa ke dule omulongi waye; keshe ou a pwa okulongwa oye e fike pomulongi waye.
“Ndele oto mono ngahelipi okambodi ke li meisho lamukweni, ove uhe wete endangalati li li meisho loye mwene?

To dulu ngahelipi okulombwela omumwanyoko: ‘Omumwameme, handi uya ndi kufe mo okambodi ke li meisho loye,’ fimbo uhe wete endangalati li li meisho loye mwene? Omunaihelele ove, kufa mo tete endangalati meisho loye mwene, opo to mono nawa, nhumbi to kufa mo okambodi ke li meisho lamukweni.
“Osheshi kape na omuti muwa hau ima oiimati ii, ndele kape na omuti mwii hau ima oiimati iwa.
Osheshi keshe omuti ohau konekwa koiimati yao. Eenghwiyu ihadi likolwa komano, nomashila eeviinyu ihaa likolwa koshixwa sheno.
Omunhu muwa oha pitifa mo memona liwa lomutima waye ouwa, ndele ou mwii oha pitifa mo owii memona laye lowii, osheshi osho shi yadi omutima, okanya ohake shi popi.
Ndele oshike hamu ifana nge: ‘Omwene, Omwene,’ nye ihamu longo osho handi shi mu lombwele.
“Okeshe tuu ou te uya kwaame ndele ota udu eendjovo dange ndele te di wanifa, ohandi mu ulikile kutya okwa fa lyelye.

Ye okwa fomunhu ta tungu ongulu, ta fe mokule nomakanghameno e a tula kemanya, nefundja eshi le uya, omatondokelo omeva okwe litwa mongulu ei, ndele inaa dula oku i teya po, osheshi oyo ya li ya tungwa nawa.
Ndelenee ou te di udu, ndele ite shi ningi, ye okwa fomunhu a tungila pehekedu longaho puhe nomakanghameno, eyelu eshi la kungulukila kuyo, oya teka po, nengumauko layo la ninga linene.”
7: Ndele eshi a mana okupopya eendjovo edi adishe momatwi ovanhu, okwa ya nee kuKapernaum.
Ndele oko okwa li omunefele e na omupiya a vela unene, hinga a fye, ndele ye okwa li e holike kuye.
Ye eshi a kundana Jesus, okwa tuma ovakulunhu vOvajuda kuye, ndele ve mu indila, e uye a velule omupiya waye.
Hano ava eshi ve uya kuJesus, ove mu indila shili va tya: “Okwa wana okukwafwa kwoove,
Osheshi oku hole oshiwana shetu ndele okwe tu tungila oshinagoga.”

Opo Jesus okwa ya ko pamwe navo. Hano eshi a li ehe li vali kokule neumbo laye, omunefele okwa tuma ko ookaume kaye vamwe ve mu lombwele: “Omwene, ino lihepeka, osheshi ame inandi wapala u uye meumbo lange.
Onghee nde litala inandi wana ndi uye mwene kwoove, ndelenee tonga ashike ondjovo imwe, omupiya wange ta veluka.
Osheshi naame yo omupangelwa, ndele ondi na ovakwaita mepangelo lange, ndele ohandi lombwele ou: ‘Inda,’ ndele ta i, nomukwao: ‘Ila,’ ndele te uya, nokomupiya wange: ‘Shi longa,’ ndele te shi longo.”
Ndele Jesus eshi e di uda, okwe mu kuminwa ndele a pungulukila kovanhu ve mu shikula, ndele ta ti: “Ohandi mu lombwele: Eitavelo linene li fike apa inandi li mona nomuIsrael.”
Ndele ovatumwa eshi va aluka ko ve uya keumbo, ova hanga omupiya a veluka.
Ndelenee opa ningwa, Ye okwa ya koshilando edina lasho Nain, novalongwa vaye novanhu vahapu ova enda pamwe naye.
Ndele eshi a ehena koshivelo shoshilando, tala, omufi a humbatwa mo, omumati ewifa laina omufiyekadi, novanhu vahapu vomoshilando ove mu findikila.
Ndele Omwene eshi e mu mona okwe mu etififa olukeno ndele okwa tya kuye: “Ino lila.”
Nokwa ehena ko ndele ta kumu kolutala, ovahumbati ova kanghama. Ye okwa tya: “Omunyasha, ohandi ku lombwele, penduka po.”
Nakufya okwa kala omutumba, ndele okwa hovela okupopya. Ye okwe mu pa ina.
Ndele aveshe ova kwatwa ketilo ndele ova hambelela Kalunga tava ti: “Omuxunganeki munene a holoka mokati ketu, naKalunga e uya a tale ovanhu vaye.”
Netumbalo eli laye ola udika muJudea ashishe nokomikunda adishe domoushiinda.
Ndele Johannes okwa hepaululilwa aishe ei kovalongwa vaye.
Opo Johannes okwa ifana ovalongwa vaye vavali, ndele okwe va tuma kOmwene okupula: “Oove tuu ou onakuuya, ile natu teelele umwe?”
Ndele ovalumenhu venya eshi va fika kuye ova tya: “Johannes Omushashi okwe tu tuma kwoove, ndele ta ti: ‘Oove tuu ou onakuuya, ile natu teelele umwe?’ ”
Ndele mefimbo tuu olo ye okwa velula vahapu va li ve kwetiwe komaudu nokeemhepo dii, novapofi vahapu okwe va pashula.

Ndele Ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Indeni mu ka hepaululile Johannes ei mwe i mona nomwe i uda: ovapofi otava mono ko, noingudu tai ende, ovanashilundu tava yela, novafitamatwi tava udu ko, ovafi otava nyumunwa, neehepele tadi udifilwa evaengeli.
Nomunelao oye ou ita limbililwa nge.”
Ovatumwa vaJohannes eshi va dja po, okwa hovela okuhepaululila eengudu dovanhu Johannes, ta ti: “Mombuwa omwa ile mu ka tale shike? Olumbungu mbela tali nyenganyengifwa komhepo?
Ile omwa ile mu ka tale shike? Omunhu mbela a djala oikutu iwa ipu? Tala ovanhu hava djala oikutu iwa ipu, ove li meengulu deehamba.
Ile omwa ile mu ka tale shike? Omuxunganeki mbela? Oshili handi mu lombwele: Ye oku dule omuxunganeki.
Oye tuu ou a shangwa kwa tiwa: ‘Tala, ohandi ku tetekelifile omutumwa wange, te ku longekidile ondjila yoye komesho yoye.’
Ohandi mu lombwele: mokati kaava va dalwa kovakainhu kaku nomunene e dule Johannes, ndele ou munini e dulike kwaaveshe mouhamba waKalunga, oye e mu dule.”
Ndele ovanhu aveshe ava va li ve mu uda, novafutifi yo ova hepaulula Kalunga Oye omuyuki, ndele ove lishashifa eshasho laJohannes.
Ndelenee Ovafarisai novanongo vomhango ova dina omhangela yaKalunga molwaashi inave liyandja va shashwe kuye.
Jesus ta twikile: “Ndelenee Omwene okwa tya: Ovanhu vepupi eli ohandi va yeleke nashike nova fa lyelye?

Vo ova fa ounona ve li omutumba poilandelo, tava ingidafana ndele tava ti:
‘Otwe mu shikila eenyalilo,
nye inamu tutula oudano;
notwa imba omaimbilo eenghali,
ndele onye inamu lila.’
“Osheshi Johannes Omushashi e uya ina lya omungome, ye ina nwa omaviinyu, nye otamu ti: ‘Oku kwetiwe kondemoni.’
Omona wOmunhu e uya, ha li ndele ha nu, nye otamu ti: ‘Tala, omufukenhu ou nongholwe, kaume kovafendelifi nokovalunde.’
Ndelenee ounongo wa hololwa kovana aveshe vavo nokutya owa yuka.”
Ndele umwe womOvafarisai okwe mu ifana a lye pamwe naye, Ye okwa ya meumbo lOmufarisai ndele okwa kala omutumba poshililo.
Ndele tala, moshilando omo omwa li mu na omukainhu omulunde, ye eshi a uda kutya Jesus e li meumbo lOmufarisai e li omutumba poshililo, okwe uya mo e noshanga yomaadi a nyika nawa unene.

Nokwa ehena konima yaye peemhadi daye, ta lili, ndele ta hovele okututika eemhadi daye nomahodi ndele te di pushula neexwiki dokomutwe waye, ndele ta fipi eemhadi daye ndele te di vaeke nomaadi a nyika nawa.
Ndele Omufarisai ou e mu ifana eshi e shi mona, okwe lipopila mwene meni laye, ta ti: “Ou ngeno omuxunganeki, ngeno a koneka omukainhu ou omushike nokwa tya ngahelipi, nokutya, ye omulunde.”
Ndele Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Simon, ondi na ondjovo oku ku lombwela.” Ye okwa tya: “Omuhongi, popya.”
“Okwa li ku nomuyandji woikolo e novanhu vavali ve mu lila oikolo, umwe okwe mu lila oikolo yeedenari omafele atano, nomukwao omilongo itano.
Ndele eshi va nyengwa okufuta, okwe di va dimina po aveshe ovo vavali. Olyelye hano mwaava vavali ta kala e mu hole e dule mukwao?”
Ndele Simon okwa nyamukula, ta ti: “Ndishi oye ou a diminwa po dihapu.” Ye okwa tya kuye: “Wa tokola nawa.”

Ndele mokupungulukila komukainhu okwa tya kuSimon: “Omukainhu ou mu wete ou? Ame nde uya meumbo loye, ove ino pa nge omeva okukosha eemhadi, ou a tutika eemhadi dange nomahodi ndele okwe di fetifa eexwiki daye.
Ove ino fipa nge komilungu, ndele ou nghee tuu e uya mo ina efa okufipa eemhadi dange.
Ove ino vaeka omutwe wange nomaadi, ndele ou okwa vaeka eemhadi dange nomaadi.
Hano handi ku lombwele: Ou okwa diminwa po omatimba mahapu, onghee oku na ohole ihapu, ndele ou ta diminwa po manini, ye oku na ohole inini.”
Nokwa tya komukainhu: “Omatimba oye okwa dimwa po.”
Ovaenda vokoshililo ova hovela okudiladila: “Ou olyelye, nomatimba eshi te a dimi po?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya komukainhu: “Eitavelo loye le ku xupifa, inda nombili.”
8: Ndele opa ningwa konima yefimbo olo, Ye okwa endaenda noilando nomikunda ndele okwa udifa evaengeli louhamba waKalunga, naavo omulongo navavali ova li pamwe naye,
ngaashi yo ovakainhu vamwe ava va li ve neemhepo dii nomaudu, ndele ova li va velulwa: Maria ou a ifanwa Magdalena, mwaau eendemoni heyali da tewa mo,
naJohanna, omukainhu waKuusa, elenga laHerodes, naSusanna navakwao vahapu ava ve va yakula noinima yavo.
Ndelenee ongudu inene eshi ya ongala, novanhu vomoilando ve mu shikula, okwe va lombwela nomafaneko:
“Omukuni okwa pita a ka kune ombuto yaye, nomokukuna dimwe da wila mondjila ndele oda lyatwa, needila dokeulu de di shomona mo.
Ndele dikwao oda wila memanya nomokumena da lemba, osheshi kakwa li ku noututo.
Ndele dikwao da wila mokati keeshosholo, neeshosholo mokumena mumwe ode di fininika.
Ndele dikwao oda wila medu liwa, da mena, ndele oda dala efele.” Hano eshi e di tya okwa popya mokule ta ti: “Ou e nomatwi okuuda, na ude ko.”
Ndele opo ovalongwa vaye ove mu pula eendunge defaneko olo.
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Nye mwa pewa okushiiva oiholekwandunge youhamba waKalunga, vamwe tava lombwelwa momafaneko, opo vaha mone nande ohava tale, novaha koneke, nande ohava udu ko.
“Efaneko eli otali ti ngaha: Ombuto oyo eendjovo daKalunga.
Domondjila ovava tave di pwilikine, ndele opo nee Satana ote uya ndele ta kufa mo eendjovo momitima davo, vaha itavele vo vaha xupifwe.
Ndele edi domemanya ovovo hava pwilikine eendjovo, ndele have di tambula nehafo, ndele vehe na omidi, ohava itavele okafimbo, ndele efiku leyeleko otava efa.
Ndele odo da wila meeshosholo ovava hava pwilikine, ndele mokweenda kwavo otava fi oshuunguungu shoisho youpuna noyomahafo okukalamwenyo oku, ndele itava tilyaneke oiimati.
Ndele odo domedu liwa ovovo tava kwatele eendjovo ve di uda momitima diwa dihe noihelele, ndele otava imi oiimati moudiinini.
“Ndele kape na ou ta tema olamba ndele te i tuvike noshitoo ile te i tula koshi yomutala, ndelenee ote i tula moshikwatelwalamba, ava tave uya mo, opo va mone ouyelele.
Osheshi kaku na oshiholekwa, itashi ka hololwa, ndele kape na osho sha hondama, itashi ka shiivika noitashi uya pouyelele.
Taleni hano nhumbi tamu udu, osheshi ou e kwete, ye ota pewa, ndele ou ehe na, ye ota kufwa naasho e shii e shi kwete.”
Ndele ina novamwaina ovalumenhu ove uya kuye ndele ova nyengwa oku mu hanga okouhapu wovanhu.
Ye okwa lombwelwa: “Nyoko novamwanyoko ove li pondje, va hala ve ku mone.”
Ndelenee Ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Meme novamwameme ovava hava udu eendjovo daKalunga ndele otave di wanifa.”
Ndele opa ningwa efiku limwe, Ye mwene novalongwa vaye ova ya mowato, ndele okwe va lombwela: “Tuyeni langhele kwinya yefuta.” Ndele vo ova ya.
Ndele mokweenda kwavo Ye okwa kofa, ndele opa tukuluka omhepo yeenghono kombada yefuta, okawato oka yada omeva, ndele ova li ve noudjuu.
Opo vo ova ya, ve mu pendula va tya: “Omuhongi, omuhongi, ohatu ningine mo!” Hano eshi a penduka, okwa hanyena omhepo nomakufikufi omeva, ndele oo okwa oka, nefuta ola lota.
Ndelenee Ye okwe va lombwela: “Eitavelo leni oli li peni?” Vo ova tila, va kumwa ndele ova tongafana: “Ou olyelye, eshi ta lombwele omhepo nomeva, ndele taa dulika kuye.”
Ndele vo ova yaukila kedu lOvagerasa la taalelafana naGalilea.
Ndele eshi a dja mo, okwa ya komunghulo, omulumenhu wonhumba womoshilando e kwetiwe keendemoni e mu shakeneka, a ninga efiku ina djala oikutu yaye, ina kala meumbo, ndelenee okwa kala meembila.
Ndele eshi a mona Jesus, okwa ingida mokule, ndele okwa wila poshi puye ndele ta popi pombada: “Ou na shike naame, Jesus, Omona waKalunga wOkombadambada? Ohandi ku ilikana, ino hepeka nge.”

Osheshi Ye okwa li a hala okulombwela omhepo ya nyata i dje mo momunhu ou, osheshi oya ninga omafiku tai mu pundaula, ndele ye okwa li a mangwa nomalyenge nokomaoko nokomaulu ndele okwa nangelwa, opo ye okwa tokola eemhango, ndele okwa telwa momifitu kondemoni.
Jesus okwe mu pula: “Edina loye olilipi?” Ye a tya: “Ongudu yakula,” osheshi eendemoni dihapu da ya muye.
Ndele do ode mu indila, ehe di lombwele di ye mombwili yomundilo.
Ndele oko kwa li ku noufita munene woingulu tau li komhunda, odo de mu indila, e di itavelele okushita muyo, ndele Ye okwe di itavela.
Eendemoni oda dja momunhu ou, ndele oda ya moingulu, noufita aushe wa mbolokotela mefuta, ya wa komunghulo ndele oya fila mo.
Ndele ovafita eshi va mona osho sha ningwa po, ova faduka po, ndele ove ke shi hepaulula moshilando nomomikunda.
Opo ovanhu ova ya ko va ka tale eshi sha ningwa ko, ndele ove uya kuJesus, ndele ova hanga omunhu ou a dja eendemoni a djala oikutu, e neendunge, e li omutumba peemhadi daJesus, ndele vo ova haluka.
Ndele ava va li po ve shi mona, ove va hepaululila omunandemoni nhumbi a velulwa.
Ndele ovanhu aveshe vokedu lOvagerasa novopoushiinda ove mu ilikana a dje po puvo, osheshi ova kwatwa ketilo linene, ndele Ye okwa ya mowato, ndele a shuna.
Ndele omulumenhu ou a dja eendemoni, okwe mu indila a itavelwe okukala puye, ndele okwe mu lekela ta ti:
“Inda keumbo u ke va hepaululile oilonga apa i fike Kalunga e i ku ningila.” Ye okwa ya ndele okwa udifila oshilando ashishe oilonga inene apa i fike Jesus e i mu ningila.
Ndelenee Jesus eshi a aluka ko, ongudu yovanhu oye mu shakeneka nehafo, osheshi aveshe va hangika ve mu teelela.
Ndele tala, omulumenhu, edina laye Jairus, omukulunhu woshinagoga, okwe uya po ndele a wila poshi keemhadi daJesus, ndele okwe mu indila e uye keumbo laye,

osheshi ye okwa li e na ewifa laye okakadona komido ngeno omulongo nambali, taka vele ke li pokufya.
Ndele eshi ta i kwinya, eengudu dovanhu de mu fininika.
Ndele oko okwa li omukainhu a vela etiko lohonde eedula omulongo nambali, noinima yaye aishe okwe i manena movahakuli, ndele aveshe ova nyengwa oku mu velula.
Ye okwa ehena ko konima yaye, ndele a kuma keenyemba doshikutu shaye, opo tuu opo etiko lohonde yaye ola oka.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Olyelye ou a kuma nge?” Ndele aveshe eshi va anya, Petrus okwa tya: “Omuhongi, ongudu yovanhu otai ku fininike, ndele otai ku pumu;”
ndelenee Jesus okwa tya: “Umwe okwa kuma nge, osheshi onda uda mwaame mwa dja eenghono.”

Ndele omukainhu eshi a mona ita dulu vali okuhondama, okwa holoka nee, ta kakama, okwa wila poshi puye, ndele okwa hepaululila moipafi yovanhu aveshe eshi e mu kumina, nanhumbi a veluka okafimbo tuu oko.
Nokwa tya kuye: “Omumwange, eitavelo loye le ku velula, inda nombili.”
Hano fimbo a popya ngaha, okwa dja umwe keumbo lomukulunhu woshinagoga, ta ti: “Omumwoye okakadona oka fya, ino lolokifa vali omuhongi.”
Ndelenee Jesus eshi e di uda, okwe mu lombwela: “Ino tila, shimha wa itavela, ota xupifwa.”
Ndele opo nee eshi e uya meumbo, ina efa mu ye nande omunhu, oPetrus naJohannes naJakob naxe naina yokaana, ovo aveke.
Ndele aveshe ova lila noku mu kwenaukila. Ye okwa tya: “Inamu lila, inaka fya, oka kofa po.”
Ndele ovo ve mu yola, osheshi ova li ve shii nokutya, ye okwa fya.
Ndele Ye okwe mu kwata keke ndele okwa popya mokule: “Okakadona, penduka!”
Nomwenyo wako owa alukila mo, ndele ka fikama diva. Ye okwe va lombwela, ve ka pe eendja.
Novakulunhu vako ova kumwa, Ye okwe va kelela okuhepaululila nande omunhu eshi sha ningwa po.
9: Ndelenee Ye okwa ifana ava omulongo navavali, ndele okwe va pa eenghono okupangela eendemoni adishe nokuvelula omaudu.
Ndele okwe va tuma okuudifa ouhamba waKalunga nokuvelula ovanaudu.
Ndele okwe va lombwela: “Mondjila inamu ya mo nande nasha, nande ononhaili ile nekutu, hanomungome ile noimaliwa ile noikutu ivali.
Ndele ngeenge tamu i meumbo, kaleni omo fiyo tamu ehene komesho.
Ndele ngeenge pe na apa itamu tambulwa, djeni ko koshilando oko nye mu lipupule ondwi keemhadi deni, shi ninge ondobwedi kuvo.”
Ndele vo ova ya ndele va enda komikunda nomikunda, ova udifila mo evaengeli, ndele ova velula ovanaudu akushe.
Omupangeli woshitine Herodes eshi a uda aishe ei ya ningwa ko, okwa limbililwa, osheshi vamwe ova tya: Johannes okwa nyumuka koufi,
ndele vakwao ova tya: Elia okwa holoka, navakwao vali: Umwe womovaxunganeki vakulu a nyumuka koufi.
Ndele Herodes okwa tya: “Johannes, onde mu tetifa omutwe, ndelenee ou olyelye hano nde mu uda ta ningi oinima i fike apa?” Ndele ye okwa konga omhito oku mu mona.
Opo ovayapostoli va aluka ndele ove mu hepaululila aishe ei ve i longa. Ye okwa ya navo mouwike popepi noshilando shaBetsaida.
Ndelenee ovanhu eshi ve shi uda, ove mu shikula ko, Ye okwe va kunda ndele okwe va hepaululila ouhamba waKalunga, ndele okwa velula ava va pumbwa okuvelulwa.
Opo nee pokuningina kwetango venya omulongo navavali ove uya kuye ndele ove mu lombwela: “Lekela ovanhu va ye momikunda nomomaumbo omoushiinda va ka konge omilele nonghuta, osheshi otu li mombuwa.”
Ndelenee Ye okwe va lombwela: “Va peni eendja.” Vo ova tya: “Katu na sha shimwe, omingome nhano adike neeshi mbali, ngeenge itatu ka landela ovanhu ava aveshe eendja.”
Osheshi vo ova li po ovalumenhu ve fike pomayovi atano. Ye okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye: “Va kalekeni omutumba eengudu, mongudu keshe ve fike pomilongo itano.”
Ndele vo ove shi ninga, ve va kaleka aveshe omutumba.
Ndele Ye okwa kufa omingome odo nhano neeshi odo mbali, ndele okwa tala keulu, ndele okwe di nangeka noupuna, ndele okwe di pambula, nokwe di yandja kovalongwa ve di pe ovanhu.
Naaveshe ova lya ndele ova kuta, noundjaumukile ovo va xupa po, ova toolwa oimbale omulongo naivali.
Ndele opa ningwa nee, Ye eshi e likalela ndele okwa ilikana, ovalongwa va ongala puye, Ye okwe va pula ta ti: “Ovanhu otava ti Aame olyelye?”
Ndele ovo ve mu nyamukula tava ti: “OJohannes Omushashi, vamwe otava ti oElia navakwao otava ti oumwe womovaxunganeki vonale a nyumuka koufi.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Nye otamu ti Aame lyelye?” Petrus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Oove Kristus waKalunga.”
Ye okwe va kumaida shili, vehe shi hepaululile nande omunhu,
ndele ta ti: “Omona wOmunhu e na okuhepekwa unene nokweekelwashi kovakulunhu nokovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovanongo vomishangwa, Ye e nokudipawa, ndele efiku etitatu oku nokunyumuka.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kwaaveshe: “Ngeenge pe na ou a hala okushikula nge, ye ne lixupule ye mwene, ne litwike omushiyakano waye keshe efiku, ye na shikule nge.
Osheshi ou a hala okuxupifa omwenyo waye, ye ote u kanifa, ndele ou ta kanifa omwenyo waye omolwange ote u xupifa.
Osheshi otashi kwafa shike omunhu, ngeenge te lilikolele ounyuni aushe, ndelenee te likanifa ile te linyono po?
Osheshi ou ta fi nge ohoni neendjovo dange, Omona wOmunhu ote mu fi ohoni, eshi te uya moshinge shaye noshaXe noshovaengeli vayapuki.
Osheshi oshili handi mu lombwele: Mwaava ve li ofika apa omu na vamwe itava makele efyo fiyo tava mono ouhamba waKalunga.”
Ndelenee opa ningwa, eshi pa pita omafiku ahetatu eshi a popya eendjovo edi, Ye okwa kufa Petrus naJohannes naJakob, ndele okwa londa pamwe navo komhunda a ka ilikane.
Ndele fimbo ta ilikana, olupe loshipala shaye ola shituka noikutu yaye oya yela ya vilima.
Ndelenee tala, ovalumenhu vavali, Moses naElia, ova kundafana naye.
Ova holoka moshinge ndele ova kundafana okudja po kwaye, nhumbi te ke ku wanifa muJerusalem.
Ndele Petrus navakwao ova umbwa eemhofi didjuu, ndele eshi va penduka ova mona oshinge shaye novalumenhu ovo vavali va li ofika puye.

Ndelenee petukauko lavo naye Petrus okwa tya kuJesus: “Omuhongi, apa ope tu wapalela okukala, natu dikeni po omatwali atatu, limwe oloye, limwe olaMoses nalimwe olaElia.” Ndele okwa li ehe shii eshi ta popi.
Ndelenee fimbo a popya odo oshilemo she uya ndele oshe va tuvikila nomudile washo, ndele vo ova haluka eshi va tuvikilwa koshilemo.
Ndele ondaka ya dja moshilemo tai ti: “Ou Omona wange omuhoololwa, mu udeni.”
Ndele ondaka ei eshi ya udika, Jesus oku wetike e li po aeke. Ndele ove shi mwenena, nomafiku enya inava hepaululila nande omunhu, nande osha shomwaai va mona oko.
Ndele mefiku la shikula eshi va londoloka komhunda, ongudu inene yovanhu oye mu shakeneka.
Ndele tala, omulumenhu umwe womongudu okwa popya mokule, ta ti: “Omuhongi, ohandi ku ilikana u tale omona wange ou, osheshi ye ewifa lange.
Ndele tala, omhepo ohai mu kwata, opo nee ota kwena unene, oyo otai mu pundaula, ndele otai mu etifa onhutu mokanya ndele otai mu teyaula, ndele inai hala oku mu efa.
Ndele ame onda ilikana ovalongwa voye ve i te mo, ndele ova nyengwa.”
Ndele Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Woo, epupi eli lihe na eitavelo nola pilalala, fiyo onaini ndi nokukala punye, noku mu lididimikila. Omona woye mu eta oku.”
Ndele omumati fimbo kwa li te uya, omhepo ya nyata oye mu pundaula ndele ye mu kama neenghono. Ndele Jesus okwa hanyena omhepo ya nyata nokwa velula omumati ou, ndele okwe mu shunina xe.

Ndele aveshe ova kuminwa eenghono dinene daKalunga.
Ndele aveshe eshi va kuminwa oinenelonga yaye aishe, Ye okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye:
“Eendjovo edi di kwateleni momatwi eni. Omona wOmunhu ta yandjwa momake ovanhu.”
Ndelenee ova li vehe udite ko eendjovo odo, vo ove di holekwa inave di shiiva, ndele ova tila oku mu pula odo e di popya.
Ndele muvo omwa penduka ediladilo: Olyelye hano munene e dule vakwao?
Ndele Jesus eshi a shiiva ediladilo lokomitima davo, okwa kufa okaana nokwe ka kaleka ofika ponho yaye,
ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ou ta tambula okaana aka medina lange, aame ta tambula, naau ta tambula nge, oye ta tambula ou a tuma nge, osheshi ou munini womunye amushe, oye omunene.”
Ndelenee Johannes okwe mu lombwela ta ti: “Omuhongi, otwa mona umwe ha te mo eendemoni medina loye, fye otwe shi mu shilika, osheshi ye iha ende pamwe nafye.”
Ndelenee Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Inamu shi mu shilika, osheshi ou ehe na ondubo nanye, ye okwa ama kunye.”
Ndelenee opa ningwa, omafiku okuyelulwa kwaye kombada eshi a li pokufika, Ye okwa tokola shili okuyuka kuJerusalem,
Ndele okwa tetekelifa ovatumwa, vo ova ya ko ndele tava i momukunda wonhumba wOvasamaria ve ke mu kongele omulele.
Ndele vo inave mu tambula, osheshi Ye okwa li ta yuka kuJerusalem.
Ndele ovalongwa vaye Jakob naJohannes eshi ve shi mona ova tya: “Omwene, owa hala tu ifane omundilo meulu u va lungwinife po, Elia ngaashi a ningile?”
Ndelenee Ye okwa punguluka, ndele te va tangunine.
Ndele vo ova ya komukunda umwe u lili.
Ndelenee eshi va ehena komesho, umwe okwa tya kuye: “Ame onda hala oku ku shikula keshe apa to i.”
Jesus okwe mu lombwela: “Eembadje odi na omakwena, needila dokeulu odi na oihadi, ndelenee Omona wOmunhu ke na apa ta wilike omutwe waye.”
Ndele Ye okwa lombwela umwe e lili: “Shikule nge!” Ndele ou okwa tya: “Omwene, efe nge manga ndi ka pake tate.”
Ndele Ye okwe mu lombwela: “Efa ovafi va pake ovafi vavo, ndele ove inda u ka udife ouhamba waKalunga.”
Ndele umwe vali okwa tya: “Omwene, onda hala ndi ku shikule, ndelenee efe nge manga, ndi ke lilekele noovakwetu ve li meumbo lange.”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Kape nomunhu a kwata oshipululo neke laye ta tale vali konima, a wapalela ngeno ouhamba waKalunga.”
10: Ndelenee konima yaai Omwene okwa hoolola omilongo heyali nokwe va tuma oovavali noovavali ve mu tetekelele koshilando nokomukunda keshe ye mwene a hala okuya ko.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Eteyo olo olihapu, ndele ovalongi ovo ovanini, ilikaneni hano Omwene weteyo a tume ovatei meteyo laye.
Indeni ko! Tala, ohandi mu tumu ngaashi eedi mokati komambungu.
Inamu ya nande nokakutu koimaliwa ile nekutu ile neenghaku, inamu kunda nande omunhu mondjila.
Ndele ngeenge tamu i meumbo, tyeni tete: ‘Ombili nai kale meumbo eli.’
Ndele ngeenge omu na omona wombili, ombili yeni otai mu kalelele, ndele ngeenge kamu na, otai mu alukile.
Ndelenee meumbo tuu omo kaleni mo, mu lye nye mu nwe osho ve shi kwete, osheshi omulongi okwe lilongela ondjabi yaye. Inamu pitapita eumbo neumbo.
Ndele ngeenge tamu i moshilando ndele tave mu tambula, lyeni osho tamu shi pewa,
novanaudu ve li mo va veluleni, nye mu va lombwele: ‘Ouhamba waKalunga wa ehena popepi nanye.’
Ndelenee ngeenge tamu i moshilando omo itave mu tambula, indeni komapandavanda asho nye mu tye:
‘Nondwi yomoshilando sheni ya kanyatela keemhadi detu, ohatu i mu pupulile, ndelenee kaleni mu shi shii, ouhamba waKalunga wa ehena popepi nanye.’
Ndele ohandi mu lombwele, oSodom tashi ka ninga hixwe efiku olo shi dule oshilando osho.
“Woo ove, Korasin! Woo ove, Betsaida! Osheshi ngeno muTirus nomuSidon mwa ningilwa oinenelonga ei ya ningilwa munye, ngeno ve lidilulula nokukala omutumba momakutu nomomute.
Ndelenee Tirus naSidon oi na oupu i mu dule efiku letokolo.
Naave yo Kapernaum, ino tumbilwa tuu fiyo omeulu? Oto ka kulukila fiyo omoshovafi.
“Ou te mu udu, ota udu nge, naau te mu dini, ota dini nge, naau ta dini nge, ye ota dini ou a tuma nge.”
Ndele venya omilongo heyali va aluka nehafo ova tya: “Omwene, eendemoni oda dulika kufye omolwedina loye.”
Opo Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Onda mona Satana a wa meulu ngaashi oluvadi.”
Taleni, onde mu pa eenghono okulyata omayoka neendje nokupangela eenghono adishe domutondi, na kape na eshi tashi mu etele oshiponga.
Ndele inamu hafela eshi eemhepo tadi dulika kunye, hafeni omadina eni eshi a shangelwa meulu.

Mokafimbo tuu oko Jesus okwa hafela pombada mOmhepo Iyapuki ta ti: “Ohandi ku hambelele Tate, Omwene weulu nowedu, osheshi oinima ei owe i holeka ovanaendunge novanongo ndele owe i hololela ava va fa ouhanana. Heeno, Tate, osheshi osho she ku wapalela.
Aishe onde i pewa kuTate ndele kaku na ou ta shiiva Omona, Tate Oye tuu aeke, ndele kaku na ou ta shiiva Tate, Omona Oye tuu aeke, naau Omona a hala oku mu hololela.”
Ndele Ye okwa pungulukila kovalongwa vaye aveke ndele okwa tya: “Omesho taa mono ei mwe i tala oku na elao.
Osheshi handi mu lombwele, ovaxunganeki vahapu neehamba va li va hala okumona ei tamu i tale, vo inave i mona, nokuuda ei tamu i udu, vo inave i uda.”
Ndele tala, omunongo womhango umwe a fikama e mu yeleka ta ti: “Omuhongi, ondi na okulonga shike opo ndi fyuulule omwenyo waalushe?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuye: “MOmhango omwa shangwa ngahelipi? Oho lesha mo ngahelipi?”
Ndele Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Hola Omwene Kalunga koye nomutima woye aushe, nomwenyo woye aushe, neenghono doye adishe, neendunge doye adishe; nomukweni ngaashi ove mwene.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuye: “Wa nyamukula sha yuka, shi wanifa opo to kala u nomwenyo.”
Ndelenee winya okwa hala okulimonikifa omuyuki ndele ta ti kuJesus: “Omukwetu olyelye?”

Ndele Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omulumenhu wonhumba a dja muJerusalem ta i kuJeriko nokwa hangika kovanyeki, ve mu dula aishe, ndele ve mu denga, ndele ova ya ve mu fiya po e na okamwenyo kanini.
Nomupristeli wonhumba a hangika ta ende nondjila ei, okwe mu mona, ndele okwe mu pitilila po.
NOmulevi osho yo; eshi e uya poima opo, okwe mu mona ndele okwe mu pitilila po.
Ndelenee Omusamaria umwe a enda nondjila ei, eshi e uya po, okwe mu mona, ndele okwe mu fila onghenda.
Ndele okwa ya kuye, a manga oipute yaye, a tila po omaadi nomaviinyu, okwe mu londeka koshilondwa shaye, ndele okwe mu twala kongulu yovaenda ndele te mu xungu.
Ndele mefiku la shikula mokufikama kwaye, okwa kufa eedenari mbali, okwe di pa mwene weumbo lovaenda ndele okwa tya: ‘Mu xunga, ndele ngeenge itadi wana, ohandi ku pe mokwaaluka.’
Hano paendunge doye elipipo mwaava vatatu a li mukwao womunhu ou a hangikile kovanyeki?”
Ndele ye okwa tya: “Oyou e mu fila onghenda.” Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Naave yo inda u ka ninge ngaha.”
Ndele eshi va ehena ko vali, Ye okwe uya komukunda wonhumba, nomukainhu umwe edina laye Marta okwe mu tambula meumbo laye.
Ndele ye okwa li e na omumwaina Maria a kala omutumba peemhadi dOmwene, ndele ta pwilikine eendjovo daye.
Ndelenee Marta okwa viyauka unene noilonga yeyakulo, nokwe uya po, ta ti: “Omwene, ku na ko na sha mboli, omumwameme eshi ta viyaukifa nge aame andike, mu lombwela a kwafe nge.”
Ndelenee Omwene okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Marta, Marta, ove to lipe oshisho noupyakadi noinima ihapu.
Ndelenee shimwe ashike sha pumbiwa. Maria okwe lihoololela ombinga iwa itai mu kufwa.”
11: Ndele opa ningwa, Ye eshi a li monhele yonhumba ta ilikana, eshi a mana, umwe womovalongwa vaye okwe mu lombwela: “Omwene, tu longa okwiilikana ngaashi Johannes a longa ovalongwa vaye.”

Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Ngeenge tamu ilikana, tyeni:
‘Tate, edina loye nali yapulwe,
ouhamba woye nau uye,
ehalo loye nali wanifwe
kombada yedu yo ngaashi meulu,
tu pa efiku keshe omungome wetu womafiku aeshe,

ndele dima po omatimba etu,
osheshi nafye yo ohatu dimine po keshe tuu ou e noikolo nafye,
ino tu twala momayeleko,
ndelenee tu xupifa momunawii.’ ”
Ndelenee Ye okwe va lombwela: “Olyelye womunye e na kaume kaye te uya kuye mokati koufiku ndele ta ti: ‘Kaume kange, pe nge omingome nhatu,
osheshi kaume kange a dja mondjila e uya kwaame nondihe na eshi handi mu pakele po;’
ndele winya womeumbo te mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: ‘Ino ningila nge oupyakadi, omuvelo owa patwa, nounona vange va nangala pwaame momutala, itandi dulu okupenduka ndi di ku pe.’
Ohandi mu lombwele, ngeenge ita penduka e mu pe omolwoukaume, ota penduka omolwekenyeneko laye, ndele ote mu pe shi fike peemhumbwe daye.
Ndelenee handi mu lombwele: indileni, ndele tamu pewa, kongeni, ndele tamu mono, kongholeni, ndele tamu yeululwa.
Osheshi keshe tuu ou ta indile, ota pewa, nakeshe tuu ou ta kongo, ota mono, naau ta konghola, ota yeululwa.
Ndele olyelye womunye xe ou, omona waye ngeenge te mu indile oshi, te mu pe eyoka ponhele yoshi,
ile te mu indile ei, ndele te mu pe ngeno ondje?
Hano nye ava muvai, ngeenge omu shii okupa ovana veni oipewa iwa, unene tuu Xo yeni yomeulu ota yandje Omhepo Iyapuki kwaava tave mu indile.”
Opo Ye okwa ta mo ondemoni ei ya fitika ondaka, ndele opa ningwa, ondemoni eshi ya tewa mo, omulumenhu omufitandaka okwa popya, neengudu dovanhu oda kumwa.
Ndele vamwe vomuvo ova tya: “Eendemoni ote di tefa Belsebul, omukulunhu weendemoni.”
Ndele vamwe ova hala oku mu yeleka ndele ove mu pula edidiliko lomeulu.
Ndele Ye eshi kwa li e wete omadiladilo avo okwe va lombwela: “Keshe tuu oshilongo ngeenge shi nondubo musho vene, otashi hanauka po, nongulu otai wile ikwao.
Ndele Satana ngeenge e nondubo muye mwene, oshilongo shaye otashi kala po ngahelipi? Ngaashi tamu ti, eendemoni ohandi di tefa Belsebul;
Ndele eendemoni ngeenge handi di tefa mo Belsebul, ovana veni otave di tefa mo lyelye? Onghee vo otava ningi ovatokoli veni.
Ndelenee shimwe ashike, eendemoni ngeenge handi di tefa nomunwe waKalunga, opo nee ouhamba waKalunga owe uya kunye.
“Omunaenghono ngeenge a homata oiti yaye, ndele ota kelele eumbo laye, emona laye ola amenwa.
Ndelenee ngeenge taku di ou e mu dule eenghono ndele te mu te, ote mu nyeka oilwifo yaye, kwa li e i lineekela, ndele ta tukula oshihakanwa e shi mu nyeka.
Ou ehe li pamwe naame, ye oku na ondubo naame, naau ita ongele pamwe naame, ye ota hanauna po.
“Omhepo ya nyata ngeenge tai di momunhu otai pumauka meenhele dihe nomeva, tai kongo etulumuko, ndele eshi itai li mono, otai ti: ‘Ohandi ka shuna meumbo lange nda dile mo.’
Ndele ngeenge tai i mo, otai li hange la kombwa nola wapekwa,
yo otai i ndele tai ka kufa eemhepo dikwao heyali, edi di i dule mowii, notadi uya ndele tadi kala mo, nohauxuuninwa yomunhu ou otai ningi ii, i dule yotete mowii.”
Ndele fimbo kwa li ta tongo odo, omukainhu umwe womongudu a popya mokule ta ti: “Edimo le ku humbata oli na elao nomavele aa wa nyama.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Oshili, ovanelao ovava tava udu eendjovo daKalunga ndele tave di diinine.”
Ndelenee eengudu dovanhu eshi da ongala, Ye okwa hovela okupopya ta ti: “Epupi eli lii hali pula edidiliko, ndele itali pewa limwe li lili olo tuu eli lomuxunganeki Jona alike.
Osheshi ngaashi Jona a li edidiliko kOvaninive, osho nOmona wOmunhu ta kala edidiliko kepupi eli.
Ohamba omukainhu yokoumbuwanhu tai holoka petokolo lovalumenhu vepupi eli, ndele tai va pe etimba, osheshi yo oya dile keexulo dedu i ude eendunge daSalomo, ndele tala, ou e li apa, e dule Salomo.
Ovalumenhu Ovaninive otava ka nyumuka efiku letokolo, nepupi eli, ndele tave li pe etimba, osheshi vo ove lidilululifwa keudifo laJona, ndele tala, ou e li apa, e dule Jona.
“Ndele kape na omunhu ta tema olamba, ndele te i tula mekololo ile koshi yoshimbale, ndelenee ote i tula koshikwatelwalamba, opo ovo have uya mo va mone ouyelele.
Eisho loye olo olamba yolutu. Eisho loye fimbo li li nawa, nolutu loye alishe oli na ouyelele, ndele ngeenge olii, nolutu loye li nomilaulu.
Lungama hano, ouyelele womeni loye uha kale omulaulu.
Hano olutu loye alishe ngeenge la yela, muhe na nande ombinga i li momulaulu, otali ningi ouyelele auke, ove wa fa wa minikilwa komutemo wolamba.”
Ndele fimbo a popya edi, Omufarisai umwe okwe mu ifana komwisha, Ye okwa ya mo ndele a kala omutumba poshililo.
Ndele Omufarisai eshi a mona Ye ine likosha, eshi a ka lya, okwa kumwa.
Ndelenee Omwene okwe mu lombwela: “Nye Ovafarisai, ohamu kosho eholo netiti kombada, ndele meni leni omu yadi enyeko nowii.
Omalai nye, ou a shita eshi shokombada, haye tuu a shita eshi shomeni yo?
Eshi shomeni shi yandjeni oikwafa yeehepele, aishe notai mu koshokele.

“Ndelenee woo, nye Ovafarisai, eshi hamu yandje oitimulongo yombidi noyoidimba noyeembidi adishe, ndele hamu pitilile ouyuki nohole okuhola Kalunga, eshi oshi nokuwanifwa naashinya kashi na okweefiwa.
Woo nye Ovafarisai, eshi mu hole oipundi yokomesho moshinagoga nokupopifwa pomalandelo.
Woo nye ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai, eshi mwa fa eembila dihe wetike, novanhu tava ende kombada yado, ndele vo kave shi shii.”
Opo umwe womovanongo vomishangwa a hovela okupopya ndele ta ti kuye: “Omuhongi, eshi to popi ngaha, oto tu fifa ohoni.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Woo nanye yo ovanongo vomhango, eshi hamu twike ovanhu omitengi didjuu okuhumbata, nye vene ihamu di kumu nande okamunwe keni kamwe.
Woo nye, ovo hamu wapeke eembila dovaxunganeki, vo ova dipawa kooxo.
Hano osho ngaha onye eendobwedi doilonga yooxo, ndele mwe i itavela, osheshi vo ove va dipaa, ndele nye otamu tungu eembila davo.
Onghee ounongo waKalunga tau ti: ‘Ohandi va tumine ovaxunganeki novayapostoli, navamwe vomuvo otave va dipaa, navakwao tave va taataa,’
epupi eli opo li pulwe ohonde yovaxunganeki aveshe ya tilwashi okeshito lounyuni,
okohonde yaAbel fiyo okohonde yaSakaria a dipaelwa pokati keyambelo notembeli. Heeno, ohandi mu lombwele oyo otai ka pulwa kepupi eli.
“Woo nye ovanongo vomhango, eshi mwa nyeka ko oshapi younongo, nye vene inamu ya mo, naavo va hala okuya mo, omwe va kelela.”
Ndele eshi e va lombwela oinima ei, ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai va hovela oku mu fininika noku mu pula oinima ihapu,
noku mu nangela, va mone sha oku mu pa etimba.
12: Ndele fimbo e li oko, ovanhu omayovi nomayovi va ongala va lyatafana, Ye okwa hovela okulombwela ovalongwa vaye tete: “Komesho yaashishe lungameni onhafi yOvafarisai, nokutya, oihelele yavo.
Ndele kape na osho sha tuvikwa itashi ka tuulwa, ndele kape na osho sha holekwa itashi ka hololwa.
Onghee hano keshe osho tamu shi popi momilaulu, otashi ka udika mouyelele, ndele adishe odo mwe di nongofola mokutwi meendjuwo, otadi ka udifilwa kombada yeengulu.
“Ndele ohandi mu lombwele, ookaume kange, inamu tila ava hava dipaa olutu novehe na vali eshi tava dulu okuninga.
Ndelenee ohandi mu ulikile nee ou mu noku mu tila: tileni ou e na epangelo, eshi a dipaa, nokuundulila moheli. Heeno, ohandi mu lombwele oye tuu ou mu tileni.
Oonamusheshe vatano ihava landwa mbela noupeni vavali? Kalunga ina dimbwa nande oimwe yomudo.
Neexwiki deni dokomutwe oda valulwa adishe. Inamu tila, nye omu dule oonamusheshe vahapu.
“Ndele ohandi mu lombwele: keshe ou ta hepaulula nge moipafi yovanhu, nOmona wOmunhu ote mu hepaulula moipafi yovaengeli vaKalunga.
Ndelenee ou te lidimbike nge moipafi yovanhu, ye ote lidimbikwa moipafi yovaengeli vaKalunga.
“Ndele keshe tuu ou ta tumbula ondjovo ta popile Omona wOmunhu mowii, otai mu diminwa po, ndele ou ha sheke Omhepo Iyapuki ite i diminwa po.
“Ndele ngeenge tave mu twala keeshinagoga nokoshipala shovapangeli noshovakulunhu, inamu kala mu noshisho mu ka tye ngahelipi ile mu ka nyamukule shike mokulipopila, ile mu ka popye shike,
osheshi Omhepo Iyapuki otai mu longo pefimbo olo eshi mu na oku shi popya.”
Ndele umwe womongudu okwa tya kuye: “Omuhongi, lombwela omumwameme tu tukule efyuululo.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa tya kuye: “Menhu ove, olyelye a tula nge ndi ninge omutokoli nomutukuli woinima yeni?”
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Pashukeni nye mu lungame keshe tuu olwisho, osheshi omwenyo womunhu ihau xupifwa kouhapu weliko laye.”
Ndele okwe va lombwela efaneko, ta ti: “Epya loshipuna shonhumba ola dala nawa.
Ndele ye okwa diladila meni laye: ‘Ohandi ningi ngahelipi, osheshi ndihe na apa handi tuvikile oilya yange?’
Ndele okwa tya: ‘Ohandi ningi ngaha, ohandi hanauna po omaanda ange, ndele ohandi tungu po amwe manene, nohandi tuvikile mo oilya yange nemona lange,
ndele handi lombwele omwenyo wange: Omwenyo, owa tuvikililwa oipalwifa ihapu yomido dihapu, tulumukwa nee, lya, nwa, ove u nyakukwe.’
Ndelenee Kalunga okwe mu lombwela: ‘Elai ove, oufiku tuu ou wonena omwenyo woye oto u kufwa, hano aishe ei we i likola otai ningi yalyelye?’
Hano osho, ou te lilikolele emona, ye ke na oupuna puKalunga.”
Ndele Ye a lombwela vali ovalongwa vaye: “Onghee handi mu lombwele: inamu fila eemwenyo deni oshisho, mu lye shike, nomalutu eni, mu djale shike.
Osheshi omwenyo ou dule eendja nolutu li dule oikutu.
Taleni omakola, oo ihaa kunu ndele ihaa teya, ngaashi ehe nelimba lokutuvikila oinima, ile okaanda, ndele Kalunga te a palula, ndele nye omu dule eedila luhapu luhapu?
Ndele olyelye womunye ta dulu okuwedela komwenyo waye nande olundibo limwe noshisho shaye?
Hano ngeenge hamu nyengwa kwaai inini, oshike hamu kalele ikwao noshisho?
Taleni nokudidilika eenhemo domado nhumbi hadi kulu, ndele itadi hodila ndele itadi tungu oshiyata. Ndele ohandi mu lombwele: NaSalomo moshinge shaye ashishe ina djala a wapala ngaashi imwe yomudo.
Hano Kalunga ngeenge ta djaleke ngaha omwiidi womoixwa wa mena nena nomongula tau ekelwa mediko, ote mu djaleke yo, nye ovaneitavelo linini.
Osho nanye yo inamu lipula naashi tamu li ile naashi tamu nu, nye inamu lalakanena ei ileile.
Osheshi aishe ei ohai kongwa koiwana yomounyuni, ndele Xo yeni oku shi shii nokutya omwe i pumbwa.
Ndelenee kongeni ouhamba waKalunga naai aishe otamu i wedelwa ko.
“Ino tila, okangudu ove, osheshi Xo a hala oku mu pa ouhamba.
Landifeni po eliko leni, nye mu yandje oikwafa yeehepele, lilikoleleni omakutu ihaa kulupa, emona meulu ihali xulu po, omo ihamu hange omulunga nonhwishi itai nyonauna.
Osheshi oko kwa kala emona loye, oko kwa kala yo omutima woye.
“Oiya yeni nai kale ya mangwa neelamba deni da tema,
nye mu fe ovanhu va teelela Omwene wavo, ta di koshivilo shehombolo, opo ve mu yeulule diva nge te uya ndele ta konghola.
Ovanelao ovapiya ava Omwene wavo te va hange ve li oupafi nge te uya, oshili handi mu lombwele, Ye ote lidjaleke, ndele te va lombwele va kale omutumba note va yakula.
Ndele nande ne uye menangelo etivali loufiku ile etitatu, ndele te va hange ngaha, ovapiya ovo ovanelao.
Ndelenee shi shiiveni, mwene weumbo ngeno e shi shii fiku omulunga te uya, ngeno ta lungama eumbo laye liha teywe.
Nanye yo osho mu kale mwe lilongekida, osheshi Omona wOmunhu ote uya motundi ei inamu i teelela.”
Opo Petrus okwa tya: “Omwene, efaneko eli ofye we li lombwela, ile aaveshe?”
Ndele Omwene okwa tya: “Olyelye hano omukeleli weumbo omudiinini nomunaendunge, Omwene waye e mu pa epangelo lovapiya vaye, e va pe eendja pefimbo lado?
Omupiya omunelao oyou Omwene waye nge te uya ndele te mu hange ta longo ngaha.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Ye ote mu pe epangelo loinima yaye aishe.
Ndelenee omupiya ou ngeenge te lipopile momwenyo waye: ‘Omwene wange ite uya diva,’ ndele ta hovele okudenga ovamati noukadona, nokulya nokunwa nokukolwa,
Omwene womupiya ou te uya efiku eli ine mu teelela nefimbo eli ine li shiiva, ndele te mu shashaula ndele ote mu pe oshipewa pamwe naava inava itavela.
“Ndele omupiya ou kwa li e shii ehalo lOmwene waye, ye ine lilongekida ndele ina wanifa ehalo laye, ye ota dengwa omadengo mahapu.

Ndelenee ou kwa li ina shiiva ehalo laye, ndele okwe lilongela omadengo, ye ota dengwa kanini. Osheshi keshe tuu ou a pewa shihapu, oye ota pulwa yo shihapu, ndele ou a pewa epangelo laihapu, ota pulwa yo ihapu,
Ame nde uya okweekela omundilo kombada yedu, ndele nda hala nokuhalelela u xwame.
Ndelenee Ame ondi nokushashwa neshasho, ndele onda fininikwa ngahelipi fiyo la wanifwa.
Mu shii mbela Ame nde uya okweeta ombili kombada yedu? Ahowe, ohandi mu lombwele, etondafano.
Osheshi okonena eli vatano meumbo limwe tava kufafana po, vatatu tava tu ondubo navavali, navavali tava tu ondubo navatatu,
xe nomona omumati, nomumati naxe, ina nomona okakadona, nokakadona naina, inamweno noshitenya, noshitenya nainamweno.”
Opo Ye okwa lombwela yo eengudu dovanhu: “Ngeenge tamu mono omwaamba wa kambakana kouninginino otamu ti: ‘odula tai uya, nosho tai uya.’
Nomhepo yaumbuwanhu ngeenge tai pepe, otamu ti: otaku di oluteni ndele osho tashi ningwa yo.
Ovanaihelele nye, mu shii okukoneka oshipala shedu nosheulu, ndele ongahelipi muhe shii okukoneka efimbo eli?
“Ndele oshike itamu tokola yo munye vene eshi sha yuka?

Nge to i kovapangeli nomunashikolo naave, kendabala shili mu paafane ombili fimbo mu li mondjila, ye ehe ku twale komutokoli weendjovo, nomutokoli ehe ku yandje komukeleli, nomukeleli ehe ku idilile modolongo.
Ohandi ku lombwele: ku na opo to di mo fiyo wa futa okahaulapa kaxuuninwa.”
13: Ndele pefimbo olo opa hangika vamwe ve mu hepaululila Ovagalilea ovo Pilatus a lumbakanifa ohonde yavo mumwe nomaxwikiloyambo avo.
Ndele Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Omu shii Ovagalilea venya va hepekwa ngahenya ova li ovalunde ve dule Ovagalilea vakwao?
Ahowe, ndele ngeenge itamu lidilulula, osho nanye yo tamu ka nyonauka po amushe.
Ile mu shii omulongo navahetatu venya va fya, eshi va wilwa koshungo yomuSiloa ova li ovalunde ve dule Ovajerusalem vakwao aveshe?
Ahowe, ndele nanye yo, ngeenge itamu lidilulula, osho tuu tamu ka nyonauka po amushe.”
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela efaneko eli: “Okwa li ku na omunhu e na omukwiyu wa twikwa mepya laye lomiviinyu, ndele ye okwe uya okukonga mo oiimati muwo, ye ine i mona mo.
Ndele a lombwela omulongi wepya lomiviinyu: ‘Tala, omido nhatu nda ile okukonga oiimati momukwiyu ou, ame inandi mona mo sha. U ka po. Oshike tau kufa ashike edu eenghono?’
Ndelenee winya okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: ‘Omwene, u efa manga neudo, fimbo handi u helele vali, ndele handi u tutile oushosho.
Kashiimba tau imi tuu omudo ou tau uya, ndele ngeenge itau imi, opo nee nau kewe po.’ ”
Ndele Ye okwa hangika ta longo moshinagoga mefiku lEshabata.
Ndele tala, omo omwa hangikile omukainhu e nomhepo youngone ya kala muye omido Omulongo nahetatu, ndele ye okwa enda omwoodimba, ina shiiva nande okuyukilila.
Ndele Jesus eshi e mu mona, okwe mu ifana ndele ta ti kuye: “Omukainhu, wa veluka koudu woye,”
opo Ye okwe mu tenheka omake aye, nopo tuu opo ye okwa yukilila ndele okwa hambelela Kalunga.

Ndelenee mwene woshinagoga okwa umana, Jesus eshi a velula mEshabata, okwa hovela okupopya ndele ta lombwele ovanhu: “Oku na omafiku ahamano oilonga, ileni hano momafiku oo mu velulwe, ndele hamEshabata.”
Ndele Omwene okwe mu nyamukula, ta ti: “Omunaihelele ove, nanye yo ihamu pitifa mo ongobe ile okambulu keni moshuunda mEshabata, nye mu ke ka xwiile?
Ndelenee omukainhu ou, omona waAbraham, Satana e mu kwatelela meemhango, tala, omido omulongo nahetatu nokuli, aha mangululwe hamba meemhango edi mefiku lEshabata?”
Ndele eshi a popya odo, ovatondi vaye aveshe ova fya ohoni, nongudu aishe ya nyakukilwa oilonga yaye inene iwa.
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Ouhamba waKalunga owa fa shike, ndele handi u faneke nashike?
Oo wa fa ombuto yoshinapi, omunhu e i kufa ndele okwe i kuna moshikunino shaye, oya mena ndele ya kula ndee tai ningi omuti, needila dokeulu oda tunga oihadi yado moitai yao.”
Ndele okwa tya vali: “Ouhamba waKalunga nandi u faneke nashike?
Oo owa fa onhafi, omukainhu e i kufa ndele okwe i pilulila moufila weelita omilongo nhee fiyo aushe wa pya.”
Ndele Ye okwa endaenda koshilando noshilando, komukunda nomukunda, a longa ovanhu nokwa ya kuJerusalem.
Umwe okwe mu pula: “Omwene, ava tava xupifwa ovanini hamba?” Ye okwe va lombwela:
“Kondjeni mu ye mo moshivelo sha finana, osheshi handi mu lombwele, vahapu tava kendabala okuya mo, ndele tava ka nyengwa.

“Mwene weumbo ngeenge a fikama ndele ta pate po omuvelo, nye otamu hovele okukala ofika pondje nokukonghola pomuvelo nokwiifana: ‘Omwene, tu yeulula,’ Ye ote mu nyamukula ta ti: ‘Ame nghi mu shii, ndele nghi shii apa mwa dja.’
Nye otamu hovele okupopya: ‘Hafye tuu ovo twa lile ndele twa nwine moipafi yoye, ndele Ove wa longa momapandavanda etu?’
Ndele Ye ota ti: ‘Ohandi mu lombwele, Ame nghi mu shii apa mwa dja; djeni po pwaame, nye amushe ovalongi vowii.’
Ndele oko tapa ka kala omalilaano nelikweshelo lomayoo, nge tamu mono Abraham naIsak naJakob novaxunganeki aveshe mouhamba waKalunga, ndelenee nye mwa undulilwa pondje.
Ndele ovanhu otava ka dja koushilo nokouninginino nokoumbangalanhu nokoumbuwanhu, tave uya ndele otava kala omutumba poshililo mouhamba waKalunga.
Ndele tala, oku na vaxuuninwa tava ningi votete, ndele ku na votete tava ningi vaxuuninwa.”
Ndele pefimbo tuu olo Ovafarisai vamwe ve uya po ndele ve mu lombwela: “Fikama Ove u dje po apa, osheshi Herodes a hala oku ku dipaa.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Indeni mu ka lombwele okavandje oko, mu tye: ‘Tala, onena nomongula handi te mo eendemoni nohandi velula, ndele efiku etitatu ohandi ka hanga efikilo.’
Ndelenee ondi nokweendaenda nena nomongula nomongheleinya, osheshi itashi ningwa omuxunganeki a file pamwe pe lili, muJerusalem omo tuu.

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, ove ou ho dipaa ovaxunganeki noho dipaa nomamanya ovo we va tuminwa, lungapi nda li nda hala okwoongela ovamwoye, ngaashi oxuxwa hai ongele ouxuxwena momavava ayo, ndele nye inamu hala.
Tala, ongulu yeni otai kala ongaho, ndele handi mu lombwele: itamu mono nge vali fiyo efimbo olo tali uya, fiku tamu ti: ‘Na nangekwe noupuna, ou te uya medina lOmwene.’ ”
14: Ndele opa ningwa, Ye eshi e uya meumbo lomukulunhu wOvafarisai mEshabata okulya omungome, vo ove mu nangela.
Ndele tala, moipafi yaye omwa li mu na omunhu a vela oshidinda.
Ndele Jesus okwa hovela okupopya ta ti kovanongo vomhango nokOvafarisai: “Osha yuka tuu okuvelula omunhu mEshabata ile ahowe?”
Ndelenee vo ova mwena filu. Ye okwe mu kuma, e mu velula ndele okwe mu lekela.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Olyelye hano womunye e nondongi ile ongobe tai wile momufima, ndele ite i shili mo ngeno divadiva nande oku naEshabata?”
Ndele vo ova nyengwa okunyamukula eendjovo edi.
Ndele eshi a mona ovaenda ve lihoololela oipundi yokomesho, okwe va lombwela efaneko ta ti:
“Ngeenge ove to ifanwa kuumwe koshivilo shehombolo, ino kala omutumba koshipundi shokomesho, puha ningwe ngeenge tape uya omwiifanwa umwe e ku dule oulenga,
ndele ou e mu ifana amushe, ngeenge te uya aha tye kwoove: ‘Yapukila ou ndele opo u nokuya koshipundi shokonima wa fya ohoni.’

Ndele ngeenge wa ifanenwa ko, kala omutumba koshipundi shokonima, naau e ku ifana, ngeenge te uya mo ote ku lombwele: ‘Kaume kange, ehena pombada,’ opo to fimanekwa moipafi yaaveshe ve li pamwe naave poshililo.
Osheshi keshe ou te linenepeke ota ninipikwa, naau te lininipike ota ka nenepekwa.”

Ndele Ye okwa lombwela ou e mu ifana po ta ti: “Ngeenge to pake po omwisha ile ouvalelo, ino ifana ookaume koye ile ovamwanyoko ile ovakweni ile ovashiinda voye oipuna, vehe ku ifane yo, ove u futwe ngaha.
Ndele ngeenge to pake po oitelekela, ifana ovakwanaluhepo noingudu noilema novapofi.
Ndele ove to ningi omunelao, osheshi ovo kave na eshi tave ku pe, ndele to ka futilwa menyumuko lovayuki.”
Ndele umwe womovaenda eshi e di uda okwa tya kuye: “Omunelao oyou ta ka lya omungome mouhamba waKalunga.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa tya kuye: “Omulumenhu umwe okwa teleka oitendele inene, ndele a shivila mo vahapu.
Ndele efimbo loitendele eshi la fika, ye okwa tuma ko omupiya waye a ka lombwele ovashivwa: ‘Ileni, osheshi ashishe sha longekidwa nokuli.’
Ndele vo aveshe ova hovela okwaanya panghedi imwe. Wotete okwa tya kuye: ‘Ame onde lilandela epya, nondi nokuya ko ndi ke li tale, ohandi ku indile, popile nge.’
Namukwao okwa tya: ‘Ame onda landa eenhani deendjoko nhano, ondi na oku ke di hetekela, handi ku indile, popile nge.’
Nomukwao vali okwa tya: ‘Ame onda hombola, onghee itandi shiiva okuya ko.’ ”

“Ndele omupiya okwa aluka ndele okwa hepaululila omwene waye adishe, ndele mwene weumbo okwa handuka, ndele ta lombwele omupiya waye: ‘Endelela, inda keendjila nokomalila oshilando, ove u ka ete mo oingudu neehepele novapofi noilema.’
Ndele omupiya okwa tya: ‘Omwene, onda wanifa eendjovo doye, ndele natango ope nonhele.’
Omwene okwa lombwela omupiya: ‘Inda komalila omikunda nokomangholo eengubu, ove u va kondjife shili okuuya mo, eumbo lange li yade,
osheshi ohandi mu lombwele, kape na nande umwe womovalumenhu venya va ifanenwe ta makele oitendele yange.’ ”
Ndele eengudu dinene oda enda pamwe naye, Ye okwa punguluka ndele ta ti kudo:
