“Ngeenge ope na ou te uya kwaame, ye ita tondo xe naina, omukainhu waye novana, novamwaina ovamati noukadona nomwenyo waye mwene nokuli, okwa nyengwa okuninga omulongwa wange.
Ndele ou ita humbata omushiyakano waye ndele ta shikula nge, ye ita dulu okukala omulongwa wange.
Osheshi ngeenge oku na ou womunye a hala okutunga ongulushungo, ita kala omutumba manga ngeno, ndele ta valula oitungifo, ngeenge oku na oimaliwa oku i wanifa,
opo shiha ninge, eshi a tunga ekanghameno ndele ota nyengwa oku i xulifa, aveshe ava ve mu tala, tava hovele oku mu sheka ndele tava ti:
‘Omunhu ou okwa hovela okutunga, ndele okwa nyengwa okuxulifa.’
Ile ngeenge oku na ohamba tai i koita i ka homone ohamba imwe, itai kala manga omutumba i lipulapule, ngeenge otai dulu nomayovi ayo omulongo umwe okushakeneka winya te uya nomayovi omilongo mbali?
Ndele ngeenge ya nyengwa, otai tumu ko ovatumwa, mukwao fimbo e li kokule ndele tai mu indile ombili.
Osho tuu kape na nande umwe womunye ta dulu okukala omulongwa wange, ngeenge ita efa aishe ye e i kwete.
“Heeno, omongwa oo oshinima shiwa, ndele omongwa ngeenge tau tutuka, otau nyenyepekwa vali nashike?
Inau wapalela mepya nomoushosho, otau ekelwashi ashike pondje. Ou e na omatwi okuuda, na ude ko.”
15: Ndele ovafutifi aveshe novalunde va li have uya kuye oku mu uda.
Ndele Ovafarisai novanongo vomhango ova ngongota tava ti: “Ou ota tambula ovalunde ndele ta lile pamwe navo.”
Ndelenee Ye okwe va lombwela efaneko eli ta ti:
“Olyelye ou womunye e na eedi efele limwe ndele ta kanifa mo imwe, ita fii po ngeno odo omilongo omugoi nomugoi, ndele ta ka shikula inya ya kana fiyo te i mono?
Ndele ngeenge te i mono, ote i humbata komapepe aye nokunyakukwa.
Ndele ngeenge te uya keumbo, ota ifana ookaume novashiinda vaye, ndele ote va lombwele: ‘Hafeni pamwe naame, osheshi odi yange ya li ya kana onde i mona.’
Ohandi mu lombwele: ‘Osho yo meulu tamu ka kala ehafo lokuhafela omulunde umwe e lidilulula, li dule olo lokuhafela ovayuki omilongo omugoi nomugoi ava itava pumbwa elidilululo.’
“Ile omukainhu olyelye, ngeenge e kwete oimaliwa oisiliveli omulongo, ndele ta kanifa po shimwe, ita temifa olamba ye ita kombo meumbo noku shi konga shili fiyo ote shi mono?
Ndele ngeenge te shi mono, ota ifana ookahewa novashiinda vaye ndele ta ti: ‘Tu nyakukweni, osheshi oshimaliwa shange nde shi kanifile, onde shi mona.’
Ohandi mu lombwele, osho tuu tamu ningi ehafo movaengeli vaKalunga omolwomulunde umwe e lidilulula.”
Opo nee Ye okwa popya vali: “Okwa li ku nomunhu e novana ovamati vavali.
Ndele ou munini okwa tya kuxe: ‘Tate, pe nge ombinga ei yeliko ndi noku i pewa’. Ye okwe va tukulila emona laye.
Ndele inapa pita nee omafiku mahapu, omona ou munini okwa ongela oinima yaye aishe, ndele okwa ya koshilongo shokokule, ndele okwa hanaunina ko emona laye nokukala moulunde.
Ndele eshi a mana po aishe, oshilongo shinya osha hangika kondjala inene, ndele ye okwa hovela okuhepa.
Okwa ya ko ndele okwe litula poshipuna shoshilongo shinya. Ye okwe mu tuma momaluxwa aye okulifa oingulu.
Ndele okwa hala okukutifa edimo laye nomahakashala omakunde aa haa liwa koingulu, ndele ine a pewa nande okomunhu.
Opo nee e lialuluka, ndele ta ti: ‘Ovapiya vatate vahapu ve fike peni ve noikulya ya wana, ndele ame ohandi fi ondjala.
Ohandi fikama ndele handi i kutate, ndele handi mu lombwele: Tate, onda nyona keulu nokoshipala shoye,
ndele ame inandi wana vali ndi ifanwe omona woye, tambule nge ngaashi umwe womovapiya voye.’

Ndele ye okwa fikama ndele okwa ya kuxe.
“Ndele fimbo a li kokule, xe okwe mu mona ndele okwe mu udila onghenda, a tondoka e mu shakeneke ndele okwe mu dingatela kofingo, yaye ndele okwe mu fipa komilungu.
Ndele omona okwe mu lombwela: ‘Tate, onda nyona keulu nokwoove, ame inandi wana vali okwiifanwa omona woye.’
Ndele xe okwa lombwela ovapiya vaye: ‘Ka eteni divadiva oshikutu shinya shiwa shiwelela, mu shi mu dike, nokalinga ka dikeni komunwe waye, neenghaku keemhadi daye,
nye mu ka tale ko onhana inya ya ondoka, i tomeni, tu lyeni fye tu hafeni,
osheshi omona wange ou okwa li a fya, ndele okwa nyumuka, okwa li a kana, ndele okwa monika.’ Ndele vo ova hovela okuhafa.
“Ndelenee omona waye omukulunhu okwa hangika mepya. Hano eshi e uya a fika popepi neumbo, okwa uda mo olwiimbo noudano.
Ndele okwa ifana omupiya umwe, okwe mu pula eshi shi li mo.
Ou okwa tya kuye: ‘Omumwanyoko e uya, xo okwe mu tomena onhana inya ya ondoka, eshi e mu mona e nomwenyo.’
Ndele ye okwa handuka, ye ina hala okuya mo meumbo. Xe okwe uya pondje, ndele okwe mu popifa nombili.
Ndelenee ye okwa tya kuxe: ‘Tala, omido edi nde ku kalela apa di fike, ndele inandi nyona nande oshipango shoye. Ove ino pa nge nande okakombwena ndi hafe pamwe nookaume kange.
Ndelenee omona woye oo a manena po emona loye meembwada, eshi e uya, ove owe mu tomena onhana inya ya ondoka.’
Ye okwe mu lombwela: ‘Omona wange, ove owa kala alushe pwaame, ndele aishe yange oyoye yo.
Ndele paife eshi otu nokuhafa, osheshi omumwanyoko ou okwa li a fya ndele okwa ninga vali omwenyo, okwa li a kana ndele okwa monika.’ ”
16: Ndele Ye okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye: “Okwa li ku na omulumenhu oshipuna shi nomukeleli weumbo lasho, a popiwa ta hanauna po emona lasho.
Ndele ye okwe mu ifana, ndele okwa tya kuye: ‘Ohandi ku udile shike hano? Valula oinima yomepangelo loye, ku na vali oku i pangela.’
Opo nee omukeleli ou okwe lipulapula: ‘Ohandi ningi ngahelipi, omwene wange ngeenge ta kufa nge oukeleli? Okulima itandi ku dulu, nokweehela nda fya ohoni.
Ondi shi shii eshi handi ningi, opo va tambule nge momaumbo avo, ngeenge handi tewa mo moukeleli.’
Ye okwa ifana aveshe ve noshikolo nomwene waye, okwa tya kwaau e uya mo tete: ‘oshikolo shoye nomwene wange oshi fike peni?’
Ndele winya okwa tya: ‘Omaadi oivambelo efele.’ Opo ye okwa tya kuye: ‘Kufa omushangwa woye woshikolo, kala omutumba ove u shangele mo divadiva omilongo itano.’
Ndele okwa tya kumukwao: ‘Ove nee, oshikolo shoye oshi fike peni?’ Ye okwa tya: ‘Oilya omakutu efele.’ Ye okwa tya kuye: ‘Kufa omushangwa woshikolo ove u shangele mo omilongo hetatu.’
Omwene okwa pandula omukeleli ehe fi omuyuki molwaashi e neendunge. Osheshi ovana vounyuni ou ove na omakeko mokukalafana kwavo ve dule ovana vouyelele.”
Ame ohandi mu lombwele: “Likongeleni nemona loipupulu ookaume, olo ngeenge tali xulu po, opo ve mu tambule momaumbo aalushe.
Ou ha kala omudiinini moinini, ye omuwa nomwaai ihapu, ndele ou ke fi omuyuki moinima inini, ye ke fi omuyuki nomwaai ihapu yo.
Ndele ngeenge ihamu kala ovadiinini nemona loipupulu, olyelye te mu pe ei yoshili?
Ndele ngeenge ihamu kala ovadiinini noinima yovanhu, olyelye te mu pe ei yeni vene?
Ndele kape nomukalele ta dulu okulongela oovene vavali, osheshi ota kala nokutonda umwe nokuhola mukwao, ile ta hokwa ou ndele ta dini mukwao. Kamu dulu okukalela Kalunga nemona.”
Ndele Ovafarisai venya va li ve hole oimaliwa, ove di uda adishe, ndele ove mu kenya.
Ndele opo Ye okwe va lombwela: “Onye tuu ovo hamu lipe ouyuki moipafi yovanhu, ndelenee Kalunga e wete omitima deni, osheshi osho sha fimana povanhu, osho oixuna puKalunga.
“Ndele omhango novaxunganeki ova xulila muJohannes, ndele okudja kefiku olo ondaka iwa youhamba waKalunga otai udifwa, ndele aveshe tave liundulile mo neenghono.
Ndelenee eulu nedu nande naa xule po, komhango itaku di nande oshinghwanyu shimwe.
“Keshe tuu ou ta henge po omukainhu waye ndele ota hombola umwe e lilii, oye ta haele, naau ta hombola omuhengwa, ota haele.
“Ndele okwa li ku nomulumenhu oshipuna a djala oikutu itilyana naai itoka iwa, ndele okwa nyakukwa omafiku aeshe mewano loinima yaye.
Ndele ohepele imwe, edina layo Lasarus a nangala poshivelo shaye nolutu laye alishe la tuta omatito,
ndele okwa hala okulikutifa noundjaumukile ava hava u koshililo shoshipuna. Neembwa ode uya ndele oda lafa omatito aye.
Ndele opa ningwa nee, ohepele ya fya, ndele oya twalwa kovaengeli mekolo laAbraham, noshipuna osha fya yo, ndele tashi pakwa.
Ndele mokukala mouyehame moshovafi, eshi sha yelula omesho asho, osha mona Abraham kokule naLasarus mekolo laye.
Ndele ye okwa ingida a tya: ‘Tate Abraham, file nge onghenda, ove u tume Lasarus a yaveke oxulo yomunwe waye momeva, ye a talaleke elaka lange, osheshi ame ndi li mo handi yehamekwa nai momutemo ou.’
Ndelenee Abraham okwa tya: ‘Omona wange, dimbulukwa, ove owa pelwe ouwa woye fimbo wa li u nomwenyo ndele Lasarus owii, hano paife eshi ye ota hekelekwa omu, ndele ove to yehamekwa.
Ndelenee oku na vali ombwili inene ya tulwa pokati ketu nanye, opo aveshe venya va hala okutaulukila kunye, vaha dule, naavo ve li oko vaha dule okuuya kufye.’
Ndele ye okwa tya: ‘Ohandi ku ilikana hano, tate, mu tuma keumbo latate,
osheshi ondi na ovamwameme ovalumenhu vatano, e va hepaululile, navo yo vaha ye monhele ei yomayehamo.’
Ndele Abraham okwa tya: ‘Vo ove naMoses novaxunganeki, nava ude venya.’
Ndelenee okwa tya: ‘Ahowe, tate Abraham, ngeenge umwe womovafi ta i ko kuvo, ngeno tave lidilulula.’
Ndelenee ye okwa tya kuye: ‘Ngeenge itava udu Moses novaxunganeki, itava itavelifwa nande namu nyumuke umwe womovafi.’ ”
17: Ndele Ye okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye: “Itashi dulika omahongaulo ehe uye, ndelenee woo, ou te a eta!
Oshiwa kuye ngeno a mangelwe emanya loshini kofingo yaye, ye a ekelwe mefuta, shi dule eshi ta hongaula kamwe kaava vanini.

Lilungameneni nye vene!
“Omumwanyoko ngeenge ta nyono, mu hanyena, ndele ngeenge te lidilulula, mu kufila po.
Ndele ngeenge te ku ningi nai luheyali mefiku limwe alike, ndele ta aluka luheyali ndele ta ti: ‘Onde lialuluka,’ mu dimina po.”
Ovayapostoli ova tya kOmwene: “Tu wedela eitavelo.”
Ndele Omwene ta ti: “Ngeno omu na eitavelo li fike pombuto yoshinapi ndele tamu lombwele omukwiyu ou: ‘Lidikula po ove u litwike mefuta,’ ngeno tau mu udu.
“Ndele olyelye womunye e na omupiya ta pulula ile ta lifa, ngeenge ta di kepya ndele te mu lombwele ngeno: ‘Ila diva, ove u lye?’
Ite mu lombwele mbela, ta ti: ‘Pakele nge po ouvalelo, ove u lidike ndele to yakula nge fimbo handi li ndele handi nu. Opo nee ove to ka lya ndele to nu.’
Ile u shii ta pandula omupiya ou eshi a longa osho e shi lombwelwa?
Hano osho nanye yo, ngeenge mwa wanifa ashishe mwe shi lombwelwa, tyeni: ‘Ofye ovapiya vongaho, otwa longa osho ashike twa li tu noku shi longa.’ ”
Ndelenee pa ningwa, Ye eshi a li mondjila ta i kuJerusalem, okwa enda nongaba yaSamaria naGalilea.
Ndele eshi e uya komukunda umwe wonhumba, ovalumenhu ovanashilundu omulongo ve mu shakeneka, ve li ofika kokule,
vo ova popya mokule tava ti: “Jesus, omuhongi, tu filonghenda!”
Ndele eshi e va mona, okwa tya kuvo: “Indeni mu ke liulikile kovapristeli.” Hano opa ningwa fimbo tava i, ova veluka.
Ndele umwe womuvo eshi a mona a veluka, okwa aluka nokuhambelela Kalunga nondaka inene,
ndele ye a wila poshi peemhadi daJesus ndele te mu pandula, ye nee okwa li Omusamaria.
Jesus okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Hamulongo ovo va velulwa? Venya omugoi ove li peni?
Inaku monika vali nande oumwe a aluka, a hambelele Kalunga, omunailongo oye tuu aeke?”
Ndele Ye okwe mu lombwela: “Fikama ove u ye, eitavelo loye le ku velula.”
Ndele eshi a pulwa kOvafarisai ouhamba waKalunga otau uya naini, okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Ouhamba waKalunga itau uya u wetike,
ndele itaku tiwa: ‘tala opopo’, ile ‘tala opapenya,’ osheshi tala, ouhamba waKalunga ou li meni munye.”
Ndele Ye okwa lombwela ovalongwa vaye: “Omafiku tae uya, nye otamu kala mwa djuulukwa mu mone nande efiku limwe lOmona wOmunhu, nye itamu li mono.
Ndele tamu lombwelwa: ‘Tala, oku li penya,’ ile: ‘Tala, opapa,’ inamu ya ko.
Osheshi ongaashi oluvadi mokushela kwalo tali minikile kominghulo deulu fiyo okominghulo dikwao, osho ngaha Omona wOmunhu ta kala mefiku laye.
Ndele tete oye e nokuhepekwa unene ndele ta ekelwashi kepupi eli.
Ndele ngaashi pa ningilwe pomafiku aNoa, osho tapa ka ningwa pomafiku Omona wOmunhu,
va kala hava li ndele hava nu, va hombola ndele va hombolwa fiyo efiku olo Noa a ya mongulu yomomeva, eyelu le uya ndele ole va nyona po aveshe.
Ndele ngaashi pa ningilwe pomafiku aLot, va kala hava li ndele hava nu, va landa vo va landifa, va twika nova tunga,
ndelenee efiku olo Lot a dja mo muSodom, opa loka omundilo nosulfuri wa dja meulu, ndele owe va nyona po aveshe,
osho ngaha taku ka ningwa efiku olo Omona wOmunhu ta ka holoka.
“Efiku olo ou ta hangika kombada yongulu e na oinima yaye meumbo, aha londoloke e ke i tale ko, nosho tuu ou ta hangika mepya ina aluka mo.
Dimbulukweni omukainhu waLot.
Ou ta kendabala okulixupifila omwenyo waye, ote u kanifa, ndele ou te u kanifa, ote ke u xupifa.
Ohandi mu lombwele: oufiku winya ovalumenhu vavali tava kala momutala umwe; umwe ta tambulwa namukwao ta fiwa po.
Ovakainhu vavali tava hangwa poshini tava tu; umwe ta tambulwa namukwao ta fiwa po.
“Ovalumenhu vavali ve li mepya; umwe ta tambulwa namukwao ta fiwa po.”
Ndele vo ove mu nyamukula va tya: “Omwene, openi?” Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oko ku na oshimhu, oko taku ongala eenhwa.”
18: Ndelenee Ye okwe va lombwela efaneko nhumbi ve nokwiilikana vaha loloke,
ndele ta ti: “Moshilando shimwe omwa li mu na omutokoli weendjovo ina tila Kalunga noina fya ohoni ovanhu.
Ndele moshilando osho mwa li omufiyekadi e uya luhapu kuye ndele okwa tya: ‘Yukifa eendjovo detu nomutamaneki wange.’
Ndelenee ye okwa ninga omafiku mahapu ina hala; konima okwe lipopila ta ti: ‘Nande ihandi tila Kalunga noihandi fi ohoni ovanhu
onda hala oku mu yukifila oshinima shaye, osheshi omufiyekadi ou ta kenyeneke nge, opo aha twe nge momesho nokuli.’ ”
Ndele Omwene okwa tya: “Pwilikineni omutokoli ou mwii eshi ta ti.
Hano Kalunga ita yukifile mbela ovahoololwa vaye oshinima shavo ava have mu ifana pombada omutenya noufiku ye a fye ounye ngeno oku va kwafa?
Ohandi mu lombwele: ote shi va yukifile divadiva. Ndelenee Omona wOmunhu ngeenge te uya, ota hange ko tuu eitavelo kombada yedu?”
Ndelenee Ye okwa lombwela vamwe ve lineekela ovo ovayuki vati, ndele ova dina vamwe, efaneko eli:
“Ovalumenhu vavali ova ya motembeli okwiilikana, umwe Omufarisai namukwao omufendelifi.

Ndele Omufarisai okwa kala ofika e likalela ndele okwa ilikana ngaha: ‘Kalunga, ohandi ku pandula, osheshi ame inandi fa ovanhu vamwe, ovakolokoshi, eembudi novanyoni vohombo ile ongaashi omufendelifi ou,
eendja ohandi di lidilike luvali moshivike keshe ndele handi yandje oitimulongo moilikolwa yange aishe.’
Ndele omufendelifi okwa kala ofika kokule, ye ina hala okuyelula omesho keulu, okwe lidenga ponhulo yaye ndele ta ti: ‘Kalunga, file nge onghenda, aame omulunde.’
Ohandi mu lombwele: ou a shuna keumbo omuyuki, e dule winya, osheshi ou te linenepeke ota ninipikwa, ndele ou te lininipike ota nenepekwa.”
Ndele ova eta ounona vanini kuye e va kume, ndele ovalongwa eshi ve shi mona, ova hanyena ovo ve va eta.
Ndelenee Jesus okwe va ifana ve uye kuye ndele ta ti: “Efeni ounona ve uye kwaame, nye inamu va kelela ko, osheshi ouhamba waKalunga owaava ve va fa.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: ou ita tambula ouhamba waKalunga ngaashi okahanana, oye ita i mo muwo.”
Ndele elenga limwe le mu pula tali ti: “Omuhongi muwa, ondi nokulonga shike, ndi fyuulule omwenyo waalushe?”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Oshike wa ifana nge muwa? Kape na nande umwe muwa, Kalunga Oye aeke.
Oipango ou i shii: ‘Ino nyona ohombo, Ino dipaa, Ino vaka, Ino lundila, Fimaneka xo nanyoko.’ ”
Ndele ye okwa tya: “Oyo aishe onde i wanifa okounyashele wange.”
Ndele Jesus eshi e di uda okwa tya kuye: “Shimwe she ku pumba natango: landifa po aishe u i kwete, ove u i tukulile eehepele, ndele to kala u na emona meulu, ndele ila ove u shikule nge.”
Ndele ye eshi e di uda, okwa nyika unene oluhodi, osheshi ye okwa li oshipuna unene.
Ndele Jesus eshi e mu mona a nyika oluhodi okwa ti: “Oipuna oi noudjuu u fike peni okuya mouhamba waKalunga.
Okupitila kwongamelo mombululu yongwiya hixwe, ku dule okuya kwoshipuna mouhamba waKalunga.”
Hano ovo ve di uda, ova tya: “Olyelye hano ta dulu okuxupifwa?”
Ndelenee Ye okwa tya: “Eshi tashi nyenge ovanhu, itashi nyenge Kalunga.”
Opo Petrus okwa tya: “Tala, ofye otwa fiya ko aishe, ndele otwe ku shikula.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oshili handi mu lombwele, kape na ou a fiya po eumbo ile omukainhu ile ovamwaxe ile xe ile ina ile ovana omolwouhamba waKalunga,
ndele ita alulilwa ngeno oinima i dule inya unenenene mefimbo eli lopaife, nomounyuni tau ke uya omwenyo waalushe.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa kufa ko ovo omulongo navavali ndele okwe va lombwela: “Tala, ohatu yeni kuJerusalem, oko aishe ya shangwa kovaxunganeki tai hepaulula Omona wOmunhu, otai ka wanifwa.
Osheshi Oye ta yandjwa momake ovapaani, ndele ta yolwa, ta shekwa ndele ta fiilwa omate,
ndele tave mu denge neeshokoto ndele tave mu dipaa, nefiku etitatu ota nyumuka koufi.”
Ndele vo ova li vehe udite ko nande kanini eendjovo odo, eendjovo odo ode va holekwa, inava uda ko osho sha tiwa.
Ndele fimbo ta ehene ko kuJeriko, omupofi okwa li omutumba pondjila ndele okwa ehela.
Ndele eshi a uda ongudu yovanhu tai ende po, okwa pula: “Oshike osho?”
Ndele vo ove mu lombwela: “Jesus Omunasareti ta ende po.”
Opo ye a ingida, ta ti: “Jesus, Omona waDavid, file nge onghenda!”
Ndele venya va tetekela, ove mu hanyena a mwene, ndele ye okwa ingida pombada a diinina: “Omona waDavid, file nge onghenda!”
Ndele Jesus okwa kanghama ndele okwe va lombwela, ve mu ete kuye. Hano eshi e uya popepi, Jesus okwe mu pula:
“Owa hala ndi ku ningile shike?” Ye okwa tya: “Omwene, ndi shiive okumona ko vali.”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Mona ko! Eitavelo loye ole ku velula.”
Opo tuu opo ye a mona ko, ndele okwe mu shikula nokufimaneka Kalunga, novanhu aveshe ava ve shi mona, ova hambelela Kalunga.
19: Ndele Ye okwe uya muJeriko, ndele okwa pitilila mo.
Ndele tala, oko kwa li ku nomulumenhu, edina laye Sakeus, omukulunhu wovafutifi, oshipuna.
Ndele ye a hala okumona Jesus nokutya, Ye olyelye, ndele okwa nyengwa kouhapu wovanhu, shaashi ye okwa li muxupi momufika waye.
Ndele ye okwa tondokela komesho ndele ta londo komukwiyu e mu mone, osheshi Ye okwa li e nokweenda po.
Ndele Jesus eshi a fika po, okwa tala pombada, ndele ta ti kuye: “Sakeus, londoloka ko diva, osheshi nena eli ondi nokuuhala meumbo loye.”
Ye okwa londoloka ko divadiva, ndele okwe mu tambula nehafo.
Ndele eshi ve shi mona, aveshe ova ngongota, tava ti: “Okwa ya a ka uhale pomulumenhu omulunde.”
Ndelenee Sakeus okwa fikama ndele ta ti kOmwene: “Omwene tala, emona lange ohandi li tukula pokati, ombinga imwe ndi i pe eehepele, ndele ngeenge oku na ou nde mu nyekele ohandi mu shunifile lune.”
Opo Jesus okwe mu lombwela: “Onena tuu eli eumbo eli la mona exupifo, osheshi naye yo omona waAbraham,
osheshi Omona wOmunhu e uya okukonga nokuxupifa eshi sha kana.”
Ndele vo eshi va pwilikina odo okwa weda ko efaneko, osheshi a li popepi naJerusalem naashi vo va li ve shii ouhamba waKalunga otau holoka diva
Ye okwa tya hano: “Okwa li ku na omunhu a daleka a ya koshilongo shokokule a vaekwe ouhamba, ye a aluke ko.
Ndele ye okwa ifana ovapiya vaye omulongo, ndele te va pe eeponda omulongo ndele okwa tya kuvo: ‘Ke di landifeni fiyo handi aluka.’
Ndelenee ovanhu vomoshilongo ove mu tonda ndele ove mu shikulifa ovatumwa ve mu lombwele: ‘Ou inatu mu hala e tu pangele.’
“Ndele mokwaaluka kwaye, eshi a nangala oshilongo okwa lombwela ovapiya venya a pa oimaliwa, ve uye kuye opo a shiive nhumbi va longa nayo mokulandakanifa.
Ndele wotete okwe uya mo ndele ta ti: ‘Omwene, oshimaliwa shoye osha likolifa oimaliwa omulongo.’
Ndele ye okwe mu lombwela: ‘Iyaloo, omupiya ove muwa, ove eshi wa diinina ngaha mushinininini, oto pewa epangelo loilando omulongo.’
Nomutivali okwe uya mo ta ti: ‘Omwene, oshimaliwa shoye oshe likola oimaliwa itano.’
Naau a lombwelwa kuye: ‘Naave yo pangela oilando itano.’
Ndele umwe vali e uya po ndele ta ti: ‘Omwene, tala, oshimaliwa shoye osheshi, osheshi onde shi tuvikila moshikaiwa.
Osheshi ame onde ku tila, osheshi ove omunhu mudjuu, to kufa osho ino shi tuvikila noho teya osho ino shi kuna.’
Opo nee ye okwe mu lombwela: ‘Ohandi ku tokolifa okanya koye mwene, omupiya ove mwii. U shii nge ame omunhu mudjuu, handi kufa eshi inandi shi tuvikila, ndele handi teya osho inandi shi kuna,
oshike hano ino yandja oshimaliwa shange kovakumaani, ame mokwaaluka kwange ngeno nde shi hanga noishoshela.’
Ndele okwa lombwela ava va li po ofika: ‘Mu kufeni oshimaliwa shaye, mu shi pe ou e noimaliwa omulongo.’
Ndele ovo va tya kuye: ‘Omwene, ou oku na nale oimaliwa omulongo.’
Ame ohandi mu lombwele: ‘Keshe tuu ou e na, ota pewa, naau ehe na, ota kufwa osho e shi kwete.
Ndelenee ovatondi vange ovo inava hala ndi va pangele va eteni oku, mu va dipaele apa moipafi yange.’ ”
Ndele Ye eshi a dimbuka okupopya odo, okwa twikila ondjila yaye a yuka kuJerusalem.
Ndele opa ningwa, eshi a ehena kuBetfage naBetania komhunda ei ya ifanwa Omhunda yEemono, Ye okwa tuma ovalongwa vaye vavali
ndele ta ti: “Indeni momukunda winya twe u taalela, ndele ngeenge mwa i mo, otamu ka hanga mo okambulwena ka pandekwa, inaka londwa nale nande okomunhu, ka pandekululeni, nye mu ka ete oku.
Ndele ngeenge oku na ou te mu pula: ‘Oshike tamu ka pandekulula’, tyeni: Omwene e ka pumbwa.”
Ndele ovatumwa ova ya ko, ndele ova hanga ngaashi va lombwelwa.
Ndele fimbo va li po tava pandekulula okambulwena, oovene vako ove va pula: “Oshike tamu pandekulula okambulwena?”
Ndele vo ova tya: “Omwene e ka pumbwa.”
Opo nee ove ka eta kuJesus, ndele ova tula ko oikutu yavo kokandongwena nova londeka Jesus kuko.
Ndele Ye eshi a li ta ende, ovanhu ova yala oikutu yavo mondjila.

Ndele eshi a fika popepi, ndele tava kulukile ekulukila lOmhunda yEemono, ongudu aishe yovalongwa oya hovela okuhambelela Kalunga nehafo nondaka inene, ve mu hambelelela oilonga aishe yeenghono ve i mona,
ndele tava ti: “Na nangekwe noupuna ohamba, ou te uya medina lOmwene, ombili omeulu nefimano opombada.”
Ndele Ovafarisai vamwe vomongudu ove mu lombwela: “Omuhongi, hanyena ovalongwa voye.”
Ndele Ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Ohandi mu lombwele: Ava ngeenge tava mwena, omamanya otaa ingida.”
Ndele eshi a ehena popepi ndele ta tale oshilando, te shi lilile,
ndele ta ti: “Ngeno mefiku eli ove wa koneka osho sha wapalela ombili yoye, ndelenee paife eshi sha holekwa omesho oye.
Osheshi omafiku otae ke uya, ovatondi voye tave ku fele omikangha ndele tave ku dingilile, ndele otave ku fininike keembinga adishe,
ndele tave ku ngumauna po fiyo okomikangha, novamwoye vomwoove, vo itava fii po emanya la londekwa kulikwao, osheshi ove ino koneka efimbo lekongo loye.”
Ndele Ye okwa ya motembeli ndele ta hovele okuta mo ovo va landifa,
ndele te va lombwele: “Pa shangwa: ‘Ongulu ei yange oyo ongulu yeilikano,’ ndele nye omwe i ninga oshikololo shovanyeki.”
Ndele Ye okwa li he va longo omafiku aeshe motembeli, ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ove mu konga ve mu dipae, nosho tuu ovakulunhu voshilongo,
ndele va nyengwa nhumbi ve mu ninge, osheshi ovanhu aveshe ve mu hokwa ndele ove mu pwilikina.
20: Ndele opa ningwa efiku limwe, Ye eshi a longa motembeli, ndele okwa udifa evaengeli, ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa pamwe novakulunhu ve uya mo,
ndele ve mu pula va tya: “Tu lombwela, okeenghono dilipi ho longo ei ile olyelye e ku pa epangelo eli?”
Ndele Ye okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Naame onda hala ndi mu pule ondjovo imwe, lombweleni nge:
Eshasho eli laJohannes ola dile meulu ile omovanhu?”
Opo vo va kundafana tava ti: “Ngeenge hatu ti: ‘omeulu,’ opo ye ta ti: Oshike hano inamu mu itavela?
Ndele ngeenge hatu ti: ‘Omovanhu,’ opo ovanhu aveshe otave tu dipaa nomamanya, osheshi vo ove shi shii, Johannes okwa li omuxunganeki.”
Opo vo va nyamukula kutya kave shii apa la dja.
Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Naame yo itandi mu lombwele, okeenghono dilipi handi i longo.”
Ndele Ye okwa hovela okulombwela ovanhu efaneko eli: “Omulumenhu umwe okwa twika epya lomiviinyu, okwe li pa ovalongi ndele okwa ya koilongo a ka menekele ko.
Ndele efimbo eshi la fika, ye okwa tuma ko omupiya kovalongi ve mu pe oiimati yepya lomiviinyu, ndele ovalongi ove mu denga, ndele ove mu shunifa hamakasha.
Opo ye a tuma ko omupiya umwe, ndele naye yo ove mu denga ndele ve mu tuka, ndele ove mu shunifa hamakasha.
Opo ye okwa tumununa ko omutitatu, ndele naye yo ve mu denga noku mu toshaula, ndele ove mu undulila pondje.
Opo omwene wepya lomiviinyu ta ti: ‘Ohandi ningi ngahelipi? Onda hala ndi tume ko omona wange omuholike, shiimba tave mu tila.’
Ndele ovalongi vepya lomiviinyu eshi ve mu mona, ove mu kundafana tava ti: ‘Ou omufyuululi, tu mu dipaeni, efyuululo li ninge letu.’
Ndele vo ove mu undulila pondje yepya lomiviinyu ndele ove mu dipaa. Mwene wepya lomiviinyu ote va ningi ngahelipi hano?
Ote uya ndele ta dipaa po ovalongi vepya lomiviinyu ovo, epya lomiviinyu ote li pe vamwe ve lili. Hano vo eshi va uda odo ova tya: Hasho nande.”

Ndelenee ye okwe va tala ndele ta ti: “Omushangwa ou otau ti ngahelipi hano:
‘Emanya olo ovatungi ve li ekelashi
olo la ninga omutwe wokolonela’?
Keshe tuu ou ta pundukile kemanya olo ye ota teka, naau ta wilwa kulo ota nyanyaulwa.
Ndele ovanongo vomishangwa novapristeli ovakulunhu va hala oku mu kwata efimbo tuu olo, ndele ova tila ovanhu, osheshi va koneka efaneko olo tali va popi.”
Osho nee ve mu nangela, ndele ova tuma ko ovayeleki ve lininga ovayuki, ve mu yule meendjovo, opo va dule oku mu yandja momake epangelo nokovatokoli nokomwene woshilongo.
Ndele vo ove mu pula tava ti: “Omuhongi, otu ku shii, ove omuyuki mokupopya nomokulonga, ove iho tale oshipala, ndele to longo ondjila yaKalunga moshili.
Osha wapala tuu, tu yandje komukesari efendelo ile ahowe?”
Ndele Ye eshi a mona eheka lavo lii, okwe va lombwela:
“Ulikilei nge ombongo. Efano eli neshangelo eli olalyelye?” Vo ova tya: “Olomukesari.”
Opo Ye okwe va lombwela: “Peni hano omukesari osho shomukesari, naashi shaKalunga, shi peni Kalunga.”
Ndele vo ova nyengwa oku mu yula meendjovo moipafi yovanhu, ndele va kuminwa enyamukulo laye, vo va mwena nee.
Ndele ope uya vamwe vomOvasadukai, ovo hava ti kaku nenyumuko, ndele ove mu pula
tava ti: “Omuhongi, Moses okwe tu shangela: ‘Ngeenge ku na omulumenhu ta filwa mumwaina e nomukainhu ye ke na ounona, opo omumwaina wanakufya e nokuhombola omukainhu ou nokudalela omumwaina oludalo.’
Hano okwa li ku novalumenhu ovamwaina vaheyali. Wotete a hombola omukainhu ndele okwa fya ehe na oludalo.
Nomutivali okwa hombola omukainhu ou ndele okwa fya ehe noludalo,
nomutitatu e mu hombola nosho tuu aveshe venya vaheyali ndele ova fya inava fiya po ovana.
Ndele xuuninwa omukainhu a fya yo.
Hano omukainhu ou ota ningi walyelye womuvo menyumuko? Osheshi aveshe venya vaheyali va hombola omukainhu ou.”
Opo Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Ovana vomefimbo lounyuni eli ohava hombola nohava hombolwa.
Ndele vo otava talwa va wapala okuya mefimbo lounyuni linya nomenyumuko lokovafi, ihava hombola nongaashi ihava hombolwa.
Osheshi itava dulu vali okufya, osheshi vo va fa ovaengeli, navo ovana vaKalunga, osheshi vo ovana venyumuko.
Ndelenee Moses yo e shi holola nokutya, ovafi otava ka nyumuka, osheshi mehepaululo loshixwa sheno ota ti: Omwene Oye Kalunga kaAbraham naKalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob.
Ndele Ye ke fi Kalunga kovafi, ndelenee okovanamwenyo, osheshi aveshe ove nomwenyo moku mu kalela.”
Ndele ovanongo vomishangwa vamwe ve mu nyamukula tava ti: “Omuhongi, wa tonga wa wapaleka.”
Ndele vo va tila oku mu pula sha vali.
Opo Ye ta ti kuvo: “Otava dulu ngahelipi okutya: Kristus Oye omona waDavid?

Ndele David mwene momishangwa domapsalome ta ti:
‘Omwene okwa lombwela omwene wange:
Kala omutumba kolulyo lange,

fiyo handi ningi ovatondi voye
oshilyatelo shokeemhadi doye.’
Hano David eshi te mu ifana Omwene, Oye omona waye ngahelipi?”
Ndele fimbo ovanhu aveshe va li po tava pwilikine, okwa popya ndele ta ti kovalongwa vaye:
“Lungameni ovanongo vomishangwa ovo hava endaenda va djala oikutu ile, ndele ve hole okukundilwa pomalandelo, nopeenhele dokomesho moivilo, nomomalukalwa okombada omeeshinagoga,
ovovo hava li omaumbo ovafiyekadi ndele hava ningi omailikano malemale pamoniko, ovo tuu tava ka mona etokolo lidjuu unene.”
21: Ndele eshi a yelula omesho okwa mona oipuna nhumbi ya tula oshali moshikefa shomayambelo.
Ndele okwa mona yo omufiyekadi ohepele a tula mo ousenda vavali.
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Oshili handi mu lombwele: Omufiyekadi ou okwa tula mo shihapu shi dule shaavenya aveshe.
Osheshi aveshe venya ova tula mo oixupe yomouyadi wemona lavo, ndele ou moluhepo laye a tula mo oipalwifa aishe ei kwa li e i kwete.”
Ndele vamwe eshi va popya otembeli nhumbi ya wapekwa nomamanya a wapala ndele ya wapalekwa noiyandjiwa, Ye okwa tya:
“Omafiku tae uya mwaai mwe i tala apa itapa fiwa nande emanya la tenhekwa kulikwao inali ngumunwa po.”
Ndele vo ove mu pula tava ti: “Omuhongi, eshi otashi ningwa naini? Nedidiliko lilipi tali holola okuuya kwayo?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Lungameni muha pukifwe, osheshi vahapu tave uya medina lange ndele tava ti: aame ou, nefimbo ola fika. Ndelenee inamu va shikula.
Ndele ngeenge tamu udu omakolokoto oita nomalwoodi, inamu tila, osheshi ei oi nokutetekela, ndele exulilo inali fika manga.”
Opo nee Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oshiwana noshiwana tai ka twilafana ondubo, oshilongo tashi tu ondubo noshilongo shikwao,
ndele otapa ka kala keenhele neenhele omakakamo madjuu edu neendjala noudu wolutapo, nomamoniko omahalwifo, nomadidiliko manene meulu.

Ndelenee aishe ei fimbo inai uya, otave mu kwata ndele tave mu taataa, ndele tave mu shilile meeshinagoga, ndele tave mu undulile meedolongo, ndele tave mu twala koshipala sheehamba noshovapangeli voilongo omolwedina lange.
Ndele eshi tashi mu pe onhele yokuhepaulula.
Omitima deni nadi kale hano dihe noshisho nhumbi mu nokulipopila.
Osheshi Ame ohandi mu pe okanya nomaunongo taa nyenge ovakondjifi veni aveshe oku mu nyamukula ile oku mu twifa eemhata.
Ndele nye otamu yandjwa kooxo nokoonyoko nokovamwanyoko nokovakweni nokookaume keni, vamwe vomunye tava ka dipawa kuvo,
ndele nye tamu ka tondelwa edina lange kwaaveshe.
Ndele kape na nande oluxwiki limwe lokomitwe deni tali ka kana.
Okelididimiko leni otamu lixupifile eemwenyo deni.
“Ndele ngeenge tamu mono Jerusalem sha kondekwa komatanga ovakwaita, opo nee shiiveni ehanauno laJerusalem ola fika popepi;
opo nee ava vomuJudea nava fadukile keemhunda naava ve li moshilando nava dje mo, naava tava hangika komikunda vaha ye musho.
Osheshi omafiku oo oehandu, opo aishe ei ya shangwa i wanifwe.
Ndelenee woo ovafimba novamwali omafimbo oo, osheshi oudjuu unene otau kala kombada yedu nehandu lokutonda oshiwana eshi,
ndele vo ove nokufya keememo deongamukonda, notava twalwa moupika koiwana aishe, ndele Jerusalem tashi ka lyataulwa kovapaani fiyo omafimbo ovapaani taa wana.
“Nomadidiliko taa ka monika metango nomohani nomeenyofi, noiwana yokombada yedu tai pangelwa koutile noihe neteelelo lasha omolwengungumo lefuta nolomakufikufi alo.
Ndele ovanhu tava fi kehaluko mokutila nomokuteelela ei tai hange edu alishe, osheshi eenghono domeulu otadi ka kakama.
Ndele tava mono Omona wOmunhu te uya ta ende moshilemo, e neenghonopangelo dinene noshinge.
Ndele ei ngeenge tai hovele okuningwa, taleni pombada nye mu yelule omitwe deni, osheshi exupifo leni ola ehena popepi.”
Opo nee Ye okwe va lombwela efaneko: “Taleni omukwiyu nomiti adishe.
Ngeenge tadi hape, otamu mono nanye vene kutya, okulombo kwa fika popepi.
Osho ngaha nanye yo ngeenge tamu mono ei ya ningwa, shiiveni ouhamba waKalunga ou li popepi.
Oshili handi mu lombwele: Epupi eli itali xulu po, ei aishe fimbo inai wanifwa.
Eulu nedu otali xulu po, ndele eendjovo dange itadi xulu po.
“Ndelenee lipashukileni, omitima deni diha lolokifwe koitendele nokokukolwa nokoshisho shoipalwifa, efiku olo lihe mu vakele ngaashi omwiyo,
osheshi olo otali hange aveshe ava hava kala kombada yedu alishe.
Pashukeni hano omafiku aeshe nokwiilikana, mu mone eenghono okuya onhapo ei aishe tai ka ningwa, nokukala ofika koshipala shOmona wOmunhu.”
Ndele Ye okwa longa ovanhu motembeli omutenya, noufiku nokwa ya a ka nangale komhunda ya ifanwa Omhunda yEemono.
Novanhu aveshe ova meneka ongula ve uya motembeli oku mu uda.
22: Ndele oshivilo shomingome dinyenye, eshi sha ifanwa Opaasa, osha fika.
Ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ova li va diladila nhumbi ve mu dipae, shaashi va tila ovanhu.
Ndele Satana okwa ya muJudas, a ifanwa Iskariot, umwe waavenya omulongo navavali.
Opo ye okwa ya ko ndele okwa kundafana novapristeli ovakulunhu, novakulunhu vovanangeli vomotembeli, nhumbi e mu yandje momake avo.
Ndele vo ova hafa ndele ova udafana oku mu pa oimaliwa.
Ndele ye okwa itavela, ndele okwa li ha kongo omhito ya wapala oku mu kengelela fimbo pehe neuyaano lovanhu.
Ndele efiku olo lomingome dinyenye ola fika, fiku odi yaPaasa i nokudipawa.
Opo Jesus okwa tuma ko Petrus naJohannes ta ti: “Indeni mu ke tu longekidile odi yaPaasa tu i lye.”
Ndele vo ove mu lombwela: “Owa hala tu i longekidile peni?”
Ndele Ye okwe va nyamukula: “Tala, ngeenge tamu i moshilando, omulumenhu te mu shakeneke, ta humbata oshitoo shomeva, mu shikuleni mongulu omo ta i,
ndele nye mu tye kumwene weumbo: ‘Omuhongi te ku pula: Olupale oli li peni, ndi lile mo odi yaPaasa pamwe novalongwa vange?’
Ndele ye ote mu ulikile olupale linene la wapalekelwa ovaenda, omo tuu tamu i longekidile.”
Ndele vo ova ya ndele ova hanga ngaashi e va lombwela, ndele va longekida odi yaPaasa.
Ndelenee efimbo eshi la fika, Ye okwa kala omutumba poshililo novayapostoli pamwe naye.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Onda djuulukwa nokudjuulukwa okulya pamwe nanye odi ei yaPaasa, fimbo inandi hepekwa,
osheshi ohandi mu lombwele, itandi i li vali fiyo tai ka wanifwa mouhamba waKalunga.”
Ndele Ye okwa kufa eholo, a pandula, ndele ta ti: “Li tambuleni, lifiileni mo,
osheshi oshili handi mu lombwele: okonena itandi nu vali koiimati ei yomuviinyu fimbo ouhamba waKalunga inau uya.”
Opo nee Ye okwa kufa omungome a pandula, ndele te u pambula, ndele okwe u va pa ndele ta ti: “Eshi olutu lange tali yandjwa molweni, shi ningeni nokudimbulukwa nge.”
Nosho tuu eholo, eshi a mana okulya, ndele ta ti: “Eholo eli olo ehangano lipe lomohonde yange tai tilwashi molweni.
“Ndele tala, eke lomukengeleli wange oli li pamwe naame poshililo.
Osheshi Omona wOmunhu ota i ngaashi kwa tiwa, ndelenee woo omunhu ou te mu kengelele.”
Opo vo ova hovela okupulafana, olyelye mbela ou womokati kavo te shi ningi.
Ndele muvo omwa tukuka eemhata olyelye womokati kavo e nokutalwa munene e dule vakwao.
Ndele Ye ta ti kuvo: “Eehamba doiwana ohadi i pangele, nomalenga ayo haa ifanwa ooxekulu.
Ndele nye hangaha, ndelenee omukulunhu womokati keni na kale a fa onghelo, naau wokomesho ngaashi ou ta yakula.
Osheshi olyelye e dule mukwao, oyou ta kala omutumba poshililo ile oyou ta yakula? Hayou ta kala omutumba poshililo? Ndele Ame ondi li mokati keni ngaashi ou ta yakula.
“Ndele nye, onye tuu ava mwa kala pwaame momayeleko ange,
osheshi Ame ohandi mu tokolele, ongaashi Tate a tokolela nge, ouhamba,
mu shiive okulya nokunwa poshililo shange, nokukala omutumba komalukalwa nokutokola omapata omulongo naavali aIsrael.
“Simon, Simon, tala, Satana a indila a pewe oku mu fifa ngaashi oilya,
ndele Ame onde ku ilikanena eitavelo loye liha dime mo mwoove. Ndele ove ngeenge wa aluka, pameka oovakweni.”
Oye okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, ame onde lilongekida okuya pamwe naave nomodolongo nomokufya.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Petrus, ohandi ku lombwele: Onena eli ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena, oto lidimbike nge lutatu.”
Ye okwe va lombwela: “Eshi nde mu tumine muhe nokakutu keembongo nekutu neenghaku, omwa hepa sha?” Vo ova tya: “Ahowe,” nande osha.
Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Ndele paife eshi ou e nokakutu keembongo ne ka kufe a kale nako nekutu osho yo, naau ehe na, ye na landife po elwakani laye, ndele ne lilandele eongamukonda.
Osheshi handi mu lombwele: Omushangwa ou ou nokuwanifilwa mwaame: ‘Ye okwa valulilwa movakolokoshi,’ osheshi aishe inya ya shangelwa nge otai wanifwa.”
Vo ova tya: “Omwene, tala, ope nomaongamukonda avali.” Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Osha wana hano.”
Opo nee Ye okwa ya pondje ndele okwa ya ngaashi a ikilila kOmhunda yEemono, novalongwa vaye ove mu shikula.
Ndele eshi a fika ko oko, okwe va lombwela: “Ilikaneni muha pundukile momayeleko.”
Ndele Ye okwe likufa muvo oshinano shoule wekupulo lemanya, ndele ta tu eengolo ndele okwa ilikana
ta ti: “Tate, ngeenge wa hala kufe nge eholo eli, ndele hahalo lange, ndelenee oloye.”
Nomweengeli womeulu e mu holokela ndele te mu dike eenghono.
Ndele eshi a ya mo mekondjo loudjuu womwenyo, okwe liweda okwiindila unene. Noshinhwi shaye sha ndodela poshi nosha li sha fomata ohonde.
Hano eshi a dimbuka okwiilikana, okwe uya kovalongwa vaye ndele okwe va hanga va kofa, osheshi vo ova kofifwa koluhodi.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oshike mwa kofa? Pendukeni nye mu ilikane, muha hangike komashindo.”
Ndele fimbo ta popi, ongudu yovanhu ye uya po, naumwe womomulongo navavali, edina laye Judas, e va kwatela komesho, ndele okwa ehena kuJesus e mu fipe komilungu.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Judas, Omona wOmunhu oto mu kengelelifa efipo lokomilungu?”
Ndele ava va li puye, eshi va mona osho sha hala okuningwa ova tya: “Omwene, natu denge neongamukonda?”
Ndele umwe womuvo okwa shasha omupiya womupristeli omukulunhu, ndele okwe mu teta okutwi kwokolulyo.
Ndele Jesus okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Efeni, naasho shi ningwe.” Ndele okwa kuma okutwi kwaye ndele okwe mu velula.
Opo Jesus okwa lombwela ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu vovanangeli novakulunhu vovanhu votembeli, ovo ve uya oku mu kwata: “Mwe uya ngaashi okukwata omukolokoshi mu nomaongamukonda noikulumbwati.
Ame nda kala omafiku aeshe punye motembeli, nye inamu kuma nge nande eke. Ndele eli olo efimbo leni neenghono domilaulu.”
Ndelenee eshi ve mu kwata, ove mu kufa po, ndele ove mu twala mongulu yomupristeli omukulunhu. Petrus okwe va shikula kokule.
Ndele vo ova shakala omundilo mokati kolupale ndele ova kala omutumba mumwe, naPetrus okwa kala omutumba mokati kavo.
Ndele okakadona komeumbo oke mu mona ta kala omutumba pomundilo, oke mu tala ndee taka ti: “Naau yo okwa li pamwe naye.”
Ndele ye okwe lidimbika ta ti: “Omukainhu ove, ame nghi mu shii.”
Nopo tuu opo mukwao e mu mona ta ti: “Naave yo umwe womuvo.” Petrus okwa tya: “Menhu ove, ame haame.”
Ndele eshi pa pita otundi imwe ngeno, umwe vali okwa tya: “Oshili, naau okwa li pamwe naye, osheshi naye yo Omugalilea.”
Ndele Petrus okwa tya: “Menhu ove, nghi shii eshi to popi.” Nopo tuu opo, fimbo a popya, ekondobolo ola kwena.
Omwene okwa punguluka, ndele okwa tala Petrus, Petrus okwa dimbulukwa eendjovo dOmwene, ngaashi e mu lombwela: “Ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena nena, ove oto lidimbike nge lutatu.”
Ye okwa pita pondje, ndele okwa lila nokulililila.
Ndele ovalumenhu ovo ve mu diinina, ove mu sheka noku mu denga.
Ndele ove mu tuvikila koshipala shaye ndele ove mu pula: “Xunganeka, olyelye ou e ku denga?”
Nomasheko makwao mahapu ove mu sheka.
Ndele eshi kwa sha, ovakulunhu voshilongo novapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ova ongala, ndele ove mu twala koshiongalele shavo,
ndele tava ti: “Oove ngeenge Kristus, tu lombwela hano.” Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Nande ondi mu lombwele, itamu itavele,
ndele nande ondi mu pule, itamu nyamukula sha.
Ndele okonena eli otamu ka mona Omona wOmunhu ta kala omutumba kolulyo leenghono daKalunga.”
Ndele vo aveshe ova tya: “Oove hano Omona waKalunga?” Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Heeno, Aame ou, ngaashi tamu ti.”
Vo ova tya: “Ondobwedi ilipipo hatu pumbwa vali? Ofye vene twe di uda mokanya kaye mwene.”
23: Ndele oshiongalele shavo ashishe osha fikama ndele ove mu twala kuPilatus.
Ndele vo ova hovela oku mu pa omatimba tava ti: “Ou otwe mu mona ta twifa ovanhu ondubo ndele ta kelele okuyandja efendelo komukesari, ndele Ye mwene ota ti Oye Kristus, ohamba.”
Pilatus okwe mu pula ndele ta ti: “Oove ohamba yOvajuda?” Ye okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Heeno ngaashi to ti.”
Ndele Pilatus okwa lombwela ovapristeli ovakulunhu nongudu aishe: “Ame nghi wete etimba momunhu ou.”
Ndele vo ova diinina oku mu fininika va tya: “Ye omupiyaanifi wovanhu noku va longa muJudea ashishe, eshi a hovela muGalilea, fiyo opapa.”
Ndele Pilatus eshi e di uda, okwa pula: “Omunhu ou ngeenge Omugalilea.”
Ndele eshi e mu uda Ye owoshikandjo shaHerodes, okwe mu tuma kuHerodes, osheshi naye yo a li muJerusalem momafiku enya.
Ndele Herodes eshi a mona Jesus, okwa hafa pombada, osheshi oye a hala nonale oku mu mona, osheshi okwe mu kundana, ndele okwa hala a ulikilwe kuye edidilikokumwifa.
Ndele okwe mu pulapula neendjovo dihapu, ndele Oye ine mu nyamukula nande.
Novapristeli ovakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ova fikama ndele ove mu pa etimba va fya ouladi.
Ndele Herodes pamwe novanhu vaye, ove mu dina noku mu sheka, ndele eshi ve mu djaleka oshikutu tashi vema, okwe mu shunifa kuPilatus.
Nefiku olo tuu olo Herodes naPilatus ova panga oukaume, shito pokati kavo opa kala ondubo.
Opo Pilatus okwa ifana ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu voshilongo nongudu yovanhu
nokwe va lombwela: “Mwa eta omunhu ou kwaame mwa tya: ye omuhongauli wovanhu, hano taleni, ame mwene onde mu pula fimbo mu li po, ndele inandi mona momunhu ou nande etimba olo tamu li mu hokololifa.
Nosho yo Herodes ine li mona, osheshi ye okwe mu shunifa kufye, hano taleni oye ou ina ninga sha shoku mu pa etimba loku mu dipaifa.
Onghee hano nda hala ndi mu dengife ndele ndi mu efe.”
Ndele ye okwa li e nomhango yoku va mangululila mukeshe tuu oshivilo omukwatwa umwe.
Opo tuu ongudu aishe oya weelelela shimwe tai ti: “Dja po naau, tu mangululila Barabas.”
Ou a hangika a tulwa meti omolwepiyaaneko moshilongo nomolwedipao.
Ndele Pilatus okwe va lombwela vali, osheshi a hala okumangulula Jesus.
Ndele vo ova nyamukula nokwiingida: “Mu valela, mu valela komushiyakano!”
Ndele ye okwa tya kuvo lutitatu: “Owii washike Ye a ninga hano? Ame inandi mona etimba lokufya muye. Hano ngeenge nde mu dengifa, ohandi mu efa.”
Ndelenee vo ove mu fininika nokwiingida Jesus a valelwe komushiyakano, ndele eingido lavo ole mu finda ko.
Opo nee Pilatus okwa tokola, ehalo lavo li wanifwe.
Ndele okwa mangulula winya kwa li a idililwa mo omolwolwoodi nedipao, ndele Jesus okwe mu yandja molwehalo lavo.
Ndele moku mu twala ko, ova kwata po umwe, edina laye Simon Omukireni, a hangika ta di kepya laye, ndele ove mu twika omushiyakano e u humbate konima yaJesus.
Nongudu inene yovanhu oye mu shikula, ovakainhu yo ovo tave mu kwenaukile notave mu lilile.
Ndelenee Jesus okwa punguluka ndele ta ti kuvo: “Oukadona nye Ovajerusalem, inamu lila nge, lililileni nye vene, nye mu lilile ovana veni.
Osheshi tala, omafiku otae uya fiku taku tiwa: ‘Ovanelao ovo eengadji, nomadimo inaa dala nomavele inaa nyamifwa.’
Vo otava hovele okulombwela eemhunda: ‘Mu tu wile, noikulundudu: Mu tu tuvikile.’
Osheshi omuti mutalala ngeenge tau ningwa ngaha, mukukutu otau ningwa ngahelipi?”
Ndele pamwe naye okwa twalwa ko yo ovalumenhu vamwe vavali, ovakolokoshi, va ka dipawe.
Ndele eshi va fika konhele ei ya lukwa Oshala shoshipongolo shomutwe, oko ve mu valela komushiyakano, nosho yo ovakolokoshi ovo, umwe kolulyo nomukwao kolumosho.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Tate, va dimina po, osheshi kave shi shii eshi tava ningi.” Vo ova tukulilafana oikutu yaye ndele tave i nyanekele.
Ndele ovanhu ova kala ofika opo ve mu tala. Novakulunhu yo ove mu kenya va tya: “Okwa li ha kwafa vamwe, ne likwafe hano, ngeenge Oye Kristus yaKalunga, omuhoololwa ou.”
Novakwaita ve mu sheka yo, ve uya kuye oku mu nwefa omeva malula.
Ndele va tya: “Ove ngeenge ohamba yOvajuda, likwafa mwene.”
Ndele kombada yaye kwa tulwa yo eshangelo la shangwa mOshigreka nomOshilatina nomOshiheberi, tali ti: “OU OHAMBA YOVAJUDA.”
Ndele umwe womovakolokoshi ovo va endjelela okwe mu sheka ndele ta ti: “Ove ku fi Kristus, likwafa, ove u tu kwafe yo.”
Ndele mukwao okwa nyamukula e mu hanyena, ta ti: “Iho tila nande Kalunga, eshi u li mehandukilo eli li fike pamwe?
Ofye ohatu hepekwa nokuli pauyuki, osheshi hatu pewa osho twe shi lilongela, ndele ou ina longa owii nande owasha.”
Ndele okwa tya: “Jesus, dimbulukwe nge, ngeenge wa fiki mouhamba woye.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuye: “Oshili handi ku lombwele, onena tuu eli to ka kala pamwe naame moParadisa.”
Ndele potundi onhihamano okwa ninga omilaulu kombada yedu alishe fiyo okotundi onhimugoi,
osheshi etango ola laula, netukulifo lotembeli ola tauka pokati.
Ndele Jesus okwa popya mokule a tya: “Tate, omhepo yange ohandi i yandje momake oye.” Ndele eshi e di tya, okwa hefa mo omhepo yaye.
Ndele omunefele, eshi a mona osho sha ningwa po, okwa fimaneka Kalunga ta ti: “Oshili, omunhu ou okwa li omuyuki.”
Nongudu aishe ya li ya ongala oku shi tala, eshi va mona eshi sha ningwa ko, ove lidenga ponhulo ndele ova shuna.
Ndele ovashiivikile vaye aveshe ova kala ofika kokule naye, osho yo ovakainhu venya va dile naye kuGalilea ve mu shikula ndele ova tala ashishe eshi.
Ndele tala, omukwashiongalele shovakulunhu, omulumenhu muwa omuyuki, edina laye Josef,
womuArimatia, oshilando shOvajuda, ou a li ina itavela omhangela yavo noshiningwa shavo, onakuteelela ouhamba waKalunga,
okwa ya kuPilatus, ndele okwa indila ko oshimhu shaJesus.
Ndele eshi e shi kufa ko okwe shi mangela moshiyata shitoka shiwa, ndele okwe shi tula mombila ya li ya hokelwa memanya omo inamu pakwa shito nande omunhu.
Ndele efiku olo ola li lelilongekido, nEshabata ola fika.
Novakainhu venya va dile naye kuGalilea, ove mu shikula, ndele ova tala ombila noshimhu nhumbi sha nangekwa mo.
Hano eshi va shuna komaumbo, ova longekida oidimba ya nyika nawa nomaadi mawa, ndele efiku lEshabata va tulumukwa opanghedi yomhango.
24: Ndele efiku lotete loshivike ongula inene, ove uya kombila ve kwete oidimba iwa ve i longekida.
Ndele vo ova hanga emanya la kandulwa po pombila.
Ndele ova ya mo meni, ndelenee inava mona mo oshimhu shOmwene Jesus.
Ndele opa ningwa eshi va li po va limbililwa, tala, ovalumenhu vavali, va djala oikutu tai vilima ova kala ofika puvo.

Ndele vo ova haluka ndele va fidimika oipala yavo poshi.
Vo ova tya kuvo: “Oshike tamu kongo omunamwenyo mokati kovafi?
Ye ke mo omu, okwa nyumuka, dimbulukweni eendjovo e di mu lombwelele fimbo a li kuGalilea,
eshi a tile: ‘Omona wOmunhu e nokuyandjwa momake ovalunde nokuvalelwa komushiyakano, nefiku etitatu e nokunyumuka.’ ”
Ndele vo ova dimbulukwa eendjovo daye.
Ndele ova aluka ko kombila ndele aishe ei ove i hepaululila venya omulongo naumwe noovakwao aveshe.
Ndelenee ava ve shi hepaululila ovayapostoli ovo ava: Maria Magdalena naJohanna naMaria ina yaJakob novakainhu oovakwao pamwe navo.
Ndele eendjovo daava ove di tala da fa eengano, ndele inave di itavela.
Ndele Petrus okwa fikama ndele ta lotokele kombila, ndele eshi a vandamena mo okwa mona mo oikutu yoliina, ndele okwa shuna keumbo a kuminwa eshi sha ningwa po.
Ndele tala, efiku olo vavali vomuvo va enda tava i komukunda edina lao Emaus, ku neekilometa omulongo naimwe okudja kuJerusalem.
Ova kundafana aishe ei ya ningwa ko.
Opa ningwa fimbo tava kundafana ndele tava konakona, Jesus mwene okwa ehena kuvo, ndele okwa enda pamwe navo.
Ndele omesho avo okwa tuvikwa, vehe mu koneke.
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Otamu kundafana shike mokweenda kweni?” Vo ova kanghama ve noipala ya nyika oluhodi.
Ndele umwe wavo, edina laye Kleopas, e mu nyamukula ta ti: “Oove auke omunailongo wa menekela muJerusalem, ino uda ei ya ningilwa mo pomafiku aa?”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oshike?” Vo ova tya kuye: “Osheshi sha ningwa Jesus Omunasareti, a li omuxunganeki omunaenghono nomoilonga nomeendjovo koshipala shaKalunga noshovanhu aveshe,
ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu novapangeli vetu ve mu yandja a tokolwe a ka fye, ndele ve mu valela komushiyakano.
Ndele fye twa li twe mu lineekela nokuteelela Oye ou e nokukulila Ovaisraeli, nokuli nena efiku etitatu ei eshi ya ningwa.
Ndelenee ovakainhu vamwe vomufye ove tu limbilika. Ova ile ongula inene kombila
ndele vo inava mona mo oshimhu shaye, ndele ove uya va tya ova mona emoniko, ovaengeli ve va lombwela oku na omwenyo.
Ndele vamwe vomufye va ya yo kombila, ndele ova hanga pe li ngaashi ovakainhu va hepaulula, ndele Ye mwene inave mu mona.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Woo nye, omalai novafi vounye keemwenyo okwiitavela aishe ei ovaxunganeki ve i popya.
Hayo tuu ei Kristus kwa li e noku i humbata nokuya moshinge shaye?”
Ndele Ye okwa hovela muMoses nomovaxunganeki aveshe, ndele okwe va fatululila adishe de mu tiwa momishangwa adishe.
Vo eshi va fika komukunda winya tava i ko, Ye okwa ninga a fa a hala okukoyelela po.
Ndelenee vo ove mu fininika va tya: “Kala pufye, onguloshi nokuli, netango otali ningine mo.” Ye okwa ya mo a kale puvo.
Ndele eshi a kala omutumba poshililo pamwe navo, Ye okwa kufa omungome ndele okwa pandula, e u pambula ndele okwe u va pa.
Opo nee omesho avo okwa pashuka, ndele ve mu dimbulukwa. Ye okwa henuka po puvo.
Ndele vo ova tongafana: “Omitima detu inadi xwama tuu mufye, eshi a popya nafye mondjila ndele okwe tu fatululila omishangwa!”
Ndele pefimbo tuu olo ova fikama ndee tava shuna kuJerusalem; ndele ova hanga ko omulongo naumwe novakwao va li pamwe navo.
Vo ova tya: “Omwene okwa nyumuka shili, okwa monika kuSimon.”
Navo yo va hepaulula eshi sha ningwa mondjila nanhumbi ve mu koneka pepambulo lomungome.
Ndele fimbo va tonga odo, Ye mwene okwa kala ofika mokati kavo ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ombili nai kale nanye.”
Vo ova haluka, va tila ndele va li ve shii ove wete oshilulu.
Ye okwe va lombwela: “Oshike mwa tila ngaha, noshike omadiladilo a tya ngaha a penduka momitima deni?
Taleni omake ange neemhadi dange mu koneke nge nokutya, Aame mwene ndi li po. Kumeni nge nye mu tale, osheshi oshilulu kashi na onhumba nomakipa, ngaashi mu wete nge ndi a kwete.”
Ndele eshi e di tya okwe va ulikila omake aye neemhadi daye.
Ndele eshi inave mu itavela natango omolwehafo nonghumwe, Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Omu kwete sha shokuliwa?”
Vo ove mu pa okanhumba koshi ka yofwa nokashila keenyiki.
Ndele Ye okwe ka tambula ndele okwe ka lya moipafi yavo.

Ndele Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Oyo ei nda popya meendjovo odo nde di mu lombwelele fimbo nda li punye, eshi nda tile aishe ei ya shangelwa nge momhango yaMoses nomovaxunganeki nomomapsalome oi nokuwanifwa.”
Opo nee Ye okwe va fatululila eendunge davo okushiiva omishangwa.
Ndele okwa tya kuvo: “Eshi sha shangwa, Kristus okwa li e nokuhepekwa nokunyumuka koufi efiku etitatu
ndele medina laye elidilululo nedimepo lomatimba oli nokuudifilwa oiwana aishe nokuhovela muJerusalem.
Ndele nye eendobwedi daai aishe.
Ndele taleni, Ame ohandi ke mu tumina osho sha udanekwa kuTate, ndele nye omu nokukala moshilando eshi fiyo tamu djalekwa eenghono dokeulu.”
Ndele Ye okwe va twala fiyo opopepi naBetania, ndele ta yelula omaoko aye, ndele okwe va nangeka noupuna.
Ndele fimbo te va nangeke noupuna, Ye okwa tukuka navo ndele okwa yelulilwa meulu.
Ndele vo ove mu ilikana nokutwa eengolo, ndele ova shuna kuJerusalem nehafo linene.
Ndele va li alushe motembeli nokuhambelela Kalunga.

1: Pehovelo opa li Ondjovo, nOndjovo oya kala puKalunga, nOndjovo ei oya li Kalunga.
Oye okwa kala pehovelo puKalunga.
Aishe oya shitwa kuye, ndele kape na nande oshinima shimwe sha shitwa, eshi inashi shitwa muye.
Muye omwa kala omwenyo, nomwenyo owa kala ouyelele wovanhu.
Nouyelele tau minikile momulaulu, nomulaulu inau likwata nao.
Opwa li omunhu a tumwa kuKalunga, edina laye Johannes.
Ou okwe uya okuhepaulula, a hepaulule ouyelele ou, opo aveshe va itavelifwe kuye.
Ndele haye kwa li ouyelele, ndelenee okwe uya a hepaulule ouyelele.
Ouyelele ou washili, hau minikile omunhu keshe, wa hangika tau uya mounyuni.
Oye okwa kala mounyuni, nounyuni owa shitwa kuye, nounyuni inau mu dimbulukwa.
Ye okwe uya kovambulavo, ndele ava vokombulavo inave mu tambula.
Ndelenee aveshe ava ve mu tambula, okwe va pa eenghono, va ninge ovana vaKalunga, ava hava itavele edina laye.
Ovo inava dalwa mohonde, ile mehalo lombelela, ile mehalo lomulumenhu, ndelenee omuKalunga.
Nondjovo ya ninga omunhu. Ye okwa kala mokati ketu, ndele fye twa tala oshinge shaye, oshinge tuu osho shEwifa laxe, okwa yada efilonghenda noshili.
Johannes okwe mu hepaulula nokwa ingida, ta ti: “Oye tuu ou nde mu tonga nda tile: ‘ou te uya konima yange, ye okwa li komesho yange, osheshi Ye opo a li, fimbo ame ndiha li po.’ ”
Nomouyadi waye ofyeni atusheni twa tambula mo, efilonghenda la wedelwa kefilonghenda.
Osheshi omhango ya yandjwa kuMoses; efilonghenda noshili olo la etwa kuJesus Kristus.
Kape na ou a mona Kalunga nande; Ewifa olo la kala mekolo laXe, olo le mu holola.
Ehepaululo laJohannes oleli, Ovajuda eshi va tuma kuye ovapristeli nOvalevi vomuJerusalem ve mu pule: “Oove lyelye?”
Ndele ye okwa hepaulula, ine likala, ndele ta ti: “Ame haame Kristus.”
Ndele vo ve mu pula: “Oove lyelye hano? Oove Elia?” Ye okwa tya: “Haame ou.” “Oove omuxunganeki winya?” Ye okwa tya: “Ahowe.”
Opo vo va tya kuye: “Oove lyelye hano, tu ka twale enyamukulo kwaava ve tu tuma. Ove mwene oto litile ngahelipi?”
Ye okwa tya: “Aame ondaka yomwiingidi mombuwa: ‘Yelakanifileni Omwene ondjila, ngaashi omuxunganeki Jesaja a tile.’ ”
Ndele ava va tumwa ovo vomOvafarisai.
Ndele vo ove mu pula tava ti kuye: “Oshike hano ho shashele, ove ngeenge ku fi Kristus ile Elia ile omuxunganeki winya?”
Opo Johannes e va nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Ohandi shashe nomeva, ndelenee mokati keni omwa kala ofika ou muhe mu shii.
Oye tuu ou te uya konima yange, ndele ame inandi wana okuditula omiya deenghaku daye.”
Ei ya ningilwa muBetania kombada yaJordan, oko Johannes kwa li ha shashele.
Efiku la shikula eli ye ota mono Jesus te uya kuye, ndele ta ti: “Tala, Odjona yaKalunga tai kufa po omatimba ounyuni.
Oye tuu ou nde mu tonga nda tile: ‘Konima yange tape uya omulumenhu ou a li komesho yange, osheshi Ye opo a li, fimbo ame ndiha li po.’
Ndele ame nda li ndihe mu shii; ndelenee opo a hololelwe Israel, onghee nde uya okushasha nomeva.”
Ndele Johannes okwa hepaulula ta ti: “Onda mona Omhepo ya fa onghuti ya kuluka ya dja meulu, ndele tai kala kombada yaye.
Ndele ame nda li ndihe mu shii, ndelenee ou a tuma nge okushasha nomeva, ye okwa lombwela nge: ‘Oye ou to mono Omhepo tai wile kombada yaye, ndele tai kala po, Oye tuu ou ta shashe nOmhepo Iyapuki.’
Ndele ame nde shi mona, ndele handi hepaulula nokutya, Oye Omona waKalunga.”
Efiku la shikula Johannes okwa li ko vali ofika pamwe novalongwa vaye vavali.
Ndele mokutala Jesus ou ta ende po, ye okwa tya: “Tala, Odjona yaKalunga.”
Novalongwa ava vavali ove mu uda eshi ta popi, ndele va shikula Jesus.
Ndelenee Jesus okwa punguluka, ndele eshi a mona tave mu shikula, ta ti kuvo: “Otamu kongo shike?” Ovo va tya kuye: “Rabbi,” (tashi ti: omuhongi) “owa kala peni?”
Oye okwa tya kuvo: “Ileni mu tale!” Ndele ova ya, ndele va mona apa a kala, ndele vo ova uhala puye efiku olo. Ndele otundi ya li po onhimulongo.
Andreas, omumwaina waSimon Petrus, oye umwe waava vavali va li ve shi uda kuJohannes, ndele tave mu shikula.
Ye okwa shakena tete namumwaina Simon, ndele ta ti kuye: “Fye otwa mona Messias, otashi ti Kristus.”
Ye okwe mu twala kuJesus. Jesus okwe mu tala ndele ta ti: “Oove Simon omona waJohannes; oto ka ifanwa Kefas,” otali ti: Petrus.
Nefiku la shikula eli, Jesus okwa fikama a ye kuGalilea; nokwa shakeneka Filippus, ndele ta ti kuye: “Shikule nge!”
Filippus okwa li Omubetsaida womoshilando shaAndreas naPetrus.
Ndele Filippus okwa hanga Natanael, ndele ta ti kuye: “Fye otwa mona ou a shangwa kuMoses momhango nokovaxunganeki, Jesus womuNasaret, omona waJosef.”
Opo Natanael okwa tya kuye: “MuNasaret otamu di tuu ouwa nande owasha?” Filippus okwa tya kuye: “Ila u ka tale!”
Opo nee Jesus okwa mona Natanael te uya kuye, ndele e mu tonga ta ti: “Tala, Omuisraeli washili ehe nekoto.”
Natanael okwa tya kuye: “Ove ou shii nge peni?” Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Fimbo Filippus ine ku ifana, eshi wa li momukwiyu, onde ku mona.”
Natanael okwa tya kuye: “Rabbi, Oove Omona waKalunga, Oove ohamba yaIsrael.”
Jesus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuye: “Eshi nde ku lombwela: onde ku mona momukwiyu, onghee wa itavela. Oto ka mona oinima inene i dule ei.”
Ndele Oye e mu lombwela: “Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: otamu ka mona eulu la yeuluka, novaengeli vaKalunga tava londo ndele tava londolokele kOmona wOmunhu.”
2: Ndele mefiku etitatu opa li pe nehombolo muKana shomuGalilea, naina yaJesus oko a li.
NaJesus yo novalongwa vaye ova shivwa kehombolo.
Ndele omaviinyu eshi a pwa po, ina yaJesus ta ti kuye: “Vo kave na omaviinyu.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Omukainhu, ondi na shike naave? Efimbo lange inali fika manga.”
Ndele ina ta ti kovayakuli: “Keshe eshi te mu lombwele, shi ningeni.”
Ndelenee opa li oitoo ihamano yomamanya yokukwatela omeva, opanghedi yokulikosha kwOvajuda, keshe oshitoo shi fike peelita efele.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Yadifeni oitoo nomeva.” Ndele vo ove i tekela ya yada ndo.
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Pindeni mo, nye mu twalele omuyakuli wovaenda.” Ndele vo ova twala.

Ndele omuyakuli wovaenda eshi a lola mo, omeva a shituka omaviinyu, ndele okwa li ehe shii apa a dja. Ndelenee ovapiya ava va tekele omeva, ova li ve shi shii nokutya omuyakuli wovaenda okwa ifana omuhomboli
ndele ta ti kuye: “Omunhu keshe tete ota yandje omaviinyu mawa, ndelenee ngeenge va kumwa, opo nee aa mai. Ove wa holeka omaviinyu mawa fiyo opaife.”
Oshikumwifalonga eshi shotete Jesus okwe shi ningila muKana shomuGalilea, ndele a holola oshinge shaye; novalongwa ve mu itavela.
Konima yaashi okwa ya kuKapernaum, Oye naina, novamwaina ovalumenhu novalongwa vaye, ndele vo inava kala ko omafiku mahapu.
Ndele Opaasa yOvajuda ya hangika ya fika, ndele Jesus okwa ya ta londo kuJerusalem.
Ndele okwa hanga motembeli ava hava landifa eehove needi neenghuti, novakumaani voimaliwa, ve li omutumba.
Ndele Ye okwa ninga oshokoto yomapando, ndele okwe va taataa mo aveshe motembeli, pamwe needi neengobe, ndele a tilashi oimaliwa yovakumaani, noitaafula yavo okwe i undulila poshi.
Ndele okwa lombwela ovalandifi veenghuti: “Tumbeni po oinima ei. Ongulu yaTate inamu i ninga oshilandelo.”
Ndele ovalongwa vaye ova dimbulukwa nokutya, opa shangwa: “Ouladi omolwongulu yoye otau li nge.”
Opo nee Ovajuda ve mu nyamukula ndele tava ti: “Oto tu ulikile edidiliko lashike, eshi to longo ngaha?”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Ngumauneni po otembeli ei, ndele handi i tungulula momafiku atatu.”
Opo Ovajuda va tya: “Otembeli ei ya tungwa omido omilongo nhee nomido hamano, ndele Ove oto i tungu momafiku atatu?”
Ndelenee Ye okwa popya otembeli yolutu laye.
Ndele eshi a nyumuka koufi, ovalongwa vaye ova dimbulukwa nokutya, Ye e shi tile, ndele va itavela omishangwa nondjovo ei Jesus e i tile.
Hano Jesus eshi a li muJerusalem momafiku aPaasa, vahapu va itavela edina laye, shaashi va mona omadidiliko Ye e a ninga.
Ndelenee Jesus ine litula muvo nelineekelo, osheshi okwa li e va shii aveshe,
ndele Ye ina pumbwa ou te mu hepaululile ta popi omunhu, osheshi Oye mwene a shiiva eshi sha kala momunhu.
3: Ndele opa li omulumenhu womOvafarisai, edina laye Nikodemus, omukulunhu wOvajuda.
Ye okwe uya kuJesus oufiku ndele ta ti kuye: “Rabbi, otu shi shii, oove omulongi wa dja kuKalunga, osheshi kape na ou ta dulu okuninga oikumwifalonga ei to i ningi, Kalunga ngeenge ke li pamwe naye.”
Jesus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuye: “Oshilishili handi ku lombwele: omunhu ngeenge ina dalululwa, ita dulu okumona ouhamba waKalunga.”
Nikodemus okwa tya kuye: “Omunhu ta dulu ngahelipi okudalwa omukulunhu? Ita dulu ndishi okushuna medimo laina nokudalwa?”
Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Oshilishili handi ku lombwele: omunhu ngeenge ita dalwa komeva nokOmhepo, ita dulu okuya mouhamba waKalunga.
Eshi sha dalwa kombelela, osho ombelela, naashi sha dalwa kOmhepo, osho omhepo.
Ino kumwa, shaashi nde ku lombwela: mu nokudalululwa.
Omhepo otai pepe apa ya hala noshihomo shayo oto shi udu, ndele ove ku shii apa tai di naapa tai i. Hano osho tashi kala nakeshe omunhu, ou a dalwa mOmhepo.”
Nikodemus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuye: “Eshi otashi ningwa ngahelipi?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Oove omulongi waIsrael, ndele eshi ku shi shii.
Oshilishili handi ku lombwele: ohatu popi eshi tu shii, ndele hatu hepaulula eshi twa mona, ndele nye itamu itavele ehepaululo letu.
Ngeenge handi mu lombwele ei oikwadu, nye itamu itavele, hano otamu itavele ngahelipi, ngeenge handi mu lombwele ei yomeulu?
Ndelenee kape na umwe ou a londa a ya keulu, oye tuu aeke a londoloka keulu, Omona wOmunhu, ou ha kala meulu.”
Ndele ngaashi Moses a tulika eyoka pombada mombuwa, nosho yo Omona wOmunhu oku nokutulikwa pombada,
opo keshe tuu ou te mu itavele, aha kane, ndele a kale e nomwenyo waalushe.
Osheshi osho Kalunga a kala e hole ounyuni, Oye a yandja Omona waye Ewifa, opo keshe ou te mu itavele aha kane, ndelenee a kale e nomwenyo waalushe.
Osheshi Kalunga ina tuma Omona waye mounyuni a tokole ounyuni, ndelenee ounyuni u xupifwe kuye.
Ou te mu itavele, ye ita tokolwa; ndelenee ou ita itavele, ye okwa tokolwa nale, osheshi ye ina itavela edina lOmona Ewifa laKalunga.
Ndelenee etokolo oleli: ouyelele we uya mounyuni, ndelenee ovanhu va li ve hole omulaulu komesho youyelele, osheshi oilonga yavo oii.
Osheshi keshe ou ta longo owii, ota tondo ouyelele, ndele ite uya pouyelele, oilonga yaye iha hanyenwe.
Ndelenee ou ha longo oshili, oye ta holokele pouyelele, oilonga yaye i hololwe, osheshi oya ningilwa muKalunga.
Ndelenee konima yoinima ei Jesus okwa ya pamwe novalongwa vaye komikunda daJudea, ndele oko a kala navo, ndele ta shashe.
NaJohannes yo okwa li ta shashe muAinon, popepi naSelim, osheshi opa li pe nomeva mahapu, novanhu ve uya ndele tava shashwa.
Osheshi Johannes okwa li ina tulwa natango modolongo.
Ndele opa ningwa eemhata pokati kovalongwa vaJohannes nOvajuda omolweyelifo.
Ndele vo ove uya kuJohannes ndele tava ti kuye: “Rabbi, winya a kala naave kombada yaJordan, ou we mu hepaulula tala, Oye ta shashe, naaveshe otava i kuye.”
Johannes okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Omunhu ita dulu okulikufila sha, ngeenge ite shi pewa tashi di meulu.
Onye vene eendobwedi dange, ame eshi nda tile: ame haame Kristus, ndelenee nda tumwa oku mu tetekelela.
Ou e nomuhombolwa, oye omuhomboli; ndelenee kaume komuhomboli ou e li ofika ndele te mu pwilikine, oye ta hafele shili ondaka yomuhomboli. Ehafo eli lange paife ola wanenena.
Oye e nokukula, ame ndi nokuninipala.
“Ou ta di kombada, oye wokombada yaaveshe. Ou womedu, oye wopedu ndele ta popi pedu. Ou ta di meulu, oye wokombada yaaveshe.
Ndele osho e shi mona naashi e shi uda, ote shi hepaulula; ndelenee kape na ou ta tambula ehepaululo laye.
Ou ta tambula ehepaululo laye, ota pameke nokutya, Kalunga Oye omunashili.
Osheshi ou a tumwa kuKalunga, oye ta popi eendjovo daKalunga, osheshi Kalunga ita yandje Omhepo ta yeleke.
Xe e hole Omona, ndele okwa yandja aishe meke laye.
Ou ta itavele Omona, oye e nomwenyo waalushe; ndelenee ou iha dulika kOmona, ita ka mona omwenyo, ndelenee ehandu laKalunga otali kala kombada yaye.”
4: Hano Omwene eshi a shiiva nokutya, Ovafarisai ova uda kutya, Jesus okwa ninga ovalongwa vahapu, ndele ta shashe e dule Johannes,
nande Jesus mwene ina shasha, ndelenee ovalongwa vaye.
Ye okwa dja mo muJudea ndele ta shuna kuGalilea.
Ndelenee Ye okwa li e nokutokola Samaria.
Hano Ye okwe uya koshilando shomuSamaria, edina lasho Sikar, popepi nepya olo Jakob e li pele omona waye Josef.
Ndele oko kwa li ofifiya yaJakob. Hano Jesus eshi a li a loloka keengeda, a kala omutumba pofifiya. Ndele opa li otundi onhihamano.
Ndele taku di omukainhu Omusamaria, te uya okuteka omeva. Jesus ta ti kuye: “Pe nge ndi nwe mo.”
Osheshi ovalongwa vaye va li va ya koshilando va ka lande oikulya.
Ndele omukainhu Omusamaria okwa tya kuye: “Oove Omujuda oto indile nge ngahelipi okunwa, aame omukainhu Omusamaria?” Osheshi Ovajuda ihava endafana nOvasamaria.
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Ngeno wa shiiva oshali yaKalunga, nalyelye ou ta ti kwoove: pe nge okunwa, ngeno ove to mu indile, ndele ye te ku pe omeva e nomwenyo.”
Omukainhu okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, ove uhe na oshitoo shokuteka mo, ondungu yo oile, omeva oo e nomwenyo ou a kwete, e li peni?
Oove omukulunhu mbela u dule tate Jakob, ou e tu pa ondungu ei, ndele ye a nwa mo novana vaye noimuna yaye?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Keshe tuu ou ta nu momeva aa, ota fi vali enota,
ndelenee ou ta nu momeva aa Ame handi mu pe, ita fi vali enota fiyo alushe; ndelenee omeva aa handi mu pe, otaa ningi muye ofifiya yomeva, aa taa fulukile fiyo omomwenyo waalushe.”
Omukainhu ta ti kuye: “Omwene, pe nge omeva oo, ndiha fye vali enota, ndele ndiha pumbwe okuuya okuteka oku.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Inda u ka ifane omulumenhu woye, ndele ileni oku.”
Omukainhu okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti: “Nghi nomulumenhu.” Jesus ta ti kuye: “Heeno, owa tonga sha yuka: ‘nghi na omulumenhu’,
osheshi ove wa kala novalumenhu vatano, naau u mu kwete paife, ke fi omulumenhu woye. Eshi we shi tonga oshili.”
Omukainhu ta ti kuye: “Omwene, ondi wete, oove omuxunganeki.
Ootate vetu va ilikanenene komhunda ei, ndele nye tamu ti muJerusalem mu nonhele yokwiilikanena mo.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Omukainhu, itavele nge, efimbo tali uya, itamu ilikana Tate komhunda ei ile muJerusalem.
Onye tamu ilikana eshi kamu shi shii; ofye ohatu ilikana eshi tu shi shii, osheshi exupifo otali di mOvajuda.
Ndelenee efimbo tali uya, ndele opo li li paife, ovailikani vashili tava ilikana Tate momhepo nomoshili; osheshi Tate a hala ava tave mu ilikana va kale va tya ngaha.
Kalunga Oye Omhepo, naava tave mu ilikanene ovo ve nokwiilikana momhepo nomoshili.”
Omukainhu ta ti kuye: “Ondi shi shii, Messias, ou ta ifanwa Kristus, ote ke uya. Oye ngeenge te uya, ote tu hololele aishe.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Aame tuu ou, ou ta popi naave.”
Opo tuu opo ovalongwa vaye ve uya, ndele va kumwa Oye eshi a popya nomukainhu. Ndelenee nande umwe ina tya: “Oto indile shike?” Ile: “To popi shike naye?”
Omukainhu okwa fiya po oshitoo shaye, ndele okwa ya koshilando, ndele a lombwela ovanhu:
“Ileni mu tale omulumenhu, ou a lombwela nge aishe nde i ninga. Pamwe Oye Kristus?”
Ovo va dja mo moshilando ndele va ya kuye.
Ndele fimbo inave uya, ovalongwa vaye ove mu indila ndele tava ti: “Rabbi, lya.”
Ndelenee Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Ame ondi neendja okulya, edi muhe shii.”
Ndele ovalongwa va tongafana: “Mbela pe na umwe e mu etela oikulya?”
Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Oikulya yange ei, Ame ndi longe ehalo laau a tuma nge nondi wanife oshilonga shaye.
“Hanye vene tamu ti: ‘ope neehani nhee natango, eteyo fimbo inali fika?’ Taleni, ohandi mu lombwele: yeluleni omesho eni nye mu tale omapya nhumbi a pya okuteywa.
Ndele paife omutei ta mono ondjabi, noiimati te i ongelele omwenyo waalushe, opo omukuni a hafe pamwe nomutei.
Osheshi moshinima eshi eendjovo edi da ninga doshili: ‘ou ta kunu oku lili naau ta teya oku lili.’
Ame nde mu tuma okuteya apa inamu longa, vamwe ve lili va longa po, ndele nye mwe uya moilonga yavo.”
Ndele Ovasamaria vahapu vomoshilando eshi ve mu itavela omolweendjovo domukainhu ou a hepaulula: “Ye okwa lombwela nge aishe nde i ninga.”
Opo Ovasamaria eshi ve uya kuye, ove mu indila a menekele puvo. Ndele Ye okwa kala ko omafiku avali.
Ndele vahapu ve dule venya va itavela omolweendjovo daye,
ova tya komukainhu: “Paife inatu itavela vali omolweendjovo doye, osheshi ofye vene twa uda ndele tu shi shii, Oye shili Omukulili wounyuni.”
Ndelenee eshi pa pita omafiku avali, Ye okwa dja ko ndele ta i kuGalilea.
Osheshi Jesus mwene okwa hepaulula ta ti: “Omuxunganeki ita fimanekwa moshilongo shaye.”
Ndelenee eshi e uya kuGalilea, Ovagalilea ove mu tambula, osheshi vo va mona aishe e i ningila muJerusalem moshivilo, osheshi navo yo va ile ko koshivilo.
Ndele Jesus okwe uya vali kuKana shomuGalilea, omo a shitukifile omeva omaviinyu. Ndele muKapernaum omwa li mu nelenga lohamba li nomona ta vele.
Lo eshi la uda Jesus a dja kuJudea ndele e uya kuGalilea, ola ya kuye, ndele le mu indila, e uye a velule omona, osheshi okwa li pokufya.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Ngeenge itamu mono omadidiliko noikumwifalonga, itamu itavele.”
Elenga lohamba ola tya kuye: “Omwene, ila fimbo okaana kange inaka fya.”
Jesus okwa tya kulo: “Inda, omumwoye ota kala e nomwenyo.” Omulumenhu okwa itavela ondjovo ei, Jesus e i mu lombwela, ndele okwa ya.
Ndele fimbo e li mondjila ta shuna, ovapiya vaye ove mu shakeneka, ndele tava ti kuye: Okaana koye oke nomwenyo.
Ndele ye okwa pula efimbo lilipipo ka hovela okutalalelwa. Ovo ve mu nyamukula: “Onghela, potundi onhihamano olwiidi le mu fiya po.”
Ndele xe okwa dimbulukwa otundi oyo tuu ei Jesus eshi a tya kuye: “Okaana koye ke nomwenyo.” Ndele ye okwa itavela neumbo laye alishe.
Oshikumwifalonga eshi osho oshitivali, Jesus e shi ninga, eshi a dja muJudea ndele te uya kuGalilea.
5: Ndele konima yoinima ei opa li oshivilo shOvajuda, ndele Jesus okwa ya kombada kuJerusalem.
Ndele muJerusalem, oposhivelo sheedi, omu netale la ifanwa mOshiheberi Betesda, ndele li neenduda nhano dinene.
Omudo mwa nangala ongudu inene yovanaudu, ovapofi novavelimbada noingudu, ava va teelela omeva a nyenganyengifwe.
Osheshi opomafimbo amwe omweengeli wOmwene okwa londolokela metale, ndele okwa nyenganyengifa omeva. Ndele ou ta i mo tete, omeva eshi a nyenganyengifwa, ota veluka, kukeshe oudu e u kwete.
Ndele opa li omunhu omulumenhu, a li ta vele omido omilongo nhatu nahetatu.
Hano Jesus eshi e mu mona a nangala, ndele okwa shiiva, a ninga efimbo lile ta vele, okwa tya kuye: “Wa hala okuveluka?”
Opo omunaudu okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omwene, ame nghi nomunhu ta twala nge metale, omeva ngeenge taa nyenganyengifwa; ndele fimbo handi i ko, umwe ta piti komesho yange.”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Fikama, kufa olutala loye u ende.”

Ndele divadiva omulumenhu okwa veluka, ndele a kufa olutala laye ndele ta i.
Ndelenee efiku olo la li Eshabata.
Opo Ovajuda va tya kwaau a veluka: “Oku nEshabata, itashi dulika okuhumbata olutala.”
Ye okwe va nyamukula: “Ou a velula nge, ye okwa lombwela nge: ‘kufa olutala loye u ende.’ ”
Opo vo ve mu pula: “Omulumenhu ou olyelye, e ku lombwela, ‘kufa olutala loye u ende?’ ”
Ndelenee ou a velulwa ine mu shiiva oye olyelye; Jesus a hangika a dja po, osheshi opa li ongudu inene yovanhu.
Ndele konima yoinima ei Jesus okwe mu mona motembeli, ndele ta ti kuye: “Tala, ove wa veluka, ino nyona vali, uha hangike kowii umwe u dule winya.”
Ndele omulumenhu okwa ya, ndele a hepaululila Ovajuda nokutya, ou e mu velula, Oye Jesus.
Ndele Ovajuda va nangela Jesus, osheshi Oye e shi ninga mEshabata.
Ndelenee Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Tate ta longo fiyo opaife, naame yo handi longo.”
Onghee hano Ovajuda va hala neenghono oku mu dipaa, osheshi hasheshi ashike eshi a nyona Eshabata, ndelenee okwa tya yo Kalunga Oye Xe, ndele e lininga e fike puKalunga.

Ndele Jesus okwe va lombwela ndele ta ti: “Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: Omona iha dulu okuninga nande sha muye mwene, ndelenee oshosho ashike ta mono Xe te shi ningi; osheshi osho Xe te shi ningi, osho Omona te shi ningi yo.
Osheshi Xe e hole Omona, ndele te mu ulikile aishe ei Oye mwene te i longo; ndele te ke mu ulikila oilonga inene i dule ei, opo mu kumwe.
Osheshi ngaashi Xe ta nyumuna ovafi, ndele te va ningi vali ovanamwenyo, osho tuu nOmona yo ta ningi ovanamwenyo ava a hala.
Osheshi Tate ita tokola nande umwe, ndelenee etokolo alishe okwe li yandja kOmona,
opo aveshe va fimaneke Omona, ngaashi tava fimaneke Xe. Ou ita fimaneke Omona, oye ita fimaneke Xe ou e mu tuma.
“Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: Ou ta udu eendjovo dange, nota itavele ou a tuma nge, oku na omwenyo waalushe, ye ita ka tokolwa, ndelenee ye okwa dja mo mefyo, ndele e uya momwenyo.
Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: efimbo tali uya, ndele opo li li paife, ovafi tava udu ondaka yOmona waKalunga, naava tave i udu, otava kala ve nomwenyo.
Osheshi ngaashi Xe e nomwenyo muye mwene, osho tuu okwe u pa Omona, Ye a kale yo e nomwenyo muye mwene.
Ndele Oye okwe mu pa eenghono dokutokola, osheshi Oye Omona wOmunhu.
“Inamu shi kuminwa, osheshi efimbo tali uya, opo aveshe ava va kala meembila otava udu ondaka yaye
ndele tava hololoka mo, ava va longa ouwa okunyumukila omwenyo, naava va longa owii, okunyumukila etokolo.
“Mwaame mwene ihandi dulu okulonga nande sha. Ongaashi handi udu, osho handi tokola; netokolo lange ola yuka, osheshi Ame ihandi shikula ehalo lange mwene, ndelenee ehalo laau a tuma nge.
Ngeenge handi lihepaulula Ame mwene, ehepaululo lange kali shii okulineekelwa.
Ope na umwe ta hepaulula nge, ndele ndi shi shii ehepaululo olo ta hepaulula nge, oloshili.
Onye mwa tuminwa Johannes, ndele ye okwa hepaulula oshili.
Ndelenee Ame itandi tambula ehepaululo komunhu, ndelenee handi popi eshi, nye mu xupifwe.
Winya okwa li oshela ya xwama ndele ya minikila, ndelenee nye omwa hala okunyakukwa okafimbo kaxupi mouyelele waye.
Ndelenee Ame ondi na ehepaululo linene li dule linya laJohannes; osheshi oilonga ei Tate okwe i pa nge ndi i wanife, oilonga tuu ei handi longo, oyo tuu tai hepaulula nge nokutya, Tate okwa tuma nge.
Ndele Tate ou a tuma nge, Ye okwa hepaulula nge. Onye inamu uda ondaka yaye nande, nye inamu mona olupe laye,
neendjovo daye kamu di kwete di kale munye; osheshi nye inamu itavela ou a tumwa kuye.
Nye tamu konakona momishangwa, osheshi omu shii nye omu na omwenyo waalushe mudo, ndele odo otadi hepaulula nge;
ndelenee onye inamu hala okuuya kwaame, mu kale nomwenyo.
“Ame ihandi tambula efimano kovanhu;
ndelenee ondi mu shii nokutya, ohole yaKalunga kai mo munye.
Ame nde uya medina laTate, nye itamu tambula nge. Ngeenge umwe e lili te uya medina laye mwene, oye nee otamu mu tambula.
Otamu dulu ngahelipi okwiitavela, onye ava hamu tambulafana omafimanekafano, nefimaneko olo tali di kuKalunga aeke, ihamu li kongo.
Inamu tya, Ame handi ke mu popya kuTate; ope na umwe te mu popi, oye Moses, ou mwe mu lineekela.
Ndelenee ngeno mwa itavela Moses, ngeno mwa itavela nge yo, osheshi Aame tuu ou nda shangwa kuye.
Ndelenee fimbo inamu itavela omishangwa daye, otamu itavele ngahelipi eendjovo dange?”
6: Konima yoinima ei Jesus okwa ya langhele kwinya yefuta laGalilea nokutya, yefuta laTiberias.
Nongudu inene ye mu shikula, osheshi vo ova mona oikumwifalonga inya ye e i ningila movanaudu.
Ndele Jesus okwa londa komhunda, ndele oko a kala omutumba pamwe novalongwa vaye.
Ndelenee Opaasa, oshivilo shOvajuda osha li popepi.
Opo Jesus eshi a yelula omesho aye, okwa mona ongudu inene yovanhu tai uya kuye, okwa tya kuFilippus: “Ohatu ka landa peni omingome okuliwa kwaava?”
Ndelenee eshi e shi tonga oku mu yeleka, osheshi Ye mwene okwa li e shi shii, eshi a hala okuninga.
Filippus okwe mu nyamukula: “Omingome deedenari omafele avali itadi va wanene, ovo aveshe va pewe nande okapambu kanini.”
Opo nee umwe womovalongwa vaye, Andreas, omumwaina waSimon Petrus, okwa tya kuye:
“Ope nokamati ke nomingome nhano doilya neeshi mbali, ndelenee edi tadi kwafa shike kwaava ve fike apa.”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Lombweleni ovanhu va kale omutumba.” Ndelenee opa li omwiidi muhapu ponhele ei. Ndele ovalumenhu ve fike pomayovi atano va kala omutumba.
Ndele Jesus okwa kufa omingome, okwa pandula, ndele okwe di pa ovalongwa, novalongwa ve di tukulila ava va li omutumba; neeshi osho tuu, dihapu, ngaashi va hala.
Ndelenee eshi va kuta, Ye okwa tya kovalongwa vaye: “Tooleni oundjaumukile va xupa po, paha hepe sha.”
Ndelenee ve va toola, ndele va yadifa oimbale omulongo naivali oundjaumukile vokomingome nhano doilya, va xupa kwaava va lya.
Opo ovanhu eshi va mona oshikumwifalonga eshi Jesus e shi ninga, ova tya: “Ou oshili omuxunganeki winya kwa li e nokuuya mounyuni.”
Ndele hano Jesus eshi e shi koneka kutya, vo ova hala oku mu kufa noku mu fininika, ve mu ninge ohamba, okwa shuna komhunda, Oye aeke.
Nonguloshi eshi ye uya, ovalongwa vaye va ya kefuta.
Ndele eshi va ya mowato, ova yauka efuta nokuyaukila kuKapernaum. Ndele opa laula nale, naJesus ine uya natango kuvo.
Ndele efuta ola tukulukifwa neenghono kokupepa kwomhepo idjuu.
Ndele eshi va kufa ko oshinano shi fike peekilometa nhano ile hamano, ve wete Jesus ta ende kombada yefuta, ndele ta ehene kowato; ovo va kwatwa koumbada.
Ndelenee Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Aame ou, inamu tila.”
Ndele vo va hala oku mu tambula mowato, mokafimbo tuu oko owato ya fika kedu linya va li ve nokuya ko.

Mefiku la shikula eli, ovanhu va fyaalele komunghulo winya wefuta va mona kutya kaku nowato ikwao, oyo aike ei ovalongwa va ya nayo, ndele Jesus ina ya mowato pamwe novalongwa vaye, ndelenee ovalongwa aveke va ya.
Ndele ope uya eewato dimwe da dja kuTiberias, de uya popepi nonhele ei, apa va lilile omingome, Omwene eshi a tonga epandulo.
Hano ovanhu eshi va mona Jesus ehe po, novalongwa vaye yo, navo yo va ya meewato, ndele va ya kuKapernaum, va ka konge Jesus.
Ndele eshi ve mu hanga langhele kwinya yefuta, ova tya kuye: “Rabbi, onaini we uya ko oku?”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: onye itamu kongo nge, eshi mwa mona oikumwifalonga, ndelenee eshi mwa lile omingome edi ndele omwa kuta.
Inamu lilongela eendja edi tadi xulu po, ndelenee eendja edi tadi kala fiyo okomwenyo waalushe, odedi Omona wOmunhu te di mu pe, osheshi Oye tuu ou Xe, Kalunga mwene, e mu tula oshihako shaye.”
Ndele vo ova tya kuye: “Fye otu nokuninga shike tu longe oilonga yaKalunga?”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Oshilonga shaKalunga osheshi mu itavele ou a tumwa kuye.”
Ndelenee vo ova tya kuye: “Edidiliko lilipipo to li ningi hano, tu li mone, fye tu ku itavele? Oto longo shike?
Ootate vetu va lile omanna mombuwa, ngaashi pa shangwa: ‘Ye okwe va pa okulya omungome wokeulu.’ ”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: HaMoses e mu pele omungome wokeulu, ndelenee Tate Oye te mu pe omungome woshili tau di keulu.
Osheshi omungome waKalunga oo tuu ou tau di keulu ndele tau pe ounyuni omwenyo.”
Ndele vo ova tya kuye: “Omwene, tu pa alushe omungome ou.”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Aame omungome womwenyo. Ou te uya kwaame, oye ita fi ondjala, ndele ou ta itavele nge, ita fi vali enota fiyo alushe.
“Ndelenee ngaashi Ame nde mu lombwela, onye mwa mona nge, nye inamu itavela.
Ashishe eshi Tate te shi pe nge, otashi uya kwaame. Ndele ou te uya kwaame, itandi mu ekeleshi.
Osheshi Ame nda dja keulu hakuwanifa ehalo lange mwene, ndelenee ehalo laau a tuma nge.
Nehalo laTate ou a tuma nge oleli, ndiha kanife po nande umwe mwaava a pa nge, ndelenee ndi va nyumune efiku laxuuninwa.
Osheshi ehalo laTate oleli: Keshe tuu ou ta mono Omona ndele te mu itavele, oye e nomwenyo waalushe; ndele Ame handi mu nyumuna efiku laxuuninwa.”
Ndele Ovajuda ve mu ngongotela eshi a tya: “Aame omungome ou wa dja meulu,”
ndele va tya: “Ye ke fi Jesus, omona waJosef, naxe naina tu va shii. Ota ti ngahelipi hano: Ame nda dja meulu?”
Jesus okwa nyamukula ndele ta ti kuvo: “Inamu ngongotelafana.
Kape na ou ta dulu okuuya kwaame okuninga Tate, ou a tuma nge, te mu shili. Ndele handi mu nyumuna efiku laxuuninwa.
Movaxunganeki mwa shangwa: ‘Ndele aveshe tava ningi va longwa kuKalunga.’ Keshe tuu ou e liudila kuTate ndele a longwa kuye, oye te uya kwaame.
Hakutya umwe ngeno a mona Tate, oye tuu aeke a dja muKalunga, oye a mona Tate.
“Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: Ou ta itavele oku na omwenyo waalushe.
Aame omungome womwenyo.
Ooxo va lile omanna mombuwa, ndele vo va fya.
Oo omungome ou tau di meulu, opo keshe omunhu e u lye, ye aha fye.
Aame omungome ou u nomwenyo wa dja meulu. Ngeenge umwe ta li omungome ou, oye ta kala e nomwenyo fiyo alushe. Nomungome handi u yandje, oo ombelela yange, ei handi i yandjele ounyuni u mone omwenyo.”
Opo Ovajuda va patafana ndele va tya: “Ou ota dulu ngahelipi oku tu pa ombelela yaye tu i lye?”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Oshilishili handi mu lombwele, ngeenge itamu li ombelela yOmona wOmunhu nye itamu nu ohonde yaye, nye kamu na omwenyo munye vene.
Ou ta li ombelela yange ye ta nu ohonde yange, oye e nomwenyo waalushe, ndele handi mu nyumuna efiku laxuuninwa.
Osheshi ombelela yange oyo eendja dashili nohonde yange oyo oshinuwa shashili.
Ou ta li ombelela yange nota nu ohonde yange, oye ta kala mwaame naame muye.
Ngaashi Tate ou e nomwenyo, a tuma nge, naame ndi nomwenyo omolwaye, osho tuu ou ta li nge, oye ta kala e nomwenyo omolwange.
Omungome oo tuu ou wa dja meulu. Hangaashi ooxo va lile omanna, ndele va fya; ou ta li omungome ou, oye ta kala e nomwenyo fiyo alushe.”
Edi okwe di popya eshi a li ta longo ovanhu moshinagoga muKapernaum.
Ndele opo nee vahapu vomovalongwa vaye eshi ve shi uda, ova tya: “Eendjovo edi odikukutu, olyelye ta dulu oku di pwilikina?”
