Ndelenee Jesus eshi a li e shi shii muye mwene nokutya, ovalongwa vaye ve di ngongotela, okwa tya kuvo: “Eshi oshe mu ningifa omwenyo mwii?
Ongahelipi hano, ngeenge tamu mono Omona wOmunhu ta londo ta i apa a kala shito?
Omhepo oyo tuu tai yandje omwenyo; ombelela kai na eshi tai kwafa. Eendjovo edi nde di mu lombwela, odo omhepo nomwenyo.
Ndelenee mokati keni omu na vamwe ihava itavele. Osheshi Jesus okwa li a shiiva pehovelo, oolyelye ava ihava itavele, nalyelye ou te ke mu kengelela.”
Ndele Ye okwa tya: “Onghee nde mu lombwela, kape na ou ta dulu okuuya kwaame ngeenge ite shi pewa kuTate.”
Okudja opo vahapu vomovalongwa vaye va shuna monima, vo inava enda vali naye.
Opo nee Jesus okwa lombwela ava omulongo navavali: “Nanye yo mwa hala okuya?”
Ndele Simon Petrus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Omwene, otu ye kulyelye ngeno? Oove u neendjovo domwenyo waalushe;
ndele fye twa itavela ndele tu shi shii, Oove Omuyapuki waKalunga.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Haame nde mu hoolola, nye omulongo navavali? Ndelenee umwe womunye omudiaboli.”
Ndelenee eshi okwe shi tonga omolwaJudas omona waSimon Iskariot, osheshi ye okwa li ou te ke mu kengelela, ndele ye a li umwe waava omulongo navavali.
7: Ndele konima yoinima ei Jesus okwa li ha endaenda muGalilea, osheshi okwa li ina hala okweenda muJudea, shaashi Ovajuda ve mu nangela ve mu dipae.
Ndele oshivilo shOvajuda, eshi shomatwali, osha li popepi.
Opo ovamwaina ove mu lombwela: “Fikama, u dje po apa, u ye kuJudea, opo ovalongwa voye va mone oilonga ei ho longo,
osheshi kape na ou a hala a monike, ta longo sha meholeko. Hano ngeenge to longo oilonga ei, lihololela ounyuni.”
Osheshi novamwaina ova li yo inave mu itavela.
Opo nee Jesus okwe va lombwela: “Efimbo lange inali fika manga. Ndele efimbo leni opo li li alushe.
Ounyuni itau dulu oku mu tonda; Ame otau tondo nge, shaashi handi hepaulula nokutya, oilonga yao oii.
Nye indeni koshivilo, Ame itandi i manga koshivilo eshi, osheshi efimbo lange inali fika manga.”
Ndele eshi okwe shi va lombwela, ndele ta fyaala muGalilea.
Ndele ovamwaina eshi va ya koshivilo, opo Jesus okwa ya ko yo, hamoipafi, ndele omeholeko.
Ndele Ovajuda ova li tave mu kongo moshivilo, ndele tava ti: “Ye oku li peni?”
Ndele Ye okwa li ta tongwa unene mokati kovanhu, tava ti: “Ye omuwa;” vamwe va tya: “Ahowe, Ye ota pukifa ovanhu.”
Ndele kape na ou e mu tonga povanhu, shaashi va tila Ovajuda.
Ndele mokati koshivilo Jesus okwa ya kotembeli, ndele ta longo ovanhu.
Ndele Ovajuda va kumwa, ndele tava ti: “Ou, omishangwa oku di shii ngahelipi, nande ina longwa?”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Elongo lange kali fi lange, ndele olaau a tuma nge.
Ngeenge pe na ou a hala okulonga ehalo laye, ota ka shiiva elongo, ngeenge ola dja muKalunga, ile handi popi mwaame mwene.
Ou ta tongo muye mwene, ota kongo efimano laye mwene, ndele ou ta kongo efimano laau e mu tuma, oye omunashili, noipupulu kai mo muye.
Moses haye e mu pa omhango hamba, ndele nande umwe mokati keni ite i wanifa. Oshike mwa hala okudipaa nge?”
Ndele eengudu dovanhu da nyamukula: “Ove u nondemoni, olyelye a hala oku ku dipaa?”
Opo nee Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Oshilonga shimwe onde shi longa, ndele nye amushe omwa kumwa.
Moses okwe mu pa epito letanda (hakutya, la dja muMoses, ndelenee okooxo) nomEshabata hamu pitifa omunhu etanda.
Hano omunhu ngeenge ta pitifwa etanda mEshabata, opo omhango yaMoses iha lundululwe, nye otamu handukilile nge shike, eshi nda velula omunhu aushe mEshabata?
Inamu tokola pashipala, tokoleni etokolo la yuka.”
Ndelenee vamwe vomuJerusalem va tya: “Ou haye ve mu konga ve mu dipae?
Ndele tala, nhumbi ta tongo moipafi yavo, ndele vo itava ti sha kuye. Mbela ovakulunhu ve shi koneka shili kutya, Oye Kristus?
Ndelenee ou otu mu shii apa a dja, ndelenee Kristus ngeenge te uya, kape na ou e shii apa a dja.”

Ndelenee Jesus okwa popya mokule motembeli omo kwa li ta longo ovanhu, ta ti: “Nye omu shii nge, ndele mu shii apa nda dja. Inandi dja mwaame mwene, ndele ou a tuma nge, Oye omunashili, ndele nye kamu mu shii.
Ndelenee Ame ondi mu shii, osheshi onda dja kuye, ndele Ye okwa tuma nge.”
Ndele vo va hala ve mu kwate, ndele kapa li nande umwe e mu kuma, osheshi efimbo laye la li inali fika manga.
Ndele vahapu vomongudu yovanhu ve mu itavela, ndele tava ti: “Kristus ngeenge te uya ota ka longa oikumwifalonga ihapu e dule ou?”
Ndele Ovafarisai va uda ovanhu tave mu popi ngaha nokunongofola, ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu nOvafarisai va tuma ko ovapiya ve mu kwate.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Okafimbo kaxupi natango ondi li punye, opo nee handi i kwaau a tuma nge;
Ndele nye otamu ka kala nokukonga nge, ndele itamu mono nge, apa Ame ndi li itamu dulu okuya po.”
Ndele Ovajuda va tongafana: “Ou okwa hala okuya peni, eshi itatu mu mono? Ota i mbela kwaava va halakana mokati kOvagreka nokulonga Ovagreka?
Eendjovo edi oda tya ngahelipi, eshi ta ti: Otamu kala nokukonga nge, ndele itamu mono nge, apa Ame ndi li, itamu dulu okuya po?”
Ndele mefiku linene, laxuuninwa loshivilo, Jesus a kala ofika nota ingida mokule ta ti: “Ngeenge pe na ou a fya enota, ne uye kwaame ye a nwe.
‘Oye ou ta itavele nge, ngaashi omishangwa tadi ti, meni laye otamu ka tondoka omilonga domeva e nomwenyo.’ ”
Ndele eshi e shi tongela Omhepo tai pewa ava ve mu itavela, osheshi Omhepo Iyapuki kwa li inai uya manga, shaashi Jesus okwa li ina yelulwa natango.
Ndele vahapu vomovanhu eshi va uda eendjovo edi, ova tya: “Oshili ou omuxunganeki winya.”
Ndele vamwe tava ti: “Ou oKristus,” ndele vamwe vali tava ti: “Kristus ota di tuu kuGalilea?
Omushangwa itau ti: Kristus ota di moludalo laDavid nomoshilando shaBetlehem, oku kwa li David?”
Ndele mokati kovanhu mwa tukuluka olutandu molwaye.
Ndele vamwe vomuvo va hala ve mu kwate; ndele kapa li nande umwe e mu kuma.
Opo nee ovapiya va shuna kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokOvafarisai. Ndele venya va tya kuvo: “Oshike hano inamu mu eta oku?”
Ovapiya va nyamukula: “Kapa li omunhu noshito, a popya ngaashi winya ta popi.”
Opo Ovafarisai va tya kuvo: “Nanye yo omwa pukifwa mbela?
Ope na tuu mbela nande umwe womovakulunhu e mu itavela, ile umwe womOvafarisai?
Ndele ovanhu ava, inava shiiva omhango, ova fingwa.”
Opo nee umwe womuvo, Nikodemus, ou a ile kuJesus oufiku, ta ti kuvo:
“Omhango yetu otai pe tuu omunhu etimba mbela fimbo ina pwilikinwa, ye a udike eshi a ninga?”
Ndele vo ve mu nyamukula tava ti: “Naave yo owomuGalilea, hamba? Konakona u tale, muGalilea ihamu di nande omuxunganeki.”
Ndele va ya, keshe tuu keumbo lavo.
8: Ndele Jesus okwa ya kOmhunda yEemono.
Ndele ongula inene okwa ya vali motembeli, ndele ovanhu vahapu ve uya kuye. Ndele Ye a kala omutumba ndele te va longo.
Ndele ovanongo vomishangwa nOvafarisai ve mu etela omukainhu a kwatwa moluhaelo, ndele tave mu kaleke ofika mokati kavo.
Opo nee tava ti kuye: “Omuhongi, omukainhu ou okwa kwatwa e li moluhaelo loovene.
Ndele Moses okwe tu lombwela, ava ve li ngaha ove nokudipawa nomamanya. Ove oto ti ngahelipi?”
Ndele eshi ve shi tila oku mu shinda, va shiive oku mu popya. Ndele Jesus okwa petama ndele ta shange nomunwe pedu.
Ndele eshi va diinina oku mu pula, okwa petuka ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ou womunye ehe netimba, ne mu kupule tete emanya.”
Ndele okwa petama vali, ndele ta shange medu.
Ndele eshi ve di uda, va pewa oushima komaliudo avo, ndele va ya, umwe naumwe, ovakulunhu fiyo ovava vaxuuninwa. Ndele Jesus okwa kala po aeke nomukainhu ou e li ofika koshipala shaye.
Ndele Jesus eshi a petuka, ndele ta ti kuye: “Omukainhu, ovapopi voye ove li peni? Kape na ou e ku tokola?”
Ndele ye ta ti: “Ahowe, nande umwe, Omwene.” Ndele Jesus okwe mu lombwela: “Naame yo itandi ku tokola, inda, ndele ino nyona vali.”
Ndele Jesus okwe va lombwela vali, ta ti: “Aame ouyelele wounyuni; ou ta shikula nge, ita ende momulaulu, ndele ota kala e nouyelele womwenyo.”
Opo nee Ovafarisai tava ti kuye: “Ove oto lihepaulula mwene, elihepaululo loye lihe shii okulineekelwa.”

Jesus okwe va nyamukula, ta ti kuvo: “Nande handi lihepaulula, ehepaululo lange oli shii okulineekelwa, osheshi Ame ondi shii apa nda dja, naapa handi i, ndele nye kamu shii apa nda dja naapa handi i.
Nye otamu tokola pambelela, Ame ihandi tokola nande oumwe.
Ndele ngeenge handi tokola, etokolo lange ola yuka, osheshi Ame haame andike, ndele ofye naTate, ou a tuma nge.
Nomomhango yeni omwa shangwa: Ehepaululo lovanhu vavali oloshili.
Ame ou handi lihepaulula mwene, naTate ou a tuma nge ota hepaulula nge.”
Ndele vo ova tya kuye: “Xo oku li peni?” Jesus okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Kamu shii nge, naTate kamu mu shii; ngeno omu shii nge, ngeno naTate omu mu shii.”
Eendjovo edi Jesus okwe di popya poshikefa shoiyandjiwa yotembeli, eshi a longa ovanhu motembeli; ndele kapa li nande omunhu e mu kwata, osheshi efimbo laye la li inali fika manga.
Ndele Jesus ta ti vali kuvo: “Ame ohandi di po, ndele nye otamu kongo nge, ndele otamu ka fila momatimba eni. Oku handi i, itamu shiiva okuya ko.”
Opo Ovajuda tava ti: “Ote lidipaa mbela, eshi ta ti: ‘Oku handi i, itamu shiiva okuya ko?’ ”
Ndele Ye okwe va lombwela: “Nye ovopedu, Ame owopombada, nye ovomounyuni ou, Ame nghi fi womounyuni ou.
Onghee nde mu lombwela, otamu ka fila momatimba eni. Osheshi ngeenge itamu itavele nokutya, Aame tuu ou, otamu ka fila momatimba eni.”
Opo nee tava ti kuye: “Oove lyelye hano?” Jesus okwa nyamukula ta ti kuvo: “Oye tuu ou nde mu lombwela nokuli pehovelo.
Ondi neendjovo dihapu oku mu tongela noku mu tokolela, ndele ou a tuma nge Oye omunashili, naashi nda uda kuye, ohandi shi tongo kounyuni.”
Ndele vo ova li vehe udite nokutya, ota popi Xe.

Opo nee Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Omona wOmunhu nge mwe mu yelula pombada, opo nee tamu ka dimbulukwa nge nokutya, Aame tuu ou, osho ihandi longo sha mwaame mwene, ndelenee osho Tate e shi longa nge, osho ashike handi shi tongo.
Naau a tuma nge oku li pwaame. Ina fiya nge po andike, osheshi ohandi longo ashishe eshi she mu wapalela.”
Ye eshi a popya edi, vahapu ve mu itavela.
Ndele Jesus okwa lombwela Ovajuda ava ve mu itavela ta ti: “Ngeenge tamu kala meendjovo dange, onye ovalongwa vange shili,
ndele tamu ka shiiva oshili, noshili otai mu mangulula.”
Opo vo ve mu nyamukula: “Fye oludalo laAbraham, tuhe na apa twa li ovapika vomunhu. Oto ti ngahelipi hano, ‘otamu ka mangululwa?’ ”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: Keshe tuu ou ta longo oulunde, oye omupika woulunde.
Ndelenee omupika iha kala alushe meumbo, omona oha kala alushe.
Omona ngeenge te mu mangulula, omwa manguluka shili.
Ame ondi shi shii nokutya, nye oludalo laAbraham, ndele omwa hala okudipaa nge, shaashi eendjovo dange inadi mona onhele munye.
Ame ohandi tongo eshi nde shi mona puTate, nanye yo tamu longo eshi nye mwa mona kuxo.”
Ndele vo va nyamukula tava ti: “Abraham oye tate yetu.” Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Ngeno nye ovana vaAbraham, ngeno hamu longo oilonga yaAbraham.
Paife mwa hala okudipaa nge, omunhu ou nde mu lombwela oshili, oye e i uda kuKalunga. Abraham ina ninga ngaha.
Nye ohamu longo oilonga yaxo yeni.” Vo ova tya kuye: “Fye inatu dalwa moluhaelo, otu na Tate umwe aeke, Kalunga.”
Jesus ta ti kuvo: “Ngeno Kalunga oXo yeni, ngeno omu hole nge, osheshi Ame nda dja muKalunga, onde uya nda dja kuye; Ame inandi dja mwaame mwene, ndelenee Ye okwa tuma nge.
Oshike inamu uda ko ondaka yange? Osheshi itamu dulu okupwilikina eendjovo dange.

Nye omu na xo yeni, Satana, ndele ouhalu waxo yeni mwa hala oku u wanifa. Ye omudipai nghee a dja, ina kala moshili, osheshi muye kamu na oshili. Eshi ta tongo oipupulu, ota tongo eshi shaye mwene, shaashi ye omunaipupulu naxe yayo.
Molwaashi Ame ohandi popi oshili, itamu itavele nge.
Olyelye mokati keni ta tomhele nge nande etimba limwe? Hano ngeenge handi popi oshili, oshike itamu itavele nge?
Ou womuKalunga, oye ta udu eendjovo daKalunga. Nye itamu di udu, osheshi kamu fi vomuKalunga.”
Opo nee Ovajuda va nyamukula tava ti kuye: “Inatu popya mbela da yuka, eshi twa tya, Oove Omusamaria nou na ondemoni?”
Jesus ta ti: “Nghi na ondemoni, ohandi fimaneke Tate, ndele nye otamu fifa nge ohoni.
Ndele haame handi kongo efimano lange mwene, oku na umwe te li kongo nota tokola.
Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: Ngeenge ope na ou ta diinine eendjovo dange, ita ka mona efyo fiyo alushe.”
Opo Ovajuda ova tya kuye: “Paife otu shi shii nee ou na ondemoni. Abraham okwa fya novaxunganeki, ndele ove to ti: ‘ngeenge pe na ou ta diinine eendjovo dange, ita ka makela efyo fiyo alushe.’
Ove u dule mbela tate Abraham, ou a fya, novaxunganeki va fya, ove oto liningi omushike hano?”
Jesus ta ti: “Ame ngeenge handi lifimaneke mwene, efimano lange olongaho, ndelenee ope na Tate ou ta fimaneke nge, Oye tuu tamu ti Oye Kalunga keni.
Ndele nye kamu mu shii, Ame ondi mu shii. Ngeno Ame ndi tye kandi mu shii, ngeno Ame omunaipupulu ngaashi nye, ndelenee Ame ondi mu shii ndele ohandi diinine eendjovo daye.
Xo yeni Abraham okwa hafela unene okumona efiku lange, ndele okwe li mona ndele ta nyakukwa.”
Opo Ovajuda va tya kuye: “Omido doye inadi fika komilongo itano, ndele wa mona Abraham?”
Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Oshili ohandi mu lombwele: Abraham fimbo ina dalwa, Ame opo ndi li.”
Opo vo ova toola omamanya ve mu kupule, ndelenee Jesus okwa hondama ndele ta di mo motembeli, ta ende mokati kavo, ta i.
9: Ndele mokweenda po kwaye okwa mona omulumenhu a dalwa omupofi.
Ndele ovalongwa ve mu pula tava ti: “Rabbi, olyelye a nyona, oye mwene ile ovakulunhu vaye, eshi a dalwa omupofi?”
Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Haye a nyona ile ovakulunhu vaye, ndelenee oilonga yaKalunga opo i hololwe muye.
Ame ndi nokulonga oilonga yaau a tuma nge, fimbo omutenya; oufiku tau uya, ndele kape na ou ta dulu okulonga.
Fimbo ndi li mounyuni, Aame ouyelele wounyuni.”
Eshi e shi popya, okwa fiila omate pedu, ndele ta ningi onhata nomate ndele ta vaeke onhata ei pomesho aye.
Ndele ta ti kuye: “Inda u ke likoshe metale laSiloa” (otali ti: Omutumwa). Ndele ye okwa ya ko, ndele te likosho, ndele a aluka e wete ko.
Ovashiinda naava kwa li have mu mono shito ta ehela, ova tya: “Ou haye tuu ou kwa li ha kala omutumba ta ehela?”
Vamwe va tya: “Oye.” Vamwe vali va tya: “Ahowe, oumwe e mu fa.” Ndele ye mwene okwa tya: “Aame tuu ou.”
Opo vo va tya kuye: “Omesho oye a twikuluka ngahelipi?”

Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Omulumenhu ou ha ifanwa Jesus, okwa pilula onhata, ndele te i vaeke pomesho ange, ndele okwa tya kwaame: Inda ketale laSiloa u likoshe mo; ndele ame nda ya ko ndele handi likosho mo nonda twikuluka.”
Ndele vo va tya kuye: “Oku li peni?” Ye okwa tya: “Nghi shii po.”
Ndele vo va twala omunhu ou a li nale omupofi kOvafarisai.
Ndele efiku olo, Jesus a ninga onhata ndele ta twikulula omesho aye, ola li Eshabata.
Ndele Ovafarisai ve mu pula yo nhumbi a twikuluka. Ndele ye okwa tya kuvo: “Okwa tula nge onhata pomesho, ndele handi likosho, ndele ndi wete ko.”

Vamwe vomOvafarisai ova tya: “Omulumenhu ou ke fi womuKalunga, osheshi iha yapula Eshabata. Vamwe ova tya? Omunhu omulunde ota dulu ngahelipi okulonga oikumwifalonga i fike apa? Ndele pa holoka olutandu mokati kavo.”
Ndele va pula vali omupofi: “Ove oto mu tongo ngahelipi, eshi a twikulula omesho oye?” Ye okwa tya: “Ye omuxunganeki.”
Ndele Ovajuda inave mu itavela nokutya, okwa li nale omupofi, ndele a twikuluka, fiyo va ifana ovakulunhu vaau a twikululwa.
Ndele ve va pula: “Ou omona weni, ou tamu ti a dalwa omupofi? Ota mono ko hano ngahelipi?”
Ovakulunhu vaye va tya: “Otu shi shii ou omona wetu, ndele a dalwa omupofi.
Ndelenee eshi a ninga omunamesho katu shi shii, ndele ou a twikulula omesho aye, katu mu shii. Mu puleni, ye omukulunhu, ne lipopile mwene.”
Ovakulunhu vaye ova popya ngaha, shaashi va tila Ovajuda. Osheshi Ovajuda ova udafana nokutya, ngeenge ope na ou ta ti: Oye Kristus, ota kondwa mo moshinagoga.
Onghee hano ovakulunhu va tya: “Ye omukulunhu, mu puleni.”
Opo nee vo va ifanununa omunhu ou a li omupofi, ndele va tya kuye: “Pa Kalunga efimano, otu shi shii omulumenhu winya omulunde.”
Ndele ye okwa nyamukula: “Ngeenge ye omulunde kandi shi shii, shimwe ashike ndi shii, onda li omupofi, ndele paife ondi wete ko.”
Ndele vo ova tya kuye: “E ku ninga ngahelipi hano, omesho oye okwe a twikulula ngahelipi?”
Ye okwe va nyamukula: “Nde shi mu lombwela nale, ndele inamu uda ko? Omwa hala hano mu ude vali shike? Omwa hala mu ninge ovalongwa vaye?”
Opo vo ve mu tuka, ndele tava ti: “Oove omulongwa waye, fye ovalongwa vaMoses.
Otu shi shii Kalunga okwa popifa Moses, ndele ou, katu mu shii apa a dja.”
Omulumenhu ou e va nyamukula ta ti: “Heeno, oshinima tashi kumwifa nge osheshi, eshi muhe shii apa a dja, nande okwa twikulula omesho ange.
Ndele tu shi shii Kalunga iha udu ovalunde, ndele ou ha tila Kalunga ndele ta wanifa ehalo laye, ota udika kuye:
Okudja kehovelo lounyuni inaku udika omunhu a twikulula omesho omunhu a dalwa omupofi.
Ou ngeno ke fi womuKalunga ngeno ke na eshi ta dulu okuninga.”
Opo ve mu nyamukula, tava ti kuye: “Ove owa dalwa moulunde woovenevene, ndele wa hala u tu longe.” Opo ve mu undulila pondje.
Jesus eshi e shi uda nokutya, ve mu undulila pondje, eshi e mu shakeneka, okwa tya kuye: “Ove ho itavele tuu Omona wOmunhu?”
Ye okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Omwene, ye olyelye, ndi mu itavele?”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Ove we mu mona, naau ta popi naave, Oye tuu ou.”
Ndele ye okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, ohandi itavele.” Ndele ta tu eengolo koshipala shaye.
Opo Jesus okwa tya: “Ame onde uya mounyuni ou okuninga etokolo. Ava ihava mono ko, va mone ko. Naava hava mono ko, va twike.”
Ndele Ovafarisai vamwe, ava va hangika pamwe naye, ove shi uda, ndele tava ti: “Nafye yo ovapofi hamba?”
Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Ngeno nye ovapofi, ngeno kamu netimba; ndele eshi hamu ti: ‘ohatu mono ko,’ etimba leni otali kalelele po.
10: “Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: ou ita i moshuunda sheedi ta piti moshivelo, ndele ta piti pamwe pe lili ta pumine mo, oye omulunga nombudi.
Ndelenee ou ta i mo ta piti moshivelo, oye omufita weedi.
Oye ta yeululwa komukeleli woshivelo needi otadi udu ondaka yaye; nota ifana eedi daye omadina ado, ndele te di pitifa mo.
Ndele ngeenge a pitifa mo eedi daye adishe, ote di kwatele komesho, needi tadi mu shikula, osheshi odi shii ondaka yaye.
Ndele umwe e lili itadi mu shikula, otadi mu i onhapo, osheshi kadi shii ondaka yavamwe ve lili.”
Efaneko eli Jesus okwe li va lombwela; ndele vo va li vehe udite ko eshi e va lombwela oshike.
Opo Jesus okwe va lombwela vali: “Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: Aame oshivelo sheedi.
Aveshe venya va ile komesho yange, ovo ovalunga neembudi, needi inadi va uda.
Aame oshivelo. Ngeenge pe na ou ta i mo ta piti mwaame, oye ta xupifwa, ndele ta kala nokuya mo nokudja mo, ndele ta mono oulifilo.
Omulunga iha endele oshinima shimwe, okuvaka ashike nokudipaa nokunyonauna. Ame nde uya, vo va kale nomwenyo nouyadi.
“Aame omufita ou muwa. Omufita ou muwa ota yandjele eedi omwenyo waye.
Ndelenee omulongeli wondjabi ou ehe fi omufita, needi dihe fi daye mwene, ota mono embungu tali uya, oye te di fii po ndele ta i onhapo; nembungu tali di kwata noku di halakanifa.
Ota i onhapo, osheshi oye omulongeli wondjabi, needi ke na ko na sha nado.
Aame omufita ou muwa, eedi dange ondi di shii, needi dange odi shii nge,
ngaashi Tate e shii nge, naame onda shiiva Tate. Nomwenyo wange ohandi u yandjele eedi.
Ondi na yo eedi dihe fi domoshuunda eshi; naadinya ondi noku di eta mo, ndele tadi udu ondaka yange, ndele tapa ka kala oshuunda shimwe, nomufita umwe.
“Onghee Tate e hole nge, eshi handi yandje omwenyo wange, opo ndi u tambule vali.
Kape na ou te u kufa nge, ndelenee Aame mwene handi u yandje. Ame ondi neenghono oku u yandja, ndele ondi neenghono oku u tambula vali. Oshipango eshi onde shi pewa kuTate.”
Opo mOvajuda mwa tukuluka olutandu molweendjovo edi.
Ndele vahapu vavo va tya: “Ye oku na ondemoni, ndele ta i eenghwengu; oshike tamu mu pwilikinine?”
Vamwe va tya: “Eendjovo edi kadi fi daau e neendemoni. Ondemoni otai dulu tuu mbela okupashukifa omesho ovapofi?”
Ndele oshivilo shokudimbulukwa eyapulo lotembeli yomuJerusalem osha fika, ndele opa li okufu.
Jesus okwa li ta endaenda motembeli molukala laSalomo.
Opo Ovajuda ve mu liongalela ndele tava ti kuye: “Fiyo onaini to tu kaleke momalimbililo? Oove ngeenge oKristus, tu lombwela hano odikilila.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Onde shi mu lombwela, ndele nye inamu itavela. Oilonga ei handi i longo medina laTate, otai hepaulula nge.
Ndelenee nye itamu itavele, osheshi kamu fi eedi dange.
Eedi dange ohadi udu ondaka yange, naame ondi di shii, ndele do otadi shikula nge.
Ndele Ame ohandi di pe omwenyo waalushe, ndele do itadi ka kana fiyo alushe, ndele kape na ou te di vakula mo meke lange.
Tate ou e di pa nge, oku dule aveshe, ndele kape na ou ta dulu oku di vakula mo meke laTate.
Ofye naTate umwe.”
Opo tuu opo Ovajuda va toola omamanya ve mu dipae nomamanya.
Jesus okwa nyamukula ta ti kuvo: “Ame onde mu ulikila oilonga iwa ihapu ya dja muTate; oshilonga shilipipo mwa hala oku shi dipaela nge nomamanya?”
Ovajuda ove mu nyamukula: “Itatu ku dipaa nomamanya molwoshilonga shiwa, ndelenee omolweshekokalunga nashaashi Ove to liningi Kalunga, nande Oove omunhu.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Momhango yeni inamu shangwa: ‘Ame onda tya: onye ookalunga?’
Oye ngeenge ta ifana venya va pewa eendjovo daKalunga, ookalunga, nomishangwa itadi dulu okudimwa po,
nena otamu ti ngahelipi kwaau, Xe e mu yapula nokwe mu tuma mounyuni: to sheke, shaashi nda tya: Aame Omona waKalunga?
Ngeenge ihandi longo oilonga yaTate, inamu itavela nge.
Ndelenee, ngeenge handi i longo, nande itamu itavele nge, itaveleni oilonga ei, opo mu shiive ndele mu ude ko nokutya, Tate oku li mwaame naame ondi li muTate.”
Opo vo va hala vali oku mu kwata, ndele Ye okwa dja mo momake avo, ndele ta i.
Ndele Ye okwa ya vali langhele kwinya yomulonga Jordan, konhele ei Johannes kwa li ta shashele, ndele okwa kala ko.
Ndele vahapu ove uya kuye ndele tava ti: “Johannes ina longa nande oshilongadidiliko, ndele aishe ei Johannes a tongela ou, oyoshili.”
Ndele vahapu vaako ve mu itavela.
11: Ndele opa li omulumenhu umwe ta vele, Lasarus womuBetania, momukunda waMaria nomumwaina Marta.
Maria oye ou a vaekele Omwene nomaadi, neemhadi e di pushulile neexwiki daye dokomutwe, hano omumwaina, Lasarus, okwa li ta vele.
Opo ovamwaina ovakainhu ova tuma kuJesus ondaka ei: “Omwene, tala, ou u mu hole, ota vele.”
Hano Jesus eshi e shi uda, okwa tya: “Oudu ou kau fi wokufya, ndelenee owokufimanekifa Kalunga, Omona waKalunga opo a fimanekifwe kuwo.”
Ndele Jesus okwa li e hole Marta nomumwaina naLasarus.
Ndele eshi e mu uda ta vele, okwa kala ko natango omafiku avali konhele oko a li.
Ndele eshi a pita po okwa tya kovalongwa vaye: “Tu shuneni kuJudea.”
Ovalongwa ova tya kuye: “Rabbi, Ovajuda hanga ove ku dipaa nomamanya, ndele ove oto i ko vali.”
Jesus ta ti: “Omutenya kau na eetundi omulongo nambali? Ou ta ende omutenya ite lipumu, osheshi oku wete ouyelele wounyuni ou.
Ndele ou ta ende oufiku oye te lipumu, osheshi ke nouyelele muye.”
Oye okwa tonga edi, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Lasarus, kaume ketu okwa kofa, ndelenee Ame ohandi i ko ndi ke mu pendule.”
Opo ovalongwa va tya kuye: “Omwene, ngeenge a kofa ota veluka.”
Ndele Jesus okwa popya okufya kwaye. Ndele vo ova li ve shii ota popi okukofa kweemhofi detulumuko.
Opo Jesus okwe va lombwela sha yuka: “Lasarus okwa fya,
ndele Ame onda hafa omolweni, shaashi nda hangika ndihe ko, opo mu itavele. Ndele tu yeni kuye.”
Opo Tomas, ou a ifanwa Omukwanambwiyu, okwa tya kovalongwa vakwao: “Nafye yo tu yeni ko tu ka fileni pamwe naye.”
Hano Jesus eshi a fika ko, okwa hanga Lasarus a ninga omafiku ane mombila.
Ndele Betania osha li popepi naJerusalem, eekilometa nhatu ngeno.
NOvajuda vahapu ve uya kuMarta naMaria ve va pendule shaashi va filwa omumwaina.
Ndele Marta eshi a uda Jesus te uya, okwe ke mu shakeneka; ndele Maria okwa li omutumba keumbo.
Ndele Marta okwa tya kuJesus: “Omwene, ngeno Ove wa li po, ngeno omumwameme ina fya.
Ndelenee nopaife ondi shi shii, keshe eshi to indile Kalunga, Kalunga ote shi ku pe.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Omumwanyoko ota nyumuka.”
Marta okwe mu nyamukula: “Ondi shi shii nokutya, ota nyumuka menyumuko mefiku laxuuninwa.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Aame enyumuko nomwenyo; ou ta itavele nge ota kala nomwenyo, nande na hangike a fya.
Ndele keshe tuu ou e nomwenyo, ndele ta itavele nge, ita fi nande fiyo alushe. Oto shi itavele tuu?”
Ye okwa tya kuye: “Heeno Omwene, handi itavele nokutya, Oove Kristus, Omona waKalunga, ou e nokuuya mounyuni.”
Ndele eshi e di tya, okwa ya ndele ta ifana omumwaina Maria, ndele okwe mu lombwela meholeko: “Omuhongi opo e li apa ndele te ku ifana.”
Maria eshi e shi uda, okwa fikama diva ndele ta i kuye.
Ndele Jesus okwa li ina fika natango komukunda, ndelenee okwa li konhele apa Marta e mu shakeneka.
Opo nee Ovajuda ovo va li pamwe naMaria meumbo tave mu pendula, eshi ve mu mona, a fikama diva ndele ta piti mo, ove mu shikula va li ve shii ta i kombila, a ka lilile ko.
Ndele Maria eshi e uya oku kwa li Jesus, ndele te mu mono, okwa twa eengolo keemhadi daye ndele ta ti kuye: “Omwene, ngeno Ove wa li po, ngeno omumwameme ina fya.”
Ndele Jesus eshi e mu wete ta lili nOvajuda ava ve uya pamwe naye tava lili, okwa tukuluka momhepo yaye ndele ta kwatwa kolukaka,
ndele ta ti: “Omwe mu nangeka peni?” Vo ova tya kuye: “Omwene, ila u ka tale.”
Jesus okwa lila.
Opo Ovajuda ova tya: “Taleni, nhumbi kwa li e mu hole.”
Ndele vamwe vomuvo ova tya: “Oye tuu ou a twikulula omesho omupofi oshike ina dula yo mbela okukelela ou aha fye?”
Opo Jesus okwa tukuluka vali momhepo yaye ndele ta i kombila. Ndele oyo ya li ekololo, nemanya le i tuvika.
Jesus okwa tya: “Kufeni ko emanya.” Marta, omumwaina wanakufya okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, ye okwa nyika nale, osheshi nena okwa ninga omafiku ane.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Inandi ku lombwela, ngeenge to itavele, oto mono efimano laKalunga?”
Opo vo ova kufa ko emanya. Ndele Jesus okwa lyaamena pombada ndele ta ti: “Tate, ohandi ku pandula, shaashi wa uda nge.
Ndele ondi shi shii, Ove ho udu nge alushe; Ndelenee molwovanhu ava va dingilila nge, ohandi popi ngaha, vo va itavele nokutya, Oove wa tuma nge.”
Ndele eshi e shi tya, okwa ingida mokule: “Lasarus, dja mo!”
Nakufya okwa dja mo, eemhadi nomaoko a mangwa nomalapi, noshipala shaye sha mangwa noshipushulifo shoshinhwi. Jesus okwe va lombwela: “Mu mangululeni, nye mu mu efe a ye.”
Opo Ovajuda vahapu, ava va li ve uya kuMaria ndele va mona osho Jesus e shi ninga, ove mu itavela.
Ndelenee vamwe vomuvo ova ya kOvafarisai, ndele ve va hepaululila eshi Jesus e shi ninga.
Ndele opo ovapristeli ovakulunhu nOvafarisai ova shiva oshiongalele shovakulunhu ndele tava ti: “Ohatu ningi ngahelipi, osheshi omulumenhu ou ota ningi oikumwifalonga ihapu?
Ngeenge hatu mu efa ngaha, aveshe otave mu itavele, nOvaroma otave uya ndee tave tu kufa oshilongo novanhu yo.”
Ndele umwe wavo, Kajafas, ou okwa li omupristeli omukulunhu omudo ou, okwa tya kuvo: “Eendunge deni odongaho,
ndele nye inamu diladila, okufya kwomunhu umwe molwovanhu kwe mu wapalela, ku dule okunyonauka po kwoshiwana ashishe.”
Ndele eshi ine shi tonga muye mwene, ndele shaashi okwa li omupristeli omukulunhu omudo winya, okwa xunganeka, Jesus oku nokufila oshiwana,
ndele hamolwoshiwana eshi ashike, ndele opo a kongolole yo ovana vaKalunga, ava ve li po ve lihana, va ninge vamwe aveke.
Ndele kefiku olo tuu olo va pangela oku mu dipaa.
Onghee hano Jesus ina enda vali moipafi mokati kOvajuda, ndele okwa ya konhele ya li popepi nombuwa okoshilando sha lukwa Efraim. Ndele oko a kala novalongwa vaye.
Ndele Opaasa, oshivilo shOvajuda osha li sha fika, nOvajuda vahapu vomomikunda va ya kuJerusalem ve liyelife, Opaasa fimbo inai dana.
Opo ova konga Jesus va pulafana va kala ofika motembeli: “Otamu ti ngahelipi: Ye ote uya tuu koshivilo?”
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu nOvafarisai ova yandja ondaka, ngeenge ope na ou e shii apa e li, oku noku shi holola, opo ve mu kwate.
12: Ndele eshi kwa li natango omafiku ahamano Opaasa fimbo inai fika, Jesus okwe uya kuBetania, oku kwa li Lasarus, ou Jesus e mu nyumuna koufi.
Oko nee oko ve mu tulila po, Marta okwa yakula ndele Lasarus okwa li umwe waava va li omutumba koshililo pamwe naye.
Ndele Maria okwa kufa omaadi onardelela e na ondilo, etata lolita, ndele ta vaeke eemhadi daJesus, ndele te di pushula neexwiki daye. Nondjuwo aishe ya yada edimba lomaadi.
Ndele Judas Iskariot, umwe womovalongwa vaye, ou te ke mu kengelela, okwa tya:
“Omaadi aa oshike inaa landifwa po needenari omafele atatu, di pewe ngeno eehepele?”
Ndele eshi ine shi tya a yavelela eehepele, ndele osheshi a li omulunga, naashi a li a humbata okakutu koimaliwa, ndele okwa li ha kufa mo eshi tashi tulwa mo.
Ndele Jesus okwa tya: “Mu efa, osheshi e a tuvikilila efiku lokupakwa kwange.
Osheshi eehepele odi li punye alushe, ndelenee Ame nghi li punye alushe.”
Opo nee ongudu inene yOvajuda eshi ye mu uda e li ko, oye uya ko ndele inava ila ko Jesus aeke, ndelenee va tale yo Lasarus, ou a nyumunwa kuJesus koufi.
Novapristeli ovakulunhu ova pangela omhangela okudipaa yo naLasarus,
osheshi vahapu vomOvajuda ova ya ko molwaye ndele va itavela Jesus.
Ndele mefiku la shikula eli, ongudu inene yovaenda ava ve uya koshivilo, eshi va uda Jesus e li mondjila te uya kuJerusalem,
ova fola eembale domilunga nova ya ve ke mu shakeneke, ndele vo va ingida: “Hosianna! Na nangekwe noupuna, ou te uya medina lOmwene, ou ohamba yaIsrael.”
Ndele Jesus eshi a mona okambulwena, okwe ka londa, ngaashi pa shangwa:

“Ino tila, omona okakadona Sion!
Tala, ohamba yoye otai uya
ya londa kokambulwena.”
Oinima ei ovalongwa vaye ova li vehe i udite ko natango, ndelenee Jesus eshi a yelifwa, ove shi dimbulukwa, eshi sha shangwa Oye ta tongwa, ndele osho ve mu ningila.
Ndele eengudu dovanhu odo da li pamwe naye eshi a ifana Lasarus a dje mo mombila, ndele e mu nyumuna, ode mu hepaulula.
Onghee nee ongudu yovanhu ya ile oku ke mu shakeneka, shaashi va uda a ningile edidiliko eli.
Opo nee Ovafarisai va tongafana: “Nye mu shi wete, kamu na eshi tamu dulu. Taleni, ounyuni aushe tau mu shikula.”
Ndele mokati kaava ve uya koshivilo okwiilikana, omwa li Ovagreka vamwe.
Ova ya kuFilippus womuBetsaida shomuGalilea, ove mu indila, va tya: “Omwene, otwa hala okumona Jesus.”
Filippus okwa ya ndele te shi lombwele Andreas, Andreas naFilippus ova ka hepaululila Jesus.
Ndelenee Jesus okwe va nyamukula ta ti: “Efimbo ola fika, Omona wOmunhu a fimanekifwe.
Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: Omuma yolulya ngeenge itai wile medu ndele itai file mo, otai likalele aike. Ndele ngeenge tai file mo, otai dala eemuma dihapu.
Ou e hole omwenyo waye, ote u kanifa, naau ta tondo omwenyo waye mounyuni ou, oye te u diininine omwenyo waalushe.
Ngeenge pe na ou ta kalele nge, na shikule nge; naapa ndi li, omupiya wange oko ta ka kala. Ndele ngeenge pe na ou ta kalele nge, Tate ote mu fimaneke.
“Paife omwenyo wange owa tukuluka ndele handi ti ngahelipi? Tate, xupife nge mokafimbo aka. Ndelenee molwaashi nde uya mokafimbo tuu aka.
Tate, fimanekifa edina loye.” Ndele meulu omwa dja ondaka: “Ame onde li fimanekifa nale, ndele ohandi li fimanekifa vali.”
Opo nee ongudu yovanhu ei ya li po ofika oye shi uda, ndele ya tya: “Odula ya ndunduma.” Vamwe ova tya: “Omweengeli okwa tonga naye.”
Jesus okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ondaka ei inai uya molwange, ndelenee omolweni tuu.
Paife ope netokolo lounyuni ou, paife omupangeli wounyuni ou ota ekelwa pondje.”
Naame ngeenge handi yelulwa po pedu, aveshe ohandi va shilile kwaame.
Ndele eshi okwe shi tya, a holole efyo la tya ngahelipi e nokufya.
Opo ongudu yovanhu ye mu nyamukula: “Fye otwe shi uda momhango kutya, Kristus ota ka kala alushe; Ove oto ti ngahelipi hano, Omona wOmunhu oku nokuyelulwa? Omona wOmunhu olyelye?”
Ndele Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Okafimbo kanini natango ouyelele u li mokati keni. Kaleni nokweenda mouyelele fimbo mu nouyelele, muha faukilwe komilaulu. Ou ta ende momilaulu, ke shii oku ta i.

Fimbo mu nouyelele, itaveleni ouyelele, opo mu ninge ovana vouyelele.”
Edi Jesus okwe di tonga, ndele ta di po ndele te va hondama.
Ndele nande okwa li ta ningi oikumwifalonga ihapu i fike apa moipafi yavo, inave mu itavela,

eendjovo domuxunganeki Jesaja opo di wanifwe, edi a tongele:
“Omwene, olyelye a itavela eudifo letu,
nokwooko kOmwene okwa hololelwa lyelye?”
Onghee va nyengwa okwiitavela, osheshi Jesaja a tile vali:

“Omesho avo e a twikifa,
nomitima davo e di kukutika,
vaha mone ko nomesho avo,
ndele vaha ude ko komutima,
vo vehe lidilulule, Ame ndihe va velule.”
Jesaja okwa popya odo eshi a mona oshinge shaye, ndele te mu tongo.
Ndelenee vahapu vomovakulunhu ve mu itavela, ndelenee vo inave shi hepaulula omolwOvafarisai, vaha kondwe mo moshinagoga.
Osheshi vo ova li ve hole efimano lovanhu komesho yefimano laKalunga.
Ndele Jesus okwa tonga mokule ndele ta ti: “Ou ta itavele nge, haame ta itavele, ndelenee oyou a tuma nge.
Ou a mona nge, oye a mona ou a tuma nge.
Ndele Ame nde uya mounyuni ouyelele, opo keshe ou ta itavele nge, aha kale momilaulu.
Nongeenge pe na ou ta udu eendjovo dange, ye ite di diinine, haame handi mu tokola; osheshi ame inandi uya okutokola ounyuni, ndelenee okuxupifa ounyuni.
Ou ta dini nge ndele ita tambula eendjovo dange, oye oku na omutokoli waye: eendjovo edi nda popya, odo tadi mu tokola efiku laxuuninwa.
Osheshi inandi popya mwaame mwene, ndele Tate ou a tuma nge, Ye okwa pa nge oshipango eshi ndi noku shi popya naashi ndi noku shi tonga.
Ame ondi shi shii, oshipango shaye osho omwenyo waalushe. Onghee eshi handi shi tongo, ohandi shi tongo ngaashi Tate a lombwela nge.”
13: Ndelenee oshivilo shaPaasa eshi sha fika, Jesus eshi kwa li e wete efimbo laye lokudja mounyuni ou nokuya kuXe ole uya, hano Oye ngaashi a kala e hole ava vaye va li mounyuni, okwa li e va hole fiyo exulilo.
Ndele pouvalelo Satana eshi a tula momutima waJudas Iskariot omona waSimon, e mu kengelele,
hano Jesus eshi a li e shi shii kutya, Xe okwe mu pa aishe momake aye, naye a dja muKalunga, ndele ta shuna kuKalunga,
okwa fikama po pouvalelo, ndele te lidula oshikutu shaye shokombada, okwa kufa oshifanduke, ndele te limange nasho moshiya.
Ndele Ye okwa tila omeva moshiyaxa shokulikoshela, ndele okwa hovela okukosha eemhadi dovalongwa, ndele te di pushula noshifanduke eshi e limanga nasho.
Oye okwe uya kuSimon Petrus, ou ta ti kuye: “Omwene, Ove oto kosho eemhadi dange?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Eshi handi shi ningi, ku shi shii paife, opo to ke shi shiiva komesho.”
Petrus ta ti kuye: “Ku na efiku limwe u koshe eemhadi dange.” Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Ngeenge itandi ku kosho, ku na sha mwaame.”
Simon Petrus okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, haemhadi dange adike, nomake yo nomutwe.”
Jesus te mu lombwele: “Ou a koshwa, ina pumbwa shimwe, okukoshwa kweemhadi adike, ndele a yela nee, omunhu aushe. Onye mwa yela, ndele hanye amushe.”
Osheshi Ye okwa li e shii ou te ke mu kengelela, onghee okwa tya: “Hanye amushe mwa yela.”
Ndele eshi a kosha eemhadi davo, okwa kufa oshikutu shaye shokombada, okwa kala vali omutumba poshililo, okwe va lombwela: “Omu udite ko tuu eshi nde mu ningila?
Nye otamu ifana nge Omuhongi nOmwene, ndele ohamu tongo sha yuka, osheshi Aame tuu ou.
Hano Aame Omwene nomuhongi weni fimbo nda kosha eemhadi deni, nanye yo mu nokukoshafana keemhadi;
osheshi Ame nde mu pa oshihopaelelwa, nye mu ninge yo ngaashi Ame nde mu ningila.
Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: Omupiya ke dule omwene waye, nomutumwa ke dule omutumi waye.
Eshi ngeenge mu shi shii, onye ovanelao ngeenge tamu shi ningi.
“Itandi mu tongo onye amushe, ondi va shii ava nde va hoolola. Ndele eshangelo eli opo li wanifwe: ‘Ou ta li pamwe naame eendja, oye ta yelulile nge oshififinwa shaye.’
Paife ohandi shi mu lombwele fimbo inashi ningwa, opo mu itavele nge, ngeenge tashi ningwa, nokutya, Aame tuu ou.
Oshili ohandi mu lombwele: Ou ta tambula ou handi mu tumu, ota tambula nge, ndele ou ta tambula nge, oye ta tambula ou a tuma nge.”
Ndele Jesus eshi a popya edi, okwa tukuluka momhepo yaye, ndele ta hepaulula, ta ti: “Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele, umwe womunye ota kengelele nge.”
Opo ovalongwa va talafana, va limbililwa kutya olyelye ta popiwa kuye.
Naumwe womovalongwa vaye, ou Jesus okwa li e mu hole, e liyaameka konhulo yaJesus fimbo ta li.
Simon Petrus okwe mu komonena komutwe ndele ta ti: Mu pula, ou ta tongwa kuye, olyelye.
Ndele ou e liyaameka ponhulo yaJesus okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, olyelye ou?”
Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Oye ou handi mu pe oshipambu eshi nde shi velela mo.” Ndele Ye okwa velela oshipambu ndele te shi pe Judas yaSimon Iskariot.
Nokonima yoshipambu eshi Satana okwa ya mo muye. Ndele Jesus okwe mu lombwela: “Eshi to ningi, shi ninga diva.”
Ndele mwaava va li poshililo kamwa li ou e udite ko nokutya, okwe shi mu lombwelela shike.
Osheshi vamwe va li ve shii, Judas eshi kwa li e kwete ekutu loimaliwa, Jesus e mu lombwela: Ka lande ei twe i pumbwa moshivilo, ile a ka yandje sha keehepele.
Hano winya eshi a tambula oshipambu, okwa ya diva pondje. Ndele pa li oufiku.
Ndele eshi a pita pondje, Jesus okwa tya: “Paife Omona wOmunhu okwa fimanekwa naKalunga okwa fimanekifwa muye.
Kalunga ngeenge a fimanekifwa muye, opo nee Kalunga ote mu fimanekifa yo muye mwene, ndele ote mu fimanekifa diva.
Ovamwange, okafimbo kanini natango ndi li punye. Otamu ka konga nge, ndele ngaashi nde shi lombwelele Ovajuda: Oku Ame handi i, itamu dulu okuya ko, osho handi mu lombwele yo paife.
Oshipango shipe handi shi mu pe: mu holafane ngaashi Ame nda kala ndi mu hole, osho nanye yo mu holafane.
Opo tuu opo aveshe tave mu koneke kutya, nye ovalongwa vange, ngeenge mu holafane.”
Simon Petrus okwe mu lombwela: “Omwene, oto i peni?” Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Apa handi i, ito dulu okushikula nge paife, ndelenee komesho oto ka shikula nge.”
Petrus okwa tya kuye: “Omwene, oshike itandi dulu oku ku shikula paife? Omwenyo wange ohandi ke u yandja omolwoye.”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Omwenyo oto u yandje molwange? Oshili handi ku lombwele: ekondobolo fimbo inali kwena, ove owe lidimbika nge lutatu.”
14: “Omitima deni inadi nyika oluhodi. Itaveleni Kalunga nye mu itavele nge yo.
Meumbo laTate omu na eendjuwo dihapu, ndele ngeno kapa li ngaha, ngeno handi mu lombwele, ohandi ke mu longela onhele.
Nande ohandi i ndi ke mu longele onhele, ohandi aluka, ndele handi mu ile, nanye yo mu kale apa Ame ndi li.
Apa handi i, ondjila omu i shii.”
Tomas ta ti kuye: “Omwene, katu shii apa to i, nondjila otu i shii peni?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Aame ondjila noshili nomwenyo; kape na ou te uya kuTate, ngeenge hamwaame ta pitile.
Ngeno mu shii nge ngeno naTate mu mu shii. Kokudja paife onye tamu mu shiiva ndele mwe mu mona.”
Filippus ta ti kuye: “Omwene, tu ulikila Xo, opo nee fye twa wana.”
Jesus te mu lombwele: “Ame onda li punye efimbo lile, ove ku shii nge, Filippus? Ou a mona nge, oye a mona Tate. Ove oto ti ngahelipi: ‘Tu ulikila Xo?’
Iho itavele kutya, Ame ondi li muTate, naTate oku li mwaame? Eendjovo odo handi mu lombwele, itandi di popi mwaame mwene, ndele Tate ou a kala mwaame, Oye ta longo oilonga.
Itaveleni nge nokutya, Ame ndi li muTate, naTate oku li mwaame, ndele ngeenge mwa anya, itaveleni nge omolwoilonga yoovene.
“Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: Ou ta itavele nge, naye yo ota longo oilonga ei Ame handi i longo, ndele ta ka longa oilonga inene i dule inya, osheshi ohandi i kuTate.
Ndele keshe eshi tamu indile medina lange, ohandi shi ningi, Tate opo a fimanekifwe mOmona.
Ngeenge tamu indile sha medina lange, Ame ohandi shi ningi.
“Ngeenge omu hole nge, diinineni oipango yange.
Naame ohandi indile Tate, ndele Oye te mu pe Omupopili umwe, a kale punye alushelushe,
Oye Omhepo yoshili, ei ounyuni itau dulu oku i tambula, osheshi itau i mono ndele itau i shiiva. Ndele nye otamu i shiiva, osheshi opunye tai kala, nomunye i li.
“Itandi mu fiye po eefiye, ohandi uya vali kunye.
Okafimbo kaxupi, ounyuni itau mono nge vali, ndele nye otamu mono nge, osheshi Ame ondi nomwenyo, nanye yo tamu kala nomwenyo.
Efiku olo otamu ke shi shiiva nokutya, Ame ondi li muTate, nanye mwaame, naame munye.
“Ou e noipango yange ndele te i diinine, oye tuu ou e hole nge; ndele ou e hole nge, ota kala e holike kuTate, naame yo ondi mu hole, ndele handi mu lihololele.”
Judas, hayou Iskariot, okwe mu pula: “Omwene, omolwashike wa hala u tu lihololele, ndele haunyuni ou?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula ta ti: “Ngeenge ku na ou e hole nge, oye ta diinine eendjovo dange, naTate ota kala e mu hole, ndele fye ohatu uya kuye, ndele hatu diki onhele yokukala muye.
Ou ke hole nge, oye ita diinine eendjovo dange, neendjovo odo tamu di pwilikine, kadi fi dange, odaTate, ou a tuma nge.
“Eshi onde shi mu lombwela fimbo ndi li punye.
Ndelenee Omupopili, Omhepo Iyapuki, Oye Tate te ke i tuma medina lange, otai mu longo ashishe ndele tai mu dimbulukifa ashishe nde shi mu lombwela.
“Ombili ohandi i mu fiile, ombili yange ohandi i mu pe. Itandi mu pe ngaashi ounyuni tau yandje. Omitima deni inadi nyika oluhodi, nye inamu tila.
Onye mwa uda eshi nde mu lombwela: Ame ohandi i ko, ndele handi uya vali kunye. Ngeno mu hole nge, otamu hafe, shaashi ohandi i kuTate, osheshi Tate oku dule nge.
Ndele paife onde shi mu lombwela fimbo inashi ningwa, opo mu itavele, ngeenge tashi ningwa.
Itandi popi vali nanye dihapu, osheshi omupangeli wounyuni ou te uya, oye ke na nande sha mwaame.
Ndelenee ounyuni ou opo u shiive nokutya, Ame ondi hole Tate, ndele ohandi ningi ngaashi Tate a lombwela nge; fikameni, tu djeni po apa.
15: “Aame omuviinyu washili, Tate Oye omulongi wepya lomiviinyu.
Oshitai keshe shi li mwaame eshi itashi imi, Oye ote shi tete po, nakeshe tuu eshi tashi imi ote shi yeleke, shi ime shili.
Onye omwa yela nokuli molweendjovo edi nde di mu lombwela.
Kaleni mwaame naame ohandi kala munye. Ngaashi oshitai itashi dulu okwiima musho vene, ngeenge itashi kala momuviinyu, osho nanye yo, ngeenge itamu kala mwaame.
“Aame omuviinyu, onye oitai. Ou ta kala mwaame naame muye, oye ta imi shihapu; osheshi ngeenge kamu kwete nge, itamu dulu okulonga sha.
Ou ita kala mwaame, oye ota ekelwashi ngaashi oshitai, ndele tashi kukuta; oyo tai ongelwa ndele tai ekelwa momundilo ndele tai pile mo.
Ngeenge tamu kala mwaame, neendjovo dange tadi kala munye, indileni keshe tuu eshi mwa hala, ndele tamu shi pewa.
Opo tuu opo Tate ta fimanekwa ngeenge tamu imi shihapu, ndele tamu ningi ovalongwa vange.
Tate ngaashi a kala e hole nge, osho yo Ame nda kala ndi mu hole; kaleni mohole yange.
Ngeenge tamu diinine oipango yange, opo nee tamu kala mohole yange, ngaashi Ame nda diinina oipango yaTate ndele handi kala mohole yaye.
Ei onde i mu lombwela, ehafo lange li kale munye, nehafo leni li kale la wanenena.
“Oshipango shange osheshi: Mu kale mu holafane, ngaashi Ame nda kala ndi mu hole.
Kape na ou e nohole i dule yaau ta yandjele ookaume kaye omwenyo waye.
Onye ookaume kange, ngeenge tamu ningi eshi handi shi mu lombwele.
Itandi mu ifana ovapiya, osheshi omupiya ke shii eshi omwene waye ta ningi; ndelenee onde mu ifana ookaume, osheshi ashishe eshi nde shi uda muTate, onde shi mu shiivifila.

Nye, hanye mwa hoolola nge, Aame nde mu hoolola, nonde mu tula po mu ye ko, nye mu ka ime oiimati, noiimati yeni i kalelele, opo nee keshe tuu eshi tamu shi indile Tate medina lange, Oye te shi mu pe.
Eshi handi shi mu lombwele mu kale mu holafane.
“Ounyuni ngeenge tau mu tondo, kaleni mu shi shii, oo wa tonda nge tete.
Ngeno onye vomounyuni, ngeno ounyuni u hole vakwao, ndelenee eshi muhe fi vomounyuni, Ame eshi nde mu hoolola mo mounyuni, onghee ounyuni tau mu tondo.
Dimbulukweni eendjovo odo nde di mu lombwela: ‘Omupiya ke dule Omwene waye.’ Ngeenge va taataa nge, otave mu taataa yo. Ngeenge va diinina eendjovo dange, nodeni otave di diinine yo.
Ndelenee eshi ashishe tave shi mu ningile omolwedina lange, osheshi vo inava shiiva ou a tuma nge.
Ngeno Ame nda li inandi uya, ndele inandi va lombwela, ngeno vo kave nomatimba, ndelenee paife kave na sha shokulipopila oulunde wavo.
Ou ta tondo nge, oye ha tondo yo Tate.
Ngeno onda li inandi longa mokati kavo oilonga ei, inai longwa komunhu umwe, ngeno kave netimba. Ndelenee paife ove shi mona, ndele ove tu tonda ofye naTate.
Ndelenee, ondjovo ei ya shangwa momhango yavo oi nokuwanifwa: ‘Ovo va tonda nge ongaho.’
“Nge Omupopili te uya, Omhepo yashili ou ta di kuTate. Ou handi mu tumu ta di kuTate, Oye ta hepaulula nge.
Nanye yo tamu hepaulula, osheshi omwa kala naame okehovelo.
16: “Oinima ei onde i mu lombwela muha ninge omwenyo mwii.
Vo otave mu kondo mo meeshinagoga, heeno, omafiku otae uya, keshe ou te mu dipaa, oye e shii ta yandjele Kalunga eyambo.
Naashi tave shi mu ningile, osheshi inava shiiva Tate, vo kave shii nge.

Ndelenee ei onde i mu lombwela, opo efimbo olo nge tali uya, mu shi dimbulukwe nokutya, Ame onde shi mu lombwela.
“Eshi inandi shi mu lombwela pehovelo, osheshi Ame nda li punye.
Ndele paife ohandi i kwaau a tuma nge, ndele kape na ou womunye ta pula nge: Oto i peni?
Ndelenee eshi nde shi mu lombwela, onghee omitima deni tadi yadifwa oluhodi.
Ndelenee ohandi mu lombwele oshili: okuya kwange otaku mu kwafa, osheshi ngeenge itandi i ko, Omupopili ite uya kunye, ndele ngeenge handi i ko, ohandi mu tumu kunye.
Ndele Oye ngeenge te uya, ounyuni ote u tomhene oulunde nouyuki netokolo:
oulunde, osheshi itava itavele nge,
ouyuki, osheshi handi i kuTate, nye itamu mono nge vali,
netokolo, osheshi omupangeli wounyuni ou a tokolwa.
“Ondi noinima ihapu natango oku mu lombwela, ndelenee paife itamu dulu oku i humbata.
Ndele winya ngeenge te uya, Omhepo yoshili, Oyo tai mu twala moshili aishe; osheshi itai tongo muyo vene, ndele eshi tai udu, osho tai tongo, naashi tashi uya komesho otai mu hololele.
Oyo tai fimanekifa nge, osheshi otai kufwa mwaai yange, ndele tai mu hepaululile.
Aishe ei Tate e i kwete, oyange, onghee nda tya: oyo tai kufwa mwaai yange, ndele tai mu hepaululile.
“Ope nokafimbo kaxupi natango, ndele itamu mono nge vali, ndele ope na vali okafimbo kaxupi, ndele tamu mono nge, osheshi Ame handi i kuTate.”
Vamwe vomovalongwa vaye ova tongafana: “Oshike hano, eshi ta ti kufye: ‘Okafimbo kaxupi natango, ndele itamu mono nge, ndele ope na vali okafimbo kaxupi ndele tamu mono nge, ndele handi i kuTate?’
Ovo va tya: Okokutya ngahelipi, eshi ta ti: okafimbo kaxupi? Katu udite ko eshi ta ti.”
Ndele Jesus eshi a koneka vo va hala oku mu pula, okwa tya kuvo: “Otamu pulafana eshi nda tya: ‘ope nokafimbo kaxupi, ndele itamu mono nge, ndele ope na vali okafimbo kaxupi, ndele tamu mono nge?’
Oshilishili handi mu lombwele: otamu kala nokulila nokunyemata, ndele ounyuni otau hafe. Onye tamu kala nokunyika oluhodi, ndelenee oluhodi leni tali ka shituka ehafo.
Omukainhu nge ta dala, oku na oluhodi, osheshi efimbo laye ola fika; ndele eshi a dala okaana, iha dimbulukwa vali oudjuu molwehafo eli, omunhu eshi a dalelwa mounyuni.
Nanye yo paife omu noluhodi, ndelenee Ame ohandi mu mono vali, omutima weni otau ka hafa, ndele kape na ou te mu nyeka ehafo leni.
“Mefiku olo itamu pula nge sha vali. Oshilishili ohandi mu lombwele: ngeenge tamu indile sha kuTate, Oye ote shi mu pe medina lange.
Fiyo onena onye inamu indila sha medina lange. Indileni ndele tamu pewa, ehafo leni li kale la wanenena.
“Oinima ei onde i tonga kunye momafaneko; otape uya efimbo eshi itandi mu lombwele vali momafaneko, ndelenee ohandi mu hepaululile Tate, itandi holeke sha.
Mefiku olo otamu indile medina lange, naame itandi ti kunye, ndi mu indilile kuTate,
osheshi Tate Oye mwene e mu hole, shaashi nye mu hole nge, ndele tamu itavele, Ame nda dja muKalunga.
Ame onda dile kuTate, ndele onde uya mounyuni. Ounyuni ohandi u fii po vali, ndele handi i kuTate.”
Ovalongwa vaye va tya kuye: “Tala, paife oto popi wa fatula, ito holeke sha, ito tongo efaneko lasha.
Paife otu shi shii, oinima aishe Ove ou i shii, Ove ino pumbwa umwe e ku pule sha. Onghee hatu itavele, Ove wa dja muKalunga.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Paife omwa itavela?
Taleni, efimbo otali uya, heeno, ole uya nokuli, onye otamu ka halakanifwa keshe tuu te liyukile, ndele tamu fii nge po andike; ndele Ame kandi li po andike, osheshi Tate oku li naame.
Oinima ei onde i mu lombwela, mu kale mu nombili mwaame. Mounyuni omu li mo mu noudjuu, ndelenee kaleni nomwenyo muwa, Ame onda finda ounyuni.”
17: Jesus eshi a popya eendjovo edi okwa lyaamena keulu, ndele ta ti: “Tate, efimbo le uya, fimanekifa omumwoye, omumwoye e ku fimanekife yo;
ngaashi Ove we mu pa epangelo lombelela aishe, opo aveshe ava we mu pa, Ye e va pe omwenyo waalushe.
Nomwenyo waalushe oo tuu ou, vo ve ku shiive, Oove auke Kalunga kashili, naau we mu tuma, Jesus Kristus.
Ame onde ku fimanekifa kombada yedu mokuwanifa oshilonga eshi we shi pele nge, ndi shi longe.
Ndele paife Tate, fimanekife nge pwoove mwene nefimano olo, nda li ndi li kwete, eshi nda kala pwoove, ounyuni fimbo inau shitwa.
“Edina loye onde li hololela ovanhu ava we va pa nge mounyuni. Vo va li voye, ndele we va pa nge; vo va diinina eendjovo doye.
Paife ove shi shii shili kutya, ashishe eshi wa pa nge, osha dja mwoove.
Osheshi eendjovo we di pa nge, onde di va pa, ndele vo ove di tambula, ndele ve shi shii shili kutya, onda dja kwoove ndele va itavela, Oove wa tuma nge.
“Ovo ohandi va ilikanene, itandi ilikanene ounyuni ou, ndelenee ovava wa pa nge, osheshi vo ovoye.
Nakeshe shange oshoye, naashi shoye oshange, ndele onda fimanekelwa muvo.
Ndele Ame nghi li vali mounyuni ou, ndelenee vo omo ve li mounyuni ou, naame handi uya kwoove. Tate omuyapuki, va diininina medina loye, eli wa pa nge, va kale umwe, ngaashi tu li naave.
Eshi nda li puvo, onde va diinina medina loye eli wa pa nge, ndele onde va amena; ndele kape na umwe wavo a kanifwa, ndelenee oye ou omona wekano aeke, opo omishangwa di wanifwe.
Ndele paife handi uya kwoove neendjovo edi ohandi di tongo mounyuni ou, vo va kale ve nehafo lange la yadelela muvo vene.
Ame onde va pa eendjovo doye, nounyuni otau va tondo, osheshi vo kave fi vomounyuni ou, ngaashi Ame ndihe fi womounyuni ou.
Itandi indile u va kufe mo mounyuni ou, ndele u va amene kowii.
Vo kave fi vomounyuni, ngaashi Ame ndihe fi womounyuni.
Va yapulila moshili yoye, eendjovo doye odo oshili.
Ngaashi Ove wa tuma nge mounyuni, osho Ame onde va tuma mounyuni.
Ndele Ame ohandi liyapula molwavo, vo va yapulilwe moshili.
“Ndelenee itandi va ilikanene ovo aveke, ndelenee naava yo tava itavele nge omolweendjovo davo.
Opo aveshe va kale umwe, ngaashi Ove Tate, u li mwaame naame ndi li mwoove, ndele vo va kale mufye, ounyuni u itavele nokutya, Oove wa tuma nge.
Ndele efimano eli wa pa nge onde li va pa, opo va kale umwe ngaashi ofye umwe.
Ame muvo naave mwaame, vo va kale umweelela, ounyuni u kale u shi shii, Oove wa tuma nge, ndele Ove u va hole, ngaashi u hole nge.
“Tate, onda hala ava wa pa nge, va ka kale apa ndi li, va tale efimano lange eli wa pa nge, osheshi Ove wa kala u hole nge, ounyuni fimbo inau shitwa.
Tate omuyapuki, ounyuni inau ku shiiva, ndelenee Ame ondi ku shii, naava va dimbulukwa nokutya, Oove wa tuma nge.
Ndelenee Ame nde va shiivifa edina loye, ndele ohandi ke li shiivifa natango, opo ohole ei wa kala u hole nge nayo, i kale muvo naame ndi kale muvo.”
18: Ndele Jesus eshi a tonga eendjovo edi, okwa pita mo pamwe novalongwa vaye, ndele ta tokola okamulonga Kidron, oko kwa li ku nepya lomiti, omo Ye okwa ya novalongwa vaye.
Ndele Judas, ou e mu kengelela, okwa shiiva yo onhele ei, osheshi Jesus okwa ongala ko luhapu novalongwa vaye.
Opo Judas okwa kufa ongudu yovakwaita novapiya va dja kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokOvafarisai, ndele te uya ko e neenyika neelamba noiti.
Ndele Jesus eshi a shiiva oinima aishe tai mu hange, okwa pita mo ndele ta ti kuvo: “Olyelye tamu mu kongo?”
Vo ve mu nyamukula: “Jesus Omunasareti.” Jesus okwa tya kuvo: “Aame ou.” NaJudas, ou e mu kengelela, okwa li ofika pamwe navo.
Hano Jesus eshi a tya kuvo: “Aame ou,” vo ova shuna shanimanima, ndele va wila poshi.
Opo Ye okwe va pula vali: “Olyelye tamu mu kongo?” Vo va tya: “OJesus Omunasareti.”
Jesus okwe va nyamukula: “Onde mu lombwela nale nokutya, Aame ou. Hano ngeenge Aame tamu kongo, efeni ava va ye.”
Opo pa wanifwe eendjovo edi a tongele: “Inandi kanifa nande umwe waava wa pa nge.”
Opo Simon Petrus, ou a li e na eongamukonda, okwe li pweya mo, ndele ta shashe omupiya womupristeli omukulunhu ndele te mu tete okutwi kwaye kwokolulyo. Nedina lomupiya ou ola li Malkus.
Opo Jesus okwa tya kuPetrus: “Shunifa eongamukonda loye moshilaleko. Eholo eli Tate a pa nge, inandi li nwa mbela?”
Ongudu yovakwaita nomuneyovi wavo novapiya vOvajuda va kwata Jesus, ndele tave mu mange.
Ndele tave mu twala tete kuHannas, osheshi oye a li xemweno yaKajafas, ou a li omupristeli omukulunhu momudo winya.
Ndelenee Kajafas oye tuu ou a lombwelele Ovajuda: osha wapala omunhu a fye omolwoshiwana.
Ndele Simon Petrus nomulongwa mukwao ova shikula Jesus. Omulongwa ou kwa li a shiivika komupristeli omukulunhu, ndele okwa ya pamwe naJesus molupale lomupristeli omukulunhu.
Ndelenee Petrus okwa li ofika konhu; opo nee omulongwa mukwao ou a li e shiivike komupristeli omukulunhu, okwa pita mo ndele ta popi nomukeleli woshivelo, okakadona, ndele ta eta mo Petrus.
Opo nee omukeleli woshivelo, okakadona aka, oka tya kuPetrus: “Ove ku fi mbela umwe wovalongwa vomunhu ou?” Winya okwa tya: “Ahowe.”
Ndelenee ovakalele novapiya ova shakala omundilo shaashi okwa li ku na outalala, ndele tava xuxumukwa, naPetrus yo okwa li ofika pamwe navo, ndele ta xuxumukwa.
Nomupristeli omukulunhu okwa pula Jesus molwovalongwa vaye nomolwelongo laye.
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Nda tonga moipafi younyuni. Alushe onda longa ovanhu meeshinagoga nomotembeli, omo hamu ongala Ovajuda aveshe, ndele inandi tonga sha meholeko.
Oshike to pula nge? Pula ava va uda eshi nda tonga kuvo; tala; vo ove shi shii osho nde shi tonga.”
Ndele Jesus eshi a tonga eendjovo edi, omumati umwe ou a li ko ofika, okwa denga Jesus enghava, ndele ta ti: “Osho to nyamukula ngaho omupristeli omukulunhu?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Ngeenge onda tonga nai, tomhene nge owii, ndele ngeenge nda tonga nawa, oto dengele nge shike?”
Opo Hannas okwe mu tuma, a mangwa, kuKajafas, omupristeli omukulunhu.
Ndele Simon Petrus okwa li ofika ta xuxumukwa. Opo vo va tya kuye: “Naave ku fi mbela umwe wovalongwa vaye?” Oye okwa anya ndele ta ti: “Ahowe.”
Umwe womovapiya vomupristeli omukulunhu, mukwao waawinya Petrus a teta okutwi, ta ti: “Inandi ku mona mepya pamwe naye?”
Ndele Petrus okwa anya vali, nekondobolo ola kwena tuu osho.
Opo vo va kufa Jesus kuKajafas, ndele tave mu twala kongulu yetokolo. Okwa li ongula inene. Ndele vo inava ya mo mongulu yetokolo vo vehe linyatekife, vo va shiive okulya Opaasa.
Opo Pilatus okwa pita mo, ta ti kuvo: “Omulumenhu ou otamu mu hokololifile shike?”
Vo va nyamukula ndele tava ti kuye: “Ou ngeno ke fi omukolokoshi, ngeno inatu mu yandja kwoove.”
Opo Pilatus ta ti kuvo: “Nye mu kufeni po hano, mu mu tokole pamhango yeni vene.” Ovajuda va tya kuye: “Fye otwa dilikwa okudipaa omunhu?”
Opo pa wanifwe ondaka ei, Jesus e i tongele, eshi a holola efyo la tya ngahelipi e nokufya.
Ndelenee Pilatus okwa shuna mo vali mongulu yetokolo, ndele ta ifana Jesus, ndele ta ti kuye: “Oove ohamba yOvajuda?”
Jesus okwe mu nyamukula: “Eshi owe shi tonga mwoove mwene, ile ovanhu ve shi ku lombwela, tava popi nge?”
Pilatus okwe mu nyamukula: “Aame Omujuda? Ovanhu vomoshilongo sheni novapristeli ovakulunhu ovo ve ku yandja kwaame; owa ninga shike?”
Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Ouhamba wange kau fi womounyuni ou; ouhamba wange ngeno womounyuni ou, ovapiya vange ngeno va lwa, ndiha yandjwe kOvajuda. Ndelenee paamha ouhamba wange kau fi waamu.”

Opo Pilatus okwa tya kuye: “Oove ohamba nokuli?” Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Heeno, ngaashi to ti, Aame ohamba. Onghee nda dalwa nde uya mounyuni ou, ndi hepaulule oshili. Keshe ou womoshili, ye ota udu ondaka yange.”

Pilatus ta ti kuye: “Oshili oshike?”
Ndele eshi e shi tya, ye okwa pita mo vali, ta i kOvajuda, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Nghi wete nande etimba muye.
Ndelenee nye omwe shi ika, ndi mu mangululile omupandekwa umwe poshivilo shaPaasa. Omwa hala hano ndi mu mangululile ohamba yOvajuda?”
Ndele vo va ingida tava ti: “Ahowe. Hayou, ndelenee Barabas!” Ndelenee Barabas okwa li omukolokoshi.
19: Opo nee Pilatus okwa kufa Jesus, ndele te mu dengifa neeshokoto.
Ovakwaita ova tunga oshidingo shoshitai shomakiya, ndele tave shi mu dike komutwe waye, ndele tave mu dike oshikutu shitilyana.
Ndele vo ove uya kuye ndele tava ti: “Kundwa, Oove ohamba yOvajuda!” ndele tave mu denge omanghava.
Pilatus a pita mo vali ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ohandi mu eta pondje kunye, mu kale mu shi shii, inandi mona muye etimba lasha.”
Ndele Jesus okwa pita mo, a dikwa oshidingo shomakiya, noshikutu shitilyana. Ndele Pilatus ta ti kuvo: “Taleni omunhu.”

Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu novapiya eshi ve mu mona, ova uyaana tava ti: “Mu valela komushiyakano!” Mu valela komushiyakano! Pilatus okwa tya kuvo: “Mu kufeni nye mu mu valele komushiyakano, osheshi ame nghi wete etimba muye.”
Ovajuda ova tya kuye: “Fye otu nomhango ndele omhango otai mu pe etimba lokufya, osheshi ote liningi Ye mwene Omona waKalunga.”
Ndele Pilatus eshi a uda eendjovo edi, okwa tila unene.
Ndele ta shuna mo vali mongulu yetokolelo ndele ta ti kuJesus: “Ove owa dja peni?” Ndele Jesus ine mu nyamukula nande.
Ndele Pilatus ta ti kuye: “Ito popi naame? Ove ku shi shii nokutya, ondi neenghono doku ku valela komushiyakano ndele ondi neenghono doku ku efa.”
Jesus okwa nyamukula: “Eenghono dokutokola nge ngeno ku di pelwe da dja kombada, ngeno ku di kwete. Onghee hano ou a yandja nge kwoove, oye e netimba li dule loye.”
Onghee hano Pilatus okwa kendabala oku mu efa. Ndele Ovajuda ova ingida tava ti: “Ou ngeenge oto mu efa, ku fi vali kaume komukesari; keshe tuu ou te liningi ohamba, oku na ondubo nomukesari.”
Opo nee Pilatus eshi a uda eendjovo edi, okwa twala Jesus pondje, ndele ta kala omutumba koshipundi shetokolo, monhele ei ya lukwa olupale lomamanya, mOshiheberi Gabbata.
Ndele efiku olo la li lelilongekidilo loshivilo shaPaasa, opotundi onhihamano. Ye okwa tya kOvajuda: “Taleni ohamba yeni.”

Opo nee vo ova ingida: “Na dje po, na dje po, mu valela komushiyakano!” Pilatus okwa tya kuvo: “Nandi valele ohamba yeni komushiyakano?” Ovapristeli ovakulunhu ova nyamukula: “Fye katu na ohamba imwe, omukesari aeke.”
Opo nee ye okwe mu yandja kuvo, a ka valelwe komushiyakano. Ovo va kufa po Jesus nove mu twala.
Ndele Ye okwe lihumbatela mwene omushiyakano, ndele ta di mo, ndele ta i konhele ya lukwa onhele yoshipongolo shomutwe, mOshiheberi otai ifanwa Golgata.
Ndele oko ve mu valela komushiyakano, novanhu vavali pamwe naye, umwe okombinga nomukwao okombinga, ndele Jesus pokati.
Pilatus okwa shanga oshipalanyolo ndele te shi tulike komushiyakano. Osha shangwa ngaha: “JESUS OMUNASARETI OHAMBA YOVAJUDA.”
Ndele oshipalanyolo eshi Ovajuda vahapu ove shi lesha, osheshi onhele ei ya valelwa Jesus komushiyakano oya li popepi noshilando, ndele osha shangwa mOshiheberi, mOshilatina nomOshigreka.
Opo ovapristeli ovakulunhu vOvajuda ova tya kuPilatus: “Ino shanga: ‘ohamba yOvajuda,’ ndele u tye, ye okwa tile: ‘Aame ohamba yOvajuda.’ ”
Pilatus okwa nyamukula: “Osho nde shi shanga, onde shi shanga nee.”

Ndele ovakwaita eshi va valela Jesus komushiyakano, ova kufa ko oikutu yaye ndele tave i tukula oitukulwa ine, keshe omukwaita oshitukulwa shimwe, nombidja yokoshi. Ndele oya li ihe nomuhondjo, oya li ya tungwa aishe mumwe, nghee ya dja pehovelo fiyo okexulilo layo.

Onghee nee va tongafana: “Inatu i tauleni, tu i ningileni oshihoololifo nokutya, otai ningi yalyelye.” Omushangwa ou u wanifwe:
“Ovo tave litukulile oikutu yange,
nomidjalo dange otave di ningile oshihoololifo.”
Ovakwaita osho va ninga.
Ndele pomushiyakano waJesus opa kala ofika ina nomumwaina waina naMaria omukainhu waKleopas, naMaria Magdalena.
Ndele Jesus eshi a mona ina nomulongwa ou a li e holike kuye, ve li ofika opo, okwa tya kuina: “Omukainhu, tala omona woye.”
Ndele ta ti komulongwa: “Tala nyoko!” Opefimbo tuu olo omulongwa okwe mu tambula meumbo laye.
Ndele konima yoinima ei, Jesus, eshi a shiiva oinima aishe ya wanifwa, omishangwa di wanifwe, okwa tya: “Nda fyenota.”
Ndele opa li oshitoo shi yadi omeva malula, ndele vo tava xwekele oshiyavo koshihati shaisopi sha yavekwa momeva aa malula, ndele tave shi tula kokanya kaye.
Ndele, Jesus eshi a tambula omeva aa malula, okwa tya: “Sha longwa sha pwa.” Ndele ta nyongameke omutwe waye, ndele ta yandje omwenyo waye.

Efiku olo ola li lokulilongekidila Eshabata lOvajuda, oimhu opo iha endjelele komushiyakano efiku lEshabata, osheshi efiku lEshabata olo ola li linene, Ovajuda ova indila Pilatus, omipindi davo di nyanyaulwe, oimhu i kufwe ko.
Opo nee ovakwaita ve uya ndele tava nyanyaula omipindi daau wotete nodamukwao ava va valelwa komushiyakano pamwe naye.
Ndelenee eshi ve uya kuJesus nove mu wete, a fya nale, inava nyanyaula omakipa aye.
Ndelenee umwe wovakwaita okwe mu twa neonga molupati laye, ndele mwa dja diva ohonde nomeva.
Ndele omumoni washo ote shi hepaulula nehepaululo laye oloshili, oye e shi shii kutya, ota popi oshili, opo nye yo mu itavele.
Osheshi eshi osha ningwa omishangwa di wanifwe: “Ina nyanyaulwa nande ekipa laye limwe.”
Nomushangwa umwe tau ti vali: “Vo otava ka tala kwaau ve mu twa.”

Ndele konima yoinima ei Josef Omuarimatia, ou okwa kala omulongwa waJesus meholeko, osheshi a tila Ovajuda, ye okwa indila Pilatus, a itavelelwe okukufa oshimhu shaJesus. Pilatus okwe mu itavela. Ye okwe uya ndele ta kufa ko oshimhu shaJesus.
NaNikodemus yo, ou a ile nale oufiku kuJesus, okwe uya, ndele ta eta oidimba iwa, omirha naaloe, i fike peekilograma omilongo nhatu ngeno.
Opo vo ova kufa ko oshimhu shaJesus ndele, tave shi mangele momalapi oliina, mumwe noidimba panghedi yOvajuda yokupaka ovafi.
Ndele ponhele ei a valelwa komushiyakano, opa li epya lomiti, nomepya eli omwa li ombila ipe, omo inamu tulwa nande omunhu shito.
Hano, omo nee va nangeka Jesus, osheshi la li efiku lelilongekido lOvajuda, nombila ei oya li popepi.
20: Ndele efiku lotete loshivike Maria Magdalena okwe uya kombila ongula inene, fimbo inaku sha, ndele okwa mona kutya emanya ola kufwa ko kombila.
Opo ye a lotoka, ndele te uya kuSimon Petrus nokomulongwa mukwao, ou Jesus kwa li e mu hole, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ovo va kufa mo Omwene mombila, ndele katu shii apa ve mu tula.”
Opo nee Petrus nomulongwa ou mukwao ova ya, ndele tave uya kombila.
Ndele ova tondokela pamwe ovo aveshe vavali, ndele omulongwa ou mukwao okwa fiya po Petrus, ndele te uya tete kombila.
Ndele ye eshi a vandamena mo, okwa mona omalapi oliina a li mo; ndele ye ina ya mo.
NaSimon Petrus okwe uya yo, ndele ta i mombila, ndele ta mono omalapi oliina e li mo.
Noshipushulifo shoshinhwi sha li komutwe waye, inashi tulwa mumwe nomalapi oliina, ndele oshe likalela ponhele i lili.
Opo nee omulongwa mukwao ou e uya tete kombila, okwa ya mo, ndele te shi mono, ndele te shi itavele.
Osheshi natango ova li vehe udite ko omishangwa nokutya, Ye e nokunyumuka mo movafi.
Ndele ovalongwa ova shuna keumbo lavo.
Ndele Maria okwa li ofika pombila, ndele ta lili. Hano eshi a li ta lili ngaha, okwa vandamena mombila.
Ndele okwa mona ovaengeli vavali va djala oikutu itoka, ve li omutumba, umwe okomutwe, nomukwao okeemhadi, apa pa li pa nangala oshimhu shaJesus.
Ndele va tya kuye: “Omukainhu, oto lilile shike?” Ye okwa tya kuvo: “Osheshi va kufa mo Omwene wange, ndele nghi shii apa ve mu tula.”
Ndele eshi e di tya, okwa punguluka, ndele ta mono Jesus e li ofika opo, ndele ina shiiva nokutya, Oye Jesus.

Jesus ta ti kuye: “Omukainhu, oto lilile shike? Olyelye to mu kongo?” Winya okwa li e shii oye omukeleli wepya, ndele ta ti kuye: “Omwene, ngeenge oove we mu kufa mo, lombwele nge apa we mu tula, ndi ke mu tale ko.”
Jesus okwa tya kuye: “Maria.” Opo nee ou okwa punguluka ndele ta ti kuye mOshiheberi: “Rabbuni, tashi ti: Omuhongi.”
Jesus okwe mu lombwela: “Ino kuma nge, osheshi inandi londa natango kuTate, ndelenee inda kovamwatate u ke va lombwele: Ohandi londo kuTate nokuXo yeni, kuKalunga kange nokuKalunga keni.”
Maria Magdalena okwa ya ndele ta hepaululile ovalongwa nokutya, a mona Omwene, naadi a lombwelwa kuye.

Ndele eshi pa ninga onguloshi yefiku lotete loshivike, noivelo eshi ya li ya patwa, omo ovalongwa va li, osheshi va tila Ovajuda, Jesus okwe uya ndele ta kala ofika mokati kavo, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ombili nai kale nanye.”
Ndele eshi e di tya, okwe va ulikila omake aye nolupati laye. Ndele ovalongwa va hafa eshi va mona Omwene.
Jesus okwe va lombwela vali: “Ombili nai kale nanye, ngaashi Tate a tuma nge, naame osho handi mu tumu.”
Ndele eshi e di tya, okwe va fudila ndele ta ti kuvo: “Tambuleni Omhepo Iyapuki.
Ava tamu dimine po omatimba, vo otave a diminwa po, naava tamu efa, va kale nao, vo otava kala nao.”
Ndelenee Tomas, umwe waava omulongo navavali, ou a ifanwa Omukwanambwiyu, ina hangika po puvo, Jesus eshi e uya.

Opo nee ovalongwa vakwao ove mu hepaululila: “Fye otwa mona Omwene.” Ye ta ti kuvo: “Ngeenge inandi mona oivadi yeendungu momake aye, ndele inandi tula omunwe wange moivadi yeendungu, neke lange molupati laye, itandi itavele.”

Ndele pa pita omafiku ahetatu, ovalongwa ova li va ongala vali, naTomas opo a li pamwe navo. Jesus okwe uya oivelo eshi ya hangika ya patwa, ndele ta kala ofika mokati kavo ndele ta ti: “Ombili nai kale nanye.”
Ndele okwa lombwela Tomas: “Eta omunwe woye oku, ove u tale omake ange, ove u yelule eke loye, u li twe molupati lange, ndele ove ino kala nakuhaitavela, ndelenee kala omwiitaveli.”
Ndele Tomas okwe mu nyamukula, ta ti: “Omwene wange naKalunga kange.”
Jesus ta ti kuye: “Osheshi wa mona nge, opo to itavele. Ovanelao ovava hava itavele nande inava mona.”
Oilongadidiliko ihapu ikwao Jesus e i ninga moipafi yovalongwa inai shangwa momishangwa edi.
Ndele ei oya shangwa, nye mu itavele Jesus Oye Kristus, Omona waKalunga, ndele moku mu itavela mu kale mu na omwenyo medina laye.
21: Konima yoinima ei Jesus okwe lihololela vali ovalongwa vaye pefuta laTiberias. Ndele okwa holoka ngaha:
Simon Petrus naTomas, ou a ifanwa Omukwanambwiyu, naNatanael womuKana shomuGalilea, novana vaSebedeus navakwao vavali vomovalongwa vaye va li pamwe.
Opo Simon Petrus okwa tya kuvo: “Ohandi ka yula eeshi.” Ovo ova tya kuye: “Nafye yo ohatu i naave.” Ndele vo ova fikama ndele tava i mowato. Noufiku oo inava kwata sha.
Ndele eshi kwa sha, Jesus okwa li ofika komunghulo wefuta. Ndelenee ovalongwa inave mu koneka nokutya, Oye Jesus.
Opo Jesus okwe va pula: “Ovamwange, omu na sha shokulya?” Vo ove mu nyamukula: “Ahowe.”
Ndele okwe va lombwela: “Oshiyulifo shi ekeleni kolulyo lowato opo tamu mono.” Ndele vo ove shi ekela mo, ndele vo va nyengwa oku shi shila mo, osheshi eeshi oda li mo dihapu.

Opo nee omulongwa winya kwa li e holike kuJesus okwa tya kuPetrus: “Oye Omwene.” Hano Petrus eshi a uda, Oye Omwene, okwe lidika ombaikifa yaye, osheshi okwa li olutu kombada, ndele ta nhukile momeva.
Ndele ovalongwa ava vakwao ove uya nowato, ndele va shila oshiyulifo shavo shi neeshi, osheshi kava li kokule nomunghulo, oshinano omafele avali shapo.
Ndele eshi ve uya kedu, ova mona ko omundilo womakala u li po, neeshi da pakwa po nomungome.
Jesus okwe va lombwela: “Eteni oku meeshi edi mwa kwata paife.”
Simon Petrus okwa ya mowato nokwa shilila oshiyulifo kedu, shi yadi eeshi dinene efele limwe nomilongo itano neeshi nhatu, ndele nande oda li dihapu di fike apa, oshiyulifo inashi pombauka.
Jesus okwe va lombwela: “Ileni mu lye!” Ndele kape na umwe womovalongwa a li e nomukumo oku mu pula: Oove lyelye? Osheshi ova li ve shi shii, Oye Omwene.
Ndele Jesus okwa ya ndele a kufa omungome, ndele te u va pe, nosho yo eeshi edi.
Hano elihololo eli etitatu nokuli, Jesus e lihololela ovalongwa vaye konima yenyumuko laye lomovafi.

Hano eshi va lya, Jesus okwa tya kuSimon Petrus: “Simon omona waJohannes, u hole nge tuu, u dule ava?” Ye okwa tya kuye: “Heeno, Omwene, Ove u shi shii nokutya, ondi ku hole tuu.” Ye okwa tya kuye: “Lifa eedjona dange.”
Ndele okwe mu pula lutivali: “Simon omona waJohannes, ove u hole nge?” Ye okwa tya kuye: “Heeno, Omwene, Ove ou shi shii ondi ku hole.” Ye ta ti kuye: “Lifa eedi dange.”

Oye ta ti kuye lutitatu: “Simon omona waJohannes, ou hole nge tuu?” Petrus okwa nyika oluhodi eshi te mu pula olutitatu: “Ove ou hole nge?” Ndele ta ti kuye: “Omwene, oinima aishe ove u i shii, ou shi shii ondi ku hole.” Jesus ta ti kuye: “Lifa eedi dange.

Oshilishili ohandi ku lombwele: Fimbo wa li omunyasha, owe lidika mwene, ndele wa ya oku wa hala, ndelenee ngeenge wa kula, opo nee oto yelula omaoko oye, naumwe e lili ote ku dike, ndele te ku twala oku ove ino hala.”
Ndelenee eendjovo edi okwe di tonga, a holole efyo eli Petrus e nokufimanekifa nalo Kalunga. Hano eshi e di tonga, okwa tya kuye: “Shikule nge.”
Opo nee Petrus okwa punguluka ndele ta mono omulongwa ou, Jesus a li e mu hole, te mu shikula, oye ou a li e liyaameka ponhulo yaye pouvalelo, ndele a tile: “Omwene, olyelye ou te ku kengelele?”
Hano Petrus eshi e mu mona, okwa tya kuJesus: “Omwene, ou ota ningwa shike?”
Jesus okwa tya: “Ame ngeenge onda hala a kale po fiyo handi uya, ove ou na shike nasho? Ove shikule nge.”
Opo nee ondjovo ei oya tana mokati kovamwatate, nokutya omulongwa ou ita fi; ndele Jesus ka tile kuye: “Ita fi, ndelenee: ngeenge nda hala, a kale po fiyo ohandi uya, ove ou na shike nasho?”
Omulongwa ou oye tuu ta hepaulula oinima ei, ndele e i shanga, notu shi shii ehepaululo laye oloshili.
Ndele ope na yo oinima ihapu i lili ei Jesus e i longa, ndele ngeno aishe ya shangwa, ngeno ondi shi shii mounyuni itamu wana omambo oo, e nokushangwa.

1: Mehepaululo lange lotete, omukwetu Teofilus, onde ku hepaululila aishe Jesus a hovela oku i longa noku i ninga,
fiyo okefiku olo a twalwa meulu, eshi a pa tete ovayapostoli, ava e va hoolola, oipango yaye mOmhepo Iyapuki;
konima yomahepeko aye okwe ve lihololela yo nomadidiliko mahapu nokutya, Oye omunamwenyo, eshi e ve limonifila omafiku omilongo ine ndele te va hepaululile oinima youhamba waKalunga.
Ndele eshi a kala pamwe navo okwe va lombwela vaha dje mo muJerusalem, ndelenee va teelele ewanifo leudaneko laXe, olo mwe li uda kwaame, ngaashi a tya.
Osheshi Johannes okwa shashele nomeva, ndele nye otamu ka shashwa nOmhepo Iyapuki omafiku amwe eshi a pita po.
Opo nee vo eshi va li va ongala, ve mu pula tava ti: “Omwene, opefimbo tuu eli to tungululile Israel ouhamba?”
Ye okwe va nyamukula, ta ti: “Kashi fi sheni okushiiva omafimbo ile eetundi edi Tate e di tula po meenghono daye mwene,
ndelenee nye otamu pewa eenghono, Omhepo Iyapuki ngeenge tai uya munye, ndele tamu ka ninga eendobwedi dange muJerusalem nomuJudea ashishe nomuSamaria nofiyo okominghulo dounyuni.”
Opo nee eshi a tonga eendjovo edi, okwa yelulwa pombada moipafi yavo, noshilemo she mu kufa po momesho avo.
Ndele fimbo va li tava lyaamene keulu, eshi ta i, tala, ovalumenhu vavali va djala oikutu itoka ova fikama puvo,
ndele tava ti: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovagalilea, oshike mu li ofika ndele tamu tale keulu? Jesus tuu ou e mu kufwa a ya meulu, osho tuu ngaha ta aluka ko, ngaashi mwe mu mona a ya meulu.”
Ndele ova shuna kuJerusalem va dja komhunda ya ifanwa Omhunda yEemono i li popepi naJerusalem, pe noshinano shi fike pondjila yEshabata.

Ndele eshi ve uya ko, ova ya kondjuwo ei yokombada omo hava kala mo yo shito: oPetrus naJohannes naJakob naAndreas naFilippus naTomas naBartolomeus naMateus naJakob yaAlfeus naSimon omuladi naJudas yaJakob.
Ndele ovo aveshe ova kala nomutima umwe va diinina mokwiilikana pamwe naMaria, ina yaJesus, novakainhu oovakwao pamwe novamwaina vaJesus ovalumenhu.
Ndele momafiku enya ovanhu ve fike pefele limwe nomilongo ivali eshi va li va ongala, Petrus okwa fikama mokati kavo ndele ta ti:
“Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, eshangelo eli oli nokuwanifwa Omhepo Iyapuki e li tongifa nale okanya kaDavid, a tonga Judas, ou a ninga omukwatelikomesho waavenya va kwata Jesus.
Osheshi okwa li a valulilwa mongudu yetu, ndele a pelwe oshipewa shoshilonga eshi.
Nepya e li lilikolela nondjabi yokunyona kwaye, ei e i pewa; nokwa wa ko, a wila poshi ndele a topa pokati, nomandjadja aye aeshe a wa mo.
Noshinima eshi osha shiivika kOvajerusalem aveshe, onghee epya eli la pewa edina melaka lavo Akeldama, otashi ti epya lohonde.

Osheshi mOmapsalome omwa shangwa:
‘Eumbo laye nali ninge eputu
muha kale nande omunhu;
umwe na tambule oufitalonga waye.’
Hano umwe womovalumenhu ava va li va endaenda nafye efimbo alishe, eshi Omwene Jesus kwa li he uya mo ndele ha di mo mokati ketu,
okudja keshasho laJohannes fiyo efiku olo a kufwa mufye, a ya meulu, na ninge ondobwedi yenyumuko laye pamwe nafye.”
Ndele ova hoolola mo vavali: Josef a ifanwa Barsabas, edina laye likwao Justus, naMatias,
opo nee va ilikana tava ti: “Omwene, Oove ou wa shiiva omitima daaveshe, tu ulikila elipipo mwaava vavali we mu hoolola,
a pewe onhele meyakulolonga eli nomouyapostoli, omo Judas e liteeka mo nokwa ya ponhele yaye mwene.”
Vo ove va pa oihoololifo, noshihoololifo osha kwata Matias, ye okwa valulilwa movayapostoli venya omulongo naumwe.
2: Ndele efiku laPentekoste eshi la fika, vo aveshe ova hangika va ongala monhele imwe.
Ndele ohaluka, meulu omwa dja oshihomo ngaashi oshikungulu shinene tashi ende, ndele osha yadifa ondjuwo aishe omu va kala omutumba.
Ndele opa monika kuvo omalaka a fa omundilo a tukauka nakeshe limwe tali wile kombada yakeshe umwe womokati kavo.
Vo aveshe ova yadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki, ndele ova hovela okupopya omalaka amwe e lili Omhepo ngaashi e va pa oku shi popya.
Ndele muJerusalem mwa kala ovalumenhu Ovajuda ovatilikalunga vokoiwana aishe yokoshi yeulu.
Ndele oshihomo eshi, eshi sha udika, ongudu yovanhu oya ongala noya kumwa, osheshi keshe tuu ou okwe va uda tava popi elaka lambulavo.
Vo aveshe ova haluka va kumwa ndele tava ti: “Taleni, aveshe ava tava popi kave fi Ovagalilea hamba?
Ongahelipi hano fye atushe eshi hatu va udu tava popi elaka eli mulo twa dalwa.
Fye ava tu li po Ovaparti nOvamedia nOvaelami naava twa kala muMesopotamia novomuJudea nomuKappadokia novomuPontus novomuAsia,
novomuFrigia novomuPamfilia novomuEgipiti novomoikandjo oyo yaLibia ya ama kuKireni, nOvaroma ovo va kala omu, nOvajudelela novauyimo mOujuda,
nOvakreta nOvajarabia, ofye keshe ou, ohatu mu udu ta popi oilonga inene yaKalunga melaka letu vene.”
Vo aveshe ova kumwa ndele va limbililwa va pulafana, tava ti: “Eshi oshishike hano?”
Ndele vakwao ve va sheka tava ti: “Vo ova kumwa omaviinyu manyenye.”
Opo nee Petrus a fikama naava omulongo naumwe, a yelula ondaka yaye mokule, ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovajuda nanye Ovajerusalem amushe, kaleni mu shi shii, nye mu pwilikine eendjovo dange.
Osheshi ava inava kolwa, ngaashi nye tamu diladila, ongula nokuli, okafimbo okatitatu,
ndele eshi osho tuu osho sha tilwe komuxunganeki Joel:

‘Omomafiku axuuninwa otaku ningwa,
Kalunga osho ta ti:
Ame ohandi tilile kombada yombelela aishe Omhepo yange,
novana veni ovamati novana veni oukadona otava xunganeke,
novanyasha veni tava ka mona omamoniko,
novaxungu veni otava ka twa eendjodi.

Heeno, nokombada yovapiya vange ovalumenhu novakainhu
ohandi tilile ko Omhepo yomOmhepo yange omomafiku enya,
ndele vo otava ka xunganeka.

Ndele handi holola oikumwifa pombada keulu
nomadidiliko kombada yedu:
ohonde nomundilo noilemo yomwifi.

Etango otali shituka omilaulu,
ohani ohonde,
efiku olo linene lOmwene la fimana fimbo inali fika.
Ndele taku ningi, keshe tuu ou ta ifana edina lOmwene ota ka xupifwa.’

“Ovalumenhu nye Ovaisraeli, pwilikineni eendjovo edi: Jesus Omunasareti, omulumenhu tuu ou mwe mu hepaululilwa kuKalunga moilonga yeenghono nomoinyengandunge nomomadidiliko oo Kalunga e mu longifa mokati keni, ngaashi nye vene mu a shii,
Oye tuu ou e mu yandjelwa ketokolo loshito nokonuno ei, Kalunga kwa li e i kwete nale, nye omwe mu valelifa komushiyakano nomwe mu dipaifa komake aavo inava shiiva omhango.
Oye ou Kalunga okwe mu nyumuna ndele okwe mu mangulula mouyehame wefyo, ngaashi efyo laha la li neenghono oku mu kwatelela mo.

Osheshi David te mu tongo:
‘Alushe handi mono Omwene koshipala shange,
osheshi Oye e li kolulyo lange,
ndiha tengauke.

Onghee tuu omutima wange u nehafo
nelaka lange tali nyakukwa,
nolutu lange tali tulumukwa meteelelo.

Osheshi omwenyo wange Ove ito u efele moshovafi
nOmuyapuki woye ito mu efa a mone eolelo.

Osheshi Ove ho shiivifile nge eendjila domwenyo,
oto ka yadifa nge ehafo lokoshipala shoye.’
“Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, efeni, ndi mu lombwele nouladi, ndi popye tatekulu David, ye okwa fya, ndele okwa pakwa, ombila yaye oi li nonena eli mokati ketu.
Ndele oye eshi a li omuxunganeki, okwa li e shi shii Kalunga e mu anenene eano nokutya, umwe womoludalo laye e nokukala omutumba kolukalwa laye louhamba.
Hano mokutala komesho okwa popya enyumuko laKristus, eshi ta ti: ‘Omwenyo waye inau fiwa mo moshovafi, nombelela yaye inai mona eolelo.’
Jesus Oye tuu ou Kalunga okwe mu nyumuna, nafye atushe eendobwedi doshinima eshi.
Hano eshi a kala kolulyo laKalunga, a yelulilwa ko, okwa pewa kuXe Omhepo Iyapuki, ou a udanekelwa, Ye okwe mu tilila, Oye ou mwe mu mona nomwe mu uda.

Osheshi David haye a londele meulu, ndelenee ye mwene ota ti:
‘Omwene okwa lombwela Omwene wange:
Kala omutumba kolulyo lange,

fiyo handi ningi ovatondi voye
oshilyatelo shokeemhadi doye.’
“Hano eumbo alishe laIsrael nali shiive shili, Jesus tuu ou, mwe mu valela komushiyakano, Kalunga okwe mu ninga Omwene naKristus.”
Ndelenee vo eshi ve di uda, ode va twa komitima, ndele ova tya kuPetrus nokovayapostoli vakwao: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, fye otu nokuninga ngahelipi!”
Ndele Petrus okwa tya kuvo: “Lidilululeni, nakeshe ou ne lishashifile medina laJesus Kristus, mu diminwe po omatimba eni, ndele nye otamu ka pewa oshiyandjwa shOmhepo Iyapuki.
Osheshi omaudaneko aa e mu udanekelwa onye vene novana veni, naaveshe venya ve li kokule, ovo aveshe Omwene Kalunga ketu te ke va ifana.”
Ndele neendjovo dihapu di lili ye a hepaulula nokwe va kumaida ta ti: “Liyandjeni nye mu xupifwe mo moludalo eli la pilalala.”
Hano ava va tambula nehafo eendjovo daye ova shashwa, mefiku olo mwa wedelwa mo ovanhu ve fike pomayovi atatu.
Ndele vo ova diinina okukala melongo lovayapostoli nomekwatafano lavo, nomokupambula omungome nomokwiilikana.
Ndele eemwenyo daaveshe da hangika ketilo, novayapostoli va longa oinyengandunge noilongadidiliko.
Ndele aveshe ava va itavela ova kala kumwe, nemona lavo ove li tula mumwe.
Ndele ova landifa po omapya avo noinima yavo, nove i tukulila aveshe opaemhumbwe dakeshe.
Ndele momafiku aeshe ova kala nomutima umwe motembeli nomomaumbo, va pambula omungome ndele ova lile eendja davo nehafo nomitima da yela,
ova hambelela Kalunga nova li ve nonghenda iwa novanhu aveshe. Keshe efiku Omwene a wedela mo mongudu yavo ava tava xupifwa.
3: Ndele Petrus naJohannes ova ya motembeli pefimbo leilikano potundi onhimugoi.

Ndele mefimbo tuu olo opa etwa omulumenhu a humbatwa, ye okwa li e noudu wombada nghee a dalwa, keshe efiku ohave mu tula poshivelo osho shotembeli, sha lukwa Shawapala, a ehele oikwafa kwaava, hava i motembeli.
Opo nee eshi a mona Petrus naJohannes va hala okuya motembeli, okwe va pula ekwafo.
Ndelenee Petrus pamwe naJohannes ove mu tala, ndele tava ti: “Tala kufye!”
Ndele ye e va dakamena omesho, a teelela a pewe sha kuvo.
Ndelenee Petrus okwa tya: “Oshisiliveli noshingoldo nghi shi kwete, ndele eshi ndi shi kwete, ohandi shi ku pe: Omedina laJesus Kristus Omunasareti, fikama u ende!”
Ndele okwe mu kwata keke lokolulyo nokwe mu kaleka ofika, opo tuu opo eemhadi daye neemhando daye oda pama.
Ndele ye okwa nhuka po, ta kala ofika, ta ende ndele ta i pamwe navo motembeli, ta ende nokunhukauka ndele ta hambelele Kalunga.
Ndele ovanhu aveshe ove mu tala, eshi ta ende ta hambelele Kalunga.
Ndele vo ove mu dimbulukwa oye tuu ou ha kala omutumba poshivelo shinya shotembeli sha lukwa Shawapala, a pewe oikwafa, ndele ova haluka va kuminwa eshi she mu ningilwa.
Ndele ye eshi a li pamwe naPetrus naJohannes, ovanhu aveshe ova kwatwa konghumwe inene, nova endelela okwoongalela puvo molukala olo la lukwa laSalomo.

Ndele Petrus eshi e va tala, okwa tya kovanhu: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovaisraeli, eshi omwe shi kuminwa shike, ndele tamu tu tale shike, twa fa twe shi ninga keenghono detu vene ile kouyuki wetu, ou eshi ta ende?
Kalunga kaAbraham naIsak naJakob, Kalunga kootate, Oye a fimanekifa Omona Jesus, Oye tuu ou nye mwe mu yandja, nomwe mu lidimbika koshipala shaPilatus, ye eshi kwa li a pangela oku mu efa.
