Ndele nye mwe lidimbika Omuyapuki nOmuyuki, nomwe lihalela omudipai.
Ndele Omwene womwenyo mwe mu dipaifa, Oye ou Kalunga e mu nyumuna koufi nafye otu li eendobwedi dasho.
Ndele kokwiitavela edina laye, eitavelo eli ola pameka omulumenhu ou mu mu wete nomu mu shii, neitavelo olo e li pewa kuJesus, ola velula oinhimbu yaye moipafi yeni amushe.
“Ndelenee paife, ovamwatate, ondi shi shii nye omwe shi ninga mokuhashiiva sha kweni, onye ngaashi novakulunhu veni yo.
Ndelenee osho ngaha Kalunga okwa wanifa osho e shi popifa nale omakanya ovaxunganeki aveshe, Kristus e nokuhepekwa.
Hano lidilululeni, nye mu lialuluke, omatimba eni opo a dimwe po,
opo nee koshipala shOmwene ku dje omafimbo omahekeleko, Ye e mu tumine Kristus Jesus, Oye ou mwe mu nuninwa nale.
Oye ou eulu la li li noku mu tambululula noku mu kwatela mo fiyo omafimbo enya, oinima aishe tai shunwa ponhele yayo, ngaashi Kalunga e shi popifa nale omakanya ovaxunganeki vaye ovayapuki.
Osheshi naMoses okwa tile: ‘Omwene Kalunga ote mu pendulile omuxunganeki omoovakweni, ongaashi ame, ye omu noku mu uda moinima aishe te i mu lombwele.
Ndele keshe omwenyo ou itau udu omuxunganeki ou, otau dimwa mo movanhu.’
Novaxunganeki aveshe, okudja kuSamuel, novapopi aveshe ve mu shikula, kwa li va popya va xunganeka omafiku aa.
Ndele onye ovana vovaxunganeki novehangano, Kalunga e li ninga nootate, eshi a tonga kuAbraham: ‘Moludalo loye omapata aeshe omounyuni otaa nangekwa noupuna.’
Onye ava Kalunga e mu nyumunina tete Omona Jesus nokwe mu tuma oku mu nangeka noupuna, ngeenge mwe lidilulula keshe umwe kowii waye.”
4: Ndele eshi va li tava tongo ngaha kovanhu, ovapristeli nomukulunhu wovanangeli votembeli nOvasadukai ve uya kuvo,
ove va handukila eshi va longa ovanhu nova hepaulula enyumuko lomovafi li li muJesus.
Ndele vo ove va kwata, ove va idilila modolongo fiyo efiku lomongula, osheshi okwa li onguloshi.
Ndele vahapu vomwaava va uda eendjovo, ova ninga ovaitaveli, nomuvalu wovalumenhu wa li lwopomayovi atano.
Opo nee mefiku lomongula ovapangeli novakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa ova ongala muJerusalem,
nosho ngaha yo omupristeli omukulunhu Hannas naKajafas naJohannes naAleksander naaveshe ava vomepata lovapristeli ovakulunhu.
Ndele vo ove va tula mokati kavo ndele tave va pula: “Okeenghono dilipi ile omedina lalyelye mwa longa eshi?”
Opo nee Petrus a yadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ovapangeli nye ovakulunhu vOvaisraeli!
Onena eli eshi tu li po hatu hokololifwa oshilonga shiwa sha ningilwa oshingudu, ndele hatu pulwa, okwa velulwa koshike?

Hano onye amushe noshilongo ashishe shaIsrael, kaleni mu shi shii, ou a velulwa ndele ta kala ofika apa moipafi yeni okedina laJesus Kristus Omunasareti, ou nye mwe mu valela komushiyakano, ndelenee okwa nyumunwa kuKalunga koufi.
‘Oye emanya olo, nye ovatungi mwe li ekelashi, ndelenee olo la ninga omutwe wokolonela.’
Ndele kaku na mukwao, exupifo la kala muye, osheshi kaku nedina limwe li lili koshi yeulu, la yandjelwa ovanhu omo tu nokuxupifilwa mo.”
Ndele eshi va mona onyati yaPetrus naJohannes, nove va wete ovo ovanhu vongaho, inava longwa, ova kumwa, ndele ve va dimbulukwa, ova kala naJesus.
Ndele eshi va tala omunhu ou a velulwa, ta kala ofika puvo, va nyengwa okutonga nande sha,
opo nee ve va lombwela, va dje mo manga moshiongalele shavo, ova kundafana
tava ti: “Ovanhu ava ohatu va ningi ngahelipi nee? Osheshi oshikumwifalonga eshi ve shi ninga, osha monika nosha shiivika kOvajerusalem aveshe, fye itatu dulu oku shi anya.
Ndelenee opo shiha tane vali pamwe pe lili mokati kovanhu aveshe, tu va hanyeneni shili, vaha popye vali nande okomunhu edina eli.”
Opo nee ove va ifanununa mo ndele ove va lombwela vaha popye nande okanini ile vaha longe vali medina laJesus.
Ndele Petrus naJohannes ove va nyamukula ndele tava ti kuvo: “Tokoleni nye vene ngeenge osha yuka koshipala shaKalunga oku mu uda komesho yaKalunga,
fye itatu dulu okukala tuha hepaulule ei twe i mona notwe i uda.”
Ndele venya nande va weda ko vali omaaneko, ve va efa ngaho, osheshi vo inava mona sha shoku va handukilila omolwovanhu, osheshi aveshe ova hambelelela Kalunga eshi sha ningwa.
Osheshi omulumenhu ou a ningilwa oshikumwifalonga, eedula daye oda hangika da koya omilongo ine.
Ndele vo eshi va efiwa, ova ya kuvakwao nove va hepaululila adishe odo ve di lombwelwa kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovakulunhu.
Ndele moku shi uda vo aveshe ova twala ondaka yavo pombada kuKalunga ngaashi omunhu umwe, tava ti: “Omwene, Oove wa shita eulu nedu nefuta nakeshe eshi shi li mo.

Oove tuu ou okOmhepo Iyapuki wa popifa okanya katate yetu David, omupiya woye, to ti:
‘Ovapaani otava lundalalele shike,
noiwana tai diladilile shike oinima yongaho?

Eehamba dedu tadi fikama,
novapangeli otava ongalele kumwe
notava tu ondubo nOmwene nOmuvaekwa waye.’
Osheshi moshilando eshi omwa ongalela mo shili, Herodes naPontius Pilatus pamwe novapaani, novanhu vaIsrael ova twa ondubo nomumwoye omuyapuki Jesus, ou we mu vaeka,
va ninge ashishe eshi eke loye nomhangela yoye ye shi pangela nale shi ningwe.
Hano paife, Omwene, tala nhumbi tava popi nomaaneko, Ove u pe ovapiya voye okupopya nouladi aushe eendjovo doye,
Ove u yelule eke loye okuvelula ovanaudu nokulonga oilongadidiliko noikumwifalonga okedina lOmona woye omuyapuki, oJesus.”
Hano eshi va dimbuka okwiilikana, onhele ei apa va ongala, oya kakama, vo aveshe ova yadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki, ndele va popya nouladi eendjovo daKalunga.
Ndele mongudu ei inene yovaitaveli aveshe ova li ve nomutima umwe nomwenyo umwe, ndele kakwa li nande oumwe a tumbula oshinima ongaashi shaye mwene, osheshi oinima yavo aishe oya tulwa mumwe.
Ndele ovayapostoli ova hepaulula neenghono dinene enyumuko lOmwene Jesus Kristus, navo aveshe ova pewa onghenda inene.
Nomokati kavo kamwa li nande ohepele, osheshi ava va li ve nomapya ile eengulu ove di landifa po, naai ve i pewa mokulandifa po, ove i eta
ndele ve i tula keemhadi dovayapostoli nakeshe umwe okwa pewa shi fike peemhumbwe daye.
Osho naJosef, ou ovayapostoli ve mu luka yo Barnabas, tali ti: omona wehekeleko, Omulevi a dalelwa muKipro,
okwa landifa po epya laye a li e kwete, noimaliwa okwe i eta, ndele okwe i tula keemhadi dovayapostoli.
5: Ndelenee omulumenhu umwe, edina laye Ananias, pamwe nomukainhu waye Safira, ova landifa po epya lavo,
omulumenhu okwa holeka po oimaliwa imwe, nomukainhu waye e i shii, noshitukulwa shimwe shayo okwe shi tula keemhadi dovayapostoli.
Ndele Petrus okwa tya: “Ananias, oshike wa efela Satana a yade omutima woye, eshi wa fufya Omhepo Iyapuki ndele wa holeka oimaliwa imwe yomepya?
Kala li loye fimbo inali landifwa po, naashi la landifwa po, oshilandwa shalo kasha li mepangelo loye? Oshike hano eshi wa paka mo momutima woye u longe eshi? Havanhu wa fufya, oKalunga.”
Ananias eshi a uda eendjovo edi, okwa wila poshi ndele okwa fya, aveshe ava ve shi uda, ova kwatwa ketilo linene.
Ovalumenhu ovanyasha ova fikama, ndele ve mu tuvika, ndele tave mu twala pondje, ndele tave mu pake.
Neetundi nhatu eshi da pita po, omukainhu waye okwe uya po, okwa li ehe shii sha, eshi sha ningwa po.
Ndele Petrus okwe mu pula: “Lombwele nge, epya leni omwe li landifa po tuu oimaliwa ei?” Ye okwa tya: “Heeno, oyoyo.”
Ndele Petrus okwe mu lombwela: “Oshike mwa udafana okushinda Omhepo Iyapuki yOmwene? Tala, eemhadi daava va ka paka omulumenhu woye, odi li poshivelo vo otave ku twala ko.”
Opo tuu opo ye a wila poshi okeemhadi daye nokwa fya; ndele ovalumenhu ovanyasha, eshi ve uya mo, ove mu hanga a fya, ove mu twala pondje ndele ove ke mu paka pomulumenhu waye.
Neongalo alishe naaveshe ava ve di uda, ova tila nokutililila.
Ndele komake ovayapostoli okwa ningwa oilongadidiliko noikumwifa ihapu mokati kovanhu, ndele vo aveshe va li ve nediladilo limwe, ndele va diinina okwoongalela molukala laSalomo.
Ndele mwaava ve lili inamu hetekela nande umwe e litule muvo, ndelenee ovanhu ve va fimaneka.
Ndele ava va itavela Omwene, ova hapupala, eengudu dinene dovalumenhu nodovakainhu.
Ndele pa ningwa, ovanaudu va twalwa peendjila ve li keembete nokomalutala, opo Petrus ngeenge ta ende po, omudidimbe waye u hange ngeno nande umwe womuvo.
Ndele koilando yomoushiinda waJerusalem okwa dja yo ovanhu vahapu, ndele va eta ovanaudu naava va hepekwa keemhepo da nyata, vo aveshe ova velulwa.
Opo nee omupristeli omukulunhu okwa fikama pamwe nongudu yaye aishe, oshimhanga shOvasadukai, ve yadi ehandu,
ndele ova kwatifa ovayapostoli ndele ove va idilila modolongo ei yaaveshe.
Ndelenee oufiku omweengeli wOmwene okwa yeulula oivelo yodolongo, okwe va pitifa mo ndele ta ti:
“Indeni mu ka holokele motembeli nye mu hepaululile ovanhu eendjovo adishe domwenyo ou.”

Ndele eshi ve di uda ova ya ongula inene motembeli ndele tava longo ovanhu.
Ndele omupristeli omukulunhu navakwao ove uya nova ifana oshiongalele shavo nongudu aishe yovakulunhu vovana vaIsrael; va tuma kodolongo, va ka talwe ko.
Ndele ovapiya ava vetokolo eshi ve uya modolongo, vo inave va hanga mo, ova aluka ndele ova hepaulula
tava ti: “Odolongo yoovene otwe i hanga ya idilwa shili novanangeli ova kala ofika poivelo, ndele eshi twe i yeulula, inatu hanga mo nande omunhu.”
Opo nee omukulunhu wovanangeli votembeli novapristeli ovakulunhu eshi va uda oinima ei, ova limbililwa, ndele tava diladila oshike tashi ke uya po.
Ndele mwe uya umwe ndele ta ti kuvo: “Taleni, ovalumenhu venya mwa idilila modolongo, ove li motembeli ndele tava longo ovanhu.”
Opo omukulunhu okwa ya pamwe novapiya vetokolo oku ke va tala ko, ye ine va eta keenghono, osheshi ova tila okudipawa nomamanya kovanhu.
Ndele vo eshi ve va eta, ove va tula moipafi yoshiongalele shovakulunhu, nomupristeli omukulunhu okwe va pula,
ta ti: “Fye otwe mu shilika shili, onye muha longe vali ovanhu edina eli, ndele taleni, Jerusalem ashishe omwe shi yadifa nelongo leni, nomwa hala mu twike ohonde yomulumenhu winya kombada yetu.”
Ndele Petrus novayapostoli vakwao ova nyamukula tava ti: “Okudulika kuKalunga ku dule okudulika kovanhu.
Kalunga kootate yetweni okwa nyumuna Jesus, ou nye mwe mu endjelelifa komuti nomwe mu dipaa.
Oye ou Kalunga e mu nenepekifa neke laye lokolulyo, a ninga Omwene, e mu lenge mouyehame Omukulili okupa Ovaisraeli elidilululo nedimepo lomanyonauno.
Ndele fye eendobwedi doinima ei aishe, nongaashi Omhepo Iyapuki yo, ou Kalunga e i pa aveshe ava hava dulika kuye.”
Ndele vo eshi ve di uda, oda lulumika eemwenyo davo, opo va hala oku va dipaa.
Ndele moshiongalele omwa fikama Omufarisai umwe edina laye Gamaliel, omulongimhango a fimanekwa kovanhu aveshe, okwa lombwela ovalumenhu va twalwe manga pondje.
Opo nee a lombwela ovakulunhu voshiongalele: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovaisraeli, lidiladileni nawa eshi mwa hala oku shi ningila ovalumenhu ava!

Manga omafiku oo inae uya, Teodas okwa holokele nokwa tile, vati oye omushikeshike, novalumenhu ve fike pomafele ane ove litula puye, ye okwa dipawa naavenya aveshe va ama kuye va halakanifwa po nova manwa po.
Ndele konima yaau, pomafiku omavalulo ovanhu, okwa holokele Judas, Omugalilea, ye okwa hongaula ovanhu, ve mu shikule, naye yo okwa nyonauka po naaveshe ava ve mu hokwa, ova halakanifwa po.
Hano paife ohandi ti kunye: Efeni ovalumenhu ava, va kale ngaha, eudafano eli noshilonga eshi ngeenge osha dja movanhu, otashi ka xula po,
ndelenee ngeenge osha dja muKalunga, nye itamu dulu oku va nyonauna po. Litaleni, muha monike nokuli, onye ovakondjifi vaKalunga mwene.”
Ndele vo ova ninga ngaashi ye a tonga, ova ifanena mo ovayapostoli, ndele tave va dengifa nove va lombwela, vaha popye vali medina laJesus, nove va efa va ye.
Vo eshi va dja mo moshiongalele shovakulunhu, ova hafa eshi va talwa va wana okushekelwa edina laJesus.
Ndele vo inava efa okulonga omafiku aeshe motembeli nomomaumbo nova udifa evaengeli laKristus Jesus.
6: Ndele momafiku enya omuvalu wovalongwa eshi wa hapupala, Ovaheleni nokutya, ovakwaneongalo velaka lOshigreka, ova ngongotela Ovaheberi, osheshi oipalwifa eshi ya tukulwa keshe efiku, ovafiyekadi vavo ova lumbulwa.
Opo naava omulongo navavali ova shiva ongudu yovalongwa, ndele tava ti kuvo: “Inashi wapala, fye tu efe eendjovo daKalunga tu yakule poililo.
Hano ovamwatate, hoololeni mokati keni ovalumenhu vaheyali ve shii okulineekelwa, ve yadi Omhepo Iyapuki neendunge, ovo hatu va tula moshilonga eshi.
Ndele fye vene otwa hala okukala meilikano nomeyakulo leendjovo.”

Ndele eendjovo edi oda wapalela oshiongalele ashishe, nova hoolola mo Stefanus, omulumenhu ou e yadi eitavelo nOmhepo Iyapuki, naFilippus naProkorus naNikanor naTimon naParmena naNikolaus, Omuantiokia omupaani e lipitififa etanda.
Ovo tuu ovo ove va tula koshipala shovayapostoli, ava ova ilikana nove va tenheka omake.
Ndele eendjovo daKalunga da tandavela, nomuvalu wovalongwa vomuJerusalem owa hapupala neenghono, nongudu inene yomovapristeli oya dulika keitavelo.
Ndele Stefanus a yada onghenda neenghono, okwa longa oinyengandunge inene noilongadidiliko mokati kovanhu.
Opo nee opa holoka vamwe vomoinagoga oyo ya lukwa yOvamangululwa noyOvakireni noyOvaaleksandria navamwe vomuKilikia novomuAsia, ndele tava twifa Stefanus eemhata,
ndelenee ova nyengwa okutomha eendunge odo Omhepo oyo ye mu popifa.
Vo ova konga meholeko ovalumenhu va tye: “Fye otwe mu uda ta popi eendjovo domasheko dokusheka Moses naKalunga.”
Ndele vo ova piyaaneka ovanhu novakulunhu novanongo vomishangwa, ovo ve uya po, ve mu kwata ndele tave mu shilile moshiongalele shovakulunhu.
Ndele vo ova eta po eendobwedi doipupulu edi tadi ti: “Omulumenhu ou ita efa okupopyaana nokusheka onhele ei iyapuki nomhango
osheshi fye otwe mu uda eshi ta ti: Jesus ou Omunasareti, ota hanauna po onhele ei, neenghedi odo twe di pelwe kuMoses ote di lundulula.”
Ndele aveshe ovo va kala omutumba moshiongalele shovakulunhu ove mu tala, noshipala shaye osha li sha foshipala shomweengeli.
7: Opo nee omupristeli omukulunhu okwa tya: “Odo tuu odo?”
Stefanus okwa tya: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate nootate, pwilikineni! Kalunga koshinge okwe lihololela tate yetu Abraham, eshi a li muMesopotamia, fimbo ina tula muHaran,
ndele ta ti kuye: ‘Dja mo medu leni nomepata loye, ove u ye kedu olo handi ke ku ulikila.’
Opo nee ye okwa dja mo medu lOvakaldea nokwa tula muHaran, ndele xe eshi a fya, Kalunga okwe mu eta medu eli, mu li mo nonena eli.
Ndele Ye ine mu pa mo efyuululo, nande oli fike ponhele yomhadi: Abraham fimbo kwa li ehe nokaana, okwe mu udanekela edu li ninge laye nololudalo laye konima yaye.
‘Ndele Kalunga okwa tile ngaha, oludalo laye tali ka ninga ovanailongo medu lihe fi lavo, ndele tave va ningi ovapika ndele tave va hepeke omido omafele ane:
ndele oshiwana eshi tashi va ningi ovapika vasho, Ame handi ke shi tokola’, Kalunga osho ta ti; ‘opo nee tava ka dja mo ndele tava longele nge monhele ei.’
Ndele Ye okwe mu pa ehangano lepitotanda, ndele Abraham eshi a dala Isak, ye e mu pitifa etanda mefiku etihetatu. Isak okwa dala Jakob, naJakob ootatekulu venya omulongo navavali.
“Ndele ootatekulu venya ova ningila Josef ondubo ndele ve mu landifa po kuEgipiti, ndele Kalunga okwa li pamwe naye,
nokwe mu xupifa moudjuu waye aushe, ndele okwe mu pa onghenda nounongo koshipala shaFarao, ohamba yaEgipiti neumbo laye alishe.
Ndele edu alishe laEgipiti nolaKaanan ola hangika kondjala nokoluhepo linene, ngaashi ootate inava mona oipalwifa.
Ndele Jakob eshi a uda muEgipiti mu noilya, okwa tuma ko ootate lwotete,
nomokushuna ko olutivali, ovamwaxe ova dimbulukiwa kuJosef, naFarao okwa shiivifilwa epata laJosef.
Opo nee Josef okwa tuma kuxe Jakob a ka talwe ko nepata laye alishe, ovanhu omilongo heyali navatano.
Ndele Jakob okwa ya kuEgipiti, ndele oko a fila ye mwene nootate.
Ndele vo ova twalwa kuSekem, va pakwa mombila ei Abraham e lilandela noimaliwa kovana vaHamor muSekem.
“Ndele efimbo lokuwanifa eudaneko Kalunga e li udanekela Abraham, eshi la ehena popepi, ovanhu ova tana nokuhapupalela muEgipiti,
fiyo ohamba imwe ya nangala Egipiti, oyo inai shiiva Josef nande okanini.
Ou okwa kotokela oshiwana shetu, ndele ta hepeke ootate, ndele okwe va fininika okweekelashi ounona vavo vaha kale ve nomwenyo.
Mefimbo linya Moses omo a dalwa, ndele okwa li okaana kawa unene ka wapalela Kalunga, ko ka li ka diininwa meumbo laxe eehani nhatu.
Ndele eshi ka ekelwashi, omona okakadona kaFarao e ka kufa po e ke litekulila, ka ninge omona waye.
Ndele Moses okwa longwa ounongo aushe wOvaegipiti, nokwa li omuladi meendjovo nomoilonga.
“Ndele omido daye eshi da ninga omilongo ine, momutima waye mwa penduka ediladilo a ka talele po ovamwaxe, ovana vaIsrael.
Ndele eshi a mona ko umwe a hepekwa nai, okwe mu popila, ndele ponhele yomuhepekwa okwa alulila winya owii waye, nokwa denga Omuegipiti ndele te mu dipaa.
Ndele ye okwa li e shi, ovamwaxe tava ka koneka kutya, Kalunga ote va xupififa eke laye, ndelenee inave shi koneka.

Ndele mefiku lomongula eshi a holoka kuvo fimbo tava patafana tave lidenge, opo a hetekela oku va anuna va kalafane nombili, eshi ta ti: ‘Ovalumenhu nye, nye ovanhu vaxe imwe, oshike tamu ningafana nai?’
Ndele ou ta ningi nai mukwao, okwe mu undula po ndele ta ti: ‘Olyelye e ku lenga u kale omupangeli nomutokoli wetu?
Owa hala tuu okudipaa nge ngaashi onghela wa dipaele Omuegipiti?’
Molweendjovo edi Moses okwa ya onhapo, ndele okwa li omunailongo medu laMidian, ndele okwa dalela kwinya ovana ovamati vavali.
“Ndele eshi pa pita omido omilongo ine, mombuwa yopomhunda yaSinai, omweengeli wOmwene e mu lihololela momundilo moshixwa sheno sha xwama.
Ndele emoniko olo Moses eshi e li mona, okwe li kuminwa, naashi a ehena ko e li tale nawa, okwa uda ondaka yOmwene tai ti:
‘Aame Kalunga kooxo, Kalunga kaAbraham naIsak naJakob’. Moses okwa hovela okukakama ndele ta tila okutala ko.
Ndele Omwene okwa tya kuye: ‘Dula ko eenghaku doye, osheshi onhele ei u li po ofika, oiyapuki.
Ame ondi wete ovanhu vange nhumbi ve li po tava hepekwa muEgipiti, nekemo lavo onde li uda, ndele nde uya poshi ndi va mangulule. Hano paife, ehena oku, ohandi ku tumu kuEgipiti.’

“Moses tuu ou ve mu dina, eshi va tile: ‘olyelye e ku lenga u kale omupangeli nomutokoli wetu’, oye tuu ou Kalunga e mu tuma a kale omupangeli nomumangululi okekwafo lomweengeli ou e mu lihololela moshixwa sheno.
Ye okwe va tembula mo nokulonga oinyengandunge noilongadidiliko medu laEgipiti nomEfuta Litilyana nomombuwa omido omilongo ine.
Moses tuu ou a lombwela ovana vaIsrael: ‘Kalunga ote mu pendulile movamwaxo omuxunganeki umwe ngaashi ame.’
Oye winya okwa li pamwe nomweengeli meongalo fimbo la li mombuwa, ou a popya naye komhunda yaSinai, ndele okwa li pamwe nootate; ye okwa pewa eendjovo di nomwenyo, e di tu lombwele.
Ndelenee ootate inava hala okudulika kuye, vo ove mu ekelashi ndele momitima davo ova shuna kuEgipiti,
eshi va tile kuAron: ‘Tu ningila oikalunga, tai tu kwatele komesho, osheshi Moses ou e tu tembula muEgipiti, katu shii nhumbi a ningwa.’
Ndele momafiku enya ove li ningila okatana kandume nova etela oshikalunga shavo omayambo nova nyakukilwa oshilonga shomake avo.

Ndelenee Kalunga okwe va pilamena ndele okwe va efa va longele ongudu yovakwaita vomeulu, ngaashi momishangwa dovaxunganeki mwa tiwa:
‘Onye vomeumbo laIsrael,
mwa etela nge tuu mbela omayambo omatomeno
nomaxwikilo makwao
omido dinya omilongo nhee mombuwa?

Ahowe, etwali laMolok mwe li humbata,
nonyofi yoshikalunga sheni Refan,
oifefa ei mwe i lihongela mu i linyongamene,
Ame handi ke mu lundululila ko
langhele kwinya yaBabilon.’
“Etwali lehepaululo la li mokati kootate mombuwa, ngaashi winya a popya naMoses, e mu lombwela, ne li tunge nokuhopaelela efano olo e li tala.
Ndele ootate vetu ove li tambula efyuululo, nove li eta oku pamwe naJosua, edu eshi ve li kufa ovanhu venya, Kalunga e va ta mo koshipala shootate, osho sha kala fiyo okounyuni waDavid.
Oye ou Kalunga e mu fila onghenda, ye a indila, a efelwe a tungile Kalunga kaJakob ongulu.
Ndele Salomo e mu tungila ongulu.
Ndele ou wOkombadambada iha kala meetembeli da tungwa nomake ovanhu, ngaashi omuxunganeki ta ti:

‘Eulu olo olukalwa lange
nedu olo oshilyatelelo sheemhadi dange,
hano nye omwa hala mu tungile nge
ongulu ya tya ngahelipi, Omwene osho ta ti,
ile onhele yange yokutulumukwa oilipipo?
Eke lange halo la shita oinima aishe ei?’
“Ovakwandudi nye, ava mokupitetanda inamu li pita komitima nokomatwi, alushe nye mwa twa ondubo nOmhepo Iyapuki, ngaashi ooxo, osho nanye yo.
Olyelye ou womovaxunganeki ooxo inave mu tonda? Ovo tuu va dipaa ava va xunganeka okuuya kwOmuyuki ou, nopaife nye mwa ninga ovakengeleli novadipai vaye.
Onye tuu ovo mwa pewa omhango, mwe i pefifwa ovaengeli, nye inamu i diinina.”
Opo nee vo eshi ve di uda, oda lengula omitima davo, ve mu likweshela komayoo.
Ndele ye okwa li e yadi Omhepo Iyapuki, nokwa liyaamena keulu ndele ta mono oshinge shaKalunga naJesus e li ofika kolulyo laKalunga.
Ndele okwa tya: “Taleni, ame ondi wete eulu la yeuluka nOmona wOmunhu e li ofika kolulyo laKalunga.”
Opo tuu vo ova ingida mokule unene, ove lifitika omatwi, opo vo aveshe ve mu nhukila,
ove mu ta mo moshilando ndele ove mu dipaa nomamanya. Eendobwedi ova tula oikutu yavo keemhadi domunyasha, edina laye Saulus.
Ndele fimbo va kupula Stefanus nomamanya, ye okwa ilikana, ta ti: “Omwene Jesus, tambula omhepo yange.”
Ndele ye okwa twa eengolo ndele ta ingida mokule unene: “Omwene, etimba eli ino li va valulila”. Ndele eshi e di tya, okwa kofa po nee.
8:
Ndele Saulus yo okwa li a panda okudipawa kwaStefanus.
Mefiku tuu olo eongalo lomuJerusalem ola hangika ketewatewo linene, naaveshe ve lihanena momikunda daJudea nodaSamaria, ovayapostoli aveke va fyaala mo.
Ovalumenhu vamwe ovaitaveli ova paka Stefanus, ndele ove mu lila eenghali dinene.
Ndele Saulus okwa hanauna eongalo, ta pumine momaumbo, ndele ta kokolola mo ovalumenhu novakainhu ndele te va idililifa modolongo.
Ndele ava va halakanifwa moshilongo, ova endaenda nova udifa ondjovo yevaengeli.
Ndele Filippus okwe uya moshilando shaSamaria nokwe va udifila Kristus.
Ndele eengudu dovanhu oda li di nomukoo umwe okutambula eendjovo odo da popiwa kuFilippus, eshi da uda eendjovo daye noda mona oikumwifalonga ei e i ninga.
Osheshi eemhepo da nyata oda dja mo muvahapu, ava va li ve di kwete, oda ingida mokule noingudu novanaudu vahapu vombada ova veluka.
Ndele moshilando shinya omwa kala ehafo linene.
Ndele moshilando shinya omwa kala omulumenhu edina laye Simon, ye okwa li ha pulike ovanhu ndele ta kumwifa Ovasamaria, osheshi oye e litya, oye umwe omunene, vati.
Ndele aveshe novakulunhu novanyasha va ama kuye tava ti: “Oye eenghono daKalunga da lukwa dakula!”
Ndele vo ove liameka kuye, osheshi ye e va kumwifa efimbo lile noumhulile waye.
Ndelenee paife eshi va itavela Filippus, e va udifila evaengeli louhamba waKalunga nedina laJesus Kristus, ve lishashifa, ovalumenhu novakainhu.
NaSimon mwene okwa itavela yo, naashi e lishashifa, okwa kala puFilippus, ndele eshi a mona oikumwifalonga noilonga yeenghono ya ningwa po, ye a kwatwa konghumwe.
Ndele ovayapostoli vomuJerusalem eshi va uda nokutya, Samaria sha tambula eendjovo daKalunga, ova tuma kuvo Petrus naJohannes.
Ndele vo eshi ve uya mo, ove va ilikanena va pewe Omhepo Iyapuki,
osheshi Ye ine uya natango nande kuumwe womuvo, vo ova li va shashelwa ashike medina lOmwene Jesus.
Ndele ava eshi ve va tenheka omake avo, vo ova pewa Omhepo Iyapuki.
Ndele Simon eshi a mona keshe ou a tenhekwa omake kovayapostoli a pewa Omhepo Iyapuki, okwe va etela oimaliwa,
ta ti: “Pei nge yo eenghono odo, opo keshe ou handi tenheke omake ange a pewe Omhepo Iyapuki.”
Ndelenee Petrus okwa tya kuye: “Oimaliwa yoye nai ye pamwe naave mekano, osheshi to diladila oshali yaKalunga otai landwa noimaliwa.
Ove ku kwete nande oshitukulwa ile oshipewa mondjovo ei, osheshi omutima woye inau yuka koshipala shaKalunga.
Hano lidilulula, u dje mo mowii ou woye, ove u indile Omwene pamwe to diminwa po omadiladilo aa okomutima woye.
Osheshi ondi ku wete, ove ou yadi onyango ilula, ndele ou li momapando oulunde.”
Opo nee Simon okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ilikanenei nge kOmwene, oshinima eshi mwe shi popya shiha hange nge nande okanini.”
Hano eshi va hepaulula nova udifa eendjovo dOmwene, ova shuna kuJerusalem ndele mondjila ova udifila momikunda dihapu daSamaria evaengeli.
Ndele omweengeli wOmwene okwa lombwela Filippus ndele ta ti: “Fikama, u ye lwokoumbuwanhu kondjila inya ya dja kuJerusalem ndele tai i kuGasa”. Oyo ihai endwa unene.

Ye okwa fikama ndele ta i ko. Ndele tala, Omuetiopia, elenga lohamba omukainhu Kandake wokuEtiopia, omulumenhu munene, namukeledi weumbo laye nowemona laye alishe, ye okwa ile kuJerusalem okwiilikana.
Ndele paife mokwaaluka, e li omutumba metemba laye ndele a hangika ta lesha omishangwa domuxunganeki Jesaja.
Opo nee Omhepo ya tya kuFilippus: “Inda ko, u ka kale popepi netemba eli.”
Ndele Filippus okwa tondokela ko, okwe mu uda ta lesha omishangwa domuxunganeki Jesaja, ndele ta ti: “Ove ou udite ko tuu eshi to lesha?”
Ndele winya okwa nyamukula: “Ohandi udu ko ngahelipi, ngeenge kape na ou ta tula nge mondjila?” Ndele okwa ifana Filippus a londe metemba, ye a kale omutumba pamwe naye.

Ndele onhele ei yomomishangwa a lesha oyei:
“Oye ta ka twalwa koshidipaelo ngaashi odi
nongaashi odjona hai limwenenene omukululi wayo,
hano osho ngaha naye yo ita makula okanya kaye.

Omolwokulininipika kwaye etokolo laye ola kufwa po,
olyelye ta dulu okuhepaulula epupi laye,
osheshi omwenyo waye owa kufwa ko kedu.”
Ndele elenga okwa pula Filippus ndele ta ti: “Ohandi ku indile, lombwele nge, olyelye ou ta popiwa komuxunganeki, oye mwene ile oumwe e lili?”
Opo Filippus okwa hovela okupopya nomokudja meendjovo odo domomishangwa okwe mu udifila evaengeli laJesus.
Ndele fimbo tave lishilile ngaha nondjila, ove uya komeva, nelenga okwa tya: “Tala, omeva oo aa, oshike tashi kelele nge ndiha shashwe?”
Opo tuu Filippus okwa tya kuye: “Ove ngeenge to itavele nomutima aushe, heeno, nashi ningwe”. Ou okwa nyamukula ta ti: “Ame ohandi itavele Jesus Kristus Oye Omona waKalunga.”
Ndele ye okwa fikameka etemba, naaveshe vavali ova ya momeva, oFilippus nelenga, ndele ye okwe mu shasha.
Ndele eshi va dja momeva, Omhepo yOmwene oya kufa po Filippus, nelenga ine mu mona vali, okwa ya nondjila yaye a hafa.
Ndele Filippus okwa hangika muAsotus, ta endaenda moilando ta udifa evaengeli, fiyo e uya muKesarea.
9: Ndelenee Saulus ou okwa fula onya natango nedipao lovalongwa vOmwene. Ye okwa ya komupristeli omukulunhu,
ndele te mu indile eenhumwafo da shangelwa eeshinagoga domuDamaskus, opo ngeenge ta mono oonakweenda nondjila ei, ngeenge omulumenhu ile omukainhu, a shiive oku va manga noku va twala kuJerusalem.
Fimbo ye e li mokweenda kwaye, opa ningwa, eshi e uya popepi naDamaskus, ohaluka okwa viliminwa kouyelele wokeulu;
ndele okwe lishata poshi nokwa uda ondaka tai ti kuye: “Saul, Saul, oshike to taataa nge?”
Ndele ye okwa tya: “Omwene, Oove lyelye?” Ye okwe mu nyamukula: “Aame Jesus Omunasareti, ou to mu taataa.
Ndele fikama po u ye moshilando, omo to ka lombwelwa eshi u noku shi ninga.”
Ndele ovalumenhu ava va li po va enda pamwe naye, ova kanghwa ashike ofika, ova uda ondaka, ndele inava mona po nande omunhu.
Opo nee Saulus okwa fikama po, ndele eshi omesho aye a pashuka, okwa li ehe wete ko vali, vo ove mu kwata komhango, ndele ove mu twala muDamaskus.
Ndele okwa li a twika omafiku atatu, ye ina lya sha, ye ina nwa sha.
Ndelenee muDamaskus omwa li mu nomulongwa edina laye Ananias. Oye ou Omwene e mu lombwela memoniko ta ti: “Ananias!” Oye okwa nyamukula: “Tala, aame ou, Omwene!”
Opo nee Omwene okwa tya kuye: “Fikama, inda kondjila inya ya lukwa ya yuka, ove u ka pule meumbo laJudas omulumenhu Omutarso, edina laye Saulus, osheshi tala, ye ota ilikana,
ndele ye okwa mona memoniko omulumenhu te uya kuye, edina laye Ananias, e mu tenheke omake aye a dule okumona ko vali.”
Ndelenee Ananias okwa nyamukula: “Omwene, omulumenhu winya onde mu uda kuvahapu, oye a ningila ovayapuki voye vomuJerusalem owii muhapu.
Ndele ye okwa pewa eenghono kovapristeli ovakulunhu okumanga, naaku yo, ovo aveshe ovo hava ifana edina loye.”
Ndele Omwene okwe mu lombwela: “Inda ko, osheshi oye oshilongifo shange sha hoololwa shokuhumbatela edina lange koiwana yovapaani nokeehamba nokovana vaIsrael,
osheshi nda hala ndi mu monifile oudjuu opo u fike, e noku u humbatela edina lange.”

Ndele Ananias okwa fikama, ndele ta i keumbo olo, ndele te mu tenheke omake aye, ta ti: “Omumwatate Saul, Omwene Jesus, ou e ku lihololela mondjila ei we uya nayo, Oye okwa tuma nge, opo u pashuke, ndele u yadifwe Omhepo Iyapuki.”
Ndele opo tuu opo momesho aye omwa wa oinima ya fa oipwakotolwa, opo nee ye a pashuka diva, nokwa fikama ndele e lishashifa
ndele ta li eendja, opo nee a pama vali. Ndele Saulus okwa kala povalongwa vomuDamaskus omafiku amwe.
Ndele ye okwa udifa diva meeshinagoga Kristus nokutya, Jesus Oye Omona waKalunga,

ndele aveshe ava ve mu uda ova kumwa, ndele tava ti: “Hamba, haye tuu ou kwa li a hanauna po aveshe ava va ilikana edina eli laJesus muJerusalem? Osho hasho she mu eta yo omu, ye e va twale va mangwa kovapristeli ovakulunhu?”
Ndele Saulus okwa pama nokupamenena nokwa kumwifa Ovajuda ava va li muDamaskus, eshi e va tomha nokutya, Jesus Oye Kristus.
Opo nee efimbo eshi la pita po, Ovajuda ve mu pangela omhangela oku mu dipaa.
Ndele Saulus okwa uda omhangela yavo, ndele vo ova kelela oivelo omutenya noufiku, va dule oku mu dipaa.
Ndele ovalongwa vaye ove mu kufa po oufiku ndele tave mu kulukifa, e li moshimbaba kombada yekuma lohote.
Ndele ye eshi e uya muJerusalem okwa hetekela okulitula movalongwa, ndele vo aveshe ve mu tila, osheshi inave shi itavela nokutya, ye a ninga shili omulongwa.

Ndelenee Barnabas okwe mu tambula, ndele e mu twala kovayapostoli ndele te va hepaululile, Saulus nhumbi ye a mona Omwene mondjila, nOmwene e mu popifa, ndele nhumbi a udifa nouladi medina laJesus muDamaskus.
Opo nee osho kwa li he uya mo ndele ha piti mo mokati kavo muJerusalem ndele ta udifa nouladi medina lOmwene.
Ndele ta popi nokuludika nOvaheleni, ndele ava ova kendabala oku mu dipaa.
Ovamwatate eshi ve shi koneka, ove mu twala kuKesarea, ndele ove mu tuma kuTarso.
Opo nee eongalo alishe lomuJudea ashishe nolomuGalilea nolomuSamaria ola li li nombili, ndele fimbo tali litungu mokweenda metilo lOmwene nomokupopilwa kOmhepo Iyapuki, ola hapupala.
Ndele fimbo Petrus a li ta endaenda mokati kavo aveshe, okwa fika nokovayapuki venya va kala muLidda.
Omo nee a hanga omunhu, edina laye Eneas, ou kwa li a nangala komutala omido hetatu, osheshi ye okwa li ta vele ombada.
Ndele Petrus okwe mu lombwela: “Eneas, Jesus Kristus ote ku velula, fikama, ove u liyalele omutala woye. Ye okwa fikama po diva.”
Opo Ovalidda aveshe nOvasaroni, ava ve mu mona, ove liameka kOmwene.
Ndele muJoppa omwa li mu nomulongwa omukainhu, edina laye Tabita, mOshigreka Dorkas, otali ti ngeenge la lundululwa: omenye. Ye okwa li ha longo oilonga iwa ihapu ndele ta yandje oikwafa ihapu.
Ndele momafiku enya okwa hangika koudu, ndele ta fi, ndele vo ove mu kosha, ndele ve mu nangeka mondjuwo yokombada.
Ndele Lidda eshi sha li popepi naJoppa, novalongwa eshi va uda Petrus oko e li, ova tuma ko ovalumenhu vavali, nove mu indila e uye kuvo divadiva.

Ndele Petrus okwa fikama ndele ta i pamwe navo. Ye eshi a fika ko, vo ove mu twala mondjuwo inya yokombada, ovafiyekadi aveshe ove uya kuye, tava lili, ndele tave mu ulikile eembidja neehema odo Dorkas e di hondja, eshi a li puvo.

Ndele Petrus okwa tya, ovo aveshe nava dje mo, ndele a twa eengolo ndele ta ilikana, ndele ta pungulukile koshimhu ndele ta ti: “Tabita, penduka po!” Ye okwa pashuka ndele eshi a mona Petrus, okwa kala omutumba.
Ndele Petrus okwe mu kwata keke laye ndele okwe mu fikamifa, a ifana mo ovayapuki novafiyekadi ndele te mu tula mokati kavo e nomwenyo.
Ndele eshi osha udika muJoppa ashishe, ndele vahapu ova itavela Omwene.
Ndele ye okwa menekela muJoppa omafiku mahapu, opuSimon omushiki woipa.
10: Ndele muKesarea omwa li mu nomulumenhu, edina laye Kornelius, omunefele wetanga lovakwaita eli la ifanwa laItalia.
Ye okwa li omuyuki, ha tila Kalunga pamwe neumbo laye alishe, ndele ha pe ovanhu oikwafa ihapu, ndele ta diinine okwiilikana Kalunga.
Ye okwa mona nawa memoniko, omutenya potundi onhimugoi omweengeli waKalunga te uya kuye, ndele ta ti kuye: “Kornelius!”
Ndele ye okwe mu tala, a tila, ta ti: “Omwene, oshike?” Omweengeli ta ti kuye: “Omailikano oye noikwafa yoye oya fika koshipala shaKalunga noya dimbulukiwa.
Hano paife, tuma ovalumenhu kuJoppa, va ka tale ko omulumenhu Simon, ou a ifanwa yo Petrus.
Ndele ye oku li meumbo laSimon, omushiki woipa, ou e nongulu yaye komunghulo wefuta.”
Opo nee omweengeli ou a popya naye eshi a ya, Kornelius okwa ifana ovanhu vaye vavali nomukwaita umwe omuyuki womwaava ve li puye,
ndele okwe va hepaululila ashishe ndele te va tumu kuJoppa.
Ndele mefiku lomongula eshi va li mondjila nove lishilila koshilando, Petrus okwa londa kombada yongulu potundi onhimugoi, a ka ilikane.
Ndele okwa li e udite ondjala inene, ndele a hala okulya. Ndele fimbo tava teleke, okwa fya ombabanghukuta.
Ndele okwa mona eulu la yeuluka ndele mwa dja oshikwatelwa, sha fonhanga inene itoka, ya mangwa keembinga dayo nhee, noya kulukifilwa poshi kombada yedu.
Omo mwa li mu noinamwenyo i lili nai lili i nomaulu ane naai hai lipweda pedu needila dokeulu,
nondaka oya tya kuye: “Fikama Petrus, dipaa u lye!”
Ndele Petrus okwa tya: “Alala, Omwene, noshito inandi lya nande osha inashi yapulwa nosha nyata.”
Ndele ondaka oye mu popifa lutivali: “Keshe eshi Kalunga e shi yapula, ove ino shi tya osha nyata.”
Ndele osho sha ningwa lutatu, opo nee oshikwatelwa osha kufwa po nosha shililwa meulu divadiva.
Ndelenee Petrus okwa li a limbililifwa kemoniko eli a mona kutya, otali ti ngahelipi, ndele tala, ovalumenhu venya va tumwa kuKornelius nokupula eumbo laSimon, ova fikama poshivelo.
Ndele va pula mokule, Simon ou a ifanwa yo Petrus, ngeenge omo e li.
Ndele Petrus eshi a li ta diladila emoniko olo, Omhepo ya tya kuye: “Tala, oku na ovalumenhu vatatu tave ku pula,
hano fikama paife, u londoloke, ove u ye pamwe navo, ino limbililwa, osheshi aame nde va tuma.”
Ndele Petrus okwa londoloka ndele ta i kovalumenhu venya, ndele ta ti: “Aame ou tamu kongo. Oshike hano she mu eta oku?”

Ndele vo ova tya: “Omunefele Kornelius, omulumenhu omuyuki nomutilikalunga, ou ta fimanekwa koshiwana ashishe shaJuda, okwa lombwelwa komweengeli muyapuki memoniko, e ku ifane u ye keumbo laye, a ude eshi u shi kwete shokupopya.”
Opo nee ye e va ifana meumbo ndele e va pakela po. Ndele mefiku lomongula Petrus okwa fikama ndele ta i pamwe navo; navakwao vamwe vomuJoppa va enda pamwe naye.
Mefiku la shikula ova fika muKesarea, naKornelius okwa hangika e va teelela, nokwa ifana ko vakwao nookaume kaye.
Ndele Petrus eshi a li pokuuya mo, Kornelius okwa ya e ke mu shakeneke, ta tu eengolo keemhadi daye ndele e linyongamena kuye.
Ndelenee Petrus okwe mu fikameka, ndele ta ti: “Fikama, naame yo omunhu.”
Ndele mokukundafana naye okwa ya mo ndele ta hange mo vahapu va li mo va ongala.
Ndele ye okwa tya kuvo: “Nye omu shi shii Omujuda okwa dilikwa okweendafana nomunailongo nokuya kuye. Ndele Kalunga okwa ulikila nge, ndiha tye nande komunhu, ye ina yapulwa ile ye ina koshoka.
Opo nee nda shikula eifano eli, ndihe na okwaanya, nopaife handi mu pula: Omwa ifanena nge shike?”

Ndele Kornelius okwa tya: “Opa pita omafiku ane, pefimbo tuu ngaashi eli, opotundi onhimugoi, ame onda li handi ilikana meumbo lange, ndele tala, omulumenhu a djala oshikutu sha vilima, a kala ofika pwaame,
ndele ta ti: ‘Kornelius, eilikano loye ola udika noikwafa yoye oya dimbulukiwa koshipala shaKalunga.
Hano tuma ko paife kuJoppa, u ifane kwoove Simon, ou a ifanwa yo Petrus, ye omweenda meumbo laSimon omushiki woipa pomunghulo wefuta. Nge e uya, ote ku lombwele.’
Opo nee onda endelela oku ku tumina elaka, ndele ove owa ninga nawa, eshi we uya po, nopaife ofyeni atusheni otu li apa koshipala shaKalunga, fye tu ude ko adishe odo we di lombwelwa kOmwene.”
Ndele Petrus okwa makula okanya kaye ta ti: “Paife ondi shi shii shili, Kalunga iha tale omunhu kombada.
Ndele moshiwana keshe, keshe ou he mu tila ndele ta diinine ouyuki, ote mu wapalele.
Eendjovo odo e di tumina ovana vaIsrael noku va udifila eenghundana diwa dombili yomuJesus Kristus, ou Omwene waaveshe,
eendjovo tuu odo da tandavela muJudea ashishe, okuhovela muGalilea konima yeshasho olo la udifilwa kuJohannes, onye mu di shii.

Mu shi shii, Jesus Omunasareti, Kalunga nhumbi e mu vaekifa Omhepo Iyapuki neenghono, Ye ta endaenda, ta longo ouwa ndele a velula aveshe venya va li mepangelo laSatana, osheshi Kalunga okwa li pamwe naye.
Ndele ofye ava eendobwedi daai aishe e i longa medu lOvajuda nomuJerusalem; Oye ou ve mu valela komuti ndele ve mu dipaa.
Oye tuu ou Kalunga okwe mu nyumuna mefiku etitatu ndele e mu efa e liholole, Ye mwene,
hakoshiwana ashishe, ndelenee okufye ava eendobwedi daye ngaashi Kalunga e tu hoolola nale, ofye ava twa lile ndele twa nwine pamwe naye, eshi a nyumuka movafi.
Ndele Ye okwe tu lombwela, tu udifile ovanhu noku va hepaululila Oye tuu ou Kalunga e mu ninga omutokoli wovanamwenyo nowovafi.
Oye tuu ou ovaxunganeki vonale ve mu hepaulula nokutya: Keshe ou te mu itavele ota mono edimepo lomatimba medina laye.”
Opo nee Petrus fimbo a popya eendjovo odo, Omhepo Iyapuki ya kulukila mwaava aveshe va pwilikina eendjovo odo.
Ndele ovaitaveli vometanda ava va li va enda pamwe naPetrus, ova kumwa, oshali yOmhepo Iyapuki eshi ya tililwa nomovapaani yo.
Osheshi ve va uda tava popi omalaka ndele tava hambelele Kalunga. Opo nee Petrus okwa tya:
“Oku na tuu mbela ou ta dulu oku va anyena eshasho lomeva, ava va pewa Omhepo Iyapuki ngaashi fye yo?”
Ye okwa lombwela, va shashelwe medina laJesus Kristus. Opo nee vo ove mu indila, a menekele puvo omafiku amwe.
11: Ndele ovayapostoli novamwatate vomuJudea ashishe ova uda kutya ovapaani yo va tambula eendjovo daKalunga.
Opo nee Petrus eshi e uya muJerusalem, ava vometanda ove mu vela ombedi,
ndele tava ti: “Ove owa ile kovalumenhu inava pita etanda, nowa lya pamwe navo.”
Ndele Petrus okwa hovela oku va hepaululila oinima aishe ngaashi ya shikulafana ndele ta ti:

“Ame eshi nda li moshilando shaJoppa nda li nda ilikana, nonda fya ombabanghukuta nonda mona emoniko: oshikwatelwa ngaashi elakana linene litoka la mangwa keembinga dalo nhee, la dja meulu, ndele la kulukifilwa poshi, le uya kwaame.
Ndele ame eshi nde li mona nonde li tala onda mona mo oinamwenyo yomaulu ane yokombada yedu, noilyani naai hai lipweda, needila dokeulu,
ndele nda uda yo ondaka tai ti kwaame: ‘Fikama Petrus, dipaa ove u lye.’
Ndele ame onda tya: ‘Alala Omwene, osheshi pehovelo nofiyo onena mokanya kange inamu ya nande osha inashi yapulwa nosha nyata.’
Ndele ondaka yomeulu oya popya lutivali: ‘Eshi Kalunga e shi yelifa, ove ino tya osha nyata.’
Ndele eshi osha ningwa lutatu, ndele ashishe sha shililwa vali meulu.
Ndele tala, opo tuu opo ovalumenhu vatatu va fikama poshivelo sheumbo olo twa li, va dja kuKesarea, va tumwa nge.
Ndele Omhepo ya lombwela nge, ndi ye pamwe navo, ndiha limbililwe, ongaashi vakwetu ava vahamano va enda pamwe naame, notwa ya mo meumbo lomulumenhu winya.
Ndele ye okwe tu hepaululila nhumbi a mona omweengeli, e li ofika meumbo laye ta ti: ‘Tuma ko kuJoppa, ove u ka ifane Simon, ou a ifanwa yo Petrus,
Ye ote ku hepaululile eendjovo odo tadi ku xupifa, oove mwene neumbo loye alishe.’
Ndele ame eshi nda hovela okupopya, Omhepo Iyapuki okwa kulukila muvo, ngaashi mufye yo pehovelo.
Ndele ame nda dimbulukwa eendjovo dOmwene, eshi e di tile: ‘Johannes a shasha nomeva, ndele nye otamu ka shashwa nOmhepo Iyapuki,’
opo nee paife Kalunga eshi e va pa oshali i fike pwaai twa pewa yo eshi twa itavela Omwene Jesus Kristus, hano aame omushike ngeno okwaanya Kalunga?”
Ndele vo eshi ve shi uda, ove limwenenena, tava hambelele Kalunga tava ti: “Osho ngaha Kalunga okwa yandja nokovapaani yo elidilululo lokumona omwenyo.”
Hano venya va li va halakanifwa komahaulo enya a hovela muStefanus, vo ova endaenda fiyo okuFoinikia nokuKipro nokuAntiokia, ndele vo inava hepaululila vamwe eendjovo odo, Ovajuda aveke.
Ndele mokati kavo omwa li mu na yo ovalumenhu vamwe Ovakipro nOvakireni, vo eshi ve uya kuAntiokia, ova hepaululila nOvaheleni yo, ndele ve va udifila evaengeli lOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Ndele eke lOmwene la kala pamwe navo ndele omuvalu waava va itavela nove liameka kOmwene owa li munene.
Ndele eudifo lavo ola fika momatwi eongalo lomuJerusalem, nova tuma Barnabas fiyo okuAntiokia.
Ye eshi a fika ko, ndele ta mono onghenda yaKalunga, okwa hafa ndele te va kumaida aveshe va kale mOmwene noku mu diinina momitima davo.
Osheshi oye omulumenhu muwa, e yadi Omhepo Iyapuki neitavelo, nomuvalu wovanhu vOmwene owa hapupala neenghono.
Ndele Barnabas okwa ya kuTarso, a ka tale Saulus, naashi e mu mona, okwe mu eta muAntiokia.
Ndele omo va kala pamwe meongalo eli omudo aushe, novanhu vahapu va longwa kuvo; muAntiokia omo ovalongwa va ifanwa lwotete Ovakriste.
Ndele momafiku enya muJerusalem omwa dja ovaxunganeki ve uya kuAntiokia.
Ndele umwe womuvo, edina laye Agabus, okwa fikama ndele ta xunganeke mOmhepo Iyapuki, ondjala idjuu tai ke uya kombada yedu alishe; osho ye uya yo mounyuni womukesari Klaudius.
Opo nee ovalongwa aveshe va pangela omhangela okuyandja oikwafa, keshe ou shi fike peenghono daye, i tuminwe ovamwatate venya ve li muJudea.
Nove shi ninga yo ndele ve i tuma kovakulunhu momake aBarnabas naSaulus.
12: Ndele momafiku enya ohamba Herodes okwa kwatifa ovakwaneongalo vamwe, e va hepeke.
Ndele okwa dipaifa Jakob, omumwaina waJohannes, neongamukonda.
Naashi a mona nokutya, Ovajuda ove shi panda, okwa kwatifa vali Petrus momafiku omingome dinyenye.

Ye eshi e mu kwata, okwe mu tula modolongo, nokwe mu yandja a diininwe keengudu nhee dovakwaita, mongudu keshe ovakwaita vane oku mu kelela, ndele okwa li a hala oku mu eta koshipala shoshiwana, Opaasa ngeenge ya piti.
Osho ngaha Petrus fimbo a nangelwa modolongo, eongalo le mu ilikanena kuKalunga, inali dimbuka.

Ndele moufiku winya, wa tetekela efiku olo Herodes a hala oku mu eta moipafi, Petrus okwa li a kofa pokati kovakwaita vavali, a mangwa nomalyenge avali, novakeleli va li va kelela poshivelo shodolongo.
Ndele tala, omweengeli wOmwene okwa kala ofika puye, nouyelele wa minikila modolongo, omweengeli okwa twa Petrus molupati, e mu pendula, ta ti: “Fikama diva!” Omalyenge a wa ko komaoko aye.
Ndele omweengeli okwe mu lombwela: “Lidika, ove u lidjaleke eenghaku; ye okwe shi ninga.” Omweengeli okwa tya kuye: “Djala elwakani ove u shikule nge!”
Ndele ye okwa dja mo ndele te mu shikula, ndele okwa li ehe shii ngeenge osho sha ningwa komweengeli oshoshili, ile pamwe okwa mona ashike emoniko.

Ndele eshi va koyelela etanganangelo lotete netivali, ove uya koshivelo shoshivela shokuya moshilando. Eshi oshe liyeulula shoovene, nova ya pondje tava ende nondjila imwe. Ohaluka, omweengeli okwa dja po puye.
Opo nee Petrus eshi a pukuluka okwa tya: “Paife onde shi shiiva shili, Omwene okwa tumina nge omweengeli waye, nokwa xupifa nge meke laHerodes nokwaaishe ei oshiwana shOvajuda she i teelela.”
Ndele ye eshi a pukuluka okwa ya keumbo laMaria, ina yaJohannes, ou ta ifanwa yo Markus, omo mwa ongala vahapu tava ilikana.
Ndele Petrus eshi a konghola koshivelo shokomukala, omupiya okakadona, edina laye Rode, okwe uya po a ka pule kutya olyelye e li ko.
Ndele eshi a koneka ondaka yaPetrus, omolwehafo ina patulula oshivelo, okwa tondokela mo, a ka tye: oPetrus e li poshivelo.
Ndelenee vo ova tya kuye: “Ove oto yadauka.” Ye okwa diinina odo tuu odo. Vo ova tya: “Shapu omweengeli waye.”
Ndele Petrus okwa twikila okukonghola, hano eshi va yeulula, ove mu mona, nova kumwa.

Ndelenee ye okwe va anda ko neke laye, va mwene, nokwe va hepaululila nhumbi Omwene e mu pitifa mo modolongo ndele ta ti: “Eshi shi lombweleni Jakob novamwatate.” Ndele okwa pita mo ndele ta i kumwe ku lili.
Ndele eshi kwa sha movakwaita omwa kala epiyaano lihe fi linini, nova li vehe shii Petrus nhumbi a ninga.
Ndele Herodes eshi a tuma ko, e mu etelwe ye ine mu mona, okwa hokololifa ovakeleli ndele e va yandja va handukilwe. Ye mwene okwa dja mo muJudea ndele ta i kuKesarea ndele ta kala ko.

Ndele Herodes okwa li a handukila Ovatirus nOvasidoni, ndele vo ova pangela omhangela ve uye kuye, ndele tava pange oukaume naBlastus, elenga lakula lohamba, ndele tava indile ombili, osheshi oshilongo shavo osha li sha mona oipalwifa koshilongo shohamba.
Ndele mefiku la ufwa Herodes okwa djala oshikutu shouhamba ndele ta kala omutumba kolukalwapangelo ndele te va popifa.
Opo nee ovanhu ova ingida pombada tava ti: “Ondaka ei oyaKalunga, kai fi yomunhu.”
Ndele opo tuu opo omweengeli wOmwene e mu denga, osheshi ye ina fimaneka Kalunga, omainyo e mu tuka ndele ye ta fi.
Ndele eendjovo dOmwene oda tana noda tandavela.
Barnabas naSaulus ova aluka kuJerusalem, ndele tava fikifa oikwafa, ndele tava di ko naJohannes, ou ha ifanwa yo Markus.
13: Ndele meongalo lomuAntiokia omwa li ovaxunganeki novalongindjovo Barnabas naSimeon a lukwa Nigeri naLukius Omukireni, naManahen, ou a tekulilwa pamwe naHerodes, omupangeli woshitine, naSaulus.
Ndele fimbo tava ningi elongelokalunga lokulongela Omwene nove lidilika eendja, Omhepo Iyapuki oya tya kuvo: “Yoololelei nge Barnabas naSaulus va ka longe oshilonga osho nde shi va ifanena.”
Ndele eshi ve lidilika eendja ndele tava ilikana, ve va tenheka omake nove va lekela.
Hano ava ngaashi va tumwa kOmhepo Iyapuki, ova ya kuSeleukia, ndele oko nee va dja, tava yauka, ndele tava i kuKipro.
Ndele eshi va fika kuSalamis, ova udifa eendjovo daKalunga meeshinagoga dOvajuda; vo va li naJohannes, omuyakuli wavo.
Ndele eshi va endaenda onhunhu ei aishe fiyo omuPafo, ova hanga mo omhule, omuxunganeki omunaipupulu, Omujuda, edina laye Barjesus.
Ye okwa li ha kala pomupangeli wonhunhu Sirgius Paulus, ou a li omulumenhu omunaendunge, nokwa ifana Barnabas naSaulus, a hala okuuda eendjovo daKalunga.
Ndele omhule ei Elimas, osheshi osho edina laye tali lundululwa, okwe va twila ondubo a hala okulimbilika omupangeli aha itavele.
Ndele Saulus, ou a lukwa Paulus, mokuyadifwa Omhepo Iyapuki okwe mu tala nokutongolola
ndele ta ti: “Omona waSatana ove, ou yadi oihelele noukolokoshi keshe, ove omutondi wouyuki aushe, ito efa nande okupengifa eendjila da yuka dOmwene.
Ndele paife eshi, tala, eke lOmwene oli li kombada yoye, ndele to twika uha mone etango omafiku amwe.” Opo tuu opo omulaulu fokofoko owe mu tuvikila, ye ta pumauka ta kongo ou te mu kwata komhango.
Opo nee omupangeli eshi a mona osho sha ningwa po, okwa itavela ndele a kuminwa omalongo Omwene.
Ndele Paulus naava va li pamwe naye, eshi va dja muPafo, ova yauka vali, va ya kuPerge shomuPamfilia, oko Johannes okwa tukuka navo, ndele okwa shuna kuJerusalem.
Ndelenee vo ova dja muPerge ndele tava ehene ko, va fika kuAntiokia shomuPisidia nomefiku lEshabata ova ya moshinagoga ndele tava kala omutumba.
Ndele omhango novaxunganeki eshi ya leshwa, oovene voshinagoga ova tuma kuvo ndele tava ti: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, ngeenge mu nondjovo yekumaido yokulombwela ovanhu, popyeni hano.”

Opo nee Paulus a fikama ndele e va mweneka neke ndele ta ti:
“Ovalumenhu nye Ovaisraeli, nanye vamwe hamu tila Kalunga, pwilikineni!
Kalunga ou koshiwana eshi shaIsrael okwa hoolola ootate, noshiwana eshi shetu e shi lenga fimbo va kala ovanailongo medu laEgipiti ndele te va pitifa mo nokwooko kwaye kwa yeluka.
Ndele okwe lididimikila eenghedi davo mombuwa efimbo li fike lwopomido omilongo ine,
ndele okwa nyona po oiwana iheyali ya kala medu laKaanan, nedu lavo okwe li va tukulila efyuululo.
Ndele eshi sha ningwa mefimbo li fike lwopomido omafele ane nomido omilongo itano. Ye okwe va pa ovapangelitokoli fiyo okomuxunganeki Samuel.
Ndele opo nee vo ve lihalela ohamba, ndele Kalunga okwe va pa Saul, omona waKis, omulumenhu womepata laBenjamin. Osho ngaha pa pita omido omilongo ine.

Ndele eshi ye e mu shundula, okwe va tumbila David, a ninge ohamba, ngaashi Ye e mu tonga, ta ti: ‘Ame onda mona David, omona waIsai, omulumenhu nde mu hokwa komutima wange, ndele ye ota wanifa ehalo lange alishe.’
Omoludalo laau, Kalunga okwa pendulila Israel Omukulili Jesus, ngaashi e shi udaneka,
Oye eshi a holoka, okwa hanga Johannes ta udifile oshiwana ashishe shaIsrael eshasho lelidilululo.
Ndele pokuxulifa okweenda kwaye, Johannes okwa tya: ‘Aame haame ou tamu diladilile nge, tala, ohandi shikulwa kwaau, inandi wana okuditula nande omiya deenghaku dokeemhadi daye.’
“Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, onye ovana vomoludalo laAbraham, nanye ava vamwe hamu tila Kalunga, fye otwa tuminwa ondjovo yexupifo eli.
Osheshi Ovajerusalem novakulunhu vavo eshi inava koneka Jesus, omoku mu tokola, va wanifa yo eendjovo dovaxunganeki, edi hadi leshwa keshe Eshabata.
Ndele nande inava mona mo muye etimba lokufya, ova indila Pilatus e mu yandje a dipawe.
Ndele eshi va wanifa ngaha omishangwa adishe de mu popya, ove mu kufa ko komuti nove mu nangeka mombila.
Ndelenee Kalunga okwe mu nyumuna movafi.
Ndele momafiku mahapu e lihololela venya va dile kuGalilea ve uya pamwe naye kuJerusalem, nopaife ovo eendobwedi mokati kovanhu.
Hano fye ohatu mu udifile eenghundana diwa nokutya, eudaneko linya Kalunga e li pa ootate,

okwe li wanifila ovana, ofye tuu ava, eshi e tu nyumunina Jesus. Ngaashi mwa shangwa mEpsalome etivali:
‘Oove Omona wange,
onena eli nde ku dala.’

Ndele eshi e mu nyumuna movafi, Oye ke na vali okushuna mefyo, mokupopya ota ti:
‘Ohandi ke mu pa omapuniko mayapuki a pama aDavid.’

Opo nee ta popi yo monhele imwe:
‘Omuyapuki woye ito efa a mone eolelo.’
Osheshi David eshi a longele ehalo laKalunga pefimbo laye, okwa kofa, ndele okwa ongelwa pooxekulu, ndele okwa mona eolelo.
Ndelenee ou a nyumunwa kuKalunga ina mona eolelo.
Opo nee hano ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, kaleni mu shi shii, omolwaau nye otamu udifilwa ekufilepo lomatimba.
Ndele moinima ei aishe mwa nyengwa okuyukipalifwa komhango yaMoses, omwaau keshe ou ta itavele, ota ningi omuyuki.
Litaleni hano, muha hangike kwaashi sha popiwa kovaxunganeki:

‘Taleni onye ovadini,
mu kumwe, nye mu nyonauke po,
osheshi ame ohandi longo oshilonga shimwe
momafiku aa eni,
heeno, oshilonga eshi, ngeno mu shi lombwelwe,
itamu shi itavele.’ ”
Ndele vo eshi va dja mo moshinagoga, ova indilwa va hepaulule eendjovo edi nomEshabata tali uya.
Ndele eshi va dja mo moshinagoga nova hanauka, Ovajuda vahapu novatilikalunga ova shikula Paulus naBarnabas, ndele ava ove va longa nove va kumaida okukala monghenda yaKalunga.
Ndele mEshabata la shikula hanga oshilando ashishe sha ongala okuuda eendjovo daKalunga.
Ndele Ovajuda eshi va mona eengudu dovanhu, ova yada ondubo unene, nova twifa Paulus eemhata ndele va sheka eendjovo daye.

Opo nee Paulus naBarnabas ova popya nouladi tava ti: “Onye tuu ava mu nokuudifilwa tete eendjovo daKalunga; ndele nye eshi tamu di kandula po, nomwe litala inamu wapala okuya momwenyo waalushe, hano taleni, ohatu liameke kovapaani.

Osheshi osho ngaha Omwene e tu lombwela:
‘Ame nde ku tula po ouyelele wovapaani,
u ninge exupifo fiyo okominghulo dedu.’ ”
Ndele ovapaani eshi ve shi uda, ova hafa nova fimaneka eendjovo daKalunga, nova ninga ovaitaveli, aveshe ava va nuninwa okuya momwenyo waalushe.
Ndele eendjovo dOmwene oda tandavela moshikandjo ashishe.
Ndele Ovajuda ova hongaula ovakainhu ovanamadina ovatilikalunga novalumenhu ovafimanekwa moshilando, va pendulila Paulus naBarnabas ehaulo, ndele tave va te mo moikandjo aishe yavo.
Opo nee ove va pupulile ondwi yokeemhadi davo nova ya kuIkonium.
Ndele ovalongwa ova yadifwa ehafo nOmhepo Iyapuki.
14: Ndele osho sha ningwa yo muIkonium; vo ova ya moshinagoga yOvajuda nova udifa neenghono, nongudu inene yOvajuda noyOvagreka oya ninga ovaitaveli.
Ndele Ovajuda ava inava itavela, ova hongaifa ovapaani ndele va twifa ondubo ovamwatate.
Ndele vo ova ningile ko omafiku tava udifa nouladi mokulineekela Omwene, ou a pameka eendjovo donghenda yaye, eshi a longifa omake avo omadidilikolonga noikumwifalonga.
Ndele ovanhu vomoshilando ova tukauka, vamwe va ama kOvajuda, vamwe okovayapostoli.
Ndelenee ovapaani nOvajuda pamwe novakulunhu vavo ova pangela omhangela oku va hepeka noku va dipaa nomamanya,
opo nee vo eshi ve shi koneka, ova ya onhapo koilando ei yaLikaonia, omuListra omuDerbe nomoushiinda wayo.
Ndele oko va udifila evaengeli.
Ndele muListra omwa li mu nomulumenhu a kala omutumba, osheshi ye a li ehe neenghono momaulu aye, ye okwa dalwa oshingudu, ina enda nande.
Ye okwa pwilikina eendjovo daPaulus. Paulus eshi e mu tala, ndele oku wete kutya, oku na eitavelo okuvelulwa,
okwe mu lombwela nondaka inene: “Kala ofika neemhadi doye!” Opo nee ye a yambuka po ndele ta ende.
Ndele ongudu eshi ya mona eshi sha ningwa kuPaulus, oya yelula ondaka pombada, ya popya Oshilikaonia, tai ti: “Ookalunga ove lifefa ovanhu nove uya kufye.”
Ndele vo ova luka Barnabas Zeus, naPaulus oHermes, osheshi oye a li ta popi.
Nomupristeli waZeus, otembeli yaye oya kala popepi noshilando, nokwa eta eehove noidingwa yeenhemo poivelo, ve nongudu yovanhu va hala oku va yambela.
Ndelenee ovayapostoli Paulus naBarnabas, eshi ve di uda, ova pombaula oikutu yavo, tava tondokele mokati kovanhu nokwiingida,

tava ti: “Ovalumenhu nye, oshike tamu ningile ngaha? Nafye yo ovanhu ngaashi nye, ndele hatu mu udifile evaengeli, opo mu lidilulule, nye mu efe oikalunga ei yongaho, nye mu alukile kuKalunga omunamwenyo ou a shita eulu nedu, nefuta nakeshe eshi shi li mo.
Omounyuni wonale okwa efa oiwana aishe i ende neendjila dayo vene.
Nande Ye ina kala nande ine liholola, osheshi okwe mu monifila ouwa, eshi e mu lokifila odula meulu nokwe mu pa omafimbo oshishipo nokwa yadifa omitima deni oipalwifa nehafo.”
Ndele mokupopya oinima ei ova kelela eengudu dovanhu noudjuu, vehe va yambele.
Ndele omwe uya Ovajuda, va dja kuAntiokia nokuIkonium, vo ove lishilila ongudu yovanhu, ndele va kupula Paulus nomamanya ndele ove mu kokolola mo moshilando, nova li ve shii okwa fya.
Ndelenee ovalongwa eshi ve mu ongalela, ye okwa penduka po, ndele okwa ya moshilando. Nefiku lomongula okwa ya kuDerbe pamwe naBarnabas.
Ndele vo eshi va udifila moshilando shinya evaengeli, naashi va likola ko ovalongwa vahapu, ova shuna kuListra nokuIkonium nokuAntiokia.
Ndele ova pameka eemwenyo dovalongwa, ndele ve va kumaida okudiinina eitavelo, tava ti: “Mokuya mouhamba waKalunga otu nokupitila moudjuu uhapu.”
Ndele eshi ve va hoololela ovakulunhu meongalo keshe, mokwiilikana nomokulidilika eendja ove va yandja kOmwene ou ve mu itavela.
Ndele eshi va pitila muPisidia ova ya kuPamfilia,
ndele eshi va udifa eendjovo muPerge, ova ya kuAtalia.
Ndele oko nee va yauka nova ya kuAntiokia, oko va dile va lekelwa nonghenda yaKalunga, va ka longe oshilonga eshi ve shi wanifa.
Ndele eshi va fika ko, ova ifana eongalo, ndele tave li hepaululile oilonga opo i fike Kalunga e i longa, eshi Ye a kala pamwe navo, nonhumbi a yeululila ovapaani oshivelo sheitavelo.
Ndele vo ova menekela mo omafiku pamwe novalongwa.
15: Ndele muJudea omwa dja vamwe ve uya oku, vo ova longa ovamwatate tava ti: “Ngeenge itamu piti etanda panghedi yaMoses, itamu dulu okuxupifwa.”

Hano eshi pwa holoka eenhamanana, Paulus naBarnabas va patafana navo, opa pangelwa omhangela nokutya, Paulus naBarnabas noovakwao vamwe vomokati kavo nava ye kovayapostoli nokovakulunhu kuJerusalem omolwepulo olo la twilwa eemhata.
Ndele vo ova findikilwa keongalo ndele va pitila muFoinikia nomuSamaria omo va hepaulula elidilululo lovapaani, nova hafifa ovamwatate.
Ndele eshi va fika muJerusalem, ova kundwa keongalo nokovayapostoli nokovakulunhu, nove va hepaululila oilonga aishe ya longwa kuKalunga, eshi a li pamwe navo.
Ndele vamwe vomoshimhanga shOvafarisai, ovo va li va ninga ovaitaveli, ova fikama ndele tava ti: “Vo ove nokupita etanda nokulombwelwa va diinine omhango yaMoses.”
Ndele ovayapostoli novakulunhu ova ongala, va ka kundafane oshinima eshi.

Ndele eemhata eshi da ya pombada, Petrus okwa kala ofika ndele ta ti kuvo: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, nye omu shi shii, momafiku onale Kalunga a hoolola mokati ketu okanya kange, opo ovapaani va ude evaengeli, ndele va ninge ovaitaveli.
Ndele Kalunga omushiivi womitima, okwe va hepaulula nawa eshi e va pa Omhepo Iyapuki ngaashi nafye yo.
Ndele Ye ina ninga nande etongolo pokati ketu navo, eshi a yelifa omitima davo neitavelo.
Hano paife oshike tamu shindi Kalunga, eshi mwa hala okutwika keefingo dovalongwa ondjoko ya li ya nyenga ootate nafye yo noku i humbata.
Ndelenee twa itavela hatu ka xupifwa konghenda yOmwene Jesus, ngaashi venya yo.”
Ndele oshiongalele ashishe osha mwena ndele ova pwilikina Paulus naBarnabas, eshi va hepaulula omadidilikolonga noikumwifalonga opo i fike, Kalunga e i va longifa mokati kovapaani.
Ndele eshi va dimbuka okupopya, Jakob ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, pwilikinei nge.
Simeon okwa hepaulula Kalunga nhumbi a ninga eshi a hovela okulilikolelela edina laye mwene oshiwana movapaani.
Ndele eshi osha twa kumwe neendjovo dovaxunganeki, osheshi opa shangwa ngaha:

‘Konima yaai Ame ohandi aluka vali,
ndele handi ka tungulula onduda yaDavid, ya teka po,
Ame ohandi i tungulula,
noikulukuma yayo ohandi i dikulula,

opo oixupe yovanhu va konge Omwene
novapaani aveshe venya va ifanenwa edina lange,
Omwene tuu ou ta ningi aishe ei, osho ta ti.

Kalunga okwa shiiva oilonga yaye aishe
okehovelo lomafimbo ounyuni.’ ”
Onghee hano omadiladilo ange oyaa: “Ava vomoupaani, ngeenge tava alukile kuKalunga, inava twikwa oudjuu,
ndele nava ka shangelwe okulidilika kutya, vo ove nokulidilika ei ya kwatafana nonyata yoikalunga nohole yoipala nombelela ya fya oshuunguungu nohonde.
Osheshi Moses e novaudifi vaye noshito nale omoilando aishe, ngaashi omishangwa daye tadi leshwa meeshinagoga omashabata aeshe.”

Ndele ovayapostoli novakulunhu pamwe neongalo alishe ova udafana okuhoolola mokati kavo ovalumenhu, ve va tume kuAntiokia pamwe naPaulus naBarnabas, ovo ava: Judas, ou a ifanwa yo Barsabas, naSilas, ovo ovalumenhu va fimana mokati kovamwatate.
Ndele ve va shangela omushangwa tau ti ngaha: “Ofye ovayapostoli novakulunhu, ovamwaxo, ohatu mu kundu, onye ovamwatate vomovapaani omuAntiokia nomuSiria nomuKilikia.
Ofye eshi twa uda vamwe vomufye va ya, nande inatu va lombwela, nove mu limbilika neendjovo davo nove mu twika oudjuu keemwenyo deni nokutya, mu nokupita etanda nokudiinina omhango.
Hano omadiladilo etu eshi a ya kumwe, otwa udafana okuhoolola mo ovalumenhu tu va tume kunye pamwe novaholike vetu Barnabas naPaulus;
ovava va yandjela edina lOmwene Jesus Kristus eemwenyo davo.
Hano osho ngaha twa tuma Judas naSilas, ovo tave mu shiivifile oinima ei nomakanya avo.
Osheshi omhangela yOmhepo Iyapuki noyetu yo oyo ei, muha twikwe nande omutengi umwe. Oyo tuu ei aike ihe shii okweefiwa:
Nye mu lidilike keshe eshi sha yambelwa oikalunga, nohonde nombelela ya fya oshuunguungu, nohole yoipala. Ngeenge tamu yepa ei, otamu ningi nawa. Kaleni nawa!”
Osho hano va lekelwa, va ya kuAntiokia, ndele tava shivi eongalo nove li pa onhumwafo ei.
Ndele ava eshi ve i lesha, ova hafela ehekeleko eli.
Ndele Judas naSilas, osheshi ovo vene yo va li ovaxunganeki, ova kumaida ovamwatate neendjovo dihapu, nove va twa ouladi.
Ndele eshi va ninga mo omafiku, ovamwatate ove va lekela nombili, va ka shune kovatumi vavo.
Ndele Silas okwa tokola okukala puvo.
Ndele Paulus naBarnabas ova kala muAntiokia pamwe navamwe vahapu, tava longo ndele tava udifa eendjovo devaengeli lOmwene.
Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku, Paulus okwa lombwela Barnabas: “Tu yeni, tu shuneni koilando inya aishe, twa li twa udifila mo eendjovo dOmwene, tu ka tale ovamwatate nhumbi ve li.”
Opo nee Barnabas a hala okukufa Johannes, ou a lukwa Markus, va ye naye.
Ndelenee Paulus okwa diladila, inashi wapala okweenda pamwe naye, osheshi ye okwa li e ve liteeka muPamfilia nokwa anya okuya navo moshilonga.
Ndele ova handuka, ndele tava dukauka, Barnabas okwa kufa Markus nokwa yauka efuta ta i kuKipro.
Ndelenee Paulus okwa hoolola Silas. Ovamwatate eshi ve mu yandja monghenda yOmwene, okwa ya.
Ndele ye okwa pitila muSiria nomuKilikia nokwa pameka omaongalo.
16: Ndele okwe uya muDerbe nomuListra, ndele tala, oko okwa li ku nomulongwa, edina laye Timoteus, omona womukainhu omwiitaveli Omujuda, ndele xe okwa li Omugreka.
Ye okwa li a popiwa nawa kovamwatate ovo va kala muListra nomuIkonium.
Paulus okwa hala Timoteus a ende pamwe naye, ndele okwe mu kufa ndele te mu pitifa etanda omolwOvajuda ava va kala moilongo inya, osheshi aveshe ova li ve shii kutya xe Omugreka.
Ndele mokweendaenda kwavo moilando noilando, ove va pa oipango ei ya ufwa kovayapostoli nokovakulunhu vomuJerusalem, ve i diinine yo.
Ndele omaongalo a pamekwa meitavelo, nefiku keshe omuvalu wovakwaneongalo owa hapupala.
Ndele ova pitila moikandjo yaFrigia naGalatia, osheshi Omhepo Iyapuki Ye va kelela okuudifila ondjovo muAsia.
Ndele eshi ve uya popepi naMisia, ova li va hala okuya kuBitinia, ndelenee Omhepo yaJesus inai va efela ko.
Opo nee va pitilila po Misia nove uya kuTroas.
Ndele moufiku ou Paulus okwa mona emoniko: omulumenhu Omumakedonia e li ofika te mu indile, ta ti: “Yaukila oku, u uye kuMakedonia, u tu kwafe!”
Ndele eshi twa mona emoniko olo, otwa konga diva omhito tu ye kuMakedonia, osheshi paife otwa li tu shi shii, Kalunga e tu ifana ko, tu ke va udifile evaengeli.
Hano eshi twa dja mo muTroas, otwa yauka nokuyukilila kuSamotrake, mefiku lomongula otwe uya kuNeapolis,
nomokudja omo otwe uya kuFilippi, okoshilando shotete kombinga inya medu laMakedonia, osho oshitembukilwanhele. Moshilando eshi otwa ningile mo omafiku amwe.
Ndele mefiku lEshabata otwa pita moshivelo shoshilando notwa ya komulonga oko twa fekela oku na onhele yokwiilikana, notwa kala omutumba ndele twa popifa ovakainhu ava va ongalela ko.

Ndele omukainhu umwe, edina laye Lidia, omushingifi woiyata itilyana wokoshilando shaTiatira, omutilikalunga, okwa li ta pwilikine, ndele Omwene okwa yeulula omutima waye okutambula odo da tongwa kuPaulus.
Ndele ye eshi a shashwa pamwe novaneumbo laye aveshe, okwe tu indila ta ti: “Onye ngeenge tamu tale nge onda itavela Omwene, ileni hano meumbo lange nye mu kale mo.” Oye okwe tu fininika.
Ndele fimbo tu li mondjila yokuya konhele yokwiilikana, otwa shakenekwa komupiya okakadona e nomhepo youpule, nokwa longela oovene eliko linene mokuxunganeka kwaye.
Ye okwa li te tu shikula fye naPaulus, ndele ta popi pombada ta ti: “Ovalumenhu ava ovo ovamati vaKalunga, ou e li kombada yaaishe, vo otave mu hepaululile ondjila yexupifo.”

Ndele eshi e shi ninga omafiku mahapu, ndele eshi sha lolola Paulus, ye okwa punguluka ndele ta lombwele omhepo: “Medina laJesus Kristus, ohandi ku lombwele: dja mo muye!” Oyo oya dja mo mokafimbo tuu oko.
Ndele oovene eshi va mona, elineekelo lokulikola kwavo la kana, ova kwata Paulus naSilas ndele ve va kokololela koshilandelo kovapangeli
nokovatokoli, ndele tava ti: “Ovanhu ava otava piyaanifa oshilando shetu. Ovo Ovajuda
ndele tave tu udifile eenghedi odo, fye itatu dulu oku di tambula noku di shikula, osheshi fye Ovaroma.”
Ndele ovanhu vomoshilando ove va hangakena, novatokoli ova pombaulifa oikutu yavo ndele tava lombwele, va dengifwe eeshokoto.
Ndele eshi ve va dengifa unene, ove va undulila modolongo nova lombwela omukeleli wodolongo e va nangele shili.
Eshi a lombwelwa ngaha, okwe va idilila modolongo yomeni ndele te va tula meti.
Ndele pokati koufiku Paulus naSilas ova ilikana ndele tava fimaneke Kalunga nomaimbilohambelelo, ovakwatwa ove va pwilikina.
Ndele opo tuu opo pa tukuluka ekakamo linene ledu, odolongo oya kakama fiyo okomakanghameno; ohaluka, oivelo aishe oya yeuluka nomalyenge aaveshe a dituluka.
Omukeleli wodolongo eshi a penduka okwa mona oivelo aishe yodolongo ya yeuluka, okwa pweya mo eongamukonda nokwa hala okulidipaa, osheshi okwa li e shii ovakwatwa aveshe ove livaka mo.
Ndele Paulus okwa popya mokule ta ti: “Ino liningila owii nande owasha, fye atushe omo tu li.”
Opo nee a indila omundilo nokwa tondokela mo, ndele a wila poshi keemhadi daPaulus naSilas;
e va pitifa mo ndele ta ti: “Oovene vange, ondi nokuninga ngahelipi ndi xupifwe?”
Vo ova tya: “Itavela Omwene Jesus Kristus, opo to ka xupifwa neumbo loye alishe.”
Ndele vo ove mu udifila eendjovo dOmwene naaveshe ava va li meumbo laye.
Ndele ye okwe va tambula mokafimbo tuu aka oufiku, a kosha oipute yavo; oye mwene novambulaye va shashwa diva.
Opo ye okwe va twala meumbo laye, okwe va pakela po ndele ta hafe, osheshi ye mwene neumbo laye alishe va ninga ovaitaveli vaKalunga.
Ndele ongula eshi kwa sha, ovatokoli ova tuma ko ovapiya vetokolo, ndele tava ti: “Efa ovanhu venya.”
Nomukeleli wodolongo okwa hepaululila Paulus eendjovo edi, ta ti: “Ovatokoli ova tuma ko ondaka mu efiwe. Djeni mo hano paife, nye mu ka ende nombili.”

Ndele Paulus ta ti kuvo: “Vo ove tu denga moipafi yovanhu, fimbo inave tu pwilikina, nande ofye Ovaroma, ndele ve tu idilila modolongo, ndelenee paife va hala ve tu te mo meholeko. Ahowe, ovo vene nave uye ve tu pitife mo.”
Ndele ovapiya vetokolo ova ka hepaululila ovapangeli eendjovo odo, ndele venya ova haluka eshi va uda ovo Ovaroma.
Vo ove uya ndele ve va popifa nombili, ove va pitifa mo ndele tave va indile va fiye po oshilando shavo.
Ndele eshi va dja modolongo ova ya keumbo laLidia, ndele va monafana novamwatate, nove va kumaida, ndele tava di po.
17: Eshi va pitila muAmfipolis nomuApollonia, vo ove uya muTessalonika, omo mwa li mu noshinagoga yOvajuda.
Ndele Paulus ngaashi a ika, okwa ya muyo nokwa kundafana navo omishangwa momashabata atatu,
nokwe va fatululila ndele te va ulikile mudo Kristus nhumbi kwa li e nokuhepekwa nokunyumuka koufi, ndele ta ti: “Jesus tuu ou, handi mu udifile, Oye Kristus.”
Ndele vamwe vomuvo ova itavela nova ama kuPaulus naSilas, nongudu inene oyomOvagreka ovatilikalunga novakainhu ovanamadina vahapu.

Ndele Ovajuda ova ninga efupandubo ndele tava shivi ovalumenhu vai poshilandelo ndele tava ngudumanifa ovanhu ndele tava dundakanifa oshilando; vo ova ongala peumbo laJason ve va konge mo nove va twale moipafi yovanhu.
Ndele vo eshi va nyengwa oku va mona, ova kokolola mo Jason novamwatate vamwe, nove va twala kovatokoli voshilando, ndele tava popi mokule, tava ti: “Ovapiyaaneki ava vounyuni aushe ve uya naamu yo;
ndele Jason ou okwe va idilila, naaveshe ava ohava nyono omhango yomukesari, eshi hava longo oku na ohamba imwe i lili nokutya, oJesus.”
Ndele ovanhu novatokoli vomoshilando eshi ve shi uda ova limbililwa.
Ndelenee omolwombabyona yaJason noyoovakwao eshi ve i pewa ove va efa.
Ndele diva moufiku tuu winya ovamwatate ova tuma Paulus naSilas kuBerea, naashi va fika mo, ova ya moshinagoga yOvajuda.

Ndele Ovajuda ava ova li ovanaendunge ve dule venya vokuTessalonika, ova tambula nohokwe eendjovo daKalunga, ndele tava konakona momishangwa omafiku aeshe, va tale, ei ve i lombwelwa, ngeenge oyoshili tuu.
Vahapu vomuvo ova ninga ovaitaveli nosho yo Ovagreka ovakainhu ovanamadina novalumenhu, ova li vahapu.
Ndelenee Ovajuda vomuTessalonika eshi va uda nokutya, eendjovo daKalunga da udifilwa muBerea kuPaulus, ve uya yo oko, va ka piyaanekifa ovanhu noku va twifa ondubo.
Opo nee ovamwatate ova tuma diva Paulus kefuta, ndelenee Silas naTimoteus ova kala po.
Ndele ovafindikili vaPaulus ove mu twala fiyo okuAtena, naashi va pewa ondaka, va lombwele Silas naTimoteus, ve uye divadiva kuye, ova ya.
Ndele Paulus fimbo a li te va teelele muAtena, omhepo yaye oya tukulukila muye, eshi a mona oshilando sha li shi yadi oiyelekela yoikalunga.
Ye okwa popya moshinagoga nOvajuda novatilikalunga nosho yo efiku keshe pomalandelo naavo va shakena naye.

Ndele ovafilosofi vamwe vomOvaepikuri novomOvastoa, ova twa eemhata naye, vamwe tava ti: “Omupopyaani ou okwa hala okupopya shike?” Noovakwao va tya: “Oye a fa omuhepaululi wookalunga vokoilongo, osheshi ye okwa li ta udifa Jesus nenyumuko laye.”
Ndele vo ove mu kufa po nove mu twala kuAreopagi ndele tava ti: “Otashi dulika tuu, tu shiive elongo olo lipe to li longo?
Osheshi ove wa tonga momatwi etu oinima tuhe i shii, hano fye otwa hala, tu i shiive oyashike ngeno.”
Ndele Ovaatena aveshe novanailongo ovo va kala mo ova li vehe nefimbo nande kushimwe, okupopya tuu nokupwilikina oinima ipe.
Ndele Paulus okwa kala ofika pokati kaAreopagi, ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovaatena, ondi mu wete onye ovaneitavelo novadiinini moinima aishe,

osheshi ame eshi nda endaenda nonda shipununa eenhele deni diyapuki, onda mona ko yo oaltari imwe i neshangelo eli: ‘Oyakalunga ina shiivika!’ Hano ou tamu mu fimaneke muhe mu shii, Oye ou, handi mu mu udifile.
Kalunga tuu ou a shita ounyuni noinima aishe i li mo, Oye Omwene weulu nowedu, Ye iha kala meetembeli da tungwa nomake.
Ngaashi iha yakulwa komake ovanhu, ongao ou a pumbwa sha ngeno, oye ha yandjele ovanhu aveshe omwenyo nomufudo noinima aishe.
Momunhu umwe okwa shita oiwana aishe yovanhu, opo i kale kombada yedu alishe, ndele okwe i yukifila nale omafimbo ayo neengaba dokukala kwayo,
opo va kale nokukonga Kalunga, va tale, ngeenge tava dulu okupamhadala fiyo okuye, noku mu mona, nande Oye ina kala kokule nafye nande olumwe,

osheshi
Muye tu li mo tu nomwenyo,
ndele hatu linyenganyenga, ndele hatu kala mo.
Ongaashi ovatoti voitevo ovakweni va tile:
‘Osheshi nafye yo oludi laye.’
Hano osheshi fye oludi laKalunga, inatu diladileni oukwakalunga u fe ngeno oshingoldo ile oshisiliveli ile emanya, efano la hongwa nounghulungu nokomayele omunhu.
Kalunga okwe lididimikila omafimbo enya okuhashiiva, ndele paife eshi ta lombwele ovanhu aveshe naakushe, ve nokulidilulula,
osheshi Ye e tu yukifila efiku lokutokola ounyuni, eshi te u tokolifa ouyuki komulumenhu tuu oo, Ye mwene okwe mu hoolola nokwe mu didilikila aveshe eshi e mu nyumuna koufi.”
Ndelenee vo eshi va uda enyumuko lovafi, vamwe ove mu sheka, ndele vamwe va tya: “Oinima ei otwa hala tu i udulule vali kwoove.”
Ndele Paulus okwa dja mo mokati kavo.
Ndele ovalumenhu vamwe va ama kuye, ndele va ninga ovaitaveli. Mokati kaava mwa li Dionisius, Omuareopagi nomukainhu umwe, edina laye Damaris noovakwao pamwe navo.
18: Ndele konima yoinima ei Paulus okwa dja mo muAtena ndele ta i kuKorinto.

Ndele okwa hanga mo Omujuda, edina laye Akwila, a dalelwa muPontus, opo a di kuItalia pamwe nomukainhu waye Priskila, osheshi omukesari Klaudius a tokola, Ovajuda aveshe va dje mo muRoma. Ndele Paulus okwa ya kuvo.
Ndele eshi a li a shiiva okulonga oilonga pamwe navo, shaashi ovo aveshe ova li ovatungi veefaila, okwa kala puvo ndele tava tungu eefaila.
Nakeshe tuu Eshabata okwa popya moshinagoga ndele ta itavelifa Ovajuda nOvagreka.
Ndele Silas naTimoteus eshi va dja kuMakedonia nove uya oku, Paulus okwa hangika ta longo ovanhu nouladi nokutomha Ovajuda nokutya Jesus Oye Kristus.
Ndelenee vo eshi ve di anya nove va sheka, okwa pupula oikutu yaye, ndele te va lombwele: “Ohonde yeni nai uye kombada yomitwe deni! Ame nghi nambedi. Paife eshi handi i kovapaani.”
Ndele okwa dja ko ndele ta i meumbo lomulumenhu ha tila Kalunga, edina laye Titus Justus, ongulu yaye ya li ya kwatafana noshinagoga.
Ndele Krispus, mwene woshinagoga, pamwe neumbo laye alishe okwa itavela Omwene, nOvakorinto vahapu vomwaava va li tava pwilikine ova itavela, ndele va shashwa.
Ndele oufiku memoniko Omwene okwa tya kuPaulus: “Ino tila, popya, ino mwena,
osheshi Ame ndi novanhu vahapu moshilando eshi.”
Ndele ye okwa kala mo odula imwe neehani 6, ta longo mokati kavo eendjovo daKalunga.
Ndele Gallion eshi a li omupangeli muAkaia, Ovajuda ova hangakena ndele va fikamena Paulus, ndele tave mu twala kolukalwatokolo,
ndele tava ti: “Ou ota hongaula ovanhu okufimaneka Kalunga konghedi i na ondubo nomhango.”
Ndele Paulus eshi a hala okupopya, Gallion ta ti kOvajuda: “Ovajuda nye, ngeno kwa popiwa okunyonauna ile oshilonga shoukolokoshi, ngeno onde lidiinikila oku mu pwilikina.
Ndele ngeenge mu neemhata nomapulo omolwomalongo nomolwomadina neemhango deni, oo aeshe onye mu noku a tokola, ame inandi hala okuninga omutokoli wado.”
Ndele ye okwe va taataa po polukalwatokolo.
Ndele vo aveshe ova nhukila mwene woshinagoga, Sostenes, ndele tave mu dengele polukalwatokolo, ndele Gallion okwa li ehe na ko nasha nasho.

Ndele Paulus eshi a kala ko omafiku, okwa lekela ovamwatate nokwa ya kuSiria pamwe naAkwila naPriskila, ndelenee ye okwe likululifa eexwiki daye dokomutwe muKenkrea, osheshi ye a hangika a ninga eudaneko.
Ndele ye okwa fika kuEfeso, nokwe va fiya ko. Ndele ye mwene okwa ya moshinagoga, ndele ta kundafana nOvajuda.
Ndele vo ove mu indila a kale puvo omafiku amwe, ndele ye ine va itavela.
Ndele okwa lekela ndele ta ti: “Ame inandi hala nande ndi kale ndihe li moshivilo shomuJerusalem, ndelenee Kalunga ngeenge e shi hala, ohandi alukile kunye.” Nokwa dja mo muEfeso a ka yauke.
Ndele eshi va helukila muKesarea, okwa ya kuJerusalem, ndele ta kundile po eongalo, ndele ta i kuAntiokia.
Ndele eshi a ninga mo omafiku, okwa fikama ndele ta endaenda noilando ngaashi ya shikulafana moikandjo yaGalatia naFrigia, nokupameka ovalongwa aveshe.
Ndele kuEfeso okwe uya Omujuda, edina laye Apollos, ou a dalelwa muAleksandria, omulumenhu omunongo mokupopya, ye okwa li omunaendunge womomishangwa.
Ye okwa li a longwa ondjila yOmwene, ndele mokupopya kwaye omhepo yaye ya xwama ndele ta hepaulula shili Jesus, ndele eshasho laJohannes olo alike a shiiva.
Ndele ye okwa hovela okupopya nouladi moshinagoga. Ndele Akwila naPriskila, eshi ve uya oku mu pwilikina, ove mu tambula, ndele ve mu longa noku mu shiivifila shili ondjila yaKalunga.
Ndele eshi a hala okutwikila kuAkaia, ovamwatate ove mu twa ouladi ndele va shangela ovalongwa vaakwinya ve mu tambule. Hano eshi a fika ko, okonghenda okwa kwafa unene ovo va itavela.
Osheshi ye okwa tomha neenghono eemhata dOvajuda moipafi, eshi e va ulikila momishangwa nokutya, Jesus Oye Kristus.
19: Ndele Apollos fimbo a li muKorinto, Paulus okwa li ta ende nokupitapita moilongo yokombada, ndele ta fiki muEfeso, ndele okwa hanga mo ovalongwa vamwe
nokwa pula kuvo: “Nye omwa pewa tuu Omhepo Iyapuki eshi mwa itavela?” Vo ove mu nyamukula, tava ti: “Fye inatu uda nandenande, ngeenge oku na Omhepo Iyapuki.”
Ndele okwe va pula: “Nye omwa shashwa neshasho lilipi?” Vo ve mu nyamukula: “Eshasho laJohannes.”
Opo nee Paulus ta ti: “Johannes okwa li ta shashe neshasho lelidilululo, eshi a lombwela ovanhu ve nokwiitavela ou te mu shikula, nokutya oJesus.”
Ndele vo, eshi ve di uda, ova shashelwa medina lOmwene Jesus.
Ndele Paulus eshi e va tenheka omake aye, Omhepo Iyapuki ye uya muvo, vo ova popya omalaka ndele tava xunganeke.
Ndele venya va li ve fike pomulongo navavali.
Ndele ye okwa ya moshinagoga nokwa popya navo nouladi omafiku e fike peehani nhatu, ndele ta kendabala oku va hepaululila oinima ei yomouhamba waKalunga.

Ndele vamwe eshi ve likukutika nova anya okwiitavela, tava sheke ondjila moipafi yovanhu, ye okwa dja po puvo, ndele ta tongola mo ovalongwa muvo, ndele okwa li ha popi keshe efiku mofikola yaTirannus.
Ndele eshi pa pita omido mbali, novanhu aveshe vomuAsia, nOvajuda nOvagreka, ova uda eendjovo dOmwene.
Ndele Kalunga okwa longifa yo Paulus oilonga inene yeenghono,
ngaashi yo eenashituke noitetahema yaye oya ka tenhekwa kovanaudu, noudu we va efa, neemhepo dii oda dja mo muvo.

Ndele eemhule dimwe Ovajuda ovaendaendi, va hetekela yo okutumbula edina lOmwene Jesus kombada yaava va li ve neemhepo dii, ndele tava ti: “Ame ohandi mu anifa medina lOmwene Jesus, ou ta udifwa kuPaulus.”
Mokati kaava ve shi ninga, omwa li ovana ovamati vaheyali vaSkeva, omupristeli omukulunhu wOvajuda,
ndele omhepo ii oye va nyamukula tai ti: “Jesus ondi mu shii, naPaulus ondi mu wete, ndele onye oolyelye?”
Nomunhu ou e nomhepo ii, okwe va nhukila ndele e va finda, ngaashi ou osho naawinya, vo ova puma mo meumbo olo ve li omalutu ongaho a tosholwa oipute.
Ndele eshi osha udika kwaaveshe muEfeso, kOvajuda nokOvagreka, ndele va kwatwa ketilo, nedina lOmwene Jesus ola fimanekwa pombada.
Ndele vahapu vomuvo va ninga ovaitaveli, nove uya okuhepaulula nokuholola oilonga yavo.

Ndele vahapu vomwaava va li va longifa oupule wavo, ova eta omishangwa davo doupule da ndubilwa onduba, ndele ve di xwika po moipafi yovanhu, nondado yado, eshi ya valulilwa kumwe, oya ninga oimaliwa oisiliveli yomayovi omilongo itano.
Hano osho ngaha eendjovo dOmwene oda kula noda pama noda holola eenghono dado.
Ndele ashishe osho eshi sha ningwa ko, Paulus e litokolela okupitila muMakedonia nomuAkaia nokuya kuJerusalem, ndele ta ti: “Ame nge nda di ko, ondi noku ka mona yo Roma.”
Ye okwa tuma ko ovakwafi vaye vavali, Timoteus naErastus muMakedonia, fimbo ye mwene ta kala efimbo limwe muAsia natango.
Ndele momafiku enya euyaano linene la tukulukila ondjila ei.

Osheshi omuhambwidi umwe woshisiliveli, edina laye Demetrius, ou ha hambula moshisiliveli omafano eetembeli daDiana (Artemis) e a likolifila ovalongi eenghulungu vakwao ovo ve mu longela eliko linene.
Ndele okwa ifana ava novalongi vakwao, va longa oshilonga osho, ndele ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye, omu shi shii eliko letu ola dja moilonga ei.

Ndele paife omu shi wete ndele hamu shi udu, Paulus ou nhumbi a ivalaleka, haamo omu muEfeso amuke, ndele nomuAsia alishe ndele ta hongaula ovanhu vahapu eshi ta ti: Oinima ei ya hongwa nomake kai fi ookalunga.

Hano paife oshiponga eshi oshi li popepi: hashilonga eshi shetu ashike sha nyika okudinika, ndelenee otembeli yakalungakadona Diana yakula, tai xutuka, nako vene yo taka kanifa etumbalo lako, oko tuu aka ka fimanekwa muAsia ashishe nomounyuni.”
Ndele vo eshi ve di uda, ova yada ehandu, va ingida mokule tava ti: “Omwene oove Diana wOvaefeso!”
Noshilando ashishe sha hovela okupiyaana, ndele ova lotokela kumwe kondabo youdano nova kokololela mo Gaius naAristarkus, Ovamakedonia, ava va enda pamwe naPaulus.
Ndele Paulus eshi a hala okuya mokati kovanhu, ovalongwa inave mu efa.
Novakulunhu vamwe vomuAsia ava va li ookaume kaye, ova tuma kuye, ndele tave mu indile, aha ye ko kondabo youdano.
Vo aveshe ova uyaana va popya, vamwe eshi novakwao shinya, osheshi ongudu aishe oya dundakana, navahapu ova li vehe shii eshi she va ongaleka ko.
Ndele mongudu omwa shililwa Aleksander, Ovajuda ve mu undula moipafi. Aleksander okwe va mweneka neke, a hala okulombwela ongudu eendjovo delipopilo.
Ndelenee vo eshi ve mu koneka nokutya, ye Omujuda, opo nee aveshe va hovela okwiingida mokule unene ngaashi okanya kamwe, ndele tava uyaana eetundi mbali, tava ti: “Omwene oove Diana wOvaefeso!”

Ndele hamushanga woshilando, eshi a li a mweneka ovanhu, ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovaefeso, oku na tuu nande oumwe ou ehe shii kutya oshilando shOvaefeso hashi pashukile otembeli inene yaDiana nefano laye la wile meulu?
Hano eshi shi li ngaha noshihe fi okutuwa eemhata, omu nokumwena muha longe osho inashi yuka.
Nye mwa eta apa ovanhu ava, vehe fi ovanyeki votembeli ile ovasheki vakalungakadona aka ketu.
Ngeenge hano Demetrius novalongi eenghulungu ve neemhata nomunhu, oku na omafiku okuhokololifa, novatokoli veendjovo oko ve li, nava ye hano va hokololifafane.
Ndelenee ngeenge mu neendjovo donhumba nodongadi dimwe di lili, odo odi nokutokolwa moshiongalele shoshiwana konghedi yoveta yoshilongo.
Osheshi oshinima eshi sha ningwa mefiku eli lonena, osha nyika oku tu pa etimba tu hokololifwe omolwondubo, nande inatu nyona sha, ndele fye itatu dulu okulipopila euyaano eli.”
Hano eshi a popya ngaha, oshiongalele osha hanauka nee.
20: Ndele euyaano olo eshi la mwena, Paulus okwa ifana ovalongwa, ndele eshi e va lombwela eendjovo dehekeleko, okwe va lekela ndele ta di po, ta i kuMakedonia.
Ndele eshi a tokola oikandjo aishe, ndele e va lombwela eendjovo dihapu domakumaido, okwe uya kuGreka.
Ndele okwa ninga ko eehani nhatu, nokwa hala a ka konde a ye kuSiria. NOvajuda eshi ve mu nangela, ye okwa tokola a shune nokupitila muMakedonia.
Ndele ovalumenhu ava va enda pamwe naye, ovo: Omuberea Sopater yaPirrus, nOvatessalonika Aristarkus naSekundus, Omuderbe Gaius, naTimoteus, novokuAsia: Tikikus naTrofimus.
Ovo ve tu tetekela, ndele ve tu teelela muTroas.
Ndele fye twa yauka okudja kuFilippi omafiku omungome munyenye eshi a pita, mefiku etitano otwe uya kuvo muTroas, omo twa menekela omafiku aheyali.
Ndele mefiku lotete loshivike, eshi twa li twa ongalela okutukula omungome, naPaulus ou a hala oku ka enda mefiku lomongula okwa popya navo, neendjovo daye okwe di twikila fiyo opokati koufiku.
Ndele mondjuwo yopombada omo twa li twa ongalela, omwa li mu neelamba dihapu.
