Ndele omunyasha umwe, edina laye Eutikus, okwa li omutumba pekende, okwa lolokela po keemhofi, Paulus eshi a popya efimbo lile, nomokukumuka okwa wa kondjuwo onhinhatu yokombada nokwa toolwa po a fya.
Opo nee Paulus okwa londolokela poshi, te liwilike kuye, e mu papatela ndele ta ti: “Inamu piyaana, omwenyo waye omo u li muye.”
Ndele ye okwa londa ko vali, ndele ta tukula omungome, ndele ta li, nokwa twikila okupopya fiyo eluwa la tenda, ndele ye ta i.
Ndele omumati ou ove mu twala keumbo e nomwenyo, ndele va hekelekwa unene.
Ndele fye otwa li twa tetekela okuya moskepa notwa ya kuAsso, tu ka pitule ko Paulus, osheshi oye e shi tu lombwela ye mwene kutya okwa hala okweenda kolupadi.
Hano eshi twa shakena naye muAsso, otwe mu tambula moskepa, ndele twa ya kuMitilene.
Ndele mokudja oko mefiku lomongula twa fika opo twa shaama naKios, nefiku la shikula otwe uya kuSamos, ndele twa kala muTrogillium, ndele mefiku likwao otwe uya kuMileto.
Osheshi Paulus okwa tokola okupitilila Efeso, aha manene efimbo muAsia, osheshi okwa li ta endelele, a ka kale ngeno kuJerusalem mefiku laPentekoste.
Ndele muMileto okwa tuma kuEfeso, ndele ta ifana kuye ovakulunhu veongalo.
Ndele vo eshi ve uya kuye, okwa tya kuvo: “Nye omu shi shii okudja kefiku lotete eshi nda lyata eemhadi dange muAsia, nhumbi nda kala punye efimbo alishe,
nhumbi nda li nda longela Omwene nelininipiko alishe nomahodi nomokushindwa kwa dila nge momanangelo Ovajuda;
nonhumbi nda li inandi fya ounye oku mu lombwela keshe tuu osho sha wapala noku mu longa povanhu nomomaumbo
fimbo nda hepaululila Ovajuda nOvagreka, ve nokulidilulula nokwaalukila kuKalunga nokwiitavela Omwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Ndele taleni, paife ohandi i kuJerusalem nda mangwa momhepo yange, ndele ame nghi shii eshi tashi ka hanga nge kwinya.
Shimwe ashike ndi shi shii, okoilando aishe, Omhepo Iyapuki ota hepaululile nge ndele ta ti: eemhango nomahepeko taa teelele nge kwinya.
Ndele ame kombinga yange nghi na nasho komwenyo wange, shamha tuu handi wanifa nehafo okweenda kwange noshilonga eshi nde shi pewa kOmwene Jesus, ndi hepaululile evaengeli longhenda yaKalunga.
“Ndele taleni, paife ondi shi shii, nye itamu mono vali oshipala shange, nye amushe ava nda endaenda mokati keni nonda udifa ouhamba waKalunga.
Onghee hano ohandi mu hepaulile efiku eli lonena, ame ndihe netimba nande olohonde yomunhu.
Osheshi ame inandi fiya po sha, ndelenee onde mu udifila omhangela aishe yexupifo laKalunga.
Litaleni hano nye vene, nye mu pashukile oshuunda ashishe, omo mwa nangekwa kOmhepo Iyapuki, eshi e mu ninga ovafita vokulifa eongalo laKalunga, e li lilikolela nohonde yaye mwene.
Osheshi ame ondi shi shii, ngeenge nda di po, omambungu haa lyana otae uya ndele taa pumine mokati keni, nao kae na nande onghenda noshuunda.
“Heeno, munye tamu di yo ovalumenhu tava popi oinima inai yuka, ve lishilile ovalongwa.
Onghee hano pashukeni nye mu dimbulukwe, nhumbi nda ninga eedula nhatu eshi nda kumaida nomahodi keshe umwe womunye oufiku nomutenya.
“Ndele paife ame ohandi mu yandje kuKalunga nokeendjovo donghenda yaye. Oye e neenghono oku mu pa efyuululo pamwe naavenya aveshe va yapulwa.
Ame inandi konga oshisiliveli noshingoldo ile oikutu yovanhu.
Ndelenee nye vene omu shi shii, omake aa ange okwa wanifa eemhumbwe dange nodavakwetu.
Moinima aishe onde mu ulikila, osho ngaha tu nokulonga nokukwafa oingone nokudimbulukwa eendjovo dOmwene Jesus e di popya Ye mwene: ‘Okuyandja oku nelao komesho yokutambula.’ ”
Ndele eshi a li ta popi ngaha okwa twa eengolo, ndele ta ilikana pamwe navo aveshe.
Ndele vo aveshe ova lila nokulililila nova dingatela kofingo yaPaulus, ndele ve mu fipa komilungu,
unene ova lilila eendjovo, eshi a tile: vo itava mono vali oshipala shaye. Ndele vo ove mu findikila koskepa.
21: Ndele opa ningwa, fye eshi twa tukauka navo notwa ya moskepa, otwa yaukila konhunhu yaKos, nefiku la shikula okuRodos, ndele eshi twa dja ko, otwe uya kuPatara.
Ndele eshi twa hanga ko oskepa tai i kuFoinikia, otwa londa mo ndele twa ya.
Ndele mokweenda kwetu Kipro eshi ya monika, notwe i ameka kolumosho, otwa ya twa yukilila kuSiria ndele twa londoloka muTirus, osheshi oskepa oya li i nokuhelula ofulaxa yayo kwinya.
Ndele eshi twa mona ovalongwa, otwa kala ko omafiku aheyali, ndele vo ova lombwela Paulus ngaashi va li va pewa kOmhepo Iyapuki, aha ye kuJerusalem.

Ndelenee eshi twa menekela ko omafiku oo, otwa fikama, ndele hatu i, vo aveshe ove tu findikila pamwe novakainhu nounona fiyo twa dja moshilando, ndele komunghulo wefuta otwa twa eengolo ndele hatu ilikana.
Ndele fye eshi twa lekelafana notwa ya moskepa, venya ova shuna komaumbo avo.
Ndelenee mokudja muTirus otwe uya kuPtolemais, oku twa xulifa okweenda kwetu moskepa, ndele twa kunda ovamwatate, ndele twa kala puvo efiku limwe.
Ndele mefiku la shikula fye ava twa enda naPaulus, otwa fikama twe uya kuKesarea, ndele twa ya meumbo lomuevaengeliste Filippus, ou a li umwe waava vaheyali, ndele twa kala puye.
Ndele ou okwa li e novana oukadona vane, ava va li ve noshali yokuxunganeka.
Ndele fimbo twa menekela mo omafiku mahapu, pe uya omuxunganeki womuJudea, edina laye Agabus.

Ndele eshi e uya oku tu talela po, okwa kufa ekwamo laPaulus, ndele e li limangifa komaulu nokomaoko aye ndele ta ti: “Omhepo Iyapuki otai ti ngaha: ‘Mwene wekwamo eli osho ngaha Ovajuda tave ke mu manga muJerusalem ndele tave mu yandje momake ovapaani.’ ”
Ndele eshi twe shi uda, ofye novadalelwamo, otwe mu indila shili aha ye kuJerusalem.

Ndelenee Paulus a nyamukula ta ti: “Nye otamu ningi ngahelipi, eshi tamu kwena ndele tamu teyaula omutima wange, osheshi ame onde lilongekida, hakokumangwa akuke, ndelenee okufila yo edina lOmwene Jesus muJerusalem.”
Opo nee, ye eshi ine tu itavela, otwa mwena ndele hatu ti: “Ehalo lOmwene nali longwe.”
Ndele omafiku enya eshi a pita, otwe lilongekida notwa ya kuJerusalem.
Ndele ovalongwa vamwe vomuKesarea ove uya pamwe nafye, nove tu twala meumbo laMnason, Omukipro, omulongwa mukulu, fye tu ka menekele meumbo laye.
Ndele eshi twe uya muJerusalem, ovamwatate ove tu tambula nehafo.
Nefiku la shikula Paulus okwa ya pamwe nafye kuJakob. Ovakulunhu aveshe va ongalela mo.
Ndele Paulus eshi e va kunda, okwe va hepaululila aishe ei Kalunga e i longa mokati kovapaani mokulonga kwaye ovanhu.
Ndele eshi ve di uda ova hambelela Omwene ndele tava ti kuye: “Omumwatate, ove owe shi mona, Ovajuda omayovi mahapu nhumbi va ninga ovaitaveli, ndele ovo ovadiinini vakukutu vomhango.
Ndele vo ove ku kundana, vati oove to longo Ovajuda aveshe venya ve li mokati kovapaani okweefa Moses, ndele to va lombwele vaha pitife vali ovana vavo etanda novaha ende vali paenghedi da ufwa.
Ohatu ningi ngahelipi hano? Ou wete kutya otapa ongala ongudu inene, shimha tuu tave ku udu we uya.
Hano ninga osho hatu shi ku lombwele paife. Omu otu novalumenhu vane, ve na eano oku li wanifa.

Tambula hano ava, ove u liyelife pamwe navo, ove u va futile yo ve likululife eexwiki davo dokomutwe, opo nee vo aveshe otave shi mono, aishe ei to i popilwa kai nomutwe noxulo, osheshi naave yo oho kala momhango, ndele to i diinine.
Ndele mokupopya ovapaani ovo va itavela, ofye twe va pangelela omhangela ndele twe va shangela, ovo ve nokulidilika eembelela domayambo nohonde nombelela ya pondwa, vo ve likelele ohole yoipala.”

Opo nee Paulus okwa tambula ovalumenhu venya ndele e liyelifa mefiku la shikula pamwe navo, nokwa ya motembeli ndele ta holola efimbo lokuxulifa omafiku omayelifo avo, opo eyandjelo lakeshe ou li etwe mo, efimbo olo manga inali xula po.
Ndelenee omafiku enya aheyali eshi e li pokuxula po, Ovajuda vomuAsia ove mu mona motembeli, va piyaaneka ongudu aishe yovanhu ndele ve mu kwata,

ndele tava popi pombada: “Ovalumenhu nye Ovaisraeli, tu kwafeni! Omunhu oye tuu ou ha longo akushe ovanhu aveshe noku va twifa ondubo noshiwana eshi nomhango nonhele ei, oye okwa etele mo Ovagreka motembeli omu, ndele okwa nyatekifa onhele ei iyapuki.”
Osheshi ova mona Trofimus, Omuefeso, oo a li pamwe naye moshilando, ndele va li ve shii, Paulus e mu eta motembeli.
Oshilando ashishe osha hovela okukulukuta, ovanhu ova tondokela ko ndele va kwata Paulus, ndele tave mu kokolola mo motembeli, opo nee oivelo oya idilwa po.
Ndele eshi va hetekela oku mu dipaa, omuneyovi okwa uda kutya Jerusalem ashishe osha dundakana.
Ndele ye okwa kufa diva ovakwaita novanefele, ndele okwa tondokela ko kuvo. Opo nee vo eshi va mona omuneyovi novakwaita, ova efa okudenga Paulus.
Omuneyovi okwe uya po ndele te mu kwatifa, ndele ta yandje elombwelo a mangwe nomalyenge avali, ndee ta pula kutya oye olyelye nokwa ninga shike.
Ndele mongudu yovanhu vamwe ova ingida onhumba, navakwao ongadi, naye eshi a nyengwa oku di shiiva mokati komapopyaano, okwa pula a twalwe kongulu youkwaita.
Ndele eshi e uya poilyatelelo, ovakwaita ova li ve noku mu humbata, ovanhu vaha dule oku mu nhukila.
Osheshi ongudu inene oya shikula mo ndele tai ingida: “Mu kufa po!”
Ndele eshi va li va hala ve mu twale meni longulu, Paulus okwa tya komuneyovi: “Otashi dulika tuu mbela tu likunde po?” Winya ta ti: “Ou shii tuu Oshigreka?
Hamba haave Omuegipiti ou a twifa ondubo momafiku opaife, ovakolokoshi venya omayovi ane nokwe va twala mombuwa?”
Ndele Paulus okwa nyamukula: “Aame Omujuda womuTarso, omunhu womoshilando shinya sha fimana shomuKilikia, ohandi ku indile, kwafe nge ndi popye novanhu ava.”
Ndele ye eshi e mu itavelela, Paulus okwa kala ofika koilyatelelo ndele ta yelulile ovanhu eke. Vo eshi va mwena, okwe va popifa mOshiheberi, ndele ta ti:
22: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate nootate, pwilikineni elipopilo lange koshipala sheni.”
Ndele vo eshi va uda ta popi Oshiheberi, ova mwenena, ye ta ti:

“Aame Omujuda, nda dalelwa muTarso shomuKilikia, ndele ame onda tekulwa omu, moshilando eshi opeemhadi daGamaliel, nda longwa okushiiva shili omhango yootate, nonda li handi kondjele Kalunga ngaashi nanye yo osho mu li nena.
Ame onda kondjifa ondjila ei fiyo okufya, nda manga ovalumenhu novakainhu noku va idilila modolongo.

Ngaashi omupristeli omukulunhu noshiongalele ashishe shovakulunhu ovo eendobwedi dange. Ovo tuu va pele nge eenhumwafo da shangelwa ovamwatate ovo va kala muDamaskus, nonda ile ko, opo ndi va ete kuJerusalem va mangwa va ka handukilwe.
“Ndelenee opa ningwa, fimbo nda li mondjila nde lishilila popepi naDamaskus, pokati komutenya, ohangelela ouyelele uhapu womeulu owa dingilila nge.
Ndele ame onde lishata poshi nonda uda ondaka ya popifa nge: ‘Saul, Saul, oshike to taataa nge?’
Ame onda nyamukula: ‘Omwene, Oove lyelye?’ Ye okwa lombwela nge: ‘Aame Jesus Omunasareti, ou to mu taataa.’
Ndele ava va li pamwe naame, ova mona shili ouyelele, ndele ondaka yaau a popifa nge, inave i uda,
ndele ame onda tya: ‘Omwene, ondi nokuninga shike?’ Omwene okwa lombwela nge, ta ti: ‘Fikama, u ye muDamaskus, omo to ka lombwelwa oinima aishe we i tokolelwa u i longe.’
Ndele ame, eshi nda twikifwa keenhe douyelele, onda kwatwa komhango kwaava va li pamwe naame, osho ngaha nde uya muDamaskus.
“Ndele omo mwa li Ananias, omulumenhu omuyuki konghedi yomhango, a fimanekwa kOvajuda aveshe.
Ye okwe uya kwaame, a ehena pwaame, ndele ta ti: ‘Saul, omumwatate, pashuka!’ Opo tuu opo ame nda ninga omunamesho, nonde mu tala.
Ndele ye okwa tya: ‘Kalunga kootate e ku hoolola nale u shiive ehalo laye, ove u mone Omuyuki, ndele u ude ondaka yomokanya kaye.
Osheshi ove u nokuninga ondobwedi koshipala shovanhu aveshe, yaai we i mona naai we i uda.
Ndele paife, oto teelele vali shike? Fikama ashike, u ka shashwe, ove u koshwe omatimba oye, nokwiifana edina lOmwene.’
“Ndele eshi nda aluka ko, onde uya kuJerusalem, nonda ilikanena motembeli, onda fya ombabanghukuta,
ndele nde mu mona. Ye okwa lombwela nge: ‘Endelela u dje mo muJerusalem paife, osheshi itava tambula ehepaululo loye lokuhepaulula nge.’
Ndele ame onda tya: ‘Omwene, voovene ove shi shii, ame nhumbi nda kwata ovaitaveli voye, ndele nde va dengifa meeshinagoga,
ndele ohonde yaStefanus, ondobwedi yoye, eshi ya tilwashi, naame yo oko nda li nonda li nde shi itavela, nonda kelela oikutu yovadipai vaye.’
Ndele Ye okwa lombwela nge: ‘Inda ko, ohandi ku tumu kokule kovapaani.’ ”
Fiyo okondjovo ei ove mu pwilikina, ndele va ingida pombada, ndele tava ti: “Ou a tya ngaha na dje ko kombada yedu, osheshi inashi wapala a kale e nomwenyo.”
Ndele eshi va li tava ingida, tava ekeleshi oikutu yavo, ndele tava fundaula edu pombada,
omuneyovi okwe va lombwela ve mu twale meni longulu, opo a shiive osho she va ingidifa, okwe va lombwela a pulwe mokudengwa neeshokoto.
Ndele vo eshi ve mu nangeka, ve mu dengife eeshokoto, Paulus okwa tya komunefele ou a li ofika opo: “Otamu dulu tuu okudenga Omuroma fimbo ina tokolwa?”
Omunefele eshi e shi uda okwa ya, ndele e ke shi lombwela omuneyovi, ndele ta ti: “Owa hala okuninga shike, omulumenhu ou Omuroma?”
Ndele omuneyovi okwa ya kuPaulus, ndele ta pula kuye: “Lombwele nge, oove ngeenge Oumuroma?” Ye okwa nyamukula: “Heeno.”
Opo nee omuneyovi ta ti: “Oukwashilongo ou onde u lilikolela noimaliwa ihapu.” Paulus ta ti: “Ame omudalwa Omuromelela.”
Opo tuu opo, venya va li va hala, ve mu denge, ove mu efa diva. Omuneyovi yo eshi a uda kutya Paulus Omuroma, a tila, eshi e mu mangifa.

Ndele mefiku la shikula, shaashi a hala okushiiva nawa omolwashike Ovajuda ve mu hokololifa, okwe mu mangululifa ndele a lombwela ovapristeli ovakulunhu noshiongalele ashishe shovakulunhu shi ongale, ndele a twala mo Paulus ndele te mu tula moipafi yavo.
23: Ndele Paulus okwa tala oshiongalele shovakulunhu ndele ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, moinima aishe ame onda kala nokweenda koshipala shaKalunga ndi neliudo liwa fiyo efiku eli.”
Ndele omupristeli omukulunhu Ananias okwa lombwela ava va li ofika, ve mu denge komulungu.
Opo nee Paulus okwa tya kuye: “Kalunga ote ku denge, oove ekuma litoka la fefengwa, ove wa kala omutumba u tokolife nge omhango, ndele to lombwele ovanhu ndi dengwe konghedi yokunyona omhango.”
Ndele ovo va li ofika opo, ova tya: “Ove to tuku omupristeli omukulunhu waKalunga?”
Opo nee Paulus okwa tya: “Ovamwatate nye, ame inandi mu shiiva oye omupristeli omukulunhu, osheshi okwa shangwa: ‘Ino tuka omupangeli woshiwana shambuleni.’ ”

Ndele Paulus eshi a li e va wete ombinga imwe yavo oyOvasadukai naikwao oyOvafarisai, okwa popya mokule moipafi yoshiongalele: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, ame Omufarisai nomona wOmufarisai. Ame ondi li po handi hokololifwa molweteelelo nenyumuko loonakufya.”
Ndele eshi e di tya, opo tuu opo pe uya eemhata pokati kOvafarisai nOovasadukai, noshiongalele osha tukuka.
Osheshi Ovasadukai otava ti: “Kaku nenyumuko nokaku novaengeli nokaku neemhepo,” ndele Ovafarisai ova itavela aishe ei.

Opo nee pa ningwa eweelelo linene, novanongo vomishangwa vamwe vomongudu yOvafarisai ova fikama, ndele tava patafana nouladi va tya: “Omulumenhu ou inatu mu mona e nowii nande washa. Omhepo ile omweengeli kashiimba e mu popifa?”
Ndele eenhamanana eshi da ya pombada, omuneyovi okwa tila kutya, otava ka pombaula Paulus, a lombwela ovakwaita, va ye ve ke mu kufe mo divadiva mokati kavo, vo ve mu twale mongulu yovakwaita.
Ndele moufiku wa shikula Omwene okwa kala ofika puPaulus ndele ta ti: “Kala nomwenyo muwa, osheshi ngaashi wa hepaulula nge muJerusalem, osho yo u nokuhepaulula nge muRoma.”
Ndele ongula eshi kwa sha, Ovajuda ova udafana nova ana eano, vo vaha makele nande eendja novaha nwe sha fimbo inava dipaa Paulus.
Ndele ava ve mu hangakena ngaha, ova li ve dule omilongo ine.
Ndele ova ya kovapristeli ovakulunhu nokovakulunhu, ndele tava ti: “Fye otwa udaneka nokwaana, fye tuha lye sha fimbo inatu dipaa Paulus.
Hano paife onye noshiongalele shovakulunhu, ka shiivifileni omuneyovi, e mu tume kunye, mwa fa mwa hala okuuda nawa eendjovo daye, ndele fye otwe lilongekida tu mu dipae, ofimbo ina fika kunye.”
Ndele omona womumwaina waPaulus omukainhu okwa uda omhangela ei, nokwe uya kongulu yovakwaita ndele te shi hepaululile Paulus.
Ndele Paulus okwa ifana umwe womovanefele ndele ta ti: “Twala omunyasha ou komuneyovi, osheshi ye oku na sha oku mu shiivifila.”
Opo nee ye e mu kufa, okwe mu twala komuneyovi ndele ta ti: “Onghwate Paulus okwa ifanene nge ndele okwa indila nge ndi ete omunyasha ou kwoove, osheshi ye oku na sha shoku ku shiivifila.”
Opo nee omuneyovi e mu kwata kokwooko ndele e mu twala pamwe pe lili ndele te mu pula: “Eendjovo edi to shiivifile nge, odilipipo hano?”
Ndele ye ta ti: “Ovajuda ova pangela omhangela, ve ku indile mongula u twale Paulus koshiongalele shovakulunhu, va fa va hala okupwilikina vali eendjovo daye.

Ndele ove ino va itavela, osheshi oku na ovalumenhu mokati kavo, ve dule omilongo ine, tave mu nangele, ndele vo ova ana eano, itava li sha noitava nu sha fimbo inave mu dipaa, ndele paife ove lilongekida ndele tava teelele eitavelelo loye.”
Ndele omuneyovi a lekela omunyasha ndele ta ti kuye: “Ino shi tya nande okulyelye, nokutya, we shi shiivifila nge.”

Ndele ye okwa ifana ovanefele vavali ta ti: “Pokafimbo okatitatu koufiku kaleni mwa longekida ovakwaita omafele avali, novalondi veenghambe omilongo heyali novalumenhu ovanamaonga omafele avali, mu va longekide okuya kuKesarea.
Ndele mangeni yo eenghambe dokulondwa kuPaulus, nye mu mu twale nawa kuFeliks, omupangeli woshilongo.”
Ndele ye okwa shanga onhumwafo tai ti:
“Klaudius Lisias ota kundu omupangeli woshilongo, Feliks, omufimanekwa munene.
Omulumenhu ou, Ovajuda ve mu kwata nokonyala ve mu dipae. Ame onde uya ndi nongudu yovakwaita, nonde mu xupifa, eshi nde mu uda kutya oye Omuroma.
Ndele ame eshi nda hala okushiiva efina lehovelo lavo, onde mu twala koshiongalele shovakulunhu vavo,
ndele nda mona kutya okwa hokololifwa eemhata domhango yavo, ndele okwa li ehe netimba lokufya ile lokwiidililwa modolongo.
Ndelenee ame eshi nda hololelwa kutya omulumenhu ou ota ve mu nangelwa, onde mu tuma kwoove, nonda lombwela yo ovahokololifi vaye ve ke mu hokololife koshipala shoye. Kundilwa po!”
Ndele ovakwaita ova ninga ngaashi va lombwelwa, va kufa Paulus ndele tave mu twala oufiku kuAntipatria.
Nefiku la shikula ove mu pa ovalondi veenghambe, va ka fike ko pamwe naye, voovene ova aluka ko, nove uya kongulu yovakwaita.
Ndele ovalondi eshi va fika kuKesarea, ova yandja onhumwafo komupangeli woshilongo nova twala yo Paulus kuye.
Ndele omupangeli eshi a lesha onhumwafo, okwa pula Paulus, kutya owomoshilongo shilipi, naashi a uda owokuKilikia,
okwa tya: “Onda hala oku ku pwilikina, ovahokololifi voye ngeenge ve uya.” Ndele okwa lombwela a kale a nangelwa mongulu yaHerodes.
24: Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku atano, omupristeli omukulunhu Ananias pamwe novakulunhu vamwe, omupopili waye Tertullus, e uya muKesarea nova shiivifila omupangeli woshilongo, kutya ova hala okuhokololifa Paulus.

Ndele eshi a ka talwa ko, Tertullus okwa hovela oku mu hokololifa ta ti: “Feliks omufimanekwa munene, fye otu nombili ihapu molwoye. Okefiloshisho loye lihapu oshiwana eshi osha mona omalundululo mawa eenghedi,
oshinima eshi hatu hepaulula alushe naakushe noku ku pandula.
Ndele ndiha mane po efimbo, ohandi ku ilikana, u tu pwilikine kanini, omolwonheni yoye.
Omulumenhu ou otwe mu koneka, oye a fa oudu wolutapo nomupiyaaneki mokati kOvajuda aveshe mounyuni aushe, nomwene woshimhanga shOvanasareti.
Ye okwa hetekela yo okunyateka otembeli yetu. Fye otwe mu kwata notwa hala tu mu tokole pamhango yetu vene,
ndelenee omuneyovi Lisias okwe uya ndele te mu kufa momake etu keenghono daye dihapu
ndele okwa lombwela ovahokololifi vaye ve nokuuya koshipala shoye. Hano ove oto dulu oku mu pwilikina, u shiive oinima ei hatu i mu hokololifa.”
Ndele Ovajuda ova ya meendjovo edi dokuhokololifa ndele tave di pameke.
Ndele omupangeli woshilongo okwa aneka Paulus a popye, nde ta ti: “Eshi ndi ku shii, ove owa kala omido dihapu omutokoli woshiwana eshi, ohandi lipopile ndi nelineekelo.
Ove ngaashi u shi shii, omafiku omulongo naavali aeke a pita po, eshi nda ya kuJerusalem okwiilikana.
Ndele vo inava hanga nge nda twa eemhata nande onalyelye, ile nda lumbakanifa ovanhu, motembeli ile moshinagoga ile moshilando.
Ndele itava dulu oku ku etela omatomhelo oinima ei tave i hokololifa nge paife.
Ndele ohandi ku hepaululile, ohandi longele Kalunga kootate kondjila ei, tava ti oyo oshimhanga, eshi nda itavela inya aishe ya shangwa momhango nomovaxunganeki,
nondi neteelelo olo lomuKalunga, navo vene ngaashi ve li kwete yo, nokutya, otaku ka kala enyumuko lovayuki nolovalunde.
Onghee naame yo ohandi kondjo shili ndi kale alushe ndi neliudo lihe noshipo puKalunga nopovanhu.
“Ndelenee eshi pa pita omido dihapu, onde uya ndi etele oshiwana shetu oikwafa nondi yambe omayambo.
Ndele fimbo nda li handi longo ei, Ovajuda vamwe vomuAsia ova mona nge motembeli, nda li nde liyelifa, ndele kamwa li nande eefina dovanhu ile ekulukuto.
Venya ngeno ve nokukala koshipala shoye nokuhokololifa nge, ngeenge ova mona nge nda nyona,
ile ava ve li po, nava tonge ngeenge onda nyona sha, eshi nda li nda kala ofika koshipala shoshiongalele shovakulunhu.
Ondjovo imwe aike shapu, eshi nda popya pombada mokati kavo: ‘Ame handi hokololifwa nena molwenyumuko lovafi.’ ”
Ndele Feliks ou kwa li e shii nawa omalongo ondjila ei, okwa mweneka manga eendjovo davo ndele ta ti: “Omuneyovi Lisias ngeenge e uya, onda hala okupwilikina naanaa eendjovo deni.”
Ndele ye okwa lombwela omunefele, Paulus a nangelwe, ye ina nangelwa unene, vakwao vaha kelelwe oku mu talela po noku mu yakula.
Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku amwe, Feliks e uya pamwe nomukainhu waye Drusila, Omujuda, nokwa ifana Paulus, ndele ta pwilikine eendjovo daye deitavelo lokwiitavela Kristus Jesus.
Ndele Paulus eshi a popya ouyuki nelidiliko netokolo olo li nokuuya, Feliks okwa tila ndele ta ti: “Inda manga, ndele ngeenge nda mono efimbo la wapalela nge, ohandi ku ifana natango.”
Ndele kombinga imwe okwa li e shii ota pewa oimaliwa kuPaulus, ye e mu efe, onghee e mu ifanena ko luhapu, ndele ta kundafana naye.
Ndele eshi pa pita omido mbali, Porkius Festus okwa tulwa mo mepangelo ponhele yaFeliks. Ndele Feliks eshi a hala okuwapalela Ovajuda, okwa fiya mo Paulus meemango daye.
25: Opo nee omafiku atatu eshi a pita po, Festus eshi a ninga omupangeli woshilongo, ye okwa dja kuKesarea ndele okwa ya kuJerusalem.
Ndele ovapristeli ovakulunhu novanamadina Ovajuda ove mu shiivifila nokutya, va hala okuhokololifa Paulus, ndele ve mu indila
va mone onghenda kuye, opo a etife Paulus kuJerusalem, osheshi ove lilongekidila oku mu nangela, opo ve mu dipaele mondjila.
Ndele Festus okwa nyamukula kutya Paulus oku li onghwate muKesarea, na Festus mwene okwa hala okuya ko diva.
Ye okwa tya: “Ovawiliki veni nave uye, tu ye pamwe navo, nomulumenhu winya ngeenge okwa nyona, a hokololifwe.”
Ndele eshi a menekela puvo omafiku ahetatu ile omulongo, okwa shuna kuKesarea. Efiku la shikula okwa kala omutumba kolukalwatokolo, ndele ta etifa Paulus koshipala shaye.
Ndele ye eshi a holoka, Ovajuda ava va dja kuJerusalem, ove mu fikamena ndele tave mu pe omatimba mahapu madjuu, ndele ova nyengwa okupameka omatomhelo avo;
osheshi Paulus e lipopila ndele ta ti: “Ame inandi nyona sha nokomhango yOvajuda ile kotembeli ile komukesari.”
Ndele Festus eshi a hala okulihokwifa kOvajuda, okwa tya kuPaulus: “Ove owa hala okuya kuJerusalem, u tokolwe kwinya omolwoinima ei moipafi yange?”
Ndele Paulus ta ti: “Ondi li ofika polukalwatokolo lomukesari, noko nda hala ndi yukifilwe, Ovajuda ava inandi nyona sha kuvo, ngaashi naave mwene u shi shii nawa.

Ndele ngeenge nda kala ndi noushima, ile ndi netimba lokufya, itandi anye okufya, ndelenee oinima ei aishe tava hokololifa nge ngeenge oyongaho, opo nee kaku na ou ta dulu okuyandja nge momake avo. Ame onde liameka komukesari.”
Opo nee Festus eshi a kundafana nomalenga aye, okwe mu nyamukula: “Ove owe liameka komukesari, hano u nokuya koshipala shomukesari.”
Ndele eshi pa pita omafiku amwe, ohamba Agrippa naBernike ove uya kuKesarea okutalela po Festus.
Ndele eshi va menekela po omafiku amwe, Festus okwa hepaululila ohamba eendjovo daPaulus, ta ti: “Omu omu na omulumenhu, onghwate, a fiwa mo kuFeliks,
oye ou eshi nda ile kuJerusalem, ovapristeli ovakulunhu novakulunhu vOvajuda va shiivifile kutya, ova hala oku mu hokololifa ndele va indila, a ka tokolwe.
Ndelenee ame onde va nyamukula kutya kashi fi onghedi yOvaroma okuyandja omunhu fimbo ina tulwa pamwe novahokololifi vaye, nofimbo ina mona omhito okulipopila osho ta hokololifilwa.
Hano eshi ve uya oku, ame ndiha mane po efimbo, mefiku la shikula, onda kala omutumba kolukalwatokolo nonda ifanena po omulumenhu winya.
Ndele ovahokololifi eshi ve mu fikamena, ova nyengwa oku mu pa etimba ngaashi nda diladila.
Ndele vo ova patafana naye omolwomapulo amwe omeitavelolongo lavo nomolwanakufya umwe, Jesus, ou Paulus ta ti e nomwenyo.
Ndele eshi nda li nda limbililwa ndihe shii oinima ya tya ngaha ngeenge i nokutokolwa, onde mu pula, ngeenge okwa hala okuya kuJerusalem ye a ka pangulilwe oko.
Ndele Paulus eshi e liameka komukesari nokwa hala okutwalwa kuye, onghee nde va lombwela, a kwatelwe modolongo fimbo handi ke mu tuma komukesari.”
Ndele Agrippa okwa tya kuFestus: “Naame yo onda hala okuuda omulumenhu ou.” Ye okwa tya: “Mongula oto ke mu uda.”
Mefiku la shikula, Agrippa naBernike ova li va djala oikutu ya vilima youlenga ve uya molupale letokolelo pamwe novaneyovi noipuna yoshilando. Kelombwelo laFestus, Paulus okwa etwa mo.

Opo nee Festus ta ti: “Ohamba Agrippa nanye amushe ava mu li apa pamwe nafye, taleni, omulumenhu ou, omolwaye ongudu aishe yOvajuda vomuJerusalem novaamu tava fininike nge nokuweelela, oye aha kale vali nomwenyo.
Ndele ame onda koneka kutya ye ke netimba lokufya, naye mwene e liameka komukesari, onda hala oku mu tuma ko.

Ndele ndihe shii eendjovo odilipipo ndi noku di shangela omwene wange, onghee hano nde mu eta apa koshipala sheni, unene tuu koshipala shoye, ohamba Agrippa, opo eshi a pwilikinwa, ndi mone owino oku mu shangela sha.
Osheshi osha nyika oulai okutuma omukwatwa, fimbo inaku shangelwa osho ta hokololifwa.”
26: Ndele Agrippa okwa tya kuPaulus: “Ove wa pewa okulipopila.” Opo nee Paulus a yelula eke laye e lipopila, ta ti:
“Ohamba Agrippa, onde litala omunelao, eshi nda itavelwa mefiku eli lonena okulipopila koshipala shoye moinima ei aishe, Ovajuda tava pe nge etimba.
Osheshi eenghedi nomapulapulo aeshe Ovajuda ou a shii nawa, onghee handi ku indile, tale nge onheni, ove u pwilikine nge.
“Okukalamwenyo kwange mounyasha, Ovajuda aveshe ove ku shii, osheshi nda kala pehovelo fiyo onena mokati koshiwana shetu nomuJerusalem.
Vo ove shii nge pehovelo, ngeenge va hala okuhepaulula, nhumbi nda li Omufarisai paenghedi odo doshimhanga shinya oshidiinini sheitavelo letu.
Ndele paife ondi li apa ofika handi hokololifilwa eteelelo lomaudaneko enya a udanekelwa ootate kuKalunga.
Ndele olo tuu olo omapata aa etu omulongo naavali eshi taa diinine okulongela Kalunga oufiku nomutenya, a hala nokuhalelela oku li mona. Eteelelo tuu olo, omwene wange, handi hokololifwa kOvajuda.
Oshike tashi mu kelele okwiitavela nokutya, Kalunga ota nyumuna ovafi?
“Ame yo onda li ndi shii, ondi nokukondjifa shili edina laJesus Omunasareti.
Osho nda ningile yo muJerusalem, nda idilila ovayapuki vahapu modolongo, eshi nda pewa eitavelelo kovapristeli ovakulunhu novakwatwa eshi va dipawa po, naame yo onde shi itavela.
Ndele akushe meeshinagoga luhapu onde va fininikifa momahandukilo okutuka Jesus moupyuhandu wange, nonde va hepekele fiyo okoilando yokoilongo.
“Mokweendela oinima ei, eshi nda ya kuDamaskus, onda li ndi nomaitavelelo ovapristeli ovakulunhu.
Opo nee, ohamba, mondjila yange, mokati komutenya, onda mona ouyelele unene, u dule ou wetango, wa dja meulu, ndele wa dingilila nge, aame mwene novafindikili vange.
Ndele fye atushe otwa wila poshi, ame onda uda ondaka ya popya mOshiheberi, tai ti kwaame: ‘Saul, Saul, oshike to taataa nge? U noudjuu okufangula konhele yeonga!’
Opo nda tya: ‘Omwene, Oove lyelye?’ Omwene ta ti: ‘Aame Jesus, ou to mu taataa.
Ndelenee penduka, likanghameka, osheshi onde ku lihololela, opo ndi ku tule po omupiya wange nondobwedi yange u hepaulule osho we shi mona nakeshe tuu osho handi ku hololele komesho.
Ame ohandi ku xupifa momake oshiwana sheni noovapaani ovo, handi ku tumu kuvo,
okupashukifa omesho avo, va dje mo momulaulu, ve uye mouyelele, va efe epangelo laSatana, nove uye kuKalunga, ndele mokwiitavela nge, va mone ekufilo lomatimba nefyuululo mokati kovayapulwa.’
“Onghee hano, ohamba Agrippa, onda dulika kemoniko olo lomeulu,

ndele tete onda udifila Ovadamaskus nOvajerusalem, nokonima onde shi ninga medu alishe laJudea nomovapaani yo, nda tya: Ovo ve nokulidilulula nokwaalukila kuKalunga, va longe oilonga ei ya wapalela elidilululo.
Omolwaashi Ovajuda va kwatela nge motembeli nova hala okudipaa nge.

Ndele kekwafo olo nde li pewa kuKalunga fiyo onena eli ondi li ofika apa, ndele handi hepaululile ovanini novanene, ndele itandi popi sha shimwe shi lili, osho ashike osho ovaxunganeki naMoses ve shi popya, shi nokuwanifwa,
nokutya, Kristus nhumbi kwa li e nokuhepekwa nonhumbi a ninga omutete womenyumuko, opo a udifile ovanhu ava novapaani yo ouyelele.”
Ndelenee eshi e lipopila ngaha, Festus okwa popya mokule ndele ta ti: “Paulus, owa pilalala eendunge. Elongo olo loye olinene notali pilalalifa eendunge doye!”
Ndelenee Paulus ta ti: “Festus omufimanekwa, inandi pilalala eendunge, ohandi popi eendjovo doshili nodeendunge diwa.

Ndele ohamba oi shii ei aishe, onghee hano handi mu lombwele yo nokuliameka kuye nouladi, osheshi ondi shi shii nawa, kaku na nande oshinima shomwaai aishe, osho inashi shiivika kuye, ei ngaashi inai ningilwa mekololo lapenipeni.
Ohamba Agrippa, ove oto itavele tuu ovaxunganeki? Heeno, ondi shi shii, oto va itavele.”
Ndele Agrippa ta ti kuPaulus: “Hamba, ou shii okuninga nge Omukriste okupu!”
Ndele Paulus ta ti: “Ngee okupu ile okudjuu, onda hala haave auke, ndelenee amushe ava tamu pwilikine nge nena, Kalunga e mu ninge ngaashi ame, kakele komalyenge aa ndi kwete mu kale muhe a kwete.”
Ndele Paulus eshi e shi tya, opo ohamba nomupangeli woshilongo naBernike, naaveshe ava va li va kala omutumba pamwe navo, ova fikama.
Ndele mokuya ova kundafana, tava ti: “Omulumenhu ou ina ninga sha shoku mu dipaifa ile shoku mu mangifa.”
Ndele Agrippa okwa tya kuFestus: “Omulumenhu ou ngeno okwa li ine liameka komukesari, ngeno okwa wana okweefiwa.”
27: Ndele eshi sha tokolwa, fye tu noku ka konda, tu ye kuItalia, Paulus okwa yandjwa pamwe neenghwate dimwe dikwao momake omukulunhu wetanga lomukesari, edina laye Julius.
Ndele otwa ya moskepa yokuAdramiti, ya li i nokuya komatulilo omuAsia, notwa yuka mefuta ndele twa enda pamwe naAristarkus Omumakedonia womuTessalonika.
Ndele mefiku la shikula otwa fika kuSidon, ndele Julius okwa li e nombili naPaulus nokwe mu efa a ka talele po ookaume kaye, a yakulwe kuvo.
Ndele eshi twa dja ko, otwa yuka mefuta, twa enda twa kunghula naKipro, osheshi omhepo oya li ye tu dja moshipala.
Opo nee eshi twa koya efuta lopuKilikia nolopuPamfilia, otwe uya muMira shomuLikia.
Ndele omukulunhu oko a hanga oskepa yokuAleksandria, tai i kuItalia, nokwe tu lombwela tu ye mo.
Ndele otwa enda omafiku mahapu nokulififida noudjuu twa taalela Knidus, ndele omhepo eshi ye tu kelela ko, otwa kunghula naKreta langhele yaSalmone.
Ndele eshi twa kunghula nomunghulo ou noudjuu, otwa fika monhele ya lukwa Omatulilo a wapala, popepi noshilando shaLasea.
Ndele efimbo lile eshi la pita po, nokweenda noskepa eshi kwa ninga kudjuu, nomafiku okulidilika eendja a kuka, Paulus okwe va kumaida,
ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye, ondi shi wete okweenda noskepa kwetu ohatu ka mona oupyakadi noiponga inene, hayofulaxa aike noyoskepa, ndelenee noyeemwenyo detu yo.”
Ndele omukulunhu okwa itavela omweendifi namwene woskepa, shi dule eendjovo daPaulus.

Netulilo olo kala li la wapala nokukala pefimbo lokufu, opo nee vahapu ova li va hala okudja mo, fye tu tale, ngeenge hatu ka hanga kuFoiniks, tu kale mo okufu, olo etulilo limwe lomuKreta la taalela pokati koumbangalanhuushilo, noumbuwanhuushilo.
Hano omhepo yokoumbuwanhu eshi ya hovela okupepa, nova li ve shii tava ka fika ko oko va li va hala okuya, ova shila mo omakanghamifo ndele va enda popepi naKreta.
Ndele eshi pa pita okafimbo, opa tukuluka omhepo yoshikungulu shokoumbangalanhuushilo.
Opo nee oskepa eshi ya ya naashi ya nyengwa okuyukilila omhepo, otwe i efa ndele hatu telaanifwa komhepo.
Eshi twe uya twa kunghula kokanhunhu ke nedina lako Kauda, otwa tulika okaskepa nokukondja noudjuu.
Eshi ve ka shilila pombada, ova hovela okupameka oskepa tai litwala koshitunhu shomeva shokuSirti, ova filukifa eefaila, nosho va twalwatwalwa.
Ndele oshikungulu eshi she tu kondjifa unene, nefiku la shikula ova ekelashi nomake avo vene ofulaxa imwe yomoskepa.
Ndele mefiku etitatu ova ekelashi nomake avo oinima noilongifo yo.
Ndele momafiku mahapu etango neenyofi eshi inadi monika, noshikungulu shidjuu she tu finda, eteelelo alishe lexupifo otwe li xupula.

Eshi va ninga omafiku inava lya sha, Paulus okwa fikama mokati kavo ndele ta ti: “Ovalumenhu nye, ngeno omwa itavelele eshi nda tile, nye inamu dja mo muKreta ngeno inamu litwika oudjuu u fike apa noshiponga.
Ndele paife ohandi mu kumaida, kaleni nomwenyo muwa, osheshi kamu na nande umwe womunye ta fi, oskepa oyo aike tai nyonauka.
Osheshi oufiku wonena pwaame opa li omweengeli waKalunga ou e kwete nge, naau handi mu kalele yo,
Ye okwa tya: ‘Paulus ino tila, ove ou nokuya koshipala shomukesari, ndele tala, Kalunga e ku pa aveshe ava tava ende pamwe naave.’
Onghee hano ovalumenhu nye, tilulukeni, osheshi ame onda itavela Kalunga kutya, ota ningi ngaashi a lombwela nge.
Ndelenee fye otu noku ka twalwatwalwa konhunhu yonhumba.”
Opo nee oufiku ou outimulongo noutine, eshi we uya, eshi twa li nokuundaulwa mEfuta Lopokati pokati koufiku, ovanaskepa ova dimbulukwa nokutya, ova ehena kedu.
Eshi va ekela mo oholo, ova koneka oule wefuta owa li u neemeta omilongo mbali, naashi va ehena ko kanini ova ekelulula mo oholo, nova hanga mo eemeta omilongo nhatu.
Ndele mokutila tuha undulilwe koitunhu yomomeva, ova filukifa mo konima yoskepa omakanghamifo ane, nova teelela nodjuulufi ku she.
Ndele ovanaskepa va hala okulivaka mo nomakoto moskepa ndele va filukifila okaskepa mefuta, vati tava twala omakanghamifo okomesho.
Opo nee Paulus ta ti komunefele nokovakwaita: “Ava ngeenge itava kala moskepa, nye itamu dulu okuxupifwa.”
Opo nee ovakwaita ova teta po eengodi kokaskepa nove ka ufila mefuta.
Opo nee fimbo va teelela ku she, Paulus okwa kumaida aveshe va lye, ta ti: “Nena opa pita omafiku omulongo naane, mwa teelela, inamu lya sha, nye inamu makela nande oikulya.
Onghee hano ohandi mu kumaida mu lye oikulya, osheshi otai mu kwafa mu xupe, osheshi nande oluxwiki limwe lokomitwe deni itali ka kana.”
Hano eshi e di tya, okwa kufa omungome, a pandula Kalunga moipafi yavo aveshe, ndele ta pambula ko, ndele ta hovele okulya.
Aveshe opo va tiluluka, ndele tava hovele okulya yo.
Ndele fye ava twa li moskepa ovanhu ve fike pomafele avali nomilongo heyali nahamano.
Opo nee eshi va lya va kuta, ova pupaleka oskepa nokweekela oilya mefuta.
Ndelenee eshi kwa sha, inava dimbulukwa edu olo, ndele ova mona ko oshikololo shi nomunghulo wa wapala opo nee va pangela omhangela va yukife mo oskepa, ngeenge tave shi dulu.
Ndele ova teta po omakanghamifolyenge ve a efela mefuta, nova mangulula omamangifo oshipungululifo shoskepa, va shilila ofaila yokomesho pombada i kwate omhepo ndele tave i yukifa komunghulo.
Ndele vo ova fika koshitunhu shokoshi, oskepa i yuke mo, nonhulo yayo oya patekena mo noinai linyenga vali, ndele ombinga ei yokonima oya teyaulwa keenghono domakufikufi.
Opo ovakwaita va hala okudipaa eenghwate, opo ovo ve shii okuyowa vehe livake po.
Ndele omunefele eshi a hala okuxupifa Paulus, ine va efela ehalo lavo, ndele ta lombwele ovo ve shii okuyowa, va nhukile mo tete mefuta va ka fike kedu.
Ndele vamwe nava ende koipilangi navamwe okoipambu yoskepa. Osho ngaha aveshe ova fika komunghulo ve li nawa.
28: Eshi twa xupa, otwa uda nokutya, onhunhu ei oya lukwa Malta.
Ovanhu vayo ove tu yakula nombili youkaume. Ova shakala omundilo wakula nove tu ifanena kuwo atushe, osheshi okwa li ku nodula noutalala.
Ndele Paulus eshi a ka tyava oikuni okwe i tula mediko, opo nee euta ola nhukifwa mo koupyu, ndele le mu dama keke.

Opo nee ovanhu vamo eshi va mona euta la endjelela keke laye, ova popya tava ti: “Omulumenhu ou shiimba oye omudipai, osheshi kalungakadona kehandukilo inake mu efa, nande a xupifwa mefuta, a kale e nomwenyo.”
Ndele oshinamwenyo osho okwe shi nipila mediko, ye ina mona nande oshiponga.

Ndele venya ova li va teelela a dinde ile a wile poshi a fye ohangelela, ndele eshi va li va teelela efimbo lile nove mu wete ye ina ningilwa nande owii washa, opo nee ove lialuluka, ndele tava ti: “Oye kalunga.”
Popepi nonhele ei okwa li ku nofaalama, ndele mwene wayo okwa li omukulunhu wonhunhu ei, edina laye Publius, ye okwe tu tambula nokwe tu menekelifa po nombili omafiku atatu.
Opa ningwa, xe yaPublius okwa vela oudu wolwiidi nowoshimela shohonde. Ndele Paulus okwa ya kuye, a ilikana nokwa tenheka omake aye kuye, ndele te mu velula.
Ndele eshi, eshi sha ningwa, ovanaudu vamwe vomonhunhu ove uya kuye, ndele va velulwa.
Vo ove tu fimaneka yo unene, ndele eshi twa dja ko, ove tu pa ashishe twe shi pumbwa.
Eshi pa pita eehani nhatu, otwa dja ko noskepa yaAleksandria ya panga mo okufu, ya didilikwa nefano laKastor naPolluks.
Ndele otwe uya kuSirakusa notwa kala ko omafiku atatu.
Eshi twa dja ko, otwa kunghula notwe uya kuRegio. Nomhepo yokoumbuwanhu eshi ya penduka konima yefiku limwe otwe uya kuPuteoli.
Oko nee twa hanga ovamwatate, ovo ve tu indila, tu menekele puvo omafiku aheyali. Opo nee twa ya kuRoma.

Ovamwatate vaakwinya eshi ve tu uda, ove tu teta ko, ove uya fiyo okoshilandelo shaAppius nokEengulu Nhatu Dovaenda oku tu shakeneka, ndele Paulus eshi e va mona, okwa pandula Kalunga nokwa ladipalekwa.

Ndele eshi twe uya muRoma, omunefele okwa yandja eenghwate daye kelenga lakula letanga lomukesari. Paulus okwa pewa omhito okulikongela apa ta kala, te lifutile mwene, ndele ta kala nomukwaita ou te mu nangele.

Opo nee eshi pa pita omafiku atatu, Paulus okwa ifana ovakulunhu vOvajuda, naashi va ongala okwa tya kuvo: “Ovalumenhu nye ovamwatate, ame nande inandi nyona sha koshiwana shetu ile keenghedi dootate, ame onda dja muJerusalem nda mangwa nonda yandjwa momake Ovaroma.
Vo eshi va pula nge nawa, va hala okweefa nge, shaashi nghi netimba lokufya.
Ndele Ovajuda eshi ve shi kondjifa, onda li ndi nokuliameka komukesari, hakutya, ndi hokololife oshiwana shetu ngeno.
Onghee hano nde mu ifana, opo ndi mu mone ndi mu popife, osheshi omolweteelelo laIsrael ndi li momalyenge aa.”
Vo ova tya kuye: “Fye inatu mona nande eenhumwafo da dja medu laJudea tadi ku popi, novamwatate ovo ve uya mo nande oumwe ine tu hepaululila owii washa noku ku popya nai.
Ndele fye otwa hala okuuda tu shiive eshi to shi diladila, osheshi fye otwa uda oshimhanga eshi hashi tuwa eemhata akushe.”

Ovo ve mu pa efiku, ndele eshi la fika, vahapu ve dule voshito ove uya kuye monduda yaye. Ndele ye okwe va fatululila ndele te va hepaululile ouhamba waKalunga, ndele te va longo okuhovela ongula fiyo onguloshi, nokwa hetekela oku va tomhifa omhango yaMoses novaxunganeki, va koneke Jesus.
Vamwe ova tomhwa keendjovo daye, ndelenee vamwe ova anya okwiitavela.
Opo nee vo eshi vaha li kumwe, ove lihana Paulus eshi a popya ondjovo ei nokutya: “Oda yuka odo Omhepo Iyapuki ya tongifa okanya komuxunganeki Jesaja, eshi a lombwela ooxo,

ndele ta ti:
‘Inda koshiwana eshi ndele to ti:
Okuuda ohamu udu, nye kamu udite ko,
nokumona ohamu mono,
ndele kamu wete ko, nye inamu koneka sha.

Osheshi omitima doshiwana eshi da kukuta,
nomatwi avo ve a fitika,
nomesho avo ve a fifikinifa;
vaha mone ko nomesho avo
novaha ude ko nomatwi avo
novaha koneke komitima davo,
vehe lidilulule, Ame ndihe va velule.’ ”
Opo nee kaleni mu shi shii: “Exupifo eli laKalunga ola tuminwa ovapaani, ndele vo otave li udu.”
Opo nee ye eshi a popya odo, Ovajuda ova dja po ndele tave litwifa eemhata unene.
Paulus okwa kala mongulu he i futile omido mbali di yadi nokwa kunda aveshe ovo ve uya kuye.
Ndele okwe va udifila ouhamba waKalunga nokwa longa ovanhu nouladi unene nokuhepaulula Omwene Jesus Kristus; ye ina kelelwa nande okulyelye.

1: Paulus, omupiya waJesus Kristus, omuyapostoli omwiifanwa, a yapulilwa evaengeli laKalunga,
ou e li udanekifa nale ovaxunganeki vaye nomishangwa diyapuki,
okuhepaulula Omona ou a dalwa moludalo laDavid kombinga yombelela,
ndele kombinga yOmhepo yOuyapuki okwa lengwa a kale Omona waKalunga meenghono, eshi a nyumuka movafi. Oye Jesus Kristus, Omwene wetu,
molwaau twa pewa onghenda nouyapostoli, opo tu dike movanhu aveshe eduliko leitavelo lokufimanekifa edina laye,
mokati kaava nanye yo vomuvo mwa ifanwa kuJesus Kristus.

Kovaholike vaKalunga, ovaifanwa vayapuki muRoma.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu noyOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Tete ohandi pandula Kalunga kange muJesus Kristus molweni amushe, osheshi eitavelo leni otali tongwa mounyuni aushe.
Osheshi Kalunga, ou handi mu longele momhepo yange mokuudifa evaengeli lOmona waye, Oye ondobwedi yange, nhumbi handi mu dimbulukwa alushe,
nokwiindila alushe momailikano ange, ngolongo nda mona ngeno omhito iwa yokuuya kunye pahalo laKalunga.
Osheshi onda djuulukwa oku mu mona, ndi dule oku mu pa eeshalinghenda dimwe dopamhepo, mu pamekwe,
nokutya, ngeenge tu lyeni pamwe, ame ndi hekelekwe keitavelo letweni, oleni nolange.

Ndele ovamwatate, inandi hala mu kale muhe shi shii, nokutya, luhapu onda li nda hala okuuya kunye, opo ndi kale ndi noiimati imwe mokati keni yo, ngaashi mokati kovapaani vamwe, ndele onda kelelwa fiyo opaife.
Aame omunashikolo wOvagreka nowaava vehe fi Ovagreka, nowovanaendunge nowomalai;
kombinga yange hano onda hala ndi mu udifile evaengeli nanye yo ava mu li muRoma.
Osheshi ame ihandi fi ohoni evaengeli, osheshi olo eenghono daKalunga okuxupifa keshe tuu ou ta itavele, tete Omujuda nOmugreka yo.
Osheshi mulo ouyuki waKalunga otau holoka omeitavelo nokeitavelo, ngaashi pa shangwa: Omuyuki ota ka kala e nomwenyo meitavelo.
Osheshi ehandu laKalunga otali holoka tali di meulu li hange ouhenakalunga aushe noukolokoshi wovanhu ava hava kalifa oshili mouhenouyuki,
osheshi osho shomuKalunga otashi dulu okushiivika noshi li poluhaela mokati kavo, osheshi Kalunga e shi va hololela.
Osheshi oinima ihe wetike kokutya, eenghono daye daalushe noukalunga waye, otai monika nawa moilonga yaye okudja keshito lounyuni, ngeenge tai konakonwa, opo va kale vehe na elipopilo.
Osheshi nande vo va shiiva Kalunga, inave mu fimaneka ngaashi Kalunga, ngaashi inave mu pandula, ndelenee omadiladilo avo a ninga ongaho, nomitima davo dihe neendunge, oda nyika omulaulu.
Fimbo ve litanga ovo ovanaendunge, ova ninga omalai,
nefimano laKalunga iha xulu po, ve li faafanifa nolupe lomunhu ta xulu po, olupe leedila noloinamwenyo yomaulu ane nolaai hai lipweda.
Onghee hano Kalunga okwe va efela mouhalu womitima davo omeenyata, osho ngaha voovene tava fifa omalutu avo ohoni,
ovo va pingakanifa oshili yaKalunga noipupulu, ndele va fimaneka nova longela oshishitwa ponhele yOmushiti, ou ta kala Omufimanekwa fiyo alushe! Amen.
Onghee hano Kalunga okwe va efela mouhalu wohoni, osheshi ovakainhu vavo onghedi yopashitwe ove i pingakanifa naayo ihe fi yopashitwe,

nosho yo ovalumenhu va efa onghedi yopashitwe mokukalafana novakainhu, ndele mokuxwama mouhalu ova xwamekafana voovene: ndele ve lininga omulumenhu nomulumenhu oififahoni, ndele mokupwiduka kwavo va mona muvo vene ondjabi ye va yeleka.
Ndele ngaashi ovo va dina eshiivo lokushiiva Kalunga, osho yo Kalunga okwe va efela meendunge dii, va longe eshi inashi wapala:
va yada okuhenouyuki akushe, oluhaelo, owii, olwisho, oumbudi, ve yadi efupandubo, edipao, omakoto, oupote, ekonda,
ovaambi, ovalundili, ovatondikalunga, ovakolokoshi, ovalinenepeki, ovalitangi, ovatoti voinima ii, oonakuhadulika kovakulunhu,
omalai, vehe shii kulineekelwa, vehe nohole, ovatondi vombili, vehenonghenda,
ovo nande va shiiva nawa omhangela youyuki waKalunga, okutya, ovo hava ningi ngaha, ove lilongela efyo, itava ningi ashike ngaha voovene, ndele hava pande yo ava have shi ningi.
2: Onghee hano, omunhu ove, uhe nelipopilo, nande u kale oove olyelye ho tokola. Osheshi mwaai ho tokola omunhu, oho litokola ove mwene, osheshi ove ou ho tokola, osho yo ho ningi.
Ndele tu shi shii etokolo laKalunga oli li lopaushili kwava hava longo ei.
Ndele omunhu ove ou ho tokola ava hava ningi ngaha ndele osho ove mwene yo ho ningi, u shii oto i etokolo laKalunga onhapo?
Ile oto dini ouyadi wouwa nowonheni nowomutima mule waye, ndele ove ino shiiva ouwa waKalunga tau ku shilile kelidilululo?
Ndelenee melikukutiko loye nomokuhelidilulula kwomutima woye, oto lihapupalifile ehandu mefiku lehandu noleholoko liyuki laKalunga,
ou ta ka pa keshe tuu ou shi fike poilonga yaye:
Kwaava tava kongo oshinge nefimano nokuhaxulapo mokudiinina oilonga iwa, omwenyo waalushe,
ndelenee kwaava hava kongo osho shavo vene nokwaava ihava dulika koshili, ndele hava dulika koulunde, ehandukilo nonya.
Oudjuu netilo otali uya komwenyo wakeshe tuu omunhu ta ningi owii, tete owOmujuda nowOmugreka yo;
ndele oshinge nefimano nombili okukeshe tuu ou ta wanifa ouwa, tete Omujuda nOmugreka yo.
Osheshi Kalunga iha tale oshipala shomunhu.
Osheshi aveshe ava va nyona vehe nomhango, ovo tava ka kana vehe nomhango, ndele ava va nyona ve nomhango, otava ka tokolwa pamhango;
osheshi ava tava pwilikine omhango, havo ovayuki koshipala shaKalunga, ndelenee ovawanifi vomhango ovo tava ka yukipalifwa.
Osheshi ovapaani ava vehe nomhango, nge tava longo pashitwe eshi tashi pulwa komhango, nande vehe nomhango, ovo omhango kuvo vene,
ndele ohava holola nokutya, oshilonga shomhango osha shangelwa ngaha momitima davo, omaliudo avo pamwe nomadiladilo avo eshi taa hepaululilafana noku va pa oushima ile noku va popila,
efiku olo Kalunga eshi ta tokola muKristus Jesus oiholekwa yovanhu opavaengeli lange.
Tala, ngeenge ho ti, oove Omujuda, ndele ho lineekele omhango, ndele ho litangele Kalunga,
nehalo laye u li shii, ndele u shii okutongola oinima ei ya wapala shili, shaashi wa longwa momhango,
ndele ho diladila to dulu okukala omukwati komhango wovapofi, ouyelele waava ve li momulaulu,
omutekuli waava vehe neendunge, nomulongi wounona, eshi u na momhango olupe lounongo noloshili;
ongahelipi hano, ove ou ho longo ovanhu, iho lilongo ove mwene; ho udifa vaha vake, ndele ove ho vake;
ho ti, vo vaha haele, ndele ove ho haele, ho nyanyaula oikalunga ndele oto nyeke eetembeli;
ove ho litangele omhango ndele oto dini Kalunga mokunyona omhango?
Osheshi omolweni edina laKalunga tali shekwa movapaani, ngaashi pa shangwa.
Heeno, epitotanda otali kwafa ashike ngeenge to wanifa omhango; ndelenee ove ngeenge omunyoni womhango, opo nee nande wa pita etanda, oto kala wa fa ino li pita.
Navali, ou ina pita etanda, ngeenge ta wanifa eenghedi domhango, ita talwa mbela oye a pita etanda, nande ina pita etanda?
Hano ou ina pita etanda palutu ndele ota wanifa omhango, oye te ku tokola, oove ou u neendada domhango nowa pita etanda, ndele to nyono omhango.
Osheshi Omujuda haye ou e wetike kombada, nepitotanda kali fi eli hali ningwa kombada mombelela,
ndelenee, Omujuda washili oye ou Omujuda womeni, nepitotanda loshili oleli lomomutima, omomhepo, hapaendada, ndele ye oku nepandulo, hapovanhu, ndelenee opuKalunga.
3: Omujuda oku na shike e dule vamwe? Ile epitotanda otali kwafa shike?
Heeno, Ovajuda ova pewa shihapu nopaenghedi adishe, tete ova pewa eendjovo daKalunga.
Ongahelipi hano? Vamwe ngeenge inava itavela, okuhaitavela kwavo otaku dimi po mbela oudiinini waKalunga?

Nandenande. Kalunga na kale omunashili, ndele keshe omunhu omunaipupulu, ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Opo u shiivike oove omuyuki meendjovo doye,
u findane ngeenge to hokololifwa.”
Ndelenee oulunde wetu ngeenge tau holola ouyuki waKalunga, ohatu ti ngahelipi opo? Kalunga omulunde mbela, eshi ta handukile ta fulu onya? Nandenande. Ohandi popi panghedi yopanhu.
Osheshi ngeenge ongaha, Kalunga ota dulu ngahelipi okutokola ounyuni ngeenge ye ke fi omuyuki?
Hano oshili yaKalunga ngeenge tai hololwa nawa koipupulu yange, ye a fimanekwe, oshike hano ame handi tokolwa vali ngaashi omulunde?
Omolwashike inatu ningeni ngaashi vamwe moku tu lundila tava ti, ohatu ti vati: “Tu ningeni owii, omo mu dje ouwa?” Etokolo lavo ola yuka.
Ongahelipi hano? Otu li po tuu tu va dule? Ahowe, nande okanini. Osheshi opo otwa tomha aveshe, nokutya, aveshe Ovajuda nOvagreka, ove li koshi youlunde,

ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Kape na omuyuki nande umwe,
kape na omunandunge, kape na ou ta kongo Kalunga;

ovo aveshe va pumha mo, aveshe va vayapala;
kape na ou ta longo ouwa, nande umwe.
omakanya avo e yadi efingaelo noululu.
Eemhadi davo ohadi endelele okutilashi ohonde.
Ehanauno noluhepo li li meendjila davo,
nondjila yombili vehe i shii.
Etilokalunga kali li moipafi yomesho avo.”
Ndele fye otu shi shii, ashishe osho omhango tai shi popi, otai shi lombwele ava ve li koshi yomhango, opo okanya keshe ka mutikwe, nounyuni aushe u kale, u netimba koshipala shaKalunga;
osheshi kape na omunhu ta ka ninga omuyuki koshipala shaye okoilonga yomhango; osheshi momhango ohamu di eshiivo loulunde.
Ndelenee paife ouyuki waKalunga ou wa hepaululwa komhango nokovaxunganeki, owa holoka uhe nomhango,
nokutya, ouyuki waKalunga owomeitavelo laJesus Kristus otau uya mwaaveshe nokwaaveshe ava hava itavele, osheshi kaku na nande etongolo.
Osheshi aveshe ova nyona, novehe noshinge shaKalunga,
ndele otava yukipalifwa oshali okefilonghenda laye omolwekulilo eli lomuKristus Jesus.
Oye ou a tulwa po kuKalunga a ninge Omuhanganifi okeitavelo mohonde yaye, opo a holole ouyuki waye, osheshi monheni yaye Kalunga a efa omatimba a ningwa nale ine a handukila,
opo a holole ouyuki waye mefimbo eli lopaife, Ye mwene a kale omuyuki, Ye a yukipalife ou a itavela Jesus.
Elitango oli li peni? Ola kufwa po molwomhango yashike? Oyo ei yoilonga? Ahowe, omolwomhango yeitavelo.
Onghee hano ohatu ti: Omunhu ota yukipalifwa keitavelo pehe noilonga yomhango.
Ile Kalunga okOvajuda aveke mbela? Ke fi kovapaani yo? Heeno, oshili okovapaani yo,
osheshi Kalunga Oye umwe ta yukipalifa ovapiti vetanda, omeitavelo, naava inave li pita okeitavelo.
Omhango ohatu i dimi po keitavelo? Nandenande, ndelenee ohatu pameke omhango.
4: Ohatu ti ngahelipi hano, tatekulu Abraham okwa mona shike pambelela?
Osheshi Abraham ngeenge a yukipalifwa koilonga okwa wana okulitanga, ndele hakoshipala shaKalunga.
Osheshi omishangwa otadi ti ngahelipi? “Abraham okwa itavela Kalunga, ndele eitavelo olo le mu valulilwa ouyuki.”
Ndele ou ta longo oilonga, ofuto yaye itai valulwa panghenda, ndele opailonga oyo ye e i longa.
Ou ita longo oilonga ndele ta itavele ou ta yukipalifa omukehenakalunga, ota valulilwa eitavelo laye ouyuki;
ngaashi naDavid yo ta tongo omunhu omunelao, ou Kalunga te mu valulile ouyuki ehe noilonga, ta ti:

“Ovanelao ava omanyono avo a dimwa po
nomatimba avo a tuvikwa.

Omulumenhu omunelao oye ou,
Omwene ite mu valulile etimba.”
Hano elao eli la tongwa, olaava aveke va pita etanda ile naava inave li pita yo? Ndishi ohatu ti: “Abraham okwa valulilwa eitavelo laye ouyuki.”
Ole mu valulilwa ngahelipi hano? Ofimbo kwa li a pita etanda ile ofimbo ine li pita? Haleli e li pita, ndelenee fimbo ine li pita.

Ndele okwa pewa edidiliko lepitotanda, li ninge oshilimbo shouyuki womeitavelo a li e li kwete fimbo ina pita etanda, opo ye a ninge xe yaaveshe ava hava itavele vehe netanda, opo va valulilwe yo ouyuki;
opo a ninge xe yovapiti vetanda, ava vehe netanda ashike, ndelenee hava ende meemhadi deitavelo olo tate yetu Abraham kwa li e li kwete fimbo ina pita etanda.
Osheshi eudaneko olo nokutya, Abraham e nokufyuulula ounyuni, inali uya kuye ile koludalo laye komhango, ndelenee omolwouyuki womeitavelo.
Osheshi ava vomomhango ngeenge ovo ovafyuululi, opo nee eitavelo ola ninga longaho, neudaneko lihe na vali oshilonga.
Osheshi omhango otai pendula ehandu, ndele apa pehe nomhango netauluko yo.

Onghee hano okeitavelo, opo shi dje mefilonghenda; eudaneko opo li kale la pama shili, ololudalo alishe ndelenee halaava aveke vomomhango, ndelenee naava vomeitavelo laAbraham, ou tate yetweni atusheni,
ngaashi pa shangwa: “Ame onde ku tula po xe yoiwana ihapu okoshipala shaKalunga ou we mu itavela, naau ha nyumuna ovafi, ndele ta ifana oyo ihe po ongaashi ngeno i li po.”
Ye okwa li ha diinine eteelelo apa pehe neteelelo, ndele okwa itavela ota ningi xe yoiwana ihapu pandjovo ei: Oludalo loye otali ningi li fike opo,
ndele ye ina yululuka meitavelo nande okwa li e liwete olutu laye la kulupa, osheshi okwa li e needula efele nekuko loshidalelo shaSara a li e li shii;
ndele eudaneko laKalunga ine li limbililwa mokuhaitavela, ndelenee a li a pama meitavelo ndele okwa pa Kalunga efimano,
nokwa li e shi shii shili, eshi Kalunga e shi udaneka, ota dulu yo oku shi wanifa.
Molwaasho “le mu valulilwa ouyuki.”
Ndelenee hamolwaye aeke pa shangwa, “le mu valulilwa ouyuki,”
ndelenee molwetu yo ava hatu li valulilwa ouyuki, ngeenge hatu itavele ou a nyumuna Jesus Omwene wetu movafi,
ou a yandjelwa omanyonauno etu ndele okwa nyumuninwa eyukipalifo letu.
5: Hano eshi twa yukipalifwa keitavelo, otu nombili naKalunga molwOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus,
molwaau twa mona yo meitavelo omhito yokufikila mefilonghenda eli omo hatu kala, nohatu lifimanekele eteelelo loshinge shaKalunga.
Ndelenee hasho ashike, ohatu lifimanekele omaudjuu yo, shaashi otu shi shii omaudjuu otaa dala elididimiko,
nelididimiko oudiinini, noudiinini eteelelo;
ndele eteelelo itali fifa ohoni, osheshi ohole yaKalunga oya tililwa momitima detu mOmhepo Iyapuki twe mu pewa.
Osheshi fye fimbo twa li oingone, Kristus okwa fila ovahenakalunga pefimbo la wapala.
Walye nee, ngeenge otaku monika ou te liyandje mokufya omolwomuyuki; heeno kashiimba ku na tuu ou e nouladi a file ou muwa.
Ndelenee Kalunga okwe tu hololela ohole yaye oku tu hola, Kristus eshi e tu fila fimbo twa li natango ovalunde.
Hano unene tuu paife, eshi twa yukipalifwa mohonde yaye, ohatu xupifwa molwaye omehandu.
Hano ngeenge fye, fimbo twa li ovatondi vaKalunga twa kwatakanifwa naye molwefyo lOmona waye, hano unene tuu paife, eshi twa kwatakanifwa, ohatu xupifwa kokukalamwenyo kwaye eshi e nomwenyo.
Ndele hasho ashike, ndele ohatu lifimanekele Kalunga omolwOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus mwaau twa mona ekwatakanifo.
Onghee hano, ngaashi oulunde wa etwa mounyuni komunhu umwe, nefyo okoulunde, osho nee efyo ole uya movanhu aveshe, shaashi aveshe va nyona.
Osheshi oulunde owa li mounyuni fimbo omhango ya li ihe po, ndele oulunde kau niwe nao apa pehe nomhango;
osho hano efyo la pangela okudja kuAdam fiyo okuMoses nokuvenya va li inava nyona panghedi yokunyona kwaAdam, oye tuu ou oshihopaelelwa shaau a li te ke uya.

Ndele oshalinghenda inashi fa enyono, osheshi omolwenyono laumwe vahapu ova fya, hano unenenene efilonghenda noshiyandjiwa shaKalunga omolwefilonghenda lomunhu umwe, Jesus Kristus, ola hapupalela vahapu.
Ndele poshali kape li ngaashi pwaashi sha etwa komunyoni umwe, osheshi muumwe omwa dja etokolo lokukanifa, ndele oshalinghenda otai eta eyukipalifo momanyono mahapu.

Hano ngeenge okokutauluka kwomunhu umwe efyo la pangelele omolwaau umwe, hano unene tuu ava tava tambula ouyadi wonghenda nowoshali youyuki otava ka pangela mokukalamwenyo taku uya omolwaau umwe, Jesus Kristus.
Hano osho pe li, ngaashi etauluko laumwe la etela ovanhu aveshe etokolo lekano, osho yo oshilonga shouyuki shaumwe tashi etele ovanhu aveshe eyukipalifo lomwenyo;
osheshi ngaashi kokuhadulika kwomunhu ou umwe ava vahapu va ninga ovalunde, osho yo kokudulika kwaau umwe ava vahapu tava ningi ovayuki.
Ndelenee omhango oye uya pokati, omatimba opo a ninge mahapu; ndelenee apa omatimba a ninga mahapu, ouyadi wefilonghenda tau monika.
Opo ngaashi oulunde wa pangela mefyo, osho yo efilonghenda tali pangele omolwouyuki li ete omwenyo waalushe molwaJesus Kristus, Omwene wetu.
6: Ohatu ti shike hano? Natu twikile okukala moulunde, efilonghenda li hapupale?
Nandenande. Fye ava twa fya mo moulunde, ohatu kala mo ngahelipi vali?
Ile kamu shi shii kutya, ofye ava twa shashelwa muKristus Jesus, otwa shashelwa mefyo laye?
Ndele otwa pakwa pamwe naye okeshasho omokufya, opo ngaashi Kristus a nyumunwa movafi koshinge shaXe, osho nafye yo tu nokweenda mokukalamwenyo kupe.
Osheshi ngeenge twa kwatakanifwa naye nokufaafana mefyo laye, ohatu ka kwatakanifwa naye nokufaafana menyumuko laye,
eshi tu shi shii kutya, omunhu wetu mukulu okwa valelwa pamwe naye, opo olutu loulunde li hanaunwe po, tuha longele vali oulunde;
osheshi ou a fya, oye okwa manguluka moulunde.
Ndele ngeenge twa fya pamwe naKristus, ohatu itavele nokutya, ohatu ka kala yo tu nomwenyo pamwe naye,
shaashi otu shi shii, Kristus eshi a nyumunwa movafi, ita fi vali, efyo itali mu pangele vali.
Osheshi eshi a fya, okwa fya mo moulunde lumwe aluke, ndele eshi ta kala e nomwenyo, ota kalele Kalunga.
Hano nanye yo litaleni, onye mwa fya mo moulunde, ndele omu nomwenyo okukalela Kalunga muKristus Jesus Omwene wetu.
Hano oulunde inau pangela momalutu eni omafi nye mu dulike ngeno kouhalu wao.
Inamu yandja oinhimbu yeni koulunde i kale oilongifo youhenouyuki, ndele liyandjeni nye vene kuKalunga ngaashi ava va nyumuka movafi, noinhimbu yeni i kale oilongifo youyuki kuKalunga.
Osheshi oulunde itau mu pangele shaashi kamu li koshi yomhango, ndelenee okoshi yefilonghenda.
Ongahelipi hano? Natu nyone mbela, shaashi tuhe li koshi yomhango, ndele okoshi yefilonghenda? Nandenande.

Kamu shi shii, kutya nge nye otamu liyandje komunhu mu ninge ovapiya vaye vokudulika kuye, onye ovapiya vaau tamu dulika kuye, ile nge ovapiya voulunde tau twala mefyo, ile ovapiya veduliko tali twala mouyuki?
Ndelenee Kalunga na pandulwe, shaashi nye ava mwa li ovapiya voulunde, omwa dulika momitima deni okolupe lelongo eli mwa twalwa mulo,
eshi mwa mangululwa moulunde, omwa ninga nee ovapiya vouyuki.
Ohandi popi panhu molwoungone wombelela yeni. Osheshi ngaashi nale mwa yandja oinhimbu yeni ovapiya vonyata novoukolokoshi omoukolokoshi, osho nopaife yandjeni oinhimbu yeni ovapiya vouyuki meyapulo.
Osheshi fimbo mwa li ovapiya voulunde omwa li muhe nouyuki.
Pomafiku enya omwa li mu noiimati ya tya ngahelipi? Oyo tuu ei mwe i fya ohoni paife. Osheshi exulilo loinima oyo olo efyo.
Ndelenee paife eshi mwa manguluka moulunde, ndele mwa ninga ovapiya vaKalunga omu na oiimati yeni tai twala meyapulo, ndele exulilo olo omwenyo waalushe.
Osheshi ondjabi youlunde oyo efyo, ndelenee oshalinghenda yaKalunga oyo omwenyo waalushe muKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu.
7: Ile kamu shi shii, ovamwatate nye, ohandi popi kwaava va shiiva omhango, kutya omhango otai pangele omunhu fimbo e nomwenyo?
Omhango ngaashi tai mangele omukainhu omuhombolwa kumwe nomulumenhu waye fimbo ye e nomwenyo; ndele omulumenhu ngeenge a fi, opo nee omukainhu a manguluka momhango yomulumenhu.

Onghee hano, ngeenge te liyandje komulumenhu umwe fimbo omulumenhu waye e nomwenyo, ota ifanwa omunyoni wohombo, ndele omulumenhu ngeenge a fi, okwa manguluka momhango ei, ke fi omunyoni wohombo, ngeenge ta hombolwa komulumenhu umwe.
Osho nanye yo, ovamwatate, omwa fya mo momhango okolutu laKristus, mu ninge vaumwe, ovaau a nyumunwa movafi, opo tu imikile Kalunga oiimati.
Osheshi eshi twa kala mombelela, ouhalu woulunde ou hau tukululwa komhango, owa mona eenghono moinhimbu yetu okwiimikila efyo oiimati.
Ndelenee otwa manguluka momhango notwa fya mo muyo, ei kwa li ye tu kwatelela mo, ndele hatu kalele Kalunga omoupe wOmhepo hamoukulu weendada.
Paife ohatu ti shike hano? Omhango oyo oulunde? Nandenande. Osheshi ngeno hamhango ya li po, ngeno inandi shiiva oulunde; osheshi omhango ngeno inai tya: “Ino haluka”, ngeno inandi shiiva okahalu.
Ndelenee oulunde eshi wa mona omhito molwoshipango, owa tukulula mwaame ouhalu keshe; osheshi oulunde uhe nomhango owa fya.
Ndele ame onda kala nale ndihe nomhango, ndele oshipango eshi she uya, opo nee oulunde wa nyumuka,
ndele ame onda fya. Osho pa holoka nokutya, oshipango eshi sha li shi nokupa nge omwenyo, osha pa nge efyo.
Osheshi oulunde eshi wa mona omhito molwoshipango owa pukifa nge, ndele wa dipaifa nge koshipango.
Onghee tuu, omhango oyo iyapuki, noshipango osho oshiyapuki noshiyuki noshiwa.
Hano eshi shiwa osha etela nge efyo mbela? Nandenande. Ndelenee oulunde, opo u holoke oo oulunde wa etela nge efyo kwaashi shiwa, opo oulunde u ninge shili oulundelela okoshipango.
Osheshi tu shi shii omhango oyopamhepo, ndelenee ame owopambelela, nda landelwa oulunde, ndi kale koshi yao.
Osheshi eshi handi longo kandi shi shii, osheshi eshi nde shi hala, itandi shi wanifa, ndele eshi handi tondo, ohandi shi longo.
Ndele ngeenge handi longo eshi inandi shi hala, ohandi itavele nokutya, omhango oyo iwa.
Hano paife, haame mwene vali handi shi longo, ndelenee oulunde ou wa kala mwaame.
Shaashi ondi shi shii mwaame, nokutya, mombelela yange kamu na ouwa nande washa. Ehalo ondi li kwete, ndelenee eenghono dokuwanifa ouwa, ahowe;
shaashi ouwa ou nde u hala, ihandi u longo, ndele owii ou inandi u hala, ohandi u longo.
Hano ngeenge ohandi longo eshi shii, haame vali handi shi longo, ndelenee oulunde ou wa kala mwaame.
Ame, ou nda hala okulonga ouwa, ondi wete mwaame omhango ei: Owii wa kanyatela nge.
Shaashi kombinga yomunhu ou womeni onda dimina nehafo omhango yaKalunga,
ndele moinhimbu yange ondi wete omhango ikwao tai kondjifa omhango yomadiladilo ange, ndele otai pikile nge momhango youlunde i li moinhimbu yange.
Aame omunhu mwii, olyelye ta mangulula nge molutu eli lefyo?
Kalunga na pandulwe omolwaJesus Kristus, Omwene wetu! Osho hano ame mwene nomadilongo ange handi longele omhango yaKalunga, ndele nombelela omhango youlunde.
8: Hano paife kape netokolo lokukanifa ava ve li muKristus Jesus, ava itava ende pambelela, ndelenee lopaMhepo.
Osheshi omhango yOmhepo yomwenyo muKristus Jesus oya mangulula nge momhango youlunde noyefyo.

Osheshi eshi sha nyenga omhango shaashi ya nghonopalekwa kombelela, Kalunga okwe shi longa, eshi a tuma Omona waye mwene molupe lombelela ya nyika oulunde nomolwoulunde, ndele okwa tokola oulunde mombelela,
opo ouyuki, ou tau pulwa komhango, u wanifwe mufye ava ihatu ende pambelela ndele opaMhepo.
Osheshi ava ve li pambelela otava diladila eshi shopambelela, ndelenee ava ve li paMhepo otava diladila eshi shOmhepo.
Osheshi omadiladilo ombelela oo efyo, ndele omadiladilo Omhepo omwenyo nombili;
osheshi ombelela ohai diladila olwoodi naKalunga, shaashi ihai dulika komhango yaKalunga, ngaashi itai shi dulu.
Ndele ava hava pangelwa kombelela itava dulu okuwapalela Kalunga.
Ndele nye itamu pangelwa kombelela, ndelenee okOmhepo, ngeenge Omhepo yaKalunga otai kala munye. Ndele ou ehe nOmhepo yaKristus, ke fi waye.
Ndelenee Kristus ngeenge e li munye, olutu ola fya molwoulunde, ndele omhepo oyo omwenyo omolwouyuki.
Nongeenge Omhepo yaau a nyumuna Jesus movafi e li munye, opo nee ou a nyumuna Kristus Jesus movafi, ota nyumuna omalutu eni yo omafi okOmhepo yaye ei i li munye.
Ovamwatate, ofye hano ovanaikolo, ndelenee havombelela tu kale pambelela.
Osheshi ngeenge tamu kala pambelela omu nokufya, ndele oilonga yolutu ngeenge tamu i dipaifa kOmhepo, otamu kala mu nomwenyo.
Osheshi aveshe ava hava endifwa kOmhepo yaKalunga, ovo ovana vaKalunga.
Osheshi nye inamu pewa omhepo youpika mu kale vali moumbada, ndelenee omwa pewa Omhepo mwaau hatu ifana: “Abba! Tate!”
Omhepo oyo vene tai hepaulula pamwe nomhepo yetu, ofye ovana vaKalunga.
Ndele ngeenge fye ovana, otuvafyuululi yo, ovafyuululi vaKalunga novafyuululi pamwe naKristus, ngeenge hatu lididimike shili pamwe naye, opo tu fimanekwe yo pamwe naye.
Ame ohandi ti: omauyehame omefimbo lopaife kae shii kuyelekwa noshinge eshi tashi ka holoka mufye.
Osheshi nokudjuulukwa shili oishitwa aishe tai teelele eholoko lovana vaKalunga.
Osheshi oishitwa ya yandjwa menyonauko, hakehalo layo vene, ndele olaau e i yandja, onghee tuu i neteelelo,
osheshi oishitwa yoovene otai ka mangululwa moupika wenyonauko i ye memanguluko loshinge shovana vaKalunga.
Osheshi otu shi shii oishitwa aishe ohai keme kumwe nafye ndele oi nefeto lokudala fiyo opaife.
Ndele hayo aike, nafye yo ava tu kwete oshali yotete yOmhepo, nafye yo ohatu keme meni letu mokuteelela okutambulwa moudalwa nokutya, ekulilo lomalutu etu.
Osheshi meteelelo fye otwa xupifwa, ndele eteelelo olo tali monika la wanifwa, kali fi eteelelo, osheshi eshi shi wetike otashi teelelwa ngahelipi?
Ndele ngeenge hatu teelele eshi tuhe shi wete, ohatu shi teelele nokulididimika.
Ndele osho yo Omhepo otai tu kwafa moungone wetu, osheshi katu shii eshi tu noku shi ilikana, ngaashi ngeno tu nokwiilikana, ndelenee Omhepo oyo mwene te tu ilikanene nomikemo dihe shii okutumbulwa.
Ndele omukonakoni womitima oku shi shii eshi Omhepo tai shi diladila, osheshi Omhepo otai ilikanene ovayapuki pahalo laKalunga.
Ndele otu shi shii, ava ve hole Kalunga, oinima aishe kumwe otave i longelwa ouwa, ava va ifanwa pamhangela yaye.
Osheshi ava e va shii shito, okwe va nunina yo shito va fe olupe lOmona waye, opo a kale shiveli mokati kovamwaxe vahapu;
ndele ava e va nunina shito, okwe va ifana yo, ndele ava e va ifana, okwe va yukipalifa yo, ndele ava e va yukipalifa, okwe va fimanekifa yo.
Ohatu ti ngahelipi hano apa? Kalunga ngeenge e tu ama, olyelye ta tu ondubo nafye?
Oye ou ina xupifa Omona waye mwene, ndele okwe mu yandja omolwetu atushe, a kale ngahelipi hano ite tu pe aishe pamwe naye?
Olyelye ta dulu okuyandja etimba kovahoololwa vaKalunga? Kalunga Oye tuu ou ta yukipalifa.
Olyelye ou ta tokolele mekano? Kristus Jesus Oye tuu ou a fya, heeno, okwa nyumunwa nokuli, oku li kolulyo laKalunga, note tu ilikanene yo.
Olyelye ou te tu tukula mohole yaKristus? Oudjuu mbela, ile efininiko ile okutewatewa ile ondjala ile onghai ile oshiponga ile eongamukonda?

Ongaashi pa shangwa:
“Omutenya aushe ohatu ku dipaelwa,
twa talwa ngaashi eedi tadi dipawa.”
Ndelenee mwaai aishe ohatu findi nokufindilila omolwaau e tu hole.
Osheshi ondi shi shii shili, hafyo ile omwenyo, havaengeli ile ovapangelinghono, hayei yopaife ile ei yokomesho, haenghono,
haule wopombada ile oule woposhi, hashishitwa nande shimwe tashi dulu oku tu tukula mohole yaKalunga yomuKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu.
9: Ame ohandi popi oshili muKristus, ihandi fufya, neliudo lange otali hepaulula pamwe naame mOmhepo Iyapuki,
nokutya, ondi noluhodi linene nouyehame alushe momutima wange.
Onda hala ame mwene ngeno ndi fingwe, nondi tongolwe mo muKristus omolwovamwatate ava vomoludi lange pambelela,
ovo Ovaisraeli, ovo oonakupewa oudalwa noshinge nomahangano; va pewa omhango, nove nelongelokalunga nomaudaneko;
ooxekulu, omuvo mwa dja Kristus pambelela, Oye ou e li kombada yaaveshe, Kalunga, Omufimanekwa alushe fiyo alushe! Amen!
Ndelenee hakutya, ondjovo yaKalunga oya puka ngeno. Osheshi ava va dja muIsrael haaveshe Ovaisraeli.
Osho vali haaveshe ovana, nande ovo oludalo laAbraham, osheshi okwa tiwa: “MuIsak oto mono mo oludalo olo tali ku lukilwa,”
nokutya: ovana ava vopambelela, havo ovana vaKalunga, ndelenee ovana veudaneko ovo tava valulilwa moludalo.
Osheshi ondjovo yeudaneko oyo ei: “Pefimbo ngaashi eli ohandi uya, ndele Sara ota ka kala e nokaana okamati.”
Ndelenee hasho ashike osho; naRebeka yo ou a ninga oufimba komulumenhu umwe, tate yetu Isak;
fimbo ounona inava dalwa, noinava longa ouwa ile owii--opo omhangela yaKalunga yopahoololo i kalelele, hamolwoilonga ndele omolwomwiifani,
okwa lombwelwa: “Omukulunhu e nokukalela ondenge yaye,”
ngaashi pa shangwa: “Jakob onde mu hokwa, ndele Esau onde mu tonda.”
Ohatu ti ngahelipi hano? MuKalunga omu na tuu mbela ouhenouyuki? Nandenande.
Osheshi Oye ta ti kuMoses: “Ohandi ka fila onghenda ou handi mu file onghenda, nohandi ka fila olukeno ou handi mu file olukeno.”
Hano nena kashi fi shaau a hala, noshihe fi shaau ta tondoka, ndele oshaKalunga ou ta file onghenda.
Osheshi omushangwa otau ti kuFarao: “Osho ngaha nde ku yelula poluhaela, ndi monikife mwoove eenghono dange, nedina lange li hepaululwe nounyuni aushe.”
Hano Oye ta filonghenda ou Ye a hala, nota kukutike ou Ye a hala.
Oto ti mbela kwaame: “Oshike hano ta velele nge ombedi? Osheshi olyelye ta dulu okwaanya ehalo laye?”
Menhu oove, heeno shili, ndele oove lyelye eshi wa hala okukondja naKalunga? Ndishi oshihongomwa itashi lombwele omuhongi washo: “Oshike wa honga nge ngaha?”
Ile omuhongi woitoo ita dulu a honge medu tuu eli limwe oshitoo shefimano noshikwao shihe nefimano?
Ndelenee nande Kalunga a hala okuholola ehandu laye nokushiivifa eenghono daye, okwe lididimika nonheni inene oitoo yehandukilo ei ya wana okunyonaunwa po,
opo a shiivife ouhapu wefimano laye moitoo yefilonghenda oyo e i longekidila nale efimano.
Nafye yo ava e tu ifana, hamOvajuda aveke, ndelenee nomovapaani yo,

ngaashi a tonga muHosea:
“Oshiwana sha li shihe fi shange,
ohandi ke shi luka ‘oshiwana shange,’
naau ehe fi omuholike wange, ‘omuholike’,

ndele tapa ningwa monhele tuu oyo va lombwelwa:
‘Onye kamu fi oshiwana shange,’
otava ka ifanwa ovana vaKalunga omunamwenyo.”
Ndele Jesaja ota ingida ta popi Israel: “Nonande omuvalu wovana vaIsrael nau fike peheke lopomunghulo wefuta, oshixupe ashike tashi xupifwa.
Osheshi Omwene ota ka wanifa ondjovo yaye kombada yedu, ndele ote i wanifa polumwe.”

Ngaashi Jesaja a xunganeka a tya:
“Omwene weengudu dovakwaita ngeno ine tu xupifila oludalo,
ngeno twa ninga twa fa Sodom, notwa ningwa ngaashi Gomorra.”
Ohatu ti ngahelipi hano? Ohatu ti: Ovapaani ava inava lalakanena ouyuki, ovo va hanga ouyuki, ndele ouyuki ou otau di meitavelo.
Ndele Israel ou a li a lalakanena omhango youyuki, ina hanga omhango oyo.
Oshike? Osheshi inave i konga keitavelo, ndele okoilonga; osho nee ve lipuma kemanya lepundukifo.

Ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Tala, ohandi dikile muSion emanya lokupuma
nemanya lokupundula,
ndele keshe ou te mu itavele, ita ka fifwa ohoni.”
10: Ovamwatate, onda hala nomutima wange, ndele handi va indilile kuKalunga va xupifwe.
Osheshi ohandi va hepaulula kutya ove na ouladi okukondjela Kalunga, ndele hapakushiiva;
osheshi inava shiiva ouyuki waKalunga, ndele va hala okudika ouyuki wavo vene, inave liyandja koshi youyuki waKalunga.
Osheshi Kristus Oye exulilo lomhango, Oye ouyuki wakeshe tuu ou ta itavele.
Osheshi Moses okwa shanga nokupopya ouyuki ou womomhango, okutya, omunhu ou te u wanifa, ota kala e nomwenyo kuo.
Ndele ouyuki ou womeitavelo otau ti ngaha: “Momwenyo woye ino tya: olyelye ta londo meulu?” nokutya, a ka tale ko Kristus;
ile: “Olyelye ta filukile moshi mwi?” nokutya, a ka yelule mo Kristus movafi.
Ndelenee otau ti ngahelipi? Ondjovo i li popepi naave, mokanya koye nomomutima woye, oyo ondjovo yeitavelo ei hatu i udifa.
Osheshi ngeenge to hepaulula nokanya nokutya, Jesus Oye Omwene, ndele to itavele momutima woye, kutya Kalunga e mu nyumuna movafi, oto xupifwa;
osheshi okwiitavela nomutima otaku yukipalifa, nokuhepaulula nokanya otaku xupifa.
Osheshi omushangwa otau ti: “Keshe ou te mu itavele, ita ka fifwa ohoni.”
Osheshi apa kape netongolo pokati kOmujuda nOmugreka; osheshi Oye tuu ou Omwene waaveshe, nomuyandji woupuna kwaaveshe ava tave mu ifana.
Osheshi: “Keshe tuu ou ta ifana edina lOmwene, oye ota xupifwa.”
Ndele otava kuu ngahelipi kwaau inave mu itavela? Ndele tava itavele ngahelipi ou inave mu uda? Ndele tava udu ngahelipi ngeenge kape nomuudifi?
Ndele otava udifa ngahelipi, ngeenge itava tumwa? Ngaashi pa shangwa: “Eemhadi oda fewa ngahelipi daava hava udifa eenghundana diwa.”
Ndele haaveshe va dulika kevaengeli, osheshi Jesaja ota ti: “Omwene, olyelye a itavela eudifo letu?”
Hano eitavelo ohali di mokuuda, nokuuda omondjovo yaKristus.

Ndele ohandi pula: “Inava uda mbela?
Heeno, ondaka yavo oya ya nedu alishe,
neendjovo davo ofiyo okominghulo dounyuni.”

Ndele ohandi pula: Israel ine shi shiiva mbela? Tete Moses ota ti:
“Ohandi mu fifa efupandubo koshiwana shihe fi nande oshiwana,
ndele handi mu fifa ouladi koshiwana shihe neendunge.”

Ndele Jesaja e na ouladi, ta ti:
“Ame onda monika kwaava inava konga nge,
ndele nda holokela ava inava pula nge.”
Ndele mokutonga Israel ota ti: “Onda twala omaoko ange omutenya aushe koshiwana ihashi dulika, shi noshityani.”
11: Ame ohandi pula hano: Kalunga okwa ekelashi mbela oshiwana shaye? Nandenande. Osheshi naame yo Omuisraeli womoludalo laAbraham, womapata aBenjamin.
Kalunga ina ekelashi oshiwana shaye e shi shiiva nale. Ile kamu shi shii eshi omushangwa tau ti mokuhepaulula Elia, nhumbi ta popi Israel kuKalunga ta ti:
“Omwene, ovaxunganeki voye ove va dipaa, ndele va kumauna po eealtari doye, aame andike nda xupa po, notava nangele omwenyo wange.”
Ndelenee enyamukulo laKalunga otali mu lombwele shike? “Ame onde lixupifila ovalumenhu omayovi aheyali ava inava twa eengolo koshipala shaBaal.”
Osho ngaha nomefimbo lopaife yo oku na oshixupe pahoololo lefilonghenda.
Ehoololo okefilonghenda, hakoilonga; ngee okoilonga yomunhu, nena efilonghenda laKalunga kali fi vali efilonghenda.
Ongahelipi hano? Eshi Israel he shi lalakanene, ine shi hanga, ndelenee ovahoololwa ve shi hanga: vakwao va kukuta,

ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Kalunga okwe va pa omhepo yeemhofi,
omesho aha mone ko nomatwi aha ude ko
fiyo onena eli.”

NaDavid ota ti:
“Oshililo shavo nashi va ningile elulo noshiliva
nepundukifo nonghone,

omesho avo naa twike, vaha mone ko;
ndele ove petameka natango eembuda davo.”
Ame handi ti hano: Ovajuda ova pundukile? Ahowe, itashi dulika. Ndele eshi va nyona, exupifo ole uya kovapaani, opo Ovajuda ve va twile ondubo.
Ndelenee epunduko lavo ngeenge oupuna wounyuni, nokuninipikwa kwavo oupuna wovapaani, ouyadi wavo otau eta oupuna u fike peni!
Ohandi popi kunye ovapaani (Ovakriste vomovapaani), ngaashi aame omuyapostoli kovapaani, handi fimaneke oshilonga shange,
ndi ladipike, ngeenge tashi dulika, oludi lange, nondi xupife nande vamwe vomuvo.
Osheshi okweekelwashi kwavo ngeenge kwa ninga ekwatakanifo lounyuni, okutambulwa kwavo oshike nee, ngeenge kaku fi okunyumuka movafi?
Ndele ngeenge omungome wotete omuyapuki nosho yo olumbololo lomungome alishe oliyapuki, nomudi ngeenge omuyapuki, noitai yo oiyapuki.
Ndele ngeenge oitai imwe oya tetwa ko, naave, ove olumono lomofuka, wa twikwa mokati koitai, ou wa pewa oshitukulwa shoye komidi nokomeva olumono liwa,
ino linenepeka nokudina oitai; ngeenge oto linenepeke, kala u shi shii, haave wa humbata efina, efina olo le ku kwatelela.
Ove to ti mbela: “Oitai ei oya tetwa ko, opo ame ndi twikwe ko.”
Eewa hano, vo ova tetwa ko kokuhaitavela kwavo, ndele ove owa kwatelwa ko keitavelo loye. Ino linenepeka, kala wa tila,
osheshi Kalunga ngeenge ina xupifa oitai yopashitwe, naave yo ite ku xupifa.
Tala hano ouwa nouladihandu waKalunga, ouladihandu waye kwaava ve mu efa, ndele ouwa waKalunga kwoove, ngee to kala mouwa waye; ngee hasho, naave yo oto kewa ko.
Navo yo, ngeenge itava anyene mokuhaitavela kwavo, otava ka twikwa mo, osheshi Kalunga e neenghono oku va twikulula mo.
Osheshi ove ngee wa kewa mo molumono lomofuka, nowa twikwa molumono liwa la tekulwa, lihe fi lomoludi loye, hano unene tuu oitai ei yopashitwe otai ka twikwa molumono lavo vene.
Osheshi ovamwatate, opo muha ye neendunge deni vene, onda hala ndi mu hololele oshiholekwa eshi: Elikukutiko ola hanga Israel kombinga, fiyo ouyadi wovapaani we uya mo.

ndele ehangano lange navo olo eli,
eshi handi kufa po omatimba avo.”
Pavaengeli, ovo ovanaita molweni, ndelenee pahoololo, ovo ovaholike omolwootate.
Osheshi eeshalinghenda neifano laye Kalunga ihe li lundulula.
Osheshi ngaashi nye nale mwa li inamu dulika kuKalunga, ndele paife omwa mona efilonghenda omolwokuhadulika kwavo,
osho tuu naava va kala ihava dulika paife, opo molwefilonghenda eli mwe li pewa, ovo yo va mone efilonghenda paife.
Osheshi Kalunga okwa idilila aveshe mokuhadulika, opo e va file onghenda aveshe.
Oule u fike peni woupuna noweendunge nowounongo waKalunga? Omatokolo aye ohaa konakonwa kulyelye, neendjila daye olyelye e di shii?

“Osheshi olyelye a shiiva omayele Omwene?
Ile olyelye a kala omupukululi waye?

Ile olyelye e mu pa sha tete,
ye e shi mu futile?”
Osheshi aishe oyomuye nomolwaye ndele tai shuna kuye. Oye na fimanekwe alushelushe. Amen.
12: Osho nee ovamwatate, ame ohandi mu kumaidifa efilonghenda laKalunga, yandjeni omalutu eni eyambo liyapuki li nomwenyo, la wapalela Kalunga; olo elongelokalunga leni lopandunge.
Ndele nye inamu faafana nounyuni ou, ndelenee shitukeni vape momadiladilo eni, opo mu shiive okukonakona ehalo laKalunga olilipi, naashi shiwa, sha wapalela nosha wana.

Osheshi kefilonghenda olo nde li pewa ohandi mu lombwele, keshe umwe mokati keni muhe lidiladilile kombada yaashi she mu yeleka, ndele kendabaleni okudiladila pandjele, keshe tuu ou pauhapu weitavelo laye, olo Kalunga e li mu pa.
Osheshi ngaashi tu kwete molutu limwe tu na oinhimbu ihapu, ndele oinhimbu aishe kai na oshilonga shimwe ashike,
osho yo nafye nande tu li po vahapu, ofye olutu limwe muKristus, ndele mokukalafana kwetu ofye oinhimbu;
ndele otu na eeshalinghenda di lili nadi lili pafilonghenda olo twe li pewa: ngeenge ku na ou e noshili youxunganeki, ne i longife paitavelo,
ngeenge e na oshilongayakulo, ne shi diinine, ou ta longo ovanhu, na kale omudiinini mokulonga;
ngeenge omukumaidi, na kumaide; ou ta yandje, na yandje nomutima muwa; ou omukwatelikomesho, na kwatele komesho nouladi; ou ta longo eyakulo longhenda, na yakule nehafo.
Ohole inai kala noihelele, tileni owii, dameni ouwa.
Mokuhola ovamwaxo filafaneni olukeno, mokufimanekafana paafaneni oshihopaelelwa.
Mokulalakana kweni inamu fya ounye; kaleni mwa xwama momhepo; kaleleni Omwene.
Hafeleni meteelelo, lididimikeni moudjuu, diinineni mokwiilikana.
Yakuleni ovayapuki meemhumbwe davo; idilileni ovaendanandjila.
Nangekeni noupuna ava tave mu taataa. Nangekeni noupuna, nye inamu finga.
Hafeni novahafi, lileni naava hava lili.
Kaleni mu nediladilo limwe, inamu lovelela ei oinenenima, kaleni mwa wana naai ixupi. Inamu litala onye ovanaendunge.
Inamu alulila nande omunhu owii waye. Lalakaneneni ei ya wapalela ovanhu aveshe.
Ngeenge tashi dulika, kombinga yeni kaleni nombili novanhu aveshe.
Ovaholike, nye vene inamu alulila omunhu owii, ndelenee peni ehandu laKalunga omhito. Shaashi opa shangwa: “Ehandu olange, Aame handi futu, Omwene osho ta ti.”
Ndelenee: “Omutondi woye ngeenge e nondjala, mu pakela po nongeenge e nenota, mu nwefa, osheshi ngeenge to ningi ngaha, oto mu ongelele omakala a xwama komutwe waye.”
Ino findwa kowii, dula owii onouwa.
13: Omunhu keshe na dulike kovapangeli ava have mu pangele. Osheshi kape na nande epangelo inali dja kuKalunga; ovapangeli ava ve li po, ova tulwa po kuKalunga.
Onghee hano ou ta anye okudulika kepangelo, ota tu ondubo nomhangela yaKalunga; ndele ava tava tu ondubo, otava ka handukilwa.
Osheshi ovapangeli inava tulwa po va tilife ava hava longo ouwa, ndelenee ovava hava longo owii. Hano ngeenge wa hala u kale ito tila epangelo, longa ouwa, ndele to pandulwa kulo;

osheshi olo omuyakuli waKalunga oku ku popila. Ndele ngeenge to longo owii, kala wa tila; osheshi eongamukonda inave li djala epwanga, osheshi olo omuyakuli waKalunga okuhandukila ava tava longo owii.
Osho hano mu nokudulika, hamolwehandukilo alike, ndelenee omolweliudo.
Osho nee hamu fendele. Osheshi ovapangeli ovo ovayakuli vaKalunga nomolwaashi hava diinine meyakulo lavo.
Yandjeni kwaaveshe eshi mu nokuyandja: efendelo kwaau e nokupewa efendelo, omakungudo ou e noku a pewa, nokutila ou e nokutilika, efimano kwaau e nokufimanekwa.
Inamu kala noshikolo nomunhu, ndele noshikolo shokuholafana osho ashike, osheshi ou e hole mukwao oye a wanifa omhango.
Osheshi edi: “Ino nyona ohombo, ino dipaa, ino vaka, ino lundila, ino haluka,” noshipango keshe shikwao, oyo ya mangwa kumwe kondjovo ei: “Hola mukweni ngaashi ove u lihole mwene.”
Ohole itai ningile mukwao owii nande washa, osheshi ohole oyo ewanifo lomhango.
Ndele eshi shi ningeni, efimbo eli eshi mu li shii, nokutya, otundi oya fika mu penduke mo meemhofi; osheshi exupifo letu oli li popepi nafye paife, li dule lefiku olo twa hovela okwiitavela.
Oufiku owa fika keengula, omutenya ou li popepi. Tu liduleni hano oilonga yomulaulu, fye tu lidikeni oilwifo youyelele.
Tu endeni paenghedi ngaashi momutenya, hamoufukulume woivilo nomoukolwe, hamomahaelo nomoihole, hamokukondjifafana nomefupa.
