Ndelenee djaleni Omwene Jesus Kristus, nombelela yeni inamu i yakulila okahalu.
14: Ndele tambuleni omwiitaveli oshingone, mu tambuleni, nye inamu patafana omadiladilo e lili noku lili.
Umwe oku neitavelo, ota dulu okulya aishe, ndele mukwao, ou oshingone, ota li ombidi.
Ou ha li, ina dina ou iha li, naau iha li, ina tokola ou ha li, osheshi Kalunga okwe mu tambula.
Oove lyelye eshi ho tokola omupiya wamweni? Ota kalele ofika mwene waye, ile a wile po. Ndele ota ka kala e li ofika, osheshi Omwene e neenghono oku mu kaleka ofika.
Umwe e wete efiku limwe li dule likwao, ndele mukwao oha tale omafiku aeshe a faafana. Keshe umwe na kale a pama momayele aye.
Oye ou ta tongola omafiku, ohe a tongolele Omwene, naau ta li, ota lile Omwene, osheshi ta pandula Kalunga; ndele ou iha li, ote shi ningile Omwene, ndele ta pandula Kalunga.
Osheshi kape na umwe womufye te likalele ye mwene, nokape na umwe te lifile ye mwene.
Osheshi ngeenge hatu kala tu nomwenyo, ohatu kalele Omwene, ile ngeenge hatu fi, ohatu file Omwene. Osho hano ngeenge tu nomwenyo ile hatu fi, ofye ovOmwene.
Osheshi osho tuu eshi Kristus e shi fila nokwa nyumuka ndele ta ningi vali omunamwenyo, opo a pangele ovafi novanamwenyo.
Ndele ove, oto tokolele shike omumwaxo? Ile ove nima, oshike ho dini omumwaxo? Osheshi atusheni otu nokuholoka kolukalwatokolo laKalunga.

Shaashi pa shangwa:
“Oshili, ngaashi Ame ndi nomwenyo, Omwene ta ti,
omunhu keshe e nokutwa eengolo koshipala shange,
nokeshe tuu elaka oli nokuhambelela Kalunga.”
Onghee hano keshe umwe womufye e na okulihokolola ye mwene kuKalunga.
Hano inatu tokolafana vali, ndele pangeleni omhangela nokuli muha tulile omumwaxo oshinima shehaulo, ile shokupundukifa mondjila yaye.
Ame ondi shi shii, ndele onda pama shili mOmwene Jesus, kape noshinima sha nyata musho vene; oye ou aeke ta tale oshinima sha nyata, okuye sha nyata.
Ndele omumwaxo ngeenge ta yehamekwa koikulya yoye, ove ito ende vali pahole. Ino nyonauna po noikulya yoye ou a filwa kuKristus.
Inamu efa hano ouwa ou mu u kwete u shekwe.
Osheshi ouhamba waKalunga kau fi okulya nokunwa, ndelenee ouyuki, ombili nehafo mOmhepo Iyapuki.
Ou ta kalele Kristus moinima ei, a wapalela Kalunga, novanhu ve mu hokwa yo.
Tu lalakaneneni hano eshi tashi hapupalifa ombili netungafano.
Ino hanauna po oshilonga shaKalunga molwoikulya. Hano, aishe oya yela, ndele omunhu ou ta li neliudo lii, oshe mu nyikila owii.
Oshiwa okukala iho li ombelela noiho nu omaviinyu, ndele ho lidilike keshe eshi tashi tondifa omumwaxo, tashi mu pundukifa ile tashi mu fifa oungone.
Eitavelo olo u li na, kala u li na ove mwene koshipala shaKalunga. Omunelao oye ou ite litokola ye mwene, oinima oyo a tala ya fa iwa.
Ndele ou a limbililwa ye ta li, oye a tokolwa, osheshi okulya inaku dja meitavelo, ndelenee keshe eshi inashi dja meitavelo, osho oulunde.
15: Ndelenee fye ava twa pama, otwa pewa tu humbate oungone waava inava pama, fye tuha kale nokuliwapalela fye vene.
Keshe umwe womufye na wapalele mukwao oku mu yakula mouwa opo a tungwe.
Osheshi naKristus yo ine liwapalela Ye mwene, ndelenee ongaashi pa shangwa: “Omasheko aava have ku sheke a wila nge.”
Osheshi keshe eshi sha shangwa nale, osha shangelwa elongo letu, opo tu kale tu neteelelo hali di melididimiko nomehekeleko lomomishangwa.
Ndele Kalunga kelididimiko nokehekeleko ne mu kwafe mu kale hamu udafana pamadiladilo aKristus Jesus,
opo mu hambelele Kalunga, Xe yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, mwa twa omhango imwe nokanya kamwe akeke.
Tambulafaneni hano, ngaashi Kristus e mu tambula okufimanekifa Kalunga.
Ndele ohandi ti: Kristus okwa ninga omuyakuli waava va pita etanda omolwoshili yaKalunga, a pameke omaudaneko ootatekulu ve a pewa,

ndelenee oiwana yovapaani otai fimaneke Kalunga omolwefilonghenda laye, ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Ohandi ku fimaneke mokati koiwana yovapaani
nedina loye ohandi li imbile.”

Ndele vali omushangwa otau ti:
“Hafeni, onye oiwana yovapaani pamwe
novanhu vaye.”

Navali:
“Hambeleleni Omwene, onye ovapaani
amushe,
noiwana aishe nai mu hambelele.”

Navali Jesaja ota ti:
“Otaku di oshitutumine shaIsai,
naau ta fikama a pangele oiwana yovapaani,
ndele omuye oiwana yovapaani tai tula mo eteelelo lavo.”
Ndele Kalunga keteelelo ne mu yadife nehafo alishe nombili meitavelo, opo mu kale mu neteelelo linene okeenghono dOmhepo Iyapuki.
Ovamwatate, naame ondi shi wete shili kutya omu li po mu yadi ouwa neshiivo alishe, opo tamu dulu okupukululafana.
Nande ongaha onde mu shangela meenhele dimwe ndi nouladi ndi mu dimbulukife oinima ei, omolwonghenda nde i pewa kuKalunga,
opo ndi kale omupiya waKristus Jesus mokati kovapaani, omoilonga iyapuki yopaupristeli yokuudifa evaengeli laKalunga, opo ovapaani va ninge eyambo la wapala, la yapulwa kOmhepo Iyapuki.
Hano ame ondi nelitango muKristus Jesus omoshilonga shaKalunga;
osheshi nghi na omukumo okutonga oinima imwe oyo aike Kristus e i longa mokulongifa nge, opo a dulikife ovapaani neendjovo nonoilonga,
okeenghono domadidiliko nodoinyengandunge, omeenghono dOmhepo yaKalunga, ngaashi ame nda wanifa eudifo levaengeli laKristus okudja kuJerusalem nomoushiinda fiyo okuIlliriko.
Ndele elalakano lange mwaashi ashishe ola li: ndiha udifile evaengeli opo edina laKristus la tongwa nale, opo ndiha tungile kekanghameno lomunhu umwe e lili,

ndelenee ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Ava inave mu udifilwa, otave ke mu mona,
naava inava uda ko, otava ka uda ko.”
Onghee onda mona luhapu omaimbo okuuya kunye.
Ndelenee paife eshi nda mana oilonga yange koilongo inya, naashi nda ninga omido dihapu nde mu djuulukwa onde uya kunye,
hano ngeenge handi i kuSpania, ohandi uya kunye, osheshi nda hala ndi mu mone mokupitila punye opo ndi kwafwe kunye okufika kwinya, eshi nda hekelekwa tete mokukala mokati keni.
Ndelenee paife ohandi ka enda kuJerusalem omolweyakulo lovayapuki.
Osheshi Makedonia naAkaia ova tala sha wapala okwoongela oikwafa yeehepele dovayapuki vomuJerusalem.
Ovo ove shi tala sha yuka, heeno, ove shi va lile yo oikolo; osheshi ngeenge ovapaani ova tukulilwa oinima yavo yopamhepo, ovo ovanashikolo oku va kwafa oinima yokolutu.
Hano eshi nda wanifa oshilonga eshi, ndele nda twala kuvo oiimati ei, opo ohandi i kuSpania nokutokola punye;
ndele ondi shi shii, ngeenge handi uya kunye, ohandi uya nepuniko laKristus la wana pombada.
Ndele ohandi mu kumaida, ovamwatate, molwOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nomolwohole yOmhepo, mu kondje pamwe naame nokwiilikanena nge kuKalunga,
ndi xupifwe movahenaduliko vomuJudea, neyakulo lange kuJerusalem li tambulwe nawa kovayapuki,
opo Kalunga ngeenge e shi hala ndi fike kunye nehafo, nondi hekelekwe pamwe nanye.
Ndele Kalunga kombili na kale nanye amushe. Amen.
16: Ame ohandi yandje kunye omumwatate omukainhu Foibe, ou omuyakuli weongalo lomuKenkrea,
mu tambuleni mOmwene, ngaashi sha wapalela ovayapuki, nye mu mu yakule moinima aishe omo a pumbwa ekwafo leni, osheshi naye yo okwa yakula vahapu naame mwene yo.
Kundileni po Priskila naAkwila, ovalongi vakwetu muKristus Jesus,
ava va yandja eefingo davo molwomwenyo wange, haame andike handi va pandula, ndelenee nomaongalo aeshe ovapaani;
neongalo hali ongala meumbo lavo, li kundileni po. Kundileni po Epainetus, omuholike wange, ou omutete waKristus muAsia.
Kundileni po Maria, ou e lihepeka molwetu moku tu longela.
Kundileni po Andronikus naJunias, ovakwetu vepata lange, novakwatwa vakwetu, ava va fimana mokati kovayapostoli, ndele ovo votete muKristus kwaame.
Kundileni po Ampliatus, omuholike wange mOmwene.
Kundileni po Urbanus, omulongi mukwetu muKristus, naStakus, omuholike wange.
Kundileni po Apellas, ou a dula eyeleko muKristus. Kundileni po ava vomeumbo laAristobulus.
Kundileni po omukwetu Herodion. Kundileni po vomoNarkissus ve li mOmwene.
Kundileni po Trifeina naTrifosa, ava hava longo mOmwene. Kundileni po Persis, omumwameme omukainhu omuholike, ou a longa noudiinini mOmwene.
Kundileni po Rufus, omuhoololwa mOmwene, naina, ou a fa meme yange yo.
Kundileni po Asinkritus, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, novamwatate ovo ve li puvo.
Kundileni po Filologus naJulia, Nereus nomumwaina omukainhu, naOlimpos novayapuki aveshe ve li puvo.
Kundilafaneni po nefipafano komilungu liyapuki. Omaongalo aKristus otae mu kundu.
Ndele ovamwatate, ohandi mu kumaida mu pashukile ava hava eta olutandu nomashindo okukondjifa elongo mwe li longwa; mu noku va yepa.
Osheshi ava ve li ngaha, itava longele Omwene wetu Kristus, ndelenee omadimo avo vene, nokeendjovo davo da fewa da fa omaadi, ohava pukifa omitima domalai.
Osheshi okudulika kweni okwa shiivika kovanhu aveshe; osho nee nde mu hafela ndele nda hala mu kale ovanongo moinima iwa nomalai moinima ii.
Ndele Kalunga kombili Oye ota ka nyanyaula diva Satana koshi yeemhadi deni. Efilonghenda lOmwene Jesus Kristus nali kale pamwe nanye.
Timoteus, omulongi mukwetu, ote mu kundu, novakwetu kepata Lukius, Jason naSosipater.
Aame Tertius, ou nda shangifwa oshishangwa eshi, ohandi mu kundu mOmwene.
Gaius, omwiidilili wange noweongalo alishe ote mu kundu. Erastus, omudiinini woimaliwa yoshilando nomumwatate Kwartus otave mu kundu.
Onghenda yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nai kale pamwe nanye. Amen.
Hano, ou e neenghono oku mu pameka opavaengeli lange nopaudifo laJesus Kristus, pashiholekwa eshi sha hololwa, osho sha li inashi hololwa momafimbo onale,
ndelenee paife osha hololwa nokomishangwa dovaxunganeki pamhangela yaKalunga kaalushe, osha shiivifilwa oiwana aishe okudika eduliko leitavelo,
ou Kalunga omunaendunge aeke, omolwaJesus Kristus na fimanekwe fiyo alushe! Amen.

1: Paulus, omuyapostoli omwiifanwa waKristus Jesus okehalo laKalunga, nomumwatate Sostenes.
Okeongalo laKalunga lomuKorinto, okovayapulwa muKristus Jesus, ovo ovaifanwa novayapuki pamwe naava aveshe hava kuwile ekwafo ledina lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus meenhele adishe, davo nodetu.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu nokOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Ame ohandi mu pandulile Kalunga kange alushe omolwefilonghenda eli laKalunga mwe li pewa muKristus Jesus,
shaashi mwa punikwa moinima aishe muye, meendjovo adishe nomokushiiva akushe,
ngaashi ehepaululo lomuKristus la pamekwa munye,
nokutya, onye inamu hepa sha shomeeshalinghenda, mokuteelela kweni eholoko lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Oye te mu pameke yo fiyo okexulilo, mu kale muhe noshipo mefiku lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Kalunga Oye omudiinini, Oye tuu ou e mu ifana mu kale mekwatafano lOmona waye Jesus Kristus, Omwene wetu.

Ndelenee ohandi mu kumaida, ovamwatate, omolwedina lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, amushe mu kale kumwe mu nondaka imwe, nye muha kale mwa tukauka mokati keni, ndelenee mu kale hamu udafana meendunge dimwe nomokudiladila shimwe.
Osheshi ovamwatate nye, ame onde mu kundana kwaava vomeumbo laKloe, kutya nye omu neemhata mokati keni.
Ame ohandi tongo odo tadi popiwa kukeshe tuu womunye, eshi umwe ta ti: “Ame owaPaulus,” nomukwao: “Ame owaApollos,” ile: “Ame owaKefas,” navali: “Ame owaKristus.”
Mboli Kristus okwa tukaulwa? Ile Paulus okwa valelwa komushiyakano omolweni mbela? Ile omwa shashelwa medina laPaulus?
Ohandi pandula Kalunga eshi inandi shasha nande umwe mokati keni, oKrispus naGaius aveke,
nande umwe aha tye, okwa shashelwa medina lange.
Heeno, novaneumbo laStefanas onde va shasha; ame noinandi shiiva vali ngeenge oku na umwe nde mu shasha.
Osheshi Kristus ina tuma nge okushasha, ndelenee okuudifa evaengeli, hanounongo weendjovo, omushiyakano waKristus opo uha dje eenghono.
Osheshi ondjovo yomushiyakano oya nyika oulai kwaava tava ka kana, ndelenee kufye ava ovaxupifwa oyo eenghono daKalunga

Osheshi opa shangwa:
“Ounongo wovanongo ohandi u hanauna po,
neendunge dovanaendunge ohandi di dimi po.”
Ovanaendunge ove li peni? Ovanongo vomishangwa ove li peni? Eenghulungu dounyuni ou odi li peni? Ounongo wounyuni ou, Kalunga ine u pilika u ninge oulai?
Osheshi ounyuni okounongo wao inau shiiva Kalunga mounongo waye, onghee hano sha wapalela Kalunga a xupife, okoulai weudifo, ovo tava itavele.
Osheshi Ovajuda otava pula omadidiliko, nOvagreka otava kongo ounongo,
ndele fye ohatu udifa Kristus, omuvalelwa komushiyakano, ou kOvajuda epundukifo, noulai kovapaani,
ndelenee ava ovaifanwa, nOvajuda nOvagreka ohatu va udifile Kristus, eenghono daKalunga nounongo waKalunga.
Osheshi oulai waKalunga u nounongo u dule wovanhu, nounongo waKalunga u neenghono di dule dovanhu.
Osheshi ovamwatate, taleni okwiifanwa kweni nhumbi ku li: havahapu ovanongo vopanhu, navahapu ovanaenghono, havahapu oidale,
ndelenee ei oilai yomounyuni, oyo ya hoololwa kuKalunga, a fife ohoni ovanongo, naai oingone mounyuni oyo Kalunga e i hoolola, a fife ohoni eshi shi neenghono,
naashi shihe nedina mounyuni nosha dinika Kalunga okwe shi hoolola, osho shihe fi oshinima, opo a xutule po osho shi li po,
opo paha kale nande ombelela imwe tai litange koshipala shaKalunga.
Ndelenee omuye mwa dja okukala kweni muKristus Jesus, ou e tu ningilwa ounongo kuKalunga, nouyuki neyapulo nekulilo,
opo pa kale ngaashi pa shangwa: “Ou te litange, ne litangele mOmwene.”
2: Naame yo eshi nde uya kunye, ovamwatate, inandi uya ndi newapalo leendjovo ile lounongo oku mu udifila ehepaululo laKalunga.
Osheshi onda tokola ndi kale punye inandi shiiva oinima imwe, oJesus Kristus aeke, ou omuvalelwa komushiyakano.
Eshi nda li punye onda li ndi noungone noumbada nokukakama neenghono,
nokupopya kwange nokuudifa kwange kakwa li eendjovo dounongo tadi heke, ndelenee ehololo lOmhepo noleenghono,
opo eitavelo leni lihe likwatelele kounongo wovanhu, ndele okeenghono daKalunga.
Ndelenee ounongo ohatu u popi mokati kaava va wana, ndele haunongo wefimbo lounyuni ou, nowovapangeli vefimbo lounyuni ou, ava tava xulu po,
ndelenee hatu popi ounongo ou waKalunga wa li wa holekwa, ou Kalunga e u ufa nale omafimbo ounyuni manga aha li ko, u ninge efimano letu.
Ounongo ou inau shiivika kovapangeli vefimbo lounyuni ou, osheshi ngeno okwa li ve u shii, ngeno Omwene woshinge inave mu valela komushiyakano,

ndelenee ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Osho eisho inali shi mona, nokutwi inaku shi uda,
sho inashi ya momutima womunhu,
Kalunga okwe shi longekidila ava ve mu hole.”
Ndele fye Kalunga okwe shi tu hololela kOmhepo yaye, osheshi Omhepo tai konakona aishe, noule waKalunga.
Osheshi omunhu olyelye ta shiiva eshi shi li momunhu? Kakele omhepo yomunhu oyo aike ei i li muye. Ndele osho tuu kaku na ou ta shiiva ei i li muKalunga, Omhepo yaKalunga Oye aeke.
Ndelenee fye inatu tambula omhepo younyuni, ndelenee Omhepo tuu ei yomuKalunga, opo tu shiive eshi twe shi pewa oshali kefilonghenda laKalunga.
Oyo tuu ei hatu i tongo yo, haneendjovo tadi longwa kounongo wopanhu, ndelenee ododo twe di longwa kOmhepo, nokufatulula oinima yopamhepo opamhepo.
Ndelenee omunhu wopashitwe iha tambula osho shOmhepo yaKalunga, osheshi ohe shi tale oulai, oye ita dulu oku shi shiiva, osheshi shi nokukonekwa pamhepo.
Ndele omunhu wopamhepo oye ta koneke aishe, ndele ye mwene ehe shii okukonekwa nande okomunhu.
“Osheshi olyelye a shiiva omadiladilo Omwene, e mu longe eendunge?” Ndelenee fye otu nomadiladilo aKristus.
3: Ndelenee ovamwatate, ame inandi dula okupopya nanye ngaashi naava vopamhepo, ndele ongaashi ovo vopambelela nongaashi ouhanana muKristus.
Omashinishini nde mu nwefa, haikulya ya pama, osheshi omwa li itamu i dulu, natango itamu i dulu;
osheshi natango nye ovopambelela. Eshi mokati keni mu nefupa neemhata, kamu fi vopambelela noitamu ende paunhu?
Ngeenge umwe ota ti: Ame owaPaulus, naumwe: Ame owaApollos, kamu fi vopambelela?
Apollos olyelye? NaPaulus olyelye? Ovo ovapiya vOmwene mwa itavelifwa kuvo, ongaashi vo va pewa kOmwene, ou oshaye naau oshaye.
Ame onda twika, Apollos okwa tekela, ndele Kalunga a kulika.
Onghee hano nakutwika nanakutekela vo kave shi sha, ndelenee oKalunga tuu ou ta kulike.
Ndelenee omutwiki nomutekeli ove fike pamwe; ndele keshe umwe ota pewa ondjabi yaye mwene i fike poshilonga shaye mwene.
Osheshi ofye ovalongi pamwe naKalunga; onye epya laKalunga, etungo laKalunga.
Pafilonghenda eli laKalunga nde li pewa, ngaashi omutungingulu onghulungu onda tunga ekanghameno, ndele umwe e lili ta tungile mo, ndele keshe tuu na tale nhumbi ta tungile mo.
Osheshi kaku na ou ta dulu okudika ekanghameno limwe olo tuu olo la dikwa, olo Jesus Kristus.
Hano ngeenge pe na ou ta tungile kekanghameno eli moshingoldo noshisiliveli, nokawe nomiti, nomwiidi noihati,
oshilonga shakeshe otashi ka holoka, osheshi efiku linya otali ke shi holola, eshi tali holoka momundilo, nomundilo otau yeleke oshilonga shakeshe umwe nhumbi sha tya.
Oshilonga shaau a tungila kekanghameno eli ngeenge tashi kala po, ota ka pewa ondjabi;
ngeenge ope na ou oshilonga shaye tashi pile mo, ota kala e nomupya; ndele ye mwene ota ka xupifwa, ndelenee ngaashi tuu okupitila momundilo.
Kamu shi shii nokutya, onye otembeli yaKalunga, nOmhepo yaKalunga tai kala munye?
Ngeenge ope na ou ta nyono po otembeli yaKalunga, oye ota nyonwa po kuKalunga, osheshi otembeli yaKalunga oiyapuki, nye otembeli ei.
Inapa kala nande umwe te lipukifa ye mwene. Ngeenge mokati keni omu na umwe e shi oye omunaendunge mounyuni ou, oye na ninge elai, opo a ninge omunaendunge.
Osheshi ounongo wounyuni ou oo oulai koshipala shaKalunga. Osheshi opa shangwa: “Ovanongo ote va yulu momakoto avo,” navali:
“Omadiladilo ovanongo Omwene oku a shii oo ongaho.”
Inapa kala hano ou te litangele ovanhu; osheshi oinima aishe oyeni,
nande oPaulus naApollos naKefas, ile ounyuni nomwenyo nefyo, naai yopaife ile inya yokomesho, aishe oyeni.
Ndelenee onye ovaKristus, naKristus owaKalunga.
4: Keshe umwe ne tu tale ofye ovapiya vaKristus, nomalenga oiholekwa yaKalunga.
Ndele komesho yoinima aishe omalenga otaa pulwa oudiinini.
Ndelenee oshinima shinini kwaame ngeenge handi tokolwa kunye, ile ketokolo lopanhu; naame mwene itandi litokola,
osheshi meliudo lange kamu na sha, ndele hasho tashi pe nge ouyuki, osheshi omutokoli wange oye Omwene.
Hano inamu tokola sha manga efimbo inali fika, fimbo Omwene ine uya, ou ta holola ei ya holekwa momulaulu, nomadilongo omutima ote a holola; opo nee keshe umwe ota pewa epandulo laye kuKalunga.
Oinima ei, ovamwatate, ofye naApollos otwe i liyeleka omolweni, opo mu lilonge okuhakoya kombada yaasho sha shangwa, opo muhe linenepeke nokupopila umwe nokudina omukwao.
Osheshi olyelye te ku tula komesho? Noshikwashike eshi u shi kwete, ino shi pewa? Ndele ngeenge owe shi pewa, oshike to litange wa fa ino shi pewa?
Ndele nye omwa kuta, mwa punapala nokuli, mwa ninga nokuli mwa fa eehamba muhe na nafye! Heeno, ngeno mwa ninga ovapangeli, nafye yo tu pangele pamwe nanye!
Osheshi ondi shii fye ovayapostoli twa tulwa kuKalunga konima yaaishe, ngaashi ava va yandjwa kokufya; otwa ninga nokuli oshiyolifa shounyuni aushe, shovaengeli noshovanhu.
Ofye omalai omolwaKristus, nye ovanamayele muKristus, ofye oingone, nye ovanaenghono; onye mwa fimana, fye otwa dinika.
Fiyo okefimbo eli otwa fya ondjala notwa fya enota, otu li hamunghele nohatu dengwa, notuhe nomutumba,
ohatu lihepeke nokulikwafa nomake etu. Ohatu popiwa nai, ndele ohatu nangeke noupuna; hatu tewatewa, ndele fye ohatu lididimike;
hatu lundilwa, fye ohatu popi nombili; fye otwa talika ngaashi oshala shounyuni aushe, fye oonakweefiwa kwaaveshe fiyo onena eli.
Eshi itandi shi shange ndi mu fife ohoni, ndelenee oku mu kumaida ngaashi ovamwange ovaholike.
Osheshi nande omu kale mu novatekuli omayovi omulongo muKristus, kamu nooxo vahapu; osheshi ame onde mu dala muKristus Jesus okevaengeli.
Onghee ohandi mu kumaida; ningeni ovahopaeleli vange.
Onghee nde mu tumina Timoteus, ou omumwange omuholike nomudiinini mOmwene, oye te mu dimbulukifa okweenda kwange muKristus, nhumbi handi longo apeshe nomeongalo keshe.
Vamwe ove linenepeka, ve shii ame ihandi uya kunye.
Ndelenee Omwene ngeenge e shi hala, ohandi uya diva kunye, opo nee ohandi ka pula haendjovo dovalinenepeki adike, ndelenee neenghono yo davo.
Osheshi ouhamba waKalunga kau fi womeendjovo, ndelenee omeenghono.
Shilipipo mwa hala? Ondi uye kunye ndi noshimwati, ile onohole nomhepo ya lota?
5: Akushe otaku popiwa nokutya, mokati keni omu noluhaelo, noluhaelo la tya ngaha nomovapaani ihali monika mo, eshi pe na ou e kwete omukainhu waxe.
Ndele nye mwa fulalala, nande mwa li mwa wana okufya oluhodi, opo ou a ninga oshinima shi fike opo a kondwe mo mokati keni?
Osheshi nande ame nghi mo mokati keni palutu, ondi li mo pamhepo, kombinga yange onda tokola nokuli nda fa ndi li punye nokutya, ou a ninga oshilonga shi fike opo, oye
ngeenge twa ongaleni, onye nomhepo yange neenghono dOmwene wetu Jesus
omedina lOmwene wetu Jesus e nokuyandjwa momake aSatana, olutu laye li nyonaunwe po, omwenyo waye u xupifwe efiku lOmwene.
Elitango leni keliwa. Mboli kamu shi shii nokutya, onhafi nande oinini, otai fulifa olumbololo alishe lomungome?
Kombeni mo onhafi ei ikulu, nye mu ninge olumbololo lipe lomungome, ongaashi munye inamu ya onhafi; osheshi odjona yetu yaPaasa, oKristus, oya dipawa.
Tu lyeni hano oshivilo, hanonhafi ikulu youlunde noyowii, ndelenee onomingome dihe nonhafi, doukoshoki nodoshili.
Monhumwafo yange onde mu shangela muha endafane novahaeli;
Inandi tonga ovahaeli vomounyuni ou ile ovanalwisho ile ovakaleli voikalunga, osheshi ngeno osho, ngeno mounyuni omu nokudja mo.

Ndelenee onde mu shangela, nokutya ngeenge pe na ou ha ifanwa omumwaxo, ye omuhaeli ile omunalwisho ile omukaleli woikalunga ile omusheki ile ongholwe ile omunyeki, muha endafane naye, nye muha lye nandenande naye.
Osheshi ondi netokolo lashike okutokola ovo vopondje? Nanye yo itamu tokola ava vomeni aveke?
Ndelenee venya vopondje Kalunga ote va tokola. “Kondeni mo ou mwii womokati keni.”
6: Umwe womokati keni e neendjovo nomukwao, ota dulu ngahelipi oku mu hokololifa koshipala shaava vehe fi ovayuki? Oshike ita i ko kovayapuki?
Kamu shi shii nokutya, ovayapuki itava ka tokola ounyuni? Hano ngeenge tamu ka tokola ounyuni, inamu wana ngeno okutokola oinima inini?
Kamu shi shii, fye ohatu ka tokola ovaengeli; mbela oinima yokukalamwenyo kwopaife otai tu nyenge?
Hano ngeenge mu noihokolola yoinima yokukalamwenyo kwopaife, otamu i tokolifa ava vehe li nawa meongalo?
Ohandi popi eshi ndi mu fife ohoni. Ile mokati keni kamu na nande omunandunge a shiive okutokola mokati kovamwaxe?
Ndelenee omumwaxe, nokutya, omwiitaveli mukwao ta hokololifa omumwaxe moipafi yaava vehe neitavelo!
Oshiponga nokuli kunye eshi mu noihokolola mokati keni. Oshike itamu liefa mu ningwe nai? Oshike itamu liefa mu nyekwe?
Ndelenee nye otamu ningi nai notamu nyeka ovanhu, ovamwaxo nokuli.
Mboli kamu shi shii nokutya, ava vehe fi ovayuki itava fyuulula ouhamba waKalunga? Inamu puka, ovahaeli novakaleli voikalunga, novanyoni vohombo nomashenge, novahaeli vomashenge,
novalunga novanalwisho, neengholwe novasheki novanyeki ovo itava fyuulula ouhamba waKalunga.
Ndele omwa li mu li ngaha, vamwe vomunye; ndelenee nye mwe liyelifa, mwa yapulwa nomwa yukipalifwa medina lOmwene Jesus Kristus nokOmhepo yaKalunga ketu.
“Ame inandi dilikwa sha,” ndele haaishe i nekwafo. “Ame inandi dilikwa sha,” ndelenee nghi nokupangelwa kusha.
“Oikulya oi li po omolwedimo, nedimo omolwoikulya;” ndele Kalunga ota ka xulifa po eshi ashishe. Ndelenee olutu inali yandjelwa oluhaelo, ndelenee okulongela Omwene. Omwene oye mwene wolutu.
Ndele Kalunga ou a nyumuna Omwene, ote tu nyumuna yo okeenghono daye.
Kamu shi shii nokutya, omalutu eni oo oinhimbu yaKristus? Otashi dulika ngahelipi oinhimbu yaKristus ame ndi i ninge oinhimbu yombwada yoipala? Nandenande.
Ile kamu shi shii nokutya, ou ta kumu ombwada yoipala ota ningi olutu limwe nayo? Osheshi Oye ta ti: “Ava vavali otava ningi omunhu umwe.”
Ndele ou ta dame kOmwene, oye omhepo imwe naye.
Kukumeni oluhaelo. Omanyono aeshe amwe, keshe eshi omunhu ta nyono, okombada yolutu, ndele omuhaeli ota nyono kolutu laye mwene.
Ile kamu shi shii, omalutu eni oo otembeli yOmhepo Iyapuki ei i li munye mwe i pewa kuKalunga, hano kamu fi veni vene?
Osheshi nye omwa kulilwa noikulila idjuu. Fimanekeni hano Kalunga nomalutu eni nonomhepo yeni.
7: Hano mokupopya oinima ei mwe i shangela nge ohandi ti: Osha wapalela omulumenhu a kale ita kumu omukainhu.
Ndelenee mokuyepa oluhaelo omulumenhu keshe na kale nomukainhu waye mwene, nomukainhu keshe na kale e nomulumenhu waye mwene.
Omulumenhu na wanife eemhumbwe domukainhu waye, nomukainhu osho na kale nomulumenhu waye.
Omukainhu ke nelipangelo okupangela olutu laye, omulumenhu oye tuu, osho tuu nomulumenhu ke nelipangelo okupangela olutu laye, ndelenee omukainhu oye tuu.
Inamu lidilikafana, okuninga mwe shi pangela mu likalele manga, opo mu liyandje keilikano, nye mu ye vali pamwe, opo muha shindwe kuSatana omolwokuhelipangela kweni.
Ndelenee eshi onde shi tya omolweitavelo, hashipango.
Ame onda hala ngeno ovanhu aveshe va kale ngaashi ame ndi li; ndele keshe umwe a pewe oshali yaye kuKalunga, umwe ei nomukwao inya.
Ndelenee ovo inava hombola novafiyekadi, ohandi va lombwele: otashi va wapalele ngeenge tava kala ngaashi ame ndi li.
Ndele ngeenge itava dulu okulipangela, nava hombole, osheshi okuhombola ku dule okuxwikwa kouhalu.
Ndelenee ava va hombola ohandi va lombwele, haame, ndele Omwene, nokutya, omukainhu ina henga omulumenhu waye.
Ndele ngee a hengana, na kale ina hombolwa, ile nava paafane ombili nomulumenhu waye; nomulumenhu aha henge omukainhu waye.
Ndelenee ava vamwe, ame ohandi va lombwele, haOmwene, ngee oku na omumwatate e nomukainhu ehe fi omwiitaveli, ndele a hokwa okukala puye, ine mu henga;
nosho yo ngeenge oku na omukainhu e nomulumenhu ehe fi omwiitaveli, nokwa hala okukala naye, ina henga omulumenhu waye.

Osheshi omulumenhu ehe fi omwiitaveli, a yapulwa omolwomukainhu, nomukainhu ehe fi omwiitaveli a yapulwa omolwomulumenhu omwiitaveli; ngeno kakwa li ngaha, ngeno ovana veni ova nyata, ndelenee paife ovo ovayapuki.
Ndelenee ou ehe fi omwiitaveli ngee a hala oku mu henga, ne mu henge, omumwatate omulumenhu nomumwameme omukainhu vehe fi ovapika voinima ya tya ngaha; osheshi Kalunga e mu ifanena ombili.
Osheshi oto shi shiiva peni omukainhu ove, nokutya, oto dulu okuxupifa omulumenhu woye, ile omulumenhu ove, oto shi shiiva peni, nokutya, to dulu okuxupifa omukainhu woye?
Ndelenee keshe omunhu na kale nokweenda ngaashi Omwene e mu pa, mwaai Kalunga e mu ifanena. Nelombwelo eli handi lombwele omaongalo aeshe.
Ngee pe na umwe a ifanwa ndele a hangika a pita etanda, ine liningifa a fa ina pita etanda; nongeenge ope na ou a ifanwa ndele ina pita etanda, ye ine lipitififa etanda.
Okupita etanda kaku na sha, nokukala ino pita etanda kashi na sha, ndelenee ewanifo loipango yaKalunga olo alike.
Keshe umwe na kale mwaai a hangika keifano.
Ngee wa hangika omupika eshi wa ifanwa, ino nyika oufiye, ndele ngeenge oto mono omhito okupewa emanguluko, hixwe u li tambule.
Osheshi ou a ifanenwa mOmwene a hangwa omupika, oye omumangululwa wOmwene; nosho tuu ou a ifanwa a hangika omudalwa, oye omupika waKristus.
Onye omwa kulilwa noikulila idjuu, inamu ninga ovapika vovanhu.
Ovamwatate, keshe tuu ou na kale koshipala shaKalunga mwaai a hangika mo keifano laye.
Mokutonga oukadona inandi pewa oshipango shOmwene, ndele ohandi tongo omayele ange ngaashi ou a filwa onghenda kOmwene, onghee ondi shi okulineekelwa.
Hano ame ohandi diladila, omolwoudjuu wefimbo tali ehene popepi, osha wapala omunhu keshe a kale ngaashi e li.
Ove ngeenge we limangeleka kumwe nomukainhu, ino konga emangululo; ngeenge ino limangeleka komukainhu, ino konga omukainhu.
Ndele ngeenge to hombola, ito nyono; nokakadona ngeenge taka ka hombolwa, itaka nyono, ndelenee ava tave shi ningi ovo tave ke lietela oudjuu wopalutu, ndele nda hala ndi mu xupife muwo.
Ndelenee ovamwatate, ohandi ti: efimbo olo olixupi, onghee hano ava ve novakainhu, nava kale momafiku aa a xupa, va fa kave va kwete.
Naava tava lili, va fe ovo itava lili, naava va hafa, va fe ovo itava hafe, naava tave lilandele sha, va fe ovo vehe na sha.
Naava hava longifa ounyuni ou, va kale va fa ovo ihave u longifa; osheshi olupe lounyuni ou otali xulu po.
Ndele onda hala mu kale muhe noisho. Omulumenhu ina hombola oku na oshisho shaai yOmwene, nhumbi a wapalele Omwene;
ndelenee ou a hombola e na oisho yopaunyuni nokutya, nhumbi a wapalele omukainhu waye;

nomadiladilo aye taa kala a tukauka. Osho tuu omukainhu ehe na vali omulumenhu, nokakadona, ove noisho yaai yOmwene, opo va kale ovayapuki kolutu nokomhepo, ndelenee omuhombolwa oku noisho yopaunyuni nokutya, nhumbi ta wapalele omulumenhu waye.
Eshi ohandi shi mu lombwele molwouwa weni vene, haku mu telifa omwiyo, ndelenee opo mu kale meenghedi diwa nye mu kale mOmwene muhe na epiyaano.
Ndele ngee ope na ou a konga okakadona ndele okwa hala oku mu hombola, nava hombolafane, osheshi itava nyono.
Ndele ou e na okakadona nota dulu okupangela omahalo aye opambelela, nena oshiwa a kale ine ka hombola.
Hano ou ta hombola okakadona kaye ota ningi nawa; naau ita hombola, ota ningi nawa unene.
Omukainhu a mangelwa kumwe nomulumenhu waye fimbo ye e nomwenyo, ndele omulumenhu waye ngeenge ta fi, ye a manguluka a hombolwe kwaau a hala, shimha tashi ningilwa mOmwene.
Ndele ngeenge ta kala ngaashi e li, elao laye olinene; olo ediladilo lange, nondi shi shii naame yo ondi nOmhepo yaKalunga.
8: Ndelenee okupopya ombelela yeyambo otu shi shii, atusheni otu neshiivo. Okushiiva otaku nenepekifa, ndele ohole otai tungu.
Ngeenge umwe e shii a shiiva sha, ina shiiva natango ngaashi e nokushiiva;
ndelenee ou e hole Kalunga, oye a shiivika kuye.
Mokupopya hano okulya kwombelela yeyambo, fye otu shi shii, mounyuni kamu na nande oikalunga, ndele ngaashi kaku na Kalunga umwe e lili, Oye tuu ou umwe aeke.
Osheshi nande oku kale ei haku tiwa oikalunga, ngee omeulu ile opedu, ngaashi ku noikalunga noovene vahapu,
ndele fye otu na Kalunga umwe, oTate, omwaau mwa dja aishe, nefikilo letu omuye, nOmwene umwe, Jesus Kristus, omolwaau aishe i li po, nafye yo omolwaye.

Haaveshe ve neshiivo eli, osheshi vamwe otava diladila oikalunga ngaashi va ika, naashi tava li ombelela yeyambo, otave i tale ya yambelwa oikalunga, ndele omaliudo avo a nyika oungone otaa nyatekwa kuyo.
Ndelenee oikulya itai tu ehenifa kuKalunga; ngeenge itatu li, ihatu kanifa sha, ngeenge hatu li, ihatu likola sha.
Ndelenee taleni nawa, elipangelo eli leni liha ninge epundukifo loingone,

osheshi ngeenge ope na ou te ku mono, ove ou neshiivo eli, u li omutumba poshililo motembeli yoikalunga, eliudo laye, eshi oye oshingone meitavelo, itali tuwa nee mbela ouladi okulya ombelela ya yambelwa oikalunga?
Ndele eshiivo eli loye otali kanifa ou oshingone, omumwaxe ou a filwa kuKristus.
Ndele eshi tamu nyono ngaha kovamwaxo ndele tamu yehameke omaliudo avo a ngonopala, otamu nyono kuKristus.
Onghee hano oikulya ngeenge tai pukifa omumwatate, itandi li vali ombelela fiyo alushe, opo ndiha hongaule omumwatate.
9: Ame nghi fi omumangululwa mbela? Nghi fi omuyapostoli? Inandi mona mbela Jesus Kristus, Omwene wetu? Nye kamu fi oshilonga shange mOmwene?
Ngeenge nghi fi omuyapostoli wavamwe, oweni shili; osheshi onye oshilimbo shouyapostoli wange mOmwene.
Elipopilo lange kwaava tava konakona nge olo eli.
Katu na eenghono hamba okulya nokunwa?
Katu na eenghono ngeno okweenda meengeda nomukainhu, omumwameme meitavelo, ongaashi ovayapostoli vakwetu novamwaina vOmwene naKefas tava ningi?
Ile ofye atuke naBarnabas tuhe na eenghono tu kale itatu longo oilonga yomake?
Olyelye ta kala nande efiku limwe moukwaita te lifutile ye mwene? Olyelye ta twike oshikokola shomiviinyu ndele ita li oiimati yasho? Olyelye ta lifa oimuna, ye ita li omashini oimuna?
Oinima ei ohandi i tongo panhu mbela? Omhango nayo hasho ya popya?
Osheshi momhango yaMoses omwa shangwa: “Ongobe tai xu moshipale, ino i manga komulungu.” Kalunga ota tongo okuyavelela eengobe adike mbela?
Oye ite shi ti ngeno omolwetu? Heeno, omolwetu pa shangwa, omupululi na pulule e neteelelo, naau ta xu, na xwe nokuteelela a pewe oshitukulwa shaye.
Fye ngee otwe mu kuna ouwa wopamhepo, hano oshinima shinene tuu mbela, ngee hatu teya kunye ouwa wopalutu?

Ngee ope na vamwe ve neteelelo lokupewa sha kunye, hafye nee ngeno unene?
Ndele fye inatu longifa eenghono edi, otwa mwenena aishe, opo tuha dikile evaengeli laKristus eimbo lasha.
Onye kamu shi shii, ava hava longo oilonga yotembeli, otava li ei yomotembeli, naava tava longo oilonga poaltari, otava mono oipewa yavo poaltari?
Osho hano Omwene e shi pangela, nokutya, ava hava udifa evaengeli nava palulwe kevaengeli.
Ndelenee inandi longifa nande oshimwe shomoinima oyo nde i pitikilwa. Nongaashi eshi inandi shi shanga ndi pewe sha mwaai; hano shipu ndi fye. Itandi efa omunhu a xutule elitango lange.
Ndele nge handi udifa evaengeli, itandi dulu oku li litangela; mwaame ndi nefininiko, woo aame, ngeenge itandi li udifa!
Osheshi ngeenge handi shi longo nehalo liwa, ondi nondjabi; ndele handi shi ningi ndihe nehalo, onghee tuu oshilonga shelenga onde shi pewa.
Ondjabi yange ilipi hano? Oyo tuu ei, eshi handi udifa evaengeli, ohandi li udifa oshali, itandi tambula oshipewa osho nde shi itavelelwa kevaengeli.
Osheshi nande ihandi pangelwa kovanhu, ame onde lininga omupiya waaveshe, opo ndi likole vahapu.
KOvajuda onda kala ngaashi Omujuda ndi likole Ovajuda; kwaava ve li koshi yomhango, ongaashi ou e li koshi yomhango, nande ame nghi li koshi yomhango, ndi likole ava ve li koshi yomhango,
kwaava vehe nomhango nda fa ndihe nomhango (nande inandi kala ndihe nomhango yaKalunga, ondi li momhango yaKristus) ndi likole ava vehe nomhango,
kwaava oingone nda ninga oshingone, ndi likole oingone; onda ninga omukwao waaveshe mwaaishe, opo ndi xupife nande ovamwe.
Ndele aishe ohandi ningi omolwevaengeli, naame yo ndi mone oshitukulwa shomulo.
Kamu shi shii, ava hava tondoka monhele yomafiyafanepo, aveshe otava tondoka, ndelenee umwe ta hakana ondjabi yefindano? Tondokeni ngaashi winya mu i hakane.
Ndele omuningi wefiyafano keshe ohe lidilike oinima aishe, ndele vo otave shi ningi va pewe oshishani tashi lembe, ndele fye ohatu pewa osho itashi lembe.
Ame inandi hala ndi tondoke inandi shiiva efikilo, ngaashi ihandi kondjo nda fa handi denge momhepo,
ndele ohandi denge olutu lange nohandi li dulikifa, opo ndiha ninge aame ou handi udifile vamwe, ame mwene ngeno ndi ekelweshi.
10: Ovamwatate, inandi hala mu kale muhe shi shii, ootatekulu aveshe va kala koshi yoshilemo, naaveshe va pitila mefuta
naaveshe ova shashelwa muMoses moshilemo nomefuta,
naaveshe ova lya oikulya tuu imwe aike yopamhepo,
naaveshe ova nwa oshikunwa shimwe shopamhepo, osheshi ova nwa memanya lopamhepo ndele va shikula, emanya olo oKristus.
Ndelenee nande ongaha, vahapu vomuvo Kalunga ine va hokwa, osheshi vo ova nyonauninwa po mombuwa.
Ndele oinima ei oya ningilwa kufye edidiliko, tuha haluke owii ngaashi venya va halukile.
Ndele nye inamu ninga ovalongeli voikalunga ngaashi vamwe vomuvo, ongaashi pa shangwa: “Ovanhu va kala omutumba okulya nokunwa ndele va fikama va dane.”
Ndele inatu kaleni mohole yoipala, ngaashi vamwe vomuvo ve shi ninga, nova nyonwa pomayovi omilongo mbali nomayovi atatu mefiku limwe alike.
Ndele fye inatu shindeni Omwene, ngaashi vamwe vomuvo va shindile, ndele va lika po komayoka.
Ndele nye inamu ngongota yo ngaashi vamwe vomuvo va ngongotele, nova nyonwa po komunyonauni.
Ndelenee ei aishe oya ningilwa venya i kale elondwelo kufye noya shangwa oku tu kumaida, ofye ava twa hangika komaxulilo omafimbo ounyuni.
Onghee hano ou e lishii e li ofika, na lungame aha wile po.

Inamu hangika keyeleko limwe, olo tuu olo lopanhu, ndelenee Kalunga Oye omudiinini, ite mu efa mu yelekwe nomayeleko e dule eenghono deni, ndele mumwe neyeleko ota longele yo omhito yokupita mo, opo mu dule oku li humbata.
Onghee hano, ovaholike vange, indeni onhapo efimaneko loikalunga.
Ohandi mu lombwele ngaashi ovanaendunge; tokoleni nye vene eshi handi shi tongo.
Eholo lepuniko eli hatu li nangeke noupuna, kali fi hamba ekwatafano nohonde yaKristus? Omungome ou hatu u pambula, kau fi ekwatafano nolutu laKristus?
Osheshi omungome umwe, nosho fye vahapu olutu limwe; osheshi ofyeni atusheni twa tambula komungome ou umwe.
Taleni Israel yopambelela; ava hava li omayambo vehe nekwatafano noaltari?
Ohandi ti ngahelipi hano? Omayambo a yambelwa oikalunga oi na tuu sha, ile oshikalunga oshi na tuu sha?
Ahowe, ohandi ti, oinima ei ovapaani tave i yambele, otave i yambele eendemoni, haKalunga; ndele ame inandi hala mu kale mu nekwatafano neendemoni.
Itamu dulu okunwa meholo lOmwene nomeholo leendemoni, itamu dulu okulya koshililo shOmwene nokoshililo sheendemoni.
Ile otwa hala okuhandukifa Omwene? Ofye otu mu dule?
Aishe ohai ningwa, ndele haaishe i nekwafo. Aishe ohai ningwa, ndele haaishe tai tungu.
Inapa kala ou ta kongo ouwa waye mwene, ndelenee keshe umwe na konge ouwa wamukwao.
Ashishe hashi shingifwa pomalandelo, shi lyeni, inamu lipulapula nasha omolweliudo;
osheshi: “Edu olOmwene, naashishe shi yadi mo.”
Ndele ngeenge ku na ou ehe fi omwiitaveli te mu ifana, ndele mwa hala okuya ko, lyeni ashishe tamu shi pewa, muhe lipulaapule sha omolweliudo.
Ndele ngee ope na ou te mu lombwele: “Eshi osha yambelwa oikalunga,” inamu lya omolwaau e shi holola, nomolweliudo;
itandi popi eliudo loye, ndele olamukweni; elipangelo lange oshike li tokolwe keliudo lamukwetu?
Ndele ngeenge handi shi li nokupandula, oshike handi shekwa omolwaashi handi shi pandulile?
Onghee hano ngeenge tamu li ile tamu nu, ile keshe tuu eshi tamu shi ningi, ashishe shi ningeni okufimanekifa Kalunga.
Inamu yandja nande omuhau, nande okOvajuda ile okOvagreka ile keongalo laKalunga,
ngaashi naame onda dulika kovanhu aveshe omoinima aishe, noihandi kongo eshi sha wapalela nge, ndelenee oshosho sha wapalela vahapu, opo va xupifwe.
11: Kaleni ovahopaeleli vange ngaashi ame omuhopaeleli waKristus.
Ndele ohandi pandula eshi tamu dimbulukwa nge moinima aishe notamu diinine omalongo ngaashi ame nde e mu pa.
Ndelenee onda hala nye mu shiive nokutya, Kristus Oye omutwe wakeshe omulumenhu, nomutwe womukainhu omulumenhu, nomutwe waKristus oKalunga.
Omulumenhu keshe ngeenge ta ilikana ile ta xunganeke a djala sha komutwe, oye ota dinifa omutwe waye.
Ndele omukainhu keshe ngeenge ta ilikana ile ta xunganeke ina djala sha komutwe, oye ta dinifa omutwe, osheshi eshi oshi fike pamwe naashi a kululwa noshimbi.
Osheshi ngeenge omukainhu ina tuvika omutwe waye, na tetife ko eexwiki daye; ndele ngeenge oshii komukainhu okutetifa eexwiki daye ile oku di kululifa ko, na tuvikile omutwe waye.
Osheshi omulumenhu ita tuvike omutwe waye, osheshi oye efano nefimano laKalunga; ndele omukainhu oye efimano lomulumenhu,
osheshi omulumenhu ka dile momukainhu ndelenee omukainhu okwa dile momulumenhu;
osheshi omulumenhu ina shitilwa omukainhu, ndelenee omukainhu oye a shitilwa omulumenhu.
Onghee omukainhu e nokukala e nedidiliko lokupangelwa komutwe waye omolwovaengeli.
Ndelenee mOmwene kape nomukainhu, omulumenhu ngeenge ke po, nokape nomulumenhu, omukainhu ngeenge ke po.
Osheshi ngaashi omukainhu a dile momulumenhu, osho tuu nomulumenhu a dalwa komukainhu; ndele aishe oyomuKalunga.
Tokoleni nye vene, ngeenge osha yuka tuu omukainhu ta ilikana Kalunga ina djala sha komutwe?
Ndele oushitwe woovene itau mu longo nokutya, omulumenhu ngeenge ta kala e neexwiki dile, ote lififa ohoni;
ndele omukainhu ngeenge e neexwiki dile, odo efimano laye, osheshi e di pewa e liuvike nado.
Ngeenge ope na ou e hole eemhata, fye katu neenghedi da tya ngaha, osho tuu yo momaongalo aKalunga.
Ndelenee moku mu lombwela eshi, itandi mu pandula, osheshi mokwoongala kweni itamu kulu mouwa, ndelenee omowii.
Tete onda uda, ngee tamu ongalele moshiongalele sheongalo, omu na oimhanga mokati keni, nokombinga ohandi shi itavele.
Heeno, oimhanga oi nokuholoka mokati keni, opo ovo vomunye ve shii okulineekelwa va shiivike.
Hano ngee tamu ongala ngaha, kaku fi okulya oshililo shOmwene,
osheshi keshe tuu ou ote lihakanene oikulya yaye mwene, nosho umwe ota fi ondjala nomukwao a kolwa.
Hamba, kamu na omaumbo okulila mo nokunwina mo? Ile otamu dini eongalo laKalunga notamu fifa eehepele ohoni? Ondi mu lombwele shike? Ondi na tuu oku mu pandula? Ahowe, apa itandi mu pandula nande.
Osheshi onda pewa kOmwene eshi nde shi mu shiivifila yo nokutya, Omwene Jesus oufiku winya a kengelelwa okwa kufa omungome,
ndele ta pandula, ndele te u pambula ta ti: “Tambuleni, lyeni, eshi osho olutu lange tali mu yandjelwa; shi ningeni nokudimbulukwa nge.”
Osho ngaha okwa kufa yo eholo, eshi va lya, ndele ta ti: “Eholo eli olo ehangano lipe omohonde yange, keshe efiku eshi tamu nu mo, shi ningeni nokudimbulukwa nge.”
Osheshi keshe efiku eshi tamu li omungome ou ndele tamu nu meholo eli, otamu hepaulula efyo lOmwene fiyo ote uya.
Onghee hano, ou ta li nai omungome ou ndele ta nu nai meholo eli lOmwene, oye ota ka kala e netimba lolutu nohonde yOmwene.
Omunhu ne lipulapule hano, ye na lye nee komungome ou, ye na nwe meholo eli;
osheshi ou ta li ndele ta nu, ye ina tongola olutu lOmwene, oye ote lilile ndele te linwine etokolo.
Onghee hano mokati keni omu noingone novanaudu vahapu, navahapu ova fya.
Ndele ngeno hatu lipulapula fye vene, ngeno itatu tokolwa;
Ndele ngeenge hatu tokolwa, ohatu dengwa kOmwene, tuha tokolelwe mekano pamwe nounyuni.
Onghee hano ovamwatate, ngeenge tamu ongalele okulya, teelelafaneni.
Ngeenge ope na ou a fya ondjala, na lye mombulavo, opo muha ongalele etokolo leni. Oinima ikwao ohandi i yukifa nge handi uya ko.
12: Ndelenee ovamwatate nye, mokupopya eeshali dopamhepo inandi hala mu kale muhe shi shii.
Omu shi shii, onye eshi mwa li ovapaani, omwa twalwa koikalunga ihai popi, muhe neanyo.
Onghee hano ohandi mu shiivifile, kape na ou ta popi mOmhepo yaKalunga ndele ta ti: “Jesus na fingwe,” ndele kape na ou ta dulu okutya: “Jesus Oye Omwene,” okuninga ta popifwa kOmhepo Iyapuki.
Eeshalinghenda odi li po di lili nadi lili, ndelenee Omhepo oyo tuu imwe aike tai di yandje;
nomayakulo e li po e lili noe lili, ndele Omwene Oye tuu umwe aeke ta longelwa;
noilonganghono oi li po i lili noi lili, ndele Kalunga ou ta longo mwaaishe, Oye tuu umwe.
Ndele keshe tuu ota pewa ehololo lOmhepo omolwekwafo laaveshe.
Osho umwe ta pewa kOmhepo eendjovo dounongo, nomukwao eendjovo dokushiiva kOmhepo tuu ei;
umwe eitavelo omOmhepo ei, omukwao oshali yokuvelula omOmhepo tuu ei imwe;
umwe oshali yoilonganghono, omukwao okuxunganeka, nomukwao okutongola eemhepo; umwe omalaka e lili nae lili, naumwe okufatulula omalaka.
Ndelenee aishe ei otai longwa kOmhepo tuu ei imwe, ta tukulile keshe tuu shaye ngaashi ya hala.
Osheshi ngaashi olutu limwe ndele oli na oinhimbu ihapu, noinhimbu aishe yolutu, nande oihapu, oyo olutu limwe, osho tuu naKristus.
Osheshi atusheni otwa shashelwa mOmhepo imwe twa ninga olutu limwe, ngeenge Ovajuda ile Ovagreka, ovapika ile ovadalwa, atusheni otwa nwefweni mOmhepo imwe.
Osheshi nolutu kali fi oshinhimbu shimwe, ndelenee oihapu.
Omhadi ngeno tai ti: “Ame ndihe fi eke, nghi fi womolutu,” ndele oyo tuu oshinhimbu shokolutu.
Nokutwi ngeno ku tye: “Ame nghi fi eisho, nghi fi wokolutu,” okwokolutu.
Olutu alishe ngeno eisho, eudo ngeno ola kala peni? Olutu alishe ngeno eudo, efimbulo ngeno ola kala peni?
Ndele paife Kalunga okwa tula oinhimbu molutu, keshe tuu shimwe, ngaashi Ye mwene a hala.
Hano ngeno aishe oshinhimbu shimwe, olutu ngeno oli li peni?
Ndele paime oinhimbu nande oihapu, olutu limwe.
Neisho itali dulu okulombwela eke: Inandi ku pumbwa, ile omutwe keemhadi: Inandi mu pumbwa.
Ndelenee oinhimbu ei yolutu tu i shii oyo oingone, oyo nee twe i pumbwa unene;
noinhimbu oyo yolutu hatu i tale ihe nefimano, oyo hatu i djaleke nokufewa, naai twe i fya ohoni, ohatu i tuvikile shili;
ndele ei ihatu i fi ohoni, inai shi pumbwa. Hano Kalunga okwa pangela olutu kumwe ngaha, ndele a djaleka osho shihe nefimano, efimano linene,
opo molutu muha kale etukauko, oinhimbu aishe i kale hai filafana oshisho shi fike pamwe.
Noshinhimbu shimwe ngeenge tashi yehama, oinhimbu ikwao otai yehama pamwe nasho; ile oshinhimbu shimwe tashi fimanekwa, oinhimbu aishe otai hafe pamwe nasho.
Ndele onye olutu laKristus noinhimbu yaye okeshe tuu ponhele yaye mwene.

Ndele Kalunga okwa tula mo meongalo tete vamwe ovayapostoli, olutivali ovaxunganeki, olutitatu ovalongindjovo nokwa yandja oilonganghono, neeshali dokuvelula, nokuyakula nokupangela, nokupopya omalaka e lili.
Haaveshe nokuli ovayapostoli, haaveshe nokuli ovaxunganeki, haaveshe nokuli ovalongindjovo, haaveshe tava longo oilonga yeenghono?
Aveshe ove na tuu oshali yokuvelula? Aveshe otava popi tuu momalaka? Aveshe otava shiiva tuu okufatulula?

Ndelenee lalakaneneni eeshalinghenda dinene odo di dule dikwao.
Ndele handi mu ulikile vali ondjila iwa unene.
13: Nande ndi tonge omalaka ovanhu novaengeli, ndelenee ame nghi nohole onda ninga oshikushu tashi lili, nongaashi ongedjo tai kwelengedja.

Nonande ondi kale ndi noshali yokuxunganeka nondi shiive oiholekwa aishe nondi kale ndi neshiivo alishe, ndele nande ondi kale ndi neitavelo alishe lokudikula eemhunda, ndelenee ame nghi nohole, ame nghi fi sha.
Nonande ondi yandjaule oinima aishe ndi palule eehepele, ile nande ondi liyandje olutu lange li xwikwe po, ame nghi nohole, ngeno kashi na eshi tashi kwafa nge.
Ohole i noutalanheni, ohole i nolukeno; ohole ihai fi efupa, ihai litange, ihai fulalala,
ihai holoka nai, ihai kongo shayo vene, ihai kenyanana, ihai dimbulukwa owii ye u ningilwa,
ihai nyakukilwa osho inashi yuka, ndele ohai nyakukilwa pamwe noshili;
ohai tuvike aishe nohai itavele aishe, ohai teelele aishe, nohai lididimikile aishe.
Ohole ihai xulu po nande, ndele okuxunganeka otaku xulu po nokupopya omalaka otaku xulu po nokushiiva otaku xulu po.
Osheshi okushiiva kwetu okombinga, nokuxunganeka kwetu okombinga;
ndele osho sha wana sha pwa, ngeenge tashi uya, opo nee eshi shokombinga otashi xulu po.
Ame eshi nda li okaana, onda tonga ngaashi okaana, nda shipununa ngaashi okaana, nonda diladila ngaashi okaana; ndelenee eshi nda ninga omukulunhu, onda efa ei yopakanona.

Osheshi paife ohatu mono ko ngaashi omoshitengelelo, ongaashi otumbutumbu, ndele mefiku linya okoshipala noshipala: paife okushiiva kwange okombinga, ndelenee efiku linya ohandi ka shiiva nda wana, ngaashi naame mwene yo nda shiivikika.
Ndele paife otaku kala eitavelo, eteelelo, ohole, oyo itatu; ndelenee ohole oinene i dule ikwao.
14: Lalakaneneni ohole, nye mu lihalele shili eeshali dopamhepo, ndele unene oshali youxunganeki.
Osheshi ou ta popi omalaka ita popi novanhu, ota popi naKalunga; osheshi kape na ou e mu udite, osheshi ota popifwa kOmhepo oiholekwa.
Ndele ou ta xunganeke ota lombwele ovanhu oku va longa noku va kumaida noku va hekeleka.
Ou ta popi omalaka ote litungu ye mwene, ndele ou ta xunganeke ota tungu eongalo.
Onda hala ngeno amushe mu popye omalaka, ndele unene nda hala mu xunganeke; osheshi ou ta xunganeke oye e dule winya ta popi omalaka, okuninga ta fatulula, eongalo opo li tungwe.
Ndelenee ovamwatate, ngeno ondi uye kunye, handi popi omalaka, ohandi mu kwafa shike, ngeenge itandi popi mehololo ile mokushiiva ile mokuxunganeka ile mokulonga?
Ongaashi oinima ihe nomwenyo oyo tai yandje ewi, ngaashi ofilita ile onyalilo; nande tai yandje ewi, olyelye ou ta shiiva osho tashi shikwa, ngeenge ita yandje ewi la tongoka?
Nosho tuu enghuma, ngeenge tali yandje ewi inali yela, olyelye te lilongekidile okuya koita?
Osho nanye yo; ngeenge itamu popi nomalaka eendjovo di uditike, omunhu ota udu ko ngahelipi osho tamu popi, okupopya kweni otaku i omhepo.
Mounyuni omu na omalaka e lili nae lili, olyelye a shiiva kutya, angapi, ndele kape na nande limwe li neendaka dihe uditike.
Ndele omatumbulo elaka ngeenge kandi a shii, ame omunailongo koshipala shomupopi, nomupopi omunailongo koshipala shange.
Osho nanye yo, eshi tamu lalakanene okupewa eeshali dopaMhepo, lihaleleni mu di pewe dihapu, mu tunge eongalo.
Onghee hano ou ta popi omalaka, na indile a dule yo oku a fatula.
Osheshi ngeenge handi ilikana nokupopya omalaka, omhepo yange oyo aike tai ilikana, ndele eendunge dange itadi imike sha.
Ongahelipi hano? Onda hala okwiilikana nomhepo yange, nonda hala yo okwiilikana neendunge dange; ondi nokwiimba nomhepo yange, nondi na yo okwiimba neendunge dange.
Osheshi ngeenge to pandula nomhepo, ou e li omutumba ina shiiva sha, ota dulu ngahelipi okwiitavela epandulo loye a tye: “Amen” ngeenge ke udite ko eshi to popi?
Heeno, ove oto pandula nawa, ndele omukweni ita tungwa kulo.
Onda pandula Kalunga eshi handi popi omalaka ndi dule amushe,
ndelenee meongalo onda hala komesho yaaishe ndi popye oitya itano neendunge, ndi longe yo vamwe, i dule oitya omayovi omulongo mokupopya omalaka.
Ovamwatate, inamu kala ounona meendunge, kaleni ounona mowii; ndelenee kaleni ovalumenhu meendunge.
MOmhango omwa shangwa: “Ovadumi nomilungu dovanailongo handi di popififa oshiwana eshi, ndelenee natango tuu itashi udu nge, Omwene osho ta ti.”
Hano, okupopya omalaka kaku fi edidiliko kovaitaveli, ndelenee okwaava vehe neitavelo; ndelenee okuxunganeka okwo edidiliko lovaitaveli ndelenee halaava vehe neitavelo.
Eongalo alishe ngeno tali ongala, naaveshe ngeno tava popi omalaka, ndele tamu uya ava inamu longwa, ile ava vehe neitavelo, ovo itava ti mbela: “Onye omwa pilalala meendunge?”
Ndele ngeenge aveshe otava xunganeke notamu uya umwe ou ehe neitavelo ile ou ina longwa, opo aveshe tave mu hololele oushima waye noku mu tomha,
nosho oiholekwa yomutima waye tai hololwa, ndele ote lipwipwike oshipala shaye nomokwiilikana Kalunga ota hepaulula nokutya: “Kalunga oku li shili mokati keni.”

Ongahelipi hano, ovamwatate? Ngeenge tamu ongala, keshe umwe oku na sha shokweeta po, umwe e neimbilo, namukwao e nelongo, naumwe e nehololelo, umwe a hala okupopya omalaka, namukwao ta fatulula; aishe nai kwafe okutunga.
Ngeenge taku popiwa omalaka, naku popye vavali ile vatatu, vo va shikulafane, naumwe na fatulule.
Ndele ngeenge kape nomufatululi, nava mwene meongalo, vo ve lipopile voovene naKalunga.
Ovaxunganeki nava popye vavali ile vatatu, noovakwao nave di yeleke,
ndele ngeenge umwe womwaava tava kala omutumba, ota hololelwa sha, opo ou wotete na mwene.
Osheshi onye amushe mu nomhito okuxunganeka mwa shikulafana, opo aveshe va longwe naaveshe va kumaidwe.
Neemhepo dovaxunganeki ohadi dulika kovaxunganeki,

osheshi Kalunga Ye ke fi Kalunga kedongakano, ndelenee okombili.
Ngaashi momaongalo aeshe ovayapuki,
ovakainhu veni nava mwene moiongalele yomaongalo, osheshi ova shilikwa okupopya, ndele nava dulike yo, ngaashi omhango tai shi ti.
Ngeenge va hala okushiiva sha, nava pule kovalumenhu vavo momaumbo, osheshi ohoni komukainhu okupopya meongalo.
Ile eendjovo daKalunga da dja munye? Ile okunye amuke de uya?
Ngeenge ope na ou e shii oye omuxunganeki ile omunamhepo na kale e shi shii, eshi handi mu shangele osho oshipango shOmwene.
Ndelenee ngeenge ope na ou ine shi koneka, na kale ine shi koneka.
Onghee hano ovamwatate, kondjeni shili mu shiive okuxunganeka, ndele okupopya omalaka inamu ku kelela.
Ndelenee aishe nai ningwe keenghedi diwa nokushikulafana.
15: Ovamwatate, ohandi mu shiivifile evaengeli olo nde li mu udifila, ndele nye mwe li tambula yo, nomwa kala yo mulo,
olo tuu olo tamu xupifilwa yo mulo, ngeenge tamu li diinine li kale ngaashi nde li mu udifila, ngeenge inamu li itavela oshimha.
Osheshi komesho yaaishe ame onde mu shiivifila eshi nde shi pewa yo ame mwene: nokutya, Kristus okwa fya omolwoulunde wetu ngaashi pa shangwa.
Ndele Ye okwa pakwa, nefiku etitatu okwa nyumunwa pamishangwa,
ndele okwe lihololela Kefas nokonima e lihololela ava omulongo navavali.
Opo nee Ye okwa holokela palumwe kovalumenhu ve dule omafele atano, vahapu vomuvo ve nomwenyo natango, ndele vamwe va kofa mo.
Ndele okwe lihololela vali Jakob novayapostoli aveshe.
Ndele hauxuuninwa e lihololela nge, aame, ou nda fa nda dalwa, inandi fika okudalwa,
osheshi ame ondi dulike kovayapostoli aveshe, inandi wana okwiifanwa omuyapostoli, osheshi ame nda taataele eongalo laKalunga.

Ndelenee okefilonghenda laKalunga ame ondi li po ngaashi ndi li, efilonghenda laye inali hepela mo mwaame, ndelenee onda longa shili ndi va dule aveshe, ndelenee haame mwene, efilonghenda laKalunga eli la kala pamwe naame.
Hano nande aame ile venya, osho hatu udifa, ndele nye mwa itavela.
Hano ngeenge Kristus ta udifwa nokutya, a nyumuka movafi, ongahelipi hano vamwe vomunye tava ti: kape nenyumuko lovafi?
Nongeenge kape nenyumuko lovafi, nena Kristus yo ina nyumunwa;
Ndelenee ngeenge Kristus ina nyumunwa, neudifo letu olongaho, osho yo eitavelo leni olongaho.
Nafye ohatu monika yo, ofye ovahepaululi vaKalunga ovanaipupulu, shaashi twa hepaulula, hatu kondjifa Kalunga kutya, Oye a nyumuna Kristus, ou ine mu nyumuna, ngeenge ovafi itava nyumunwa.
Osheshi ovafi ngeenge itava nyumunwa, naKristus ina nyumunwa yo.
Ndele Kristus ngeenge ina nyumunwa, eitavelo leni yo kali nekwafo, onye omu li moulunde weni;
hano naava yo va fya muKristus, ova kana.
Hano ngeenge twa tula eteelelo muKristus mokukalamwenyo oku akuke, ofye omapongo unene tu dulike kovanhu aveshe.
Ndelenee paife Kristus okwa nyumuka movafi, Oye wotete waava va kofa mo,
osheshi efyo ngaashi le uya molwomunhu umwe, osho yo nenyumuko lovafi omolwomunhu umwe.
Osheshi ngaashi aveshe tava file muAdam, osho yo aveshe tava ningwa ovanamwenyo muKristus.
Ndelenee keshe tuu omolufo laye: tete oKristus, opo nee ava vaKristus tava shikula meuyo laye.
Opo nee exulilo tali uya, fimbo ta yandje ouhamba kuKalunga Xe, eshi a hanauna po elelo alishe nepangelo neenghono adishe.
Osheshi Oye e nokupangela fiyo ota tula ovatondi vaye aveshe koshi yeemhadi daye.
Omutondi wahauxuuninwa ou ta hanaunwa po oye efyo.
Osheshi aishe e i tula koshi yeemhadi daye. Ndele eshi ta ti: “Aishe oya tulwa koshi, opo nee fye otu shi shii, ou a tula aishe meke laye, Ye ina tulwa mo.”
Ndele oinima aishe ngeenge ya tulwa mepangelo laye, opo nee Omona Ye mwene ote ke litula yo koshi yaau e mu tulila ko aishe, Kalunga, opo a kale omunashisho moinima aishe.
Ndele ngeenge hasho, ava ve lishashifila ovafi, otava ningi shike? Ovafi ngeenge itava nyumunwa, oshike hano tave lishashifa ponhele yavo?
Nafye yo ohatu litulile shike moiponga keshe efimbo?
Keshe efiku ondi li pokufya, oshili, ngaashi nye ovamwatate, elitango lange muKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu.
Olwoodi nda li nalo muEfeso, eshi nda lwa noilyani paenghedi dovanhu, otashi kwafa nge shike? Ngeenge ovafi itava nyumunwa: “Opo nee tu lyeni hano, fye tu nweni,” osheshi mongula ohatu fi.
Inamu puka: “Ookaume vai otava nyono po eenghedi diwa.”
Kololokweni hano pauyuki, ndele ningeni eendunge nye inamu nyona; osheshi ope na vamwe inava shiiva nande Kalunga. Ohandi shi mu lombwele opo mu fye ohoni.
Ndelenee pamwe pe na ou ta ti: Ovafi otava nyumunwa ngahelipi, ndele tava holoka ve nomalutu e li ngahelipi?
Elai ove, eshi to shi kunu, itashi ningi omwenyo, ngeenge inashi fila mo.
Ndele ngeenge to kunu, ito kunu eshi tashi ningi olutu, ndelenee ombuto yongaho, ngeenge oilya ile keshe tuu eshi shi lili.
Ndele Kalunga te shi pe omuno ngaashi Ye a hala, ndele keshe ombuto otai pewa olutu layo vene.
Eenhumba adishe kadi li shimwe, eemhumba dovanhu odi lili, nodoimuna odi lili, neenhumba doudila odi lili, nodeeshi odi lili.
Ndele oku na omalutu omakwaulu, noku nomalutu omakwadu, ndele oshinge shomalutu omakwaulu oshi lili, noshinge shomalutu omakwadu oshi lili.
Oshinge shetango oshi lili, noshinge shohani oshi lili nosheenyofi oshi lili, ndele keshe onyofi i na yo oshinge shayo shi lili.
Nenyumuko lovafi osho li li: otapa kunwa olutu tali xulu po, ndele tapa nyumunwa olutu itali xulu po.
Mokudinwa tamu kunwa, moshinge tamu nyumunwa; omoungone tamu kunwa, ndele otaku nyumunwa meenghono.
Otapa kunwa olutu lopashitwe, ndele tapa nyumunwa olutu lopamhepo. Ngaashi pe nomalutu opashitwe, osho yo pe nomalutu opamhepo.
Ndele opa shangwa yo: “Omunhu wotete, Adam, okwa ninga omunamwenyo,” Adam ou a xuuninwa okwa ninga omhepo ei hai yandje omwenyo.
Ndelenee hasheshi shopamhepo shotete, ndelenee eshi shopashitwe osho shotete; notashi shikulwa nee kwaashi shopamhepo.
Omunhu wotete okwa dja medu, omukwadu; omunhu omutivali, Omwene, a dja meulu.
Ngaashi omunhu omukwadu a kala, osho yo ovakwadu; nongaashi omukwaulu a kala, osho yo ovakwaulu.
Ndele ngaashi twa li twa djala efano laau omukwadu, osho hatu ka djala yo efano laau omukwaulu.
Ndele eshi ohandi shi mu lombwele, ovamwatate, nokutya, onhumba nohonde itai fyuulula ouhamba waKalunga, naashi tashi xulu, itashi fyuulula osho itashi xulu.
Taleni, ohandi mu lombwele oshiholekwa: Hafye atushe hatu fi, ndelenee atusheni ohatu ka shitululwa.
Divadiva, mepakumo leisho, omokushikwa kwenghuma laxuuninwa, osheshi enghuma otali ka shikwa, novafi otava nyumuka, ndele itava xulu po vali, ndele ofye ohatu shitululwa.
Osheshi eshi shopanyonauko oshi nokudjala shinya shihe nenyonauko, naashi tashi fi, otashi djala shinya itashi fi.

Ndele eshi shopanyonauko ngeenge tashi djala shinya shihe nenyonauko, naashi tashi fi ngeenge tashi djala eshi itashi fi, opo nee ondjovo ei ya shangwa, otai ningi yoshili:
“Efyo ola ponwa po filu mefindano!

Efyo, efindano loye oli li peni?
Efyo, oshitwifo shoye oshi li peni?”
Oshitwifo shefyo osho oulunde, neenghono doulunde odo omhango.
Ndelenee Kalunga Oye na pandulwe, ou ote tu pe efindano omolwOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Onghee hano, ovamwatate ovaholike, kaleni mwa pama, muha tengauke, alushe kaleni ovaladi moilonga yOmwene, mu kale mu shi shii nokutya, oshilonga sheni kashi fi oshimha omOmwene.
16: Mokupopya ongalo hai shivilwa ovayapuki, nanye yo ningeni ngaashi nda lombwelele omaongalo omuGalatia.
Mefiku lotete loshivike keshe, keshe tuu womunye na tuvikile sha mombulavo palikolo laye, muha hangike eshi nde uya tamu i shivi.
Ndelenee ngeenge nde uya ko, opo nee handi ka tuma ovanhu ovo mwe va tala va wana va twale eeshalihole deni neenhumwafo kuJerusalem.
Ngeenge sha wapalela oshinima eshi ame ndi ye ko yo, tu ende pamwe.
Ndelenee onda hala okuuya kunye, ngeenge nda pitile muMakedonia, osheshi ohandi pitile muMakedonia.
Ndelenee ohandi kala punye efimbo limwe, kashiimba ndi menekele po okufu, opo nee nye mu findikile nge akushe tuu oku ohandi i.
Osheshi paife inandi hala oku mu talela po mokutokola kwongaho, osheshi onda diladila ndi kale omafiku punye, ngeenge Omwene e shi hala.
Ndele muEfeso onda hala okukala mo fiyo okuPentekoste.
Osheshi ame onda yeululilwa oshivelo shoshilonga shinene shi nepuniko, ndele ope novanandubo vahapu.
Ndelenee Timoteus ngeenge te uya, taleni hano a kale punye ehe netilo, osheshi ye ota longo oshilonga shOmwene, ngaashi naame yo handi shi longo.
Inapa kala nande umwe te mu dini, ndelenee mu kwafeni a dje ko nombili e uye kwaame; osheshi otwe mu teelela fye novamwatate.
Mokudimbulukwa omumwatate Apollos, onde mu kumaida shili okuuya kunye pamwe novamwatate, ndele ye ina hala nande okuuya paife, ote uya ngeenge a mono omhito.
Kaleni oupafi, mwa pama meitavelo, ovalumenhwelela, mwa pamenena.
Ashishe nashi longwe mohole.
Ndele ohandi mu kumaida, ovamwatate: nye omwa shiiva eumbo laStefanas, nomu shi shii ovo votete vomuAkaia, ndele ove liyandja meyakulo lovayapuki.
Nanye yo kaleni tamu dulika kwaava ve li ngaha, nokukeshe ou ta longo navo ndele ta humbata oudjuu pamwe navo.
Nonda hafela okuuya kwaStefanas naFortunatus naAkaikus, osheshi ovo ve li pwaame ponhele yeni;
va hekeleka omhepo yange nodeni yo. Fimanekeni hano ovalumenhu va tya ngaha.
Omaongalo omuAsia otae mu kundifa. Akwila naPriskila otave mu kundile po mOmwene neenghono, pamwe neongalo hali ongala meumbo lavo.
Ovamwatate aveshe meitavelo otave mu kundile po. Kundilafaneni po nefipo lokomilungu liyapuki.
Ekundilo lange, aame Paulus neke lange mwene.
Ngeenge ope na ou ehe hole Omwene, oye na fingwe! Maran ata!
Efilonghenda lOmwene Jesus nali kale pamwe nanye.
Ohole yange oi li pamwe nanye amushe omuKristus Jesus. Amen.

1: Paulus, omuyapostoli waKristus Jesus okehalo laKalunga, nomumwatate Timoteus, okeongalo laKalunga lomuKorinto, pamwe novayapuki aveshe muAkaia aishe.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu noyOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Kalunga naXe yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus na hambelelwe, oXe yefilonghenda naKalunga kehekeleko alishe,
ou te tu hekeleke moudjuu wetu aushe, opo tu shiive yo okuhekeleka ava ve li moudjuu keshe onehekeleko olo Kalunga ta hekeleke fye vene.
Osheshi ngaashi omauyehame aKristus e tu yada pombada, osho yo omahekeleko e tu yada pombada omolwaKristus.

Ndelenee ofye ngeenge tu li meefina, otadi ningi exupifo nehekeleko leni, navali, ofye ngeenge hatu hekelekwa, otashi mu etele ehekeleko, notashi mu pameke mu lididimikile omauyehame oo tae tu yehameke yo.
Neteelelo letu kunye ola pama. Osheshi ou shi shii onye ngaashi mwa kwatafana nomahepeko, nosho mwa kwatafana nehekeleko yo.
Osheshi ovamwatate, inatu hala nye mu kale inamu shiiva oudjuu winya we tu hanga muAsia; omaudjuu a li manene unene e dule eenghono detu, opo twa li hatu limbililwa molwokukalamwenyo kwetu nokuli,
nafye vene yo otwe litala otwa tokolelwa efyo, opo tuha kale twe lineekela fye vene, ndelenee tu lineekele Kalunga, ou ta nyumuna ovafi.
Ye okwe tu xupifa mo moshiponga shefyo olo linene, ndele ote tu xupifa nokomesho, ndele muye otwa tula mo eteelelo letu nokutya, ote ke tu xupifa nokomesho yo,
eshi nanye yo tamu tu kwafa momailikaneno eni, opo momakanya mahapu epandulo molwetu li yeluke pombada omolwefilonghenda eli twe li pewa.
Osheshi elitango letu oleli: Ehepaululo leliudo letu oleli kutya, fye otwa enda mounyuni naunene mokati keni, mouyapuki nomoukoshoki waKalunga, hamounongo wopambelela, ndele mefilonghenda laKalunga.
Ndele mwaashi hatu mu shangele kamu na shimwe shi lili, osho tuu osho tamu shi lesha nomu shi udite yo; ndele ondi neteelelo mu kale mu udite ko fiyo okexulilo,
ngaashi nokuli mwa kala mu tu udite kombinga, nokutya ofye elitango leni, ngaashi nanye yo oletu mefiku lOmwene wetu Jesus.
Ndele melineekelo eli onda li nda hala tete okuuya kunye, onye mu pewe epuniko etivali,
nondi pite punye mokuya kuMakedonia, nomokwaaluka kuMakedonia okuuya vali kunye, nokekwafo leni okuuya kuJudea.
Hano eshi nda li nda hala okuninga ngaha, inandi shi diladila nawa mbela? Ile handi pangele eemhangela dange pambelela ndi kale ngeno ndi neendjovo mbali: “Heeno, heeno” na “ahowe, ahowe”?
Ndelenee Kalunga Oye omudiinini, onghee ondjovo yetu kunye itai kala “heeno” na “ahowe.”
Osheshi Omona waKalunga Jesus Kristus, Oye ou a udifwa mokati keni kufye, kwaame naSilvanus naTimoteus, Oye ke fi “heeno” na “ahowe,” ndelenee muye omwa dja “heeno.”
Osheshi omaudaneko aKalunga aeshe oku li muye “heeno,” onghee hano muye tamu di “Amen” yao kefimano laKalunga kufye.
Ndelenee ou te tu pamekele pamwe nanye muKristus nokwe tu vaeka, Oye Kalunga,
ou e tu twa oshilimbo shaye nokwe tu pa momitima detu ombabyona yOmhepo.
Ndelenee ame ohandi ifana Kalunga a ninge ondobwedi yomomwenyo wange, ame eshi inandi uya nale kuKorinto, onde mu tala onheni,
hakutya fye otwa hala okupangela eitavelo leni, ndelenee fye ovayakuli pamwe nanye omolwehafo leni; osheshi meitavelo omwa pama.
2: Ndelenee ame nda li nda tokola shili, inandi hala okuuya kunye ndi mu etele vali oluhodi.
Osheshi ame ngee ohandi mu nyikifa oluhodi, olyelye hano ta hafifa nge vali, ngee haye winya ngeno nde mu nyikifa oluhodi?
Ndele osho tuu eshi nde shi mu shangela, opo mokuuya kunye muha nyikifwe oluhodi kwaava va li ve nokuhafifa nge, osheshi onde mu lineekela nye amushe, nokutya ehafo lange oleni yo amushe.
Osheshi moudjuu unene nomouyehame womomutima onde mu shangela nomahodi mahapu, haku mu nyikifa oluhodi, ndelenee onda hala mu shiive ohole ei inene ndi i na yoku mu hola.
Ndele ngeenge umwe a eta oluhodi, haame a nyikifa oluhodi, ndelenee onye tuu amushe, ndiha popye dihapu unene.
Ehandukilo olo e li mona kuvahapu, ola wana;
osho hano kombinga ikwao mu noku mu dimina po vali noku mu hekeleka, opo aha ningine moluhodi unene.
Onghee ohandi mu kumaida mu hovele oku mu hola;
osheshi onde shi mu shangela ndi shiive nhumbi mu li mokuyelekwa kweni, ngeenge omu neduliko moinima aishe.
Ndelenee ou tamu mu dimine po sha, naame yo ohandi dimi po; osheshi osho nde shi dima po, ngeenge onda li ndi na sha okudima po, onde shi dima po omolweni koshipala shaKristus,
opo tuha findwe kuSatana, osheshi omakoto aye otu a shii.
Ndelenee ame eshi nde uya kuTroas okuudifa evaengeli laKristus, onda yeululilwa oshivelo mOmwene,
ndelenee inandi mona etulumuko momhepo yange, osheshi inandi mona mo omumwatate Titus. Onghee nde va lekela, ndele nda ya kuMakedonia.
Ndelenee Kalunga na pandulwe, ou te tu wilike alushe molweendo lwefindano muKristus, ou te tu hololifa apeshe edimba liwa lokushiiva kwaye!
Osheshi ofye edimba liwa laKristus kuKalunga mokati kaava tava xupifwa nomwaava tava ka kana;
kwaava edimba lefyo okefyo, ndele kwaavenya edimba lomwenyo olokuyandja omwenyo. Ndele olyelye ou a wanena eshi?
Inatu fa venya vahapu hava shingifa eendjovo daKalunga, ndelenee onomadiladilo a yela, ngaashi ava hava longifwa kuKalunga, omoipafi yaKalunga ohatu popi muKristus.
3: Ohatu hovele vali mbela okulitanga fye vene? Ile ohatu pumbwa mbela ngaashi vamwe eenhumwafo depopilo mwe di shangelwa, ile da shangwa kunye?
Onye vene onhumwafo yetu ya shangelwa momitima detu, ya shiivika noya leshwa kovanhu aveshe,

osheshi osha shiivika, onye onhumwafo yaKristus, ya yakulwa kufye, inai shangwa nohinga, ndelenee onOmhepo yaKalunga omunamwenyo, inai shangelwa moitaafula yomamanya, ndelenee omoitaafula yomitima dopanhu.
Elineekelo li fike apa okulineekela Kalunga otu li kwete muKristus;
hafye vene tu shiive ngeno okudiladila sha meenghono detu vene, ndelenee eshi hatu shi dulu, otashi di kuKalunga.
Oye tuu ou e tu longekida yo tu kale ovayakuli vehangano lipe, hapamanyolo, ndelenee omOmhepo, osheshi omanyolo taa dipaa, ndelenee Omhepo otai yandje omwenyo.

Ndelenee eyakulo lefyo nokuli eli la li la hokelwa momamanya noundada, ngeenge la holoka moshinge shi fike apa, ovana vaIsrael ngaashi va nyengwa okutala oshipala shaMoses molwoshinge shokoshipala shaye, nande tashi xulu po vali!
Hano eyakulo lOmhepo otali kala linene li fike peni li dule linya moshinge!
Osheshi ngeenge eyakulo letokolo lekano ola li nokuli li noshinge, opo nee eyakulo louyuki oli yadi oshinge shinene komesho yaashinya.
Osheshi linya la li li noshinge, ngeenge tali yelekwa naali lihe noshinge, olo kali noshinge omolwoshinge eshi shinene sha wanenena.
Eshi tashi xulu po ngeenge sha kala noshinge, opo nee eshi itashi xulu po, otashi kala noshinge shinene shi dule shinya.
Hano ofye eshi tu neteelelo li fike apa, otu nouladi uhapu mokupopya kwetu,
fye katu li ngaashi Moses, ou a tuvikile oshipala shaye, opo ovana vaIsrael vaha mone exulilo laashi tashi xulu po.
Ndelenee omadilongo avo a kukutikwa, osheshi natango onena eli omishangwa dehangano likulu ngeenge tadi leshwa, oshituviko osho tashi kala itashi kufwa po, osheshi tashi kufwa po muKristus.
Heeno, fiyo onena eli Moses ngeenge ta leshwa, oshituviko otashi tuvike omitima davo.
Ndelenee omitima davo ngeenge de liameke kOmwene, oshituviko otashi kufwa po.
Osheshi Omwene Oye Omhepo, naapa Omhepo yOmwene tai kala po, ope nemanguluko.
Ndelenee atushe ava hatu tale noipala ya tuvikululwa oshinge shOmwene, ngaashi moshitengelelo, ohatu shituka tu fe efano tuu olo omoshinge okoshinge, ngaashi Omwene Oye ou Omhepo ta shitulula.
4: Onghee hano eshi tu neyakulolonga eli pafilonghenda olo twe li pewa, ihatu fi ounye,
ndelenee otwa efa oinima aishe yohoni yomeholeko, ndele fye ihatu ende nekoto, ihatu endameke eendjovo daKalunga, ndelenee mokuholola oshili otu nelipopilo keliudo keshe lomunhu koshipala shaKalunga.
Ndele evaengeli letu ngeenge la tuvikwa, ola tuvikwa mwaava tava ka kanifwa,
mwaava vehe neitavelo, eendunge davo da twikifwa kukalunga kefimbo lounyuni eli, vo itava minikilwa kouyelele wevaengeli loshinge shaKristus, Oye ou efano laKalunga.
Osheshi ihatu liudifa fye vene, ndelenee Jesus Kristus nokutya, Oye Omwene, nafye ovapiya veni molwaJesus,

osheshi Kalunga ou a tile: “Ouyelele nau minikile momulaulu, Oye tuu ou a minikila momitima detu,” opo okushiiva kwoshinge shaKalunga ku tandavelife ouyelele, nokutya oshinge tuu osho tashi taima moshipala shaKristus.
Ndelenee emona tuu eli ohatu li kwatele moitoo yedu, opo ouyadi weenghono u kale waKalunga, ndele uha monike tau di mufye vene.
Mwaaishe otu li po twa fininikwa, ndele inatu patekena po, ofye twa limbililwa, ndele inatu kanifa eteelelo,
ohatu tewatewa, ndele inatu ekelwashi, twa natwa poshi, ndele inatu nyonwa po.
Ohatu ende nokuhumbata alushe efyo laJesus molutu letu, opo omwenyo waJesus u holoke yo molutu letu.
Osheshi ofye ava tu nomwenyo ohatu yandjwa efimbo keshe mefyo molwaJesus, opo omwenyo waJesus u holoke yo mombelela yetu ya nyika efyo.
Osho ngaha hano efyo tali longo mufye, ndelenee omwenyo omunye.
Ndelenee eshi fye tu na omhepo tuu oyo imwe yeitavelo, ngaashi pa shangwa: “Onda itavela, onghee ohandi popi,” osho nafye yo otwa itavela, nonghee ohatu popi yo,
eshi tu shi shii nokutya, ou a nyumuna Omwene Jesus, Oye te tu nyumuna yo pamwe naJesus, ndele ote ke tu kaleka ofika pamwe nanye.
Osheshi aishe otai ningwa omolweni, opo efilonghenda eli tali hapupala alushe, li pendule muvahapu ve dule voshito epandulo tali hapupala okufimaneka Kalunga.
Onghee hano itatu kanifa ouladi, osheshi nande omunhu wetu wokombada ta nyonauka po, ou womeni ota shituka mupe efiku nefiku.
Osheshi oudjuu ou wetu owopakafimbo, notau ke tu etela efimano linene la wana olo laalushe,
ofye ava ihatu tale ei i wetike, osheshi ei i wetike otai xulu po, ndelenee inya ihe wetike otai kala po fiyo alushe.
5: Osheshi otu shi shii, olutu letu, etwali eli lopedu, ngeenge tali hanaunwa po, fye otu netungaumbo kuKalunga, eumbo laalushe meulu, inali tungwa nomake.
Onghee hano hatu keme nokudjuulukwa fye tu dikwe eumbo ekwaulu,
osheshi ngeenge twe li dikwa, itatu monika tu li hamunghele.
Osheshi ofye ava tu li natango metwali eli, ohatu keme tu noudjuu, osheshi inatu hala okudulwa, ndelenee okudjalekwa tuu, opo eshi shi nokufya shi ponwe po komwenyo.
Ndelenee ou e tu longekidila oshinima eshi, Oye Kalunga, ou e tu pa ombabyona yOmhepo.
Onghee otu neyombamo alushe ndele otu shi shii, fimbo tu li mombuletu, molutu eli letu, katu li mOmwene,
osheshi ohatu ende meitavelo, hamokumona,
ndelenee fye otu neyombamo shili notwa djuulukwa okutembuka mo molutu nokufika mombuletu kOmwene.
Onghee hano otwa hala oku mu wapalela ngeenge tu li mombuletu ile katu mo.
Osheshi ofyeni atusheni tu nokuholoka kolukalwatokolo laKristus, opo keshe tuu ou a pewe osho e shi longa molutu, ngeenge ouwa ile owii.
Hano etilo lOmwene eshi tu li shii, ohatu kendabala okwiitavelifa ovanhu, ndelenee kuKalunga otwa shiivika nawa; ndele ondi neteelelo nokutya, nanye yo omu tu shii momaliudo eni.

Osheshi ihatu lihokwifa fye vene kunye, ndelenee otwa hala tu mu pe omhito mu litange molwetu, nye mu kale mu na sha okutomhifa venya have litangele osho hashi monika nomesho, hasheshi shi li momutima.
Osheshi ngeenge otwa li twa piyaana, otwe shi ninga omolwaKalunga; ndele ngeenge otu nombili otu i kwete molweni.
Osheshi ohole yaKristus otai tu fininike ofye ava twa tokola ngaha: umwe okwa fya omolwaaveshe, hano aveshe ova fya;
ndele Oye okwa fya ponhele yaaveshe, opo ovo ve nomwenyo vehe likalele vali voovene, ndelenee Oye ou e va fila nokwe va nyumukila.
Onghee hano mokudja paife kape na ou tu mu shii pambelela; nonande twa li twa shiiva Kristus pambelela, katu mu shii vali ngaha.
Hano ngeenge ope na ou e li muKristus, oye omushitwa mupe; eshi shikulu osha xula po, tala, aishe ya ninga ipe.
Ndelenee ashishe eshi tashi di muKalunga, ou e tu hanganifa naye mwene muKristus nokwe tu pa oshilongayakulo shehanganifo.
Osheshi Kalunga okwa kala muKristus nokwa hanganifa ounyuni naye mwene, ndele ine va valulila omatauluko avo, ndele okwe tu pa ondjovo yehanganifo.
Ponhele yaKristus ofye hano ovatumwa, ndele Kalunga ote tu kumaidifa. Ponhele yaKristus ohatu mu ilikana: Itaveleni mu hanganifwe naKalunga.
Oye ou ina shiiva nande oulunde, okwe mu ninga oulunde molwetu, opo tu ninge ouyuki waKalunga muye.
6: Ndelenee ofye ovalongi pamwe naye ohatu mu kumaida yo, efilonghenda laKalunga muhe li tambule oshimha,

osheshi ota ti:
“Efimbo la wapala onde ku uda,
nefiku lexupifo onde ku kwafa.”
Tala, efimbo la wapala opaife, tala, efiku lexupifo opaife.
Fye itatu pe omunhu omhito okudina moshinima nande oshimwe, oshilongayakulo shetu shiha shekwe,
ndelenee moinima aishe ohatu liholola ofye ovayakuli vaKalunga: melididimiko linene, momahepeko, momaluhepo, momafininiko,
mokudengwa, modolongo, momapiyaano, moilonga idjuu, omokukala oupafi, mokulidilika oikulya;
moukoshoki, mokushiiva, moutalanheni, mokukala nombili, mOmhepo Iyapuki, mohole yashili ihe neliningifo,
meendjovo doshili, meenghono daKalunga, noilwifo youyuki meke lokolulyo nolokolumosho;
mokufimanekwa nomokudinwa, mokupopilwa mouwa nomowii, ngaashi ovapukifi, nande fye ovanashili,
ngaashi ovo inava shiivika, ndelenee otwa shiivika nawa; ngaashi ovo ve li pokufya, ndele tala, otu nomwenyo, ngaashi oonakuhandukilwa, fye inatu dipawa po,
ngaashi ava ve nomahodi, ndele otu nehafo alushe, ngaashi eehepele, ndele ohatu punapalifa vahapu, ngaashi ovo vehe na nande sha, ndele otu noinima aishe.
Omakanya etu otwe e mu makulila onye Ovakorinto, omitima detu oda mbwalangadja.
Onye kamu nofina mufye, omu nofina momitima deni vene.
Ndelenee yandjeni ngaashi mwa pewa. Ohandi mu lombwele ngaashi ounona: Nanye yo mbwalangadjeni.
Inamu humbata ondjoko imwe pamwe naava vehe neitavelo; osheshi ouyuki ou noukumwe washike nouhenouyuki? Ile ouyelele ou nekwatafano lashike nomulaulu?
Ndele Kristus naBelial otava udafana ngahelipi? Ile omwiitaveli e noshitukulwa shashike naau ehe fi omwiitaveli?

Otembeli yaKalunga oi nekwatafano lashike noikalunga? Osheshi fye otembeli yaKalunga omunamwenyo, Kalunga ngaashi a tonga:
“Ame onda hala okukala muvo,
nokweenda mokati kavo,
Ame ohandi kala Kalunga kavo,
ovo notava ningi oshiwana shange.”

Onghee:
“Djeni mo mokati kavo nye mu liyoolole
mo muvo, Omwene osho ta ti,
nye inamu kuma eshi sha nyata;
opo Ame ohandi mu tambula,

nohandi ningi Xo yeni,
onye notamu ningi ovamwange ovamati noukadona,
Omwene Omunaenghono adishe osho ta ti.”
7: Eshi tu na hano omaudaneko e fike apa, ovaholike, tu likosheni kedilo keshe naali lombelela naali lomhepo, fye tu wanifeni eyapulo mokutila Kalunga.
Tu peni onhele momitima deni. Kape na ou twe mu ninga nai, kape na ou twe mu nyona, kape na ou twe mu nyeka.
Eshi ihandi shi popi oku mu tokola, osheshi nde mu lombwela nale kutya, nye omu li momitima detu, tu kale pamwe mokufya nomokukalamwenyo.
Elineekelo lange oku mu lineekela olihapu nondi nokulitanga kuhapu molweni; ondi yadi ehekeleko, ehafo lange oli yadi pombada momaudjuu etu aeshe.
Osheshi eshi twa fika kuMakedonia, ombelela yetu inai mona nande etulumuko, ndelenee twa fininikwa keembinga adishe: kombada omalwoodi, meni etilo.
Ndelenee Kalunga, ou ha hekeleke oonakupolimana, okwe tu hekeleka nokuuya kwaTitus,

ndele haneuyo laye alike, ndelenee nosho yo nehekeleko olo ye eshi a hekelekwa kunye, osheshi okwe tu hepaululila odjuulufi yeni, nenyemato leni nouladi weni molwange, opo nee ehafo lange la hapupala pombada.
Osheshi nande nde mu nyikifa oluhodi nonhumwafo yange, inandi lialuluka musho, nande nda li nde lialuluka eshi ndi wete onhumwafo ei ye mu nyikifa oluhodi, nande okafimbo akeke,
paife onda hafa, hamolwaashi mwa nyikifwa oluhodi, ndelenee omolwaashi mwa fya oluhodi lelidilululo; osheshi mwa nyikifwa oluhodi lopahalo laKalunga; opo tuhe mu etele nande oshiponga.
Osheshi oluhodi lopahalo laKalunga otali longo elidilululo lexupifo, omo omunhu ite lialuluka mo vali; ndelenee oluhodi lounyuni tali eta efyo.

Taleni hano, ouladi u fike peni oluhodi eli leni lopahalo laKalunga la longa munye, nelipopilo li fike peni, noutondwe apa u fike, netilo apa li fike, nodjuulufi, nonyati, nomahandukilo e fike peni! Mwaashishe omwe limonifa, onye kamu noshipo moshinima shinya.
Hano nande nde mu shangelele, inandi shanga molwaau a ninga nai ile molwaau a ningwa nai, ndelenee ouladi weni omolwetu opo u holoke mokati keni koshipala shaKalunga.
Onghee hano twa hekelekwa nee. Ndelenee ehekeleko eli letu ola wedelwa ko ehafo linene okehafo laTitus, osheshi omhepo yaye oya hekelekwa kunye amushe.
Osheshi ngeenge nde mu pandulila sha kuye, inandi fifwa ohoni, ndele ngaashi ashishe osho nde shi mu lombwela osho shoshili, osho tuu nasho twe shi mu pandulila kuTitus osha monika osho shoshili.
Ndele omutima waye owe mu kenukila shili, eshi ta dimbulukwa eduliko leni amushe, nhumbi mwe mu tambula nokutila nokukakama.
Onda hafa eshi handi dulu oku mu lineekela moinima aishe.
8: Ndelenee ovamwatate, ohatu mu shiivifile efilonghenda laKalunga osho le shi yandjela omaongalo omuMakedonia,
nande ova li momayeleko manene nomadjuu, molwouyadi wehafo lavo, nomoluhepo lavo linene ova yandja nomwenyo muwa eeshali dihapu.
Osheshi paenghono davo, heeno, aame ondobwedi yoshinima eshi, mokuyandja kwavo kehalo lavo ova koya nokuli eenghono davo,
nokwiindila kuhapu ove tu indila neenghono va pewe okukala pamwe nafye meyakulo lovayapuki;
ndele vo inava yandja ngaashi twa teelela, ndelenee ove liyandja voovene tetetete okOmwene, ndele nokufye yo okehalo laKalunga,
ndele osho twa kumaida Titus, oye ngaashi a hovela nale, a wanife mokati keni oshilonga eshi yo shohole.
Ndele ngaashi mu na aishe ihapu: meitavelo, mondjovo, mokushiiva, mouladi u lili nau lili, mohole yeni ya dja mufye, osho kaleni mwa wana moshilonga eshi yo shohole.
Eshi ihandi shi mu lombwele ngaashi oshipango, ndelenee moku mu ulikila ouladi wavakweni onda hala okuyeleka ohole yeni ngeenge oyoshili.
Osheshi efilonghenda lOmwene weni Jesus Kristus omu li shii Oye nande okwa li oshipuna, a ninga ohepele omolweni, opo mu punapale koluhepo laye.
Ndelenee ohandi mu lombwele omayele ange moshinima eshi, osheshi otashi mu kwafa, onye ava mwa li votete oudwaali, hamokuwanifa akuke, ndelenee nomokuhala yo.
Ndelenee paife wanifeni oshilonga eshi yo, opo ngaashi mwa hangika mwe shi hala, onye mu shi shakenife yo paenghono deni.
Osheshi ehalo liwa lokuyandja ngeenge li li po, ola wapalela osho omunhu e shi kwete hasheshi ehe shi kwete.
Hakutya ngeno ovakweni va pupalifwe, nye mu lololwe,
ndelenee napa kale efaafano, oupuna weni u kwafe oluhepo lavo, ndelenee opo oupuna wavo u yakule oluhepo leni, pu kale ngaha efaafano,
ongaashi pa shangwa: “Oye ou a ongela shihapu, ina xupifa po, naau a ongela shinini, ina hepa sha.”
Ndele Kalunga na pandulwe, Oye ou a pendula momutima waTitus ouladi omolweni,
osheshi a tambula ekumaido lange, a nyatipala nokuli okuya kunye okehalo laye mwene.
Ndele fye otwa tuma naye omumwatate a shiivika momaongalo aeshe omolwoshilonga shevaengeli.
Hasho ashike eshi, ndele okwa hoololelwa yo komaongalo, a ninge omufindikili wetu okutwala eeshali edi twe di ongelela efimano lomwene nedidiliko lehalo letu liwa
Ohatu ningi ngaha, puha kale nande oumwe ta mono omhito oku tu pa oushima omolwekwafo eli linenenene hatu pashukile.
Osheshi ohatu diinine eshi shiwa hakoshipala shOmwene ashike, ndelenee nokoshipala shovanhu yo.
Pamwe naava ohatu tumu vali omumwatate umwe, ou twe mu tala moinima ihapu oye omuladi, ndele paife ouladi waye ou dule wonale, osheshi ye okwe mu lineekela neenghono.
Mokutonga Titus, oye omukwetu, nomulongi mukwetu molweni, ile ovamwatate ovo ovatumwa vomaongalo, ovo efimano laKristus.
Hano eshi tamu va hololele ohole yeni, ndele tamu holola elitango letu omolweni ola twa, otamu shi ningi moipafi yomaongalo.
9: Kombinga yeyakulo lovayapuki itandi pumbwa oku mu shangela;
osheshi ehalo leni lokuyandja ondi li shii, nolo tuu olo handi li mu tangele moipafi yOvamakedonia, nokutya, Akaia sha kala she lilongekida okudja oudwaali, nosho ouladi weni wa kwata vahapu vomuvo.
Onghee tuu onda tuma ko ovamwatate ava, opo oku mu tanga kwetu kuha monike kwongaho moshinima eshi, ndele mu kale mwe lilongekida ngaashi nda tile;
paha ningwe Ovamakedonia ngeenge tave uya ko naame, notave mu hange inamu lilongekida, ofye tuha tye onye, tu fifwe ohoni melineekelo eli.
Onghee hano onde shi tala osha wapala okukumaida ovamwatate, va ka tetekele okuya kunye nova longekide eeshali mwe di udaneka nale, di ninge eeshali depuniko, do diha nyike ouluva.
Didilikeni eshi, ou ta kunu nouluva, ota teya yo nouluva, naau ta kunu nepuniko, ota teya yo nepuniko.
