Keshe tuu na yandje ngaashi omutima waye tau mu lombwele, hanomunyengutima ile kefininiko, osheshi Kalunga e hole ou ta yandje nehafo.
Ndelenee Kalunga ta dulu oku mu hapupalifila efilonghenda keshe, mu kale mu na alushe moinima aishe ashishe, eshi mwe shi pumbwa, opo mu dule okulonga nawelela oshilonga keshe shiwa;

ngaashi pa shangwa:
“Oye oha udu, oha pe eehepele,
ouyuki waye tau kala alushe.”
Naau ta pe omukuni ombuto, nomungome okulya, oye ta hapupalifa yo ombuto yeni ndele ta kulifa oiimati youyuki weni,
opo nee eshi mwa punapalekwa mwaaishe, mu dule okulonga, muhe noihelele, oshilonga keshe shiwa, tashi pandulifa Kalunga omolwetu.
Osheshi eyakulo eli lekwafo itali kufa po ashike oluhepo lovayapuki, ndelenee tali hapupalifa oiimati omolwomapandulo mahapu okupandula Kalunga,
eyakulo eli leni eshi tali va hololele nhumbi mwa pama, otava hambelele Kalunga omolweduliko leni kevaengeli laKristus, nomolwekwatafano leni navo naaveshe.
Navo yo otave mu ilikanene notave mu djuulukwa omolwefilonghenda eli linene laKalunga olo nye mwe li pewa.
Kalunga na pandulilwe oshali yaye ihe shii kutumbulwa.
10: Aame Paulus mwene ohandi mu kumaida omolwonheni nolukeno laKristus, ame ou ndi li moipafi yeni, vati, nda fa nde lininipika, ndele ngeenge ndi li kokule nanye, ihandi tila,
ndele ohandi indile ngeenge handi uya kunye, ndiha pumbwe okulongifa ouladi ou handi diladila okuholoka nao ndi nonyati kuvamwe ava tave tu fekele nokutya, ohatu ende pambelela.
Nande ohatu ende mombelela, ihatu kondjo pambelela;
osheshi oilwifo yetu kai fi yopambelela, ndelenee oya pama koshipala shaKalunga okuhanauna po eenguluhote.
Ohatu hanauna po omapopilongulu, nelinenepekifo keshe tali nenepekele okushiiva kwaKalunga, nakeshe ediladilo ohatu li tula meti li dulike kuKristus,
ndele twe lilongekida okuhandukila okuhadulika keshe, ngeenge eduliko leni ola holoka nawa.
Taleni osho shi li komesho yeni. Ngeenge ope na ou a pama momadiladilo aye nokutya, oye owaKristus, oye na diladile muye mwene, nokutya ngaashi oye waKristus, osho nafye yo.
Ndele nande ndi litange unene kanini molwepangelo letu olo Omwene e li tu pa oku mu tunga, nohaku mu ngumauna po, ihandi ka fifwa ohoni.
Eshi ohandi shi ti, kuha monike nda fa nda hala oku mu tilifa neenhumwafo dange.
Osheshi eenhumwafo daPaulus, vati, odi neenghono noda pama, ndelenee okuholoka kwaye kwopalutu okwa nyika oungone nokupopya kwaye kaku noshilonga.
Oye ou ta ti ngaha, na kale e shi shii, ngaashi tu li meendjovo domeenhumwafo detu, eshi tu li kokule, osho tu li nomoilonga, eshi tu li punye.
Osheshi fye otuhe nonyati okulitula ile okuliyeleka noonima ava tave lieta nokulitanga, ndele vehe neendunge, osheshi tave liyeleke navo vene, notave lishaameke navo vene,
ndele fye ihatu litange tu koye oshiyelekifo, ndelenee pashiyelekifo osho Kalunga e shi tu ufila opo tu fike nokunye.
Osheshi itatu lovelele kokule unene, twa fa itatu fiki kunye, osheshi okuudifa evaengeli laKristus otwa fika nokunye.
Ihatu litange unene tu litangele ngeno oilonga yovanhu, ndele otu neteelelo olo, eitavelo leni eshi tali kulu, opo nee fye, pailonga oyo twe i longa ohatu ka kula mokati keni,
opo tu udife evaengeli komadu e li kombada yeni, tuha kale nokulitangela osho sha longwa nale, oko fye inatu longa.
“Ndelenee ou te litange, ne litangele mOmwene;”
osheshi haye ou te litange ye mwene a dule ngeno eyeleko, ndelenee oyou Omwene te mu tange.
11: Ngeno omu lididimikile kanini oulai wange! Heeno, tamu tale nge tuu onheni.
Osheshi ohandi mu kondjele nouladi waKalunga, osheshi onde mu valekela omulumenhu umwe, ndi etele Kristus okakadona ka koshoka.
Ndelenee onda tila, ngaashi Eva a hongaulwa kekotokelo leyoka, osho omadilongo eni taa nyonauka notaa efa ouyuki noukoshoki mokukala kweni naKristus.

Osheshi ngeenge ope na ou te uya ndele te mu udifile Jesus umwe, ou inatu mu udifa, ile tamu tambula omhepo imwe oyo inamu i tambula, ile evaengeli limwe olo inamu li tambula, otamu liefele mo naanaa.
Osheshi ame inandi litala ndi dulike nande omoshinima shimwe kovayapostoli venya vanene.
Ndele ngeenge ame ondimushima mokupopya, kandi fi omushima mokushiiva; otwe shi holola nokuli punye okeenghedi adishe moinima aishe.
Ile onda tula etimba, ame eshi nde lininipika onye mu nenepekifwe evaengeli laKalunga eshi nde li mu udifila oshali?
Omaongalo amwe onde a nyeka, eshi nda tambula kuo ondjabi, opo ndi mu yakule. Ame eshi nda kala punye onda fya oluhepo, inandi lolokifa nande olyelye.
Ndelenee ovamwatate ovo va dja kuMakedonia, ova kwafa nge eshi nda li nde shi pumbwa; nomoinima aishe onde livangeka ndihe mu lolole, osho handi ningi nokomesho.
Oshili, ngaashi oshili yaKristus i li mwaame, elitango eli ihandi li nyekwa momikunda daAkaia.
Oshike hano? Osheshi ame nghi mu hole mbela? Kalunga e shi shii.
Ndelenee eshi handi shi ningi, ohandi shi ningi nokomesho, opo ndi kufe onhele kwaava tava kongo onhele yokumonika ve tu fa mwaashi tave shi litangele.
Osheshi ovanhu vamwe va tya ngaha ovo ovayapostoli ovanaipupulu, ovalongi ovanamakoto, ovo tave liningi ovayapostoli vaKristus.
Ndelenee kashi fi oshikumwifa! Osheshi naSatana mwene ote lifefa omweengeli wouyelele.
Kashi fi hano oshinima shinene, ngeenge ovapiya vaye tave liningi ovayakuli vouyuki, ndele exulilo lavo otali ningi li fike poilonga yavo.
Navali ohandi ti: Ndelenee ngeenge ame elai, tambulei nge ongaashi elai, opo naame yo ndi litange kanini.
Eshi ohandi shi popi paife, eshi handi litange nelineekelo li fike apa, itandi shi popi pahokwe yOmwene, ndelenee opaulai.
Hano vahapu eshi have litange pambelela, naame yo ohandi litange.
Onye ohamu lididimikile omalai, osheshi onye vene ovanaendunge.
Ohamu itavele nge tamu pikwa ovapika, ngeenge tamu nyekwa, nge tamu yulwa, nge pe na ou te linenepeke, nge pe na ou te mu denge moshipala.

Okulififa ohoni ohandi ti: Okuninga ngaha ofye oingone.
Ndele umwe ngeenge a nyatipala oku shi ninga, ohandi popi moulai, naame yo nda nyatipala.
Vo Ovaheberi naame yo. Vo Ovaisraeli, naame yo. Vo oludalo laAbraham, naame yo.
Vo ovapiya vaKristus, ohandi popi ngaashi elai, ame ndi va dule. Ame ndi va dule moilonga nomokwiidililwa modolongo, luhapu, onda dengwa nokudengelelwa unene, luhapu onda li hanga ndi fye.
OkOvajuda onda dengwa lutano omadengo omilongo ine, limwe kali po;
lutatu onda dengwa noikumbwati, lumwe nda dengwa nomamanya, lutatu nda hangika moskepa ya teka, onda telaanifwa mefuta omutenya aushe noufiku;

luhapu nda kala meengeda, omoudjuu nomilonga, omoudjuu mokati kovakolokoshi, omoudjuu koshiwana shetu, omoudjuu kovapaani, omoudjuu womoilando, omoudjuu womombuwa, omoudjuu womefuta, omoudjuu womokati kovamwatate ovanaihelele,
omoilonga nomoudjuu, omokukala oupafi luhapu oufiku, omondjala nomenota, omokulidilika oikulya luhapu, omoutalala nomonghai.
Nokuikwao aishe opa wedelwa oupyakadi molwovanhu vahapu efiku keshe, noshisho shomomaongalo aeshe.
Olyelye oshingone, naame ndiha kale oshingone? Olyelye ta punduka, naame ndiha pye?
Nge ndi nokulitanga, ohandi litangele oungone wange.
Kalunga Xe yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, ou a hambelelwa alushelushe, Oye e shi shii ihandi fufya.
OmuDamaskus elenga lohamba Aretas okwa li a nangela oshilando shOvadamaskus, a kwate nge,
ndele ame onda pitifwa mekende lohotekuma yoshilando ndi li moshimbaba, ndele nda kulukifwa ndele handi henuka mo momake aye.
12: Ondi nokulitanga, nande itaku kwafa, ndele ohandi hovele okupopya omamoniko nomahololo Omwene.

Omulumenhu wonhumba womuKristus ondi mu shii, paife opa pita eedula omulongo nanhee, oye eshi a vakulilwa meulu etitatu, ngeenge okwa li molutu, kandi shi shii nongeenge a dile molutu, kandi shi shii, oKalunga e shi shii.
Ndele ondi shi shii, omulumenhu oye tuu ou, ngeenge omolutu ile a dile molutu, kandi shi shii, oKalunga e shi shii.
Okwa vakulwa a twalwa moParadisa, okwa uda eendjovo dihe shii kutumbulwa, omunhu ina itavelelwa oku di tonga.
Omolwomulumenhu ou ohandi litange, ndele ihandi litangele ame mwene, shapu oungone wange.
Osheshi ngeno nda hala okulitanga, ngeno kandi fi elai, osheshi ngeno ohandi popi doshili; ndelenee ohandi shi efa, opo kuha kale ou ta diladila nge kombada yaasho e shi wete mwaame, ile ta udu nge.
Ndele opo ndihe linenepekele omamoniko manene, onda pewa ekiya mombelela yange, omweengeli waSatana okuhepeka nge neenghono, opo ndihe linenepeke.
Omolwaashi onda ilikana Omwene lutatu, shi efe nge.

Ndelenee Oye okwa lombwela nge: “Efilonghenda lange ole ku wanena, osheshi eenghono dange otadi wanenene pombada omoungone.” Osho hano ohandi litangele oungone wange nehafo, eenghono daKristus opo di kale mwaame.
Molwaasho nda hokwa oungone nomadengo nomahepeko noluhepo nomafininiko omolwaKristus; osheshi ngeenge ondi li oshingone, aame omunaenghono.
Ame onda longa ngaashi elai; osheshi mwa ningifa nge ngaha. Ame nda li nda wana ngeno okupopilwa kunye, osheshi kandi na apa ndi dulike kovayapostoli venya vanene, nande ame oshinima shongaho.
Oilongadidiliko yomuyapostoli, ndi shii oya longwa mokati keni nelidiiniko alishe, nomadidiliko noinyengandunge noilonga yeenghono.
Osheshi openi mwa fya oluhepo mu dulike komaongalo makwao, shapu opopo ame inandi ninga omutengi weni? Kufilei nge po owii ou.

Taleni, olutitatu onde lilongekida okuuya kunye, ndele itandi ke mu etela oudjuu, osheshi itandi kongo oinima yeni, ndelenee onye vene. Ndishi ovana ihava kongele ovakulunhu vavo oinima, ndelenee ovakulunhu ohava kongele ovana vavo.
Ndelenee ame ohandi ka yandja aishe nehafo, ndele handi liyandjele eemwenyo deni. Ame eshi ndi mu hole neenghono, omolwaashi mbela ndi holike kunye kanini?
Ndelenee nashi tye ngaha, inandi mu etela oudjuu, ndelenee shapu ame omunamakoto, onde mu kwata nomakoto.
Ile mbela onde lilikolela sha nokulongifa umwe waavo, nda tuma kunye?
Onda indila Titus okuya ko pamwe nomumwatate umwe; ile pamwe Titus okwa kendabala okulilikolela sha kunye? Ofye inatu endela mbela momhepo imwe nomoshikoti shimwe?
Onye mwa diladila shiimba nonale, fye ohatu lipopile punye. Koshipala shaKalunga muKristus ohatu popi; ndelenee aishe oyoku mu tunga, ovaholike.

Osheshi onda tila nokutya, pamwe mokuuya kwange itandi mu hange mu li po ngaashi nda hala, naame handi hangika kunye ngaashi nye inamu hala; nye shiimba omu neemhata nefupa noutondwe nomalutandu nomalundilo nokwaamba noipupulu nelinenepeko nedundakano,

opo paha ningwe, nge handi uya ko, Kalunga kange ta ninipike nge vali punye, nondi nokunyika oluhodi omolwavahapu, ovo va nyona nale inave lidilulula monyata nomoluhaelo nomoumbudi woipala ei ve i longa.
13: Olutitatu handi uya kunye paife eshi. Ondjovo keshe otai pamekwa komakanya eendobwedi mbali ile nhatu.

Onda lombwela nale, handi tetekele okulombwela ovo va nyona nale, navakwao aveshe ngaashi nda lombwela eshi nda li punye lutivali, osho nopaife, eshi ndihe ko, ame nge handi uya ko vali itandi mu tale onheni.
Osheshi otamu kongo etomhelo lomuKristus ta popi mwaame; Oye ou ke fi oshingone kunye, ndelenee Oye omunaenghono munye.
Nande okwa valelwa fimbo a li oshingone, oku nomwenyo okeenghono daKalunga. Osho nafye yo oingone muye, ndelenee otu nomwenyo pamwe naye okeenghono daKalunga omolweni.
Liyelekeni nye vene, ngeenge omu li meitavelo; lipulapuleni. Ile inamu lishiiva nye vene nokutya, Jesus Kristus oku li munye? Ngeenge hasho, nye itamu dulu eyeleko?
Ndelenee ondi neteelelo mu tu shiive, fye hafye ava itatu dulu eyeleko.
Fye ohatu ilikana Kalunga, muha ninge owii nande washa, hasho ngaha tu monike ngeno hatu dulu eyeleko, ndelenee onye tuu mu longe ouwa, ndele ofye tu fe ovo itava dulu eyeleko.
Osheshi itatu dulu sha mokukondjifa oshili, ndelenee omokupopila oshili,
osheshi otwa hafa eshi tu li po oingone, ndele onye ovanaenghono; osho nee osho hatu shi ilikanene, mu ninge mwa wana mwa pwa.
Onghee ohandi shange ei ndihe li punye, opo nge ndi li punye, ndiha ninge ndimukukutu okepangelo olo nde li pewa kOmwene okutunga, hakuhanauna po.
Ndele natango, ovamwatate, hafeni, ningeni mwa wana mwa pwa, tambuleni omakumaido, kaleni momhango imwe, diinineni ombili, opo Kalunga kohole nokombili ota kala pamwe nanye.
Kundilafaneni po nefipo liyapuki lokomilungu.
Ovayapuki aveshe otave mu kundile po.
Efilonghenda lOmwene Jesus Kristus, nohole yaKalunga, noukumwe wOmhepo Iyapuki nau kale pamwe nanye amushe. Amen.

1: Paulus, omuyapostoli, hakovanhu ile hamomunhu, ndelenee okuJesus Kristus nokuKalunga Xe, ou e mu nyumuna movafi,
novamwatate aveshe ve li pwaame, nokomaongalo omuGalatia.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu noyOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus,
ou e liyandja omolwomatimba etu, opo e tu xupife mefimbo lii lounyuni wopaife opahalo laKalunga, Tate yetu;
Oye na fimanekwe alushe fiyo alushe! Amen.
Ame onda kumwa, eshi mwa pilamena diva ou e mu ifana mefilonghenda laKristus, ndele mwa ama kevaengeli limwe,
nande kali fi limwe; ndele ope na vamwe tave mu piyaaneke nova hala okweendameka evaengeli laKristus.
Ndele ngeno nande ofye ile omweengeli womeulu ne mu udifile evaengeli limwe, lihe fi eli twe li mu udifila, oye na fingwe.
Ngaashi twa tonga nale, osho handi mu lombwele nopaife vali: ngeenge ope na ou te mu udifile evaengeli limwe, lihe fi olo mwe li tambula, oye na fingwe.
Ame ohandi kongo paife ohokwe yovanhu ile oyaKalunga? Ile handi kongo okuwapalela ovanhu? Ngeenge onda hala okuwapalela ovanhu natango, ngeno kandi fi vali omupiya waKristus.
Ndelenee ovamwatate nye, ohandi mu shiivifile evaengeli eli nde li udifa kali fi lopanhu;
nongaashi inandi li pewa kovanhu noinandi li longwa, ndelenee onde li hololelwa kuJesus Kristus.
Osheshi okukala kwange kwonale kwomOujuda mwe ku uda, eongalo laKalunga nhumbi nde li telatele unene noku li hanauna po,
nonda li nda ehena komesho mOujuda ndi dule vakwetu vahapu novomepupi lange vomoludi letu, ongaashi nda li omuladi okudiinina eenghulunghedi dootatekulu.
Ndelenee eshi sha wapalela Kalunga, ou a hoolola nge okudja medimo lameme nokwa ifana nge molwefilonghenda laye,
okuholola Omona mwaame, opo ndi mu udife mokati kovapaani, ame inandi kundafana nopehovelo nombelela nohonde,
ndele inandi ya kuJerusalem kwaava va li tete ovayapostoli komesho yange, ndele onda ya kuArabia nonda alukila vali kuDamaskus.
Ndelenee eshi pa pita eedula nhatu, onda ya kuJerusalem, tu ka shiivafane naKefas, nonda kala puye omafiku omulongo naatano.
Ndele ovayapostoli vamwe inandi va mona, Jakob aeke, ou omumwaina wOmwene.
Naadi handi di mu shangele, tala, okoshipala shaKalunga ihandi fufya.
Opo nee onda ya komikunda daSiria nodaKilikia.
Ndele omaongalo enya omuJudea e li muKristus, inaa shiiva nge koshipala.
Vo ova kundana ashike: “Winya e tu telatele nale, ota udifa paife eitavelo eli e li hanauna po nale,”
ndele va hambelela Kalunga molwange.
2: Eshi pa pita eedula omulongo nanhee, onda ya vali kuJerusalem pamwe naBarnabas naTitus yo onde mu kufa.

Ndelenee onda ya ko omolwelihololelo, nonde va hepaululila evaengeli eli handi li udifa mokati kovapaani; onde li hepaululila ovanamadina vomuvo, ndi ude ngeenge ohandi tondoka oshimha ile onda tondokela oshimha.
Ndele nomufindikili wange, Titus, nande ye Omugreka, ina fininikwa okulipitifa etanda.
Ndele molwovamwatate ava ovanaipupulu, ve livakela mokati ketu, va hondjaunine okulava elipangelo letu tu li kwete muKristus Jesus, ve tu pike ngeno,
fye inatu liyandja kuvo nande olumwe, opo oshili yevaengeli i kalelele mokati keni.
Ndelenee ovanamadina venya, nonhumbi va li nale, kashi fi shange; Kalunga iha tale oshipa shomunhu, venya va fimana inava fininikila nge nande oshinima shimwe.
Ndelenee eshi va mona, evaengeli nde li pewa ndi li udifile ava inava pita etanda nongaashi Petrus e li pelwe e li udifile ava va pita etanda,
osheshi oye tuu ou a pa Petrus eenghono a longe oilonga youyapostoli mokati kaava va pita etanda, okwe di pa nge yo mokati kovapaani,

ndele eshi va koneka onghenda nde i pewa, Jakob naKefas naJohannes, ava va talwa eengudi, ove tu pa omake edidiliko leudafano loshilonga, fye naBarnabas, opo fye tu ye kovapaani, navo okovapiti vetanda.
Osho ashike tu dimbulukwe eehepele, nongaashi handi shi ningi yo shili.
Ndelenee Kefas eshi e uya kuAntiokia, onde mu hanyena moipafi, osheshi a pewa ombedi.
Osheshi ovalumenhu vokuJakob fimbo inave uya, okwa li ha li pamwe novapaani; ndele venya eshi ve uya, okwa amuka ko ndele te litukula ko kuvo, shaashi a tila venya vomepito letanda.
NOvajuda vakwao ove liningifa yo pamwe naye, fiyo Barnabas a twalwatwalwa komaliningifo avo,

ndelenee ame eshi nda mona kutya, inava enda nokuyukilila pashili yevaengeli, onda lombwela Kefas moipafi yaaveshe: “Oove Omujuda ngeenge oho shikula eenghedi dovapaani ndele hado edi dOvajuda, oto dulu ngahelipi okufininika ovapaani okushikula eenghedi dOvajuda?”
Koludi letu ofye Ovajuda, katu fi ovalunde vomovapaani,

eshi tu shi shii kutya, omunhu iha yukipalifwa molwoilonga yomhango, ndelenee omolweitavelo laJesus Kristus, onghee hano nafye yo otwa itavela Kristus Jesus, opo tu yukipalifwe okeitavelo laKristus, hakoilonga yomhango, osheshi kape na nande ombelela imwe tai yukipalifwa koilonga yomhango.
Ndelenee nafye vene, ava twa hala okuyukipalifwa muKristus, ngee hatu monika ofye tu valunde, opo nee naKristus okwa ninga yo omuyakuli woulunde? Alala!
Osheshi ngeenge handi tungulula eshi nda ngumauna po, ohandi liholola, aame omunyoni.
Osheshi ame onda fya mo momhango okomhango, opo ndi kalele Kalunga.

Ame onda valelwa pamwe naKristus, nondi nomwenyo, haame mwene vali, ndelenee Kristus ta kala e nomwenyo mwaame; hano fimbo handi kala ndi nomwenyo molutu, ondi nomwenyo mokwiitavela Omona waKalunga, ou e hole nge nokwe liyandja ponhele yange.
Efilonghenda laKalunga itandi li xutula, osheshi ngeno oku nouyuki womomhango, ngeno Kristus a fila epwanga.
3: Woo Ovagalati nye, omalai! Olyelye e mu pililika, muha dulike koshili, nye ava Jesus Kristus mwe mu fanekelwa moipafi yeni omuvalelwa komushiyakano?
Shimwe ashike nda hala mu lombwele nge: Omhepo omwe i pewa moilonga yomhango ile omokuuda mu neitavelo?
Mboli kamu neendunge? Nye mwa hovela mOmhepo, omwa hala mu xulife mombelela?
Oshike mwe litwika oudjuu u fike apa epwanga? Ngeenge epwanga shili.
Hano ou te mu pe Omhepo ndele ta longo oilonga yeenghono munye, ote shi ningi koilonga yomhango ile okokuuda meitavelo?
Ngaashi Abraham “a itavela Kalunga, neitavelo laye le mu valulilwa ouyuki.”
Hano kaleni mu shi shii kutya, ava vomeitavelo ovo nee ovana vaAbraham.
Nomushangwa, eshi we shi mona nale kutya, Kalunga ota yukipalifa ovapaani okeitavelo, onghee hano wa udifila Abraham evaengeli eli nale, nokutya: “Omwoove oiwana aishe tai nangekwa noupuna.”
Osho hano ava vomeitavelo tava nangekwa noupuna pamwe naAbraham omwiitaveli.
Osheshi aveshe ava vomoilonga yomhango, otava kala koshi yefingo, osheshi opa shangwa: “Keshe ou iha kala mwaai aishe ya shangelwa momushangwa womhango e u wanife, oye omufingwa.”
Nokape na ou ta yukipalifwa koshipala shaKalunga omolwomhango: “Apa kape nomalimbililo, osheshi omuyuki ota kala e nomwenyo okeitavelo.”
Ndele omhango kai fi yomeitavelo, osheshi: “Ou te i wanifa, oye ta kala e nomwenyo muyo.”
Kristus okwe tu kulila mefingo lomhango, eshi a ninga omufingwa omolwetu, osheshi pa shangwa: “Keshe ou ta endjelele momuti, oye a fingwa,”
enangeko noupuna laAbraham opo li ye kovapaani muKristus Jesus, opo tu mone keitavelo Omhepo oyo twe i udanekelwa.
Ovamwatate ohandi popi panhu, eudaneko lefyuululo lomunhu, ngeenge la pamekwa, kape na ou ta dulu oku li dima po, ile okulundulula nokuwedela ko sha.
Ndele Abraham okwa pewa omaudaneko, ye mwene noludalo laye, inapa tiwa, nomaludalo, ngaashi mahapu, ndelenee ngaashi umwe: noludalo loye, olo Kristus.
Ndelenee onda hala okutya, ehangano la pamekwa kuKalunga muKristus, itali dimwa po komhango ye uya eshi pa pita omido omafele ane nomilongo itatu, neudaneko itali dimwa po kuyo.
Osheshi efyuululo ngeno tali di momhango, ngeno itali di vali meudaneko. Ndelenee Kalunga okwe li yandja kuAbraham paudaneko.
Hano omhango otai longo shike? Oyo oya wedelwa po omolwomatauluko, i kale po fiyo oludalo la pewa eudaneko tali uya; oyo noya dikifwa ovaengeli noya yandjwa meke lomupopili.
Nomupopili ke fi waumwe aeke, ndele Kalunga Oye umwe aeke.
Hano omhango oi nondubo nomaudaneko aKalunga? Ahowe, nande kanini. Osheshi ngeno pa yandjwa omhango hai yandje omwenyo, ngeno ouyuki otau di shili momhango.
Ndelenee omishangwa da idilila aveshe koshi youlunde, opo ovo tava itavele va pewe mokwiitavela Jesus Kristus osho sha udanekwa.
Ndelenee eitavelo fimbo inali uya, otwa li twa kwatelwa koshi yomhango, omo twa diinininwa eitavelo fiyo eitavelo la hololwa.
Osho ngaha omhango ya ninga omutekuli wetu, i tu twale kuKristus, opo tu yukipalifwe keitavelo.
Ndelenee eitavelo eshi le uya, fye katu fi vali vomepangelo lomutekuli.
Osheshi onye amushe ovana vaKalunga omolweitavelo muKristus Jesus.
Osheshi amushe ava mwa shashelwa muKristus, omwa djalekwa Kristus.
Kape na vali Omujuda nOmugreka, kape na vali omupika nomudalwa, kape na vali omulumenhu nomukainhu; osheshi onye amushe umwe muKristus Jesus.
Ndele nye ngeenge ovaKristus, onye yo oludalo laAbraham novafyuululi paudaneko.
4: Ndelenee ohandi ti: Omufyuululi fimbo okaana, kape netukauko pokati kavo nomupiya, nande oye mwene woinima aishe;
ndele ota kala mepangelo lovatekuli nomalenga fiyo okefimbo olo la pangelwa kuxe.
Osho nafye yo; fimbo twa li ounona otwa li twa kwatelelwa moupika weenghedi dounyuni.
Ndelenee ewano lefimbo eshi la fika, Kalunga okwa tuma Omona waye a dalwa komukainhu nokwa dalelwa momhango,
opo a kulile ava ve li koshi yomhango, fye tu pewe vali oudalwa.
Ndele shaashi nye ovana, Kalunga okwa tuma Omhepo yOmona waye momitima detu ta ingida: “Abba! Tate!”
Hano ku fi vali omupika, oove omona, ndele ngee omona, ove omufyuululi yo waKalunga molwaKristus.
Ndelenee nale, fimbo inamu shiiva Kalunga, omwa li hamu longele ei ihe fi ookalunga koludi layo.

Ndelenee paife, eshi mwa shiiva Kalunga, naunene tuu eshi mwa shiivika kuKalunga, otamu dulu ngahelipi okwaalukila vali keenghedi odo donale dihe noshilonga nodihe neenghono, nomwa hala mu ninge ovapika vado vali?
Omu li po tamu tongola omafiku neehani nomafimbo nomido.
Onda tila omolweni, pamwe onde mu lihepekela epwanga.
Ovamwatate, ohandi mu indile, fei nge, ngaashi ame nde mu fa. Inamu ningila nge owii washa.
Ndelenee nye mu shi shii, omolwoungone wokolutu lange nde mu udifila tete evaengeli,
nomu shi shii, nhumbi mwa yelekwa kolupe lange lopalutu, nye inamu dina nge, noinamu tonda nge, ndele mwa tambula nge ongaashi omweengeli waKalunga, heeno, ongaashi Kristus Jesus.
Hano elitango leni kutya, nye ovanelao, oli li peni? Osheshi ohandi mu hepaulula, ngeno sha dulika, ngeno mwa kufa mo omesho eni mu a pe nge.
Hano onda ninga omutondwa weni, eshi nde mu lombwela oshili?
Ouladi wavo molweni kau fi woshili; ova hala oku mu tukula mo, nanye opo mu shiive okukala nouladi omolwavo.
Onawa okukala nouladi alushe moshinima shiwa, hafimbo olo alike ndi li punye.
Ovamwange, ava ndi noku mu dalulula nouyehame, fiyo Kristus ta mono olupe munye.
Nonda hala, ngeno ndi li punye paife, nondaka yange ndi i shitukife, osheshi onde mu limbililwa.
Lombwelei nge hano, onye ava mwa hala okupangelwa komhango, omhango kamu i udite hamba eshi tai ti?
Osheshi opa shangwa: Abraham okwa li e novana vavali, umwe owomupika, nomukwao owomudalwa okeudaneko.
Ndelenee omona womupika a dalwa pambelela ndelenee oo womudalwa okeenghono deudaneko.
Odo omafaneko; ovakainhu ava ovo omahangano avali: limwe olokomhunda yaSinai, lokudalela oupika, olo tuu Hagar;
osheshi Hagar oyo omhunda yaSinai i li muArabia, noyo ya yeleka Jerusalem shopaife, shi li moupika novana.
Ndelenee Jerusalem shokombada, osho omudalwa, nosho meme yetu.

Osheshi pa shangwa:
“Nyakukwa, oove ongadji, ou iho dala,
kuwilila pombada, oove ou iho fetwa;
osheshi ovana vaau ina hombolwa ovo ovahapu,
ve dule vaau e nomulumenhu.”
Ndelenee ovamwatate nye, onye ovana veudaneko ongaashi Isak.
Ndelenee ngaashi momafiku enya, omudalwa pambelela a taataa winya omudalwa paMhepo, osho nonena yo.
Ndelenee omishangwa otadi ti ngahelipi? “Taataa mo omupika nomona, osheshi omona womupika ita dulu okufyuulula pamwe nomona womudalwa.”
Osho hano ovamwatate, fye katu fi ovana vomupika, ndelenee ovomudalwa.
5: Otwa mangululwa kuKristus tu kale memanguluko. Kaleni mwa pama, muha tulwe vali meti loupika.
Taleni, aame Paulus, handi mu lombwele, ngeenge tamu lipitififa etanda, Kristus ke na eshi te mu kwafa.
Ndele keshe tuu omunhu te lipitififa etanda, ohandi mu lombwele, oye oku nokuwanifa omhango aishe.
Onye amushe ava mwa hala okuyukipalifwa komhango, onye omwe likufa mo muKristus nomwa wa mo mefilonghenda.
Osheshi mOmhepo ohatu teelele etimaumbwile louyuki, omolweitavelo.
Osheshi muKristus Jesus nande epitotanda ile okuhapita etanda kaku nekwafo, ndelenee eitavelo hali longo mohole.
Onye mwa li hamu tondoka nawa. Olyelye e mu kelela okudulika koshili?
Ehongaulo olo inali dja mwaau te mu ifana.
Okanhafi kanini taka pifa olumbololo alishe lomungome.
Ame onde mu lineekela mOmwene kutya, kamu na nande ediladilo limwe. Ndelenee ou te mu limbilike, oye ta handukilwa, nande na kale olyelye.
Ndele ovamwatate, ame ngee handi udifa natango epitotanda, ohandi hepekelwa vali shike? Ngeno eshindo lomushiyakano kali po vali.
Ovapiyaaneki veni ngeno ove lilutule, ngeno xwepo!
Ovamwatate, omwa ifanenwa emanguluko, ndelenee inamu efa ombelela yeni i pwidukifwe kemanguluko, ndele yakulafaneni mohole.
Osheshi omhango aishe oya wanifilwa mondjovo ei imwe: “Hola mukweni ngaashi u lihole mwene.”
Ndelenee ngeenge nye hamu lumatafana nohamu lyana, litaleni, muha manafane po filu.
Ndelenee ohandi mu lombwele: kaleni nokweenda mOmhepo, onye noitamu wanifa vali ouhalu wombelela.
Osheshi ombelela oi nondubo nOmhepo, nOmhepo i nondubo nombelela; ohai kalafana i nondubo, opo muha ninge osho mwe shi hala.
Ndelenee nye ngeenge ohamu endifwa kOmhepo, opo nee kamu li koshi yomhango.
Ndele oilonga yombelela i li poluhaela, oyo ei: oluhaelo, oihole, onyata, okukalela olwisho loipala,
oukalele woikalunga, oundudu, etondafano, eemhata, oukodi, ehandu, omashilafano, omaliyalafano, oimhanga;
efupa, omadipao, oukolwe, eenhingo naikwao ya fa ei, nda tetekela oku i mu lombwela, ngaashi nde mu lombwelele, kutya ava tava longo oilonga ya tya ngaha, itava ka fyuulula ouhamba waKalunga.
Ndelenee oiimati yOmhepo oyo ei: ohole, ehafo, ombili, onheni, oukaume, ouwa, oudiinini, engungumano, elididimiko.
Kape nomhango i nondubo noilonga ya tya ngaha.
Naava vaKristus Jesus ova valela ombelela yavo nouhalu wavo nolwisho lavo komushiyakano.
Hano ngeenge otu nomwenyo womOmhepo, tu kaleni yo nokweenda mOmhepo.
Inatu kaleni ovakongi vefimano longaho nokushindafana nokufilafana efupandubo.
6: Ovamwatate, omunhu ngeenge ta hangika a nyona, opo nee onye ava vopamhepo mu pukululeni nomhepo yonheni, ove u lungame naave yo uha hongaulwe.
Yakulafaneni omitengi, osho ngaha tamu wanifa omhango yaKristus.
Osheshi ngeenge ope na ou e shii oye omushike, nande oye wongaho, oye ote lipukifa mwene.
Ndele omunhu keshe na konakone oilonga yaye mwene nhumbi i li, opo a kale e nelitango molwaye mwene, hamolwamukwao,
osheshi keshe tuu oku nokuhumbata omutengi waye mwene.
Ndelenee ou ta longwa eendjovo, oye na tukulile omulongindjovo waye moinima yaye aishe iwa.
Inamu lifufya, Kalunga iha shekwa; osheshi eshi omunhu te shi kunu, osho tuu te shi teya yo.
Ou ta kunu mombelela yaye, ota ka teya enyonauko kombelela; ndele ou ta kunu mOmhepo, oye ta ka teya omwenyo waalushe okOmhepo.
Ndele mokulonga ouwa inatu lolokeni, osheshi efimbo ngeenge la fiki, ohatu ka teya yo, ngeenge itatu loloka.
Onghee hano fimbo tu nomhito, tu ningileni aveshe ouwa, ndelenee unene tuu ovo oovakwetu vomeitavelo.
Taleni eendada dinene di fike apa handi mu shangele neke lange mwene!
Aveshe ovo va hala okulimonikifa pambelela va wapala, otave mu fininike mu lipitife etanda, opo vaha hepekelwe omushiyakano waKristus.
Osheshi ovo yo tave lipitifa etanda, voovene ihava diinine omhango, ndele va hala nye mu lipitife etanda, opo ve litangele ombelela yeni.
Ndelenee ame, nashi kale nge kokule, ndi litangele ngeno oshinima shi lili, omushiyakano wOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus oo auke, molwao ounyuni wa valelelwa nge, naame nda valelelwa ounyuni.
Osheshi epitotanda nokuhapita etanda kaku nekwafo, ndelenee okushitululwa.
Naaveshe ava tava shikula eyukifomhango eli, ombili nonghenda nai kale navo nokombada yaIsrael waKalunga.
Osho hano paha kale vali nande umwe ta twike nge oudjuu, osheshi handi humbata oivadi yOmwene Jesus molutu lange.
Efilonghenda lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nomhepo yeni, ovamwatate! Amen.

1: Paulus, omuyapostoli waKristus Jesus okehalo laKalunga okovayapuki ava ve li muEfeso ovaitaveli muKristus Jesus.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu noyOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Kalunga naXe yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus na hambelelwe, Oye ou e tu nangeka noupuna nomapuniko aeshe opamhepo moikwaulu omuKristus,
ngaashi e tu hoolola muye fimbo ounyuni inau shitwa, tu kale ovayuki notuhe noshipo koshipala shaye mohole,
eshi e tu nunina nale tu ninge ovana vaye muye omolwaJesus Kristus pahokwe yehalo laye,
okupandulifa efimano longhenda yaye e i tu pa mOmuholike.
Muye otu nekulilo omolwohonde yaye, edimepo lomanyonauno okoupuna wonghenda yaye,
oyo tuu oyo e i tu pa ihapu ihapu mounongo aushe nomeendunge adishe,
eshi e tu shiivifila oshiholekwa shehalo laye opahokwe yaye iwa ei, e i pangela muKristus,
omolwelelo leumbo, te ke li wanifa pakufika komafimbo, nokutya ta ka kwatakanifa muKristus aishe oyo yomeulu naai yokombada yedu.
Omuye nafye yo twa pewa oshipewa shefyuululo, osho twe shi nuninwa nale opamhangela yaye, Oye ou ta longo aishe payukifo lehalo laye mwene,
opo tu kale ehambelelo lefimano laye, fye ava twa tula etimaumbwile muKristus.
Nanye yo eshi mwa uda muye ondjovo yoshili, evaengeli lexupifo leni, eshi mwa itavela yo, omwa didilikwa muye noshilimbo shOmhepo Iyapuki, ou a udanekwa,
Oye ou a ninga ombabyona yefyuululo letu okukulila Omona waye nokuhambelelifa efimano laye.
Onghee hano naame yo, eshi nda uda eitavelo leni mOmwene Jesus nohole yeni yokuhola ovayapuki aveshe,
ihandi dimbuka okupandula Kalunga omolweni moku mu dimbulukwa momailikano ange,
nokwiindila opo Kalunga wOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, Xe yefimano, e mu pe ngeno omhepo younongo noyehololo moku mu shiiva,
Ye a minikile omesho eni omomutima, opo mu shiive eteelelo olo mwe li ifanenwa, noupuna wefimano lefyuululo laye apa u fike movayapuki vaye,
nouneneyadi ndoondoo weenghono daye apa u fike kufye ava hatu itavele opakulonga kweenghono daye dinene,
odo e di holola muKristus, eshi e mu nyumuna movafi ndele e mu tula omutumba kolulyo laye momaulu,
kombada yomapangelo aeshe nomauhamba meenghonopangelo neenghono noumwenepangelo nakeshe tuu edina hali tumbulwa hamefimbo eli alike lopaife lounyuni ou, ndelenee nomulinya tali uya,
ndele aishe okwe i tula koshi yeemhadi daye, ndele okwe mu pa a kale omutwe waaishe keongalo,
olo olutu laye nouyadi waau ta yadifa aishe mwaaishe.
2: Ndele Kalunga okwe mu tula omwenyo onye ava mwa li mwa fila momatauluko nomomatimba eni,
omu mwa endaenda nale panghedi yefimbo lounyuni eli noyomupangeli weenghonopangelo domomhepo nokutya, pamhepo yomupangeli ou ta longo paife movana vokuhadulika,
mokati kavo nafye yo atushe twa endaenda nale, omolwisho lombelela yetu twa shikula ouhalu wombelela noweendunge ndele twa li ovana vehandu paushitwe wetu nongaashi vamwe yo.
Ndelenee Kalunga ou a yada efilonghenda omolwohole yaye inene a kala e tu hole,
okwe tu tula yo omwenyo pamwe naKristus, ofye ava twa li twa fila moulunde, okonghenda mwa xupifwa,
ndele okwe tu nyumuna pamwe naye, nokwe tu tula mumwe naye moikwaulu muKristus Jesus,
opo a holole momafimbo okomesho oupuna wefilonghenda laye uhe nondjele mouwa waye kufye muKristus Jesus.
Osheshi mwa xupifwa konghenda omolweitavelo, lo inali dja munye vene, olo oshali yaKalunga,
hamolwoilonga, opo paha kale nande umwe te litange.
Osheshi ofye oshilonga shaye twa shitilwa muKristus Jesus oilonga iwa oyo ya longekidwa nale kuKalunga opo fye tu kale nokweenda muyo.
Onghee hano dimbulukweni kutya, onye ava mwa li nale ovapaani pambelela, omwa ifanwa muhe fi ovapititanda kwaava hava tiwa ovapititanda opapitifotanda olo tali longwa nomake mombelela,
mefimbo linya mwa li muhe na Kristus, omwa li muhe noukwashilongo waIsrael, ovanailongo komahangano eudaneko, muhe neteelelo nomuhe na Kalunga mounyuni;
ndelenee paife eshi mu li muKristus Jesus, nye ava mwa li vokokule mwa ninga vopopepi omohonde yaKristus.
Osheshi Oye ombili yetu, Oye ou ovo aveshe vavali e va ninga umwe, nokwa kumuna po ekuma la li pokati, nokutya, etondafano,
eshi mombelela yaye mwene a hanauna po omhango yoipango noyeenghedi, opo a shite ava vavali va ninge omunhu umwe mupe muye mwene nokuninga ombili,
naava vavali e va kwatakanife naKalunga molutu limwe momushiyakano nokufifa etondafano muye mwene.
Ndele Ye okwe uya oku mu udifila ombili, onye ava mwa li kokule, nombili kwaava vopopepi;
Osheshi omolwaye ofyeni atusheni tu nomhito kuTate mOmhepo imwe.
Osho hano paife nye kamu fi vali ovanailongo novaenda, ndelenee nye omwa ninga ovakwao vovayapuki novaneumbo vaKalunga,
omwa tungilwa momukangha wovayapostoli nowovaxunganeki omu mwa kala Kristus Jesus emanya lokokonela,
mwaau etungo alishe tali kwatafana kumwe ndele tali kulu, tali ningi otembeli iyapuki omOmwene;
ndele muye nanye yo otamu tungwa, mu ninge eumbo laKalunga omOmhepo.
3: Onghee hano aame Paulus, omumangwa waKristus Jesus omolweni ovapaani,
ndishi mwa uda epangelo leumbo longhenda yaKalunga, nde li pewa molweni,
nokutya, oshiholekwa eshi nde shi hololelwa memoniko, ngaashi nde mu shangela nokuli paxupi;
nomoku di lesha tamu dulu okukoneka okushiiva kwange moshiholekwa shaKristus,
osho inashi shiivifilwa ovana vovanhu mefimbo lomapupi onale, ngaashi sha hololelwa paife ovayapostoli vaye ovayapuki novaxunganeki mOmhepo,
nokutya, omevaengeli tuu olo, ovapaani ovo oonakufyuulula pamwe navo omolutu limwe ndele ve noshipewa meudaneko muKristus Jesus.
Ame nda ninga omuyakuli walo opashali shonghenda yaKalunga oyo nde i pewa kokulonga kweenghono daye.
Aame ou omunini ndi dulike kovayapuki aveshe onda pewa efilonghenda eli, okuudifila ovapaani evaengeli loupuna waKristus uhe fi okukonakonwa,
nokuhololela aveshe epangelo loshiholekwa eshi sha li sha holekwa muKalunga, Omushiti waaishe, okudja momafimbo ounyuni onale,
opo omapangelo neenghonopangelo eenghwaulu di shiivifilwe keongalo ounongo uhapu waKalunga,
opamhangela yaalushe oyo e i pangela muKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu,
muye tu na ouladi nomhito pamwe nelineekelo okeitavelo okufika kuKalunga.
Onghee hano ohandi ilikana, muha lololwe komauyehame aa ange ndi a kwete molweni, osheshi oo efimano leni.
Onghee hano ohandi tu eengolo koshipala shaXe yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus,
mwaau epata keshe meulu nokombada yedu le mu lukilwa,
opo Ye e mu pe paupuna wefimano laye eenghono dokupameka omunhu womeni okOmhepo yaye,
Kristus opo a kale momitima deni okokwiitavela, opo mu kale mwa twamifwa nomwa dikwa mohole,
mu dule okukoneka pamwe novayapuki aveshe oumbwalangadja, noule womukokomoko, noule woposhi, noule wopombada,
nokushiiva ohole yaKristus ei i dule eshiivo alishe, opo mu yade ouyadi aushe waKalunga.
Ndelenee Oye tuu ou ta dulu okulonga shihapuhapu kombada yaai hatu i indile nohatu i diladila paenghono odo tadi longo mufye,
Oye na fimanekwe meongalo nomuKristus Jesus komapupi aeshe alushe fiyo alushe. Amen!
4: Hano aame omupandekwa mOmwene, ohandi mu kumaida, mu kale nokweenda ngaashi sha wapalela eifano leni mwa ifanwa nalo,
mu kale mu nelininipiko nombili nonheni nokulididimikilafana mohole,
ndele nye mu hale shili okudiinina oukumwe mOmhepo omekwamo lombili lokumanga kumwe:
olutu limwe nOmhepo imwe, ngaashi mwa ifanenwa meteelelo limwe mwe li pewa, eshi mwa ifanwa;
Omwene umwe, eitavelo limwe, eshasho limwe,
Kalunga umwe Xe yaaveshe, Oye ou ha kala kombada yaaveshe ndele ta longifa aveshe nota kala munye amushe.
Ndelenee keshe tuu ou womufye okwa pewa onghenda pashiyelekifo shoshali yaKristus.

Onghee hano ta ti:
“Mokulonda kwaye kombada okwa ya neenghwate,
odo oshihakanwa shaye,
nokwa yandja eeshali kovanhu.”
Ndelenee okulonda oku okushike ngeno, ngeenge hasheshi, a kulukila tete meembwili domedu?
Hano ou a kuluka, Oye tuu ou a londa yo, a ya pombada langhele kwinya a koya omaulu aeshe, opo a wanife ashishe.
Ndele Ye okwa yandja vamwe va ninge ovayapostoli navamwe ovaxunganeki navamwe ovaevaengeliste navamwe ovafita navamwe ovalongindjovo
opo a longekide ovayapuki va kale va wana va pwa moshilonga sheyakulo, okutunga olutu laKristus,
fiyo fye atushe ohatu hange oukumwe womeitavelo nomeshiivo okushiiva Omona waKalunga, tu ninge ovakulunhu, twa kula, twa fika kewano louyadi waKristus,
tuha kale vali ouhanana hava telaanifwa nohava fungafungifwa keemhepo adishe delongo nomomanyanekelodanauko ovanhu nomomakonda omalungameno, omapukifo,
ndelenee mokudiinina oshili mohole, tu kule moinima aishe mwaau a ninga omutwe, omuKristus,
mwaau olutu alishe ngaashi la tulwa kumwe notali kwatelwa kumwe komufipa keshe, otali kulu li tungikike mohole, keshe tuu oshinhimbu shi fike pashiyelekifo shasho.
Hano eshi ohandi shi mu lombwele noku mu kumaida mOmwene: Inamu kala vali nokweenda ngaashi ovapaani hava ende moulai womadiladilo avo,
ovo va laula meendunge davo ndele ve li kokule nomwenyo womuKalunga omolwokuhashiiva kwomuvo nomolwelikukutiko lomitima davo,
ndele ovo va fifa omaliudo avo nove liefela mouhalu okuwanifa ashishe osho sha nyata molwisho.
Ndelenee hasho mwa longwa okushiiva Kristus,
ngeenge mwe mu uda nomwe mu longwa oshili ngaashi ya kala muJesus:
nokutya, mu nokulidula omunhu mukulu, ou mwe mu shikula nale, ndele ohe linyono po mokushikula ouhalu u nekonda.
Ndele mu shituke vape momhepo yomadiladilo eni,
ndele nye mu djale omunhu mupe a shitwa a fa Kalunga omouyuki nomouyapuki woshili.
Onghee hano efeni oipupulu, popyeni oshili keshe tuu namukwao, osheshi mokukalafana ofye oinhimbu yaKristus.
Handukeni, ndelenee inamu nyona. Inamu efa etango li ningine mu nehandu.
Ndele inamu pa Satana onhele.
Omulunga aha vake vali, ndelenee na longe nokulongifa omake aye ouwa, opo a kale e na sha okuyandjela eehepele.
Momakanya eni muha pite nande ondjovo ya nyata, ndelenee odedi diwa dokutungafana, da wapala okupwilikina.
Ndele Omhepo Iyapuki yaKalunga inamu mu nyikifa oluhodi, osheshi Oye e mu tulwa oshilimbo fiyo okefiku lekulilo.
Onya keshe, ekeshuko nehandu, efulakato netukano, owii keshe nau kale kokule nanye.
Ndelenee kalafaneni mu noukaume nokufilafana onghenda nokudiminafana po omatimba, ngaashi Kalunga e mu dimina po muKristus.
5: Ningeni hano ovahopaeleli vaKalunga ngaashi ovana ovaholike,
nye mu kale nokweenda mohole ngaashi Kristus kwa li e mu hole nokwe liyandja molwetu oshali, eyambo, edimba liwa, la hokiwa kuKalunga.
Ndelenee oluhaelo nakeshe tuu onyata youlunde ile olwisho inali tumbulwa nande vali mokati keni, ngaashi sha wapalela ovayapuki,
neendjovo defifohoni nomashendjo oulai inali udika mo, ndelenee edi domapandulo.
Osheshi nye omu shi shii nawa, nye mu shi wete, keshe omuhaeli ile omulinyateki noulunde, nomunalwisho, osheshi ou omulongeli woikalunga, ke noshitukulwa shefyuululo mouhamba waKristus nowaKalunga.
Paha kale ou te mu pukifa neendjovo dongaho, osheshi omolwaai ehandu laKalunga otali hange ovana vokuhadulika;
hano inamu kwatafana nayo pamwe naavo.
Osheshi nale omwa li omulaulu, ndelenee paife mwa ninga ouyelele mOmwene. Kaleni nokweenda ngaashi ovana vouyelele,
osheshi ouwa keshe nouyuki noshili, oyo oshiimati shOmhepo.
Ndele shipashipeni eshi tashi wapalele Omwene,
ndele inamu kala mu neendafano nande linini noilonga yomulaulu ihai imike, ndelenee oshipu mu i hanyene.
Osheshi ohoni yongaho nokuli okutonga eshi tave shi longo meholeko.
Ndelenee aishe ei tai ka pewa oushima eshi tai hololwa pouyelele, osheshi ashishe eshi tashi ka hololwa, osho ouyelele.

Onghee ta ti:
“Penduka ove ou ho kofa, ndele nyumuka movafi,
Kristus ote ku minikile.”
Litaleni hano nawa nhumbi hamu ende, hangaashi omalai, ndelenee ongaashi ovanaendunge;
longifeni nawa efimbo, osheshi omafiku omai.
Onghee hano inamu kala muhe neendunge, ndele shiiveni ehalo lOmwene olilipi.
Inamu kolwa komaviinyu omo hamu di eliefo, ndelenee yadifweni kOmhepo;
hokololelafaneni omapsalome nomalwiimbo opamhepo, nokwiimbila nokuhambelela Omwene momitima deni,
nokupandula alushe Kalunga, Tate, omolwaaishe medina lOmwene Jesus Kristus,
mu dulikafane keshe tuu komukwao mokutila Kristus.
Ovakainhu, dulikeni kovalumenhu veni ongaashi kOmwene.
Osheshi omulumenhu oye omutwe womukainhu, ngaashi Kristus yo Oye omutwe weongalo, Ye Omuxupifi wolutu.
Ndelenee ngaashi eongalo hali dulika kuKristus, osho tuu ngaha ovakainhu nava dulike kovalumenhu vavo moinima aishe.
Onye ovalumenhu, holeni ovakainhu veni ngaashi Kristus e hole eongalo, nokwe liyandja molwalo,
opo e li yapule noku li yelifa mekosho lomeva oneendjovo,
opo a dule okukaleka ofika moipafi yaye mwene eongalo la yelifwa lihe nedilo ile eengonyoto ile oinima inai wapala, ndelenee li kale liyapuki nolihe noshipo.
Osho ngaha novalumenhu ve nokuhola ovakainhu vavo ngaashi omalutu avo vene; oye ou e hole omukainhu waye, oye oku lihole ye mwene.
Osheshi kape na ou ha tondo ombelela yaye mwene, ndelenee ohe i palula nohe i tekula, ngaashi Kristus ha tekula eongalo laye.
Osheshi ofye oinhimbu yolutu laye noyombelela yaye nomakipa aye.
“Onghee hano omulumenhu e nokufiya po xe naina nokulimangela komukainhu waye, vo vavali tava ningi omunhu umwe.”
Oshiholekwa eshi oshinene, ndelenee ohandi tongo Kristus neongalo laye.
Ndelenee keshe womunye na kale yo e hole omukainhu waye mwene ngaashi e lihole ye mwene, ndele omukainhu na fimaneke omulumenhu waye.
6: Ounona nye, dulikeni kovakulunhu veni mOmwene, osheshi osho sha yuka.
“Fimaneka xo nanyoko,” osho oshipango shotete shi neudaneko:
“Opo u kale nelao nomwenyo mule kombada yedu.”
Nanye ooxe, inamu shinda ovana veni noku va handukifa, va tekuleni meduliko nomekumaido lOmwene.
Ovapiya nye, dulikeni koovene veni vomounyuni ngaashi kuKristus, nokutila nokukakama meyuko lomitima deni,
muhe va longele noihelele okuwapalela ovanhu, ndelenee ongaashi ovayakuli vaKristus nokulonga komwenyo ehalo laKalunga,
nokulonga nehalo liwa, mwa fa hamu longele Omwene, havanhu,
nye mu kale mu shi shii kutya, keshe ou ta longo ouwa washa, ote u alulilwa kOmwene, nge omupiya ile omudalwa.
Nanye yo oovene, osho va ningileni, efeni okutilifa, eshi mu shi shii, Omwene weni nowavo e li meulu, ndele munye kamu nokatongotongo.
Ndele natango, ovamwatate, lipamekeni mOmwene nomeenghono domepangelonghono laye.
Lidikeni oilwifo aishe yaKalunga, opo mu dule okufikamena ekonda laSatana;
osheshi ekondjo letu kali fi okukondjifa ombelela nohonde, ndelenee otu nokulwifa oovene novanaenghono, novapangeli vounyuni ou womilaulu, neemhepo dowii mevalelwa.
Onghee hano tambuleni oilwifo aishe yaKalunga, mu shiive okulipopila mefiku lii nokukala ofika eshi mwa longa aishe.
Hano kaleni ofika mwe limanga oshiya sheni noshili, nye mwa djala ponhulo oipapa yoivela youyuki,
nelilongekeko tali di mevaengeli lombili li ninge eenghaku keemhadi deni.
Mwaaishe kwateni oshikelelifo sheitavelo, mu dule okudima po nasho oikuti yomunawii ya xwama omundilo,
nembale loshivela lexupifo li tambuleni, neongamukonda lOmhepo, nokutya, eendjovo daKalunga.
Eshi shi ningeni nomailikano nomaindilo aeshe nokwiilikana alushe mOmhepo ndele molwaasho kaleni mwa pashuka moudiinini aushe nokwiilikanena ovayapuki aveshe;
nomu ilikanene nge yo ndi pewe eendjovo da yuka, ngeenge handi popi nouladi okuholola, opo ndi udife nouladi oshiholekwa shevaengeli,
omolwalo aame omutumwa ndi li momalyenge ndi li udife nouladi ngaashi ndi nokupopya.
Ndelenee opo mu shiive okukala kwange nhumbi ndi li naasho handi ningi, Tikikus omumwatate omuholike nomuyakuli omudiinini mOmwene, oye te ke mu hepaululila aishe;
handi mu tumu kunye, mu kale mu shi shii nhumbi tu li, ye a hekeleke omitima deni.
Ombili nai kale novamwatate, nohole mumwe neitavelo kuKalunga Tate nokOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Efilonghenda nali kale naaveshe ava ve hole Omwene wetu Jesus Kristus mokuhaxula po. Amen.

1: Paulus naTimoteus, ovapiya vaKristus okovayapuki aveshe muKristus Jesus, ovo ve li muFilippi nokovafita nokovayakuliongalo.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu noyOmwene Jesus Kristus!
Ohandi pandula Kalunga kange keshe tuu apa handi mu dimbulukwa,
ndele momailikano ange aeshe ohandi mu ilikanene alushe nehafo, onye amushe,
eshi mu nekwatafano lomevaengeli okefiku linya lotete fiyo opaife,
nohandi lineekele shili nokutya, ou a hovela oshilonga shiwa munye, Oye ote shi wanifa yo fiyo okefiku laKristus Jesus.

Naasho sha yuka yo, ndi kale noku mu diladila ngaha onye amushe, osheshi ondi mu kwete momutima wange, nofimbo ndi li meemango nomanga handi popile nohandi pameke evaengeli, onye ava mu noshitukulwa shonghenda pamwe naame.
Osheshi Kalunga Oye ondobwedi yange, nhumbi nde mu djuulukwa nohole yokomwenyo yaKristus Jesus.
Ndele eshi handi indile ohole yeni i hapupale alushe mokushiiva nomokukoneka akushe,
mu shiive okutongola oinima ei iwa unene, mu kale fiyo okefiku laKristus mwa koshoka, nye muha limbilike nande omunhu,
mwa yadifwa noiimati youyuki, oyo i li po molwaJesus Kristus okufimanekifa nokuhambelelifa Kalunga.
Ndelenee ovamwatate, nda hala mu kale mu shi shii, eshi sha ningilwa nge, osha tandavelifa evaengeli,
fiyo sha shiivika ketanga alishe lovakwaita vomouhamba nokuvamwe aveshe nokutya, ame nda mangwa omolwaKristus.
Novamwatate vahapu vomOmwene mokulineekela omalyenge ange va tuwa ouladi u dule wonale okupopya eendjovo daKalunga vehe noumbada.
Nande vamwe hava udifa Kristus kondubo nokepatafano ndele vamwe kehalo liwa,
ava ohave shi ningi kohole, osheshi ve shi shii, ame nda tulwa po okupopila evaengeli,
ndele venya vamwe ohava udifa Kristus nokukonga osho shavo vene nomwenyo inau yela, nove shii tava wedele nge oluhodi momalyenge ange.
Ndelenee opo ope na shike? Kristus shimha ta udifwa keenghedi adishe, ngee pamoniko longaho ile moshili! Nondi li po handi shi nyakukilwa nohandi ke shi hafela komesho yo.
Osheshi ndi shi shii, eshi otashi lundulukile nge exupifo omolwomailikano eni nokekwafo lOmhepo yaJesus Kristus,

ongaashi ndi neteelelo nelineekelo nokutya, ame itandi ka fifwa ohoni nande moshinima shimwe, ndelenee Kristus ta ka fimanekwa nouladi aushe paife naalushe omolutu lange nongeenge mokukalamwenyo ile mefyo.
Osheshi omwenyo wange oKristus, nokufya okwo elikolo.
Ndelenee ngeenge ndi nokukala ndi nomwenyo mombelela otaku etele oshilonga shange oiimati, ndele nghi shi shii shilipipo handi hoolola.
Hano handi fininikwa keembinga mbali, onda hala okudja po ndi ka kale puKristus, osheshi osho sha wapalela nge unene;
ndelenee okukala mombelela omolweni ku dule po shinya.
Ndele eshi nda shiiva eshi shili, ondi shi shii yo kutya handi ka kala nomwenyo nohandi kala punye amushe, mu kulifwe, nye mu hafifwe meitavelo,
opo elitango leni omolwange muKristus Jesus tali kala lihapu unene mokuuya kwange kunye vali.

Kaleni ashike nokweenda nokuwapalela evaengeli laKristus, opo ngeenge nde uya ko, ndi mu mone ile ngee ndi li kokule, ndi mu ude, mu li momhepo imwe, nye mu li omukoo umwe mokukondjela eitavelo levaengeli pamwe naame,
ndele nye muha mbadapalifwe kovanandubo nande moshinima shimwe. Eshi osho edidiliko lekano kuvo, ndelenee kunye olexupifo, edidiliko la dja kuKalunga.
Osheshi onye omwa pewa hakwiitavela akuke Kristus, ndelenee oku mu hepekelwa yo,
nye mu nolwoodi tuu olo mwe li mona ndele hamu udu paife ndi li kwete.
2: Hano ngeenge ku na ekumaido lasha lomuKristus, ngee ehekeleko lasha lohole, ile oukumwe washa wOmhepo, nounamutimanghenda washa nolukeno,
wedeleni ehafo lange li wane, mokukala mu li omukoo umwe nomu nohole imwe, nye mwa twa ediladilo limwe nelalakano limwe,
nye muha longe nande sha kokulihola nokukonga efimano longaho, ndelenee omelininipiko keshe umwe na tale omukwao e li komesho yaye mwene,
nye muha tale keshe tuu osho shaye ashike, ndelenee shomukwao yo.
Omadiladilo eni naa fe enya aKristus Jesus kwa li e a na,
Oye nande olupe laKalunga, Oye ina hakana a kale a fa Kalunga,
ndelenee okwe lidula Ye mwene nokwa djala olupe lomupika nokufaafana novanhu
nomokukala kwaye okwa li a fa omunhu; nokwe lininipika Ye mwene a dulika fiyo omefyo, heeno, fiyo omokufya komushiyakano.
Onghee hano Kalunga okwe mu lenga, nokwe mu luka edina li li kombada yomadina aeshe,
opo aveshe ve nokutwa eengolo medina laJesus naava vomeulu novokombada yedu naava vokoshi yedu,
nelaka keshe li nokufimaneka Kalunga Xe nokuhepaulula, kutya Jesus Kristus Oye Omwene.
Onghee hano ovaholike vange, ngaashi mwa kala hamu dulika alushe, longeni shili nokutila nokukakama mu xupifwe, hasheshi ndi li mokati keni ashike, ndelenee unene paife, eshi ndihe po punye,
osheshi Kalunga Oye tuu ha longo munye okuhala nokulonga pahokwe yaye.
Aishe i longeni muhe nomapulapulo nomu he nomalimbililo,
opo mu kale ovahenashipo, mwa koshoka, ovana vaKalunga, muhe na edilo mokati koludi eli la pilalala nola ngolyoka, mu vilime mokati kavo ngaashi eenyofi mounyuni,
mokudiinina eendjovo domwenyo, mu kale elitango lange mefiku laKristus opo ndi kale inandi tondoka epwanga noinandi lihepeka oshimha.
Ndele nande ohandi tilwashi ngaashi eyambo meyakulo leitavelo leni, ohandi hafe, nohandi nyakukwa pamwe nanye amushe,
nosho nanye yo, hafeni nokunyakukwa pamwe naame!
Ndele mokulineekela Omwene Jesus onda hala Timoteus ndi mu tume kunye diva, opo ndi tuwe yo ouladi, ngee nda uda nhumbi mu li,
Osheshi ame nghi na umwe ta diladila ngaashi aame, e mu file oshisho shili,
osheshi vo hava kongo oinima yavo vene, hayei yaKristus Jesus.
Ndelenee oulineekelwa waTimoteus omu u shii eshi a kala pamwe naame ongaashi xe nomona okuyakula evaengeli.
Ondi netimaumbwile nokutya, ohandi mu tumu kunye shimha tuu nda mona nhumbi handi ningwa.
Nondi nelineekelo mOmwene, ame mwene yo handi ke uya diva.
Ndelenee onda tala osha yuka okushunifa kunye Epafroditus omumwatate, omulongi nomukwaita omukwetu, omutumwa weni nomuyakuli moluhepo eli lange.
Osheshi ye e mu djuulukwa onye amushe ndele okwa djaalela omolweni eshi mwe mu kundana, kutya okwa li ta vele.
Nokwa li a ditika, hanga a fya, ndele Kalunga okwe mu fila onghenda, nahaye aeke, naame yo, ndiha wedelwe oluhodi kulikwao.
Osho hano nda endelela oku mu tuma, mu nyakukwe, ngeenge mwe mu mona, naame yo opo ndi kufwe oluhodi limwe.
Mu tambuleni hano mOmwene nehafo alishe, novanhu ngaashi ye, va fimanekeni,
osheshi omolwoshilongo shaKristus oye hanga a fya, eshi a yandjela nge omwenyo waye a yakule nge ponhele yeni.
3: Ndele natango, ovamwatate, hafeni mOmwene! Oku mu shangululila oinima ei itaku lolola nge, ndelenee kunye epameko.
Lungameni eembwa odo, lungameni ovalongi ovo vai, lungameni ovo va pitifwa nai etanda.
Osheshi ovapiti vetanda vashili ofye ava hatu longele Kalunga mOmhepo yaKalunga nohatu litangele Kristus Jesus, fye itatu lineekele ombelela,
nande ame ndi na sha shokulineekelwa yo pambelela. Ngeenge pe na ou e shii, oye e na sha shokulineekela ombelela, ame ondi mu dule.
Ame ou nda pitifwa etanda mefiku etihetatu, aame womoludi laIsrael, womapata aBenjamin, Omuheberi womOvaheberi, pamhango Omufarisai,
pauladi ndimuhepeki weongalo, pauyuki womhango aame omuhenashipo.
Ndelenee ei ya li eliko lange, onde i tala oyo oshiponga omolwaKristus.

Heeno oshili, oinima aishe, eshi nde i shaameka nokushiiva Kristus Jesus Omwene wange, handi i tale oyo oshiponga, osheshi omolwaye nda kanifa aishe nohandi i dini oyo oimbodi yongaho, ndi likole Kristus,
ndele ndi monike ndi li muye, ndihe nouyuki wange mwene womomhango, ndelenee oyou womeitavelo laKristus, ouyuki tuu ou hau di muKalunga molweitavelo;
nondi mu shiive, neenghono denyumuko laye nokukala pamwe naye momauyehame aye ndi mu fe mokufya kwa fa kwaye,
ame ndi fike ko kenyumuko lokovafi.
Hakutya nde shi hanga ngeno ile nda wana nda pwa, ndelenee ohandi shi lotokele, ndi shi kwate, ngaashi ame nda kwatwa kuKristus Jesus.
Ovamwatate, ame itandi litale nokutya, nde shi hanga, ndelenee handi shi ningi: ohandi dimbwa ei yokonima nohandi lalakanene ei yokomesho,
ohandi lotokele kefikilo, okondjabi yefindano Kalunga e i ifanena nge neifano lopombada muKristus Jesus.
Hano ofyeni atusheni ava twa wana, tu diladileni ngaha, nongeenge mu nomadiladilo amwe moshinima shonhumba, naasho otamu ke shi hololelwa kuKalunga.
Ndelenee keshe apa twa fikeni, natu endeni mondjila imwe nokukala mediladilo limwe.
Ovamwatate, ningeni ovahopaeleli vange, nye mu tale ava hava ende pashihopaelelwa eshi mwa kufa mufye.
Osheshi vahapu, ngaashi nde ve mu lombwela luhapu nohandi mu lombwele vali, ndi nomahodi, ohava ende ovatondi vomushiyakano waKristus.
Exulilo lavo olo ekano, nedimo lavo olo kalunga kavo, nefimano lavo ohoni yavo, nohava diladila ei yopadu.
Ndelenee oukwashilongo wetu otu u kwete meulu, omo hatu teelele Omwene Jesus Kristus Omuxupifi,
ou ta ka shitulula omalutu etu aa a xutuka, a fe olutu laye loshinge, okeenghono daye tadi dulikifa aishe kuye.
4: Onghee hano ovamwatate ovaholike ava nde mu djuulukwa, onye ehafo lange noshishani shange, kaleni mwa dama mOmwene, ovaholike.
Euodia naSintike ohandi va kumaida, va kale va twa omhango imwe mOmwene.
Naave yo omuyakuli wange washili, ohandi ku indile, u kwafe ovakainhu ava, osheshi ovo va kondjela evaengeli pamwe naame nonaKlemens novayakuli vakwetu ava ve nomadina avo membo lomwenyo.
Hafeni alushe mOmwene! Navali handi ti: Hafeni!
Olune leni nali shiivike kovanhu aveshe. Omwene oku li popepi.
Kaleni muhe na nande oshisho shasha, ndelenee oufyoona weni u shiivifileni Kalunga momailikano nomomaindilo pamwe nomapandulo,
nombili yaKalunga ei i dule eendunge adishe, otai ka amena omitima deni nomadiladilo eni muKristus Jesus.

Ndele natango, ovamwatate, ashishe osho shoshili, naasho sha fimana, naasho sha yuka, naasho sha koshoka, naasho shi holike, naasho shi netumbalo liwa, ongee onghedi iwa ile epandulo, ei aishe i diladileni.
Naai mwe i lilonga nomwe i tambula nomwe i uda nomwe i mona mwaame, i ningeni, Kalunga kombili nota ka kala pamwe nanye.
Onda li nda hafa unene mOmwene, osheshi ngolongo mwa tukuluka okufila nge oshisho, nongaashi nonale mwa li mwe shi hala, ndele inamu mona omhito oku shi ninga.
Hakutya omolweemhumbwe dange handi shi popi, osheshi ame onda ika okuwanena naai ndi i kwete.
Ondi shii okukala noluhepo nondi shii okukala nehepuluko, onda ika aishe nokukala akushe, okukuta nokufya ondjala, okukala noupuna noluhepo.
Aishe ohandi i dulu omolwaKristus, ou ta pameke nge.
Nande ngaha nye mwa ninga nawa, eshi mwa kwafa nge moudjuu wange.

Nanye yo Ovafilippi, omu shi shii, pehovelo leudifo levaengeli, eshi nda dja kuMakedonia, inapa kala nande eongalo limwe le litula kumwe naame mokuvalula eshi sha yandjwa naashi sha tambulwa, onye amuke.
Osheshi nokuTessalonika yo onye mwa tumina nge halumwe aluke ei nde i hepa.
Hakutya handi kongo oshali, ndelenee ohandi kongo oiimati i mu hapupalele.
Ndelenee onda tambula aishe, nda wana ndele pa xupa nokuli. Nda mona ehepuluko linene, eshi nda mona kuEpafroditus, osho mwe shi tumina nge, oyo edimba liwa, neyambo liwa la wapalela Kalunga.
Ndelenee Kalunga kange ote mu wanifile keshe eshi mwa pumbwa shi fike poupuna waye mefimano muKristus Jesus.
Ndelenee Kalunga Tate yetu, Oye na fimanekwe alushe fiyo alushe. Amen.
Kundileni po omuyapuki keshe muKristus Jesus. Ovamwatate aveshe ve li pwaame otave mu kundile po.
Ovayapuki aveshe otave mu kundu, unene ovaneumbo lomukesari.
Efilonghenda lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nomhepo yeni! Amen.

1: Paulus omuyapostoli waKristus Jesus okehalo laKalunga, nomumwatate Timoteus,

kovamwatate muKristus, ovayapuki novaitaveli vomuKolossi.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu.
Ohatu pandula Kalunga Xe yOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus alushe ngeenge hatu mu ilikanene,
osheshi eitavelo leni lomuKristus Jesus, nohole yeni yokuhola ovayapuki aveshe, otwe i uda
nomolweteelelo leni, mwe li tuvikililwa meulu nomwe li uda nale meendjovo doshili yevaengeli,
la fika kunye nongaashi li li mounyuni aushe ndele tali imi oiimati, ngaashi mokati keni yo, okefiku olo mwa uda ndele mwa shiiva onghenda yaKalunga yomoshili,
nongaashi mwe shi longwa kuEpafras, omulongi omukwetu omuholike, omuyakuli omudiinini waKristus molweni,
ndele oye e tu hepaululila yo ohole yeni yomOmhepo.
Onghee nafye yo, kokudja kefiku olo twe shi uda, inatu efa oku mu ilikanena noku mu indilila mu yadifwe okushiiva ehalo laye meendunge adishe nomounongo wopamhepo,
okweenda kweni opo ku wapalele Omwene, mu mu hafife mwaaishe shili nokwiimika oiimati moshilonga keshe shiwa, nokukula mokushiiva Kalunga,
nokunghonopalekwa neenghono adishe paenghono defimano laye mu shiive okulididimikila moudjuu keshe nokutalonheni
nokupandula nehafo Tate, ou e tu wapaleka tu pewe oshitukulwa shefyuululo lovayapuki mouyelele.
Ou e tu xupifa mo mepangelo lomulaulu nokwe tu tembulila mouhamba wOmona waye omuholike.
Muye otu nekulilo nekufilo lomatimba omohonde yaye.
Oye olupe laKalunga iha monika, Omudalwa wotete woishitwa aishe.

Osheshi muye omo mwa shitilwa aishe inya yomeulu naai yokombada yedu, ei i wetike naai ihe wetike, omalukalwapangelo ile ouhamba, nomapangelo ile omapangelonghono a pama, aishe ya shitilwa muye noye mu shitilwa,
ndele Oye wotete kwaaishe, nomuye aishe oya pamenena mo.
Ndele Oye omutwe wolutu nokutya, weongalo, Oye tuu ou ehovelo, Omudalwa wotete ou a nyumuka kovafi, opo a kale omukomesho moinima aishe;
osheshi osho sha wapalela Xe, muye mu kale ouyadi aushe,
ndele mokuninga ombili omolwohonde yomushiyakano waye ohandi ti: molwaye a hanganife aishe muye naai yokombada yedu naainya yomeulu.
Nanye yo ava mwa li nale ovaliteeki novatondadi vaye momadilongo eni nomolwoilonga ii,
Ye e mu hanganifa paife molutu lombelela yaye omolwefyo laye, opo e mu tule koshipala shaye ovayapuki, muhe noshipo nomuhe noushima,

ngeenge tamu kala meitavelo, mwe likanghameka mulo, mwa pamenena mo, muha tengauke meteelelo levaengeli eli mwe li uda nola udifilwa ovashitwa aveshe vokoshi yeulu, olo tuu eli ame Paulus nda ninga omuyakuli walo.
Paife ohandi hafe mokuhepekwa omolweni, noixupe youyehame waKristus ohandi i wanifa mombelela yange omolwolutu laye, nokutya eongalo,
oleli nda ninga omuyakuli walo, omolwoutekuumbo waKalunga oo nde u pewa molweni ndi udife eendjovo daKalunga noku di wanifa,
nokutya, oshiholekwa osho sha li sha holekwa omafimbo nomapupi ndelenee paife osha hololelwa ovayapuki vaye,
ovo Kalunga a hala oku va shiivifila oupuna wefimano loshiholekwa eshi shi li mokati kovapaani, osho Kristus munye, eteelelo lefimano.
Oye hatu mu udifa nokukumaida nokulonga omunhu keshe mounongo aushe, opo tu kaleke omunhu keshe poluhaela a wana muKristus.
Osho tuu eshi handi shi lihepekele nokukondja pakulonga kwaye oko taku longo mwaame neenghono.
2: Osheshi ame onda hala mu shiive olwoodi linene apa li fike ndi li kwete molweni nomolwaava ve li muLaodikea nomolwaaveshe ava inava mona oshipala shange shopalutu,
opo omitima davo da kwatafana mumwe mohole, di tuwe ouladi okutambula oupuna aushe weendunge da wana, nova longwe okushiiva oshiholekwa shaKalunga, osho oKristus.
Oye tuu ou muye mwa holekwa omamona aeshe ounongo neshiivo.
Edi ohandi di popi opo muha pukifwe nande okomunhu e neendjovo domaheko,
osheshi nande nghi li punye palutu, ondi li punye pamhepo, ndele nda hafa mokutala eenghedi deni nepamo leitavelo leni muKristus.
Hano ngaashi mwa tambula Kristus Jesus Omwene, osho kaleni nokweenda muye,
nokutwama nokulitungila muye nokulipamekela meitavelo, ngaashi mwa longwa, nye mu kale mwa yada omapandulo.
Lungameni, paha kale umwe te mu yulifa ounongo wovanhu nomapukifo ongaho, te likwatelele meenghedinghulu nomoihovelanghono younyuni, hamuKristus.
Osheshi muye mwa kala ouyadi aushe woukalunga palutu.
Nanye yo mwa yada muye, Oye tuu ou omutwe womapangelo aeshe neenghonopangelo adishe.
Muye mwa pitifwa etanda, hapitotanda eli hali ningwa nomake, ndelenee oleli lokulidula olutu lombelela, olo epitotanda laKristus,
eshi mwa pakwa pamwe naye meshasho, mulo mwa nyumuka yo pamwe naye keitavelo okwiitavela eenghono daKalunga, ou e mu nyumuna movafi.
Nanye ava mwa li mwa fila momatauluko nomokuhapitatanda kwombelela yeni, Oye e mu tula omwenyo pamwe naye, eshi e tu dimina po omatauluko aeshe,
nokwa dima po eshangelo loipango la li li nondubo nafye, okwe li kufa po nokwe li valela komushiyakano.
Ndele komushiyakano Kristus okwe limangulula momapangelo eenghono novapangeli aveshe vopamhepo okwe va kaleka poluhaela noku va endifa molweendo laye lefindano.
Inamu itavela mu tokolwe hano nande okomunhu omolwokulya nokunwa, ile omolwoshivilo ile omolwohani ipe ile omolwEshabata,
osheshi oyo omudidimbe woinima tai uya, ndele olutu olo laKristus.
Ondjabi yeni yefindano muhe i nyekwe nande okomunhu a hokwa elininipiko nokulongela ovaengeli note litumbalekele omamoniko nokwa fulalala keendunge daye dopambelela,
ndele ite likwatele kOmutwe mwaau olutu alishe la kwatelwa kumwe keengolo nokomifipa, notali kulu opakulifo laKalunga.
Onye ngeenge mwa fya mo pamwe naKristus moihovelifonghono younyuni, oshike hano tamu itavele okutwikwa eenghedi ngaashi oonakukala mounyuni nokutya:
“Ino shi kwata, ino shi lavela, ino shi kuma!”
Nande aishe ei oi li po i longifwe noi xule po paipango nopamalongo ovanhu,
ei aishe oi na ngaho efimano lounongo omolwelongelokalunga nelininipiko ve li lihoololela voovene naashi kai na onghenda nolutu; ndelenee oyo kai na nande oshilonga noi li po i hafife ombelela.
3: Hano ngeenge mwa nyumunwa pamwe naKristus, kongeni inya yokombada, oko Kristus e li omutumba kolulyo laKalunga.
Omadiladilo eni naa dame oinima yopombada, hainima ei yokombada yedu.
Osheshi nye omwa fya, nomwenyo weni owa holekwa pamwe naKristus omuKalunga;
Kristus, omwenyo wetu, fiku ta holoka, nanye yo otamu ka holoka pamwe naye mefimano.
Dipaeni hano oinhimbu yeni yopadu: oluhaelo, onyata, olwisho loipala, okahalu kai, nolwisho leliko olo elongelo loikalunga,
osheshi ei hai etele ovana vokuhadulika ehandu laKalunga.
Nanye yo mwa li mwa endaenda nale muyo, eshi mwa kala muyo.
Ndelenee efeni paife ei aishe: ehandu nepiyaano nowii nesheko neendjovo dohoni tadi piti momakanya eni.
Inamu lombwelafana oipupulu, osheshi nye omwe lidula omunhu mukulu pamwe noilonga yaye,
nomwa djala omunhu mupe, ou ta shitilwa mokushiiva, pafano lOmushiti waye;
nande kape na vali Omugreka nOmujuda, epitotanda nokuhapitatanda, omupaani nOmuskiti, omupika nomudalwa, ndelenee aishe nomwaaveshe oKristus.
Onghee hano ovahoololwa nye vaKalunga, ovayapuki novaholike, djaleni efilonghenda lomomutima, ombili, elininipiko, engungumano noutalanheni,
lididimikilafaneni, diminafaneni po omanyono, ngeenge mwa ningafana nomukweni, ngaashi Kristus e mu dimina po, osho nanye yo mu ninge;
ndele kombada yaaishe djaleni ohole, oyo oshimangifo sha wana shoku mu manga kumwe.
Nombili yaKristus nai pangele momitima deni, oyo ei mwe i ifanenwa omolutu limwe, ndele kaleni mu shii okupandula.
Eendjovo daKristus nadi kale da yadelela munye; longafaneni, pukululafaneni neendunge adishe, nomapsalome nomaimbilopandulo, nomalwiimbo opamhepo nokwiimbila Kalunga nokupandula momitima deni.
Nakeshe eshi tamu shi ningi neendjovo ile noilonga, shi longeni ashishe medina lOmwene Jesus nokupandula Kalunga Xe molwaye.
Ovakainhu nye, dulikeni kovalumenhu veni, ngaashi sha wapalela mOmwene.
Ovalumenhu nye, holeni ovakainhu veni, nye inamu va ningila onyanya.
Ounona nye, dulikeni kovakulunhu veni moinima aishe, Osheshi osho sha wapalela mOmwene.
Ooxe nye, inamu shinda ovana veni, vehe mu livangeke.
Ovapiya nye, dulikeni moinima aishe koovene veni vomounyuni, hanokulongela omesho mu hokuwe kovanhu, ndelenee omouyuki wokomutima nokutila Omwene.
Keshe eshi tamu shi ningi, shi ningeni komitima deni nokulongela Omwene, hamunhu,
nye mu kale mu shi shii otamu ka pewa kOmwene ondjabi yefyuululo; osheshi nye ohamu longele Omwene Kristus.
Osheshi ou ta longo owii, ota ka alulilwa osho e shi nyona ndele itapu talwa oshipala shomunhu.
4: Oovene nye, yandjeni kovapiya veni eshi sha yuka naashi she va yeleka, osheshi omu shi shii, nanye yo omu na Omwene meulu.
Diinineni mokwiilikana nokukala mo oupafi nokupandula,
noku tu ilikanena yo, opo Kalunga e tu yeululile oshivelo shondjovo tu popye oshiholekwa shaKristus omolwaasho nda mangwa yo,
ndi shi holole ngaashi nda pewa ndi shi popye.
Mokweendafana naava ve li pondje kaleni mu neendunge nokukoneka efimbo liwa.
Eendjovo deni nadi kale alushe donghenda, da fingala omongwa, nye mu kale mu shi shii nhumbi mu nokunyamukula keshe umwe.
Tikikus, omumwatate omuholike, omulongi omudiinini nomupiya mukwetu mOmwene, oye te mu hepaululile nhumbi ndi li.
Oye tuu handi mu tumu kunye, opo a shiive nhumbi mu li, ye a hekeleke omitima deni.
Oye pamwe naOnesimus, omumwatate omudiinini nomuholike, ou omukweni, otave mu hepaululile ashishe eshi shi li oku.
Aristarkus, onakumangwa mukwetu, ote mu kundifa, naMarkus, omukwao waBarnabas, oye ou mwe mu lombwelwa mu mu tambule, ngeenge te uya kunye,
naJesus ou ha ifanwa Justus, ovo vomepitotanda. Vo aveke ove li ovalongi vakwetu molwouhamba waKalunga, ovo nova hekeleka nge.
NaEpafras, omukweni, omupiya waKristus Jesus, ote mu kundile po yo, oye ou he mu kondjele alushe momailikano aye, opo mu kale mwa fikama mwa wana nomwa pama mehalo alishe laKalunga.
Osheshi ame ohandi mu hepaulile, oye e na shili ouladi molweni nomolwaava vomuLaodikea novomuHierapolis.
Otamu kundilwa po kuLukas, omuhakuli omuholike nokuDemas.
Kundileni po ovamwatate vomuLaodikea, naNimfas neongalo hali ongala meumbo laye.
Onhumwafo ei ngeenge ya leshwa kunye, i tumeni i ka leshwe nomeongalo lomuLaodikea, nye mu leshe yo ei tai di kuLaodikea.
Ndele lombweleni Arkippus: Diinina eyakulolonga eli we li pewa kOmwene, u li wanife shili.
Ekundifo kwaame, Paulus, neke lange mwene. Dimbulukweni omalyenge ange. Efilonghenda nali kale nanye. Amen.

1:
Paulus naSilvanus naTimoteus okeongalo lOvatessalonika, li li muKalunga Xe nomOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili.
Ofye ohatu pandula Kalunga alushe omolweni amushe fiku hatu mu diladila momailikano etu,
nokudimbulukwa alushe koshipala shaKalunga Tate yetu oshilonga shomeitavelo, nokulihepeka kweni mohole nelididimiko leni meteelelotimaumbwile lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus,
ngaashi otu shi shii, ovamwatate ovaholike vaKalunga nokutya, onye mwa hoololwa.
Osheshi evaengeli letu ola fika kunye haneendjovo adike, ndelenee omeenghono yo nomOmhepo Iyapuki nomeyelelo la pama, ngaashi mu shi shii, nhumbi twa li mokati keni omolweni.
Ndele nye omwa ninga ovashikuli vetu novOmwene eshi mwa tambula eendjovo nehafo lomOmhepo Iyapuki, nande mwa li meefina dihapu,
osho ngaha mwa ninga ovahopaelelwa vovaitaveli aveshe vomuMakedonia novomuAkaia.
Osheshi omunye mwa dja oshihomo sheendjovo dOmwene hamuMakedonia nomuAkaia amuke, ndelenee eitavelo leni okwiitavela Kalunga ola tandavela apeshe, ndele fye inatu pumbwa oku shi popya vali.
Osheshi ovo vene have tu hepaulula, okuuya kwetu kunye nhumbi kwa li, nanye yo nhumbi mwa amuka koikalunga nomwe uya kuKalunga, mu longele Kalunga omunamwenyo nomunashili,
nokuteelela Omona waye ta di meulu, ou e mu nyumuna koufi, Jesus, ou te tu xupifa mehandu tali uya.
2: Ovamwatate, nye vene omu shi shii okuuya kwetu kunye kakwa li kwongaho,
ndelenee nande twa hangelwe opo twa hepekwa muFilippi ndele twa langaulwa, ngaashi mu shi shii, otwa li tu nouladi muKalunga oku mu udifila evaengeli laKalunga omolwoodi linene.
Osheshi ekumaido letu inali dja momapukifo ile momahongaulo nongaashi inali tongwa nekonda;
ndele ngaashi Kalunga e tu tala twa wana okulineekelelwa evaengeli, osho hatu popi, hakuhala tu wapalele ngeno ovanhu, ndelenee oKalunga, ou ta konakona omitima detu.
Ngaashi mu shi shii, fye inatu enda nande lumwe neendjovo deheka ile okulikongela emona nekonda, Kalunga Ye ondobwedi yetu.
Fye inatu konga yo okufimanekwa kovanhu, kunye ile kuvamwe,
nande ofye ngaashi ovayapostoli vaKristus twa wana okupewa efimaneko, ndelenee otwa holoka mokati keni nombili ngaashi ina omunyamifi ha tekula ouhanana vaye;
osho nafye yo moku mu djuulukwa neenghono twa hala oku mu pa yo havaengeli laKalunga alike, ndelenee eemwenyo detu vene yo, osheshi onye omwa ninga ovaholike vetu.
Ovamwatate nye, ndishi omwa dimbulukwa oilonga yetu noudjuu wetu, nokulonga nomake omutenya noufiku, tuha etele nande umwe mokati keni oudjuu, eshi twe mu udifila evaengeli laKalunga.
Onye naKalunga eendobwedi, nhumbi twa kala mouyapuki nomouyuki ndele tuhe noshipo mokati keni nye ovaitaveli,
ngaashi mu shi shii, otwa li hatu mu kumaida keshe umwe womunye ngaashi xe novana vaye noku mu twa omukumo,
noku mu kunghilila shili, mu ende ngaashi sha wapalela Kalunga, ou e mu ifanena mouhamba waye nomoshinge shaye.

Onghee hano nafye yo ohatu pandula Kalunga tuhe nedimbuko, osheshi ondjovo yaKalunga mwe i uda kufye, mwe i tambula hangaashi ondjovo yovanhu, ndelenee ongaashi i li shili ondjovo yaKalunga, ei tai longo yo munye ava mwa itavela.
Osheshi ovamwatate nye, omwa ninga ovashikuli vomaongalo aKalunga enya omuJudea a kala muKristus Jesus, osheshi nanye yo omwa hepekwa kuvakweni, ngaashi venya kOvajuda,
ovo va dipaa yo Omwene Jesus novaxunganeki nove tu taataa, vo inava wapalela Kalunga, ndele ve nondubo novanhu aveshe,
eshi have tu kelele okuudifila ovapaani, opo va xupifwe; osho ngaha tava yadifa alushe oulunde wavo. Ndelenee ehandu ole uya nokuli kombada yavo.
Ndelenee ovamwatate nye, eshi twa li tu nokutukauka nanye okafimbo palutu, hapamwenyo, otwa hala nodjuulufi inene tu mone oipala yeni.
Onghee hano otwa li twa hala okuuya kunye, aame Paulus, halumwe aluke, ndelenee Satana okwe tu shilika ko.
Osheshi olyelye vali eteelelo letu nehafo noshishani shelitango letu, ngeenge hanye yo koshipala shOmwene wetu Jesus mokuuya kwaye?
Osheshi nye efimano letu nehafo letu.
3: Onghee hano eshi twa li twa nyengwa okulididimika vali, otwa pangela omhangela tu kale muAtena ofye atuke,
notwa tuma ko Timoteus, omumwatate nomuyakuli waKalunga pamwe nafye mevaengeli laKristus, e mu pameke noku mu hekeleka meitavelo leni,
opo paha kale nande umwe ta limbililwa komaudjuu aa; osheshi nye vene omu shi shii, omo tuu twa tulwa mo.
Nale nokuli, fimbo twa li punye, otwe mu lombwela, nokutya otu noku ka hangwa komahepeko, ngaashi opa ningwa yo, ndele mu shi shii.
Onghee hano eshi nda nyengwa okulididimika vali, onda tuma ko, ndi ude eitavelo leni, paha ningwe, omuhongauli e mu hongaule ngeno, ndele oshilonga shetu pamwe sha ninga shongaho.

Ndelenee paife, Timoteus eshi a aluka ko, e uya kufye, okwe tu etela onghundana iwa yeitavelo leni nohole yeni, nanhumbi hamu tu dimbulukwa alushe nohole ndele mu nodjuulufi oku tu mona, ngaashi nafye yo hatu mu djuulukwa.
Onghee hano ovamwatate, fye otwa hekelekwa keitavelo leni moudjuu wetu aushe nomokufininikwa kwetu.
Osheshi paife otu nomwenyo, ngeenge mwa fikama mwa pama mOmwene.
Epandulo letu la tya ngahelipi ngeno hatu li etele Kalunga omolweni, nomolwehafo eli alishe hatu mu hafele koshipala shaKalunga ketu
manga hatu ilikana shili omutenya noufiku, tu pewe omhito okumona oipala yeni, fye tu wanife eshi eitavelo leni le shi hepa.
Ndelenee Oye mwene, Kalunga ketu, Tate yetu, nOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, na yukife ondjila yetu kunye;
ndele nye Omwene ne mu kulife, Ye ne mu punike mohole yokuholafana nokuhola aveshe, ngaashi twa kala tu mu hole,
opo Ye a pameke omitima deni, di hangike dihe noshipo omouyapuki koshipala shaKalunga ketu, Tate yetu, omokwaaluka kwOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, pamwe novayapuki vaye aveshe.
4: Ndele natango, ovamwatate, ohatu mu ilikana nohatu mu kumaida mOmwene Jesus, mu kule muyo natango, nhumbi mu nokweenda nokukala mwa wapalela Kalunga, ngaashi hamu ende paife.
Osheshi omalombwelo aa twe mu pa mOmwene Jesus omu a shii nokuli.
Osheshi ehalo laKalunga oleli: eliyapulo leni, mu yepe oluhaelo;
keshe ou womokati keni a kale e shii kudiinina omukainhu waye omouyapuki nomokufimaneka,
hamolwisho louhalu, ngaashi ovapaani ava inava shiiva Kalunga;
ndele kuha kale ou ta nyeka omukwao note mu etele oshiponga nande omoshinima shimwe, osheshi Omwene Oye omuhandukili waaveshe ava, ngaashi twe mu lombwela nale notwe mu hepaululila.
Osheshi Kalunga ine tu ifanena enyato, ndele ouyapuki.
Onghee hano ou ha dini ei, oye iha dini omunhu, ndelenee oKalunga mwene, ou a yandja Omhepo yaye Iyapuki kufye.
Ohole yokuholafana, ovamwatate, ihamu pumbwa oku i shangelwa, osheshi onye vene mwa longwa kuKalunga okuholafana,
nohamu shi ningile yo ovamwaxo aveshe vomuMakedonia ashishe. Ndelenee ohatu mu kumaida, ovamwatate, mu kule muyo natango,
ndele mu tale efimano leni nokutya, olo okukala mengungumano nokulonga oilonga yeni hamu longifa omake eni vene, ngaashi twe mu lombwela,
opo mu ende mu neenghedi moipafi yaava vopondje ndele inamu pumbwa sha.
Ndelenee ovamwatate, fye inatu hala mu kale muhe shi shii, ava va kofa po (oonakufya) nhumbi ve li, muhe va nyikile oluhodi ngaashi venya vamwe vehe neteelelo.
Osheshi fye ngeenge hatu itavele Jesus a fya, ndele a nyumuka, opo nee Kalunga ota ka eta pamwe naye ovo va kofa mo muJesus.
Osheshi ohatu mu lombwele, ngaashi ondjovo yOmwene nokutya, fye ava hatu fyaala po tu nomwenyo fiyo okealuko lOmwene, ihatu tetekelele ava va kofa po.
Osheshi Omwene Ye mwene ota ka londoloka keulu neingido lelombwelo nondaka yomweengeli omukulunhu nekweno lenghuma laKalunga, ovafi ovo va fila muKristus, otava ka nyumuka tete,
opo nee nafye yo, ovanamwenyo ava twa fyaala po, ohatu ka vakulwa po shimwe pamwe naava moilemo, tu ka shakeneke Omwene kombadambada, ndele hatu ka kala alushe pOmwene.
Hano lihekelekeni neendjovo edi.
5: Ndelenee omafiku nomafimbo itamu pumbwa oku a shangelwa, ovamwatate,
osheshi nye vene omu shi shii nawanawa nokutya, efiku lOmwene otali uya ngaashi omulunga moufiku.
Fimbo tava ti: “Ombili, kape na nande ombili,” opo nee ehanauno tali va vakele, ngaashi omufimba ta hangwa koshifeta, ndele kave na apa tava i onhapo.
Ndelenee nye ovamwatate, kamu li momulaulu, efiku olo lihe mu hange ngeno ngaashi omulunga;
osheshi nye amushe ovana vouyelele novana vomutenya, katu fi ovana voufiku ile vomulaulu.
Inatu kofeni hano ngaashi venya vamwe, ndele tu pashukeni tu kale ovalidiliki.
Osheshi ovo hava kofa, ohava kofa oufiku, naava hava kolwa, ohava kolwa oufiku.
Ndele ofye ava vomutenya, tu kaleni tu nelidiliko ndele twa djala oipakotolwa yoivela yeitavelo noyohole nembale loshivela leteelelo lexupifo;
osheshi Kalunga ine tu ufila okuhandukilwa, ndelenee tu xupifwe omolwOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus,
ou e tu fila, opo tu kale tu nomwenyo pamwe naye, ngeenge twa pashuka ile twa kofa.
Onghee hano hekelekafaneni nye mu tungafane keshe umwe nomukwao, ngaashi hamu shi ningi nokuli shito.
Ndelenee ovamwatate nye, ohatu mu dimbulukifa, mu tale nolupandu ava hava longo mokati keni ndele have mu kwatele komesho mOmwene ndele have mu pukulula,
nye mu va fimaneke noku va hola shili molwoshilonga shavo. Kalafaneni nombili!
Ohatu mu kumaida, ovamwatate, hanyeneni ava vehe neenghedi, ovambada va tweni ouladi, yakuleni oingone, aveshe va taleni onheni.
Taleni paha kale nande umwe ta alulile mukwao owii waye, mu hale alushe okulongelafana ouwa noku u longela aveshe.
Hafeni alushe!
Ilikaneni muhe nedimbuko.
Kaleni nokupandula mwaaishe, osheshi olo ehalo laKalunga muKristus Jesus molweni.
Omhepo inamu i dima po,
okuxunganeka inamu ku dina.
Konakoneni aishe, nye mu diinine eshi shiwa.
Kukumeni ashishe sha nyika owii.
Ndelenee Kalunga kombili, Oye mwene, ne mu yapule shili ounhu aushe, omhepo nomwenyo nolutu i amenwe i kale ihe noshipo fiyo okealuko lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Ou he mu ifana, Oye omudiinini, Oye ote shi wanifa yo.
Ovamwatate, tu ilikaneneni!
Kundileni po ovamwatate aveshe nefipo liyapuki.
Ohandi mu anifa mOmwene, onhumwafo ei mu i leshifile ovamwatate ovayapuki aveshe.
Efilonghenda lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nanye! Amen.

1:
Paulus naSilvanus naTimoteus,
Okeongalo lOvatessalonika muKalunga, Tate yetu nomOmwene Jesus Kristus.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga, Tate yetu noyOmwene Jesus Kristus!
Otu nokupandula Kalunga alushe molweni, ovamwatate, ongaashi osha wapala yo, osheshi eitavelo leni otali kulu shili, nohole yeni yokuholafana tai hapupala mukeshe umwe mokati keni,
opo fye vene ohatu litange momaongalo aKalunga molweni, omolwelididimiko leni neitavelo leni omokutewatewa kweni akushe nomaudjuu oo hamu a humbata.
Osho edidiliko letokolo laKalunga la yuka, nokutya nye mu talwe mwa wapalela ouhamba waKalunga, ngaashi tamu u hepekelwa yo.
Kalunga okwe shi tala sha yuka okwaalulila ovahepeki veni omahepeko,
noku mu pa, onye tuu ava mwa hepekwa, etulumuko pamwe nafye omokuholoka kwOmwene Jesus, fiku ta di meulu pamwe novaengeli vaye ovanaenghono,
omomalaka omundilo, fiku ta handukile ava inava shiiva Kalunga noitava dulika kevaengeli lOmwene wetu Jesus.
Ovo tava ka wilwa kehandu nokenyonauko laalushe tali di koshipala shOmwene nokefimano leenghono daye,
mefiku olo te uya okuvadimifwa movayapuki vaye nokukuminwa movaitaveli vaye aveshe, osheshi onye omwa itavela ehepaululo twe li mu udifila.
Onghee hatu mu indilile alushe Kalunga ketu e mu tale mwa wapalela eifano, Ye a wanife neenghono ehalo leni alishe okuhala ouwa noshilonga sheitavelo,
edina lOmwene wetu Jesus opo li fimanekwe munye, nanye yo muye, panghenda yaKalunga ketu noyOmwene Jesus Kristus.
2: Ndelenee mokupopya ealuko lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nokwoongelwa kwetu kuye, ohatu mu indile, ovamwatate,
muha kanife diva eendunge ile muha halukifwe nande komhepo ile kondjovo ile konhumwafo ya dja kufye, vati, ongefiku lOmwene la fika.
Inamu efa mu pukifwe nande okomunhu opanghedi ya sha, osheshi eliteeko li nokuuya tete, nomunhu woulunde e nokuholoka, omona wekano,
omunandubo ou te litula pombada yaashishe hashi ifanwa Kalunga nouyapuki, opo nee ye te ke litula motembeli yaKalunga ndele te liluku Kalunga.
Inamu shi dimbulukwa eshi nde mu lombwela alushe fimbo nda li punye?
Ndele paife nye omu shi shii eshi tashi mu imbi okuholoka fiyo efimbo laye la fika.
Osheshi oshiholekwa shoudinimhango tashi longo nokuli, shamha tuu tapa kufwa po eshi tashi u imbi paife.
Ndele opo nee omudinimhango ota holoka, oye ou Omwene Jesus ote ke mu dipaa po nomufudo womokanya kaye note mu hanauna po neholoko lealuko laye,
ou te uya palongifo laSatana meenghono adishe nomadidiliko noikumwifa yoipupulu,
nomakonda aeshe ouhenouyuki okunyona po ava tava ka kana, osheshi inava tambula ohole yoshili yoku va xupifa.
Nomolwaasho Kalunga te ke va tumina epukifo lidjuu vo va itavele oipupulu,
opo va tokolwe aveshe ovo va anya okwiitavela oshili ndele va hokwa ouhenouyuki.
Ndelenee fye otu nokupandula alushe Kalunga molweni, ovamwatate ovaholike vOmwene, ava Kalunga e mu hololela okudja pehovelo exupifo meyapulo lOmhepo nomeitavelo loshili,
mwe li ifanenwa yo kuye okevaengeli letu okupewa efimano lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus.
Onghee hano, ovamwatate, kaleni ofika mwa pama, nye mu diinine shili omapukululo mwe a longwa kufye nande okondjovo ile konhumwafo yetu.
NOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus Oye mwene naKalunga Tate yetu ou a kala e tu hole nokwe tu pa monghenda ehekeleko laalushe neteelelo liwa,
Oye na hekeleke omitima deni, Ye ne mu pamekele meendjovo adishe diwa nomoilonga aishe iwa.
3: Ndele natango, ovamwatate nye, tu ilikaneneni, opo ondjovo yOmwene i tondoke i ka fimanekwe pamwe ngaashi punye,
nafye opo tu xupifwe kovapwidi novai, osheshi eitavelo kali fi lomunhu keshe.
Ndelenee Omwene Oye omudiinini; Oye te mu pameke ndele te mu amene kowii.
Nohatu mu lineekele mOmwene, nokutya, otamu ningi paife nokomesho yo oinima oyo twe i mu lombwela,
NOmwene na yukife omitima deni mohole yaKalunga nomelididimiko laKristus.
Ndelenee medina lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus ohatu mu lombwele, Ovamwatate nye, mu amuke kukeshe tuu omumwatate ta ende moupote ndele iha shikula omapukululo oo mwe a pewa kufye.
Nanye vene omu shi shii nhumbi tu nokuhopaelelwa kunye, osheshi inatu kala mo nokukala ovahefi mokati keni;
fye kakwa li twa lya omungome oshali pomunhu nande umwe, ndele otwa kala nokulonga noudjuu oufiku nomutenya, tuha twike nande umwe mokati keni oudjuu.
