Inatu shi ninga, tuhe neenghono ngeno oku shi ninga, ndelenee otwa hala oku mu pa oshihopaelelwa mu tu hopaelele.
Osheshi fimbo twa li punye, otwe shi mu lombwela nokutya: “Ou ina hala okulonga, ina lya yo nande.”
Ndele ohatu udu oku na vamwe vomokati keni hava ende monyalo, kave na eshi tava longo, otava shelemba ashike.
Ava ve li ngaha ohatu va lombwele nohatu va kumaida mOmwene Jesus Kristus, va kale nokulonga nokungungumana va lye omungome wavo vene.
Ndelenee onye, ovamwatate, mokulonga ouwa inamu fya ounye.
Ndele ngeenge oku na ou iha udu ko eendjovo detu monhumwafo ei, mu didilikeni, nye inamu endafana naye, opo a fye ohoni.
Ndele inamu mu tala ngaashi omutondadi weni, ndele mu pukululeni ngaashi omumwaxo.
Ndele Oye, Omwene wombili, ne mu pe ombili alushe opaenghedi adishe. Omwene na kale nanye amushe.
Omakundilo ange neke lange mwene Paulus, olo edidiliko lange meenhumwafo dange adishe, osho ngaha handi shange.
Efilonghenda lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nanye amushe! Amen.

1: Paulus, omuyapostoli waKristus Jesus opamhangela yaKalunga, Omuxupifi wetu, noyaKristus Jesus, Oye eteelelo letu,
okuTimoteus, omona wange shili meitavelo. Efilonghenda nonghenda nombili yaKalunga, Tate yetu nokuKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu!
Hano ngaashi nde ku lombwela, eshi nda ya kuMakedonia, u kale natango muEfeso, opo u kumaide ovanhu vamwe, vo vaha longe omalongo amwe e lili,
vo vaha diinine eengano nomapatavalulo ehe nexulilo, aa taa eta ashike eemhata, itadi pameke eleloumbo laKalunga olo lomeitavelo.
Ndelenee efikilo lekumaido olo ohole tai di momutima wa yela nomeliudo liwa nomeitavelo lihe noihelele,
omo ovanhu vamwe va puka mo nove liameka komapopyaano ongaho,
eshi va hala va kale ovalongimhango, nande kave udite ko eendjovo odo noinima oyo tave i tongo ndele tava ti, oi li mondjila.
Ndelenee otu shi shii, kutya omhango oyo iwa, ile umwe te i longifa pamhango,

nokushiiva yo nokutya, omhango inai yandjelwa omuyuki, ndelenee ava vehe nomhango ndele ihava dulika, vehe na Kalunga, novalunde, vehe fi ovayapuki, novalinyateki, ovadipai vooxe novadipai vooina novadipai vovanhu,
novahaeli nomashenge, ovavaki vovanhu, ovanaipupulu novaani voipupulu nakeshe eshi shi nondubo nomalongo a yuka,
opavaengeli lefimano lelao laKalunga, eli nde li pewa mokulineekelwa.
Ndele ohandi pandula ou a pa nge eenghono, oKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu, eshi a tala nge ame omudiinini nokwa tula nge meyakulolonga,
ame ou nda li nale omusheki nomutaataai nomuhepeki. Ndele onda filwa onghenda, osheshi ame nde shi ningile mokuhashiiva sha nomokuhaitavela.
Nefilonghenda lOmwene wetu ola li linene shili pamwe neitavelo nohole i li muKristus Jesus.
Ondjovo ei oya pama shili noya wana okutambulwa nokutya: Kristus Jesus okwe uya mounyuni okuxupifa ovalunde, mwaava aame omunene ndi va dule aveshe.
Ndelenee ame onda filwa onghenda, Jesus Kristus opo a holole mwaame tete outalanheni waye aushe ndi ninge oshihopaelelwa shaava tave ke mu itavela va mone omwenyo waalushe.
Ndele Ohamba yomafimbo ounyuni, ei ihe nexulilo noihe wetike, oyo Kalunga omunandunge aeke, na hambelelwe, Ye na fimanekwe alushe fiyo alushe! Amen.
Omona wange Timoteus, omhango ei ohandi i ku pe noku ku lineekela, pamaxunganeko aa e ku xunganekelwa nale, opo u shiive okukondja olwoodi liwa mokulikwatelela muo,
nokudiinina eitavelo neliudo liwa, olo la ekelwashi kuvamwe, noskepa yeitavelo lavo oya teka po.
Ongaashi Himeneus naAleksander, ava nda yandja kuSatana, opo va handukilwe, vaha sheke vali.
2: Hano, tetetete ohandi ku kumaida, napa ningwe omaindilo nomailikano nomailikaneno nomapandulo omolwovanhu aveshe,
eehamba novapangeli aveshe, opo tu kale tu nokukalamwenyo ku nombili nengungumano metilokalunga nomeenghedi diwa da fimana.
Osho oshiwa nosha wapala moipafi yaKalunga, Omukulili wetu,
ou a hala ovanhu aveshe va xupifwe nova fike meshiivo loshili.
Osheshi Kalunga Oye umwe nopokati kaKalunga novanhu oumwe, omunhu Kristus Jesus,
ou e liyandja Ye mwene oikulila yaaveshe, ndele sha li shi nokuhepaululwa mefimbo lasho.
Onghee hano naame onda tulwa po omuudifi nomuyapostoli ohandi popi doshili muKristus, itandi fufya omulongi woiwana meitavelo nomoshili.
Hano onda hala ovalumenhu va ilikane apeshe va yelula omaoko mayapuki vehe nehandu novehe neenhamanana.

Osho yo ovakainhu nava djale oikutu tai wapalele eenghedi diwa nokuliwapeka noshishohoni noukoshoki, haneexwiki da vindwa ile noulenga woshingoldo ile noshilanda ile noikutu youkengeli ei tai landwa nondilo,
ndelenee onoilonga iwa ei tai wapalele ovakainhu ovo tave lihepaulula kutya, vo oonakutilakalunga.
Omukainhu e nokuliefela nokulongwa mengungumano nomeduliko alishe.
Ame itandi shi itavele omukainhu a ninge omulongindjovo ile a pangele omulumenhu, ndelenee ne lilonge okukala a mwena nokukala meduliko alishe.
Osheshi Adam okwa shitwa tete, Eva okonima.
Ndele Adam ina pukifwa, ndelenee omukainhu oye a pukifwa, ndele a nyona.
Ndelenee ye ota ka xupifwa mokudala ounona, ngeenge ta kala meitavelo nomohole mouyapuki nokukala moukoshoki.
3: Ondjovo ei oyoshili, umwe ngeenge a hala oshilonga shoufitaongalo, oye okwe lihalela oshilonga shiwa.
Hano, omufitaongalo e nokukala omuhenashipo, omulumenhu womukainhu umwe aeke, omulidiliki, omunaendunge, omunaenghedi, e shii okuyakula ovaenda, e shii okulonga.
Hangholwe, hamunamhata, hamuluva, ndelenee omunambili, omunanheni, hamunalwisho woimaliwa,
ou e shii okupangela nawa eumbo laye mwene, ndele ta tekula nawa ounona vaye neenghedi da fimana meduliko.
Ndelenee ou ita dulu okutekula eumbo laye mwene, ota dulu ngahelipi okufila eongalo laKalunga oshisho?
Hapo e lidilulula, opo ehe linenepeke ndele ta wile metokolo laSatana.
Ndelenee e nokumona epopilo liwa kwaavo va li pondje, opo aha hangike komasheko nokomwiyo waSatana.
Osho yo ovayakuliongalo nava kale ve neenghedi da fimana vehe neendaka mbali, havapika voikolwifa, havakongi veliko loulunde,
ndelenee ovayakuliongalo ovadiinini voshiholekwa sheitavelo meliudo la koshoka.
Ndele naava yo nava talwe tete, nongeenge va monika vehe noshipo, opo nee tava shiiva okuyakula.
Osho yo ovakainhu vavo nava kale ve neenghedi da fimana, kave fi ovalundili, ndelenee ovalidiliki novadiinini moinima aishe.
Ovayakuliongalo ve nokukala ovalumenhu vomukainhu umwe auke, ve shii okutekula nawa ovana nomaumbo avo vene.
Osheshi ava tava yakula nawa, ovo tave limonene oulineekelwa muwa nouladi uhapu meitavelo lomuKristus Jesus.
Ame ohandi ku shangele oinima ei metimaumbwile ndi uye diva kwoove.
Ndelenee ngee handi imbwa kusha, ove u kale u shi shii nhumbi ove mwene u nokukala meumbo laKalunga, olo eongalo laKalunga omunamwenyo, olo ongudi nekanghameno loshili.

Nosha shiivika nawa shili nokutya, oshiholekwa shelao lomuKalunga osho oshinene: Kalunga a holoka mombelela, okwa yukipalifwa mOmhepo, okwa monika kovaengeli, okwa udifilwa mokati koiwana, okwa itavelwa mounyuni, okwa tambulwa mefimano.
4: Ndelenee Omhepo otai popi eendjovo di uditike nawa nokutya, momafiku axuuninwa vamwe otave liteeka po eitavelo, ndele tava ka shikula eemhepo dipukifi nomalongo eendemoni,
otava pukifwa koihelele yovanaipupulu, ovo va xwikwa eliudo lavo noshixwikifo,
ovo tava kelele okuhombola nokulya oikulya ya shitwa kuKalunga, i liwe nokupandula kovaitaveli nokwaava va shiiva oshili.
Osheshi keshe tuu eshi sha shitwa kuKalunga, osho oshiwa, kashi shii okweekelwashi, ngeenge tashi tambulwa nepandulo.
Osheshi otashi yapulwa keendjovo daKalunga neilikano.
Hano, ngeenge to dimbulukifa ovamwatate oinima ei, ove to ningi omuyakuli muwa owaKristus Jesus, ndele to lipalula neendjovo deitavelo nodelongo la yuka eli we li shikula.
Ndelenee eengano da nyata neendjovo dovakainhu di hanyena, ndele ove lideula metilokalunga.
Osheshi edeulo lokolutu oli nekwafo lixupi, ndelenee etilokalunga otali kwafa moinima aishe, osheshi olo li neudaneko lomwenyo wopaife nowokomesho.
Ondjovo ei oya yuka noya wana okutambulwa shili;
osheshi omolwaasho hatu lihepeke nokukondja, shaashi fye otwa tula elineekelo letu muKalunga omunamwenyo, ou Omukulili wovanhu aveshe, ndele unene wovaitaveli.
Hano, oinima ei va lombwela noku va longa.
Inapa kala nande umwe ta dini ounyasha woye. Ndele kala omuhopaelelwa wovaitaveli meendjovo nomokweenda, mohole, momhepo, meitavelo nomoukoshoki.
Fiyo ohandi uya, diinina oku va leshela omishangwa noku va kumaida noku va longa.
Ino hepifa oshalinghenda i li mwoove, ei we i pewa mouxunganeki, ovakulunhu eshi ve ku tenheka omake avo.
Aishe ei i diinina, ove u kale muyo, opo okweehena kwoye komesho ku monike kwaaveshe.
Lipashukila ove mwene nenongeko loye; dama mulo! Osheshi ngeenge to shi ningi, oto lixupifa ove mwene naava tave ku pwilikine.
5: Omukulunhu ino mu hanyena pombada, ndelenee mu kumaida ngaashi xo; ovalumenhu ovanyasha ongaashi ovamwaxo,
ovakainhu ongaashi onyoko, ovanyasha ongaashi ovamwanyoko, omoukoshoki aushe.
Fimaneka ovafiyekadi, ava ovafiyekadi shili.
Ndelenee omufiyekadi ngeenge e nounona ile ovatekulu, vo nave lilonge tete okufila oshisho ovaneumbo lavo mouyuki nokwaalulila ovakulunhu vavo eyakulo liwa, osheshi osho sha wapala moipafi yaKalunga.
Ndele omufiyekadielela omulikaleli ota tula elineekelo laye muKalunga, ota kala mokwiilikana nomokwiindila oufiku nomutenya.
Ndelenee omuliefeli mouhalu oye okwa fya, nande oku nomwenyo.
Oinima ei i va lombwela yo, vaha kale ve noshipo.
Ndelenee ou iha file vakwao oshisho naunene ava vambulaye, ye okwe lidimbika eitavelo noku dulike kwaau ehe fi omwiitaveli.
Momuvalu namu shangelwe mo omufiyekadi ou aeke a ninga eedula omilongo hamano, ndele a kala omukainhu womulumenhu umwe,
ndele a hepaululwa a longa oilonga iwa ndele a tekula ounona vaye nokuyakula ovaenda, ndele a kosha eemhadi dovayapuki nokwa kwafa ovahepekwa, ndele okwa diinina oshilonga keshe shiwa.
Ndelenee ovafiyekadi ava ovanyasha va efa, osheshi ngeenge tava hangika kokahalu ndele tava kenyanana Kristus, ova hala okuhombolwa,
ndele tava i metokolo, osheshi ova ekelashi eitavelo lavo lotete.
Ndele vo otava ningi ovananyalo mokweendaenda nomaumbo, ndele havananyalo ashike, ndelenee otava popyaana notave litula moinima yovanhu ndele tava popi eendjovo dihe shi okupopiwa.
Onghee ame onda hala ovafiyekadi ava ovanyasha va hombolwe vo va dale ounona nova lele omaumbo avo, ndele vaha pe omunandubo omhito yokusheka.
Osheshi vamwe ova kanduka mo nokuli ndele ova shikula Satana.
Omulumenhu omwiitaveli nomukainhu omwiitaveli, ngeenge e novafiyekadi ve li puye, ye ne va kwafe, opo eongalo liha pyakidikwe kuvo, ndele oli nokukwafa ovafiyekadi vashili.
Ovakulunhu ava hava lele nawa, ove lilongela okufimanekwa shili, unene ava ve li moshilonga shondjovo ndele tava longo.
Osheshi omishangwa otadi ti: “Ongobe tai xu moshipale ino i manga komulungu,” nadikwao: “Omulongi okwe lilongela ondjabi yaye.”
Omukulunhu ngeenge ta hokololifwa, ino tambula eendjovo, okuninga pe na eendobwedi mbali ile nhatu
Ava hava nyono, va hanyena moipafi yovanhu aveshe, opo vakwao yo va kale va tila.
Ohandi ku anifa koshipala shaKalunga noshaKristus Jesus noshovaengeli ovahoololwa, ove u diinine oinima ei uhe na etokolo lasha, la tetekela oshinima ndele uha tongole ovanhu.
Ino endelela nande okutenheka omake oye komunhu, ove ino kwatafana nomatimba ovanhu vamwe. Lidiinina u kale omukoshoki.
Ino nwa vali omeva aeke, ndelenee nwa yo omaviinyu manini omolwoudu woye wendjadja nowoshifeta tashi ku hange efiku nefiku.
Omatimba ovanhu vamwe oku li poluhaela, notaa tetekele okupangulwa, ndele oo avamwe otae va shikula konima.
Osho tuu yo noilonga iwa oi li poluhaela, ndele naayo ihe li poluhaela itai dulu okukala ya hondama.
6: Aveshe ava ve li mondjoko youpika, nava fimaneke shili oovene vavo, edina laKalunga nelongo opo liha shekifwe.
Ndelenee ava ve noovene vavo ovaitaveli, inave va dina, shaashi vo ovamwaxe, ndelenee nave va longele shili, osheshi vo ovaitaveli novaholike. Longa oinima ei nokukumaida.
Ngeenge ope na ou ta nongeke shimwe shi lili ndele ita dame meendjovo edi diwa dOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nomelongo lopatilokalunga,
oye ote linenepeke, ye ke na eendunge, ndelenee ota yenwa komapulapulo, eemhata nokomatomhafano muwo tamu di efupa nondubo nomatukafano nomalimbililo mai,
netamatamo lihe noshilonga movanhu ve neendunge da nyonauka, ndele va kanifa oshili ndele tava tale kutya, etilokalunga olo oshilikolifo shemona lomounyuni.
Heeno, etilokalunga olo eliko linene shili, shamha omunhu a wana naai yaye.
Osheshi fye inatu eta mo sha mounyuni, ndele itatu dulu okudja mo na sha.
Ndelenee ngeenge otu na oipalwifa noikutu, osho tuu nashi tu wanene.
Ndelenee ava va hala okupunapala, otava wile momahongaulo nomomwiyo nomouhalu uhapu woulai nowoiponga, tau ninginifa ovanhu menyonauko nomekano.
Osheshi olwisho loimaliwa olo efina lowii aushe, nomoku li haluka vamwe va puka mo meitavelo, ve lityuulifa nomaudjuu mahapu.
Ndelenee oove, omunhu waKalunga, inda onhapo oinima ya tya ngaha, lalakanena ouyuki netilokalunga neitavelo nohole nelididimiko noutalanheni.
Kondja ekondjo liwa leitavelo, dama omwenyo waalushe we u ifanenwa ndele wa hepaulula ehepaululo liwa moipafi yeendobwedi dihapu.
Ohandi ku lombwele koshipala shaKalunga, ou omuyandji womwenyo kwaaishe noshaKristus Jesus, ou a hepaulula ehepaululo liwa koshipala shaPontius Pilatus,
nokutya, ove u diinine oshipango eshi uhe nonyata ile uhe noshipo fiyo okeholoko lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus,
ou ta ka hololwa pefimbo laye kOmupangeli omunelao, ou Omupangeli aeke, Ohamba yeehamba adishe nOmwene woovene,
ou aeke ita fi noha kala mouyelelelela omu itamu shiiva okwiiwa, Oye ina monika nande okomunhu, Ye ita dulu okutalwa. Efimano olaye neenghono daalushe odaye. Amen.
Oipuna yomounyuni ou va kumaida, vehe linenepeke, navali vaha tule elineekelo lavo moupuna kau fi okulineekelwa, ndelenee nave lineekele Kalunga omunamwenyo, ou he tu pe pauyadi aishe yoku tu hafifa,
vo nava longe ouwa, va ninge oipuna yoilonga iwa, va ninge ovayandji nokutukulilafana,
vo ve lituvikilile emona tali ningi ekanghameno liwa laayo yokomesho, opo va mone omwenyo waalushe.
Heeno, Timoteus, tuvikila nokudiinina eshi we shi pewa, ove yepa omapopyaano a nyata noongaho neemhata doipupulu hadi tiwa eshiivo vati,

eshiivo eli la itavelwa kuvamwe, ava ve liteeka eitavelo.
Efilonghenda nali kale nanye.

1: Paulus omuyapostoli waJesus Kristus kehalo laKalunga, paudaneko lomwenyo womuKristus Jesus,

okuTimoteus, omona wange omuholike.
Efilonghenda nonghenda nombili kuKalunga Tate nokuKristus Jesus, Omwene wetu!
Ame ohandi pandula Kalunga, ou handi mu longele, nghee sha dja kootatekulu neliudo la yela, ngaashi ihandi efa oku ku dimbulukwa momailikano ange oufiku nomutenya
mokudimbulukwa omahodi oye ondi nodjuulufi oku ku mona, opo ame ndi yadifwe ehafo,
eshi nda dimbulukwa eitavelo yo lomwoove lihe noihelele, olo la kala tete munyokokulu Loide nomunyoko Eunike, ndele ondi shi shii shili, oli li yo mwoove.
Onghee hano ohandi ku dimbulukifa u xwameke oshalinghenda yaKalunga, ei we i pewa, eshi nde ku tenheka omake ange.
Osheshi Kalunga ine tu pa omhepo youmbada, ndelenee oyeenghono noyohole noyelididimiko.
Hano ino fya ohoni okuhepaulula Omwene wetu, naame omumangwa waye, ino fya nge ohoni, ndelenee tu humbate kumwe oudjuu omolwevaengeli paenghono daKalunga,
ou e tu xupifa nokwe tu ifana neifano liyapuki hamolwoilonga yetu, ndelenee opamhangela yaye mwene nopafilonghenda eli fye twe li pewa oshali muKristus Jesus manga ounyuni inau hovela,
ndelenee ola hololwa paife okeholoko lOmukulili wetu Kristus Jesus, ou a hanauna po efyo nokwa eta pouyelele omwenyo nokuhaxulapo, okevaengeli,
omolwalo nda tulwa po omuudifi nomuyapostoli nomulongi.

Olo tuu eli handi hepekelwa ngaha, ndelenee itandi fi ohoni, osheshi ame ondi mu shii ou nde mu lineekela, ndele ondi shi shii shili, Oye oku neenghono dokutuvikilila nge oshipewa shange fiyo okefiku linya.
Diinina oshihopaelelwa sheendjovo odo diwa we di uda kwaame meitavelo nomohole, oyo i li muKristus Jesus.
Oshipewa osho shiwa we shi pewa shi diinina mOmhepo Iyapuki, tai kala mufye.
Ove ou shi shii nokutya, aveshe ava ve li muAsia ova fiya nge po, ngaashi Figelus naHermogenes.
Omwene na file eumbo laOnesiforus onghenda, osheshi luhapu a hekeleka nge, ye ina fya ohoni omalyenge ange.
Ndelenee eshi e uya kuRoma, okwa konga nge unene nokwa mona nge.
Omwene ne mu kwafe, ye na mone onghenda kOmwene mefiku linya. Oove mwene u shi shii nawa, nhumbi ye a yakula nge shili muEfeso.
2: Oove hano, omumwange, likolelela mefilonghenda eli li li muKristus Jesus;
ndele osho wa uda kwaame mokati keendobwedi dihapu, shi yandja kovalumenhu ve shi okulineekelwa, va wana oku shi longa vakwao yo.
Ove, humbata oudjuu, ngaashi omukwaita muwa waKristus Jesus.
Kape na omukwaita te lipyakidile oipalwifa, osheshi a hala okuwapalela ou, e mu shivila moukwaita.
Ndele ou ta kala mefiyafano, ita pewa oshishani, ngeenge ita fiyafana po pamaufo.
Omunepya ou te lihepeke oye e nokupewa tete oiimati.
Diladila nawa eshi handi shi ku lombwele, osheshi Omwene ote ku pe omayele moinima aishe.
Dimbulukwa, Jesus Kristus, ou a nyumunwa movafi, Oye a dja mepata laDavid pavaengeli lange,
mulo handi humbata oudjuu fiyo omeemhango, nda fa omukolokoshi; ndelenee eendjovo daKalunga inadi mangwa.
Onghee ohandi lididimikile ashishe eshi omolwovahoololwa, opo navo yo va mone exupifo li li muKristus Jesus noshinge shaalushe.

ngeenge hatu lididimikeni,
ohatu ka kaleni nokupangela yo pamwe naye;
ndelenee ngeenge ohatu mu likale,
Oye ote ke tu likala yo.

Fye ngeenge twa kala inatu diinina,
Oye ta kala omudiinini,
osheshi Ye ita dulu okulikala Ye mwene.”
Va dimbulukifa oinima ei noku va lombwela koshipala shOmwene, vaha patafane eendjovo dongaho dihe na nande ekwafo, ndelenee otadi kanifa ovapwilikini.
Diinina, u monike kuKalunga oove omufindani momayeleko, omulongi ita fi ohoni oshilonga shaye, e shii okutukula nawa ondjovo yoshili.
Ndelenee livangeka eendjovo da nyata nomapopyaano ongaho, osheshi ava tava kwatafana nado, ovo tava ka pwila mo moudinikalunga,
ndele eendjovo davo otadi ka tandavela muvo ngaashi oudu wombulwa, vamwe vomuvo Himeneus naFiletus,
vo ova kanduka mo moshili, eshi tava ti: enyumuko ola ningwa nale, ndele tava nyono po eitavelo lavamwe.
Nande ongaha, ekanghameno la pama laKalunga tali kala la pamenena, ndele ou na oshihako eshi: “Omwene ava vaye oku va shii, nakeshe tuu ou ta ifana edina lOmwene, na efe ouhenouyuki.”
Ndelenee meumbo linene ihamu kala oiyuma yoshingoldo noyoshisiliveli aike, ohamu kala yo yoiti noyedu, imwe oya fimana, ikwao inai fimana.
Hano, ngeno ope na ou te liyelifa mwaai, ye ota ningi oshiyuma sha fimana sha yapulwa shi noshilonga kumwene washo, sha wapalela keshe tuu oshilonga shiwa.
Ndelenee inda onhapo yokahalu kounyasha, ndele shikula ouyuki neitavelo, nohole nombili pamwe naava tava ifana Omwene nomutima wa yela.
Ndele hanyena omapulapulo a nyika oulai, ndele ehe neendunge, osheshi u shi shii, oo otaa dala eemhata;
ndelenee omupiya wOmwene ina wapala okutwa eemhata, oye e nokukala e nonheni naaveshe, omulongi ta shiiva okulonga nokulididimikila owii;
ye e nokupukulula ovanandubo e nombili, ngeno Kalunga e va pe elidilululo opo va shiive oshili,
ndele va ninge vali eendunge, va kololokwe, va manguluke mo momwiyo waSatana, ou e va manga okulonga ehalo laye.
3: Ndelenee kala u shi shii, momafiku axuuninwa otape ke uya omafimbo madjuu,
osheshi ovanhu otava kala nokulihola voovene, ovanalwisho voimaliwa, ovalitangi, novalinenepeki novasheki, vehe neduliko kovakulunhu, vehe shii kupandula, vehe neitavelo,
vehe nohole, vehe nombili, ovalundili, ovahenalidiliko, ovakwanyanya, ovatondi vouwa,
ovakengeleledi, ovahayavala, ovafulalali, ohole yavo yokuhola ouhalu mwii i dule ei yokuhola Kalunga;
ovo ve nemoniko longaho letilokalunga, ndelenee tava shilike eenghono dalo. Naava ve li ngaha, va kukuma.
Vamwe vomuvo hava pumine momaumbo, tava heke ovakainhu ava va lololwa koulunde, ndele tava telaanifwa kouhalu u lili nau lili,
ava tava kala alushe nokulilonga, ndelenee vo kave na apa tava ka fika keshiivo loshili.
Ngaashi naanaa Jannes naJambres va li va twa ondubo naMoses, osho yo ava ve nondubo noshili, vo ovanhu va nyonauka meendunge, itava dulu momayeleko eitavelo.
Ndelenee vo kave na apa tava ehene komesho, osheshi oulai wavo otau ka holokela aveshe, ngaashi waavenya wa holoka yo.
Ndelenee ove wa ninga omushikuli wange momalongo nomeenghedi, meemhangela, meitavelo, moutalanheni, mohole, melididimiko,
momataatao, momayehameko, ngaashi ame nda hepekelwa muAntiokia nomuIkonium nomuListra. Omataatao oku fike peni nde a humbata! Ndelenee Omwene okwa xupifa nge mo muo aeshe.
Ndele aveshe ovo va hala okukala metilokalunga muKristus Jesus, otava ka hepekwa.
Ndelenee ovanhu vai novakengeleledi otava ka ehena komesho mowii nokupukifa nokupuka.
Ndelenee ove kala mwaai we i longwa ndele ou i shii shili, osheshi ou mu shii ou e i ku longa,
ndele omishangwa diyapuki ou di shii nghee wa dja mounona woye, edi di neenghono doku ku longa eendunge, u xupifwe mokwiitavela Kristus Jesus.
Omishangwa adishe da yandjwa keenghono dOmhepo yaKalunga odi shii kulonga nokukumaida nokupukulula nokutekula mouyuki,
omunhu womuKalunga opo a kale a wana nokwa wanenena oshilonga keshe shiwa.
4: Ohandi ku anifa koshipala shaKalunga noshOmwene Kristus Jesus, ou te uya okutokola ovanamwenyo novafi okokuholoka kwaye nokouhamba waye,
udifa ondjovo; shi ninga mefimbo liwa nomefimbo lii; hanyena, vela ombedi, kumaida monheni nokulonga,
osheshi otape uya efimbo vo tava kenyanana elongo la yuka, ndelenee pauhalu wavo otave ke likongela ovalongi ngaashi omatwi avo taa nyuwa.
Nomatwi avo otave a pilike koshili, ndele tava pwilikine eengano.
Ndelenee ove kala omulidiliki moinima aishe, humbata oudjuu, longa oshilonga shomuudifi wevaengeli, wanifa nawa oshilongayakulo shoye.
Osheshi ame ohandi tilwashi nokuli ngaashi eyambo ndele efimbo lange lokutukuka ola fika.
Ame onda lwa olwoodi liwa, onda xulifa etondoko, neitavelo nde li diinina.
Opo nee nda tuvikililwa oshishani shouyuki handi ke shi pewa mefiku linya kOmwene, omutokoli omuyuki, ndelenee haame andike, naaveshe ava ve hole eholoko laye.
Endelela diva u uye kwaame.
Osheshi Demas mokuhola ounyuni ou wopaife, okwa fiya nge po, ndele ta i kuTessalonika, Kreskens okwa ya kuGalatia, Titus okuDalmatia.
Lukas oye aeke a kala pwaame. Kufa Markus, mu uye naye, osheshi ye e noshilonga kwaame a yakule nge.
Tikikus onde mu tuma kuEfeso.
Elwakani lange linya nda fiya kuTroas meumbo laKarpus, li etelela, fiku to uya, nomishangwa, unene omishangwa edi domapergamenti.
Aleksander, omuhambwidi woshikushu, okwa ninga nge nai unene; Omwene ote ke mu pa shi fike poilonga yaye.
Naave yo mu londoka, osheshi ye okwa lwifa eendjovo detu neenghono.
Moihokolola yange yotete kapa li nande umwe ta popile nge, ndelenee aveshe ova fiya nge po. Eshi inashi va velifa eembedi.
Ndelenee Omwene okwa kala pamwe naame, nokwa pameka nge, eudifo levaengeli opo li wanifwe kwaame novapaani aveshe ve li ude; ndele ame onda xupifwa mokanya konghoshi.
Ndele Omwene ota ka mangulula nge mo mukeshe tuu oshilonga showii, ndele ta ka xupifa nge mouhamba waye womeulu. Kuye efimano alushe fiyo alushe. Amen.
Kundifa Priskila naAkwila neumbo laOnesiforus.
Erastus okwa fyaala muKorinto, Trofimus onde mu fiya muMileto, ta vele.
Endelela, u uye fimbo okufu inaku ya. Eubulus ote ku kundile po naPudens naLinus naKlaudia novamwatate aveshe.
Omwene Jesus Kristus na kale nomhepo yoye. Efilonghenda nali kale nanye.

1: Paulus, omupiya waKalunga nomuyapostoli waJesus Kristus, omolweitavelo lovahoololwa vaKalunga neshiivo loshili lopatilokalunga,
opateelelo lomwenyo waalushe, ou wa udanekwa kuKalunga iha fufya, nalenale efimbo manga inali hovela,
ndelenee efimbo eshi la fika, okwa holola ondjovo yaye meudifo, nde i pewa pamhangela yaKalunga, Omukulili wetu,
okuTitus, omona wange shili paitavelo letu limwe, efilonghenda nombili kuKalunga Tate nokuKristus Jesus, Omukulili wetu.
Eshi nde ku fiya muKreta, ou yukife, eshi ame nda fiya po inashi yukifwa, ove u nangeke moshilando keshe ovakulunhu, ngaashi ame nde shi ku lombwela;
omukulunhu ou na kale ehe noshipo, omulumenhu womukainhu umwe aeke, e novana ovaitaveli, ihava popiwa ve hole oipala, vo kave fi ovo ihava dulika.
Osheshi omufitaongalo oku nokukala ehe noshipo ngaashi sha wapalela elenga laKalunga, hanakulihola mwene, hamuhandunhu, hangholwe, hamukolokoshi, hamukongi weliko loulunde,
ndelenee e shi okuyakula ovaenda, e hole ouwa, omunambili, omuyuki nomuyapuki nomulidiliki,
e nokudama mondjovo ei i shii okulineekelwa yopalongo, opo a dule ngaha okukumaida nelongo la pama nokutomha ava tava tu eemhata.
Osheshi ope na vahapu ve neenyamukudi, tava popyaana ongaho novapukifi, unene mokati kovapiti vetanda.
Omakanya avo e nokuumikwa. Vo ohava dongakanifa omaumbo nokuli mokulonga eshi inashi wapala okulongwa, molweliko longaho.
Umwe womokati kavo, omuxunganeki wavo vene, okwa tile: “Ovakreta alushe ovanaipupulu, vo oilyani novafukenhu.”
Ehepaululo olo oloshili, onghee hano va hanyena shili neenghono, vo va veluke meitavelo,
ndele vaha shikule eengano dOvajuda noipango yovanhu, ava va pilamena oshili.
Kovakoshoki oinima aishe ya koshoka: ndele kwaava va nyata ndele vehe neitavelo, kave na sha sha koshoka, osheshi eendunge neliudo lavo ola nyata.
Vo otava ti ova shiiva Kalunga, ndelenee moilonga yavo otave mu likale, osheshi ovo oikungifa yongaho, ihava dulika, inava wana okulonga oshilonga nande shimwe shiwa.
2: Ndelenee ove tonga eshi sha wapalela elongo liwa.
Ovashamane nava kale ovalidiliki, ve neenghedi da fimana, ovakoshoki, ve li nawa meitavelo nomohole nomelidiliko.
Osho tuu novakainhu nava kale ve neenghedi da wapalela ovayapuki, vehe fi ovalundili, havapika voikunwa ihapu, ndelenee ovalongi vomwaashi shiwa,
opo va shiive okupukulula ovakainhu ovanyasha vo va kale ve hole ovalumenhu vavo nokuhola ovana vavo,
ndele va kale ve neenghedi diwa novakoshoki ve shii okutekula omaumbo avo, ve nomwenyo muwa, ndele tava dulika kovalumenhu vavo vene, opo ondjovo yaKalunga iha shekifwe.
Novalumenhu ovanyasha va kumaida yo va kale ovalidiliki.
Ove mwene liulikila omuhopaelelwa moilonga aishe iwa, nelongo loye nali kale la yela nola fimana
neendjovo doye nadi kale diwa nodihe noshipo, omunandubo a fifwe ohoni eshi ina mona omhito oku tu popila molwii.
Kumaida ovapiya va dulike koovene vavo, vo ve va hafife moinima aishe, inava kala neenyamukudi,
vaha vake, ndelenee va holole oudiinini meenghedi adishe, opo va wapaleke mwaaishe elongo laKalunga, Omukulili wetu.
Osheshi efilonghenda laKalunga ola holoka li etele ovanhu aveshe exupifo,
ndele tali tu tekula, fye tu efe okudina Kalunga nouhalu wopaunyuni, fye tu kale tu neendunge nouyuki nokuhola Kalunga fimbo tu li mounyuni ou wopaife,
mokuteelela kwetu ewanifo leteelelo lelao neholoko loshinge shaKalunga omunene nolOmukulili wetu Jesus Kristus,
Oye ou e liyandja ponhele yetu e tu kulile mo mowii aushe Ye e liyelifile oshiwana shaye mwene, osho hashi diinine shili oilonga iwa.
Oinima ei i tonga noku va kumaida noku va hanyena meenghono adishe we di pewa. Paha kale nande umwe te ku dini.
3: Va dimbulukifa, va dulike kovapangeli nokovakulunhu voshilongo noku va fimaneka, vo va kale ve lilongekidila oshilonga keshe shiwa,
vaha tuke nande omunhu, vaha patafane, ndele nava kale nombili ve nonghenda novanhu aveshe.

Osheshi nafye yo nale otwa li tuhe neendunge, fye inatu dulika, otwa li twa puka notwa li ovapika vouhalu u lili nou lili, fye twa kala mowii nomefupandubo ndele twa li twa tondwa ndele twa tondafana.
Ndelenee ouwa waKalunga, Omukulili wetu nohole yokuhola ovanhu eshi ya holoka,
Oye okwe tu xupifa hamolwoilonga youyuki twe i longa ngeno, ndelenee opafilonghenda laye kekosho ledalululo noleshitululo lOmhepo Iyapuki,
e i tilila mufye ihapu muJesus Kristus, Omukulili wetu,
opo fye ngaashi twa yukipalifwa kefilonghenda laye, tu ninge ovafyuululi vomwenyo waalushe pateelelo.
Ondjovo ei oya pama, ndele nda hala u i longe noudiinini, opo ava va itavela Kalunga va diinine shili okulonga oilonga iwa; osho nee osha wapala notashi kwafa ovanhu.
Ndelenee yepa omapulapulo oulai nomavalulo omapata, nondubo neemhata dokupatafanena omhango, osheshi oinima ei oyongaho noitai kwafa sha.
Omunaimhanga mu kukuma, ngeenge we mu kumaida lumwe ile luvali.
Osheshi u shi shii omunhu a tya ngaha a puka ndele ta longo oulunde nokwe litokola ye mwene.
Fiku handi tumu kwoove Artemas ile Tikikus, ove mwene endelela u uye kwaame muNikopolis, osheshi onda tokola ndi kale ko okufu.
Senas, omunongomhango, naApollos va lekela, ove u va longekide nawa, va kale ve na adishe tave di pumbwa.
Naava vetu yo nave lilonge okukwafa oku ku noluhepo, vaha kale vehe noiimati.
Aveshe ava ve li pwaame otave ku kundile po. Kundila po ava ve tu hole meitavelo. Efilonghenda nali kale nanye amushe.

1:
Paulus, omukwatwa waKristus Jesus nomumwatate Timoteus.
OkuFilemon omuholike, omulongi pamwe nafye
nokomumwameme omukainhu Appia nokomukwaita mukwetu Arkippus nokeongalo olo hali ongala meumbo loye.
Efilonghenda kunye nombili yaKalunga Tate yetu noyOmwene Jesus Kristus!
Ame ohandi pandula Kalunga kange alushe moku ku dimbulukwa momailikano ange,
osheshi onda uda ohole yoye neitavelo loye okwiitavela Omwene Jesus nokuhola ovayapuki aveshe,
ohandi ilikana, eitavelo loye, olo tuu olo tu li kwete atushe, li kale la pama mokushiiva ouwa aushe ou tu u na muKristus Jesus.
Osheshi onda pewa ehafo linene nehekeleko molwohole yoye, osheshi omitima dovayapuki oda hekelekwa kwoove, omumwatate.
Onghee hano nande ame onda wana, muKristus, oku ku lombwela u longe eshi shi nokulongwa,
ndele omolwohole ohandi ku indile shaashi ndi li ngaashi ndi li, aame Paulus nda kulupa, nopaife omukwatwa nokuli waKristus Jesus,
ohandi ku indile molwomumwange ou nde mu dala ndi li momalyenge aa, Onesimus ou,
nale okwa li ehe noshilonga oku ku kwafa, ndelenee paife e noshilonga kwoove nokwaame. Ame ohandi mu shunifa.
Ndelenee mu tambula ngaashi omutima wange.
Onda li nda hala a kale pwaame, a kwafe nge ponhele yoye meemhango edi devaengeli;
ndelenee inandi hala okuninga sha, ndihe neitavelelo loye, opo ouwa woye uha dje mokufininika, ndelenee omehalo liwa.
Kashiimba ye okwa li e nokukala mwe litukuka efimbo lixupi, opo u kale u mu kwete alushe,
hangaashi omupika vali, ndelenee e dule omupika, ongaashi omumwaxo omuholike e holike shili kwaame ndelenee unenenene kwoove, omombelela nomOmwene.
Hano ngee wa tala nge aame omukweni, mu tambula ngaashi ame mwene;
ndele ngee e na eshi a nyona kwoove, ile e ku lila eengunga, di valulile nge.
Aame Paulus nde shi shanga neke lange mwene: ame ohandi ka futa, ndiha tye: Futa ove mwene; osheshi owa lila nge eengunga ove mwene.
Heeno, omumwatate, ngeno u kwafe nge mOmwene. Hekeleka omutima wange muKristus.
Ohandi ku shangele nokulineekela eduliko loye, ndi shi shii nokutya, ove oto ka longa shi dule eshi nda tonga.
Ndele ohandi ku lombwele yo, longele nge onhele kombuleni, osheshi ondi na eteelelo, otamu pewa nge omolwomailikaneno eni.
Epafras, omukwatwa pamwe naame muKristus Jesus, ote mu kundile po,
naMarkus naAristarkus naDemas naLukas, ovalongi pamwe naame.
Efilonghenda lOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nomhepo yeni. Amen.
Kalunga eshi kwa li a popifa mefimbo lonale ootate luhapu nopaenghedi di lili nodi lili movaxunganeki,
paife momafiku tuu aa opexulilo okwe tu popifa mOmona ou e mu tula omufyuululi waaishe, Oye tuu ou e mu shitifa yo omaunyuni, noinima aishe pexulilo otai ka ninga yaye.

Oye evadimo lefimano laye nolupe loukwatya waye, ou ha humbatifa oinima aishe ondjovo yeenghono daye, Ye eshi a wanifa muye mwene ekoshelo lomatimba etu, okwa kala omutumba kolulyo lOmufimanekwa mokombadambada,
nokwa ninga omunene e dule ovaengeli, ngaashi a fyuulula edina li dule lavo.

Osheshi onaini a popifa umwe womovaengeli nande lumwe:
“Oove Omona wange,
onena tuu eli nde ku dala,”
ile:
“Ame ohandi ningi Xe,
Oye ta kala Omumwange?”

Nongaashi eshi ta eta mo vali Oshiveli shaye mounyuni, ota ti:
“Novaengeli aveshe vaKalunga ove nokulinyongamena kuye.”

Novaengeli te va tongo ngaha:
“Ovaengeli vaye ote va shitukifa eemhepo
novapiya vaye omalaka omundilo.”

Ndelenee kOmona ota ti:
“Olukalwapangelo loye, Kalunga, otali kala po fiyo alushe
nodibo yoye youhamba woye oyo odibo youyuki.

Ndele vali:
“Ove, Omwene, nalenale wa shita edu
nomaulu oo oilonga yomake oye,

oyo tai xulu po, ndele Ove to kalelele.
Inya otai kulupa po aishe ya fa oshikutu,

ndele to ke i tonya ngaashi elwakani,
ndele tai ka shituka,
ndele Ove oto kalelele ngaashi wa kala ko,
nomido doye itadi xulu po.”

Ndele olyelye mbela womovaengeli
a lombwelwa kuye nande lumwe:
“Kala omutumba kolulyo lange,
fiyo handi ningi ovatondi voye oshilyatelo
shokeemhadi doye?”
Ovo aveshe kave fi eemhepo dokuyakula, va tuminwa eyakulo laavo tava ka fyuulula exupifo?
2: Onghee hano otu nokudiinina edi twe di uda tuhe di pitilile.
Osheshi ondjovo ei oya popififwa ovaengeli eshi ya li ya pama, netauluko keshe nokuhadulika keshe okwa mona ehandukilo la yuka,
hano fye ohatu i ngahelipi onhapo, ngeenge hatu dini exupifo linene li fike apa, la udifwa tete kOmwene ndele la pamekwa kwaava ve li uda, ndele tave li fikifa kufye,
eshi Kalunga yo a hepaulula pamwe navo nomadidiliko noikumwifalonga noilonganghono i lili neeshali dOmhepo Iyapuki pahalo laye.
Osheshi ounyuni ou tau uya, ou hatu u tongo, ine u tula mepangelo lovaengeli.

Ndele umwe a hepaulula monhele imwe ndele ta ti:
“Omunhu omushike, eshi ho mu dimbulukwa,
nomona womunhu eshi ho mu file oshisho?

Okafimbo kaxupi we mu ninipikile,
e dulike kovaengeli,
nowe mu dika oshinge nefimano
ndele we mu pa epangelo kombada yoilonga yomake oye.

Oinima aishe owe i tula koshi yeemhadi daye.”
Osheshi eshi e mu tulila aishe mepangelo laye, ina fiya po nande shimwe inashi findilwa koshi yaye. Ndelenee paife katu wete natango nokutya, aishe oya findilwa mo.
Ndelenee ou a ninipikilwa okafimbo kanini e dulike kovaengeli, Jesus, otu mu wete a dikwa oshinge nefimano omolwouyehame wokufya, opo a lole efyo ponhele yaaveshe okefilonghenda laKalunga.
Osheshi sha wapalela ou, aishe i li omolwaye naaishe ya dja muye, mOmwene wexupifo lavo, e mu lenge mouyehame, a kale a wana nokutwala ovana vahapu moshinge.
Osheshi ou ta yapula naava va yapulwa, aveshe ova dja muumwe, onghee ita fi ohoni oku va ifana ovamwaxe,

eshi ta ti:
“Edina loye onda hala oku li shiivifila vakwetu
nomokati keongalo ohandi ku imbile ehambelelo.”

Navali:
“Elineekelo lange ohandi li tula muye,”
nadimwe vali:
“Tala, aame nounona ava Kalunga e va pa nge.”
Hano ngaashi ounona va ninga ombelela nohonde, naye yo okwa kwatafana navo opanghedi tuu oyo imwe, opo a hanaune po nefyo laye ou a kala e nepangelo lefyo nokutya, Satana,
ye opo a mangulule aveshe ava va li moupika woumbada wefyo mokukalamwenyo kwavo akushe.
Osheshi havaengeli te va tambula, ndelenee ta tambula oludalo laAbraham.
Onghee hano Ye okwa li e nokufaafana novamwaxe moinima aishe, opo a ninge omupristeli omukulunhu omunamutimanghenda nomudiinini moilonga yaye yopuKalunga, Ye a longele ovanhu edimepo lomatimba.
Osheshi Oye mwene, eshi a yehamekwa nokwa hongaulwa, ota dulu okukwafa ava tava hongaulwa.
3: Onghee hano, ovamwatate ovayapuki naava mwa ifanwa keifano lomeulu, omadiladilo eni a kanyatelifeni komuyapostoli nokomupristeli omukulunhu wehepaululo letu, Kristus Jesus,
ou e li po omudiinini kwaau e mu lenga ongaashi naMoses yo okwa li omudiinini meumbo laye alishe.
Osheshi Jesus a talwa e lilongela efimano linene li dule laMoses, ongaashi omutungi weumbo e nefimano linene li dule leumbo laye.
Osheshi keshe tuu eumbo oli nomutungi walo, ndelenee omutungi waaishe oKalunga.
Ndele Moses okwa li omudiinini meumbo laye alishe ngaashi omupiya, opo a kale ondobwedi yoipopiwa yokomesho,
ndelenee Kristus ngaashi Omona meumbo laye. Neumbo laye ofye, ngeenge hatu diinine shili eyombamo nelitango leteelelo fiyo okexulilo.

Onghee hano Omhepo Iyapuki ngaashi ta ti:
“Nena eli ngeenge tamu udu ondaka yaye,

inamu kukutika omitima deni,
ngaashi sha ningilwe meluliko
mefiku leyeleko mombuwa,

omo ooxo va shindile nge nova yelekele nge,
nande va mona oilonga yange oule womido omilongo ine.

Onghee hano onda handukila epupi olo
ndele nda tile: ‘Alushe momitima davo otava puka,
ndelenee vo inava shiiva eendjila dange,’

opo nee mehandu lange onda anene nda tya:
‘Ovo itava fiki metulumuko lange.’ ”
Shi pashukileni hano, ovamwatate, paha kale nande umwe womunye e nomutima mwii uhe neitavelo ndele ta efa Kalunga omunamwenyo.
Ndelenee kumaidafaneni keshe efiku manga tapa tiwa “nena,” paha kale nande oumwe womunye ta kukutikwa kekotokelo loulunde.
Osheshi fye otwa ningwa ovakwao vaKristus, shamha tuu hatu diinine elineekelo letu fiyo okexulilo ngaashi pehovelo.

Eshi tapa tiwa:
“Nena eli ngeenge tamu udu ondaka yaye,
inamu kukutika omitima deni ngaashi sha ningilwe meluliko.”
Oolyelye hano ava va udile ndele ve mu handukifa? Havaava aveshe va tembulwa kuMoses muEgipiti?
Oolyelye ava e va uditile ehandu omido omilongo ine? Havaava va nyona, noimhu yavo ya nyonaukila mombuwa?
Noolyelye e va anena: “Itave ke uya mo metulumuko laye? Havo tuu venya va li inava dulika?”
Ndele fye otu wete kutya, omolwokuhaitavela kwavo inava dula okuya mo.
4: Tu tileni hano, fimbo eudaneko okuya ketulumuko laye li li po, paha monike nande umwe womunye a fyaala ondjilakati.
Osheshi eendjovo diwa otwe di udifilwa yo ngaashi venya, ndelenee eendjovo deudifo inadi va kwafa, osheshi inadi kwatafana meitavelo noonaku di uda.

Osheshi fye ava twa itavela, ohatu i metulumuko, ngaashi Oye ta ti:
“Mehandu lange onda ana:
‘Ovo itava fiki metulumuko lange,’ ”
nande oilonga yaye ya pwa nghee tuu okeshito lounyuni.
Osheshi monhele imwe okwa tonga efiku etiheyali ta ti: “Efiku etiheyali Kalunga okwa tulumukwa koilonga yaye aishe,”

ndele paife naapa vali:
“Ovo itava ka fika metulumuko lange.”
Hano otashi kala ngaha: Vamwe tava i mo, ndele ovo va udifilwa tete eendjovo diwa inava ya mo molwokuhadulika.

Ye okwa pangela vali efiku limwe, efiku eli nokulombwelifa David, eshi pa pita efimbo lile li fike apa, ngaashi pa tiwa:
“Nena eli ngeenge tamu udu ondaka yaye,
inamu kukutika omitima deni.”
Osheshi Josua ngeno e va fikifa ketulumuko, ngeno Kalunga ina tonga vali efiku lokomesho.
Otapa kala hano etulumuko lEshabata lokomesho koshiwana shaKalunga.
Osheshi ou a ya metulumuko laye, oye ta tulumukwa yo koilonga yaye ngaashi Kalunga kuyaye mwene.
Hano tu diinineni tu fike metulumuko olo, paha kale nande umwe ta punduka nokushikula oshihopaenenwa shokuhadulika ngaashi venya.

Osheshi ondjovo yaKalunga oi nomwenyo neenghono, noi neememo i dule eongamukonda leememo keembinga mbali, otai tu, ndele tai tongola omwenyo nomhepo, eengolo nomungo; ndele i shii okutokola omadilongo nomadiladilo omutima.
Ndele kape na nande oshishitwa shimwe sha holekwa moipafi yaye, ndelenee aishe oya kala ngaho poluhaela momesho aye, kwaau tu noku mu lihepaululila.
Hano eshi tu nomupristeli omukulunhu a tokola omaulu, Jesus, Omona waKalunga, tu dameni hano kehepaululo.
Osheshi omupristeli wetu omukulunhu haye ou, ehe uditile oungone wetu olukeno, ndelenee Oye ou a shindwa moinima aishe ngaashi fye, ndelenee ke netimba.
Tu yeni hano kolukalwa lefilonghenda tu neyombamo, tu talwe nonghenda fye tu mone efilonghenda loku tu kwafa pefimbo liwa.
5: Osheshi keshe tuu omupristeli omukulunhu a dja movanhu, ota tulwa moshilonga omolwoinima yovanhu ve i na naKalunga, a yambe eeshali nomayambo omolwomatimba.
Oye e shii okufyonghenda ava vehe nounongo naava va puka, osheshi naye mwene yo a nyika oungone.
Nomolwoungone waye oye e nokuyamba ponhele yaye mwene yo, ngaashi ta yambe ponhele yoshiwana molwomatimba.
Kape na ou ta dulu okulikufila oulenga ou ye mwene, ndelenee ota ifanwa kuKalunga ngaashi Aron.

Osho tuu naKristus haye mwene e lilenga a kale omupristeli omukulunhu, ndelenee a lengwa kwaau a tya kuye:
“Oove Omona wange,
onena tuu eli nde ku dala.”

Ngaashi ta popi yo monhele imwe:
“Oove omupristeli fiyo alushe
opanghedi yaMelkisedek.”
Jesus a yandja pomafiku aye omombelela omayambo omaindilo nomailikano nokukuwa pombada nomahodi kwaau ta dulu oku mu xupifa mefyo, nokwa udika omolwetilokalunga.
Nande Oye Omona okwe lilonga eduliko okouyehame ou e u humbata,
ndele eshi a ningwa a wana a pwa, okwa ninga omuwanifi wexupifo laalushe kwaaveshe ava tava dulika kuye,
ou Kalunga e mu tula a kale Omupristeli omukulunhu panghedi yaMelkisedek.
Apa otu na shihapu okutonga, ndele ope noudjuu oku shi fatulula, osheshi mwa fya ounye okuuda.

Osheshi nye mokutala efimbo eli leni mOukriste, ngeno omwa wana okuninga ovalongindjovo, otamu pumbwa vali mu longwe omahovelo otete eendjovo daKalunga, notamu pumbwa natango omashini, haendja da pama.
Osheshi keshe tuu ou ta nyamifwa nomashini, oye ina twama meendjovo douyuki, osheshi oye okahanana.
Ndelenee eendja da pama odaava va kula, ava tava dulu kokwiika okutongola ouwa nowii.
6: Onghee hano tu efeni omahovelolongo aKristus, ndelenee tu lalakaneneni ewaneneno, tuha tungulule vali ekanghameno lelidilululo lokoilonga ya fya noleitavelo okwiitavela Kalunga,
nelongo lomashasho nomatenheko omake nenyumuko lovafi netokolo laalushe.
Nosho twa hala okuninga, Kalunga ngeenge te shi itavele.
Osheshi ava va li va minikilwa ndele va makela oshali shomeulu ndele va pewa Omhepo Iyapuki, ngee va efa eitavelo, otava ka nyengwa okwaaluka ve lidilulule;
ova makela ondjovo iwa yaKalunga neenghono defimbo lounyuni tau uya,
ndele ova efa, otava ka nyengwa okulidilulula vali, osheshi otave livalelele vali Omona waKalunga komushiyakano noku mu shekifa.
Osheshi edu eli tali nu odula tai li loko luhapu, ndele tali dalele ovo ve li longelwa yo, otali mono enangeko noupuna kuKalunga;
ndelenee ngeenge tali menifa eengwena neeshosholo, kali noshilonga, oli li popepi nokufingwa, nexulilo olo okuxwikwa po.
Ndelenee onye ovaholike, nande ohatu tongo ngaha, ohatu mu tale kutya, ei oiwa notai mu etele exupifo.
Osheshi Kalunga ke fi omuhenouyuki a dimbwe ngeno oilonga yeni nohole yeni mokufimanekifa edina laye, eshi mwa yakulile ovayapuki ndele hamu shi ningi natango.
Ndele otwa halelela shili keshe umwe womunye a holole ouhapu u fike pamwe, opo mu diinine mu kale mu neteelelo la pama fiyo okexulilo,
muha fye ounye, ndelenee mu ninge ovashikuli vaavenya va ninga keitavelo nokelididimiko ovafyuululi vaasho sha udanekwa.
Osheshi Kalunga eshi a pa Abraham eudaneko, okwe lianena Ye mwene, shaashi kapa li sha shimwe shi mu dule e shi anene,
ndele ta ti: “Oshili, ohandi ku punike nokupunikilila, nohandi ku hapupalifile nokuhapupalifilila.”
Ndele Abraham, eshi a teelela nokulididimika, a mona osho sha udanekwa.
Osheshi ovanhu ohava anene osho shi va dule, neano otali va pamekele oshinima ndele tali xulifa eemhata adishe.
Hano osho yo Kalunga eshi a hala okushiivifila shili ovafyuululi vomaudaneko nokutya, omhangela yaye kai nokulunduluka, okwe i pameka neano,
opo tu tuwe shili ouladi koinima oyo ivali itai lunduluka, muyo Kalunga ina dula okufufya, ofye ava twa ya onhapo, tu kanyatele keteelelo li li komesho,
olo tu li na, la fa ekanghamifo lomwenyo la pama nola kwatelela, la hanga meni mwi langhele metukulifo,
omo mwa yaJesus, omulotoki wokomesho ponhele yetu, eshi a ninga omupristeli omukulunhu panghedi yaMelkisedek fiyo alushe.
7: Osheshi Melkisedek ou, ohamba yaSalem, omupristeli waKalunga wOkombadambada, ou a shakeneka Abraham ndele te mu nangeke noupuna, Abraham eshi a finda eehamba,
ou Abraham e mu pa oshitimulongo moinima yaye aishe, oye tuu ou, ngaashi edina laye yo tali ti, tete “ohamba youyuki,” navali “ohamba yaSalem” nokutya, ohamba yombili;
ou ehe na nande xe ile ina ile epata, ke nexulilo lokukala kwaye ile ehovelo lomafiku aye, ndele e shii okuyelekwa nOmona waKalunga, Oye ta kala omupristeli alushelushe.
Taleni hano ye apa e fike, ou natatekulu Abraham mwene e mu pa oshitimulongo moihakanwa yaye.
Paife ovana vaLevi, ava va pewa oupristeli, ove noshipango va tambule pomhango oshitimulongo kovanhu, nokutya, kovamwaxe, nande ova dja moshinena shaAbraham.
Ndelenee ou nande ke fi omukwapata lavo, okwa tambula kuAbraham oshitimulongo nokwa nangeka noupuna ou kwa li e nomaudaneko.
Opo kape na nande eemhata nokutya, omunini ota nangekwa noupuna komukulunhu.
Ndelenee apa, ovanhu ovo ve nokufya, tava tambula oshitimulongo, ndele kwinya ou ta hepaululwa oku nomwenyo.
Ndele handi ti, naLevi yo, ou ha tambula oshitimulongo, okwa yandjela muAbraham oshitimulongo,
osheshi ye okwa li moshinena shaxekulu, Melkisedek eshi e mu shakeneka.
Hano ewaneneno ngeno la fikifwa koupristeli wOvalevi, osheshi molwao oshiwana sha pewa omhango, oshike hano kwa li ku nokuholoka omupristeli umwe e lili panghedi yaMelkisedek ndele hapanghedi yaAron?
Osheshi apa pe nelunduluko loupristeli, nomhango yo oi nokulunduluka;
osheshi ou te shi tongelwa, ye owomapata e lili, omu kwa li inamu dja nande oumwe a yakula moaltari.
Eshi sha shiivika vali okutya, Omwene wetu a dja mepata laJuda, olo Moses kwa li ine li lombwela sha kombinga youpristeli.
Ndele eshi tashi monika unene nawa shi dule penya, eshi tapa holoka omupristeli e lili a fa Melkisedek,
umwe ou ina ninga omupristeli palombwelo lomhango yopambelela, ndelenee okeenghono domwenyo itau nyonwa po.

Osheshi oye ta hepaululwa:
“Oove omupristeli fiyo alushe
opanghedi yaMelkisedek.”
Ndele osho ngaha onghedi ikulu tai dimwa po, osheshi oya li ihe neenghono noihe noshilonga,
ngaashi omhango inai dula okufikifa sha kewano; ndelenee ponhele yayo tapa tulwa eteelelo liwa li dule linya, mulo hatu ehene kuKalunga.
Ndele ngaashi eshi inashi ningwa pehe neano, osheshi venya va ninga ovapristeli paha li eano,

ndelenee ou e shi ningilwa neano, okwa nangekwa mo kwaau a tya kuye:
“Omwene okwa ana, ndele ite lialuluka:
‘Oove omupristeli fiyo alushe.’ ”
Osho ngaha Jesus a ninga omupameki wehangano liwa li dule linya.
Ndele venya va li vahapu va kala ovapristeli, shaashi va nyengwa okukala po omolwefyo,
ndelenee Oye shaashi ta kala po alushe, e noupristeli tau kalelele.
Onghee hano ota dulu yo okuxupifa shili ava tava ehene kuKalunga mokweendela muye, shaashi oku nomwenyo alushe, e va ilikanene.
Heeno, omupristeli omukulunhu a tya ngaha okwe tu wapalela yo, omuyapuki ehe nomatimba, ke na nande oshipo, a yoololwa movalunde, nokwa ningwa munene a yelwa pombada yomaulu.

Ou ita pumbwa ngaashi ovapristeli ovakulunhu, okuyamba keshe efiku, tete omolwomatimba aye mwene, opo nee a yambe omolwomatimba oshiwana. Osheshi Oye e shi ninga lumwe aluke, eshi e liyandja Ye mwene eyambo.
Osheshi omhango otai nangeke moupristeli ovakulunhu, ovanhu va nyika oungone, ndelenee ondjovo ei yeano, oyo ya shikula omhango, otai nangeke Omona ou a ningwa a wana a pwa fiyo alushe.
8: Ndelenee oshinima shinene shi dule ikwao eshi hatu shi popi paife osheshi: Otu nomupristeli omukulunhu e li ngaha, e li omutumba kolulyo lolukalwapangelo lOmufimanekwa meulu,
a kale omuyakuli woinima iyapuki nouyapukielela metwali lashili, la tungwa kOmwene, hakomunhu.
Osheshi keshe tuu omupristeli omukulunhu ta tulilwa po okuyamba eeshali nomayambo, onghee hano naye yo e nokukala e na sha shokuyamba.
Ngeno ye okwa li kombada yedu, ngeno ke fi omupristeli, osheshi ava hava yandje eeshali panghedi yomhango opo ve li,

ovo hava yakula mwaashi shi li efano nomudidimbe woikwaulu, ngaashi sha hololelwa Moses, eshi a li e nokudika etwalingulu, a lombwelwa kuKalunga: “Tala nawa, u longe oinima aishe pafano eli wa ulikilwa komhunda.”
Ndelenee paife Kristus a pewa oshilongayakulo shiwa shi dule shinya, ngaashi a ninga Omupokati wehangano liwa li dule linya, la dikilwa komaudaneko mawa e dule enya.
Osheshi linya lotete ngeno ola li la wana, ngeno likwao inali pumbiwa.

Osheshi ote va lombwele nokutanguna:
“Taleni, otape uya omafiku,
Omwene osho ta ti,
Ame ohandi dikile eumbo laIsrael
neumbo laJuda ehangano lipe,

hehangano la fa olo nde li ningila ooxo
efiku nde va kwata kokwooko
nde va kufa mo medu laEgipiti,
osheshi vo inava kala mehangano lange,
naame yo onde va efa po,
Omwene osho ta ti.

Osheshi ehangano olo
handi ke li ninga neumbo laIsrael
omafiku oo ngeenge a pita po, oleli,
Omwene osho ta ti:
Omhango yange ohandi ke i tula mo momadiladilo avo
nohandi ke i shangela momitima davo,
nosho ngaha ohandi ka kala Kalunga kavo,
ovo notava ka ninga oshiwana shange.

Ndele itapa ka kala vali umwe ta longo mukwao
ile omumwaxe ndele ta ti: ‘Shiiva Omwene,’ osheshi aveshe,
ounona novakulunhu vomuvo otava ka shiiva nge.

Ohandi ke va fila onghenda omolwomanyonauno avo,
nomatauluko avo itandi ke a dimbulukwa vali.”
Hano eshi ta ti: ehangano lipe, okwa shiivifa nokutya, linya lotete ola kulupa; ndele eshi sha kulupa nosha kulupilila, osha nyika okuxula po.
9: Heeno, nehangano linya lotete ola li li neemhango delongelokalunga nouyapukingulu walo woukwambada yedu,
osheshi etwali ola dikwa ngaha: tete omwa li mu nolupale lotete, omo mwa kala oshikwatelwalamba noshitaafula nomingome detaliko, onhele ei oya ifanwa “ouyapuki,”
ndele konima yetukulifo etivali okwa li ku na olupale la lukwa “ouyapukielela,”

omo mwa li mu noaltari yoshingoldo yokutwimina, noshikefa shehangano sha vaekwa noshingoldo keembinga adishe, musho omwa li oshimbudju shoshingoldo omo mwa kala omanna, onhaili yaAron ya tutuma omafo noipelendemanya yehangano,
nokombada yasho okwa fanekelwa ovakerubi voshinge va tuvika oshituviko shekwatakanifo, oinima ei kai nomhito yokupopiwa paife shimwe nashimwe.
Ndele oinima ei aishe eshi ya li ya longwa ngaha, ovapristeli ohava i mo efimbo keshe molupale lotete letwali okuwanifa oilongayakulo,
ndelenee mushinya oshitivali, omupristeli omukulunhu oye aeke ha i mo lumwe aluke omudo keshe, ita i mo ehe nohonde, te i yambele omolwaye mwene nomolwomatimba oshiwana, aa inaa ningwa owina.
Osho ngaha Omhepo Iyapuki ta holola ondjila yokuya mouyapukielela inai yeululwa, olupale lotete letwali fimbo li li po.
Eshi osho efaneko tali faneke efimbo lopaife, panghedi yasho tapa yandjwa eeshali nomayambo oo itaa dulu okuninga omuyakuli womelongelokalunga a kale a wana a pwa meliudo laye,
ndelenee ngaashi oinakuliwa noikwakunuwa, nomalikoshelo e lili no ku lili, oyo omhango yopambelela, ya tulwa po i kale fiyo efimbo lomhango ipe le uya.
Ndelenee Kristus eshi a ninga omupristeli omukulunhu wouwa wokomesho, okwa tokola metwali linene nola wanenena li dule linya, noinali tungwa nomake, nokutya olo kali fi lomeshito eli,
nokwa ya mo mouyapukielela hanohonde yoikombo noyeenhana, ndelenee onohonde yaye mwene lumwe aluke, nokwa wanifa ekulilo laalushe.
Osheshi ohonde yeemhedi noyoikombo ya shaminwa nomute wondema yondjelipa wa undwa kwaava va nyata, ngeenge tau va yapula, otava koshoka pambelela,
unene hano ohonde yaKristus, ou a li ehe na nande oshipo, e liyandja Ye mwene eyambo kuKalunga okOmhepo yaalushe, oyo tai ka kosha omaliudo etu okoilonga ei ya fya okulongela Kalunga omunamwenyo.
Onghee hano Oye a ninga Omupokati wehangano lipe, osheshi efyo laye ola ninga ekulilo lomanyono efimbo lehangano lotete, ovaifanwa opo va mone efyuululo laalushe la udanekwa.
Osheshi apa pe na eudaneko lefyuululo, efyo lomufyuululifi li nokushiivika shili,
osheshi eudaneko lefyuululo otali pamekwa kokufya, lo kali neenghono omufyuululifi fimbo e nomwenyo.
Onghee hano nehangano linya lotete yo inali yapulwa pehe nohonde,

osheshi Moses eshi kwa li a mana okuleshela oshiwana ashishe oipango aishe pamhango, okwa kufa ohonde yeenhana noyoikombo pamwe nomeva nolududi litilyana, naisopi nokwa shamina omushangwa woovene noshiwana ashishe,
nokwa tya: “Ohonde ei oyo yehangano olo Kalunga e li mu dikila.”
Ndele osho tuu etwali noikwatelwa aishe yomelongelokalunga okwe i shamina nohonde.
Ndele hanga aishe tai yapulwa nohonde pamhango, nokape nekufilepo lomatimba pehe netiko lohonde.
Hano omafano aainya yomeulu e nokuyapulwa nomayambo e li ngaha, ndelenee oikwameulu yoovene i nokuyapulwa nomayambo mawa e dule aa.
Osheshi Kristus ina ya mouyapuki wa tungwa nomake, oo efano longaho laawinya washili, ndelenee okwa ya meulu loovene, opo a ka holoke koshipala shaKalunga paife molwetu,
hakutya, e liyandje eyambo luhapu, ngaashi omupristeli omukulunhu ha i mo keshe omudo mouyapukielela e nohonde ihe fi yaye mwene,

osheshi ngeno kasha li ngaha, ngeno okwa li a wana okuhepekwa luhapu nghee tuu ounyuni wa shitwa. Ndelenee paife Oye a holoka lumwe aluke opexulilo lomafimbo ounyuni, a kufe po omatimba okeliyandjo laye mwene ngeyambo.
Nongaashi ovanhu va ufilwa ve nokufya lumwe aluke nokomesho etokolo,
osho tuu naKristus yo, eshi a yandjelwe lumwe aluke eyambo a kufe po omatimba avahapu, ta ka holoka olutivali ehe netimba kwaava have mu teelele, va mone exupifo.
10: Osheshi omhango, shaashi oyo omudidimbe wongaho wouwa wokomesho, halupe loinima yoovene, itai dulu okuninga ava tava eta omayambo keshe omudo va kale va wana va pwa.
Ngeno osho, ngeno va mana okuyamba, osheshi ava tava longele ngaha Kalunga, shaashi va yapulwa nokuli palumwe vehe nomaliudo tae va pe eembedi molwomatimba avo.
Ndelenee momayambo omu na omadimbulukifo omatimba omudo keshe.
Osheshi ohonde yeemhedi noyoikombo itai dulu nande okukufa po omatimba.

Onghee hano Kristus mokuuya mounyuni ota ti:
“Omatomenoyambo neendjayambo ino a hala,
ndelenee wa longela nge olutu,
omaxwikiloyambo netimbayambo ino a hokwa,

opo Ame nda tonga: ‘Tala, ohandi uya,
momishangwa onda shangwa mo, okulonga ehalo loye, Kalunga.’ ”
Eshi a tya tete: “Omatomenoyambo neendjayambo nomaxwikiloyambo ino a hala noino a hokwa,” nande haa yambwa pamhango,
opo tuu ota ti vali: “Tala, ohandi uya okuwanifa ehalo loye, Kalunga.” Oye ota kufa po eshi shotete, a tule po oshitivali.
Mehalo tuu eli fye twa yapulwa okeyambo lolutu laJesus Kristus lumwe aluke nosha wana.
Nomupristeli keshe oha kala ofika efiku nefiku mokuwanifa oshilongayakulo shaye noha yambe luhapu omayambo oo tuu oo amwe, ehe na opo taa dulu okukufa po omatimba;
ndelenee Kristus, eshi a yandja eyambo limwe alike ofiyo alushe molwomatimba, okwa kala omutumba kolulyo laKalunga,
nota teelele ashike ovatondadi vaye va ningwe oshilyato sheemhadi daye.
Osheshi neyambo limwe alike okwa wanifila alushe fiyo alushe ava tava ka yapulwa.
NOmhepo Iyapuki otai tu hepaululile eshi,

eshi ya tile:
“Ehangano olo handi ke li ninga ofye navo,
omafiku oo ngeenge a pita po, oleli,
Omwene osho ta ti:
Omhango yange ohandi ke i tula momitima davo
nohandi ke i shangela momadiladilo avo.”

Ndele ya tile vali:
“Omatimba avo nomatauluko avo itandi ke a dimbulukwa vali.”
Apa a dimwa po, itapa pumbwa vali eyambo molwomatimba.
Hano ovamwatate, eshi tu li po tu neyombamo la pama okuya mouyapukielela omolwohonde yaJesus,
ondjila ipe i nomwenyo e i tu yapulila, tai pitile moshitukulifo nokutya, mombelela yaye,
notu nomupristeli munene nomuleli weumbo laKalunga,
tu eheneni hano tu nomutima wa yuka notu neitavelo la pama, twa shaminwa momitima da kufwa omaliudo mai, nokolutu twa koshwa nomeva mayela.
Tu diinineni ehepaululo leteelelo letu tuhe nomatengauko, osheshi omuudaneki Oye omudiinini,
ndele tu filafaneni oshisho fye tu twaafane omukumo mohole nomoilonga iwa.
Tuha efe eongalo letu vene, ngaashi vamwe ve li po hava ningi, ndelenee tu kumaidafaneni, unene eshi tamu mono efiku olo tali ehene popepi.
Osheshi ngeenge hatu nyono owina nande twa shiiva oshili, itapa kala vali eyambo molwomatimba,
ndelenee eteelelo letokolo alike la tilifa, nehandu lomundilo wokulungwinifa ovanandubo.
Ou ta ekeleshi omhango yaMoses oye e nokufya pehe nonghenda nande, ngeenge ope na eendobwedi mbali ile nhatu;
hano otamu ti ngahelipi ehandu olo tali kala li fike peni kwaau ta lyata nomhadi Omona waKalunga nota dini ohonde yehangano, omo a yapulilwa mo ndele ta sheke Omhepo yefilonghenda?
Osheshi otu mu shii ou a tonga: “Ehandu olange, Aame handi futu,” Omwene osho ta ti; navali: “Omwene ota ka tokola oshiwana shaye.”
Oixuna yongaho okuwila momake aKalunga omunamwenyo.
Ndelenee dimbulukweni omafiku enya onale, eshi mwa li mwa minikilwa, omwe lididimikila momahepeko madjuu,
kombinga imwe eshi mwa li mwa shekwa nomwa hepekwa moipafi yovanhu, nokombinga ikwao mwa ninga ovakwao vaavenya va kala momayehameko ngaashi nye.
Osheshi omwa li mwa yehamekwa pamwe neenghwate, nokunyekwa kwoinima yeni mwe ku humbata nehafo nokushiiva nokutya, onye omu na emona liwa meulu li dule eli.
Hano elineekelo leni inamu li ekelashi, osheshi olo li nondjabi inene.
Osheshi otamu pumbwa elididimiko, opo mu wanife ehalo laKalunga, nokupewa eshi mwe shi udanekelwa.

“Osheshi ope nokafimbo,
okafimbo kaxupi kongaho, ou e nokuuya ote uya nee, ye ita kala ko,

ndele omuyuki wange ota ka kala e nomwenyo okeitavelo,
ndele ngeenge ta shuna monima,
omwenyo wange itau mu hokwa.”
Ndelenee fye katu shi ovashunimonima voku ka kana, ndelenee ofye hatu itavele, eemwenyo detu di xupifwe.
11: Eitavelo olo elineekelo la pama okulineekela osho tashi teelelwa nokuliyukifa painima ihe wetike.
Osheshi omulo ovakulunhu vonale va pewa ehepaululo liwa.
Meitavelo otu udite ko nokutya, ounyuni owa tungifwa ondjovo yaKalunga, noinima ei i wetike inai dja moinima ihe wetike.

Meitavelo Abel okwa yambela Kalunga eyambo liwa li dule eli laKain, nomolwalo a pewa ehepaululo nokutya, oye omuyuki, Kalunga eshi a hepaulula omayambo aye; nomeitavelo tuu olo ota popi natango nande a fya.
Meitavelo Henok okwa kufwa po aha mone efyo, ye ina monika, osheshi Kalunga e mu kufa po. Osheshi fimbo ina kufwa po, okwa pewa ehepaululo nokutya, Kalunga e mu hokwa.
Kape na ou ta dulu okuwapalela Kalunga, ngeenge kape neitavelo, osheshi ou ta ehene kuKalunga e nokwiitavela nokutya, oko e li, naava tave mu kongo, ote va pe ondjabi.

Meitavelo Noa, eshi a shiivifilwa inya inai monika natango, metilo liyapuki okwa tunga ongulu yomomeva, a xupife eumbo laye, nomeitavelo okwa tokola ounyuni nokwa ninga omufyuululi wouyuki tau di meitavelo.
Meitavelo Abraham eshi a ifanwa a tembukile kedu olo te ke li pewa li ninge efyuululo laye, okwa dulika, nokwa dja mo ina shiiva apa ta i.
Meitavelo okwa kala omunailongo medu leudaneko la fa lihe fi laye, nokwa li ha kala momatwali pamwe naIsak naJakob, ovafyuululi veudaneko pamwe naye,
osheshi okwa li ha teelele oshilando shinya shi nomakanghameno a pama, nomutoti nomutungi washo oKalunga.
Meitavelo naSara yo okwa li a pewa eenghono okutunga epata; nonande a hangika a kulupa, okwa dala molwaashi oye a tala omuudaneki e shi okulineekelwa.
Onghee hano omuumwe, ou omukulupe, mo omwa tutuma vahapu va feenyofi dokeulu nova fehekedu lopomunghulo wefuta lihe shii okuvalulwa.

Meitavelo aveshe ava va fila mo, vo inava mona eshi sha udanekwa, ndelenee ove shi tala ashike kokule nokwiitavela, nove shi kunda, nove lihepaulula nokutya, ovo ovanailongo novaenda kombada yedu eli.
Osheshi ava hava ti ngaha, otave liholola, ovo tava kongo oshilongo shovambulavo.
Ngeno ova popya shinya va dile mo, ngeno ove nomhito okushuna mo,
ndelenee paife otava djuulukwa oshilongo shiwa shi dule shinya, oshomeulu. Onghee hano Kalunga ite va fi ohoni a ifanwe Kalunga kavo, osheshi okwe va longekidila oshilando.
Meitavelo Abraham okwa yandja Isak eyambo eshi a yelekwa kuKalunga. Abraham tuu ou a pewa omaudaneko kuKalunga; nande ongaho okwa yandja ewifa laye Isak eyambo.
Kalunga okwe mu lombwela: “OmuIsak oludalo loye tali ka dja.”
Osheshi Abraham a diladila kutya Kalunga ota dulu okunyumuna Isak koufi; onghee okwe mu peululwa a fa a dja mefyo.
Meitavelo Isak okwa nangeka Jakob naEsau noupuna omokutala inya yokomesho.
Meitavelo Jakob, eshi a li pokufya a nangeka noupuna ovana vaJosef aveshe vavali, ndele ta indile mokulinyongamena komutwe wonhaili yaye.
Meitavelo Josef, eshi a li pokufya okwa tonga etembu lovana vaIsrael, nokwe va lombwela omakipa aye nhumbi tave a ningi.
Meitavelo ovakulunhu vaMoses ova li ve mu holeka eehani nhatu, eshi a dalwa, osheshi va mona okaana kawa, vo inava tila oshipango shohamba.
Meitavelo Moses, eshi a kula, okwa anya a ifanwe omona wokakadona kaFarao,
okwe lihoololela, a hepekwe pamwe noshiwana shaKalunga nokwa dina ouwa wokafimbo womoulunde,
nokushekwa kwaKristus okwe ku tala oko oupuna u dule omamona omuEgipiti, osheshi e a pilamena a taalela kondjabi.
Meitavelo okwa fiya po Egipiti ehe noutile wehandu lohamba, okwe likolelela, osheshi a kala a fa e wete ou ehe wetike.
Meitavelo okwa dika po Opaasa neshamino lohonde, omudipai woiveli opo aha kume kuvo.
Meitavelo va tokola Efuta Litilyana va fa va enda poukukutu, fimbo Ovaegipiti eshi ve shi hetekela, va fila mo.
Meitavelo ohote yaJeriko oya teka po, eshi ya dingililwa omafiku aheyali.
Meitavelo ombwada Rahab ina hanaunwa po pamwe novanandubo eshi a idilila eendadi nombili.
Ndele ohandi ti shike vali? Osheshi efimbo otali ka pwila nge po, ngeenge handi hepaulula Gideon, Barak, Simson, Jefta, David naSamuel novaxunganeki,
ava va teya po oilongo okeitavelo, nova diinina ouyuki, va mona omaudaneko a wanifwa, nova fitika po omakanya eenghoshi,
va dima po eenghono domundilo, va ya onhapo eememo domaongamukonda, va ninga ovanaenghono moungone wavo, novaladi molwoodi, va taataa po eengudu dovakwaita dovanailongo.
Nokwa li ku novakainhu va alulilwa oonakufya vavo va nyumunwa. Vakwao ova hepekwa nokuhepekelelwa, vo inava hala okumangululwa, opo va mone enyumuko liwa unene.
Vamwe vali va dengwa nova shekwa, ndele va mangwa nomalyenge nova idililwa modolongo,
va dipawa nomamanya, va shaaxwa nokutetwa, va hepekwa nai, va dipawa nomaongamukonda. Va tembauka nova djala oikafa yeedi noyoikombo; va fya oluhepo, va fininikwa nova monifwa oixuna,
ovo tuu ava ounyuni inau wana va kale muwo, va endaenda neefuka neemhunda nomomakololo nomomakwena edu.
Nonande aveshe ava va pewa ehepaululo okeitavelo, inava mona ewanifo leudaneko,
osheshi Kalunga e tu nunina ouwa u dule winya, venya vaha fike kewaneneno vehe li nafye.
12: Onghee hano, eshi tu noshilemo shi fike apa sheendobwedi she tu dingilila, nafye yo tu liduleni keshe eshi tashi tu findile poshi, noulunde uhe kwete oku tu dingatela, fye tu lotoke nokudiinina mefiyafan o li li komesho yetu,

omesho a taalela Jesus, omuhoveli nomuwanifi weitavelo, ou kwa li a hepekelwa momushiyakano omolwehafo e li tulikilwa, nokwa li ehe na ko nasha nomasheko, Oye a kala omutumba kolulyo lolukalwapangelo laKalunga.
Dimbulukweni ou e lididimikila ondubo i fike apa yovalunde, muha loloke neemwenyo deni diha fye ounye.
Natango inamu lwa fiyo ohonde mokukondja kweni noulunde.

osheshi ou e holike kOmwene, ota handukilwa kuye
ndele ta denge noshokoto omona keshe te mu tambula.”
Lididimikileni ehandutekulo, Kalunga ta kala nanye ongaashi e li novana, osheshi okaana olyelye ihaka dengwa kuxe?
Ndelenee ngeenge tamu kala muhe nomadengo, ngaashi aveshe hava dengwa, opo nye kamu fi ovana vomohombo, ndelenee ovana vomoluhaelo.
Ndele ngaashi vali twa kala nootate vetu vopalutu, eshi ve tu denga ndele twa dulika kuvo, hano ohatu kala ngahelipi tuha dulike ngeno kuxe yeemhepo neduliko li dule linya, fye tu kale tu nomwenyo?
Osheshi venya ove tu tekula nomadengo paendunge davo vene, tu tekulilwe okafimbo kaxupi, ndelenee ou te tu tekulile nomadengo osho tashi tu wapalele, opo tu pewe oshipewa shomouyapuki waye.
Heeno, edengo keshe pefimbo lalo katu li wete olo ehafo, ndelenee olo oluhodi, ndele komesho otali imikile ava va tekulwa kulo oshiimati shombili oshomouyuki.
Pamekeni hano omaoko a wa neengolo da loloka.
Ndele yukifeni omalila eemhadi deni, opo omhadi yoshingudu iha fonghoke, ndelenee i veluke.
Lalakaneneni ombili naaveshe neyapulo, osheshi ou ehe li kwete ita ka mona Omwene.
Litaleni, paha kale nande umwe te likufa mefilonghenda laKalunga, paha tutume nande omudi woululu mokati keni ndele tau eta edundakano ndele vahapu tava nyatekwa kuwo.
Ndelenee opo paha kale nande umwe omuhaeli ile omukenouyuki ngaashi Esau, ou a landifa po oushiveli waye okulya kumwe akuke.
Osheshi omu shi shii, komesho eshi a hala enangeko noupuna, okwa efiwa, osheshi ina mona vali onhele yokulidilulula, nande okwa li e li konga nomahodi.
Osheshi nye inamu ehena komhunda hai kumwa nomake nokomundilo wa xwama nokomulaulu woshilemo nokomulaulu nokoshikungulu,
nokoshihomo shenghuma nokondaka, novaudi vayo va indila vaha lombwelwe vali sha;
osheshi inava dula okupwilikina oshipango eshi: “Nande oshinamwenyo tashi kumu komhunda ei, shi nokudipawa nomamanya.”
Nemoniko eli ola li oixuna yongaho, la tongifa Moses ta ti: “Ohandi tila unene nohandi kakama.”
Ndelenee nye omwa ehena komhunda yaSion nokoshilando shaKalunga omunamwenyo, okuJerusalem shomeulu nokovaengeli vomayovi omilongo,
nokongudu yoshivilo nokeongalo loiveli ei ya shangelwa meulu nokuKalunga, omutokoli waaveshe nokeemhepo dovayuki va wana va pwa,
nokuJesus, Omupokati wehangano lipe nokohonde yeshamino tai tongo oinima iwa i dule inya yaAbel.

Taleni hano, muha kandule po ou ta popi, osheshi ngeenge venya va kandula po ou a holola ehalo laKalunga kombada yedu, va nyengwa okuya onhapo, unene tuu fye, ngeenge hatu pilamene ou te li holola e li meulu.
Efiku linya ondaka yaye kwa li ya kakamifa edu, ndele paife a udaneka ta ti: “Lumwe ohandi ka kakamifa edu neulu yo.”
Ndelenee odo “lumwe natango” otadi holola nokutya, ei tai kakamifwa shaashi oyo oishitwa otai ka lundululwa, opo ei itai kakamifwa i kale po.
Onghee hano eshi hatu pewa ouhamba itau kakama, tu kaleni nokupandula, nosho ngaha tu longeleni Kalunga noutile uyapuki noumbada, noku mu wapalela.
Osheshi Kalunga ketu Oye omundilo hau lungwinifa.
13: Kaleni mu hole ovamwaxo.
Okuyakula ovaenda inamu ku dimbwa, osheshi moku shi ninga vamwe va nangeka ovaengeli, inave shi shiiva.
Dimbulukweni eenghwate mwa fa mwa mangwa pamwe navo, noonakuhepekwa, osheshi nanye yo omu li molutu.
Ohombo nai fimanekwe kwaaveshe, nomutala wohombo nau kale uhe noshipo; osheshi ovaholi voipala novateihombo Kalunga te va tokola.
Mokukala kweni kaleni muhe nolwisho. Eshi mu shi kwete nashi mu wanene, osheshi Ye okwa tya: “Ame ihandi ku efa noitandi ku fii po nande.”

Onghee hano hatu dulu okutya nelineekelo:
“Omwene Oye omukwafi wange,
ame ihandi tila;
omunhu ota dulu okuninga nge shike?”
Dimbulukweni ovakwatelikomesho veni ava ve mu udifila eendjovo daKalunga; taleni exulilo leengeda davo na shikuleni eitavelo lavo.
Jesus Kristus Oye tuu ou onghela nonena nofiyo alushe.
Inamu twalwatwalwa komalongo e lili naku lili muhe a shii; osheshi onawa omwenyo ngeenge tau pamekwa kefilonghenda, hakeendja inadi kwafa ava va kala mudo.
Fye otu noaltari omo mwa shilikwa okuliwa kwaava hava yakula metwali.
Osheshi ohonde yoinamwenyo ei tai twalwa komupristeli omukulunhu mouyapukielela omolwomatimba, ndelenee omalutu ayo otaa xwikilwa pondje yeenhanda.
Osho yo Jesus opo a yapule oshiwana nohonde yaye mwene, okwa hepekelwa kondje yoshivelo.
Onghee hano tu yeni pondje kuye, twa dja meenhanda, nokuhumbata okushekwa kwaye;
osheshi apa katu na oshilando tashi kalelele, ndelenee ohatu kongo shinya tashi uya.
Hano omolwaye natu eteleni Kalunga alushe omahambeleloyambo nokutya, oshiimati shomilungu edi tadi pandula edina laye.
Inamu dimbwa okulonga ouwa nokutukula mwaayo mu i kwete, osheshi omayambo a tya ngaha Kalunga e a hokwa.
Shikuleni ovakwatelikomesho veni, nye mu dulike kuvo, osheshi ovo hava pashukile eemwenyo deni ngaashi ovo tave ke di pulwa, opo ve shi ninge nehafo, hanokukema, osheshi osho itashi mu wapalele.
Ilikaneni omolwetu, osheshi fye otu shi shii shili, otu nomaliudo mawa, eshi twa hala okweenda nawa omoinima aishe.
Unene ohandi mu kumaida ngaha, ame ndi mu shunifilwe diva.
Ndelenee Kalunga kombili, ou a alula mefyo omufita omukulunhu weedi omolwohonde yehangano laalushe, Omwene wetu Jesus,
Oye ne mu longekidile ouwa keshe, okuwanifa ehalo laye, Oye na longe munye eshi she mu wapalela omolwaJesus Kristus, efimano olaye alushe fiyo alushe. Amen.
Ndele ohandi mu kumaida, ovamwatate, tambuleni ondjovo ei yekumaido, osheshi onde mu shangela ashike paxupi.
Kaleni mu shi shii, omumwatate Timoteus okwa efiwa, nongeenge te uya diva, ohandi uya naye oku mu talela po.
Kundileni po ovakwatelikomesho veni aveshe novayapuki aveshe. Ava vomuItalia otave mu kundile po.
Efilonghenda nali kale nanye amushe! Amen.

1:
Jakob, omupiya waKalunga nowOmwene Jesus Kristus,
Ohandi kundile po omapata omulongo naavali, oo a kala melihano.
Ovamwatate, hafeni shili, ngeenge tamu hangika komahongaulo opahapu,
osheshi omu shi shii kutya, okuyelekwa kweitavelo leni otaku longo elididimiko.
Ndelenee elididimiko nali kale li noshilonga sha wana, opo mu kale mwa wana muhe noshipo nomuhe na eshi mwe shi pumbwa.
Ndele ngeenge umwe womunye okwa hepa ounongo, ne u indile kuKalunga ou e hole okuyandjela aveshe nokuhe nokungongota, opo nee ote u pewa.
Ashike ye na indile meitavelo, ina limbililwa, osheshi ou ta limbililwa, a fa ekufikufi tali twalwatwalwa notali telaanifwa komhepo.
Omunhu a tya ngaha ina diladila kutya, ota pewa sha kOmwene,
omulumenhu womitima mbali nomutengauki meendjila daye adishe.
Ndelenee omumwatate ou munini ne litangele ounenenhu waye,
noshipuna nounininhu washo, osheshi otashi ka xula po ngaashi onhemo yomwiidi.
Osheshi etango otali piti noupyu walo ndelenee tau lembeke omwiidi, nonhemo yao tai yaumuka ko, newapalo lokutalwa kwayo tali xulu po; osho yo noshipuna otashi lembe meendjila dasho.
Omulumenhu omunelao oye ou te lididimikile eshindo, osheshi ngee a ningi omuduli walo, ota ka pewa oshishani shomwenyo, ou Omwene a udanekela ava ve mu hole.
Omunhu ngeenge ta shindwa, ina tya: “Ohandi shindwa kuKalunga,” osheshi Kalunga iha dulu a shindwe kowii, naye mwene iha shindi nande omunhu.
Ndelenee keshe umwe ota hongaulwa kokahalu kaye mwene, oko hake mu shili notake mu heke;
nokahalu ngeenge ka fimbapala, otaka dala oulunde, noulunde eshi wa wanifwa, otau dala efyo.
Ovamwatate ovaholike, inamu puka.
Keshe oshipewa shiwa, nokeshe oshali sha wanenena, ohashi di kombada, okuXe yomauyelele, kwaau puhe nomalundululo ile omapilauko ouyelele nomulaulu.
Oye e tu dala kondjovo yoshili opahalo laye, opo tu kale ovatete voishitwa yaye.
Hano mu shi shii, ovamwatate ovaholike, omunhu keshe na kale ha endelele okupwilikina, ne liteelele mokupopya, ye ne liteelele mokuhanduka;
osheshi ehandu lomulumenhu ihali longo osho sha yuka koshipala shaKalunga.
Onghee hano liduleni eenyata adishe nowii aushe, nye mu tambule nomwenyo wa ngungumana eendjovo da twikwa munye odo di na eenghono okuxupifa eemwenyo deni.
Kaleni hano ovawanifi veendjovo, havapwilikini vongaho nokulifufya nye vene.
Osheshi umwe ngeenge omupwilikini weendjovo ndele hamuwanifi wado, okwa fa omulumenhu ta tale oshipala shaye mokatengelelo;
ye ote litale, ndele ta di po, ndele te lidimbwa diva nhumbi ye a tya.
Ndelenee ou ta tale nokukonakona momhango ei ya wana yemanguluko ndele ta kala mo, ye ehe fi omupwilikini ha dimbwa, ndelenee omuwanifi shili, oye ta kala omunelao mokulonga kwaye.
Ngeenge ope na umwe mokati keni e lishii oye omulongelikalunga ndele ita pangele elaka laye, ndele ota pukifa omutima waye, okulongela Kalunga kwaye okwongaho.
Elongelokalunga la yela nolihe nedilo lasha koshipala shaKalunga naTate oleli: okutalela po eefiye novafiyekadi momaudjuu avo, nokuliamena aha nyatekwe kounyuni.
2: Ovamwatate, eshi mu na eitavelo kOmwene wetu Jesus Kristus, Omwene wefimano, inamu kala nokutala olupe lomunhu.
Osheshi moshiongalele sheni ngeenge tamu uya omulumenhu a djala okalinga koshingoldo noikutu youkengeli, ndele tamu uya yo ohepele e noshikutu shoinyanyu,
ndele tamu tale kwaau a djala oikutu youkengeli ndele tamu ti kuye: “Kala omutumba ponhele ei iwa,” ndele kohepele tamu ti: Ove kala ofika kwi, ile: “Kala omutumba apa poshilyatelo sheemhadi dange,”
ngeenge ongaha, inamu likondjifa munye vene nomwa ninga ovatokoli mu nomadiladilo mai?
Ovamwatate ovaholike, pwilikineni, Kalunga ina hoolola hamba ava va talwa kounyuni ou eehepele, va ninge oipuna meitavelo novafyuululi vouhamba ou wa udanekelwa ovo ve mu hole?
Ndelenee nye omwa dina ohepele. Ava have mu hepifa ndele tave mu twala kovatokoli, haipuna hamba?
Havo tuu ovo hava sheke edina eli liwa mwe li lukilwa?
Ngeenge tamu wanifa omhango onghwahamba pamishangwa nokutya: “Hola omukweni ngaashi u lihole ove mwene, opo nee tamu ningi nawa;”
ndelenee ngeenge otamu tale olupe lomunhu, otamu tula etimba, omhango notai mu tokola onye ovanyoni.
Osheshi ou ta wanifa omhango aishe, ndele ta nyono shimwe, oye oku netimba laaishe.
Osheshi ou a tile: “Ino nyona ohombo,” Oye a tya yo: “Ino dipaa.” Hano ove nande ino nyona ohombo, ndelenee ove to dipaa, owa ninga omutauluki womhango.
Kaleni hano hamu tongo ndele hamu longo ngaashi ovo tava ka tokolwa komhango yemanguluko.
Osheshi etokolo kali nonghenda naau ehe nonghenda, nonghenda otai litange kombada yetokolo.
Ovamwatate, otashi kwafa shike, umwe ngeenge ta ti oku neitavelo, ndelenee ye ehe noilonga? Eitavelo eli otali dulu oku mu xupifa tuu mbela?
Ngeenge pe nomumwatate omulumenhu ile omumwatate omukainhu e li hamunghele, nokwa hepa oipalwifa yakeshe efiku,
ndele umwe womunye ta ti kuvo: “Indeni nombili mu ka xuxumukwe nye mu likutife,” ndele nye inamu va pa osho sha pumbiwa kolutu, otashi kwafa shike?
Osho yo neitavelo, ngeenge kali noilonga ola fya mulo vene.
Ndele kashiimba ope na ou ta ti: “Ove ou neitavelo, naame ondi noilonga.” Ulikile nge eitavelo loye lihe noilonga, opo ame nohandi ku ulikile eitavelo lange noilonga yange.
Ove ho itavele kutya, Kalunga umwe, owa ninga nawa; eendemoni yo ode shi itavela ndele hadi kakama.
Ndelenee munhu ove wongaho, owa hala tuu u shiive kutya, eitavelo lihe noilonga, olongaho?
Abraham, tate yetu, ina yukipalifwa koilonga, eshi a yamba omona waye Isak koaltari?
U wete nee nhumbi eitavelo la longa pamwe noilonga yaye, neitavelo la wanifwa koilonga?
Nomushangwa owa wanifwa, ou tau ti: “Abraham okwa itavela Kalunga, ndele molweitavelo laye Kalunga okwe mu tala omuyuki,” nokwa ifanwa kaume kaKalunga.
Paife omu wete ko kutya, omunhu ota yukipalifwa koilonga yaye, hakeitavelo alike.
Osho sha li yo sha ningwa kombwada Rahab oo a yukipalifwa molwoilonga, eshi a yakulile eendadi ndele te di pitifa mondjila i lili moku va lekela.
Osheshi ngaashi olutu lihe nomhepo, la fya, osho yo neitavelo lihe noilonga, ola fya.
3: Ovamwatate, inamu hala mu ninge vahapu ovalongindjovo, osheshi omu shi shii kutya, fye ohatu ka mona etokolo lidjuu komesho yovakwetu;
osheshi fye atushe ohatu puka luhapu. Ngeenge ope na ou iha puka meendjovo, oye omulumenhu a wanenena, ta dulu yo okupangela olutu laye alishe.
Taleni, ohatu tula oitomo momakanya eenghambe, opo di dulike kufye, ndele hatu endifa olutu lado alishe.
Taleni yo eeskepa, nande odinene ndele hadi endifwa keemhepo didjuu, ohadi yukifwa kokayukifo kaningholi oku omushingi a hala.
Osho yo tuu elaka olo oshinhimbu shinini ndele ohali litangele oinenenima. Taleni nhumbi ohandje hai xwike ofuka inene!
Nelaka olo yo omundilo, ounyuni woulunde; elaka moinhimbu yetu otali liholola olo tuu hali nyateke olutu alishe ndele tali xwameke olweendo lokukala kwetu, nalo vene ola xwamekwa koheli.
Osheshi oushitwe waaishe, woifitukuti noweedila nowoilikoki nongaashi yo woikwameva, ohai deuka noya deulwa nokuli koshitwe yomunhu,
ndelenee elaka kape na ou ta dulu oku li deula; olo owii uhe na nande etulumuko, li yadi oudiyo tau dipaa.
Nelaka ohatu hambelele Omwene Tate, ndele hatu tuku nalo ovanhu va shitwa oshifefa shaKalunga;
Mokanya tuu aka kamwe otamu piti enangeko noupuna nefingo. Ovamwatate, itashi dulika shi kale ngaha.
Ofifiya ohai fulukifa tuu modjo imwe aike omeva manyenye naa malula?
Ovamwatate, ndishi omukwiyu itau dulu okwiima eemono, ile omuviinyu ngeno eenghwiyu? Osho yo omufima ulula itau dulu okudidila omeva manyenye.
Olyelye omunongo nomunandunge mokati keni? Oye na holole oilonga yaye monghalelo yaye iwa mengungumano lounongo.
Ndelenee momutima weni ngeenge omu nefupa lilula neenhamanana, inamu litanga, ndele inamu fufya nokukondjifa oshili.
Ounongo wa tya ngaha hayou hau di kombada, ndelenee owopaunyuni nowopanhu nowopandemoni.
Osheshi apa pe nefupa neenhamanana, opo pe na yo edongakano noilonga aishe yowii.
Ndelenee ounongo ou hau di kombada, tete owa yela nopo nee u nombili nou nolukeno nowiitaveleli nou yadi onghenda noiimati iwa; kau nomalimbililo ile oihelele.
Noiimati youyuki ohai kunwa mombili kwaava hava ningi ombili.
4: Omalwoodi nomashilafano mokati keni otaa di peni? Hamouhalu weni ou hau kondjo moinhimbu yeni?
Nye ohamu haluka, ndelenee kamu na sha, hamu dipaa nomu nefupa, ndele ihamu dulu okumona sha; ohamu shilafana ndele tamu lu, ndelenee kamu na eshi mu kwete, osheshi nye ihamu indile.
Nande hamu indile, ihamu mono sha, shaashi ohamu indile nai, mu i longife mouhalu weni.
Ovanyoni vohombo nye, kamu shi shii hamba nokutya, oukaume wounyuni ou owo okutonda Kalunga? Hano ou a hala okukala kaume kounyuni, ota ningi omutondi waKalunga.
Ile omu shii omushangwa otau popi dongaho: “Omhepo ei i li mufye okwe i twila olwisho noku i kodilila?”
Ndelenee ye ota yandje efilonghenda linene unene. Onghee tapa tiwa: “Kalunga oku tonde ovalinenepeki, ndelenee ovalininipiki te va file onghenda.”
Dulikeni hano kuKalunga, kondjifeni Satana, ndele ye te mu i onhapo.
Eheneni kuKalunga, opo nee Ye ta ehene kunye. Yelifeni omake eni, nye ovalunde, yelifeni omitima deni, nye ovanamitimambali.
Shiiveni oluhepo leni, nyikeni oluhodi nokulila; okuyola kweni naku shituke oluhodi, nehafo leni nali shituke oufiye.
Lininipikeni koshipala shOmwene, ndele Ye ote mu nenepeke.

Ovamwatate, inamu ambafana. Ou ta ambe mukwao ile ta tokola mukwao, ota ambe omhango ndele ta tokola omhango; ndelenee ngeenge to tokola omhango, opo nee ove ku fi omuwanifi womhango, ndelenee omutokoli wayo.
Omuyandjimhango nomutokoli umwe aeke, Oye ou e neenghono okuxupifa nokukanifa; ndelenee ove, oove lyelye eshi to tokola mukweni?
Pwilikineni nye ava hamu ti: “Nena ile mongula otwa hala tu ye koshilando shonhumba noshongadi, tu kale ko omudo umwe, tu shingife fye tu likole,”
nye ava muhe nowino waashi tashi ningwa komongula; osheshi okukala kweni okwa tya ngahelipi? Oko omwifi, ou hau monika okafimbo kanini ndele tau lihane po.
Ponhele yasho ngeno ohamu ti: “Omwene ngeenge e shi hala ndele tu nomwenyo, ohatu ka ninga eshi ile shinya.”
Ndelenee paife nye ohamu litangele nokulinenepeka. Elitangelo alishe la tya ngaha olii.
Hano, ou e shii okulonga ouwa, ndele ye ite shi ningi, oye e netimba.
5: Paife hano oipuna nye, pwilikineni, lileni nokuli lilila omaluhepo oo tae uya kombada yeni.
Eliko leni la tukwa, noikutu yeni oya lika keenhwishi,
oshingoldo noshisiliveli sheni osha ninga oilemo, noilemo yayo otai ningi ondobwedi yoku mu pa oushima ndele tai li ombelela yeni ngaashi omundilo. Omwe lindubalekela omaliko momafiku axuuninwa.
Taleni, ondjabi yovalongi vomapya eni ovo hava teya oilya yeni, oyo mwe i va lumbula, otai kuu onghuwo, nenyeme lovatei ola fika momatwi Omwene weengudu dovakwaita.
Mwa kala mounyenye weni kombada yedu nomwa wanifa omauhalu eni; omitima deni omwe di ondolela efiku lokutomwa.
Omwa tokola nomwa dipaa omuyuki, ye ine mu kondjifa.
Onghee hano ovamwatate nye, kaleni nokulididimika fiyo Omwene ota aluka. Taleni, omunepya oha teelele oiimati iwa yedu ndele he li lididimikile fiyo ta pewa odula yonhemuna noyokomusheko.
Nanye yo teeleleni nokulididimika, pamekeni omitima deni, osheshi ealuko lOmwene oli li popepi.
Ovamwatate, inamu ngongotelafana, muha tokolwe; taleni, omutokoli oku li ofika ponhu.
Ovamwatate, hopaeleleni ovaxunganeki ovo va popya medina lOmwene mokuhumbata oudjuu nomokulididimika.
Taleni, ovo ve lididimika, ohatu va tale ovanelao. Elididimiko laJob olo mwe li uda, nomwa mona exulilo e li pewa kOmwene, osheshi Omwene Oye omunalukeno nomunamutimanghenda.
Ndelenee komesho yaaishe, ovamwatate, inamu ana, nge keulu ile kedu, nosho yo eano keshe; “heeno” yeni nai kale “heeno,” na “ahowe” yeni nai kale “ahowe,” opo muha wile metokolo.
Mokati keni ngeenge ope na ou e noudjuu, na ilikane, naau e nehafo, na imbe epandulo.
Ope na tuu umwe mokati keni ta vele? Oye na ifane ovakulunhu veongalo, ndele vo nave mu ilikanene ndele nave mu vaeke omaadi medina lOmwene.
Neilikano leitavelo otali xupifa omunaudu, Omwene note mu yambukifa po, ndele ngeenge okwa hangika a tula etimba, otae mu kufilwa po.
Hepaululilafaneni omatimba eni, nye mu ilikanenafane, opo mu velulwe; eilikano lashili lomuyuki otali dulu shihapu.
Elia okwa li ngaha omunhu ngaashi fye, ndele ye okwa ilikana, odula iha loke, ndele yo inai loka ko kombada yedu omido itatu neehani 6.
